Joseph vang chu Egypt gama ana umsa ahitai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Joseph le asopite chule chuche khanga miho jouse chu athigam taovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chujouvin Israel chate chu achipha lheh jengun, apungtul tullun, atamlheh jeng taovin, chule hattah ahitaovin; gamsung chu alosoh taovin ahi.","ref":"Sol 7:17"},"8":{"text":"Tun Egypt gama chun Joseph hephalou lengthah khat ahung lengchang tan ahi.","ref":"Sol 7:18."},"9":{"text":"Chuin aman amite jah-a, Veuvin, Israel chate mipi hi eiho sangin atamjouvin, chule ahatjouvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hungun, eihon amaho hi chingthei tah-in bolu hite: achuti louleh amaho pungcheh cheh-untin, hung hitiding ahi, gal kisatna khattou ahung umteng, amaho imelmateu lama hung pangun tin, eiho eisat untin, hitichun gamsunga konin potdoh getnunte, ati.","ref":"Sol 7:19"},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun amahon apohgih houva amaho gimbol dingin achunguva tohvai homho apansah taove. Chule amahon Pharaoh dingin gou kholna khopiho Pithom le Rameses asauvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahivangin amahon amaho chu abolgim chanun apung cheh-un, akhangcheh cheh-un ahi. Chuin amahon Israel chate jehchun alunggim taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule Egypt miten Israel chate chu gimtah-in ana-u atohsah-un ahi."},"14":{"text":"Amahon natoh hahsatah ho bon nganin, cheh-in, chule loujaova natoh jat tintangin ahinkhou chu asugenthei lheh jengun: ana-u atohsahna jouseuva genthei tah-in atohsah-un ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule Egypt lengpan Hebrew mi naososah teni, khatnu min Shiphrah le khatnu min Pu-ah chu akihoupin;"},"16":{"text":"Ajah lhona, Nangnin Hebrew numei ho nao nasosah lhonteng, naososahna touna chunga chun amaho chu velhonin; iti hama hichu pasal ahile natha lhonding ahi: ahin numei ahivangle hinghoi lhonin, ati."},"17":{"text":"Ahivangin naososah teni chun Pathen aging lhonin, Egypt Lengpa thupeh bangchun abol lhonpon, ahin naosen pasal ho chu ahinghoiji lhonin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuphatnin Egypt lengpan naososah teni chu akouvin, ajah lhona, Ipi dinga hicheho hi nabol lhona, naosen pasal ho chu nahing hoi lhon ham? ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin nao sosah teni chun Pharaoh jah-a, Hebrew numei hohi Egypt numei ho tobang ahilou jeh-u ahi; ajehchu amaho adamtheijun, nao sosah ho ahengu alhun masangle anasoh lhaji taovin ahi, atilhone."},"20":{"text":"Chutichun Pathen'in nao sosah teni chung chun aphalam tah-in na atongin ahi: chuin miho chu apung tul tul jengun, nasatah-in ahatdoh taovin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, nao sosah teni chun Pathen aginjeh lhonin, a-insungmi lhonding apen ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh'in amite chu athupeh-in, Pasal chapang pengtapou chu vadunga seplutnun, numei chapang tapou chu hing hoijun, atitai.","ref":"Sol 8:19"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Levi phunga peng pasal khat achen Levi chanu khat ji dingin akipuitan ahi.","title":"Mosi Pen"},"2":{"text":"Chuin amanu chun nao avopmin, chapa khat ahingtai. Amanun ama chu naosen hoitah ahichu amu phatnin, lhathum aselin ahi.","ref":"Sol 7:20; Heb 11:23"},"3":{"text":"Amanun ama chu aselbe joulou phatnin, pumpenga kisa sinkhup khat alan, thingnai man le vahaibonin aloibitnin, asunga chun naosen chu akhumin; vadung kama peng lah-a chun agakoitai."},"4":{"text":"Chule achunga ipi ahung sohdem ti ve dingin asopinu chu gamlatah-a adingin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh chanu chu kisil dingin vadunga chun ahung suh-in; chule asoh numei ho chu lui panga chun avah leovin ahi: chuin amanun peng lah-a sinkhup chu amuphatnin, hichu galadin asohnu chu asolin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin amanun hichu ahon phatnin naosen chu amutai: chule, veuvin, naosen chu ahung kapmin ahi. Chuin amanun amapa chu alung asen, Hichehi Hebrew chate lah-a khat ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chujouvin a-unu chun Pharaoh chanu jah-a chun, Keima kache-a hiche naosen hi nadonpeh dinga Hebrew naodon numei kaga koupeh ding ham? ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh chanun amanu jah-a, Chen, ati. Chuin nungahnu chu achen, naosen nuchu agakoupeh tan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh chanu chun amanu henga, Hiche naocha hi kipuijin lang keima dingin neihin vah peh-in, chule keiman natohman kapeh ding nahi ati. Chuin numei chun chapang chu akipuijin, avahtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin chapang chu ahung khandoh phatnin, naodonnu chun Pharaoh chanu henga ahinpuijin, ama amanu chapa ahitan; chule amanun amin Mosi asah tai: Ajehchu keiman twilah-a kona kalahdoh ahi, ati.","ref":"Sol 7:21"},"11":{"text":"Chuin hiche laichun ahitin ahi, Mosi akikhanlhit phatnin, asopite henga agachen, apohgih-u chu agaven ahile, Egypt mikhatnin asopi Hebrew mi khat aden chu amulhi tan ahi.","title":"Mosi Midian Gama Ajam","ref":"Sol 7:23-27."},"12":{"text":"Chuin aman akimvel dung avelen, koimacha amulou phatnin Egypt mipa chu athatnin, neldi lah-a aselin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule ani ni channia apotdohkit phatnin, veuvin, Hebrew mi ni akidel lhonin: aman athemo jopa henga, Ipidinga nasopi naden ham? ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin amapan, Keiho chunga pipui le thutan dinga kon natunham? Egypt mipa natha banga chu keijong thading neigot ham? ati. Chuin Mosi akichatan, Tahbeh-a hiche thilhi kihedoh-a ahitai, ati."},"15":{"text":"Tun Pharaoh'in hichehi ajah phatnin, Mosi chu thadingin aholtan ahi. Ahin Mosi Pharaoh maikoh-a konin ajam mangin, Midian gama achengin: chule ama twikul panga atouvin ahi.","ref":"Sol 7:29; Heb 11:27"},"16":{"text":"Tun Midian thempupa chun chanu sagi aneijin ahi. Chuin maho chu twi thalin ahungun, apa kelngoihon chip dingin kongho chu athal dimun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin kelngoi chingho chu ahungun amaho chu anodoh-un ahi: ahivangin Mosi adingdoh-in amaho chu akithopin, akelngoi honu chu twi achipsah-in ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amaho apau Reuel henga ahung phatnun, aman ahenguva, Iti dana tunia nahiti hungvah uham? ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin amahon, Egypt mikhatnin kelngoi chingho khutna konin eihuhdoh-un, chule keiho dingin lhingsetnin twi jong eithal peh-un, kelngoihon jong twi achipsah-in ahi, atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chuin aman achanute jah-a, Ama chu hoija umtam? ipidinga mipa chu nahin dalhah-u ham? an nedingin gakouvun, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Mosi chuche pa toh chending chu anomtan: chule aman achanu Zipporah chu Mosi apetan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin amanun chapa khat ahinpeh-in, amin Gershom asahtai: ajehchu aman, Keima mi gama khopema kahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin phat chomkhat jouvin ahitin ahi, Egypt lengpa chu athitan ahi. Chuin Israel chate chu asohchan jeh-un akhoisauvin, akapmun, chule asohchan jeh uva akanao chu Pathen kom alhungtan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Pathen'in akhoisat nao chu ajahpeh tan, Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob toh akitepna chu ageldoh tan ahi.","ref":"Semt 15:13-14"},"25":{"text":"Chuin Pathen'in Israel chate chu ahinven, amaho chu akhohsah tan ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Mosi'n Midian thempu anupa pa Jethro kelngoihon achingin ahi. Chuin kelngoihon chu neldi gam nunglam panga chun apuijin, Pathen molsang Horeb ahunglhung tan ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Mosi Akou"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pakai Vantil chu hamboh lah-a konin meikongin ahung kilah-in ahi. Chuin aman aven ahile, veuvin, hamboh chu meikongin akouvin, ahinla hamboh chu akavampon ahi.","ref":"Sol 7:30-34"},"3":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Tun keima kiheijing ting, i-atile hamboh khu kalouham, hiche melchihna nasatah hi gavenge, atin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin avedinga akihei chu Pakaiyin amu phatnin, hamboh lah-a konchun Pathen'in ahin kouvin, Mosi, Mosi, ati. Chuin aman, Hikoma kaume, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin aman, Hilam hin nai hih-in: nakenga konin nakeng chot sutlhan, ajehchu nadinna chu muntheng ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chukalvallin aman, Keima napu napate Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Jacob Pathen kahi, ati. Chuin Mosi'n amai aseltai: ajehchu aman Pathen avet ngamlou ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin, Keiman Egypt gama kamite kisuh genthei kichen tah-in kamutan, chule tohvai homho jala akanao kajatai; ajehchu keiman agenthei nao kahetai."},"8":{"text":"Chule Egypt miho khutna kona huhdoh dingle amaho chuche gama kona chu puidoh-a, gamphatah le gamlentah khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam, Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite, chule Jebus mite gama puitou dinga hung kumlha kahi."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun, ven, Israel chate kana chu kakom ahung lhung tai: chule Egypt miten amaho abolgenthei nao jong kamudoh tai."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun hungin, kami Israel chate Egypt gama kona napuidoh theina dingin Pharaoh henga nasol ing kate, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pathen henga, Keima koi kahia, Pharaoh henga kache-a, Egypt gama kona Israel chate chu kagapui doh ding ham? ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin aman, Tahbeh-a keiman nangma kaumpi ding nahi; chule hichehi keiman kasol nahi amelchihna hiding ahi: nangman miho chu Egypt ma kona nahin puidoh teng, hiche molsanga hi Pathen najen dingu ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pathen henga, Vetan, keima Israel chate heng kagalhuna, amaho jah-a, Napu napateu Pathen'in naheng uva eihinsol ahi, kati tengle; amahon, Amin ipiham? tia ahinsei tei dingu ahin, ahenguva ipi kasei ding ham? ati.","ref":"Pot 6:2-3."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Pathen'in Mosi henga, KEIMA CHU KEIMA KAHI: chule Israel chate jah-a chu KEIMA kitipan nangho henga eihinsol ahi tia nasei ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Tph 1:4,8"},"15":{"text":"Chukal valin Pathen'in Mosi jah-a, Israel chate henga chun, Napu napateu Pakai Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathen'in naheng uva eihinsol ahi: hichehi tonsotna kamin, chule nakhang khanguva neihet jingna dingu ahi tin seipeh-in."},"16":{"text":"Chen, Israel upaho chu gakhom khomin lang, ahenguva, Napu napateu Pakai Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathen chu kahenga ahung kilah-in, kajah-a, Keiman nangho tahbeh-in kahung vilun, chule Egypt gama nachung uva kibol chu kamutan:"},"17":{"text":"Chuin keiman, Nangho Egypt suhgentheina-a kona kapuidoh uva, Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite, chule Jebus mite gam, bongnoi le khoiju lonna gama chu kapuilut dingu nahiuve, tin kaseije, gatin."},"18":{"text":"Chutengle amahon nathusei angai dingu ahi. Chutengle nangma le Israel upa ho Egypt lengpa koma nahung diu, ajah-a, Hebrew mite Pakai Pathen'in keiho eikimu piuvin ahi: tun Pakai ka Pathen'u henga ganlhaina kaganei nadingun, gamthipma nithum lampi neiche sah-un tia nahenga kataovu ahi, tia nasei dingu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ahin Egypt lengpa chun khut thahat tah tilouva nasoldoh louheldiu ahi ti kichen tah-in kahei."},"20":{"text":"Chule keiman kakhut kahin lhandoh ding, alah uva kabolding thil kidanga chu Egypt kajepding: chujouteng aman nangho nasoldoh dingu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule keiman Egypt mite mitmu-a hiche mitehi khotona kapeh ding, chule hung hiti ding ahi, nangho nache tengule agoh-a nache lou dingu ahi.","ref":"Pot 12:35-36."},"22":{"text":"Ahin numei takipmin a-inheng le a-in'a pemho henga dangka le sana-a kijepna ho, ponsil nihchen ho apa-a alah dingu: hicheho chu nachapa teo le nachanu teo najepnadiu; hitia chu nanghon Egypt mite chu nachom dingu ahi, ati."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n adonbutnin ajah-a, Hijongle ven, amahon eitahsan lou dingu, kathujong angailou dingu ahi: ajehchu amahon, Nahenga Pakai akilahpoi ati dingu ahi, ati.","title":"Pathen'in Mosi Thilkidang Boltheina Thahat Apeh"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin ahenga, Nakhutna umchu ipiham? ati. Chuin aman, Tenggol ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin aman, Tolla seplhan ati. Chuin aman hichu tolla aseplhan ahile gul asohtan; chuin Mosi chuche masanga konchun ajamtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Nakhut lhangin lang hichu ameijin manin; (Chuin aman akhut alhangin, amanin ahile, akhutna tenggol asoh kit tai:)"},"5":{"text":"Amahon apu apateu Pakai Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathen chu nahenga ahung kilahnai ti atahsan theina dingun, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin ahenga asei kitnin, Tun nakhut chu na-opma koijin, atin ahi. Chuin aman akhut a-opma akoitan ahi: chuin hichu alahdoh phatnin, veuvin, akhutchu aphah-in buhbang bangin abangtan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hichun aman, Nakhut chu na-opma koikitnin, ati. Aman akhut chu a-opma akoikitnin ahile, a-opma akhut chu atidang bang bang ahi kit tai."},"8":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, amahon nangma natahsan lou uva, chule melchihna masajong chu angai louvule, amahon melchihna nunung joh chu atahsan dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, Amahon hiche melchihna ni teni jonghi atahsan lou uva, chule na thusei jong angai lou uva ahileh, nangman vadung twi nalah-a, tolgo chunga nasunlhah ding ahi. Chule nangman vadunga kona nalahdoh twi chu tolgo chunga chu thisan hungsoh ding ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakai henga, Vo ka Pakai, keima tumasangin jong, chule nangman nasoh henga thu nahinseija patnin jong mi kamnal kahipoi: ahin keima thusei ngongkai le lei kipehlou kahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin ama henga, Mihem kam sema koiham? Ahiloule paomo le na-ngong, chule kho muthei le mitcho sema chu koiham? Pakai keima kahi hilouham?"},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun chen, keiman nakam kaumpi jinga, nasei ding kahil ding ahi ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin aman, Vo ka Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, nangman nasolnom dang khat solmaijin ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Pakai lunghanna chu Mosi chunga akoujahtan, ahenga, Levi mi nasopipa Aaron uma hilouham? aman thu phatah-in aseitheije ti kahei. Chujongle ven, ama nangma kimupi din ahungdoh-e: aman nangma namuteng alungsung kipahding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule nangman ama henga thu nasei ding, akamsunga thuho nakoipeh ding ahi: chule keiman nangma kam le ama kam kaumpi ding, chule nabol lhonding kahil ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule amachu nangma dinga mipi ho henga thuseija pangding: ama chu nangma dinga nakam khela panga, chule nangma ama dinga Pathen khela napan ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule nangman hiche tenggol hi nakhutna nakichoi ding, hichea hi melchihna ho nabolding ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Mosi anupa pa Jethro henga ahung kilen, ajah-a, Nahenga katao ahi, Egypt gama kasopite henga kinungle kit dingin neisolin, hingnalai naovem gavenge, ati. Chuin Jethro'n Mosi jah-a, Lung mongin chetan, ati.","title":"Mosi Egypt Gama Ahung Kile"},"19":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Midian gama Mosi henga, Chen, Egypt gama kilekit tan, ajehchu nangma thadinga nahol ho jouse chu athigam taove, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n a-inneipi le achapate chu apuijin, sangan chunga atousah-in, Egypt gama akiletan ahi. Chule Mosi'n Pathen tenggol chu akhutna akichoijin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Ven, Egypt gama nakile teng nakhutna kakoi thil kidang ho jouse chu Pharaoh angsunga nabol ding ahi: hijongle aman miho chu asoldoh louna dinga Pharaoh lung chu katahsah ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule nangman Pharaoh jah-a, Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, Israel chu kachapa, apeng masapen ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule keiman najah-a kasei ahi, Aman keima eijen theina dingin kachapa chu soldoh tan: chule nangman ama soldoh ding nanop louva ahile, ven, keiman nachapa katha ding, apeng masapentah chu kathading ahi, tia nasei ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Pot 12:29"},"24":{"text":"Chule lampia jinlhun in'a chun ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin ama chu akimupin, thadin aholtan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hichun Zipporah'in meituh songhem khat alan, achapa chep atanpeh-in, hichu akengbula aseplhan, Tahbeh-in nangma hi keima dinga thisanso inneipu nahi, ati."},"26":{"text":"Hitichun amachu alhadoh tan ahi. Chuin amanun, Cheptan jeh-a chu nangma keima dinga thisanso inneipu nahi ahi, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Aaron henga, Gamthipma Mosi kimupi din chen, ati. Chuin ama achen, Pathen molsanga chun ama akimupin, achopmin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Aaron henga chun asolpa Pakai thusei jouse le athupeh melchihna jouse chu aseipehtan ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron achelhonin, Israel upaho jouse akhom khom lhontai."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Aaron'in Pakaiyin Mosi henga asei thu jouse chu aseijin, miho mitmun melchihna ho chu aboltan ahi:"},"31":{"text":"Chuin mipi chun atahsan taove. Chuin Pakaiyin Israel chate avila, athohgimnao ahinvet pehchu ajah phatnun, amaho akunun Pathen ahou taovin ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuche jouchun Mosi le Aaron alut lhonin, Pharaoh henga, Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, gamthipma keima dinga Kut aboltheina diuvin kamite solin ati, tin asei lhonin ahi.","title":"Pharaoh Angsunga Mosi le Aaron"},"2":{"text":"Ahinla Pharaoh'in, Pakai chu koi hija, keiman athu kangaija Israelte kasoldoh ding ham? Keiman Pakai chu kahepon, Israelte jong kasoldoh louding ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Hichun amanin, Hebrew mite Pathen'in eikimupi lhon ahi. Nahenga kataolhon ahi, Pakai ka Pathen'u henga ganlhaina gabol dingin nithum lampia neisolun: achutiloule aman ichunguva gamna hise ahiloule chemjam achuhsah ding ahi, atilhone."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Egypt lengpan amani henga, Nangni Mosi le Aaron'in ipidinga mipi hohi anatoh-u nangahsah lhonham? napohgih hou gakipoh thim thimun, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh'in, Veuvin, hiche gam mihohi tun tamtah ahiuvin, nangnin amaho chu apohgih houva konin nakicholdo sah lhontan ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin chuche nile le chun Pharaoh'in tohvai poho le alamkai ho athupeh-in, ajah uva,"},"7":{"text":"Nanghon masanga banga chu miho chu cheh aden nadingu changpol napehkit lou dingu ahitai: amaho cheohen lang amaho ding cheh pol gakihol khomu hen."},"8":{"text":"Chule tumasanga acheh denjiu jatjat chu nadensah jing dingu: hichea kona chu nalhomsah loudiu ahi: ajehchu amaho thaseuva ahi; hijeh-a, Ka-Pathen'u henga ganlhaina gabol dingin neisolun tia pengu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hahsa tah-a atoh diuvin chuche miho chunga chun natoh hahsacheh koibe peh-un; amahon thumanlou ngaisah daohen, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin mipi tohvai poho le toh lamkai chu achedoh-un, mipi ho henga chun, Pharaoh'in hitihin aseije, Keiman nangho changpol kapehlou dingu ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Nangho cheovin lang namu nathei theijuva pol gakiholun; hijongle nanatoh-u chu kilhomsah deh louding ahi, agatiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chutichun mipi chu changpol khela manding changkung gakhom khom dingin Egypt gam pumpi-a akithecheh taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin tohlamkai ho chun amaho chu anouvin, nanitin natoh houchu changpol aumlai bang chun tong bukimun, atiuve."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh toh lamkaiho chun mipi ho chunga apansah Israel chate lamkaiho chu avouvin, Ipi dinga nacheh dennu natoh chu masanga banga janhi le tunia nabol bulhit lou uham? tin aphohsal taovin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hichun Israel chate lamkaiho chu ahungun Pharaoh henga agakapmun, Ibola nangman nasohte hi neihiti bolu hitam?"},"16":{"text":"Nasohte hi changpol la eikipe pouvin, chule amahon kahenguva, Cheh denguvin eitiuvin ahi. Chule ven, nasohte hi eivouvin, ahivangin athemmo chu namite ahiuve, atiuvin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahivangin aman, Nangho thase nahiuve, nangho thase nahiuve: hijeh-a chu nanghon, Cheohitin Pakai henga ganlhaina gabolu hite natiu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun cheovin lang na gatongun: ajehchu nangho changpol kipelou ding nahiuve, hijongle nacheh dendiu jat chu nabulhit dingu ahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Nanghon niseh-a nanatoh naova na cheh dendiujat chu nalhomsah loudiu ahi tia akiseipeh phatnu chun, Israel chate lamkaihon achunguva thilphalou chua ahitai ti amudoh taovin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin amaho Pharaoh koma kona ahungpot doh-u toh kilhonin, lampia anading Mosi le Aaron chu akimutopi taovin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin amahon amani henga, Pakaiyin nave lhonhen lang nachung thu lhon tanhen; ajehchu nangnin keiho thana dinga akhutnuva chemjam koina dingin Pharaoh mitmu le asohte mitmun thet umtah in neisem taovin ahi, atiuve."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Mosi Pakai henga akinungle kitnin, Pakai, ipi dinga hiche mite chungahi phalou tah-a na natoh ham? Ipi dinga neisol ham?","title":"Mosi Pathen Henga Akiphin"},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu Pharaoh henga namina thusei dinga kahunga pat hin, aman hiche mite chunga thilse abol jingin; chule nangman jong namite nahuhdoh hihhelin ahi, ati."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Keiman Pharaoh chunga ipi kabol ding tu-a hi nangman namu ding ahi. Ajehchu khut thahat hin amaho chu asol ding, chule khut thahat hin amaho chu agamsunga kona adeldoh tho sah ding ahi, ati."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pathen'in Mosi henga thu aseijin, ajah-a hitin aseije, keima Pakai chu kahi.","title":"Pathen'in Mosi Akou","ref":"Semt 7:1; 28:3; 35:11; Pot 3:13-15."},"3":{"text":"Chule keima Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob hengah Pathen hat chungnung minin kana kilah-in; ahinla amahon kamin JEHOVAH hin eina hepouvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule gamdangmi ahinao akholjina gamu Canaan gam chu amaho pehdingin keiman amahotoh kakitepna kaphut doh-in ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Egypt miten sohchanga ahennaova Israel chate akhoisatnao jong chu kajan; chule kakitepna chu kageldoh tan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun Israel chate henga hitin seijin, Keima Pakai kahin, chule Egypt mite pohgih ho noija kona kapui diu, apohgih houva kona kalhadoh uva, chule keiman ban jahdoh le thutanna nasatah puma kahuhdoh ding nahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Chule nangho kamite hidinga kalah uva, chule keima na-Pathen'u kahi ding: chule Egypt mite pohgih ho-a kona napuidoh uva Pakai na-Pathen'u kahichu nahetdingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob henga pehdinga kana kihahselna gamachu kapuilut ding nahiuvin; chule hichu nagoulo diuva kapeh ding nahiuve: keima Pakai chu kahi, tin, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate hengah thu aseijin; ahivangin alhagaovu ahesoh jehle asoh channu akhoh behseh jehchun Mosi thusei chu angaipeh pouvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati."},"11":{"text":"Chenlang Egypt lengpa Pharaoh chun agama kona Israel chate asoldoh nadingin gaseijin, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakai henga, Vetan, Israel chaten bon kathu angailou uva ahile; Pharaoh'in keima kam chepkitanlou thuhi iti angaiding ham? ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga thu aseijin, Egypt gama kona Israel chate puidoh nadingin, Israel chate le Egypt lengpa Pharaoh'a henga seiding thu apen ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hichenghi apu apateo insung aluchangho chu ahiuve; Israel'a kona apeng masapen Reuben chapate chu Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron le Carmi ahiuve. Hichenghi Reuben insung mite ahiuve.","title":"Mosi le Aaron Khanggui"},"15":{"text":"Chule Simeon chapate chu Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin le Zoher, chule Canaan numeinu chapa Shaul ahiuve. Hichenghi Simeon insung mite ahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Chule hicheng hi amaho khanggui dungjuija Levi chapate min chu ahi; Gershon, Kohath, chule Merari ahiuve. Chule Levi damsung kumkho chu kum jakhat le somthum le sagi ahi.","ref":"Minb 3:17-20; 26:57-58; 1 Thusm 6:16-19"},"17":{"text":"Gershon chapate chu, a-insungu dungjuijin Libni le Shimei ahilhone."},"18":{"text":"Chule Kohath chapate chu, Amran, Izhar, Hebron, chule Uzziel ahiuve. Chule Kohath damsung kumkho chu kum jakhat le somthum le thum ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule Merari chapate chu, Mahli le Mushi ahilhone. Hichenghi akhangguiju dungjuija Levi insung mite ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Amram'in apa sopinu chanu Jochebed chu aji dingin akipuijin; amanun Aaron le Mosi ahinpeh-in ahi. Chule Amram damsung kumho chu kum jakhat le somthum le sagi ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule Izhar chapate chu, Korah, Napheg, chule Zichri ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Chule Uzziel chapate chu Mishael, Elzaphan, chule Zithri ahiuve."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Aaron'in Amminadab chanu Nahshon sopinu Elisheba chu aji dingin akipuijin; chule amanun Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, chule Ithamar ahinpeh-in ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule Korah chapate chu, Assir, Elkanah, chule Abiasaph ahiuve. Hichenghi Korah insung mite ahiuve."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Aaron chapa Eleazar chun Putiel chanute lah-a khat aji dingin akipuijin; chule amanun Phinehas ahinpeh-in ahi. Hichenghi a-insungu dungjui cheh-a Levi ho pate bulpiho ahiuve."},"26":{"text":"Hiche teni hi Pakaiyin, Egypt gama konin Israel chate chu galsat miho dungjuijin puidoh lhonin tia asei na Aaron le Mosi chu ahillhone."},"27":{"text":"Hiche teni hi ahi Egypt gama kona Israel chate puidohna dinga Egypt lengpa Pharaoh henga thusei teni chu: Hiche teni hi chuche Mosi le Aaron chu ahilhone."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Egypt gama Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseini chun ahitin ahi,","title":"Pathen'in Mosi Le Aaron Athupeh"},"29":{"text":"Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, Keima Pakai chu kahi: keiman nahenga kasei jouse chu Egypt lengpa Pharaoh henga seijin, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakai angsunga chun, Vetan, keima kam cheptanlou kahin, chule Pharaoh'in iti kasei angaiding ham, ati."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Ven, keiman nangma Pharaoh henga dingin pathen'in kasemtai; chule nasopipa chu nangma themgao hiding ahi."},"2":{"text":"Nangman kathupeh jouse chu aboncha naseidoh ding; chule nasopipa Aaron'in agamma kona Israel chate chu asoldohna dinga Pharaoh henga aseiding ahi"},"3":{"text":"Chule keiman Pharaoh lungchang kasuhtah ding, Egypt gamsunga chu kamelchih naho le kathil kidangho kapunsah ding ahi.","ref":"Sol 7:36"},"4":{"text":"Hijongleh Egypt gamsunga kakhut kalhah nading le, kagalsat miho le kami Israel chate chu thutanna nasatah-a Egypt gamsunga kona kapuidoh nadinga Pharaoh'in nasei angaideh louding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule keiman Egypt chunga kakhut kajah-a, amaho lah-a kona Israel chate kapuidoh teng, keima Pakai kahi chu Egypt miten ahet dingu ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chutichun Mosi le Aaron'in Pakaiyin athupeh bang bangin abol lhonin, chuti chun abol lhon tai."},"7":{"text":"Chule amanin Pharaoh henga thu aseilhon chun Mosi kum somget alhingtan, chule Aaron chu kum somget le kum thum alhingtan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Aaron Tenggol"},"9":{"text":"Pharaoh'in najah lhona, Nangnin thilkidang vetsah lhonin atiteng; nangman Aaron hengah, Natenggol chu lanlang Pharaoh angsunga seplhan, natiding ahi. Chuteng hichu gul hungsoh ding ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron Pharaoh henga alutlhonin, Pakai thupeh bangchun abol lhontan ahi. Chuin Aaron'in atenggol chu Pharaoh masang le asohte masanga aseplhan ahile, hichu gul asohtan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuphatnin Pharaoh'in jong miching ho le doi themho akoukhom tai. Tun Egypt mitpheldoi themho, amaho jong chun adoijuva konin chutobang bang chun aboltheijun ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho amitakipmin atenggol cheh-u chu aseplhaovin ahile hicheho chu gul asohtan ahi: ahivangin Aaron tenggol chun atenggol hou chu avallhum gamtan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh lungsung chu Pakaiyin aseibang chun amani thusei angailouna dingin, Aman atahsah tan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Pharaoh lungsung akisuh tah jeh-a aman miho chu achesah nomlou ahi.","title":"Hise Masapen: Twi Thisan Aso"},"15":{"text":"Nangma jingkah le Pharaoh henga gachen: ven, ama twikhuh lama chun achei; chule nangma amato kimuto dinga vadung panga chu nanading ding; chule gul naso sahna tenggol chu nakhutna nakichoi ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chutengle nangman ama henga, Hebrew mite Pakai Pathen'in nangma henga, Amahon keima gamthipma eijen theina diuvin kamite chesah-in, tia seidinga eihinsol ahi: ahinla ven, tugeihin hichu nangman nangaipoi."},"17":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Hichea konahi Pakai kahi chu neihet ding ahi. Ven, kakhut na tenggola hi vadunga twi chu kajepding ahin, chule hichu thisan sohding ahi.","ref":"Tph 16:4"},"18":{"text":"Chule vadunga um nga hochu thiding, vadung chu uiding ahin; chule Egypt miten vadunga twi chu donding akidah diu ahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Aaron jah-a, Natenggol chu lanlang Egypt twiho chunga, aluidung hou chunga, vadung ho chunga, atuikul hou chunga, chule atuikul hou jouse chunga aboncha thisan asotheina ding le Egypt gam pumpi-a thing kongho le song kongho-a jong thisan aumna dingin nakhut jahdoh-in tin seijin, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thupeh bang chun Mosi le Aaron'in abol lhontan ahi; chuin aman atenggol chu alamin, Pharaoh mitmu le asohte mitmun vadunga um twi chu ajeptan ahi; chuin vadunga um twi jouse chu thisan asohtai."},"21":{"text":"Chuin vadunga um nga ho chu athin; vadung chu a-uitan, Egypt miten vadung twi chu adonthei tapouvin; chule Egypt gamsung pumpi-a chun thisan aumtan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Egypt mitpheldoi themho chun adoi uva konin chutobangma chun abolun ahi. Chule Pharaoh lung chu tahsah-in aumin, Pakaiyin aseibang chun aman amani thusei angai dehpon ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh chu akiheijin a-insunga aluttan, hiche thuhi alungsunga angaito pon ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Egypt miten donding twi holna-in vadung vel chu alaitauvin ahi; ajehchu amahon vadung twi chu adonthei louvu ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin vadung chu avoh-a pat nisagi alhingtan ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Pharaoh henga gachen lang, ajah-a hitin gaseijin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Eijen theina diuvin kamite soldoh tan.","title":"Hise Nina: Uphoh"},"2":{"text":"Chule nangman amaho chu nasol nomlouva ahile, ven, keiman nagamsung pumpi uphoh-a kajep ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule vadung chun uphoh atama tam ahinsepdoh ding, hicheho chu na-in sung, na-indan sung, najalkhun chung, nasohte insung, namite chung, nathuh khuh sung, chule nachang bong mehnao kong houva hunglut ding ahiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chule uphoh ho chu nangma chungle namite chung, chule nasohte jouse chunga hung kaltou diu ahi, tin seijin ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Aaron henga seijin, Vachadung ho chule vadung hole twikul ho chunga natenggol pumin nakhut chu jahdoh inlang uphoh hochu Egypt gam chunga hungdoh sah-in, tin, ati."},"6":{"text":"Hiti chun Aaron'in Egypt twi chunga chun akhut ajahdoh-in ahile uphoh ho chu ahungdoh-un, Egypt gam chu alodim taovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin mitphel doithem ho jong chun adoiju chu mangchan chutobangma chun abolun, Egypt gam chunga chun uphoh hochu ahungdoh sah-un ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hichun Pharaoh'in Mosi le Aaron akouvin, ajah lhona, Keima le kamite-a kona uphoh hohi alahmang nadingin Pakai henga ngeh lhonin; chutengle Pakai henga ganlhaina boldinga mipi chu kasol ding ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pharaoh jah-a, Lunglhai selin neithu peh-in, itih phatle nangma le na-insunga kona uphoh ho suhmanga auma vadunga bou aumna dinga nangma-a ding, nasohte-a ding, chule namite dinga katao dingham? ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin aman, Jingle ati. Chuin aman, Pakai ka Pathen'u bang hi koimacha dang aumpoi ti nahet nadingin: nathusei dungjuijin hitahen."},"11":{"text":"Chule uphoh hochu nangma-a kon, na-insung ho-a kon, nasohte-a kon, chule namite-a kona chemanguva, vadunga bou umdingu ahitai, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron chu Pharaoh koma konin apotdoh lhontai. Chuin Mosi'n Pharaoh douna-a uphoh ho asosah jehchun Pakai henga ataotan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi thu dungjuijin ahinboltan: chuin uphoh ho chu inho, kho ho, chule louho-a konchun athigam taovin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin amahon hiho chu alhuh lhuh-in asekhom mun: gamsung chu apumpin a-uitan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahivangin Pharaoh'in chomkhat akicholdona amuphatnin, Pakaiyin anasei bangin alung atahsah-in; amani thusei chu angaipeh tapon ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Aaron jah-a, Egypt gam pumpi-a leivuichu kha ahung so nadin natenggol lamin lang gamsunga leivui chu jepmin, tin seijin, ati.","title":"Hise Thumna: Kha"},"17":{"text":"Chuin amanin chutichun abol lhontan ahi: ajehchu Aaron'in atenggol chu akhut toh alamin, leisetna leivui chu ajepmin ahile sa le mihem chunga chun kha ahung langtan; chuin Egypt gam pumpi-a chun tolla leivui jouse chu kha ahungsoh tan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule mitphel doithem hochun adoiju chu amang chaovin kha asosah gouvin, ahivangin amahon abolthei tapouvin ahi. Chutichun sa le mihem chunga chun kha alangtan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chujouvin mitpheldoi themho chun Pharaoh henga, Hichehi Pathen khutjung ahi atiuvin ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin anaseisa bang chun Pharaoh lungsung chu tahsah-in aumin; aseilhon angaipeh tapon ahi.","ref":"Luk 11:20"},"20":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Jingpi matah-in thouvin lang Pharaoh anga gadingin: ven, ama twikhuh lama ahunge; chule nangman ajah-a, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Amahon eijen theina dingun kamite soldoh-in ati.","title":"Hise Lina: Thousi Vaibong"},"21":{"text":"Chutilouva, nangman kamite nasoldoh louva ahile, ven, nangma chung, nasohte chung, namite chung, chule na-insung chunga thousivaibong kahin lansah ding; Egypt mite insungho le adinnau leiset chunga chu thousivaibong dimset ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuche nikho chule kamite chenna Goshen gamchu kakhendoh ding, chukoma chu thousivaibong himhim umlou ding; chuteng keima leiset lailung Pakai kahi nahetdoh ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule keiman kamite le namite kah-a kikhenna kakoi ding: jingle hiche melchihna chu hung umding ahi, gatin, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin chutichun aboltan; Pharaoh insung le asohte insunga, chule Egypt gam pumpi-a chun genthei umtah thousivaibong ahung lhungtan: thousivaibong jehchun gam chu suhboh-in aumtan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh'in Mosi le Aaron chu akouvin, ahenglhona, Nangho cheovin lang hiche gamahin na-Pathen'u henga ganlhaina ganei taovin, ati."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Chutobanga bolding chu thildih ahipoi; ajehchu keihon Egypt mite-a dinga thet umtah hochu Pakai ka-Pathen'u henga ganlhaina-a kaneidiu ahi: ven, Egypt mite dinga thet umtah hochu amitmu tah uva ganlhaina-a kaneijuva ahile, amahon songa eiselou dingu ham?"},"27":{"text":"Aman eithupeh banguva gamthip nithum lama kacheuva, Pakai ka-Pathen'u henga ganlhaina kanei dingu ahi, ati."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh'in, Pakai na Pathen'u henga gamthipma ganlhaina nanei theina dingun nasolu vinge; ahin gamlatah-a vang nachelou dingu ahi: keima dingin neitao peh-un, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Ven, keima nakoma kona kachedoh-a, Pharaoh le asohte, chule amite-a kona thousivaibong hohi jinga patna achemang nadiuvin Pakai koma kagatao ding ahi: ahin mipi ho chu Pakai henga ganlhaina neidinga chesah louna dingin, Pharaoh'in dohan neibolkit tahih-un, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Mosi Pharaoh anga konin apotdoh-in, Pakai henga ataotan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi thusei bangchun abolin; chule thousivaibong hochu Pharaoh'a kon le asohtea kon, chule amite-a konin aladoh-in; khatcha jong aumdena aumpon ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh'in hiche chunga jong hi alung atahsah-in, miho chu asoldoh dehpon ahi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Pharaoh koma lutnin lang ajah-a, Hebrew mite Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Keima eihou theina diuvin kamite chu soldoh tan.","title":"Hise Ngana: Gancha Pul"},"2":{"text":"Nangman amaho soldoh ding nada-a, nahen jing nahlaija ahile,"},"3":{"text":"Ven, loujaova um naganchaho chung, sakol ho, sanganho, sangongsang ho, bongchalho, kelngoiho chungah Pakai khut chuding: gancha pul khohtah langding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Israel mite gancha honle Egypt mite gancha hon chu achomkhen ding: chule Israel chate-a poupou chu khatcha jong thilou ding ahi, tin gaseijin, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin phatbih khat atepmin, Pakaiyin jing nikhole hiche thilhi gamsunga abolding ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chutichun ajing nikhon Pakaiyin chuche thil chu aboltan, Egypt gamsunga gancha jouse chu athitai: ahinla Israel chate gancha ho chu khatcha jong athipon ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh'in mi asolin, chule veuvin, Israel mite gancha khatcha jong athi aumpon ahi. Chuin Pharaoh lungthim chu akisutah-in; chule miho chu alhadoh dehpon ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga, Nangnin thuh sunga konin vut khutdim la lhonin lang, hichu Mosi'n Pharaoh mitmu tah-in van lama thehen.","title":"Hise Gupna: Uilut"},"9":{"text":"Hichu Egypt gamsung jouse-a leivuinel soh ding, Egypt gamsung pumpi-a mihem chungle gancha chunga uilut le mase nasatah chaljal ding ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin amanin thuh sunga vut chu ahamlhonin, Pharaoh angsunga ading lhonin; chuin Mosi'n hichu van lama athen ahile, mihemle gancha chunga chun uilut ahungsoh tan, mase khohtah achaljal tan ahi.","ref":"Tph 16:2"},"11":{"text":"Chuin chuche uilut jehchun mitpheldoi themho chu Mosi masanga adingthei tapouvin ahi; ajehchu uilut chu mitphel doithemho le Egypt mite jouse chunga chu-ah ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Pharaoh lungthim chu atahsah-in, Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseibang chun athu seilhon chu angai pehpon ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Jingpitah-in thouvin lang, Pharaoh henga gadingin, chule ahenga, Hebrew mite Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Keima eihou theina diuvin kamite soldoh tan.","title":"Hise Sagina: Gelchang"},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu leiset chung jouse-a hin keima tobang koimacha aumpoi ti nahet nadinga, tuchunga hi nangma lungsung chung le nasohte chung, chule namite chunga ka hise jouse kahin chuhsah ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma le namite chu hise-a kajep theina dinguva, tu-a hi keiman kakhut kalhandoh ding: chule nangma leisetna kona paidoh-a naum ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule kathahat nahi nangma vetsah nading le kamin hi vannoi leiset pumpi-a phondoh-a aumna dinga, hiche jeh tah-a hi nangma katundoh nahi.","ref":"Rom 9:17"},"17":{"text":"Tugeihin nangman amaho nasoldoh louva konhin, kamite douna-in nangle nang naki choisangin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ven, jing nikho tuphat tah hile Egypt gam kiphudoh-a pat tuchan geija anaumkha louhel, gel nasatah chu kahin juhsah ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun mi solinlang, loujaova um nagancha jouse gakhop khom sah-in; ajehchu in'a kipuilut louva loujaova um mihemle gancha chung jouse-a chu gel hunglha ding, amaho chu thiding ahiuve, gatin, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh sohte lah-a Pakai thu gingho chun asohteu le aganchahou chu insunga ajamlut sah loijun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule Pakai thu ngaisah louho chun asohteu le aganchahou chu louva adalha denun ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Egypt gam jouse mihem chung le gancha chung, chule Egypt gamsung jouse-a louva hampaho jouse chunga gel ahunglhah nadingin, van lama nakhut jahdoh-in, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n atenggol chu van lama ajahdoh tan ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin van ginle gel ahinsoltan; mei chu leichunga avahmat jengin; hitichun Pakaiyin Egypt gam chunga chun gel alhah sahtan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chutichun gel, meito kihal gel alhan, akhohset danchu namkhat ahung hiuvapat Egypt gamsunga hitobang hi aumkha khapon ahi.","ref":"Tph 8:7; 16:21"},"25":{"text":"Chuin Egypt gam jouse-a loujaova thil um jouse, mihem le gancha jong gel chun aseplih gamin; chule gel chun loujaova hampa louhing jouse aseplih-in, gama thing jouse jong asepbong gamtan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Israel chate umna Goshen gama chun bou gel alhapon ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh'in mi asolin, Mosi le Aaron chu agakou sah-in, aheng lhona chun, Tuchung hin keima kachonse tai; Pakai chu achonpha ahin, keima le kamite vang gilou kahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Van gin nasatah le gel hi abeina dingin, Pakai henga ngeh lhonin, (ajehchu phasetna ahitai;) keiman nangho kasoldoh uva, nangho na-umsot tahlou dingu ahi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n ahenga, Keima khopi sunga kona kapotdoh dohle Pakai henga kakhut kajahdoh ding: leiset hi Pakaiya ahi nahetdoh nadinga van gin chu thipding, geljong lhahbe louding ahitai, ati."},"30":{"text":"Ahivangin nangma le nasohte thudol vang, nanghon Pakai Pathen chu nagindeh lou dingu ahi kahei, ati."},"31":{"text":"Chule tupat phungle sakol chang chu suhmangin aumtan ahi. Ajehchu sakol chang chu avui ahungdoh tan, tupat phung vang chu apahlaitah ahi."},"32":{"text":"Ahin suhlou chang le butun vang akedoh loulai jeh-in suhmangin aumpon ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Mosi Pharaoh koma konin khopi chu adalhan, Pakai henga akhut ajahdoh-in ahi; chuin van ginle gel chu atangtan, lei chunga go ajutapon ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh'in go le gel chule van gin ho atan amuphatnin, chonset abolbe nalaijin, amale asohte chun alungthimu atahsah kit taovin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh lungthim chu suhtah-in aumin, Pakaiyin Mosi henga anasei bang chun, Israel chate chu alhadoh dehpon ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Pharaoh koma galutnin: ajehchu hiche kamelchihna hohi amasanga kamusah theina dinga, amale asohte lungsung chu katahsah ahi:","title":"Hise Getna: Khaokho"},"2":{"text":"Chutia chu nangman nachapate le natupate nabenga Egypt gamsunga kathilbol ho leh alah uva kamelchihna bolho naseipeh uva; chule keima Pakai kahi nahetna dingu ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron Pharaoh hengah ahunglut lhonin, ajah-a, Hebrew mite Pakai Pathen'in hiti hin ati, Nangma itihchan ka-angsunga kineosah ding nada nahlai ding ham? Keima eihou theina dingun kamite soldoh tan."},"4":{"text":"Chutilouva, kamite nasoldoh nomlouva ahile, ven, jingle nagam pumpi-a khaokho kahin lhalut ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule koiman tol amu theilou leuva amahon leiset chung alosoh dingu ahi: chule gel suhset moh, nahenga umnalai jouse chu anehjou hel diu, chule nangma-a dinga keh loujaova thingphung jouse jong chu aneh jouhel dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule amahon na-insung le nasohte jouse insung, chule Egypt mite jouse insung chu alodim sohdiu; hichu napateu le naputeuvin jong leiset chunga achenuva pat tuni geija amukhah lou dingu ahi, ati. Chuin ama akiheijin, Pharaoh henga konin apotdoh tai."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh sohte chun ahenga, Hiche mipahi itih chan eiho dinga thanga pang dingham? Pakai a-Pathen'u chu ajen theina diuvin miho chu soldoh tan: Egypt gamhi suhmangin aumtai ti nahet loulai ham? atiuve."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron chu Pharaoh henga ahinpui kitnun ahi. Chuin aman aheng lhonna, Cheovin, Pakai na-Pathen'u chu gajen taovin: ahin koi koi cheding nahiuvem? ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Keiho kakhangdong hou le katehse hou toh, kachapateu le kachanuteu toh, kabong honhou le kakelngoi honhou toh kache dingu ahi; ajehchu keihon Pakai henga Kut kabol dingu ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah lhona, Keiman nachasen houtoh kasoldoh uva ahile, Pakaiyin na-umpiu hen: chingtheijun, ajehchu namasanguva thilphalou aume."},"11":{"text":"Chutiponte: tun nangho pasal chengchu cheovin lang Pakai chu gajen taovin: ajehchu hichu nangaichatnu ahi, ati. Chuin Pharaoh angsunga konin amani chu anodoh taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Khaokhote Egypt gamsung chunga ahungchuh uva, hiche gama gel seset moh hampa louhing jouse anehthei nadiuvin, khaokhote-a dingin Egypt gamsung chunga hin nakhut jahdoh-in ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Egypt gam chunga atenggol chu ajahdoh-in ahile, Pakaiyin sun nilhum jankhovah-in gamchunga chun solam hui anunsah tan, chuin jingkah ahung hi phatnin solam hui chun khaokho hochu ahin polut tan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin khaokho ho chu Egypt gam jouse chunga ahung taovin, Egypt gam pumpi jouse-a chun acholnga taovin ahi. Hiho chu akhohse lheh jengun; amaho masanga hin amaho tobang khaokho ana umkhapon, amaho nunga jong chutobang umkit louding ahi.","ref":"Tph 9:2-3"},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu hicheho chun leiset pumpi chu atomchah jeng taovin, chutichun gamsung chu athim jengtan; chule gelin asuhset moh gama hamhing tincheng le thingna jouse chu anegam hel taovin ahi. Chutichun Egypt gamsung jouse-a chun thingphung ho-a thing hing le loujaoa hampa louhing a-eng him him khatcha jong aumtapon ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh'in Mosi le Aaron chu gangtah-in akouvin, ajahlhona, Keima Pakai na Pathen lhonle nangni douna-in kachonse tai."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun, katao ahi, Kachonset hi khatveiseh neingaidam kit lhonin, hiche thina hi keija kona alahmang theina din Pakai na Pathen henga neitaopeh lhonin, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin ama Pharaoh koma konin apotdoh in, Pakai henga atao tai."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin lhumlam hui hattah anunsah-in ahile, hichun khaokho ho chu alhoh mangin, twipi sana alhoh lutsoh keijin; Egypt gam pumpi-a chun khaokho khatcha jong aumtapon ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakaiyin Pharaoh lung chu atahsah-in, chuti chun aman Israel chate chu asoldoh dehpon ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Egypt gam chunga tohkhah thei hel khopma muthim ahung umtheina dingin van lama nakhut jahdoh-in, ati.","title":"Hise Kona: Muthim"},"22":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n van lama akhut ajahdoh tan ahile, nithum Egypt gam pumpi chunga chun nasatah-in mu athimtan ahi.","ref":"Labu 105:28; Tph 16:10"},"23":{"text":"Amaho khatle khat akimuto thei tapouvin, nithum sung chun koimacha aumna munna kona kipatdoh aumpon ahi. Ahivangin Israel chate jouse chennaho-a chun vah aneicheh-un ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh'in Mosi chu akouvin, ajah-a, Nangho cheovin lang, Pakai chu gajen taovin; nabonghon houle na kelngoihon hou bouchu umhen: nachasen hou jong chu nangho toh lhonuhen, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Nangman Pakai ka-Pathen'u henga ganlhaina-a kato dinguva ganlhaina thilto dingle govam thilto ding jong neipeh dingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Kagancha hou jong keiho toh lhonding ahi: gancha kengtin khatjong dalhah-a umlou ding ahi: ajehchu Pakai ka-Pathen'u kajen nadinguva phabep kalhendoh dingu ahin; amun kalhun masang seova hoichepena hi Pakai kajen dingu kihet louvu ahi, ati."},"27":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakaiyin Pharaoh lung chu atahsah tan, amaho chu asoldoh nompon ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh'in ahenga, Kakoma konin chemangtan, kichih theijin, kamai mukit tahih-in; ajehchu kamai namukit ninileh nathi ding ahi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Nangman nasei dih-e, keiman namai kamukit louding ahitai ati."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Pharaoh chung le Egypt gam chunga hise khat kalhunsah be nahlai ding ahin; chujouteng leh hikoma kona hi nasoldoh diu ahitai: aman nasoldoh tengule, thonlouva nanodoh tho sohkei jeng dingu ahi.","title":"Mosi'n Egypt Gama Apeng Masa Jouse Thi Ding Aphondoh"},"2":{"text":"Tun mipi ho henga seipeh-in, chule pasal jouse le numei jousen aheng akoma konin dangka le sana-a kisem kijepnaho kithum cheh uhen, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Egypt mitmu-a chun Israel miho chu khohsahna apetan ahi. Chukal valin mipa Mosi chu mipi mitmu le Pharaoh sohte mitmun Egypt gam sunga mi minthang tah ahitan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Jan khangkim donle Egypt gamsung lailung tah-a kalut ding:"},"5":{"text":"Chule Egypt gamsunga chapa peng masapen jouse, laltouna-a tou Pharaoh chapa lenpena pat, sumheija sohnu chapa lenpen changeija thisoh hel dingu; chule gancha asoh masapen ho jong thisoh hel dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule Egypt gamsung jouse-a chu kana nasatah umding, hitobang hi anaum khalou ahin, umjong umkit louhel ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahin Israel chate douna-a vang, mihem douna hihen le gancha douna hijongle, uichan jong alei achalohsah louding ahi; chutia chu nanghon Egypt mite le Israel kah-a Pakaiyin ichana kikhena akoiham ti nahet ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuteng hiche nasohte jouse hi kahenga hung suh uva, ka-angsunga bohkhup diu, Chedohtan, nanungjui mipi jouse toh: ahung tidingu; chujou teng keima kachedoh ding ahi, ati. Chuin ama Pharaoh koma konchun lunghang tah-in apotdohtan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Egypt gamsunga hi kathilbol kidang apun chehcheh theina dinga Pharaoh'in nathu angailou ding ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron'in Pharaoh angsunga hiche thilkidang hojouse hi abol lhonin: chule Israel chate chu agama kona asoldohlou nadingin, Pakaiyin Pharaoh lung chu atahsah-in ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Egypt gama Mosi le Aaron henga chun aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Kalchuh Kut","ref":"Thmpu 23:5; Minb 9:1-5; 28:16; Danb 16:1-2."},"2":{"text":"Hiche lhahi nangho dinga lha kipatna hiding: nangho dinga kumsunga lha masapen chu hiding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Israel mipi kikhom ho jouse henga chun thu seilhonin lang, hitin seilhonin, Hiche lha nisom chan ni hile mitinin ama-a dingin kelngoinou khatcheh kilah-u hen, apu apateu insung dungjuija in khatna dinga kelngoinou khatcheh hiding ahi:"},"4":{"text":"Chule ijemtia insung khat chu kelngoinou khat dinga alhom behseh-a ahile, amale a-inhengpa chun kelngoinou khat chu amijatnu dungjuijin kilah-u hen; mitinin ava khamcheh-a aneh dingjat dungjuija kelngoinouva dinga chu mi nasimtoh dingu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Na kelngoinouvu chu nolna beihel, achal kum khat lhingbep hiding: nanghon hichu kelngoi ham, ahiloule kelcha hama kona nalah dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule nanghon chuche lha ni somle nili chan ni geija nakoi dingu: chule Israel mipi kikhom khomho jouse chun nilhah teng atha dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule amahon athisan chu alah uva, aneh nadiu inho kotchung teni le achung jolla chu anu dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule amaho chuche jan chule aphe chu meija agouva, cholsolou changlhah toh an-che kha toh ame dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Asela naneh loudiu, chule twija kihon jong naneh lou dingu, amavang alu jong akeng jong chule asung jouse puma meija nasahmin tho dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule nanghon jingkah geija khatcha nakoilou dingu ahi; jingkah geija anaumden tapouchu meija nagovam dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule hitia hi naneh dingu ahi; tai kigah pum le kengchot kise pum, chule nakhut uva natenggolu kichoi puma kinotah-a naneh dingu ahi: hichehi Pakai kalchuh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu tujan tengle keiman Egypt gamsung kahin jotpa ding, Egypt gamsunga mihem le gancha apeng masa jouse kathagam ding; chule Egypt pathen jouse chunga jong thutanna kalhunsah ding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule thisan chu nangho dinga na-umnao inho chunga melchih na-a pangding; chule thisan chu kamu teng, nangho chu kakalchuh ding; Egypt gam kahin got teng, hise chu nangho sumang dinga nachung uva chulou ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho hi nangho dinga hetjingna hiding; chule nanghon hichehi nakhang lhumkei uva Pakaiya dinga kutna nanit dingu; nanghon hiche kut hi a-itih-a chonna dan kisuna nanit dingu ahi.","ref":"Pot 23:15; 34:18; Thmpu 23:6-8; Minb 28:17-25; Danb 16:3-8"},"15":{"text":"Nanghon ni sagi cholsolou changlhah naneh diu; ni masa ni-a patna na-in houva kona chol nakoidoh diu ahi. Ajehchu koihile nimasa ni-a patna ni sagi changeija chola kisem changlhah netapou chu, hiche mipa chu Israel lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi.","title":"Cholsolou Changlhah Kut"},"16":{"text":"Chule nimasani chule nangho dinga kikhoppi theng umding; chule ani sagi ni jongleh kikhoppi theng umkit ding ahi; chule hiche nikho ho-a chu natoh imacha natohlou dingu; amitinin anehsohkei dingu ahin, nehding bou chu nakibol thei dingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule nanghon cholsolou changlhah kut chu nanit dingu ahi; ajehchu chuche nilele-a chu nagalsat hou Egypt gama kona kapuidoh ahiuve. Hijeh-a chu hiche nikho hi a-itih-a akhang akhanga chonna dan kisuna nanit dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Nanghon lha masapen chuche lha nisomle nili nilhah-a pat, chuche lha mama nisomni le nikhat nilhah changeija cholsolou changlhah naneh dingu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ni sagi sunga chu chol him him na-inhouva kimulouhel ding ahi: ajehchu koi hijongle chol kiso netapou chu, maljin hihen, gamsunga peng hijongle, chutobang michu Israel mipi kikhomho lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chol kiso tapou imacha nanehlou dingu ahi; nachenna mun jouseuva cholsolou changlhah bou naneh dingu ahi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chujouvin Mosi'n Israel upaho jouse akouvin, ajah uva, Kelngoinou chu kikaijun lang, na insungmi cheh-u dungjuijin kalchuh sa chu that taovin.","title":"Kalchuh Kut Masapen"},"22":{"text":"Chule nanghon hyssop bohkhat nalah uva, lheng sunga um thisan lah-a chu nadelut dingu, chuche lheng sunga um thisana chu kotbeng teni le kotchungjol chu nanu dingu: chule jingkah ahunghi kahse-a koimacha a-inkot khah-a kona potdoh louding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu Egypt mite sugam dinga Pakaiyin ahin jotpa ding ahin; chule aman kotchin teni le kotchungvuma thisan chu amutengle, Pakaiyin hiche kot chu akalchuh ding, nangho sugam dinga suhmangna chu na-insungu ahin lutsah louding ahi.","ref":"Heb 11:28"},"24":{"text":"Chule hiche thil hi nangho le nachapa teovin a-itih-a chonna danna nanit jing dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, athutep banga Pakaiyin napeh dingu gamsung chu nalhun phat tengu jongle, hiche natoh hi nanit jomjing dingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, nachateovin naheng uva, Hiche natoh hi ipi vetsahna ham? ati phat tengule;"},"27":{"text":"Nanghon, Aman Egypt mite asuhgama eiho eihuhdoh laijuva, Egypt gama Israel chate inho kalchuhpa Pakai kalchuh ganlhaina chu ahi nati dingu ahi, ati. Chuin mipi chu akunun Pathen ahou taovin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu achemangun, Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron athupeh bangchun aboltaove."},"29":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin khangkimin alaltouna-a tou Pharaoh cha masapena pat gal hing kikaija songkul'a kihen cha masapen geijin, Egypt gamsunga apeng masapen jouse athat gamin; chule gancha masapen ho jouse jong athat gam tan ahi.","title":"Apengmasa Jouse Kithagam","ref":"Pot 4:22-31."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh chu jan-in athouvin, asohho jouse le Egypt mite jouse chu athoudoh uvin; chule Egypt gama chun kana nasatah aumtan ahi; ajehchu mithi louna in khatcha jong umlou ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin aman jan-in Mosi le Aaron chu akouvin, aheng lhona, Kipatdoh-un, nangni le Israel chate chu kamite-a konin chedoh taovin; chule cheovin lang nasei bangin Pakai chu gajen taovin."},"32":{"text":"Chule naseilhon bangin nabonghou le nagancha hou jouse jong kipuijun lang chetaovin; chule keijong phatthei neiboh-un, ati."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Egypt mite chun chuche miho chu gamsunga kona gangtah-a soldoh loina ding chun akinotaove; ajehchu amahon, Eiho mithi ihisoh diu ahitai, atiuve."},"34":{"text":"Chuin miho chun achangbong amehsao chu chol kiso masangin akichoijun, achanglhah mehnao kongho pona kijel chu alengkou uva akiput taovin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chule Israel chate chun Mosi seibang chun abolun; amahon Egypt mite-a konin sana le dangka-a kisem kijepnaho le vonho chu akithumun ahi.","ref":"Pot 3:21-22"},"36":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Israel mite chu Egypt mite mitmun khotona amusah-in, hiti chun amahon athum chanu chu apeuvin ahi. Chutichun amahon Egypt mite chu achom gamun ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu Rameses'a konin Succoth lama ajin taovin, amaho chu nunao chapang simlouvin, kenga lamjot cheh pasal sangjagup ahiuve.","title":"Israel ten Egypt Adalhah-u"},"38":{"text":"Chule choplop mihonpi chu amaho toh achetou khomun; chule kelngoihon, bonghon, chule gancha tamtah toh alhon khomun ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chule amahon Egypt gama kona ahinkipoh-u changbong mehsa-a chun cholsolou changlhah akangun ahi, ajehchu chol kiso louva ahi; ijeh inem itile Egypt gama kona asotdoh tho jengu ahijeh-a, amaho akhongai sot thei louvu, nehding imacha akigotman louvu ahi."},"40":{"text":"Tun Egypt gama cheng Israel chate akhopemnao phatsung chu kum jali le kum somthum ahi.","ref":"Semt 15:13; Gal 3:17."},"41":{"text":"Chuin kum jali le kum somthum kichaijin ahitin ahi, chuche nile le chun ahitin ahi, Pakai janel jouse chu Egypt gama konin apotdoh taovin ahi."},"42":{"text":"Hiche hi Egypt gama kona ahinpuidoh jeh uva Pakai geldohna dinga anitdiu jan chu ahi. Hiche hi Israel chate jousen akhanguva anitdiu Pakai jan chu ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga, Kalchuh kut kiman dingdan chu hichehi ahi; maljin koimachan hichu aneh louding ahi:","title":"Kalchuh Kut Kiman Ding Dan"},"44":{"text":"Ahin suma kicho soh vangchu, nangman achep natanjou tengle, hichu aneh theiding ahi."},"45":{"text":"Gamchom mi le soh sum thalo vang chun hichu aneh theilou ding ahi."},"46":{"text":"Hichu inkhat sunga nehding ahin; nanghon aphe khatjeng jong inpolama nachoidoh lou dingu; chule agujong nasuhboh lou dingu ahi.","ref":"Minb 9:12; Jhn 19:36"},"47":{"text":"Israel mipi ho chun hiche hi anit dingu ahi."},"48":{"text":"Maljin khat nakoma pema auma, Pakai dinga kalchuh kut anit dinga ahile, apasal jousen chep tanu henlang, chujou tengle hinnai hen, chule hichu nit hen; chutengle ama chuche gama penga mikhat tobang hiding ahi. Ajehchu chep tanlou tapou chun hichu anehlou dingu ahi."},"49":{"text":"Agam sunga peng hihen, nalah uva hung khopem gamdangmi hijongle, dan khat bou hiding ahi, ati."},"50":{"text":"Chutichun Israel chate jousen abol taovin; Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron athupeh bangchun abol taovin ahi."},"51":{"text":"Chuin chuche nilele chun ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin Israel chate chu aloi loijin Egypt gama konin apuidohtan ahi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Apeng Masa Jouse Kithenso"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate lah-a naobu hinphukeh-a apeng masa jouse chu mihem hihen gancha hijongle kahenga thenso soh keijun: hichu keija ahi, ati.","ref":"Minb 3:13; Luk 2:23"},"3":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n mipi ho henga aseijin, Nanghon Egypt gamsung sohchana in'a kona nahungdoh nao hiche nikhohi hejingun; ajeh chu Pakaiyin khut thahatna hiche mun'a kona chu nahin puidoh-u ahi. Chol kiso changlhah naneh loudingu ahi.","title":"Cholsolou Changlhah Kut"},"4":{"text":"Abib lha hiche nikho-a hi nahung potdoh-u ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Canaan miho, Hit miho, Amon miho, Hiv miho, chule Jebus miho gam, napu napateu pehdinga akihahselna khoiju le bangnoi lona gama chu napuilut phat tengule, hiche lha ngeija hi hiche kin kibol hi nanit jing dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nisagi cholsolou changlhah naneh dingu, chule ani sagi ni chu Pakaiya dinga kut hiding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nisagi chol solou changlhah nehding ahin; nakom him himuva chol kiso changlhah kimulou ding, nachennao mun jouse vellah-a jong chol him him kimulou ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule chuche nikho chule nachapa nahetsah-a, ajah-a, Egypt gama kona kahung potdoh-a Pakaiyin kachunga anatohho jeh-a hichehi kibola ahi, tia naseipeh ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule Pakai danthu chu nakama aumtheina dinga, hiche hi nakhut chunga melchihna hiding, chule namit teni kikah-a hetjingna hiding ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin khut thahat tah-a Egypt gama kona napuidoh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun kumseh le hiche dan kisem hi aphatseh-a nanit jingding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule napu napate le nangma henga ana kihahselna banga, Pakaiyin Canaan miho gama napuilutna, hiche gam chu napeh tengle hitiding ahi,","title":"Apeng Masa"},"12":{"text":"Nangman naobu hinphukeh masa jouse le nagancha apeng masa chengse chu Pakai dinga nachom khen ding ahi; pasal ho chu Pakaiya ding ahi.","ref":"Pot 34:19-20; Luk 2:23"},"13":{"text":"Chule sangan asoh masa chengse chu kelngoinouva nalhatdoh ding; nalhatdoh louding ahile angong chu naheboh ding ahi. Nachate lah-a apeng masapen pasal jouse chu nalhatdoh ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, phat ahung lhung ding ho-a chu nachapan, Hichehi ipi tina ham? tia nahindoh tengle, nangman ahenga, Pakaiyin akhut thahat chun Egypt gam sohchana in'a kona eina lhatdoh ahi:"},"15":{"text":"Chule ahitin ahi, Pharaoh chun eisoldoh nomlou phatnun, Pakaiyin Egypt gama mihem le gancha apeng masa jouse chu atha gam jeh-a keiman naobu hinphukeh-a apeng masa pasal jouse chu Pakai koma kalhandoh ahi; ahivangin kachate lah-a apeng masa jouse chu kalhatdoh-in ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule hiche hi nakhut chunga melchihna le namit teni kikah-a hetjingna hiding ahi: ajehchu khut thahatna Pakaiyin Egypt gama kona eipuidoh-u ahi, nati ding ahi, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Pharaoh'in mipi ho chu asoldoh phatnin, alampi chu anai vangin Pathen'in Philistine mite gam jotna lampia chun amaho apuipon ahi: ajehchu Pathen'in, Achuti loule mipi ho chun galkisat amutengule kisih untin, Egypt lama kilekit getnunte, ati ahi.","title":"Meibang Khompi le Meikong Khompi"},"18":{"text":"Ahin Pathen'in mipi chu twipi san jotna gamthip lampia chun apuijin;chule Israel chate chu Egypt gama kon chun galsat dinga kigosan akitol tou taovin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Joseph guho chu apon ahi: ajehchu aman Israel chate chu ana kihahsel sah-a, ajah uva, Pathen'in nangho thonlouva nahungvil dingu ahin; chule nanghon kagu hi hikoma kona napohtou dingu ahi, anati ahi.","ref":"Semt 50:25; Josh 24:32."},"20":{"text":"Chuin amaho Succoth'a konin akipat doh-un, gamthip chin Etham'a agebuh-u asongun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin sun le jana achetheina diuvin Pakai chu sun le meibang khompin amasanguva achen, chule jan le meikong khompin amaho chu vah pedingin amasanguva achepeh-in ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hitichun sun na meibang khompi le jana meikong khompi chu mipi ho masanga konchun alamangpon ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Twipisan Agalkaiju"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate henga, amaho kiheijuva Baal-zephon maijona um Migdol le twikhanglen kah-a Pi-hahiroth mun'a gebuh akison nadiuvin seipeh-in: hiche masanga chu twikhanglen panga gebuh nason dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu Pharaoh'in Israel chate thudola, Amaho gamsunga chun a-ohden taovin, gamthip chun amaho akhakhum den ahitaove, atiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule keiman Pharaoh lungsung chu kasuh tah ding, aman amaho ahin nungdel ding ahin; chule Egypt miten keima Pakai kahi ahetna dinguva, keima Pharaoh le asepaiho jouse chunga jabola kaum ding ahi. Chuin amahon hiti chun abol taovin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Egypt lengpa henga mipi chu ajam taove ti aseipeh taovin ahi. Chuin Pharaoh le asohte lungsung chu mipi ho douna chun akiheitan, chule amahon, Ipi dinga hiche hi inaboluva, eiho eijen naova kona Israel chu isoldoh-u hitam? atiuve."},"6":{"text":"Chuin aman asakol kangtalai chu akigotnin, amite chu akipuijin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin aman lhentum sakol kangtalai jagup le Egypt sakol kangtalai jouse, chule khatcheh chunga sepai lamkaiho chu akipuijin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Egypt lengpa Pharaoh lungsung chu atahsahtan, aman Israel chate chu anungdel tai; chule Israel chate chu hangtah-a chedoh-a ahitaove."},"9":{"text":"Ahivangin Egypt mite chun Pharaoh sakol kangtalai ho le sakol jouse, asakol chung tou miho, chule asepaihon chutoh amaho chu anungdel taovin, chuin amaho chu Baal-zephon phah masang Pi-hahiroth kom, twikhanglen panga agebuh ason naova chun apha taovin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh ahung nai phatnin, Israel chate akhodah uvin ahile, veuvin, Egypt mite chu anunguva ahung kijot jot jenguvin; chuin amaho akicha talheh jengun ahi. Chuin Israel chate chu Pakai henga atao taovin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amahon Mosi henga, Egypt gama lhankhuh umlou hija gamthipma thidinga neipuidoh-u ham? Nangman ibola Egypt gama kona neipuidoh uva, hitia hi neibolu ham?"},"12":{"text":"Egypt mite kajen theina diuvin neilimsah hih-un tia Egypt gama kanaseiju chu hiche thuhi hilou ham? ajehchu gamthipma kathigam sang uva Egypt mite kajenu chu keiho dinga phajo ahi, atiuve."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n mipi henga, Nangho kicha hih-un, ding thimbeh-un lang, Aman nangho tunia namusah dingu Pakai mi huhhingna chu veuvin: ajehchu tunia namu-u Egypt mite hi a-imatih chana avela namu kitlou dingu ahitai."},"14":{"text":"Pakaiyin nangho dinga gal asatding, chule nangho na-umthim beh dingu ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Ipi dinga kahenga naka uham? Israel chate chu amalamuva ache nadiuvin ahenguva seipeh-in."},"16":{"text":"Ahin nangman natenggol chu domsangin lang, twikhanglen chunga chun nakhut jahdoh-in, hichu hom khenin: chule Israel chaten tolgoa twikhanglen lailung chu ajotdingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule keima, ven, keimatah-in Egypt mite lungsung kasuhtah ding, chule amahon amaho nung chu ajui dingu ahi. Chule Pharaoh le ajanelho jouse, asakol kangtalai ho, chule asakol chunga tou miho chunga keiman jabolna kamuding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule Pharaoh chung le asakol kangtalai chung, chule asakol chungtou miho chunga jabola kaum tengle, Egypt miten keima Pakai kahi chu ahet dingu ahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Israel gebuh masanga che Pathen vantil chu akichonin, anunguva achen; chule meilhang khompi chu amasanguva kon chun akichonin, anunguva adingtan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin hichu Israel miho gebuh le Egypt miho gebuh kikah-a chun ahungin; hichu amaho ding chun meilhang le muthim ahin, khat ho ding vang chun janle vah apen ahi. Chutichun jankhovah keijin khatnin khat chu anailutpon ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n twipi chunga chun akhut ajahdoh tan ahi; chuin Pakaiyin hiche jan chun solam hui hattah mangchan twipi chu alelon sah-in, twipi chu tolgo asosahtan, twiho chu akikhentan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu twipi lailung tolgoa chun alut taovin; chule twiho chu jetle veija bang bangin akisungin ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 10:1-2; Heb 11:29"},"23":{"text":"Chuin Egypt miho chun anung delun, Pharaoh sakol ho, akangtalai ho, asakol chunga tou miho jouse chu amaho nunga chun twipi lailunga chun alut taovin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, jingkah ahiphatnin Pakaiyin Egypt mite chu meilhang le meikong khompia konin ahinven, Egypt mite janel chu asunohphah tan,"},"25":{"text":"Asakol kangtalaiju kangho chu alahdoh peh-in ahile amahon gihsatah in atolun ahi. Hijeh chun Egypt miten, Eiho Israel maikoh-a konhin jamtao hite; ajehchu Pakaiyin amaho dinga Egypt mitehi asat ahitai, atiuvin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Egypt mite sakol ho, akangtalaihou, chule asakol chunga touhou chunga twiho chu ahung lonkhom kitna dingin, twipi chunga chun nakhut jahdoh-in, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n twipi chunga chun akhut ajahdoh-in ahile, jingkah ahunghi phatnin twipi chu angaija alonhat bangin ahunglong kit tai; chuin Egypt hiche lama chun ajamun; Pakaiyin Egypt mite chu twipi lailunga chun alehlut gamtan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin twiho chu ahung long gom kitnin, sakol ho, kangtalai ho, sakol chunga touho, chule amaho hin nungdel twipi sunga lut ho Pharaoh janelho jouse chu achuptan; khatcha jong asohcha aum pouvin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ahivangin Israel chaten twipi lailunga chun tolgo laija lam ajotnun; chule twiho chu amaho dingin ajetlam le aveilam uva bang bangin akisungin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chutichun Pakaiyin chuche nikho chun Israel chate chu Egypt mite khutna konin ahuhhingtan; chule twipanga konin Israelte chun Egypt mite athiu chu amuvin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Israel ten Egypt mite chunga Pakai natoh loupi chu amutaovin ahi: chule mipichun Pakai chu aging taovin, Pakai le asoh Mosi chu atahsan taove."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Mosi le Israel chate chun Pakai henga hiche la hi asaovin, hitihin aseijuve: Loupitah-a gal ajotah jeh-in, keiman Pakai henga la sange; aman sakol le achunga toupa chu twipi sunga alehlut tai.","title":"Mosi La","ref":"Tph 15:3."},"2":{"text":"Pakai chu kahatna le ka la ahin, chule eihuhinga jong ahung hitai. Ama ka Pathen ahin, keiman ama kavahchoi ding; Ama kapa Pathen ahin, keiman kachoi sang ding ahi.","ref":"Labu 118:14; Isai 12:2."},"3":{"text":"Pakai chu gal hatmi ahi. Pakai chu amin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pharaoh sakol kangtalai ho le asepai janel chu aman twipi sunga alehlutnin; asepai lamkai lhenchom ho jongchu twipi sana alhalut gam tan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Twi thuh-in achupsoh taovin; twi thuhtah noija chun song bangin alhalut taove."},"6":{"text":"Vo Pakai nakhut jetlam chu thanei na-in aloupin: vo Pakai nakhut jetlam chun melma chu asuchip tan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Naletna chungnunga chun nangma douna-a kipanho chu najoutan; nalunghanna chu nahin soldoh-in, amaho chu changpol bangin akavam taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nanah hai chun twiho chu akhom khomin, twisoh chu alhuh-in adingden tan, chule twithuh chu twipi lailunga adingchah dentan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Melma chun, Keiman kanungdel ding, kaphah pa-a thil kichomdohho chu kahop khending; kangaichat chu achunguva kasuh bulhit ding; kachemjam kasa doh-a, kakhutnin amaho asuhmang ding ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Nangman nahui chun namutnin ahile, twipi chun amaho chu akhukhum tan: twi thuh sunga chun amaho chu ngen bangin alhalut taovin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Vo Pakai, pathen ho lah-a hi nangma tobang koi umam? nangma tobanga thenna-a loupi, pachat naho-a gin um, chule thil kidang ho bolla koi umam?"},"12":{"text":"Nangman nakhut jetlam najah doh-in, leisetnin amaho chu aval lhumtai."},"13":{"text":"Nangman nami hepina-in nalhatdohsa namite chu napui doh-in, nangman nathahatna-in amaho chu nachenna munthenga chun napui lhungtan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Mipi chun jaovintin, chule kichadiu: Philistine mite chenna munchu lungkham na-a dimding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuteng Edom lenghon hichu kidang asahdiu; Moab mihat ho chu kihot hotdiu; Canaan gama cheng ho jouse chu junmang diu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nangman nachohdohsa namite chu agalkai kahseovin, Vo Pakai, namite chu agalkai kahseuva kichat le tijat na chu amaho chunga chuding; naban thahat nasatah-a chu amaho song banga umthimbeh dingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangman nachenna dinga nasemna mun, Vo Pakai nakhut tah-a naphudet muntheng, nagoulo molsanga chu amaho chu napuilutna nachensah ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Pakaiyin atonsot atonsotna lengvai apohding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ajehchu Pharaoh sakol ho, akangtalai ho leh, asakol chunga touho toh twipi sunga alutnuvin, chuin Pakaiyin twipi chu achunguva alonsah kittan ahi; ahivangin Israel chate chu twipi lailung tolgo chunga chun acheuvin ahi.","title":"Miriam La"},"20":{"text":"Chuin Aaron sopinu Miriam themgaonu chun akhutna thih khutbeh khat akilah-in; chule numei jouse chun thih khutbeh choipum le lampumin anung ajuijun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Miriam'in amaho chu adonbutnin, Nanghon Pakai henga la saovin, ajehchu aman loupitah-a gal ajou tan ahi; aman sakol le achunga toupa chu twipi sunga aleh lutan ahi, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuti chun Mosi'n Israel chu twipi sana konchun ahin puijin, Shur gamthipma alut taovin ahi; chuin amaho gamthipma chun nithum acheuvin ahile twi amu tapouvin ahi.","title":"Twikha"},"23":{"text":"Chuin Marah ahung lhun phatnun, Marah mun'a twiho chu akhat jeh-in adonthei tapouvin ahi. Hiche jeh-a chu hiche mun chu Marah kisah-a ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin mipi ho chu Mosi chunga aphun taovin, Ipi kadondiu ham? atiuvin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin ama Pakai henga akaptan ahileh, Pakaiyin thingphung khat amusah-in, hichu twiho lah-a chun akholutnin ahile, twiho chu atwi tan ahi. Chua chun aman amaho dingin chonadan le thupeh asemin, chule chuachun amaho chu apatepmin,"},"26":{"text":"Ajah uva, Nanghon Pakai na Pathen'u aw hi chingthei tah-a nangai uva, amitmu-a adih chu nabol uva, chule achondan thu jouse nanit uva ahile, keiman Egypt mite chunga kachuhsah hiche natho hi khatcha jong nachung uva kachuhsah louding ahi; ajehchu keima nangma damsah-a Pakai chu kahi ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin amaho Elim ahung lhungun, chukoma chun twikhuh somleni le lusuphung somsagi aumin ahi. Chuin amahon twipanga chun gebuh asongun ahi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin amaho Elim'a konin akholjin kitnun, Egypt gam adalhahnao lhanina ni somle ninga ni tah chun Israel chate mipi kikhomho jouse chu Sinai le Elim kikah-a um Sin gamthip ahunglhung taovin ahi.","title":"Manna le Vamim"},"2":{"text":"Chuin gamthipma chun Israel chate mipi kikhomho jouse chu Mosi le Aaron dounan aphun taovin;"},"3":{"text":"Israel chate chun aheng lhona, Pathen'in Egypt gama sabel ho koma katou uva, nengtah-a changlhah kaneh laijuva Pakai khutna eina thisah joh-u hitavele; ajehchu nangnin hichea mipi ho hi kella thisah dinga hiche gamthipma hi neihin puilutnu ahi, atiuvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hichun Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Ven, keiman nangho dinga van'a kona changlhah kahinjuhsah ding ahin; amaho kadan thua achonuleh achonlouvu kapatep theina dinga, mipi ho chu potdoh uva niseh-a anehkham cheh diu aga kilokhom dingu ahi.","ref":"Jhn 6:31."},"5":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, anigup nile ahin lokhom hou chu akigontup dingu; hichu niseh-a alokhomu jatni hiding ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron'in Israel chate jouse henga, Nilhah tengleh Egypt gama kona nahinpui doh uva chu Pakai ahi nahet dingu:"},"7":{"text":"Chule jingkah tengleh Pakai loupi namu dingu ahi; ajehchu Pakai douna-a naphunchel nao chu aman ajatai: keini ipi kahi lhona keini chunga naphunu ham? atilhone."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Hiche hi nilhah teng Pakaiyin nanehdiu sa napeh uva, jingkah teng changlhah nengtah-a napeh tengule namu dingu ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin naphun nao, ama douna-a naphun chelnao chu ajatan ahi. Keini koi kahilhon ham? keini douna-a phun nahipouvin, Pakai douna-a phun nahijo bouvui, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Aaron henga, Israel chate mipi kikhomho henga, Pakai angsunghi hinaijun; ajehchu aman naphun nahou chu ajatai, tin seipeh-in ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Aaron'in Israel chate mipi kikhomho henga thu aseipat patnin, amahon gamthiplam chu aveovin ahile, veuvin, Pakai loupi nachu meilhang lah-a ahung kilah-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,"},"12":{"text":"Israel chate phunchel nachu keiman kajatan ahi. Amaho henga chun, Nilhah teng sa naneh dingu, chule jingkah tengle changlhah-a navaset dingu; chutengle keima Pakai na-Pathen'u kahi nahet dingu ahi, tin seijin, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, nilhah-in vengkeho chu ahungdoh-un, agebuh uchu atomchah tan ahi. Chule jingkah-in janelho kimvela chun daitwi analhan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin daitwi lha chu ahul phatnin, veuvin, gamthip tol chunga chun thil lumpilpel neocha cha, buhbang neocha cha tobangin amuvin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chun hichu amuphatnun khatle khat akihouvun, Hiche hi manna ahi atiuve: ajehchu ipi ahi ahetlouvu ahi. Chuin Mosi'n ahenguva, Hichehi Pakaiyin naneh dinguva napeh-u changlhah chu ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 10:3"},"16":{"text":"Hiche thil hi Pakaiyin ana thupeh chu ahi: Mitinin ama nehkhop cheh, na-insung mijat dungjuijun mikhat cheh-a dingin omer khatcheh; amitakipmin aponbuh sunga umho jouse-a dingin kilokhom cheh hen, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Israel chaten hitichun abolun, abangin atamjep chule abangin alhomjep akilo khomun ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amahon omer-a ate phatnun, atam lodoh panjong imacha amoh aneipon, chule alhom lodoh pajong chu alhinglel dehpon; amitinin anehkhop cheh ding akilo khomun ahi.","ref":"2 Cor 8:15"},"19":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Koimachan jingkah changeijin khenhih hen, ati."},"20":{"text":"Ahivangin amahon Mosi thusei chu angaipouvin; alah uva mi phabepmin jingkah geija dingin akhenun, ahin hichu ana thanin, a-uitan ahi. Chuin Mosi achunguva alunghang tan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuti chun jingkah seh le amitakipmin anehkhop cheh ding akilokhom jiuvin; nisa ahung sat tengleh hichu ajunmang jitan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, anigup ni chule changlhah chu ajatni, mikhat dingin omer nicheh alohkhom jiuvin ahi. Chuin mipi kikhom vaipoho jouse chu ahungun, Mosi ahung hetsah taovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho henga chun, Hiche hi Pakaiyin asei chu ahi, Jingkhu Pakaiya dinga kicholdo ni cholngah nitheng ahi. Nahon dingu chu tunin honunlang, nakan dingu chu kanguvin, chua amoh umchu jingkah lama dingin kikoijun, ati.","ref":"Pot 20:8-11"},"24":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n aseibang chun jingkah changei chun akoijuvin ahile, hichu anengpon, thanjong athan pon ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Hichu tunin neovin; ajehchu tuni hi Pakaiya dinga cholngah ni ahi: tunia hichu loujaova namu lou dingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hichu nigup sunga nalokhom dingu; ajing nisagi ni chu cholngah ni ahin, chuche nikho chule khatcha jong umlou ding ahi, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, mi phabep nisagi ni chun aloh khomdin apotdoh un, ahin khatcha amupouve."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Kathupeh ho le kadan thuho hi itihchan nitnom louva naum dingu ham?"},"29":{"text":"Veovin, Pakaiyin cholngah ni napeh jeh uvin, nigup chan nileh nini-a ding changlhah napeh-u ahi; amitakip namun cheh-a umun lang, nisagi nileh aumna mun'a konin koimacha potdoh hihhen, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chutichun mipi chu nisagi nin acholdo taovin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Israel insung chun hichu amin manna asah-un ahi. Hichu pathikhom mu tobanga bangleh ahin, atuidan chu khoijutoh kihala kisem changlhah tobang ahi.","ref":"Minb 11:7-8."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Hiche thilhi Pakai thupeh chu ahi, Egypt gama kona kapuidoh laijuva gamthipma kavahnao changlhah chu amutheina diuvin; nakhang khanguva umjing dingin omer dimkhat koijun, ati."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Aaron henga, Bel khat lan lang asunga chun manna omer dimkhat koijin; hichu nakhang khanguva umjing dingin Pakai angsunga koijin, ati.","ref":"Heb 9:4"},"34":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi thu apehbang chun chin jing dingin hettohsahna angsunga chun akoitan ahi."},"35":{"text":"Hitichun Israel chaten alo dingu gamsung ahung lhun kahseovin, kum somli sung chun manna chu aneovin; Canaan gam gamgiho ahunglhun kahseovin manna chu aneuvin ahi.","ref":"Josh 5:12"},"36":{"text":"Tun omer khat chu ephah hop soma hopkhat ahi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate kikhom khom pumpi chu Sin gamthipma konchun akipatdoh kitnun, Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Rephidim'a chun gebuh asongun ahi. Chuin chukoma chun mipi ho donding twi aumtapon ahi.","title":"Songpi-a Kon Twi (Minb 20:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Hijeh chun mipi chun Mosi akinah piuvin ajah-a, Kadon dinguvin twi neipeovin atiuvin ahi. Chuin Mosi'n ahenguva, Ipi dinga kei neiki nahpiu ham? Ipi dinga Pakai chu napatep uham? ati."},"3":{"text":"Chumuna chun mipi chu twi ngaichan adangchah taovin; chule mipichu Mosi chunga chun aphun uvin, ajah-a, Ipi dinga keiho le kachateu chule kagancha hou hi dangchah-a thigamsah dinga Egypt gama kona neipuidoh-u ham? atiuvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Mosi Pakai henga akapmin, Hiche mipi hohi i-kaloding hitam? amahon keima songa selih ding eigo taove, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Mipi masanga chun chen, chule Israel upaho chu kipuijin; chule vadung navohna tenggol chu nakhutna kichoijin lang, chen."},"6":{"text":"Ven, keima namasanga um Horeb songpi chunga khu kadin ding; chule nangman songpi chu navoh ding, hichea kona chu twi hungput doh-a, hichu mipin adonthei dingu ahi, ati. Hitichun Mosi'n Israel upaho mitmu tahchun hitichun aboltan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Israel chaten Mosi akinahpi jeh-u le Pakai chu ilah uva umam umhih-em, tia Pakai chu apatep jeh uvin, aman chuche mun chu Massah le Meribah asah tan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chujouvin Amalek mite chu ahungun, Rephidim mun'a chun Israelte chu ahungsat taovin ahi.","title":"Amalek Mite Toh Kisat"},"9":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Joshua jah-a, Ilah uva mi lhengdoh-in, chule cheovinlang Amalek mite khu gakisat piuvin: jingtengle kakhutna Pathen tenggol choipuma lhang chungvuma kadin ding ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chutichun Mosi'n ahenga aseibang chun Joshua'n abolin, Amalek mite akisatpi taovin: chuin Mosi, Aaron le Hur chu lhangvuma chun akaltou taovin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Mosi'n akhut adopsang phatle Israelte chun ajou jiuvin; aman akhut adoplhah phat phatle Amalek mite chun ajou jiuvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahin Mosi khut chu ahung khamtan; chuin amanin song alalhonin, anoija akoilhonin, ama achunga atouvin; chule Aaron le Hur chu asih langkhat gela apang lhonin, akhut teni chu adomsang jing lhonin; chutichun akhut chu nisalhum kahsen det tah-in apang tan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chutah chun Joshua'n Amalek le amite chu chemjamin ajoutan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Hichehi hetjinga aumna dingin lekhabua suninlang, Joshua nabenga jong jahsah kitnin;
