Chule amahon Mosi thusei bangchun abolcheh-un ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Aaron henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Thempu-a Dinga Dan"},"9":{"text":"Nangma nahin, naumpi nachate ahiuvin, houkhom ho houbuh sunga nachelut tenguleh ju ahiloule khamnathei nadonlou dingu ahi, achuti loule nathi dingu ahi: hichehi nakhang khanguva a-itih-a dinga chonna dan hiding,"},"10":{"text":"Chutia chu nanghon atheng le athenglou, chule angim le angimlou nase khen theijuva,"},"11":{"text":"Chule nanghon Israel chateho chu Pakaiyin Mosi khutna amaho aseipeh chondan jouse nahil theina dingu ahi, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Aaron le akidalha achapateni Eleazar le Ithamar henga, Meija kisem Pakai henga thilto lah-a aval anneh thilto chu laovin lang, hichu chol beijin maicham panga chun neovin: ajehchu hichu atheng chungnung ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 6:14-18."},"13":{"text":"Chule nanghon hichu muntheng mun'a chu naneh dingu ahi: ajehchu hichu meija kisem Pakai henga ganlhaina ho lah-a nangma chan chule nachapate chan hija ahi: hitia hi keima eina kithupeh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule jap thilto a-op le dop thilto adahbul chu nangma le nachapaten, chule nangma toh umkhom nachanuten muntheng khatna naneh diu ahi: ajehchu hicheho chu Israel chate chamna thilto ganlhainaho-a kona kipedoh nangma chan chule nachapate chan chu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 7:30-34"},"15":{"text":"Dop thilto adahbul le jap thilto a-op chu amahon Pakai anga jap thilto-a ajap dinga meija kisem athao thilto chutoh ahin choitha dingu; chule hichu Pakai athupeh dungjuija a-itih-a chondan hidinga, nangma le naumpi nachapate chanding hiding ahi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n chonset thilto kelcha chu hoitah-in akholin ahile, veuvin, hichu akahvam tan ahi: hichun ahing nalai Aaron chapateni Eleazar le Ithamar chunga chun alung ahangin, hitihin aseitai,"},"17":{"text":"Ipiding jeh penna nanghon chonset thilto chu theng chungnung ahi ti henasa le Pathen'in hichu houkhom ho chonkhelna poding le Pakai anga amaho dinga longlhenna bolna dinga nangho napeh-u ahi ti henasa-a munthenga naneh lou uham?","ref":"Thmpu 6:24-26"},"18":{"text":"Veovin, athisan chu muntheng sunga ahin kichoilut poi: keiman kathupeh banga, tahbeh-a nanghon hichu munthenga nananeh ding dolu ahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Aaron'in Mosi henga, Ven, tuni kho-a hi amahon achonset thiltou leh agovam thiltou Pakai anga atou ahin chule hitobang thil hohin eilhun khumtai. Chule keiman tuni hin chonset thilto chu ana netaleng, hichu Pathen mitmun san hinantem? ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n hichu ajah phatnin, alunglhai tan ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Nehthei le Nehmo Saho (Danb 14:3-21)"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate henga hitihin seipeh lhonin, Hiche hohi leiset chunga sa ho jouse lah-a naneh diu saho chu ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Sa jouse lah-a kon akengtin kikhena, atin ni-a kika, chule anehsa ihdoh kitna lhaikit tapou chu naneh dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hijeng jongle hiche hohin anehsa ihdoh kitna lhaikitnu henglang, atinnu kika jong le naneh lou dingu ahi: Sangongsang hin anehsa a-ihdoh kitnin alhainan, ahin akengtin akikah loujeh-in; ama chu nangho dinga athenglou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule jupi khun anehsa a-ihdoh kitnin alhainan, ahin atin akikah loujeh-in, ama chu nangho dinga athenglou ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule telep khun anehsa a-ihdoh kitnin alhainan, atin akikah loujeh-in, ama chu nangho dinga athenglou ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule vohcha khu akengtin akikhena atin akikah jeng vangin, anehsa a-ihdoh-a alhailou jeh-in, ama chu nangho dinga thenglou ahi."},"8":{"text":"Amaho sa naneh lou dingu, chuleh athilong jong natohkhah lou dingu ahi. Amaho nangho dinga athenglou ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Hichehohi twilah-a um naneh dingu jouse chu ahi: twilah-a um alha le alip neitapou, twikhanglen ho-a um hihen, vadung ho-a um hijongle, hicheho chu naneh dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule alha le alip neilou ho jouse, twikhanglen ho-a um hihen, chule vadung ho-a um hijongle, twi lah-a chatle thei jouse le twilah-a um ahingthei jouse chu, nangho-a dinga thet umtah hiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amachu nangho dinga thet umtah hiding ahin; nanghon asa-u chu naneh loudiu, athilong hou chu thet uma nahet joh dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Twilah-a um alha le alip neilou tapou hu nangho dinga thet umtah hiding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule hiche hohi vachaho lah-a nanghon thil thet uma nahet dingu chu ahi; nanghon hicheho chu nanehlou dingu ahin, amaho thet umtah ahiuve: mulaopi, muvanlai chule mungagal."},"14":{"text":"Muthong le, mu chilhah jouse:"},"15":{"text":"Va-ah tincheng le achilhah jouse;"},"16":{"text":"sumbupi, lhang simbu le kakhut, chule muthi le achilhah jouse,"},"17":{"text":"Chuleh sumbu neo, twivatot vom, chule sumbupi,"},"18":{"text":"Chule twivatot, twilen vamuhsao, chule chammu,"},"19":{"text":"Twiva, Vakengsang chule achilhah jouse, chule Vashonglhu chule bah."},"20":{"text":"Tolla vah vacha jouse, akeng li-a che ho jouse chu nangho dinga thet umtah hiding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hijongle nanghon nanehthei tolla vah kengli nei ahia lengle thei hochu, lei chunga chople nathei ding akengphang chunguva kengho neichan chu;"},"22":{"text":"Amaho lah-a kona hicheho hi naneh thei dingu ahi; khaokho leh achilhah, khaonam leh achilhah, lhenglhe le achilhah, chule khaokhopi le achilhah."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla adang tolla vah kengli nei ahia lengthei jouse chu nangho dinga thet umtah hiding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule hicheho jeh-a hi nangho athenglou nahi dingu ahi: koi hile amaho thilong tongkha chu nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule koi hileh amaho thilong pokha chun apon akisop ding ahin, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Sa akeng tin kikah-a ahia ni kisolou leh anehsa ihdoh-a lhailou taphot thilong chu nangho dinga aboh ahin; atongkha tapou chu aboh hiding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule akeng li-a che gamsa jouse lah-a, akhophanga chetapou chu nangho dinga aboh ahi; koi hileh amaho thilong tongkha chan chu nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule amaho thilong pokha chanchun aponho akisop ding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi; amaho chu nangho dinga aboh ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hicheho jong hi leichunga vah ganhingho lah-a nangho dinga aboh hiding ahiuve; kongkoi, jucha, sumkong le achilhah,"},"30":{"text":"Chule khoili, thangkip, tangnam, dahdeng chule bui,"},"31":{"text":"Hicheho hi avathoho jouse lah-a nangho dinga aboh hochu ahiuve: koi hileh amaho athi nunguva tongkha chan chu nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule ipi hitaleh hicheho hin athi nungule alhah khum pennu chu aboh hiding ahi: thinga kisem umle bel hihen, von hihen, vun hihen, dip hihen, chule itobang umle bel hihen ipi tobang bolna-a kimangcha hijongle, hichu twija delut ding ahin, chule hichu nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi; chutengle atheng hibep ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule hicheho chun akheh khum leibel tapou chu, asunga chu ipi uma hijongle aboh hiding; chuleh nanghon leibel chu nasukeh dingu ahi."},"34":{"text":"Nehthei anneh jouse lah-a chutobang twijin ajotkhum tapou chu aboh hiding: chule chutobang lhenga kona kidon tapou jongchu aboh hiding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chule hicheho thilong halkhat nin alhahkhum thil tapou chu aboh hiding ahin; tapkong hihen, bel kitunggol hijongle, hicheho chu suhset hiding ahi: ajehchu hicheho chu aboh ahin, chule nangho dinga aboh hiding ahiuve."},"36":{"text":"Hijeng jongle twinah ahiloule komtong twi nengtah-a aumna mun chu atheng hiding ahi: ahinla ipi hijongle hicheho thilong tongkha chan chu aboh hiding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chule hicheho thilong halkhat chun tuding muchi khattou akheh khuma ahile, hiche chu atheng hiding ahi."},"38":{"text":"Ahinla amuchi chunga chun twi themkhat akikoija, chule hicheho thilong halkhat chu hiche chunga chu achuh-a ahile, hichu nangho dinga aboh hiding ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chule naneh theiju saho lah-a kona khattou athia ahile; athilong tongkha chanchu nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chule chuche thilong nekha chun aponho akisop ding, nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi. Chule chuche thilong popa jongchun aponho akisop ding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chule leichunga kitholtho ganhing tapou chu thet um hiding ahi; hichu nehlou helding ahi."},"42":{"text":"Ipi hitaleh a-oija kithol, kenglia chetho, ahilouleh leichunga kithol tho ganhingho lah-a keng tampi neija kitholtho ho, hicheho chu nanehlou dingu ahi; ajehchu hicheho chu nangho dinga thet um ahiuve."},"43":{"text":"Nangho akitholtho ganhing tapouva naki suhboh louhel dingu, chule naboh louna dinguva amaho-a kona jong nakisuhnet lou dingu ahi."},"44":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahi. Hijeh-a chu nangho nakisuh thenguva, atheng nahi dingu ahi; ajehchu Keima atheng kahi. Chule leichunga kitholtho ganhing tapouva nangho le nangho naki suhboh lou dingu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:2; 1 Pet 1:16"},"45":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile keima na-Pathen'u hidinga Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh uva Pakai chu kahi; Hiche jeh-a chu nangho nathen dingu ahi; ajehchu keima atheng kahi."},"46":{"text":"Hichehi saho, vachaho, twilah-a vahle ahingthei jouse, chule leichunga kitholthoho chung changa dan chu ahi;"},"47":{"text":"Aboh le atheng khenna dingle, sa nehthei le nehtheilou kisekhen theina dinga ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati.","title":"Nao Neijouva Numei Kisuhthengna"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate henga hitihin seijin, Numei khatnin nao avopma cha pasal ahina ahile, amanu chu ni sagi aboh hiding; anumei hina-a athenlou nikhoho dungjuija aboh hiding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule niget chan nileh naosen chep chu kitanding ahi.","ref":"Semt 17:12; Luk 2:21"},"4":{"text":"Chule amanu chun athisan kisuhtheng na-a nisomthum le nithum gei ajomding; akisuh thengna nikho alhin kahse-a munthenga jong lut louding chule thiltheng tapou jong atoh khah thei lou ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla amanun numei ahina ahile, anumei hina athenlouna nikho dungjuija hapta ni aboh hiding ahi. Chule amanu chun thisana akisuh thengna chu ni somgup le nigup ajompeh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule amanu kisuhthengna nikhoho alhin tengle, amanun chapa-a ding, ahiloule chanua dinga govam thilto dinga kelngoinou kumkhat lhingbep khat; chule chonset thilto dinga vakhu nou ahiloule vapal khat houkhom ho Houbuh phunga chu thempupa henga ahinchoi ding:"},"7":{"text":"Aman hichu Pakai anga ato-a, amanu dinga longlhena abolpeh ding: chule amanu chu athilonna-a kona chu suhtheng hiding ahi. Hiche cha pasal ahilouleh cha numei hingnu-a dinga dan chu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule ijemtia amanun kelngoinou ahinchoi joutah louva ahileh, amanun vapal ni ahiloule vakhu nou ni; khat govam thilto ding chule adang khat chu chonsetna thilto dinga ahinchoi ding: thempu chun amanu dinga longlhena abolpeh-a, chule amanu chu theng ding ahi.","ref":"Luk 2:24."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Phah Thudola Danthu"},"2":{"text":"Mikhatnin atahsa chung avuna abohdoh khat, akhih khat, ahiloule akangdoh laikhat ahin neija, chule hichu atahsa vunna phah natna tobang ahia ahile, chuteng ama chu Aaron thempupa ahilouleh achapate thempupaho henga nahin pui dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun tahsa vuna hise chu avetding; chule natna laija timul chu ahung kana, chule natna kimuchu atahsa vun sanga athuh johle, hiche chu phahna hise ahi: chule thempupan ama chu avetna, chule amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ijemtia atahsa vuna ahung ngoudoh lai chu ahung kana, chule mutheija avun sanga athuhjoh louva, chule atimul chu ahung kan louva ahile, thempupa chun chuche hise neipa chu ni sagi akhatup ding:"},"5":{"text":"Chule ni sagi lhin nileh thempupa chun amachu avetna, chule veuvin, anatna chu amitmua atan dena, chule hise chu avuna chal louva amule, thempupa chun amachu ni sagi akhatup beding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule ni sagi lhin nileh thempupa chun amachu avetkitna, chule veuvin, hise chu avomthima, chule hise chu avuna chal louva amule, thempupa chun ama chu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: akhihbou ahi; amachun aponho akisopma, atheng hiding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla akisuhtheng nadinga thempupa akimupi jouva, akhih chu avuna achallheh jenga ahile, amachu thempupan avetkit ding:"},"8":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun avetna, akhih chu avuna challa amuleh, chutengle thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu phahnat ahi."},"9":{"text":"Phahna hise chu mikhat chunga aumteng, amachu thempupa henga kipuiding ahin;"},"10":{"text":"Chule thempupan amachu avetna, veuvin, avuna apomdoh lai vun chu akana, hichun amul chu akansah-a, chule apomdoh laija chu vouthah-a amua ahile,"},"11":{"text":"Amapa vuna chu phahna lui uma ahin, thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh-a, akhatup louding ahi: ajehchu ama phah-a ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule phahna chu avuna ahung jaldoh-a, chule phahna chun hise neipa vun chu thempupan avetna lam jouse aluchanga patna akeng phang geija atomsoh hela ahile,"},"13":{"text":"Chutengle thempupan angaito ding: chule veuvin, phahna chun amapa tahsa pumpi chu atoma ahile, thempupan hise veipa chu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi. Aboncha keija hung kang soh-a ahitan, amachu atheng hiding ahitai."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla ama-a chu vouthah ahungdoh-a ahile, amachu aboh hiding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule thempupan hiche vouthah chu avetna, amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: ajehchu vouthah chu aboh-a ahin, hichu phahnat ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahiloule vouthah chu ahung kikhel kitna, chule akang ahung kiso kitna ahile, amachu thempupa henga hung ding;"},"17":{"text":"Chule thempupan ama avetding; chuleh veuvin, hise chu akanga ahung kikhel kitna ahile, thempupan hise veipa chu atheng ahitai tia aphondoh ding ahi: amachu thenga ahitai."},"18":{"text":"Atahsa ativuna chu uilut ahungdoh-a, chule hichu adam tah-a,"},"19":{"text":"Chule uilut umna mun'a chu ahung pomdoh akang, ahiloule ahung ngoudoh laikhat auma, chule iti hama santhim dana auma ahileh, hichu thempupa henga vetsah ding ahi:"},"20":{"text":"Chule hichu thempupan avetna, avun sanga thuhjoa amua, chulai mun'a amulchu akanga kikhela ahile, thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu uilutna kona hung sohdoh phahna hise chu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ahinla, thempupan hichu avetna, chule veuvin, hia chu amul akang aumlouva, chule hichu avun sanga athuhjoh louva, avomthima ahile, chuteng chule thempupan amachu ni sagi akhatup ding:"},"22":{"text":"Chule hichu avuna akithe jala ahile, thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu hise ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla ahung ngoudoh laichu angai ngai ahijinga, achal louva ahile, hichu uilut ahibouvin; chule thempupan amachu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ahiloule mihem khat meijin atahsa akah-a, meijin akahna aphelai laijachu ahung vamdoh, asanthim ahiloule akang auma ahile,"},"25":{"text":"Chutengle hichu thempupan avetding, chule veuvin, ahung vamdohdoh laija amulchu ahung kana, chule avun sanga agathuh lutna ahileh, hichu meikah-a kona hung potdoh phahnat ahi. Hiteng chule thempupan amachu athenglou ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu phah hise ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ahinla thempupan hichu avetna, chuleh ahung vamdoh laija chu amulkang umlouva, chule hichu avun dangho sanga athuhjoh louva, avomthima ahile, thempupan amachu ni sagi akhatup ding:"},"27":{"text":"Chule ni sagi lhin nile thempupan amachu avetding, chule veuvin, avun sunga chu hichu nasatah-a akithejala ahile, thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu phahna hise ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule ahung vamdoh laichu angai ahijinga, chule avuna akithejal louva, ahia hichu avom thima ahile, hichu meikah-a kona hung duldoh ahin: thempupan amachu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi; ajehchu meikah jeh-a hung khidoh ahibouve."},"29":{"text":"Pasal ham numei ham aluchang ham ahilouleh akhamul hama chu hise aneija ahile,"},"30":{"text":"Chuteng thempupan hise chu avetding, chule veuvin, hichu avun sanga agathuhlut joh-a, chule chua chu ai-eng ena eng mulngat khat auma ahile; chuteng thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu tithah luchunga ahilouleh khamula um phahna ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule thempupan tithah hise chu avetna, chule veuvin, hichu avun sanga agathuh lutjoh louva, chule chuche-a chu mulvom aumlouva ahile, thempupan tithah hise neipa chu ni sagi akhatup ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule ni sagi lhin nileh thempupan hise chu avetding, chule veuvin, tithah chu kithejal louva, chule hichea chu ai-eng enna eng amul jong aumlouva, chule tithah chu avun sanga agathuh lutjoh louva ahile;"},"33":{"text":"Amachu amul hetngima umding, amavang tithah laichu ahetngim louding ahi; chule thempupan tithah neipa chu nisagi akhatup beding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chule ni sagi alhin nile thempupan tithah chu avetding, chule veuvin, tithah chu avuna akithejal louva, ahiloule avun sanga jong agathuh lutlouva ahile, thempupan amachu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding; chule amachun aponho akisopma, chule atheng hiding ahitai."},"35":{"text":"Ahinla akisuhngim jouva tithah chu avuna akithejala ahileh;"},"36":{"text":"Chuteng thempu pan ama avet ding, chule veuvin, tithah chu avuna akithejala ahile, thempu pan ai-eng eng mul aholkhoh louding ahi: ama athenglou ahitai."},"37":{"text":"Ahinla tithah chu aumdenna, chule chuche mun'a chu mulvom ahung kedoh-a, chule tithah chu adam tah-a ahile, amachu atheng ahitai: thempupan amachu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi."},"38":{"text":"Pasal ham ahiloule numei hamin atahsa vuna chu ahung vamdoh, akang hung vamdoh aneija ahile;"},"39":{"text":"Chuteng thempupan avetding ahi: chule ativun ahung vamdoh hochu akangdup leh, hichu avuna tikang hung umdoh-a ahin; ama atheng ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chule pasal alua kona asam pullha-a chu luchai ahin, atheng ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chule pasal alujang mailam panga asam pullha-a chu dehchai ahin; ama atheng ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chule ijemtia aluchai ahiloule adehchai laija chu tina sandang khat ahung bohdoh-a ahile, hichu aluchai ahiloule adehchai laija phahnat hung pongdoh chu ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chuteng thempupan hichu avetding, chule veuvin, aluchai ahiloule dehchai laija tina hung bohdoh chu tivun danga phahna hung pongdoh tobanga asandang ahile;"},"44":{"text":"Amachu miphah ahin, aboh ahitai: thempupan amachu aboh tahbeh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi; hise chu alujanga uma ahitai."},"45":{"text":"Chule hise neija miphah chun aponho abokeh ding, chule alu tol puma ane chunglam akhu ding, chuleh athenglou, athenglou, tia asapding ahi."},"46":{"text":"Ama-a hise chu aum laisung nikhoho lhungkeija amachu suhboh hiding ahi; ama athenglou ahin; achanga chengding ahi: gebuh pamlam chu ama chenna ding ahi."},"47":{"text":"Phahna hise umna von jong chu, samul von hihen, tupat ponnel von, hijongleh,","title":"Phah Natna Nei Von Chungchanga Danthu"},"48":{"text":"Akikhonto hihen akisahtho hihen, tupatpon hihen, samul pon hijongleh, savun hihen ahilouleh savuna kisem thilkhat pou pou hijongleh,"},"49":{"text":"Hise chu von akikhontho ham, akisahtho ham, savun ham, savun thil itobang khat pou pouva eng danga ahilouleh sandanga abe-a ahile, hichu phahna hise ahin; chule thempupa henga vetsah ding ahi."},"50":{"text":"Chule thempupan hise chu avetding, chule hise po-a von chu ni sagi akhatup ding ahi."},"51":{"text":"Chule hise chu ni sagi lhin nileh avetding; hise chu von akikhontho ahiloule akisahtho chung, samul chung, savun chung, ahiloule savuna kisem ipi chung hijongle, hise chu akithe jala ahile; hise chu tijat umtah phahnat ahi: hichu aboh ahi."},"52":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu aman chuche von chu akikhontho hihen, akisahtho hile, samula hihen, tupatna hile, ahilouleh savun thil ipi hitaleh ahallhah ding ahi; ajehchu tijat umtah phahnat ahin; hichu meija hallhah ding ahi."},"53":{"text":"Chule thempupan avetna, chule hise chu von akikhongtho hihen, akisahtho hileh, ahilouleh savun thil kiti pou pouva chu kithejal louva ahile;"},"54":{"text":"Chutengle thempupa chun hise umna thil chu asop dinguva amaho athupeh ding, chule ni sagima hichu akhatup beding:"},"55":{"text":"Chule hichu akisop jouteng thempupan hise chu avetding, chule veuvin, hise chu avouso akikhelchom louva, chule hise chu akithejal louva ahile; hichu aboh ahin; nangman hichu meija nahalding ahi: hichu asunglama tijat umtah ahin; asung hihen apolam hijongle aneh ahitai."},"56":{"text":"Chule thempupan avetna, chule veuvin, hise chu akisop jouva avom thima ahile, chuteng hichu vona kona, savuna kona, ahilouleh akikhontho le akisahtho-a kona asalhah ding ahi."},"57":{"text":"Chule hichu von chunga akikhontho hihen, akisahtho hijongleh, chule savun pon pou pou chunga chu akilah nahlaija ahile, hichu akithejal hise ahin; nangman hise chu meija nahalding ahi."},"58":{"text":"Chule von, akikhontho hihen, akisahtho hileh, ahilouleh savuna kisem itobang von hitaleh nasop ding, chule hichea kona chu hise chu apotdoh-a ahile, ani veina nasop kitding; chutengle atheng hiding ahitai."},"59":{"text":"Hiche hohi von samula hihen, tupatna hile, akikhontho hihen, akisahtho hijongleh, ahilouleh savun thilkhat pou pouva phahna hise umchu atheng ahi, ahilouleh athenglou ahi tia phondohna ding dan chu ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Miphah Suhthengna ding Dan"},"2":{"text":"Hichehi miphah kisuhtheng nikho-a juiding dan chu ahi. Amachu thempupa henga ahinpui dingu;","ref":"Matt 8:4; Mrk 1:44; Luk 5:14; 17:14"},"3":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun gebuh-a kona potdoh ding; chule thempupa chun avetding, chule veuvin miphahpa chunga hise chu adam tah-a ahile;"},"4":{"text":"Chuteng thempupan akisuhtheng dingpa henga kona chu vacha theng ahing ni, chuleh Cedar thing, ponsanthip le Hyssop lah dinga athupeh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun vacha ho lah-a khat chu leibel sunga twi lona chunga nathadiu ahi, tia athupeh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Vacha ahingpa chu ahile, cedar thing, Ponsandup chule Hyssop chu alah-a, hicheho chu vacha hing chutoh twi long chunga kithat vacha thisana chu adelut ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule aman aphahna akona kisutheng dingpa chunga sagi vei athin ding, chule amapa chu atheng ahitai tia aphondoh ding, chule vacha hing chu gam onga alha mang ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule akisutheng dingpa chun aponho asopma, chule asam jouse ahet tolla, ama athen theina dinga twija gakisil ding ahi. Chujou teng chule ama gebuh sunga hunglut ding, aponbuh pama ni sagi khongai nalai ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahinla ni sagi lhin ni-a chu aman aluchanga asam jouse, akhamul chuleh amitchung mul jouse, amulho jouse ahet ngima, chule aman aponho asopma, ama tahsa jeng jong twija asil ding ahi, chule ama theng ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule niget lhin nileh aman nolna beihel kelngoinou chal ni leh, nolna beihel kelngoinou anu kumkhat lhingbep khat, chule anneh thilto ding changbong nel thao toh kihal ephah hopsom-a hopthum, chule thao log khat ahin choiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule ama suthenga pang thempupa chun akisutheng dingpa le chuche thil ho chu houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga apehlut ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun kelngoinou khat chule thao log khat chu alah-a, suhkhel thilto dinga ato-a, chule Pakai angsunga jap thilto-a ajap ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule aman kelngoinou chu chonset thilto chule govam thilto athana ding munthenga mun'a chu athading ahi; ajehchu chonset thilto thempupa-a ahibanga, suhkhel thilto jong chutobangma chu hija ahin; hichu atheng chungnung ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun suhkhel thilto thisan chu phabep alah-a, thempupan hichu akisutheng dingpa jetlam bilmong, akhut jetlam khutpi chung, le akeng jetlam kengpi chunga anuding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule thempupan thao log khatna kona chu phabep alah-a, aveilam khutphang chunga alheilhah ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule thempupan akhut veilama um thaova chu akhut jetlam khut jung adelutna, akhut junga thao chu Pakai anga sagivei athe ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule akhutna umnalai thao amohse chu thempupa chun akisutheng dingpa jetlam bilmong, ajetlam khutpi, ajetlam kengpi chunga, chule suhkhel thilto thisan chunga chu anuding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule thempupa khutna thao umnalai amohchu aman akisutheng dingpa lujanga asunlhah ding, chule thempupan ama dinga chu Pakai anga longlhena abolpeh ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun chonset thilto chu ato-a, athen louna-a kona kisutheng dingpa-a dinga longlhenna abolpeh ding; chule aman govam thilto chu athading ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule thempupan maicham chunga um govam thilto le anneh thilto chu atoding, chule thempupan ama dinga longlhena abolpeh ding: chuteng ama atheng hiding ahitai."},"21":{"text":"Ahinla ama chu mivaicha ahia, chuchengpi chu atojou louva ahile, aman alonglhena kibolna dinga suhkhel thilto-a jap dinga kelngoinou khat ahin kaiding; chule anneh thilto-a dinga changbong neljet thao toh kihal ephah hopsom-a hopkhat le thao log khat,"},"22":{"text":"Chule aman amujou dandana vapal ni ahiloule vakhu nou ni; khat chu chonset thilto ding le adang khat chu govam thilto dinga ahinchoi ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule hicheho chu aman niget lhin nileh akisuhtheng nadinga thempupa henga, houkhom ho Houbuh kotphunga Pakai angsunga chu ahin choiding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun suhkhel thilto kelngoinou leh thao log dimkhat chu alah ding, chule thempupa chun hichu Pakai anga jap thilto ato ding;"},"25":{"text":"Chuteng aman suhkhel thilto kelngoinou chu athading, chule thempupa chun chuche suhkhel thilto thisan phabep chu alah-a, akisutheng dingpa jetlam bilmong chunga, ajetlam khutpi chunga, chule ajetlam kengpi chunga anuding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun thao chu ama khutphang veilam chunga alheilhah ding,"},"27":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun akhut veilama um thao chu ajetlam khutjunga sagi vei Pakai angsunga athe ding,"},"28":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun akhutna thao chu akisutheng dingpa jetlam bilmong chunga, ajetlam akhutpi chung, ajetlam kengpi chunga, chule suhkhel thilto thisan chunga chu anuding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chule thempupa khutna aum nalaiho sechu, aman akisutheng dingpa lujanga anua, amapa-a dinga chu Pakai anga longlhena abolpeh ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chule aman amapan amujou dungjuija ahinchoi vakhu teni ahilou leh vapal nou teni chu lah-a, khat chu atoding,"},"31":{"text":"Amapan amujou dungjuija khat chonset thilto dinga, chule adang khat chu anneh thilto le govam thilto dinga ahinchoi ding, chule thempupa chun Pakai anga akisutheng dingpa chu longlhena abolpeh ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hichehi koi hileh phah hise veija, akhutna akisuhtheng nadinga kimujou louho chunga kimang ding dan chu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Chenna In Phah"},"34":{"text":"Keiman nalodiuva kapeh-u Canaan gam nahung lutnuva, chule keiman nalonao gamsunga chu insung khatna phah hise kachuhsah tengleh;"},"35":{"text":"Chuche inneipa chu thempupa henga hunga, Insunga hin hise khat um bangin kahe-e, tia aseiding ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chutengle thempupa chun chuche insunga umjouse chu abona aboh ahilouna dinga, ama hise phochen dinga insunga asunglhah masanga, a-in chu amahon asuh-ong nadiuva thupeh apehding ahi. Chujou tengle thempupa chu insung vedinga sunglha ding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chule aman hise avetna, chule veuvin, hise chu in-bang dunga auma, engdang ahilouleh sandang banga akilah-a, bang sanga athuhlut joh-a ahile,"},"38":{"text":"Chuteng thempupa chu insunga kona kotphunga hungdoh-a, a-in chu nisagi akhatup ding ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chule thempupa chu nisagi nile hungkitna, avetding, chule hise chu chuche inbang ho-a ana challa ahile;"},"40":{"text":"Chuteng thempupa chun hise umna in'a song ho chu alahdoh diuva athupeh ding, chule amahon song ho chu khopi pam muntheng lou khatna aselut dingu;"},"41":{"text":"Chule aman a-insung kimvel chu ahet theng sah ding, chule amahon ahet lhah-u vutvai chu khopi pam muntheng lou mun khatna agasun lhah dingu ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chule amahon song chombeh alah uva, chuche songho umna-a chu akoikhel dingu, chule aman leingan dang alah-a, in chu aloithah ding ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chule ijemtia aman songho alahdoh-a, a-in chu ahet ngima, chule aloithah kit jouva, hise chu ahungkitna chuche insunga chu ahung sokitna ahile;"},"44":{"text":"Chutengle thempupa chu hunga avetding, chule hise chu insunga kithe jalsoh-a ahile; insunga chu tijat umtah hise chua ahitan; chule hichu athenglou ahitai."},"45":{"text":"Chule aman a-in, asongho, athing ho, chule aloina jouse asuhsetna, chule khopi polam muntheng lou laija apohdoh ding ahi."},"46":{"text":"Chujongle chuche in khachah-a aum laisungse-a chu koitobang agalutna aumle, amachu nilhah tokah-a atheng louva umding ahi."},"47":{"text":"Chule chuche insunga galum kha-a chun aponho akisopma, chule chuche insunga gane kha-a chun aponho akisop ding ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chule a-in kiloithah jouva chu thempupa ahung lutna, ahungvetna, chuleh a-insunga hise chu kithejal soh louva ahile; thempupa chun in chu atheng ahi tia aphonding ahi: ajehchu hise chu dama ahitai.","title":"Insung Suhtheng Dan"},"49":{"text":"Chule aman in suhtheng nadinga vacha ni, Cedar thing le Ponsanthip, chuleh Hyssop alah ding,"},"50":{"text":"Chule vacha teni lah-a khat chu leibel sunga twilong chunga athading,"},"51":{"text":"Chule aman cedar thing, hyssop, ponsanthip, chule vahing chu alah-a, vacha kithat thisan sungle twi longa adelut ding, chule in chu sagi vei athekhum ding;"},"52":{"text":"Chule aman vacha thisana, twilonga, Cedar thinga, hyssopma, chule ponsanthipma in chu asuhtheng ding ahi."},"53":{"text":"Ahin aman vacha hing vangchu khopi pampeh gam onga agalha doh ding; chule chuche insung dinga chu longlhena abolding; chule hichu atheng hiding ahitai."},"54":{"text":"Hiche hi phah hise jouse le tithah jouse,"},"55":{"text":"Chule vonphah, inphah,"},"56":{"text":"Apomdoh, akhihdoh, chule avamdoh-a dinga dan chu ahin,"},"57":{"text":"Athenlou pet le athen pet kihetna dinga kihilna chu ahi: hiche hi phah chung changa dan chu ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Numei le Pasal Thilonga Kona Thenlouna"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate henga thu seilhonin lang, ajah uva hitin seilhonin, Pasal khattou atahsa-a kona longdoh thi neija ahile, hiche athi lonjeh-a chu amachu aboh hiding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hiche hi athilong doh-a kona abohna hiding ahi: athi longdoh atahsa-a kona ahung londoh jenga, ahiloule atahsa-a kona alondohsah da-a ahijongle, amachu athenglou ahi."},"4":{"text":"Thilongdoh neipa galupna jalkhun tapou chu aboh ahin, chule ama toupha thil jouse jongchu aboh hiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule thilongdohpa lupna tongkha tapou chun aponho asop ding, amatah twija kisil ding, chule nilhah kah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule thilongdoh pa toupha thil tapou chunga gatouva chun aponho asop ding, amatah twija kisil ding, chule nilhah kah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule thilongdoh neipa tahsa tongkha tapou chun aponho akisop ding, amatah twija kisil ding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule thilongdohpa chun mi atheng khattou achil aset khum khah-a ahileh, amapan aponho asopding, amatah twija kisil, chule nilhah kah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule thilongdohpa touna tapou chu aboh hiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule koi hile ama delpha thil tapou gatongkha chan chu nilhah kahse-a aboh hiding; chutobang thilho tapou pole-a chun aponho akisop ding, amatah twija kisil, chule nilhah kah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Koihileh thilongdohpa tongkha-a twija akhut teni soplou chun, aponho akisop ding, amatah twija kisil, chule nilhah kah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule thilongdoh pan atohkhah leija kisem umle bel tapou chu suhkeh ding, chule thinga kisem umle bel tapou chu twija silding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule thilong neipa chu athilon na-a kona suhthenga aumteng, aman akisuhtheng nading nisagi akisimdoh ding, aponho asopma, chule atahsa chu twilonga asil ding, chule atheng hiding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule aniget chan nileh aman vapal nou ni ahiloule vakhu ni akilah-a Pakai anga houkhom ho Houbuh kotphunga hunga chule hichu thempu apeh ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule thempu chun khat chu chonset thilto-a, chule adangkhat chu govam thilto-a atoding; chule thempupa chun Pakai anga athilondoh jeh-a chu ama dinga longlhena abolpeh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule pasal khattou abotwi achedoh tah-a ahile, aman atahsa twija asilding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule chuche abotwi chuhna pon le savunho jouse chu twija sopding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chujongle numei chu pasal to alupkhoma, amapa botwi chu apotdoh-a ahile, anilhona twija kisilding, chule nilhah kahse-a aboh hilhon ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule numei jin ama-a kona thil longdoh aneija, chule atahsa-a kona longdoh chu thisan ahia ahile; amanu chu ni sagi chom koidoh ding ahi: chule koi hileh amanu tongkha-a chu nilhah kahse-a aboh hiding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule amanun aga chom um sunga agalup pha chule aga toupha thil tapou ho chu aboh hiding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Koi hileh amanu jalkhun gatongkha tapou chun aponho asopding, amatah twija kisil ding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Koihileh amanun atoupha thil tapou gatongkha chun, aponho asopding, amatah twija kisil ding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Amanu jalkhun chunga um hihen, atoupha thil khattou hileh, amapan agatoh khah leh, amapa chu nilhah kahse-a aboh hiding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule pasal'in amanu aluppi jengtah-a, amanu thi chu amapa chunga abeleh, amapa chu ni sagi aboh hiding; chule alupna jalkhun jouse chu aboh hiding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule numei khatnin angaina banglouva nitamtah thi aneija, ahiloule achoma aumna phat valsetna thi aneija ahile; athilon na-a athenlouna nikhosung sese chu amanu achoma aumna nikho hiding ahi; amanu chu aboh hiding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Thilonga aumsung se-a alupna jalkhun tapou chu amanu dinga chom koidoh-a aumna jalkhun tobang ding ahi. Chuleh amanun atoupha thil tapou chu, achoma aum sunga aboh banga aboh hiding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule koihile chuche thilho tongkha-a chu aboh hiding ahin, aponho akisopma, amatah jong twija kisila, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ahinla athilonna-a kona chu athen tah-a ahile, amanun ama-a dinga nisagi akisimdoh ding, chujouteng amanu atheng hiding ahitai."},"29":{"text":"Chule aniget chanileh amanun vapal ni ahilouleh vapal nou ni akilah-a, houkhom ho houbuh kotkhah phunga thempupa henga ahin choiding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuteng thempupa chun khat chu chonset thilto-a, chule khat chu govam thilto-a ato ding, amanu thenlouna thilongdoh jeh-a chu amanu-a dinga Pakai angsunga longlhena abolpeh ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chutia chu amahon alah uva um houkhom ho houbuh chu asuhboh tenguleh, athenlou naova athilouna dinguva, nanghon Israel chate chu thenlouna-a kona nakhendoh dingu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hichehi ama-a kona thilondoh jeh le, abotwi chedoh jeh-a thenglouho,"},"33":{"text":"Chule athilon jeh-a dammo-a numei, chuleh athi longa pasal le numei, chule thinei numei lupia pasal ho-a dinga danthu chu ahi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aaron chapaten Pakai angsunga thilto aneipet lhona athilhon jouvin, Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin,","title":"Longlhenna nikho"},"2":{"text":"nasopi Aaron henga, athilouna dingin thingkhong chunga hepi touna masanga ponjal sunga um muntheng sunga aphat jouse-a ahunglut louna dingin seipeh-in; ajehchu hepi touna chunga chu keima meiloma kahung kilah ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Heb 6:19"},"3":{"text":"Aaron chu muntheng sunga hitia hi hunglut ding ahi: chonset thilto dinga bongchalnou khat, govam thilto dinga kelngoichal khat.","ref":"Heb 9:7"},"4":{"text":"Aman tupat sangkhol theng chu aki-ah-a, atahsa chunga chu tupat pon chu akichen ding, tupat konggah akigah-a, chule tupat lukhuh chu akikhuh ding ahi: hichehohi vontheng ahin, hijeh-a chu aman atahsa twija akisila, chuleh akivon ding bou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Israel chate houkhom ho-a kona chu chonset thilto-a dinga kelnou ni leh govam thilto-a dinga kelngoichal khat alahding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule Aaron'in ama chonset thilto bongchal chu ama dinga atoa, ama-a dingle a-insung dinga longlhena abolding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuteng aman kelcha ni chu alah-a, houkhom ho Houbuh kotkhah phunga Pakai angsunga apehdoh ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule Aaron'in kelcha ni chunga chu, khatchu Pakaiya dinga, chule adangkhat chu keldai dinga vangvetna aneiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule Aaron'in Pakaiya dinga vang chuhna kelcha chu ahinkaija, chonset thilto-a atoding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla keldai dinga achunga vang chuhna kelcha chu, longlhenna bolna-a mandinga ahinga Pakaiya apehlut ding, chule keldai dinga gamthipma agalhadoh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Aaron'in ama chonset thilto-a ding bongchal chu ahin kaija, ama le a-insung dinga longlhenna abolding, chule ama chonset thilto-a ding bongchal chu athading:"},"12":{"text":"Chule aman Pakai angsung maichama kona chu mei-am lhengkhat dim leh akhut dimsetna gimnamtui dimset kisubong chu alah ding, chule pondal sunga achoilut ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuteng aman hiche gimnamtui khu chun hettohsahna thingkhong chunga um hepi touna chu akhu-a chutia chu ama athi louna dinga, Pakai angsunga gimnamtui chu meisunga akoilutding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule aman bongchal thisan chu alah-a, hichu akhutjunga hepi touna chung solam sanga atheding; chule hepi touna maija chu thisan chu akhut junga sagivei atheding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chujouteng aman chonset thilto kelcha chu mipi ho-a dinga atha-a, athisan chu ponbuh sunga ahin choilutna, bongchal thisan abol banga chu abolding, chule hepi touna chung le hepi touna maija chu atheding ahi.","ref":"Heb 9:12."},"16":{"text":"Chule aman Israel chateho chu athenlou jeh-u le asuhkhel uva achonset jeh uva, munthenga dinga chu longlhenna abolpeh ding ahi: chule hitia chu athenlou nalah uva um houkhom ho houbuh-a dinga chu abolding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule ama muntheng sunga ama le a-insung ding, chule Israel houkhom ho jouse dinga longlhenna boldinga agalutna chule ahungdoh kahse-a, koimacha houkhom ho Houbuh sunga chu umlou ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule Pakai angsunga um maicham mun'a chu che-a, hiche dinga chu longlhenna aga bolding; chule bongchal thisan le kelcha thisan chu phabep alah-a, maicham sakiho chunga chu akoi kimvel ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule aman hiche chunga chu akhutjunga thisan sagivei athea, asuhthenga, Israel chate athenlou naova kona asuhtheng ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule aman muntheng le houkhom ho Houbuh chule maicham chu kichamna aboljou tengleh, kelcha hing chu ahin kaiding:","title":"Kelcha Kihinglha"},"21":{"text":"Chule Aaron'in akhut teni chu kelcha lujanga angapma, achunga chu Israel chateho khangitlouna jouse, asuhkhel nao jouse leh achonsetnao jouse aphondoh-a, kelcha lujanga akoija, chule mihem aboldinga kilom khat khutna gamthipma aga lhadohsah ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Kelcha chun amaho khangitlouna jouse chu achunga apoh-a, koima chen louna gama apohlut ding; chule mipa chun kelcha chu gamthipma agalha ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chujouteng Aaron chu houkhom ho houbuh sunga hunga, munthenga agalut petna avonho, tupat vonho chu asuhlhah-a, chua chu adalhah ding ahi.","ref":"Ezek 44:19."},"24":{"text":"Chule aman munthenga um twija atahsa akisila, avonho akivona, chule hungdoh-a govam thilto, mipi ho govam thilto chu atoding, chule ama-a ding le mipi ho-a dinga longlhenna abolding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule chonset thilto thao chu maicham chunga agoding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule keldai dinga kelcha galhadohpa chun aponho akisop ding, chule atahsa twija asila, chujouteng gebuh sunga hunglut ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule thisan munthenga longlhen bolna-a kipolut chonset thilto-a ding bongchal le chonset thilto-a ding kelcha chu khatnin gebuh pama apohdoh ding; chule amahon avunho, apheho le a-eh ho chu meija agodiu ahi.","ref":"Heb 13:11"},"28":{"text":"Hitiho meija gagoupa chun aponho asopding, ama chu twija atahsa akisil ding, chujouteng leh gebuh sunga hunglut ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chule hichehi nangho dinga a-itih-a chondan hiding ahi: lhasagi chana nisom lhin nikhole nanghon nahinnao nakisuh gim dingu, nagamsung miu hihen lang, gamdangmi nalah uva khopen hijongle natoh kiti him him natohlou dingu ahi.","title":"Longlhen Nikho Nitdingdan"},"30":{"text":"Ijeh inem itileh Pakai angsunga nachonset nahou jouse-a kona nathen theina dinguva, chuche nikho teng chuleh nangho suhthengna dinga thempun nangho dinga longlhenna nabolpeh dingu ahi."},"31":{"text":"Hiche nikho chu nangho dinga choldona dinga cholngah ni hiding, chule a-itih-a chondan hidinga nahinnao nasuh gim dingu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule aman apa khela thempu tohmuna natong dinga thao anua, akatdoh thempupa chun longlhenna chu abolding, chule tupat ponho le vontheng ho jeng jong chu akivon ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule aman munthenga dinga longlhenna abolding, maicham leh houkhom ho houbuh-a dinga longlhenna abolding, chule thempuho leh houkhom mipi ho-a dinga longlhenna abolding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Hichehi Israel chatea dinga kumkhatna khatvei achonset nahou jouse jeh-a longlhenna bolna dinga, nangho-a kipe a-itih-a chondan hiding chu ahi. Chuin aman Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin aboltan ahi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Thisan Thenje"},"2":{"text":"Aaron, achapate, chule Israel chate jouse henga hitin seijin; Hichehi Pakaiyin athupeh hochu ahi,"},"3":{"text":"Israel insung mi koihileh gebuh sung ahiloule gebuh pama bongchal ham, kelngoi ham, ahilouleh kelcha ham thatna auma,"},"4":{"text":"Pakai Houbuh masanga Pakai henga thilto-a to dinga houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga ahinchoi louva ahileh; thisan kiso mona chu aman akipoh ding ahi; aman thisan aso ahin; hiche mipa chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding:"},"5":{"text":"Hichu Israel chaten gam onga ganlhainaho abol hou chu ahin choijuva, Pakai henga, houkhom ho houbuh kotphung, thempupa henga ahin choijuva, Pakai henga chamna thilto-a dinga ato theina dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule thempu chun thisan chu houkhom ho houbuh kot phunga Pakai maicham chunga athea, chule athao chu Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga ahalding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule amahon anajonpiu thilhaho henga chu ganlhaina abolkit loudiu ahitai. Hichehi amaho dinga akhang akhanga a-itih-a chondanu hiding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule nangham amaho henga chu, Israel insungmi hihen ahiloule gamdang mi nangho lah-a hung khopem hijongle, koitobang govam thilto ganlhaina toh-a,"},"9":{"text":"Pakai henga todoh dinga houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga hinchoilou auma ahile; hiche mipa ngei chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule koitobang Israel insung mi hihen,ahilouleh gamdang mi nangho lah-a khopem hijongle thisan ne aumleh; thisan ne mi chu keiman kamaingat ding, chule amite lah-a kona kapaidoh ding ahi.","ref":"Semt 9:4; Thmpu 7:26-27; 19:26; Danb 12:16,23; 15:23."},"11":{"text":"Ijehnem itile tahsa hinna hi thisana um ahin: chule hichu nahinna uva dinga longlhen bolna dinga maicham chunga nangho kapeh nahiuve: ijeh inem itile hinna-a dinga longlhen bola chu thisan ahi.","ref":"Heb 9:12"},"12":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu, Nangho koimachan thisan nanehlou dingu, chule nalah uva khopem gamdangmi koimachan jong thisan anehlou ding ahi, tia Israel chate henga kasei ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule Israel chate lah-a kon hihen, ahiloule nalah uva khopem gamdangmi koihile gam galenga nehthei sa ahilouleh vacha gamana chun: athisan chu avatlhah sah-a, leivui avuhkhum ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu hichu tahsa jouse hinna ahi; athisan chu ahinna ahi. Hijeh-a chu, Nanghon tahsa jouse hinna hi athisanu ahijeh-a, itobang tahsa thisan hileh naneh louhel dingu ahi: koihileh anea aumle amachu paidoh hiding ahi, tia Israelte henga keiman kasei ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule nagam miteo hihen, ahilouleh gamdangmi hijongle, koitobang athikam ahilouleh gamsan athasa ne-a chun, aponho asopding, ama chu twija kisil ding, chule nilhah tokah-a athenglou hiding: chujou tengleh atheng hiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla aman aponho soplouva, atahsa akisil louva ahileh; akhangit louna akipoh ding ahi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Numei le Pasal Kitimatna Chunga Dan"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva hitin seijin, Keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahi."},"3":{"text":"Nana chenao Egypt gam chonna banga nangho nachon loudiu, chule keiman nangho kahin lhutna Canaan gam chonna banga jong nachon louhel dingu: chule amaho chona dan jong najuilou dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nangho kathulhah ho-a nachon uva, chule hicheho-a chu nalam lhah theina dinguva kachona danho nanit dingu ahi; Keima Pakai na Pathen nu kahi."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nanghon ka chondan kisun hole keima thutanna ho nanitdiu: hichu mikhatnin anitleh ama hicheho-a chu hing ding ahi; keima Pakai kahi.","ref":"Neh 9:29; Ezek 18:9; 20:11-12; Luk 10:18; Rom 10:5; Gal 3:12"},"6":{"text":"Nangho koimachan akinaipi a-insungmi sagohkeo hodohpeh dinga najot lou dingu ahi: Keima Pakai kahi."},"7":{"text":"Nangman napa sagohkeo hina ahilouleh nanu sagohkeo hina chu naho dohpeh louding ahi: amanu nanu ahin, amanu sagohkeo hina chu nangman naho dohpeh louding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nangman napa jinu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi: Hichu napa sagohkeo hina ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 20:11; Danb 22:30; 27:20"},"9":{"text":"Nangman nasopi, napa chanu hihen, nanu chanu hijongle, in'a peng hihen mun danga peng hijongleh, asagohkeo hina chu naho dohpeh louding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 20:17; Danb 27:22"},"10":{"text":"Nangman nachapa chanu hihen, nachanu chanu hijongle, asagohkeo hina chu naho dohpeh louding ahi. Ajehchu amaho sagohkeo hina chu nangma sagohkeo hina ahibouve."},"11":{"text":"Napa jinu chanu, napan ahinchu nasopinu ahi, nangman amanu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Nangman napa sopinu sagohkeo hina chu naho dohpeh louding ahi. Amanu chu napa kinaipi asopinu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 20:19-20"},"13":{"text":"Nangman nanu sopinu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi. Ajehchu amanu chu nanu kinaipi asopinu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nangman napa sopipa sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding, nangman ama jinu jong nagajot lutlou ding ahi: amanu chu nanungah ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nangman namounu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi: amanu chu nachapa jinu ahin; nangman amanu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 20:12"},"16":{"text":"Nangman nasopipa jinu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi: nasopipa sagohkeo hina ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 20:21"},"17":{"text":"Nangman numei khatleh achanu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding, chule achapa chanu ahilouleh achanu chanu jeng jong asagohkeo hinao hodohpeh dinga nakipui louding ahi: ajehchu amanu kiguijoppi numei ho ahiuve: hichehi gitlouna ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 20:14; Danb 27:23"},"18":{"text":"Chule nangman numei khatchu asopinu hinlai sungse-a, amanu suhgentheina ding le ama sagohkeo hina hodoh peh dinga asopinu chu nakipuithei louhel ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chujoule athenlou jeh-a chomkoija aumlai sungse-a, nangman amanu sagohkeo hina hodoh peh dinga najot louhel ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 20:18."},"20":{"text":"Chukalvala jong nangman nakisuhboh na dinga naheng nakom inneipi chu aluppi louding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 20:10"},"21":{"text":"Chule nangman nachilhah lah-a khatcha jong Molech houna dinga meija govam dinga naphal doh louhel ding, na Pathen min jong nasuh minset louding ahi: keima Pakai kahi.","ref":"Thmpu 20:1-5"},"22":{"text":"Nangman numei toh nalupkhom banga pasal toh nalupkhom louding ahi: hiche chu thet umtah ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 20:13"},"23":{"text":"Chule nangma nakisuhboh nadinga ganhing kiti tapou toh nalupkhom louding ahi. Numei tapou jongchu ganhing khat anga aluppi dinga gaum lou ding ahi: hichehi jon chungnung ahi.","ref":"Pot 22:19; Thmpu 20:15-16; Danb 27:21"},"24":{"text":"Hiche thil ho kiti tapouva hin nangho kisuboh hih-un: ajehchu nangho masanga kana paidoh namho chu hicheho jouse-a hi kisuboh ahiuvin:"},"25":{"text":"Chule gam chu suhboh-in aumtan: hijeh-a chu keiman akhangitlou naochu talen kamat sah-a, gamsung amatah-in achengho chu ahin lohdoh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nanghon keima chondanho le kathu tan naho nanit tei dingu, chule nanam mite ahiuva, gamdang mi nalah uva khopemho ahiuva jong, hiche kidah umho hi khatcha jong nabol lou dingu ahi:"},"27":{"text":"(Ijeh inem itile nangho masanga agama um miho chun hiche kidah umhohi ana bolu ahin, chule gamsunghi suhboh-a anaum ahi;)"},"28":{"text":"Agam min nangho masanga anaumho analodoh banga, nanghon jong nasuhboh tengule nalohdoh louna diuvin."},"29":{"text":"Ajehchu koihile hiche kidah umho lah-a khat bolla chu, hiche tobang bola mihem chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu namasanguva ana kibol hitobang thet umtah chonnaho hi nabol louna dingule, hitiho-a hi suhboh-a naum louna dinguva, ka thupeh hohi nanit dingu ahi: keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseije, hitin ati,","title":"Thenna le Thudih Thudola Danthu"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate houkhom ho jouse henga hitihin seijin, Nangho nathen dingu ahi: ajehchu keima Pakai na Pathen'u hi atheng kahi.","ref":"Thmpu 11:44-45; 1 Pet 1:16"},"3":{"text":"Nangho amitakipmin nanu le napa naginuva, chule kacholngah nikho ho nanit dingu ahi, keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.","ref":"Pot 20:8,12; Danb 15:12,16"},"4":{"text":"Milimho lama kihei hih-un lang, alim semthu pathen ho jong kisem hih-un: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.","ref":"Thmpu 26:1; Pot 20:23; 34:17; Danb 27:15."},"5":{"text":"Nanghon Pakai henga chamna thilto longlhenna nato uva ahile, nanghon hichu nalungcham tah uva nato dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hichu natodoh nikhou le ajing nikho-a nanehjou tei dingu ahi: ijemtia ani thum ni geija um nalaija ahile, hichu meija goding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule hichu anithum ni-a akineh poupouva ahile, kidah umtah ahin; hichu kisang louding ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu ane jouse chun Pakai thiltheng asuh minset jeh uva, akhangit lounao akipoh cheh dingu: chule hiche mihem chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nangman nagam ga na-at teng le, nangman nalou ningho jouse chu na-at sohkei louding, chule na-at na-a alhajah ho chu nakichom ngim louding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 23:22; Danb 24:19-22."},"10":{"text":"Chule nangman nalengpi thei gaho nachom ngimsel louding, nalengpi thei gaho jong aboncha nalotheng louding; hitiho chu vaichate le gamdang mi dinga nakhenpeh ding ahi: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangma naguchat louding, dihlou tah-a jong nabol louding, chule khat le khat kah-a jong jou nasei louding ahi.","ref":"Pot 20:15-16; Danb 5:19,20."},"12":{"text":"Chule nangma kamin panna jouva nakihahsel louding, na-Pathen minjong nasuh minset louding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.","ref":"Pot 20:7; Danb 5:11; Matt 5:33"},"13":{"text":"Nangman naheng nakom najoulhep louding, chomjong nachom louding ahi. Akigoipa lo chu jan khovah-a jingkah geija nakoma naumsah louding ahi.","ref":"Danb 24:14-15."},"14":{"text":"Nangman na-ngong nagaosap louding, mitcho masanga jong kipal lhuh theina nakoi louding ahi, na-Pathen joh nagin ding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.","ref":"Danb 27:18"},"15":{"text":"Nathu tan na-a chonphat louna nabol louding ahi: nangman mivaichate chu nakhohsah chom louding, ahiloule mithaneite jong najabol chom louding: amavang chonphatah-a naheng nakom thu natan ding ahi.","ref":"Pot 23:6-8; Danb 16:19."},"16":{"text":"Chule nangma namite lah-a thuse seija nachesuh nachetouna louding: chule naheng nakom thisan thua jong jouthu-a napan louding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi."},"17":{"text":"Nangman nalungsunga nasopipa nahotbol louding: iti nama jongle nangman naheng nakom naphosal louding, chule chonset nabolsah louding ahi.","ref":"Matt 18:15."},"18":{"text":"Nangman phu nalah louding, namite chateho chunga thangthipna jong nanei louding ahi, amavang nangman naheng nakom chu nangma naki ngailut banga nangailut ding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.","ref":"Matt 5:43; 19:19; 22:39; Mrk 12:31; Luk 10:27; Rom 13:9; Gal 5:14; Jac 2:8"},"19":{"text":"Nanghon kachondan ho nanit diu ahi. Nanghon nagancha hou chu gancha dangto nakimatsah lou dingu ahi: nanghon nalou uva muchi natu hal lou dingu ahi. Chule tupat le samul kihal von jong nachunga nakaisah louding ahi.","ref":"Danb 9:11."},"20":{"text":"Chule soh numei, pasal khat dinga khao khisa, lhadoh loulai le chamlhatna peh loulai khat chu tahsa ngaichatna jeh-a khattouvin aluppia ahile, amanu chu kijepding ahi: amanu chamlhat ahiloujeh-a anilhona vang kithat louding ahi"},"21":{"text":"Chule amapa chun asuhkhelna thilto chu Pakai henga houkhom ho houbuh kotkhah bula chu ahinchoi ding, suhkhkelna thilto dinga kelngoi chal khat ahinkai ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuteng thempupa chun amapan anabol chonsetna jeh-a chu, amapa dinga suhkhel thilto kelngoi chal chu Pakai anga atodoh-a, amapa dinga longlhenna abolpeh ding ahi: chutengle amapan anabol chonsetna chu kingaidam ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule nangho chuche gama nalut uva, chule nanghon nehdinga thing namkim naphu tengule, aga chu cheptan louva nasim dingu: hichu nangho dinga kum thum cheptan lou hiding; hichu nanehlou dingu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ahinla akum li na-a vang chuche gaho jouse chu, Pakai vahchoina dinga atheng hiding ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Chule akum nga na vang, nangho-a dinga aga asodoh thei nadinga aga naneh dingu ahi: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi."},"26":{"text":"Nanghon imacha athisan puma nanehtha lou dingu: chule mitpheldoi le ailhim namanchah lou dingu ahi.","ref":"Semt 9:4; Thmpu 7:26-27; 17:10-14; Danb 12:16,23; 15:23; 18:10."},"27":{"text":"Nanghon nasamu nahet tol kimvel lou dingu, chule nabeng mul hou jong aning navoset lou dingu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 2:5; Danb 14:1"},"28":{"text":"Nanghon mithiho jeh-a natahsao na-at pop lou dingu, chule nati chunguva jong imacha lim nasemlou dingu ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi."},"29":{"text":"Nangman jonthanhoi sahna dinga nachanu noti'a napansah louding ahi; achuti loule gamsung hi jonthanhoina-a hunglhun tin, gamsunghi gitlouna-a dim ding ahi.","ref":"Danb 23:17."},"30":{"text":"Nanghon kacholngah ho nanit diu; chule kamun theng naja dingu ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.","ref":"Thmpu 26:2"},"31":{"text":"Nanghon amaho-a kona nakisuhboh louna dingun lhakou mangchaho ngaisang hih-un, chule doithemho jong hol hih-un: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.","ref":"Danb 18:11; 1 Sam 28:3; 2 Leng 23:4; Isai 8:19."},"32":{"text":"Nangma lukangho masanga nadin doh ding, tehse mai najading, chule na Pathen nagin ding ahi: keima Pakai kahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule namdang khat nagam sunga nangho toh akhopem khoma ahile, ama chu dihlou tah-a nabol lou dingu ahi.","ref":"Pot 22:21; Danb 24:17-18; 27:19."},"34":{"text":"Amavang gamdang mi nangho toh chengkhoma chu nangho-a dinga nalah uva peng tobang hiding, nangho naki ngailut banguva nangailut dingu ahi: ajehchu nangho jong Egypt gama gamdang mi nana hiu ahi: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi."},"35":{"text":"Nanghon thutanna lam, asaotena ahin, agih tena ahin, ahiloule asan tena hijongle chonphat louna nabol lou dingu ahi.","ref":"Danb 25:13-16; Thuch 20:10; Ezek 45:10."},"36":{"text":"Khaikot dih, gihtum dih, Ephah dih, chule hin dih nanei diu ahi: keima Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh uva Pakai na Pathen'u kahi."},"37":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nanghon kachondan ho le kathutan jouse najuidiu, chule naboldiu ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Thumanlou Jeh-a Gotna"},"2":{"text":"Israel chateho henga hitihin seikitnin, Israel chate lah-a kona ahin, Israel gama khopem gamdang mi lah-a kon hijongle, koitobang Molech henga acha pe-a chu; ama chu thatei teiding ahi: agam mite chun ama chu songa asediu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Keiman amapa douna-a kamaingat ding, chule amite lah-a kona kapaidoh ding ahi; ajeh chu aman keima muntheng suhbohna ding le keima mintheng suhminset nadingin acha Molech henga apen ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule itiham khatna agam mite chun amapan acha Molech henga apeh chu akimumo sah uva, chule amapa chu atha lou uva ahileh,"},"5":{"text":"Chuteng chule keiman amapa le a-insung mite douna-a kamaingat ding, chule Molech to jonthanhoi dinga amatoh jong jouse chu amite lah-a kona kapaidoh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule koi hile amaho to jong dinga lhakou ho le doithemho lama kihei tapou chu, amapa douna-a kamaingat ding, chule amite lah-a kona kapaidoh ding ahi"},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun nangho kisuthengun lang atheng hiuvin: ajeh chu keima Pakai na-Pathen'u kahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule nanghon keima chondan ho nanit uva, natohdoh dingu ahi: ajehchu keima nangho suthengpa Pakai chu kahi."},"9":{"text":"Koi hile apa ahiloule anu gaosapma chu thonlouva thatei ding ahi: aman apa ahiloule anu agaosap ahin; athisan chu ama chunga chuding ahi.","ref":"Pot 21:17; Matt 15:4; Mrk 7:10."},"10":{"text":"Chule pasal khat pasal dang ji to jonga, aheng akompa jinu to jonga chu, ajongpa le ajongnu anilhona thatei ding ahi.","ref":"Pot 20:14; Thmpu 18:20; Danb 5:18."},"11":{"text":"Chule pasal khat apa jinu to lumkhoma, apa sagohkeo hina hodohpeh-a chu, amani chu anilhona thatei ding ahi; amani thisan chu amani chunga chuding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:8; Danb 22:30; 27:20"},"12":{"text":"Chule pasal khat amounu to alupkhoma ahile, amani chu anilhona thatei ding ahi; amanin kidah umtah aboldoh lhon ahitai; amani thisan chu amani chunga chuding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:15"},"13":{"text":"Pasal khat apasal chanpi khattoh numei to lupkhom banga alup khoma ahile, amani chun kidah umtah abol lhon ahitan; amani chu thatei ding ahi: amani thisan amani chunga chuding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:22"},"14":{"text":"Chule pasal khatnin ajinu le ajinu nu ji-a anei kopma ahile, hichu gitlouna ahi: nalah uva gitlouna aumlouna dinga amapa le amani chu meija hala umdingu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:17; Danb 27:20"},"15":{"text":"Chule pasal khat gancha khattoh alupkhoma ahile, amapa chu thatei ding: chule nanghon agancha jong chu atha dingu ahi.","ref":"Pot 22:19; Thmpu 18:23; Danb 27:21"},"16":{"text":"Chule numei khatnin gancha khat ajotlutna, chuche tochun alupkhoma ahile, nangman numeinu le gancha chu nathatei ding ahi: amani chu thitei ding ahilhone; amani thisan chu amani chunga chuding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule pasal khatnin asopinu, apa chanu hihen anu chanu hile akichenpi-a, aman amanu sagohkeo amua, amanun amapa sagohkeo amua ahile; hichu gilouna ahi; amani chu amiteu mitmu-a paidoh-a umlhon ding ahi: amapan asopinu sagohkeo hina chu ahodoh peh ahitan; amapan akhangit louna chu akipoh ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:9; Danb 27:22."},"18":{"text":"Chule pasal khatnin numei anatna neipet khat alupia, amanu sagoh hina ahodoh peh-a ahile; amapan amanu twinah ahodoh peh ahin, amanun athisan twinah chu ahodoh ahitai: chule amani chu anilhona amiteu lah-a kona paidoh-a umlhon ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:19"},"19":{"text":"Nangman nanu sopinu ahin, napa sopinu hile asagokeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi: ajeh chu amapan akinaipi a-insungmi ahodoh ahi: amanin achonset nalhon akipoh lhonding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:12-14."},"20":{"text":"Chule pasal khatnin apa-ngahpa jinu alupkhom pia ahile, aman apa-ngahpa sagohkeo hina chu ahodohpeh ahitan: amanin achonset nalhon akipoh lhonding, chabeija thilhon ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule pasal khatnin asopipa jinu akipuija ahile, hichu thilthenglou ahin: aman asopipa sagohkeo hina ahodohpeh ahi; amani chabeija umlhon ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:16"},"22":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu keiman nangho kahin puilut nadingu gam chun nangho nalohdoh louna dingun; nanghon kachondan ho le kathutana ho nitnun lang chule bolun."},"23":{"text":"Chule nangho masanga keiman kakaidoh nam chondan bangin chonhih-un: ajeh chu amahon hitiho jouse hi anabolun, hijeh-a chu keiman amaho chu kahot ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ahinla keiman nangho henga, Nanghon amaho gam chu nalo diu, chule hiche bongnoi le khoiju lona gam chu nalo diuva kapeh ding nahiuve, kati ahi. Keima nangho namdang ho-a kona khendoh-a Pakai Pathen chu kahi."},"25":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nanghon satheng le saboh, vacha boh le atheng nakhen dingu ahi: chule sa hile vacha hile chule tolla kitholtho ho hijongle keiman nangho-a kona athenglou ahi tia kakhendoh ho-a kona chu nahinnao thet umtah nasolou dingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule nangho keima dinga atheng nahi dingu ahi: ijeh-inem itile Pakai keima hi atheng kahin, chule keima-a tum hidinga nanghohi midang ho-a kona kakhen doh nahiuve."},"27":{"text":"Pasal hihen numei hile, lhakou ahiloule doithem hia chu thonlouva thading ahi: amahon amaho chu songa asediu ahi: amaho thisan chu amaho chung mama-a chuding ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Aaron chapate thempuho henga hitihin seijin, Koimacha amite lah-a mithiho jeh-a kisuboh louding ahi:","title":"Thempuho Thenna"},"2":{"text":"Ahin a-insungmi amato kinai, anu-a ding, apa-a ding, achapa-a ding, achanu-a ding, chule asopipa-a ding,"},"3":{"text":"Chule asopinu nungah theng, ama to kinaija um, jinei loulaija ding; hichenga dinga vanghi kisuboh thei ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahinla amite lah-a aluchangpen ahi jeh-in, athenlou nadinga ama le ama kisuboh louding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amahon aluchangu avotol loudingu, abengmulu mongjong avoset lou dingu, chule atahsao jong a-atpop loudiu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:27-28; Danb 14:1."},"6":{"text":"Amaho chu a-Pathen'uva ding atheng hidiu, chule a-Pathen'u min jong asuhboh loudiu ahi. Ajeh amahon meija kisem Pakai henga thilto le a-Pathen'u changlhah chu atojiu ahi: hijeh-a chu amaho atheng hidingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Amahon ji dinga noti ahiloule athenglou chu akipui loudiu; chule ajipan adasa numei jong akipui lou dingu ahi: ajehchu amapa chu a-Pathen'a dinga atheng hija ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nangman hijeh-a chu amachu nasuhtheng ding ahi; ajehchu aman nangma Pathen changlhah chu atodoh ahi: amapa chu nangma dinga atheng hiding ahi: ijeh inem itile nangma suthenga Pakai keima atheng kahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule thempu khat penpen chanu chu noti'a apana amale ama akisuhboh-a ahile, apa asuhboh ahin: amanu chu meija halding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule asopite lah-a thempu chungnunga pang, alua thao kinu, thempu vonho von dinga kisuthenga chun, alu ahodoh louding, aponho jong abokeh louding;"},"11":{"text":"Thilong kiti tapou anailut louding, apa-a ding le anu-a dinga jong kisuboh louding;"},"12":{"text":"Munthenga kona jong potdoh louding, a-Pathen muntheng jong asuhboh louding ahi; ijeh inem itile a-Pathen thao kinu lallukhuh chu achunga um ahi: Keima Pakai chu kahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule aman ajinu chu nungah theng ahi petna akipui ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Meithai, akidasa numei, akisubohsa, ahiloule noti, hicheho hi akipui louding ahi; amavang amite lah-a kona nungah theng khat akipui ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Amite lah-a jong achilhah asuhboh louding ahi; ajehchu Pakai keiman ama kasuhtheng ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,"},"17":{"text":"Aaron henga hitin seijin, Nakhang sunguva nachilhah hou lah-a nolna nei poupou chun, a-Pathen changlhah toh dingin galut dahen."},"18":{"text":"Koi hile nolna neichan chu lut louding ahi: amitcho, a-elbai, anahkui soi, ahiloule atichunga aval nei,"},"19":{"text":"Pasal akengbong, ahilouleh akhutbong,"},"20":{"text":"Atingbong, mineo, ahiloule amitna nolna um, tipat, tibol, ahiloule atilchangkeh hijongle;"},"21":{"text":"Aaron chilhah ho nolna nei koimachan Pakai henga dinga meija kisem thilto toh dinga hungnailut lou dingu ahi: aman achunga nolna anei ahi: a-Pathen changlhah tohdinga hungnailut lou ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Aman a-Pathen changlhah athengpen le atheng chu ania anehthei ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Aman nolna khat aneijeh-a chu keima muntheng aman asuhboh louna dinga, ama pondal sunga chu lutlou ding, maicham naija jong hunglut lou ding ahi: ajehchu Pakai keiman amaho kasuhtheng ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n hichehi Aaron le achapate chule Israel chate jouse henga aseipeh tan ahi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Thiltoho Thendan"},"2":{"text":"Aaron le achapate henga chun amaho Israel chate thil thengho-a kona akikang seova, chule keima henga amahon athensosao hiche thilho-a chu keima mintheng asuhboh louna dingun seipeh-in: Keima Pakai chu kahi."},"3":{"text":"Amaho henga hitihin seijin, Koi hijongle nakhanggui jouseuva nachilhah jouse lah-a kon achunga thenlouna aumpetna Israel chaten Pakai henga akatdoh-u thilthengho henga galutna chu, amachu keima angsunga kona kipaidoh ding ahi: Keima Pakai chu kahi."},"4":{"text":"Aaron chilhahte lah-a kon koitobang miphah hihen lang, ahiloule thilong hijongle, akisuhtheng kahse-a thil thengho lah-a kona imacha aneh louding ahi. Chule koi hile thilonga kona kisuboh thilkhat tongkha-a, ahiloule ama-a kona abotwi chedoh-a chu,"},"5":{"text":"Ahiloule akisuhbohna thei ding akitholtho, ahiloule thenlouna akilahson nathei mi, itobang thenlouna nei hijongle;"},"6":{"text":"Chutobang khattou tongkha tapou chu nilhah tokah-a thenglouva umding, chule aman atahsa twija asop masangse-a thil thengho lah-a kona imacha aneh louding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule nisa ahung lhumteng, ama theng ding ahitan, chujou tengle thiltheng lah-a kona chu anehding ahitai: ajehchu hichu ama an ahi."},"8":{"text":"Akisuhboh nadinga achama thia ham, san apelih ham chu aneh louding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu amahon kachondanho anit dingu ahi, achuti louva ahile hiche chonsetna chu apoh uva, hichu asuhboh uva ahile thi dingu ahi: keima Pakai amaho suthenga chu kahi."},"10":{"text":"Gamdang mi kiti tapouvin thiltheng chu aneh louding ahi: thempute henga khopem hihen, soh thalah hijongle thiltheng chu aneh theilou ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla thempu chun asuma mikhat achoh-a ahile, amapa chun hichu anehding, chule a-insunga penga jong chun: amahon ama anneh chu anehthei dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Thempu chanu khattou gamdang mi toh akichena ahile, amanun thiltheng kitoh ho lah-a kona chu ima anehthei louding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahinla thempu chanu chu meithai ahiloule akida ahia, chabei ahia, chule anungah lai banga apa insunga umdinga ahung nungkih ahile, amanun apa anneh chu aneh teiding ahi: amavang gamdang min hichu aneh louding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule pasal khattouvin hetlouva thiltheng lah-a kona ima aneh-a ahile, aman thiltheng chu thempu henga aledit kitding, hopnga-a hopkhat apehbe ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule amahon, Israel chateho thiltheng ho, Pakai anga ato houchu asuhboh lou dingu;"},"16":{"text":"Ahiloule athiltheng houchu aneh tengule suhkhelna khangitlouna chu apohsah lou dingu ahi: ajehchu keiman amaho suthenga Pakai chu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,"},"18":{"text":"Aaron heng le achapate heng, chule Israel chate jouse henga hitihin seijin, Israel insunga kona hihen, Israel lah-a um gamdang mi hijongle, koitobang akitepna khattouva dinga ganlhaina, ahiloule lungcham thilto-a dinga Pakai henga govam thilto tohding auma ahile,"},"19":{"text":"Nanghon nalungcham tah uva bongho, kelngoiho, ahiloule kelcha ho-a kona nolna beihel achal napeh dingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla nolna neitapou chu natolou dingu ahi: ajehchu hichu nangho-a dinga kisanpeh louding ahi.","ref":"Danb 17:1"},"21":{"text":"Koi hijongle akitepna suhbulhit nading ham, ahiloule lungcham thilto dinga bong ham, ahiloule kelngoi hama Pakai henga chamna thilto ganlhaina toh chan chun, athilto chu sanpeh ahina dinga ahoi chamkim atoding ahi: achunga chu nolna imacha umlou ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mitcho, kengbong, atipat, tahsa-a apomdoh nei, tina-a kon anai long, ahiloule tipat tapou chu nanghon Pakai henga nato lou diu, chule Pakaiya dinga maicham chunga meija kisem thilto-a nato lou dingu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Bongchal ahiloule kelngoinou atahsa tibah-a aval, ahiloule alhasam auma ahile, nangman hichu lungcham thilto-a nato thei ahi: ahinla kitepna-a dinga vang hichu kisang louding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Nangman gancha atilchang kisuhchip, kitatkeh, kisukeh, le ki-atkeh kiti tapou chu Pakai henga nato louding ahi; chule hitobang ho-a chu nagamsunga jong thilto imacha nabol lou dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Gamdang mi khutna kona hicheho chu na-Pathen changlhah hidinga nato louding ahi: ajeh chu amaho-a bohna aumin, chule amaho-a nolna aumin ahi: hicheho chu nangho dinga kisanpeh louding ahiuve."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,"},"27":{"text":"Bongchal ham, kelngoi ham, ahiloule kelcha ham ahung so tengle amachu ni sagi api toh umkhom ding ahi: chule niget channi-a patna Pakai henga meija kisem thilto-a dinga kisang ding ahitai."},"28":{"text":"Chule bongpi hihen kelngoipi hile, anouho toh nikhat sunga nathalou diu ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chule nanghon Pakai henga thangvahna ganlhaina nato tengule, nalungcham tah uva nato dingu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Anikho mama-a chu hiche chu nehjou keiding ahi: ajing geija dinga imacha khenlou ding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi."},"31":{"text":"Hijeh chun nanghon kathupeh ho nanit uva, chule hicheho chu nabol dingu ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule nanghon ka mintheng jong nasuhboh loudiu; amavang Israel chate lah-a keima suhthenga kaumding ahi: keima nangho suthenga Pakai chu kahin,"},"33":{"text":"Egypt gama kona na-Pathen'u hidinga hinpui dohpa chu kahi: Keima Pakai chu kahi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Kut"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva hitin seijin, Pakai kut ho thudola, nanghon kikhoppi theng ahi tia naphondoh dinghou chu, hichehohi keima kut ho chu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nigup sunga na kitong ding ahin: nisagi ni vang chu cholngah ni ahin, kikhoppi theng ahi; hiche nikho-a hi natoh imacha natoh lou dingu ahi: hiche hi nachen namun jouseuva Pakai cholngah ni ahi.","ref":"Pot 20:8-10; 23:12; 31:15; 34:21; 35:2; Danb 5:12-14"},"4":{"text":"Hiche hohi aphat ahunglhun dungjuija nanghon naphon lediu Pakai Kut ho, kikhoppi thengho chu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Lha masapen nisom le nili nilhah chu Pakai kalchuh Kut ahi.","title":"Kalchuh Kut le Cholsolou Changlhah Kut (Minb 28:16-25)","ref":"Pot 12:1-13; Danb 16:1-2."},"6":{"text":"Chuche lha mama nisom le ninga ni chu Pakai dinga cholsolou changlhah Kut ahi. Nisagi cholsolou changlhah naneh diu ahi.","ref":"Pot 12:14-20; 23:15; 34:18; Danb 16:3-8"},"7":{"text":"Nimasa pen nile nanghon kikhoppi theng khat nanei diu, chule hiche sunga chu natoh imacha natohlou dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla nisagi sunga chu Pakai henga meija kisem thilto nato dingu ahi: nisagi ni chu kikhoppi theng ahin, nanghon hiche sunga chu natoh imacha natohlou dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,"},"10":{"text":"Israel chate henga hitin seijin, Keiman nangho kapehnao gamsunga nahung lutnuva, chule aga na-at tengule, nanghon nachang-at doh-u aga masapen ho phalkhat chu thempu henga nahin choi dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule aman nangho dinga santhei ahina dinga aphal chu Pakai anga ajap ding: cholngahni jou ajing le thempu chun ajap ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule nanghon aphal najap niu chule, Pakai henga govam thilto-a dinga kumkhat lhingset nolnabei kelngoi nou achal khat nahin kai dingu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuche-a dinga anneh thilto chu thao toh kihal changbong neljet ephah hopsom-a hopni, Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga meija kisem thilto hiding: chule adonding thilto chu lengpitwi hin khat hoplia khat hiding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule nanghon na-Pathen'u henga thilto nahinchoi nikhou mamachu ahunglhun masanga, changlhah hile, kanpoh hile, changvui hile naneh loudiu ahi. Hichehi nachen namun jouseova a-itih-a nakhang khanguva chondana naman diu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nanghon cholngah ni jou ajinga pat, jap thilto-a dinga changhal nahinchoi niuva pat nasim dingu; choldoni sagi nasuhlhing diu ahi:","title":"Lholhun Kut (Minb 28:26-31)","ref":"Pot 23:16; 34:22; Danb 16:9-12."},"16":{"text":"Cholngah sagina jou ajinga pat nisom nga-a nasim uva; Pakai henga anneh thilto thah nato diu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nanghon nachen namun houva kona ephah hopsom-a hopni-a kisem japtho changlhah lumni nahin choidiu; hichu changbong neljetna kon hiding, chol toh kikantha ding; hichu Pakai henga dinga ga masaho ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Chule nanghon changlhah chutoh kumkhat lhingbep nolnabei kelngoinou sagi, bongchalnou khat, chule kelngoichal ni natotha diu; hicheho chu Pakai henga govam thilto le a-anneh thiltoho, adon thilto ho, Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga meija kisem thito ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chujouteng nanghon chonset thilto-a dinga kelchaho noukhat natodiu, chule chamna thilto-a dinga kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou ni natodiu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun hicheho chu gamasaho changlhah le kelngoinou ni chutoh Pakai henga jap thilto hiding ajapding: hichu Pakaiya dinga atheng thempupa kipe chu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule nanghon chuche nikho mama chule, hichu nangho dinga kikhoppi theng ahi tia naphondoh diu: hiche sunga chu nanghon natoh imacha natoh lou dingu ahi. Hichehi nachen namun jouseuva nakhang khanguva a-itih-a dinga chondan hiding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule nanghon nagam gao na-at tengule, na-atpet nuva chu naloulai ninghou na-at ngimsel loudiu, na-at naova alhajah jong nachom khom loudiu ahi: hicheho chu vaichate le gamdang mi dinga nakhenpeh dingu ahi: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:9-10; Danb 24:19-22."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Kumthah Kut (Minb 29:1-6)"},"24":{"text":"Israel chate henga hitihin seijin, lhasagi channa nikho masapen nileh nanghon choldona nanitdiu, sumkon mut hetjingna kikhoppi theng naman dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hiche sunga chu nanghon natoh imacha natohlou dingu; amavang nanghon Pakai henga meija kisem thilto nato dingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Longlhenna Nikho (Minb 29:7-11)","ref":"Thmpu 16:29-34."},"27":{"text":"Hiche lhasagi channa nisom lhin ni chu longlhenna nikho hiding: hichu nangho dinga kikhoppi theng hiding; chule nanghon nahinnao nasuh gimuva, Pakai henga meija kisem thilto nato dingu ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hiche ni-a chu nanghon natoh kiti natohlou diu ahi: ajehchu hichu longlhenna nikho ahin, Pakai na-Pathen'u anga nangho ding longlhenna kibol nikho ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile koihile hiche nikho-a ngeija ahinna suhgim lou chu, amachu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chule koihile hiche nikho ngeija natoh khattou tonga chu, amachu amite lah-a kona keiman kasuhmang ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Nanghon itobang natoh hile natoh louhel dingu ahi: hichehi nachen namun jouseova nakhang khanguva a-itih-a ding chondan hiding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hichehi nangho dinga cholngahna choldoni hiding, chule nanghon nahinnao nasuh gim dingu ahi: hiche lha niko ni nilhah-a pat ajing nilhah geija nangho cholngahni nanitdiu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Houbuh Kut (Minb 29:12-40)","ref":"Danb 16:13-15."},"34":{"text":"Israel chate henga hitihin seipeh-in, hiche lhasagi channa nisom le ni ngani hi Pakai henga nisagi sung Houbuh Kut hiding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Ani masapen nikho-a chu kikhoppi theng umding: hiche sunga chu natoh imacha natoh loudiu ahi."},"36":{"text":"Nanghon nisagi sung Pakai henga meija kisem thilto nato diu: nigetni chu nangho dinga kikhoppi theng hiding; Pakai henga meija kisem thilto nato diu ahi; hichehi kipun khomna loupitah ahin; chule hiche sunga hi nangho koimachan na natoh loudiu ahi."},"37":{"text":"Hichehohi Pakaiya ding kut ho, Pakai henga meija kisem thilto, govam thilto, anneh thilto, ganlhaina, don thilto anikho dungjuijuva tona dinga kikhoppi theng ahi tia naphondoh dinghou:"},"38":{"text":"Pakai cholngah niho, na thiltohou, na kitepnahou jouse, chule na lungcham thiltohou, Pakai henga napeh hou simlouva mandingho chu ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chujongle lhasagi channa nisom le ninga ni, nanghon nagam gahou nakhop khom tengule, nanghon Pakaiya dinga kut nisagi naman diu ahi; animasa pen ni chu cholngahni hiding, chule nigetni jong chu cholngahni hiding ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chule nimasa pen nile nanghon thingpha gaho, lusu doho, thingdo aboh phaho boh, vachadung panga keh huisum ho nalah diu, chule Pakai anga nisagi nakipa thanop diu ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chule hiche hi Pakai dinga kut tia kum khat sunga nisagi naman diu ahi. Hichehi nakhang khanguva dinga a-itih-a chondan kipe-a chu ahi: hichehi nanghon lhasagi channa sunga nanit jingdiu ahi."},"42":{"text":"Nangho nisagi lhambuh sunga nachendiu; Israel chate apeng jouse lhambuh-a cheng dingu ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chutia chu nakhang khanguva nanghon Israel chate Egypt gama kona kahinpuidoh chun amaho lhambuh-a kana chensah-e ti nahet themna diu ahi: keima Pakai na Pathen'u chu kahi."},"44":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate henga Pakai kut ho chu aphongdoh tan ahi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati;","title":"Meivah Vetsui dingdol (Pot 27:20-21)"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate henga meivah ho avah jomjing theina dingin, vahding monga kiheh Olive thao thengseh chu nahenga ahin choina diuvin thupeh neijin."},"3":{"text":"Hichu Aaron nin Pakai anga nilhah-a pat jingkah geija tanglouva hettohsahna pondal pamlam, houkhom ho houbuh sunga agoltoh ding ahi; hiche hi nakhang khanguva a-itih-a dinga nachondanu hiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aman Pakai angsunga meivah khom theng chunga meivah ho chu tanglouva agoltoh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule nangman changbong neljet nalah-a, hichea kona chu changlhah lum somleni nasemding, lumkhat khatna ephah hopsom-a hopni nalutsah cheh ding ahi.","title":"Vetsahna Changlhah","ref":"Pot 25:30."},"6":{"text":"Chule hicheho chu Pakai angsung dokhang theng chunga nangman golkhatna gup cheh-a golnia nagol ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule hetjingna changlhah, Pakai henga meija kisem thilto hidinga nangman agolni chunga chu bego thengsel nakoi ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Atonsot kitepna-a dinga Israel chate-a kona kila ahito lhona, cholngahni sehle aman hiche chu tanglouva Pakai anga phatecha agontup jing ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule hiche chu Aaron le achapatea hiding, amahon hichu munthenga aneh diu ahi; ajeh chu a-itih-a chondan hijing dinga Pakaiya dinga meija kisem thilto chu ama dinga thengtah hija ahi.","ref":"Matt 12:4; Mrk 2:26; Luk 6:4"},"10":{"text":"Chule Israel numei khat chapa, apa chu Egypt mi ahin, ama chu Israel chate lah-a achedoh-in: hiche Israel numeinu chapa leh Israel mi khat gebuh sunga akidel lhonin;","title":"Chondihtah le Kitahtah-a Thutan Thua Vetjui ding"},"11":{"text":"Chuin Israel numeinu chapa chun Pakai min chu ataitomin, agaosap tan ahi.
