Chuin amahon amapa chu Mosi henga ahin puijuvin: (anu min chu Shelomith, Debri chanu, Dan phunga kon ahi)."},"12":{"text":"Amahon Pakai lunggel amaho henga vetsah-a aum theina din, amapa chu vetsuijin akoijuve."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,"},"14":{"text":"Agaosap mipa chu gebuh pama puidoh-in; chule athusei jaho jouse chun alujang chunga chun akhutnu ngamuhen, chule houkhom ho jouse chun songin sepmuhen."},"15":{"text":"Chule Israel chate henga chu, Koi hile a-Pathen gaosap chan chun achonset akipoh ding ahi, tia naseipeh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Pakai min taitompa chu thonlouva thatei ding ahin, chule houkhom ho jousen amachu songa ase dingu ahi: gamdangmi jong chu agam sunga pengpa banga Pakai min ataitoma ahile thading ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule koi hile mithat tapou chu thonlouva thatei ding ahi.","ref":"Pot 21:12."},"18":{"text":"Chule koihile gancha thatna chun, gan chu gan'a aditding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule khattouvin aheng akom chunga nolna khat achuhsah-a ahile, aman abol tobang banga chu ama chunga kibol ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Gubong chu gubonga, mit chu mitna, ha chu ha-a; aman mikhat chunga nolna asosah banga ama chunga jong kisosah kitding ahi.","ref":"Pot 21:23-25; Danb 19:21; Matt 5:38"},"21":{"text":"Chule gancha thatna chun, adit ding; chule mihem thatna vang chu, ama thatei ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Nanghon gamdang mi-a ding ahin, nagam mihou khatna ding ahin, dan khatbou naneidiu ahi. Ajehchu keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi, ati.","ref":"Minb 15:16"},"23":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate henga, amahon agaosap pa chu gebuh pama ahinpuidoh uva, chule ama chu songa ase diuvin aseipehtai. Chule Israel chaten Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bang chun abol taovin ahi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Sinai molsanga Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati.","title":"Kum Sagi Channa (Danb 15:1-11)","ref":"Pot 23:10-11."},"2":{"text":"Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva hitin seijin, Nangho keiman kapeh-u gam nahunglut tengule, agam pumpin Pakai henga cholngahni anitding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nangman kumgup nalouva muchi natuding, chule kum gup nalengpilei nalhongim ding ahi, chule aga naki chopkhom ding,"},"4":{"text":"Ahinla kum sagi lhinkum chu agam pumpi dinga cholngahna, Pakaiya dinga cholngah hiding ahi. Nangman nalouva muchi natulou ding, nalengpilei nalhongim louding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nangman nachang atna nunga changson chu na-at louding, nalengpigui malngim lou ga jong nalokhom louding ahi; ajehchu agam pumpi dinga cholngah kum ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule gam pumpi cholngah kum-a achama hung kehdohho chu nangho dinga anneh hiding; nangma-a ding, nasohnu-a ding, nasoh thalah-a ding, chule nangma toh khopem khom gamdangmi-a ding,"},"7":{"text":"Chule nagancha-a ding, chule nagamsunguva um saho-a dinga, chua kona hung gadoh jouse chu nangho anneh hiding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule nangman cholngah kum sagi nakisim ding, kum sagi sagivei; chule cholngah kumho kikah sungse chu nangma dinga kum somli le kumko hiding ahi.","title":"Jubilee"},"9":{"text":"Chuteng lhasagi channa nisom lhinni le nangman Jubilee sumkon namutging sah ding, longlhenna nikhoteng sumkon chu nagam pumpiu sunga namut ging sah ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule nanghon kum somnga kum chu nathenso diu, chule gamsung pumpi sunga chengho jouse henga chamlhatna naphondoh dingu ahi. Hichu nangho dinga Jubilee hiding; mitinin ama ama neilegou akinungmu kitding, chule mitin a-insung mite henga kile kitding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Kum somnga channa chu nangho dinga Jubilee hiding: nanghon natuloudiu, chua kona achama hung khangdoh jong na-at loudiu, chom ngimlou nalengpi leija kona lengpi ga hojong nalokhom louding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu Jubilee ahin; nangho dinga atheng hiding ahi: nanghon gamsunga kona achama hung kehdoh hochu naneh dingu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hiche Jubilee kum-a hi mitin ama ama neilegou nalepeh dingu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule nangman naheng nakom henga thilkhat tou najoh-a, ahiloule naheng nakom khutna kona thilkhat tou nachoh-a ahile, nangho khatle khat naki suhgentheito lou dingu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Jubilee jou kum jat dungjuija nangman naheng nakoma kona nachoh ding, chule aga kum jat dungjuija nangman ama henga ajoh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Akumho atam dungjuija nangman chuche man chu nakalsah ding, chule akum alhom dungjuija chuche man chu nasuhlhom ding; ajehchu aga na kumho dungjuija aman nangma henga ajoh ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nangho khat le khat nakisuh gentheito loudiu; amavang Pathen nagin joh dingu ahi: ajehchu keima Pakai na Pathen'u chu kahi."},"18":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu nanghon kachondan ho najuijuva, kathu tanho nanit uva, natoh dingu ahi; chutile nangho gamsunga bitkeija nachen dingu ahi.","title":"Kum Sagi Chungchanga Boina"},"19":{"text":"Chuteng gamchun aga ahinso sah-a, nanghon vasetna nanehdiu, chule asunga chu bitkeija nachen dingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule nanghon, Veuvin, keihon tujong katu daova, agaho jong kalokhom daova ahile, Kum sagi lhinna-a chu ipi kanehdiu ham? nati uva ahile,"},"21":{"text":"Chuteng keiman kum gup channa-a chu kavangbohna nachung uva kathupeh ding, chule hichun kumthum sung ding ga asodoh ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chutia chu nanghon kum get channa le muchi natu dingu, ahivanga kumko channa geija aga lui chu naneh dingu; aga ahung lhun kahse-a nanghon alui kikhola kona chu naneh dingu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Gam chu a-itih-a dinga johdoh louding ahi: ajehchu gamchu keija ahibouve; chule nangho hi keima koma gamdangmi le hungkhopem nahibou uve.","title":"Neilegou Kilepeh"},"24":{"text":"Chule nanghon nalonao gamsung jouse-a chu, gam kilhatdoh hi naphal dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Nasopipa chu hung vaicha lheh tah-a, chule aman aneilegou phabep chu ajohdoh-a, akinaipi a-insungmi khat chuche lhatdoh dinga ahunga ahile, ama chun asopipan ajoh chu alhatdoh ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule mipa chun koimacha alhatdoh ding nei hih-a, chule ama tah-in alhatdoh jouding ahi tahle,"},"27":{"text":"Chuteng aman anei alahkit theina dingin, ajoh dohna kumho kisim henlang, aval chu ajoh napa henga lepehkit hen."},"28":{"text":"Ahinla aman amapa henga chu alepeh joulou tah-a ahile, athil kijohdoh chu amapa khutna Jubilee kum ahikahsea umden ding ahi: chule Jubilee teng hiche lahdohna hung umding, chule amapa chun anei ahinle neikit ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chule mikhatnin kulbang kikai khum khopi sunga um chenna in khat ajoh-a ahile, aman hichu ajohdoh jou kumkhat guilhungset sunga akilhatdoh thei ding; kum khat lhingset sunga aman alhatdoh thei ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ahinla hichu kum khat lhingset sunga akilhatdoh tahlouva ahile, kulbang kikai khum khopi sunga in chu akhang khanga achopa-a dinga kiphutdet ding: chule Jubilee teng jongle pehdoh louding ahitai."},"31":{"text":"Ahinla kulbangin akolkhumlou khoneo ho-a um inho vangchu gamsunga um louho dana kisimding: hicheho chu lhatdoh thei hiding, chule Jubilee tengle pehdoh hiding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hijeng jongle Levi mite khopiho le agoulou khopiho-a inho vangchu, Levi miten itih phat hijongle alhatdoh theiju ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule mikhatnin Levi miho-a kona thilkhat achoh-a ahile, agou lona khopi-a akijohdoh in chu Jubilee kum tengle pehdoh hiding ahi. Ijeh inem itile Levi phungho khopi ho-a in ho chu Israel chate lah-a amahon aneiju chu ahi."},"34":{"text":"Ahinla akhopiu pamho-a um louho chu kijoh theilou ding ahi; ajeh chu hichu a-itih-a dinga amaho gouchan ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chule nasopipa chu ahung vaicha tah-a, chule nalah uva chu vaichatna alhuhlhah tah-a ahile, nangman amachu nakithopi ding ahi: henge, gamdangmi le khopem banga nangma koma nachen sah ding ahi.","title":"Mivaichaho Dinga Batna Kipe","ref":"Danb 15:7-8."},"36":{"text":"Ama-a konin nangman akan ahiloule apung lahih-in: nasopipa chu nangma toh achenkhom theina dingin, na Pathen gingin."},"37":{"text":"Nangman nasum chu akan dinga napeh louding; naneh nachah jong apung dinga napeh louding ahi.","ref":"Pot 22:25; Danb 23:19-20"},"38":{"text":"Canaan gam peh dingle na-Pathen'u hidinga, Egypt gama kona nahin puidohpao Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi."},"39":{"text":"Chule nakoma cheng nasopi khat chu ahung vaichatna, nangma henga ahung kijoh-a ahile; nangman ama chu soh banga na natohsah louding:","title":"Soh Kilha Ong Thudol","ref":"Pot 21:2-6; Danb 15:12-18."},"40":{"text":"Amavang soh thalah bang le khopem banga nahenga umding, Jubilee kum geija nangma najen ding ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chujouteng aman nanga kona potdoh ding, ama le aumpi achate abonuva, chule a-insung mite henga kinungle kitnuva, apu apate goulona gama chu kile kitding ahi."},"42":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile amahohi Egypt gama kona kahin puidoh keima sohte ahiuve: amaho soh-a kijoh lou dingu ahi."},"43":{"text":"Nangma ama chunga hunam tah-a navaihom louding; amavang na-Pathen nagin johding ahi."},"44":{"text":"Soh pasal le soh numei nanghon naneikop dinghou chu, nakimvel uva um Pathen houlou ho hidiu ahi: amaho lah-a kona nanghon soh pasal le soh numei nakichoh dingu ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chujongle nalah uva khopem gamdangmi chateho-a kona le, nagam sunguva peng nangho toh umkhom amaho insung mite chu nachoh theiju ahi: chule amaho chu nangho neilegou hiding ahiuve."},"46":{"text":"Chule amaho chu nangho nunga nachateo goulo dinga, nei le gou alo diuva nalah dingu ahi; amaho chu a-itih-a nangho soh hiding ahiuve: ahinla nasopiten Israel chate chunga vang, nangho khatnin khat chunga hunam tah-a navai homlou dingu ahi."},"47":{"text":"Chule nakoma khopemho le gamdangmi khat chu ahung haodoh-a, chule ama koma cheng nasopipa chu ahung vaichatna, chule nakoma um gamdangmi ahiloule khopempa heng, ahiloule gamsungmi khat henga ahung kijoh tah-a ahile;","title":"Soh Akilhatdoh ho"},"48":{"text":"Ama chu akijoh jouteng lhatdoh kit thei hiding ahi; asopite ho lah-a khatnin ama alhatdoh thei ahi."},"49":{"text":"Apa-ngahpa ahiloule apa-ngahpa chapa chun ama alhatdoh theiding ahin, ahiloule ama insungmi akinaipi khatnin alhatdoh thei; ahiloule ajo lhangle ama le ama akilhatdoh thei ahi."},"50":{"text":"Chule aman ama chapa chu ama akichohna kum-apat Jubilee kum gei dinga chu akihoupi ding ahi: chule ama akijohdohna manchu akum kisim dungjuija, amatoh ana umkhom soh thalah khat phat dungjuija kitepding ahi."},"51":{"text":"Kum tamtah aum nahlaija ahile, hicheho dungjuija chu akilhatdohna man chu akichohna suma kona apehding ahi."},"52":{"text":"Chule Jubilee kum lhinna ding chu kum phabep bou avatna ahile, ama amapa toh asimding, akumho dungjuija chu akilhatdohna man chu apeh ding ahi."},"53":{"text":"Akum kum-a soh thalah banga amapa chuto umding: chule akhatpa chun nangma angsunga ama chunga chu hunam tah-a vai ahomlou ding ahi."},"54":{"text":"Chule hiche kumho sunga hi ama lhatdoh-a aumlouva ahile, Jubilee kum tengle potdoh ding, ama le aumpi achate chu potdoh ding ahiuve."},"55":{"text":"Ajeh chu Israel chate chu keima dingin kasohte ahiuvin; Egypt gama kona kahin puidoh kasohte ahiuve: keima Pakai na Pathen'u chu kahi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nanghon nangho semthu lim, ahiloule khenthu lim nakisem loudiu, lim kituntho jong natundoh loudiu, songa kisem limpou pou jong a-anga kun nadinga naphudoh lou dingu ahi: ajehchu keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.","title":"Thuman Jeh-a Vangbohna (Danb 7:12-24 ; 28:1-14)","ref":"Pot 20:4; Thmpu 19:4; Danb 5:8; 16:21-22; 27:1."},"2":{"text":"Nanghon kacholngah nikhoho nanit uva, kamun theng najaboldiu ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi."},"3":{"text":"Nanghon kachondan ho-a nachon uva, kathupeh ho nanit uva, chule nabol uva ahile;","ref":"Danb 11:13-15; 28:1-14."},"4":{"text":"Keiman nangho aphatcha gotwi kapeh diu, chule gamsung chun aga ahinsodoh ding, loujaova thingphung hon jong agau ahin sepdoh dingu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule nachang voh-u chu lengpigui lokhomto kikaimatna, nalengpiga lokhomu chu muchi lhah phattoh kikaimat ding: nanghon na annu vasetna naneh uva, chule nagam sunguva bitkeija nachen diu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule keiman gamsunga chamna kalensah-a, chule nalup uva, koimachan nasuh kichat lou dingu ahi: chule gamsunga kona gamsa gilouho chu kano manga, chemjam minjong na gamsungu apal louding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule nanghon namelma teo nadel uva, amaho nangho masanga chemjam'a loudingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nalah uva mi nga-in jakhat nadel uva, mi jakhat nin sangsom nadel jamdiu: namelma teu chu namasanguva chemjam'a loudingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman nangho kajabol uva, kaphat theisah dingu, chule kapunsah uva, nangho to kakitepna naphudoh ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule nanghon akikhol chu naneh uva, athah jeh-a aluichu nahin pohdoh dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule keiman ka houbuh nalah uva katundoh ding: kahinnan nangho ahot louding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Keima nalah uva kache le-a, na Pathen'u kahiding, chule nangho kamite nahi dingu ahi.","ref":"2 Cor 6:16"},"13":{"text":"Nanghon amaho soh nahilou na dinguva, Egypt gama kona nangho hinpui dohpa Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi; chule keiman nanamkol jon khaovu kasuhtana, dingjanga kachesah nahitaove."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla, nanghon kathu nangailou uva, chule hiche thupeh ho jouse nabol lou uva;","title":"Thumanlou Jeh-a Gotna (Danb 28:15-68)"},"15":{"text":"Chule kachondan ho nanah sahmo uva, nahinnaovin kathutan naho ahotbola, chutia chu kathupeh ho jouse nabol daova, kakitepna nasuhkeh uva ahile;"},"16":{"text":"Hichehi keiman jong nangho chunga kabolding ahi; namit teniu kamang ding le nalungsungu sugenthei dinga, nachung uva tijatna, khutsao le khosihpi kachuhsah ding ahi. Chule mohseh-a muchi nalhah dingu ahi, ajehchu namelmate nehding bep ahibouve."},"17":{"text":"Chule keiman nangho douna-a kamai kangat ding, chule nangho namelma teu masanga naloudiu: nangho hinmuda hochun nachung uva vai ahomdiu; chule nangho koima del louva najam dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule hicheho jouse jeh-a jong kathu nangailou nahlai uva ahile, nachonset jeh uva sagi vei kasuh gentheibe ding nahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Chule nakiletsah piu nathanei nao chu kasuhkeh ding; chule navan-u chu thih, chule na leiset nu chu sum-eng kaso ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuteng nathahat naochu mohjen seh-a kisumang ding ahi; ajehchu naleiset un aga asolou ding, gamsunga thingphung honjong aga aseplou dingu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule nangho keito kikala nacheova, kathu nangailou uva ahile; nachonset nahou dungjuija chan sagi-a tam hise nachung uva kalensah ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Keiman nachateo chom mang ding, nagancha hou sumang ding, chule lhomcha naso dinguva gamsaho jong kahinsol ding; chule nalam lhongpiu hou chu agohkeo hiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule hiche ho-a jonghi nangho nakisem thah lou nahlai juva, chule keima toh kikala nachon nahlai uva ahile;"},"24":{"text":"Keima jong nangho to kikala kacheding, chule nachonset nahou jeh-a sagivei kasuhgimbe ding nahiuve."},"25":{"text":"Chule keiman kakitepna nelkalna phula dinga, nachung uva chemjam kachuh sah ding ahi: chule nakhopi hou sunga nangho nakikhop khom tengule, nalah uva natset kalensah ding; chule nangho namelma teu khutna kipedoh ding nahiuve."},"26":{"text":"Chule keiman na-an neh-u hungkon dohna kasuhtan tengle, numei somin thuh khatna nachang lhah-u akandiu, chule amahon nachang lhah-u chu agih dungjuija napehdiu; nanghon naneh uva, ahivanga nava loudiu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule hicheho jouse jenga jonghi nanghon kathu nangailou uva, chule keima toh kikala nache nahlai juva ahile;"},"28":{"text":"Chuteng keima nangho toh kikala lungsa tah-a kacheding; chule keima, keimatah-in nachonset nahou jeh-a sagivei kagimbol ding nahiuve."},"29":{"text":"Chuteng nanghon nachapateo tahsa naneh dingu, chule nachanuteu tahsa jong naneh dingu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chule keima namun sanghou kasuhsetna, nalimsem hou kasuh boh-a, nalongu chu namilim hou long chunga kaselhah ding, chule kahinnan nangho ahotding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Keiman nakhopi hou agoh-a kakoija, namun theng hou chu agohkeova kakoiding, chule nathil namtui hou nam chu kanahpeh louding nahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Chule keiman gamsung chu agohkeova kakoiding: chule namelma teu asunga chengho chun hichu kidang asahdiu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule keiman Pathen helouho lah-a nangho kathecheh ding, nanung uva chemjam'a kalap ding ahi: chule nagamu chu agohkeova uma, nakhopi hou chu ahomkeo hiding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuteng gamsung chu agohkeova aumsungse-a acholngah nikhoho amanding, chule nangho namelma teu gamsunga naum dingu ahi; chutengle gamsung chu kicholdo ding, acholngah nikhoho aman ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Agohkeova aumlai sungse-a kicholdo ding ahi; ajehchu nangho asunga nachen laijun, cholngah nikho hon akicholdo pon ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chule nangho lah-a ahingdoh amoh chasun chunga chu, aumnao amelmateu gamsunga chu alungsunga kichatna kachuh sah ding; thingdo kilin ginin jong amaho adel ding; chule chemjam masanga jam banga jam dingu; chule koiman adellou tengu jongle amaho lhuding ahiuve."},"37":{"text":"Chule koiman adellou tengu jongle amaho chemjam masanga jam banga, khat chu khat chunga lhuding ahiuve: chule nanghon namelma teu masanga dinjou nathei tha nanei loudiu ahi."},"38":{"text":"Nangho Pathen helouho lah-a namanthah heldiu, chule namelma teu gamin nangho naneh jouhel dingu ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chule nangho lah-a ahoidoh hochun namelma teu gamsunga ana khangitlou naho anguipi diu; chule apu apateu khangitlou naho jong chu angui mangpi dingu ahi."},"40":{"text":"Iti hama amahon akhangit lounao le apu apateu khangitlouna, asuhkhel nao keima douna-a asuhkhelna hou, chule keima toh kikala alamlhah nahou aphondoh uva ahile;"},"41":{"text":"Chule keima jong amaho toh kikalin kanachen, chule amelmateu gamsunga kana puilut tan; ijemtia alungsung cheptan louho chu asuhnemuva, chule akhangit lounao talen chu akisanuva ahile;"},"42":{"text":"Keiman Jacob to kakitepna, Isaac to kakitepna, chule Abraham to kakitepna chu kageldoh kitding; chule gamsung chu kahin geldoh ding ahi.","ref":"Semt 17:7-8; 26:3-4; 28:13-14"},"43":{"text":"Gamsung jong amahon adalhah uva, gamsung chun amaho beija agohkeova aum sunga chu acholngah nikhoho aman ding: chule amahon akhangitlou naova atalen matnu chu asandiu ahi: ajehchu amahon kathu tanho anahsah loujeh uva, chule amahon keima chondan ho ahotbol jeh-u ahi."},"44":{"text":"Chule hiche ho jouse jeh-a hi amelmateu gamsunga aumtengule, keiman amaho kapaidoh louding, suhmanghel ding le kakitepna suhkeh nadinga kahot loudingu ahi: ajehchu keima Pakai a-Pathen'u chu kahi."},"45":{"text":"Hijongle keiman amaho jala hi, a-Pathen'u kahi theina dinga Pathen helouho mitmu-a Egypt gama kona kahungpuidoh aputeo apateu to kakitepna chu kageldohkit ding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi."},"46":{"text":"Hicheho hi chondanho, thutan naho, danthuho, Pakaiyin amale Israel chate kah-a Sinai molsanga Mosi khutna asemchu ahi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Pathen'a Ding Thilpeh Chungchanga Danthu"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva hitin seijin, Mikhatnin mihem khat chu Pakaiya katdoh nadinga kitepna aneija ahile, nangman nahisah sah chu hiding ahi"},"3":{"text":"Nangman nahisah ding dan chu pasal kum somni apat kum somgup upa ahile, amachu munthenga shekel dungjuija dangka somnga hiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Numei ahile nangman nahisah ding chu shekel somthum hiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule kum nga-a pat akum somni sung ahile, nangman pasal la chu shekel somni, chule numeija chu shekel som nahisah ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule lhakhat napat kum nga gei ahile, pasal ho dinga natepeh dingchu shekel nga hiding, numei hoding chu shekel thum hiding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule kum somgup mapat chunglam ahia, pasal ahile, shekel somlenga nahisah ding, numei ahile shekel som nahisah ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla nangman nahisah sanga ama anavaichat johle, amachu amale ama thempu henga hung kipelut ding, chule thempun aman atepding ahi. Akihahselpa hijouna dungjuija, thempun aman atepding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule Pakaiya thilto dinga ahin kaiju chu gancha ahia ahile, mitinin Pakaiya dinga ahin to jouseu chu atheng hiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aman hichu akhel louding, aphalou chu apha-a jong alheh louding ahi: chule ijemtia gan chu gana alheh tah-a ahile, hiche chule alhetna chu ania atheng hiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule hichu Pakai henga ganlhaina atoji louvu sathenglou ahia ahile, aman gan chu thempu anga ahin pehlut ding:"},"12":{"text":"Chule hichu thempun hichu apha hile ase hile aman atepding; thempu nangman aman natep jat jat chu aman hijeng ding ahi"},"13":{"text":"Ahinla aman hichu alhatdoh dinga ahile, nangman aman natep chunga chu nga-a khat abelap ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule mikhatnin a-in chu Pakaiya atheng hidinga asuhtheng tengle, thempun hichu apha hile ase hile aman atepding: thempun atep jatjat chu hijeng ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule a-in suthengpa chun a-in chu alhatdoh dinga ahile, nangman aman natep chunga chu nga-a khat abelap ding, chule hichu ama-a hiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule mikhatnin agoulo loumun behkhat chu Pakai henga asuhtheng tah-a ahile, aman dingchu chuche-a muchi kilhah dungjuija nangman natepding ahi; sakolchang chi homer khat chu dangka shekel som nga-a kitepding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aman alou chu Jubilee kum-a pat asuhthenga ahile, nangman aman natep jatchu hijing ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ahinla aman alou chu Jubilee jouva asuhtheng ahile, thempun apehding sum avat chu Jubilee hunglhun nading kum avatho dungjuija asimdoh pehding, chule hichu nangman nateppeh jatna kona kisulhom ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule lou suthengpa chun ipijeh hama alhatdoh dinga ahile, nangman aman natep chunga chu nga-a khat abelap ding, chuteng hichu ama-a dinga kisuhdet pehding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule aman alou chu alhatdoh louding ahia, ahiloule alou chu midang khat henga ajohdoh-a ahile, kilhatdoh kit louding ahitai."},"21":{"text":"Ahinla louchu Jubilee sunga pehdoh ahia ahile, akikatdoh lou banga hichu Pakaiya atheng hiding ahi; hichu thempu gouchan hiding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule khattouvin ama neilegou hilou, amavang achohtho loumun chu Pakai henga asuhthenga ahile;"},"23":{"text":"Chuteng thempun Jubilee kum geija dinga nangman natep chu ama dinga asimpeh-a, chule hiche nikho mama chule amapan nangman natep jat chu thiltheng banga Pakai henga apeh ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Jubilee kum tengle alou chu akichohna pa henga kile kitding, masanga agam neipa heng ngeija chu kile kitding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule nangman natep ho jouse chu munthenga shekel dungjui hicheh ding, gerah somni chu shekel hiding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Gancha peng masapen, Pakaiya dinga apeng masapen hidingho bouchu koimachan asuhtheng louding ahi; bongchal hihen, ahiloule kelngoiho hijongle; hichu Pakaiya ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ahinla hichu gantheng louva kon ahile, natep dungjuija amapan alhatding, chule achunga nga-a khat abelap ding; ahiloule hichu akilhat lou dinga ahile, nangman aman natep dungjuija kijohdoh ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hijeng jongle thil kikatdoh tapou, mikhatnin aneiho jouse lah-a kon mihem le gancha lah-a kon hihen, agouchan alouva kon hijongle Pakaiya dinga akatdoh chan chu kijoh louding, lhatjong kilhatdoh louding ahi: thil kikatdoh jouse chu Pakaiya ding atheng chungnung hia ahi.","ref":"Minb 18:14."},"29":{"text":"Mihem lah-a kona suhmang dinga kikatdohsa mihem vangchu koiman alhatdoh louding, amavang kithat teiding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chule gamsunga somma khat jouse, gamsung muchi-a kon hihen, ahiloule agam theiga lah-a kon hijongle, Pakaiya ahi: Pakaiya dinga atheng ahi.","ref":"Minb 18:21; Danb 14:22-29."},"31":{"text":"Chule mikhatnin asoma khat hochu lhatdoh ding agotna ahile, aman hiche chunga chu nga-a khat abelap ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule bonghon, ahiloule kelngoi hon thudola somakhat chu, moljol noija lut tapou asom lhina jouse chu Pakai henga dinga atheng hiding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Aman hichu aphaham ahiloule aseham akholkhoh louding, chule khel jong akhel louding ahi: chule iham tia aman akhel khah tah-a ahile, hiche chu le akhelpa chu ania atheng hiding ahi; hichu kilhatdoh louding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Hicheho hi Sinai molsanga Israel chatea dinga Pakaiyin Mosi henga athupeh chu ahi."}}}}},"4":{"info":{"name":"Minbu","shortname":"Minb","abbr":[],"desc":"Mosi Lekhabu Thumna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt gama kona ahungdoh kalu kumni channa, alhani lhinna nimasa jouse chu a-in ko kon, aphung phunga apate kailhah cheh-in, amin jatnu dungjui cheh-in pasal jouse abonchan simsoh keijin."},"3":{"text":"Israel sunga galsat dinga manthei jouse kum somni-a pat achunglam sechu nangma toh Aaron'in aloi loija sim sohkei lhonin."},"4":{"text":"Chule aphung phunga apate kailhah-a insung luchang pentah mikhat cheh nakithopi lhon dinga nalhen doh lhon ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule hicheng jouse hi nangni kithopi ding miho minchu ahi: Reuben phunga kon; Shedeur chapa Elizur."},"6":{"text":"Simeon phunga kon, Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel."},"7":{"text":"Judah phunga kon, Amminadab chapa Nahshon."},"8":{"text":"Issachar phunga kon, Zuar chapa Nethaneel."},"9":{"text":"Zebulun phunga kon, Helon chapa Eliab."},"10":{"text":"Joseph chate holah-a kon: Ephraim phunga kon, Amihud chapa Elishama: Manesseh phung kon, Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel."},"11":{"text":"Benjamin phunga kon Gideoni chapa Abidan."},"12":{"text":"Dan phunga kon, Ammishaddai chapa Ahiezar."},"13":{"text":"Asher phunga kon, Ocran chapa Pegiel."},"14":{"text":"Gad phunga kon, Deuel chapa Eliasaph."},"15":{"text":"Naphtali phunga kon, Enan chapa Ahira hiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hichenghi houkhom na lah-a kona aminche cheh ahiuvin, apu apateu phung kaija pipu cheh, Israel asang sang luchang ho ahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron chun hiche amin kisimdoh chengse hi apuidoh lhonin;"},"18":{"text":"Chule houkhom ho jouse chu lhani lhinna nimasa pen nichun akhom khomun, amahon apu apaova a-inko dungjui cheh-in, kum somni-a lhah chunglamse chu asimun, amin jatnu dungjui cheh-in aphung guiju chu aphongdoh taove."},"19":{"text":"Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin, aman jong Sinai gamthipma chun aminu asimtan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Israel chapa alenpen Reuben chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkei tan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Reuben phunga kon akisimdoh amaho chengse chu; sangsomli le sanggup toh janga ahi."},"22":{"text":"Simeon chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;"},"23":{"text":"Simeon phunga kon akisimdoh amaho chengse chu sangsomnga le sangko toh jathum ahi."},"24":{"text":"Gad chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;"},"25":{"text":"Gad phunga kon akisimdoh amaho chengse chu sangsomli le sangnga toh jagup le somnga ahi."},"26":{"text":"Judah chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;"},"29":{"text":"Issachar phunga kon akisimdoh amaho chengse chu sangsomnga le sangli toh jali ahi."},"30":{"text":"Zebulun chate chu akhangu dungjui, ahile;"},"31":{"text":"Zebulun phunga kon akisimdoh amaho chengse chu sangsomnga le sagi toh jali ahi."},"32":{"text":"Joseph chate, aminso dinga Ephraim chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;"},"33":{"text":"Ephraim phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli toh janga ahi."},"34":{"text":"Manasseh chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;"},"35":{"text":"Manasseh phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomthum le sangni toh jani ahi."},"36":{"text":"Benjamin chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;"},"37":{"text":"Benjamin phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomthum le sangnga toh jali ahi."},"38":{"text":"Dan chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;"},"39":{"text":"Dan phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomgup le sangni toh jasagi ahi."},"40":{"text":"Asher chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;"},"41":{"text":"Asher phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli le sangkhat toh janga ahi."},"42":{"text":"Naphtali chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;"},"43":{"text":"Naphtali phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomnga le sangthum toh jali ahi."},"44":{"text":"Hichenghi Mosi le Aaron nin asimdoh lhon chu ahin, Israel pipuho chu mi som le mini ahin; mikhat cheh chu phung khat cheh-a ding ahi."},"45":{"text":"Hijeh chun hichengho jouse hi Israel chate ho, apu apateu insung dungjui cheh-a kumsom ni-a lhah chunglamse, Israel sunga gal konthei cheh akisimdoh hochu ahiuvin;"},"46":{"text":"Aboncha akisimdoh jouse chu, sangjagup toh sangthum toh janga le somnga ahi."},"47":{"text":"Ahivangin Levi ho chu apu apateu kailhah phung lah ahin akisimtha pon ahi."},"48":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,"},"49":{"text":"Levi phung bou chu nasimtha louding, Israel chate kisim na-a jong nasimtha louding ahi."},"50":{"text":"Ahivangin nangman Levi ho chu hettohsahna houbuh chung le asunga um sumlheng ho chung, chule thildang aum jouse vetupma napansah ding ahi; amahon houbuh le asunga sumlheng ho jouse apoh dingu; chule hicheho chunga chu lhacha-a pangdiu, chujongle houbuh kimvela chu gebuh akison dingu ahi."},"51":{"text":"Houbuh chu malama akichon ding tengle, Levi miten aphetlhah dingu: chule houbuh chu sonding ahitengle, Levi mihon atundoh dingu ahi: chule hetkhahlou mi anaija hunga aumle thajeng ding ahi."},"52":{"text":"Chule Israel chate chun ama ama ponbuh cheh chu abung abunga akisah diu, amitakipmin ajanelu dungjuija aponlap kom cheh uva akisah dingu ahi."},"53":{"text":"Amavang Levi ho chun Israel houkhom ho chunga lungsatna aumlouna dinga, hettohsahna houbuh vela chu akisah dingu ahi. Chule Levi ho chun hettohsahna houbuh chunga mopohna anei dingu ahi."},"54":{"text":"Chuin hitichun Israel chate chun Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh jouse dungjui chun abol taovin ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Aphung Dungjui cheh-a Pon-In akisonu"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate jouse chun apu apateu insung melchihna kom, aponlap kom cheh uva pon in akison cheh dingu; amahon houkhom ho houbuh-a kona gamlatah-a pon in chu akison dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule nisa hung sodoh na solam sanga chu ajanelu kihop khen dungjuija Judah le ajanel hon gebuh ason dingu ahi: chule Amminadab chapa Nahshon chu Judah chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahin,"},"4":{"text":"Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomsagi le sangli toh jagup ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule ama banna gebuh kison dinga chu Issachar phung hiding: chule Zuar chapa Nethanel chu Issachar chate chunga gal lamkaija pangding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomnga le sangli toh jali ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chujoule Zebulun phung hintin: chule Helon chapa Eliab chu Zebulun chate chunga gal lamkaija pang ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule ami janel, jatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomsagi le sangli toh jali ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule Judah gebuh-a kisimdoh chengse chu, sangjakhat le sangsomget le sanggup toh jali ahi. Amahohi kipatdoh masadiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule noilam sanga chu ajanelu kihop khen dungjuija Reuben le ajanel hon gebuh ason dingu ahi: chule Shedeur chapa Elizur chu Reuben chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli le sanggup toh janga ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule ama koma gebuh kisonho chu Simeon phung hiding ahi: chule Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel chu Simeon chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomnga le sangko toh jathum ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chubanna chu Gad phung hiding: chule Deuel chapa Eliasaph chu Gad chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli le sanga toh jagup le somnga ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Reuben gebuh sunga kisimdoh chengse chu sangjakhat le sangsomnga le sangkhat toh jali le somnga ahi, chule amaho chu agolni chana kipatdoh dingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuteng houkhom ho houbuh chu gebuh lailunga Levi ho gebuh chutoh kitoldoh thading; amitakip amun cheh-a aponlap-u dungjuija, aponbuh-u ason bang banguva chu kitol dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule lhumlam sanga chu ajanelu kihop khen dungjuija Reuben le ajanel hon gebuh ason dingu ahi: chule Ephraim chate chunga gal lamkai ding chu Ammihud chapa Elishama hiding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli le janga ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule akoma chu Manasseh phung hiding: chule Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel chu Manasseh chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomthum le sangni toh jani ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chubanna chun Benjamin phung hintin: chule Gedeoni chapa Abidan chu Benjamin chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomthum le sangnga toh jali ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule Ephraim gebuh sunga kisimdoh chengse chu sangjakhat toh sangget toh jakhat ahi. Chule amaho chu malam no-a agolthum channa-a chedingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule Dan le ajanel ho gebuh chu ajanelu kihop khen dungjuija sahlam sanga umding ahi: chule Ammishaddai chapa Ahiezer chu Dan chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomgup le sangni toh jasagi ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule akoma gebuh kison dinga chu Asher phung hiding: chule Ocran chapa Pagiel chu Asher chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli le sangkhat toh janga ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chubanna chun Naphtali phung hintin: Enan chapa Ahira chu Naphtali chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomnga le sangthum toh jali ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule Dan gebuh-a kisimdoh jouse chu sangjakhat le sangsomnga le sangsagi toh jagup ahi. Chule amaho chu aponlap utoh anunung pena cheding ahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Chule hichengse hi Israel chate lah-a apu apateu insung dungjuija kisimdoh chu ahi: agebuh uva ajanel pumpiu akisimdoh chengse chu abonchang keijin sangjagup leh sangthum to janga le somnga ahi."},"33":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin, Levi ho chu Israel chate lah-a chun akisimtha pon ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chutichun Israel chaten Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bang chun abol taovin; aponlap kom cheh uva pon in akisonun, amaho insung kailhah dungjui cheh le apu apateu insung dungjui cheh-in malama akitolun ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hichehohi Pakaiyin Sinai molsanga Mosi henga thu anasei nikho-a Mosi le Aaron chilhah ho chu ahiuve.","title":"Aaron Chapate"},"2":{"text":"Chule hicheho hi Aaron chapate min chu ahi: apeng masapen Nadab, chule Abihu, Eleazer chule Ithamar ahiuve.","ref":"Minb 26:60"},"3":{"text":"Hichehohi thempu natohna-a lhacha natoh tong dinga aman akatdoh, thempu dinga thao kinu Aaron chapate ho min chu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule Nadab le Abihu chu Sinai gamthipma Pakai masanga dan ngailouva gimnamtui ahalpet lhonin, Pakai angsunga athi lhontan, chule amanin cha aneilhon pon ahi: chule Eleazer le Ithamar chun apao Aaron mitmun thempu natohna lhachana chu atong lhontan ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 10:1-2; Minb 26:61"},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Thempu Lhachana tong dinga Levi Mite Kilhendoh"},"6":{"text":"Levi phung chu hinpui naijin lang, amahon ama henga lhacha na atohtheina diuvin Aaron thempu masanga hinpui lutnin."},"7":{"text":"Chule amahon houbuh lhacha natoh nadinga, houkhom ho houbuh maija chu ama le houkhom pumpiho kin aboldingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule amahon houbuh lhacha natohna dinga, houkhom ho houbuh manchah jouse achin uva, Israel chate jouse tohding kin chanchu atoh dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule nangman Levi mite chu Aaron le achapate henga napehdoh ding ahi: amaho chu Israel chate lah-a kona apumpiuva ahenga dinga pehdoh ahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Chule nangman Aaron le achapate chu thempu-a napan sah-a, chule amahon thempu tohmun chu angatup diu: chule hetkhahlou mi ahung naija aumle kithat ding ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,"},"12":{"text":"Chule keima, ven, keiman Israel chate lah-a naobu phukeh-a apeng masaho jouse khela Levi mitehi Israel lah-a kona kalahdoh ahitai: hijeh chun Levi mite chu keija hidingu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu apengmasa jouse chu keija ahi; ijeh inem itile keiman Egypt gama apengmasa jouse katha nikho-a chu, Israelte lah-a apengmasa jouse mihem hihen gancha hijongle keima-a dinga kana suhtheng ahitai: amaho keija hiding ahiuve: keima Pakai chu kahi, ati.","ref":"Pot 13:2"},"14":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Sinai gamthipma chun Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Levi Mite Kisim"},"15":{"text":"Levi chateho jouse a-inko kou-a, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjuija, pasal takip lhakhatna pat chunglamse nasim ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakaiyin athupeh bangin amaho chu asimtan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule hicheho hi aminu dungjuija Levi chapate chu ahiuvin; Gershon, Kohath, chule Merari ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Chule hiche hohi a-inkou dungjuijin Gershon chapate ahiuve; Libni chule Shimei ahilhone."},"19":{"text":"Chule a-insungu dungjuija Kohath chapate chu; Amram, Izehar, Hebron, chule Uzziel ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chule a-inkou dungjuija Merari chapate chu; Mahli chule Mushi ahiuve. Apu pateu insung kailhah dungjuija hiche hohi Levi insung mite ahiuve."},"21":{"text":"Gershon'a kon hochu Libni insung mite le Shim insung mite ahiuvin; amaho hi Gershon insung miho chu ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Amaho-a kon kisimdoh, pasal jouse kisim dungjuija lhakhat napat achunglam akisimdoh ho chu sangsagi le janga ahi."},"23":{"text":"Gershon insung mite chun houbuh tomlam, lhumlam sanga houbuh akisondiu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule Gershon insung mite pipuding chu Lael chapa Eliasaph hiding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule Gershon le achapaten houkhom ho houbuh sunga atohdiu chu houbuh, ponbuh, chule achung khuna, houkhom ho houbuh kotna khai ding ponjal,"},"26":{"text":"Chule inhong sunga kikhai pondal ho, houbuh koma umle maicham kimvella um inhong kotna ding pondal, chule akhaoho jouse le hichea pangthei jouse chu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule Kohath insungmiho chu Amram insungmi, Izehar insungmi, Hebron insungmi, chule Uzziel insungmi ahiuve: hichenghi Kohath insungmi ahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Muntheng vetup ding mi pasal lhakhat napat achunglamse akisim doh sangget le jagup ahi."},"29":{"text":"Kohath chapateho insungmi chun houbuh pang lhanglam sanga chu pon in akisondiu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Kohath chilhah insung mite pipupen ding chu Uzziel chapa Elizaphan hiding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule amopoh diu chu Pathen thingkhong, dokhang, meivah khom, maicham ho, akin bolnadiu munthenga sumlheng ho, pondal, chule chua kin kibolding jouse chu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule Aaron thempupa chapa Eleazar chu Levi ho pipuiho chunga pipui pen hiding, chule muntheng vetupma pangho vesuile hiding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Merari'a kon hochu Mahli insungmite le Mushi insungmite ahiuvin; hichengse hi Merari insungmi ho ahiuve."},"34":{"text":"Chule amaho-a kon kisimdoh, pasal jouse kisim dungjuija lhakhat napat achunglam akisimdoh ho chu sang gupto jani ahi."},"35":{"text":"Merari chilhahte insung pipupen chu Abihail chapa Zuriel ahi; hicheho hin houbuh pang sahlam sanga chu pon in akison dingu ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chule Merari chapate vetup dinga kinganse chu houbuh thingpeh ho, chua kimang banggol ho, akhomho, akhom tunnaho, sumlheng ho, chule hicheho to kisai thil jouse,"},"37":{"text":"Chule ahongsung kimvella akhomho, akhom tunnaho, akilbeh naho leh akhaojangho chu ahi."},"38":{"text":"Ahinla solam sanga Houbuh maija, houkhom ho houbuh mai tah-a solam sanga ponbuh song ding chu Mosi le Aaron chule achapateho hiding, Israel chatehoa dinga muntheng mopohna chu atohdiu ahi; chule midang akom naija hung aumleh thajeng ding ahi."},"39":{"text":"Pakai thupeh-a Mosi le Aaron'in asimdoh lhon Levi mite akisimdoh jouse chu, a-inko pumpiuva, pasal lhakhatna pat chunglam jouse chu sangsomni le sangni ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Israel chate apengmasa pasal jouse lhakhat napat chunglam jouse simdoh inlang, aminhou jatchu simdoh-in.","title":"Levi Miten Chapa Peng Masapen ho Panmun Alo-u"},"41":{"text":"Chule nangman Levi mite chu keija dinga Israel chate apeng masaho jouse khella nalahding, (keima Pakai kahi); chule Israel chate gancha apengmasa jouse khela Levi mite gancha chu nalah ding ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakai thupeh bangin Israel achate lah-a apengmasa ho jouse chu asimdohtan ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chule apengmasa pasal jouse min kisim dungjuijin lhakhatna pat achunglam jouse chu sangsomni le sangni toh jani le somsagi le thum ahi."},"44":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,"},"45":{"text":"Israel chate lah-a apengmasa jouse khelin Levi mite, aganchaho khellin Levi mite ganchaho lan; chule Levi mite chu keija hidingu ahi: Keima Pakai chu kahi."},"46":{"text":"Chule lhatdoh-a umding Israel chate apengmasa Levi miho sanga jani le somsagi le thuma tamho chu;"},"47":{"text":"Nangman mikhat na Shekel nga cheh, munthenga shekel kila dungjuija nalahding ahin; (Shekel khat chu gerah somni ahi.)"},"48":{"text":"Chule nangman sum chu avalho lhatdohna dinga Aaron le achapate napehding ahi, ati."},"49":{"text":"Chuin Levi mite sanga tamjoho kilhatdohna ding sum chu Mosi'n alatan ahi."},"50":{"text":"Munthenga shekel dungjuijin Israel chate apengmasa ho-a konin aman sum shekel sangkhat le jathum le somgup le nga alatan ahi."},"51":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin, Mosi'n lhatdamna sum chu Pakai thu dungjuijin Aaron le chapate apetan ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga asejin, hitin ati,","title":"Levi Phung Sunga Kohath Phung Mite Natohding"},"2":{"text":"Kohath chapate mijat chu Levi chapaho lah-a kon le a-insung chule apu apateo insung dungjuijin,"},"3":{"text":"Kum somthuma lhah chunglam kum somnga gei houkhom ho houbuh sunga natohna tongdinga pangthei nalai jouse chu simdoh lhonnin."},"4":{"text":"Hichehi houkhom ho houbuh sunga Kohath chapaten thiltheng chungnung penho chungchanga atohdiu kin chu hiding ahi:"},"5":{"text":"Houbuh chu akichondoh ding tengle, Aaron le achapate chu hunguva muntheng chungnunga kikhai pondal chu aloilhah uva, hettohsahna thingkhong chu akhukhum dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule hichu satwilut vuna akhu khumuva, chule apumpia chu pondum khat akhukhum diu, chutengle ajolho chu athollut dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule vetsahna changlhah dokhang chunga chu pondum khat apha uva, chule hiche achunga chu kongho, thihkheho, sum lhengho, chule asinna ding asinho akoi dingu: chule tanglouhela kikoijing changlhah chu chuche chunga umding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule amahon hicheho chunga chu ponsanthip khat aphadiu, chule hichemama chu satuilut vunho-a akhukhum muva, chule ajolho chu athollut dingu ahi.."},"9":{"text":"Chule amahon pondum khat alah uva alhacha natoh naova kimangcha meivah khom le athaomei, avutloho, akongho, chule chua um athaobelho jouse chu akhukhum diu:"},"10":{"text":"Chule amahon hiche chu le umle belho jouse chu satuilut vunho-a akhukhum uva, ajol chunga chu akoidiu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule sana maicham chung chu pondum khat na akhu khumuva, hichu satuilut vun khuna-a akhudiu, chule ajolho chu avodiu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule amahon munthenga akin bolnaova kinbolna manchaho jouse chu pondum khatna akoijuva, satuilut vun khuna akhudiu, chule moljol chunga akoidiu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule amahon maichama kona vut hochu alahdoh uva, chule achunga ponsandup khat apha diu:"},"14":{"text":"Chule hiche chunga chu amahon kinbolna-a amanchah-u umle belho jouse, gimnamtui halnaho, sathuhna thihkhe kaho, vutloho, twibel ho, chule maichama um thiljouse chu satuilut vun khuna ho-a akhuva, moljol ho avodiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule houbuh chu akichondohna dinga, Aaron le achapaten muntheng le asunga um le bel jouse akhukhum jou tengule; Kohath chapate chu apudinga hungdiu: amavang amahon athilouna dinguva thiltheng tapou chu atohkhah loudiu ahi. Hichehohi houkhom ho houbuh-a Kohath chapate pohding chu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Aaron thempupa chapa Eleazar tohding chu; meija vahding thao, gimnamtui, nitin anneh thilto, nuding thao, chule houbuh pumpi leh asunga um jouse, munthenga thil umjouse le chua um le bel ho jouse vetsui ding chu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,"},"18":{"text":"Levi miho lah-a konin Kohath phung insungmite chu paidoh lhon hih-in;"},"19":{"text":"Ahinla amahon thiltheng chung nungho anaitengule thilouva ahinthei nadinguva hitia hi nabolpeh lhon ding ahi. Aaron le achapate chu lutnuntin, atohdiu kin le apohdiu cheh agotpeh diu:"},"20":{"text":"Amavang thilthengho akikhukhum pet teng, athilouna diuva avedinga lutlou diu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Levi Phung Sunga Gershon Phung Mite Natohding"},"22":{"text":"Gershon chapate mijat chu apu apateo insung pumpi le a-insungu dungjuijin simdoh-in;"},"23":{"text":"Lhacha kin bola lutna, houkhom ho houbuh sunga natohna tongthei jouse chu kum somthuma lhah chunglam kum somnga gei jouse chu nasimdoh ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Kinbol le pohgih pohna lam hi Gershon insung mite tohding kin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule amahon houbuh pondal ho, houkhom ho houbuh, achung khuna, achunga um satuilut vun chung khuna, chule houkhom ho houbuh kotna kikhai pondal,"},"26":{"text":"Chule inhong sunga pondal ho, houbuh kom le maicham kimvela um inhongsung kotpi kotkhah-a pondal kikhaiho, akhaoho, chule akinbol naova manchah jouse le amaho dinga kisem jouse chu apohdiu ahi. Hitia chu amahon kin chu aboldiu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Gershon chapate natoh jouse, apohdiu jouse le akinboldiu jouse chu Aaron le achapate thupeh-a kona aboldingu ahi: chule nangman apohdiu jouse-a dinga thuneina napehding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hiche hi Gershon insung chapatehon houbuh sunga atohdiu kin chu ahi. Chule amaho natoh jouse chu Aaron thempupa chapa Ithamar mopohna noija umding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Merari chapate chu ahile, a-insung hou le apu apateo insung kailhah dungjuija nasimding;","title":"Levi Phung Sunga Merari Phung Mite Natohding"},"30":{"text":"Kum somthuma pat chunglam kum somnga gei, houkhom ho houbuh sunga natong dinga, kinbolna-a lutsese chu nasimding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule amaho mopohna chu hichehi hiding ahi; houkhom ho houbuh sunga anatohnao dungjuija, houbuh thingpehho, chua um banggol ho, akhompiho, akhom tunnaho,"},"32":{"text":"Chule ahongsung kimvela khompiho, akhom tunnaho, akilnaho leh akhaoho, amanchahho jouse pum leh anatohna hou jouse toh pohding ahin; amin cheh uva apoh diu manchah cheh chu nagonpeh ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Hichehi Aaron thempu chapa Ithamar khut noija houkhom ho houbuh sunga akin jouseu dungjuija Merari chapate insung tohding kin chu ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron chule houkhom pipuihon Kohath chapate chu a-insungu dungjui le apu apateo insung kailhah dungjuijin asimtaovin,","title":"Levi Mite Kisim"},"35":{"text":"Kum somthuma pat chunglam kum somnga gei houkhom ho houbuh sunga natong dinga, kinbolna-a lutsese chu,"},"36":{"text":"Amaho insung kailhah cheh-a kisimdoh-a chu sangni le jasagi toh somnga ahi."},"37":{"text":"Hiche hohi Pakaiyin Mosi khutna kona athupeh dungjuija Mosi le Aaron'in Kohath insungmi teho jouse houkhom ho houbuh sunga kin natong dinga asimdoh lhon chu ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chule Gershon chapateho a-insung pumpiu, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjuija kisimdoh ho,"},"39":{"text":"Kum somthuma pat chunglam kum somnga gei, houkhom ho houbuh sunga natong dinga kinbolna-a lutsese chu,"},"40":{"text":"Chuti chun a-insungu pumpi le apu apateu insung kailhah-a kona kisimdoh chu sangni le jagup toh somthum ahi."},"41":{"text":"Hichengse hi Gershon chapate insungho-a houkhom ho houbuh sunga kinbolna jouse-a natongthei cheh dinga Mosi le Aaron'in Pakai thupeh dungjuija asimdoh lhon chu ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chule Merari chapate insung, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjuija a-insung pumpiu kisimdoh ho chu ahi."},"43":{"text":"Kum somthuma pat chunglam kum somnga gei houkhom ho houbuh sunga natong dinga, kinbolna-a lutsese chu,"},"44":{"text":"Hitichun a-insungu dungjuija kisimdoh chengse chu sangthum le jani ahi."},"45":{"text":"Hichengse hi Pakaiyin Mosi khutna kona athupeh dungjuija Mosi le Aaron'in Merari chapate insung anasimdoh lhon chengse chu ahi."},"46":{"text":"Mosi, Aaron chule Israel lamkai pipuihon a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh-a anasimdoh hou chengse chu,"},"47":{"text":"Kum somthuma lhah chunglam kum somnga gei, kinbolna lhacha natohna le houkhom ho houbuh sunga lhacha kinbona dinga hungchan chu,"},"48":{"text":"Hitia amahoa kona kisimdoh jouse chu sang get le janga toh somget ahi."},"49":{"text":"Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Mosi khutna konin amitakip chu atohdiu kin dungjui cheh leh apohdiu dungjui cheh-in asimdoh un, hitichun Pakaiyin Mosi anathupeh bangin amaho chu asimdoh tan ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Mi Thenglou ho"},"2":{"text":"Miphah takip, athilong takip le, thilonga suboh chan chu ponbuh polama anodoh nadiuvin Israel chate thu pen:"},"3":{"text":"Alaitah-a ka chenna aponbuh hou asuhboh louna diuva, nangma pasal le numei agoma nanodoh-a, ponbuh polama nakoidoh ding ahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Israel chaten chutichun abolun, amaho chu ponbuh polama akoitaove. Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a anasei bang chun Israel chaten aboltauvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Tohkhel Jeh-a Leona","ref":"Thmpu 6:1-7."},"6":{"text":"Israel chate jah-a seipeh in, Pasal ahiloule numei khattouvin Pakai douna-a mihemin abolji chonset itobang hijongle abol tengle, hitobang mi chu themmo changa ahin,"},"7":{"text":"Chutengle amahon achonset bolu chu aphondoh dingu, chule aman asuhkhelna chu lhingsetna aledit ding, hichea chu hopnga-a hopkhat abe-a, anasuhkhelna pa chu apehding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla asuhkhel ditdohna ding mipa chu inko neilou ahile, asuhkhelna chu Pakai hengle thempu heng ngeija ledit hen; longlhenna kelngoichal simlouva, ama dinga longlhenna khat semding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule Israel chatehon thempu henga ahinchoi ju ahintou thiltheng hou jouse chu ama-a hiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule amitakip thilto kisuthengho chu ama-a hiding; itobang hile mi khattouvin thempupa apeh tapou chu, ama-a hiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Ji Kitahlou Thudol"},"12":{"text":"Israel chate jah-a seipeh in lang hitihin tin, Pasal khattou aji ajammanga, amapa douna-a suhkhel abola,"},"13":{"text":"Pasal khattou amanutoh alup khoma, hichu ajipa mitmu-a kona akisel manga, aki-imchah-a, chule amanu akisuhboh-a, amanu chunga ahetoh aumlouva, chule amanu matdoh ahilouva;"},"14":{"text":"Chule amapa chunga thangthipna lhagao achuh-a, akisuboh-a a-inneipi chu athang thippi khah tah-a; ahiloule amapa chunga thangthipna lhagao achuh-a, ana kisubohlou a-inneipi chu athang thippi khah tah-a ahile;"},"15":{"text":"Chuteng mipa chun a-inneipi chu thempupa henga apuiding, amanu dinga thilpeh suhlou chang anneh ephah hopsom ma hopkhat ahinchoi ding; amapan achunga thao asunlou ding, bego jong akoilou ding ahi; ajehchu hichehi thangthip thilpeh, hetjingna thilpeh le, khanset geldoh jingna thilpeh ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun amanu chu akom naija apuilutna, Pakai masanga adinsah ding:"},"17":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun twitheng leibela ahindopma; houbuh lhonga leivui chu alah-a, twilah-a chu alhahlut ding;"},"18":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun numeinu chu Pakai anga adinsah-a, asam alhaplhah peh-a, akhutna chu thangthipna thilpeh, hetjingna thilto chu akoi ding: chule thempupa chun akhutna sapset konsah twikha chu akidop ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chutengle thempun amanu kihahsel sah-a, amanu jah-a chu, Koimachan naluppi louva, na-inneipu khela midangtoh thanhoi na-a navamang lou ahile, hiche sapset konsah twikha-a konhin ongtholin:"},"20":{"text":"Amavang na-inneipu khela midang henga vahmanga, nakisuh boh-a, chule na inneipu tailou midang khattouvin naluppi-a ahileh:"},"21":{"text":"Chutengle thempupa chun numeinu chu sapsetna kitepna khatna akitepsah-a, chule thempu chun numeinu jah-a, Pakaiyin napheipi amonsah-a, chule na-oipi apohsah tengle, Pakaiyin namite lah-a nangma gaosap le hahselna nachansah hen;"},"22":{"text":"Chule hiche sapset kona twihin na-oipi pohsah ding le napheipi monsah dinga na-oipi sunga lutding ahi, atiding; chule numeinu chun Amen, Amen, atiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun hiche sapsetna hochu lekhabu khatna ajihlutna, chule aman hicheho chu twikha-a chu asoplhah ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule aman numeinu chu sapset konsah twikha chu adonsah ding, chule sapset konsah twi chu amanu sunga lutna hungkha ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chujouteng thempu chun thangthipna thilpeh chu numeinu khutna kona alah-a, thilto chu Pakai masanga ajapma, maicham chunga ato ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule thempu chun thil kitohdoh, hetjingna ngeitah chu khutdim khat achoija, maicham chunga ahalvam ding, chujou tengle aman numeinu chu adonsah ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule aman amanu chu twi adonsah tengle hitiding ahi, hichu, amanu kisuboh ahia, a-inneipu douna-a suhkhel nei ahile, sapset konsah twi chu asunga lutna, hungkha-a, a-oipi hungpoma, chuleh apheipi hungmon lhading: chuleh numeinu chu amite lah-a sapset chang hitading ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ahinla numeinu chu akisuhboh lou ahi-a, athensel ahivangle; amanu chu ongthola, son le pah aneiding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hichehi inneipi khat a-inneipu khela michom henga achea akisuboh tenga dinga thangthipna dan ahin,"},"30":{"text":"Ahiloule ama chunga thangthipna lhagao ahung uma, ajinu chunga thangthipna nei ahile, numeinu chu Pakai masanga adinsah ding, thempupa chun amanu chunga hiche dan jousehi atoh bulhit ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chutengle mipa chu khangitlouna-a kona ongthola, numeinu chun ama khangitlouna chu akipoh ding ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Nazir Miho Dinga Dan"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate lah-a seipeh-in lang, ajah uva, Pasal ahiloule numei Pakaiya dinga atumbeh hiding, Nazir mikhat hina dinga kitepna-a kitep dinga akichomkhen tengule;"},"3":{"text":"Amachu ju le khamna theija kona kikangse ding, juthuh ahiloule khamnathei juthuh adonlou ding, lengpiga ju tapou hijongle adonlou ding, chule lengpiga athah hihen alui hijongle anehlou ding ahi.","ref":"Luk 1:15"},"4":{"text":"Akichom khenna nikhoho jouse-a chu lengpiguija kona kisem, amuho-a patna ahoh changeija kisem ipi hijongle anehlou ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Akichom khenna akitepna nikhoho jouse-a chu aluchanga samchem chulouding ahi. Chule Pakaiya dinga akipehdohna nikhoho abulhit masangse-a ama chu atheng hiding, chule alua asamlom jong akhansah ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pakaiya dinga akichom khenna nikhoho sungse-a chu aman mithilong anailou ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aman apa ham, anuham, asopipa ham ahiloule asopinu ham athi tengle, amale ama kisuboh louding ahi; ajehchu a-Pathen suhthengna chu aluchanga uma ahi."},"8":{"text":"Akichom khenna nikhoho sungse-a chu ama Pakaiya dinga atheng ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahin mikhattou akoma photlotna athi jeng tah-a, Pathen'a akipeh thengna aluchu abohtah-a ahile, akisuhtheng nikho nile alu ahettol ding, anisagi nile ahettol ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule aniget lhin nile aman houkhom ho houbuh kotbula thempu henga chu vakhu nou ni ahiloule vapal nou ni ahinchoi ding;"},"11":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun khatchu chonset thilto-a ato-a, chule khat chu govam thilto-a atoding, chule amadinga chu longlhena abolding ahi; ajehchu mithilong jeh-a achonsea ahin, chule hiche nima ma-a chu aman alu akisuhtheng ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule akichomkhena nikho hochu Pakai henga suhthengna dinga, kumkhat lhingsa kelngoinou chal khat suhkhel thilto-a dinga ahinkai ding ahi. Amavang akichom khenna abohtah jeh-a chu amasanga nikhoho chu moh hiding ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Chule hichehi Nazir mikhatnin akichom khenna nikhoho alhin teng abolding dan chu ahi: amachu kimutona houkhom ho houbuh kotna chu hung kipui ding:","ref":"Sol 21:23-24."},"14":{"text":"Chule aman Pakai henga govam thilto-a todinga kumkhat lhingsa nolnabei kelngoinou chal khat, chonset thilto-a dinga kumkhat lhingsa nolnabei kelngoinou chal khat, chule chamna thilto-a dinga kumkhat lhingsa nolnabei kelngoinou chal khat apehding,"},"15":{"text":"Chule cholsolou changlhah pocha khat, thao toh kihal changbong neljet changlhah phengkhat, thao kinu-a pasetna kisem cholsolou changlhah khat toh, anneh thilto le donding thilto apehding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule thempu pan hicheho chu Pakai masanga ahinchoi ding, chule aman chonset thilto le govam thilto chu atoding:"},"17":{"text":"Chule aman kelngoichal chu Pakai anga chamna ganlhaina thilto-a dinga cholsolou changlhah pocha khattoh atoding: Thempu pa chun a-anneh thilto le adon thilto jong atoding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule Nazir mi chun houkhom ho houbuh kotna chu akichom khenna lu chu akivoding, chule akichom khenna melchihna asam chu alah-a, hichu gan lhaina chamna thilto ho noija um meisunga aselut ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule thempu pa chun akihonminsa kelngoichal chu adah khatle pocha-a cholsolou changlhah lum khat, chule cholsolou changlhah paset khat alah-a, hicheho chu akichom khenna sam avojou tengle Nazir pa khutna apehding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule thempu pa chun hicheho chu Pakai anga jap thilto-a dinga ajapding ahi: hiche hi le jap thilto-a dinga kitoh a-om le amal chu thempu-a dinga atheng ahi. Chujouteng lehin Nazir mi chun lengpitwi adonthei ding ahitai."},"21":{"text":"Hichehi akitepma Nazir mi-a dinga dan le, akhutnin aphal dungjuija apeh ho simlouva, akichom khenna-a dinga Pakai henga athilpeh ding chu ahi: kitepna-a akitep banga chu akichom khenna dan dungjuija aboltei ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Thempu Mi Phattheiboh"},"23":{"text":"Aaron le achapate jah-a chun hin seijin, Hiche dungjuija hi Israel chate chu phatthei naboh uva, ahenguva hitia nasei dingu ahi,"},"24":{"text":"Pakaiyin nangma phatthei naboh henlang, naching jinghen,"},"25":{"text":"Pakaiyin nachunga amai vahsah henlang, nachunga lungsetna neijinghen,"},"26":{"text":"Pakaiyin nachunga amai hinlah henlang, chamna napejing hen."},"27":{"text":"Chutia chu amahon Israel chate chunga kamin akoidiu; chule keiman amaho phatthei kabohding ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mosi'n Houbuh lhingsetna atundoh-a, thao anua, chule asuh thenga, asunga um amanchah jouse, maicham le um le bel ho jouse toh agoma thao anua asuhtheng phatnin, ahitin ahi.","title":"Lamkai Pipu ho Thilpeh"},"2":{"text":"Phungho pipui, akisimdoh saho chunga lamkai, Israel pipui ho, apu apateu insunga aluchangho chun thilpeh aneijun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule amahon athilto hou; kangtalai innei gup le bongchal somleni hochu Pakai anga ahinchoijun; kangtalai khat chu pipui ni-a ding, chule bongchal khat chu mikhat cheh-a ding ahin: chule amahon hichu houbuh maija ahin choijun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,"},"5":{"text":"Hiche hohi houkhom ho houbuh kinbol na-a manchah dingin amaho-a konin lanlang, amitakip ama ama tohding kin dungjui cheh-in Levi ho chu pen, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n kangtalai hole bongchal ho chu alan Levi ho apetan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Kangtalai ni le bongchal li chu Gershon chapateho atohdiu kin dungjui cheh-in apen:"},"8":{"text":"Chule kangtalai li le bongchal get chu Aaron thempupa chapa Ithamar khut noija um Marari chapateho chu atohdiu kin dungjui cheh-in apen ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahin aman Kohath chapateho chu imacha apepon ahi; ajehchu amahon alengkou uva aput tho uchu munthenga atohdingu kin chu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin pipui hon thao kinu nikho chun maicham katdohna-a dingin thilto aneijun; hitichun pipuiho jengin jong maicham maija chun thilto aneijun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, maicham katdohna-a dinga chu pipui khat cheh-in ama ama nikho-a athilto dingu chu apeh cheh dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Anikho masapen ni-a thilpeh pe-a chu Juda phunga Aminadab chapa Nahshon ahin:"},"13":{"text":"Ama thilpeh chu muntheng shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin; aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"15":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"16":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat:"},"17":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichenghi Aminadab chapa Nahshon thilto ahi."},"18":{"text":"Anini lhin nin Issachar pipu Zuar chapa Nathaneel chun thilto abolin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Aman athilto-a dingin munthenga shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat atoh-in: aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"21":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"22":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat,"},"23":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichenghi Zuar chapa Nathaneel thilto ahi."},"24":{"text":"Anithum lhin nin Zebulun chate pipu Helon chapa Elia'in thilto abolin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ama thilto chu munthenga shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin: aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"27":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"28":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat,"},"29":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichenghi Helon chapa Elia thilto ahi."},"30":{"text":"Anili lhin nin Reuben chate pipui Shedeur chapa Elizur'in thilto abolin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ama thilto chu munthenga shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin: aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi."},"32":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"33":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"34":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat;"},"35":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichenghi Shedeur chapa Elizur thilto ahi."},"36":{"text":"Ani nga lhin nin Simeon chate pipu Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel'in thilto abolin ahi."},"37":{"text":"Ama thilto chu munthenga shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin: aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi."},"38":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"39":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"40":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat;"},"41":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichenghi Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel thilto ahi."},"42":{"text":"Anigup lhin nin Gad chate pipu Deuel chapa Eliasaph'in thilto abolin ahi."},"43":{"text":"Ama thilto chu munthenga shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin: aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi."},"44":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"45":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"46":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat;"},"47":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichenghi Deuel chapa Eliasaph thilto ahi."},"48":{"text":"Anisagi lhin nin Ephraim chate pipu Amihud chapa Elishama'in thilto abolin ahi."},"49":{"text":"Ama thilto chu munthenga shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin: aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi."},"50":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"51":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"52":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat;"},"53":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichenghi Amihud chapa Elishama thilto ahi."},"54":{"text":"Niget lhin nin Manasseh chate pipu Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel'in thilto abolin ahi:"},"55":{"text":"Ama thilto chu munthenga shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin: aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi:"},"56":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"57":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"58":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat;"},"59":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichengpi hi Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel thilto ahi."},"60":{"text":"Aniko lhin nin Benjamin chate pipu Gideoni chapa Abidan'in thilto abolin ahi."},"61":{"text":"Ama thilto chu munthenga shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin: aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi."},"62":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"63":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"64":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat;"},"65":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichenghi Gideoni chapa Abidan thilpeh ahi."},"66":{"text":"Anisom lhin nin Dan chate pipu Amishaddai chapa Ahiezer'in thilto apen ahi."},"67":{"text":"Ama thilto chu munthenga shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin: aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi."},"68":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"69":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"70":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat;"},"71":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichenghi Amishaddai chapa Ahiezer thilto ahi."},"72":{"text":"Nisom le khat lhin nin Aser chate pipu Ocran chapa Pagiel'in thilto abolin ahi."},"73":{"text":"Ama thilto chu munthenga shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin: aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi."},"74":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"75":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"76":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat;"},"77":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichenghi Ocran chapa Pagiel thilto ahi."},"78":{"text":"Anisom le ni lhin nin Naphtali chate pipu Enan chapa Ahira'in thilto abolin ahi."},"79":{"text":"Ama thilto chu munthenga shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin: aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi."},"80":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:"},"81":{"text":"Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:"},"82":{"text":"Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat;"},"83":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hicheng hi Enan chapa Ahira thilto ahi."},"84":{"text":"Hichehi Israel pipuhon thao anu nikhouva maicham kithensona chu ahi: dangka kongtong somleni, dangka sumlheng somleni toh, sana thihkhe somleni ahi."},"85":{"text":"Dangka kongtong ho chu shekel jakhat le somthum cheh-a gih ahin, sumlheng ho chu shekel somsagi cheh-a gih ahi. Dangka um le bel jouse chu muntheng shekel dungjuia shekel sangni le jali gih ahi."},"86":{"text":"Gimnamtui dimset sana thihkhe chu somleni ahin, munthenga shekel dungjuijin shekel som gih cheh ahi. Thihkhe-a sana ho jouse gihdan chu shekel jakhat le somni ahi."},"87":{"text":"Govam thilto dinga bongchal jouse chu bongchal somnileli, kelngoichal somgup, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou somgup, an neh thilpeh jouse toh; chule chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou chu somleni ahi."},"88":{"text":"Chule chamna ganlhai thilto-a ding bongchal jouse chu bongchal somnileli, kelngoichal somgup, kelchal somgup, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou somgup ahi. Hichehi thao akinu jouva maicham thensona chu ahi."},"89":{"text":"Chuin Mosi Ama toh kihou dinga houkhom ho houbuh sunga alutphatnin, Cherub teni kikah-a, hettohsahna thingkhong chunga hepi touna-a kon ahenga thu kisei aw khat ajan, chuin ama koma chun thu aseitan ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Meivah ho Kivah Dingdan","ref":"Pot 25:31-40; 37:17-24."},"2":{"text":"Aaron jah-a thu seijin lang, Nangman meivah navah tengle, meivah sagi chun meivah khom masangtah chu asalvah ding ahi, tin seijin ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Aaron'in hitichun abolin, Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun meivah ho chu meivah khom masanga avahtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hiche meivah khom kisem dan chu sana kikheng ahin, akhom topala pat apah geichu akikheng ahi: Pakaiyin Mosi anavetsah dan bang bang chun, aman meivah khom chu asemin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.","title":"Levi Miteho Kithenso"},"6":{"text":"Israel chate lah-a konin Levi ho chu lhengdoh inlang amaho chu suthengin."},"7":{"text":"Chule amaho suhthenga aumna diuva hitia hi nabolding ahi: achunguva suhthengna twi chu thekhumin lang, amahon atipum piuva amul jouseu chu avolhah diu, chule aponsilu akisop uva, hitia chu amaho kisuhtheng dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chutengle amaho chun bongchalgol khat le anneh thilto, thao toh kihal changbong neljet ngei chu kilah-uhen, chule nangman bongchalgol dang khat chonset thilto dinga nalah ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule nangman Levi ho chu houkhom ho houbuh maija nahinpui ding: chule Israel chate khoppi pumpi chu nakhop khom sohkei ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule nangman Levi ho chu Pakai anga nahin puija, chule Israel chaten amaho chunga chu akhut angap dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Pakai lhacha na atoh doh theina dinguva, Aaron'in Levi ho chu Israel chate-a kon thilto khat banga Pakai angsunga atodoh ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule Levi hon akhutnu chu bongchal teni luchunga angapdiu; chule nangman Levi ho longlhenna dinga bongchal khat chu chonset thilto-a dinga nato-a, chule khatpa chu govam thilto-a dinga nato ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule nangman Levi ho chu Aaron le achapate masanga natousah-a, amaho chu Pakai henga thilto banga natodoh ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hitia chu Levi hochu Israel chate lah-a kona nakhendoh ding: chule Levi ho chu keija hiding ahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Chujou tengle Levi ho chu houkhom ho houbuh lhacha natong dinga lutdiu: chule nangin amaho chu nasuh thenga, thilto khat banga natodoh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho apumpiuva Israel chate lah-a kona keima eikipe ahitan; naobu takip phukeh ho jouse khel, apeng masa jouse khela keiman amaho keija dinga kana kilah ahitai."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu Israel chate lah-a kon apeng masa jouse mihem hihen lang, gancha hile keija ahi. Keiman Egypt gama apeng masa jouse kathagam nikho-a chu amahohi keija dinga kasuhtheng ahitai.","ref":"Pot 13:2"},"18":{"text":"Chule keiman Levi hohi Israel chate apeng masa ho jouse khela kalah ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule Israel chaten muntheng ahinnai tengule, Israel chate lah-a hise umlouna dinga; keiman Levi ho hi Israel chate lah-a kona Aaron le achapate henga houkhom ho houbuh-a Israel chate lhacha natong ding le Israel chate-a dinga longlhenna boldinga thilpeh banga kapeh ahitai."},"20":{"text":"Mosi le Aaron chule Israel chate houkhom ho jouse chun Levi mite chungchanga Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh jouse bangin Levi ho chunga chun abolun, Israel chate chun amaho chunga chutichun abol taovin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Levi miho akisuthengun, avonhou akisop thengun; Aaron'in amaho chu Pakai angsunga thilto bangin atoh doh-in; chule Aaron'in amaho suhtheng nadingin longlhenna abolpeh tan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin hiche jou chun Levi miho chu houkhom ho houbuh sunga Aaron le achapate masanga lhacha natong dingin alut taovin ahi: Pakaiyin Levi ho chung changa Mosi athupeh bangin, amahon hitichun achunguva abol taovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,"},"24":{"text":"Hiche hi Levi mite thudol ahi: kum somni le nga-a lhah chunglamse houkhom ho houbuh-a sunga lhacha natong dinga lutdiu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule kumsom nga alhin tengule lhacha natohna-a kona kicholdodiu, atohbe loudiu ahitai."},"26":{"text":"Hijongle houkhom ho houbuh-a chu asopi hotoh ngaichat ahinaova lhachana atoh khomdiu, amavang lhacha kin abol loudiu ahi. Hitia chu Levi miho chu atohdiu nagonpeh ding ahi, ati."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt gama kona ahung potdoh nungu kumni lhinna, lha masapen-in Pakaiyin Sinai gamthipma Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati.","title":"Anivei Channa Kalchuh Kut","ref":"Pot 12:1-13."},"2":{"text":"Israel chaten akitep phat dungjuijin kalchuh kut mang jingu hen."},"3":{"text":"Hiche lha nisom le nili ni, nilhah lam, akitep phat tah-a hi naman dingu; chondan kisun jouse le akibolding dan jouse dunjuija naman dingu ahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate chu kalchuh kut aman nadingun aseipeh tan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin amahon lhamasa nisom le nili ni nilhah-in Sinai gamthipma chun kalchuh kut chu amangun, Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh jouse dungjuijin, Israel ten hitichun abol taovin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule mi phabep mithilong jeh-a kisuboh aumun, hicheni chun kalchuhkut anitthei tapouvin ahi. Chuin amaho hicheni chun Mosi le Aaron masanga ahungun;"},"7":{"text":"Chule hiche miho chun ajah-a, Mithilong jeh-a suhboh-a um kahiuvin; ibola Israel chate lah-a akitep phat sunga Pakaiya thilpeh kapediu kijahda ham? atiuve."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n ajah uva, Khongaita diuvin, keiman nangho chung changa Pakaiyin thupeh aneijam ngaijing kate, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,"},"10":{"text":"Israel chate jah-a seipeh inlang, hitin seijin, Nalah uva ahiloule nachilhah hou lah-a mikhattou thilong khat jeh-a athenlouva, ahiloule kholgamla tah-a um hijongle, amachun Pakaiya kalchuhkut aman thouthou ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Lhani lhinna nisom le nili nilhah lamle aman dingu, cholsolou changlhah le anche kha toh amediu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Amahon hichu khatcha jong jingkah geija akhenlou diu, agujong khatcha asuhboh loudiu: kalchuhkut kiman dingdan jouse dungjuija aman diu ahi.","ref":"Pot 12:46; Jhn 19:36"},"13":{"text":"Ahin mikhat chu atheng ahia, chule kholgama che jong ahilouva, ahia kalchuhkut mangding anoplouva ahile: amatah chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi; ajeh chu aman akitep phat sungin Pakaiya dingin thilpeh ahinchoipon, hichepa chun achonset akipoh ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule nalah uva namdang mi ahung kholjin auma, ama chun Pakaiya kalchuhkut manding anople, kalchuhkut kiman dingdan dungjuija le chonna ngai dungjuija amanding ahi: nanghon namdang mi ding le agama peng denpa-a dinga dan khatseh naneidiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin houbuh kitundoh ni chun ponbuh, hettohsahna ponbuh chu meilom'in atomin ahi. Chule nilhah lamin houbuh chung chu meikong bangin, jingkah geijin aumin ahi.","title":"Tijat Umtah Meilhang (Pot 40:34-38)"},"16":{"text":"Chutobang chun aumjing jengin ahi: sunle meilom'in atomin chule jan le meikongin akilangjin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule meilom chu houbuh akona lahtouva aum tengle, Israel chate chu akitol jiuvin, chutengle meilom kingahna mun'a chun Israel chaten ponbuh akison jiuvin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Israel chate akitol jiuvin, chule Pakai thupeh dungjuijin gehbuh akison jiuvin; meilom chu houbuh chunga aum laisen apon in houva akicholnga jiuvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule houbuh chunga meilom chu nitampi aumteng le, Israel chaten Pakai thupeh anitnun, akitoldohji pouvin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Meilom chu houbuh chunga chu ni lhomcha aum kom jongle chutobang chun abolun ahi; Pakai thupeh dungjuijin amaho aponbuh uva aumun, chule Pakai thupeh dungjuijin akitol jiuvin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hitichu ahin, meilom chu nilhah-a pat jingkah gei auma, hiche meilom chu jingkah-a akilah-a ahile amaho akitol jiuvin ahi.
