Sun hihen jan hijong le meilom chu akilahdoh tihtih le amaho akitol jiuvin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahiloule nini hihen, lhakhat hihen, ahiloule kumkhat hijongle, meilom chu houbuh chunga auma, aumdena ahile, Israel chate chu aponbuh houva aumun, akitol ji pouve: ahin hichu akilah doh tengle, akitol jiuvin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Pakai thupeh dungjuijin amaho ponbuh-a akicholdo jiuvin, Pakai thupeh dungjuijin akitol jiuvin ahi; Pakaiyin Mosi khutna athupeh dungjuijun, amahon Pakai thu chu anitjiuvin ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.","title":"Dangka Sumkon"},"2":{"text":"Mipi ho koukhom nading le ngahmun ho kitoldoh na-a naman theina dingin dangka sumkon ni semin, hichu sehcha-a nakhetna nasem ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hichu ania amahon amut tengule mipi ho jouse chu nahenga houkhom ho houbuh kotna chu hung kikhom diu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule amahon sumkon khatbou amutnuva ahile, Israel asang asang luchang ho, pipuiho chu nakoma hung kikhom diu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nanghon kigina khatvei namut tengule, solam sanga um gebuh hochu kitolmasa diu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nanghon kigina aniveina namut tengule, lhanglam sanga gebuhho kitoldiu ahi; amahon akitol nadiuva kigina amutdiu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla houkhom ho chu akikhop khom ding tengule nanghon namut diu, amavang kigina namut banguva naginsah lou dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule Aaron thempu chapate chun sumkon chu amut dingu; chule nakhang lhumkei uva a-itih-a dinga chonna dan hiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule nagamsunguva nasugenthei uva namelma teu satdinga nacheuva ahile, nanghon sumkona chu kigina namut diu; chutile Pakai Pathen angsunga goldoh-a naum diu, chule namelma teova kona huhdohna-a naum diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chujongle nakipa nikhou le, naniloupi nikho hou, chule lha kipatseh le napumgo thiltou le nachamna thiltou ganlhaina chunga chu, hicheho chu nangho dinga Pathen angsunga geldoh ahitheina dinga sumkon ho namut dingu ahi. Keima na Pakai Pathen'u kahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin akum nina, alhani lhina, nisomni channi chun ahitin ahi, meilom chu hettohsahna houbuh-a konin akiladoh tan ahi.","title":"Sinai'a Kon Akipatdoh-u"},"12":{"text":"Chuin Sinai gamthipma konin Israel chate akitolun; Paran gamthipma chun meilom chu akingatan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Mosi khutna Pakai thupeh dungjuijin amahon akholjinu masapen chu apan taovin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Amasa penin agalsat miteo dungjuijin Judah chate houbuh ponlap chu achen; chule janel ho chunga lamkaija chu Amminadab chapa Nashon ahi."},"15":{"text":"Issachar chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Zuar chapa Nathaneel ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Zebulun chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Helon chapa Eliab ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin houbuh chu aphelhauvin; Gershon chapate le Merari chapaten houbuh chu apouvin malam ajon taovin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin agalsat miteu dungjuijin Reuben ponbuh ponlap chu akitolin, chule Shedeur chapa Elizur chu janel chunga lamkai ahi."},"19":{"text":"Simeon chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Gad chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Deuel chapa Eliasaph ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Kohath miho chun muntheng chu apouvin akitolun ahi. Chule adangho chun amaho hunglhun masangin houbuh chu anatung doh masaovin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin agalsat miteu dungjuijin Ephraim chate ponbuh ponlap chu akitolin; chule Ammihud chapa Elishama chu ajanel hou chunga lamkai ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule Manasseh chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule Benjamin chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Gideoni chapa Abidan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Dan chate gebuh ponlap chu akitolin, hichu ami janel hou sunga gebuh nunungpen ahin ahi: chule Amishaddai chapa Ahiezer chu janel chunga lamkai ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule Asher chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai Ocran chapa Pagiel ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule Naphtali chate phunga janel chunga lamkai chu Enan chapa Ahira ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hiche hi akitol laijuva agalsat miteu dungjuija Israel chate kitoldan ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n anupapa, Midian mi Raguel chapa Hobab jah-a, Pakaiyin nangho kapeh ding nahiuve tia aseina mun jona che kahiuve; hungin kilhonnute, keihon na bolpha naovinge, ajeh chu Pakaiyin Israelte thudola thilpha aseije, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah-a, Kahung louding ahi; ahin keima kagam le ka-inkote koma kache johding ahi, ati."},"31":{"text":"Chuin aman, Katao ahi, neidalha hih-un; ajehchu nangman keihon gamthipma gebuh iti kason diu nahen, nangma keiho mitna napan ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, nangma keihotoh nalhon khomma ahile, henge, hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin keiho chunga phatna abolding chanchu keihon jong nangma chunga kaboldiu ahi, ati."},"33":{"text":"Chuin amaho Pakai molsanga kon chun nithum lampia chun akipat doh-un: chule Pakai kitepna thingkhong chu nithum lampia chun amaho kingahna ding mun hol dingin amasanguva achen ahi.","title":"Mipite Akipat Doh-u"},"34":{"text":"Chule amaho ngahmuna kona achedoh tengule Pakai meilom chu sun le achunguva aumjin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chule ahitin ahi, thingkhong chu akitol tengle Mosi'n, Pakai, kipatdoh-in, chule namelmaho chu kithecheh-u henlang; nangma nahotbolte chu na angsung jamuhen, atijin ahi.","ref":"Labu 68:1."},"36":{"text":"Chule hichu akingah tengle, aman, O Pakai, Israel sangtamtah henga hung kile kitnin atijin, ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin mipi chu aphun phatnun, Pakai alunglhai tapon: chule hichu Pakaiyin ajan, alung akoujah jengtai; chuin Pakai lunghanna chu amaho lah-a akoudoh tan, gebuh pammong penna umho chu aka mangtan ahi.","title":"Taberah Kiti Mun"},"2":{"text":"Chuin mipi chu Mosi hengah apengjah taovin ahile, Mosi Pakai henga ataovin, hichun meichu amit tai."},"3":{"text":"Mipi lah uva chu Pakai meija ahung kou jehchun, aman hiche munchu Taberah asahtai."},"4":{"text":"Chuin choplop mihonpi lah-a chun sa ducha-a aumtan; chule Israel chate jong chu akapkit taovin; Kon eiho nehding sa eipeh dingu ham?","title":"Mosi'n Lamkai Somsagi Alhendoh"},"5":{"text":"Egypt gama manbeija ineh-u nga ho, changmai ho, donkho ho, louthul ho, louthul tilnei ho, louthul chang neiho chu igel doh-un ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla tun ihinnao agolhatan; chule imitmu uva manna tilou imacha aumpon ahi, atiuve."},"7":{"text":"Chule manna chu pathikhomu toh abangin, chule avoupoh chu thingnaidol toh abangin ahi.","ref":"Pot 16:13-15."},"8":{"text":"Chule miho chu cheova, alokhomuva, sumheija agoibongu, ahiloule songlhenga avoh bonguva, khangbela akanuva, chutengle hiche-a chu changlhah asemjiu ahi: hichu atuidan thaothah kikang changlhah toh abangin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule jana gebuh chunga daitwi ahunglhah tengle, manna chu alhahtha jin ahi.","ref":"Pot 16:13-15"},"10":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n mipi ho jouse a-inko ko-a, ami takip ponbuh kotna akau ajatan; Pakai lunghanna chu nasatah-in ahung kong dohtan, Mosi jong chu alung nommo lheh tan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakai henga, Ipi dinga nasoh hi nagimbol ham? Ipi jeh-a kachunga mipi jouse pohgih hi nangapma, nangma mitmu-a nalungsetna kachan leltam?"},"12":{"text":"Keiman hiche miho jouse hi kanavop ham? Keima hinbeh hiuva Nangma kahenga, Mipan naosen noichep lai apom bangin nangman amahohi na-angsunga pomin lang, apu apateu kateppeh gamma puilutnin neitiham?"},"13":{"text":"Keiman mipi jouse pehdinga sa hoija kalah ding ham? Ajehchu amaho kahenga akapmun, Kaneh diuvin sa neipeuvin, atiuve."},"14":{"text":"Mipi hijatpi hi kachang seh-in pojou ponge, ajehchu keidingin agihsa behseh-e."},"15":{"text":"Hitia hi neibolding ahile, katao ahi, namit mu-a lungsetna kachana ahile, hilai munahin tule tun neithat jengin; kamanthahna muda jenginge, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Nangman mipi ho chunga lamkai le upa ahi tia nahet Israel upaho mi somsagi kahenga hinkhomin; chule amaho chun nangma to adinkhom theina diuvin houkhom ho houbuh-a hinpuijin."},"17":{"text":"Chule keima kahung kumlhah-a hikoma chu nangma kakihoupi ding: chule nachunga um lhagao chu kalah-a amaho chunga kakoiding; chule nangman mipi ho pohgih chu nachang seh-a napoh louna dinga amahon napoh hu dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule nangman mipi ho jah-a, Jing nikho-a dingin nangma cheh kisutheng uvin, nanghon sa naneh dingu ahitai. Ajehchu nangho Pakai nakhanga nakapmun, kon keiho nehding sa eipeh diu ham? Egypt gama kaumu chun nom kasajouve, nati uve: hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin nangho sa napeh uva naneh diu ahitai."},"19":{"text":"Nanghon nikhat jong hilou, nini jong hilou, ninga jong hilou, nisom jong hilou, chule nisomni hilou;"},"20":{"text":"Ahinla lha lungkeija nanah hom sunguva ahungdoh-a, naloh-u asotokah seuva ding ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon nalah uva um Pakai chu nanotthap uvin, a-angsunga nakamun, Ipidinga Egypt gama kona ihung doh uham? nati uve, tin seipeh-in, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n, Alah uva kaumna mipi, kenga lamjotthei cheh sangjagup hiuva; nangman, Amahon lhakhat lhungkeija aneh diuva sa kapeh ding ahi, tin naseije."},"22":{"text":"Anehkhop nadiuva kelngoihon le gancha honho chu kithapeh ding hiuvem? ahiloule anehkhop nadiuva twikhanglen'a nga jouse kimatkhom peh ding hiuvem? ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Pakai khut chu kisuchoma hitam? tu-a hi nangman kathusei nachunga aguilhun aguilhun lou namu ding ahi, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Mosi apotdoh-in, mipi ho chu Pakai thu chu aseipeh-in, chule mipi lah-a upa somsagi ho chu akhomin, houbuh kimvella chun adinsah tai."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Pakai meilom'in ahung kumlhan, ajah-a thu aseijin, chule achunga um lhagao chu aladoh-in, upa somsagi ho apetan ahi. Chuin ahitin ahi, lhagao achunguva achuh phatnin, gaothu aseijun, atang tapouvin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ahin mi ni chu gebuh-a umden ahin, khatpa minchu Eldan ahin, khat chu Medad ahi: chuin Lhagao chu achung lhona achun; amanihi amin kilakhom lah-a chu jao ahilhonin, houbuh-a potdoh lou ahilhone. Chuin amanin gebuh sunga gaothu aseilhon tan ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin gollhang khat ahunglhaijin, Mosi jah-a, Eldad le Medad-in gebuh sunga gaothu aseilhone, ahungtin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin agollhangho lah-a khat, Mosi lhacha Nun chapa Joshua'n adonbutnin, kapu Mosi, amani khu phohthipmin, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n ajah-a, Keima jala namit thip ham? Pakai mite jouse themgao hiuhenlang, Pakaiyin achunguva alhagao koi tavele kati, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Israel upa hochu gebuh sunga aluttaovin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiya konin hui ahung nungin, twikhanglen'a konin vamim ahinlhoh-in, gebuh kom, hilama kona nikhat lampi, khulama kona nikhat lampi tobang gei, gebuh kimvela, chule hichu leiset chunga kon tongni geija sangin alhahsah-in ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Vamim Apeh-u"},"32":{"text":"Chuin mipi ho chu adingdoh-un, nilhum keile jan khovah-in, chule ajing nilhum keijin, vamim hochu aloh-un: alohlhom pen pan pocha som alohdoh-in; chule hicheho chu ama ama ding cheh-in gebuh kimvela chun thejaovun ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin ahakah uva sa chu aumnalaija, alhaigoi masangun, Pakai lunghanna chu mipi dounan ahung kongdoh tan, Pakaiyin mipi chunga chun hise nasatah achuhsah tan ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chule hiche mun'a chu sa-a lop miho avuitah jeh-un, hiche mun chu Kibroth-hatta-avah asahtai."},"35":{"text":"Chuin mipi chu Kibroth-hatta-avah'a konin Hazeroth jonin akitolun, Hazeroth'a gebuh asemtaovin ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Ethiopia numei khat akichenpi jeh-in Miriam le Aaron'in ama douna thu aseilhontan ahi: ajehchu aman Ethiopia numei khat ana kichenpin ahi.","title":"Miriam Talen Mat"},"2":{"text":"Chuin amanin, Tahbeh monga Pakaiyin Mosi'a kona bou thu aseiham? eini-a kona jong asei hilouham? atilhone. Chule hichu Pakaiyin ajatan ahi."},"3":{"text":"(Tuhin Mosi kiti mipahi leiset chunga mijouse lah-a alungneng pen ahi)."},"4":{"text":"Chuin phulou helouvin Pakaiyin Mosi, Aaron, chule Miriam henga thu ahin seijin, Nangho thum houkhom ho houbuh lama hungun, ati. Chuin amaho ahung taovin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pakai chu meilhang khompin ahung kumlhan, houbuh kotna chun adingin, Aaron le Miriam chu ahin kouvin: chuin amani ahung potdoh lhonin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin aman, Tun kathu ngailhonin: nalah uva themgao auma ahile, keima Pakaiyin amachu gaova kakihetsah-a, chule manga akoma thu kasei ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ka-insung pumpi-a tahsan umtah, kalhacha Mosi chunga vang chutobang ahipoi.","ref":"Heb 3:2"},"8":{"text":"Ama hitoh kikam sanna, kicheh tah-a, thu ki-im beija kakihoupiji ahi; chule aman Pakai melso jong amu ahi; chuti ahile ibola kalhacha Mosi douna-a thusei ding kichalou nahi lhonham? ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pakai lunghanna chu amani dounan ahung koudoh-in; chuin adalhatan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin meilhang chu houbuh-a konin akihohdoh tan; veuvin, Miriam chu ahung phah-in, buhbang bangin abangtan: chuin Aaron'in Miriam chu aven, chuin veuvin, amanu aphah ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Aaron'in Mosi jah-a, Ohe, ka Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, ngolhoi tah-a kanachon lhona, kaboldoh lhon chonsetna, hiche chonsetna hi kachung lhona ngam loujenin."},"12":{"text":"Mi anu sunga atipum akehkhat beisa-a hungpenga bangin, amanu hi athisa bangin umsah hih-in, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Mosi Pakai henga ataovin, Vo Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, amanu hi tun damsah-in, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Amanuhi apan amaichanga achil asetkhuma ahile amanu nisagi sung jahchalou ding ham? gebuh-a konin nisagi kaidoh-unlang, hiche jou chule puilut hikit hen, ati.","ref":"Minb 5:2-3."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Miriam chu nisagi gebuh pama akoijun; Miriam ahung kipui lut kit kahsen mipi chu akitol tapouve."},"16":{"text":"Hichejou mipi chu Hazeroth'a konin akichonun, Paran gamthipma chun ponbuh asong taove."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Gam Velhi Dinga Mi Kisol"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate kanapeh, Canaan gam kholtoh dingin, apu apateu kailhah cheh-a mi khatcheh, alah uva vaipo khatcheh chu solin, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakai thupeh bang chun amaho chu Paran gamthipma konin asoltai. Hiche miho chu Israel chate aluchang ho ahiuvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule hichengsehi amaho min ahi: Reuben phunga Zaccur chapa Shammua."},"5":{"text":"Simeon phunga, Hori chapa Shaphat."},"6":{"text":"Judah phunga Jephunneh chapa Caleb."},"7":{"text":"Issachar phunga, Joseph chapa Igal."},"8":{"text":"Ephraim phunga, Nun chapa Oshea."},"9":{"text":"Benjamin phunga, Raphu chapa Palti."},"10":{"text":"Zebulun phunga, Sodi chapa Gaddiel."},"11":{"text":"Joseph phunga, tichu Manesseh phunga Susi chapa Gaddi."},"12":{"text":"Dan phunga, Gemalli chapa Ammiel."},"13":{"text":"Asher phunga, Michael chapa Sethur."},"14":{"text":"Naphtali phunga, Vophsi chapa Nahbi."},"15":{"text":"Gad phunga, Michi chapa Geuel ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hiche hohi Mosi'n gam velhi dinga asol miho min chu ahi. Chuin Mosi'n Nun chapa Oshea chu Jehoshua tin asah-in ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n amaho chu Canaan gam velhi dingin asolin, ahenguva hitin aseije, Lhanglam sanga kon khun chetouvun lang, molchunga khun kaldoh-un;"},"18":{"text":"Chule gavechenun agam chu itobang ham, chule asunga chengho chu hatnaovem ahiloule hatmovem, lhomuvem ahiloule tamuvem;"},"19":{"text":"Chule achennao gamchu itobang ham, pha-am ahiloule se-ham, achennao khopiho-a chu itobang khopi ho-a chenguva, pon in'a cheng hiuvem ahiloule kulpi-a cheng hiuvem;"},"20":{"text":"Chule agam chu itobang gam ham, leipha ham ahiloule leiphalou ham, hichea chu thing umam ahiloule umhih-am gaveovin. Nangho hangsanun lang agamga hinpouvin. Hichelai phat tah chu lengpithei ga masapen minphat tah ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chutichun amaho achetouvun, agam chu Zin gamthipma pat Hamath lutna Rehob geijin akhol taovin."},"22":{"text":"Chuin amaho lhanglama konin achetouvun, Anak chate ho Ahinam, Sheshai, chule Talmai umna mun Hebron ahung lhungun ahi. (Tun Hebron chu Egypt gama Zoan kisahdoh ma kum sagi masanga kisadoh ahitai.)"},"23":{"text":"Chuin amaho Eshcol vachadung ahung lhungun, hichea konchun amahon lengpi theiboh khat aboh pumin asat lhaovin, minin moljolin ahinjong lhonin; chule kolbuthei ho le thei changho ahin pouvin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hiche munna kona chu Israel chaten lengpiga boh asatlhah jeh-un, hiche mun chu Eshcol vachadung akisahtan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin amahon gam chu agakhol toh-u nisomli jouvin ahung kilekit taovin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin amaho acheuvin Mosi le Aaron henga, chule Kadesh mun'a um Paran gamthipma Israel chate houkhom ho jouse henga ahungun; chule amaho hengle houkhom ho jouse henga thu ahin pouvin, agamga jong chu amaho avetsah-un ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule amahon ama henga, Keiho nangman neisolnao gama chu kacheuvin, tahbeh mongin agam chu khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam ahi; chule hiche hi agamga chu ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin agama chengho chu mihat ahiuvin, akhopihou chu kulpi kikai khum ahin, chule aletna lenthei ahi; chukalvalin keihon chukoma chun Anak chateho kamuvin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Amalek miho chu lhanglama achengun; Hit miho, Jebus miho, chule Amor miho chu molsang ho-a achengun; chule Canaan miho chu twikhanglen pang le Jordan panga achengun ahi, atiuve."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Caleb min mipi ho chu Mosi angsunga chun aphoh thipmin, Eiho mangang tah-in cheu hitin, galo jengu hite; ajehchu eihon ijo teitei dingu ahi, ati."},"31":{"text":"Ahivangin ama chekhom piho chun, Eiho amaho igajo lou dingu ahi; ajehchu amaho eiho sanga hatjo ahiuve, atiuve."},"32":{"text":"Amaho chun agakhol tohnao gamchung chang thudola chun Israel chate henga thulhut phalou ahin pouvin, Keiho kacheuva kaga kholtoh nao gam chu agama chengho negamhel thei gam ahin; chule chua kaga mu-u mijouse chu milen ngen ahiuve."},"33":{"text":"Chule keihon chumuna chun milen tahtah ho, Anak chapate, milen tahtah ho chilhah-a kon hungpengho chu kagamuve: chule keiho mitmun keihochu khaokhopi bangbep kahiuvin, amaho mitmu-a jong chutobangma chu kahiuve, atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Semt 6:4"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin houkhom ho jouse chun aw sangtah-in asamun, apengun; hiche janchun mipi chu akaptaovin,","title":"Mipi Kiphin"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate jouse chu Mosi le Aaron chunga aphun taovin: houkhom pumpi chun ajah lhona, Pathen'in Egypt gama eina thisah-u hitavele! Ahiloule Pathen'in hiche gamthipma hi eina thisah-u hitavele!"},"3":{"text":"Chule ipi dinga Pakaiyin hiche gamahi chemjam'a lougam ding le, kaji kachateu hi gal anchah hiding bepma eipuilutnu hitam? eiho dinga Egypt gama kilekit phajo louding ham? atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chuin amaho khatle khat akihouvun, Eihon lamkai khat kilhenu hitin, Egypt gam lama kilekit tao hite, atiuve."},"5":{"text":"Hichun Mosi le Aaron chu Israel chate houkhom kikhomho jouse angsunga chun abohkhup lhontan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin gam kholtoh-a cheloi lah-a pang Nun chapa Joshua le Jephunneh chapa Caleb chun aponsil lhon abot-eh lhonin:"},"7":{"text":"Israel chate houkhom ho jouse henga chun, Kholtoh dinga kachot lenao gamchu gampha tah mongmong ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pakai ichunguva alunglhaina ahile hiche gama chu eipuilut nuva, khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam chu eipeh diu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Pakai dounan kiphinda poupou vunlang, chuche gam mite jong kicha hih-un; ajehchu amaho i-anchah dingu ahiuve: akihon bitnao chu amaho-a kona chedoh ahitan, chule eihovang Pakaiyin eiumpiuve: amaho chu kicha hih-un, tin aseilhonin ahi.","ref":"Heb 3:16"},"10":{"text":"Ahinla houkhom ho jouse chun songa sedingin agaotaovin ahi. Chuin Pakai loupina Israel chate jouse angsung, houkhom ho houbuh-a chun ahung kilahtan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Itihchan hiche mipi ho hin eilung hansah diuham? Chule alah uva melchihna hijatpi kamusah nunguva jong, itihchan eitahsan da diuham?","title":"Mipite-a Dinga Mosi Atao"},"12":{"text":"Keiman amaho chu natsetna kajepma, kasuhmang ding; chule keiman nangma amaho sanga lenjole hatjo nam khatna kasemding nahi ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakai henga, Chuteng Egypt mihon hichehi ajah diu, (ajehchu nangman hiche mihohi nathahatna amaho lah-a kona nahinpuidoh ahi;)","ref":"Pot 32:11-14."},"14":{"text":"Chule amahon hiche gama cheng miho henga aseidiu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon, Pakai nangma hiche miho lah-a naum, Pakai nangma chu kimaito-a akimupiu, nameiloma achungu na-opkhum, chule amasanguva sunle meiloma nache-a, janle meikonga nacheji chu ajataovin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tun nangman hiche mite jousehi mikhat bangin that talechun, nangma minthan ja-a namho chun,"},"16":{"text":"Pakaiyin hiche mihohi ahahselna gama apuilut jou tahlou jeh-a, gamthipma athagam ahi atudiu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule tun, nahenga katao ahi, ka Pakai thilboltheina chu loupi hen, nangman hitia nasei bangin,"},"18":{"text":"Pakai chu thoh hattah, hepina lentah nei, khangitlouna le suhkhelna ngaidam ji, chule themona chu donlouva koilou, pate khangitlouna chate chunga khangthum khangli geija viljing nahi.","ref":"Pot 20:5-6; 34:6-7; Danb 5:9-10; 7:9-10"},"19":{"text":"Katao ahi, hiche mipi ho Egypt'a pat tuni geija nangaidam bangin, nahepina lentah dungjuijin hiche mipite khangitlouna hi ngaidamtan, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin, nangma thu dungjuijin amaho hi kangaidam tai;"},"21":{"text":"Ahinla keima tahbeh-a kahinjing bangin, leiset pumpihi Pakai loupina-a dimset ding ahi.","ref":"Heb 3:18"},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche mite Egypt gam le gamthip laija kaloupina le kathilbol kidang bolho mujouse, chule tu-a som veijen eipatepma, ka aw ngailou jouse hin;"},"23":{"text":"Thonlou hela amahon apu apateo kahahselna gam chu amu louhel diu, chule eilung hansah jousen jong amulou diu ahi:"},"24":{"text":"Kalhacha Caleb vangin lunggel chom neija, eijui lhingset jeh-a, agachena gama chu kapuilutding, chule achilhah ten alodiu ahi.","ref":"Josh 14:9-12"},"25":{"text":"(Tun Amalek miho le Canaan miho chu phaichama chun achengun ahi.) Jingle kiheijun lang, twipisan jotna lampia konin gamthipma lut taovin, ati."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Akiphin Jeh uva Pakaiyin Talen Amatsah-u"},"27":{"text":"Hiche houkhom gilouho keima douna aphun phun uhi itihchan kathoh ding ham? keima chunga Israel chate phunna hohi kajatan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Amaho chu seipeh-in, keima tahbeh-a kahinjing bangin tin Pakaiyin aseije, Nanghon kana benga nasei jouseu banga hi, nachung uva keiman kabolding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Nalongu hiche gamthipma hi lhukam ding ahi: keima douna phunna, kum somni-a lhah chunglam, nami jatnu dungjuija nalah uva kona kisim doh jouse chu,","ref":"Heb 3:17"},"30":{"text":"Jephunneh chapa Caleb le Nun chapa Joshua tailou, nangho chensahna dinga kahahselna gama chu khatcha nalutlou dingu ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ahinla mi anchah ding bep natiu nachasen hou, amaho chu kapuilutna, nanghon nanot thapmu gam chu ahetdiu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Nangho thudol vang, nalongu hiche gamthipma hi lhuchap ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule nachateo chu gamthipma kum somli vahle leova, nalongu gamthipma hi abeihel kahse-a najon thanhoi naochu athoh diu ahi.","ref":"Sol 7:36"},"34":{"text":"Gam nagakhol nao nikhojat dungjuija, nisomli ngeichu, nikho khat nakhangitlou naochu kumkhat nakipoh diu, kum somli sunga, chutengle keima hi aki pampai teng iti ji-am nahetdiu ahi."},"35":{"text":"Pakai Keima kaseidoh ahin, douna-a kikhom khom hiche houkhom gilouho jouse chunga hi katohdoh tahbeh ding ahi: hiche gamthipma hi mangthah uva, thigam ding ahiuve, ati."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n gamkholtoh dinga asol miho, ahung kile kitnuva gamthudol akaleh-a thu ahinpoh jeh uva, houkhom ho jouse phunchel sahho,"},"37":{"text":"Chule gam chunga thudola thulhut phalou hinpoho ngei chu, Pakai angsunga hisen athigam taovin ahi."},"38":{"text":"Ahinla gamkhol dinga cheho lah-a pang, Nun chapa Joshua le Jephunneh chapa Caleb vang ahing lhon nalaije."},"39":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n hiche thukisei hohi Israel chate chu aseipeh tai: chuin mipi chu alung hem cheh taovin ahi.","title":"Gam Lahding Agot Masat Penu (Danb 1:41-46)"},"40":{"text":"Chuin jingpitah-in athoudoh un, molsang vuma akaldoh-un, Veuvin, eiho hikoma i-umuve, Pakaiyin eitep pehnao mun'a ichetou dingu ahi: ajehchu eiho ichonse taove, atiuve."},"41":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n ipi dinga Pakai thupeh napalkeh-u ham? Hiche nathil gonuhi lolhing louding ahi."},"42":{"text":"Namelma teu masanga tha-a naum louna dingun, chetou hih-un; ajehchu nalah uva Pakai aumtapoi."},"43":{"text":"Ajehchu Amalek mihole Canaan miho namasanguva aumun, achemjam muva nalou gamdiu ahi: ajehchu nangho Pakaiya kona kiheimang nahitaovin, hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin naumpi lou dingu ahi, ati."},"44":{"text":"Ahin amaho lhangvuma kaltou dingin akigotei teijun: ahivangin Pakai kitepna thingkhong le Mosi la gebuh-a konin akipatdoh pon ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chuphatnin Amalek miho le chucheng lhangvuma cheng Canaan miho chu ahungkum lhaovin, amaho chu athagtnun, Hormah geijin asatpeh-un ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Ganlhaina Chungchanga Danthu"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate chu seipeh in lang, ajah uva hitin seijin, Keiman nangho kapeh, nachenna diu gam nalhun tengule,"},"3":{"text":"Ganhon ahiloule kelngoi honna kona Pakai henga gimnamtui dinga, Pakaiya dinga meija kitohdoh thilto govam thilto ham, kitepna guilhunsah ganlhaina ham, lungcham thilto ham, ahiloule nakut loupiho ham napeh tengule,"},"4":{"text":"Chutengleh Pakai henga thilto pedingpa chun anneh thilto-a dinga changbong neljet ephah hopsom-a hopkhat toh kihal thaotwi hin khat hoplia hopkhat ahinchoi ding;"},"5":{"text":"Chule donding thilto lah-a lengpitwi hin khat hoplia hopkhat chu govam thilto ham, ganlhaina ham toh kelngoinou khatna dinga nagon ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahiloule kelngoichal khat dinga, nangman changbon neljet hopsom-a hopni, thaotwi hin khat hopthum-a hopkhat toh kihal anneh thilto nagon ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule donding thilto dinga chu lengpitwi hin khat hopthum-a hopkhat Pakaiya henga gimnamtui tah hidinga nato ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule govam thilto dinga bongchal nagon tengle, ahiloule kitepna suhbulhit na dinga ganlhaina ham, ahiloule Pakai henga chamna thilto ham nagon tengle;"},"9":{"text":"Chutengle nangman thaotwi hin keh khat toh kihal changbong nelsel hopsom-a hopthum, bongchal tochun anneh thilto ding nahin kaiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule donding thilto-a lengpitwi hin keh khat, Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kitohdoh thilto nahinchoi ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hitia chu bongchal khat ham, ahiloule kelngoichal khat ham, kelngoinou khat ham, ahiloule kelnou khat hama dinga nabol ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Nagondiu jat dungjuija, amitakip henga ajatnu dungjuija naboldiu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule agama peng jouse chun, Pakai henga gamnamtui tah hidinga meija thilto apeh tengule hitia hi aboldiu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule namdang mi nangho toh akholjin khoma, ahiloule nakhang khanguva nalah uva khosaden chan chun, Pakai henga dinga gimnamtui thilto meija kitohdoh thilto apeh noma ahile, nangho bolbang banga aman jong abolding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule nangho houkhom ho le namdang mi nalah uva khopem hon pomding chondan khat naneidiu, nakhang khanguva a-itih-a chondan khatbou nanei dingu ahi: namdang miho chu Pakai anga nangho bang bang hidingu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nangho le nalah uva khopem namdang miho-a dinga dan khatseh le chonna dan khatseh umding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 24:22"},"17":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,"},"18":{"text":"Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva seipeh-in, Nangho keiman kapuilut na ding gama chu nalhun tengule,"},"19":{"text":"Chutengle hitiding ahi, nanghon agam changlhah naneh tengule, Pakai henga jap thilto nato dingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Nachanglhah meh masapenu chu jap thilto-a natodiu: changphola jap thilto nabol banguva chutia chu nabol dingu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Nakhang khanguva nachanglhah mehmasa penu chu Pakai henga jap thilto-a nato dingu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Mosi henga anasei hiche thupeh jouse hi nasuhkhel uva, nanit lou uva ahile,"},"23":{"text":"Pakaiyin Mosi ana thupeh ni-a kipat amasanglam nakhang lhungkeijuva Pakaiyin Mosi khutna kona nangho nathupeh jouse geija chu;"},"24":{"text":"Chutengle hung hitiding ahi, houkhom ho hetlouva hetlou jeh-a suhkhel ahile, houkhom ho jousen bongchal golkhat Pakai henga gam namtuitah hidinga govam thilto-a ding, a-anneh thilto le adonding thilto toh dan dungjuija atotha diu, chule chonset thilto-a dinga kelnou khat atodiu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule thempupa chun Israel chate houkhom ho jouse dinga longlhenna abolding, hetlouva kibol ahijeh-a kingaidam ding ahiuve. Chule ahetlou jeh uva Pakai henga meija kitohdoh ganlhaina thilto ahinchoi uva, Pakai henga achonsetnao thilto ahinchoi dingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule Israel chate houkhom ho jouse le amaho lah-a khopem namdang mipi jouse chu kingaidam ding ahiuve; ajehchu mijouse chun ahetlouvu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule mikhat tou hetlou jeh-a achonsetna ahile, amachun kelcha anu kumkhat lhingbep khat chonset thilto-a dinga ahinchoi ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 4:27-31."},"28":{"text":"Chutengle thempupa chun hetlou jeh-a chonsepa dinga chu longlhenna abolding ahi, chule aman Pakai anga hetlou jeh-a chonset abola alonglhena abol tengle amachu kingaidam ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Nanghon Israel chate lah-a peng hihen, nalah uva hung khopem namdang mi hijongle, hetlou jeh-a chonset bolpa dinga dan khat nanei dingu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ahivangin henasa-a bolpa chu, gamsunga penga hihen lang, namdang mi hijongle, amachun Pakai i-sah louva abol ahin; amachu amite lah-a kona kipaimang ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ajehchu aman Pakai thu chu anot thapma, athupeh apalkeh ahin, hichepa chu paimanga umding ahi; akhangit louna chu ama chunga chuding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule Israel chate gamthipma aumpetnun, choldo ni-a thingkang chom mikhat amutaovin ahi.","title":"Cholngahni Sukehpa"},"33":{"text":"Chuin thingkang chom muho chun amachu Mosi le Aaron chule houkhom ho jouse henga ahin puitaovin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin iloding akiphondoh loulai jeh-in, amachu mihen na-a akoi taove."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Mipa chu thatei ding ahi: houkhom ho jousen gebuh polama songa asediu ahi, ati."},"36":{"text":"Chuin mipi chun Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin amachu gebuh pama ahin puidoh-un, songa aseplih taovin ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Von Chungchanga Danthu"},"38":{"text":"Israel chate jah-a chun akhang khanguva apon geihou ajeppah nadiu le, agei ajep pahnao chunga chu adumpol aba diuvin seipeh-in,","ref":"Danb 22:12"},"39":{"text":"Chule nanghon najeppah nao chu nangho dinga, hichu navet nuva, Pakai thupeh jouse chu nageldoh uva nabol nadiu hidin: chule jonthanhoi boldinga anung najuijiu nalung ngaichatnu le namit vetnu chu najuilou nadiu ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chutia chu kathupeh jouse nageldoh uva, nabol uva, na Pathen'u dinga atheng nahinadiu ahi."},"41":{"text":"Keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahin, na Pathen'u hidinga Egypt gama kona nahin puidohpao chu kahi: keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Izhar chapa, Kohath chapa, Levi chapa Korah le Reuben chapate Eliab chapa teni Dathan le Abiram, chule Peleth chapa On chun miho apuijun,","title":"Korah, Dathan, chule Abiram Kiphin","ref":"Jud 11."},"2":{"text":"Chuin houkhom ho sunga um loupileh, minche cheh akikhom khomho pipui jani le somnga le Israel chate phabep toh Mosi maija adingdoh-un,"},"3":{"text":"Chuin amaho Mosi le Aaron dounan akikhomun, aheng lhona, Houkhom ho jouse, amitakip athengun alah uva Pakai aume ti hena sasan nakibolthei sah behseh lhone. Ibola Pakai houkhom ho chung vuma kidomsang jeng nahi lhonham? atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n hichu ajah phatnin, tolla aboh khupmin:"},"5":{"text":"Korah le aloiho jouse jah-a chun aseijin, hitin ati, Jingkah le Pakaiyin koi chu ama-a hija, koi chu atheng hijaham avetsah-a; chule amachu aheng anailut sah ding ahi: chule ama alhenpa tah ngeichu akinailut sah ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hiche hi bolun: Korah le aloiho jousen gimnamtui lheng ho kilah-un;"},"7":{"text":"Chule Asunga chun mei hallun lang, jingteng Pakai angsunga asunga chun gimnamtui koijun; chule hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin alhen amapa chu atheng hiding ahi. Nangho Levi chate, nakibolthei sah behseh taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Korah jah-a, Ngaijun, katao ahi, nangho Levi chapate;"},"9":{"text":"Ama henga puinaja, Pakai houbuh lhachana tongding le, houkhom ho masanga akinthengu bol dinga ding dinga Israelte Pathen'in Israel houkhom ho-a kona nachomkhenu hi nangho dinga thil neocha bou hia nagelu ham?"},"10":{"text":"Chule aman nangma le nasopi ho Levi chapate jouse ama henga napuinai taove: achutile nanghon themputna jong nahol nahlaiju ham?"},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun nangma le naloiho jouse Pakai dounan nakikhom khomun: ahi. Aaron chu ipi hija ama douna-a naphunu ham? ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Eliah chatehi Dathan le Abiram koudin mi asolin ahile, amanin, hungtou lhon ponge:"},"13":{"text":"Khoiju le bongnoi lonna gama kona gamthipma thadinga neihin puidoh-u hi thilneocha hija, kachunguva naki piput sah ham?"},"14":{"text":"Chukal vallin nangman khoiju le bongnoi lonna gama neipuilut pouvin, ahiloule lou le lengpilei la neilosah deh pouve: hicheng miho jouse mit hi kaldoh nagot ham? kahung tou lhon louding ahi, ati lhontan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Mosi alung ahang lheh jengtan, Pakai henga, Athil toujong sanghih-in; keiman amaho-a konin sangan khatjong kalapon, amaho khatcha jong kasuna pon ahi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Korah jah-a, Nangma le naloiho jouse, nangma le amahose chu Aaron toh jingle Pakai angsunga naum diu ahi:"},"17":{"text":"Chule amitakipmin nagimnamtui lheng cheh kilah unlang, asunga gimnamtui koijun, chule amitakipmin nagimnamtui lheng cheh-u gimnamtui lhengcheh-u, jani le somnga chu Pakai anga hinchoijun; nangma le Aaron'in jong nagimnamtui lheng cheh nakichoi lhonding ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amitakip min agimnamtui lheng cheh akilah-un, asunga mei akoijun, achunga gimnamtui akoijun, houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga chun Mosi le Aaron toh ading khom taovin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Korah chun amaho dounan houkhom ho jouse houkhom na ponbuh kotphunga akhomin ahi: chuin Pakai loupina chu houkhom ho jouse henga ahung kilah tan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati,"},"21":{"text":"Hetmanlouva amaho kasuhmang theina dingin, hiche houkhom ho-a konin kikhindal lhonin ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin amani abohkhup lhonin, Vo Pathen, tahsa jouse lhagao ho Pathen, mikhat chonset jeh-a houkhom ho jouse chunga lunghang ding nahi hitam? atilhon tan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin,"},"24":{"text":"Houkhom ho jah-a chun, Korah, Dathan chule Abiram houbuh-a konin kikhin doh-un tin seijin ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Mosi akipatdoh-in Dathan le Abiram henga achen; chule Israel upahon anung ajuijun ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin aman houkhom ho jah-a, Naheng uva katao ahi, hiche miphalou ho ponbuh ho-a konin kikhin doh-un, chule a-imachao tongkha hih-un, achuti loule achonsetnao jouse-a mangthah getnun nate, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chutichun amaho Korah, Dathan chule Abiram houbuh ningtina konin akipat doh-un ahi. Chuin Dathan le Abiram ahungdoh lhonin, aponbuh-u kotphunga chun ajiteu, achateu, chule achasen houtoh ading taovin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n hichea kona hi Pakaiyin keima hicheng na jouse tong dinga eisol ahi nahet dingu ahi; ajeh chu keiman hiche hohi kalung chama kabol ahipoi."},"29":{"text":"Hiche miho hi mijouse thi ngaija athiuva, ahiloule miho kivil banga akiviluva ahile, Pakaiyin eihin sol hilou ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ahinla Pakaiyin thilthah abola, leiset akam katna, amaho hi aneijouseu toh aval lhuma, chule kotong sunga gangtah-a alhah lhumuva ahile; hiche miho hin Pakai alung hansah uve ti nahet chet dingu ahi, ati."},"31":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, aman hicheng thuhi aseijou jouvin, anoijuva leiset chu ahung keh-in akikhen totan ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Leisetnin akam ahin kathom sah-in, amaho le a-inhou, chule Korah loiho jouse le athilkeo jouseu chu aval lhumtan ahi."},"33":{"text":"Amahole aneijouseu ahingin kokhuh sunga chun alhalutnun, chule achunguva leiset akichin; amaho houkhom ho lah-a konin amangthah taovin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin avela um Israel ho chu amaho pen gin chun ajam gamtaovin ahi. Ajehchu amahon, Eiho jong leijin eival lhum getnunte atiu ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiya konin meikong ahungdoh-in, gimnamtui hal mi jani le somnga chu akavamtan ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Gimnamtui Lheng"},"37":{"text":"Aaron thempu pa chapa Eleazar jah-a, gimnamtui lhengho chu meikong lah-a kona ladoh nadin seipeh-in, ajehchu hicheho chu atheng ahi; chule meichu gamlha thim tah-a thaijah-in."},"38":{"text":"Amaho hinna douna-a chonseteho gimnamtui lheng ho chu maicham khuna kongdalin semuhen; ajehchu amahon Pakai anga ato-u ahin, hijeh-a chu hicheho chu thenga ahi. Chule hicheho chu Israel chate dinga melchhihna hiding ahi, ati."},"39":{"text":"Chuin Eleazar thempupan meikavam hon thiltona amanu sum-eng gimnamtui lheng ho chu alan, hiche ho chu maicham khuna kongdalin asemin;"},"40":{"text":"Hichu Aaron chilhah hilou namdang mi koimachan Pakai angsunga gimnamtui hal dinga ahung nai louna diu; Pakaiyin Mosi khutna kona ahenga aseibanga, Korah le aloiho abah louna diuva, Israel chate dinga hetjingna hiding ahi."},"41":{"text":"Ahivangin ajingin Israel chate houkhom ho jouse chu Mosi douna le Aaron dounan aphunuvin, Nangman Pakai miho nathatne atiuvin ahi.","title":"Aaron'in Mipite Ahuhdoh"},"42":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, houkhom ho chu Mosi le Aaron douna-a akikhop petnun, houkhom ho houbuh lam chu aveovin ahile: veuvin, hichu meilom'in atomin, chule Pakai loupi chu ahung kilah-in ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron chu houkhom ho houbuh maija chun ahung lhonin ahi."},"44":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a thu aseijin,"},"45":{"text":"Amaho chu hetmanlouva kasuhmang thei nadin, hiche houkhom ho lah-a konhin hung doh-in, ati, chuin amaho chu abohkhup gam taovin ahi."},"46":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Aaron jah-a, Gimnamtui lheng kilah-inlang, asunga chun maichama kon mei koilutnin, chule gimnamtui hal loijin lang, mangang tah-in houkhom ho henga chenlang, amaho dingin longlhenna gabolin: ajehchu Pakaiya konin lunghanna ahungdoh tan, hise akipantan ahi, ati."},"47":{"text":"Chuin Aaron'in Mosi'n athupeh bangchun alan, houkhom ho lah-a alhailuttai; chule veuvin, mipi ho lah-a chun hise chu anakipantan ahi. Chuin aman gimnamtui ahalin, mipi ho dinga chun longlhenna aboltan ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chuin ama athiho le ahingho kikah achun adingin ahile, hise chu atangtan ahi."},"49":{"text":"Tun Korah chungchang thua thiho tilouvin, hise-a thichu sangsom le sangli le jasagi ahi."},"50":{"text":"Chuin Aaron chu houkhom ho houbuh kotphung lama Mosi henga akiletan: chule hise chu atangtan ahi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Aaron Tenggol"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate jah-a seijin lang, apu apateu insung kailhah mikhat cheh-a kon tenggol khatcheh, apipuhou jouse apu apateo insung kailhah cheh-a kon tenggol somleni lan lang; chule nangman amitakip min chu atenggol chung cheh uva chun sunnin."},"3":{"text":"Chule nangman Aaron min chu Levi tenggol chunga nasutding ahi; ajeh chu tenggol khat cheh chu apateo insung luchang cheh-a ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule nangman hiche ho chu nangma kakimupina houkhom ho houbuh sung hettohsahna maija chu nakoi ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, keiman kalhen pen tenggol chu hungpah ding ahi: chutengle Israel chate aphun nao, nangni douna-a aphunao chu keija kona kasuh tang ding ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate henga chun aseijin ahile, pipuho chu aman tenggol khatcheh apeuvin, apu apateo insung dungjuijin tenggol somleni apeuvin ahi. Chule Aaron tenggol chu amaho-a tenggol lah-a chun aumin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n hettohsahna houkhom ho houbuh sunga Pakai anga chun tenggol ho chu akoitan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, ajingin Mosi hettohsahna houbuh sunga chun alutnin ahile, veuvin, Levi insung dinga Aaron tenggol chu anadonin, amumdoh-in, chule ahungpah-in, jonmot anagan ahi.","ref":"Heb 9:4."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n tenggol ho chu Pakai angsunga konin Israel chate henga ahinpodoh-in; chule amahon aveovin, amitakipmin atenggol cheh akilah taovin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Aaron tenggol chu akiphinho hetna-a hettohsahna maija koidin hinlechoi kitnin; chutengle amaho keima douna-a aphunchel naova athilou nadinguva nasuhthip ding ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n hiti chun abolin, Pakaiyin thu apeh bang chun aboltan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Israel chaten Mosi jah-a, Ven, keiho kathigamun, kamang thah-un, kamanthah gamhelu ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Koi hijongle Pakai houbuh hinnai jouse chu thiding ahi: thina-a chu imanthah dingu hitam? atiuve."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin Aaron jah-a, Nangma le nachapa, chule napu napateu insungin munthenga khangitlouna chu napohdiu, chule nangma le nachapate nangma toh na themputnao khangitlouna chu napohdiu ahi.","title":"Thempuho le Levi ho Mopohna"},"2":{"text":"Chule Nangma le nachapaten hettohsahna houbuh maija lhachana natoh naova nakithopi theina dinguvin, Levi phunga nasopi ho, napa phungmi hochu hin kipuijin."},"3":{"text":"Chule amahon nangma natoh ding le houbuh natohding jouse chu avetup dingu ahi: amaho ahia nangma nahi-a jong nathilou na dinguva munthenga bel hole maicham bou chu ahin nailou dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule amahon nangma nakitho piuva, houkhom ho houbuh natoh le houbuh lhacha natoh jouse atohdiu: chule namdang min vang nahinnai louding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chutia chu Israel chate chunga lunghanna aumbe louna dinga, nangman muntheng natoh le maicham natoh chu natoh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule keima, ven, keiman nasopi ho Levi chate chu Israel chate lah-a konin kalheng doh-in; houkhom ho houbuh-a natong dingin Pakai dinga thilpeh khat bangin nangma nakipe taove."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun nangma le nangma to umkhom nachapaten maicham le pondal sunglam thua thempu tohmuna na natoh diu ahi: nathempu tohmun natohhi nalhacha natohdiu thilpeh-a kapeh-u nahiuve: namdang mi ahin naija chu thiding ahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Aaron jah-a, Ven, keiman jap thilto, Israel chaten thiltheng jouse chu nangma mopohna jong kapen; hicheho jouse chu thaokinu ahijeh-a nangma le nachapate a-itih-a chondan khat hidinga kapeh nahi.","title":"Thempuho Chanvou"},"9":{"text":"Hiche hi meija kona amoh, nanga dinga thiltheng chungnung ho chu ahi: athil tohou jouse anneh thilto jouse, achonset thiltou jouse, asuhkhel thiltou jouse-a keima eipehdiu jouse chu nangma le nachapate dinga theng chungnung hiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Muntheng chungnunga chu nangman nanehding; pasal takipmin anehdingu ahi: hichu nangma dinga atheng hiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hichehi nanga ding ahi; Israel chaten dopkhang thilto dinga athilto hou, ajap thilto hou jouse toh, nangma le nangma toh umkhom nachapate le nachanute henga a-itih-a chondan hidinga kapeh nahiuve: na-insunga atheng tapouvin hichu aneh dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Thao apha pentah le, lengpitwi apha pentah, chule suhlou chang, aga masapen ho Pakai henga apehdingu hou jouse chu nangma kapeh nahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule Pakai henga ahin choi dingu gamsunga amin masapen chan chu nanga ding ahin; na-insunga atheng takipmin hichu aneh dingu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Israel gamsunga thilto jouse nanga hiding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 27:28."},"15":{"text":"Pakai henga apeh-u, tipum jouse-a naobu phukeh masa chan chu mihem hihen gancha hile nanga hiding ahi: ahivanga cha masapen chu nalhatdoh teiding ahin, chule gancha thenglou apeng masapen ho chu nalhat doh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule lhakhat ahia patna alhatdohna ding ho chu nalhatdoh ding, alhatna man nangma gon dungjuija, muntheng shekel dungjuija shekel chu gerah somni ahin, shekel nga-a nalhat ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahivangin bongnou masapen, kelngoi masapen le kelcha masapen chu nalhatdoh louding ahi; amaho atheng ahiuve: athisanu chu maicham chunga nathe-a, athao chu Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kitoh thilto dinga nagoding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule a-om kijap le adah jetlam nanga ahibanga, atipum chu nangma ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Israel chaten Pakai henga lhuh thilto apeh-u thil thengho jouse chu, nangma le nangma toh umkhom nachapate le nachanute henga a-itih-a chondan hidinga kapeh nahiuve. Hiche hi Pakai anga a-imatih chana dinga nangma le nachilhahte henga chi-a kitepna hiding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Aaron henga thu aseijin, ajah-a, Nangman amaho gamsunga gou naneilou ding, chule alah uva chan jong naneilou ding ahi: Keimahi Israel chate lah-a nagou le nachan chu kahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule ven, keiman Levi chate chu Israel gamsunga hopsom jouse chu, atoh-u lhacha natoh, houkhom ho houbuh-a alhacha natoh-u jehtah chun agoulo diuvin kapen ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 27:30-33; Danb 14:22-29."},"22":{"text":"Tua patna Israel chaten chonset apoh uva athilouna dinguva, houkhom ho houbuh aga nailou dingu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Amavang Levi ho chun houkhom ho houbuh lhachana atoh uva, athemo nao chu apohdiu ahi. Hichehi a-itih-a nakhang lhum keijuva dinga chondan hiding, chutia chu Israel chate lah-a goulo naneilou diu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Amavang Israel chaten Pakai henga lhuh thilpeh-a apeh-u ahopsom hou chu Levi hon gouva alodiuva kapeh ahitai; hijeh-a chu keiman ajah uva, Israel chate lah-a amahon goulo aneilou diu ahi, kati ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Levi ho Somakhat"},"26":{"text":"Nangman Levi ho kihoupin lang, ajah uva, Nanghon Israel chate hopsom, keiman nagoulo diuva kapeh chu amaho-a kon nalah tengule, hopsom-a hop khat ngeichu Pakai dinga lhuh thilto-a napehdiu ahi, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chule hiche nalhuh thilto hou chu pholla chang leh lengpi chilhahna-a pum dimset banga kisimding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hita chu Israel chate hopsom nalah jouse chu Pakai henga lhuh thilto-a nato diu; chule chuche Pakaiya lhuh thilto chu Aaron thempupa napeh diu ahi."},"29":{"text":"Nathilto hou jouse lah-a kon aphapen le, atheng chengse chu Pakai henga lhuh thilto-a nato teidiu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu nangman amaho jah-a hitia nasei ding ahi, Nanghon aphapen ho nalhuhdoh tenguleh Levi ho dinga hiche hi changphol le lengpitwi kiheh na-a kona agasoh-a kisim ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule hiche hi nangma le na-insung miten mun jouse-a naneh thei dingu ahi: ajeh chu hichehi houkhom houbuh-a nalhacha natoh manuva kipe tohman ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule hichea kona aphapen nalhuh tengule, hiche jeh-a chu nanghon chonset napoh loudiu: chule nathi louna dinguva Israel chateho thiltheng jouse chu nasuhboh theilou dingu ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.","title":"Bongsan Kigouvam Vut"},"2":{"text":"Hichehi Pakai thupeh chona danthu ahin, Israel chate henga chun bongla asan, pol lou, achunga nolna beihel, achunga namkoljon kibut khalou, nahin kaipeh nadiuvin seijin."},"3":{"text":"Chule hiche chu Eleazar thempupan gebuh pama ahin kaidoh dinga napeh ding, chule mikhatnin a-angsung laitah-a atha ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chutengle Eleazar thempupa chun athisan chu akhutjunga alah-a, houkhom ho houbuh masanga sagivei atheding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule khatnin ama mitmu-a bongla chu agoding; avunjong, atipum jong, athijong chule a-eh jong ahalding;"},"6":{"text":"Chutengle thempu chun Cedar thing le hyssop chule asandup alah-a, bongla kigona meikong lah-a chu aselut ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule thempu chun aponho akisopma, atahsa twija akisil ding, chujoule gebuh-a hunglut ding, chule thempupa chu nilhah geija thenglou ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hitia bongla gou penpen chu twija avon asopma, amajong twija kisilding, chule nilhah geija thenglou ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule mitheng khatnin bongla kigona vutvam chu alokhoma, gebuh pam muntheng lai khatna akoiding, chule Israel chate houkhom ho-a dinga kisekhena twija mandinga koiding ahi: hichu chonset suhtheng na hiding ahi.","ref":"Heb 9:13"},"10":{"text":"Chule bongla kigona vutvam lohkhompa chun avon asopma, nilhah geija atheng louva umding ahi: chule hichu Israel chate le alah uva namdang akholjin khompiu ho-a dinga a-itih-a dinga dan hiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Koi hile thilong tongkha-a chu nisagi thenglouva umding ahi.","title":"Thilong Tohkhah"},"12":{"text":"Chule hiche twija chu anithum nile kisuthenga, anisagi nile amachu thengding ahi; ahin ama anithum nile akisuhtheng louva ahile, anisagi lhinni jongle thenglou ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Mi khattou mithi long tongkha-a, chule kisutheng louchun, Pakai houbuh asuhboh ahin; amachu Israel chate lah-a kona kipaimang ding ahi. Ajeh chu achunga kise khenna twi akithe khumpon, ama chu athenglou hiding; athenlouna chu achunga umnalai ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hichehi mikhat pon in'a athi tenga dan ding chu ahi: pon in sunga hunglutho jouse le, pon in sunga um jouse chu nisagi thenglou diu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule asunga um kong le bel asin umlouva kihong jouse chu athenglou hiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule koi hijongle tol lhanga chemjam'a kithat, ahiloule mithilong, ahiloule mithigu, ahiloule lhankhuh tongkha-a chu nisagi athenglou hiding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule hiche athengloupa dinga chu amahon chonset thensona bongla kigona vutvam hochu alahdiu, chule twi longlai toh kongsunga ahaldiu,"},"18":{"text":"Chutengle mitheng khatnin hyssop alah-a, twija chu adelutna, ponbuh chung le kongho chung jouse le mi aumho chung jouse-a, migu, ahiloule akithat, ahiloule mithi, ahiloule lhankhuh tongkhapa chu athinkhum ding:"},"19":{"text":"Chule mithengpa chun athengloupa chu anithum channi, chule anisagi channile athin khum ding ahi: chule anisagi channi le amajong kisuthenga, avon asopma, atahsa twija kisilngim ding, chule nilhah lam lebou thengding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ahin mi athenglou, ama le ama kisutheng lou chu, houkhom ho lah-a kona kipaimang ding ahi; ajehchu mipa chu Pakai muntheng asuhboh ahi: achunga kisekhena twi akithin khumlou ahin; amachu athenglou ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule hichu amaho dinga a-imatih channa dinga chondan hiding ahi. Chule kisekhena twi chapma pangpen pen chun apon akisop ding; chule kisekhena twi tongkha penpen chu anilhah geija aboh-a umding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule ipi hijongle atheng loupan athamkhah tapou chu aboh hiding ahin; chule chuche thil tongkha pa chu nilhah geija bohding ahi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Israel chate, houkhom ho pumpi ngei chu lha masa sungin Zin gamthip ahung lhungun ahi. Chuin mipi ho chu Kadesh'a gebuh akisonun; chule hia chun Miriam athin, hia chun avuitaovin ahi.","title":"Kadesh Mun'a Thilsoh (Pot 17:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Chule hia chun houkhom ho ding twi aumtapon; chuin amaho Mosi le Aaron dounan akikhom khom taovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin mipin Mosi akinah piuvin, hitin atiuve, Isopihou Pakai angsunga anathi laijuva chu Pathen'in eina thisah-u hitavele!"},"4":{"text":"Chule ipidinga keiho le kagancha hou hi hikoma thi dinga, nangman Pakai houkhom ho hi hiche gamthima neipuidoh-u ham?"},"5":{"text":"Chule ipi dinga keiho hiche gitlouna muna hi puilut dinga Egypt gama kona neihung doh sah-u ham? Hiche hi muchi, thei changho, lengpitheiho, kolbuthei ho mun jong ahipon; twidon ding jeng jong aumpoi, atiuvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron chu mipi kikhom mitmu tah-a chun houkhom ho houbuh kot lama chun achelhon tan, amai tolla asulut lhonin ahi: chuin Pakai loupina chu ahenguva ahung kilahtan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati."},"8":{"text":"Tenggol chu kilah-in, chule nangma le nasopipa Aaron'in mipi chu khomkhom lhoninlang, amitmu tah-un songpi jah-a chun thu seilhonin; hichun atwi ahin putdoh sah-a, chutia chu nangman songpi-a kona chu twi naputdoh sah ding ahi. Chutengle nangman houkhom ho le aganchahou twi napeh ding ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin ama thupeh bangin Mosi'n tenggol chu Pakai angsunga konin akilahtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Aaron'in houkhom ho chu songpi masanga chun akhom lhonin; chule ajah uva, Tun doumah bolho nanghon ngaijun; hiche songpi-a kona hi twi kalon dohsah teitei lhonding ham? ati lhone."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n akhut chu adomsangin, atenggolin songpi chu nivei avon ahi. Chuin twi chu neng jengjungin ahung longdoh tan, hitichun houkhom ho le agancha houvin jong adonun ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron jah-a, Nangnin Israel chate mitmu-a suhtheng dinga neitahsan lhonlou jehchun; hiche mihohi keiman kapeh gamsunga chu napuilut lhon louding ahitai, ati."},"13":{"text":"Hiche hi Meribah twi ahi; ajehchu Israel chaten Pakai chu akidou piuvin, chuin Ama amaho-a chun suhthengin aumin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n thupole ho chu Kadesh'a konin Edom lengpa koma asolin, ahenga, Nasopipa Israel'in hitin aseije, nangman kachunguva lhung hahsatna ho jouse nahesoh keijin:","title":"Edom Lengpan Israelte Agamsung Ahosah Nomlou"},"15":{"text":"Itobanga kapu kapateu chu Egypt gama anachesuh uva, chule keiho Egypt gama phat sottah kana chennuva; chule Egypt mihon keiho le kapu kapateu einabol genthei danhou;"},"16":{"text":"Chule keihon Pakai henga kapen phatnun, aman ka aw-u ajatan, vantil khat ahin solin, Egypt gama konin eipuidoh-un ahi. Chule ven, keiho Kadesh mun, nagamgi china um khopi khatna kaumuvin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Katao ahi, Nagamsung neijot galkaisah-un: keihon loulai ahiloule lengpithei leiho lah kajot loudiu, twikul ho-a twi jong kadon loudiu ahi: lengpa lamlena bou kacheuva, nagamgi sung kagalkai kahseuva jetle veija jong kakihei loudingu ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Edom'in ahenga, nahung galkai theilou dingu ahi, achutiloule nangdouna-a chemjam toh kahung konding ahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chun ajah-a, Keiho lamlena chu kache dingu ahi: chule ijemtia kei le kagancha hon natwi kadon uva ahile, aman kapeh dingu ahi: imacha dang bollouva kenga bou kache galkai dingu ahi, atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chuin aman, Nagalkai theilou ding ahi, ati. Chuin Edom chu amaho dou dingin mi tamtah le galsatmi hat tahho toh ahung kon taovin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hitichun Israel gamgi galkaisah ding Edom anomtapon; hijeh chun Israel chu ama-a konin achoma akihei mangtai."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate, houkhom ho jouse ngei chu Kadesh'a konin ahung kitolun, Hor molsang ahung lhung taovin ahi.","title":"Aaron Thi"},"23":{"text":"Chuin Edom gamgia Hor molsanga chun Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga chun aseijin, hitin ati."},"24":{"text":"Aaron amitetoh kigom khom ding ahitai; ajehchu ama Israel chate kana peh gama chu lutlou ding ahi, ajehchu Meribah twija chun kathu dounan nakiphin lhonin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Aaron le Achapa Eleazar chu kouvun lang, Hor molsanga hinpui touvin:"},"26":{"text":"Chule Aaron vonho chu sutlhan lang, achapa Eleazar vonpeh-in: chule Aaron amitetoh kigoma khoma, hia chu thiden ding ahi, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakai thupeh bangin abolin: houkhom ho jouse mitmu-a chun amaho Hor molsang lama akaltou taovin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Aaron vonho chu asutlhan, achapa Eleazar chu avonpeh-in; chule hiche molsang chunga chun Aaron athitan ahi: Chuin Mosi le Eleazar chu molchunga kon chun ahung kumsuh lhontan ahi.","ref":"Pot 29:29; Minb 33:38; Danb 10:6"},"29":{"text":"Chuin houkhom ho chun Aaron thi chu amu phatnun, amaho Israel insung pumpi ngei chun Aaron chu nisomthum alunghem piuvin ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin lhanglama cheng Canaan mi Arad lengpa chun gam velhi lampia ahunguve tia kisei ajah phatnin; Israel chu akisatpin, amaho lah-a phabep jong gal hingin ahinkaijin ahi.","title":"Canaan Mite Chunga Galjona","ref":"Minb 33:40."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Israel chu Pakai henga kihahsel in, Tahbeh-a nangman hiche mihohi kakhutna neipeh doh-a ahile, keiman akhopihou kasuhmang hel ding ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Israel aw chu angaipeh-in, Canaan miho chu akhutna apedoh tan; chuin amahon amaho le akhopi hou chu asumang hel taovin ahi. Chule aman hiche munchu Hormah tin asahtai."},"4":{"text":"Chuin amaho Hor molsanga konin Edom gam velkolna dingin twipisan jotna lampi lamchu ajonkit taovin; chule mipi ho chu lampi jeh-in alungu alha lheh jengtan ahi.","title":"Sum-enga Kisem Gul","ref":"Danb 2:1."},"5":{"text":"Chuin mipi ho chun Pathen le Mosi dounan thu aseitaovin, Ipi dinga nangnin Egypt gama kon hiche gamthipma thiding gunsetna neipuidoh uham? Ajehchu changlhah jong aumpon, chule twi jongla aumhih-in, kahinna-un hiche changlhah jangthet thut hi akidah tan ahi, atiuve.","ref":"1 Cor 10:9"},"6":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin mipi lah-a chun gulgu khohtah ahin lansahtan ahileh, hicheho chun mipi ho achu-in: Israel mi tamtah athitan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun mipi ho chu Mosi henga ahungun, Keihon Pakai le nangma dounan thu kaseijun kachonse taovin ahi; Aman gul hohi keiho lah-a kona alahmang nadingin Pakai henga taovin, atiuve. Chuin Mosi mipi dingin ataotan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Gulse khohtah khat lim seminlang, hichu mol lhon leh-a tahdoh-in, chule hitiding ahi, gul'in achuh tapou chun sum-eng gul chu avetna ahile hingding ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n sum-eng in gullim khat asemin, hichu mol lhon leh-a atah-in, chuin ahitin ahi, gul chun khat tou achuh-a, achuhpa chun sum-eng gullim chu avetteng ahingjin ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 18:4; Jhn 3:14"},"10":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu akitollun, Oboth munna pon-in akison taovin ahi.","title":"Hor Molsanga Kon Moab Phaicham"},"11":{"text":"Amaho Oboth'a konin akitolun, Moab toh kigalsai nisolam Ije-abarim gamthipma pon-in akisonun ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hichea konchun amaho akichonun, Zared phaichama pon-in akisonun ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hichea konchun amaho akichonun, gamthipma um, Amor mite gamsunga kona hungdoh Arnon gal langkhat lama chun pon-in akisonun ahi. Ajeh chu Arnon hi Moab le Amor kikah-a um Moab gamgi ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai galsatnaho lekhabu sunga, Aman twipisan le Arnon vachaho-a athilbol,"},"15":{"text":"Chule Moab gamgia um Ar chenna mun'a lunglha vachaho-a athilbol, tin akisunin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin hichea konchun amaho Beer'a achetouvun ahi: hichemun chu Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Miho chu khom khomin, chule keiman amaho chu twi kapeh ding ahi, tia aseina twikhuh chu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuphatnin Israel ten hiche la hi asaovin; Vo twikul, twiput sah-in, nanghon ahenga la saovin:"},"18":{"text":"Danthu pepa thupeh dungjuijin, atenggolun pipuihon twikhuh alaijun, miloupi hon twikhuh alaijun ahi. Chuin amaho gamthipma konin Mattahan'a achetauve ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Mattanah'a konin Nahaliel: chule Nahaliel'a konin Bamoth:"},"20":{"text":"Chule Moab gamsunga phaichama um Bamoth'a konin Jeshimon kimu phahna Pisgah molvum alhungun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Israel ten Amor mite lengpa Sihon koma thupo ho asolun, ajah-a,","title":"Sihon Lengpa Og Chunga Galjona (Danb 2:26—3:11)"},"22":{"text":"Nagamsung neijot galkai sah-un; keiho loulai le lengpilei laija kakiheilut loudiu; twikhuh-a twiho jong kadon loudiu: gamgi kakhelto kahseuva lengpa lamlen bou kajot dingu ahi, atiuvin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule Sihon'in Israelte chu gamsung agalkai diu chu aphaltapon; ahin Sihon'in amite jouse akhom khomin, gamthipma Israel sat dingin akontan ahi. Chuin ama Jahaz'a ahungin, Israelte toh akisattai."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Israel ten amachu chemjamin athat uvin; agam chu Arnon'a pat Jabbok gei, Ammon chate gam geijin alotaovin ahi. Ajeh chu Ammon chate gamgi chu hat tah ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Israel ten hiche khopi ho chu alauvin; chule Israelte chu Amor miho khopi jouse, chule Heshbon le akhoneo jouseuva acheng taovin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Heshbon hi Moab leng masapa galla anasatna, agam jouse Arnon geija akhutna kona analahpeh-a Amor mite lengpa Sihon khopi ahi."},"27":{"text":"Hijeh chun amahon thuchih-in aseijun, Heshbon'a hungun, Sihon khopi kigong henlang kisahen:"},"28":{"text":"Ajehchu Heshbon'a konin mei ahungkan, Sihon khopi-a konin meikou ahung kongdoh-in; hichun Moab gama um Ar, chule Arnon munsanga pakaiho chu akavamtan ahi.","ref":"Jer 48:45-46."},"29":{"text":"Moab, nangma ada nahi! Vo Chemosh mite amangthah nahitaove: aman asohcha achapateho le achanute chu Amor mite lengpa Sihon henga gal hinga kaidin apetan ahi."},"30":{"text":"Keihon amaho kakapmun; Heshbon chu Dibon geijin amangthah tan, chule keihon Medeba lhunna Nophah geijin kamhellin kalha taove, tin aseijun ahi."},"31":{"text":"Hitichun Israelte chu Amor miho gama acheng taovin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Jaazer velhiding mi asoldoh-in, chule amahon hiche khoho chu alauvin, chua cheng Amor miho chu anodoh taovin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin amaho ahung kile kitnun Bashan jotna lampia akaltouvun ahi. Chuin Bashan lengpa Og chu amaho satdin, amale amite jousetoh Edrei galmuna galsatdin ahung kondoh taovin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Amakhu kicha hih-in: ajehchu keiman amale amite jouse, chule agam khu nakhutna kapeh doh ahitai; nangman amakhu Heshbon'a um Amor mite lengpa Sihon nabolna bang banga nabolding ahi, ati."},"35":{"text":"Hijeh chun amahon amale achapate chule amiteho jouse chu khatcha jong ahing doh abeihel kahsen athatgamun ahi: chuin amahon agam chu alotaovin ahi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Israel chaten malam anouvin, Jericho kom Jordan gal Moab phaichama chun gebuh akison taovin ahi.","title":"Moab Lengpan Balaam Koudinga Mi Asol"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Zipper chapa Balak chun Israel ten Amor miho chunga anabol jouse chu amusoh keijin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Moab chun miho chu atamjeh-un akicha lheh jengtan: chule Moab miho chu Israel chate jeh-in alungu athoilheh jengtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Moab'in Midian upaho henga chun, Tu-a hi bongchalin loujaova hampa aneh jouhel banga, hiche mihonpi hin iveluva umjouse hi aneh jouhel dingu ahi, ati. Chule chuphat laija chu Zippor chapa Balak hi Moab mite lengpa hija ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun aman ama miho chate gam, vapi panga um Pethor kho-a Boer chapa Balaam koudin sotol ho asolin, ahenga, Vetan Egypt gama kon hungpot doh mihon khat aume: ven, amahon leiset chung alodimun, chule amaho keimatoh kimaito tah-in aumuve;","ref":"Minb 31:8; 2 Pet 2:15-16; Jud 11"},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun, katao ahi, keiman amahohi kajo-a, katha gamuva, hiche gama kona kadelmang thei nadingun, hungin lang hiche mihohi hung gaosapmin; ajehchu amahohi keima dingin ahatbeh seh-un ahi: ijeh inem itile nangman phatthei naboh mi chu phatthei achangin, koihile nagaosap mi chu gaosap achange ti kahei."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Moab upaho le Midian upaho chun aisan kipa manding hochu achoijun, akipat doh-un, Balaam henga ahungun, Balak thusei chu ajah-a asei taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho koma, Tujan hikoma hin geh-un lang, Pakaiyin keima koma aseibang bangin keiman nangho koma thu hinpokit nange ati. Hitichun Moab puiho chu Balaam toh agehkhom taovin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pathen chu Balaam henga ahungin, ajah-a, Naum khompi miho khu koi hiuvem? ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Balaam'in Pathen henga, Moab lengpa Zippor chapa Balak-in kahenga ahinsola,"},"11":{"text":"Ven, Egypt gama kona hungpot doh-a leiset chung lodima mihon khat aumuve: Tun hungin lang amahohi eihung gaosap peh-in, keiman amaho kajo-a, kadeldoh jou thei khat le gatin tia ahinsol ahi, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Balaam jah-a, Nangma amaho hitoh nakilhon louding; chule nangman hiche mihohi nagaosap louding ahi; ajehchu amaho phattheiboh chang ahiuve, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin jingkah-in Balaam athoudoh-in, Balak pipuiho jah-a, Nagam lamuva kilekit taovin; ajehchu nangho toh lhonkhoma chedingin Pakaiyin eija nompoi, tin aseitan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Moab pipuiho chu akipat doh-un, Balak henglama acheuvin, Balaam keihotoh hungding anompoi, agatiuve."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Balak in pipuiho amaho sanga ja-umtah cheh asolkit nalaijin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin amaho Balaam henga ahungun, ahengah, Zippor chapa Balak'in hitin aseije, Katao ahi, kahenga nahung nadingin imacha kidal tansah hih-in;"},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman nangma jana lentah kapeh-a kachoi sang ding, chule nangman kahenga nasei chan chu kabolding ahi: hijeh chun hungin lang hiche mitehi neihung gaosap peh-in, atie atiuve."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Balaam'in Balak sohte henga chun adonbutnin ajah uva, Balak'in a-in dimset sana dangka eipeh ding hijongle, keima Pakai ka Pathen thu kalvalin tamtah bolding hihen, lhomcha bolding hijongle che ponge;"},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun, naheng uva katao ahi, Pakaiyin kahenga ipi aseibe-am kahet theina dingin, tujan jong hi-ah geh kitnun, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin jan-in Pathen chu Balaam henga ahungin, ajah-a, Miho chu nangma kou-a hung ahiule kipat in lang amahotoh kilhonin, amavang keiman nahenga kasei thubou chu nabol ding ahi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Balaam jingkah-in athoudoh in, asangan pho asepdoh in, Moab pipuiho chutoh alhontai."},"22":{"text":"Chuin ama ache jehchun Pathen lungsat asoujahtan: Pakai Vantil chu ama douna-a kimaitopi din lampia chun anadingtan ahi. Hichepet nahi ama sangan chunga touva, asoh minin akilhonpi ahi.","title":"Balaam Le Asangan"},"23":{"text":"Chuin sangan chun Pakai Vantil khatnin akhutna chemjam achoija lampia adin amutan ahi; chuin sangan chu lamsih lama akiheidoh-in, loulai langa achetan ahi. Chuin Balaam'in sangan chu lampia heilutna din avon ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ahin Pakai Vantil chu alang teni-a bang umgel lengpilei lampia chun ana dingin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin sangan nin Pakai Vantil chu amuphatnin bang suhnan akineijin, Balaam kengchu bang toh atat cheptan ahile, aman avokitnin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Pakai Vantil chu ache gamla jepmin, jetle vei akiheina ding lampi umlou munneo laitah khatna anading tan ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin sangan chun Pakai Vantil chu amuphatnin, Balaam noija a-optan ahi. Chuin Balaam lungsat chu akoujah tan, aman sangan chu tenggolin avon ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin sangan chu ahin paosah-in, aman Balaam jah-a, Keiman nangma chunga ipi kabola hitia hi thumveijen neivoh ham? ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Balaam'in sangan jah-achun, Nangin neidai chatvai jeh ahi, kakhutna chemjam umlebon kathading nahi, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin sangan chun Balaam henga, Keima nasangan kahilou hija, nanga kahia patna tuni chan geija kachunga nahung tou jing hilouham? hitobanga hi masanga nachunga kanabol khah-em? ati. Chuin aman, Nabolkhapoi, ati."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Balaam mit ahadohsah-in ahile, aman Pakai Vantil lampia adina akhutna chemjam adopchu amutan ahi. Chuin ama akunin, tolla aboh khupmin chibai aboh tan ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Pakai Vantil chun ajah-a, Ipi dinga nangman sangan chu thumvei jen navoh ham? Ven, nalampi hi kamitmu-a akaleh lam ahi jeh-a, nangma lamtin dinga hungkon doh-a kahi;"},"33":{"text":"Ahin sangan chun keima eimu-a, keija kona thumveijen kihei doh ahin, ama kiheidoh lou hile tu-a hi thonlouva nangma katha-a ama kahinghoi ding ahi, ati."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Balaam'in Pakai Vantil hengah, Keima kachonse tai: ajehchu keiman douna-a lampia nadinna nei lamtin chu kahetlou ahi. Hijeh chun tun, hiche nangma lunglhai louna ahile, keima kilekit tange, ati."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Pakai Vantil chun Balaam henga, Miho khutoh lhonin, amavang keiman kaseipeh ding thubou chu nasei ding ahi, ati. Hitichun Balaam chu Balak pipuiho chutoh alhontan ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Balak in Balaam hungchu ajah phatnin, Arnon gamgi mong lhapeh-a um Moab khopi khatna ana kimutopi dingin ahungdoh-in ahi.","title":"Balak'in Balaam Alamto"},"37":{"text":"Chuin Balak'in Balaam henga, Keiman nangma kou dinga lungnem tah-a mi kahinsol hilouham? Ipi dinga kahenga hunglou nahim? Keiman nangmahi ja-um tah-a katunmo-a nabol ham? ati."},"38":{"text":"Chuin Balaam'in Balak henga, Ven, keima nahenga kahungtai; keiman tu-a hi ipi hijongle seina ding tha kaneibeh-em? Pathen'in kakama akhum thu bou chu kaseiding ahi, ati."},"39":{"text":"Chuin Balaam chu Balak toh akilhonin, Kirjath-huzoth'a ahunglhon tan ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chuin Balak'in bongchal ho le kelngoi ho atohdoh-in, Balaam le aumpi pipuiho henga chun athot tan ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, Balak'in Balaam chu apuijin, mipi ho jouse amutheina dingin, Baal munsang ho-a chun apuitou tan ahi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Balaam'in Balak henga, Hikomahin keima dingin maicham sagi seminlang, chule bongchal sagi le kelngoichal sagi neigot peh-in, ati.","title":"Balaam Gaothusei Masapen"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Balaam'in aseibang chun Balak'in aboltan: Balak le Balaam chun maicham chung tinna chun bongchal khat le kelngoichal khat atohdoh lhontan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Balaam'in Balak henga, Nagovam thilpeh koma hin ding jingin, keima kimupi dinga Pakai ahung khattoule, keima gacheng ting, chule aman eimusah tapou chu seipeh nange, ati. Chuin ama munsang khatna achetan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pathen'in Balaam akimupin ahi. Chuin aman ahenga, Keiman maicham sagi kagongin, maicham jouse chunga chun bongchal khatle kelngoichal khat cheh katoh-in ahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Balaam kamsunga thu akoipeh-in, ajah-a, Balak henga kilekit ninlang, gaseipeh in, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin ama ahenga akile kitnin ahile, veuvin ama le Moab pipuiho jouse chu govam ganlhaina koma chun anadingun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin aman athulemin thu aseipaijin, hitin ati, Moab lengpa Balak'in Aram gam solamsang molsang ho-a konin eihin puijin, kajah-a, Hungin lang Jacob neihung gaosappeh-in, hungin lang Israel hung chouvin, ati.","title":"Balaam Thulem ho"},"8":{"text":"Pathen'in agaosap louho chu ken iti kagaosap dingham? ahiloule Pakaiyin achoulou chu ken iti kachou ding ham?"},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman songpiho chungvuma konin ama kamun, chule lhang ho-a konin ama chu kaven ahi: veuvin, mipichu achanguva chengdio, namtin lah-a kisim thei louding ahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Koiham Jacob leivui simjou ding le Israelte hoplia hopkhat simjou dinga? michonpha thin neithisah inlang, kahinkho bei danjong ama-a tobang hihen, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Balak'in Balaam jah-a, Kachunga hi ipi nabol hitam? Keiman kamelmate gaosap dinga kapui nahin, ahin, vetan, nangman amaho phatthei naboh jotan ahi, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin aman adonbutnin, Pakaiyin kakama eikhumpeh hohi kaseidoh nadinga kachihthei ngailou dingham? ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Balak'in ajah-a, Katao ahi, hungin, chukoma kona chu amaho namuthei nadin, keimatoh munchom khatna che hite; chua kona chu nangman apamnung pen hobou namu ding, abonchauva namulou ding ahin, amaho chu keima-a dingin neigaosap peh-in, ati.","title":"Balaam Gaothusei Aniveina"},"14":{"text":"Chuin aman ama chu Sophim loulai, Pisgah molsang vuma chun apuijin; chule maicham sagi asemin, chule bongchal khat le kelngoichal khatcheh maicham takip chunga atoh-in ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin aman Balak henga, Keima Pakai to gallanga kakimuto laisen, nangma govam thilto phunga ding jingin, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Balaam akimupin, akama thu akhumpeh-in, ajah-a, Balak henga chekitnin lang, hitin seijin ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin ama ahenga ahunga ahile, veuvin, ama thilto phunga chun Moab pipui hotoh anadingun ahi. Chuin Balak'in ahenga, Pakaiyin ipi aseijem? ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin aman thulem aseipanin, hitin ati, Kipatdoh-in Balak, ngaijin; nangma Zippor chapa, kathusei hi ngaijin:","title":"Balak Thulem ho"},"19":{"text":"Pathen chu jou seiji-a mihem ahipon; chule lungheiji-a mihem chapa jong ahipoi; Aman aseisa chu abolda dingham? ahiloule aseidohsa chu abolphat lou dingham?"},"20":{"text":"Vetan, keiman phatthei bohna ding thupeh kamutan' chule aman phatthei aboh ahitan, keiman lehei thei ponge."},"21":{"text":"Aman Jacob khangitlouna, chule Israel'a jong chonvalna amupoi: Pakai a-Pathen chun aumpin, chule lengpa khosap awgin chu alah uva aumin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Pathen'in amaho chu Egypt'a kona ahin puidoh ahin; aman sakol kinei thahat tobang aneijin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Jacob douna ding themthu aumpon, chule Israel douna dingin aisan theina jong aumpoi: Tu-a hi Jacob le Israel thudola Pathen'in ipi abol hitam! kiti ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Vetan, hiche mite hi keipi bahkai lentah banga thoudoh dingu, keipi bahkai khangdong banga dingdoh ding ahi: aman a-anchah aneh masangse le asatha thisan adon masangse-a kol louding ahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Balak'in Balaam henga, Amaho hi gaosap jong gaosap hih-in, phatthei jong phatthei boh hih-in, ati."},"26":{"text":"Ahivangin Balaam'in Balak adonbutnin, Pakaiyin asei jouse chu kaboltei ding ahi, tia kaseipeh nahilou ham? ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Balak'in Balaam henga, Hungin, katao ahi, munchom khatna napui jing kate; chua konchun amaho neigaosap peh lechun Pathen lunglhai maithei ding ahi, ati.","title":"Balaam Gaothusei Athumveina"},"28":{"text":"Chuin Balak'in Balaam chu Jeshimon lam kimuna Peor molsang vuma apuijin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Balaam'in Balak henga, Hikoma hin maicham sagi neigon peh-in lang, kelngoichal sagi gotsan neikoi peh-in, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Balak'in Balaam seibang chun abolin, maicham takip chunga chun bongchal khat cheh le kelngoichal khat cheh atohtan ahi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Balaam'in Israel chapate phatthei abohding chu Pakai lungdei ahi, ti ahet phatnin, phatdang bangin themthu holin achedoh tapon, gamthip lam johchu amaingat tan ahi."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Balaam akhodah-in ahile, Israel chu aphung dungjui cheh-a agebuh uva aumu amun ahi, chuin Pathen lhagao chu achunga ahung chutan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin aman athulem aseipanin, hitin ati, Boer chapa Balaam thuseidoh; amit kihadoh sahpa thuseidoh:"},"4":{"text":"Pathen thuho ja-a, hat chungnungpa gaothilmu-a mupa, kipal lhu-a ahivanga amit hahjingpa thuseidoh ho:"},"5":{"text":"Vo Jacob, naponbuh ho iti hoi hitam! Chule vo Israel, nahoubuh ho iti hoi hitam!"},"6":{"text":"Phaicham bangin akiphajal deh-in, vadung panga honleiho abangin; Pakai phudoh Aloes thingphung hole, twipanga Cedar thingphung ho toh abangin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aman atwibel ho-a konin twi hinbung lhantin, achilhahte chu twi tampi lah-a umdiu; alengpa jong Agag sanga sangjo ding, chule alenggam chu kichoisang ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pathen'in ama Egypt gama kona ahin puidoh ahin, aman sakol kinei thahat tobang aneijin ahi: akidoupi namtin vaipiho anehjou ding, aguhou ahe ngema, athalchanga athilpai dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ama aboh-in, keipi bahkai bangin, chule keipi bahkai lentah bangin akole: kon ama asuhthou ngam ding ham? Nangman phatthei naboh chan phatthei changhen lang, nagaosap chan chu gaosap changhen, ati.","ref":"Semt 12:3; 49:9."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Balaam chunga chun Balak lungsat akoujahtan, akhut teni abengton ahi: chuin Balak'in Balaam jah-a, Kamelmate gaosap dinga kakou nahin; ahin, vetan, nangman amaho thumvei jen hi phatthei nabohtan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun naumna lama jamtan: keiman jana lentah chang dinga tundoh kagot nahin; ahivangin, vetan Pakaiyin nangma jabola naumna dinga konin natingtan tan ahi, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Balaam'in Balak henga, Kahenga nahinsol miho henga jong kaseisa hitalou ham?"},"13":{"text":"Balak'in keima sana dangka a-in dimsetna eipeh ding hijongle, Pakai thupeh kalvala kachama aphabolna hihen, asebolna ding hijongle kabollou ding ahi; amavang Pakaiyin aseiho bouchu kaseiding ahi, kati hilou ham?"},"14":{"text":"Chule tun, vetan keima kamite henga kache ding ahitai; hijeh chun hungin, hiche miho hin ni nunung nile namite henga ahin thilbol dinghou chu seipeh-inge, ati.","title":"Balaam Gaothusei Nunungpen"},"15":{"text":"Chuin aman athulem aseipanin, hitin ati, Beor chapa Balaam thusei ho, chule amit kihadoh sahpan thusei ho:"},"16":{"text":"Pathen thupeh ho japa le chungnung pen hetna thudol hepa, hat chungnung pen gaothilmu-a mupa, kipal lhu-a ahivanga hahjingpa thuseidoh ho:"},"17":{"text":"Keiman ama chu kamuding ahin, tuvang hilouding; keiman amachu kavet ding ahin, naicha vang ahipoi: Jacob'a kona Ahsi khat hungdoh-a, Israel lah-a kona leng tenggol khat hung kitungdoh ding; hichun Moab ningkoi ho avoh-a, chule Seth chateho jouse asuhmang ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule Edom chu chanvou hung hiding, Seir jong amelmateuva dinga chanvou hung hiding ahi: chule Israel ten hangsan tah-a aboldingu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Lengvai podingpa chu Jacob'a kona hungdoh-a, khopi-a umdenpa chu asuhmang ding ahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin aman Amalek lam aven athulem aseipanin, hitin ati, Amalek hi chitin namtin bulpi ahinan, amavang akichaina ding chu tonsotna manthah na hiding ahi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin aman Ken miteho aven, athulem aseipanin, hitin ati, Nachenna mun chu dettah ahin, nabuh chu songpi chunga nakiset in ahi:"},"22":{"text":"Hijeng jongle Asshur'in gal hinga nakaimang kahse-a, Ken chu suhsetna umding ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin aman athulem aseikitnin, Ohe! Pathen'in hitia hi ahinbol tengle, koi hingjou tantem!"},"24":{"text":"Chule Chittim gamkaija konin kong inneiho hunguntin, Asshur le Eber chu asuh gentheidiu, chule amajong a-itih-a dinga mangthah ding ahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Balaam akipatdoh-in, aumna lama akile kit tai. Chule Balak jong alampia achetan ahi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Israelte chu Shittima achengun, chule miho chun Moab chanute toh jonthanhoi abolpan taovin ahi.","title":"Peor Mun'a Israel Mite"},"2":{"text":"Chuin amaho chun Israelte chu a-pathen hou ganlhaina-a akoutaovin; chule miho chun aneovin, a-pathenhou anga abohkhup taovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Israel chun Baal-Peor chu ajoptan ahile, Pakai lungsat chu Israel chunga akongjah tan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Mipi lamkaiho jouse chu puijin lang, tijat umtah Pakai lungsatna chu Israel te-a kona akichon mangtheina dingin, Pakai masang nisanoi tah-a khailih-in ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israel thutan ho henga, Nangho amitakipmin Baal-Peor jopma amite jousechu that cheh hen, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, Israel chate lah-a mi khat ahungin, Mosi mitmule Israel chate houkhom ho houbuh kot maija kapma-um miteho mitmu-a chun Midian mi numei khat asopiho henga ahin puijin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Aaron thempu chapa, Eleazar chapa Phinehas in hichu amuphatnin, houkhom ho lah-a konchun akipatdoh-in, akhutna tengcha khat akichoijin;"},"8":{"text":"Chule Israel mipa chu pon in sunga ajuilutnin, anilhonin Israel mipale numeinu chu a-oipi laitah chu asunpai tan ahi. Chutichun Israel lah-a konin hise chu atangtan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule hiche hise-a thi chu sangsomni toh sangli ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Aaron thempupa chapa Eleazar chapa Phinehas'in kalung hanna chu Israel te-a konin aheimangin ahi; ajehchu kathangthipna-a Israel chate kasuhmang lounadin, amaho lah-a keiding jal-in athang thipmin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun hitin seijin, Ven kachamna kakitepna chu ama kapetan ahi;"},"13":{"text":"Chule hichu ama le ama nunga achilhah hon anei dingu, a-itih-a thempu hina dinga kitepna ahi;
