ajehchu ama a-Pathen'a dingin athang thipmin, Israel chate-a dingin longlhenna chu abolin ahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Tun akithatna Israel mipa, Midian numei nutoh kithat koppa min chu, Zimri ahin, Salu chapa Simeon miho lah-a insungmi upa khat ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule Midian numei akithatnu minchu Cozbi ahin, apa Zur chu mipi chunga lamkai, Midian miho insunga mi upa khat ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati."},"17":{"text":"Midian ho chu sunohphah inlang, chule sugammin:"},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon Peor chungchang le, Peor jeh-a hise lan mikho-a kithat Median pipupa chanu Cozbi le asopinu chungchanga alungthim gilouvun nasunoh phah-un ahi, ati."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin hise umjou chun ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron thempupa chapa Eleazar henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,","title":"Minkhum Anivei Chana","ref":"Minb 1:1-26."},"2":{"text":"Israel chate houkhom ho lah-a konin apu apateo insung kailhah-a, Israelte galsatna konthei cheh kum somni-a pat chunglam sese simdoh lhonin, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Eleazar thempupan amaho chu Moab phaicham Jordan pang Jericho naija chun akihoupi lhonin,"},"4":{"text":"Pakaiyin Mosi le Egypt gama kona hung potdoh Israel chateho thu apeh bangin, mipi ho kum somni apat chunglamse chu simdoh-un, atilhone."},"5":{"text":"Reuben, Israel chapa lenpen: Reuben chateho chu: Hanoch'a kon Hanoch insung mite ahung kondoh-un: Pallu'a kon Pallu insung mite ahung kondoh-un ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hezron'a kon Hezron insung mite: Karmi'a kon Karmi insung mite ahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Hichengse hi Reuben inko ahiuvin: chule amaho akisimdoh sese chu sangsomli le sangthum toh jasagi le somthum ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Chule Pallu chapa chu Eliab ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule Eliab chapate chu Nemuel, Dathan, chule Abiram ahiuve. Hiche Dathan le Abiram hi ahi houkhom ho lah-a minthang tah Korah le akiloipihon Pakai anelkal laijuva amahoto ana kiloija Mosi le Aaron ana nelkala teni chu."},"10":{"text":"Chule hicheho loi athiu chun leisetnin akam akan, amaho chu Korah toh avallhum than, meijin mi janitoh somnga akalih-in, amaho chu melchihna khatnin ahung pangtaove."},"11":{"text":"Achuti jeng vang chun Korah chate chu athipon ahi."},"12":{"text":"Simeon chapate chu insungu dungjuijin: Nemuel'a kon Nemuel insung mite: Jamin'a kon Jamin insung mite: Jachin'a kon Jachin insung mite:"},"13":{"text":"Zerah'a kon Zerah insung mite: Shaul'a kon Shaul insung mite ahiuve."},"14":{"text":"Hichehohi Simeon insungmiho ahiuvin, Sangsomni le sangni toh jani ahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Gad chateho chu a-insungu dungjuijin: Zephon'a kon Zephon insung mite: Haggi'a kon Haggi insung mite: Shuni'a kon Shuni insung mite:"},"16":{"text":"Ozni'a kon Ozni insung mite: Eri'a kon Eri insung mite:"},"17":{"text":"Arod'a kon Arod insung mite: Arali'a kon Areli insung mite ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Hiche hohi Gad chate insungmihi akisimdoh dungjuija ahiuvin, Sangsomli toh janga ahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Juda chapate chu Er le Onan ahilhonin; chuin Er le Onan chu Canaan gama athilhon tan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Juda chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin: Shelah'a kon Shelah insung mite: Pharez'a kon Pharez insung mite: Zerah'a kon Zerah insung mite ahiuve."},"21":{"text":"Chuleh Pharez chapate chu: Hezron'a kon Hezron insung mite: Hamul'a kon Hamul insung mite ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Hiche hohi amaho akisim doh dungjuija Juda insung mite ahiuvin, sangsomsagi le sanggup toh janga ahiuve."},"23":{"text":"Issachar chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin: Tola'a kon Tolla insung mite: Pua'a kon Pua insung mite:"},"24":{"text":"Jashub'a kon Jashub insung mite: Shimron'a kon Shimron insung mite ahiuve."},"25":{"text":"Hichehohi Issachar insung mite akisimdoh-u dungjuija amijat-u chu ahin, sangsomgup le sangli toh jathum ahiuve."},"26":{"text":"Zebulun chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin: Sered'a kon Sered insung mite: Elon'a kon Elon insung mite: Jahleel'a kon Jahleel insung mite ahiuve."},"27":{"text":"Hicheho hi Zebulun insung miho akisimdoh-u dungjuija amijatnu chu ahin, sangsomgup toh janga ahi."},"28":{"text":"Joseph chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin, Manasseh le Ephraim ahilhone."},"29":{"text":"Manasseh chapate chu: Machir'a kon Machir insung mite: Machir'in Gilead ahingin, Gilead'a konin Gilead insung miho ahungdoh-in ahi."},"30":{"text":"Hichehohi Gilead chapate ahi: Jeezer'a kon Jeezer insung mite: Helek'a kon Helek insung mite:"},"31":{"text":"Asriel'a kon Asriel insung mite: Shechem'a kon Shechem insung mite:"},"32":{"text":"Shemida'a kon Shemida insung mite: Hepher'a kon Hepher insung mite ahiuve."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Hepher chapa Zelophehad chun chapa aneitapon, chanu ho bou aneijin ahi. Chule Zelophehad chanute min chu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah chule Tirzah ahi."},"34":{"text":"Hichehohi Manasseh insung miho ahin, chule akisimdoh amaho chengse chu, sangsomnga le sangni toh jasagi ahiuve."},"35":{"text":"Hiche hohi Ephraim chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin, Shuthelah'a kon Shuthelah insung mite: Becher'a kon Becher insung mite: Tahan'a kon Tahan insung mite ahiuve."},"36":{"text":"Chule hichehohi Shuthelah chapateho ahi: Eran'a kon Eran insung mite ahiuve."},"37":{"text":"Hichehohi amaho akisim doh-u dungjuija Ephraim chapate insung miho ahiuvin, sangsomthum le sangni toh janga ahi. Hichehohi a-insungu kailhah cheh-a Joseph chapate ahiuve."},"38":{"text":"Benjamin chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin: Bela'a kon Bela insung mite: Ashbel'a kon Ashbel insung mite: Ahiram'a kon Ahiram insung mite:"},"39":{"text":"Shupham'a kon Shupham insung mite: Hupham'a kon Hupham insung mite: Naaman'a kon Naaman insung mite ahiuve."},"40":{"text":"Chule Bela chapateni chu Ard le Naaman ahilhone: Ard'a kon Ard insung mite: Naaman'a kon Naaman insung mite ahiuve."},"41":{"text":"Hicheho hi a-insungu kailhah cheh-a Benjamin chapate ahiuvin, chule akisimdoh-u dungjuijin amaho chu sangsomli le sangnga toh jagup ahi."},"42":{"text":"Hicheho hi Dan chapate a-insungu dungjuija ahiuve: Shuham'a kon Shuham insung mite ahiuve. Hiche hohi a-insungu kailhah cheh-a Dan insung miho ahiuve."},"43":{"text":"Shuham insung mite jouse, akisimdoh dungjuijin amaho chu sangsomgup le sangli toh jali ahi."},"44":{"text":"Asher chateho chu a-insungu dungjuijin; Jimna'a kon Jimna insung mite: Jesui'a kon Jesui insung mite: Beriah'a kon Beriah insung mite ahiuve."},"45":{"text":"Beriah chapateho chu; Heber'a kon Heber insung mite: Malchiel'a kon Malchiel insung mite ahiuve."},"46":{"text":"Chule Asher chanu min chu Sarah ahi."},"47":{"text":"Hichehohi Asher chapate insung miho ahiuvin, akisimdoh-u dungjuijin, sangsomnga le sangthum toh jali ahiuve."},"48":{"text":"Chule Naphtali chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin; Jahzeel'a kon Jahzeel insung mite: Guni'a kon Guni insung mite:"},"49":{"text":"Jazer'a kon Jezer insung mite: Shillem'a kon Shillem insung mite ahiuve."},"50":{"text":"Hichehohi a-insungu dungjuija Naphtali insung miho ahiuvin, amaho akisim doh hochu sangsomli le sangnga toh jali ahi."},"51":{"text":"Hiche hohi Israel chateho jat ahin, sangjagup toh sangkhat toh jasagi le somthum ahiuve."},"52":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati.","ref":"Minb 34:13; Josh 14:1-2."},"53":{"text":"Hicheho henga hi gam chu alodinguva aminu kisimdoh dungjuija kihoppeh ding ahiuve."},"54":{"text":"Atamho henga chu nangman alodiu lentah napehding, chule alhomho henga alodiu neocha napeh ding ahi. Amitakip henga chu amijat kisimdoh dungjuija alodiu kipeding ahi."},"55":{"text":"Hijeng jongle gam chu vang sanna kihomding ahin, apu apateu phungmin kailhah dungjuija amahon alodingu ahi."},"56":{"text":"Vang kisan dungjuija gam chu atam le alhom kikah-a kihom khen ding ahi."},"57":{"text":"Chule hiche hohi Levi ho a-insungu dungjuija kisimdoh hochu ahiuve; Gershon'a kon Gershon insung mite: Kohath'a kon Kohath insung mite: Merari'a kon Merari insung mite ahiuve."},"58":{"text":"Hiche hohi Levi mite insung miho ahiuvin, Libni mite insung, Hebron insung mite, Mahli insung mite, Mushi insung mite, Kohath insung mite ahiuve. Chule Kohath'in Amram ahingin ahi."},"59":{"text":"Chule Amram jinu minchu Jochebed ahin, Levi chanu, anun Egypt gama Levi'a dinga ahinpeh ahi: chule amanun Amram chu Aaron le Mosi chule asopinu lhon Miriam ahinpeh-in ahi."},"60":{"text":"Chule Aaron'in Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar le Ithmar ahingin ahi.","ref":"Minb 3:2"},"61":{"text":"Ahin Nadab le Abihu chu Pakai anga mei thenglou ato pet lhonin athilhon tan ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 10:1-2; Minb 3:4"},"62":{"text":"Chule amaho Pasal lha khatna pat chunglamse akisimdoh hochu sangsomni le sangthum ahiuve. Ajehchu amaho chu Israel chate lah-a goulo ding akipeh lou jeh-un, Israel chate lah-a akisimtha pouvin ahi."},"63":{"text":"Hichehohi Mosi le Eleazar thempupan, Moab phaicham, Jordan pang, Jericho naija asimdoh lhon Israel chate chu ahiuve."},"64":{"text":"Ahivangin Mosi le Aaron thempupan Sinai gamthipma Israel chate anasim lhon miho chu amaho lah-a hin khatcha beh jong aumtapon ahi."},"65":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin amaho thudola chun, Amaho thonlouva gamthipma thiding ahiuve, anati ahi. Chutia chu Jephunneh chapa Caleb leh Nun chapa Joshua tilou adang khatcha jong kikhenlou anahitan ahi.","ref":"Minb 14:26-35"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Joseph chapa Manasseh insunga Manasseh chapa, Machir chapa, Hepher chapa, Gilead chapa, Zelophehad chapa ahungun: chule achanute min chu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah chule Tirzah ahi.","title":"Zelophehad Chanute"},"2":{"text":"Chuin amaho Mosi le Eleazar thempupa masang, pipui hole houkhom ho jouse masang-ah, houkhom ho houbuh kotbula chun adingun, hitin aseijuve,"},"3":{"text":"Kapao chu gamthipma athin, chule Korah loiho lah-a Pakai douna-a kichom khomho loi lah-a chun ana pangpoi; amavang ama chonset na-a thi anahin, chapaho ana neipon ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chapa neilou jeh-a kapamin chu ipi dinga a-insung mite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ham? Hijeh chun kapao sopi holah-a chankhat neipeuvin atiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n athu chu Pakai henga alhuttan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu seijin, hitin ati."},"7":{"text":"Zelophehad chanute sei chun adih aseiju ahi: apao sopiho lah-a gou chanding napeh tei dingu ahi; chule apao gou chanding chu amaho napeh ding ahi.","ref":"Minb 36:2"},"8":{"text":"Chule nangman Israel chate jah-a hitia naseiding ahi; Pasal khat chu chapa beija athia ahile, apa gouchu achanu teo napeh dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahinla amachun chanu aneilouva ahile, nanghon ama gouchu asopiho napeh dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule aman sopi aneilouva ahile, ama gouchu apa sopiho napeh dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule apao chun sopi aneilouva ahile, nanghon agouchu a-insunguva akinaipi pa henga napeh diu, ama chun aloding ahi. Hichu Pakaiyin Mosi athueh banga Israel chate dinga thutanna chondan hiding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Nangma hiche Abarim molsanga hin kaldoh-in lang, Israel chate kanapeh gam khu gaven.","title":"Mosi Khel Dinga Joshua Kilhen (Danb 31:1-8)","ref":"Danb 3:23-27; 32:48-52."},"13":{"text":"Chule nangman hichu navetjou tengle, nasopipa Aaron kagop khom banga nangma jong namite toh kagop khom ding nahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu Zin nelgama houkhom ho phunchel laijun, twiphunga amitmu uva suhthenga kaumna dinga kathupeh napalkeh lhonin ahi. Hichu Zin gamthipma um Kadesh mun'a Meribah twi chu ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakai henga thu aseijin, hitin ati."},"16":{"text":"Pakai tipum jouse-a um lhagao Pathen chun houkhom ho chunga mikhat tunghen,"},"17":{"text":"Chutia chu Pakai houkhom ho hi achingbei kelngoi abah louna dinguva amasanguva potdoh-a, amasanguva chelut ding, chule amaho puidoh dingle amaho puilut dingin, ati.","ref":"1 Leng 22:17; Ezek 34:5; Matt 9:36; Mrk 6:34"},"18":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Asunga lhagao um mipa, Nun chapa Joshua chu kipuijin lang achunga nakhut ngamin;","ref":"Pot 24:13."},"19":{"text":"Chule amachu Eleazar thempupa le houkhom ho jouse masanga dinsah inlang, amitmuva chun mopohna pen."},"20":{"text":"Israel chate houkhom ho jouse seingai ahina diuva, ja naumna phabep chu achunga nakoiding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule ama Eleazar thempupa anga ding ding, chule amachun Pakai angsunga Urim thutanna dungjuija ama-a dinga thumop athumpeh ding ahi. Ama le Israel chate jouse, houkhom ho jouse ngeichu ama thusah-a potnuva, chule ama thusah-a lut ding ahiuve, ati.","ref":"Pot 28:30; 1 Sam 14:41; 28:6"},"22":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakaiyin athupeh bangchun abolin; Joshua chu Eleazar thempupa le houkhom ho jouse masanga adinsah tan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin aman achunga chun akhut angamin, Pakaiyin Mosi khutna athupeh bangin amachu mopohna apetan ahi.","ref":"Danb 31:23"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati.","title":"Nitin thilto Ho (Pot 29:38-46)"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate chu thu penlang, hitin seijin, Keima-a dinga thil kitoh ho, keima henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kisem kaganlhaina ka changlhah hochu, kahenga akitep phat dungjuija natona dingun chingtheijun."},"3":{"text":"Chule nangman ajah uva, Hiche hi Pakai henga dinga meija kisem thilto nato dingu chu ahi; jomjing govam thilto-a ding chu, nolnabei kelngoinou kumkhat lhingbep ni hiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kelngoi nou khat chu jingkah lamle nato dingu, chule kelngoi nou adang khatma chu nilhah lamleh nato dingu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule a-anneh thilto ding chu thao kimehdoh hin khat hopli-a hopkhat toh kihal changbong nel Ephah khat hopsom-a hopkhat hiding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hiche hi Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kisem kilhaina, Sinai molsanga kisudetsa jomjing govam thilto chu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule donding thilto ding chu kelngoinou khatna dinga hin khat hoplia hopkhat hiding; munthenga chu lengpitwi chihtah chu Pakai henga donding thito hidinga nasunlhah dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule kelngoi dang chu nilhah lamleh natodiu ahin; jingkah lama anneh thilto bangle donding thilto banga chu Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga meija kisem kilhaina nato dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule cholngahni leh kumkhat lhingbep nolna beihel kelngoinou ni, chule anneh thilto dinga thao toh kihal changbong nel hopsom-a hopni, chule adonding thilto toh nato tha dingu ahi.","title":"Cholngahni thilto"},"10":{"text":"Hiche hi jomjing govam thilto le adonding thilto tilouva jong, hiche hi cholngah niseh-a govam thilto ding chu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule nangho lha kipat sehleh Pakaiya govam thilto natodiu; bongchal gol ni, kelngoi chal khat, nolna beihel kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou sagi nato dingu ahi.","title":"Lha Nikho Masapen Ni-a thilto"},"12":{"text":"Chule bongchal khatna dinga, a-anneh thilto ding chu thao toh kihal changbongnel ephah hopsom ma hopthum; chule kelngoichal khatna dinga a-anneh thilpe ding chu, thao to kihal changbongnel ephah khat hopsom-a hopni hiding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule kelngoinou khatna dinga a-anneh thilto dingachu thao to kihal changbongnel ephah hopsom-a hopkhat hiding ahi; hiche hi Pakaiya dinga meija kisem kilhaina govam thilto gimnamtui chu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule adonding thilto houchu bongchal khatna dinga lengpitwi hin keh khat, kelngoichal khatna dinga hin khat hopthum-a hopkhat, chule kelngoinou khatna dinga hin khat hoplia hopkhat hiding ahi. Hichehi lhaseh-a pumgo thilto, kumlhung keija lhaseh-a bolding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule jomjing govam thilto le adongding thilto tilouva jong, kelchanou khat chu chonset thilto-a dinga Pakaiya nato dingu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule lhamasa pen nisomle nili ni chu Pakai dinga kalchuh kut ahi.","title":"Cholsolou Changlhah Kut-a thilto (Thmpu 23:5-14)","ref":"Pot 12:1-13; Danb 16:1-2."},"17":{"text":"Chule hiche lha nisom le ninga nichu kut ahin; nisagi chol solou changlhah nehdingu ahi.","ref":"Pot 12:14-20; 23:15; 34:18; Danb 16:3-8"},"18":{"text":"Nikho masapen nile kikhoppi theng umding; hiche sunga chu natoh imacha natoh lou dingu ahi;"},"19":{"text":"Amavang Pakai henga govam thilto-a dinga meija kisem kilhaina naboldiu, bongchal gol ni le kelngoichal khat, chule kum khatbep kelngoinou sagi nato diu, hiche hochu nolna beihel hidingu ahi;"},"20":{"text":"Chule a-anneh thilto-u chu changbongnel thao toh kihal hiding, bongchal khatna dinga ephah hopsom ma hopthum, kelngoichal khatna dinga ephah hopsom ma hopni hiding ahi;"},"21":{"text":"Kelngoinou sagiho jouse dinga chu kelngoinou khat cheh dinga ephah hopsom-a hopkhat hiding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule nangma longlhen bolna-a kelcha khat chonset thilto dinga nato dingu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Jomjing govam thilto, jingkah-a govam thilto tilouva jong hichengho jonghi nato dingu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Pakai henga gamnamtui hidinga meija kisem kilhaina sa chu hiche banga hi aniseh-a, nisagi lhumkeija nato dingu ahi: hichehi jomjing govam thilto le adonding thilto tilouva jong pehtei dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule nisagi nile kikhoppi theng khat nanei uva, natoh imacha natohlou dingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ga masa nikho, hapta kut sunga Pakai henga anneh thilto thah nahin to tengu jongleh, nanghon kikhoppi theng nanei diu, natoh imacha natoh lou dingu ahi;","title":"Ga Masa Kut na thilto (Thmpu 23:15-22)","ref":"Pot 23:16; 34:22; Danb 16:9-12."},"27":{"text":"Amavang Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga govam thilto natodiu; bongchal gol ni, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou sagi nato dingu ahi;"},"28":{"text":"Chule a-anneh thilto diu chu changbongnel thao toh kihal hiding, bongchal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopthum, kelngoichal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopni,"},"29":{"text":"Kelngoi sagiho jouse dinga chu kelngoinou khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopkhat hiding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chule nangma longlhen bolna dinga kelchaho nou khat nato dingu ahi."},"31":{"text":"Jomjing govam thilto le, a-anneh thilto-u (hicheho chu nolna beihel hidiu,) chule adonding thilto hou tilouva jong hicheho chu nato diu ahi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule lhasagi channa, hiche lha nimasa nileh nanghon kikhoppi theng khat nanei diu; natoh imacha natohlou diu ahi; hichu nangho dinga sumkon ho mut nikho ahi.","title":"Sumkon Kutna Thilto (Thmpu 23:23-25)"},"2":{"text":"Chule nanghon Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga govam thilto nato dingu; bongchal golkhat, Kelngoichal khat, Chule kum khat lhingbep nolna beihel kelngoinou sagi nato dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule a-anneh thilto-u chu thao toh kihal changbongnel hiding; bongchal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopthum, chule kelngoichal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopni hiding,"},"4":{"text":"Kelngoinou sagi ho jouse-a dinga chu kelngoi khat cheh dinga ephah hopsom-a hopkhat khat hiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule nangma longlhen bolna dinga kelcha nou khat chu chonset thilto-a nato ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Lhaseh-a govam thilto le a-anneh thilto, niseh govam thilto le adonding thilto, chule ajatnu dungjuija Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kisem kilhaina tilouva jong, hicheho hi nato dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule nanghon hiche lhasagi channa nisom channi le kikhoppi theng khat nanei diu; chule nanghon nahinnao nasuhgim diu; chule hiche sunga natoh imacha natoh loudiu ahi.","title":"Lhatdohna Nikho-a Thilto (Thmpu 23:26-32)","ref":"Thmpu 16:29-34."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga pumgo thilto natodiu, bongchal golkhat ,kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou sagi nato dingu ahi. Hicheho chu nolna beihel hidingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule a-anneh thilto-u chu thao toh kihal changbongnel hiding, bongchal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopthum, chule kelngoichal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopni hiding;"},"10":{"text":"Kelngoi sagi ho jouse-a dinga chu kelngoinou khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopkhat khat hiding ahi;"},"11":{"text":"Longlhenna chonset thilto leh jomjing pumgo thilto, chule a-anneh thilto le adonding thilto hou tilouva jong, kelchanou khat jong chonset thilto-a nato dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule lhasagi channa nisom le ninga nile kikhoppi theng khat naneidiu; natoh imacha natoh loudiu, Pakai henga ni sagi kut nabol diu ahi.","title":"Lhambuh Kutna Thilto (Thmpu 23:33-44)"},"13":{"text":"Chule nanghon Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kisem kilhaina pumgo thilto natodiu, bongchal gol somlethum, kelngoichal ni, kum khatbep kelngoi somleli: hicheho chu nolna beihel cheh hiding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule a-anneh thilto-u chu thao toh kihal changbongnel hiding, bongchal somle thuma dinga chu, bongchal takipma dinga ephah hopsom-a hopthum, kelngoichal ni-a dinga chu kelngoichal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopni hiding,"},"15":{"text":"Chule kelngoi somleli ho jouse-a dinga chu kelngoinou khat dinga ephah hopsom-a hopkhat cheh hidingu ahi;"},"16":{"text":"Chule jomjing pumgo thilto, a-anneh thilto-u le adonding thilto-u tilouva jong, kelngoiho noukhat chonset thilto-a nato dingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule anini lhin nile nanghon bongchal gol somleni, kelngoi chal ni, kumkhat bep nolna beihel kelngoi nou somleli nato diu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoichal ho-a ding, kelngoichal hole kelngoinou ho-a ding, ajatnu dungjuija angaina dungjuija, a-anneh thilto-u le adonding thilto-u nato dingu ahi;"},"19":{"text":"Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u, chule adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, kelcha ho nou khat chu chonset thilto-a nato dingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule anithum nile bongchal somlekhat, kelngoichal ni, chule nolna beihel kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou somleli nato dingu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoi chalho-a ding, chule kelngoiho-a dinga ajatnu dungjuija, angaina dungjuija, a-anneh thilto-u le adonding thilto-u nato dingu;"},"22":{"text":"Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u, chule adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, chonset thilto-a dinga kelcha khat hiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule anili nile bongchal som, kelngoi chal ni, chule nolna beihel kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou somleli nato dingu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelchal ho-a ding, chule kelngoiho-a dinga ajatnu dungjuija angaina banga, a-anneh thilto-u le adonding athilto-u nato dingu;"},"25":{"text":"Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u chule adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, kelchaho nou khat chonset thilto-a apehdingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule ani nga nile bongchal ko, kelngoichal ni, chule apolkom beihel kum khat lhingbep kelngoinou somleli nato dingu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoi chal ho-a ding, chule kelngoi nou ho-a dinga chu, amaho ajatnu dungjui le angaina banga a-anneh thilto-u le adonding athilto-u nato dingu;"},"28":{"text":"Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u, chuleh adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, chonset thilto dinga kelcha khat nato dingu ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chule anigup nile bongchal get, kelngoichal ni, chule nolna bei kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou somleli nato dingu;"},"30":{"text":"Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoichal ho-a ding, chule kelngoinou ho-a dinga chu amaho jat dungjui le angaina banga a-anneh thilto-u leh adonding thilto-u nato dingu ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u, chule adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, chonset thilto dinga kelngoi khat nato dingu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule ani sagi lhin nile bongchal sagi, kelngoichal ni, chule nolna beihel kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou sagi nato dingu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoichal ho-a ding, chule kelngoinou ho-a ding, ajatnu dungjuija leh angaina banga, a-anneh-u thilto-u le adonding thilto-u nato dingu;"},"34":{"text":"Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u chule adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, chonset thilto dinga kelcha khat nato dingu ahi."},"35":{"text":"Aniget nile kikhoppi loupitah khat naneidiu; hiche sunga nanghon natoh imacha natoh loudiu ahi."},"36":{"text":"Ahin Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga, meija kisem kilhaina govam thilto natodiu; bongchal khat, kelngoichal khat, nolna beihel kelngoi sagi kumkhat lhingbep nato dingu ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoichal ho-a ding, chule kelngoinou ho-a dinga amaho jat dungjuile angaina banga a-anneh thilto-u leh donding athilto-u nato dingu;"},"38":{"text":"Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u, chule adonding thilto-u tilouva jong, chonset thilto dinga kelcha khat nato dingu ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chule nakitep nahou, nalung cham thilto hou, napumgo thilto houding, na anneh thilto hou ding, nadon ding nathilto hou ding, nachamna thilto hou ding tilouva jong, hicheng hi Pakaiya dinga na kut houva chu nabol dingu ahi, ati."},"40":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Pakaiyin athupeh jouse dungjuijin Israel chate henga aseitan ahi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n phung lamkai ho jah-a, Israel chate chungchang thudol aseijin, hitin ati; Hichehi Pakai thupeh ahi.","title":"Kitepna Chungchanga Dan"},"2":{"text":"Mikhattou Pakai henga kitepna khatna akitepma, ahiloule ahinna kikanna dinga kihahselna khatna akihahsela ahile, athusei chu apalkeh louding, akama aseidoh dungjuija atohding ahi.","ref":"Danb 23:21-23; Matt 5:33"},"3":{"text":"Numei khattou Pakai henga kitepna khatna akitepma, anungah laija apa in'a ana umlaija, kikanna khatna amanu akikana;"},"4":{"text":"Chule apan akitepna le ahinna kikan nadinga akikan nachu ajah-a, apan amanu athipsan jeng ahile; akitepna jouse chu ding jing ding ahin, chule ahinna anakanna akihahselna jouse jong chu ding jing ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amavang apachun ajah nikho-a chu ajahda-a ahile; amanu kitepna ho, ahiloule ahinna kikan nadinga akikannaho chu dinglou ding ahi; chule apan ajahda jeh-a, Pakaiyin amanu chu angaidam ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule amanu akitepet ahiloule amanun ahina akana dia akamsunga thu hungpotdoh laija chu jinei ahitah-a;"},"7":{"text":"Chule hichu ajipan ajah-a, chule ajah nikho-a chu amanu ana thipsanna ahile; amanu kitepnaho chu ding jing ding; chule ahinna kikana dinga akihahsel naho chu ding ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla ajipan hichu ajahdoh nikho-a ajahda-a ahile, amanu kitepna khatna anakitepna, chule ahinna akikana akamsunga kona thu hungpot doh ho chu asuhmang pehding; Pakaiyin amanu chu angaidam ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Amavang meithai le akidasa numei jin ahinna kikan nadinga akitepna tapou chu amanu chunga ding jing ding ahi.","title":"Meithaiho"},"10":{"text":"Chule amanu chu ajipa in'a kitep ahia, ahiloule ahinna chu kihahsel na-a akan ahi-a,"},"11":{"text":"Chule ajipan hichu ajah-a, amanu athip sana, ajahda louva ahile, akitepna jouse chu dingjing ding, ahinna kikan nadinga akihahselna takip chu ding jing ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla ajipan hiho chu ajahdoh nikho-a ajah da-a ahile; akitepna thudola akama kona potchan, ahiloule ahinna kikana thudol chu dinglou ding ahi. A-inneipun ajahda ahin, Pakaiyin amanu angaidam ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Kitepna tapou le ahinna sugentheina dinga kikana tapou chu ajipan aphudet thei, ahiloule asuhmang thei ahi."},"14":{"text":"Amavang a-inneipun ani ania amanu henga chu imacha seilouva auma ahile; amanu akitepnaho le amanu chunga akikana jouse chu aphudet peh ahi. Amapan hicheho chu ajahdoh nikho-a athipsan jeh-a chu, hicheho chu anamdet ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla amapan hicheho ajahdoh nunga asuhmanga ahile; amapan amanu chonsetna chu akipoh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hicheho hi Pakaiyin Mosi ana thupeh, pasal le a-inneipi kikah-a, chule amanu khangdong ahilai, apa in'a aumlaija amanu le apa kikah-a dinga chondan apeh chu ahi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,.","title":"Midia Mite Douna-a Galtheng"},"2":{"text":"Midia mite chunga Israel chate phu lanlang, chujouteng na mite toh gopkhoma naum ding ahitai."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n mipi ho henga chun aseijin, hitin ati; Nangho lah-a mi phabep galsat dingin galvon kivonu henlang, Midia mite doudin cheohen, chule Midia mite chungah Pakai phuba galao hen."},"4":{"text":"Israel phung jouse-a kon, phung khatna kon sangkhat cheh chu galkon dinga nasol dingu ahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Hitichun Israel sangtamtah ho lah-a konin phung khatna kon sangkhat cheh, galkon dinga galvon kivon mi sangsom le sangni alhengdoh taovin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n amaho chu manchah thengtah hole mutding sumkon ho chu akhutnuva akichoisah-in, chule Israelte phungtina sangkhat cheh le Eleazar thempu chapa Phinehas chu galsat din asoltan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bang chun, amahon Midia mite asat taovin; chule pasal jouse athat taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin adang athahou tilouvin jong amahon Midia leng ngaho athatnun, amaho chu: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur chule Reba ahiuve. Beor chapa Balaam jong chu chemjamin athatnun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chun Midia numei ho le achasen hou jouse gal hingin ahin kaijun ahi, chule agancha hou jouse, akelngoi hou jouse, chule athilkeo jouseu ahin chomun ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin amahon achennao khopi jouse le akulpiu phatah ho jouse chu meijin ahal lha uvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amahon galthil achom jouseu, mihem le ganhing agomin apui taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin amahon gal hinga kiman jouse le thil achomdoh hou jouse chu Mosi le Eleazar thempupa, chule Israel chate houkhom ho henga Jericho naija um, Jordan pang Moab phaichama gebuh-ah ahinpui taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Eleazar thempupa, chule houkhom ho lah-a lamkai pipuiho chu amaho kimupi din gebuh pama apotdoh-un ahi.","title":"Galsat Miho Hung Kilekit"},"14":{"text":"Chuin galmuna kona hung janel lamkaiho, sepai asang sang lamkai ho, chule aja aja chunga lamkai ho chunga chun Mosi alunghang tan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n amaho henga, Nanghon numei ho jouse hi hinghoi nahiuvem?"},"16":{"text":"Veovin, hiche numei ho hin Balaam thumopma kona Israel chate hi Peor chungchanga Pakai douna asuhkhel sah-u ahin, chule Pakai houkhom ho lah-a chu hise analanga ahi.","ref":"Minb 25:1-9"},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun chapangho lah-a pasal takip chu thatnun lang, chule numei takip pasal toh lupkhom kha jouse chu thatnun,"},"18":{"text":"Amavang numei chapang jouse, pasal toh lumkhom khalou jouse chu nangho-a dingin hinghoijun;"},"19":{"text":"Chule nangho gebuh pama ni sagi naum dingu: koi hijongleh mi that tapou, chule koi hijongle mithilong tongkha tapou chu, nangho le nami mat hou agoma nithum ni leh ni sagi ni-a naki suhtheng dingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule navon jouseu, savuna kisem jouse, kelmulla kisem jouse, chule thinga kisem jouse chu sutheng uvin, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Eleazar thempupan galsatna che galsat miho henga chun, Hichehi Pakaiyin Mosi henga athupeh danthua chondan ahi;"},"22":{"text":"Sana, dangka, sum-eng, thih, tin chule ngen hobou,"},"23":{"text":"Meija katheilou thil jouse chu nanghon meija nahal diu, chuteng hichu atheng hiding ahi. Hijeng jongle kisekhena twija suhtheng hiding ahi. Chule mei kahthei jouse chu twija nadediu ahi,"},"24":{"text":"Chule nanghon napon hou chu ani sagi nile nasop theng diu, chuteng atheng nahi dingu ahitai. Chujou tengle nangho gebuh-a nahung lut dingu ahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,.","title":"Galthil Kichom Kihop"},"26":{"text":"Nangmale Eleazar thempupa, chule houkhom ho lah-a lamkai pipuihon, galla kichom doh chu mihem hihen sa hijongle ajat simtoh-un."},"27":{"text":"Chule galsat dinga galmuna konho le houkhom ho jouse kah-ah galthil chu hopnin hoppeh-un:"},"28":{"text":"Chule galsat dinga galmuna konho-a konin Pakaiya dingin kai dongun; mihem'a kon, bongchal ho-a kon, sangan ho-a kon, chule kelngoi ho-a konin agomun janga lah-a khatcheh laovin;"},"29":{"text":"Pakaiya lhuh thilto dingin, akehkhat chu lanlang, Eleazar thempupa chu pen."},"30":{"text":"Chule Israel chate chan akeh khatna konin, somnga lah-a konin khat ladoh-un lang, mihem'a kon, bongchal ho-a kon, sangan ho-a kon, kelngoiho-a kon, gamsa jouse-a konin laovin lang, chule Pakai houbuh chingtup-a pang Levi ho henga peuvin."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Eleazar thempupan Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun abol lhontan ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule galsat mihon ahinlah-u galthil kichomho simlouvin, kelngoi chu sangjagup toh sangsomsagi le sangnga ahin,"},"33":{"text":"Bong sangsomsagi le sangni,"},"34":{"text":"Sangan sangsomgup le sangkhat,"},"35":{"text":"Chule pasal to kitimat khalou numei chu sangsomthum le sangni ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chule akeh khat, galsatna konho chan chu: kelngoi sangjathum le sangsomthum le sangsagi le janga ahin;"},"37":{"text":"Chule Pakaiya dinga kelngoi kai kipe chu jagup le somsagi le nga ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chule bongchal ho chu sangsomthum le sanggup ahin; hicheho lah-a kona Pakaiya dinga kai kipe chu somsagi le ni ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chule sangan ho chu sangsomthum le janga ahin; Pakaiya dinga kai kipe chu somgup le khat ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chule mihem chu sangsom le sanggup ahin; hicheng lah-a Pakaiya dinga kai kipe chu mi somthum le ni ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun, Pakaiya lhuh thilpeh kai chu Mosi'n Eleazar thempupa apetan ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chule Israel chate chan akehkhat, galsatna konho lah-a kona Mosi'n ahopkhenho chu;"},"43":{"text":"(Tun houkhom ho chan akeh khatna chu: kelngoi sangjathum le sangsomthum le sangsagi to janga ahin,"},"44":{"text":"Chule bongchal sangsomthum le gup,"},"45":{"text":"Chule sangan sangsomthum le janga,"},"46":{"text":"Chule mihem sangsom le sang gup ahi.)"},"47":{"text":"Israel chate-a chan akeh khatna konin, Mosi'n mihem le gancha agomin somnga-a khat alan, chule Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun Pakai houbuh ngahtup Levi miho chu apen ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chuin janel asang sangho chunga lamkai, asang sang lamkaiho le, ajaja lamkaihon, Mosi ahin naijun,"},"49":{"text":"Chuin amahon Mosi henga, Nasoh keihon mi keiho mopohna noija um galsat miho sese kasimun ahile, mi khatcha akisam aumpoi."},"50":{"text":"Hijeh chun amitakip min Pakai henga thilpeh dingin kanei hou, sana-a kisem kijepna ho, sumguiho, chaoho, khutjemho, bilbaho, chule khiho Pakai anga kahinna uva dinga longlhenna bolna dingin kahin choijun ahi, atiuve."},"51":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Eleazar thempupa chun amaho-a konin sana jouse, sana-a kisem kijepna jouse ala lhontan ahi."},"52":{"text":"Chule Pakaiya dinga asangsang lamkaiho le ajaja lamkaihon apehdoh-u thilpeh sanaho jouse chu, shekel sangsom le sanggup toh jasagi le somnga ahi."},"53":{"text":"(Ajehchu galkon miho amitakip min ama ding cheh-a thil ahin kichomu ahi.)"},"54":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Eleazar thempupan asangsang lamkai ho le jalamkai ho sana chu ala lhonin, Pakai angsunga Israel chate-a dinga melchihna khat hidingin, houkhom ho houbuh sunga achoilut lhontan ahi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Reuben chate le Gad chate chun gancha atama tam aneijun: chule amahon Jazer gam le Gilead gam amuphatnun, veuvin, amun chu gancha vahna dinga mun phatah ahijeh-in,","title":"Jordan Solama Phungho (Danb 3:12-22)"},"2":{"text":"Gad chate chule Reuben chate chu ahungun, Mosi le Eleazer thempupa, chule houkhom lamkai pipuiho henga aseijun, hitin atiuve,"},"3":{"text":"Ataroth, Dibon, Jezer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Shebam, Nebo chule Beon,"},"4":{"text":"Pakaiyin Israel houkhom ho masang tah-a anasuhmang gamhi gancha vahna dinga phatah ahin; nasoh houhin gancha kaneijun ahi:"},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun amahon, Keiho namitmu-a lungsetna kachan uva ahile, hiche gam hi nasohte lo dingin nei pedoh jengun, chule keiho Jordan gal lama neipuilut da taovin, atiuvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Gad chate le Reuben chate jah-a chun, Nasopi ho gal kona cheova, nangho hilaija hi natou thim dingu ham?"},"7":{"text":"Chule ibola nanghon Israel chate chu Pakaiyin apehnao gam agalkai diuva kona nalung lhahsah uham?"},"8":{"text":"Kadesh-bernea'a kona agam vedinga kasolai chun napateu vin hitihin anabolun ahi.","ref":"Minb 13:17-33"},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho Eshcol phaichama acheuva, agam agamu-u chun, amahon Israel chate chu Pakaiyin apehnao gama alut louna diuvin alunglhah sah-un ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Pakai lunghanna chu hiche pet chun ahung koudohtan, chule ama akihah sellin, hitin ati.","ref":"Minb 14:26-35"},"11":{"text":"Thonlouva Egypt gama kona hungdoh miho kumsom ni-a lhah chunglamse koimachan keiman Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga kanatep gam chu amutheilou dingu ahi, ajehchu amahon eijui bulhing pouve;"},"12":{"text":"Kenez mi Jephunneh chapa Caleb le Nun chapa Joshua tilou; ajehchu amanin Pakai ajui bukim lhonin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakai lunghanna chu Israel chate chunga akoudoh tan, Pakai mitmu-a thilse bolho khang jouse chu abeisoh kahsen amaho chu gamthipma kum somli avavai sah-in ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule veuvin, chonset punna mite, Israel chunga Pakai lunghan punbesah nadingin, nangho napateu khelin nahung kisepdoh-un ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu nangho ama najuinaova kona nakihei manguva ahile, aman amaho hi gamthipma adalhah kit ding, chule nanghon hiche miho jouse hi nasuh mangdiu ahi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin amahon ama ahin naijun, Keihon hilaija hi kagancha ho hongding le kachateu ho-a ding khopiho chu kasahdiu:"},"17":{"text":"Amavang keiho tah hi Israel chate cheng achen nadiu gamsunga kapuilut kahseuva amasanguva manchah puma kigosa kachediu ahi: chule agama cheng miho jeh-a hi kachateu kul kikai khum khopiho-a kachen sahdiu ahi, atiuve."},"18":{"text":"Israel chate amichang cheh-in aloding cheh-u alo kahseuva keiho ka in'uva kahung kile loudiu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile keihon amaho toh Jordan gallang, ahiloule akal lam chu kalokhom loudiu ahi; ajeh chu keiho gamloding chu hilam Jordan solamsang ahi, atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n amaho henga, Hitobang thil hi nabol uva, Pakai angsunga galsatna nakon uva,"},"21":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin amelmate a-angsung kona adelmang kahse-a, nangho galvon kivon jouse Pakai angsunga Jordan nagal kaijuva,"},"22":{"text":"Chule Pakai angsung tah-a agam chu suhnema auma ahile; chujouteng chule nangho nakinungle uva, chule nangho Pakai angle Israelte anga themona bei nahi dingu; chule agam chu Pakai angsunga nangho loding hiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon hitia chu nabol lou uva ahile, veuvin, nangho Pakai douna-a chonse nahiuvin, thonlouva nachonset nao chun nahin holdoh dingu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Nachasen teo dingin khopi saovin lang, nakelngoi houva din kelngoi hong saovin, hitichun nakam muva thupot dungjui chun bollun, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Gad chate le Reuben chate chun Mosi henga, ka Pakai thupeh banga nasohten kabol dingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Kachasen hou, ka-inneipiteu, kakelngoi hon hou, chule kagancha hou, hiche Gilead khopiho sunga umdingu ahin,"},"27":{"text":"Ahin ka pakai pa seibanga, nasohte amitakip galsat dinga galvon kivon chengse, galsatna Pakai angsunga kache dingu ahi, atiuve."},"28":{"text":"Hijeh chun amaho chung thua hin Mosi'n Eleazar thempupa le Nun chapa Joshua, chule Israel chate phung lamkai ho thu apen:","ref":"Josh 1:12-15."},"29":{"text":"Chule Mosi'n amaho jah-a, Gad chate le Reuben chate hi nangho toh Pakai angsunga amitakip galvon akivon uva, Jordan agalkaijuva, gamchu namasanguva suhnema auma ahileh; chuteng nanghon Gilead gam chu amaho lodinga napeh dingu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ahin amaho galvon puma nangho toh agalkai khom lou uva ahile, amahon Canaan gama nangho lah-a loding anei dingu ahi, ati."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Gad chatele Reuben chate chun adonbutnun, Pakaiyin nasohte henga asei banga chu keihon kabol dingu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Kachan dingu kagoulo diu chu Jordan hilamsang ahitheina dinga keiho galvon kivon puma Pakai angsunga Canaan gamsunga kagalkai dingu ahi, atiuve."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Amor mite lengpa Sihon gam le Bashan lengpa Og gam, agamgi sunga khopi ho, gamsung kimvella khopiho chu Gad chate, Reuben chate chule Joseph chapa Manasseh phung akehkhat hochu apetai."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Gad chate chun Dibon, Ataroth le Aroer,"},"35":{"text":"Chule Atroth, Shophan, Jazer le Jogbehah,"},"36":{"text":"Beth-nimrah chule Beth-haran, kul kikai khum khopiho, chule kelngoi hongho asadoh-un ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chule Reuben chaten Heshbon, Elealeh le Kirjathaim,"},"38":{"text":"Nebo, Baal-meon (amin ho kikhela ahitai,) chule Shibmah khopiho asadoh-un, chule amahon asahdoh-u khopiho chu minchom asah-un ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chuin Manasseh chapa Machir chate hochu Gilead'a acheuvin, agalaovin, chule asunga um Amor miho chu anodoh-un ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Gilead chu Manasseh chapa Michir apen, ama chua achengtan ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chuin Manasseh chapa Jair chu achen, chua khopi neoho chu alan, chule hicheho chu Havoth-Jair asahtai."},"42":{"text":"Chule Nobah achen Kenath le chua kho neoho chu alan, ama min aputsah-in, Nobah asahtan ahi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hicheng hi Mosi le Aaron khut noija Israel chate asepai ho toh Egypt gama kona akholjin nao chu ahi.","title":"Egypt'a Kona Moab Chan Akholjinao"},"2":{"text":"Chule Mosi'n Pakai thupeh-a konin akholjin nao dungjuijin achedoh nao asunne: chule hicheng hi achedoh nau dungjuija akholjinu chu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Ramases'a konin alha masapen nisomle ninga channa lha masapen, kalchuh kut ni ajingin Israel chate chu Egypt miho jouse mitmun khut thahat tah-in ahung kitoldoh taovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Egypt miho chun achateu apeng masapen jouse Pakaiyin athaho chu avuijun, a-pathenhou chunga jong Pakaiyin thu atan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu Ramseses'a konin ahung kitoldoh-un, Succoth'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin amaho Succoth'a konin akipat doh-un gamthip monglha Ethama gebuh akisonuve."},"7":{"text":"Chuin amaho Etham'a konin akipat doh-un, Baal-Zephon maija um Pi-hahiroth lamma akile heijun, Migdol'a gebuh akison taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin amaho Pi-hahiroth maija chun akipat doh-un, dillen lah-a achepeh-un, gamthipma chun alutnun, hitichun amaho Etham gamthipma chun nithum akitolun, chuin Marah'a gebuh akison taovin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Marah'a konin akipat doh-un, Elim'a ahung lutnun, Elim'a chun twinah somleni le lusu phung somsagi aumin, hia chun amahon gebuh akison taovin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin amaho Elima konin ahung kipatdoh-un, twipisan panga gebuh akison taovin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amaho twipisan panga konin akipat doh-un, Sin gamthipma gebuh akison taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin amaho Sin gamthipma konin akitolun, Dophkah'a gebuh akison taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin amaho Dophkah'a konin akipat doh-un, Alush'a gebuh akison taovin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin amaho Alush'a konin akichonun, mipi ho donding twi umlouna mun Rephidim'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin amaho Rephidim'a konin akipat doh-un, Sinai gamthipma chun gebuh akison taovin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Sinai nelphaija konin akichonun, Kibroth-hatta-avah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin amaho Kibroth-hatta-avah'a konin akipat doh-un, Hezeroth'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule amaho Hazeroth na konin akipat doh-un, Rithmah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin amaho Rithmah'a konin akipat doh-un, Rimmon-parez'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Rimmon-parez'a konin akipat doh-un, Libnah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Libnah'a konin akichonun, Rissah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Rissah'a konin akitollun, Kehelathah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Kehelathah'a konin achekitnun, Shapher molsanga gebuh akisonun ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Shapher molsanga konin akitolun, Haradah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Haradah'a konin akitolun, Makheloth'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Makheloth'a konin akitolun, Tahath'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Tahath'a konin akipat doh-un, Tarah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Tarah'a konin akipat doh-un, Mithkah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Mithkah'a konin acheuvin, Hashmonah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Hashmonah'a konin akipat doh-un, Mosiroth'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Mosiroth'a konin akipat doh-un, Bene-ja-akan'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Bene-ja-akan'a konin akichonun, Hor-hagidgad'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Hor-hagidgad'a konin acheuvin, Jotbathah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Jotbathah'a konin akitolun, Ebronah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Ebronah'a konin akipatdoh-in, Ezion-gaber'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Ezion-gaber'a konin akichonun, Kadesh kiti Zin gamthipma chun gebuh akisonun ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chuin Kadesh'a konin akichonun, Edom gam monga um Hor molsanga gebuh akisonun ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chuin Aaron thempupa chu Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Hor molsang chunga akaltouvin, chuin hia chun Israel chate Egypt gama kona ahungdoh-u kum somli lhinni, lha-nga channa nimasani chun athitan ahi.","ref":"Minb 20:22-28; Danb 10:6; 32:50."},"39":{"text":"Chule Aaron Hor molsang athi chun kum jakhat le somni le thum ahitai."},"40":{"text":"Chule Canaan lengpa Arad chu Canaan gam lhanglama cheng ahin, Israel chate hung chu ajatan ahi.","ref":"Minb 21:1."},"41":{"text":"Chuin amaho Hor molsanga konin akipat doh-un, Zalmonah'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chuin Zalmonah'a konin akipat doh-un, Punon'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chuin Punon'a konin akipat doh-un, Oboth'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"44":{"text":"Chuin Oboth'a konin akipat doh-un, Moab gamgia Ije-abarim'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chuin Iim'a konin akipat doh-un, Dibongad mun'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"46":{"text":"Chuin Dibongad'a konin akichon kitnun, Almon-diblath-aim mun'a gebuh akisonun ahi."},"47":{"text":"Chuin Almon-diblath-aim'a konin akichonun, Nebo masanga Abarim molsang ho-a chun gebuh akisonun ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chuin Abarim molsang ho-a kon chun Moab phaicham Jordan gal Jericho naijah gebuh akisonun ahi."},"49":{"text":"Chuin Jordan gal Moab phaichama um Beth-jesimoth apat Abel-shittim geichun gebuh akisonun ahi."},"50":{"text":"Chuin Moab phaicham, Jordan gal, Jericho naija chun Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,.","title":"Jordan Kan Masanga Kithumopna"},"51":{"text":"Israel chate henga chun seipeh inlang, hitihin seijin, Nangho Jordan nagalkaijuva Canaan gamsung nalhun tenguleh;"},"52":{"text":"Nanghon namasanguva um agam neiho chu nadeldoh uva, chule amilim hou nasuhmang peh dingu, alim semthu a-pathen hou nasuhmanguva, chule amun thenghou nasuhlhuh diu ahi:"},"53":{"text":"Chule agama cheng miho chu nadeldoh uva, hia chu nachendiu ahi: ajehchu keiman gam chu nalo dinguva kapeh-u nahi."},"54":{"text":"Chule nanghon agam chu vang nasan uva na-insung kailhah dungjui cheh-a nakihop dingu ahi. Chule atamte chu natam peh uva, chule alhomte chu nalhom pehdiu: amitakip min avang san dungjui cheh-a mun chu aloding, napu napateu phung dungjuija nalo dingu ahi.","ref":"Minb 26:54-56"},"55":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon agama cheng miho na masang uva kona nadeldoh louvule, hung hiti ding ahi: nanghon na-umden sahhou chun namit uva dinga moljuma panguva, napang peh uva dinga linga pangdingu, chule nachen nao gama chu nasunoh phah uva hungpang diu ahi."},"56":{"text":"Chukalvalla jong hung hitiding ahi, amaho chunga boldinga kanagel banga chu nangho chunga kabolding ahi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.","title":"Canaan Gam Gamgi ho"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate thu penlang, chule ajah uva hitin seijin, Nangho Canaan gamsunga nalut tengule, (hichehi nangho lodinga hunglha ding gam chu ahin, Canaan gam agamgi chin hotoh hitha ding ahi)."},"3":{"text":"Lhanglama nagamgi dingu chu Zin gamthipma pat Edom gamgi chin gei hiding, chule lhanglam sang gamgi chu Chi dil solam among gei hiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule nagamgiu chu lhanglama Akrabbim kaltouna-a patna hung kiheidoh-a, Zina galkai ding; chule Kadesh-barnea lhanglama chepeh ding, chule Hazar-addar'a cheding, chule Azmon galkai ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule agamu ngahna chu Azmon'a patna Egypt vadung geija akolding, ahung kikhodoh ho chu twipia kinga ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule lhumlam gamgi ding chu, agamgi-a dinga twipilen naman diu; hichehi lhumlama nagamgiu hiding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule nangho sahlam gamgi ding chu, twipilen'a kona Hor molsang chan hiding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hor molsanga kona nanghon Hamath lutna geichu namelchih peh dingu; nangho gamgi kilhungdoh chu Zedad'a kilhung lutding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule agamgi chu Ziphron geija kilhunga, Hazarenan'a kilhunglut ding; hichu sahlama nagamgiu hiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule nangho solam gamgi chu Hazarenan'a patna Shepham geija namelchih diu,"},"11":{"text":"Chule gamgi chu Shepham'a pat A-in solam sanga Riblah'a kilhunglha ding, chule agamgi chu kilhungsuh-a, Chinnereth solam dil gei lhungding,"},"12":{"text":"Chule agamgi chu Jordan geija kilhung lha-a, chule akilhungdoh ho Chi twipia kilhunglut ding; hichu nangma gam kimvela nagamgi hiding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate thu apen, Hiche gamhi nanghon vang sanna nalodiuva Pakaiyin phung ko hole phung kehkhat ho anapeh chu ahi.","ref":"Josh 14:1-5."},"14":{"text":"Reuben chate aphung kailhah le apu apateu insung dungjuija, chule Gad chate aphung kailhah le apu apateu insung dungjuija, amahon alodingu gou chu amu-u ahitai, chule Manasseh phung keh khat jong aloding dolu chu changa ahitaove:"},"15":{"text":"Phung nile phung keh khat hochun achandingu chu Jordan hilamsang, Jericho nai solamsang, nisa sona lamsang amutaovin ahi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,.","title":"Gam Hoppehna Ding Chungchanga Mopohna Nei Lamkaiho"},"17":{"text":"Hichehohi nanghon nalodingu gam nahop khenpeh dinghou min chu: Eleazar thempupa le Nun chapa Joshua ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule nangman nalodiu gam hopkhen peh dinga aphung takipma kona pipui khat cheh nalhendoh dingu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Amaho min chu hiche hi ahi: Judah phunga Jephunneh chapa Caleb;"},"20":{"text":"Simeon chate phunga, Ammihud chapa Shemuel;"},"21":{"text":"Benjamin phunga kona Chislon chapa Elidad;"},"22":{"text":"Chule Dan chate phung lamkai Jogli chapa Bukki;"},"23":{"text":"Joseph chate phung lamkai, Manasseh chate phunga dingin, Ephod chapa Hanniel;"},"24":{"text":"Chule Ephraim chate aphung lamkai, Shiphtan chapa Kemuel;"},"25":{"text":"Chule Zebulun chate phung lamkai, Parnach chapa Elizaphan;"},"26":{"text":"Chule Issachar chate phung lamkai, Azzan chapa Paltiel;"},"27":{"text":"Chule Asher chate phung lamkai, Shelomi chapa Ahihud;"},"28":{"text":"Chule Naphtali chate phung lamkai, Ammihud chapa Pedahel ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hichehohi Pakaiyin Canaan gama Israel chate gouchan hoppeh dinga athupeh hochu ahi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Moab phaicham Jordan gal Jericho naija chun Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati.","title":"Levi te Dinga Kipe Khopiho","ref":"Josh 21:1-42."},"2":{"text":"Israel chate chu agou chanhou lah-a kona Levi miho chen nading khopi apeh nadingun thu pen, chule nanghon Levi miho chu khopiho kimvela gam op-ho chu napeh dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule khopiho chu achenna dingu hintin, chule agam op-hou chu agancha hou, athilkeu hou, aganhing hou jouse-a ding hiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule nanghon Levi miho napeh dingu gam op-ho chu, khopi kulbanga pat polam tong sangkhat kimvel hiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule khopiho pamlam chu nate dingu, solam sanga tong sangni, lhanglam sanga tong sangni, lhumlam sanga tong sangni, chule chunglam sanga tong sangni hiding, akhopi chu alailunga umding, hichehohi amaho dinga khopiho gam-op hiding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule nangman Levi miho napehding khopiho lah-a chu hoidohna khopi gup, tolthatpa jamlutna dinga nalhendoh ding; chule amaho dinga khopi somlileni nabedingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chitia chu Levi miho napeh dingu khopiho jouse chu khopi somlileget hiding, amaho chu agam op-toh napehtha diu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule nanghon napeh diu khopiho chu Israel chate losa ho-a kon hiding; atam neiho-a kona natampeh diu, alhom neiho-a kona nalhom pehdiu: amitakip min Levi miho chu analo akhopihou dungjui cheh-a apeh dingu ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,.","title":"Kiselna Khopiho (Danb 19:1-13 ; Josh 20:1-9)"},"10":{"text":"Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva, Nangho Jordan gal Canaan gamsung nahung galkai tengule,"},"11":{"text":"Nanghon nangho dinga hoidohna khopi dinga khopiho na kilhendoh diu; chutia chu kiningman louva khattou tolthatna chu chulama jamthei ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule hicheho chu nangho-a dinga phula dingho-a kona nahoidohna diu hiding; houkhom ho thutanna anga adin tokahse-a mithat chu athi louna ding hiding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule nanghon napehdiu khopi holah-a kona gup chu nangho dinga hoidohna hiding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nanghon Jordan hilam sanga khopi thum napeh uva, Canaan gamsunga khopi thum napeh diu; hichu hoidohna khopi ho hiding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hicheng khopi gup chu, Israel chate le namdang hoding, chule alah uva khopemdenho agomuva dinga hoidohna hiding, kiningman louva tolthat chan chulama jamthei ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule aman thih manchah khatna amachu avoh-a, athitah-a ahile, ama chu tolthat ahitan; tolthat chu thatei teiding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule athina theija, aman songa asekhah-a, athitah-a ahile, ama chu tolthat ahitan; tolthat chu thatei tei ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ahiloule aman thina khopma thing manchah khutchoi khatna avoh-a, ama athi tah-a ahile, ama chu tolthat ahintan; tolthat chu thatei teiding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Thisan phulapa amatah chun tolthatpa athading; aman ama chu amu mule atha ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla muda mana asotlhuh ham, ahiloule achanlhih-a thilkhat touva asea, athitah-a ahile,"},"21":{"text":"Ahiloule kidouna jeh-a akhutna avoh-a, ama athitah le; ama vopenpa chu thatei teiding ahi. Ajehchu ama tolthat ahitan: thisan phulapa chun amuteng le atha ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla aman amachu kidouna beija hetman louva asotlhuh ham, ahiloule changlhi louva ama chunga thil khattou asekhuma ahile,"},"23":{"text":"Ahiloule mikhat thinathei khop song khat touva amapa chu mulouva asekhah-a, ama athitah-a; ahia ama chu akidoupi jong hilou chule suhgenthei dia jong ahol hilou ahile,"},"24":{"text":"Houkhom ho chun mithat pale thisan phulapa kikah-a thutanna dan dungjuija thu atan dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule houkhom ho chun mi thatpa chu thisan phulapa khutna kona ahuhdoh uva, houkhom ho chun ama chu ajamna hoidohna khopi-a chu agathah diu; chule ama chukoma chu thaotheng kinu thempu chungnungpa thi kahse-a umjing ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ahinla tolthat pa chu ajamna lam, ahoidohna khopi gamgi pam polama, ahungpotdoh khah-a;"},"27":{"text":"Chule thisan phulapa chun hoidohna khopi polama amapa chu amua, thisan phulapan mithatpa chu atha-a ahile; amachu thisana themmo chang louding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ajehchu ama hoidohna khopi sunga chu thempu chungnung thi tokahse-a umthim behding ahin, thempu chungnung thi nung teng vangle mithatpa chu alosa agam sunga hung kinung lekit ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chutichun hicheng jousehi nangho dinga nakhang khanguva, nachena mun jouseuva chondan hiding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Koi hijongle mi khattou thatna aumle tolthatpa chu ahetoh ho kama kona thajeng ding ahi. Ahinla mikhattou thana dinga achunga hettohsah khatnin photchena aneilou ding ahi.","ref":"Danb 17:6; 19:15."},"31":{"text":"Chukal vallin nanghon thinakhop hella mochang tolthat chu lhatdohna dinga kilhatdohna nalah lou dingu ahi, ajehchu ama chu thatei teiding joh ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule hoidohna kulpi-a jampa chu thempupa thikah-a, gamsunga chengdia ahung kile theina dinga, ama dinga kilhatdohna nalah theilou diu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Hitia chu nanghon nachen nao gam chu nasuh boh loudiu, thisan jeh-a gam chu boh-a ahin; thisan lonna gam chu kisutheng joulou ahin; amavang thisan sopa thisana bou kisutheng thei ahi."},"34":{"text":"Hijeh chun nachena diu gam, keima chenna chu suboh hih-un: ajehchu keima Pakai Israel chate lah-a cheng jinga chu kahi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Gilead chate insung mi upaho, Machir chapa Manasseh chapa Joseph chapate insung miho chun, Mosi angle lamkai ho anga, Israel chate upaho masang ahin naijun, aseitaovin ahi:","title":"Chanu Gou Loding Danho"},"2":{"text":"Chuin amahon, Chaten vang sanna alodiu gam chu pedingin Pakaiyin ka pakai thu anapen; chule kasopipa Zelophehad gouchan chu achanute pehdingin ka pakai hi Pakaiyin ana thupeh tai.","ref":"Minb 27:7"},"3":{"text":"Tun amaho chu Israel chate phung dangho chatetoh kicheng tale, agou loding hou chu kapa tehouva kona kiladoh-a amaho kichenpi phungho gouchan chuto kigoppeh ding ahin; chutia chu vang dungjuija kagou chanuva kona kiladoh ding ahitai;"},"4":{"text":"Chule Israel chate Jubilee ahunghi tengle, amaho gouchu amahon akichenpiu phungho gou chutoh kigop thading ahitan; chutia chu amaho gou chu kapu kapatehou phungho goulah-a kona kiladoh ding ahitai, atiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate chu Pakai thupeh dungjuijin thu apen, hitin ati, Joseph chapateho phungin aseiju chu adih lheh-e.","title":"Amaho Jatcheh toh Akichen dingu"},"6":{"text":"Zelophehad chanuho chungchanga Pakaiyin thu apeh chu hitihi ahi, Amaho pha asah penpenu chutoh kichengu hen, ahinla apu apateu phung sunga ho kichen piu hen:"},"7":{"text":"Chuti chu Israel chate gouchan chu phung khatna kona phung khatna kichon lele louding ahi; ajehchu Israel chate tapou chun amatah-in apu apatehou gou chu anga dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule chanu tapou, Israel chate sung koiphung hitale gouloa chun, hiche apa phung insung khatna chu inneipi hiding, hitia chu Israel chate takip min apu apateu gou chu alothei dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Gou chu phung khatna kona phung khatna kichon lele louding; amavang Israel chate phung khat cheh chun ama ama gou akinga dingu ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun Zelophehad chanute chun abol taove;"},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu Zelophehad chanute Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah, Noah chu apateo sopiho chapate toh akicheng taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin amaho Joseph chapa Manasseh chapate insung miho toh akicheng taovin, agouhou chu apateu insung phunga chun aumdentan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hicheho hi Jericho naija Jordan pang Moab phaija Israel chate henga Mosi khutna Pakai thupeh, thupeh ho le thutannaho chu ahi."}}}}},"5":{"info":{"name":"Danbu","shortname":"Danb","abbr":[],"desc":"Mosi Lekhabu Ngana"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche thuho hi Mosi'n Israelte jouse henga Jordan gal gamthip hilam sang, twipisan gal Paran le Tophel, Laban le Hazeroth, chule Dizahah kikah phaichama asei ahi.","title":"Thumakai"},"2":{"text":"(Seir molsang lampi jotna-a ichele Horeb'a pat Kadesh-barnea gei chu nisomle nikhat lam ahi.)"},"3":{"text":"Chuin kum somli lhin na-in ahitin ahi, lhasom le lhakhat lhina, chuche lha nimasa nichun, Pakaiyin amaho peh dinga ahenga athupeh jouse dungjui chun Mosi'n Israel chate henga aseijin,"},"4":{"text":"Hichu Heshbon'a cheng Amor lengpa Sihon le, Edrei sunga Astaroth'a cheng Bashan lengpa Og atha jou ahi.","ref":"Minb 2:21-34"},"5":{"text":"Moab gam sung Jordan pang hilam sanga, Mosi'n hiche danthu hi aphongdoh panin, hitin ati."},"6":{"text":"Pakai i-Pathen'un Horeb molsanga chun ijah uva aseijin, Nangho hiche molsanga nachamsot behseh taove:"},"7":{"text":"Kiheijun lang, nakholjin ban jom taovin, chule Amor mite molsang le akom naija um mun jouse-a, phaichama, thinglhanga, dama, lhanglama, chule twilen panga, Canaan mite gama, chule Lebanon gei, twipi, Euphrate vapi geijin cheovin."},"8":{"text":"Veovin namasanguva gam kakoi peh uve; Pakaiyin napu napateu Abraham, Isaac, Jacob henga pehding le amaho nunga achilhahte peh dinga ana kihahsel nagam chu galo taovin."},"9":{"text":"Chule hiche laichun naheng uva kana seijin, Keiman kachang seh-in nangho napojou pou vinge;","title":"Mosi'n Thutan Vaihom Ding Alhendoh (Pot 18:13-27)"},"10":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'un nangho napunsah taovin, chule veuvin, tunvang natam danu chu van'a ahsi ho jatjen nahitaove."},"11":{"text":"(Napu napateu Pakai Pathen'u chun athutep bangin tu-a sanghin ajat sang khatnin napunsah beu henlang, phatthei naboh-u hen.)"},"12":{"text":"Kei changseh in naboinao, napohgih-u, nakiphin nao iti kapohjou dingham?"},"13":{"text":"Nanghon naphung sunguva michingho, ahethemho, chule mihet ho lhengdoh unlang, keiman amaho chu nachung uva vaihomin seminge, tin kanaseijin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule nanghon, Nangman naseiho hi keihon kabol dinguva pha ahi, tin neidonbut un ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun keiman naphung pipuihou, michingho, mihet ho chu kalheng doh-in, nachung uva vaihomin kapansah-in, sangkhat chunga, jakhat chunga, somnga chunga, chule somkhat chunga lamkai dingleh, naphung sunguva vaipon kapansah tan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule hiche laichun keiman nathutan vaihomhou chu thu kanapen, ajah uva, Nasopi ho kah-a aboina hou chu ngaipeh unlang, mijouse leh asopipa kikah, ahiloule nalah uva um gamdangmi kikah-a chun chonphat na-in thu tanun."},"17":{"text":"Thutan na-a maipha navetlou dingu; amavang alen thu nangai banguva aneo thujong nangaidiu; mihem maija kichatna naneilou dingu ahi; ajehchu thutanna chu Pathen'a ahi. Chule nangho dinga thuhahsa behsetho chu kaheng hinlhutnun, keiman ngailha nange, tin kana seijin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule hiche laichun keiman naboldiu jouse kana thupeh jiuvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Pakai i-Pathen'uvin thu einapeh bangun, Horeb molsanga kon ikipatdoh-un, Amor mite molsang lampia namu-u gamthip lentah le gimneitah jouse chu ijot lhung keijun, chuin Kadesh-barnea iga lhung taove.","title":"Kadesh-Bernea'a Kona Gamvelhi Ding Mi Akisol (Minb 13:1-33)"},"20":{"text":"Chuin keiman naheng uva, Nangho Pakai i-Pathen'uvin eipehnao Amor mite molsang chu nalhung taove."},"21":{"text":"Veovin, Pakai na Pathen'un namasanguva gamchu nakoipeh uve. Chetou vinlang napu napateu Pathen'in naheng uva aseibangin galo jengun; kicha hih-un, lungjong lungthoi hih-un, tin kanaseijin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule amitakip kahenga nahungnaijun, kajah-a, Keihon imasanguva mi solung ting, amahon gam chu gakhol toh-uhen lang, ipi lampia ichetou uva, ipi khopi-a ilut diuham? tithu hinpo hen, nati uvin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule akisei chun eilung lhaisah lheh-in; chuin keiman nalah uva mi somleni, phung khatna mikhat cheh kalheng doh-in ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin amaho akiheijun, molsang lama chun akal touvun, Eshcol phaichama ahungun, akholle taovin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule amahon agamga akhutnun ahin loh-un, ihenguva ahin pohsuh peh-un, chule thu ahinpouvin, Pakai i-Pathen'un eipeh-u chu gampha ahi, atiuve."},"26":{"text":"Achuti vangin nangho chetou ding nanom pouvin, Pakai i-Pathen'u thupeh chu nadou jouvin ahi.","ref":"Danb 9:23; Heb 3:16."},"27":{"text":"Chule napon in sunguva naphun chelun, Pakaiyin eithet jeh uva suhmang dinga Amor mite khutna pehlut dinga, Egypt gama kona eipuidoh-u ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hoilama ichetou diuham? Isopihou vin, Miho chu alentheijun, eiho sangin asang jouvin, khopi hochu alentheijin, van geija pal akikho touvin ahi; chukal valin chua chun Anakim chapate kaga mu uvin ahi, tin ilungu asudoijun ahi, nati uve."},"29":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman najah uva, Amaho chu ginghih-un, kijong kicha hih-un."},"30":{"text":"Namasanguva che Pakai na Pathen'u chun namitmu tah uva Egypt gama nangho dinga nabolpeh hou jouse dungjuijin gal satpeh naovin nate."},"31":{"text":"Chule gamthipma min acha apoh banga, Pakai na Pathen'un hiche munhi nalhun kahseuva, lampi jouse-a iti napoh-u ham chu namu taove.","ref":"Sol 13:18"},"32":{"text":"Ahin hichan geihin jong Pakai na Pathen'u chu natahsan pouvin;","ref":"Heb 3:19"},"33":{"text":"Naponbuh son nadiu mun holdohpeh dingle, nachenao lampi musah dinga, jan le meikonga, sunle meilhanga namasang uva chepa chu natahsan deh pouve."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin nathu seiju ajan, alungsatan, akihah selin, hitin ati.","title":"Pathen'in Israel Talent Apeh (Minb 14:20-45)","ref":"Heb 3:18."},"35":{"text":"Tahbeh-a hiche khang gilou mite khatchan jong napu napateu pehdia kahah selna gampha chu amulou heldiu ahi."},"36":{"text":"Jephunneh chapa Kaleb tailou: aman hichu amuding, chule agachotsa gam chu amale achilhahte kapeh ding ahi; ajehchu aman Pakai chu ajuikim helin ahi, ati."},"37":{"text":"Nangho jal-in Pakai chu keichunga alung hangin, Nangma jengjong chumuna chu nalut louding ahi."},"38":{"text":"Ahin namasanga ding Nun chapa Joshua, amachu lutding ahi. Ama chu tilkhouvin; ajehchu aman hiche gam chu Israel alosah ding ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chukal valin, Anchah dingbep ahi natiu nachasen houleh, chuche laija sele pha hekhen loulai nachateo hochu chua lut dingu, chule keiman kapeh-a, amahon alo dingu ahi."},"40":{"text":"Ahin nangho vang kiheijunlang, twipisan lampi gamthip lama nakholjin ban jom taovin, ati."},"41":{"text":"Chuphatnin nanghon nei donbutnun, kahenga, Pakai dounan kachonse taove, Pakai ka Pathen'un eithupeh jouseu dungjuijin chetaoving ting, galsatnu vinge, nati uve. Chuin amitakip min agalvon nakivoncheh phatnun, thinglhang lama kaldin phasademin na-umtaove."},"42":{"text":"Ahin Pakaiyin kahenga, Chetou hih-un, chule galjong gasat hih-un; ajehchu keima nalah uva kaumpoi: achutiloule nagalteu masanga gal lel getnun nate, tin seipeh-in eiti."},"43":{"text":"Hijeh chun najah uva kaseipeh-un; chule nanghon nangai pouvin, ahin Pakai thupeh dounan nagolkeh-un, hangtah-in thinglhang lama nakaltou taove."},"44":{"text":"Chuin hiche molsanga cheng Amor mite chu nangho dou dingin ahungkon doh-un, khoihon mi adel bangin nahin delun, Seir gei le Hormah geijin nathatnun ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chuin nahung kileuvin, Pakai masanga nakap-un; ahinla Pakaiyin na-aw-u nangaipeh pouvin, anakhang jong nasunpeh pouve."},"46":{"text":"Chuti chun chuche mun'a nagasuhmangu nikhoho dungjuijin Kadesh mun'a nisot tah naum denun ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakaiyin kahenga asei bangin iki heijun, twipisan lampia gamthiplam jonin ikhol jinun, chule Seir molsang chu nikho tamtah ivelkolun ahi.","title":"Kum Kisuh Mahthah","ref":"Minb 21:4."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga aseijin, hitin ati;"},"3":{"text":"Nanghon hiche molsang hi navelsot behset taove; sahlam sanga kiheijun,"},"4":{"text":"Chule nangman mipi chu thu penlang, Seir'a cheng nasopi hou Esau chate gamsung najotdiu; amahon nakichat diu ahi; hijeh chun nangho chingthei tah-in umun;","ref":"Semt 36:8"},"5":{"text":"Amaho toh kina hih-un, ajehchu keiman agamu chu nangho kapeh louding, kengphang te jong kapeh louhel ding nahiuve; ajehchu Seir molsang chu Esau lodia kanapeh ahitai."},"6":{"text":"Nanghon naneh dingu an-neh chu amahoa kona suma nakichoh uva nanehdiu, chule nadon diu jong suma nakichoh uva nadondiu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un nakhut uva natoh jouseu phatthei aboh-in, chule gamthip lentah najotnu chu ahen ahi. Hiche kum somli sunghin Pakai na Pathen'un na-umpiuvin, lhahsamna imacha nanei pouvin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Eloth le Ezion-gober'a pat phaicham lampi jotna-in Seir'a cheng Esau chilhah isopiteu gamchu ipal pouvin, ikiheijun Moab gamthip lampia iki tolun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, Moab chu sugim hih-un, gal'in jong kisatpi hih-un; ajehchu agamu chu nalodiuva kapeh louding nahiuve; ajehchu Ar chu Lot chilhahte kapeh ahitai, ati.","ref":"Semt 19:37"},"10":{"text":"Masangin chua chun Anakim te banga len, tam le, sanga Emim mite ana chengun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amaho jong chu Anakim ho banga mihatna sim ahiuvin; Moab miten vang, Emim tin amin sah-un ahi."},"12":{"text":"Masangin Seir'a hin Hor miho jong anachengun; ahinla Pakaiyin amaho apeh gam Israel'in analo bang chun, Esau chaten amasanguva konin asumangin, alopaijun, amaho khelin acheng taove."},"13":{"text":"Tun kipatdoh-un lang Zered vachadung chu galkaijuvin, tin kaseijin; chuin Zered vachadung chu igalkai taove."},"14":{"text":"Chule Kadesh-barnea idalhah uva pat Zered vacha igalkai geiju, Pakaiyin ahahsel nao banga janel lah-a kona gal hat ho khang kichaihel tokah chu kum somthum le kumget ahi.","ref":"Minb 14:28-35"},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu amanthah hel tokah uva, janel lah-a kona sumang dinga Pakai khut chun amaho anadou tahbeh ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun ahitin ahi, eiho lah-a kona galsat ho jouse amanthah heluva, chule athigam phatnun,"},"17":{"text":"Pakaiyin kahenga hitin aseijin, hitin ati,"},"18":{"text":"Tunia hi nangman Moab gamsung Ar najotpaija nagalkai ding ahi;"},"19":{"text":"Chule Ammon chate naija nahung tengle, amaho chu sugenthei hih-in, chule kinah jong kinahpi hih-in; ajehchu Ammon chate gamchu nalodinga kapeh louding ahi; ajehchu Lot chate lo dia kanapehsa ahitai, ati.","ref":"Semt 19:38"},"20":{"text":"(Hiche gam jongchu mihat ho gama anakisim ahin; hia chu mihat ho masang laija anacheng ahiuve; chule amaho chu Ammom miten Zamzummim anasah-uvin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Anakim ho banga len, tam le sang ahiuve: ahinla Pakaiyin amaho chu amasanguva asumangin, amahon alopaijun, chule chu-a chun achengun:"},"22":{"text":"Seir'a cheng Esau chate-a dinga amasanguva kona Hor mite asuhmangpeh bangin abolpeh-in ahi: chuin amahon alopaijun, tuni geihin amaho khelin achengun ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Hazerim le Azzah geipeh-a cheng Avim miho chu Caphtor-a kona hungdoh Caphtor miho chun asumangun, chule amaho khelin acheng taove)."},"24":{"text":"Kipatdoh-un, nakholjin ban jomun lang, Arnon vapi galkaijun: veuvin, Amor mi Heshbon lengpa Sihon le agam chu nakhut na kapeh ahitai. Hichu lopanun lang gal'in kidoupiuvin."},"25":{"text":"Tunia hi vannoi pumpi-a um namho chunga nangma kichatna le ginna kakoi patding ahin; amahon nangma chungchang thu kilhut jaovintin, nangma jeh-a kithing uva, lung gentheidiu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Kedemoth gamthipma konin Heshbon lengpa Sihon henga chamna thu kengin sottol kasolin,","title":"Israel'in Sihon Lengpa Ajo (Minb 21:21-30)"},"27":{"text":"Nagam sungu neijotpai sah-in, lamlhonga bou chengkatin, jet le veija jong kiheiponge;"},"28":{"text":"Nangman kaneh ding an sumin neichoh sah inlang, chule kadon ding twi jong sumin neichoh sah-in: kenga bou kagalkai dingu ahi."},"29":{"text":"(Seir'a cheng Esau chate le Ar'a cheng Moab chaten eibolna bangin,) Pakai ka Pathen'un eipehnao gam Jordan kagalkai kahseuva dingbou ahi, kati."},"30":{"text":"Ahinla Heshbon lengpa Sihon'in agam ijot galkai diuchu eiphalpeh pouve. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen uvin tunikho-a banga hi nakhut nuva apehlut theina dinga alungu asuh tah-a, alouchal sah ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, Vetan keiman Sihon le agam chu namasanga kape pantai: agama nachenthei nadin lo pantan, eiti."},"32":{"text":"Chujouvin Sihon amale amite jouse Jahaza'a eiho douna-a galsat din ahung kondoh taove."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Pakai i-Pathen'un amaho chu imasanguva ahinpedoh-in, chuin eihon ama le achapate, chule amite jouse ithatgam taove."},"34":{"text":"Chuin hiche petchun akhopi jouseu ilaovin, khopi tinna mihem jouse pasal, numei, chule naosen ho isumang helun, khatcha jong ihinghoi pouvin,"},"35":{"text":"Eiho-a dingin aganchahou le akhopihouva kichomho bou ilaovin ahi."},"36":{"text":"Arnon vapi pamchina um Aroer'a pat, vapi chinna um khopi-a kipat Gilead chan geijin, eiho dinga hetbeh seh khopi khatcha aumpoi. Ajehchu Pakai i-Pathen'un abonchauvin eiho eipe soh hel taovin,"},"37":{"text":"Ammon chate gam sese le Jabbok vapi gamkaiho, molsang ho-a khopiho le Pakai i-Pathen'un eijahda nao mun ho-a bou chu nahunglut louvu ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin ikiheijun, Bashan jotna lampia ichetouvun, chuin Bashan lengpa Og le amite jouse eihotoh Edrei mun'a kisatdin ahung konun ahi.","title":"Bashan Lengpa Og Kijo (Minb 21:31-35)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, Amachu kicha hih-in; ajehchu keiman amale amite jouse, chule agam nakhutna kapeh ding ahin; chule Heshbon'a cheng Amor lengpa Sihon nabol banga amachu nabolding ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chutichun Pakai i-Pathen'un Bashan lengpa Og le amite jouse jong ikhutnuva eipeuvin; mikhatcha jong hinghoi louvin ithat gamun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule hichepet chun akhopiho jouse ilaovin, Bashan'a Og lenggam Argob gamkai jouse-a khopi somgup lah-a ilah louvu khatcha aumpon ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hiche khopi jousehi kulbang sangtah tah-a kiget khum le, kotpi neicheh, chule kotgol ho-a kikam ngen ahin; hiche tilouvin kul kiget khumlou khopineo tamtah jong ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule Heshbon lengpa Sihon ibolnao bangin khopi tinna pasal hole numei ho chule chapangho isumang hel jengun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Gancha jouse le khopiho-a thil kichomho vang eiho chantumdin ikilah-uve."},"8":{"text":"Chule hichepet chun Amor mite lengni-a konin Jordan hilam panga galla um gam Arnon vapi'a pat Harmon molsang geijin ilaovin;"},"9":{"text":"(Harmon chu Sidon miten Sirion asah-un, Amor miten Shenir asah-un),"},"10":{"text":"Phaicham khopi jousele, Gilead gam jouse, chule Bashan gam jouse Salcah le Edrei geijin, Bashan'a Og lenggam sunga khopiho chu inalaovin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu Bashan lengpa Og bou chu mihat milenho lah-a ahingdoh amoh hija ahi. Veovin, ajalkhun chu thih jalkhun ahin, Ammon chate kho Rabbath-a um hilou ham? mihem tong dungjuijin adung chu tongko ahin, avai tongli ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuche petna inalo-u hiche gamhi Arnon vapi panga um Aroer'a patna Gilead molsang kehkhat le, asunga khopi hochu Reuben mite le Gad mite kana petan ahi.","title":"Jordan Solam Sanga Chengden Phungho (Minb 32:1-42)"},"13":{"text":"Gilead gam adang sese le Og lenggam Bashan pumpi chu Manasseh phung kehkhat kanapen; Argob gamkai jouse le Bashan pumpi chu mihat le milenho gam anakiti."},"14":{"text":"Manasseh chapa Jair'in Argob gam pumpi, Geshuri le Maachathi gamgi geijin alan, hichu ama min aputsah-in, tuni geijin Bashan Havoth-jair akiti."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Gilead chu Machir kanapetai."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Reuben mite le Gad mite henga Gilead'a pat Arnon vapi phaicham kehkhat, chule agamgi diuvin Jabbok vapi geijin kapen, hichu Ammon chate gamgi ahi."},"17":{"text":"Phaicham jong, Jordan le apanga um gamho, Chinnereth'a pat Ashdoth-pisgah solam sanga um phaicham twipi, chituipi geijin kanapen ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hiche laichun nangma thu kanapen, Pakai na Pathen'un hiche gamhi nalodiuva anapeh ahi. Nasopi hou Israel chate masanga namihang hou jouse chu galvon vonpuma nagalkai diu ahi.","ref":"Josh 1:12-15."},"19":{"text":"Ahinla najiteu, nachasenhou, chule nagancha hou, (ajehchu gancha nahao lheh-uve ti kahen,) keiman kapeh-u nakhopi houva chu umden dingu,"},"20":{"text":"Nangho banga Pakaiyin nasopiteu acholngah sah kahseu le Jordan galla Pakai na Pathen'un napeh-u gam alo kahseuva umdingu ahi. Chujou tengle amitakipmin keiman kapeh gamchu nahung lokit chehdiu ahi, kati."},"21":{"text":"Chule hiche laichun Joshua thu kapen, Pakai na Pathen'un hiche lengteni abolna jouse chu namitnin namutan, chutobang ma-a chu Pakaiyin nalo dingu lenggam ho chu abolding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'un nangho dinga gal nasatpeh ding jeh-un, nanghon amaho chu kicha hih-un kati."},"23":{"text":"Chule hiche laichun Pakai henga ngehna kana neijin, hitin kati;","title":"Mosi Canaan Gam Alutding Akiphalpeh Lou","ref":"Minb 27:12-14; Danb 32:48-52."},"24":{"text":"Vo Pakai Pathen, nangman nasoh hi nalet je le nakhut thahat je neimusah pantai; ajehchu leile van'a nathilbol bang le thahat bang bolthei Pathen koi umam?"},"25":{"text":"Katao ahi, neigalkai sah inlang, Jordan galla gam phatah molsang hoitah le Lebanon chu neimusah-in, kanati."},"26":{"text":"Ahinla nangho jeh-in Pakaiyin eina lunghan khumin, eingaipeh nompoi: chule Pakaiyin kahenga, Phaset tante, hiche thuhi kahenga seikit tahih-in."},"27":{"text":"Pisgah molvum'a kaldoh inlang lhumlam, sahlam, lhanglam chule solama khodah-in lang, hichu namit-in ven; ajehchu nangma hiche Jordan hi nagalkai louding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ahin Joshua ngansen lang, tilkhouvin, chule hatsah-in; ajehchu ama hiche miho masanga hi galkaija, nagamu ding gamchu amaho alosah ding ahi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuti chun Beth-peor maijon phaichama chun i-um taovin ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun, vo Israel, nahin theijuva, napu napateu Pakai Pathen'in napeh-u gamchu nagalo theina dingun, najui diuva kahil masah dem chondanho leh thutannaho hi ngaijuvin.","title":"Mosi'n Thu Kingaina Israel Atilkhou"},"2":{"text":"Keiman nangho kathupeh hi nakoibe loudiu, chule chua kona jong nalahdoh louhel diu, chutia chu keiman kapeh-u Pakai na Pathen'u thupeh chu nanit diu ahi.","ref":"Tph 22:18-19"},"3":{"text":"Baal-peor jeh-a Pakai thilbol chu namitnun namutaove. Ajeh chu Baal-peor jui jouse chu Pakai na Pathen'un nalah uva konin asumangtai.","ref":"Minb 25:1-9"},"4":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon Pakai na Pathen'u heng lama behho vang amitakip tunigei hin nahingjing naove."},"5":{"text":"Veovin, Pakai Pathen'in eithupeh bangtah chun, lodinga nachenna diu gama naboldiuvin, keiman chondan le thutanna chu kahil taove."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun hicheho chu nit unlang bolun; ajehchu hichu namtin ho mitmu-a nachih naole nahet them nao ahin, amahon chondan kisun jouse hi ajah uva, Tahbeh-in hiche nam lentehi aching le ahechen mite ahiuve, atidiu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ikouna chanuva einaijiu Pakai i-Pathen'u tobanga amaho naiji Pathen nei chutobang namlen koi umam?"},"8":{"text":"Chule tulaija namasanguva kakoi dan kisun jouse banga hititah-a chondan hole thutan na nei namlen dang koi umam?"},"9":{"text":"Kichih thei pou pouvun lang, gunchu tah-in nalhagaovu hongphaovin, achuti louleh namitnun amu thilho chu sumilun natin, nahinlai nikho sungseuvin nalungsunguva konin mangthah get ninte: ahin nachapate le nachapate chate chu hiljouvin."},"10":{"text":"Adeh deh-in Horeb molsanga Pakai na Pathen anga nadin nikhou, chule Pakaiyin kahenga anasei, Mipi ho chu neikhop khompeh-in, leiset chunga ahinlai nikho sungseuva keima ginje akihil theina diule, achateu ahiltheina diuvin kathu jahsah inge ati nikho chu."},"11":{"text":"Chuin nahin naijun molsang bula nadinguvin, chule molsang chu vanlaijol geijin muthim, meilhang, chule thimletlut nin meijin akan ahi.","ref":"Pot 19:16-18; Heb 12:18-19."},"12":{"text":"Chuin meikong lah-a konchun Pakaiyin naheng uvah thu aseijin, a-aw cheng chu najaovin, alim vang namupouve; a-aw sehseh najaovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin aman naheng uva thuson, najui diuva athupeh akitepna chu aphongdoh-in, song pheng ni chunga asunin ahi.","ref":"Pot 31:18; 34:28; Danb 9:10"},"14":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin hichepet chun lodinga nachennao gama nabol diuvin, chondan kisunho le thutan naho chu nangho kahil diuvin eina thupeh-in ahi.","ref":"Pot 21:1"},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun nangho kichihtheijun, ajehchu Horeb'a meikong lah-a Pakaiyin naheng uva thu asei nikho chun, nanghon alim namu pouve.","title":"Semthu Milim Hou Chungchanga Gihsalna"},"16":{"text":"Achutiloule nakisuhboh uva, alim semthu, ipi lim hamkhat toh kilou, pasal ham, numei ham tobang kisem getnun natin,","ref":"Pot 20:4; Thmpu 26:1; Danb 5:8; 27:15"},"17":{"text":"Leichunga um ganhing khat tou tobang, vanlaijola lengle alhanei vacha khat tou tobang,","ref":"Rom 1:23"},"18":{"text":"Leichunga a-opma kithol ganhing khat tou tobang, leinoi twilah-a nga khat lim tobang, kisemthu getnun nate."},"19":{"text":"Chule achutiloule namitna vanlam navet uva, nisa, lhathah,ahsi ho, chule van janelpi namu tengule, Pakai na Pathen'un vannoi pumpi-a nam jouse-a dinga apeh chu houding le jendingin kiheilut getnun nate."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla Pakaiyin tunikho-a nahi nao banga hi agoulo ama mite hidinga nalah uva, thih meilhum sung, Egypt gama kona nana puidoh-u ahi.","ref":"Pot 19:5; Danb 7:6; 14:2; 26:18; Tit 2:14; 1 Pet 2:9"},"21":{"text":"Chukalvalin nangho jeh-in Pakai keima chunga alunghangin, Jordan kagalkai louna dingle, Pakai na Pathen'un lo dinga napeh-u gam phatah-a chu kalut louna din akihah selin ahi.","ref":"Minb 20:12"},"22":{"text":"Keima vang hiche gama kathi-a, Jordan hi galkai louding kahitai;
