ahin nangho nagalkaijuva chuche gam phatah chu nagalo diu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Nangho kichih theijun, ajole Pakai na Pathen'un nang hotoh akitepna sumil khaovin natin; Pakai na Pathen'un ajahda alim semthu ham, ahiloule ipiham khat toh kilou kisemthu getnun nate."},"24":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u hi kavamhel mei ahin, thangthip tah Pathen ahi.","ref":"Heb 12:29"},"25":{"text":"Nanghon chate le chateho chate nahin neijuva, gamsunga chu sottah nachen uva, nakisuhboh uva, alim semthu, ahiloule ipihamkhat toh kibang lim nakisem thuva, Pakai na Pathen'u mitmu-a thilse nabol uva, nalung hansah uva ahile,"},"26":{"text":"Lo dinga Jordan nagalkai nao gama kona chu naman thah helnadiuva, tunikho-a hi nachung uva ahetoh dinga van le lei kakou ahin; chukoma chu nachensot loudiu, suhmang hela naum johdiu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin namtin lah-a nathe cheh uva, Pakaiyin napuinadiu Pathen helouho lah-a chu lhomcha naphah diu ahi.","ref":"Danb 28:36"},"28":{"text":"Chule chua chu mutheilou, jatheilou, netheilou, thilnam jalou, mihem khutsem thing le song pathen lhachana natoh dingu ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hijongle chua kona Pakai na Pathen'u chu nahol uva, nalungthim pumpiu le nahinnao pumpi-a nahol ule, namu dingu ahi.","ref":"Jer 29:13"},"30":{"text":"Hesoh genthei natouva, ni nunungni le hicheng thil jouse nachung uva achuhteng, Pakai na Pathen lama nakiheijuva, a-aw nangai uva ahile,"},"31":{"text":"(Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u chu hepina-a dim Pathen ahi,) aman nadalhah loudiu, nasuhmang louheldiu, napu napateu henga akihahselna le akitepna chu asuhmil louhel ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Ajehchu nikho che masaho, nangho masanga Pathen'in leichunga mihem asem nikho-a pat, chule van langkhatna pat alangkhat geija, hiche tobang thil nasa adang anaum kha-a, ahiloule hitobang hikija khatam? dong temun."},"33":{"text":"Nanghon najah uva nathilou banguva, meikong lah-a kona Pathen thusei aw min ajahkhah em?"},"34":{"text":"Ahiloule Pakai Pathen'in Egypt gama namitmuva abol hojouse dungjuija, Pathen'in lhepna-a, melchih na-a, thil kidang, khut thahatna, ban jahdoh-a, tijatna nasatah-a, namkhat lah-a kona namkhat lahdoh dinga cheding agot khah-em?"},"35":{"text":"Pakai chu Pathen ahi ti nahet theina dinguva, naheng uva kimusah ahi. Amalou koima dang aumpoi.","ref":"Mrk 12:32"},"36":{"text":"Aman nahil theina diuva, van'a kona a-aw najah sah uva; chule leichunga ameikou loupitah chu namusah-u ahi; chule nanghon meikou lah-a konchun athu najaovin ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chule napateu angailut jehchun, amaho nungin achilhahte alhengin, chule Egypt gama konin athahat thilbol theina-a chun amitmu-a konin napui doh-un;"},"38":{"text":"Tunikho-a banga hi nangho puilutna, agamu gouva lodinga peh dingin, nangho sanga lenjole hatjo namho namasanguva konin anodoh-in ahi."},"39":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai hi vanchung le leichung Pathen ahi ti hi tuni hin heuvin lang, nalungun ngai touvin; Amalou adang khatcha aumpoi."},"40":{"text":"Hijeh chun nangho le nanung uva nachateo aphatthei na dingu leh, a-itih-a dinga Pakai na Pathen'un napeh-u leiset chunga hi nahinkhou asotna dingin, tunikho-a kathupeh-u ama chona dan kisemho le athupehho hi nit jingun, ati."},"41":{"text":"Chujouvin Mosi'n Jordan hilam pang nisolam panga khopi thum akhendoh-in,","title":"Jordan Solam Sanga Hoidohna Khopiho","ref":"Josh 20:8-9."},"42":{"text":"Tolthat ho, gutuhna neilou, masanga jong hotna neilou tosoija aheng akom that ho ajamlutna ding; chule hiche khopiho khatna ajamlut le ahintheina din akhendoh-in:"},"43":{"text":"Hicheho chu Reuben mite-a dingin phaicham gamthipma um Bezer ahin, Gad mite-a dingin Gilead gama um Ramoth ahin, chule Manasseh mite-a dingin Bashan gama um Golan ahi."},"44":{"text":"Chule hiche hi Mosi'n Israel chate angsunga apeh danthu chu ahi.","title":"Pathen Danthu Kipeh Thumakai"},"45":{"text":"Hicheho hi Egypt'a kona ahungdoh nunguva Mosi'n Israel chate jah-a anasei, hettohsah le, dan kisemho, chule thutan ho chu ahin,"},"46":{"text":"Mosi le Israel chaten Egypt gama kona ahung potdoh nunguva anatha-u Hesbon'a cheng Amor mite lengpa Sihon gamsung Jordan pang hilam sang, Beth-peor maijona um phaichama apeh ahi."},"47":{"text":"Chuin amahon ama gam le Bashan lengpa Og gam, Jordan hilam pang nisolam sanga cheng Amor mite lengni gamchu alouvin,"},"48":{"text":"Arnon vapi panga um Areor'a pat, Hermon'a um Sion molsang chan,"},"49":{"text":"Chule Jordan hilam pang solam sanga phaicham jouse, Pisgah twinah phung noija um twikhanglen phaicham geijin alouvin ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israelte jouse akouvin, ahenguva, Vo Israel, nakihil uva, nachintup uva, chule nabol diuvin, tunia naheng uva kasei chonna danho leh thutannaho hi ngaijun.","title":"Thupeh Som (Pot 20:1-17)"},"2":{"text":"Pakai i-Pathen'uvin Horeb'a eihotoh kitepna khat anaseme."},"3":{"text":"Pakaiyin hiche kitepna hi ipateu toh abol ahipon, tunia ahingnalai jouse eihotah tojoh abol ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pakaiyin nang hotoh kimaiton molsanga chun meikong lah-a konin thu anaseijin,"},"5":{"text":"(Hiche pet chun Pakai thu chu nangho hetsah dingin Pakai le nangho kah-a kana dinge. Ajehchu meikong jehchun nana kichauvin, molsanga chun nakaltou pouvin;) hitin ati,"},"6":{"text":"Keima Pakai na Pathen kahin, nakihenna in, Egypt gama kona nahin puidohpa chu kahi."},"7":{"text":"Nangman Keima ansunga Pathen dangho nanei louding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nangman alim semthu, chung van'a um hihen, ahiloule noi leisetna um hihen, ahiloule leinoi'a twisunga um hijongle, akibahpi ima lim nasem louding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 26:1; Danb 4:15-18; 27:15."},"9":{"text":"Nangma hitobangho anga nakun louding, alhacha-a jong napan louding ahi. Ajehchu keima Pakai na Pathen hi thangthip tah Pathen kahin, keima eihot bola pate khansetna chu achate khangthum khangli chan geija vila, achunguva phulajia kahin,","ref":"Pot 34:6-7; Danb 7:9-10"},"10":{"text":"Keima eingailua chule kathupeh nit chu sang tamtah ho chunga khotona musah-a kahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangman Pakai na Pathen minchu mohseh-a napat louding ahi. Ajehchu mohseh-a amin pana chu Pakaiyin themona beija alhalou ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:12."},"12":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in nathupeh banga cholngah ni chu athengin mangin.","ref":"Pot 16:23-30; 31:12-14."},"13":{"text":"Nigup sunga na natoh-a, natohding jouse chu natoh ding,","ref":"Pot 23:12; 31:15; 34:21; 35:2; Thmpu 23:3"},"14":{"text":"Amavang nisagi ni chu Pakai na Pathen cholngah ni ahi. Hiche nikho-a hi nangma nahin, nachapate ahin, nachanute ahin, nasohpa ahin, nasohnu ahin, nabongchal ahin, nasangan ahin, nagancha poupou ahin, nakotpi sunga um namaljin hijongle ima natoh loudiu; nangma bang banga nasohpa le nasohnu jong kicholdodiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule Egypt gama soh-a um nanahin, chule Pakai na Pathen'in chua kona khut hattah le ban jahdoh-a nahin puidoh ahi chu geldoh-in. Hijeh-a chu Pakai na Pathen'in cholngah ni nitdinga nathupeh ahi."},"16":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in thu nathupeh bangin nanu napa jabolin, chutile Pakai na Pathen'in napehna leisetna chun nahinkho sotnintin, naphatthei ding ahi.","ref":"Danb 27:16; Matt 15:4; 19:19; Mrk 7:10; 10:19; Luk 18:20; Eph 6:2,3."},"17":{"text":"Tol natha louding ahi.","ref":"Semt 9:6; Thmpu 24:17; Matt 5:21; 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9; Jac 2:11."},"18":{"text":"Jon jong nabol louding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 20:10; Matt 5:27; 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9; Jac 2:11."},"19":{"text":"Gujong naguchat louding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:11; Matt 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20; Rom 13:9."},"20":{"text":"Naheng nakom chunga hettohsah dihlouva jong napan louding ahi.","ref":"Pot 23:1; Matt 19:18; Mrk 10:19; Luk 18:20."},"21":{"text":"Naheng nakom ji jong nadeichat louding, naheng nakom in ahin, alou ahin, asohpa ahin, asohnu ahin, abongchal ahin, asangan ahin, naheng nakoma thilpou pou chu nathangset louding ahi.","ref":"Rom 7:7; 13:9."},"22":{"text":"Hiche thuho hi Pakaiyin molsanga meikong lah-a kon, meilom lah-a kon, chule muthim satah lah-a kona aw gingtah-a houkhom ho nabon uva henga anasei ahin; abelap tapoi. Chule hicheho chu songpheng ni-a asunin, kahenga einapen ahi.","ref":"Heb 12:18-19."},"23":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, nanghon muthim lah-a kona aw najah-u chun, (ajehchu molsang chu meikonga ka ahi,) nangho nahiuvin, naphung uva aluchangho ahiuvin, chule nalamkai jouseu ahin kaheng neihin naijun,","title":"Mipite Kichat (Pot 20:18-21)"},"24":{"text":"Chule hitin naseijui, Vetemin, Pakai i-Pathen'un aloupina le aletna eimusah-un, chule meikong lah-a konin a-aw ijaovin ahi. Tunikho hin eihon Pathen'in mihem akihoupia, ahivanga ahin chu imu taove."},"25":{"text":"Hijeh chun tu-a ibola ithijeng diuham? Ajehchu hiche meikou nasatah hin eikahvam dingu ahi; eihon Pakai i-Pathen'u aw jahbe leuhen ithi teidingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu eiho banga meikong lah-a kona hingjing Pathen aw ja-a, hing nalai tahsa pujouse lah-a koi umam?"},"27":{"text":"Nangman ganai jinlang, Pakai i-Pathen'uvin asei ding chu gangai jin; chule Pakai i-Pathen'uvin nahenga aseijouse chu nangin kabonchao jah-a seijin lang, keihon ngai ungting, bolu vinge, nati uve."},"28":{"text":"Chule kahenga nathusei petnuchun Pakaiyin nathuseihou chu ajan; Pakaiyin kahenga, Keiman mipin nahenga athuseiju aw chu kajan ahi. Amahon athuseihou jouse chu aseidih lheh uve."},"29":{"text":"Kaden, amaho ding le achateu dinga a-itih-a aphalheh jing nadin, a-itih laijin jong hitobang lungchu pujingu henlang, eigingu henlang, kathupeh jouse anit jing jeng taveleu!"},"30":{"text":"Chenlang ahenguva, Napon in nuva lutkit taovin, gatipeh-in."},"31":{"text":"Nangma vang kakoma dingin lang, alodiuva kapehna gama abol theina diuva amaho nahil dinga thupeh jouse, chonna dan kisemho, chule thutanna ho nahenga kasei ding ahi, ati."},"32":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai na Pathen'un nathupeh banguva nabolna diuvin chingtheijun; nangho jetle veija nakihei mang lou dingu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Nalodiu gama naphat theijuva, nahinkhou asotna dinga, Pakai na Pathen'un nathupeh-u lampi jouse chu najot sohkei dingu ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun hichehohi nacheuva nagalo diu gama naboldiuva Pakai na Pathen'un nangho hil dinga thupeh eipeh dan thupeh ho, chondan ho, chule thutanna hochu ahi,","title":"Thupi Khaotah"},"2":{"text":"Chutia chu nahinkhou asotna dinga keiman nangma le nachapa chule nachapa chapate kathupeh achondanho le athupehho chu nahinkho lhumkei uva nanit uva, Pakai na Paten chu nagin dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun, vo Israel, Pakai napu napateu Pathen'in athutep banga khoiju le bongnoi lona gama chu naphat theijuva chule hatah-a napun nadiuvin, ngaijin lang, naboldoh nadin chingtheijin."},"4":{"text":"Ngaijin, vo Israel, Pakai na Pathen'u chu Pakai khat seh ahi.","ref":"Mrk 12:29."},"5":{"text":"Chule nangman Pakai na Pathen chu nalung pumpi-a, nalhagao pumpi-a chule nathaneina pumpi-a nangailut ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 22:37; Mrk 12:30; Luk 10:27"},"6":{"text":"Chule tu nikho-a nangma kathupeh hohi nalung sunga nachin jing ding ahi.","ref":"Danb 11:18-20"},"7":{"text":"Chule nangman hicheho hi nachate henga tomngai tah-a nahilding, na-insunga natoupet tengle, lamdunga nachepet tengle, naluppet tengle, chule nathodoh teng jongle naseipeh ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule hicheho chu melchihna dinga nakhutna nabua, chule namit teni kikah-a thuchihbom tobang hiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule hicheho chu na-in khomhou le nakotpi hou chunga nasut dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, Pakai na Pathen'un napu napateu Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga pehdinga akihahselna gam, nangma sahdoh hilou khopi lentah le phatah ho-a chu nahin puilutna,","title":"Thumanlou Chungchanga Gihsalna","ref":"Semt 12:7; 26:3; 28:13."},"11":{"text":"Nangma dimsah hilou thilpha jouse dimna inho, nangman nalai hilou twikul kilaiho, nangma phu hilou lengpilei le Olive thingphung ho chu nangman naneh-a nava teng le,"},"12":{"text":"Chuteng chingtheijin, ajole Egypt gam kihenna in'a kona nahin puidoh Pakai chu sumil getnin nate."},"13":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen chu nagin na, ama najena, chule ama minna nakihahsel ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 4:10; Luk 4:8"},"14":{"text":"Nanghon pathen dang, nakimvel uva cheng miho pathen nung najui loudiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"(Ajehchu nalah uva Pakai na Pathen chu thangthip Pathen ahin,) ajole Pakai na Pathen lungsat nachung uva koujah-intin, leiset chunga konin nasumang hel getnunte."},"16":{"text":"Nanghon Massah mun'a nana patep banguva Pakai Pathen chu na patep loudiu ahi.","ref":"Pot 17:1-7; Matt 4:7; Luk 4:12."},"17":{"text":"Nanghon Pakai na Pathen'un thupeh napeh-u adan thupeh ho, ahettohsah ho, chule achonna dan kisunho chu gunchu tah-a nanit dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin napu napateu henga ana kihahselna gama nagacheuva naga lona dingu le naphat theina dinguva Pakai mitmu-a adih le apha chu nabol diu,"},"19":{"text":"Pakaiyin anasei banga namelma teu jouse chu namasang uva kona nomanga umdingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule ahunglhung ding phat teng nachapan nahenga, Pakai i-Pathen'un nana thupeh hettohsah ho, dan kisunho, thutanna ho chu ipi kiseina ham? tia nadoh tengleh,"},"21":{"text":"Chuteng nachapa henga chu, Keiho Egypt'a Pharaoh soh kana hiuvin, Pakaiyin Egypt'a kona khut thahat tah-a eipuidoh-u ahi;"},"22":{"text":"Pakaiyin kamit mutah-un Egypt chung leh Pharaoh chung, chule a-insung pumpi chunga, melchihna ho, thilkidang ho, thina, chule thohtheilou hel lungkhamna eimu sah-un ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule pehdinga ipu ipateu anahahselna gama eipuilut theina diuvin, hia konchun eina puidoh-un ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule tunikho-a banga hi eihinghoi theina dingu le, a-itih-a iphat theina dingu, chule Pakai i-Pathen'u igin na dinguva, Pakaiyin hiche chondan jousehi ibol diuva eina peh-u ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule aman eithupeh banguva, Pakai i-Pathen'u masanga hiche thupeh ho jouse chu initnuva ahile, hichu ichon phatnao hiding ahi, tia naseipeh dingu ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule lodinga nachenao gama chu Pakai na Pathen'un napuilut nuva, na angsunguva nam tamtah Hit mite, Girgash mite, Amor mite, Canaan mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite chule Jebus mite nangho sanga tamjole hatjo nampi sagi anodoh tengle,","title":"Pakai Amatah Mite (Pot 34:11-16)","ref":"Sol 13:19."},"2":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'un amaho chu namasanguva apehdoh tengle, nanghon amaho chu natha uva nasuhmang heldiu, amahotoh kitepna nasem loudiu, hepina jong namusah louhel dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amaho tojong nakichenlou ding, nachanu jong achapa dinga napehlou diu, chule achanu jong nachapa ji dinga nalah louding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon nachapa chu pathen dangho lhacha-a apan theina dinga keima eijui na-a kona aheimangdiu: chutia chu Pakai lungsatna chu nachungah deujah-a, photlotna nasuhmang ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon amaho chu hitia hi naboldingu ahi: amaichamu nasuhmang pehdiu, amilimhou nasuhboh diu, athingbom hou chu naphuh lhuh pehdiu, chule alim semthu milimho chu meija nahalvam dingu ahi.","ref":"Danb 12:3"},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen uva dinga namtheng nahiu ahin, Pakai na Pathen'un leiset chunga nam jouse chungvuma ama-a dinga nam tumbeh hidinga nalhen doh-u ahi.","ref":"Pot 19:5; Danb 4:20; 14:2; 26:18; Tit 2:14; 1 Pet 2:9"},"7":{"text":"Namdang sanga natamjoh jeh uva Pakaiyin nachung uva ngailutna akoija, nalhenu ahipoi; ajehchu nangho nam jouse lah-a alhompen nanahiu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla Pakaiyin nangailut jeh-u le, napu napateu henga akihahselna asuh bulhit nom jeh-a Pakaiyin khut thahat tah-a napui doh uva, soh channa in'a konleh, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh khutna kona nalhatdoh-u ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai na Pathen chu Pathen ahin, kitahtah Pathen, ama ngailuho le athupeh nit ho henga khang sangkhat geija akitepna le akhotona koijing,","ref":"Pot 20:5-6; 34:6-7; Minb 14:18; Danb 5:9-10"},"10":{"text":"Chule ama hotbolpa chu sumang dinga amai uva lethuh jia Pathen ahi: ama ahotbol pa chu adep jing louding, amaikoh tah-a alethuh ding ahi, ti kihetnin."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nangman tunikho-a kathupeh danthupeh ho, chonna dan kisunho, chule thutanna ho hi nanit ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chutengle hung hitiding ahi, nangman hiche thutanna hohi nangaija, nanitna, chule nabola ahileh, Pakai na Pathen'in napu napate henga akihahselna, akitepna le ahepina chu anit jingding ahi.","title":"Thuman Chungchanga Vangbohna (Danb 28:1-14)","ref":"Danb 11:13-17."},"13":{"text":"Chule aman nangma nangailutna, phatthei naboh ding, chule napunsah ding; nangma pehdinga napu napateu henga akihahselna leisetna chu nalaigilga le naleiset ga, nachang, nalengpi thei, nathao nabong hole kelngoihon ho phatthei abohding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nangma nam jouse chungvuma phatthei nachan ding; nangho lah-a kon, ahiloule nagancha lah uva kona anu hijongle apaham hijongle achinga umlou helding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Pakaiyin nangma-a kona natna jouse alahmanga, nangman nahet Egypt hiveiho jouse chu nachunga khatcha akoilou ding; nangma nahot bolte jouse chunga akoijoh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Pakai Pathen'in napehdoh ding miho jouse chu nasuhmang hela, achunguva khotona naneilou ding, a-pathen'u jong najen louding ahi; ajeh chu hichu nangma dinga thanga hungpang ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nangman nalungthima, Hiche namho hi keisangin atamjon, iti kanomang jou ding ham? nati-a ahile,"},"18":{"text":"Amaho chu nakichat louding; amavang Pakai na Pathen'in Pharaoh leh Egypt mite jouse chunga anatoh jouse chu nageldoh joh-a,"},"19":{"text":"Nangman namitna namu patepna nasatah ho, melchihna ho, thil kidangho, khut thahat tah le ban jahdoh-a Pakai na Pathen'in napuidoh chu nageldoh ding ahi: Pakai na Pathen'in nakichat miho jouse chunga chutobanga chu abolding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chukal vala jong Pakai na Pathen'in nangma-a kona kisel ahingdoh amoh ho chu asuhmang kahse-a alah uva khoi-ngal alhakhum ding ahinalaije."},"21":{"text":"Nangman amaho chu nakichat louding ahi: ajehchu tijat umtah le hat chungnung Pakai na Pathen'u nalah uva aume."},"22":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'in namasanga hiche namho chu athem thema anodoh ding ahi. Nangman khatvei phulsuh-a nasuhmang thei louding ahi; achuti loule gamsa ho nachunga hungpung getnunte."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai na Pathen'in amaho chu nangma henga hinpe doh intin, chule suhmang hela aumkah seuva manthah na-a nasatah-a asuhmang ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule aman aleng hou chu nakhutna ahin pehdoh ding, nangman amin'u vannoi'a kona nasuhmang ding ahi. Amaho nasuhmang hel tokah se-a koimacha namasanga dingjou louding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Alim semthu pathen ho chu meija nahalding, achung kai sana ahiloule adangka ho chu nadeichat louding, lah jong nakilah louhel ding ahi; atiloule chua ohkhan nate: ajehchu Pakai na Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule na-insunga thil thet um napohlut louhel ding ahi; atiloule hiche tobang chun sapsetna-in umkhan nate. Amavang nangman hichu nasatah-a nathetna, nakidah johding ahi: ajehchu hichu sapset thil ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nahin uva, napun uva, napu napateu henga Pakaiyin ana hahselna gama chu nalut uva nalotheina dingun, tunia kapeh thupeh jouse hi nabolna dingun chingtheijun.","title":"Lo Ding Gamphatah"},"2":{"text":"Chule nangho suhnem nading, photchetna ding, nalungsunguva ipi umam hetdohna dingle, aman nathupeh hou chu najuidiu najui loudiu hetna dinga, Pakai na Pathen'un kum somli sung gamthipma nahinpui nao lampiho chu geldoh-un."},"3":{"text":"Mihem changlhah seh-in ahingpon, Pakai kamsunga kona hungpotdoh thucheng jouse-a bou hingding ahi ti nangho nahetsah theina dinguva, aman nasuhnem uva, gilkel nathoh dingu aphala, nangho nahiuva, napu napateu ahia jong ahet khahlouvu manna-a navah-u ahi.","ref":"Matt 4:4; Luk 4:4"},"4":{"text":"Hiche kum somli sunghin natahsa chunguva navonu achulpon, nakengu jong apom pon ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mihemin achapa asehgim jibanga, Pakai na Pathen'in nasehgim chu, nalunga jong nangaito ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu alampia nachena dingu le, ama nagin na dinguva Pakai na Pathen'u thupeh ho chu nanit dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un gamphatah, thinglhang le phaichama kona hunglong doh twinah le twisam putdohna gam, vachadung ho lona gama napuilut uva,"},"8":{"text":"Suhlou chang, sakol chang, lengpigui ho, theichang phungho, kolbuthei ho, Olive thao le khoiju lona gam,"},"9":{"text":"Lhasam louva changlhah naneh nadingu, asunga chu imacha nalhahsam loudingu; asong ho thih hija, alhangho-a kona sum-eng laidoh theina gamphatah-a napuilut dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nanghon naneh uva nava tengule, aman gam phatah napeh jeh uva Pakai na Pathen'u chu nathangvah dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tunia nangho henga kathupeh; adan thupeh ho, athutan naho, achonna danho hi nanit daova, Pakai na Pathen'u chu nasuhmil louna dingun chingtheijun.","title":"Pakai Suhmil Chungchanga Gihsalna","ref":"Hos 13:5-6."},"12":{"text":"Achuti loule naneh-a nava tengle, chule in hoitah nakisah-a asunga nachen tengle,"},"13":{"text":"Chule nagancha honu le nakelngoi hon hou ahung puna, nasanao le nadangka hou ahung puna, naneijouseu ahung punteng,"},"14":{"text":"Chuteng le nalungthimu hung kichoisanga, henkola na-umnao in, Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh-a Pakai na Pathen chu sumil khaovin natin;"},"15":{"text":"Gulse le aipi umna, Twi umlouna gamgo gamthip lentah le tijat umtah lhungkeija nahin pui galkaija, meituh songpi-a kona twi nape pao;"},"16":{"text":"Nahinkho nunung lamle naphat theina diuva nasuhnem theina diule naphotchet theina diuva gamthipma napute napateu vin ahetkhah louvu manna-a navahpao chu sumil khaovin natin;"},"17":{"text":"Chule nangman nalungthima, Kathil boltheina le kakhut thahat na-in hiche haona hohi eilampeh ahi, tigetnin nate."},"18":{"text":"Amavang Pakai na Pathen chu nageldoh ding ahi: ajehchu tunikho-a banga hi napateu henga ana kihahselna akitepna chu aphudet theina dinga thahat nape-a chu ama ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, Pakai na Pathen'u chu nasuhmil heluva, Pathen dang nung najuijuva, alhacha na natoh uva, nahou uva ahile, tunikho-a hi kagihsal nahiuve, nangho namanthai teidingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'u aw najuinom loujeh uva, namasanguva namdangho asuhmang banga, chutobanga chu namanthah dingu ahi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngaijun, Vo Israel: Tunia hi nangho sanga nasajo le hatjo, khopi lentah le van geija akulbang kisaho lodinga Jordan nagalkai ding ahin,","title":"Mipihon Thu Amanlouvu"},"2":{"text":"Nangin nanahetsa-u Anakim chate, Anak chate masanga koiham ading joudinga? tia miseina-a nanajah sao milentah tah le sangtah ho masanga nachedingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun tunikho hin namasanguva che-a chu Pakai na Pathen'u ahi ti heuvin; aman amaho chu kavamthei mei banga asuhmanga, na-angsung laitah uva asuhnem dingu ahi. Hitia chu Pakaiyin najah uva asei banga, amaho chu nanodoh uva, nasuhmang loi jeng dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in namasanga kona amaho anodoh nung tengle, Kachon phatna jeh-a Pakaiyin hiche gam lodinga eipuilut ahi, tin seihih-in; hiche nampiho gitlou jeh joh-a Pakaiyin namasanguva kona amaho anodoh ahibouve."},"5":{"text":"Nachon phatna jeh, ahiloule nalungthima chondihna nanei jeh-a agamu lodia nache ahipoi: amavang hiche nam mite gitlou jeh le, Pakaiyin napu naputeu Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob henga akihahselna asuh bulhitna dinga, Pakai na Pathen'un namasanguva kona amaho anodoh joh ahibouve."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun hiche gampha hi nachon phatnao jeh-a Pakai na Pathen'un nalodiuva napeh-u ahipoi ti kihet un; ajehchu nangho milouchalte nahi bouvui."},"7":{"text":"Gamthip laija chu iti dana Pakai na Pathen'u nalunghansah-u ham geldoh-un lang, sumil hih-un; Egypt gama kona nakipat doh nikhouva pat, hiche mun nahunglhun geijun, nangho Pakai dounan nkiphinun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Horeb'a jong Pakai chu nalunghan sah uvin, chutichun nangho suhmangna ding khopmin Pakai chu alungsan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Songpheng teni, Pakaiyin nang hotoh akitepna songpheng teni chu ladinga molchunga kakaltou chun, nisomli le jan somli kaga umin, an kanepon, twi jong kadonpon ahi.","ref":"Pot 24:18"},"10":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Pathen khutjunga kisun songpheng ni eipen; hichea chun kikhoppi nikho-a Pakaiyin molsanga meikong lah-a kona nangho jah-a athusei jouse dungjuijin achunga chun akisunin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin nisomli le jan somli kichai nichun ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin songpheng ni, kitepna songpheng teni ngei chu eipen ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, Kipatdoh-in, hikoma konhin chesuh loijin; ajehchu Egypt'a kona nahin puidoh namite khu amaho le amaho akisuboh-un; kathupeh lampi-a konin gangtah-in akihei mangun, amaho dingin akilhajol milim akisem taove, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chukal valin Pakaiyin kahenga, Hiche mitehi kaven ahile, vetan, milouchalte ahiuve."},"14":{"text":"Amaho hi kasuh manga, aminu vannoi'a kona kanoimang nadin kalolo neilosah jengin; chule nangma-a kona amaho sanga nasajole hatjo namkhat kasem ding ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun kakiheijin molsanga konin kahung kumlhan, chuin molsang chu meijin akan; chule kitepna songpheng teni chu kakhut teni-a aumin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin kaven ahile, veuvin, Pakai na Pathen'u dounan nachon seovin, bongnou lim kilhajol nana kisemun; Pakaiyin nathupeh-u lampia konin gangtah-in nakihei mangun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin songpheng teni chu kalan, kakhut teni-a konin kaseplhan, namitmu tah-un kasuchip min ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amasa-a bang chun nisomli le jan somli Pakai angsunga kaboh khupmin; ama lunghansah dinga Pakai mitmu-a giloutah-a chonset nabol hou jouseu jehchun, an neloule twi donlouvin kaumin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ajehchu nangho sumang dinga nachung uva Pakai lunghanna, alungsatna le alunglhai louna chu kakichan ahi. Ahivangin Pakaiyin hichepet jong chun kathu angaijin ahi.","ref":"Heb 12:21"},"20":{"text":"Chuin Pakai chu Aaron chunga suhmang na ding khopmin alunghangin; Aaron dinjong hiche petchun kataovin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin nachonset nao, na bongnou kisemu chu kalan, meija kagouvin, leivui banga adi kahsen kachil goijin; chule adi chu molsanga kona longlha vachadunga chun kalehlut tai."},"22":{"text":"Chule Teberah'a, Massah'a, Kibroth-hatta-avah'a jong Pakai chu nalunghansah-uvin ahi.","ref":"Minb 11:3,34; Pot 17:7."},"23":{"text":"Chutobang chun Pakaiyin Kadesh-barnea'a kona nasol uva, Chetouvun lang keiman kapehnao gamchu galo taovin ati chun; Pakai na Pathen'u thupeh dounan nakiphin un, ama natahsan hih-un, athujong nangai pouvin ahi.","ref":"Minb 13:25—14:38; Danb 1:21,26; Heb 3:16"},"24":{"text":"Nanghohi kahet nikhouva patnin Pakai dounan nakiphin un ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chutia Pakaiyin nangho suhmang ding ahi atijeh chun, amasa-a kabohkhup bangchun, nisomli le jan somli Pakai anga kaboh khupmin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai henga kataovin, Vo Pakai Pathen, naloupina vanga nalhat doh-a, khut thahat tah-a Egypt'a kona napuidoh nam mite le nagoulote hi sumanghih-in."},"27":{"text":"Nasoh Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob chu geldoh inlang, hiche mite lungtahna, agitlouna le, achonset naohi vehih beh-in."},"28":{"text":"Achuti loule neihin puidohnao gam miten, Pakaiyin ateppehna gama apuilut theilou jeh le, aman amaho ahot jeh-a, gamthipma thagam dinga ahin puidoh-u ahi, tigetnunte."},"29":{"text":"Amavang nathahat thilboltheina le naban najahdoh-a nahinpuidoh namite le nagoulote ahiuve, katin ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche laichun Pakaiyin kahenga, Amasa-a bangin songpheng ni khengin lang, molsang chunga kaheng lama hungtouvin lang, thing thingkhong khat semin.","title":"Mosi'n Thupeh Avela Amukit (Pot 34:1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Chule nangin nasechip songphenga kisun thucheng hochu songpheng teni chunga chu kasutding, chule hichu thingkhong sunga nakoiding ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Shittim thingin thingkhong kasemin, chule amasa bangin songpheng ni kakhengin, chule songpheng teni chu kakhutna choipumin molsanga chun kakal toutai."},"4":{"text":"Chuin songpheng chunga chun akisun masa bangin, khoppi nikho-a molsanga meikong lah-a kona Pakaiyin naheng uva asei thupeh som chu asunin; chule hichu Pakaiyin keima eipetai."},"5":{"text":"Chuin kaki heijin molsanga konin kahung kumlhan, songpheng chu kasem thingkhong sunga chun kakhumin; Pakaiyin eithupeh bangin chua chun aumjing tan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu Jaakan chate kho Beeroth'a konin Mosera alhungun; chua chun Aaron athin, chumun mama-a chun avui taovin; chule ama khelin achapa Eleazer'in thempu tohmun lhachana chu atongtai.","ref":"Minb 20:28; 33:38."},"7":{"text":"Chua konchun amaho Gudgodah'a alhungun, Gudgodah-a konin vapi twiho umna gam Jotbath alhungun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hiche laichun Pakai kitepna thingkhong puding le, Pakai angsunga dinga lhachana tong dingin, chule tunichan geija amin phatthei boh dingin Pakaiyin Levi phung chu achom khenin ahi.","ref":"Minb 3:5-8"},"9":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Levi'n asopite lah-a chan jong, gou jong aneilou ahi; Pakai na Pathen'un athupeh banga, Pakai chu agoulo hija ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin phat masa-a bang chun nisomli le jan somli molsanga chun kaumin; chule hichepet jong chun Pakaiyin eingaipeh-a, Pakaiyin nangho nasumang tapouvin ahi.","ref":"Pot 34:28."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, Kipatdoh-in, Apu apateu pehdinga kaki hahsel na gamchu alutnuva agalo theina diuvin, mipi ho chu lamkaijin, eiti."},"12":{"text":"Chule tun, Israel, Pakai na Pathen'in nanga kona angeh chu ipiham, Pakai na Pathen chu naginna, alampi jouse-a najuija, ama nangailutna, nalung pumpi le nathaneina pumpi-a Pakai na Pathen najena,","title":"Pathen'in Angeh Chu Ipiham"},"13":{"text":"Naphat theina dinga tunia kathupeh, Pakai thupeh hole achonna dan kisunho nanitding hi hilouham?"},"14":{"text":"Veuvin, van le vanho jouse van, chule leiset le asunga umjouse jonghi Pakai na Pathen uva ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla napu napateu ngailut ding bou chu Pakai lunglhaina ahin, amaho nunga achilhahteu, nangho jeng jong tunia nahinao bangahi mijouse chungvuma nalhenu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun nalungsung chep tanun lang, louchal tahih-un."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u hi pathenho Pathen, pakai ho Pakai, Pathen loupitah, hat chungnung, tijat umtah, mihem mai velou le, lepthol lalou ahi.","ref":"1 Tim 6:15; Tph 17:14; 19:16; Sol 10:34; Rom 2:11; Gal 2:6; Eph 6:9"},"18":{"text":"Aman paneilou le meithai thu dihtah-in atanin, gamdangmi nehding le vonding apen angailun ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun nanghon gamdangmi ngailuvin; ajehchu nangho jong Egypt gama gamdangmi nanahiu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Nangman Pakai na Pathen nagin ding; ama najena, ama-a nabe ding, chule amina nakitep ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Amachu navahchoi dingpa ahin, chule namit teni-a namu hiche thil loupile tijat umtahho nangma dinga ana bola na Pathen chu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Napu napateu chu Egypt gama mi somsagi toh anachesuh-un; chule tun Pakai na Pathen'un natamdanu chu van'a ahsi ho banga tamin nasemtaove.","ref":"Semt 15:5; 22:17; 46:27"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nangman Pakai na Pathen chu na ngailutna, aman nanganse na ho, achona dan kisunho, athutanna ho, chule athupehho nanit jingding ahi.","title":"Pathen Loupina"},"2":{"text":"Chule tunikhon heuvin, ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u gimbolna, aloupina, akhut thahat, chule aban jahdohna hekhalou le mukhalou nachateo henga thu kasei ahipoi;"},"3":{"text":"Chule Egypt mite lailung tah-a Egypt lengpa Pharaoh chung le agamsung pumpi-a athilkidang bol ho le anatohho,","ref":"Pot 7:8—12:13"},"4":{"text":"Egypt sepai ho chung le asakol hou chung, chule akangtalai chunga anabol ho, amahon nahin nungdel naova twipisan iti achupsah-u, chule iti dana Pakaiyin amaho tunigeija asuhmang ham,","ref":"Pot 14:28"},"5":{"text":"Chule hiche munna nahunglhun kahseuva gamthipma chu naheng uva ipi abol,"},"6":{"text":"Chule Reuben chapa Eliab chapateni Dathan le Abiram chunga ipi abol, leisetnin akam iti ahinkah-a amaho le a-insungu pumpi, chule apon inhou le Israelte lah-a anei jouseu aval lhum ham ti hekhalou le mukhalou nachateo henga thu kasei ahipoi.","ref":"Minb 16:31-32"},"7":{"text":"Ahin nangho mitnin vang Pakai thilbol loupiho jouse chu amun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nahat theijuva, lodinga nachennao gam chu nagalo theina dinguvin, keiman tunia kathupeh, dan thupeh ho jousehi nanit dingu ahi.","title":"Gamtep Gama Vangbohna"},"9":{"text":"Chutile Pakaiyin napu napateu leh achilhah teo pehdinga ahahselna, bongnoi le khoiju lonna gama chu nahinkhou sot thei ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu galo dinga nachenao gamchu nahungdohnao Egypt gam, anche louhing hon, muchi natheuva nakenga twi nachap jinao tobang ahipoi."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla galo dinga nachenao gam chu thinglhang le phaicham umna, van gotuijin achap nou jingna gam,"},"12":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'un avettup jingna gam, Pakai na Pathen'u mit chu kum kipatna pat kum kichaigeija achunga aum jingna gam ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, Pakai na Pathen chu nangailutna nalung pumpi le nalhagao pumpi-a ama jen dinga tunia kapeh thupeh hi chingthei tah-a nangaija ahile,","ref":"Thmpu 26:3-5; Danb 7:12-16; 28:1-14."},"14":{"text":"Nachang, na lengpithei, chule nathao twi naki khoptup theina dinga van gotwi masale gotwi nunung aphatcha kapeh dingu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule naneh uva nava theina dinguva, nagancha teo dinga nagamsunguva hamhing kaphatsah ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nalungsungu lheplhah-a aumlouna dingle, nakihei manguva pathen dang ho najen uva nahoulou nadingun chingtheijun."},"17":{"text":"Chutile Pakai lunghan nachunga koujah intin, gojuh louna din van khah intin, leijin aga asodoh louding,Pakaiyin napeh-u gam phatah-a konin mangthah loi getnun nate."},"18":{"text":"Hijeh chun hiche kathuho hi nalungthim le nahinna-in vop inlang, namit teni kah-a thuchih bom tobang ahitheina din, nakhut chunga melchihna hidingin kanbeh-in."},"19":{"text":"Chule hicheho chu nachateo nahil dingu, na-in'uva natou petnu, nalam jot petnu, nalup petnu chule natho tengu jongle nahil jingdiu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule na-inkot khomho chung le nakotpiho chunga hichehi nasut dingu ahi.","ref":"Danb 6:6-9"},"21":{"text":"Chutia chu napu napateu pehdinga Pakaiyin ahahselnau gama chu nahinkhou le nachateo hinkhoho chu leichunga vangam nikhoho banga sotding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen chu ngailut ding, alampi jouse jotdinga chule ama-a behjing dinga kathupeh ho chu chingthei tah-a nanitna ahile,"},"23":{"text":"Pakaiyin namasanguva konin hiche nam jousehi anodoh ding, nangho sanga nasajole hatjo namho nahin lodiu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Nakeng phanguva nachot phahna chanu chu nangho-a hiding, gamthip le Lebanon'a pat, luipilen, Euphrates luipi-a pat twikhanglen mong gei sana nangho-a hiding ahi.","ref":"Josh 1:3-5"},"25":{"text":"Namasanguva ding ngam koimacha umlou ding ahi. Ajehchu aman naheng uva anasei banga, nachot phahdiu gamjousea chu Pakai na Pathen'un nangho gin nale kichatna akoiding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Veuvin, tunin namasanguva phattheina le gaosapna kakoije."},"27":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen nu thupeh ho, tu-a kapeh hohi nanit nuva ahile phattheina hintin,"},"28":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'u thupeh nanit lou uva, nahetkhah lou pathen dangho houdinga, tunia kathupeh lampia kona nakihei manguva ahile gaosapna hiding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, galo dinga nachenao gama chu Pakai Pathen'in napuilut tengu le, Gerizim molsang chunga chu phat theina nakoi uva, Ebal molsang chunga gaosapna nakoi dingu ahi.","ref":"Danb 27:11-14; Josh 8:33-35"},"30":{"text":"Hichu Jordan gal langkhat, nisa lhumna lamsanga Moreh phaicham kom, Gilgal maijon muncham dunglaija Canaan mite chena gama chu uma hilouham?"},"31":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un napehnao gamchu galo dinga Jordan nagalkai diu ahin, chule hichu nalouva, asunga nachendiu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule tunia namasanguva kakoi chonna dan kisun hole thutanna hochu nanitna dinguva nachihthei dingu ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hichehohi napu napateu Pakai Pathen'in leisetna nahin laiseuva nalodiuva anapehnao gama nanitdiu chonna dan le thutan naho chu ahi.","title":"Pathen Houna Ding Munkhat Seh"},"2":{"text":"Nagalo diu gama namhon molsang ho chung le lhangho chunga, chule thinghing phung engsel noitina, a-pathen hou anajen nau munho jouse chu nasuhmang soh heldiu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule amaicham ho nasuh chimuva, asong phu hou navohboh uva, athingbom hou meija nahaldiu, semthu milim pathenho naphuh lhuh uva, chuche munna kona chu aminu nasuhmang diu ahi.","ref":"Danb 7:5"},"4":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'u henga vang chutia nabol loudiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai na Pathen'un naphung jouseu lah-a kona amin umna dinga alhendoh ding mun, hiche mun ngeichu nahol diu, hiche mun'a chu nahung diu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule hilama chu nagovam thiltohou, naganlhai na hou, na somakhat hou, nakhutjap thilpeh hou, nakitep nahou, nalung cham tah uva thilto natohou, nagan honu le na kelngoi hon lah uva apeng masapen ho chu nahin choidiu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule chua chu Pakai na Pathen'u masanga naneh uva Pakai na Pathen'in nanatohna jouse-a phatthei nabohna chung changa nangma le na-insung mite jouse nakipa diu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tunikho-a hilai mun'a mitinin ama mitmu-a dih asah chan abol banga hi nabol loudingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un napeh-u choldona le gou lona munchu nalhung hihlai tadiuve."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla nangho Jordan nagalkaijuva, Pakai na Pathen'un lodinga nana peh-u gama nachen tengule, chule nakimvel uva namelma teu jouse-a kona choldona napeh tengule, bitkeija nachendiu ahitan;"},"11":{"text":"Chutengle Pakai na Pathen'un amin umna dinga alhending munkhat umintin; hilama chu kathupeh jouse, nagovam thiltohou, naganlhai nahou, nahopsom hou, nakhutjap thilpeh hou, Pakai henga nakitepnao deilhen kitepna jouse nahinchoi dingu ahi;"},"12":{"text":"Chule nangho Pakai na Pathen'u masanga, nangho le nachapateo le nachanuteu, nasoh pasal ho leh nasoh numei hou, chule nakotpi sunguva um Levi miteho toh nakipa khomdiu ahi; ajehchu amaho nang hotoh chan le gou neikhomlou ahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Mun namuna jouse-a govam thilto nato louna dingin chingtheijin."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla Pakaiyin naphung sungu khat penpena kona alhendoh ding munna chu govam thilto nato uva, chua chu kathupeh jouse nabolding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahivanga Pakai na Pathen'u phattheiboh dungjuija aman napeh jouseu chu nalungin angaichat dungjuija nakotpi phung jouse-a natha-a, asa naneh theiding ahi. Mi atheng le atheng louvin jong, sapengchal le sakhichal hijongle aneh theiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Thisan bou naneh loudiu, twibanga tolla nasunlhah diu ahi.","ref":"Semt 9:4; Thmpu 7:26-27; 17:10-14; 19:26; Danb 15:23"},"17":{"text":"Nakotpi hou sunga chu nachang hopsom-u, nalengpi gao hopsom, nathao twi'u hopsom, nagancha houlah-a apeng masaho ahiloule nakelngoi hon lah uva apeng masaho, kitepna-a nakitepna hou, nalungcham thilto hou, nakhutna najap thiltohou chu naneh theilou dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Amavang Pakai na Pathen'un alhending mun'a chu Pakai na Pathen'u masanga vang ,nang le nachapate le nachanute, nasoh pasal le nasoh numei ho, chule nakotpi hou sunga um Levi hotoh naneh teidiu ahi. Chule Pakai na Pathen'u masanga nakhut nangapna jouse-a chu nakipa diu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Leichunga nahinlai chansea Levi mite nanot thap lounadin chingtheijin."},"20":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'un nana teppeh-u banga nagamgi akehletna, chule, Nahinna-in sa nehding ngaichat jeh-a sa nenge nati tengle, nahinnan aduchat sa chan chu naneh thei ahi."},"21":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in amin koina dinga analhen munchu nanga kona agamlat behsetna ahile, keiman kathupeh banga, Pakaiyin napeh nagancha hon le nakelngoihona kona natha-a, nakotpi phunga chu nahinna-in aduchat channa naneh ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Sapeng chal leh sakhichal kineh banga naneh ding ahi; athengle atheng louvin kibanga aneh dingu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Thisan bou chu naneh louhelna dingin chingtheijin; ajehchu thisan chu hinna ahin; chule hina chu asa toh naneh koptha theilou ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 17:10-14"},"24":{"text":"Nanghon hichu naneh loudiu, twibanga tolla nasunlhah dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Pakai mitmu-a thildih nabol tengle, nangma le nanunga nachate naphat theina dinguva hichu naneh lou dingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Nathil theng neiho le nakitep naho bou chu nachoija, Pakaiyin alhending mun'a chu nache ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule na govam thilto chu asa le athisan agoma Pakai na Pathen'u maicham chunga na nato-a, chule aganlhaina thisan chu Pakai na Pathen maicham chunga kisung lhading, asachu naneh ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen mitmu-a apha le adih nabol tengle, nangma le nanunga nachate dinga a-itih-a naphat theina dinguva, nangman kathupeh jouse hi lunglutna nangaija nanitding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in galo dinga nachenao gama nampiho chu namasanguva kona asuhmanga, nanghon amaho najo uva, agamuva nachen tengule;","title":"Milim Hou Chungchanga Gihsalna"},"30":{"text":"Namasanguva kona akisuhmang banguva, amaho nung najuina-a na-o louna ding le, hiche namhohin itobanga a-pathen'u ajenum? amaho bolbangin eihon jong bolute, tia a-pathen'u thudol hou nakhol louna dingun chingtheijun."},"31":{"text":"Hitobanga chu Pakai na Pathen'u henga nabol loudingu ahi. Ajehchu amahon Pakaiya thet umjouse, ahot ho chu abol jiuvin, achapateu le achanuteu san a-pathen dingun meijin ahal jiuve."},"32":{"text":"Boldinga thu kapeh chanchu nabolding ahi; hichea kona chu nabelap louding, lah jong nalahdoh louding ahi.","ref":"Danb 4:2; Tph 22:18-19"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nalah uva themgao ham, mang neiham asodoh-a, melchihna ham, thil kidang namusah uva,","title":"Milim Houdia Mijol ho Songa Selih ding"},"2":{"text":"Chule melchihna ham, thil kidang ham chu aguilhuna, chule naheng uva, Nahet khahlouvu pathen dangho juiju hitin, amaho jennu hite tia aseile;"},"3":{"text":"Nanghon chuche themgao ham, mang neipa ham thuchu ngaihih-un; ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in nalung pumpile nalhagao pumpiuva Pakai na Pathen'u chu nangailut nangailut lou hetna dia napatepmu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nanghon Pakai na Pathen'u nung najuijuva, naginuva, athupeh ho nanit uva, athu naman uva, ama najen uva, chule ama-a nabediu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule chuche themgao ham, mangnei ham pachu tha jengding ahi; ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u Egypt gama nahinpuidoh uva, sohchana in'a kona nalhatdoh paova kona kihei mangna ding thu aseijin, Pakai Pathen'in chedinga thu napehnao lampia kona kiheimang ding nagouvin ahi. Chutia chu nanghon agilou chu nalah uva kona chu nasuhmang diu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nanu chapa nasopipa ham, nachapa ham, nachanu ham, na-angkoi na-inneipi ham, nagol napai ham, nahinna tobang hela nagel khatnin guhthima najola, nahenga, Nangman nahetkhah lou, nangma le napaten ahetkhah louvu pathen dangho gahouvu hite;"},"7":{"text":"Nakimvel uva mite, nakom naiham, gamlatah-a umham, kolmonga pat kolmong langkhat gei pathen ho chu gahouvu hite tia aseija ahileh,"},"8":{"text":"Nangman amachu nanoppeh louding, ngaijong nangaipeh louhel ding; namitnin jong akhotolou ding, kheh jong nakheh louding, chule imjong na-im mang lou ding;"},"9":{"text":"Amavang natha teitei joh ding; nangman ama thana dinga achunga nakhut nalhah masat pending, chujoule mipijouse khut chu achunga chuding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule ama chu songa nase-a naselih dingu ahi; ajehchu aman Egypt gamsunga sohchana in'a kona nahin puidoh Pakai na Pathen'a kon heimang ding nagon ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chutia chu Israel jousen ajah uva, kicha diu, chule nalah uva hitobang gitlounahi abolkit tah loudingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in chenna dinga nanapeh khopiho khatna thu kisei;"},"13":{"text":"Nalah uva kon mi phabep, Belial chate achedoh-un, akhopi sunguva mite chu ajol lhaovin, ajah uva, Nanahet khah louvu pathen dangho lhachana tong dingin cheohite, tia kisei najah-a ahile;"},"14":{"text":"Chuteng nangman nadoh toh ding, nakhol ding, gunchutah tah-a nadoh ding, chule ven, hichu thutah ahia, chutobang thet umchu nalah uva akibol tahbeh ahi-a ahile;"},"15":{"text":"Chuche khopi-a chengho chu chemjam hema natha teiding, chua cheng jousele, chua ganchahon chu chemjam hema nasuhmang hel ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule chua galthil kichom jouse chu kholai lamlena nakhop sohkeija, chuche khopi le thilkichom takip chu Pakai na Pathen dinga meija nahalding ahi. Chule hichu a-itih-a dinga kisevuma, avela kisadohkit louhel ding ahitai."},"17":{"text":"Chule nakhutna gaosap thil natohkhah louding ahi: chutile Pakai chu tijat umtah alungsatna-a kona akileheija, napu napateu henga anamusah banga hepina namusah-a, nachunga lainatna aneija, napunsah ding ahi;"},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen mitmu-a adih bolna dinga tunia keiman thu kapeh ama thupeh jouse nanitna dingin, Pakai na Pathen aw nangaijin ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangho Pakai na Pathen'u chate nahiuve: mithi puldou na-a nangho le nangho naki-at chen loudingu, chule namitmulu jong nahet tol louhel dingu ahi.","title":"Puldou Petna Bollou ding","ref":"Thmpu 19:28; 21:5."},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu nangho Pakai na Pathen uva dinga mitheng nahiu ahin, chule Pakaiyin leichunga um nam jouse chungvuma ama-a tum hidinga achombeh-a nalhenu ahi.","ref":"Pot 19:5-6; Danb 4:20; 7:6; 26:18; Tit 2:14; 1 Pet 2:9"},"3":{"text":"Nanghon thet um kiti mongmong naneh louhel dingu ahi.","title":"Sa Theng Le Sa Thenglou (Thmpu 11:1-47)"},"4":{"text":"Nanghon naneh dingu saho chu: bongchal, kelngoi, chule kelcha."},"5":{"text":"Sakhichal, sapengchal, sajuh, gamkel, gambongchal chule gamkelngoi."},"6":{"text":"Chule sa jouse lah-a kon akengtin kikhena atin ni-a kika, chule anehsa ihdoh kitna lhaikit tapou chu naneh dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijongle anehsa ihdoh kit ahiloule atin kikhenkah lah-a kon sangongsang, telep, jupi, hichehohi naneh loudiu ahi; ajehchu amahon anehsa a-ihdoh-un alhaikit naovin ahin atinnu vang akika pon ahi. Hijeh-a chu nangho dinga athenglou hiuva ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule vohcha jong atin akikah vangin anehsa a-ihdoh-a alhaikit lou jeh-in nangho dinga athenglou ahi. Nanghon asao naneh loudiu, athilongu jong natohkhah loudiu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Twilah-a ganhing nenehthei houchu hichehohi ahi: alha nei le alipnei jouse naneh diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule alha le alip neilou jouse chu naneh loudingu ahi; hicheho chu nangho dinga thenglou ahi."},"11":{"text":"Vacha theng jouse naneh dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahin naneh loudiu hochu: muvanlai, mungagal, muthong"},"13":{"text":"Muvom, mubong, chule muthong toh kilimlo jouse."},"14":{"text":"Va-ah le amatoh kilimlo jouse,"},"15":{"text":"Chule sumbu, vabah, kakhut, chule mu toh kilimlo jouse."},"16":{"text":"Sumbuchanglit, sumbupi, twivatot,"},"17":{"text":"Chule twivamuhsao, muthong lhem, vatot muhkon"},"18":{"text":"Chule twilungva, twivakang le akilimlo jouse, vakhong lhu le bah,"},"19":{"text":"Chule a-opma kitholtho-a lengthei takip nangho dinga athenglou ahi: hicheho chu nehlou ding ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla vacha thengho jouse chu naneh theiju ahi."},"21":{"text":"Nanghon athikam imacha naneh loudingu ahi: hichu nakotpi phunga um kholjin mihon anehdiuva napeh ding; ahiloule gamchom mi henga najohthei ahi. Ajehchu nangho Pakai na Pathen'u dinga mitheng nahiu ahi. Nanghon api noitwija kelnou nahon loudingu ahi.","ref":"Pot 23:19; 34:26."},"22":{"text":"Akumtina nalouvin asodoh namuchi-a kona hungpeng doh jouse hopsom-a hopkhat thonlouva napeh ding ahi.","title":"Hopsom-a Hopkhat Chungchanga Danthu","ref":"Thmpu 27:30-33; Minb 18:21."},"23":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen ginje nakihil jing theina dinga, nachang hopsom, nalengpi theiga hopsom, nathao twi hopsom, nabonghon le nakelngoi hon na kona peng masaho chu amin umna dinga alhendohna munachu Pakai na Pathen angsunga naneh ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei naboh teng, Pakai na Pathen'in amin umna dinga alhendohna mun chu nanga kona agamlhat behsetna, ahiloule alampi chu asao behsetna, chutia chu napoh joulouva ahile;"},"25":{"text":"Nangman athil chu sum nasosah-a, sum chu nahin choija, Pakai na Pathen'in alhendohna mun'a chu nacheding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule hiche sum chu nahinna-in angaichat jouse bongchal ham, kelngoi ham, lengpithei ham, ahiloule zuchih ham, nahinnan angaichat jouse chohna-a namana; chukoma chu Pakai na Pathen angsunga naneh-a, nangma le na-insung mite kipah tah-a naum dingu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule nakotpi sunga um Levi mite chu nanot thap louding ahi; ajehchu aman nangma toh chan le goulo aneikhom pon ahi."},"28":{"text":"Kumthum akichai sehle chuche kum-a nathilsoh jouse hopsom nahin choija, nakotpi sunga nasetkhom ding,"},"29":{"text":"Chule Levi mite (ajehchu amahon nangma toh chan le goulo aneikhom lou ahi,) le na kotpi sunga um namdang mi, pabeiho, chule meithaiho chun aneh uva vading ahiuve; chutile Pakai na Pathen'in nakhutna natoh jouse chu phatthei abohna ding ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum sagi kichai sehle lha ongna nabolji ding ahi.","title":"Kum Sagi Channa (Thmpu 25:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Chule lha ongna umdan chu hichehi hiding ahi: aheng akom batna pechanin alha-ong ding ahi; aheng akom ahiloule asopi batna homa chun alahpeh teitei louding ahi; ajehchu hichehi Pakai lha-ongna kiti chu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Gamdang mi batna napeh vang chu nalelah kit thei ahi, ahinla ipi hile nangma-a nasopi henga umchu nalha-ong ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu nalah uva koima avaicha umlou ding ahi; ajehchu lodinga Pakai Pathen'in napeh gama chu Pakaiyin nasatah-a phatthei naboh ding ahi;"},"5":{"text":"Tunia thu kapeh hiche thupeh ho jouse jui dinga Pakai na Pathen aw chu kituptah-a nangaija ahile."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu aman nana thutep banga Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei naboh ding ahin: nangman nam tamtah henga nahop ding, amavang nangman apa nalah louding; nam tamtah chunga vai nahom ding, amavang amahon nang chunga vai ahomloudiu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in napehna gama nakotpi sunga chu nasopite khattou nalah uva vaicha auma ahile, nangman nalung natahsah louding, nasopi vaicha-a kona nakhut nakihsah louding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 25:35."},"8":{"text":"Amavang ahenga naphalna khut nalhana, alhahsamna-a angaichat lhingsetna napehjoh ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nangman nalungsung gilouva chun Kum sagina lha ongna kum anaitai tia nagel louna dingle; nasopi chunga namit thipma ima pelouva naum louna din chingtheijin; chutile nangma dounan Pakai kou intin, nadingin chonset hikhante."},"10":{"text":"Nangman ama napeh teitei ding; chule ama napeh tengle nalung nanatsah louhel ding ahi. Ajehchu hiche-a ding tah-a chu Pakai na Pathen'in natoh jouse le nakhutna nabol jouse chu phatthei aboh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu gamsunga kona migenthei beitih umlou ding ahi. Hijeh-a chu nagamsunga nasopipa, nami vaichapa, namilhasampa chunga nakhut hongphalin tia thu kapeh nahi.","ref":"Matt 26:11; Mrk 14:7; Jhn 12:8"},"12":{"text":"Chule nasopi Hebrew mi pasal ham, ahiloule numei ham nahenga hung kijoh auma, kumgup nangma najentah-a ahile; akum sagi lhinnale nanga kona ongthola nalhadoh ding ahi.","title":"Soh ho Bolding Dan (Pot 21:1-11)","ref":"Thmpu 25:39-46."},"13":{"text":"Chule nanga kona ongthola nasoldoh tengle, agohkeova nachemang sah louding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nakelngoi hona kon, nachang phola kon, nalengpi ga chilna-a kona itlou hella napeh ding; Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei naboh na-a kona chu ama napeh ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule nangman jong Egypt gama soh nanahi-a, Pakai Pathen'in nalhatdoh ahi chu nageldoh ding ahi; hijeh-a chu tunia hichehi kathupeh nahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, nangma le na-insungmi angainat jeh, nangma toh umkhom nop asah jeh-a, amachun nahenga, Nanga konin chemang ponge ati-a ahileh;"},"17":{"text":"Nangman thih hemkhat nalah ding, kotkhah phunga abil navuding, chule amachu a-itih a dinga nasoh hiding ahi. Chule nasoh numei chunga jong chutobang ma-a chu nabol ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Nanga kona ongthola nasoldoh chu nang dinga thil hahsatah tobang hilouding ahi; ajehchu thalah soh natoh chan ni atoh-a kum gup set nangman najen ahi. Chutia chu Pakai na Pathen'in natohna channa phatthei naboh ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Nagancha hole nakelngoi hon lah-a achal pengmasa ho jong chu Pakai na Pathen dinga nathenso ding: nabongchal peng masapen chu na natoh sah louding, nakelngoi honlah-a apeng masapen jong chu amul navo louding ahi.","title":"Gancha Apeng Masaho","ref":"Pot 13:12."},"20":{"text":"Chule hichu nangma le na insung miten kumsehle Pakaiyin alhenna mun'a chu Pakai na Pathen angsunga naneh dingu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule alah-a nolna nei auma, akengbai ham, amitcho ham, deimotah-a nolna nei umtapou chu Pakai na Pathen henga ganlhaina-a nato louding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Nangin hichu nakotpi ho sunga naneh ding: mi aboh le athengin kibang tah-a sapeng chal le sakhichal sa kineh banga anehdiu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Athisan bou chu naneh louding, twi banga tolla nasunlhah ding ahi.","ref":"Semt 9:4; Thmpu 7:26-27; 17:10-14; 19:26; Danb 12:16,23"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abib lhachu nit inlang, Pakai na Pathen henga kalchuhkut bolin: ajehchu Abib lha jan laija chu Pakai na Pathen'in Egypt'a kona nahin pui ahi.","title":"Kalchuh Kut (Pot 12:1-20)","ref":"Thmpu 23:5-8; Minb 28:16-25."},"2":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin amin umna dinga alhena mun'a chu ganchahon le kelngoi hon lah-a kona Pakai na Pathen henga kalchuh kut ganlhaina nabol ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nangman hichu chol kiso changlhah toh naneh louding; Egypt'a kona nahung dohlai nikho chu geldohna dinga nahinlaise-a cholsolou changlhah, gimbolna changlhah ngei chu nisagi naneh ding ahi; ajehchu Egypt gama kona kinotah-a hung doh-a nahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule nagamsunguva chu nisagi sung chol kiso changlhah himhim kimulouding; chule nimasani nilhah lama naganlhai sa chu jankhovah jingkah geija umlou ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in napehna kotpi sung khat penpena chu kalchuhkut ganlhaina nabolthei louding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amavang Pakai na Pathen'in amin umnadia alhending mun'a chu, Egypt gama kona hungpotdoh phattah, nilhumdon, nilhah lama chu kalchuhkut ganlhaina nabolding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'in alhending mun'a chu asa chu nago-a naneh ding, jingkah le nakile-a, naponbuh-a nache ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nigup sunga cholsolou changlhang naneh ding; nisagi nile Pakai na Pathen'a dinga kikhop loupi umding ahi. Hiche sunga chu na natoh louding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nangman hapta sagi nasimdoh ding: hapta sagi chu chang-atna dia koite nalap pat ni-a patna nasim ding ahi.","title":"Lholhun Kut (Pot 34:22 ; Thmpu 23:15-21)","ref":"Minb 28:26-31."},"10":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen henga nakhut tah-a lungcham thilto nato-a haptaho kut chu nanit ding, Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei naboh dungjui bangtah-a Pakai na Pathen henga napeh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'in amin umna dinga adeilhen mun'a chu Pakai na Pathen angsunga nangma nahin, nachapa ahin, nachanu ahin, nasohpa ahin, nasohnu ahin, nakotpi sunga um Levi mite ahin, nangma to umkhom namdang mi ahin, pabeiho ahin, meithai ahin, nakipa dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule nangma tahjong Egypt gama sohchanga ana um nahi nageldoh-a: hiche dan kisunhohi nanitna nabol ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nachang le nalengpi ga nakhoptup jou tengle, nisagi sung lhambuh kut naman ding ahi.","title":"Lhambuh Kut (Thmpu 23:33-43)","ref":"Minb 29:12-38."},"14":{"text":"Chule na kut sunga chu nangma nahin, nachapa ahin, nachanu ahin, nasohpa ahin, nasohnu ahin, chule nakotpi sunga um Levi mite ahin, gamdangmi ahin, paneilou ahin, meithai ahin nakipa dingu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Pakaiyin adeilhen na ding mun'a chu Pakai na Pathen'u henga nisagi sung kut loupi nabol dingu ahi. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in nalhosoh jouse le nakhutsoh jouse chunga phatthei naboh ding ahin, hijeh-a chu nakipa teiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Kumkhat sunga na pasal jouseu Pakai masanga aman adeilhen mun'a chu thumvei gaki lulah dingu ahi; cholsolou kutna, haptaho kutna, chule lhambuh kutna: chule Pakai masanga khutgoh keova kilulah loudingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mitinin Pakai na Pathen'un apeh phatthei bohna dungjuija ajokham cheh apehding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in napeh nakul kotpi jouse-a, naphung jouse-a thutan hole vaipoho natundoh ding: chule amaho chun mipi thuchu dihtah-a atanpeh dingu ahi.","title":"Adih-a Kivaipoh"},"19":{"text":"Dihlou tah-a thu natan louding; mihem mai vea jatum na neilou ding; nehguh jong nalah louding ahi: ajehchu nehguh chun miching mit asuchon, michonpha ho thusei jong aheikon jin ahi.","ref":"Pot 23:6-8; Thmpu 19:15"},"20":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in napehna gam chu nalo theija, nachen theina dinga, adih bouchu najui ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen maicham nasem nading vella chu ipi thing hitaleh thingbul naphu louding ahi.","ref":"Pot 23:13."},"22":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in ahot milim tapou natundoh louding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 26:1"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bongchal ahiloule kelngoi chunga nolna nei, ahiloule deimona um tapou chu Pakai na Pathen henga ganlhaina-a nato louding ahi. Ajehchu hichu Pakai na Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi."},"2":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'un napeh-u kotpi sung hoichepen hijongle, nalah uva Pakai na Pathen thutep sukeh-a amitmua gitlouna bol pasal ahiloule numei akimu doh-a,"},"3":{"text":"Pathen dangho agajena, keiman kathupeh hilou nisa ham, lhathah ham, van janel khattou ahouva;","ref":"Pot 22:20"},"4":{"text":"Chule hichu nangma nakisei peh-a, nangman najah-a, gunchu tah-a nadoh toh-a, chule ven, hichu adih ahia, Israel sunga chutobang thil thet um bolla aum chu akiphotchetna ahile:"},"5":{"text":"Chutobang thilse bol pasal ahiloule numei chu nakul kotpi phunglama napui doh-a, chuche pasal ahiloule numei ngeichu, chule athikah seuva songa nase dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahetoh mini, ahiloule mi thum kama kona thidinga lompa chu tha hiding ahi; ahin ahettohsah mi khat kama vang amachu kithat louding ahi.","ref":"Minb 35:30; Danb 19:15; Matt 18:16; 2 Cor 13:1; 1 Tim 5:19; Heb 10:28"},"7":{"text":"Ama thana dinga chu ahettohsah hon akhut alap masat pen dingu, chujoule mipi jousen khut alhahdiu ahi. Chutia chu nalah uva thilphalou chu nasuhmang diu ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 5:13"},"8":{"text":"Thisan kiso thu, them kichu thua, kivohto thu, nakotpi sunga kinel nohphah na thu nang dinga ageltoh hahsa behseh ahung sodoh-a ahile: nakipat doh-a, Pakai na Pathen'in adeilhen ding mun'a chu nache ding;"},"9":{"text":"Chuche laija Levi thempuho le thutana pang ding pa henga nahunga, nadoh tohding; chule amahon athutan lhuhnao chu namusah dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin adeilhen ding mun'a mihon namusahdiu dungjuija chu nabolding; chule nahetsah-u jouse dungjuija nabolna dinga nachih theiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amahon thulhuh dan nahil dungjui le, thutan dan nahil dingu dungjuija nabol ding; amahon namusahdiu thu lhuhsah-a kona chu jetlam le veilama napeldoh louding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen anga kinbola pangji thempu thu le thutanpa thu ngailouva ama kisongpa ngei chu thi ding ahi: chule Israel lah-a kona aphalou chu nasuhmang ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chutile mijousen jaovintin, kichaovintin, ama le ama kisongin ima boltapou vinte."},"14":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in napehna gam chu nahung lhuna, hichu nalo-a, asunga nachenna, Avela namho jouse bangin kachunga lengkhat kisem inge nati tengle;","title":"Lengpa Dinga Thuhilna","ref":"1 Sam 8:5."},"15":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in alhendingpa tahchu iti jongle lenga natunding ahi: nasopite lah-a kona mikhat chu nachunga lenga natunding ahin; nasopi hilou namdang mi chu nachunga natunlou ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla aman ama dinga sakol apunsah louding, ahiloule sakol apunsahna dinga mite chu Egypt gama akilesah louhel ding ahi: ajehchu Pakaiyin naheng uva, Nangho hiche lampia chu nakilekit louheldiu ahi, anatin ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 10:14-22,27; 11:1-8; 2 Thusm 1:15; 9:27"},"17":{"text":"Alung kiheimang louna dinga jijong tampi anei louding; chule sana dangka jong nasatah-a apunsah louhel ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule hiti ding ahi, ama alenggam laltouna-a atouteng, Levi mite le thempuho angsung um hiche dan thuhi lekhabu khatna akijih dohding:"},"19":{"text":"Chule hichu amatoh umkhom ding, ahinkho lhum keija asimding ahi: chuti henglang hile Pakai ginje ahetna, chule hiche danthu-a thuchengho le dan kisunho chu atohdoh na dinga chingthei ding,"},"20":{"text":"Asopiho chunga alungthima akichoisang lou ding, chule thupeh-a kona jetlam ahiloule veilama akihei manglou ding; achaina geija Israelte lah-a ama ahin achate ahin alenggam sunga ahinkho sot thei ding ahi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thempuho le Levi ho, chule Levi phung jouse chun chanle gou Israel toh aneikhom theilou diu ahi; amahon meija kigou Pakaiya dinga thiltoho le Ama chanho chu aneh dingu ahi.","title":"Thempuho Chan"},"2":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu amahon asopite lah-a gou aneiloudiu ahi: aman ahenguva aseibanga, Pakai chu agoulou ahi.","ref":"Minb 18:20"},"3":{"text":"Chule mipi-a kona thempu chanding chu hicheho hi ahi, bong ahiloule kelngoija ganlhaina thilto hintoh hochun thempupa chu adah, akhalhang, chule agilpi apeh dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nangman na chang ga masapen, lengpitwi masapen, thaotwi masapen, chule na kelngoimul kivou masapen jong ama napeh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in amale achapate chu a-itih-a Pakai mina lhacha na tong dinga naphung jouseu lah-a kona ana lhendoh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule Levi mikhat chu akhopemna Israel jouse lah-a khopi khatpen pena kona ahunga, Pakaiyin alhending mun chu alungpumpia ngailutna neija ahunga ahile;"},"7":{"text":"Chuteng Pakai anga dingjing asopi Levi hon abol bang banga Pakai a-Pathen mina lhacha-a pangding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Agouchan kijohna-a kona amu tilou amahon nehding chan kibang aneicheh dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in napehna gam chu nalhun tengle, chuche namho chonna thet umtah hochu boldinga naki themchuh louhel ding ahi.","title":"Chidang Namdang Hou Natoh Chungchanga Gihsalna"},"10":{"text":"Nalah uva achapa ham ahiloule achanu ham mei pal galkaisah, ahiloule ailhim mangcha, gaothusei, mitpheldoi mangcha, ahiloule doichoi,","ref":"Thmpu 19:26; Pot 22:18"},"11":{"text":"Ahiloule milhimthei, lhagao bohtoh kijol, doi-aithem, mithilha koutheiho chu nalah uva umloubeh ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:31"},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche thilho boljouse chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; chule hiche thet umtahho jeh-a hi Pakai na Pathen'un na-angsung uva kona amaho anodoh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nangma Pakai na Pathen angsunga pha chamkim nahiding ahi.","ref":"Matt 5:48"},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu naloding hiche namhohin gaothusei ho le aisan ho thu angaiju ahin; nangma vang Pakai na Pathen'in chutia boldin naphalpoi.","title":"Themgao Hinsolpeh Dinga Kitepna"},"15":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in nalah uva kon, nasopite lah-a kona keima tobang themgao khat nahin tundoh pehdingu ahin; amathu chu nangaidiu ahi.","ref":"Sol 3:22; 7:37"},"16":{"text":"Horeb mun'a kikhopi nikho-a, Kathi louna din Pakai ka Pathen aw neijah sahkit danlang, hiche meikong nasatah hi neimusah kit hih-in, tia Pakai na Pathen nangaichatna jouse dungjui chun."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, Amahon aseiju chu aseikha lheh-uve ati."},"18":{"text":"Keiman asopiteu lah-a konin nangma tobang khat themgao khat tundoh peh ungting, akamsunga kathu kakhum ding; keiman ama kathupeh ding jouse chu aman ajah uva aseipeh ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, aman kamina aseiding kathu hohi angailou chanchu, keiman ama-a kona hichu kangeh ding ahi.","ref":"Sol 3:23"},"20":{"text":"Ahinla aseidinga thu kapehlou kamina achama thusei themgao, ahiloule pathen dangho mina thusei chanchu, chuche themgao ngeichu thiding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule nangman nalungthima, Thu chu Pakaiyin asei ahipoi ti iti kahet ding ham? nati-a ahile,"},"22":{"text":"Themgao khatnin Pakai mina thu aseija, aseidoh thilho chun anung ajui louva, ahung guilhun louva ahile, hiche thilchu Pakaiyin asei hilou ahin; amavang themgaopa chun hichu ama lungchama asei ahi: nangman ama chu nakichat louding ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in agamu napeh amaho chu Pakai na Pathen'in asuhmanga, chule nangman agamu natoupha-a, akhopi hou le a-inhouva nachen tengle;","title":"Kiselna Khopiho (Minb 35:9-28 ; Josh 20:1-9)"},"2":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in lodinga napehna gam lailunga chu khopi thum nakhendoh ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in lodinga napehna gam pumpi chu hopthum-a nahopkhen na, tolthat takip jamlut theina dinga lampi nagon ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule tolthat ahintheina dinga chumuna jamlut dingho thudol chu hichehi ahi: amasanga kihot tona umlouva tosoija aheng akom that ho;"},"5":{"text":"Mi aheng akom toh gam manga thingphuh dinga achea, thingchu phuhlhuh nadinga aheicha chu alap donga, achang chu aga-a kona alendoh-a, aheng akompa chunga achuh-a, athi-a ahile; hiche khopiho khatna chu jamlutna hingding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amasa hotna aneiloujeh-a ama chu thidinga lom ahilou vangin, thisan phu lapan tolthatpa chu alungsat petnin nungdel intin, lampi asaojeh-a phapantin, that getninte."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu khopi thum nakise khen ding ahi, tia thu kapeh nahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'in napu napate henga peh dinga anahahselna gamchu akehletna, napu napate pehdinga athutep gam apumpi chu napeh-a ahile;"},"9":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen chu ngailut ding le alampi jot jing dinga, tunia thu kapeh hiche thupeh jousehi nanitna ahile; hiche khopi thum tilouva khopidang thum jong nakibelap thei ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chutia chu Pakai Pathen'in lodinga napehna gamsunga chu thisan phu nachunga aumlouna dinga, monabei thisan kiso umlou ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla khat touvin aheng akom ahotna amachu achanlhih-a, ama douna-a akipatdoh-a, thina theija avoh-a, athitah-a, hiche khopiho sung khatna chu ajamlutna ahile;"},"12":{"text":"Chuteng akhopi upaho chun mi asola chua kona ahinpuijuva, athi theina dinga thisan phulapa khutna chu apehdoh diu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Namit nin ama chu akhoto louding, amavang aphatna dinga themona bei thisan kiso chu Israel'a kona nasuhmang ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in lodinga napeh nagoulona gamsunga malaija mihon anaphu sao, naheng nakom gamgi chu nachondoh louding ahi.","title":"Gollui lai Gamgiho","ref":"Danb 27:17."},"15":{"text":"Mihem khat themona ahin, ahiloule chonsetna ahin, itobang chonsetna bola hijongle, mikhat douna-a hettohsah khat kipanlou ding ahi. Hettohsah mini ham ahiloule mi thum ham kama bou athudol chu kisudet ding ahi.","title":"Hettohsah Thudol","ref":"Minb 35:30; Danb 17:6; Matt 18:16; Jhn 8:17; 2 Cor 13:1; 1 Tim 5:19; Heb 10:28."},"16":{"text":"Hettohsah lhem khatnin mikhat thilbol adihlouva ngoh dinga ahung kipatdoh-a ahile;"},"17":{"text":"Akinel teni chu anilhona chuche nikho laija thempu le, thutanpa masang Pakai angsunga chu ding lhonding;"},"18":{"text":"Thutanpa chun gunchu tah-a kholtoh ding: chule veuvin hettohsah chu hettohsah lhem ahia, asopi chunga dihlou tah-a ahettohsah ahile;"},"19":{"text":"Chutengle asopi chunga bolding agot bang banga chu, amachunga naboldiu ahi. Hitia chu nalah uva kona thilse chu nasuhmang diu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule aumnalai ho chun ajah diu, kichadiu, chukalle chutobang thilse chu nalah uva abolkit loudiu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule namitnin akhoto louding; hinkho khela hinkho, mit khela mit, ha khela ha, khut khela khut, chule keng khela keng kila ahi.","ref":"Pot 21:23-25; Thmpu 24:19-20; Matt 5:38"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Namelmate sat dinga nakon doh-a, sakol ho, akangtalai ho, mipi nang sanga tamjo namuteng, amaho chu kicha hih-in; ajehchu Egypt gama kona nahinpuidoh-a Pakai na Pathen chun naumpi jingnai.","title":"Galsat Thudol"},"2":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, gal nasatdiu konle, thempu chun mipi ho chu anailutna akihoupi ding,"},"3":{"text":"Chule ajah uva, Ngaijun, Vo Israel, tunia hi namelma teu satdia nahung naiju ahita: nalungu lhahsah hih-un, kicha hih-un, hot jong kihot hih-un, chule amaho jeh-in tijong tija hih-un;"},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen chu nangho huhhing dinga, nangho dinga namelma teu satdinga nangho toh lhonkhoma ahi, atiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule gal lamkai ho chun mipi jah-a, Inthah sa-a thensolou mi koi naum uvem? Ama chu a-in lama chedin kilekit tahen, achuti loule gala thi intin, midangin kithenso getninte."},"6":{"text":"Chule lengpihon sema aga neloulai naum uvem? Ama jongchu a-in lama chedin kilekit hen, achuti loule gala thi intin, midangin aga kineh getninte."},"7":{"text":"Chule jihol neija kichenpi loulai naum uvem? Ama chu a-in lama chedin kilekit tahen, achuti loule gala thi intin, midangin kichenpi getninte."},"8":{"text":"Chule lamkai ho chun mipi ho henga asebe nahlai ding, Akichale alungthoi naum uvem? Ama chu a-in lama chedin kilekit tahen, achuti loule ama lungbang bangin asopite lungthoi getninte, atidiu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, lamkai hon mipi henga thu aseichai tengule, agalsat lamkaiho chu mipi amakaisah ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Khopi khat satdinga nahungnai tengle, ahenguva chamnathu seiphongin."},"11":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, chamna thua nahin donbut nuva, nahenga ahung kihon uva ahileh, hiti ding ahi: chua um mijouse chu nanoija hiuva, nangma najen dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahin nakichampi nomlouva, nangma nanasat thuh-a ahi vangle, nangman hichu na-umkhum ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'in nakhutna napehdoh tengle, chua pasal jouse chemjam'a monghema nathagam ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla numei ho le naosen ho, ganchaho le khopi sunga umjouse, chua thil kichom jouse geija nakilah ding; Pakai na Pathen'in nanapeh namelma teu thil nachomho chu naneh ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hiche nam miteho khopi hilou, nanga kona gamlatah-a um khopiho jouse chunga chutia chu nabol ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai na Pathen'in nagou loding napeh hiche khopi ho-a mite chu, ahaithei khatcha nahinghoi louding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hit mite, Amor mite, Canaan mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite, Jebus mite chu Pakai na Pathen'in nathupeh banga nasuhmang helding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chutia chu amahon a-pathen hou chunga abolu thet umtah chonnaho chu nahil louna ding ahi; achuti loule Pakai na Pathen'u chunga nachonset khah ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Khopi khat lah dinga achunga gal nabola, phat sottah na-umkhum teng, chukoma thingphung ho chu heicha-a naphuh-a nasuh manglou ding ahi. Ajehchu naneh thei ahin, kulpi umna-a pangdinga naphuh lhuh louding ahi, (ajehchu loujaova thingphung ho hi mihem hinkho ahi)."},"20":{"text":"Nemse ahikah seuva nangma kisatpi khopi chu umkhum na dinga, aga kinelouva nahet thingho bou chu nasuhmanga naphuh lhuh ding ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in lodinga napeh gamsunga chu mikhat kithatna, loujaova along luma, koitha ahi kihelouva aumle:","title":"Tolthat Hetchetlouho Thudol"},"2":{"text":"Chuteng na upahou le nathutan hou hunguva, akithatpa-a kona akimvela khopiho chu atediu;"},"3":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, akithatpa-a kona khopi naipen, hiche khopi-a um upaho ngeichun bongla natong loulai, koljon kaikha loulai khat ahinkaijuva;"},"4":{"text":"Chule chuche khopi upaho chun bongla chu loukikai loulai le ima tuloulai phaichama chu akai lhah uva, chuche phaichama chu angong atan lhahdiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule thempuho Levi chapaten ahin nai dingu ahi; ajehchu amaho chu Pakai na Pathen'un akin bol dingle, Pakai mina phattheiboh dinga alhendoh ahin; kinohphahna tin le kivohtona thutin chu athuva kona kitan ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule akithatpa-a kona khopi naipen upaho jouse chun phaichama angong kitan bongla chunga chu akhutnu akisop uva,"},"7":{"text":"Chule amahon hitia hi adonbut uva aseidingu ahi, Kakhut uvin hiche thisan hi aso ahipon, chule kamitnun jong amupon ahi."},"8":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nalhatdohsa nami Israelte henga hepina neijinlang, chule themona neilou thisan kiso hi nami Israelte chunga nga hih-in, atidiu ahi. Chutile thisan kiso chu ngaidama umding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chutia chu Pakai mitmu-a apha naboltengle, nalah uva kona mona neilou thisan kisochu nakoimang dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Namelmate chunga galbol dinga nakon doh-a, Pakai na Pathen'in amaho chu nakhutna napeh doh-a, gal hinga nakaija,","title":"Gal-hinga Kimanho Numei ho Thudol"},"11":{"text":"Chule sohchangho lah-a chu numei melhoi namu-a, deichatna naneija, naji dinga nangaito-a ahile;"},"12":{"text":"Nangman amanu chu na-in lama napui ding, alu akivo tolding, chule atinho atan ding;"},"13":{"text":"Chule amanun asoh channa von chu ama-a kona aholhah-a, na-inna umden ding, lhakhat lhingset anu le apa pul adou ding ahi: chujouteng amanu henga nalutna, a-inneipu nahi-a, chule amanu na-inneipi hiding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, nangman amanu-a kipana naneilouva ahile, anop nopna-a nasolding; amavang sum manavang najoh louhel ding, kiveina-a nanei louhel ding ahi; ajehchu amanu nasuhnem ahitai. Chapa Lenpen Goulo Thudol;"},"15":{"text":"Pasal khatnin jini aneija, khat angailutna, khat ahotna, amani adeinu le ahotnu chun chate ahinpeh gel lhona; achapa masapen chu ahotnu hin ahile,"},"16":{"text":"Chuteng hitiding ahi, aman anei agou chu chapate losah dinga agot teng, ahotnu chapa apeng masa sanga chu adeinu chapa apeng nukhahjo chu apengmasa-a asem louhel ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aneijouse lah-a channi apeh-a kona ahotnu chapa chu apeng masa-a asim ding ahi. Ajehchu amapa chu thahat kipatna ahin; pen masatna chanvou chu ama-a hija ahi."},"18":{"text":"Mikhatnin chapa louchal le kiphinhat aneija, apaham anuham thu ngailouva, gimbolna apeh teng jongle athuhon angailouva ahile,","title":"Thumanglou Chapa Thudol"},"19":{"text":"Chuteng anu le apan amatlhona, akhopi upaho heng le aumnao kotpi phunga ahinpuidoh lhonding;"},"20":{"text":"Chule amanin khopi upaho henga chu, Hiche kachapa lhonhi louchal le kiphinhat ahin, kathulhon ngaiding anompoi; amahi neh hatle julop ahi atilhonding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule akhopi sunga pasal ho jouse chun athina dinga songa asediu ahi. Chutia chu nalah uva kona agilou chu nakoi mangdiu; Israelte jousen ajah uva, kichadiu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule pasal khatnin thinalom chonset abola, amachu thading ahia, amachu thinga nakhai lih-a ahile;","title":"Danthupeh Chomchom"},"23":{"text":"Along chu jankhovah-a thing chunga umden louding, hiche nima ma chu navuitei ding ahi; (ajehchu akikhai chu Pathen gaosop changa ahi;) Pakai Pathen'in goulo dinga napeh gamchu akisuboh louding ahi.","ref":"Gal 3:13"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nasopipa bongchal ahiloule kelngoi vahmang namu-a ahile nakimu mosah louding ahi: iti nama jongle nasopite henga nahinpuilut teiding ahi.","ref":"Pot 23:4-5."},"2":{"text":"Nasopipa chu nanaija umlou ahia, ahiloule nahetlou ahia ahile, na-in'a nahin kaija, nasopin ahinhol kahse-a naumpi-a, chule amachu nalepeh kitding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chutobang ma-a chu asangan chunga nabolding; aponsil chunga nabol ding; nasopipa mansah thil mang jouse nangin namu chasun chu chutobanga chu nabolding; nangman nakiselden louding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nasopi ho sangan ahiloule bongchal lamsih-a lhu-a namu-a ahile nakimu mosah louding ahi: nangman amaho akaidoh-a aumkitna dinga nakithopi tei teiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Numei jin pasal von akivon louding, pasal'in jong numei von akivon louding ahi. Ajehchu chutia boljouse chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahi."},"6":{"text":"Lamdunga nache na-a vachabuh thingchung ham, tollhang hama anou ham atwi ham um nato-a, apin anou ham, atuiham chu aopkhuma ahile, api chu anou toh nalahkop louding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Amavang api chu itijong le nalhadoh-a anou vang chu nakilah ding ahi; chutile nangdin phantin, chutia chu nahinkho sotding ahi."},"8":{"text":"In thah nasah teng, chua kona mikhatou alhah-a na-in chu thisan sona-in ahilouna dinga, na-in chungdal nasem ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nalengpi leija muchi dang chomchom natulou ding ahi; achuti loule namuchi tu ga chun nalengpi theiga chu asuboh ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:19."},"10":{"text":"Bongchal le sangan mang kopma lou nakai louding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangin samul le tupat kihal tobang, pat jatchom chom kihal ponsil nasil louding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Nangman nakivon ponsil mongchep munlia chun ponjem semin.","ref":"Minb 15:37-41."},"13":{"text":"Mikhatnin ji aneija, amanu henga alutna, avetda-a,","title":"Kitimat Lampanga Thending Thudol"},"14":{"text":"Amanu chunga nolna thusei phat akipeh-a, amanu asuh minsetna, Hichenu hi kakipuijin, ahenga kahung phatnin nungah ahipoi ti kamu doh-e atia ahile;"},"15":{"text":"Chuteng nungahnu nule pa chun chuche khopi-a kotpi phunga upaho henga chu nungah theng ahina melchihna amusah lhonding;"},"16":{"text":"Chule nungahnu pa chun upaho jah-a chu, Hichepa hi aji dinga kachanu kanapen ahile, amapan ahotbol tan;"},"17":{"text":"Chule veuvin, amapan amanu chunga nolna thu aseijin, Nachanu anungah hina kahepoi ati; ahinla hichehohi kachanu nungah theng ahina melchihna ahi, atiding ahi. Chule khopi upaho angsunga chu ponchu aphajal lhonding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule chuche khopi upa hochun mipa chu amatnuva asehgimdiu;"},"19":{"text":"Chule amahon amapa chu dangka shekel jakhatna agapmuva, hichu nungahnu pa apeh diu ahi; ajehchu aman Israel nungah theng khat aminset sah ahi: chule amanu chu amapa ji hikit ding; aman amanu ahinlaisea ada louhel ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla hichu adih ahia, nungahnu dinga chu nungah theng ahina melchihna akimulouva ahile,"},"21":{"text":"Chutengle nungahnu chu apa inkot phunga akaidoh uva, khopi pasal hon amanu chu athina dinga songa ase ding ahi; ajehchu amanun apa insung jonthanhoi apatna, Israel sunga ngolhoi thil abol ahi: chutia chu nalah uva kona thil gilou chu nasuhmang dingu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Numei aji um luppi pasal akimule, anilhona numei luppi pasal le numei chu thikop ding ahi. Chutia chu Israel lah-a kona thil gilou chu nasuhmang diu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Pasal khat dinga jiholsa nungah theng chu mikhatnin khopi sunga amua, amanu aluppia ahile,"},"24":{"text":"Chuche khopi kotpi polama anilhona nahin kaidoh uva, athilhonna dinga songa nase dingu ahi; numeinu chu khosunga umngala apen loujeh, chule pasalpa chu aman aheng akom ji asetpi jeh ahi. Chutia chu nalah uva kona thil gilou chu na suhmang diu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ahin mikhatnin loujaova mijihol amua, mipa chun acham louva abola, aluppi le; amanu luppi mipa bouchu thiding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Amavang nungahnu chu imacha nalo louding ahi; nungahnu chunga chu thina theilom chonset umlou ahi: ajehchu hiche thudol hi mikhatnin aheng akom adouva atha tobang ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu aman amanu loujaova amu ahin, mijihol nungah chu apengin, ahuhhing ding koimacha aumpoi."},"28":{"text":"Min nungah theng mijihol hilou amua, amanu amatna, aluppia, chule amani chu akimudoh-a ahile,","ref":"Pot 22:16-17."},"29":{"text":"Chutengle aluppi mipa chun nungahnu pa chu dangka shekel somnga apeh-a, amanu chu aji hiding ahi; ajehchu aman amanu asuhboh ahitan, ahinlai sungse-a amanu adathei louding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Min apaji akichenpi louding, apa deljong ahodohpeh louding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:8; 20:11; Danb 27:20."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi atilchang keh, ahiloule ajang ki-at tan chu Pakai houkhom na-a lutlou ding ahi.","title":"Pakai Mite-a Kona Paidoh"},"2":{"text":"Pakai houkhom ho lah-a jaocha kiti lutlou ding; ama khangsom changei jenga jong Pakai houkhom holah-a lutlou ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ammon mi ahiloule Moab mi chu Pakai houkhom na-a lutlou ding; khangsom geija jong Pakai houkhom na-a a-imatih channa lutloudiu ahi.","ref":"Neh 13:1-2."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Egypt gama kona nahung doh-un lamdunga chun changlhah le twisih jengchan jong nana lamdot pouvin;
