chule Mesopotamia gam, Pethor kho-a Beor chapa Balaam chu nangma douna-a nagaosap dinga athalah jeh-u ahi.","ref":"Minb 22:1-6"},"5":{"text":"Hijeng jongle Pakai na Pathen'in Balaam thu angaipon; ahinla Pakai na Pathen'in nalungset jeh-in, Pakai na Pathen'in gaosapna chu nangma dingin phattheiboh na-in aheidohtai.","ref":"Minb 23:7—24:9"},"6":{"text":"Nahinlaisea a-itih-a amaho dinga chamna le aphattheina dingu nahol louhel ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nangman Edom michu nathet louding ahi; ajehchu ama nasopipa ahi. Nangman Egypt michu nathet louding ahi; ajehchu agamsung uva kholjin mi nanahi ahi."},"8":{"text":"Amaho chate chu akhang thum channa teng Pakai houkhom ho lah-a lutdiu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Namelmate doudinga janel akon tengle, thil gilou tin chenga konin kitimin.","title":"Sepaite Ngahmun Suhtheng ding"},"10":{"text":"Nalah uva mikhattou janlaija thenlounan aphah jeh-a aboh-a aumle, amachu janna gebuh-a kona potdoh-a, gebuh sunga hunglut louding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amavang hitiding ahi, nilhah lam ahunghi tengle twija kisila; nisa alhum tengle gebuh sunga hunglut kitding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Nangin gebuh pamlama jong eh thahna munkhat nanei ding, chua chu nacheji ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule namanchah lah-a chu lei lona khat naneiding; chule hitiding ahi, nangma pamlama naposo tengle hichea chu lei nalaija, nakiheija nanga kona hungpotdoh chu navuh khum ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen chu nahuhdoh ding le namelmate pedoh dinga nagebuh lah-a vahle jia ahi; hijeh-a chu nachunga aboh ima amu louva, nanga kona akiheimang louna dinga, nagebuh chu atheng hiding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Soh apu-a kona kiteldoh nahenga hunga chu apu henga napehdoh kit louding ahi.","title":"Danthu Chomchom ho"},"16":{"text":"Nakotpi hou sunga akilhen ding adeinapen na mun'a chu nalah uva nangma toh chengding ahin; ama nasuh genthei louhel ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Israel chanute lah-a noti, ahiloule Israel chapate lah-a Sodom mi umthei louhel ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:29."},"18":{"text":"Noti man le uicha man chu Pakai na Pathen in'a kitepna khattouva dinga nahin poh louding ahi. Ajehchu hiteni chu Pakai na Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi."},"19":{"text":"Nasopi henga apung dinga thilpa napeh louding; sum pung ahin, neh le chah-a apung ahin, chule ipi hijongle apung dinga kipe thil himhim napeh louding ahi.","ref":"Pot 22:25; Thmpu 25:36-37; Danb 15:7-11."},"20":{"text":"Namdang henga vang apung dingin thil napeh thei ahi; amavang nasopi henga apung dinga thil apa-a napeh louding ahi. Hitia chu nagoulo ding gama nakhut lhahna pou pouva Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei naboh theina ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Nangman Pakai na Pathen henga kitepna-a nakitep teng, pe dinga nangongkai louding ahi; ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in thonlouva nahenga angeh ding ahin; hichu nadinga chonset hiding ahi.","ref":"Minb 30:1-16; Matt 5:33."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla kitepna lama nakikangse-a ahile, hichu nanga dinga chonset hilouding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Nakama nakihahsel sa lungcham thilto ngei chu, Pakai na Pathen henga nakitep dungjuija, nakama kona potdoh sachu nanitna nabol ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Naheng nakom lengpi leija nahung tengle, lengpiga chu nagot channa navasetna nanehthei ahin; amavang nabella nakoi louding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Naheng nakom changkung ding lah-a nahung tengle, changvui chu nakhutna nakisi thei ahin; amavang naheng nakom chang dinglai chu koite-a na-at theilou ding ahi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasal khatnin ji akipuija akichenpia, amanu chunga thenlouna amujeh-a amitmua lunglhaina achan joulou tah-a ahile; amapan kidana lekha asutna, amanu khutna apeh-a, a-in'a kona asoldoh ding ahi.","title":"Kida Le Avela Kichenkit","ref":"Matt 5:31; 19:7; Mrk 10:4."},"2":{"text":"Chule amanu a-in'a kona apotdoh teng, che-a pasal chomkhat ji hithei ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule a-inneipu nunung joh chun ahotna, kidana lekha asutna, akhutna apeh-a, a-in'a kona asoldoh ham; ahiloule ajidinga amanu akipuija a-inneipu nunung chu athia ahile;"},"4":{"text":"Amanu ana soldoh-a a-inneipu masa chun, amanu kisuhboh nunga chu jidinga akipuikit thei lou ding ahi; ajehchu hichu Pakai anga dinga thet umtah ahi. Chule Pakai na Pathen'in lodinga napeh gamsunga chonset nalutsah louding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pasal khatnin ji anei tille galsatna konlouding, natoh khatpou pouva tong dinga jong goi hilouding ahi. Amavang in'a ongthol tah-a kumkhat uma, ajinu alunglhaisah ding ahi.","title":"Danthu Chomchom ho"},"6":{"text":"Koimachan sumhei song anoinung ahiloule achungnung thil mana kitungchu alah louhel ding ahi; ajehchu aman mihem hinkho chu thil mana alah ahi."},"7":{"text":"Mi khattouvin Israel chate asopiho aguh-a, akiveina anei ham, ahiloule ajoh ham akimudoh-a ahile; chuche gucha chu thiding ahin; chule thilse chu nalah uva kona nasuhmang ding ahi.","ref":"Pot 21:16."},"8":{"text":"Phah hise thudolla Levi thempuho jousen nahil dingu dungjuija pontho tah-a nitna dingin chingtheijun; keiman amaho kathupeh banga nangman boldinga nanit ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 13:1—14:54."},"9":{"text":"Egypt gama kona nanahung doh jou uva, lampi-a Pakai na Pathen'un Miriam abolna chu geldoh-un.","ref":"Minb 12:10"},"10":{"text":"Nasopi thil khattou apa-a napeh tengle, athil tun ladinga a-in sunga nalut louding ahi.","ref":"Pot 22:26-27."},"11":{"text":"Nangma inpoa nadinding, apa-a napeh mipa chun athiltun chu nahenga ahinchoidoh ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Amapa chu mivaicha ahile, athiltun chu najan gepi louding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chutia chu apon noija nomtah-a alupma, phatthei naboh theina dinga, nisa alhum tengle athiltun chu iti nama jongle ama napehkit ding ahi. Hichu Pakai na Pathen angsunga nachon phatna hiding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nangman soh kithalah avaicha le alhasam chu nasopi hihen lang, ahiloule nagam sunga nakotpi sunga um namaljin ho hijeng jongle, nasuh genthei louding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:13."},"15":{"text":"Atoh ni-a chu alo napehding, nisan alhumkhum louding ahi; ajehchu genthei ahin, hichea chu alung angah ahi; achuti loule nangma dounan Pakai henga peng tale, hichu nang dinga chonset hiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chate jala pate kithat louding, pate jala chate kithat louding ahi. Amitakip chu ama ama chonset jeh-a kithat ding ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 14:6; 2 Thusm 25:4; Ezek 18:20."},"17":{"text":"Nangman kholjin mi le paneiloute thu dihlouva natan louding, meithai ponsil jong thiltun mana nalah louhel ding ahi.","ref":"Pot 23:9; Thmpu 19:33,34; Danb 27:19."},"18":{"text":"Ahinla nangma Egypt gama sohchanga nana um ahin, Pakai na Pathen'in chua kona nalhatdoh ahi chu nageldoh ding ahi. Hijeh-a chu hichehi naboldinga kathupeh nahi."},"19":{"text":"Nangman nalouva chang na-atna, loulaija changphal nahaimil tengle, gala dinga nachekit louding ahi: hichu kholjin miho, paneilou ho, meithai ho-a ding ahi. Chutile Pakai na Pathen'in nakhut natoh jouse phatthei abohding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:9-10; 23:22."},"20":{"text":"Nangman na Olive thing navoh tengle, abahho chu naveiboh louding ahi: hichu kholjin mite, paneiloute chule meithai ho ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Nangman na lengpi leija aga nalokhom teng, akhai nahol louding ahi: hichu gamdang mite, paneiloute chule meithai ho ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule nangma Egypt gama sohchang nana hichu nageldoh ding ahi. Hijeh-a chu hiche boldinga hi kathupeh nahi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasal ho kahlah-a kinahna auma, thutan ho henga athu-u tansah dinga ahung tengule; amahon michonpha ho chu them achanuva, migilou chu themmo achan dingu ahi."},"2":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, migilou chu vohdinga lom ahile, thutanpa chun alupsah-a, ama angsung laitah-a ijatvei ham athemona dungjuija vohding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Aman somlivei avohding; avala avoh thei louding ahi; avalin vohen, hicheng kalval chun tamtah vei votaleh, nasopipa chu namit mu-a kijumso behseh ding ahi.","ref":"2 Cor 11:24"},"4":{"text":"Bongchal chang chilpet amuh nakan louding ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 9:9; 1 Tim 5:18."},"5":{"text":"Sopiho achenkhomuva, alah uva khat athia, cha aneilouva ahile, athipa jinu chu pama midangtoh kichenglou ding ahi. A-inneipu sopipan avetna, akichenpi ding, amanu chunga chu asopipa tohding kin chu atohding ahi.","title":"Sopipa Thi teng Tohding Kin","ref":"Matt 22:24; Mrk 12:19; Luk 20:28."},"6":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, amanun cha ahin masah pen chun Israelte lah-a amin manlouna dinga asopi thisapa munchu aloding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule mipa chun asopipa jichu akichenpi nomloule, asopipa jinu chu kotpi phunga upaho henga chea, ka-inneipu asopipa Israelte lah-a asopipa min tundoh ding anomhih-in, ka-inneipu sopipa kin abol nompoi agati ding ahi.","ref":"Ruth 4:7-8"},"8":{"text":"Chutengle khopi upahon amapa akou uva, akihoulimpi diu, chule ama ada teiteija, kakichenpi nompoi ati-a ahile,"},"9":{"text":"Asopipa jinu chu upaho angsunga amapa henga hungding, amapa kenga kona kengkoh chu asutna, amaija chil asetkhuma, Asopipa insung atungdoh nomloupa chu hitia hi bolding ahi, tia adonbutna aseiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule amapa minchu Israel lah-a, Akengkoh kisutpehpa insungmi kisah ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pasal ho kahlah-a kina auma, khatjopa jinu chun a-inneipu chu avopa khutna kona huhdoh dinga ahung naija, amanun akhut alhandoh-a, amapa chu ajanga amatna ahile,","title":"Dan Chomchom ho"},"12":{"text":"Amanu khut chu natanboh peh-a, amanu chu nakhoto louhel ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nadipma khaikot jatni, agihle ajang naneilou ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:35-36."},"14":{"text":"Na-insung jong thil tena jatni, alen le aneo naneilou ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai na Pathen'in napehna gamsunga nahinkho asotna dinga agih tena le asao tena chamkimle dihtah naneiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu chutobanga bol ho jouse le chonphat louna thil boljouse chu Pakai na Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt'a kona nahungdoh laijuva lamdunga Amalek ten nabolnao,","title":"Amalek Mite Thadinga Thupeh","ref":"Pot 17:8-14; 1 Sam 15:2-9."},"18":{"text":"Pathen jong ginglouva, nalhahsam le nachol laitah-a iti nakimaito pia, nanunga hung achatmo jouse, anu nungpen geija iti atha gam ham chu geldoh-in."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu hitiding ahi, Pakai na Pathen'in gouloa nanei dinga napehna gama chu, Pakai na Pathen'in nakimvela namelmate jouse-a kona nacholdosah tengle, vannoi'a kona Amalek kihetna chu nanoimang ding ahi. Hichehi nasuhmil louding ahi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, Pakai na Pathen'in goulo dinga napehna gam chu nahung lhuna, nalo-a, nachenlut tengle,","title":"Lholhun Thilto"},"2":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in napehna gama kona leiset ga jouse lah-a kona amasapen chu pocha sunga nakoija, Pakai na Pathen'in amin umsahna dinga adeilhen mun'a chu nahinchoi ding ahi.","ref":"Pot 23:19"},"3":{"text":"Chule chuche nikho-a thempu hidingpa henga chu nache-a, ajah-a, Eipeh dinguva ipu ipateu henga Pakaiyin anahahsel leimuna chun kahung lhuntai tia tunia hi Pakai na Pathen henga kaphondoh ahi, tia nagasei ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuteng thempu chun nakhutna kona pocha chu alah-a, Pakai na Pathen maicham masang tah-a chu aluiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen anga chu thu naseija, hitia hi nasei ding ahi, Mangthah dinga gotsa Syria mipa chu kapa ahin, Egypt ma anachesuh-in, milhomcha toh anapem lutnin, chuin chua chun nam lentah, thaneitah, chuleh tamtah ahung hidoh-in;"},"6":{"text":"Chuin Egypt miten eina bolseuvin, eibol gimun, sohna hahsatah kachunga akoijun;"},"7":{"text":"Chuin Pakai kapu kapateu Pathen henga chun kakapmun ahile, Pakaiyin kakounao aw ajan, kathohnatna houle kathoh gimnao, eikisuh genthei naochu aven;"},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Egypt'a konin khut thahat tahle ban lhang doh-in, tijat nasatah hole melchihna ho, chule thil kidangho pumin eihin puidoh taovin;"},"9":{"text":"Hiche mun'a hin eina puilutnun, hiche gam khoijule bongnoi lonna gam ngeihi eipe taovin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule tun, vetan, vo Pakai, nangman neipeh leiset ga masapen chu kahinchoi tai, nati ding ahi. Chule hichu nangin Pakai na Pathen masanga natuna, Pakai na Pathen chu nahou ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'in nangma le na-insungmi napeh thilpha takip chunga chu, nangma le nalah uva um Levi te, chule kholjin miho nakipa cheh dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hopsom peh kum, nalhosoh hopsom jouse napeh jou kum thumna, Levi ho, namdang miho paneilouho, meithaiho chun nakotpi hongsunga aneh uva, avatheina diuva napeh joutengle,","ref":"Danb 14:28-29."},"13":{"text":"Chuiteng nangman Pakai na Pathen henga, Ka-in'a konin thil thengho kahinpodoh-in, chujongle Levi ho, kholjin miho, paneilou ho, meithai ho jong nangman neipeh thupeh dungjuijin kanapen, nathupeh ho jouse kasukhel pon, sujong kasumil pon:"},"14":{"text":"Hia konchun kalunghem petnin kana nepon, hia konchun thil aboh tapouva mandingin jong kana lamangpon, chule hia konchun mithi ho dingin jong kana pepoi: amavang Pakai ka Pathen aw joh chu lunglutnin kana ngaijin, chule nangman neina thupeh jouse dungjuijin kaboltan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nachenna theng, van'a konin hin vesuh-in lang, nami Israelte le kapu kapateu henga khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam pehdia nanahahsella neina peh-u gamhi phatthei hinboh-in, natiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tunikho-a hi Pakai na Pathen'in hiche chon dan kisunho le thutan ho nabol dinga nathupeh ahi. Hijeh-a chu nangin hicheho chu nalung pumpile nahinna pumpi-a nanitna, najui ding ahi.","title":"Pakai Amatah Mite"},"17":{"text":"Tunia hi nangin Pakai chu na Pathen hidinga, alampiho-a chedinga, adan kisunho, athupeh hole, athutan naho nitna dingle, athu ngaidinga naphondoh ahitai."},"18":{"text":"Chule tunikho-a hi Pakaiyin nana thutepsa banga ama mite chombeh hidingle, athupeh jouse nitding,","ref":"Pot 19:5; Danb 4:20; 7:6; 14:2; Tit 2:14; 1 Pet 2:9"},"19":{"text":"Chule vahchoina, minthana le, jabolna-a asemsa nam jouse chungvuma choi-at dingle, aman aseisa banga Pakai na Pathen henga vaipi theng khat hidinga naphondoh ahitai."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israel upaho toh mipi chu thu apen, Tunia nangho kapeh thupeh jouse hi nit uvin.","title":"Song Chunga Kisun Pathen Danthu"},"2":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'in napeh gam Jordan gal nakai nitengleh hitiding ahi, song lentah ho naphu-a, hiho chu songlou nanu ding ahi.","ref":"Josh 8:30-32"},"3":{"text":"Chule napu napateu Pakai Pathen'in nathutep jouse banga, Pakai na Pathen'in napeh-u bongnoi le khoiju lonna gamchu nalut theina dinga, nagalkai tengle achung ho-a chu hiche danthu thucheng jouse hi nasut dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Jordan nagalkai joutengle hitiding ahi, tunia kathupeh hiche song hohi Ebal molsanga naphu-a, songlouva naloijol ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule chua chu Pakai na Pathen henga maicham, song maicham khat nasem ding; achunga chu thih manchah imacha nalap louhel ding ahi.","ref":"Pot 20:25"},"6":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen maicham chu khetlou songho-a kona nasem ding ahi. Hiche chunga chu Pakai na Pathen henga govam thilto nato ding;"},"7":{"text":"Chule chamna thilto nato-a, chua chu naneh ding, chule Pakai na Pathen anga nakipa ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule songho chunga chu hiche danthu jouse hi kichehtah-a nasut ding ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Mosi le Levi thempuhon Israel jouse lah-a aseijun, Vo Israel, chingthei jinlang ngaiphan; tunia hi Pakai na Pathen mite nahung hi ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Pakai na Pathen aw nangai ding, tunia nangma kathupeh thupeh ho le adan kisunho hi nabolding ahi, atiuve."},"11":{"text":"Chuin hiche nikho mama chun Mosi in mipi thu apen, hitin aseije,","title":"Thumanlou Chungchanga Gaosapna"},"12":{"text":"Jordan nagalkai tengule mipi ho phatthei bohdinga hiteho Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, chule Benjamin hi Gerizim molsang chunga dingden dingu ahi.","ref":"Danb 11:29; Josh 8:33-35"},"13":{"text":"Chule hiteho Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, chule Naphtali hi agaosap dinga Ebel molsang chunga ding dingu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule Levi hon thu aseijuva, Israel mite jouse henga aw sangtah-a asapmuva,"},"15":{"text":"Khutthemho khutna kisem, Pakai dinga thet umtah alim semthu ahiloule lhahtho ham anakoigu aumle gaosap changin umhen, atidiu; chule mipi jousen, Amen, atiuva adonbut dingu ahi.","ref":"Pot 20:4; 34:17; Thmpu 19:4; 26:1; Danb 4:15-18; 5:8."},"16":{"text":"Anu ahiloule apa jabol louva chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.","ref":"Pot 20:12; Danb 5:16."},"17":{"text":"Aheng akom gamgi chondohpa chu sapset changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.","ref":"Danb 19:14."},"18":{"text":"Mitcho lampia kona vaveisah-a chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:14."},"19":{"text":"Kholjin mi, paneilou, chule meithai thutana akaleh-a heidoh chanchu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.","ref":"Pot 22:21; 23:9; Thmpu 19:33-34; Danb 24:17-18."},"20":{"text":"Apa ji luppi-a chu gaosap changhen, ajehchu aman apa del ahopeh ahi, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:8; 20:11; Danb 22:30."},"21":{"text":"Gancha poupou jonpia chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.","ref":"Pot 22:19; Thmpu 18:23; 20:15."},"22":{"text":"Asopinu, apa chanu, ahiloule anu chanu luppi-a chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:9; 20:17."},"23":{"text":"A-inneipi nu luppi-a chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:17; 20:14."},"24":{"text":"Aheng akom guhthima philla chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Monabei mi thana dinga thilpeh la-a chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hiche danthu jouse boldinga sudet loupa chu gaosap changhen atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.","ref":"Gal 3:10."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, tunia nangma kathupeh jouse nitna dingle juina dinga Pakai na Pathen aw chu gen ngaitah-a nangaija ahile, Pakai na Pathen'in leiset chunga nam jouse vuma nachoisang ding ahi.","title":"Thuman Chungchanga Vangbohna (Thmpu 26:3-13 ; Danb 7:12-24)","ref":"Danb 11:13-17."},"2":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen aw nangaija ahile hiche phattheina jouse hi nachunga hung chua, nachuphel ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nangma khopi sunga phatthei nachan ding; nangma loujaova phatthei nachan ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nachilhah, naleiset ga, nagancha hon, nabongpi hon, chule nakelngoi hon ho phatthei changdiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Na palbom le nathil kholna jong phatthei changding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nahung vailhun teng phatthei nachan ding, navaikon doh teng jong le phatthei nachan ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma doudinga hungkon namelmate chu Pakaiyin namai koh-a athagam ding: nangma dou dinga lampi khatna hungdoh uva, namai koh-a lampi sagi-a jamcheh diu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pakai chun nathil kholna in le nakhut natoh jouse chunga phattheina chu thu apeh ding; Pakai na Pathen'in napeh gamsunga chu aman phatthei nabohding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nangman Pakai na Pathen thupeh ho nanitna, alampiho-a nache-a ahile, aman nahahsel na banga Pakaiyin ama ding tuma namtheng khatna natundoh ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule leiset mite jousen Pakai mina nakikou chu amuva, nangma nakichat dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin napu napate henga nangma pehdinga anahahselna gama chu, Pakaiyin thil le lo, nachilhah, nagancha, naleiset ga-a nanen jengjung sah ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Pakaiyin nangma dinga nagamsunga aphatcha gotwi peding le, nakhutna nanatoh jouse phattheiboh dinga, agou kholna phatah vanchu nahonpeh ding; nangman nam tamtah henga thil apan homin natin, nangin thil apa-a nalah louding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tunia kathupeh Pakai na Pathen thupeh hohi nitding le juidinga nangaija ahile, Pakaiyin amei hilouva alua nakoija, chule anoinung hilouva achunga bou nakoiding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule tunia kathupeh thuho-a kona pathen dangho jenna dinga anungu juina-a jetlam ahiloule veilama nakihei louhel ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Amavang hung hitiding ahi, tunia kathupeh athupeh jouse le, achonna dan kisunho jouse juidinga Pakai na Pathen aw chu nangailouva ahile; hiche gaosapna jouse hi nachunga hungchua, nachup helding ahi.","title":"Thumanlou Jeh-a Thilsoh (Thmpu 26:14-46)"},"16":{"text":"Khopi sunga gaosapna nachan ding, chule loujaova jong gaosapna nachan ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Na palbom le nathil kholna jong gaosap changding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Nachilhah, naleiset ga, nabongpi hon, nakelngoi honho jong gaosap changding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Nahung vailhun tengle sapset nachana, navai kondohteng jongle sapset nachan ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Nathilbol gitlouna-a kona neidalhah jeh-a nangma nakisuh manga namanthah hel loi kahse-a Pakaiyin na natohna chunga, nakhut lhahna jouse-a, gaosapna, suhnohna, housetna jouse ahinchuhsah ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Galo dinga nachena gama kona aman nasuhmang hel kahse-a, Pakaiyin nachunga natset alenden sah ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Pakaiyin hihet, khosih, tipom chetchut, tisat val, chemjam, huise, chule motna-a najepma, namanthah hel kahse-a hicheng hin najuiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Naluvuma um van chu sum-eng soh-a, nanoija leiset chu thih hungsoh ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Pakaiyin nagama gotwi chu leivui le vutvai aso-a, namanthah hel kahse-a nachunga van'a kona hung julha ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Namelmate masanga Pakaiyin gal nalelsah ding; amaho sat dinga lampi khatna nakon doh-a, amasanguva lampi sagi-a najam ding ahi. Chule leiset lenggam jouse-a nakichonle ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule nalong chu chungleng vacha jouse le leiset gamsa dinga anneh hiding, chule koimachan anomang loudiu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Pakaiyin Egypt gam uilutna, thilona, tinakhih neija, tithah na-a najep natna, chuho-a kona chu nadamdoh louhel ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Pakaiyin ngolna-a, mitchot na-a, lungkidanna-a najepding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Muthim noija mitcho akimai banga sunchang noija nakimai ding, nalampi-a nalolhin louding: a-itih-a bolgenthei le chom mangbou nahi-a, koimachan nahuhhing louding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Nangin jihol neijin natin, midangin amanu aluppi ding: nangin in kisah-in natin, nangla chua nachen louding: nangin lengpilei kibolin natin, chua kona lengpiga nalo louding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Namitmu na-angsung laitah-a nabongchal kithat ding, hichu nanehlou ding: namaikoh tah-a kona nasangan pumhatna kikai mang ding, nakilepeh louding: nakelngoi chu namelmate kipe ding, ahuhdoh ding koimacha naneilou ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Nachapate le nachanute midangho kipe ding, namitna navetna, nilhumkeija amaho lhangai na-a natha beiding: nakhutna hatna himhim umlou ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Naleiset ga le natoh gim ga jouse chu nahet khahlou nam khatnin anehchai ding; nangma suhgenthei le noigep vou nahiding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chutia chu namitnin avet nathilmu ho jala chu nangolding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Pakaiyin suhdam theilou uilut khohtah-a nakhup teni le kengteni, nakengto-a pat nalujang gei anatsah ding ahi."},"36":{"text":"Pakaiyin nangma le nachunga atunding nalengpa chu nangma le napu napateu jong anahet khahlou beh namkhat henga napuilut dingu ahin; chuachu thih le song pathen dangho bou nagajen dingu ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin napuina ding namtin lah-a chu nangma datmo umtah, paochamtuh, chule seichah bep nahungso ding ahi."},"38":{"text":"Nangman muchi tamtah loujaova napohlut ding, amavang themcha bou nalokhum ding ahi; ajehchu khaokhopin anehchai ding ahi."},"39":{"text":"Nangman lengpilei nabola, nalho ngim ding, amavang alengpitwi chu nadonlou ding, chule lengpiga jong nalo khom louding ahi; ajehchu lungin anehdiu ahi."},"40":{"text":"Nangman nagamsung jouse-a Olive thing nanei ding, amavang athao chu nakinu louding ahi; ajehchu na Olive chu aga pulgam ding ahi."},"41":{"text":"Nangman chapate le chanute hingin tin, ahinla nanopsahna hilouding ahi; ajehchu gal hinga chegamdiu ahi."},"42":{"text":"Nagamsunga thingphung jousele aga jouse chu khaokhon anehgamhel ding ahi."},"43":{"text":"Nalah-a um namdang mi chu nang vuma hatah-a hung kichoisang ding; nangma hatah-a nanemsuh ding ahi."},"44":{"text":"Aman nangma apa-a napeh ding, nangman vang ama apa-a napeh louding: ama aluchangin pangintin, nangma ameija nahung panding ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chukal vala jong Aman nathupeh athupeh ho le adan kisunho nitna dinga Pakai na Pathen aw nangailou jeh-a, namanthah hel kahse-a hiche gaosap nahohi nachunga hungchua, nanung ajuija, nachup mangding ahi."},"46":{"text":"Chule hicheho chu nangma le nachilhahte chunga a-itih-a dinga melchihna le thil kidanga umding ahi."},"47":{"text":"Thiljouse anen jeh-a Pakai na Pathen chu lungsung thanom tah le kipah tah-a najenlou jeh-a;"},"48":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin nangma doudinga ahinsol ding namelmate chu gilkel le dangchah-a, sagohkeu le ijakai lhasama najending: aman nangma nasuhmang hel kahse-a nangonga thih namkoljon napohsah ding ahi."},"49":{"text":"Pakaiyin nangma doudinga gamlatah-a kon,leiset kolmanga kon namkhat, mulaopi banga gangjet; apaovu jong nahetlouhel nam khat ahinpui ding ahi."},"50":{"text":"Kichat umtah melpu, tehse ja-ngaina neilouhel, chapang jong lungset chomlou nam;"},"51":{"text":"Chule amachun namanhel kahse-a nagancha hon le nagamga aneh ding: aman nasuhmang hel kahse-a chang, lengpithei, thao, nabongnou, ahiloule nakelngoi hon ho-a kona apungdoh hojong nakhenpeh louhel ding ahi."},"52":{"text":"Natahsan nangapna nagamsung pumpi-a kulpi kikai khum sangtah ho chu achimlhahsoh kahse-a, aman nakotpi jouse-a na-umkul ding: Pakai na Pathen'in napeh gamsung pumpi nakul kotpiho jouse na-umkul khumdiu ahi."},"53":{"text":"Namelmate bol hesohna-a naki-um kul le nakineh chintona-a chu, Pakai na Pathen'in napeh nangmatah chilhah, nachapate le nachanute sa chu nanehding:"},"54":{"text":"Chutia chu nalah-a um lungnem le hongphal pa jongchun asopipa le a-angkoi ajinu, chule achate lah-a, ahinghoi ding amohpen jeng jong chu amuset ding:"},"55":{"text":"Chutia chu amaho khatcha jong anehding achate sa chu apehlou ding ahi: ajehchu nakotpi phung jouse-a namelma ten umkulna le nehchep na-a nasuhgenthei ding jeh-a imacha akikhenlou ahitai."},"56":{"text":"Nalah uva um numei lungnemle lungneng pen, alung nemle alungnet behseh jeh-a akengkho taljum jong tolla chuhsah nomlou numei jong chun a-angkoi ajipa le achapa chule achanu chu amuset ding,"},"57":{"text":"Chule akengteni kah-a hung pengdoh-a chasen le ahin hinding achate jong, amuset ding ahi: ajehchu umkulna le gotchep na-a namelma ten nakotpi phung jouseuva nasuh genthei jeh uva, ijakai lhahsap jeh-a amanun amaho chu guhthima anehgam ding ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 6:28-29; Kala 4:10"},"58":{"text":"PAKAI NA PATHEN kiti min loupitah le tijat umtah hi nagin theina dinga hiche lekhabu sunga kisun danthuho jouse chingthei tah-a najui louva ahile;"},"59":{"text":"Pakaiyin nangma hise le nachilhahte hise chu hise kidangtah, hise nasatah, sottah umding hise, natna khohtahden, sottah umjom jingding asosah ding ahi."},"60":{"text":"Chukalvala jong nangman nagin Egypt gama hise jouse chu, nachung uva alensah ding; hicheho chun nakolchah ding ahi."},"61":{"text":"Chule hiche danthu lekhabu sunga kisun lou natna tincheng le hise tincheng ho jong chu Pakaiyin namanthah hel kahse-a nachunga ahinlhut ding ahi."},"62":{"text":"Chule natam jeh-un van'a ahsi jat ana hijongleu chun, lhomcha bou kikhen ding nahiuve; ajehchu Pakai na Pathen aw nangaipon ahi."},"63":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, naphatna bolding le nangma suhpung ding chu Pakai kipana ahi banga; chutia chu nangma suhmang dingle manlou soding chu Pakai kipah hiding ahitai; chule galo dinga nachena gama kona chu nakibotdoh dingu ahi."},"64":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin mijouse lah, leiset kolmong langkhatna pat langkhat geija nathe cheh uva; chua chu nangma nahi-a napu napate ahiuva jong anahet ngailou thing le song pathen ngeichu najending ahi."},"65":{"text":"Chule hiche namho lah-a chu choldona namu louding, nakengto jengin jong olna amulou ding: Pakaiyin lungsung linglaona, mit setna, chule lungkhamna napeh johding ahi."},"66":{"text":"Chule namalam hinkho chu lung opkaina hiding, sunle jana nakichat na, nahinkho dinga dettah-a ngamna nanei louding ahi."},"67":{"text":"Kichatna nalunga nagel ding jeh le namitna namu ding thilmujeh-a, jingkah teng, Pathen'in nilhah hisah taveleh! nati-a, nilhah teng, Pathen'in jingkah hisah taveleh! natiding ahi."},"68":{"text":"Chule hichehi namukit louding ahitai tia kaseina lampia chu Pakaiyin Egypt gama kong inneija nale puilut kitding: chua chu namelma te henga sohpa le sohnu-a vuldinga nakijoh diu ahin, koimachan nakichoh loudiu ahi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hichehohi Horeb'a amahotoh kitepna asem tilouva, Moab gama Israel chate toh neidinga Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh kitepna thuchengho chu ahi.","title":"Moab Gamsunga Pakai Le Israel Kitepna"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israelte jouse akouvin, ajah uva, Nanghon Egypt gama Pharaoh chung, asohte jouse chung, chule agampumpi chunga Pakai thilbol jouse chu namitmu tah uva namu taovin;"},"3":{"text":"Patepna nasatah ho, melchihna ho, chule thilkidang nasatah ho chu namit uva namutaovin:"},"4":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin Pakaiyin hetchetna lungthim, muchetna mit, chule jahchetna nakhang tunigeijin napehih laijuve."},"5":{"text":"Chule keiman gamthipma kum somli kana lamkaijun: nachung uva naponsilu achulpon, nakenguva nakengkoh-u jong aluipon ahi."},"6":{"text":"Keima hi Pakai na Pathen'u kahi nahet theina diuvin, nanghon changlhah nane pouvin, lengpitwi le khamna thei jong nanadon pouve."},"7":{"text":"Chuin hiche mun'a nahunglhun phatnun, Heshbon lengpa Shihon le Bashan lengpa Og chu eiho satdin ahung kondoh lhonin, eihon ina joutaove.","ref":"Minb 21:21-35"},"8":{"text":"Chule agamhou ilaovin, Reuben mite, Gad mite, chule Manasseh phung kehkhat goulodin ipetaove.","ref":"Minb 32:33"},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun nabol jouseuva nakhantou theina diuvin, hiche kitepna thuho hi nitnun lang juijun."},"10":{"text":"Tunin nabonchaovin, naphung lamkai hou, na-upahou, napipu hou, chule Israel mite jouse toh Pakai na Pathen'u anga nading sohkeijun,"},"11":{"text":"Nacha senteu, na-inneipi teu, napon in sunguva um nakhopem hou, na thing tuh houva pat twikhai ho geijin:"},"12":{"text":"Tunia Pakai na Pathen'un nangho toh asem, Pakai na Pathen to akitepna le akihahselna sunga nalut theina dingun;"},"13":{"text":"Aman nahenga aseibanga le, napu napateu Abraham, Isaac, Jacob henga anakihahsel banga, Tunikho-a hi aman nangho ama mite hidinga natundoh theina dingu le, ama nangho Pathen ahitheina ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hiche kitepnale kihahselna hi nangma changseh toh kasem ahipon,"},"15":{"text":"Tunia Pakai i-Pathen'u anga ilah uva hikoma umpa, chule tunia hikoma ilah uva umloupa to jong ahi:"},"16":{"text":"(Ajehchu Egypt gama iti ina chen uva, chule ihin jotpao nampiho iti ihin palpao ham naheuvin,"},"17":{"text":"Chule alah uva um athet umtah hou, amilimhou, thing le song, dangka le sana hochu namuvin ahi.)"},"18":{"text":"Ijemtia nalah uva pasal ham, numei ham, insungham, inkoham, phungham, Pakai i-Pathen'uva kona, hiche nam mite pathenho gajen dinga alunghei manga ummaithei ahin; achuti loule nalah uva thingkha le hampa kha jungnei hung umdoh getninte;","ref":"Heb 12:15"},"19":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, hitobang michun hiche gaosapna thuho hi ajah tengle, Dangchah chu khamna-a akibelap bangin, kalung ngaito dandanin umjong leng chamna neinange, tin alungsunga ama le ama phatthei kiboh henlang hileh,"},"20":{"text":"Pakaiyin amachu akhen louhel ding, ahinla Pakai lungsatna le athang thipna chu amapa chunga chu meikhu-a kitungdoh-a, hiche lekhabua kisun gaosapna ho jousehi achunga chuding, chule Pakaiyin aminchu vannoi'a kona hi anoimang ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin amachu hiche dan lekhabu sunga kisun kitepna chunga gaosapna ho jouse dungjuija, Israel phung jouse-a kona hamsetna chang dinga akhendoh ding:"},"22":{"text":"Chutia chu nanunga hung pengdoh ding nachate khang hunglhung dingho le, gamlatah-a kona hung ding namdang mi hon Pakaiyin achunga achuhsah chuche gamna hise le natna ho chu amutengule;"},"23":{"text":"Chuche gam pumpi chu kath, chi, meikah, ima kitu lou, ima galou, asunga hampa jong kehlou, Pakaiyin alungsatna le alunghana asumangsa Sodom le Gomorrah, Admah le Zeboiim tobang ahi atidiu:","ref":"Semt 19:24-25"},"24":{"text":"Chule namtinho jouse jengin jong, Ipibola Pakaiyin hiche gamhi ahitibol hintem? hiche lunghanna nasatah hi ipi tina ahidem? atidiu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chutengle mihon, Egypt gama kona amaho ahinpuidoh laijuva amaho toh anasem, apu apateu Pakai Pathen kitepna chu adalhah jeh-u ahi;"},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu Aman amaho henga apeh hilouho pathen dangho, ahetkhah louvu pathen ho henga acheuvin agajenun, ahou jeh uva;"},"27":{"text":"Hiche lekhabu sunga kisun gaosapna jouse pohlut khum dinga Pakai lunghanna chu hiche gam chunga koujah-a ahitai;"},"28":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin amaho chu lungsatna, lunghanna, chule lungphatmona nasatah, tunikho banga hi, agamma kona ajung aja-a abodoh-a mi gamdanga aselut ahitai, atidiu ahi."},"29":{"text":"Thil kiselho chu Pakai i-Pathen uva ahin: ahin akiphongdoh saho chu hiche danthua thuho jouse hi ijuitheina diuva a-itih-a dinga eihole ichateuva ding ahi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, namasanga kakoi hiche phattheina le gaosapnaho jouse hi nachunga ahung lhuna, Pakai na Pathen'in nadel lutna namho jouse lah-a kona chu nahin geldoh-a,","title":"Semthahna Le Phattheiboh Chandingdan"},"2":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen henga nahung kile-a, nangma le nachaten nalung pumpiu le nahinna pumpiuva tunia nangma thu kapeh jouse dungjuija hi a-aw nangai uva ahile;"},"3":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in gal hinga nakikaina chu aleheija, nachunga lainatna aneija, chule hung kileheija Pakai na Pathen'in nathe chehna namho jouse lah-a kona nachopkhom kitding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Na mi khattou chu van mong geija ana kinodoh-a ahijongle, chua kona Pakai na Pathen'in nalonkhoma, chua kona nahin puidoh ding ahi;"},"5":{"text":"Chule Pakai Pathen'in napu napateu vin alonao gamsunga chu nahin puilutna, nangman hichu naloding; Aman nabol phatna, napu napateu chungvuma napunsah ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'in nahin theina ding, nalungthim pumpile nahinna pumpi-a Pakai na Pathen nangailutna dinga, nalungsung le nachilhahte lungsung chep atan ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'in hiche gaosapna jousehi namelmate le nahotbol te, chule nabolsete chunga akoiding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule nangma nahung kile-a Pakai aw chu nangaiding, tunia nangma kathupeh ama thupeh jouse hi nabolding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'in nakhutna athilbol jouse, nachilhahte, nagancha ho, chule nagamga aphatna dinga hatah-a asuhpung ding ahi: ajehchu Pakai chu napu napateu chunga athanop banga, naphatna dinga nangma chunga thanom kitding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hiche dan lekhabu sunga kisun athupeh hole adan kisunho nitna dinga Pakai na Pathen thu nangaija; chule Pakai na Pathen henglama nalungthim pumpile nahinna pumpi-a nakihei ja ahile chuti ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu tunia nang kathupeh hiche thupeh hi nanga kona kisel ahipon, chule gamlapi-a umjong ahipoi."},"12":{"text":"Ijah uva, ibol theina diuva, eiho dinga van'a koi gakal touva, eiho henga ahin pohlhah ding ham? natina diuva hichu van'a uma ahipoi.","ref":"Rom 10:6-8"},"13":{"text":"Ijah uva, ibol theina diuva, eiho dinga twikhanglen galla koi gachea, ihenguva ahinpoh galkai ding ham? natina diuva hichu twikhanglen galla um jong ahipoi."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla thuchu nanit theina dinga, nakom naicha, nakam sungle nalungsung um ahibouve."},"15":{"text":"Ven, tuni hin namasanga hinna le thilpha, thina le thilse kakoipeh-e."},"16":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen chu nangailut nading, alampiho juina ding, athupeh hole achondan ho chule athutan ho nitna dinga tunia kathupeh hohi nanitna ahile nahina, napuntheina ding: chule lodinga nachenna gama chu Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei nabohding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Amavang najahlouna dinga nalungthim akihei manga, puimanga naum joh-a, pathen dang nahouva, najena ahile,"},"18":{"text":"Namanthah teidiu ahi tia tunia hi kaphondoh ahi; galo dinga Jordan nagalkaina gama chu nahinsot louheldiu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Namasanguva hinna le thina, phattheina le gaosapna kakoije ti nangho douna-a ahetoh dinga tunia hi van le lei kakou ahi; hijeh chun nangma le nachilhahte nahinthei dingu hinna kilhenun:"},"20":{"text":"Chutia chu Pakai na Pathen nangailutna, a-aw nangaija, chule ama nakolchah theinadin: ajehchu ama nahinna ahin, nahinkho sotna ahi: chutia chu Pakaiyin napu napa te Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob peh dinga ahahselna gama chu nachen theiding ahi.","ref":"Semt 12:7; 26:3; 28:13"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Mosi achen, Israel miho jouse henga chun hiche thuho hi aseije,","title":"Joshua'in Mosi Akhel"},"2":{"text":"Chuin ajah uva, Tuni hin keima kum jankhat le kum somni kalhingtan; kalut le kapot le joutapon ahi: chujongle Pakaiyin jong kajah-a, Nangma hiche Jordan hi nagalkai louding ahi, eiti."},"3":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'u chu namasanguva lamkaijin tin, aman hiche namhohi namasanguva kona asumang ding, chule nanghon amaho gamchu nalo dingu ahi. Chule Pakaiyin ana seibanga, Joshua'in nalamkai dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin amaho chu Amor miho lengteni Sihon le Og abol banga abolding, chule aman asuhmang gamho banga abolding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule keiman nangho thu kapeh-u thupeh ho jouse dungjuija ahenguva nabol theina dinguva, Pakaiyin amaho chu namaikoh uva napehdoh dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hatnunlang hanguvin, kicha hih-un, amaho khu ging jong ging hih-un: ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u, nangho nalhonpia chu ama ahi; Aman nalosam sah loudingu, dajong nadalhah louheldiu ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Joshua akouvin, Israelte jouse mitmu-a chun ajah-a, hatninlang hangin; ajehchu nangma Pakaiyin apu apateu pehdinga anahahsel gama chu hiche mipite hitoh nalhona, nangman amahohi nalosah teiding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule namasanga chea amachu Pakai ahi, aman aumpi ding, aman nalosamsah louding, dajong nadalhah louding ahi.","ref":"Josh 1:5; Heb 13:5"},"9":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n hiche danhi asunin, Pakai kitepna thingkhong poleji Levi chapate thempuho le, Israel upaho jouse henga apen ahi.","title":"Danthu Kum Sagi Sehle Simding"},"10":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n amaho thu apen, ajah uva, Kum sagi kichaiseh, kilhadohna kum le lhambuh kut laile,","ref":"Danb 15:1; 16:13-15"},"11":{"text":"Ama deilhen nading mun'a Israel chate jouse Pakai na Pathen anga kilah dinga ahung tengule, hiche danthu hi Israelte jouse masanga ajahdiuva nasimpoh ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Amahon ajah uva, ahetnuva, Pakai na Pathen'u chu aginuva, hiche danthu-a um thu jouse hi anitna dingun, mijouse, numei ahin, pasal ahin, chapang ahin, nakotpi sunga um gamdang mi ahin khomkhom soh keijin:"},"13":{"text":"Chule imacha heloulai nachateo chun lodinga nachenao Jordan gal gamsunga chu nachen laiseuva Pakai na Pathen ginje ahettheina diuva ajahdiu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Ven, nathi nading nikho ahung naitai; mopohna kapehthei nadin Joshua chu kouvin lang houkhom na pon in sunga hung kilah lhonin ati. Chuin Mosi le Joshua ache lhonin, houkhom ho ponbuh sunga agakilah lhontai.","title":"Pakaiyin Mosi Henga Athuhil Nunungpen"},"15":{"text":"Chuin Pakai chu houbuh sunga meibang khomin ahungkilah-in: meibang khompi chu houbuh kotchung tah-a chun adingden tai."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Vetan, nangma napu napate toh nalupkhom ding ahitan; hiche mipihohi kipat uva, aga umnadingu mite lah-a gamdang mite pathenho nung ajuijuva noti'a gapangdiu, chule keima eidalhah uva, amahotoh kanabol kitepna chu apalkehdiu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuteng hiche nikho chule achunguva kalungsatna deujah ding, amaho kadalhah-a, amaho-a kona kamai kasel ding, amaho bahgama umdiu, thilse tamtah le hesohnahon alhun khumdiu; chutia chu hiche nikho chule, I-Pathen'u ilah uva aumloujeh-a thilse hohi ichunguva hunglhung hilouham? atidiu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Pathen dangho lama akihei nalam uva thilse jouse ahin boldiu ho jeh-a chu, hiche nikho chule kamai kaseltei ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun hiche la hi nangma dingin kisut in lang, Israel chate hilin; hiche la hi Israel chate chunga keima dinga hettohsahna dingin akam sunguva khumpeh-in."},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu apu apateu kahahselna, bongnoi le khoiju lona gama amaho kapuilut teng, amahon aneh uva, vaset uva, chule hungthao diu; chutengle pathen dangho lama kiheijuva, hiho chu ajendiu, keima eilunghan sah uva, kathupeh apalkehdiu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, thilse tamtah le lungkhamna tamtah-in aphah tengule, achunguva hettohsah khat banga hiche la hin ahettohsah ding ahi; ajehchu achilhahteu kama kona hiche la hi suhmila umlou ding ahi: ajehchu tujeng jonghin kahahselna gama kapuilut masanga achele nadinguva alung ngaitohou chu kahen ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hijeh chun Mosi'n hiche la hi hiche ni mama chun asunin, Israel chate chu ahiltai."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Aman Nun chapa Joshua chu mopohna apen, ajah-a, Hatninlang hangin, ajeh chu nangman Israel chate chu amaho kahahselna gama chu napuilut ding ahi; keiman nangma ka umpi ding nahi, ati.","ref":"Minb 27:23; Josh 1:6."},"24":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Mosi'n hiche danthu hohi lekhabu khatna asutchaija, jo ahi phatnin,"},"25":{"text":"Mosi'n Pakai kitepna thingkhong pu-a pang Levi ho chu thu apen, hitin aseije,"},"26":{"text":"Hiche danthu lekhabu hi laovinlang, nachung uva hettohsah dingin Pakai na Pathen'u kitepna thingkhong koma chun koijun."},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu nakiphin hat danule nalouchal danu kahei: veuvin, tunikho-a nang hotoh kahin khomlai petna bon Pakai douna-a nakiphin uva ahile; kathinung teng ijat nabolbe tadiuvem?"},"28":{"text":"Hiche thuho hi anakhang uva kaseija, ahetoh dinga vanle lei kakou theina dingin, naphung houva upaho le nalamkai hou jouse kahenga hinkhomun."},"29":{"text":"Ajehchu kathi nungle nangho le nangho nasatah-a nakisuhset nuva, nangho kathupeh-u lampia kona nakihei mangdiu; chule ninunung lamle thilphalouvin nalhah khumdiu ahi; ajehchu nakhut soh-u thilbola kona suh lunghangna dinga Pakai mitmu-a thilphalou nabol dingu ahi ti kahei, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Israel houkhom ho jouse nakhanga chun hiche lacheng hi akichai kahsen asei pehtan ahi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo vanho, nana hinsungun, keiman thu seijinge; chule vo leiset, kakama thupot ho ngaijin.","title":"Mosi La"},"2":{"text":"Kathuhil hi gotwi bangin juntin, kathusei daitwi bangin chimintin, hamnel chunga gophin bangle, hampa chunga gohongju banginte."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai min kaphongdoh ahi: Nanghon Pathen loupina seichoi leuvin."},"4":{"text":"Ama songpi ahin, anatoh ho achamkime; ajehchu alamlhah jouse thudih ahi: khansetna beihel le thutah Pathen, chondih le chonpha chu ama ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ama hole amaho akisuboh-un, amonao chu achate mona ahipoi: amaho khanglamvai le lungput janglou khang ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Vo mingol le mitanangte, chutia chu Pakai nalethuh diuham? Ama nachodoh pao napao hilouham? Ama nasem paole natungdoh pao hilouham?"},"7":{"text":"Gollui lai geldoh inlang, khang tamtah-a kumho chu ngaito temin; napa dongle chun navetsah ding ahin, na upate dongle chun naseipeh taovinte."},"8":{"text":"Hatchung nungin namho agoulo diu ahoppeh lai, aman Adam chapate asekhen laichun, Israel chate ajatnu dungjuijin mipite gamgi chu anasepeh-e.","ref":"Sol 17:26."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai chanvou chu amite ahin, Jacob hi agouchan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aman amachu neldi gam, agohkeo gamthip ginghou hou lah-a amu ahi; Aman ahinpuidoh-a, ahila, ama mitchang banga avettup ahi."},"11":{"text":"Mulaopi in abuh aphetlhah-a, anou chunga akijapma, alha ajahkhuma, amat ji-a, alha chunga apoh banga;"},"12":{"text":"Chutia chu Pakai bouvin ama apuile-a, gamdang pathen toh umkhom lou ahi."},"13":{"text":"Louvin asepdoh ga aneh theina dingin leiset mun sangho chunga atousah-in; songpi-a konin khoiju achepdoh sah-in, meituh songa konin thaotwi aputdoh sah-in;"},"14":{"text":"Bongnoiha le kelngoi noi, kelngoinou thaotah, chule Bashan kelngoi chalho, le kelho, suhlou chang phapen tah; chule lengpitwi thisan thengtah ju in nadonin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahin Jeshurun athao behsettan, akeng apeh pehtai; nathaovin, nasalha jengin, thaovin natome; chuin asempa Pathen adalhan, alhatdamna songpi chu totnopnan aneitai."},"16":{"text":"Amahon namchom pathenho jeh-in athangthip sah-un; thet umtah ho-a konin alunghan sah-un ahi."},"17":{"text":"Amahon Pathen kom hilouvin thilha ho, ahetkhah louvu pathenho, napu napateu vin anagin louva athah beh-a hungpot pathen thah ho henga ganlhai abolun ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 10:20."},"18":{"text":"Nahinga Songpi chu iman nagelpon, nahin semdoh-a Pathen chu nasumil tai."},"19":{"text":"Pakaiyin hichu amuphatnin, Achapate le achanuteu suhlunghan sahna jeh chun amaho chu akidahtai."},"20":{"text":"Chuin aman, amahoa kona kamai kaselding, akichainao ipi soh mongam kavet ding ahi: Ajehchu amaho khang lamvai mite ahiuvin, tahsanna umlou chate ahiuve."},"21":{"text":"Amahon Pathen hilouho-a eithangthip sah-un; apannabei houva eichou lunghangun; kenjong nam hilouho-a kona athangthip nadiuva kachouthou uva, nam ngoltah-a kona kachou lunghang dingu ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 10:22; Rom 10:19."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu kalunghana-a mei akongdoh-in, thikholkhul geija akahlhah ding, hichun leiset le asunng keh jouse akah lhah-a, molsang bulho jouse meijin akahding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Achunguva setna kaset thopma, achunguva kathal chang ho kamanchah ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Amaho gilkelin akah uva, meika nasatah le suhgamna nasatah-in aval lhum diu ahi: leivui lah-a kitol gulgu toh kilhona achunguva gamsaho ha hemtah kasolpeh ding ahi"},"25":{"text":"Polama chemjamin, sunglama tijatna-in, gollhang le nungah theng, noicheplai le samkangsa jong asuhmang ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Aning ninga kathecheh-a, mihem lah-a kona hetjinga aumnao kichaina kabolding ahi, kati;"},"27":{"text":"Akidoupi houvin agelkhel uva, Kakhutnu hi choisangin aumin, hiche ho jouse hi Pakaiyin abol ahipoi, tia aseiuva melma lunghanna chu kaginlou hile."},"28":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho thumopbei nam ahiuvin, chule amaho-a hetkhena himhim aumpon ahi."},"29":{"text":"O, hichehi ahetkhen na dinguva ching hitaveleu, khonunga akichaina dingu angaito dingu hija!"},"30":{"text":"A songpiuvin amaho akijohdoh-a, Pakaiyin amaho akhakhum ahilou ngale; mikhatnin sangkhat iti adela, minin sangsom iti adeljam ding ham?"},"31":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho songpi chu eiho Songpi tobang ahipon, imelmateu amaho le amaho jengjong thutan ho ahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Ajehchu alengpi guiju chu Sodom lengpigui le Gomorrah loujaova kon ahi: alengpi ga houchu gilkha lengpiga ahin, aga bohho chu akhan ahi."},"33":{"text":"Alengpitwi houchu dragon gu le gulgu phaloutah ahi."},"34":{"text":"Hichehi kakoma kikhol hilou hija, kagou ho lah-a kikha khum hilou ham?"},"35":{"text":"Phulahna le lethuhna chu keima-a ahin; aphat tahle akengto-u kithol ding ahi: ajehchu amanthah nao nikho anaitan, achunguva hunglhung ding thilho chu gangtah-a hunglhung ding ahi.","ref":"Rom 12:19; Heb 10:30."},"36":{"text":"Ajehchu athahatnao abeisoh-a, akikhu khumle akidalha abeihel tengule; Pakaiyin amite thu tan intin, asohte-a dinga alung aheiding ahi.","ref":"Labu 135:14."},"37":{"text":"Chule aman hitia aseiding ahi, A-pathenhou, atahsanu angapnao asongpiu chu hoiba hitam?"},"38":{"text":"Aganlhainao sathao ne-a, adon thilto lengpitwi donho chu? amaho chu hung thoudoh uhenlang nakithopiu hen, chule nahongbit nun pangu hen."},"39":{"text":"Tun veuvin, kei, keimamong monghi Ama chu kahi, Keima toh pathen hikhom adang aumpoi: Keiman kathatjin, chule kahinsah jin; Keiman kamavojin, chule kadamsah kitjin ahi: kakhutna kona huhdoh jouding koimacha aumpoi."},"40":{"text":"Ajehchu Keiman van lama kakhut kadom sangin, tonsotna kahing jinge katin ahi."},"41":{"text":"Kachemjam duljeju chu kanola, kakhutnin thutanna atuh-a ahile; kamelmate chunga phu kalah ding, eihot bolte kalethuh ding ahi."},"42":{"text":"Akithatho le sohchangho thisan le, melmate lamkaiho luchanga kon, Ka thalchang ho thisan kadonkham sah-a, kachemjamin saphe avalhum ding ahi."},"43":{"text":"Vo namtinho, hiche amitetoh hin kipah-un: ajehchu aman asohte thisan phu alah-a, akidoupi ho chunga phu alah ding, chule agam le amite chunga hepina anei ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Rom 15:10; Tph 19:2."},"44":{"text":"Chuin Mosi amatah chu Nun chapa Hoshea toh ahungin, hiche la thu jouse chu mipi ho nabenga aseijin ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n hiche thuho jouse hi Israel pumpi jah-a asei aseichaijin,","title":"Mosi Thuhil Nunungpen"},"46":{"text":"Chuin amaho jah-a, Tunia nalah uva kaphondoh thu jouse-a hin nalungu koijun lang, hiche danthu jouse hi chingthei tah-a ajuidiuva nachateo nathupeh dingu ahi."},"47":{"text":"Hichehi nangho-a dinga mohthil ahipoi; ajehchu hiche hi nahinkhou ahi: chule hicheho jala hi lodinga Jordan nagalkai nao gama chu nahinkhou sotding ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chuin hiche nikho mama chun Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,","ref":"Minb 27:12-14; Danb 3:23-27."},"49":{"text":"Jericho toh kigalsai, Moab gama um Abarim molsanga um Nebo molsanga khun kaltouvin lang; Israel chaten alo dinguva kapeh Canaan gamchu gaven:"},"50":{"text":"Nasopipa Aaron Hor molsanga athia amitetoh akigop bangin, nakaltouna lama chun hungthiden ninlang namite toh kigomtan."},"51":{"text":"Ajehchu Zin gamthip, Kadesh mun Meribah twiphunga Israel chate lah-a keima douna in nachonkhela; Israel chate lah-a neijabol loujeh ahi."},"52":{"text":"Hijeng jongle agam chu namasangtah-a nagamu ding, amavang Israel chate kapeh gamsunga vang chu nalut louding ahi, ati."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule hichehi Pathen mipa Mosi'n athi masanga Israel chate phatthei abohna, phattheina chu ahi.","title":"Mosi'n Israel Chate Phatthei Aboh"},"2":{"text":"Chuin aman, Sinai'a konin Pakai ahungin, Seir'a konin ahenguva dingin akipatdoh-e; aman Paran molsanga konin asalvah-in, mitheng sangsom to ahunge: akhutjet lama konin amahodin danthu khaotah apotne."},"3":{"text":"Ahi, aman mipi angailun, amithengte jouse nakhutna aumui: chule amaho nakengbulla atouvun, mitinin nathu akisandiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Jacob mipite agoudiuva apeh danthu chu Mosi'n einapeuve."},"5":{"text":"Mipi lamkaiho le Israel phungho akikhop khom phatnun, ama Jeshurun'a aleng changin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Reuben hingjing henlang thihih hen; chule amite jong lhomcha hihih hen."},"7":{"text":"Hichehi Judah phatthei kibohna ahi, chuin aman, Pakai, Judah aw hi ngaijin lang, amite henga puijin; amadin akhut teni hi bulhingset henlang, amelmate-a kona kithopi-a chu nangma hin, ati."},"8":{"text":"Levi thudolla aman, Massah mun'a naphotchet pa, Meribah twiphunga nakibaopi pa, na mithengpa henga na Thummim le na Urim chu umhen.","ref":"Pot 17:7; 28:30; Minb 20:13."},"9":{"text":"Aman anu le apa henga, Keiman ama kanamupon, aman asopite jong ahekhenpon, chule achate tahjong ahepoi: ajehchu amahon nathu amangun, nakitepna anitnun ahi."},"10":{"text":"Amahon nathutanna chu Jacob ahiluva, chule na danthu chu Israel ahil dingu; namasanga gimnamtui akoijuva, na maicham chunga pumgo ganlhai aboldiu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pakai, anei agouhou phatthei boh-inlang, akhutna anatohhou sanpeh-in; ama mudaho le ama douna-a hung kipan hochu akipat doh kit louna diuvin akongu jeppeh-in, ati."},"12":{"text":"Benjamin thudolla aman, Pakai ngailutna chu akoma bitkeija chengding; chule Pakaiyin nilhum keija akhu-a, alengkou teni kikah-a chengding ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chule Joseph thudolla aman, Agam chu van thilluho-in, daitwi ho-in, leinoi thuhtah-a umho-in Pakai phattheiboh changhen,"},"14":{"text":"Chule nisan asodoh ga thillu ho le lhathah-a asodoh thil luho-in,"},"15":{"text":"Chule tonlai molsangho thilgun holeh kemlou lhang ho-a thil manlu ho,"},"16":{"text":"Chule leiset le athil manlu holeh, asung dima umho-in; chule hamboh lah-a chengpa lungdeijin: Joseph lamkaipa luchang le asopite-a kona kikhendohpa luchanga phattheibohna hunglhung hen."},"17":{"text":"Aloupina chu abongchal sohmasa pen abangin, akiho chu gambong ki ho abange: hicheho-a chu aman mite chu kolmong geija anokhom ding; chule amaho chu Ephraim mi sangsom le Manasseh mi asang sang chu ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Chule Zebulun thudolla aman, Zebulun nangma napotdoh na-a kipah inlang, chule Issachar nangma naponbuh sunga kipah-in."},"19":{"text":"Amahon miho chu molsang lama akoudiu, hia chu chonphatna ganlhai atodiu ahi. Ajehchu amahon twikhanglen ninglhina le, nellah-a kiselgu gou ho chu achopdiu ahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chule Gad thudolla aman, Gad kehlena chu nunnom hen: ama keipi bahkai bangin achengin, banjang le lu-a lallukhuh chu amaltelin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule chua danthu pepa chanvou mun'a chu ama atou jeh-in, ahop masapen ama akichantan: chule mipi lamkaiho chutoh ama ahungin, aman Pakai dihna le Israelte chunga athutanna atongdoh-in ahi, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chule Dan thudolla aman, Danhi keipi bahkai nou ahin, Beshan'a kona hungchom doh ding ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chule Naphtali thudolla aman, Vo Naphtali, lungdeija lunglhaile Pakai phatthei boh-a dim, lhumlamle lhanglam gam lotan, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chule Asher thudolla aman, Asher hi chilhah in phatthei changhen lang, asopite henga lahthei dol hihen, chule akeng thaotwija dehen."},"25":{"text":"Nakengchot thih le sum-eng hiding, nahinlai nikhoho banga nahatna jong umding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Nangma napanpi dinga vanlaijola touva, chule aloupina-a meibol chunga um Jeshurun Pathen tobang khatcha aumpoi."},"27":{"text":"Tonsot Pathen chu nakiselna ahin, chule noilama atonsot bannang aumin ahi: Aman namasanga kona melmate adelmang ding, amaho chu sumangin atiding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chutengle Israel changseh bitkeija chengding, Jacob twinah chu changle lengpithei gama umding; chule avanin jong daitwi alhahsah ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Vo Israel, anunom nahi: nangma tobang koi umam, Vo napanpi nao lumdal le na loupina chemjam, Pakai huhhing mite! Namelmate nahenga ajounao kimuntin, nangman amun sanghou nachotpha ding ahi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Mosi Moab phaicham konin Nebo molsang, Pisgah vuma akaldoh-in, hichu Jericho jontah ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin Gilead gam jouse chu Dan geijin avetsah-in,","title":"Mosi Thi"},"2":{"text":"Chule Naphtali gam jouse, Ephraim gam, Manasseh le Judah gam pumpi, twikhanglen mong geijin,"},"3":{"text":"Chule lhanglama Jericho phaicham, tumthing kena khopi Zoar geijin avetsahtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, Nachilhah te kapeh ding ahi tia Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga kana kihahselna gamchu hichehi ahi: keiman hichehi namitnin ka musahtan, amun vang nalhun louding ahi, ati.","ref":"Semt 12:7; 26:3; 28:13"},"5":{"text":"Chuti chun Pakai thu dungjuijin, Pakai soh Mosi chu Moab gama chun athiden tai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Aman Moab gamsunga phaicham khat Beth-peor jona chun avuijin, ahinla tuni geihin alhan chu koimachan ahepoi."},"7":{"text":"Chule Mosi athichun kum jakhat le kum somni ahitan; amit athimpon, athahat jong alha dehpoi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Moab phaichama chun Israel chaten Mosi chu nisomthum akauvin; chuti chun Mosi dinga kana le lunghemna chu akichaitai."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Nun chapa Joshua chu Mosi'n achunga akhut angap jeh-in, chihna lhagao adimset tan: Israel chaten athu angaijun, Pakaiyin Mosi thu apehbangin abolun ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule chucheng nunga pat chun Pakaiyin kimaito tah-a anahet Mosi tobang Israel sunga themgao khatcha asohdoh kit tapon,","ref":"Pot 33:11."},"11":{"text":"Egypt gamsunga Pharaoh heng le asohte jouse heng, chule agamsung pumpi-a, melchihna ho le thil kidangho jouse chu boldinga Pakaiyin anasol,"},"12":{"text":"Chule Israel jouse mitmu tah-a Mosi'n anavetsah chuche khut thahat tah jouse-a le chuche tijat umtah jouse boldoh-a khatcha asohdoh kit tapon ahi."}}}}},"6":{"info":{"name":"Joshua","shortname":"Josh","abbr":[],"desc":"Joshua Lekhabu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai soh Mosi athijouvin ahitin ahi, Mosi lhacha Nun chapa Joshua henga Pakaiyin hitin ati.","title":"Pathen'in Joshua Kanaan Lo Dinga Thupeh Anei"},"2":{"text":"Kasoh Mosi athitan, hijeh chun tun kipat in, nangmale hiche mipi jouse, amaho Israel chate dinga kapeh gam jondingin hiche Jordan hi galkaijun lang cheovin."},"3":{"text":"Mosi henga kana seibangin, nakengton achotphana chanchu nang kapeh nahitai.","ref":"Danb 11:24-25"},"4":{"text":"Gamthiple hiche Lebanon apat Euphrates vadunglen, Hit mite gamjouse chuleh nilhum lama twikhanglen gei nangma gamsung hiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nahinlai sungse-a koimacha namasanga ding joulou ding, Mosi kana umpi banga nangma jong kaumpi ding nahin, nangma nadalha pongting, nujong nanuse ponge.","ref":"Danb 31:6,8; Heb 13:5"},"6":{"text":"Hatninlang hangsanin, ajehchu apateu pehdinga kana kihahsel gam chu alodiuva hiche mitehohi nahoppeh ding ahi.","ref":"Danb 31:6,7,23"},"7":{"text":"Kasoh Mosi juidinga kapeh dan jouse nabola nachintup theina dingin, nangma hatpou pouvin lang hangtah-in umin. Nachena channa naphattheina dingin, chua kon chun jet le veija kihei mang loujenin."},"8":{"text":"Hiche danthupeh buhi nakamtoh kikhenkah hih hen, amavang asunga kisunho dungjuija nabola nachintup theina dingin sunle jan-in lunggiltah-in ngaiton. Chutile nalampi lamjangpeh a nalolhinsah ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Keiman nangma kanathupeh hilouham? hatninlang hangin, kicha hih-in, lungjong lungthoi hih-in. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in nachena chana naumpi jinge."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Joshua chun mipi vaipoho jouse chu thu apen aseije,","title":"Joshua'n mipi ho thu apeh"},"11":{"text":"Gebuh lailunga cheovinlang mipi jah-a nehlechah kigot tupmun, ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in lodinga napeh-u gamchu che-a galodinga, nithum sunga hiche Jordan hi nagalkai dingu ahi, tin mipi thu gapeuvin, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chule Reuben mite, Gad mite chule Manasseh phung akehkhat ho henga Joshua'n hitin aseijin,","ref":"Minb 32:28-32; Danb 3:18-20; Josh 22:1-6."},"13":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'un nakicholdo sah un, chule hiche gamhi napetaove, tia Pakai lhacha Mosi'n nangho henga napeh-u thuchu geldoh un."},"14":{"text":"Na-inneipiteu, nachasenhou chule nagancha hou Mosi'n napehnao Jordan gal hilama umden hen. Ahinla manchah choi miho galhangho jouse, masanga anacheuva, amaho na kithopi diu,"},"15":{"text":"nangho napeh banga Pakaiyin nasopi hou akicholdosah masangse-a, chule Pakai na Pathen'in amaho apeh-u gamchu alo masangseuva naki thopi diu ahi. Chujoule Jordan solama umna gam nalo diuva Pakai soh Mosi'n napeh-u gama chu nakile uva nalodiu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin amahon neithupeh jouseu chu bolungting neisolnao channa cheovinge tin Joshua adonbutnun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Imajousea Mosi thu kanangai bangun nangma thujong lunglut tah-in ngai uvinge, Pakai Pathen'in Mosi aumpi bangin nangma jong naumpi teihen atiuve."},"18":{"text":"Nathupeh douva chule nathupeh ngailou koi hijongle kithat ding ahi, hang pou pouvin lang hattah-in umin, atiuve."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nun chapa Joshua'n Shittim'a konin mini guhthimin gam velhi dingin asollin, chelhon inlang gamchu adeh-in Jericho gave lhonin tin aseipeh-in ahi. Chule amani amin Rahab kiti notinu in'a chun ahunglhonin, ageh lhontai.","title":"Jericho khopi velhi dinga Joshua'n mi asol","ref":"Heb 11:31; Jac 2:25."},"2":{"text":"Chule veuvin, tujanhin gam velhi dingin Israel chilhah ho hikoma ahunguve, tin Jericho khopi lengpa chu thu ahilun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hichun Jericho lengpan nahenga na-inna hunglut miteni chu hinpui doh-in; ajehchu amani gamjouse velhi dinga hunglhon ahi ti seidingin Rahab henga mi asolle."},"4":{"text":"Chuin numeinu chun miteni apuidoh-in, asellin, henge kahenga mini ahunge, ahinla hoija hungkon ahilhon vang kahepoi, tin aseije."},"5":{"text":"Chule ahitin ahi, kotpi khachah phat don, khothim phatnin, miteni chu achedoh lhontan, hoija achelhon kahepoi. Mangang tah-in amani chu nungdelun, ajehchu phapaovin nate ati."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla amanun, amani chu in chunga apuitouvin, akisetoh changpol lah-a chun aseltai."},"7":{"text":"Chuin mihochun miteni chu Jordan kaimun lampi geipeh chun anungdellun, chule anungdelho chu apotphatnun kul kotkhah chu akhah taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin amani ahung kumlhon masangin in chunga amanu akaldoh-in,"},"9":{"text":"chule amanun Pakaiyin hiche gam napeh-u ahitai, nangho gin nahi kachunguva achun, chule nangho jeh-a hiche gama chengho jouse kihotlhugam dingu ahitai ti kahei, tin miteni chu aseipehtai."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu Egypt'a kona nahungpot doh uva Pakaiyin twipisan chu nangho dinga iti akansah-a, chule nanghon nathagamhelu Jordan gal langkhatna um Amor leng teni Sihon le Og chunga ipi nabolu chu kanajaove.","ref":"Pot 14:21; Minb 21:21-35"},"11":{"text":"Chule hichehi kajahjah-un kalungu ajunlha tai, nangho jeh-in koimacha chunga hanna himhim aumtapoi. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u chu chunga leh noija Pathen ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun kangeh nahi lhone, Pakai minin kahenga kihahsel lhonin, keiman nangni lungsetna kamusah tah jeh-in, Nangnin jong kapa insung chunga lungsetna neimusah lhoninlang, melchihna dihtah neipe lhonnin."},"13":{"text":"Chuti chun, kanule kapa, kasopi numei ho le pasal ho, chule aneijouseu neihinghoi peh-un lang, kahinkhouhi thina-a konin neihuhdoh peh-un, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin miteni chun amanu jah-a, kathilbol lhonhi naseidohlouva ahile nanghodin kahinna tohlhoninge. Chule hung hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin hiche gamhi eipeh tengule lungsetna neitahle dihtah-in nangma nabollunge tin adonbut lhone."},"15":{"text":"Chujouvin amanun amani chu bangkotna konin khaovin akhailhatai. Ajehchu amanu in chu khopi kulchunga kisa ahin, chule ama kul chunga chu chenga ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin amanun, amani jah-a, mol langa lampia khun chelhonin, nanungdel hon mugetnun nate. Chule nanungdel ho akilekit kahseovin nithum sung gakisel lhonin, chule chujou tengle chethei lhontan nate."},"17":{"text":"Hichun miteni chun amanu jah-a, neiki hahsel sah nalhon kitepna achun mona neilhon hih inge."},"18":{"text":"Vetan, keiho hiche gam kahunglut tengule, hiche neikhai lhah nalhon bangkotna hi patkhao santhip nakhiding, chule nanule napa nasopi pasal ho, chule napa insungmite jouse na-inna anapuikhomin,"},"19":{"text":"chule hitiding ahi. Koi hijongle na-inna kona kholaija potdoh aumleh mona thisan chu aman akipoh ding, keiho themmo hilouding ahi. Chule koihile na-inna naumpi chunga khutlha aumle athisan chu kaluchunguva chuhen,"},"20":{"text":"chule kathilbol lhonhi naseidoh a ahile, neiki hahsel sah lhon kitepna-a kona chu mo kachan lhon louding ahi atilhone."},"21":{"text":"Chuin amanun nasei bang banglhon chu hitahen, ati. Chuin amanun amani chu asolmangin apotdoh lhontai. Chuin amanun pat santhip chu bangkotna akhaitan, ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin amani mollama chun achelhonin, anungdelho akinungle kahseovin chua chun nithum agaum lhone. Chuin anungdelho ahung kinungle uvin lamjousea aholun amutapouve."},"23":{"text":"Hichun miteni chu molla konin ahung kumsuh lhonin, agalkai lhonin akilekit lhontai. Chuin Nun chapa Joshua henga ahunglhonin, achung lhona thilsoh jouse chu ahenga aseipeh lhontai."},"24":{"text":"Chuin amanin tahbeh-in Pakaiyin gamjousehi ikhutnuva eipehdoh-u ahitai. Ajeh chu agama cheng jouse chu eihojeh-in akihot lhugam taove tin Joshua henga aseipeh lhone."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Joshua jingpitah in athouvin, chule Shittim'a konin akipat doh-un, Jordan lui ahunglhung taove. Amale Israel chate jouse agalkai masangun chua chun ageh taove.","title":"Israel Chate Jordan Agalkai"},"2":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi. Nithum jouvin lamkaiho chu gebuh lah-a chun acheuvin;"},"3":{"text":"Chule amahon mipi ho chu Pakai na Pathen thulhun thingkhong chu Levi thempuhon aput namu phat tengule naum naova konin kichon unlang chuche nungchu najuidingu ahi, tin thu apeuve."},"4":{"text":"Ahinla nanghole hiche kikah chu tong sangni tobanga nakigamlat diu, nachenadiu lampi nahet theina dingun, nai hihhelun. Ajehchu tumasangin hiche lampia hin nanache khapouve."},"5":{"text":"Chule Joshua'n mipi jah-a, nangho kisuthengun ajehchu Pakaiyin jingleh nalah uva thilkidang abolding ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n thempuho jah-a, thulhun thingkhong chu puvinlang mipi masanga chun cheovin, ati. Chuin amahon thulhun thingkhong chu apuvin mipi masanga chun achetauve."},"7":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, keiman Mosi kana umpi bang banga nangma jong kaumpi ding nahi, ti amahon ahetheina dingun tunia hi Israel pumpi mitmu-a kachoi sang panding nahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chule nangman thulhun thingkhong pu-a pang thempuho jah-a, Jordan vapam chin nagei phat nule Jordan'a nadindendiu ahi, tin thu pen, ati."},"9":{"text":"Hitichun Joshua'n Israel chate jah-a, hilama hungun lang Pakai na Pathen'u thuhi ngaijun, ati.","title":"Joshua'n Mipi Atilkhou"},"10":{"text":"Chule Joshua'n hia konahi hingjing Pathen nalah uva aume ti nahet dingu ahi. Chule aman Kanaan mihole Hit miho, Hiv miho Perizz miho, chule Girgash mihole Amor miho chule Jebus miho thonlou hela namasanguva adeldoh ding ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Veovin, leiset pumpi Pakai thulhun thingkhong chu namasanguva Jordan lui galkai ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun phung khatna mikhatcheh Israel phungho-a konin somleni lhengdoh-un."},"13":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi. Pakai leiset pumpi Pakai thulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho kengin achot chot nuleh Jordan twipi chu kiting tanding sahlama kona hunglong twipia kona chu kikhendoh ding, chule hichu aloma kiting dending ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, mipihole mipi masanga thulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho Jordan galkai nadinga aponbuh uva kona akipatdoh phatnun,"},"15":{"text":"Chule thingkhong puho Jordan lui aga lhunuva, thingkhong pu thempuho keng chun twi agahchot lutnule, (ajehchu chang atlai sungsele Jordan luihi longletji ahi)."},"16":{"text":"Sahlama kona hunglong suh twi chu akiting denin, Zarethan koma um Adam khopi geijin gamlatah-in akidilin ahi. Chule phaicham gamlatah twipi lamsanga chi twipi lama longsuh laichu atantan, hitichun mipi ho chu Jericho khopi dontah-a chun agalkai taove."},"17":{"text":"Pakai thulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho chu Jordan lui mipi ho chu agalkaisoh kahseovin, Jordan lailunga tolgoa chun ading detnun, chule Israelte jouse chu tolgoa agalkai taovin ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi. Mipi jouse Jordan agalkai sohkei phatnun, Pakaiyin Joshua henga,","title":"Jordan'a Kona Song Somleni"},"2":{"text":"Phung khatna konin Pasal khat cheh, mipi lah-a pasal somleni lhengdoh-in,"},"3":{"text":"Chule ajah uva, thempuho dettah a adinnau mun Jordan lailunga konchun song somleni laovin. Chule hicheho chu pogalkai junlang tujana nagenadiu munachun koijun, tin thu pen, tin aseipeh-in ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n Israel chate lah-a phung khatna kon mikhat cheh analhendoh mi somleni chu akouvin,"},"5":{"text":"Chule Joshua'n ajah uva, Jordan lailung Pakai na Pathen'u thulhun thingkhong masanga chun gacheuvin lang Israel chate phungjat dungjuijin nangho mikhatnin, song khat cheh nalenguva hinpuvin, ati."},"6":{"text":"Hiti achu hichehi nalah uva melchihna hunghia, khonung tengle, nachateovin apateu henga hiche songhohi ipi kihetna ham? tia nadoh tengule"},"7":{"text":"Nanghon Pakai thulhun thingkhong masanga Jordan lui alonglai adinjeh ahi. Jordan agalkai laijun Jordan twi chu akangtanin, chujeh-in hiche songhohi Israel chate dinga a-itih a dinga hetjingna hiding ahi, tia amahochu nadonbut diu, ahi ati."},"8":{"text":"Chule Israel chaten Joshua thupeh bangin abollun, Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a anasei bangin, Israelte phungjat dungjuijin alauvin, agenao mun geijin apogal kaijun, chuachun akoitauvin ahi.","title":"Jordan Lailunga Song Somleni Kiphu"},"9":{"text":"Chule Joshua'n thulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho dinna Jordan lailunga chun song somleni aphutnin, hihochu tunichanin aumjinge."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu tulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho chu Mosi'n Joshua henga thu anapeh jouse dungjuijin mipi henga seipehdin Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a thu anapeh chu akichai kahsen Jordan lailunga chun adingdenun ahi. Chuin mipi chu kinotah-in agalkai taovin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule ahitin ahi, mipi ho chu agalkai sohkei phatnun Pakai thulhun thingkhong le thempuho chu mipi mitmun agalkai taove.","title":"Joshua Choisanga aum"},"12":{"text":"Chule Reuben chate, Gad chate chule Manasseh phung kehkhat gal manchah pumin, Mosi'n ahenguva aseipeh bangin Israel chate masanga anagalkaijun ahi."},"13":{"text":"Galvona kivonjousadem mi sangsomli tobang gal satdingin Jericho phaicham ho-a Pakai masanga akitolun, ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hicheni chun Pakaiyin Israel pumpi mitmu-a chun Joshua achoisangin ahi. Chuin amahon Mosi agin bangun amachu ahinlai sungsen agingun ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Joshua henga aseijin,"},"16":{"text":"Hettohsahna thingkhong pu-a thempuho chu Jordan'a kona ahungdoh nadiuvin thu pen, ati."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun Joshua'n Jordan'a konin hungdoh taovin, tin thempuho thu apetan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule ahitin ahi, Pakai thulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho chu Jordan lailunga kona ahungdoh uva, chule tolgo akaidoh phatnun angai bang bangin Jordan luichu alongkittan, vadung pangho chu aletkittan, ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin mipi chu lha masapen nisom channin Jordan luija konin ahungdoh un, Jericho gam solamsang Gilgal'a chun gebuh asong taovin ahi.","title":"Gilgal Song Kiphu"},"20":{"text":"Chule song somleni Jordan luija kona alahdoh uchu Gilgal'a chun Joshua'n aphuttan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule aman Israel chate jah-a, khonung tengle nachateovin apateu henga, hiche songhohi ipi kihetna ham? tia nadoh tenguleh,"},"22":{"text":"Nanghon nachateo henga, Israel chu hiche Jordan'a hin tolgon anagalkaijun ahi, ti nahetsah dingu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un twipisan kagalkai kahseuva kamasanguva agotsah bangchun, Pakai na Pathen'un Jordan twi chu nagalkai kahseovin akansah-in, ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hiti achu leiset mite jousen Pakai khut chu hattah ahi, ti ahetheijuva, nanghon Pakai na Pathen'u chu a-imatih chana nagin theina dingu ahi tin aseipeh-in ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuleh ahitin ahi, Jordan gal lhumlam sanga um Amor mite leng jouse le, twipi panga um Kanaan mite leng jousen Israel chate masanga Jordan agalkaisoh kahseovin Pakaiyin Jordan luichu akansah-e, ti ajah phatnun alungu ajunlha gamtan, Israel chate jehchun amaho-ah hanna lung him him aumtapoi.","title":"Chep Kitan Kitna"},"2":{"text":"Hichepet chun Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, chemcha hem hinsem munlang, Israel chate chu aniveina-a din achepmu tanpeh kitnin, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Joshua chun chemcha hem asemin, Israel chate chu achepmu atanpehtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule Joshua'n chep atanna ajehchu hichehi ahi. Egypt'a kona ahungdoh nungun mipi jouse galmiho jengjong, Egypt'a kona ahungdoh jouvun, gamthip lampia athigam taovin, ahi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt'a kona hungpotdoh jouse chu cheptansa ahiuvin ahi. Ahinla ahungdoh nunguva gamthipma lamkah-a pengho jouse chu chep tanlou ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Egypt'a kona hungdoh Israel chate galmi jousen Pakai aw lunglut tah-a angailou jeh-un, suhmanga aumkah seovin gamthipma kum somli athammun, Pakaiyin apateu pehdinga anatepsa khoijule bongnoi lonna gam chu amaho musahlou dingin ana kihahselin, ahi.","ref":"Minb 14:28-35"},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun akheluva atundoh achateu chu Joshua'n achepmu atanpehtan ahi. Ajehchu amaho lamdunga chep ana tanpeh loujeh-un, chep tanlou anahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Chule ahitin ahi, mipi jouse chep akitanjou phatnin, adam kahseovin aumnao gebuh a chun aumun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, tunia nangho-a kona Egypt te i-sah louna chu katolmang ahitai, ati. Hijeh chun tuni geihin hiche munchu Gilgal akisahtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Israel chaten Gilgal'a chun gebuh akisonun, hiche lha nisomlenili channi nilhah lamin Jericho phaicham ho-a chun kalchuh kut anit taove.","title":"Gilgal'a Kalchuh Kut Kiman","ref":"Pot 12:1-13."},"11":{"text":"Chule kalchuh kut jou ajing nikhotah chun amahon hiche gama mimle chang leija kona cholsolou changlhah chule changkanpoh chucheni mama chun anetaovin, ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule chuche gam changvui anehjouvu ajing chun Mana chu akichaitan, Israel chaten Mana chu nejong anetapouve. Ahinla amahon hiche kum-a pat chun Kanaan gam gachu anetaovin, ahi.","ref":"Pot 16:35"},"13":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Joshua Jericho naija aumpet chun akhodah-in aven ahile, veuvin, amasanga mikhat achemjam sadohsan akhutna achoijin adingin ahi. Chuin Joshua'n akom anaijin ajah-a, keiho lama pang nahim, ahiloule kamelmate lama panga nahim? ati.","title":"Vantil Khat Joshua Henga Akilah"},"14":{"text":"Chuin aman ahipoi, Pakai janel lamkaija hungjoh kahi ati. Chuin Joshua tolla aboh khupmin ahouvin, ajah-a, Pakaiyin nasoh henga ipi seinom naneijem? atin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Pakai janel gallamkai chun Joshua jah-a, nakengchot sutlhan, ajehchu nadinna mun chu muntheng ahi, ati. Chuin Joshua'n chuti chun aboltan, ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Jericho chu Israel chate jehchun akikhahchahtan, koimacha alutle apotle aumtapoi.","title":"Jericho Kisuhchim"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, vetan, Jericho le alengpau chule mihat mihangsan tamtah hohi nakhutna kapeh ahitai."},"3":{"text":"Chule nangho galmi jousen khopihi naum uva, hitia chu khatvei navelsoh diu ahi. Chule chutobangma chu nigup sunga naboldingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule thempu sagin kelngoichal ki-a kisem sumkon sagi kitepna thulhun thingkhong masanga achoijuva, chule anisagi ni-a chu khopi chu vel sagivei navelsoh dingu, chuteng thempuhon sumkon ho chu amutdiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi. Amahon kelngoichal ki-a kisem sumkon chu amut huilhung jenjunu gin najah tenguleh mipi chun ha-aova na-aodiu, chutahle khopi kulchu chimlhading ahi. Chule mipi chu ama ama majon cheh a jangjela kaltou dingu ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Nun chapa Joshua'n thempuho chu akouvin, ajah uvah, thulhun thingkhong hi jong unlang, thempu sagin Pakai kitepna thingkhong masang lama chun kelngoichal ki-a kisem sumkon sagi choijuhen ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin aman mipi jah-a, chepeh unlang khopi chu velkolun lang, chule galvona kivonta pouchu Pakai kitepna thingkhong masanga chun cheohen, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi. Joshua'n mipi henga thu aseijou phatnin, kelngoichal ki-a kisem sumkon sagi choija thempuho chun Pakai masanga achoiju sumkon ho chu amut taovin, chule Pakai thulhun thingkhong chun anungu ajuitan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule galvon kivon hochu sumkon ho mut thempuho masanga chun acheuvin, chule anungthop ho chu thulhun thingkhong nunga ahungun, thempuho chun ache pumu chun sumkon ho chu amutnun ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n na aona dinguva thu kapeh ding nikho alhin tokahse-a, na ao-loudingu, chule nahusat loudingu ahi. Chule thujong nasei loudingu, thu kapeh tenglebou na aodiu ahi, tin mipi chu thu apetan, ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chutichun Pakai thulhun thingkhong chu khopi chu khatvei avelsah un, chule gebuh a ahung kilekitnun, agehjiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chule Joshua jingpitah-in athouvin, thempuho chun Pakai thulhun thingkhong chu apuve."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thingkhong masanga kelngoichal ki-a kisem sumkon ho choija thempu sagiho chu tanglouvin acheuvin ahi. Chule galvona kivonho chu amasanguva acheuve. Ahinla anungthop ho chu Pakai thulhun thingkhong nunga ahungun, thempuho chun chepumin sumkon ho amut jingun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin anini channin khopi chu velkhat avellun gebuh a ahungkile uvin ahi. Chutichun nigup abolluve."},"15":{"text":"Chuin anisagi channin ahitin ahi, khovah then thenin athouvun, abol ngaima bangun khopi chu vel sagi avelun ahi. Hichenia bou chu khopi chu vel sagivei avelu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin avel sagi chana-in ahitin ahi, thempuhon sumkon ho amut phatnun Joshua'n mipi jah-a hatah-in aovun ajehchu Pakaiyin khopihi nangho napeh-u ahitai atin, ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule khopile asunga umjouse ngeichu sapsetna dinga Pakaiya kipedoh ahitai. Rahab noti le a-insunga aumpi chengse bouchu sohcha ding ahi. Ajehchu amanun imisolte niu anaselin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule sapset thilho-a konin kikang seuvin. Achutiloule sapset thilho chu lakhaovin natin, sapset changkhaovin nate. Chule Israel gebuh a jong sapsetna lhungintin, boina umgetninte."},"19":{"text":"Ahinla sana dangka, thihle sum-eng bel jouse Pakai dinga kisuthenga ahi. Hicheho chu Pakai goukhol na-a kikoiding ahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chutichun thempuhon sumkon ho amutphatnun ahitin ahi. Mipin sumkon ho gin ajah phatnun ha aovin a-aovun ahileh, kulpi chu achimlhatan, chuphatnin mipi chu amaho doncheh a jangjelin alhai touvun khopi chu alataove."},"21":{"text":"Chuin amahon khopi sunga um numeile pasal nungah le gollhang abonin, ateh akhang chule bongchal le kelngoi, chule sangan abonchan chemjamin athat gamhel taovin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla Joshua'n gamvelhi teni jah-a, notinu in'a chun lut lhonin lang amanule aneijouse chu ahenga nana kihahselna lhon bang chun gapuidoh lhonin, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin gollhang gamvelhi teni chu ahunglhonin, Rahab, anule apa, asopiho chule aneijouse toh apuidoh lhontan, ahi. Chule amanin a inkote jouse apuidoh lhonin Israel gebuh pama adalha lhontan, ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin amahon khopi chu asunga thil umjouse toh meijin ahalvamun, sana dangka, thihle sum-eng belho bouchu Pakai in'a gou kholna-a akoitaovin, ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n Rahab notinu le aneijouse, chule apa insung ahuhhingin ahi. Chule amanu tuni geijin Israelte lah-a acheng nalaije. Ajehchu amanun Joshua'n Jericho gavelhi dinga asolteni chu ana selin, ahi.","ref":"Heb 11:31"},"26":{"text":"Chuti chun Joshua'n amaho chu ahahselin, hitin aseije: hiche Jericho khopi hintungdoh kitna chu Pakai masanga sapset chenghen. Abul phutna chun achapa lenpen achan ding, chule akotpiho atundoh tengle achapa lhumpen achan ding ahi,","ref":"1 Leng 6:34."},"27":{"text":"Hitichun Pakaiyin Joshua aumpin, gam jouse-a amin chu akithangtan ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahin Israel chaten sapsetna thil chungah asukhel taove. Ajehchu Judah phunga Zerah chapa Zabdi chapa Karmi chapa Achan'in sapsetna thilchu alan ahi. Chuin Israel chate chunga Pakai lunghana chu akoudoh jahtan ahi.","title":"Achan Chonsetna le gotna"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n Jericho akonin Bethel solam Bethaven koma um Ai kho-a mi asolin, ajah uvah, chetou vunlang gamchu gaveovin tin aseijin ahi. Chuin miho chu acheuvin Ai khochu agave taove."},"3":{"text":"Chuin amaho chu Joshua henga ahung kilekitnun, ajah-a, mijouse kontousah datan, ahinla sangni sangthum tou kontouvu henlang Ai khochu nokhumu hen, mijouse suhthachol datan, ajeh chu lhomcha bou ahiuve, atiuvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hichun mipi ho lah-a mi sangthum tobang akontou taove. Ahin amaho Ai miho masanga ajamtaovin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Ai miten amaho mi somthumlegup tobang athatnun ahi. Ajehchu kotpi-a kona Shebarim geipeh a ahindelsuh uva, ajamsuh nalam uva athao ahi. Hijeh chun miho lung chu alhoplhatan, twibang ahijengtai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n avonho abottelin Pakai thulhun thingkhong masanga chun nilhah geijin aboh khupmin, tolla amai asulutnin, amale Israel upaho chun, aluchung uva leivui akinutaove."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n, vo Pakai Pathen, ipidinga hiche mipihohi Amor mite khutna napeh doh-a thagam dingbepma Jordan napui galkai mongham? Jordan gal langkhatna lungmonga kanaum hitaleh!"},"8":{"text":"Vo Pakai, Israelte hi amelmate masanga kinungchon jing tale ipi seitang em?"},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu Kanaan mihole hiche gama cheng jousehin hichu jaovintin, eium kimvel untin kaminuhi leisetna kona asuhmang diu ahitai.
