Chutengle Namin loupitah hi inaloding hitam? ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, thoudoh-in, ipi dinga hiti achu nabohkhupma nalup ham? ati."},"11":{"text":"Israel achonvaltan, kathupeh kathulhun jong eisuhkeh peh-un, amahon sapsetna thil jengjong alauvin, aguvin, aselguvin, athilkeo lah uva aselun ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu Israel chate amelmateu masanga ding joulouva galte masanga nungjam joh ahiuve. Ajehchu amaho chu sapset changa ahitaovin, nalah uva kona sapset thilchu nasuhmang lou uleh kaumpi louding nahitaove."},"13":{"text":"Kipat in mipi ho sutheng inlang ajah uva, jing nikho-a dingin kisuthengun; ajehchu Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, Israel nalah uva kona sapsetsa thilchu nasuhmang kahseuva namelma teu masanga nadin jouloudiu ahi, tin seipeh-in."},"14":{"text":"Hiche jehchun jingkah tengle naphungu dungjuija naki khopdiu, chule hitiding ahi. Pakaiyin alhendoh phung chu abom dungjuija hungdiu ahi. Chule Pakaiyin alhendoh bom chu a-insung dungjuija hungdiu, chule Pakaiyin alhendoh dungjuija amichangcheh hungdiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, sapset thiltoh kimattha pen penchu amale aneijouse meija kigouvam ding ahi. Ajehchu aman Pakai thulhun asukhelin, Israel lah-a chonval tah-in thil abole, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Joshua jingpitah-in athouvin, Israelte chu aphung phungin ahinpuijin ahile Judah phungchu alheng dohtai."},"17":{"text":"Chuin aman Judah sunga abom bomin ahinpuijin, Zarhi bom chu alhengdoh-in ahi. Chuin Zarhi bom chu mikhat khatnin ahinpuijin ahile Zabdi chu alheng dohtan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin a-inkouvin mikhat khatnin ahinpuijin ahile Judah phunga Zarah chapa Zabdi chapa Karmi chapa Achan chu amandohtan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n Achan jah-a, kangeh nahi, kachapa Pakai Israel Pathen chu loupi chamkim jana penlang nachonsetna phongin, chule ipi nanabol tun imlouvin kakoma seijin, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Achan'in Joshua chu adonbutnin, ajah-a, tahbeh mongin Pakai Israel Pathen dounan kana chonsetan, hitihin kanaboltai."},"21":{"text":"Keiman thil kichomho lah-a chun Babylon von hoitah khatle dangka shekel jani, chule shekel somnga-a gih sana lhon khat kamun ahile, kavejou tahih-in, kakilahtan ahi. Chule vetan, hicheho chu kaponbuh lailung leinoi'a kaselin, dangka chu anoija aume, atin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n mi asolin, amaho chu ponbuh lama alhaijun, chule vetan, hichu aponbuh sunga anaselin, dangka anoinunga anaume."},"23":{"text":"Chuin amahon ponbuh a konin hicheho chu aladoh-un, Joshua le Israel chate jouse henga ahinchoijun Pakai angsunga akoitaove."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Joshua le aumpi Israel pumpin Zarah chapa Achan dangka, von, sana lhon, achapate le achanute, abongchalho, asanganho le akelngoiho, aponbuh chule aneijouse ahintolun Achor phaicham ahinlhut taove."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n ibola neisuh lunggimu ham? Pakaiyin tunia nangjong nasuh lunggim ding ahitai, ati. Chuin Israel mipin amale aumpi jousen songin asepmun, asejou phatnun meijin ahalvam taove."},"26":{"text":"Chuin amahon achunga chun songlhuh lentah atungdoh-un, hichu tunigei hin aumjing nalaije. Hitichun alungset tijat umtah-a konin Pakai akileheitai. Hijeh chun hiche munchu tunigeijin Achor phaicham akisahtai."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, kicha hih-in, lungjong lunglha hih-in, galmi jouse puijin kipat inlang Ai kho-a chetouvin, ven, Ai lengpa le amite chule akhopile agam nakhutna kapeh nahitai.","title":"Ai Kho Kisuhmang"},"2":{"text":"Chule Jericho le alengpa chunga nabol banga Ai le alengpa chunga jong nabolding ahi. Chule thilkichomhole ganchaho chu nangho ding ahin, khopi nunglama chu achanglhi nakoiding ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chutichun Joshua le galmiho jouse Ai satna chedin akipat doh-un ahi. Chuin Joshua'n mihat, mihang sangsomthum alhengdoh-in, jannin asoldohtan, ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin amaho chu thu apen, veuvin, khopi nunglama nachanlhih diu ahi. Khopi-a kona chegamla behseh louva, kigosa dema naum johdiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule keimale kaumpi chengse chun khopi chu hinnai lutnung kating, chule hung hitiding ahi. Keiho doudinga ahungdoh tengule, amasa bangchun keiho amasanguvah jamung ting,"},"6":{"text":"(ajehchu amaho keiho nunga hungdoh ding,) amaho khopisunga kapuidoh kahseovin, ajehchu amahon amasa-a bangin, amaho amasanguvah ajamtaove atidiu ahin, hijeh-a chu amasanguva kajamdiu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuteng nanghon nachanlhih naova kona nakipat doh uva, khopi chu nalahdiu ahi. Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in nakhut uva apehding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, nanghon khopi chu nalah tengule nahal dingu ahi. Pakai thupeh dungjuija nabol dingu ahi. Veovin, thu kapeh nahiuve, ati."},"9":{"text":"Hichun Joshua chun amaho chu asoldoh-in, chule amaho changpang dingin acheuvin, Ai khole Bethel kikah Ai lhumlama chun aga umun, Joshua vang hiche janchun mipi lah-a agehtan, ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Joshua jingpitah-in athouvin, mihochu asimin, amale Israel upaho mipi masanga chun Ai kho jonin akitoltou taove."},"11":{"text":"Chuin mipi jouse ahenga amatoh umkhom galmiho jouse chu chetouvun, chule ahin naijun khopi masanga ahunglhung uvin, Ai khopi sahlama chun ponbuh asonguve. Tun amahole Ai kikah-a chu phaicham khat umah ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin aman mi sangnga tobang apuijin, khopi lhumlam sang Bethel le Ai kikah-a chun changlhi-a kisel dingin akoitan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin amahon khopi sahlama um mipi janel, chule khopi lhumlama changpangho geija agontohsoh phatnin, hiche janchun Joshua phaicham lailunga achetan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Ai lengpan hichu amuphat chun, kinotah-in ama athouvin, khopi miho, amale amite jouse chu phaichama chun Israelte satdingin ahung kondoh taove. Ahinla khopi nunglama asat ding achanglhi aume tichu ahepouvin, ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Joshua le Israel mijouse chu gallel bangin amaho masanga chun gamthip lama chun ajamtaove."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Ai kho-a um mijouse chu amaho nungdel dingin akikoukhomun, Joshua nung adelun khopi-a konin akitolmang taove."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Ai khole Bethel kho-a chun Israelte nungdela chelou khatchabeh aumpouve. Chule khopi kot chu honsan adalhaovin Israelte chu adeltaove."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, Ai kholam ngan nakhutna tengcha chu gah lhandoh-in, ajehchu hichu nakhutna kapeh ding ahi, ati. Chuin Joshua'n akhutna um tengcha chu khopi lam ngan alhang dohtan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin changpangho chu aumna mun uva konin akipatdoh loijun, akhut alhandoh doh chun alhaijun, khopi-a chun alutnun hichun alauvin gangtah-in ahallha taove."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Ai kho miho chu akiheijun anung lamu agah vetnule, veuvin, khopi meikhu van'a akitungdoh amuvin, hoilampena jamding ham ahetapouve. Chuin gamthip lama jam mipi ho chu ahung kilekitnun, anungdelhou chunga chun achutaove."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Joshua le Israel pumpi, achanglhi hon khopi alah-u chule khopi meikhu kitungdoh chu amuphatnun akiheijun Ai kho miho chu athatgam taove."},"22":{"text":"Chuin adangho chu amaho satdin khopi-a konin ahung kitoldoh-un, hitichun amaho alang alanga Israelte lailung tah-a aumtaove. Chuin akihinghoile ajamdoh khatcha aumsah tapouve."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Ai khopi lengpa chu ahingin amanun, Joshua henga ahinkai taovin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Israel ten gamlah le anungdel nao gamthipma Ai kho mijouse chemjam'a akitha-a akisuh gamhel phatchun, Israelte jouse Ai kho-a akileuvin chemjamin asumang taovin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho-a Ai khopi-a thijouse chu anumei apasal'in sangsom le sangni ahiuve."},"26":{"text":"Joshua'n ateng alhandoh chu Ai kho-a miho athajou tokahseochun akhut alha lhapon ahi."},"27":{"text":"Pakaiyin Joshua henga athupeh bangin hiche khopi-a ganchaho le thil kichomho bou chu Israel ten ama ama chanding dola akilah-u ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Joshua Ai kho chu ahalin, a-itih-a dingin alhuh-in asemin, tunichan hin ahomkeo ahijinge."},"29":{"text":"Chule Ai kho lengpa chu nilhah geijin thingleh-a akhaijin, chule nilhum ding konin Joshua'n thu apen, thilong chu thingleh-a konin alalhauvin khopi lamlen lutna bulla apaijun achunga song atungdoh-un tunichanhin aum nalaije."},"30":{"text":"Chujouvin Joshua'n Ebal lhanga Israel Pakai Pathen dingin maicham asemin ahi.","title":"Ebal Molla Dan Asimu","ref":"Danb 27:2-8."},"31":{"text":"Mosi dan lekhabua kisun bangin Pakai soh Mosi'n Israel chilhah ho thu anapeh bangchun, hiche maicham chu songa kisem ahin, koiman achunga thih alhahkhum loulaiju ahi. Hichea chun Pakai dingin govam thilto le chamna thiltoho atoh-in ahi.","ref":"Pot 20:5"},"32":{"text":"Chuin aman hiche songa chun Mosi danho chu Israel chate mitmun asunin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule Israelte jouse, a-upahou, thutan vaihomho, Levi te thempuho chu Pakai thingkhong jongho masanga, thulhun thingkhong sihtoa chun phung chomho le chuche gama pengho jouse jongchu ading khom sohkeijun, akehkhat Gerezim molpangah adingun, Pakai soh Mosi'n Israelte chu vang aboh tahdi ding ahi tia thu anapeh bangchun, akeh khat chu Ebal jonna aumun ahi.","ref":"Danb 11:29; 27:11-14"},"34":{"text":"Chule chujouchun danthua thujouse danthu bu-a kisun jouse dungjuijin vangbohna le sapsetna thuho chu asimdoh-in ahi."},"35":{"text":"Mosi thupeh jouse chu Israelte houkhom ho jousele, numei ho le chapang neocha cha hole amaho lah-a chidang namdang chengho hetnin Joshua'n simlou khatchabeh aneipon ahi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Jordan hilamsang thinglhang, phaicham chule twipilen Lebanon geija cheng jouse Hit mi, Amor mi, Kanaan mi, Perizz mi, Hiv mi chule Jebus mi lengho jouse chun ajah phatnun,","title":"Gibeon Miten Joshua Alheplhah-u"},"2":{"text":"Amaho Joshua le Israel satdingin lungkhat tah-in akikhom khomtaove."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Gibeon na chengho chun Joshua'n Jericho le Ai kho abolnaho chu ajah phatnun,"},"4":{"text":"Amahon doha abolun palaija kisol bangin acheuvin, asanganhou chunga khaodip pon luiho aphaovin, jupenglui asesaho le akikanchomho apouvin,"},"5":{"text":"Chule kengchotlui abehbeh a pol akiseovin, vonlui akivonun, anehdiuva changlhah ahinkipoh hou jong agon, a-ap gamtan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin amaho Gilgal gebuh-a Joshua henga acheuvin, amale Israel mite henga, keiho kholgam latah-a kona hung kahiuvin, hijeh chun tun neikicham piuvin, atiuve."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Israel miten Hit mite jah-a, nangho kalah uva cheng hikhatnun nate. Achutile nang hotoh thulhunna iti kasem dinguham? atiuve.","ref":"Pot 23:32; 34:12; Danb 7:2."},"8":{"text":"Chuin amahon Joshua jah-a nasohte kahiuhi atiuve, chuin Joshua'n ajah uva, nangho koi nahiuva hoijakona hung nahiuvem? ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin amahon ajah-a, Pakai na Pathen min jala nasohte hi kholgam latah a kona hunga kahiuve. Ajehchu keihon aminthangjele Egypt gama athilbol jouse kaja taove,"},"10":{"text":"chule Jordan galla um Amor mite lengni Heshbon lengpa Sihon le Ashtaroth na cheng Bashan lengpa Og chunga athilbol jouse phatah-in kajaovin, ahi.","ref":"Minb 21:21-35"},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun ka-upahou le kagamsunga cheng mijousen kajah uvah, nanehdiu kipoh unlang, amaho kimupi dingin cheovin, chule alah uva keihohi nasohte kahiuve. Hijeh chun tun nanghon neikichampiuvin gatiuvin tin eihilun ahi, atiuve."},"12":{"text":"Naheng uva hungdinga kakigot uva pat kanehdiuva kahinpoh-u hiche changlhah hohi sapeh-ah ahi. Ahinla tun veuvin, agopmin a-ap tai."},"13":{"text":"Chule ju kahin kikhum nao penghohi athahleh ahin, veuvin tun, asegamtai. Hiche kavon houleh ka kengchot-u jonghi lamsaotah kahinjot jeh uva luigama ahitai, atiuve."},"14":{"text":"Chuin mihochun Pakai chu dong louvin an anehkhompi taovin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n amahochu hinghoi dingin chamna asemin, akitep pitan ahi. Chule mipi kikhomho lamkaiho jong ahenguva akitep taovin, ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin amato akitep nungu nithum jouvin ahitin ahi. Amahochu alah uva chengah akhovelhou ahiuchu ahedoh taovin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate akitolun, anithum chanin akhopihou alhung taovin ahi. Tun akhopihou chu Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth chule Kirjath-jearim ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin mipi kikhomho pipuiho Pakai Israel Pathen minna akihahsel tahjeh-un, Israel chaten amaho chu asumang tapouve. Chuin houkhom ho jouse chu pipuiho chunga chun aphuntaove."},"19":{"text":"Ahinla pipuiho jousen houkhom hojouse henga, tonsot Pakai Pathen minna ahenguva kihahsela akihitai. Hijeh chun tun eihon amaho itohkhah theilou diu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Eihon amaho chunga hitihin boluhite, eiho amaho chunga ina kihahsel taovin, amahohi ihinghoi teidiu ahi. Achutiloule ichunguva lunghana hunglhung getninte."},"21":{"text":"Chuin pipuiho chun amaho chu hinghoijun atiuvin, ahin pipuiho kitepna bangin mipi kikhomho dingin thingpo twikhaijin panguhen atiuve."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n amaho chu akouvin, ajah uva, kalah uva cheng hiuva, ipidia nangho-a kona gamlatah-a chenga kahiuve tia neijoulhep muham? ati."},"23":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun nangho gaosap changa nahitaove. Soh nahinaole Pathen in dinga thingpole, twikhailea napan naova kona khatcha jong ongthol naum lou dingu ahi, tin aseitan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin amahon Joshua chu adonbutnun, Pakai na Pathen'in asoh Mosi henga hiche gam jouse nangma pehdinga thu napeh chule acheng jousehi namasanga nasuhgam ding ahi ti soh hohin kichentah-in eina hilui. Nangho jeh-in kahinkhouhi suhmanga aumdinghi kakicha behsetnun, hiti ahi kana bollu ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Chule tun vetan, keihohi nakhutna um kahiuvin, kachunguva boldingin aphai, adih-e, natichu boljengin, atiuve."},"26":{"text":"Chuin hitichun aman amaho chu abolin Israel chate khutna konin ahuhdoh un, amaho chu athat tapouve."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n hiche nikho chun amaho chu houkhom ho Pakai maichama dinga thingpole twikhaija alhendohna mun'a chun tuni geijin, apansahtan ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun ahitin ahi, Jerusalem lengpa Adonizedek'in Joshua'n Ai kho alah a asuhmanghela Jericho khopi le alengpa asuhmang banga Ai khole alengpa abol chule Gibeon'a chenghon Israel toh kichamna asemuva alah uva aum ajah phatchun,","title":"Amor Mite Chunga Galjona"},"2":{"text":"Akichalheh jengun, ajehchu Gibeon hi lengte khopiho khat banga khopi lenkhat ahin, hichu Ai kho sangin jong alenjon asunga chengjouse hattah ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun Jerusalem lengpa Adonizedek chun Hebron lengpa Hoham le Jarmuth lengpa Piram chule Lachish lengpa Japhia chule Eglon lengpa Debir henga mi asolin,"},"4":{"text":"Hungun lang eihung kithopiuvin, Gibeon sumangu hite. Ajehchu Joshua le Israel chatetoh kichamna asemtaove, ati."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun, Amor te leng ngaho: Jerusalem leng, Hebron leng, Jarmuth leng, Lachish leng chule Eglon leng akikhom khomun, amahole asepai janel jouse akontouvun, Gibeon koma gebuh asemun, akisatpi taove."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Gibeon mihochun Gilgal gebuh-a Joshua henga mi asolun, nasohte-a dingin nakhut lhang thase hih-in. Kahenguva hungtou loijinglang nei hung kithopiuvin, neihuhhing jengun ati. Ajehchu thinglhanga cheng Amor te lengho jouse keiho doudin akikhom taove."},"7":{"text":"Chutichun Joshua Gilgal'a konchun amale agalsatmi jouse, mihat mihangho jouse chu akontou taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua henga amaho chu kicha hihbeh-in, amaho chu nakhutna kapehdoh nahitai, namasanga miho khatcha dingjou louding ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun hetman louvin Joshua Gilgal'a konin ahenguva jankhovah in achetouvin, ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin amaho chu Israelte masanga chun amaimoh sah-in, chule Gibeon'a chun mitamtah athatnun ahi. Bethhoron jottouna lampi lhungkeijin adeltaovin, Azekah le Makkedah geijin agathatnun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Israelte masanga ajammuva Beth-horon lama achesuh petnun, Pakaiyin Azekah geijin van'a konin achunguva gel len tahtah alhahsah in athiuvin ahi. Israel chaten chemjam'a atha sangun gel selih chu atamjon ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakaiyin Amor mite chu Israelte khutna apehdoh nichun Joshua'n Pakai jah-a, hitin aseijin, Israel chate mitmun; Nisa nangma Gibeon chunga dingdenin, chule lha jong Aijalon damjola dingdenin, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin mipi chun amelmateu chunga phu alahjou masang seochun nisa chu adingden tan, chule lhajong chu aumden tai, hiche hi Jasher lekhabua kisuna hilouham? Hitichun vantham jola nisa ading denin, nikhat lhumkei tobang lhumvah louvin aumin ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 1:18"},"14":{"text":"Chule chuche masang ahiloule chuche nungin jong chutabong nikho, Pakaiyin mihem khat aw angaipehna aumkhapoi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin Israelte dinga gal anasat ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Joshua le aumkhompi Israel jouse Gilgal gebuh a akilekit taove."},"16":{"text":"Ahin chuche leng ngaho chu ajamun Makkedah songkoa akisel taove."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Joshua henga hiche leng ngaho chu Mekkedah songko khatna akiseluve, tin ahungseipeh taove."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n songko kotna chun song len tahtah tanglut unlang amaho ngahtup din mi koijun ati."},"19":{"text":"Chule nangho umden louvin, nagalmiteo nungdelun, chule amaho lah-a anungthop ho geijin thatnun amaho akhopi houva lutsah hih-un. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in amaho chu nakhut uva apehdoh ahitai, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Joshua le Israel chaten amaho chu asuhmanghel nadiuvin hathan athatnun, amoh chengchu kul kikai khum khopiho-a chun aluttaovin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin mijouse chu Mekkedah gebuh a Joshua henga lung mongtah-in akileuvin ahi. Koiman Israel chate chung kitimong monga akam akeh tapouve."},"22":{"text":"Hiche jouchun Joshua'n songkotkhah chu hongunlang leng ngaho chu kahenga hinpuijun, atin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin chutichun abolun songkoa konchun leng ngaho Jerusalem lengpa, Hebron lengpa, Jarmuth lengpa, Lachish lengpa chule Eglon lengpa chu ahenga ahinpui taove."},"24":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, hiche lengho chu Joshua henga ahinpui phatnun, Joshua'n Israel mipi jouse chu akouvin, amatoh kilhon galmi lamkaiho jouse jah-achun hung naijun lang hiche lengho ngong nakengun chonun ati. Chuin amaho ahung naijun amaho ngong chu akenguva achon taove."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n ajah uva, kicha hih-un, lungjong lunglha hih-un, hatnunlang hangsan uvin ati. Ajehchu Pakaiyin nakisatpiu namelma teu jouse chu hitia chu abolding ahi, ati."},"26":{"text":"Chule hiche jouchun Joshua'n amahochu asatnin, athatnin thingphung nga chunga akhaijin ahi. Chule amahochu thingchunga nilhah geijin akhaijun ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin nilhum dingkonin ahitin ahi, Joshua'n thu apen, amahochu thingleh-a konchun alalhauvin, akiselnao songkoa chun alehlutnun ahi. Songho chu song lenpipin asingun, hichu tunigeijin jong aumnalaije."},"28":{"text":"Chuin chuche nichun Joshua'n Makkedah chu alan, hichu chemjamin asumangin, mihing jouse asugamhelin khatcha jong ahinghoipoi. Chule Jericho lengpa chunga anabol bangchun Makkedah lengpa chunga jong aboltai."},"29":{"text":"Chujouvin Joshua'n aumpi Israel chate jousetoh Makkedah'a patnin Libnah lama acheuvin, Libnah chu asat taove."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Libnah le alengpa chu Israelte khutna apedoh-in, asunga cheng miho jouse chemjamin athat gamin, khatcha jong ahinghoipoi. Chutichun Jericho lengpa abolna bang chun chuche lengpa jong chu aboltan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n Libnah'a konin aumpi Israel jousetoh Lachish'a acheuvin, chuin gebuh asongun asattaove."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Lachish chu Israelte khutna apedoh-in, hichu nini channin alan ahi. Libnah anabolna jouse bangchun akhopile asunga cheng mihing jouse chu chemjamin asumangtai."},"33":{"text":"Chujouchun Gezer leng Horam chu Lachish kithopi dingchun ahung touvin ahile, Joshua'n amale amite chu khatcha khen neilou helin athatgamtai."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Lachish'a konin aumpi Israel jousetoh Joshua chu Eglon'a acheuvin, gebuh asongun asat taove."},"35":{"text":"Chuin chuche nichun amahon alauvin, chule asunga mihing umjouse chu chemjamin asatnun, hiche nikho mama chun Lachish abolna bangun athatgam heltai."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Joshua chu aumpi Israel jousetoh Eglon'a konin acheuvin Hebron ho chu asat taove."},"37":{"text":"Chule amahon hichu alauvin, Eglon anabolna jouse bang chun, Hebron le alengpa aumpi jousele, asunga cheng mihing jouse chu chemjamin athatgam heltan ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chuin aumpi Israel jousetoh Joshua Debir lama acheuvin, asatnun,"},"39":{"text":"Aman Debir le alengpa chule khopi jouse chu alan, chule amahon amahochu chemjamin asatnun, asunga cheng mihing jouse chu athatnun, khatcha ahinghoi pouve. Hebron abolna bangle Libnah le alengpa abolna bangchun Debir le alengpa jongchu aboltan ahi."},"40":{"text":"Hitichun Joshua'n lhanglam gam hihen agam pumpin, sim gamho phaigam chule twiputna chana lengte jouse chu asugam sohkeijin, Pakai Israel Pathen thupeh bangin khatcha khenlouvin, ahaithei jouse athat gamheltan ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chule Joshua'n Kadesh-barne'a pat Gazah channin, Goshen gam jouse toh Gibeon channin asumang heltan ahi."},"42":{"text":"Pakai Israel Pathen'in Israel dinga gal asat jeh-in, Joshua'n hiche lenghole agam jouseu chu khatvei lah-in alatai."},"43":{"text":"Chuin Joshua aumpi Israel jousetoh Gilgal gebuh-a chun ahung kilekit taove."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Hezor lengpa Jabin'in hicheho chu ajah phatnin, Madon lengpa Jobab, Shimrom lengpa chule Achshaph henga,","title":"Joshua'n Jabin Le Apanpiho Ajo"},"2":{"text":"chule sahlang thinglhang gamle Chinnereth lhanglam phaichamle dam chule lhumlam Dor gamgi-a cheng lengho henga,"},"3":{"text":"chule solamle lhumlama Kanaan mi, Amor mi, Hit mi, Perizz mi chule thinglhanga um Jebus mi chule Mizpeh gam Hermon noilam Hiv mite henga mi asoltan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule asepai jouseu toh mitampi atama tam, atam dannu chu luikama nel simsenlou jatjen sakol kangtalai tamtah toh akondoh taove."},"5":{"text":"Chuin hiche lengho jouse chu akisuhkhom phatnun Israel doudingin Merom twipanga gebuh asongkhom taove."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua henga, amaho jehchun kicha hih-in, ajehchu jing nikho tuphat donle amaho Israel masanga thagam dinga kapehdoh ding nahi. Nangman asakolu aja nabana akangtalaihou meija nahalvam ding ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun Joshua'n agalsat miho jousetoh amaho satdingin phulou helouvin Merom twilah-a chun ahungun, amaho chu anokhom taove."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin amahochu Israelte khutna apedoh-in, amahon amaho chu athatnun Zidon gei, Misrephoth-maim gei chule solam Mizpeh phaicham geijin adelun, khatcha khenlou helin athat gamtaove."},"9":{"text":"Chule Pakai thupeh bangchun Joshua'n amaho chunga abolin, asakolhou ja abanin, asakol kangtalai hou meijin ahalvamtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Joshua hichepet chun akinunglen, Hazor chu alan, alengpa chu chemjamin athat tai. Ajehchu chuche masang chun Hazor chu chuche lenggam jouse chunga alenpen anahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin chuche sunga um mihing jouse chu chemjamin athatnun, amaho chu asugam helun, khatcha ahinghoi pouve. Chule aman Hazor chu meijin ahal lhatai."},"12":{"text":"Chuin chugama lengho khopi jousele alengteu jouse chu Joshua'n amanin chemjamin athat tai. Chule Pakai soh Mosi'n athupeh bangin amaho chu asumang heltai."},"13":{"text":"Ahinla Joshua'n anahallhah Hazor seh tilouvin molvum'a dingjing khopiho chu Israel ten khatcha anahal lhapouve."},"14":{"text":"Chuin chuche khopiho-a thilkichom jousele ganchaho chu Israel chaten galla kichom thilin akilah-un ahi. Ahivangin amahon amitakip asuhmang tokahseovin chemjamin athatnun khatcha jong ahinghoi pouve."},"15":{"text":"Pakaiyin asoh Mosi henga thu anapeh bangin Mosi'n Joshua koma thu anapen, chutobangma chun Joshua'n abolin Pakaiyin Mosi thu anapeh jouse chu bolouva akhen khatcha aumpoi."},"16":{"text":"Chutichun Joshua'n chuche gam jouse thinglhang gamho, lhanglam gamkai jousele Goshen gam jouse, phaichamle phaitong jouse chule Israel molle chuche molsanga damjol jouse alan,","title":"Joshua'n Gam alah ho"},"17":{"text":"Seir lhang geija kikhotou Halak molsanga pat Hermon mol noilam Lebanon phaichama um Baalgad chan geijin alahpeh-in, alengho jouse amanin asatnin athatgamtan, ahi."},"18":{"text":"Joshua'n chuche lengho chu phat sottah anakidoupin, ahi."},"19":{"text":"Gibeon'a cheng Hiv miteho tailou Israel chate toh kichamna sema khopi khatcha jong aumpoi. Adang jouse galla chu alah ngenchangu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin Mosi anathupeh bangin aman amahochu lungsetna beihela asuhmanghel theina dinga, amahon Israel ahung kidoupina dinguva alungu kitahsah chu Pakaiya kon ahi.","ref":"Danb 7:16"},"21":{"text":"Chuin chuphat chun Joshua ahungin molsang ho-a konchun Hebron, Debir le Anaba konin Judah molsangho jouse-a konle Israel moljouse-a konin Anakim te chu athatnin, Joshua'n amaho chu akhopihou pumin asumang heltan, ahi."},"22":{"text":"Israelte gamsunga chun Anakim te khatcha thalouva kihinghoi aumtapoi. Gaza, Gath, chule Ashdod nabou aumtaove."},"23":{"text":"Chutichun Pakaiyin Mosi henga anasei jouse dungjuijin Joshua'n gampumpi chu alan ahi. Chuin Joshua'n amaho aphungu kikhen dungjuijin hichu alodiuvin Israelte apetan ahi. Chule agamchu galla konin akicholdotai."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun nisolam Jordan gal langkhat Arnon vapidunga kipat Hermon lhang gei, chule solam phaicham jouse Israel ten asuh manguva atouphao gama lengho chu hitehohi ahiuve.","title":"Mosi'n Anajo Lengho","ref":"Minb 21:21-35; Danb 2:26—3:11."},"2":{"text":"Heshbon'a cheng Amor mite lengpa Sihon, Arnon vapidung panga um Aroer'a pat, chule vapidung lailunga pat, Gilead gamsung kehkhatna pat, Ammon chate gamgia um Jabbok vapidung chan geipeh-a anavaihom,"},"3":{"text":"chule phaichama pat solama Chinnereth twipi geile Phaicham twipi gei Beth-jeshimoth jotna lampia solam chi twipi geipeh chule Ashdoth-pisgah noi lhanglama pat,"},"4":{"text":"Ashtaroth le Edrei'a cheng amoh ho lah-a Amoth Bashan lengpa Og gamsung,"},"5":{"text":"Chule Hermon lhanga Salcah a Bashan gam jouse, Geshur mitele Maachath mite chule Gilead gamgi kehkhat Heshbon lengpa Sihon Gamgi geijin vai anahome."},"6":{"text":"Amahochu Pakai soh Mosi le Israel chatehon anatha gamuva, chule Pakai soh Mosi'n Reuben te le Gad te chule Manasseh phung kehkhat-ho lodinga anapeh ahi.","ref":"Minb 32:33; Danb 3:12."},"7":{"text":"Chule Joshua to Israel chaten Jordan gal hilam lhumlamsanga atha gamu chuche lengho chu ahiuvin, agammu chu Lebanon phaicham Baalgad'apat Halak lhang, Seir geija kikhotou ahi. Hichehi Joshua'n kihop khen dungjuija alodiuva Israelte phungho anapeh gamhochu ahi.","title":"Josua'n Anajo Lengho"},"8":{"text":"Molsangho le damphai, phaichamle twinah ho-a chule gamthip gamle lhanglam gama Hit miho, Amor miho chule Kanaan miho, Perizz miho, Hiv miho chule Jebus miho gamchu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Jericho lengpa, khat; Bethel koma um Ai kho lengpa, khat;"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem lengpa, khat; Hebron lengpa, khat;"},"11":{"text":"Jarmuth lengpa, khat; Lachish lengpa, khat;"},"12":{"text":"Eglon lengpa, khat; Gezer lengpa, khat;"},"13":{"text":"Debir lengpa, khat; Geder lengpa, khat;"},"14":{"text":"Hormah lengpa, khat; Arad lengpa, khat;"},"15":{"text":"Libnah lengpa, khat; Adullam lengpa, khat;"},"16":{"text":"Makkedah lengpa, khat; Bethel lengpa, khat;"},"17":{"text":"Tappuah lengpa, khat; Hapher lengpa, khat;"},"18":{"text":"Aphek lengpa, khat; Lasharon lengpa, khat;"},"19":{"text":"Madon lengpa, khat; Hazor lengpa, khat;"},"20":{"text":"Shimronmeron lengpa, khat; Achshaph lengpa, khat;"},"21":{"text":"Taanach lengpa, khat; Megiddo lengpa, khat;"},"22":{"text":"Kadesh lengpa, khat; Karmel gam Jokneam lengpa, khat;"},"23":{"text":"Dor panga Dor lengpa, khat; Gilgal nam miho lengpa, khat;"},"24":{"text":"Tirzah lengpa, khat; Lengho jouse abonchauvin somthumle khat ahiuve."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Joshua chu ateh-in, akumjong atamlheh tan, chule Pakaiyin ajah-a nangla natehkem tan, nakum atamlhehtan, gamtamtah lahding aumnalaijin ahi, ati.","title":"Gam Lahdinga Kivat Nalaiho"},"2":{"text":"Lahmoh chu hiche gamhohi ahi. Philistine le Geshur gamgichin jouse,"},"3":{"text":"Egypt masanga um Shihora pat sahlam Kanaan mihon atouphao Ekron gamgidung geija umho, Philistine te leng ngaho, Gazeth te Ashdod te, Eshkalon ho, Gitt ho, Ekron ho chule Avi te jong ahiuve,"},"4":{"text":"Lhanglama Kanaan miho gam jouse chule Sidon miho koma um Meareh apat Aphek lama Amor miho gamgi changei,"},"5":{"text":"chule Gibli miho gamle Lebanon pumpi, nisolam sanga, Hermon lhangnoija Baal-gad'apat Hamath lutna changei ahi."},"6":{"text":"Lebanon'apat Misrephoth-maim changei, thinglhang gam cheng jousele amaho chu Israel chate masanga kona kadeldoh ding ahi. Sidon miho jouse, nangma kathupeh bangchun vangvet na-a konin Israel chate henga achenna diuvin ahoppeh poupouvin ahi.","ref":"Minb 33:54"},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun hiche gamhi phung ko hole Manasseh phung kehkhat ho henga agoulo diuvin hoppeh-in ati."},"8":{"text":"Amaho chutoh Reuben te le Gad te chun Jordan sahlama achan dinguva Mosi'n anapeh chu anakisan taovin, Pakai soh Mosi amatah-in anapeh bang ngeichu ahi.","title":"Jordan Solamsanga Gam Kihop","ref":"Minb 32:33; Danb 3:12."},"9":{"text":"Arnon vapidung panga um, Aroer le vadung lailunga um khopi medeba phaicham jouse-a pat Dibon changei,"},"10":{"text":"chule Heshbon'a lengchang Sihon, Amor mite lengpa khopi jouse Ammon chate gamgi gei,"},"11":{"text":"chule Gilead le Geshur mite chule Maachath'te gamgisungho leh Hermon lhang pumpi chule Bashan pumpi Salcah changei,"},"12":{"text":"Milen mihat amoh umnalai, Ashtaroth le Edrei leng Bashan na Og lenggam jouse, hicheho jeh-a hi Mosi'n amaho ana douva anadeldoh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin Israel chatehon anadeldoh pouve. Geshur mite ahilou jongle Maachath mite, Geshur mitele Maachath mitechu tuni geijin Israelte lah-a acheng nalai juve."},"14":{"text":"Aman amaho koma ana seibang chun, Levi phunga miho vangchu chenna ding gam ana kipepoi. Israel Pakai Pathen'a dinga meija kigou ganlhainaho bouchu amaho gou ahi.","ref":"Danb 18:1."},"15":{"text":"Chule Mosi'n Reuben chateho chu a-insungu dungjui cheh in chenna ding gam anapei.","title":"Reuben Phung Chandinga Kipe Gamsung"},"16":{"text":"Chule amaho gamding chu Arnon luipanga um Aroer'apat chule alailunga um khopilen Medeba phaicham jouse jong ahi."},"17":{"text":"Heshbon chule phaichama um akhopilen hochu Dibon le Bamoth-baal chule Beth-baal-meon,"},"18":{"text":"chule Jahezah le Kedemoth chule Mephaath,"},"19":{"text":"chule damjolla um lhang chunga Kirjathaim le Sibnah chule Zareth-shahar,"},"20":{"text":"chule Beth-peor le Ashdoth-pisgah chule Beth-jeshimoth,"},"21":{"text":"chule phaichama um khopilen jouse Heshbonna leng Amor mite lengpa Sihon lenggam jouse Mosi'n Midia ho leng chapa jousetoh anathakhom, Evi, Rekan, Zur chule Reba chuche gama cheng Sihon leng noidouho chu ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Beor chapa Balaam doithempa jong chu Israel chaten midang atha nalah uva chun chemjamin anatha thaovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Reuben chateho gamgi chu Jordan le anaivelse chu ahi. Hiche khopihole khohohi Reuben chate a-insungu dungjuija achenna dinguva alou gam chu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule Mosi'n Gad phunga Gad chateho ngeichu, a-insungu dungjuijin achenna dingu gam anapen, ahi.","title":"Gad Phung Chandinga Kipe Gamsung"},"25":{"text":"Chule agamsunga chu Jazer le Gilead khopilenho jouse, Ammon chateho gam akehkhat Aroer geile masanga Rabbah changei ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule Heshbon'a pat Ramath-mizpeh le Betonim chule Mahanaim apat Dabir gamgi gei ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule damjol Beth-aram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth chule Zephon, Heshbon lengpa Sihon lenggam sunga amoh jouse Jordan le agamsung, Chinnereth twikhanglen pamchin geija gal langkhat Jordan solam chan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hichehi Gad chate a-insung dungjuija agoulo dinguva kigotpeh khopilen hole akhoneoho chu ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n Manasseh phung kehkhat chu alodiu gam anapei. Chule hichehi Manasseh chate phung kehkhatnin a-insungu dungjui cheh a analo chu ahi.","title":"Solam Sanga Manasseh Phung Chandinga Kipe Gamsung"},"30":{"text":"Chule hiche Mahanaim apat, Bashan pumpi gamsung Bashan leng Og gam jousele Bashan gama Jair khopi jousetoh, hichu khopilen somgup ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule Gilead gam kehkhat le Ashtaroth chule Edrei Bashan Og lenggam khopi lenho Manasseh chapa Machir chateho-a ahin, Machir chatedia a-insungu dungjui cheh a kigotpeh ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hichehohi Moab phaicham ho-a, Jordan gal langkhatna Jericho solam sanga Mosi'n achenna diuva ana hoppeh gamho chu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Ahinla Mosi'n Levi phung chu goulo gam khatcha anapepoi. Ahenguva ana seibangin, Israel Pakai Pathen chu agoulou ahijenge.","ref":"Minb 18:20; Danb 18:2"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule hiche gamhohi Israel chaten Kanaan gam alonao gamho chu ahin, Eleazar thempule Nun chapa Joshua, chule Israel phungho pate lamkaihon alo diuva anahoppeh-u ahi.","title":"Jordan Lhumlam Sanga Gam Kihop"},"2":{"text":"Pakaiyin Mosi khutna thu anapeh banga, phung ko le akehkhat dinga vang asanuva analou ahi","ref":"Minb 26:52-56; 34:12"},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu Mosi'n Jordan gal langkhatna chu phung nile phung kehkhat ho chu achen nadiu anapeh ahitai. Levi te goulo ding khatcha anapepon ahi.","ref":"Minb 32:33; 34:14-15; Danb 3:12-17"},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Joseph chate chu phungni, Manasseh le Ephraim ahin, hijeh chun Levi ho chu achen nadiu khopilen hole khopamvel ganlhat lena ding munle anachenau inmun tilou chu anape pouve."},"5":{"text":"Pakaiyin Mosi thu anapeh bangchun Israel chateho jong hiti chun anaboluvin gamchu ana kihom uve."},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin Gilgal'a Joshua henga chun Judah chate ahungun, chule Kenimi Jephunneh chapa Kaleb chun ahenga, Pathen mi Mosi henga Pakaiyin keimale nangma chungchang Kadesh-barnea'a aseichu nahenai, ati.","title":"Hebron chu Kaleb Kipe ahi","ref":"Minb 14:30."},"7":{"text":"Pakai soh Mosi'n Kadesh-barnea'a kona gam velhi dinga eisol chun kum somlia upa kahitan, kalung ngaito bangin ahenga thu kalhut kitne.","ref":"Minb 13:1-30"},"8":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin, kalhonpi kasopiho chun mipilung ajunlhah sah-un, kenvang Pakai ka Pathen chu kajuilhum keije."},"9":{"text":"Chule hicheni chun Mosi akihahselin, nangin Pakai ka Pathen najui lhumkei jeh-in, nakengin achotphah gamchu a-itih a nangmale nachate goulo gam hiding ahi, ati.","ref":"Minb 14:24"},"10":{"text":"Chule tun vetan, Israel chate gamthipma avavei laijuva Mosi henga Pakaiyin hiche thuhi Mosi henga anaseija patchun hiche kum somli le kum nga hi aseibangin Pakai chun eina hinghoijin chule tun vetan, tunin keima kum somget le kum nga kahitai."},"11":{"text":"Mosi'n eina solni-a bangchun tuni geijin kahat jing nalaije. Galkon nale lhunkit theina jenga jong chupetna kathahatna bang ngeichun tunjong katha ahat jing nalaije."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun chuche ni-a Pakaiyin anasei bangin, hiche molsangho neipetan ati. Ajehchu nangman chuche laichun Anakim miho chutobanga akhopilen nasatah tahho kulpi kiget khum ahiuchu najatai. Chutia Pakaiyin ei umpile Pakai seibanga keiman amaho chu kadeldoh ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n amachu phatthei aboh-in, chule Hebron chu Jephunneh chapa Kaleb chu alodingin apetai."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun Aman Pakai Israel Pathen chu ajuilhumkei jeh-in, Hebron chu tunigeijin Kenizz mi Jephunneh chapa Kaleb goulo gam ahunghitai."},"15":{"text":"Chule Hebron minhi masangin Kirjath-arba anahin, hiche Arba chu Anakim miho lah-a milentah anahi. Chule agam chu galla konin akicholnga tai."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin hichehi Judah phungmi chateho insungho vangsan na-a kona achanu chu ahi. Lhanglam sanga atonungpen Zin gamthip gamgi Edom gamsung geichu ahi.","title":"Judah Vang sanna Kipe Gamgi"},"2":{"text":"Chule noilama agamgi chu chituipi pamchina pat ahin, twipama kona gah suhvetna lhanglam sang chu ahin,"},"3":{"text":"chule lhanglam ngan Mealeh-acrabbin jonnin akikhosuh-in, Zin lam ajuipeh-in, lhanglam panga Kadesh-barnea geijin akikhotouvin, Hezron jonna achen, Adar geijin achen chule Karkea vella akiheitai."},"4":{"text":"Chua konin Azmon lam ajonin, Egypt luipi lama akikhotouvin, hichu vapidunga akikholutnin, hichu lhanglam sanga nagamgi ngahna hiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule solam gamgi chu chi twipi gei ahin, Jordan kichaina gei, chule sahlama gamgi chu twininglut Jordan sodohna chu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule gamgi chu Beth-hoglah'a achetoupeh-in, Beth-arabah sahlama achepeh-in, chule gamgi chu Reuben chapa Bohan songphung geijin akikhotou peh-in,"},"7":{"text":"chule gamgi chu Achor damjolla patna Debir lama akikho toupeh-in, chutimachun sahlama Gilgal lam gahvetna vapidung lhanglam sanga um Adummin jottouna masang chu ahi. Chule gamgi ngahna chu Enshemesh twiho lamsanga akikhopeh-in, chua kona kikhodoh chu Enrogel geipeh ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule gamgi chu Hinnom chapa gom'ah akikho touvin, Jabush miho lhanglam gamgi geipehchu agasun, hichu Jerusalem ahi. Chule gamgi chu Hinnom lhumlam gom masanga molvum geipeh chun akikhotouvin, hichu mihat ho umna chunglama damjol monglha sahlama uma ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule gamgi chu lhangvuma kona Nephtoah twinah geijah achesah-in Kirjath-jearim kiti Baalah lama chu kikaipeh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule gamgi chun Baalah lhumlam sanga patna Seir lhang geija chu agah kolkhum peh-a, Jearim lhang panglam ahopeh, hichu sahlama Chesalon ahin Beth-shemesh'a chesuh-a Timnah geija ajotpeh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule gamgi chu Ekron pang sahlam sanga kikho-a, chule gamgi chu Shicron geija kikhanga, Baalah mollam ajotpeh-a, Jabneel geija kikho-a, chule akondohna gamgi chu twikhanglen chu hija ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Chule lhumlam gamgi chu twipilen le apangchingei ahin, hichehi Judah chate insung dungjuija agam hopmu chu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule Jephunneh chapa Kaleb henga chun, Joshua henga Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Judah chate lah-a chan khat Anak pa khopi Arba Hebron kiti khopi jengjong chu apen ahi.","title":"Kaleb'in Hebron Le Debir Alah (Thutn 1:11-15)","ref":"Thutn 1:20."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Kaleb'in Anak chapa thum Sheshai, Ahiman, chule Talmai, Anak chate chu adeldoh-in,"},"15":{"text":"chuin ama chua konchun Debir'a chengho henga achetouvin, chule Debir hi masang laijin Kirjath-sepher anakitin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Kaleb'in Kirjath-espher sumanga, agajou theija chu kachanu Achsah hi ajidinga kapeh ding ahi, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Kaleb sopipa Kenaz chapa Othniel'in hichu alatan, aman achanu Achsah chu ajidingin apetan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, aheng agalhun chun apa henga lou thumdingin ajolin ahi. Chuin amanu a-sangan chunga akumlhan, Kaleb'in amanu jah-a, ipi nadeijem? ati."},"19":{"text":"Aman adonbutnin vang neiboh-in, ajehchu nangman lhanglam gam neipetan, twinah neiho neipehthan ati. Chuin aman sahlama twinahhole lhanglam twinahho chu apetai."},"20":{"text":"Hichehi Judah chate phung a-insung dungjuija goulo gam ahi.","title":"Judah Khopiho"},"21":{"text":"Chule Judah chate phung khopilenho Edom gamgi lamsanga lhanglam sanga gam monglha penho chu Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,"},"22":{"text":"chule Kinah, Dimonah chule Adadah,"},"23":{"text":"chule Kadesh, Hazorle Ithnan,"},"24":{"text":"Ziph, Telam, Bealot,"},"25":{"text":"chule Hazor, Hadattah, Kerioth, Hezron, hichu Hazor,"},"26":{"text":"Amam, Shema le Moladah,"},"27":{"text":"chule Hazargaddah, Hashmonle Bethpelet,"},"28":{"text":"chule Hazar-shual, Beer-sheba le Bizjothjah,"},"29":{"text":"Baalah le Ijim le Azem,"},"30":{"text":"chule Eltolad le Chesil le Hormah,"},"31":{"text":"chule Ziklag le Madmannaah le Sansannah,"},"32":{"text":"chule Lebaoth le Shilhim, A-in le Rimmon khopi lenho jouse chu somni le kole akhodang danghotoh,"},"33":{"text":"chule phaichama chun Eshtaol, Zorah le Ashnah,"},"34":{"text":"chule Zanoah, Engannim, Tappuah le Enam,"},"35":{"text":"Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh le Azekah,"},"36":{"text":"chule Sharaim chule Adithaim, Gederah chule Gederothaim, khopilen somleli le akho dangdang hotoh,"},"37":{"text":"Senan, Hasashah le Migdalgad,"},"38":{"text":"chule Dilean le Mizpeh le Joktheel,"},"39":{"text":"Lachish, Bozkath le Eglon,"},"40":{"text":"chule Kabbon, Lahmam le Kithlish,"},"41":{"text":"chule Gederoth, Bethdagon, Naamah, Makkedah, khopilen somlegup le akho dang dang hotoh,"},"42":{"text":"Libnah, Ether le Ashan,"},"43":{"text":"chule Jiphtah le Ashnah le Nezib,"},"44":{"text":"chule Keilah, Achzib le Mareshah khopilen ko le akho dang dang hotoh,"},"45":{"text":"Ekron khopilen le akhodang dang hotoh,"},"46":{"text":"Ekron'a pat twikhanglen chanpeh Ashdod naija umjouse, akhodang dang hotoh,"},"47":{"text":"Ashdod le akhopi hole akhodang danghou, chule akhodang dangho Egypt vapidung le twipilen chule chuche gamgi ngahna changei."},"48":{"text":"Chule thinglhang gama Shamir le Jattir le Sokoh,"},"49":{"text":"chule Dannah le Kirjath-sannah, Debir kiti jongchu ahi."},"50":{"text":"Chule Anab le Eshtemoh le Anim,"},"51":{"text":"chule Goshen, Holon chule Giloh, khopilen somlekhat le akhodang dang hotoh,"},"52":{"text":"Arab, Dumah le Eshean,"},"53":{"text":"chule Janum, Beth-tappuah le Aphekah,"},"54":{"text":"chule Humtah, Kirjath-arba hichu Hebron kiti ahin chule Zior khopi len ko hole akho dang dangho,"},"55":{"text":"Maon, Karmel, Ziph le Juttah,"},"56":{"text":"chule Jezreel le Jokdeam le Zanoah,"},"57":{"text":"Kain, Gibeah, Timnah, khopi somle kho dang dangho,"},"58":{"text":"Halhul, Beth-zur le Gedor,"},"59":{"text":"chule Maarath le Beth-anoth le Eltekon khopilen gupleh khodang dang hotoh,"},"60":{"text":"Kirjath-jearim kiti Kirjath-baal le Rabbah khopilen nile akhodang danghotoh,"},"61":{"text":"Gamthip machun Beth-arabah, Middin le Secacah,"},"62":{"text":"chule Nibshan chule chi khopi Engedi khopilen gup leh khoneo hotoh ahiuve."},"63":{"text":"Jerusalem'a cheng Jebus mite vangchu Judah chaten adeldoh joupouvin, hijeh chun Jebus mite chu tuni geijin Jerusalem'a Judah chate lah-a achenghal jinguvin ahi.","ref":"Thutn 1:21; 2 Sam 5:6; 1 Thusm 11:4."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Joseph chate vang chuhna chu, Jericho koma Jordan'a pat solama Jericho twi umnagei, Jericho a kipatna gamthip geija kikhotou Bethel mol pumpi chu ahi.","title":"Alhangpia Joseph Chate Gamgi"},"2":{"text":"Chule Bethel'a pat Luz geija akikhodoh in, Archi gamsung Ataroth geijin akikhopeh in, ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule lhumlam panga Japhleti mite gamgi Beth-horon lhang nemjo gamsung Gezer channin akikhosuh in, hichu twikhanglen'a alutnin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hitichun Joseph chate Manasseh le Ephraim'in agam chu alotaove."},"5":{"text":"Chule a-insungu dungjuijin Ephraim chate gamgi chu hitihi ahi. Solam sanga agoulou gamgi Ataroth-addar a pat Beth-horon sahlam gei ahi.","title":"Ephraim Mite Gamgi"},"6":{"text":"Chule gamgi chu twikhanglen sahlam sanga Michmethah geijin akikhodoh-in, chule solama Taanath-shiloh geijin ahung kikhodoh-in, hichu ajotpeh-in, solama Janoah chan akikho lhungpeh-in ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin hiche Janohah'a pat Ataroth le Naarah changei akikhosuh-in, Jericho ahopan chule Jordan'a akikholutne."},"8":{"text":"Gampumpi chu Tappuah konin lhumlam sanga Kanah vapidung geijin akilhungdoh-in, hichu twikhanglen'a akikholutne. Hichehi Ephraim chate phung a-insung dungjuijuva agoulou gamchu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule Manasseh chate goulah-a Ephraim chate goulo ding khopilen kikhendohho chu akhopilen jouseule akhodang dangho chu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule amahon Gezer'a cheng Kanaan miho chu ananodoh pouve. Hijeh chun Kanaan miho chu Ephraim mite lah-a tuni geijin achengun kai apeovin, ajenun ahi.","ref":"Thutn 1:29"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh phung dingin chan khat ana umin ahi, ajehchu ama Joseph cha masapen ahi. Gilead pa Manasseh chapa masapen Machir chu ahi. Hijeh chun ama galhat ahijeh-in Gilead le Bashan gama achenge, ajehchu amaho gal hat ahi.","title":"Manasseh Mite Gamgi"},"2":{"text":"A-insungu dungjuija Manasseh chilhah dangho Abiezer chate, Helek chate, Asriel chate, Shechem chate, Hepher chate chule Shemida chate dingin jong chan khat anaume. Amahohi a-insungu dungjuija Joseph chapa Manasseh chapate ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Ahinla Manasseh chapa Machir, Machir chapa Gilead chapa Hepher, Hepher chapa Zelophehad'in achanute tilou chapa aneipon, achanuteu minho chu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah le Tirzah ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin amahon Eliazer thempu, Nun chapa Joshua chule pipuiho ang ahin naijun kasopihou lah-a goulo eipehna dingun Pakaiyin Mosi thu anapeh ahi, agatiuve. Hijeh chun Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Joshua'n apateo sopiho lah-a agoulo dingu anapetan ahi.","ref":"Minb 27:1-7"},"5":{"text":"Hitichun Jordan gal langkhatna um Gilead le Bashan tilouvin Manasseh chu chan som achange."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu Manasseh chanuten achapate lah-a gou alo khomun, chule Manasseh chapa dangho chu Gilead achang taove."},"7":{"text":"Manasseh gamchu Ashera pat Michmethah changei ahin, Shechem masanga um agamgi chu lhanglam En-tappuah mite chenna gam geijin akikhosuh-in ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tun Tappuah gam Manasseh achangin, ahinla Manasseh gamgi chinna um Tappuah kho chu Ephraim chate-a ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin agamgi chu Kanah vapidung lhanglama chun akilhungsuh-in, hiche Ephriam khopiho chu Manasseh khopiho lah-a aumin, chule Manasseh gamgi ngahna jongchu vapidung sahlam pang ahin, chule twikhanglen changei ahi."},"10":{"text":"Lhanglam sang chu Ephraim ahin, sahlam gam chu Manasseh'a ahin, chule twikhanglen chu agamgi ahi. Chule sahlama Asher chule niso lama Issachar gamchan chu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Manasseh chu Issachar le Asher gama Beth-shean le akhopiho, Ibleam le akhopiho Dor'a chenghole akhopiho, Endorra chenghole akhopiho, Taanach a chenghole akhopiho, Negiddo'a chenghole akhopiho, agamhou thum geijin achangin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin Manasseh chapate chun chuche khopi lenho-a chengho chu anodoh joupouve. Hitichun Kanaan mite chu hiche gama chun achengden taove.","ref":"Thutn 1:27-28"},"13":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin ahitin ahi. Israel chate chu ahung hatdoh phatnun, amahon Kanaan mite chu kai apehsah-un, ahinla agama konin anodoh theng theipouve."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Joseph chaten Joshua jah-a, tunigeija Pakaiyin phatthei eiboh jeh uva mipi hijatpi kahiu henasa-a ibola kalodiu vang khat, chan khatsehbou neipeh uham, atiuve.","title":"Ephraim Mite Le Manasseh Phung Kehkhat Hon Gam athumbeu"},"15":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n amaho chu adonbutnin, nangho natamlheh uva Ephraim lhanga chu natehbehseh tah uva ahile, Perizz mitele milen mihat ho gamsunga gammang lama nangho chetouvun lang gakituhchai taovin, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Joseph chate chun thinglhang gamchu keiho-a dingin alhingpoi. Jangcham gama cheng Kanaan mite jousele Bethshean le khopiho chengse chule Jezreel damjola chenghon thih kangtalai anei cheh uve atiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n Joseph insung mite Ephraim le Manasseh henga, nangho mitamle thahat tahte nahiuvin chankhat sehbou chang pouvin nate,"},"18":{"text":"ahinla molsang hi nangho ding ahi, gammang ahijeh-in kivatchaijun lang, agamgijui chan chu nangho ding ahi. Kanaan mite chun thih kangtalai neijuhen hatlheh jongleu nanodoh dingu ahi tin aseipeh-e."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate kikhom pumpi chu Shiloh a akikhom khomun, chua chun houkhom ho houbuh atungdoh-un ahi. Chule amasanguva gamchu athunoijuva aumtai.","title":"Shiloh-a Houbuh Akitundoh Le Gam Kihop khen"},"2":{"text":"Chule Israel chate lah-a agou chanding muloulai phung sagi aum nalaijun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n Israel chate jah-a, Pakai napateu Pathen'in napeh-u gam galo ding chu itihchan nahsah louva na-umsahdiu ham?"},"4":{"text":"Nalah uva phungkhat cheh-a konin mi thum lhengdoh-un, chule keiman amaho kasola amaho kipat uva gamchu agachotnuva, alodiu dungjuija agasuh chetnuva kahenga hungkilekit dingu ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chule amahon hichu hop sagi-a ahopdiu, Judah lhanglam gamsunga umding, Joseph insungin sahlam gamsung alodiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hitichun gam umchan chu hopsagi-a photchetna nanei uva, Pakai i-Pathen'u anga nangho dinga vang kavetpeh theina dinga hiche photchetna chu kahenga nahin lhut dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla Levi miten nalah uva chan aneipouve, ajehchu Pakai thempu natoh chu amaho chan ahijenge. Chule Gad le Reuben chule Manasseh phung kehkhat vang chun Pakai lhacha Mosi'n apehnao gam Jordan gal solam chu alodiu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin mihochu akipat doh-un, achetauve ahi. Gam phochenna cheho chu Joshua'n thu apen, cheovin, gamchu gachonun, gapho chenun lang hiche Shiloh-a hi nangho dinga Pakai anga vang kavet theina dingin kahenga hung kile kitnun, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin mihochu acheuvin, gamchu agachon sohkeijun, khopilen hochu lekhabua asunlutnun, mun sagin akhenun ahi. Chule Shiloh lama chun alhonpiuvin Joshua henga ahungkile kitnun ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n Shiloh-a Pakai masanga amaho dingin vang asantan ahi. Chule chuachun Joshua'n gamchu Israel chate kihop khen dungjuijin ahoppehtan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Benjamin phung chilhah ho chan chu a-insung dungjuijin ahungdohtan, achandiu gamsung Judah chatele Joseph chate gam kikah chu ahung hikhatan ahi.","title":"Benjamin Gam Chan"},"12":{"text":"Chule Sahlama agamgiu chu Jordan'a pat sahlam sanga Jericho lhang panga akikho touvin, Lhumlam molla chun akikho lutnin, Beth-aven gamthipma akilhung lutnin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule gamgi chu chu-a konchun Luz lam, lhanglama Luz kiti Bethel lhang panga akikhon, hichu Beth-horon noilam lhanglam sanga Ataroth-adar lama achesuh-in,"},"14":{"text":"chuin agamgi chu chua konin akikhon Beth-horon toh akigalsai lhanglam sanga um molsanga pat twipilen ning chu lhum-lhanglam sanga akikho kimvelin, Judah chate khopi khat Kirjath-baal, Kirjath-jearim kiti chu ahi. Hichu nilhumlama agamgiu chu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule lhanglama agammu chu Kirjath-kearim monga kipat in agamgiu chu lhumlama akikhon Nephtoah twikulho-a akikholutnin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule agamgiu chu sahlama milen mihat ho damjola um Hinnom chapa jangcham masanga um molsanga akikho doh-in, lhanglam Jebus lhangpang Hinnom gom geijin akikhon Enrogel'a akikholutne."},"17":{"text":"Chule sahlama konin akikho kimvelin, Enshemesh-a akilhung lutnin, Adummin gam kentoh kigalsai Gelioth lama akilhungin chule Reuben chapa Bohan songphu-a akikholutne."},"18":{"text":"Chule Arabah sah lamsang toh kigalsaijin akilhungpeh in, chule Arabah'a ahung kilhunglhan,"},"19":{"text":"chuin agamgi chu Bethhoglah sahlam panga ahung kilhungin, chule gamgi akilhung doh hochu Jordan mong lhanglam chi twipi pang sahlama aumin, hichu lhanglam gamgi ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Jordan chu solam sanga gamgi ahi. A-insung dung juijin hiche gamgi jousehi Benjamin chate goulo ding chu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tun a-insungu dungjuija Benjamin chate phunga khopi lenho chu Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Keziz phaicham,"},"22":{"text":"chule Beth-arabah, Zemaraim le Bethel,"},"23":{"text":"chule Avim, Parah le Ophrah,"},"24":{"text":"chule Chephar-haammonai, Ophi le Geba khopilen somlenile akhoneo hotoh,"},"25":{"text":"Gibeon, Ramah le Beeroth,"},"26":{"text":"chule Mizpeh, Chephirah le Mozah,"},"27":{"text":"chule Rekem, Irpeel le Taralah,"},"28":{"text":"chule Zelah, Eleph chule Jebus hichu Jerusalem Gibeath le Kirjath ahin khopilen somleli le akhoneo hotoh ahi. A-insung dung juija Benjamin chaten alodingu chu ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin anivei channa vangvetna chu Simeon henga, a-insungu dungjuijin Simeon chate phung dingngei chun ahungdoh-in ahi. Chule agoulo chu Judah chate goulo sunga uma ahi.","title":"Simeon Gam Chan"},"2":{"text":"Chule amahon agoulo naova aneiju chu Beersheba ahiloule Sheba le Moladah,","ref":"1 Thusm 4:28-33"},"3":{"text":"chule Hazashul, Balah le Azem,"},"4":{"text":"chule Eltolad, Bethul le Hormah,"},"5":{"text":"chule Siklag, Beth-marcaboth le Hazar-susah,"},"6":{"text":"chule Beth-lebaoth, Sharuhen khopilen somlethum le akhoneoho,"},"7":{"text":"Ain, Remmon, Ether le Ashan, khopilen lile khoneoho,"},"8":{"text":"chule lhanglama Baalath-beer, Ramath geijin hiche khopi lenho kimvela khoneoho jouse chu ahi. Hichehi a-insung dungjuija Simeon chate phungho gam lo chu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Judah chateho chanding lah-a chu Simeon chate goulo uma ahin, ajehchu Judah chate chanchu amaho dinga lenbehseh ahin, hijeh-a chu Simeon chate goulo chu amaho goulo sunga chu aneiju ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin a-insungu dungjuijin vangvet thumna chu Zebulun chate chunga achutai. Chule agoulo gamgi chu Sarid chan ahi.","title":"Zebulun Gam Chan"},"11":{"text":"Chule agamgiu chu twipia Meralah lama akilhung touvin, Dabbashath alhungin, chule Jokneam masanga vapidung chu alhungin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Sarid na konin Chisloth-tabor gamsung geijin nisolam sanga akiheijin, chuin Cabarathna achedoh-in Japhia geijin achetouvin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule chua konin solam juijin Gittah-hepher le Ittah-kazin ajotpeh in, chule Remmon-mathoar'a Neah geijin achen,"},"14":{"text":"chule agamgi chun Hannathon sahlam akhokhelin, chule akilhungdoh hochu Jiphtah-el phaicham ageijin,"},"15":{"text":"chule Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron le Idalah chule Bethlehem khopilen somlenitoh khopineoho ahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Hiche khopilenle akhoneo hohi a-insungu dungjuija Zebulun chate goulo chu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin vangvet alina chu Issachar chunga, a-insungu dungjuijin Issachar chate dingin achutan ahi.","title":"Issachar Gam Chan"},"18":{"text":"Chule agamsung chu Jezreel lamsanga Chesulloth le Shunem,"},"19":{"text":"chule Hapharaim, Shihon le Anaharath,"},"20":{"text":"chule Rabbith, Kishon le Abez,"},"21":{"text":"Chule Remeth, Engannim, En-haddah le Beth-Pazzez,"},"22":{"text":"chule agamgi chu Tabor, Shahazimah le Beth-shemesh alhungin, chule agamgi ngahha kilhungdohho chu Jordan ageijin ahi. Khopilen somlegup le akhoneoho chu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Khopihole akhoneoho, a-insungu dungjuija Issachar chate goulo chu hichehi ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin vangvet a-nga channa chu a-insungu dungjuija Asher chate phung dingin ahungdoh tan ahi.","title":"Asher Gam Chan"},"25":{"text":"Chule agamgi ngahna chu Helkath, Hali, Reten le Achshaph,"},"26":{"text":"chule Allammalech, Amad, Mishal, lhumlama Karmel le Shihor-libnahth gei ahin,"},"27":{"text":"chule nisolam sanga Beth-dago na akiheijin, Zebulun alhungin, Jiphthah-el gom Beth-emek le Neiel sahlama achen, veilamsang Cabulla achedoh-in,"},"28":{"text":"chule Hebron, Rehod, Hammon le Kanah, Zidon len geijin jong,"},"29":{"text":"chujouvin agamgi chu Ramah-a akiheijin, khopidet Tyre le Hosah'a akiheijin, chule akilhungdoh ho chu Achzib geija konin twikhanglen chan alhunge."},"30":{"text":"Ummah jong, Aphek, Rehob, khopilen somnileni toh akhoneoho,"},"31":{"text":"Hiche khopihole akhohohi a-insung dungjuija Asher chate phungin alouchu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Vangvet gupvei channa chu a-insunga dungjuijin Naphtali chate dingin ahungdoh-in ahi.","title":"Nephtali Gam Chan"},"33":{"text":"Chuin agamgiu chu Heleph-a kon, Allon, Zaanannim, Adammi-nekeb, Jabneel, Lakum gei ahin, chule akilhungdoh ho chu Jordan geijin aumin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chukitnin agamgiu chu lhumlama Aznoth-tabor lama akiheijin, chua konin Hukkok alhungin, Zebulun lhanglam sang alhungin, chuin Asher lhumlam sanga achen, nisolam Jordan chunga Judah alhungin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chule kul kikhokhum khopiho chu Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath Chinnereth,"},"36":{"text":"chule Adamah, Ramah le Hezor,"},"37":{"text":"chule Kedesh, Edrei le Enhazor,"},"38":{"text":"chule Iron le Migdalel, Horam, Beth-anath le Beth-shemesh khopilen somleko le khoneoho,"},"39":{"text":"hiche khopihole khoneoho a-insung dungjuija Naphtali chate phung goulo chu ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chuin a-insung dungjuijin vangvetna sagina chu Dan chate dingin ahungdohtan,","title":"Dan Gam Chan"},"41":{"text":"chule alodingu agamsungu chu Zorah, Eshtaol le Ir-shemesh,"},"42":{"text":"chule Shaalabbin, Aijalon le Ithlah,"},"43":{"text":"chule Elon le Thimnathah le Ekron,"},"44":{"text":"chule Eltekeh le Gibbethhon le Baalath,"},"45":{"text":"chule Jehud le Bene-berak le Gathrimmon,"},"46":{"text":"chule Me-jarkon le Rakkon Japho naija gamgi ahi."},"47":{"text":"Chule Dan chate gamsung amaho dingin aneobehseh-in hijeh chun Dan chateho Leshem chate sat dingin akonun, chule ajouvun chemjamin athat gamun, chule gamchu alotaovin, achengun, Leshem chu apao min Dan alauvin Dan asah un ahi.","ref":"Thutn 18:27-29"},"48":{"text":"Hichehi akhopihole khoneohotoh a-insung dungjuijin Dan chate phungin gouva alodingu chu ahi."},"49":{"text":"Amahon gampumpi achanding dolcheh gamgi asekhennuva akihop jouphat un, Israel chaten alah uva Nun chapa Joshua chu agam loding apetaovin, ahi.","title":"Joshua Dinga Gam Kipeh"},"50":{"text":"Pakai thu dungjuijin aman athum Ephraim molla Timnath-serah geichun apeovin ahi. Chule aman khopilen chu asadoh-in chua chun achengtan ahi."},"51":{"text":"Hiche hohi agamlo dinguva Eleazar thempu le Nun Chapa Joshua, chule Israel chate aphunguva apa teovin, mipi ho houbuh kotpi phung, Pakai masang Siloh mun'a vangvet na-a agamlo dinguva ana hoppeh-u chu ahi. Hitihin amaho gamchu akihom jou taovin ahi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.","title":"Hoidohna ding Khopi Gup","ref":"Minb 35:6-32; Danb 4:41-43; 19:1-13."},"2":{"text":"Israel chate henga hitihin seijin, nanghon Mosi jah-a kasei bangin kiselna khopi lenho semmun ati."},"3":{"text":"Mikhatnin dihloutah a koiham khat atha-a ahile kiselna dinga hicheho chu nangho-a dinga thisan so-a phulading pa-a kona hoidohna hiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule hitia chu ama chutobang khopilenho khatna chu jamlutna, khopi kotpiphunga adina chule chuche khopi-a um upaho jah-a ajeh aseiphongleh, amahon amachu khopi sunga alah lutnuva mun apeh dingu, hiti achu amahotoh chengding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule thisan phulading pachun, ahin nungdela ahile amahon mithatpa chu ama khutna apehdoh loudingu ahi. Ajehchu aman aheng akom chu hotna nei masalouva tosoija atha ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule amachu mipi angsunga athu tandinga adin kahse-a chule hiche laija thempu chungnung thikahsea hiche khopi-a chu chengding ahi. Chutengle mithatpa chu ama khopilen ajamdohna khopi a-in'a chu kilekit ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule amahon Naphtali molla um Galilee'a Kadesh, Ephraim molla Schechem chule Hebron kiti Judah molla um Kirjath-arba chu alhengun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule Jericho solam Jordan gal langkhatna chun Reuben phungho lah-a phaicham gamthipma Bezer, Gad phungho lah-a Gilead'a Ramoth chule Manasseh phungho lah-a Bashan gama Golan apeovin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hichehohi Israel chate jousele alah uva khopem tosoija mithatchan chulama ajama thisan phulapa khutna kona athilouna dinga mipi ho masanga adin kahse-a akiselna dinga kilhengdoh khopiho chu ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Levi pateho luchangho chu Eleazar thempu heng, Nun chapa Joshua heng, Israel chate phung luchangho henga ahungun,","title":"Khopi Somleget Levi ho Kipeh"},"2":{"text":"chule amahon Kanaan gamsunga um Shiloh a amaho henga kachena dingun khopi lenho chule kagancha ho dingun akhovelho eipehtha dinguva Mosi henga Pakaiyin thu anapehsa ahitai atiuve.","ref":"Minb 35:1-8"},"3":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thupeh bangchun akhopilen houle akhoveluva ho jouse chu Israel chaten agoulouva konin Levi mite chandingin apeovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule Kohath te insung midingin vangvetna ahungdoh in, chule Aaron thempu chate amaho chu Levi mite ahiuvin, Judah phunga konle Simeon phunga konin chule Benjamin phunga konin khopilen somlethum vangvet na-a konin achangun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Kohath chate amoh chengse chun Ephraim phung insungho-a konle, Dan phunga konin chule Manasseh phung kehkhatna konin khopilen som vangvet na-a konin achang taovin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule Gershon chateho chun vangvet na-a konin Issachar phung insungho-a kon, Asher phunga kon, Naphtali phunga kon, chule Bashan'a um Manasseh phung akehkhatna konin khopilen somlethum achangun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Merari chaten a-insungu dungjuijin Reuben phunga kon, Gad phunga kon chule Zebulun phunga konin khopi somleni achangun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh dungjuijin khopilen hole akhovelho chu Israel chaten vangvet na-a konin Levi mite apetaovin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule amahon hichea amin kisei khopilenho hi Judah chate phunga konin Simeon chate phunga konin apedoh-un;"},"10":{"text":"Hichu Levi chate lah-a, Kohath Insunga kon Aaron chate chan chu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho chu vangvetna masapen changa ahiuve."},"11":{"text":"Chule amahon Judah thinglhang gama akhopi Hebron chu akimvela akhovelho pumin Anak pa Arba chu apetaovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahin khopilen loujaohole khoho vangchu Jephunneh chapa Kaleb lodingin apetaovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hitichun amahon Aaron thempupa chate chu mithat ho kisellutna khopilen hidingin, Hebron le akhovelho chule Libnah le akhovelho pumin,"},"14":{"text":"chule Jattir le akhovelho pumin Eshtemoa le akhoheng pumin,"},"15":{"text":"chule Holon le akhovelho pumin, Debir le akhovelho pumin,"},"16":{"text":"chule a-in le akhovelho pumin, Juttah le akhovelho pumin, Beth-shemesh le akhovelho pumin, phungnia konchun khopilen ko apetaovin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule Benjamin phunga konin Gibeon le akhovelho, Geba le akhovel ho,"},"18":{"text":"Anathoth le akhovelho chule Almon le akhovel hotoh khopilen li ahi."},"19":{"text":"Aaron thempu chate khopilen abonin akhovelho pumin somlethum ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Kohath chate insungho, Kohath chate amoh Levi ho chun, Ephraim phunga kona avang vetnuva kon amu-u khopilenho chu aneijun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon Ephraim lhanga Shechem le akhovelho pumpin, mitha-a kona hoidohna khopilen hidingin Gezer jong akhovelho pumin,"},"22":{"text":"Chule Kibzaim le akhovelho pumin, Beth-horon le akhovelho pumin, khopilen li amaho apeovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule Dan phunga kon Eltekeh le akhovelho pumin, Gibethon le akhovelho pumin,"},"24":{"text":"Aijalon le akhovelho pumin, Gathrimmon le akhovel ho pumin khopilen li ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule Manasseh phung kehkhatna kon Tanach le akhovel ho, chule Gathrimmon le akhovel ho pumin khopilen ni ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hiche kho jousele akhovelho jouse-a chenghi Kohath chate insung miho amohho dingchu khosom ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule Gershon chateho Levi phungho chu Manasseh phung kehkhat ho channa-a kon, mithat ho kisellutna khopi Bashan gama Golan chu akhovel hotoh Beesh-terah khole akhovel hotoh, khopilen ni apetaovin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule Issachar phunga konin Kishon le akhovel hotoh, Dabareth le akhovel hotoh,"},"29":{"text":"Jarmuth le akhovel hotoh, Engannim le akhovel hotoh, khopi li ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chule Asher phunga kon Mishal le akhovel hotoh, Abdon le akhovel hotoh,"},"31":{"text":"Helkath le akhovel hotoh, Rahob le akhovel hotoh khopilen li ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule Naphtali phunga konin Galilee sunga um Kedesh le akhovelho pumin, mithat ho kisellutna khopilen hidingin; chule Hammoth-dor le akhovelho pumin, Kartan le akhovelho pumin khopilen thum ahi."},"33":{"text":"Gershon mite insungho khopilen jousele akhovelho pumin, khopilen somlethum ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chule Zebulun phunga kon, Levi mite amohse Merari chate insungho henga Jokneam le akhovel hotoh, Kartah le akhovel hotoh,"},"35":{"text":"Dimnah le akhovelho pumin, Nahalal le akhovelho pumin khopilen li ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chule Reuben phunga konin Bezer le akhovel hotoh, Zehazag le akhovel hotoh,"},"37":{"text":"Kedemoth le akhovel hotoh, Mephaath le akhovel hotoh khopilen lima ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chule Gad phunga kon mithat ho hoidohna khopi Gilead gama Ramoth le akhovelho toh Mahanaim khole akhovel hotoh,"},"39":{"text":"Heshbon le akhovel hotoh, Jazer akhovel hotoh abona khopilen li ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chutichun Levi insungmi amohse Merari chate insung mihon vangvet na-a kona amu khopilen jouse chu somleni ahi."},"41":{"text":"Israel chaten alo sunga um Levi mite khopilen jouse chu akhovelho hop pummin somlileget ahi."},"42":{"text":"Hiche khopilenho hin akimvel aneisoh keijun; hiche khopi jouse chu chutabanga chu umcheh ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin apateo henga ana kihahsel nasa gamjouse chu Israel henga apetan, chuin amahon alovin chua acheng taovin ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Amaho Acholngahsah"},"44":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin apateo henga akihahsel dungjuijin, amaho akicholdosah tai. Chule amaho masanga amelmateu jouse apedohtai."},"45":{"text":"Pakaiyin Israel insung henga thupha aseichan chu athonna um umlouvin, aguilhung sohkeijin ahi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hichun Joshua'n Reuben mite, Gad mite Manasseh phung akehkhat akouvin,","title":"Joshua'n Phung Nile akeh Phatthei Aboh"},"2":{"text":"chule ahenguva, nanghon Pakai lhacha Mosi thupeh jouse nanit sohkeijun, chule kathupeh ka aw gin jouse chu nanit un ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nanghon nasopi ho ni hijatpihi, tuni geijin nadalha pouve. Amavang Pakai na Pathen'u thupeh chu nachingtup jingun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule amaho henga akitepna bangin tun Pakai na Pathen'un nasopi hou cholngahna apetan ahi. Hichejeh chun tun, nangho Jordan gal langkhat lama Pakaiyin asoh Mosi anapeh gama chun kile taovin."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai na Pathen'u ngailu dingle, alampi jouse jot dingle, athupeh ho juidingle, ama-a behjing dingle, nalhagao pumpiule nalungthimu pumpi-a jen dinga Pakai lhacha Mosi'n nathupeh-u danho tongdoh dingin chingtheijun, ati."},"6":{"text":"Hitichun Joshua'n amaho phatthei aboh-in, asoldohtai. Chule amaho aponbuh uva akile taovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tun Manasseh phung kehkhat chu Mosi in Bashan alodiuvin, anapen, ahivangin Joshua'n Jordan panga lhumlam sangchu asopite henga akehkhat chu apen ahi. Chuin Joshua'n amaho jongchu phatthei aboh-in aponbuh cheh uva asoldoh tan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule amaho henga, von tamtah toh thih sum-eng, sana, dangka, gancha tamtah toh gou tamtah pumin naponbuh uva kileovin, nagalteova nalah-u thilkichom nasopi houtoh kihom uvin, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Reuben chate Gad chate chule Manasseh phung akehkhat akileuvin, Mosi khutna Pakaiyin athupeh banga amahon alodingu gamchu, Gilead gama chenna dinga Shiloh kiti Kanaan gama Israel chate-a konin apotdoh-un ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin amahon Kanaan gamsunga um Jordan gamgi chin alhun phatnun, Reuben chate, Gad chatele Manasseh phung akeh in, Jordan pama vet dinga maicham khat asemun ahi.","title":"Maicham Asemuva Akilung nopmou"},"11":{"text":"Chuin Israel chaten ajah phatnun, veuvin, Reuben chate, Gad chatele Manasseh phung keh khatnin Israel lampi laija Kanaan gamtoh kigalsaija Jordan pama chun maicham khat asemuvin ahi, ti thu ajaove."},"12":{"text":"Hichu Israel chaten ajah phatnun, Israel chate abonchauvin amahotoh kidouva chedingin Shiloh a chun mipi akikhom taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chun Eleazar thempupa chapa Phinehas chu Gilead gamsunga um Reuben chate, Gad chate le Manasseh phung akehkhat henga chun asolun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule amaho chu Israel phung jouse lah-a inpi ngah cheh leng chapa som chule Israel asang asang lah-a apateo insunga a-upapen cheh ahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Chule amaho Gilead gama um Reuben chate Gad chatele Manasseh phung akeh khat henga ahungun amahotoh akihouvun aseijuve."},"16":{"text":"Pakai Mipi kikhomte chun hitin atiuve, Israel Pakai Pathen chunga ipi nasuhkhelu hitam, Pakai nung najuinaova kona nakihei mang jenguva, Pakai douna-a maicham nakitundoh jenguhi."},"17":{"text":"Peor'a chonsetna chu eiho dinga lhing loulai ham? Hiche-a kona chu eiho tuni geija thengloulai ihiuvin, hicheni chun Pakai mipite lah-a natset ana lengin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Amavang nangho tunia Pakai nung juina-a kona hi nakihei mang got teiteiju hitam? Tunia nanghon Pakai nadou ule jing nikhole Israel mipi chunga ama lunghana hung chuding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hitajengjongle, nalonao gamchu athenlouva ahile, Pakai lona gam Pakai houbuh umna keiholah-a hungcheng jengun, amavang Pakai dounale keiho douna-in Pakai i-Pathen'u maicham tilou maicham dang semhih-un."},"20":{"text":"Zarah chapa Achan'in sapset thil le suhkhel aneija kona, Israel mipikikhom chunga lunghana anachu-a hilouham? Chule hiche mipa chu ama khangitlou jeh-a achangseh-a thilouva hilou ham? atiuve.","ref":"Josh 7:1-26"},"21":{"text":"Chuin Reuben chate, Gad chate, chule Manasseh phung akeh khatnin adonbutnun, chule Israel asang asang luchangho henga aseijun"},"22":{"text":"Pakai, Pathen ho Pathen, Pakai Pathenho Pathen chun ahei, chule Israel honjong ahetdingu ahi, hichehi douna ahia, ahiloule Pakai douna-a suhkhel ahile, (tunin neihinghoi hih-un),"},"23":{"text":"Keihon Pakai nungjui na-a kona kihei mangna dinga maicham kasemuva, ahiloule achunga govam thilto katouva, chuche-a chu chamna thilto katouva ahileh Pakaiyin eiphulah-u hen."},"24":{"text":"Chule hiche kichatnajeh-a hiche chu kabollou-uleh, phat ahunglhun phatleh nachateovin kachateu henga, Israel Pakai Pathen chu ilonge nati uham? tia ahinsei theiju ahi."},"25":{"text":"Reuben chate, Gad chate, nanghole keiho kikah-a Pakaiyin Jordan hi gamgia asem ahin, nanghon Pakaiya chan naneipouve, atiuva, nachateovin, kachateu Pakai ginna asuhtang theidiu ginna-a kabolu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hichejeh chun keihon tun eiho govam thilto tona ding hilou, chule ganlhai thilto tona ding hilouvin maicham khat semdingin kigongu hite, katiuvin,"},"27":{"text":"ahinla keihon govam thilto le, kilhaina thilto chuleh chamna thilto hotoh Pakai anga kilhaina kaboluhi khonunga hungding ichateu dinga hettohsahna hung hiding ahi. Khonungle nachateovin kachateu henga nangho Pakaiya chan naneipouve, atilounadiu ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu keihon hung hitiding ahi katiuve, amahon keiho koma ahiloule khonungle kasonho koma aseitengule; Veovin kapu kapa teovin Pakai maicham lim kigong abollu chu govam thiltona ding ahipon, ganlhaina ding jong ahipoi. Amavang keihole nangho kikah-a hettohsahna ahi, tia keihon kaseipeh dingu ahi."},"29":{"text":"Keihon tunia Pakai kadou uva, ama-a kon kiheimanga, ahoubuh masanga um Pakai i-Pathen'u maicham tilouva govam thiltoho, nehding thilto ahilouleh ganlhaina ding dang kasem louhel dingu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Phinehas thempupa aumpihon Israel asang asang luchangho le mipi kikhomho vaipohon Reuben chate, Gad chate, Manasseh chaten aseiju chu ajah phatnun, alungu alhaitan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Eliazar thempupa chapa Phinehas chun Reuben chate, Gad chate, Manasseh chate henga, tuni hin keihon ilah uva Pakai aume ti kaheuve; ajeh chu Pakai douna-in suhkhel nabol pouvin ahi. Tun nanghon Pakai khutna konin Israel chate chu nahuhdoh taovin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule Eliazar thempu chapa Phinehas chun vaipoho Reuben chate, Gad chate umna Gilead gama konin Kanaan gam Israel chate henga, thu ahinpo taovin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule hicheho chun Israel asulunglhai lheh in, chule Israel chate chun Pathen avahchoi taovin ahi. Chule Reuben chate chenna gam suhmangna dinga galsatna cheding agotapouvin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Reuben chate, Gad chaten, maicham chu hettohsah asah-un ahi. Ajehchu hichehi eiho kah-a Pakai chu Pathen ahi ti melchihna hiding ahi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Israelte avelluva adou miho-a kona Pakaiyin choldona apehjou nungpeh-in, Joshua chu ateh lhehtan, chule akum atamin avoilhatan ahi.","title":"Joshua'n Lhahna Thu Asei"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n Israel jouse, a-upahou, aluchanghou, avaipohou, akouvin amaho henga keima katehtan, kakum jong atamtan ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'un nangho jeh-a hiche namho jouse chunga abol hojouse hi namuvin ahi. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u chu gal nasatpehpao chu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Veovin, keiman twipilen lhumlam gei jenga jong Jordan'a kona naphung houvin alotheina dinguva, keiman nam jouse kasuhmanga, hiche nam amoh ho chu vangvet na-a kahop peh-u nahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chule Pakai na Pathen'un na masang uva kona amaho anomanga, namitmuva kona akaidoh-a; Pakai na Pathen'u naheng uva akitepna banga chu nanghon agamu chu nalo dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu nangho jetlam ahiloule veilama nakiheile louna dinguva, lekha-a kisun Mosi danthu jouse jui dingle tongdoh dingin hangsanun."},"7":{"text":"Chule nangho lah-a umden namho lah-a chehih-un, a-pathen'u minjong pan hih-un; amaho mina kihahsel hih-un, jen jong jen hih-un, a-angsung uva jong bohkhup hih-un."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla tuni chana nabol bangun Pakai na Pathen'u chu kolchah jingun."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin namlenle namhat ho namasanguva adeldohtai. Ahin nangho dingin tunigeijin namasanguva koimacha adingjou pon,"},"10":{"text":"nalah uva mikhatnin mi sangkhat adelthei ahi. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un, nangho dinga ama kitepna banga gal nabolpeh-u ahi.","ref":"Danb 3:22; 32:30"},"11":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'u nangailut nadingun nangho nasatah-in kigingphaovin lang hiuvin."},"12":{"text":"Ahiloule nangho nakinung leuva, akidalha namho nalah uva cheng nalaiho hi nakivop piuva, amahotoh jilecha-a nakilah taouva, amahotoh nakiloi uva, amahon jong nakivop piuva ahile,"},"13":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'un leiset phatah napeh-u, hiche munna hi namanthah tokah seova amahochu nangho dinga thangle pel hiding, chule napangteni-a dinga kivohna mol, chule namit dinguva ling hunghijo ding ahi. Hijeh chun kihetchen uvin."},"14":{"text":"Chule veuvin, tunia keima leiset mijouse lampia chemang ding kahi, chule nalungsungu le nalhagao uvin naheuve. Pakai na-Pathen'un nangho chunga asei thilho chu thil khatjong athon aumpon ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu hung hitiding ahi, Pakai na Pathen'un nateppeh dungjui uva, thil jouse chu nangho dinga apha ahunglhun banga, Pakai na Pathen'un leiset phatah napehna uva kona nasuh manghel kahseuva Pakai na Pathen'un thilphalou jouse nachunga ahinlhun sah ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Aman nahenga nathupeh Pakai na Pathen thulhun, chu chonval tah-a nasuhkeh uva, nacheuva pathen dang naga jenuva, chule amaho anga nagabokhup-uleh, Pakai lunghanna chu hungkong jalintin, aman napeh-u gampha-a chu mangang tah-a namanthah dingu ahi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n Israel phung jouse Shechem'a akhomin, Israel upaho jouse phung bulpiho athutanhou, avaipohou jouse akouvin chule amaho Pathen anga akipelut taovin ahi.","title":"Shachem Mun'a Joshu'an Mipi ho jah-a Thu Asei"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n mipi ho henga hitin aseije, Israelte Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, nidang laijin napateu chu vadunglen gal langkhatna ana chengun, Abraham pa le, Nahor pa Terah tah-in jong, abonun pathen dang ana jenun, ahi.","ref":"Semt 11:27"},"3":{"text":"Chuin keiman napau Abraham chu vadunglen gal langkhatna kapuidoh-in, Kanaan gamsung pumpi-a kapuijin, achilhah kapunsah-in chule Isaac kapen ahi.","ref":"Semt 12:1-9; 21:1-3"},"4":{"text":"Chule keiman Isaac chu Jacob le Esau kapen, chule alodingin Esau chu Seir mol kapen ahinla Jacob le achate vang Egypt'a achesuh taovin ahi.","ref":"Semt 25:24-26; 36:8; 46:1-7"},"5":{"text":"Keiman Mosi le Aaron kasollin, Egypt gama chun alah uva thil kidang kabolin hise kalansah in chule hiche jouchun kapuidoh in ahi.","ref":"Pot 3:1—12:42"},"6":{"text":"Chule keiman napateu chu Egypt'a konin kahin puidoh-in, chule nangho twipi lama nahungun, chule Egypt miho chun twipisan geijin napateu chu kangtalai le sakol in ahin nungdelun ahi.","ref":"Pot 14:1-31"},"7":{"text":"Chule amaho Pakai henga akau le nangho le Egypt miho kikah-a aman muthim ajinsah-in, twipi chu achunguva alonsah-in, amaho akhukhumin, chule Egypt mite chunga ipi katoh ham tichu namitnun naveovin ahi. Chule nangho phat sottah gamthipma naum taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Jordan gal langa um Amor mite gama kapuilutnun, amahon nangho nakisat piuvin, chuin agamu chu nalotheina dingun amahochu nakhut uva kapen, chuin nangho masanga kasumangin ahi.","ref":"Minb 21:21-25"},"9":{"text":"Hichun Moab lengpa Zippor chapa Balak akipatnin Israel asatnin, chuin Beor chapa Balaam chu nagaosap dingun akousah-in,","ref":"Minb 22:1-24-25"},"10":{"text":"ahivangin ken Balaam thu kangaipon, hichejeh chun aman nang phatthei naboh jingin, hitia chu ama-a kona kahuhdoh nahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin nangho Jordan galla nacheovin, Jericho'a nahungun, Amor mi Perizz mi, Kanaan mi, Hit mi, Girgash mi, Hiv mi, Jebus miho chule Jericho hon nasatnun, ahin ken amaho, nangho khutna kapen ahi.","ref":"Josh 3:14-17; 6:1-21"},"12":{"text":"Chuin nangho masanga amaho delmang dingin khoingal ho kasolin; Amor lengteni chunga jong, hichu nangho chemjamle thal'a kon ahipon ahi.","ref":"Pot 23:28; Danb 7:20"},"13":{"text":"Chule nangho ngaito hilouhelin ken nangho gam kapen, chule nasah louhelu khopi-a nacheng uvin, chule naphu louhelu lengpi theile Olive thei naneovin ahi.","ref":"Danb 6:10-11"},"14":{"text":"Hiche jehchun tun, Pakai ginguvin, lunglut tahle dihtah-in jen'uvin, napa teovin vadunglen gal langkhat le Egypt gama anahouvu pathen dangho chu paimangun chule Pakai jen'uvin."},"15":{"text":"Chule nangho dinga Pakai jen chu aphalou abahle, tunin najen ding chu nangman lhengdoh-in, Vadunglen gal lama napateovin anajen a-pathen hou chu najendingu ham? Ahiloule agama nana chennu Amor miho pathen chu najen dingu ham? Amavang keile ka-insung mite vangin Pakai kajen dingu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin mihochun adonbutnun, Pakai Pathen'in ajahda keihon pathen dang iti nama jongle jenpou vinge atiuve."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu Egypt gama keiho le kapateu soh in'a kona eipuidoh uva chu Pakai Ka Pathen'u ahin, kamit mutah uva melchihna loupitah tah abolin, chuleh kachena chanule kajotpanao miho-a konin eihuhdoh-uve."},"18":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin mijouse, agama cheng Amor mite jengjong, kama sang uva adeldoh-in; hiche jeh-a chun keihon Pakai kajen dingu ahi, ajehchu Amachu ka Pathen'u ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n miho henga chun Pakai chu najen theilou dingu ahi, ajehchu ama Pathen theng ahin, thangthip Pathen ahin, nagolkeh naole nachonset nahou angaidam louding ahi ati."},"20":{"text":"Nanghon Pakai chu nadalhah uva gamdang pathen najen uva ahile, nangho dinga thilpha abolnunga, nachunga khansetna ahinlhun sah jeng ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin mipihon Joshua henga, ahipoi, keihon Pakai bou kajendingu ahi, atiuve."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n mipi ho henga, nanghon Pakai jending joh tunin nakilhen taovin ahi, ti hettohsah chu nanghotah nahiuve atile amahon keihotah ahettohsah kahitaove, atiuvin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hichejeh chun tun nalah uva um gamdang pathenho chu paidoh-un, chule Pakai Israel Pathen henga nalungu koijun, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin mipihon Joshua henga, Pakai ka Pathen'u chu jenung kating, ama thu jengbou kangai dingu ahi atiuve."},"25":{"text":"Hicheni chun Joshua'n mipitoh thulhun asemin, chule kitepnadan kisun khatle chondan khat Shechem'a aphutdoh-in ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n hiche thuho chu Pathen dan lekhabua ajihlutnin, chuin song lenpitah khat alan, gangpi phungnoi khatna atungin, hiche chu Pakai muntheng kom ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n mipi ho henga, veuvin, hiche songhi eiho kah-a hettohsah chu ahi.
