Pakaiyin ihenguva aseijouse chu hiche hin ajatan ahi; hijeh-a chu hichehi nangho dinga hettohsah hiding, achutiloule na Pathen chu nuse khagetnun nate, ati."},"28":{"text":"Hitichun Joshua'n mipi ho chu a-inuva kilecheh dingin akikhensahtan ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chule ahung hitin ahi, hiche jouchun Nun chapa Joshua Pakai soh chu kum jakhat le kumsom ahin athitan ahi.","title":"Joshua le Eleazar Thi"},"30":{"text":"Gaash lhang sahlam sanga, Ephraim molla um Timnath-serah sunga ama chandinga kisem gamgi chinna chun avuitaovin ahi.","ref":"Josh 19:49-50"},"31":{"text":"Chuin Joshua hinsungsen chule upaho, Joshua sanga upajoho Pakaiyin Israelte dinga anatoh jouse anaheho adam sungu chun Israel mipi ho chun Pakai anajui sohkeijun ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule Israel chaten Egypt'a kona Joseph guho apoh touvu chu, Shechem pa Hamor chate-a kona Jacob'in dangka jakhatna anachoh achun avuijun, chule hichu Joseph chate lonamun ahitan ahi.","ref":"Semt 33:19; 50:24-25; Pot 13:19; Jhn 4:5; Sol 7:16."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Aaron chapa Eleazar athitan, chuin amahon Ephraim lhanga achapa Phinehas anapehnao agamsung lhanga chun avuitaovin ahi."}}}}},"7":{"info":{"name":"Thutanho","shortname":"Thutn","abbr":[],"desc":"Thutan Vaihomho Lekhabu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Joshua thi nungin ahitin ahi, Israel miten Pakai henga, Keiho-a dinga Canaan mite douva kisatpi dinga koi che masapen dingham? tin adongun ahi.","title":"Judah Phung Chule Simeon'in Adonibezek Amat"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin, Judah chetou ding ahi; Ven, keiman gamsunghi akhutna kapehdoh ahitai ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Judah'in asopipa Simeon hengah, Canaan mite eisat khompi dingin keima eikipe kagam lona-a hungtouvin; chule chutobangma chun nangma nakipe nagam lona-a jong kilhonpinge, ati. Hitichun Simeon'in akilhonpin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Judah achetouvin, chule Pakaiyin Canaan mite le Perizz mite chu akhutna apehdoh tan: chule amahon Bezek'a chun mi sangsom athat uvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule amahon Adonibezek chu Bezek'a amuvin, ama chu akisat piuvin, chule Canaan mite le Perizz mite chu athatnun ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahivangin Adonibezek ajamin; chuin amahon anungdelun, amanun, chule akhutpi le akeng khopiho atanpeh-un ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule Adonibezek'in, Leng somsagi akhutpiu le akengpiu kitanlhaho chun kadokhang noija anmal akilokhomu ahin: keiman kana bol bang banga chu Pathen'in kachunga eilethuh ahitai ati. Chule amahon ama chu Jerusalem'a ahinpuijun, chua chun ama athitai."},"8":{"text":"Tun Judah chatehon Jerusalem asatnun, alauvin, chemjamin asatnun, chule khopi chu meijin ahal lhaovin ahi.","title":"Judah Phungin Jerusalem Le Hebron Alo-u"},"9":{"text":"Chule hiche nungchun Judah chate chu molsanga cheng, lhanglama cheng, chule phaichama cheng Canaan mite toh kisat dingin achesuh-un ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Judah'in Hebron'a cheng Canaan miho akisatpin; (tun Hebron hi masangin Kirjath-arba ana kiti:) chuin amahon Sheshai, Ahiman, chule Talmai chu athatnun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin chua konchun Debir'a chengho akisatpin ahi: masangin Debir min chu Kirjath-sepher anahi.","title":"Othniel'in Debir Khopi Alo (Josh 15:13-19)"},"12":{"text":"Chule Caleb'in, Koihile Kirjath-sepher gasatna, gala-a aumleh, amachu ajidinga kachanu Achsah kapeh ding ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Caleb naopa Kenaz chapa Othniel'in hichu agalatan; chuin aman achanu Achsah chu ajidin apetan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, amanu amapa henga ahung phatnin, amanun apa henga gam athumdin angehtai. Chuin amanu asangan'a konin akumlhan ahile, Caleb'in amanu henga, Ipi nadeijem? anati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin amanun ahenga, Phatthei neiboh-in: Nangman lhanglam gam neipeh ahi ngaleh, twinahho jong neipen, ati. Chuin Caleb'in twinah sahnung le lhangnung chu apetai."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Mosi nupapa Ken mipa chate chu tumthing kena khopi-a konchun Judah chate toh apotdoh-un, Arad lhanglama um Juda gamthipma alutnun; chule acheuvin miho lah-a chun agacheng taovin ahi.","title":"Judah le Benjamin Phung Mite Galjo"},"17":{"text":"Chuin Judah chu asopipa Simeon toh achen, Zaphath'a cheng Canaan mite athat nun, asugam helun ahi. Chule akhopi minchu Hormah akitin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule Judah'in Gaza chu agamsung pumpi toh, Askelon chu agamsung pumpi toh, Ekron chu agamsung pumpi toh alan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Judah aumpin; aman molsanga chengho chu adelmangin; amavang phaichama chengho chun thih sakol kangtalai aneijeh-un adeldoh joupon ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Mosi'n anasei bangin Hebron chu Caleb apeuvin ahi. Chuin aman chukoma konchun Anak chate thumho chu adeldoh-in ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule Jerusalem'a chenga Jebus mite chu Benjamin chaten adeldoh pouvin; amavang tunigeijin Jebus mite chu Benjamin chatetoh Jerusalem'a achengkhom nalaijun ahi.","ref":"Josh 15:63; 2 Sam 5:6; 1 Thusm 11:4"},"22":{"text":"Chule Joseph insung miho jong chu Bethel satnin akonun; chule Pakaiyin amaho aumpin ahi.","title":"Ephriam le Manasseh Phung Miten Bethel Alo-u"},"23":{"text":"Chule Joseph insung miho chun Bethel gavelhi din mi asolun ahi. (Masangin hiche khopi minchu Luz anakisah-in ahi.)"},"24":{"text":"Chuin gam velhihon khopi-a kona hungdoh mikhat amuvin, ahengah, Kataovu ahi, khopi lutna hoilang ham neihilun, chutile hepina kamusah dingu nahi, atiuve."},"25":{"text":"Chuin aman khopi lutna avetsah phatnin, amahon khopi chu chemjamin asumangun; mipa vang chu a-insung mite toh asoldoh taovin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin mipa chu Hit miho gama achen, khopi khat agatungdoh-in, hichu Luz asah-in: tuni geijin hiche minchu apujing nalaijin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Manasseh'in Bethshean'a chenghole akhopi, Taanach'a chengho le akhopiho, Dor'a chengho le akhopiho, Ibleam'a chengho le akhopiho, Megiddo'a chengho le akhopiho chu anodoh pon; amavang gamsunga chun Canaan miho acheng jouvin ahi.","title":"Israel ten Anodoh Louvu Miho","ref":"Josh 17:11-13."},"28":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Israelte ahunghat phatnun Canaan miho chu hunama natongin apansah-un, adeldoh sohkei pouvin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ephraim'in jong Gazer'a cheng Canaan miho chu adeldoh pon; amavang Canaan miho chu Gezer'a amaho lah-a achengun ahi.","ref":"Josh 16:10."},"30":{"text":"Zebulun'in jong Kitron'a cheng miho ahin, chule Nahalol'a cheng miho ahin adeldoh pon; amavang Canaan miho chu alah uva achengun, hunam natongin apansah uvin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Asher'in jong Accho'a cheng miho, Zidon'a cheng miho, Ahlab'a, Achzib'a, Helbah'a, Aphik'a, chule Rehob'a cheng miho chu adeldoh pon ahi."},"32":{"text":"Amavang agama cheng Canaan miho lah-a chun Asher mite chu achengun ahi. Ajehchu amaho adeldoh louvu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Naphtali'in jong Beth-shemesh'a chengho ahin, chule Beth-anath'a chengho chu adeldoh pon; amavang agama cheng Canaan miholah-a chun ama achengun ahi. Ahijeng vangin Beth-shemesh le Beth-anath'a chengho chun amaho henga kai apeuvin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chule Amor mite chun Dan chate chu molsang lama adel touvun, phaichama hungjong ahungsah pouvin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Ahin Amor mite chu Aijalon'a um Heres molsang le Shaalbim'a achengun ahi. Ahivangin Joseph insung mite khutnin amaho chu ajouvin, hitichun amaho hunam natongin apangtaovin ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chule Amor miho gamgi chu Akrabbim lam chetou na-a pat, songpi-a pat achunglam ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakai vantil khat Gilgal'a konin Bochim'a ahungtouvin, hitin aseije, Keiman Egypt'a konin kapotdoh sah-in, napu napateu kahahselna gamsunga kahin puilutnin; chule keiman kanaseijin, Nang hotoh kakitepna imatih-a jong kasukeh louding ahi.","title":"Bochim mun'a Pakai Vantil"},"2":{"text":"Chule nangho hiche gama cheng miho toh kijop matna naneilou diu; amaicham nasuhchim pehdiu ahi kanati. Ahinla nanghon ka aw nangaipouve. Ibola hiche hi nabolu hitam?","ref":"Pot 34:12-13; Danb 7:2-5"},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun hiti jonghin kaseije, Namasanguva kona amaho kadeldoh louding; amavang amaho chu naveluva ling banga umdiu, chule a-pathen houchu nangho dinga thang hiding ahiuve, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Pakai vantil chun Israel chate jouse henga hiche thu asei pet chun, amaho awsang tah-in akap taovin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin amahon hiche mun minchu Bochim asah-un; chule chukoma chun Pakai henga kilhaina abolun ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Joshua'n mipi ho chu alhadoh phatnin, Israel mite amichangcheh chu agamu lodin a-inlam cheh uva ache taovin ahi.","title":"Joshua Thi"},"7":{"text":"Chuin miho chun Joshua hinlaise le, Israelte dinga Pakai natoh loupitahho anamu-a Joshua sanga hingsot upaho hinlaise chun Pakai chu ajenun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakai lhacha Nun chapa Joshua chu kum jakhatle somkhat alhin phatnin athitan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin amahon Gaash sahlam Ephraim molsanga um agoulo Timnath-heres gamgi-a chun avuitaovin ahi.","ref":"Josh 19:49-50"},"10":{"text":"Chuin chuche khang miho jouse jong chu apu apateu toh gopkhomin aumgam taovin; chule amaho nungin Pakai helou, chule Israelte dinga anatohho hephalou khangchom ahung umdoh tan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chun Pakai mitmun thilse abolun, Baal ajenun ahi.","title":"Israel ten Pakai Hou Angah-u"},"12":{"text":"Chule amahon Egypt gama kona hinpuidoh-a apu apateu Pakai Pathen chu adalhaovin, aveluva um mihemho pathenho lah-a pathen dangho chu ajuijun, hicheho anga chun aboh khupmun, Pakai chu alunghansah taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule amahon Pakai adalhaovin, Baal le Astaroth chu ajen taovin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hichun Pakai lunghanna chu Israelte chunga ahung soudohtan, amaho achomgam hou khutna chun achomgam dingun apedohtan; chule amaho agal miteu masanga adin joulou nadingun, aveluva um agal miteu khutna ajohdoh tan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Pakaiyin aseibang le amaho chunga akihahselna bangchun, achedohna chanuva Pakai khut chu amaho dounan aphalou lama achun; amaho nasatah-in agenthei taovin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakaiyin thutan ho atundoh peh-in, amaho chun achomgam hou khutna konin ahuhdoh jiuvin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin amahon athutanhou thu chu angai pouvin, pathen dangho nung juijun noti'n apangun, a-anguva aboh khupmun ahi. Amaho apu apa teovin Pakai thupeh angaijuva achenau lampia konchun gangtah-in akihei mangun, hibang chun abolpouvin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin thutan ho atundohpeh phatnin, Pakaiyin thutan ho aumpin, thutan ho nikholaisen agalteu khutna konin ahuhhingin ahi. Ajehchu amaho suhgenthei le bol hesoh-a aum uva apen pennao jehchun Pakaiyin alung aheitan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule ahitin ahi, thutanpa athi phat phatle amaho akilehei jiuvin, pathen dangho chu jending le a-anga bohkhup dingin apu apateu sangin abohjo jiuvin; acham tah uva anatoh uva konle, alouchal uva konin atang deh pouvin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Pakai lunghana chu Israelte chunga ahung soudoh-in, hitin aseije, Hiche mite hin apu apateu henga thupeh kanapeh kakitepna asuhkeh uva, chule kathu angailou jeh-un,"},"21":{"text":"Keiman jong Joshua athia adalhah namhohi amasanguva kona khatcha kadeldoh louding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chutia chu amaho-a kona hi, apu apa teovin anajui banguva Israel ten Pakai lampi chu ajuijuvem ajuihih uvem kaphotchet ding ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Hichejeh-a chu Pakaiyin hiche namho chu mangang tah-a delmang louva akoija, chule Joshua khutna jong ana pehdoh lou ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin Israelte, Canaan gamsunga galkisat hekha loulai Israel mi tampiho patep nadia akhen namtin vaipiho chu hichenghi ahiuvin;","title":"Gamsunga Chengnalai Namho"},"2":{"text":"Israel chate khangguihon galsat dan ahetna dingu leh, tumasanga ima anahe loulaihon ahetna dinguva kikhena ahiuve;"},"3":{"text":"Hiche ho chu, Philistinte leng nga ho, Canaan miho jouse, Sidon miho, Baal-hermon molsanga patna Hamath lutna geija Lebanon molsanga cheng Hiv miho ahiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chule Israel ten Pakai thupeh, Mosi khutna kona apu apateu henga ana thupeh chu angainah uvem ti photchetna dinga amaho chu kikhendoh ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu Canaan miho, Hit miho, Amor miho, Perizz miho, Hiv miho, Jebus miho lah-a achengun;"},"6":{"text":"Chule amahon achanuteu ajidingun alauvin, achanuteu amaho chapate dingin apeuvin, chule a-pathen hou jong ajenun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule Israel chate chun Pakai mitmun thilse abolun, Pakai a-Pathen'u asumilun, Baal le Asherah ajenun ahi.","title":"Othniel"},"8":{"text":"Hichejeh chun Pakai lunghana chu Israelte chunga asoudoh tan, hijeh chun Mesopotamia lengpa Chushan-rishathaim khutna amaho ajohdoh tan; hitichun Israel ten Chushan-rishathaim chu kumget ajenun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate Pakai henga apen phat uvin, Pakaiyin Israelte huhdoh ding khat, Caleb naopa Kanez chapa Othniel ngeichu atungdoh-in, amachun amaho ahuhdoh-in ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Pakai lhagao chu achunga achun, aman Israelte thu atanin, galsat din akondoh-in: chule Pakaiyin Mesopotamia lengpa Chushan-rishathaim chu akhutna apedoh-in; chule akhutnin Chushan-rishathaim chu ajoutan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin gamsung chu kum somli akicholdon ahi. Chuin Kenaz chapa Othniel chu athitai."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Israel chaten Pakai mitmun thilse abolkit taovin; chule amaho Pakai mitmu-a thilse jeng abol jeh-u chun, Pakaiyin Israelte dounan Moab lengpa Eglon chu athahatsah tan ahi.","title":"Ehud"},"13":{"text":"Chuin aman Ammon le Amalek chate ahenga akhomin, akondoh-in Israelte agajouvin, tumthing khopi chu alotan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hitichun Israel chaten Moab lengpa Eglon chu kum somleget ajenun ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahivangin Israel chate Pakai henga aka phatnun, Pakaiyin Benjamin mi Gera chapa Ehud, mi veikolong pa chu ahuhdoh dingun atundohpeh-in; chule ama khutna chun Israel chaten Moab lengpa Eglon henga thilpeh athotnun ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla Ehud'in hemto chemjam tongkhatna sao akisemin, ajetlam malpi chunga avonnoija akigah-in ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin aman thilpeh chu Moab lengpa Eglon henga ahin choijin: chule Eglon chu mithaotah ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin aman thilpeh apeh jou phatnin, thilpeh hinpoho chu asolmangtai."},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin amatah Gilgal'a song kikhena mun'a konchun akileheijin, ahenga, Vo lengpa keiman nahenga dingin guhthim thusei ding kaneije atile, aman thipmin atin ahi. Chuin akoma ding jouse chu ama-a konin achemang taovin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Ehud ahenga ahungin; chule ama chu amachang dingabou anei nipilai touna indan-a chun atouvin ahi. Chuin Ehud'in ahenga, Nahenga seiding Pathen'a kon thukhat kaneije ati. Hichun ama atouna-a konchun akipatdoh-in ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Ehud'in akhut veilam ahin lhang doh-in, ajetlam pheichunga chem chu alan, a-oija adotlut tai."},"22":{"text":"Chule achem nunga chun achemkung jong alutthan; chem chu athaovin atomin ahile aman chem chu a-oija konin asatdoh joutapon; chule a-eh ahungdoh-in ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chujouvin Ehud hongcha lama apotdoh-in, touna danho kotho chu akha khumin, akam khumtan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ama achedoh phatnin asohteho ahungun, chule touna danho kot kikam chu amuphatnun, Amahin thonlouva nipilai indan sunga akeng akikhu hinte atiuvin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin amahon jachat umleuvin angah-un; chule veuvin, aman indan kot chu ahongtapon ahi. Hijeh chun amahon aheh hongna alauvin, ahongdoh-un; chule veuvin a pakaiyu chu tolla athisan analumin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule amaho khongai kahchun Ehud ahoidohtan, song kikhetna mun akhelin, Seirah geijin ajamdoh tan ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, ama ahung phatnin, Ephraim molchunga chun sumkon ahin mutnin, chule Israel chate chu amatoh mola konin ahungsuh-un, ama amasan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho henga, Kanung hinjuijun: ajehchu Pakaiyin namelmao Moab mite chu nakhut nuva apehdohtai, ati. Chule amahon anung ajui suh-un, Moab mai naija um Jordan gal kulho chu alauvin, koimacha agalkaisah pouvin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin amahon hiche pettah chun Moab mite sangsom tobang athat uvin, amaho chu mihat cheh le mihangsan cheh ahiuve; koimacha ahoidoh aumpon ahi."},"30":{"text":"Hitichun hiche nikho chun Moab chu Israel khutnoija suhnemin aumin ahi. Chuin gamsung chu kum somget acholngan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule amanungin Anath chapa Shamgar ahin, amapan bong sutna tengcha-in Philistine te mi jagup athatnin: chule Israelte jong ahuhdoh-in ahi.","title":"Shamgar"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Ehud athi phatnin, Israel chate chun Pakai mitmun thilse abolkit taovin ahi.","title":"Deborah le Barak"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin amaho chu Hazor mun'a vaihompa, Canaan lengpa Jabin khutnah ajohdoh tan ahi. Ajanel lamkai chu Sisera ahin, amachu Gentile ho umna Harosheth'a cheng ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu Pakai henga atao taovin ahi. Ajehchu aman thih-a kisem sakol kangtalai jako aneijin; chule aman kum somni Israelte chu nasatah-a asuh genthei ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule Lapidoth jinu Deborah themgaonu chun hiche laija chu Israelte thu atan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule amanu chu Ephraim molsanga um Ramah le Bethel kikah-a Deborah tumthing noija chu chenga ahin; chule Israel chate chu athu-u tansah dinga ahenga hungjiuva ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin amanun Kadesh-napthtali'a kon Abinoam chapa Barak agakou sah-in, ajah-a, Israel Pakai Pathen'in, Tabor molsang lama chun chenlang, Naphtali chatele Zebulun chate sangsom kipuijin,"},"7":{"text":"Chule keiman Jabin gal lamkaipa Sisera chu asakol kangtalai le amihonpi to nangma heng Kidron vapidung lama kahin puiding; amachu nakhutna kapehdoh ding ahi, tia thu napeh hilouham? ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Barak'in amanu henga, Nangman nei kilhonpi leh chenange; amavang nei kilhonpi lou dinga ahile kache louding ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin amanun, Keiman thonlouva kalhonpi ding nahi; ahivanga nakalsona lampia hi nangma dinga loupina umlou ding ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin Sisera chu numei khat khutna ajohdoh ding ahi, ati. Chuin Deborah akipatnin Barak toh akilhonin Kadesh lama achelhontan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Barak'in Zebulun le Naphtali chu Kadesh'a akouvin; mi sangsom toh alhon touvin: chule Deborah'in alhon toupin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tun Mosi nupapa Hobab chate lah-a Ken mi Heber chu Ken miho-a konin akitumse-in, Kedesh koma um Zaanaim phaichama chun ponbuh akisontan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule amahon Tabor molsanga chun Abinoam chapa Barak chu achetoutai ti Sisera henga aseipeh taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Sisera'in akangtalai jouse, athih kangtalai jako geijin, chule Gentile ho umna Harosheth'a kon Kishon vapidung geija akoma um mijouse chu akhom khomin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Deborah'in Barak henga, Kipat in, ajehchu tunihi Pakaiyin nakhutna Sisera apehdoh nikho ahi; Pakai chu namasanga che hilouham? ati. Hitichun Barak Tabor molsanga konin achesuh-in, mi sangsomin anung ajuijun ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Barak masanga Sisera le akangtalai ho, chule aumpiho chu chemjam monghemin amaimoh sahtan; hitichun Sisera chu akangtalaija konchun akumlhan akengin ajammang tan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahivangin Barak'in Gentile ho umna Harosheth geijin kangtalai ho le janelho chu anungdelin; Sisera sepai jouse chu chemjam monghemin alhusoh keijun, khatcha asohcha aumpouvin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahivangin Sisera chu Ken mi Heber inneipi Jael ponbuh geijin akengin ajamlutnin ahi. Ajehchu Hazor lengpa Jabin le Ken mi Heber insung kikah-a chamna uma ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule Jael chu Sisera lamto dingin ahungdoh-in, Hunglutnin, ka pakai, kahenga hunglutnin, kicha hih-in ati. Chuin amapa amanu ponbuh sunga ahunglut phatnin, amanun ama chu pon akhu khumin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin amapan amanu jah-a, Nahenga katao ahi, dondingin twi themkhat neipen, ajehchu kadang achah lheh-e ati. Chuin amanun bongnoi hai ahongin, amapa adonsah-in, chule akhu khumtai."},"20":{"text":"Chule amanu koma aseikitnin, Pon in kotna dingin lang, chule hiti ding ahi, mikhattou nahenga ahunga, Hikoma hi mi umam? tia nadoh ule, aumpoi tin seijin, ati."},"21":{"text":"Hiche jouchun Heber jinu Jael'in pon in kilna thingkil chu alan, akhutna sehtumkhat alan, ahenga kangchan achen, angeichanga chun akhenlutnin, toltoh akilmat jengin ahi; ajehchu ama acholjeh-a aihmumil hela ahi. Hitichun amapa athitai."},"22":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, Barak'in Sisera ahinjui laijin, Jael chu amapa kimutopi dingin apotdoh-in, chule ahenga, Hungin, keiman naholpa chu vetsah inge, ati. Chuin amapa amanu ponbuh-a ahung phatnin, veuvin Sisera chu athisan analumin, thingkil chu angeichanga ana kiphut in ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hitichun hiche nikho chun Pathen'in Canaan lengpa Jabin chu Israelte masanga asunemtai."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate khut akhangtou chehcheh-in, Canaan lengpa Jabin asuhmang kahseovin, Canaan lengpa Jabin chu ajoupeh-un ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Deborah le Abhinoam chapa Barak in hiche nikho chun la asalhonin, hitin atilhone,","title":"Deborah le Barak La"},"2":{"text":"Mipite amaho le amaho akipehdoh uva, Israel phu alahpeh jeh-in, Pakai chu avahchoijun."},"3":{"text":"Vo lengho, ngaijun; Vo pipuiho, nana hinsungun; kei, keimatah in Pakaiya la sangting, Israel Pakai Pathen vahchoi La kasah ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pakai, Seir'a kona nangma nahung doh-a, Edom loujaova kona nahung kondoh chun, leiset akihot nemin, vanho apullhan, meilhang ho atuisoh gamtai."},"5":{"text":"Molsang ho chu Pakai masanga ajunlhan, Sinai jengjong chu Israel Pathen masanga ajunlha tai.","ref":"Pot 19:18."},"6":{"text":"Anath chapa Shamgar nikho laijin, Jael nikho laijin, Lamlhongpiho athipbeh-in, kholjinle hon lampel ajotnuve."},"7":{"text":"Khosunga chengho aum tapouvin, Israel sunga aum tapouve; Keima Deborah kakipat doh-a, Israel sunga minu khatna kakipatdoh masangsen."},"8":{"text":"Amahon pathen thah ho akilhennun, chuin kotpi sunga gal anaume. Israel sangsomli lah-a lumle teng ana umam?"},"9":{"text":"Kalungthim hi mipi lah-a kona achamtah-a kipedoh Israel gamvaipoho lah-a aume, Pakai chu nunnom hen."},"10":{"text":"Seijuvin, nangho sangan kang chunga touho, thupi tanna-a touho, chule lamdunga cheleho."},"11":{"text":"Atuikhainau munho-a thalkap ho thal len gina kona kihuh dohhon, chumuna chu amahon Pakai chonphatna natoh aseiphong diu, chonphatna natoh ngei chu Israel sunga akho sunguva chengho lah-a ajahsah diu; chuteng Pakai mite kotpi phunga kumsuh diu ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Thouvin, thouvin, Deborah; thouvin, thouvin, la khat san: kipat doh-in, nangma Abinoam chapa Barak, chule gal hinga ki kaiho gal hingin kaijin."},"13":{"text":"Chujouvin aman ahingdohpa chu miho lah-a miloupiho chunga vaihomin apansah-in; Pakaiyin keima mihat ho chunga vai eipohsah-in ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ephraim'a konin Amalek douding amaho lah-a jung khat aumin, nangma nungin namite lah-a Benjamin; Machir'a konin gamvaipoho ahungsuh-un, chule Zebulun'a konin thil sunhon lekhamol tuhho ahungsuh-un ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule Issachar leng chapa ho chu Daborah toh aumkhomun; Issachar jengjong, chule Barak jong aumin: ama chu kengin phaichama lama akisolin ahi. Reuben kikhentel jeh-in lungsunga lunggel lentah asohdoh-in ahi."},"16":{"text":"Kelngoiho pen gin ngaidinga, kelngoi honlah-a ibola nangma uma nahim? Reuben kikhentel jeh-in lungsung kikholna nasatah aumin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Gilead chu Jordan gal langa achenge: chule Dan chu ibola kong innei sunga umden ham? Asher twipi panga aumjingin, chule abahho kah-a achengin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Zebulun le Naphtali hi gam sanglam loulaija thina ginglouva ahinkholhon phaldoh-a mi ahilhone."},"19":{"text":"Lengho ahungun gal ahungsatnun, Megiddo twipi pang Taanach mun'a Canaan lengho asatnun; Amahon gamthil le sum alapouvin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Amahon van'a konin gal asatnun, ahsihon alamlhah uva konin Sisera asatnun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Kishon vapidungin amaho alhoh mangun, hichu malai vapi, Kishon vapi chu ahi. O kahinna, nangman thahatna nachotpha ahitai."},"22":{"text":"Chujouvin sakol ho chu akihatil jeh-un, amihatpaovin ahatil jeh-un, atinhou alhong gamtan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Meroz chu samseuvin, tin Pakai vantil'in aseije, asunga chengho jouse chu nasatah-in samseuvin; ajehchu Pakai kithopi din ahung pouvin, ahat ho doudinga Pakai kithopi dingin amaho ahung pouvin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Numei ho jouse chungvuma Ken mi Heber jinu Jael chu phatthei changding ahin; ponbuh-a cheng numei ho jouse chungvuma phatthei changding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Amapan twi athumle amanun bongnoi apen; amanun milen kongsunga bongnoi ha ahin domin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Amanun akhutnin thingkil alan, akhut jetlama natongho seh alan; seh-a chun Sisera akhenin, amanun angeichang akhet pai phatnin alu chu avochiptan ahi."},"27":{"text":"Amapa amanu kengbula aboh khupmin, alhun, akijamtai: amanu kengbula aboh khupmin, alhun; abohkhupna-a chun athisan akijamtai."},"28":{"text":"Sisera nuchun bangkotna konin aven, avangkah-a konin apengjah-in, Ipidinga akangtalai hung geisangham? Ipidinga akangtalai kangho khongai ahidem?"},"29":{"text":"Aloi numei chinghon adonbutnun, Henge, amanu amale ama akidonbutnin,"},"30":{"text":"Amaho gangjou louvu hitam? Gal thilkichom kihom louvu ham? Pasal takip dinga nungah khat ahiloule ni; Sisera dinga gal thillah jemchom chom, gal thillah kikhui pahjem chomchom, alangtoa kikhuipah jem chomchom, galthil kilahho ngonga dinga kilomho amujou louvu ahidem? ati."},"31":{"text":"O Pakai, Hitichun nagalmiteu mangthah hen: ahivanginla ama ngailuho chu thahat tah-a chelai nisa banguhen. Chuin gamsung chu kum somli acholdon ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Israel chaten Pakai mitmun thilse jeng abolun ahile; Pakaiyin amaho chu Midia te khutna kum sagi apedoh tan ahi.","title":"Gideon"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Midia te khut chun Israelte chu ajoutan: chule Midia mite jehchun Israel chaten molsang ho-a kokhuh, leikoho, chule kuldet akisem taovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Israel ten muchi atu tengule Midia miho ahung tou jiuvin, chule Amalek miho le solam chateho jongchu amaho doudin ahung tou jiuvin;"},"4":{"text":"Chule amaho dounan gebuh asong jiuvin, Gaza geijin leisetna kon muchi jouse chu asuse jiuvin, chule Israelte dingin nehding himhim akhenji pouvin, kelngoiho, bongho, sanganho jong akhenji pouvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho aganchahou le aponbuh-u toh hungtou jiuva, mihonpi chu khaokho banga hung kitol jiuva ahi; ajehchu amahole asangongsang hou chu simjou lou ahiuvin, gamsung sumang dinga hunglut jiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule Midia mite jeh chun Israelte chu nasatah-in avaicha taovin; chuin Israel chate Pakai henga apeng taovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin ahung hitin ahi, Midia mite jeh-a Israel chaten Pakai asap phatnun,"},"8":{"text":"Pakaiyin Israel chate dingin themgao khat ahinsol peh-in, ama chun ahenguva hitihin thu aseijin, Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Keiman Egypt'a kona kahinpuidoh uva, nabul putnaova kona kahinpuidoh nahiuvin;"},"9":{"text":"Chule Egypt mite khutna konle, nabol gentheihou khutna kona kahuhdoh uva, namasanguva kona kadeldoh-a, agamu nangho kapeh nahiuve;"},"10":{"text":"Chule keiman naheng uva, Keimahi Pakai na-Pathen'u kahi; nanghon agamuva nachennao Amor mite pathenho chu ging hih-un, kanatin: ahinla nanghon kathu nanit pouvin ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakai vantil khat ahungin, Ophrah kho-a um Abiezer mi Joash gangpi phung noija atouvin; chule achapa Gideon chun Midia mite-a kona sel dingin lengpiga chilna-a suhlou chang achilin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Pakai vantil chu ahenga akilah-in, ajah-a, Nangma mihang gal hatpa, Pakaiyin naumpi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Gideon'in ama henga, Vo ka Pakai, Pakaiyin eiumpiuva ahileh, hichengpihi ibola kachunguva chu-a ham? Chule kapu kapateuvin keiho henga Pakaiyin keiho Egypt'a kona eihin puidoh-u hilouham, tia anaseiju athilbol kidangho chu hoilamba hija hitam? Ahinla tun Pakaiyin eida lhaovin, Midia mite khutna eipedoh taove, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin amapa aven, hitin aseije, Hiche nathahatna-a hin konin, chule nangman Midia te khutna konin Israel nahuhdoh ding ahi, keiman kasol nahi hilouham? ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin aman ahenga, Vo ka Pakai, iti dana keiman Israel kahuhdoh dingham? Ven, ka-insung hi Manasseh sunga dinga alhasampen ahin, chule keimahi kapa insunga dinga alhumpen kahi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin ahenga, Thonlouva keiman nangma kaumpi ding nahin, chule nangman Midia mite chu mikhat tha-a natha ding ahi, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin aman ahenga, Tu-a namitmu-a lungsetna kachana ahile, nangman nei kihoupina melchihna neimusah-in."},"18":{"text":"Nahenga katao ahi, nahenga kahunga thilpeh kahin choidoh-a na anga kakoi kahsen, hiche mun'a konin chedoh hih-in, ati. Chuin aman, Nahung kahse-a kana ngading nahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Gideon alutnin, kelnou khat athatnin, chule changbong chol solou ephah khat aga kangin; saphe chu pocha sunga ahengin, atwi chu bel sunga asunglutnin, gangpi phung noija aumna-a chun ahinchoijin, amapa chu apen ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Pathen vantil chun ahenga, Saphe le chol solou changlhah chu lanlang songpi chungahin koijin lang, atuichu sunglhan ati. Chuin hitichun aboltai."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Pakai vantil'in akhutna um tenggol muh-a chun saphe le cholsolou changlhah chu agah tongkhan ahileh, songpi-a konchun mei ahung kongdoh-in, saphe le cholsolou changlhah chu akamangtan ahi. Chujouvin Pakai vantil chu amitmua konin achemang tai."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Gideon'in ama chu Pakai vantil ahi ahet phatnin, Gideon'in, Ohe Pakai Pathen! ajehchu keiman Pakai vantil chu kimaito tah-in kakimupi tai, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin ahenga, Lung mongin umin, kicha hih-in; nathi louding ahi, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Gideon'in Pakai dingin chua chun maicham khat atungdoh-in, hichu Jehovah-shalom asahtai. Tuni geijin Abiezer mite umna Ophrah'a aum jingin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin hiche jan mama chun ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin ahenga aseijin, Napa bongchal gol, kum sagi lhing bongchal gol nina ngei chu lanlang, napa Baal maicham chu suchimin, chule akoma um thingbom chu phuhlhun;"},"26":{"text":"Chule hiche songpi chunga hin Pakai na Pathen dingin maicham khat sanlang, hoitah-in goltupmin, chule bongchal nina chu lanlang, naphuh ding thingbom thinga chun halvam thilpeh chu toh-in, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chujouvin Gideon'in asohte mi som apuijin, Pakaiyin ahenga aseibang chun aboltan ahi. Chule ahitin ahi, apa insung mihole khopi-a miho aginjeh chun sunnin abolngam pon, jannin abolin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin khopi miho chu jingpi tah-a ahungthodoh phatnun, veuvin Baal maicham chu ana kisulhun, chule akoma um thingbom jong chu ana kiphuh lhutan, chule Maicham kisa chunga chun bongchal nina chu ganlhaijin ana kitoh-in ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin amaho khatle khat, Hichehi koibolham? tin akidong touvin ahi. Chule amahon akholuva adoh phatnun, Hichehi Joash chapa Gideon bol ahi, tin adonbutnun ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chujouvin khopi sunga mihon Joash henga, Nachapa hinpuidoh in, thitei tei ding ahi. Ajehchu aman Baal maicham asuchimin, chule akoma um thingbom chu aphuh lhun ahi, atiuve."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Joash'in akidin tepiho jouse henga, Nanghon Baal dinga thu naseipeh dingu ham? Nanghon ama nahuhhing dingu ham? Koihile ama-a dinga thusei chanchu tu jingkah ahipet hin kithat jenghen; ama pathen ahile achungthu kisei hen, ajehchu mikhatnin amaicham asuhchim pehtai, ati."},"32":{"text":"Hijeh chun aman, Baal'in amapa dounan achungthu kiseihen, ajehchu aman a-maicham asuhchim pehtai, atin, amapa chu Jerubbaal asahtai."},"33":{"text":"Chujouvin Midia te jousele Amalek mite chule solama chateho akikhomun, agalkaijun, Jezreel phaichama pon in asong taovin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakai lhagao chu Gideon chunga ahung chun, chule aman sumkon amutnin; Abiezer miho anunga ahung kikhomun ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin aman Manasseh mite umna jouse-a thusep asolin, amaho anunga ahung kikhomun ahi. Chule Asher henga jong, Zebulun henga jong, Naphtali henga jong thusep asolin; chuin amaho ama kimutopi din ahung touvun ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Gideon'in Pathen henga, Nangman nasei banga kakhutna Israel nahuhdoh dinga ahile,"},"37":{"text":"Ven, keiman tollhanga kelngoi mul kakoi ding; daitwi chu kelngoimul chungabou alhah-a, akivela leiset chungchu agotseh-a ahile, nasei banga chu kakhutna Israel nahuhdoh ding ahi tichu kahet ding ahi, ati."},"38":{"text":"Chuin chutichu ahitai. Ajehchu ajing jingkah matah-in athouvin, kelngoimul ho chu achom khomin, atuichu kelngoi mula kona chu ahehlhan ahile, kongkhat adimsetnin ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chuin Gideon'in Pathen henga, Kachunga lunghang hih beh-in, khatvei sehseh bou seikit inge: katao ahi, hiche kelngoi mula hin khatvei patep kit inge; tun kelngoimul chung bouchu gotsah inlang, leiset chung vang daitwi kotsah-in, ati."},"40":{"text":"Chuin Pathen'in hiche janchun hitichun aboltai. Ajehchu kelngoi mul chung bouchu ago-in, leiset chung jouse chu dai akotnin ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Jerubbaal, (hichu Gideon ahi,) le aumpi miho jouse chu jingpi tah-in athoudoh-un, Harod twikul panga chun ponbuh asongun; hitichun Midia sepai janel chu asahlam uva Moreh lhang chin phaichama aumun ahi.","title":"Gideon'in Media Mite Ajo"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Gideon henga, Akhutnuva Midia mite kapehdohna din nalhonpi miho chu atam behseh uve, achuti loule Israelte kei dounan hoithou vintin, kakhut tah-in eihuhdoh ahi tigetnunte, ati."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun chenlang mipi ho jahdin gaseiphongin, Koitobang akicha le atijachan chu, Gilead molsanga konhin kinungle loihen, tin ati. Chuin mipi-a konchun mi sangsomni le ni akinunglen, sangsom aum denun ahi.","ref":"Danb 20:8"},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Gideon henga, Mipi hohi atam behseh nalaijui; Amaho hi twiphunga puilhan, chukoma chu keiman nangma-a dingin kapatep ding ahi. Chule hitiding ahi, keiman, Amahi nangma toh lhonkhom ding ahi katichan chu nangma toh lhonkhom ding; chule koi hijongle nahenga, Amahi nangma toh lhonkhom louding ahi kati chanchun, nangma toh lhonkhom louding ahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Hitichun aman mipi ho chu twiphunga apuilhan ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin Gideon henga, Koihile uicha banga twi chu aleija letho chanchu achoma nakhendoh ding, chutobang ma-a chu akhupma bohkhupma donho jong nakhendoh ding ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin akama akhut koija letho ho jouse chu jathum ahiuvin; mipi adangse vangchu akhupma dilsua dontho ho ahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Gideon henga, Ale-tho mi jathum hochu mangcha-a nangma kahuh hinga, Midia te chu nakhutna kapehdoh ding ahi. Adangse vangchu ama ama muncheh-a chetaohen,"},"8":{"text":"Hitichun mihon aneh dingu le asumkon cheh-u akhutnuva akichoijun ahi. Chuin aman Israel dangse chu amitakip aponbuh cheh-a asolin, hiche mi jathum ho chu aumdensah-in ahi: chule Midia mipi janel chu ama noija phaichama chun aumun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin hiche jan mama chun ahung hitin ahi, Pakaiyin ahengah, Thoudoh-in, mipi janel lah-a khun chesuh-in; ajehchu nakhutna kapehdoh"},"10":{"text":"Amavang chesuh ding nakichatle, nasohpa Purah kilhonpin lang janel lah-a chun chesuh-in;"},"11":{"text":"Chule amahon ipi aseijiu nagajah ding ahin, chutengle mipi janel henga chesuhna dinga nakhut chu suhhatna umding ahitai, ati. Chujouvin ama asohpa Purah toh mipi janelho lah-a sepai manchah choiho umna china chun aga chesuh lhonin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule Midia miho, Amalek miho, chule solam chate mipi ho chu khaokhote banga tamin phaicham lhonlhunga aumun; chule asangongsao houchu simsenglou, twikhanglen panga neldi banga tam ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Gideon ahung phatnin, veuvin, chukoma chun mikhatnin agolpa koma amang aseijin, hitin ati, Ngaijin, keiman mang khat kamatnin, ven, Midia mipi janel lah-a butunna kisem changlhah pheng ahung kilih lutnin, ponbuh geijin ahung lutnin, hichun ahinse-a ahileh asuchimtan, akilehkhup min, athalin akijamtai, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin aloipan adonbutnin, Hichu Israel mikhat Joash chapa Gideon chemjam tilou imadang hiponte. Ajehchu Pathen'in akhutna Midia te le mipi janel hi apehdoh ahitai ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Gideon'in mang kisei le aledohna kisei chu ajah phatnin, Pathen ahouvin, Israel mipi ho lah-a akinunglen, hitin aseije, Thouvun, ajehchu Pakaiyin nakhut uva Midia mipi janel chu apedohtai, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin aman mi jathum chu loithumin akhenin, akhutcheh uva sumkon khatcheh apen, chule leibel keu khatcheh, asunga thaomei kikoi leibel keu khatcheh toh apen ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin aman ahenguva, keima neiveuvin lang, kabol bang bangin bollun. Chule veuvin, keima ngahmun pam kahung lhun tengle hung hitiding ahi, keima bol bangbang chu nabol cheh dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Keima le kaumpi jousen sumkon kamut tengule, nanghon jong ngahmun jouse pang tinna sumkon namut uva, Pakai le Gideon chemjam, nati diu ahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Hitichun jan khangkim kipat tah-in Gideon le aumpi mi jakhat chu gebuh pam chu ahung lhungun, amaho chu ngahtup ana kikhel jou pettah-u ahin; chuin amahon sumkon amutnun, akhutnuva leibel keuho chu avokeh uvin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule loithumho chun asumkonnu chu amutnun, bel homho jong chu asukeh un, akhut veijun meivah ho chu adomun, akhut jetna sumkon tuh in amutnun, chuin Pakai le Gideon chemjam tin a-ao taovin, ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin ngahphol kimvella chun amitakip adinna cheh uva adingun ahi. Chuin janel chu alhaijun, hatah in apengun ajammang taovin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin loithumho chun asumkonu amutnun ahile, Pakaiyin mitin chemjam chu aloipa chunga achuhsah-in, mipi janel pumpi lah ngeija chun; chuin mipi janel chu Zererath'a mun'a um Beth-shittah lama le, Tabbath lama Abel-meholah gamgi geijin ajamtaovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Israel mijouse chu Naphtali'a kon, Asher akon, Manasseh'a konin akikhomun, Midia miho chu anung delun ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Gideon'in Ephraim molsang jouse-a thusep asolin, ahenguva, Midia mite doudin hungsuh un, chule amaho masanga konin Bethbarah le Jordan geijin atwi neh-u chu lahpeh-un, atin ahi. Chujouvin Ephraim mijouse chu akikhom khomun, Bethbarah le Jordan geijin amaho-a konin atwi neh-u chu alah peh-un ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule amahon Midia mite leng chapa ni Oreb le Zeeb chu amanun; chuin amahon Oreb chu Oreb song chunga athatnun, chule Zeeb chu Zeeb lengpiga chilna-a athatnun, Midia te chu anungdelun, Oreb le Zeeb luchang chu Jordan gallanga Gideon henga ahinpouvin ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Ephraim mihon ahenga, ibola nangin keiho neihiti bol uva, Midia mite toh kisatna nacheuva chu neikou louvu ham? atiuvin amachu nasatah-in ahouseuvin ahi.","title":"Media Mite Apumjo-u"},"2":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho henga, Nang hotoh tekah dinga tu-a keiman ipi kabol em? Abiezer theichang ga lokhom sanga Ephraim lengpiga lokhom chu phajo louham?"},"3":{"text":"Pathen'in nakhut uva Midia leng chapa teni Oreb le Zeeb chu apedoh tan: keiman nang hotoh tekah dinga ipi katoh jouding ham? atin ahi. Chuin chuche aseiphatnin ama chunga lunghan nau chu adailhatan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Gideon Jordan'a ahungin, apalgalkai paijin, amale alhonpi mi jathum chu amaho nungdel nan alhadah taovin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin aman Succoth miho henga, Naheng uva katao ahi, kanung juija miho hi changlhah peovin, ajehchu amaho alhadah taove, chule keiman Midia leng teni Zebah le Zalmunna nung kadel ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Succoth leng chapate chun, Zebah le Zalmunna khutchu nakhutna umbeh hita-a, keihon nasepai ho chu changlhah kapeh dingu ham? atiuvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Gideon'in, Hiche jeh-a chu Pakaiyin Zebah le Zalmunna kakhutna eipehdoh phatle, keiman gamthipma lingho le khaogui lingneiho-a naphe-u kabotel ding ahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin ama Penuel geijin achepeh-in, hitobangma chun ahenguva aseijin; chule Penuel'a um miho jongchun, Succoth mihon adonbutna bangu chun anadonbutnun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin aman Penuel miho henga aseijin, Lungmonga kahungkit tengle, hiche insanghi kasuhchim ding ahi, atin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tun Zebah le Zalmunna chu Karkor munna aumlhonin, chule aumpi miho chu sangsom le sangnga ahiuvin, abonuva chu solam chate janel hon lah-a amoh ngen ahiuve. Ajehchu chemjam lamthei cheh mi sangjakhat le sangsomni athiuvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Gideon Nabah le Jogbehah solam sanga chengho ponbuh lampia chun achetouvin, chule janel chu aban tha gamin ahi: ajehchu amaho mongtah-a umuva ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Zebah le Zalmunna ajam phatnin, aman anung delin, chule Midia lengteni Zebah le Zalmunna chu amanin, janel pumpi chu amaimoh sahtan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Joash chapa Gideon chu nisa sodoh masangin galmuna konin ahung kinungle tan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Succoth mi golhang khat amanin, adongin ahile, amapan Succoth leng chapateho le, a-upahou mi somsagi le sagi geijin phatechan ahiltai."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Succoth miho henga chun ahungin, chule ajah uva, Veuvin Zebah le Zalmunna, Tu-a hi nakhutna Zebah le Zalmunna khut chu umbeh hija, namite lhasamho chu changlhah kapeh diuham? tia neitaitom nao chu, atin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin aman khopi-a upaho chu amanin, gamthipma lingle khaogui lingnei chu alan, hicheho-a chun Succoth miho chu ahiltan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule Penuel insang chu asuhchimin, khopi-a miho chu athatnin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chujouvin Zebah le Zalmunna henga, Tabor munna nathaho chu itobang mi hiuvem, atin ahi. Chuin amanin, Amaho chu nangma tobang ahiuvin, amitakip leng chapate tobang cheh ahiuve, tin adonbut lhone."},"19":{"text":"Chuin aman, Amaho chu kasopite ahiuvin, kanu chapa ngen ahiuve: Pakai ahin jing bangin, nangman amaho chu nana hinghoi hile, keiman nangni hi kathalhon louding nahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin aman achapa masapen Jether henga, Kipatdoh inlang amani hi thatnin, ati. Ahinla gollhang chun achem adohdohpoi: ajehchu ama chapang nalai ahijeh-in akichan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chujouvin Zebah le Zalmunna'in, Nangma kipat inlang kachung lhonna hung chun; ajehchu mi ahi dungjuija, athahat jong umding ahi, atilhone. Chuin Gideon akipat doh-in, Zebah le Zalmunna chu athatnin, chule a-sangongsao ngonga um kijepnaho chu alan, ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chujouchun Israel mihon Gideon henga, Nangmale nachate, chule natute geijin kachunguva vaihomin. Ajehchu nangman Media miho-a konin neihuhdoh uvin ahi, atiuve."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Gideon'in amaho henga, Keima kahin, kachate ahiuvin jong nangho chunga vai kahomlou dingu ahi; Pakaiyin nangho chunga vai ahom ding ahi, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Gideon amaho henga, Keiman nangho henga ngehnom khat kaneije, mijousen agalthil chomuva kona bilba ho jouse chu keima neipeuvin, ati (Ajehchu amahon sana bilba aneiju ahi; ajehchu amaho Ishmael mi hiuva ahi)."},"25":{"text":"Chuin amahon adonbutnun, Keihon hicheho chu kipahtah-in peuvinge, atiuve. Chuin amahon pon aphaovin, ami takipmin gal thila kichomdoh bilba hochu asepkhom taovin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin aman athum sana bilbaho chu sana shekel sangkhat toh jasagi in agih-in; hicheho lah-a chu Midia lengho kivon na ngong'o, ponsandup ho, chule sangongsao hon angonguva aki-o'u khivuiho kisimtha lou ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Gideon'in thempu boitong sangkhol khat asemin, hichu ama khopi Ophrah ngeija akoijin ahi. Chuin Israelte jousen chukom mun'a chun acheuvin, noti'n apangun; hiche chu Gideon le a-insungmite dingin thang ahung sohtan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hitichun Midia te chun kiletsahna-a aluchangu aputkit louna dingun Israel chate masanga suhnemin aumtan ahi. Chule Gideon nikho sungin gamsung chu kum somli mongtah-in aumtan ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Joash chapa Jerubbaal achen, a-in'a agachengtan ahi.","title":"Gideon Thi"},"30":{"text":"Chule Gideon ama laigila kon chapa somsagi ahingin ahi. Ajehchu aman ji tamtah anei ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule Shechem'a cheng athaikemnu jongchun chapa khat ahinpeh-in, amin Abimelech asah-in ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Joash chapa Gideon chu tehkem setnin athitan, Abiezer mite umna Ophrah mun'a um apa Joash vuikhuh-a chun avuitaovin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Gideon athi joujou chun, Israel chate chu akilehei kitnun, chule Baal henga noti chonin achon kitnun, Baal-berith chu a-pathen diuvin akisemuvin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chule Israel chate amun jouse-a agaltehou khutna kona amaho huhdoh-a Pakai a-Pathen'u chu ageldoh tapouve."},"35":{"text":"Chule Israelte anamusah phatna jouse dungjuijin jong, Gideon kiti Jerubbaal insung miho henga jong khotona amusah pouvin ahi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Jerubbaal chapa Abimelech chu Shechem'a anu sopite henga achen, amaho akihoupin, anu pa le a-insungmi jouse henga hitin aseije,","title":"Abimelech"},"2":{"text":"Katao ahi, Shechem'a cheng mijouse jah dingin seijun, Jerubbaal chapate somsagi chun nangho chunga vai ahom chu phajo-am, ahiloule mikhatnin nachung uva vai ahom chu phajo em? Keimahi nagu-u leh naphe-u kahi tijong geldoh-un, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin anu sopiho jousen Shechem'a cheng mijouse jah-a ama chungchanga hiche thu jouse chu aseijun ahile; alungun Abimelech nung juidingin aumtaove; ajehchu amahon, Amahi isopiu ahi, atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chuin amahon Baal-berith in'a konin dangka somsagi apeuvin, hiche-a chun Abimelech'in pannabei le thulahlou miho agoijin, amahon anung ajuijun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin ama apa in Ophrah'ah achen, asopiho Jerubbaal chapate somsagi chu song khat chunga athatnin ahi. Jerubbaal chapa aneopen Jotham vangchu ahing hoijin ahi; ajehchu ama kisela ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Shechem miho jousele Millo insungmi jouse akikhomun, acheuvin, Abimelech chu Shechem'a um khompi phaichama chun lengin atungtaovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin hichu Jotham aseipeh phatnun, ama achen Gerizim molvum'a adingin, aw sangtah-in asamin, amaho henga, Shechem'a um mihon, Pathen'in nathuseiju angainadin, keima thusei hi ngaijun."},"8":{"text":"Khatvei chu thingphung ho achunguva leng changding thao nu dingin achedoh-un; Olive thingjeh-a, Kachung uvah vaipon pangin atiuvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahinla Olive thing chun ahenguva, Mihem le Pathen jabolna kineiji kathao hi kadalhah-a, thingphung ho chunga dopsanga umdinga kache dingham? ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin thingho chun theichang thing henga, Nangma hungin lang kachunguva vai hungpon atiuve."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla theichang thing chun ahenguvah, Keiman kalhum na leh kaga phatah hi kadalhah-a, thingphung ho chunga dopsanga umdinga kache dingham? ati."},"12":{"text":"Chujou phatnin thingho chun lengpigui henga, Nangma hungin lang kachunguva vai hungpon atiuve."},"13":{"text":"Chuin lengpigui chun ahenguva, Mihem le Pathen kipasah ka ju hi kadalhah-a, thingphung ho chunga dopsanga umdinga kache dingham? ati."},"14":{"text":"Chujou phatnin thing jouse chun theimi koma, Nangma hungin lang kachunguva vai hungpon, atiuve."},"15":{"text":"Chuin theimi chun thingho henga, Nanghon tahbeh-a nachung uva leng hidinga thao neinu uva ahileh, hungun lang natahsan naochu kalim'a hung ngam uvin: achuti louva ahile, theimi-a konhin mei hungpot doh henlang, Lebenon'a cedar thingho hi hung kavam hen, ati."},"16":{"text":"Hiche jehchun tun, dihtahle lung thengsela Abimelech chu lenga nalhenu ahi-a, Jerubbaal le a-insung mite chunga phatecha nabolu ahi-a, chule akhutna achandinga kilom dungjuija achunga natong nahiuva ahile,"},"17":{"text":"(Ajehchu kapan nangho dinga gal asatna, ahinkho set toh dinga aphala, Midia miho khutna kona nahuh doh-u ahin;"},"18":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon tunin kapa le a-insung mite dounan nakipat doh-un, achapate mi somsagi chu song khat chunga nathatnun, chule asohnu chapa Abimelech chu nasopiu ahijeh-in Shechem miho chunga lengin nasemun ahi.)"},"19":{"text":"Tunia hi nanghon Jerubbaal le a-insung mite chunga kitah tahle lunggiltah-a natong nahi vangule, nangho Abimelech chunga kipah unlang, amajong nangho chunga kipahhen."},"20":{"text":"Amavang chuti ahi louva ahileh, Abimelech'a konin mei hungdoh henlang, Shechem miho le Millo insung chu kavamhen; chule Shechem mihole Millo insunga konin mei hungdoh henlang, Abimelech chu kavamhen, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Jotham alhaijin, ajam mangin, Beer kho-a achen, asopipa Abimelech agin jeh-in chuachun achengtai."},"22":{"text":"Israelte chunga Abimelech'in kumthum vai apoh jouvin,"},"23":{"text":"Pathen'in Abimelech le Shechem miho kikah-a lhagao phalou ahinsolin; chule Shechem miho chun Abimelech chu lungthim kitahloutah-in abolun:"},"24":{"text":"Hichu gilou tah-a anabolu Jerubbaal chate mi somsagi ho phu chu achunguva achuh theina dingle, athisannu phu chu athatnuva pang asopipau Abimelech chunga achuh-a; chule asopihou thana dinga kithopi-a Shechem miho chunga achuh theina dinga chuti ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Shechem miho chun molchunga ama changlhi ding akoijun, chule amahon chuche lampia amaho hinhopa jouse chu achomun: chule hiche thu chu Abimelech henga akiseipeh tan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Ebed chapa Gaal chu asopihotoh ahungin, Shechem agalkaijun; chule Shechem miho chun ama chu atahsanun ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin amaho loujaova apotdoh-un, alengpi theihou chu alohkhomun, achilun, kipa golnop abolun, chule a-pathen'u in'a alutnun, aneuvin, adonnun, chule Abimelech chu agaosap uvin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Ebed chapa Gaal'in, Abimelech chu koi hija, chule Shechem chu koi hija, eihon ama ijendiu ham? Amachu Jerubbaal chapa hilouham? Chule avaipo chu Zebul hilou ham? Shechem pa Hamor miho chu jenuvin: ajehchu ipidinga ama ijendingu ham?"},"29":{"text":"Chule amahohi Pathen'in kakhutnoija aumsah hile, keiman Abimelech kalahdoh ding ahi, ati. Chuin aman Abimelech henga, Nagalsat mi supungin lang, hung doh-in, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin khopi vaipo Zebul chun Ebed chapa Gaal thusei ajah phatnin, alunghan akongjah tan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin aman Abimelech henga guhthimin thupo asolin, ajah-a, Ven, Ebed chapa Gaal le asopiho Shechem'a ahungun; chule vetemin, amahon nangma dounan khopi kul akai taove."},"32":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun nangma naumpi nasopi ho toh jan-in kipat unlang, loujaova chang lhiuvin;"},"33":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, jingkah-a nisa ahungso sole, nangma jingpitah-in thoudoh inlang, khopi chu nokhumin: chule ven, amale aumpiho nang douna ahung tengule, nangman aphat namu dungjuija achunguva na natohding ahi, ati."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Abimelech aumpiho toh jannin athouvun, chule loi li akiso-un Shechem douna-in achang pangun ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Ebed chapa Gaal apotdoh-in, khopi lutna kotpi-a chun adingin; chule Abimelech le aumpiho chu akisel naova konin ahungpot doh-un ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Gaal'in miho chu amuphatnin, Zebul henga, Ven mipikhu molsang chunga konin miho ahungsuh uve, ati. Chuin Zebul'in ahenga, Molsang le-lim ho chu nangin mi-a namu hinte, atin ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chuin Gaal'in aseikitnin, Ven, lampia gamsung kimlai tah-a konin miho ahung suh-in, chule loi dangjong Meonemin phaicham ahunge ati."},"38":{"text":"Hichun Zebul'in ahenga, Abimelech chu koi hija, amachu ijen diuham? tia nathuseina nakam chu tu-a hoilama um hitam? Hiche mihohi hilou ham nangin nataitom chu? Katao ahi, potdoh inlang, gakisatpin ati."},"39":{"text":"Chuin Gaal chu Shechem miho masanga achedoh-in, Abimelech akisatpi tai."},"40":{"text":"Chuin Abimelech'in ama chu adelin ahile, ama masanga ajamtan; kotpi lutna geijin mi tamtah alhun, akitongkhan ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chuin Abimelech Arumah'a achengtai. Chule Zebul'in Gaal leh asopiho chu Shechem'a achen nalou diuvin anomangin ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, mipi chu lou jaova apotdoh-un; hichu Abimelech aseipeh taovin ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chuin aman mipi chu akipuijin, hopthum in ahomin, loujaova chun achang pangun, chule aveovin ahile, veuvin, mipi ho chu khopi-a kona ahungdoh-un; chuin amaho dounan akipatdoh-in, amaho chu athat tai."},"44":{"text":"Chuin Abimelech le aumpiho chu amasang lamuva alhaijun, khopi lutna kotpi-a chun adingun; adang loini chun loujaova umho chu anokhumun, athatgam taovin ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chuin Abimelech'in nilhum keijin khopi chu akisatpin; chule khopi chu alan, asunga cheng jouse chu athatnin, khopi chu asuchimin, asugoi selin ahi."},"46":{"text":"Chuin Shechem daivei insanga umhon hichu ajah phatnun, Berith pathen in'a kohomsung khatna alut taove."},"47":{"text":"Chuin Shechem daivei insanga um mijouse akikhom khomtai tichu Abimelech ahil taovin ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chuin Abimelech ama le aumpi mijousetoh Zalmon molsanga akaldoh-un; chule Abimelech'in akhutna heicha akichoijin, thinga konin abah alhamlhan, hichu alan, alenga apun, chule aumpiho henga chun, Ipi kabol namu bangun, kino uvin, kabol bang banghin bolun, ati."},"49":{"text":"Chuin mipi jouse chun Abimelech bol bang chun athingbah ding cheh-u alham lhaovin, Abimelech nung ajuijun, kohoma chun akoijun, achunguva kohom chu ahal khumun; hitichun Shechem daivei insanga umho jong chu athi taovin, amaho chu numei le pasal sangkhat tobang ahiuve."},"50":{"text":"Chujouvin Abimelech chu Thebez'ah achen, chule Thebez kho dounan gebuh agasongin, ahin latan ahi."},"51":{"text":"Ahinla khopi sunga chun daivei insang dettah khat aumin, hiche sunga chun numei le pasal, chule khopi sunga um mijouse chu akikha khumun; kul chunga chun ahung kaldoh-un ahi."},"52":{"text":"Chuin Abimelech insanga chun ahungin, ahung satnin, meija hal dingin insang kotphung lama ahungin ahi."},"53":{"text":"Chuin numei khatnin sumheisong halkhatnin Abimelech luchang ahinsepmin, alugu asepkeh tan ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 11:21"},"54":{"text":"Hichun aman agalvonpo gollhangpa chu gangtah-in akouvin, ahenga, Mihon numei tha ahi eiti lounadin nachemjam satdoh inlang neithatnin ati. Chuin gollhangpa chun asunpaijin ama athitai."},"55":{"text":"Chuin Israel miho chun Abimelech athi amuphatnuvin, amitakip ama mun cheh-a achetauve."},"56":{"text":"Hitichun Pathen'in Abimelech'in asopi somsagi atha-a, apa chunga akhansetna jouse chu alethuh tan ahi."},"57":{"text":"Chule Shechem miho thilse bol jouse chu Pathen'in aluchung uva akhuhpeh-in; chule achunguva Jerubbaal chapa Jotham sapsetna chu ahung lhungtan ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Abimelech nungin Issachar mi Dodo chapa, Pu-ah chaoa, Tolla chu Israel huhdohdin ahung kipatdoh-in; chule amachu Ephraim molsanga um Shamir kho-a cheng ahi.","title":"Tolla"},"2":{"text":"Chuin aman kum somni le kumthum Israelte thu atanin, chuin athin, Shamir'a akivuijin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin ama nungin Gilead mi Jair ahung kipatdoh-in, kum somni le kumni Israelte thu atanin ahi.","title":"Jair"},"4":{"text":"Chule aman sanganchal chunga toucheh chapa somthum aneijin, chule amahon khopi somthum aneijun, tunichan geihin Havoth-jair akitin, hicheho chu Gilead gamsunga um ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Jair athin, chule Camon'a akivuitan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chun Pakai masanga thil gilou abolkit taovin, Baal le Ashtaroth, chule Syria pathenho, Zion pathenho, Moab pathenho, Ammon chate pathenho, chule Philistine te pathenho ajenun, Pakai chu adalhaovin, amachu jenjong ajen pouvin ahi.","title":"Jephthah"},"7":{"text":"Chuin Pakai lunghana chu Israelte chunga asoudoh tan, chule aman Philistine te khut le Ammon chate khutna ajoh dohtan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin hiche kum-a patchun amahon Israel chate, Jordan gala um Amor mite gam Gilead'a um Israel chate jouse chu kum somle kumget sung asugentheijun, anoijuva akun sah-un ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chukalvalin Ammon chate chu Judah douna le, Benjamin douna, chule Ephraim insungmi douna kisatpi dingin Jordan agalkaijun; hitichun Israel ahesoh lheh jengtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu Pakai henga apengun, Nangma dounan kachonse taove, ajehchu ka Pathen'u kadalhaovin, Baal jeng kahoutaovin ahi, atiuve."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Israel chate henga, Keiman nangho Egypt mite-a kona, Amor mite-a kona, Ammon chate-a kon, chule Philistine te-a kona kahuhdoh nahilouvu ham?"},"12":{"text":"Zidon miten jong, Amalek mite, chule Maon miten nasuh gentheijuvin; chuin kahenga natao ule, amaho khutna konin kahuhdoh-un ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin nanghon keima neidalhaovin, pathen dangho najenun ahi; hijeh chun keiman nangho nahuhdoh kit tapouvinge."},"14":{"text":"Cheovinlang nanghon nakilhenu pathenho henga chun gakap taovin; amaho chun nangho nahesoh genthei naova konin nahuhdoh-u hen, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chun Pakai henga, Keiho kachonse taove. Nangman pha nasah dungjuijin kachunguva boljengin; kataovu ahi, tuni hin nei huhdoh pou pouvun, atiuve."},"16":{"text":"Chuin amahon alah uva konin gamdang pathenho chu apaimangun, Pakai chu ajen taove. Chuin Israelte gim gentheina chu athohjou tapon ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chujouchun Ammon chate akikhom khomun, Gilead'a gebuh asongtaove. Chule Israel chate jong akikhom khomun, Mizpeh'a gebuh asongtaovin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Gilead leng chapatele miho chu khatle khat akihouvun, Ammon chate douna kisatpi dinga hung kipandoh ding chu itobang mi ham? Ama chu Gilead gama chengho jouse lamkaija pang ding ahi, atiuve."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Gilead mi Jephthah chu mihat hangsantah ahin, amahi noti chapa ahin; chule Gilead'in Jephthah ahingin ahi."},"2":{"text":"Chule Gilead jinu chun chapate ahingin; chule ajinu chapate chu ahungkhang lennun, amahon Jephthah chu anomangun, ahenga, Nangman kapao in nalo louding ahi; ajehchu nangma hetlou numei cha nahi, atiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chujouvin asopiho-a konin Jephthah ajamangin, Tob gama agachengtai. Chuin pannabei miho Jephthah toh akiloijun, amatoh michomin ache jiuvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chujou chomkhat jouvin ahung hitin ahi, Ammon chate chun Israel chunga gal ahin bolun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Ammon chaten Israel chunga gal abol phatnun, Gilead upaho chu Tob gama kona Jephthah puidoh dingin achedoh taove."},"6":{"text":"Chuin amahon Jephthah henga, Hungin, Ammon chate toh ikisat theina dingun, keiho gal lamkaijin hung pangin, atiuve."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Jephthah'in Gilead upaho henga, Nanghon neihot uva, Kapa in'a kona neikai doh-u hilou ham? Chule ibola tu-a hi nagenthei phatnuva kahenga hunga nahiuvem? ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Gilead upaho chun Jephthah henga, Hiche jeh-a chu Ammon chateho toh kisat dinga nangma keiho to nalhona, chule Gilead'a chengho jouse chunga kalamkai uva napana dinga, nahenga hung kihei kit kahiuve, atiuvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Jephthah'in Gilead upaho henga, Ammon chate satdinga in'a neipui kitnuva, chule Pakaiyin amaho chu ka angsunga eipehdoh-a ahile, keima nalamkai uva kapan mongding ham? ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Gilead upahon Jephthah henga, Nathu sei banga kabol lou uleh, Pakai chu ikah uva ahetoh hihen, atiuve."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Jephthah Gilead upaho toh alhonin, chule miho chun amachu achunguva vaipo dingle alamkai diuvin asemun; chule Jephthah'in hicheng thu jousehi Mizpah mun'a Pakai angsunga asei ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Jephthah'in Ammon chate lengpa henga thupo ho asolin, ajah-a, Nangman keima ilo ding neiti-a, kagam sunga keima douva kisatpi dinga hunga nahim? atin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Ammon chate lengpan Jephthah thupo ho chu adonbutnin, Israel ten Egypt gama ahungdoh laijuva kagam'u Arnon'a kona Jabbok, chule Jordan geija alo jeh-u ahi: hijeh chun tun hiche gamho chu kicham delin neilepeh kit taovin, atin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Jephthah in Ammon chate lengpa henga thusep mi asol kitnin:"},"15":{"text":"Ahenga, Jephthah'in hitihin aseije, Israel'in Moab gam alahpeh pouvin, chule Ammon chate gam jong alahmang peh pouvin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahin Israel Egypt'a kona ahungdoh-u chun, twipisan geijin gamthip gam ahin jotnun, chule Kadesh ahung lhungun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Israel'in Edom lengpa henga thusep asolin, Nahenga katao ahi, nagamsung neijot galkai sah-in, atin; ahinla Edom lengpan angaipeh pon ahi. Chuin hiche bangma chun Moab lengpa henga thusep asolkitnin; ahin aman jong anoppeh dehpoi. Hijeh chun Israel Kadesh'a aumdentai.","ref":"Minb 20:14-21"},"18":{"text":"Chujouvin amahon gamthip lah ahin jotnun, Edom gam le Moab gam chu avelkolun, Moab gam solam sanga ahungun, Arnon gal lampanga gebuh asaovin, ahivangin Moab gam gamgi sunga ahunglut pouvin ahi. Ajehchu Arnon hi Moab gamgi ahi.","ref":"Minb 21:4"},"19":{"text":"Chuin Israel'in Amor mite lengpa, Heshbon lengpa Sihon henga thusep asolin, chule Israel'in ahenga, Nahenga katao ahi, kagam kalut theina dingin, nagam chu neipal galkaisah-in, ati.","ref":"Minb 21:21-24"},"20":{"text":"Ahin Sihon'in agamsung pal galkai ding chun Israel chu atahsan pon: ahivangin Silhon'in amiteho jouse akhom khomin, Jahaz'a gebuh asongun, chule Israel akisatpi tan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakai Israel Pathen'in Shihon le amite jouse chu Israel khutna apedoh tan, chuin amahon amaho chu athatnuvin ahi. Hitichun Israel'in chuche gama cheng Amor mite gam jouse chu alo taovin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin amahon Arnon'a kon Jabbok geijin jong, chule gamthip gama kon Jordan geijin Amor mite gamsung chu alo taovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hitichun tun Israel Pakai Pathen'in Amor mite chu amite Israel masanga konchun anodoh ahitan; nangman hichu nalo dingham?"},"24":{"text":"Nangman na-pathen Chemosh'in nalo dinga napeh chu nalo louding ham? Hijeh chun Pakai ka Pathen'un kamasanguva kona adeldoh hou gamsung chu kalo dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule tu-a hi nangho Moab leng Zippor chapa Balak sanga phajo nahiuvem? Aman Israel douna kiphin kha-em? Ahiloule amaho akidoupi khah-em?","ref":"Minb 30:2"},"26":{"text":"Israel chu Heshbon le akholenho, Arnon le akholenho, Aroer le akholenho, chule Arnon panga khopiho jouse-a kum jathum achen laija chu? Chuche phat sunga chu ibola ana kinunglah kitlou nahim?"},"27":{"text":"Hijeh chun keima nangma dounan kachonsepoi, nangman keima neidouhi kachunga dihlou joh nahi. Thutan Pakai chun tunikho hin Israel chate le Ammon chate kikah-a thu tanhen, ati."},"28":{"text":"Ahivangin Ammon chate lengpan Jephthah'in ahin misol ahinsola thu asei chu ngaipeh-in aneipon ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakai Lhagao chu Jephthah chunga achun, chule ama Gilead le Manasseh agalkaijin, Gilead gama Mizpeh agalkaijin, chule Mizpeh'a um Gilead gama Mizpeh'a konin Ammon chate umnalam ajonin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Jephthah'in Pakai henga kihahsel na-in akihahselin, chule hitin aseije, Nangman Ammon chate chu kakhutna thonlouva neipehdoh-a ahile,"},"31":{"text":"Hitiding ahi, Ammon chate-a kona lungmonga kahung kilekit tengle, eikimutopi dinga kakotna kona hungpotdoh masapen chu thonlouva Pakaiya hiding, chule keiman govam thilto-a katoding ahi, ati."},"32":{"text":"Hitichun Jephthah chu Ammon mite satdingin ahenglam uva achen; chule Pakaiyin amaho chu akhutna apedoh tan ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho chu Aroer'a kipat in Minnith changeijin athatpeh-in, khopi somnijen, chule lengpilei phaicham geijin hathan athattan ahi. Hitichun Ammon chate chu Israel chate masanga suhnemin aumun ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Jephthah Mizpeh kho-a a-in'a ahungin ahile, veuvin, achanu ama kimupi din khongcha beng pumle lam pumin ahungdoh-in ahi. Amahi chanu changkhat seh ahin; amanu tailou hi chapa le chanu dang aneilou ahi.","title":"Jephthah Chanu"},"35":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, aman amanu amuphatnin, apon abotkeh-in, Kaden Kachanu! nangman keima neisunem lheh-in, chule nangma hi eisugimho lah-a khat nahitai. Ajehchu keima Pakai henga kana kamkatan, chule kih theilou ding kahitai, ati."},"36":{"text":"Chuin amanun ahenga, Hepa, nangman Pakai henga nakam nanakat ahitah-a ahile, nangman nakama nana phondoh bangbang chun kachunga boltan; ajehchu Pakaiyin nagalmite Ammon chate chunga phu nalahpeh ahitai, ati."},"37":{"text":"Chuin amanun apa henga, Hichehi keima dingin neibol peh-in, Molsang chung dunga kachesuh kachetouva, kagol hotoh nungah theng kahina pul kagadou nadiuvin, lhani neichang lhan, ati."},"38":{"text":"Chuin aman, Chen, ati. Hitichun aman amanu chu lhani sunga dinga asolmang tan ahi. Chuin amanu aloiho toh achen, molsang chungho-a chun nungah theng ahina pul chu agadou tan ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chuin lhani nungin ahitin ahi, amanu apa henga ahung kinunglen, aman akitepna bangin amanu chunga atongtan: chule amanu pasal to akitimat pon ahi. Chule hichehi Israelte chonna dan ahung hitan,"},"40":{"text":"Hitichun Israel chanute chu Gilead mi Jephthah chanu lunghempi nan kumseh leh nili achedoh jiuvin ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Ephraim miho chu akikhom khomun, sahlama acheuvin, Jephthah henga, Ipijeh-a Ammon chate kisatpi dinga nahung galkaija, chule ibola naki lhonpi dinga neikou lou uham? Na inpuma kahal khum dingu nahi, atiuve.","title":"Jephthah Leh Ephraim Mite"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Jephthah ahenguva, Keima le kamite Ammon chateto hatah in kakisat nun, kahinkou laijun akhut uva konin neihuh doh pouve."},"3":{"text":"Chuin neihuhdoh louvu kahet phatnin, kahinkho kaki choithon, Ammon chate kisatpi din kagalkaijin, Pakaiyin amaho chu kakhutna eipehdohtan ahi. Achutile ibola tunia hi keima to kisat dinga nahung kon uham? ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Jephthah'in Gilead mihojouse akhomin, Ephraim toh akisat tai. Chule Gilead mihon Ephraim miho chu athat taove; ajehchu amahon, Nangho Gilead mite hi Ephraim'a kona jammang, Ephraim mite le Manasseh mite lah-a kona jam mangho nahiuve, atijiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Gilead miho chun Ephraim miho lhun masanga Jordan galkainaho chu ana laovin: chule ahung hitin ahi Ephraim mite ahung jamdoh hochun, nei galkai sah-un ati tengule; Gilead miho chun ahenguva, Nangma Ephraim mi nahim? tin adong jiuvin; amahon, Kahipoi, ati-a ahile,"},"6":{"text":"Amahon ahenga, Chuti ahile Shibboleth gah ti-in ati jiuvin: chuteng aman Sibboleth ati jin ahi; ajehchu dihtah-a aseidoh thei jilou ahi. Chuteng amahon amapa chu aman jiuvin, Jordan vadung lampia chun athat jiuvin ahi. Hitichun hiche chunga chun Ephraim chu mi sangsomli le sangni athatnun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule Jephthah'in Israelte chunga kumgup thu atanin ahi. Chujouvin Gilead mi Jephthah chu athitan, chule Gilead khopi ho sung khatna akivuitan ahi.","title":"Jephthah Thi"},"8":{"text":"Chuin ama nungin Bethlehem'a um Ibzan'in Israelte thu atanin ahi.","title":"Ibzan, Elon, Chule Abdon"},"9":{"text":"Chule aman chapa somthum le chanu somthum aneijin, aman hiche achanute chu gamdanga asolin, chule achapate dingchu gamdangmi chanu somthum apuipeh-in ahi. Chule ama Israelte chunga kum sagi thutanin apangin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chujouvin Ibzan athitan, Bethlehem'a avuitaovin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amanungin Zebulun mi Elon'in Israel chate thu atanin; chule aman Israelte chunga kumsom thutanin apangin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Zebulun mi Elon athitan, chule Zebulun gamsunga um Aijalon mun'a akivuitan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule amanungin Pirathon mi Hillel chapa Abdon chu Israelte thutanin apangin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule aman chapa somli leh tu somthum aneijin, sangan gol somsagi chunga atouvin ahi. Aman Israelte chunga kumget thu anatanin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Pirathon mi Hillel chapa Abdon athitan, Ephraim gama Amalek mite molsanga um Pirathon munna akivuijin ahi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Israel chaten Pakai mitmun thilse abolkit taovin ahile, Pakaiyin amaho chu Philistine te khutna kum somli apedohtan ahi.","title":"Samson Pen"},"2":{"text":"Hichelai chun Zorah kho-a Dan phunga kon Manoah kiti khat anaumin; chule ajinu chu aching ahin, chaneilou ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Pakai vantil chu numeinu henga chun ahung kilah-in, amanu henga, Tun vetemin, nangma achinga nahin, cha nahingpoi; ahinla nangman nao nahinvop ding, chule chapa khat naneiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Katao ahi, hichejeh chun chingtheijin, ju le khamnathei donhih-in, chule thilthenglou kiti poupou jong nehih-in."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu vetan, nangma gaijin natin, chapa khat nanei ding; aluchanga samchem kilam louding ahi. Ajehchu naosen chu naobu-a kon Pathen'a dinga Nazir hiding ahi. Chule ama chun Israelte chu Philistinte khutna kona ahuhdoh patding ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin numeinu chu ahungin ajipa henga, Pathen mi khat kahenga ahungin, amaiso chu Pathen vantil maisotoh abangin, Kichat aumlheh-e; ahinla keiman hoija hungkon nahim tinjong kadongpon, chule aman jong kahenga amin eiseipehpoi:"},"7":{"text":"Ahin aman kahenga, Ven, nangman nao navopding, chapa khat nanei ding ahi; chule nangman tun ju le khamna thei donhih-in, thilthenglou kiti poupou jong nehih-in: ajehchu chapang chu naobu-a kona athini geija Pathen'a dinga Nazir hiding ahi, tin aseije, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Manoah Pakai henga ataovin, hitin aseije, Vo ka pakai, nahinsol Pathen mipa chu kakom lhona hungkit henlang, ahung pengding chapang chunghi ipi katohlhon dingham eihung hil lhonhen, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pathen'in Manoah aw chu angaipeh-in; amanu loujaova atouna-a Pathen vantil chu amanu henga ahung kitnin; ahinla ajipa Manoah chu amatoh anaumpon ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin numeinu chu mangang tah in alhai jel-in, ajipa chu agahilin, ahenga, Ven, nikhat ni-a kahenga hung kilah mipa chu kahenga ahung kilah kitne, agati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Manoah akipat doh-in, ajinu nung ajuijin, mipa koma chun ahungin, ahenga, Nangma hiche numei to kihouva chu nahim? ati. Chuin aman ahenga, Kahi, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Manoah'in, Tun nathuseiho chu hung guilhung hen. Chapang chu iti kakhou khah lhona, chule achunga ipi kabol lhon dingham? ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakai vantil chun Manoah henga, Numeinu henga kasei jouse bangchun amanu kichih thei hen."},"14":{"text":"Amanun lengpi guija kona kisem ipi thil hijongle nehda hen, chule ju le khamnathei jong dondahen, chule thilthenglou kiti poupou jong nehdahen: kathupeh jouse chu amanun juihen, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Manoah'in Pakai vantil henga, Nahenga katao ahi, keinin nang dinga kelnou khat kagagot lhon kahsen neiumpeh lhonin, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Pakai vantil chun Manoah henga, Nangman nei khongaisah jongle chun keiman nachanglhah neponge: chule nangman govam thilto nato dinga ahile, Pakai henga nato ding ahi, ati. Ajehchu Manoah'in amachu Pakai vantil ahilam ahetlou ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Manoah'in Pakai vantil henga, Nathusei aguilhun tengle nangma kajolbol theilhon na dingin, namin ipiham neisei peh-in, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Pakai vantil'in ahenga, Akiselguh ahi munasa-a, ibola hitachu kamin neidoh ham? ati.","ref":"Semt 32:29."},"19":{"text":"Hitichun Manoah'in kelnou khat chu anneh thilto toh alan, songchung khatna Pakai henga atoh doh-in ahi. Chuin vantil chun kidang tah-in abolin, Manoah le ajinun hichu avelhonin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu ahung hitin ahi, meikou chu maichama kona van lama alentou chun, Pakai vantil chu maicham meikou lah-a chun alengtou tan ahi. Chuin Manoah le ajinun hichu avelhonin, amailhon tolla asulut lhontan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakai vantil chu Manoah le ajinu henga akilahkit tapoi. Hichun Manoah'in Pakai vantil ahichu ahedohtai."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Manoah'in ajinu henga, Eini thonlouva ithitei lhonding ahitai, ajehchu einin Pathen imulhontai, ati."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla ajinun amahenga, Pakaiyin eini eithanom lhona ahile, govam thilto le neh thilto chu eini khutna kona akisan louding, chule hicheho jouse jonghi eivetsah lhon louding, chujongle tuphat tah-a hi hitobang thilho jong hi eiseipeh lhon lou ding ahi, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin numeinu chun chapa khat ahingin, Samson asahtai. Chuin chapang chu ahung khangin, Pakaiyin phatthei aboh-in ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Zorah le Eshtaol kikah-a Dan gebuh-a chun Pakai lhagaovin achunga na atong pantan ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Samson chu Timnah'a achesuh-in, chule Timnah'a chun Philistine te chanuho numei khat amun ahi.","title":"Samson Le Timnah Numeinu"},"2":{"text":"Chuin ama ahung touvin anule apa henga aseijin, hitin ati, Keiman Timnah'a Philistine te chanuho numei khat kamui: hijeh chun amanu chu kaji dingin gapui lhonin, ati."},"3":{"text":"Hiche phatchun anule apan ahengah, Nasopi ho chanute ahiloule kamite jouse lah-a numei umlouhel hija, cheptanlou Philistine te kichenpi ding nagot ham? atilhonin ahi. Chuin Samson'in apa henga, Amanu neipui peh-in; ajehchu amanun kalung atoh lheh-e, ati."},"4":{"text":"Achuti vangin anule apan hichu Pakaiya kon ahi le, aman Philistine te douna-a phat gomkom ahol ahi chu ahelhon pon ahi. Ajehchu hiche petna chu Philistine ten Israelte chunga vai ahomu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chujouvin Samson anule apa toh Timnah'a achesuh-un, chule Timnah kho lengpi leilai ahung lhung taovin: chuin veuvin, keipi bahkai golbep khatnin ahin ngih tai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Pakai Lhagao chu thanei tah-in achunga ahung chun ahile, aman kelnou alhetel bangin, akhutna imacha choilouvin abottel tan ahi. Ahinla aman athilbol chu anule apa henga aseidoh pon ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin ama achesuh-in, numei chutoh akihoulimin; chule amanun Samson alunglhaisah lheh-in ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin phat chomkhat jouvin amanu puidingin ahung kilekitnin, akeipi bahkai thasa longchu ve dingin akiheijin ahile; veuvin, keipi bahkai long sunga chun khoilhah anakaijin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin aman akhutnin alan, alamjot pumin anen, anule apa koma ahungin, amani jong apen, chule amanin jong anelhonin ahi. Ahinla hiche khoiju chu keipi bahkai thilong sunga kona alah ahi chu anule apa aseipeh pon ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hitichun apachu numeinu koma chun achesuh tan ahi. Chuin Samson'in chukhoma chun golvah abolin ahi; ajehchu gollhang hon hitia chu abolngai mong ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, amahon ama amuphatnun, ama koma umdingin loi somthum ahinpuijun ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Samson'in ahenguva, Keiman naheng uva thuchih khat kasei ding: hiche chu nanghon golvah nisagi sunga neihilchen theijuva, nahetdoh uva ahile, keiman nangho ponsil somthum, chule kikhelna von somthum kapeh dingu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Amavang neihilchen theilouvu leh, nanghon ponsil somthum le kikhelna von somthum neipeh dingu ahi, ati. Chuin amahon ahenga, Nathuchih chu seijin, keihon ngaijuvinge, atiuve."},"14":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho henga, Mi ne-a konin nehding ahung potnin, thahat tah-a kona thil lhumtah ahung potne, ati. Chuin amahon nithum geijin thuchih chu ahedoh thei pouvin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin nisagi nin ahitin ahi, amahon Samson jinu henga, Hiche thuchih hi eihil chetna dingun najipa jolin, achutiloule nangma le napa inhi meija kahal dingu ahi: nangman kanei hou lahpeh dinga neikouvu ham? Hiti chu hilouham? atiuvin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Samson jinu chu ahenga akapmin, hitin aseije, Nangman nei ngailut ahipon, neihot joh ahi: Nangman kamite henga thuchih nadongin, keima neiseipeh poi, ati. Chuin aman amanu henga, Ven, keiman kanu kapa koma jong kaseilou ahin, hiche chu nangma koma kasei ding ham? ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin agolvah-u kibol sungse, nisagi ni chun amanu a-angsunga akapkap jengtan ahi. Chuin ni sagi nin ahitin ahi, amanun aha ngeh behseh jehchun aseidoh pehtan ahi. Chuin amanun thuchih chu amite chateho henga aseipeh tan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin ni sagi ni nisalhum masangin khopi-a cheng pasal ho chun ahenga, Khoiju sanga lhumjo ipiham? chule keipi bahkai sanga hatjo ipi ham? atiuvin ahi. Chuin aman amaho henga chun, Kabongla-a hi lou nakai louvu hile, kathuchih hi hedoh pouvin nate, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Pakai Lhagao achunga ahungchun, ama Ashkelon'a achesuh-in, mi somthum athatnin, avonhou chu ahinlan, athuchih aseidohho henga chun kikhelna von somthum chu apetan ahi. Chuin alunghan akoujah-in, apa in lama achetou tan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Samson jinu chu agolpa, agolpha pena aneipa henga chun ape taovin ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahinla chomkhat jouvin ahung hitin ahi, suhlou chang atlaijin, Samson'in kelnou khat apon ajinu agavilin; chule, Indan sunga kajinu henga kagalut ding ahi, ati. Ahin ajinu pa-in alutding aphalpon ahi."},"2":{"text":"Chuin ajinu pan, Keiman najinu nahot mongmonga kangaito ahitan; hijeh-a chu naloipa kapeh ahitai. Anaonu hi ama sanga hoijoa hilouham? Nahenga katao ahi, amanu khelin kipuitan, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Samson'in amaho chungchanga hitin aseitai, Tun keiman amaho chunga mona boljong leng Philistine mihon a-engkhan eihisah thei pouvinte, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Samson achen sial jathum amanin, ameiju akan matnin, meisel phabep alan, amei le amei kikah-a chun akanmat pehtan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin meisel ho-a chun mei atih-in, Philistine te changphung dinglah-a alhalut nin ahile, changphal le changphung dinglai ho, lengpilei le Olive thing jouse geijin akamangtan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin Philistine ten, Hichehi kon abol ham? atiuve. Chuin amahon, Timnah tupa Samson bol ahi, ajehchu aman ajinu alahpeh-a aloipa apeh jeh ahi, tin adonbut uve. Chuin Philistine te ahungun, amanu chule apa chu meijin ahal lih taovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Samson'in amaho henga, Nanghon hiche nabol jeh uva hi, keiman nachung uva phu kalah ding ahi, hichu kabol chaiteng umthim bepding kahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho chu khotona beijin mitamtah athatnin; chule achesuh-in Etam songpi vuma agacheng tan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chujouvin Philistine te achetouvun, Judah gamsunga gebuh asonguvin, chule Lehi mun'a chun akithe jalun ahi.","title":"Samson'in Philistine te Ajo"},"10":{"text":"Chuin Judah miten, Ipi bola keiho douna-a hunga nahiuvem, atiuve. Chuin amahon adonbutnun, Samson kantum dingle, kachung uva abol bang banga achunga bol dinga hungtouva kahiuve, atiuve."},"11":{"text":"Chuphatnin Judah mi sangthum Etam molsang songpi chunga chun achetouvun, chule Samson henga, Philistine hi eiho chunga vaipo ahiuve ti nahetlou ham? Chule nangman kachunguva nabol pihi ipi ham? atiuve. Chuin aman amaho henga, Ka chunga atoh bang banguva chu keiman jong amaho chunga katoh ahi, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chule amahon ama henga, Keihon nangma Philistine te khutna kapehdoh theina dinguva, nangma kantum dinga hunga kahiuve, atiuve. Chuin Samson'in ahenguvah, Nangho tah-in neitha louna dingun kahenga kihahselun,atin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin amahon ahenga, Ahipoi, keihon nangma kakanchah uva, amaho khutna kapehdoh dingu ahibouve; keihon nangma nathat pouvinge, atiuve. Chuin amahon amachu khao thahbet nin akanun, song chunga konchun ahin puidoh-un ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule ama Lehi mun ahunglhun phatnin, Philistine te chu ama dounan hatah in a-aovun ahi. Hichun Pakai Lhagao thanei tah-in achunga ahung chun ahile, akhut kikanna khaoho chu meija kihaltan abang jengin, akhutna konin akikan naho chu alhamang tan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule aman Sangan khagu thahbet khat amun, hichu alan, hiche-a chun mi asang asang avolihtan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Samson'in, Sangan khagu mangchan, athop athopmin kavolhun, Sangan khagu mangchan, mi sangkhat kathatnin ahi, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin ahung hitin ahi, aman thu aseijouvin, sangan khagu chu akhutna konin apaimangin, hichemun chu Ramath-lehi asahtai."},"18":{"text":"Chuin ama hatah-in adang chahtan, Pakai hengah ataovin, hitin ati, Nangman nasoh khutna hi hitobang lhatdohna nasatah hi napeh ahitan; tu-a hi dangchah-a kathi-a, cheptan louho khutna hi kalhuh ding ham? ati."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pathen'in Lehi mun'a chun komtong apokehsah-in ahile, chu-a kon chun twi ahung longdoh-in; chule aman adonphatnin, alungthim ahatdoh kitnin, ahaldoh kit tai. Hijeh chun hiche mun chu En-hakkore asah tan, hichu tuni geijin Lehi mun'a aum jingin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin aman Philistine te nikho laijin Israelte chunga kum somni thu anatanin ahi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Samson Gaza'ah achen ahile numei kijoh khat amun, amanu henga chun alut tan ahi.","title":"Gaza mun'a Samson"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Gaza mite henga, Samson hilama ahunge, ti aseipeh taovin ahi.
