Chuin amahon a-um na munm chu a-umkimvelun, chule jan khovah keijin khopi kotpi-a chun achanguvin, jan khovah in thipchetnin aumun, Jingkah kho ahungvah vahleh itha dingu ahi, akitiuvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Samson khangkimgei alumin, khangkimin athoudoh-in, khopi kotpi kotkhahle akhom tenitoh abotdoh-in, abonchan alengkouva apun, Hebron maijona um lhangvum khatna apudoh pehtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule hiche nung chun ahitin ahi, aman Sorak phaichama numei khat amin Delilah kitinu chu adeicha tan ahi.","title":"Samson le Delilah"},"5":{"text":"Chuin Philistine vaipoho chu amanu henga ahungun, ahenga, Amapa hi kakan tum uva achunga kachuh theina dingun, iti achunga tha kanei thei dingu ham ti hetdohna dingin, amapa khu anajolin lang, athahatna nasatah khu hoija umham ana hedoh-in: chule keiho mikhat cheh-in nangma dangka sangkhat le jakhat kapeh dingu ahi, atiuve."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Delilah'in Samson henga, Nahenga katao ahi, nathahatna nasatah hi hoija uma hija, chule nangma suhgentheina dinga hi ipi-a naki kan dingham? neiseipeh temin, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Samson'in amanu henga, Ago khalou khaogui hing sagi in eikanleo, keima lhasam tangting, midangho bang bang kahi ding ahitai, ati."},"8":{"text":"Hiche phatchun Philistine vaipohon chun amanu henga, ago khalou khaogui hing sagi ahinchoijun, chule amanun hicheho-a chun akanin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tun mi phabepmin ama chu achang lhiuvin, indan sunga chu amanu toh uma ahiuve. Chuin amanun ahenga, Samson, Philistine te nachunga chuding ahi taove, ati. Chuin aman khaoguiho chu patdum kipheh meija kihaltan bangin abottan jengtan ahi. Hitichun athahatna chu hetdoh ahipon ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Delilah'in Samson henga, Ven, nangman neidai chavaijin, jouvin neilheme. Tu-a hi katao ahi, ipi-a nakikan tum thei dingham? ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin aman amanu jah-a, amahon mi kikanna khahlou khao thahbet-a eikan leu, kalhahsam ding ahitan, chuteng midangho bang bang kahi ding ahitai, ati."},"12":{"text":"Hitichun Delilah'in khao thahbet alan, Samson chu akanin, ajah-a, Samson, Philistine te nachunga chuding ahitaove, atin ahi. Chule mi phabepmin indan sunga achanlhih jingu ahi. Chuin aman hicheho chu patjang kibot tan bangin akhutna konin atumtan tan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Delilah'in Samson henga, Tuni geihin nangman neidai chavaijin, jouvin nei lheme: ipi-a kikan ding nahim, neihilin, ati. Chuin aman, Nangman kalua kasam pheh sagi hi hehkople chun, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin aman ahehkopmin akildet chetnin, ahenga, Samson, Philistine te nachunga chuding ahitaove, ati. Chuin ama a-imutna konin athoudoh-in, asam lom kihehkop leh akilna chu abotdoh tan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin amanun ahenga, Nalungsung keima koma umlouva, nangman kalungsetne iti neitithei ham? Nangman hiche thumvei neidai chavaijin, nahatna nasatah hi hoilaija umham neiseipeh poi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, amanun aniseh-a angah jinga, adoh jing phatnin, amapa thiding khopmin alung gimtan ahileh;"},"17":{"text":"Hichun alungthim jouse amanu henga aseijin, hitin ati, Kalu chunga samchem kipan khalou ahi; ajehchu keima kanu oisunga patna Pathen'a dinga Nazir mi kahi. Kasam akivo chaija ahile kahatna keija kona chemanga, kalhahsam ding, midangho bang bang kahiding ahitai, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Delilah'in amapan ahenga alungsunga um jouse aseidoh chu amuphatnin, Philistine vaipoho koudingin mi asolin, ajah uva, Khatvei hungtou kitnun, ajehchu aman alungsunga um jouse eiseipehtai, ati. Chujouvin Philistine vaipoho chu ahungun, akhutnuva sum jong ahin choijun ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin amanun amapa chu apheipi chunga alupsah-in a-imutsah-in; asam voudingin mi akouvin, alua lom sagi-a asam kikan chu avolhah pehtan ahi. Chuin amanun asugim panin, chule athahatna chu ama-a konin achemang tan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin amanun, Samson, Philistine te nachunga chuding ahi taove, ati. Chuin ama a-imutna-a konin ahung thouvin, chule, Nidang bangin chedoh ingting, kithing lhange ati. Ahinla Pakaiyin ama adalhah chu ahepon ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ahinla Philistine ten amanun, amit teni akaldoh-un, Gaza'a apui lhaovin, sum-eng henkol abupeh-un; songkul inna sumhei goijin apangtai."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla alu-a asam chu akivotol nungin ahung khangpan kit tan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chujou phatnin Philistine vaipoho chu a-pathenu Dagon henga kilhaina loupitah bola, kipa thanop boldingin akikhom khom taovin ahi. Ajehchu amahon, I-pathen'u hin imelmapao Samson hi ikhutnuva eipehdoh-u ahi, atiu ahi.","title":"Samson Thi"},"24":{"text":"Chuin mipin ama amuphatnun a-pathen'u chu avahchoijun ahi. Ajehchu amahon, I-pathen'un imelmapao, chule eiho tamtah eithatnuva, igamsungu sumangpa hi ikhutnuva apehdoh ahitai, atiuve."},"25":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, amaho alungthimu akipa phat chun, Vetnom um eibolpeh diuvin Samson gakouvun atiuvin ahi. Chuin amahon songkul in'a konchun Samson agakouvun, chule aman amaho dingchun vetnom um abolpehtai. Chuin amahon amachu khom lentah ni kah-a adinsah-un ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Samson'in akhut kaile-a pang chapangpa henga chun, Inpi kingapna khom teni chu kaki ngainadin neituh sah-in, ati."},"27":{"text":"Tun in chu numei le pasal dimsetna ahin, chule Philistine vaipoho jouse chu umsoh keijuva; Chule in chunga chu Samson vetnom um bol vedinga numei pasal mi sangthum jen uma ahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Samson Pakai henga ataovin, Vo Pathen, Philistinte chunga khatvei sehseh kamit teni asuhchotnao phu kalah theinadin; Vo Pakai Pathen, katao ahi, neigel doh-in, chule katao ahi, tu khatvei sehseh hi katha hatsah-in, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Samson'in inpi douva pang, alaija inpi kidouna khomteni chu atuh-in; chule khatna chun akhut jetlam angamin, khat joh-a chun akhut veilam angamin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Samson'in, Philistine mite hito thitha tange, atin ahi. Chuin aman athahat jouse-a asonin ahile, inpi chu vaipoho jouse le asunga umho jouse chunga chun achimtan ahi. Hitichun hiche athinia amitha chu ahinlaija atha sangin atamjon ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chujouvin asopitele apa insung mite ahungsuh-un, along chu alauvin, ahin potouvun, Zorah le Eshtaol kikah-a apa Manoah lhankhuh-a chun avui taovin ahi. Aman Israelte chunga kum somni thu anatanin ahi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Ephraim molsanga chun Micah kiti mikhat aumin ahi.","title":"Micah Milim Semthu"},"2":{"text":"Chuin aman anu henga, Nangma-a kona dangka shekel sangkhat le jakhat kiladoh, nana gaosap khum, chule keima jah-a jong nanasei chu, ven, hiche dangka chu kakoma aume; keima lah ahi, ati. Chuin anun, Kachapa, Pakaiya phattheiboh changin, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin aman anu koma dangka shekel sangkhat le jakhat chu anungpeh phatnin, anun ahenga, Milim kilha le kikheng semna dinga keiman kakhutna kon kachapa dinga dangka chu Pakaiya kapehdoh ahitai: hijeh-a chu tu-a hi nangma koma kapehdoh ding ahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin sum chu anu henga alepeh-in ahi. Chuin anun dangka shekel jani chu alan, dangka khengpa apen ahile, aman hiche-a kon chun milim kilha le milim kikheng asemin; chule hicheho chu Micah in'a umin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Micah kitipa chun pathen ho inkhat aneijin, thempu boitong sangkhol le milim houna asemin, chule achapate lah-a khat chu athenso-in, amachu thempun apangin ahi.","title":"Micah Thilha Hounaho"},"6":{"text":"Hiche laichun Israel ten leng aneipouvin, ahinla mijousen ama mitna dih asah chanchu aboljengu ahi.","ref":"Thutn 21:25"},"7":{"text":"Chule Judah gam Bethlehem'a kon Judah insungmi gollhang khat aumin; ama chu Levi mi ahin, chule chukoma chu khopema ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule hichepa chun chen nading mun amu muna-a cheng dingin Judah gam Bethlehem khopi chu ahin dalhan ahi. Chuin ama akholjin lena lamin, Ephraim molsanga um Micah in chu ahung lhungin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Micah'in amapa henga, Hoija kona hung nahim? ati. Chuin aman ahenga, Keima Judah gam Bethlehem'a kon Levi mi kahin, chule chen nading mun hola kholjin le-a kahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Micah in ahenga, Keima toh chengkhomin, chule keima dingin pa le thempu-in pangin, chule keiman kumkhatna dangka shekel som, von tokhat, chule nehle chah kapeh ding ahi, ati. Hitichun Levi mipa chu achengtai."},"11":{"text":"Chule Levi mipa chu mipatoh umkhom dingchu anomtan, chule gollhangpa amapa dingchun achapa khat tobang ahitan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Micah chun Levi gollhangpa chu athenson, chule gollhangpa chu athempun apangin, Micah in'a chun aumin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chujouvin Micah'in, Tun Levi mikhat thempu-in kaneitan, Pakaiyin kachunga thilpha abolding ahi ti kahetai, ati."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche nikho laichun Israelte lah-a leng aumpoi. Chule hiche nikholai machun Dan mite chenna ding gam aholun ahi; ajehchu hiche nikho geija chu Israelte phung lah-a amaho gamlo ding aumloulai ahi.","title":"Micah Le Dan Phung Mite"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Dan chate chun aumnao mun Zorah le Eshtaol kho-a konin a-insungmiu pasal hangsan cheh mi nga gam velhi dingle gamhol dingin asolun; ajah uvah, Cheovinlang gamchu gakholun, atiuve. Hichun Ephraim molsanga um Micah in'a chun aga lhungun, hia chun ageh taovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amaho Micah in'a aumlaijun, amahon Levi gollhangpa chu a-awso-a konin aheuvin; aheng lama akiheijun, ajah-a, Kon hikoma hi nahin puilut ham? Chule hikoma hi ipi nabol ham? chule hikoma hi ipi naneijem? atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chuin aman ahenguvah, Micah'in hiti khati hin eibolin, eigoijin, chule athempua kapan ahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin amahon ahenga, Nahenga kataovu ahi, kachenao lampia hi kakhantou kakhantou lou dingu kahet theina diuvin, Pathen neidoh peh-un, atiuvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin thempupa chun ahenguvah, Lungmong tah-in cheovin, Pakaiyin nachenao lampia naumpi naove, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chujouvin mi ngaho chun akipat doh-un, Laish kho-a ahung lhungun, hichea chengho Sidon miho bang banga-a chamdela, mongtah le bit keija achenu chu amuvin; chule hiche gama chun ipi lama hijongle ajachatnau boldoh pehding lamkai aneipouvin ahi. Chule amaho Sidon mite-a konin agamlauvin, chule koimato jong kigui jopna anei pouvin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin amaho Zorah le Eshtaol'a sopite henga ahungun: chule asopiho chun ahenguva, Ipi seithei nanei uvem? atiuve."},"9":{"text":"Chuin amahon, Amaho doudinga ikontou theina dinguvin, kipat un: ajehchu keihon gamchu kagam'u uvin, chule veovin, gamphatah ahi. Ima nabol got louvu ham? Chu gama cheding le galut ding chule galo ding thase hih-un."},"10":{"text":"Nangho nache tengule, mongtah-a cheng miho kom le gam lentah nalhun dingu ahi. Ajehchu Pathen'in leisetna thil um jouse lhahsam louna mun chu nakhut uva napeh-u ahitai, atiuve."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Zorah le Eshtaol kho-a konchun Dan insung mite mi jagup chu manchah pumin ahung kondoh-un ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin amaho achetouvun, Judah gam Kirjath-jearim'a gebuh asongtaove. Hijeh chun hiche munchu tuni geijin Mahaneh-dan asah-un ahi. Veovin hichu Kirjath-jearim nunglama uma ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin amaho chua konchun Ephraim molsang lam ajonun, Micah in ahung lhung taovin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chujouvin Laish gam velhia che mi ngaho chun adonbutnun, asopiho henga, Nangho hiche inho-a hi thempu boitong sangkhol, milim ho, milim kilhah le, milim kisoltho aume ti nahet uvem? Hijeh chun tun ipi nabol dingu ham ngaitouvin, atiuve."},"15":{"text":"Chuin amaho chulama chun akiheijun, Levi gollhangpa umna in, Micah in geija chun ahungun, ama chu chibai aboh-un ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Dan insungmi galvon kivona mi jagupho chu kotpi-a chun adinguvin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin gam velhia mi nga chu ache touvun, hilama chun ahung lutnun, milim kisemthu, boitong sangkhol, milimho, milim kilhajolho chu alauvin, chule thempupa chu galvonna kivon mi jagup ho toh kotpi phunga chun adingun ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amaho Micah in'a acheuva, milim kisemthu ho, thempu boitong sangkhol, milimho, akisoltho milim ahin lah-u chun, thempupan amaho henga , Ipi bola nahiuvem? ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin amahon ahenga, Thipbeh-in, nakhutnin nakam kihupmin lang, kanungu hinjuijin, chule keiho dingin pa le thempu-in pangin. Nangma dinga mi khatseh insunga thempu-a panding phajo-am, ahiloule phung khat le Israel insung khat chunga thempu-a pan phajo-am? atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chuin thempupa lungsung chu akipah lheh-in, thempu boitong sangkhol, milimho, chule akilhahtho milim chu alan, mipi lailunga chun achetan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hitichun amaho akiheijun, akipat doh-un, chule amasanguva chapangho le ganchaho achesah-un ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule Micah in'a kona gamla thimtah agei phatnun, Micah invela miho chu akikhom khomun, Dan miho chu adelpha taovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin amahon Dan chate chu agah samun ahi. Chuin amaho Micah heng lama chun akiheijun, ahenga, Ipin nabola hitobang mihonpi toh nahung ham, atiuve."},"24":{"text":"Chuin aman, Nanghon keiman kakisem ka-pathen le kathempu nakilah uvin nachemang taove. Chule ken idang kanei nahlai ham? chule nanghon kahenga, ipin nabol ham, natiu chu ipi nasei nao ham? ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Dan chate chun ahenga, Kalah uva na awgin kijah sah hih-in, achuti loule alunghangho nachunga hung chuntin, nahinkho le na-insung pumpi manlo ding ahi, atiuve."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Dan chate chu alampiuva achemang taove, chule Micah'in amaho chu ama dinga ahatvalu chu amu phatnin, akinunglen a-in lama achetai."},"27":{"text":"Chuin amahon Micah thilsemho le athempupa chu ahin laovin, mongtah le bitkeija cheng mite umna Laish kho chu ahunglhung taove. Chuin amahon amaho chu chemhemin athatnun, khopi chu ahallha taove."},"28":{"text":"Amaho Zidon'a kona gamlatah ahijeh ule, koimatoh kiguijop lou ahi jeh-u chun ahuhdoh dingu koima aumpon ahi. Hichu Beth-rehob koma phaichama uma ahi. Chuin amahon khopi khat asaovin, chua chun acheng taove."},"29":{"text":"Chuin akhopi semu chu Israel'a dinga hungpenga apau Dan min aput sah-un, Dan asah taove. Ahivangin khopi minchu amasa Laish anahin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Dan chate chun semthu milim atungdoh-un; agamu chu sohchanga ache kahseuvin Manasseh chapa, Gershom chapa, Jonathan le achateho chu Dan phunga thempun apanguvin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin amahon Micah'in asemthu milim chu atungdoh-un, hiche phatsungse chu Pathen in chu Shiloh-a aumin ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin hiche nikho laichun ahung hitin ahi, Israelte lah-a leng aumlou laichun, Ephraim molsang panga chun Levi mikhat ana khopemin, ama chun Juda gam Bethlehem'a konin thaikem khat akipuijin ahi.","title":"Levi Mipa Le Athaikemnu"},"2":{"text":"Chuin ama thaikemnu chu ama dounan noti'n apangin, chule ama-a konin achedoh-in Juda gam Bethlehem'a apa in'a chun achen, chua chun lhali aga umin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin a-inneipu chu amanu kamdama kihoupi ding le hin nungpui kit dingin akipat doh-in, asoh khat le sangan kopto akipuijin, anung ajuijin ahi. Chuin amanun amapa chu apa in'a ahin puijin; chule nungahnu pa chun amapa amuphatnin kipah tah-in alamton ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin anupa-pa, nungahnu pachun, amapa chu a-umsah-in; chule amapa jong ama chutoh nithum aumkhomin ahi. Hitichun mahon aneuvin, adonun, chule chu-a chun ageh-un ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin nili chanin ahung hitin ahi, jingkah matah-a ahung thodoh doh-un, amapa che dingin akipatdoh tan ahi. Hichun nungahnu pa chun achanu jipa henga, Changlhah themkhat beh nenlang nalung suhal photnin, chujou tengle chenan nate, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin amani atou lhonin, anekhom, adonkhom lhonin ahi. Ajehchu nungahnu pa chun mipa henga chu, Katao ahi, lunglhai selin umin, tujan khongaijin lang, nalungthim kipasah-in, atin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin mipa chu chedinga akipatdoh phatnin, anupa-pa chun alho lhon ahile, amapa aumkit tai."},"8":{"text":"Chuin ani nga ni jingpi tah-in amapa chedingin ahung thoudoh-in ahile, nungahnu pa'n ahenga, Katao ahi, nalung suhal tadin, ati. Chuin amani nisa akihei geijin akhongai lhonin, chule amanin anekhom kit lhonin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule mipa chu ama, athaikem, chule asohpa toh chedinga ahung kipatdoh phatnin, anungahnu pa chun ahenga, Ven, tuhi nilhah hiding ahitan, kangeh nahi, tujan khongai nalaijun: ven, nikho kichai ding ahitai, nalungthim kipana dingin hilaija hin geh maijun; chule jingle in nalhun theina dingin, jingpitah le najotna ding jonnan nate, ati."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla mipa chu khongai ding anompon, hijeh chun akipat doh-in achen, Jebus maijon ahung lhungtan, hichu Jerusalem ahi. Chule akoma sangan ni apho lhingset toh, athaikemnu aumin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amaho Jebus kom ahung lhunun, nikho chu beiding ahitan; asohpa chun apu henga, Katao ahi, hungin, Jebus miho khopi-a hin lutnu hitin, gehtao hite, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin apupan ahenga, Eiho Israel chate-a hilou, hetkhahlou miho khopi-a ilut loudingu ahi; Gibeah kho geija cheu hite, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin asohpa henga, Hungin, Gibeah ahiloule Ramah khatjoh joh naiju hitin, jan geh-u hite ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin amaho acheuvin, alamjot ajomun; chule Benjamin mite kho Gibeah kom alhunun, nisa alhumtan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin amaho hilama chu lutding le Gibeah'a chu geh dingin akihei lutnun ahi. Chuin ama alutphatnin, khopisung lamlen khatna atoutan ahi. Ajehchu amaho puiding le a-in'a lhunsah ding koimacha umlouva ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin veuvin nilhah ahiphatnin, tehsepu khat alou kona-a konin ahungin, ama jong chu Ephraim molsanga kon ahin; Gibeah'a khopem ahi: ahivangin chuche mun'a cheng miho chu Benjamin mi ahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chuin ama agah khodah-in ahile, khopi lampi-a tou kholjin mipa chu amun; chuin tehsepun ajah-a, Hoija cheding nahiuva? chule hoilama hungkon nahiuvem? ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin aman amapa henga, Keiho Juda gam Bethlehem'a kon Ephraim molsang jonding kahiuvin, keima chu mun'a kon kahi. Keima Juda gam Bethlehem'a gache-a kahin, ahin tu-a hi Pakai in'a cheding kahi; chule koiman a-in'a eilhunsah ding aumpoi."},"19":{"text":"Ahin hikoma hin changpol le ka sangan hou dinga ngaikhoh ho aumin, chule keima ding le kasohnu ding, chule nasohpan alhonpi gollhangpa dingin lengpitwi le changlhah jong aumin ahi, imacha alhasam beihela uma ahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin tehsepun, Lungmong tah-in umun; hijongle nadei jouseu keima chunga ngamun lang, lamlhonga vang geh hih beh-un, ati."},"21":{"text":"Hitichun tehsepu chun amapa chu a-in'a apuilutnin, a-sangan teni chu nehding apen; chule amahon akengu akisilun, aneovin adonun ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin amaho alungsungu akipa laitah-un, veuvin, khopi miho phabep, Belial chapa phabep chun aumnao in chu aum kimvelun, akot chu achumun, chule a-inneipa tehsepu henga chun, Na in'a lhungpa chu kaki timatpi dingun hinpui doh-in, atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Semt 19:5-8."},"23":{"text":"Chuin mipa, a-inneipa chu ahenguva achedoh-in, ajah uva, Ahipoi, kasopiho, ahipoi, naheng uva katao ahi, hitilom hin khangse hih-un; hiche mipa hi ka in'a hung ahi namu jeh uvin, hiche ngol hoitah hi bolhih-un."},"24":{"text":"Veovin, hikomahin kachanu nungah khat le thaikemnu aume; keiman amani hinpui doh ingting, nanghon amanichu noinep munlang, achung lhona pha nasah sah-u chu boljeng uvin: hichepa chunga vang chutobang thilse chu bol hih-un, ati."},"25":{"text":"Ahinla miho chun ama thusei chu ngaisah-in aneipeh pouve. Hitichun mipa chun athaikemnu chu apuijin, amaho henga chun ahin puilut tan ahi; chuin amahon amanu aluppiuvin, jan khovah jingkah geijin akichep naovin ahi. Chuin jingkho ahung vah phatnin, amanu asolmang taove."},"26":{"text":"Chuin thingjang ahungvah phatnin numeinu chu ahungin, apupa umna mipa kotphunga chun alhun, khovah lhah kahsen hia chun aumtan ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin jingkah-in a-pakaipa athouvin, inkot chu ahongin, achena ding lampia chu che dingin apotdoh-in ahile; veuvin, athaikem numeinu chu kotbula chun analhun, chule akhut teni chu kotbula ana kingamin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin amapan ahenga, Thouvin, chetaohite ati. Ahin adonbut tapoi. Hichun mipan amanu chu a-sangan chunga adomdoh-in, amajong atoudoh-in, achena dinga achetai."},"29":{"text":"Chuin amapa a-in alhun phatnin, chemcha khat alan, athaikemnu chu atuh-in, agutoh pumin a-at khen khenin, tum somleni ason, chuin Israel gam pumpi-a athot tai.","ref":"1 Sam 11:7"},"30":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, hiche mujouse chun, Israel chate Egypt gama kona ahung potdoh uva pat tuni chan geihin hitobanghi akibol khapon, mujong akimu khapoi. Hichehi ngaitouvin, thuhilna lauvin lang, nalungthimun thu seijun, atiuve."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Israel chate jouse chu Dan'a pat Beersheba changei, chule Gilead gamsunga konin jong achedoh-un, mihonpi chu mikhat bangin Pakai ansung Mizpeh mun'a akikhom khomun ahi.","title":"Galsat Dinga Israelte Kigot"},"2":{"text":"Chuin mipi jouse lamkaiho, Israel phungho chu Pathen mite kikhopna-a chun apangun, chemjam lamthei cheh kenga kalsong sepai sangjali ahiuvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"(Hichun Benjamin chaten Israel chate chu Mizpeh'a achetou uve ti ajataovin ahi.) Chuin Israel chaten, Iti dana hitobang gitlouna natoh hi sohdoh-a ham? neisei peh-un, atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Levi mipa, akithat numeinu jipa chun amaho adonbutnin, ahenguva, Benjamin miho khopi Gibeah'a chun keima le kathaikemnu jan gehdingin kahung lhonin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hichun Gibeah miho keima dounan ahung kipat doh-un, jan-in kaumna in aum kimvelun, thadingin eigouvin: kathaikemnu hunamin abolun ahile, athilotan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin keiman kathaikemnu chu kahin pon, kasat tel telin, chule Israelte chenna gamtina kathot kimvel tai. Ajehchu amahon Israel sunga thet umtah jonthanhoi le ngol hoitah na atong doh-un ahi."},"7":{"text":"Veovin, nangho nabonun Israel chate ngen nahiuve: hikoma hin nathuhilu le nathumop mu neipeuvin, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin mipi jouse chu mikhat bangin akipat doh-un, Eiho khatcha iponbuh uva ichelouhel diu, khatcha i-in'uva iche louhel dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahin eihon tu-a hi Gibeah chunga ibol dingu chu hiche hi ahi: vang kivet dungjuija amaho doudinga ikon tou dingu;"},"10":{"text":"Chule amaho Benjamin te khopi Gibeah'a alhun tengule, amahon Israel sunga ngol hoitah aboldoh banguva chu achunguva na atoh theina dinguvin, eihon Israel phung jouse-a kona mipite an thah dinga, mi jakhat lah-a kon som, sangkhat lah-a kona jakhat, chule sangsom lah-a kon sangkhat ilhendoh dingu ahi, atiuvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hitichun Israel mite jouse khopi douna chun mikhatseh bangin akipunkhom taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Israel phungho chun Benjamin phungho jouse henga mi asolun, Nalah uva kibol hitobang khangitlouna hi ipi hitam?"},"13":{"text":"Hichejeh chun tun keihon amaho chu katha uva, Israel lah-a kona gitlounahi kasuhmang nadingun hiche miho, Gibeah'a um Belial chate chu neipedoh-un, atiuve. Ahinla Benjamin chaten asopiho Israel chate thusei chu ngaisah-in aneipeh pouvin:"},"14":{"text":"Amavang Benjamin chate chu Israel chate satdingin, akhopi houva konin Gibeah khopi-a chun akikhom khomun ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule hiche pettah-a chun Gibeah a chengho lhentum cheh jasagi tilouvin, Benjamin chate chu akhopihou jouse-a konin chemjam lamthei mi sangsomni le sanggup aumin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hicheho lah-a chun lhentum cheh veikolong mi jasagi aumun; chule amaho chun samjangte geija khel louhela sepkha thei cheh ahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chule Israel mite chu Benjamin simlouvin chemjam lamthei cheh mi sangjali ahiuvin; amaho hi abonuva galhang cheh ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu akipat doh-un, Pathen in lama chun ache touvun, Pathen'a konin thumop angeh-un, Keiho lah-a Benjamin chateho toh kisat dinga koipen kachetou masah ding ham? atiuve. Chuin Pakaiyin, Judah chetou masa ding ahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Hitichun Israel chate chu jingkah-in athou doh-un, Gibeah dounan gebuh asong taovin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Israel miho chu Benjamin to kisatdin akondoh uvin; chule Israel chate chu amaho toh kisat dingin Gibeah'a chun akigoltoh taovin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Benjamin chate chu Gibeah'a konin ahung potdoh-un, hiche nikho chun Israel mite sangsomni le sangni jen tolla asat chapmun ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Israel mite chu akitil khouvun, amasani-a akigolna mun mama uva chun galsat dingin akigolkit taovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"(Chuin Israel chate achetouvun, nilhah geijin Pakai angsunga akapmun, Pakaiya kon thumop angeh-un, Kasopipa Benjamin chate douva kisatpi dinga kachetoukit ding ham? atiuve. Chuin Pakaiyin, Agakisatpi din kontouvin, ati.)"},"24":{"text":"Chuin anikho ni channin Israel chate chu Benjamin chate dounan ahung nailut kit taovin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin anikho ni chanin Gibeah'a konin Benjamin amaho doudingin ahungdoh-in, Israel chate sangsom le sang get chu tolla asat chapmun ahi; amaho chu abonchauva chemjam lamthei cheh ahiuve."},"26":{"text":"Hiche phatchun Israel chate, chule mi jouse chu ache touvun, Pathen in'a ahungun, akapmun, chule Pakai angsunga atouvun, hiche nikho chun nilhah geijin an angolun, chule Pakai angsunga chun govam thilto le chamna thilto atoh-un ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Israel chaten Pakai adongun, (ajehchu hiche nikho laija chu Pathen thulhun thingkhong chu hikoma chu uma ahin,"},"28":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho laichun Aaron chapa Eleazar chapa Phinehas chu a-angsunga chun adingjin ahi), Kasopipa Benjamin chate douva kisatpi dinga kachekit ding ham? atiuve. Chuin Pakaiyin, Kontouvin, ajehchu jingle amaho khu nakhutna kapehdoh ding ahi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Israel ten Gibeah kimvela changpang ding akoigu taovin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chule anithum channin Benjamin chate sat dingin Israel chate akontouvun, nidanga bangin Gibeah'a kidou dingin akigolkit taovin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Benjamin chate chu mipi ho dou dingchun ahungdoh-un ahile, khopi-a konchun agamlha taovin ahi. Chule nidang bangin miho chu asatnun, Pathen in chetouna lamlhong le Gibeah jotna loujao lah-a chun Israelte mi somthum tobang athatpan kit taovin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Benjamin chaten, Amasa bangin imasanguva tha-in aumkit taove, atiuve. Ahinla Israel chate chun, Eiho jamuhitin, khopi-a konin lamlhonga puidoh uhite, atiu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Israel miho jouse chu apanmun cheh uva konin ahung kipatdoh uvin, amaho le amaho Baal-tamar'a akigolun; chule Israel chate changpanga pangho chu aumnao Gibeah phaichama konin ahungdoh-un ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Israel mipi lah-a konin kilhengdoh mi sangsom ho chu Gibeah dou dingin ahungdoh-un, chule gal kisat chu anasa lheh-in ahi. Ahivangin Benjamin miho chun achunguva manthah na akomchaova aume ti ahepouve."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Benjamin chu Israel masanga agal lel sahtan; chule hiche nikho chun Israel chaten Benjamin mite chu sangsomni le sangnga le jakhat athatnun; amaho chu chemjam lamthei cheh ahiuve."},"36":{"text":"Hitichun Benjamin chaten agal lel'u chu amutaovin ahi. Ajehchu Israel miho chun Gibeah pama changpang akoihou chu atahsan jeh uva, Benjamin miho dinga chu mun a-otnu ahi.","title":"Israelte Galjodan"},"37":{"text":"Chuin changpangho chun kinotah-in Gibeah chu adel khumun; chule changpangho chu akihom khenun, khopi sunga chengho jouse chu chemjamin athat gamtaovin ahi."},"38":{"text":"Tun Israel miho leh changpangho chun akah uva melchihna khat aneiju ahin, hichu khopi-a kona meikong nasatah le meikhu ajamdohsah dingu ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chutichun Israel mite chu agalsat naova kona akicholnga kahlah-un, Benjamin miho chun ahin nokhumun, Israel mi somthum tobang athatnun ahi. Ajehchu amahon, Amahohi kisatna masa-a banga imasanguva gallel kit ahi taove atiu ahi."},"40":{"text":"Ahinla khopi-a kona meikong leh meikhu khompi banga ahung kitundoh phatnin, Benjamin miho chu akinung heijun aveovin ahile, veuvin, khopi-a kon meikong chu van geijin akikho touvin ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chuin Israel miho ahung kinunghei kitnun ahile, Benjamin mihon kidang asaovin ahi; ajehchu amahon achunguva manthah na ahung lhungtai ti amuvin ahi."},"42":{"text":"Hijeh chun amaho Israelte masang chun akinung heijun, gamthip lama ajam taove; ahinla gal kisatchun apha paovin, khopi-a kona hungdoh hochun alah tah uva konin asumangun ahi."},"43":{"text":"Hitichun Benjamin miho chu aumkolun, adelun, Gibeah maijon nisona lam geijin bailam tah-in kengin achilun ahi."},"44":{"text":"Chuin Benjamin miho chu sangsom le sangget athiuvin; abonchauvin mihangsan jeng ahiuve."},"45":{"text":"Chuin amaho akiheijun gamthip Rimmon songpi lama ajam taovin ahi. Chuin amahon lamlhonga chun mi sanga athatnun, chule Gidom geijin hatah-in anung adelun, mi sangni athatnun ahi."},"46":{"text":"Hitichun chuche nikho-a Benjamin mite athi jat chu chemjam lamthei cheh mi sangsomni le sangnga ahin; amaho abonchauva mihangsan cheh ahiuve."},"47":{"text":"Ahin mi jagup hochu akiheijun gamthip Rimmon songpi lama chun ajamun, chule Rimmon songpi-a chun lhali aumun ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chuin Israel miho Benjamin miho chunga achukit uvin, chemjamin athatnun, khopi jouse-a konin amu jouseu mihem hihen, sahem hijongle athat gamun ahi. Chule amahon ahung lhunnao khopi jouse jongchu meijin ahalun ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Israel mihon chu Mizpeh'a akihahselun, Ilah uva khatchan achanu Benjamin mi ji dinga apehthei louding ahi, atiuve.","title":"Benjamin Phung Mite Jiding"},"2":{"text":"Chuin mipi chu Pathen in'a ahungun, Pathen anga nilhah geijin aumun, aw sangtah-in asamuvin, hakan akapmun;"},"3":{"text":"Vo Israelte Pakai Pathen, hitobang pihi ipi jeh-a Israel lah-a soh-a, tunikho-a Israel lah-a kona phungkhat lhasam ding hitam? atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chuin ajingin ahung hitin ahi, miho chu jingpi tah in athouvun, maicham khat asaovin, govam thilto le chamna thilto atoh-un ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Israel chaten, Israel phung jouse lah-a kona Pakai henga dinga mipi houkhom ho toh lhontou lou koi umam? atiuve. Ajehchu amahon Mizpeh mun'a Pakai henga hunglou tapou chungchanga kihahselna lentah aneijuva, Amachu thatei tei ding ahi, atiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu asopipao Benjamin dingin alung hesoh-un, Tuni hin Israel'a konin phung khat akipai dohtai."},"7":{"text":"Tu-a amoh umnalai ho ji ding chungchanga hi ipi ibol dingu hitam? Eihola Ichanuteu ajidiuvin pepouhite tin Pakai anga kihahselna ineitaovin, atiuve."},"8":{"text":"Chuin amahon, Pakai henga dinga Mizpeh'a hungtou lou Israel phung khat tou umam? atiuvin ahi. Chuin veovin, Jabesh Gilead'a konin akikhomho umna gebuh'a chun koimacha ahungpouve."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu mipi chu akisima ahile, veuvin, Jabesh Gilead'a cheng miho chu khatcha jong aumpon ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin mipi kikhom chun ahangsan dehset cheh mi sangsom le sangni asolun, chule thupeh aneijun, ahenguva, Cheovinlang Jabesh Gilead'a chengho chu numei leh achateuse toh chemhemin gathatnun."},"11":{"text":"Chule hichehi nabolding dolu chu ahi: nanghon pasal takip, chule pasal toh lumkhomsa numei takip chu natha gamheldiu ahi, atiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chuin amahon Jabesh Gilead'a kon chun pasal hekhalou nungah theng jali amudoh-un ahi. Chuin amahon amaho chu Canaan gama Shiloh gebuh-a ahin puijun ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin houkhom pumpi chun Rimmon songpi-a um Benjamin chatetoh kihou dingle, amaho lungmong tah-a kou dingin mi phabep asolun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun Benjamin chu ahungkit tan; chule amahon amaho chu Jabesh Gilead miho-a kona ahinghoiju numei ho chu ajidingun apeuvin; ahinla hicheho chun atohjou pon ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Israel phungho sunga chun kikhenna aumsah jehchun, mipi ho chu Benjamin jeh-in alunghemun ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chujouvin mipi kikhomho lah-a upaho chun, Benjamin'a konin numei ho akisumang tai ti imu utoh lhona, ahing nalaiho ji dinga hi ipi ibol dingu hitam? atiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chuin amahon, Israel lah-a kona phungkhat suhmanga aumlou nadinga, Benjamin miho lah-a kona ahingdoh hohin goulo aneitei dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ahinla eihon amaho chu aji dinguva ichanuteu ipehthei loudingu ahi: ajehchu Israel chate chun kihahselna ananeijuva, Benjamin mi jidinga achanu pechan chu sapset changhen anatiu ahi, atiuve."},"19":{"text":"Chujouchun amahon, Veuvin Bethel sahlam, Bethel'a kona Sheshem jotna lamlhong solam, chule Lebonah lhanglam Shilloh mun'a khun kumseh le Pakai golvah akiboljin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hichejeh chun amahon Benjamin chate chu athupeh-un, ahenguva, Cheovin lang lengpi leija khun gachang pangun;"},"21":{"text":"Chule ana veuvin lang, veuvin, Shiloh kho-a nungah ho chu lamna-a lamdinga ahungule, lengpi leija konchun hungpot unlang, amitakipmin Shiloh chanute-a konchun naji ding cheh-u kimatnun lang, chule Benjamin gam lama chepiovin."},"22":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, apatehou ahiloule asopitehou kehenguva kiphinna thu seidinga ahung tengule, keihon amaho henga, Keiho jal-in amaho chunga khun khohsahna neijun, ajehchu gal kisatna-a chu eihon amitakip ajidingu ikhendoh peh pouvin, chule nanghon tu-a jonghi amaho napeh-u ahilou jeh-in, themmo chang pouvin nate, tin seinao vinge, atiuve."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Benjamin chate chun hitichun aboltauvin, amahon amijat dungjuijun alama hungdohho aji dinga akimat hou chu akipuijun; chule agoulonao gama akileuvin, khopi ho chu asaphaovin, acheng taovin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin hichephat chun Israel chate chu hiche mun'a konchun akipat doh-un, amijouse ama phungle insung, chule agou lona mun cheh-a achedoh taovin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hichelai chun Israelte lah-a leng aumpon: amijousen ama mitmu-a pha asah chu abol jengu ahi.","ref":"Thutn 17:6."}}}}},"8":{"info":{"name":"Ruth","shortname":"Ruth","abbr":[],"desc":"Ruth Lekhabu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun thutan ho vaihomho nikho laijin, gamsunga kel analhan ahi. Chuin Judah gam Bethlehem'a pasal khat a-inneipi le achapa teni toh Moab gama phat chomkhat cheng dingin anacheuvin ahi.","title":"Elimelech Le A-Insungmite Moab Gamma Acheu"},"2":{"text":"Pasalpa minchu Elimelech ahin, a-inneipi minchu Naomi ahi, chule achapa teni minchu Mahlon chule Chilion ahin, Judah gam Bethlehem kho-a um Ephrath mi ahiuve. Amaho Moab gama acheuvin agaum taove."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Naomi inneipu Elimelech chu athitan; amanu le achapateni adalhatan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin achapa tenin Moab numei ji-in akipui lhonin; Khatnu minchu Orpah ahin, khajonu minchu Ruth ahi. Chutichun hiche gama chun kumsom tobang anachengun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Mahlon le Chilion jong ani lhonin athi lhontan; hitichun Naomi chu a-inneipu le achapa tenin adalhatan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin Naomi Moab gama kona kilekit dingin amou tenitoh akipat dohtan ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin amite nehding apen aviltai ti Moab gama konin ajan ahi.","title":"Naomi toh Ruth Bethlehem'a Akilekit lhon"},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun amanu amou teni toh aumna-a konin akipatdoh-in; Judah gam kilekit nading lampi-a chun achetauve."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Naomi in amouteni jah-a, chelhonin, nanuteni incheh-a kinungle lhontan; nangnin athiho le keima neibolna lhon bangin Pakaiyin lungsetna-in nabol lhonhen."},"9":{"text":"Na-inneipu teni incheh-a lung kicholdona namulhon nadingin, Pakaiyin phatthei nape lhonhen, ati. Chujouvin abenglhon chu achopmin, athummun aw sangtah-in akap taove."},"10":{"text":"Chuin amanin amanu jah-a, keini namite henga nangma toh kakile tei lhonding ahi, atilhon tai."},"11":{"text":"Ahin Naomi'in, kachanu teni kinungle lhontan; Ibola keima toh nakilhon hon dingham? Kanaobua ji-a nanei theilhon ding chapa um nalaija ham?"},"12":{"text":"Kinungle lhonin, kachanu teni, chelhontan; ajehchu ji neikit dingin kateh behsehtai. Keiman kinepna kaneije tin seijing ting, tujan mamahin ji neijingting, chapate hingkit jongleng;"},"13":{"text":"Nangnin amaho kikhan lhit gei nangajou lhonding hinam? jineilouva amaho nangalhon dingham? Hitheiponte, kachanu teni; ajehchu Pakaiyin akhut keima douna-a alapjeh hin, nangni-a ding gelnan kalung ana tangeije, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chutichun amaho aw sangtah-in akap kit taove. Chuin Orpah in atehpi lhahnan achopmin; Ruth vang chun akolchahtan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Naomi in hitin aseije, ven na-unu amitele a-pathenho henga akilekit tai. Nangjong na-unu nung juijin kiletan, ati."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla Ruth'in, nangma dalha dingle nanung kajuina-a kona kinungle kit dingin neijol hih-in: ajehchu nache che na-a kache ding, nachen chenna-a kachen ding; namite chu kamite hia, na Pathen chu ka Pathen hiding;"},"17":{"text":"Nathi thi na-a kathi-a, hiche munna chu eikivui ding ahi. Thina tilouvin thil dangin eikhen lhonna ahile, Pakaiyin kachungah abolnom nom bolhen, achungnung jo cheh-in jong chuhsah jenghen, tin aseitai."},"18":{"text":"Naomi'in amounu amatoh kilhon dinga dettah-a apan amu phatchun, ajah-a imacha aseitapon ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hitichun amani Bethlehem alhunlhon kahsen achepeh lhontan ahi. Chuin ahitin ahi, Bethlehem alhunlhon phatchun, khosung pumpi chu amani jeh-in akiling soh jengin; chule numei hon, hichehi Naomi hilouham? atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chuin amanun ajah uva, Naomi neiti hih-un, Mara neitijouvin; ajehchu Hatchung nungin nasatah in eisugenthei tan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ninglhinga potdoh-a kahin, Pakaiyin ahomkeovin in eihin lepui kit tai. Pakaiyin keima douna ahet tohsah-a, Hatchung nungin kachungah gentheina achuhsah namu nunguva, ipi dinga Naomi neiti nahlaiju ham?"},"22":{"text":"Hitichun Naomi chu ahung kile kitnin, Moab numei amounu Ruth toh Moab gama konin ahung kile lhontan ahi. Chuin sakol chang ki-at patlaijin Bethlehem ahunglhung lhontai."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun, Naomi'in a-inneipu sopi mihaotah khat aneijin; ama chu Elimelech insunga kon ahin, amin chu Boaz ahi.","title":"Ruth'in Boaz Loulaija Changkhai Achom"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Moab numei Ruth'in Naomi jah-a, tun keima louva cheng kating, koihile amitmua lungset eichan penpen louva changkhai gaholinge, ati. Chuin Naomi'in ajah-a, kontan kachanu, ati.","ref":"Thmpu 19:9-10; Danb 24:19"},"3":{"text":"Chuin amanu apotdoh-in, achen, louva chang at-ho nunga changkhai aholtan ahi. Chule amanu chu Elimelech insungmi Boaz loulaija avahlut khatan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, Bethlehem'a konin Boaz ahungin, chang at-ho jah-a, Pakaiyin na-umpiu hen, ati. Chuin amahon jong Pakai;in nangma phatthei naboh hen, tin adonbutnuve."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Boaz in chang at-ho vesuija pang sohpa jah-a, hichenu hi hoi koi nungah ham? ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin chang at-ho vesuija pang sohpa chun adonbutnin, amanu hi Moab gama kon Naomi toh hung kinungle khangdong Moab nungahnu chu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Amanun, katao ahi, chang at-hon adalhah-u changphal lah-a changkhai neihol khom sah-in, atin; hitichun amanu ahungin, in'a chomcha akicholdo tilouvin, jingpi-a pat tuchan geihin achomkhom peh-in ahi, tin adonbutne."},"8":{"text":"Chujouvin Boaz chun Ruth jah-a hitin aseije, kachanu, kathusei nangai nah louding ham? Midang louva changkhai holdin chehih-in, hikoma konin jong potdoh hih'in, ahin ka numei ho toh kikhen louvin kivop jingin."},"9":{"text":"Amahon a-atnao loulai chu velhin lang, anungu juijin. Gollhang hon nangma natohkhah louna dinga thu kapeh louva nabol ham? nadang achah teng twibel phunga chenlang, gollhang hon ahinkhaiju twi chu donjin."},"10":{"text":"Chuin amanu tollah aboh khupmin, amapa jah-a, keima gamdang mi kahi munasa-a, ipijeh-a neihet thema, namitmu-a hibanga lungsetna kachan ham? ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Boaz'in adonbutnin, amanu jah-a, na-inneipu thinunga natehpi najennaho; nanule napa, napenna gam nahin dalhah-a, masanga nahet khahlou miho lah-a nahung thu kichentah-a eikihetsah ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Pakaiyin natohna chunga lethuhna napehen lang, chule kicholdo nadinga alhaving noi nahinjot Pakai Israel Pathen chun, kipaman lhingsetnin napehen, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin amanun, ka Pakai, na mitmu-a lungsetna changjing inge; ajehchu nasoh numei ho lah-a khatbeh hihih jongleng, nangman neilhamon in, nasohnu hi lungset tah in nei kihoulim pitai, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin an aneh phatnun, Boaz'in amanu jah-a, hungin lang an hungnen, chule nachanglhah halchu lengpitwi thuh-a hin hung kide-in, ati. Chuin amanu chu chang at-ho koma atoutan; amapa chun amanu chu changkanpoh apen, amanun ane vasetnin, amoh phabep akhenin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin amanu changkhaiho lohkhom dingin akipatdoh phatnin, Boaz'in asoh pasal ho athupeh-in, ajah uva, hichenu hi changphal ho lah jenga jong kilokhom sah-un, phohsal hih-un."},"16":{"text":"Chule changphal loma konin jong amanu kilokhom dingin phabep lhahsahthu jiuvin lang, phoh hih-un, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuti chun amanun nilhah geijin loulaija chun changkhai aholin, chule changkhai alokhom chengse chu avolhan ahileh, hichu sakol chang ephah khat tobang ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amanun hichu apon khopi sungah alutnin; atehpin achangkhai hinpoh chu amutan ahi. Chuin amanun anehvaset jouva anehval akhen chu atehpi apetan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin atehpin ajah-a, tunia hoilama changkhai nahol em? hoija na nagatoh em? Nangma nahin hethempa chu nunnom hen, ati. Chuin Ruth'in aloukona mipa chu atehpi jah-a aseipeh-in, ajah-a, tunia kakonna louneipa chu Boaz ahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Naomi'in amounu jah-a, Athiho le ahing nalaiho chungah lungsetna nungsun lou Pakai chu nunnom hen ati. Chuin Naomi'in ajah-a, hiche mipa chu eiho dinga isopiu, inko ikinaipi penhou lah-a khat ahi, ati.","ref":"Thmpu 25:25."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Moab numeinu Ruth'in, amapa chun kahengah, kachang a-at jou kahseovin, ka gollhangho toh kikhen louvin ummin, tin aseije ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Naom'in amounu Ruth jah-ah, kachanu, amapa numei ho toh nakon khomchu aphai. Ajehchu midang louva kon le chun hitabang chu namu louding ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Hitichun amanu Sakol chang le suhlou chang ki-atchai kahsen changkhai holdingin Boaz numei ho toh kikhen louvin aumkhomin; chule atehpi toh achengkhom lhontan ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin atehpi Naomi'in amanu jah-a, kachanu, nangdia thilpha asotheina dinga, nakicholdo nading kangaito peh louding ham?","title":"Ruth'in Aji Ding Amu"},"2":{"text":"Chule nangman anumeiho nakivop piji Boaz khu i-inkopau hilouham? Ven, tujan tengle phola sakolchang ajapchil ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun kisilngimin lang, thao kinun, navon phapen kivonin lang, pholla chesuh-in: ahin amapan neh le don achai masangsen akoma chun kiphong hih-in."},"4":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, alupna ding munchu melchih inlang, ama aluptengleh, chu-a chun lutnin, chule akeng hohdoh inlang chu-a chun lumin; chutengle aman nabolding nahil nante, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Ruth'in amanu jah-a, kahenga nasei jouse kabolding ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin amanu pholla achesuh-in, atehpin asei bangin agaboltai."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Boaz'in nehle don achai phatnin, lung kipah tah-in chang kisevum banna chun lum dingin achetan ahi; chuin amanu kangchan ahungin, amapa kengchu ahohdoh-in, chu-a chun alumtai."},"8":{"text":"Chuin khangkimin ahitin ahi, amapa chu akinin, agah kiheileh; ven, numei khat akeng todopmah alumin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin amapan koi nahim? ati. Amanun adonbutnin, nasohnu Ruth kahi; hijeh chun nasohnu hi naponmong neisilpeh in; ajehchu nangma kasopi kinaipi nahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin aman, kachanu, Pakaiyin phatthei naboh hen; ajehchu gollhang ahao hihen, avai hijongle anungu najuilou hin, amasalama sangin ajona lamah khotona namusah cheh-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule tun, kachanu, kicha hih-in; keiman na-ngeh jouse kabolpeh ding nahi: ajehchu kakhopi sunga kamite jousen numei chondihtah nahi ahesoh keijuve."},"12":{"text":"Tun keima nakinaipi nasopi kahichu adih-e; ahin keima sanga sopi kinaipi aumnalaije.","ref":"Ruth 2:20"},"13":{"text":"Tujan gehden tan, jingkah tengle hitiding ahi, amapa chun sopi khat boldingdol kinchu nangma chunga abola ahile, aphai; sopi boldingdol kinchu bolhen. Amavang aman hiche sopi boldingdol kinchu nangma chunga abol louva ahile, Pakai ahinjing bangin, keiman sopi boldingdol kinchu nangma chunga bolnange. Jing khovah kahsen gehdentan, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chutichun amanu chu amapa kengdopmah jingkah geijin alumtan; jingkah phalvah then masangin athoudohtan ahi. Chuin amapan, pholla numei ahunge ti koiman hetdahen, ati."},"15":{"text":"Aman amanu jah-a, naponsil chu hinchoijin lang, do-in, ati. Chuin aman ponchu adon ahile sakol chang tena gup atepeh-in, apohsahtai. Chuin amanu khopi sunglama aluttan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin amanu atehpi kom agalhun phat chun, atehpin, kachanu, ito nahungbah hinam? ati. Chuin amanun mipa chun ama dinga abolpeh jouse chu aseipehtan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule amanun, hiche sakol chang tena gup hi amapan eipeh ahi; ajehchu amapan kajah-a, natehpi henga khut gohkeovin chehih-in eiti, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amanun, kachanu, hiche thua hi ipi ahungso nahetchet kah-in khongaijin; ajehchu tunia hiche thuhi asuhchet masangse-a amapa kicholdo louding ahi, ati."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Boaz kotpi phung-ah achetouvin, chua chun atoutan ahi. Chuin ven, Boaz'in anasei akinaipi asopipa chu ahungin; Boaz'in ajah-a, golpa hung kiheijin lang, hikoma hin hungtouvin, ati. Chuin amajong akiheijin atoutai.","title":"Boaz'in Ruth Akichenpi"},"2":{"text":"Chuin aman khopi sunga upa som akouvin, ajah uva, hikoma hin touvun, ati. Chuin amaho atou taove."},"3":{"text":"Hichun aman akinaipipen asopipa jah-a, Moab gamma kona hungkile kit Naomi'in, isopipao Elimelech gam behkhat ajoh-in:"},"4":{"text":"Hiche thuhi nangma hetsah dinga kagel ahi, hikoma chengho le kamite upaho anga hichu kichohtan. Nangman nalhat dinga ahile, lhatnin; nalhat louding ahile, kahet thei nadin neisei peh-in; ajehchu nang tailou hiche lhatding chu koimacha aumpon, Keihi nang bantah-a kahi, ati. Chuin amapan, hichu lhatnange, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Boaz'in, Naomi khutna kona louchu nachoh ninile, agoulo chunga athipa min chu aumjing theina dinga, athipa inneipi Moab numei Ruth jong nachohtha ding ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Hichun asopi kinaipipa chun, keima dingin lhat thei ponge, atiloule keima neilegou ngeijong kisuh chatvai ding ahi. Lhatdohna tha kanei jonghi nangma chang maijin, ajehchu keiman kalhat thei louding ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Masanglaijin Israelte lah-a lhatdohna le kilhet tona chung changa chonna ngai dan chu hiti ahi: ipi thu hitale suhchetna dinga chu, pasal khatnin akengkoh asutlhah-a, michom khatpa chu apehji ahi: hichu Israelte lah-a suhdetna hija ahi.","ref":"Danb 25:9."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun asopi kinaipi penpa chun Boaz jah-a, nangma dingin kilhattan, ati. Chuti chun aman akengkoh asutlhan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Boaz'in upaho le mipi jouse jah-a, tunia hi nangho hichehi ahetoh nahiuve, keiman Naomi khutna konin Elimelech gou jouse, chule Chilion le Mahlon neijouse aboncha kachoh ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Hiche chungvum chun, athipa minchu agouva aumjinga, hitia chu athipa min chu asopiho lah-a kon leh aumna mun kotpi phunga kona kahlhah-a aumlouna dingin, Moab numei Ruth, Mahlon inneipi jong kajidingin kachoh thatai; tunia hi ahetoh-a nangho nahiuve, ati.","ref":"Danb 25:5-6"},"11":{"text":"Chuin kotpi phunga um mijouse le upaho chun ajah-a, keiho ahetoh kahiuve. Pakaiyin na-insunga hunglut numeinu hi Israel insung tungdoh teni, Rachel le Leah tobang hisah hen; chule nangma jong Ephrathah'a phathei jin lang, Bethlehem'a namin kithang hen.","ref":"Semt 29:31."},"12":{"text":"Pakaiyin hiche khangdong numeinu chilhah-a kona napehding na-insung chu, Judah dinga Tamar ahinpeh Pharez insung tobang chu hihen, atiuve.","ref":"Semt 38:27-30"},"13":{"text":"Hitichun Boaz'in Ruth akipuijin, ji-in aneitai. Chuin ama amanu koma alut phatnin, Pakaiyin amanu chu nao avopsah-in, chapa khat ahingtan ahi.","title":"Boaz Chilhah"},"14":{"text":"Chuin numei hon Naomi jah-a, Tuni tah ngeija sopi kinaipi beija nadalha louva Pakai chu nunnom hen; chule amapa hi Israel sunga amin kithang hen."},"15":{"text":"Chule amapa hi nahinkho kiledohsah le nateh nunga navah-a hungpang hen; ajehchu nangma nangailu-a, nangma dinga chapa sagi sanga phachomjo namounun amahi ahin ahi, atiuve."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Naomi'in naosen chu alan, a-angah apomin, adonin apangtan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin a-inheng numei hon naocha min asah-un, Naomi'a dingin chapa khat apenge, atiuvin; Obed asahtaove. Amahi David pa, Jesse pa ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tun hicheho hi Perez chilhah ahiuve. Perez in Hezron ahingin,"},"19":{"text":"Hezron'in Ram ahingin, Ram'in Amminadab ahingin,"},"20":{"text":"Amminadab'in Nahshon ahingin, Nahshon'in Salmon ahingin,"},"21":{"text":"Salmon'in Boaz ahingin, Boaz in Obed ahingin,"},"22":{"text":"Obed'in Jesse ahingin, Chule Jesse'in David ahinge."}}}}},"9":{"info":{"name":"1 Samuel","shortname":"1 Sam","abbr":[],"desc":"Samuel Lekhabu Khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Ephraim molsang Ramathiam Zophim mun'a Ephrath mi, Zuph chapa, Tohu chapa, Elihu chapa, Jeroham chapa, amin Elkanah kiti mikhat anaumin ahi.","title":"Shiloh Mun'a Elkanah le A-insung Mite"},"2":{"text":"Chule aman ji ni aneijin, khatnu minchu Hannah ahin, achom khatjonu minchu Peninnah ahi. Chule Peninnah chun cha aneijin, ahinla Hannah'in vang cha aneipoi."},"3":{"text":"Chule hiche mipahi akhopia konin kumsehle Shiloh'a janel Pakai houding le ganlhai boldin achetoujin ahi. Chule Pakai thempu Eli chapateni Hophni le Phinehas chu hia chu umji lhon ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Elkanah hin thilto aneiphat tengle a-inneipi Peninnah le achapate le achanute jouse chu chan apejin,"},"5":{"text":"Ahinla Hannah vang chun achanding doltah apejin ahi: ajehchu aman Hannah angailun, ahinla amanu chu Pakaiyin anaobu akhapeh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin anaobu akhapeh jehchun khatjonu chun alungnat nadingin nasatah-in alunghansah jin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule chutia chu kumseh-a aboljing ahin, Pakai in'a amanu achetou tengle amanu aphinsejin; hijeh chun amanu akapmin anjong aneji tapoi."},"8":{"text":"Chujouvin Elkanah'in a-inneipi Hannah hengah, Ibola naka ham? ebola an nelouva um nahim? chule ibola lungkhama uma nahim? Keima nang dinga chapa som sanga phajoa kahi louham? ati."},"9":{"text":"Chutia amahon Shiloh'a an aneh uva, chule twi adonjou phatnun, Hannah akipatdoh tan ahi. Tun Eli thempu chu Pakai houin khom khat bula touna chunga touva ahi.","title":"Hannah le Eli"},"10":{"text":"Chuin amanu chu ahinna ahesoh lheh jengin, Pakai henga ataovin, chule laina tah-in akapmin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amanu kitepna khatna akitepmin, Vo janel Pakai, nasohnu thohgimnahi neivet peh-a, neihet jinga, nasohnu hi nasuhmil louva, nasohnu hi chapa khat neipeh-a ahile, chuteng ahinkho lhumkeija Pakaiya kapeh ding, alua samchem kilamlou ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Minb 6:5"},"12":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, amanu Pakai anga ataojom jing laihin, Eli'n amuh phunchu anaven ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tun Hannah hin alungsunga asei ahijeh-in, amuh bouchu aphunin, ahin a-aw vang akijapoi. Hijeh chun Eli'n amanu jukhamin agelin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Eli'n amanu jah-a, Itihchan nakham dingham? Naju chu nanga konin koimangin, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Hannah'in adonbutnin, Ahipoi, ka pakai, keima lungkham na-a dim numei kahi; keiman ju le khamnathei jong kadonpoi, amavang Pakai anga kahina kabuhlhah joh ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nasohnu hi Belial chanun neisim hih-in, ajehchu kakiphina le kahesohna tambehseh jenga tuchana hi thu kasei ahi, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuphatnin Eli'n adonbutnin, Lung mongin chetan: Israel Pathen'in nathilthum chu naphal pehtai ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amanun, Nasohnu hi namitnun lungsetna neimusah-in, ati. Chutichun hiche numei chu achena ding lampia achen, an anen, chule lungkham mel aputapon ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin amaho jingkah matah-in athouvun, Pakai ahouvun, akileuvin, a-in'u Ramah'ah ahung taove. Chuin Elkanah'in a-inneipi Hannah chu aluppin; chule Pakaiyin amanu chu ageldoh tan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun ahung hitin ahi, Hannah'in nao avopma, aphat ahunglhin tah-in chapa khat ahingin, Pakai henga kanathum ahi atin, amin Samuel asahtai.","title":"Samuel Pen le Akikatdoh"},"21":{"text":"Chuin Elkanah kitipa le a-insung mijouse chu Pakaiya kumtin ganlhai le akitepna tohdohdin achetou taove."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla Hannah achetoupoi; ajehchu amanun a-inneipu henga, Naosen in noi abankahsea kachetou louding ahi, Pakai anga gaki lahthei ahi-a, chule chumuna a-itih-a aumden theiding teng kahinpui ding ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin a-inneipu Elkanah'in ajah-a, Nangman phante nati bangchun boltan; noi aban kahsen khongai jengin; Pakaiyin bou athu chu phutdet hen, ati. Chutichun amanu aum denin, chule achapan noi aban kahsen avah-in ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin amanun noi abansah phatnin, ama chu alhontoupin; bongchal thumtoh, changbong ephah khat le lengpitwi haikhat toh Shiloh'a Pakai in'a ahinpuitai: chule chapang chu khangdong cha ahi nalaije."},"25":{"text":"Chuin bongchal khat athatnun, naosen chu Eli henga apuitaovin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin amanun, Vo ka pakai, nangma nahinjing bangin, ka pakai, hilaimuna nangma koma ana dinga Pakai henga anataova numei chu keima kahi."},"27":{"text":"Hiche chapang dinga hi anataova kahin; Pakaiyin ahenga kanathum kataona chu eipetai."},"28":{"text":"Hijeh chun keiman jong amahi Pakai henga kapeh ahi; ama ahinlai chansea Pakaiya hiding ahi, ati. Chuin amapan chukoma chun Pakai ahoutan ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Hannah ataovin, Kalungsung Pakaiya akipah lheh-in, Pakaiya ka ki hi choisangin aumin ahi: nami huhhingna-a chu kakipa jeh-in, kamelmate chunga kakam akikeh lenin ahi.","title":"Hannah Taona","ref":"Luk 1:46-55."},"2":{"text":"Pakai banga thenga koima aumpoi: ajehchu nang tailou koimacha dang aumpon; i-Pathen'u tobang songpi jong aumpoi."},"3":{"text":"Kiletsah valin thu seitahih-in; nakamin hoithona thu pothih hen: ajehchu Pakai chu hetna Pathen ahin, chule aman thil kibol jouse aleptohji ahi."},"4":{"text":"Mihatte thalpi abong gamin, chule akipal lhuho chu hatna-in ataiju akigah pehtai."},"5":{"text":"Ana oivaho-a chu neh holnan amaho le amaho changlhah mandin akipedoh-un, anakel ho akelkit tapouve: chutichun achingan cha sagi ahingtan, chatam neinuchu alhasamtai."},"6":{"text":"Pakaiyin athatnin achoh hingjin: chule thikholkhul'a apuisuh-in apuidoh kitjin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pakaiyin avaichatsah-in chule ahaosahjin; aman asunemin chule adomsang jin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Aman mivaicha chu leivuija konin akaithouvin; leng chapate lah-a tousah dingle, loupina laltouna losah dingin; khutdo chu eh lah-a konin adom doh-in ahi. Ajehchu leiset khompi jouse Pakaiya ahin, achunguva chu vannoihi atun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aman amithengte kengchu achintup ding; chule migiloupa chu muthima thipbeh-a umding ahi; ajehchu thahatna koima dingjou louding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Pakai douho chu ahal hala kisuchipdiu; amaho chunga Ama van'a kona hung kitumding ahi. Pakaiyin leiset kolmong gei thu atan ding; aman alengpa chu thahat apehding, athaonupa ki chu achoisang ding ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Elkanah a-in lam Ramah kho-a achetai. Chule chapang chun Eli thempu masanga Pakai kin aboltan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tun Eli chapa teni chu Belial chapate ahilhonin, amanin Pakai ahe lhonpon ahi.","title":"Eli Chapate"},"13":{"text":"Chule mipi ho lah-a thempuho bolding chu, khattouvin akilhaina atodoh teng, sa chu asou laitah le thempu sohpa chun satul kathum neikhat ahinchoija;"},"14":{"text":"Chule aman hichu bel bilnei, khangbel len, ahiloule bel sunga chu asutlutna, satul ka-a ahin khaidoh jouse chu thempupan ama dinga akilahji ahi. Hitia hi Shiloh'a hung Israelte jouse henga aboljiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Sathao chu ago masang uva jong thempu sohpa chu hunga, ganlhaina bolpa jah-a chu, Thempupa-a dinga gopeh dingin saphe chu neipen; ajehchu aman nanga kona akihon minsa alah louding, asel bou alahding ahi, atiji ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule khattouvin ahenga, Amahon athao ago masat teiju ngai ahi, chujou tengle nahinnan adeijat jat kilah-in tia aseija ahileh; aman, Ahipoi, tu-a hi neipeh teiding ahi, achuti loule thahatsana kalahding ahi, tia adonbut ji ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuti chun gollhangho chonsetna chu Pakai masanga anasalheh jengtan; mihon Pakaiya thilto chu athetlo taovin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Amavang chapangchan Samuel'in tupat ponnem thempu boitong sangkhol aki-ah in, Pakai anga lhacha na atongin ahi.","title":"Shiloh Mun'a Samuel"},"19":{"text":"Chukalvalin anun sangkhol chol neokhat akhuipeh-in, kumsehle ganlhaina boldinga a-inneipu toh ahungtou lhonteng ahinchoi pehjin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Eli'n Elkanah le a-inneipi phatthei aboh-in, Pakai henga thilpeh jalchun hiche numeija hin Pakaiyin sonle pah napelhon hen, ati. Chuin a-in lhona achelhon tai."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Hannah ahung vilin ahile amanun nao avopmin, chapa thumle chanu ni ahingin ahi. Chule chapang Samuel chu Pakai angsunga akhanglenin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tun Eli atehlheh jengtan, Israelte jouse chunga achapateni thilbol jouse; houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga numei hung kikhom ho iti alup piji lhonham ti ajatan ahi.","title":"Eli le Achapate"},"23":{"text":"Chuin aman aheng lhonna, Ibola chutobang thil nabolhon ham? Ajehchu nakhanset bollhon chu hiche miho-a konhin kajan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ahipoi, kachateni; kajahhi thulhut phaloutah ahi: nangnin Pakai mite chu nachon khelsah lhon ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Mikhat tou midang douna-a achonsetna ahile, thutanpan athu atan ding ahin: ahin mikhat tou Pakai douna-a achonsetna ahile, kon ama dinga ataopeh dingham? ati. Ahijeng vangin Pakaiyin amani thading atup jeh chun, apao thusei chu angaideh lhonpon ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin chapang Samuel chu akhang akhangin, Pakai le mihem deisah-in aumtan ahi.","ref":"Luk 2:52."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Pathen mikhat Eli henga ahungin, ajah-a hitin ati, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Amaho Egypt gama Pharaoh insunga aum laijuva chu napa insunga kichentah-a kana phondoh hitalou ham?","title":"Eli Insung Chunga Gaothu Kisei"},"28":{"text":"Chule Israel phung jouse-a kona kathempu hiding, ka-maicham chunga thilto ding, gimnamtui halding, chule kamasanga thempu boitong sangkhol kivon dinga kana lhendoh hilouham? Chule Israel chate meija kigou thilpeh jouse napa insung kanapeh hilouham?","ref":"Pot 28:1-4; Thmpu 7:35-36"},"29":{"text":"Ipi dinga kaumna-a kathupeh kaganlhaina le kathilto napeh manga, kami Israelte thilpeh jouse-a kon ahoipen chun nathao dohsah nadinga keisanga nachapateni najabol joh ham?"},"30":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai Israel Pathen'in, Keiman nangma insungle napa insungchu a-imatih chana kamasanga vahle diu ahi, tia anasei ahin: ahinla tun Pakaiyin, Hichu keija konin gamla tahen; ajehchu eijabol ho chu kajabol ding, chule nahsah louva eibolho chu nahsah louva kabolding ahi, ati."},"31":{"text":"Vetan, na-insunga tehse khatcha aumlouna dinga, nangma ban le napa insung mite ban kasatlhah nading nikhoho chu ahung lhungtai."},"32":{"text":"Chule Kachen namun le Pathen'in Israel apehding gou jouse-a chu melma khat aum namu ding: chule a-imatih chana na-insunga tehse umta louhel ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule ka-maicham'a kona kasatlhah louding namipa chu namitlhi sosah dingle nalungsung suna dinga kakoiding: chule na-inna peng jouse chu adonglai cheh-a thiding ahiuve."},"34":{"text":"Chule hichehohi nachapateni Hopni le Phinehas chunga thil hunglhung dingho namelchihna ahi; nikhat sunga anilhona thilhon ding ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 4:11"},"35":{"text":"Chule keiman kalungthim le kangaito dungjuija tongding, keima dinga thempu tahsan umtah khat kitundoh ding: chule keiman a-insung dettah-a katundohpeh ding; chule ama a-itih-a kathaonupa masanga vahle jing ding ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, na-in'a umnalai chasun chu ahenga hunguva dangka pehkhat le changlhah kamkhat athum diu, ahenga, Changlhah halkhat kaneh theina dingin, thempu natoh khat neipen, tia asei dingu ahi, ati."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chapang Samuel chu Eli masanga Pakai kin bolin apangin ahi. Chule hichelai chun Pakai thuchu amantam lheh jengin; phongtah-a kilahna anaumpoi.","title":"Samuel Henga Pakai Kilah"},"2":{"text":"Chuin hiche laichun ahitin ahi, Eli chu aumna-a alupma, kho muthei lou leuva amitchu ahung thima;"},"3":{"text":"Chule Pathen kitepna thingkhong umna Pakai houin'a Pathen thaomei chu amit masang, chule Samuel chu imu ding aluplhah petnin;"},"4":{"text":"Chutichun Pakaiyin Samuel akouvin ahile aman, Hikoma kaume, tin adonbutnin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin ama Eli henga alhaijelin, Hikoma kaume; ajehchu nangman neikouve, agatin ahi. Chuin aman, Kakoupoi, galumkit tan, ati. Chuin ama achen alumtai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin avelin akoukitnin, Samuel, ati. Chuin Samuel athouvin, Eli henga chun achekitnin, Hikoma kaume; ajehchu nangman neikou monge, ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Kakoupoi, kachapa; galum kittan, ati."},"7":{"text":"Tun Samuel'in Pakai chu ahehih laijin, Pakai thujong chu ahenga akiphong hihlaije."},"8":{"text":"Chuin athumvei channa-in Pakaiyin Samuel akoukitnin ahi. Chuin ama athouvin, Eli henga achen, ajah-a, Hikoma kaume; ajehchu nangman neikou monge, ati. Chuin Eli'n Pakaiyin chapang chu akou ahi ahedohtan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun Eli'n Samuel henga, Chen, galum kittan; chule hitiding ahi, aman nahinkou kitna ahileh, nangman, Seijin, Pakai, nasoh in kajanai natiding ahi, ati. Chutichun Samuel aumna-a agalumtai."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Pakai ahungin, adingin, amasa-a bangchun, Samuel, Samuel, tin akouvin ahi. Hichun Samuel'in adonbutnin, Seijin; ajehchu nasoh-in kajanai, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Samuel jah-a, Ven Israel sunga thilkhat kabolding ahin, hichun ajachan nakhang asutding ahi.","title":"Eli Insunga Pathen Kiphonna"},"12":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule Eli douna-a a-insung chungchanga kanasei jousechu kaboldoh ding; kakipat tengle achaina jong kabolding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu aman ahetsa khansetna jeh-a, a-insung chu a-imatih chana athu katan ding ahi tia kahilsa ahitai. Ajehchu achapa tenin thilse abol lhonin, aman amani anaphoh tangpoi."},"14":{"text":"Chule hichejeh-a chu keiman Eli insung chunga kana kihahsela, Eli insung khansetna chu ganlhai le anneh thilto-a jong a-itih-a suhtheng thei hilouding ahi, kanati ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Samuel chu jingkah geijin alumin, Pakai in kot ho ahongin ahi. Chule Samuel'in Eli henga athilmu hetsah dingchu akichalheh-in ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hichun Eli'n Samuel akouvin, ajah-a, Kachapa Samuel ati. Chuin Samuel'in adonbutnin, hikoma kaume, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin aman, Pakaiyin nahenga aseichu ipithu ham? kangeh nahi, Keija konin imhih-in: nahenga aseijouse chu kahenga na-im auma ahile, Pathen'in nahenga chutobang chun chule akhohcheh-in jong bolhen, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in thujouse chu ahilin, chule ahenga imacha a-im aumpoi. Chuin aman, Ama Pakai ahin, aman pha asah sah chun bolmaihen, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Samuel chu ahung khanglen jep jepmin, Pakaiyin aumpin, chule ama thuho chu khatcha jong tolla alhah sahpon ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Dan'a pat Beersheba geijin Israelte jousen Samuel chu Pakai themgao khatnin akitung dohtai ti ahetauve."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Shiloh'a chun Pakai ahung kilah kitnin ahi: ajehchu Pakai thu dungjuija Shiloh'a chu Pakai amatah Samuel henga kiphongdoh ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Samuel thu chu Israelte jouse henga ahung lhungtan ahi. Tun Israelte chu Philistine te satdin akondoh taovin, Ebenezer panga ponbuh asongun: Philistine te chun Aphek mun'a ponbuh asongun ahi.","title":"Kitepna Thingkhong Kilahpeh"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Philistine te chu Israelte satdingin amaho le amaho akigol toh-un: chuin gal akisat phatnun Israelte chu Philistine te masanga agallel taovin; chule amahon galmuna chun galsat mi sangli tobang athat taovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin mipi chu gebuh ahunglhun phatnun Israel upaho chun, Ipijeh-a tunia Pakaiyin Philistine te masanga eigol lel sah-u ham? Shiloh'a konin Pakai kitepna thingkhong chu eiho henga dingin gapodoh-u hitin, hichu ilah uva ahungteng, hichun igalmiteu khutna konin eihuhdoh theijunte, atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Hijeh chun mipichun Cherub teni kikah-a cheng janel Pakai kitepna thingkhong chu chua kona agapoh theina diuvin Shiloh'a mi asolun: chule Eli chapateni Hophni le Phinehas chu Pathen kitepna thingkhong chutoh chukoma chun aum lhonin ahi.","ref":"Pot 25:22"},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thingkhong chu gebuh ahunglhun phatnin Israelte jousen ha aovin a-aovun, hitichun leiset akithong leovin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Philistine ten gingleng lunga a-ao ginu ajah phatnun, Hebrew miho gebuh-a ging lenglung khu ipithu hitam, akitiuvin ahi. Chuin amahon Pakai kitepna thingkhong gebuh hunglhung ahi ti ahechen taove."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Philistine ten Gebuh-a Pathen hunglut ahi atiuvin akicha taovin ahi. Chuin amahon, Ohe idau ahi! ajehchu tumasangin hitobang thil anasoh khapoi."},"8":{"text":"Ohe idau ahi! hiche hat chungnung Pathenho khutna kona kon eihuhdoh diuham? Hichehohi gamthipma Egypt mite hivei jouse-a sugama Pathenho chu ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Vo nangho Philistine te, nangho soh-a ana um banguva, Hebrew mite soh-a naum louna dingun hatnunlang, kipasal sah-un: nangho kipasal sah-un lang, satnun atiuve."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Philistine techun asatnun, Israelte chu jo-in aum taovin, chule amaho amitakip aponbuh lam cheh uva ajam taovin; chule nasatah-a kithana aumin ahi: ajehchu Israelte chu keng sepai sangsomthum athiuvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Pathen kitepna thingkhong chu alah peh-un; chule Eli chapateni Hophni le Phinehas jong athat taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin sepai lah-a konin Benjamin phunga kon mikhat alhaijelin, apon teldehduh le aluchanga leiset pumin hicheni mama chun Shiloh'a alhailutnin ahi.","title":"Eli Thi"},"13":{"text":"Chuin ama ahungphatnin, veuvin, Eli chu lampamah touna chung khatna atouvin, anaven ahi: ajehchu Pathen kitepna thingkhong jeh chun alungsung akithingin ahi. Chule mipa khopi sunga ahunglut phatchun aseijin ahile khopi pumpi mihochu hakan akaptaovin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule Eli'n ka awgin chu ajah phatnin, Hiche awging lullul khu ipithu hitam? ati. Chuin mipa chun kinotah-in ahungin, Eli ahung hiltai."},"15":{"text":"Tun Eli chu kum somko le kumget ahitan; amit athimin, kho amuthei tapon ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin mipan Eli jah-a, Keima sepai lah-a kona hungdoh-a kahin, tunia hi sepaiho lah-a kona hungjam doh kahi, ati. Chuin aman, Kachapa, chukoma chu ipi soh em? ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin thupopan adonbutnin ajah-a, Philistine te masanga chun Israelte ajamun, mipi lah-a chun nasatah-a kithana aumin, chule nachapa teni Hophni le Phinehas jong athi lhonin, Pathen kitepna thingkhong jongchu alataove, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, aman Pathen kitepna thingkhong aphahpoh phatnin, kotpi phung sih-a chun atouna-a konin anung lhuh-in, angong atat bongin, athitan ahi; ajehchu ama tehse ahin, gih-a ahi. Chule aman kum somli Israelte thu anatanin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule amounu Phinehas inneipi chu naovopma soh koncha ahi: chuin aman Pathen kitepna thingkhong kilahle atehpu le a-inneipu thithu ajah phatnin, ama abungin nao aneitan ahi. Ajehchu anatchu achunga hunglhung ahitai.","title":"Meithai Phinehas Jinu Thi"},"20":{"text":"Chuin ama athikon chun akoma ding numei ho chun, Kicha hih-in; ijeh inem itile chapa khat nahin ahi, atiuve. Ahinla amanun adonbut tapon, ngaijong angaisah tapoi."},"21":{"text":"Hichun amanun naosen min chu Ichabod asah-in, Loupina chu Israel'a konin akitol mangtai ati: Pakai kitepna thingkhong kilahpeh jeh le, atehpu le a-inneipu jeh ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin amanun, Loupina chu Israel'a kon kitolmang ahitai: ajeh chu Pathen thingkhong kilahmanga ahitai, ati."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Philistine ten Pathen thingkhong chu alauvin, Ebenezer'a konin Ashdod'a ahinpouvin ahi.","title":"Philistine te Lah-a Kitepna Thingkhong"},"2":{"text":"Philistine ten Pathen thingkhong ahinlah phatnun, Dagon in'a ahinpouvin, Dagon koma akoi taovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule ajing jingkah matah-a Ashdod miho atho phatnun, veuvin, Dagon chu Pakai thingkhong masanga chun amai tollam ngan analhutan ahi. Chuin amahon Dagon chu adomdoh-un akitunna mama-a chun atung kitnun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin ajing jingkah matah-a atho phatnun, veuvin, Dagon chu Pakai thingkhong masanga chun amai tollam ngan analhun; chule Dagon luchang le akhutphang teni chu tanbohsan kotbula chun anaumin, Dagon tahsa chubou ana kidalhan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun Dagon thempupa hihen lang, Dagon insunga hung koi hijongle, Ashdod'a Dagon kotphung chu tuni geijin achon pouvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai khutchu Ashdod mite chunga gihsatah-in achun, chule amaho chu asumangin, Ashdod le agam kimvela chengho chu uilutnin ajepmin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Ashdod miten hichu amuphatnun, Israel Pathen thingkhong hi eihotoh umthei ponte: ajehchu ama khut chu eiho chungle i-pathen'u Dagon chunga anasa behseh jengin ahi, atiuve."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun amahon Philistine te milen milal jouse ahenguva akou khomun, Israel Pathen thingkhong hi i-ilo diuham? atiuve. Chuin amahon adonbutnun, Israel Pathen thingkhong chu Gath lama kipotahen, atiuve. Chuin Israel Pathen thingkhong chu chulama chun apotaove."},"9":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, hichu chulama apoh nungun, Pakai khutchu suhgamna nasatah-in khopi dounan achun; khopi sunga mite chu alen aneo abonun ajepmin, achunguva uilut achutan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun amahon Pathen thingkhong chu Ekron'a asoltaove. Chuin ahitin ahi, Ekron'a Pathen thingkhong ahunglhun phatnin, Ekron mite chu apeng jah-un, Amahon eiho le imiteu thatgam dingin Pathen thingkhong chu eiho henga ahinpouve, atiuvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun Philistine milen milal ho jouse chu agakoukhom sah-un, ahenguva, Israel Pathen thingkhong hi solmangun, chule eiho imiteu eitha louna dingin aum namun mama-a chekit tahen, atiuve. Ajehchu hiche khopi jouse sunga chu suhgamna nasatah uma ahitan; Pathen khut chu gihsatah-a chua ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Chule mihem athilouho chunga chun uilut achun; chule khopi-a kana awgin chu van alhung touvin ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai thingkhong chu Philistine gama lhasagi aga umin ahi.","title":"Kitepna Thingkhong Hungkile Kit"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Philistine ten thempuho le doithemho akouvun, ahenguva, Pakai thingkhong chu ikalodiuham? Aumna ngaija chu iti kasol diuham? neisei peh-un, atiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chuin amahon, Israelte Pathen thingkhong chu nasol ule agoh-in solhih-un, ahinla suhkhel thilto khattoh nalesoltha teidiu ahi; chuteng nadam uva, ipijeh-a nangho-a kona akhut achondoh louham ti nahet dingu ahi, atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Hichun amahon, Amatoh kalesol tha dingu suhkhel thilpeh dingchu ipi hiding ham? atiuve. Amahon adonbutnun, Philistine te milal ho jat dungjuija uilut lim sanatum ngale sana jucha lim nga; ajehchu nabon chaova chungle namilen milal hou chunga chu natna kibang chua ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun gamsung suse na-uilutnu limle najucha limu chu nasem uva; chule Israel Pathen chu loupina napeh dingu ahi. Chuti henlang hile nanghole na-pathen hou, chule nagam uva konin akhut ajangkhaisah domding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuti ahile ibola Egypt mite leh Pharaoh banga nalungu natahsah uham? Aman alah uva kidangtah-a na atoh phatna chu amahon mipi achedohsah uva, chule amaho potdoh-u hilouham?"},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun kangtalai thah khat semun lang, namkoljon pokhalou bongpi noi kilhohlai ni kaijun, chule bong kang chuto sutouvin lang, anouteni chu amani-a konin inlama hinkaijun."},"8":{"text":"Chule Pakai thingkhong chu domun lang bongkang chunga koijun; chule suhkhel thilpeh ding sana tum amato nung soltha dinga nasemhou chu thingkhong khatna khumun lang apanga koijun; chule achemang nadingin solmangun."},"9":{"text":"Chule Beth-shemesh lampia ama gamkaija chu chetoupeh-am veuvin; achetou peh-a ahile hiche thilse khohtahhi amabol hija ahi; amavang achetoupeh louva ahile, eisugimuva chu ama khut ahipon, achama ichunguva hungsoh ahi ti ihetdiu ahi, atiuve."},"10":{"text":"Chuin mihon achuti bolun, bongpi noi kilhohlai ni akaijun, chule bongkang chuto asutouvin, chule anouteni chu in'a ahentup taove."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thingkhong le sana jucha lim le uilut lim umna thingkhong chu bongkang chunga chun akhangdoh taove."},"12":{"text":"Chuin bongpi tenichun Beth-shemesh jotna lamchu ajonjang lhonin, kun pumin lamlhongpi chu ajotpeh lhonin, jetle veija apetdoh lhonpoi; chule Philistine milal hochun Beth-shemesh gamgi geijin ajuipeh-un ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule Beth-shemesh mihochun phaichama chu asuhlou changu ana-atnu ahin: amaho akhoda uva ahile thingkhong chu amutaovin, hiche amujeh-u chun akipah lheh-un ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin bongkang chu Beth-shemesh khomi Joshua lou ahung lutnin, chua songpi lentah khat umna-a chun adingtai. Chuin amahon bongkang thingchu a-eh un, bongpi tenichu Pakai henga govam thilto-in atoh taove."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Levi hon Pakai thingkhong le aumpi sana manluho umna thingkhong chu alalhauvin, songpilen chunga chun akoitaove. Chule Beth-shemesh mihon hiche nikho mama chun Pakai henga govam thiltoho le ganlhainaho abol taovin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Philistine milal ngahon hiche amuphatnun, hicheni mama chun Ekhron'a akile taove."},"17":{"text":"Chule Philistine ten Pakai henga suhkhel thilto dinga ahin nungsolu uilut lim sanatumho chu ahile; Ashdod dinga khat, Gaza dinga khat, Ashkelon dinga khat, Gath dinga khat, chule Ekron dinga khat ahin;"},"18":{"text":"Chule sana jucha limho chu, kul kikai khum khopiho le thinglhang khoneoho puma Philistine te milen milal nga ho khopi jouse jat dungjuija ahin, Pakai thingkhong akoilhahnao Abel songpilen chung geichu ahi. Hiche songpi chu Beth-shemesh mite Joshua loulaija chu tuni geijahi umjing nalai ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin amahon Pakai thingkhong sung avetjeh-un, Aman Bethshemesh mihochu athatnin; mipi ho lah-a mi sangsomnga le somsagi jen athatnin ahi. Pakaiyin mipichu tamtah atha jeh-in mipi chu alunghem taovin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Beth-shemesh miho chun, Hiche Pakai Pathen thengtah masanga hi koiham adingjou dinga? Chule eihoa kona ama koihenga chedoh dingham? atiuve.","title":"Kiriath-Jearim Mun'a Kitepna Thingkhong"},"21":{"text":"Chuin amahon Kirjath-jearim kho miho henga thupole ho asolun, ahenguva, Philistine ten Pakai thingkhong ahinpokit taove; hungsuh-un lang naheng uva potaovin, atiuve."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Kirjath-jearim miho chu ahungun, Pakai thingkhong chu apotouvun, thinglhanga Abinadab insunga apolutnun, achapa Eleazar chu Pakai thingkhong chingtup dingin athenso taove.","ref":"2 Sam 6:2-4; 1 Thusm 13:5-7."},"2":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Kirjath-jearim'a thingkhong chu phat sottah aumin ahi; ajehchu kum somni jen uma ahi. Hitichun Israel insung pumpi chun Pakai lhangaijin akachamun ahi.","title":"Samuel'in Israel Chunga Vai Ahom"},"3":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Israel insung jouse jah-a, Nangho nalung pumpiuva Pakai henga hungkile nahiuva ahile, nalah uva konin gamchom pathenho le Ashtaroth chu koimangun; chule Pakaiya din nalungu gongtup unlang, amabou jenun: chutile aman Philistine te khutna kona nahuhdoh dingu ahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Hichun Israel ten Baalim le Ashtaroth chu akoimangun, Pakai bou ajentaove."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in, Israelte chu abonchauvin Mizpeh'a khom khomun, chule keiman Pakai henga nataopeh uvinge, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Mizpeh'a akikhom khomun, twi athalun, Pakai angsunga asunglhaovin, hiche nikho chun an angolun, Keiho Pakai dounan kachonse taove, atiuve. Chuti chun Samuel'in Israelte chu Mizpeh'a athu-u atanin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Philistine ten Israelte Mizpeh'a akikhom khomuve ti ajah phatnun, Philistine milal ho chu Israelte doudingin akontouvin ahi. Chuin Israel chaten hichu ajah phatnun, Philistine te chu akicha taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Israel chaten Samuel henga, Philistine te khutna kona eihuhdoh nadingun Pakai ka-Pathen'u hengu keiho dingin tanglouvin neitao peh-un, atiuve."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in kelngoinou noicheplai khat alan, apumin Pakai henga govam thilto-in atohdoh-in: Israelte din Pakai henga ataovin; Pakaiyin asanpehtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in govam thilto ato laijin, Philistine te chu Israel satdin ahung naijun ahi. Ahinla Pakaiyin hiche nikho chun Philistine te chunga vangin nasatah aginsah-in, alungboi sah-in, Israelte masanga agal lel taovin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Israel mite chu Mizpeh'a konin apotdoh-un, Philistine te chu anungdelun, Beth-car aphah kahseovin athatpeh-un ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chujouvin Samuel'in song khat alan, Mizpeh le Shen kah-a atungin, chuin Hichan geijahi Pakaiyin eipanpiu ahi atin, aminchu Ebenezer asahtai."},"13":{"text":"Chutichun Philistine te chu suhnemin aumun, chule amaho Israelte gamsunga ahungkit tapouve. Samuel nikho laisen Pakai khutchun Philistine te adou jingin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule Philistine ten Israel te-a kona analah khopiho chu Ekron'a pat Gath geijin Israelte alepeh kit tan; chule agam kimvelho jouse jongchu Philistine te khutna konin Israel ten alelah kit taovin ahi. Chule Israelte le Amor mite kah-a chun chamna aumin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule Samuel'in ahinlai sungin Israelte thu anatanin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule akumseh'in Bethel le Gilgal, chule Mizpeh'a achekol lejingin, hiche munho-a chun Israelte thu atanjin ahi"},"17":{"text":"Chule Ramah'a chun a-in aumjeh'in ahungkile kitjin; chule hia chun Israelte thu anatanjin; hia chun Pakai dingin maicham khat asemin ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Samuel ateh phatnin achapa teni chu Israelte chunga thutandin apansah tan ahi.","title":"Mipiten Leng Ding Angeh-u"},"2":{"text":"Tun achapa lenpenpa minchu Joel ahin; aninapa minchu Abiah ahi: amanichu Beersheba-a thutan ahilhone."},"3":{"text":"Chule achapa teni chu ama lampia achelhonpon; ahin alam louva sum muding agolhonin, nehguh akilah lhonin, chule thudih chu aheikon lhonin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hichun Israel upaho jouse chu akikhom khomun, Samuel henga Ramah'a ahungun,"},"5":{"text":"Chule ajah-a, Ven, nangla natehtan, nachapa tenila nang lampiho-a achelhon poi; tun namdangho jouse bangin kathu-u tanding leng khat neisem peh-un, atiuve.","ref":"Danb 17:14"},"6":{"text":"Ahinla amahon, Kathu-u tanding lengkhat neipeuvin, tia aseiju chun Samuel alung phatmo sah-in ahi. Chuin Samuel Pakai henga ataotan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Samuel henga, Mihon nahenga aseijouse chu ngaipehtan, ajehchu amahon nangma napaiju ahipon; amavang achunguva vai kahom louna dinga keimajoh eipaiju ahibouve."},"8":{"text":"Egypt gama kona kahinpuidoh-a pat tuni geija athilbol jouseu dungjuija keima eidalhah uva, pathen dang ajenjiu banga chu, nangma henga jong abolu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun amaho thuchu ngaipeh-in: ahijeng vangin amahochu gihsalin lang, achunguva leng changdingpa thutan dingdan chu musah-in, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Pakai thuho jouse chu leng neipeuvin tia ngeh-a mipi ho henga chun ahiltan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin aman, Hichehi nachung uva lengchang dingpa thutan dingdan chu hiding ahi: aman nachapateo chu ama-a dinga alah-a, akangtalaiho-a ding le asakol sepai dinga apansah ding, chule abang asakol kangtalai masanga lhaiding ahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chule aman asang chunga gallamkai, somnga chunga gallamkai dinga apansah ding; chule amaho chu alou lhouding, achang atding, agalmanchah semding, chule asakol kangtalai ho manchah sema apansah ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aman nachanuteu chu gimnamtui semding, anhon ding, chule changlhah semdinga akilahding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule aman nalouhou, nalengpi leihou, chule na-olive honhou chu aphapenho kisana alah-a, asohte apehding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule aman namuchi houle nalengpigao somakhat alah-a, avaipoho le asohte apehding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule aman nasoh pasal hou le nasoh numei hou, chule nagollhang phapenhou le nasangan hou chu alah-a, ama na atohsah ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aman nakelngoi honhou somakhat alahding: chule nangho ama soh-a napan dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule nanakilhenu lengpa jeh-a chu nahung ka diu;
