chule hiche nikho chule Pakaiyin nanangai peh loudingu ahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin mipichu Samuel thusei chu ngaiding anompouvin; amahon, Ahipoi, kachunguva leng khat kaneitei dingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chutia chu keiho jong namdangho jouse tobang kahidiu; chule kalengpaovin kathu-u eitan pehdiu, chule kamasanguva lamkaija kagalu eisatpeh dingu ahi, atiuve."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in mipi ho thujouse chu angaijin, chuin abonchan Pakai nakhang sunga akhumsoh kitnin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Samuel henga, athuseiju ngaipeh inlang leng khat tundoh pehtan, ati. Chuin Samuel'in Israel miho henga chun, Amitakip nakhopi cheh uva chetaovin, ati."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun hichelai chun Benjamin mikhat amin Kish kiti Abiel chapa, Zeror chapa, Bechorath chapa, Aphiah chapa, Benjamin mi, mihat thuneitah khat aumin ahi.","title":"Saul le Samuel Kimuto"},"2":{"text":"Chule aman gollhang dei umtah le hoitah amin Saul kiti chapa khat aneijin: chule Israel chate lah-a chun ama sanga hoija mi aumpoi. Alengkouva pat chunglamse chu midangho vuma sangdoh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Saul pa Kish sanganho chu amangin ahile Kish'in achapa Saul jah-a, Tun kipat in, nasoh ho lah-a khat kipuijin lang, sanganho holin chen, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin aman Ephraim molsang ajotpeh-in, Shalisha gamsung ajotnin, ahinla amanin amujou lhonpon ahi. Chuin Shalim gamsung ajotpeh lhonin, chua jong chun anaum pouvin ahi. Chuin Benjamin gamsung ajotpeh lhonin, ahinla amudeh lhonpoi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin amani Zuph gam ahunglhung lhon phatnin, Saul'in ahin kilhonpi asohpa jah-a, Hungin, kileta hite, achuti loule kapa sanganho chung sangin eini chunga lungkham jogetninte, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin aman ahenga, Ven, tuhin hiche khopi sungahin Pathen mi khat aume, chule amachu ja umtah mi ahin; aman asei jouse guilhung jengji ahi. Tun hilama chun chehite; ijem atile ichena lhonding lampi eihil theilhon khattou vinte, ati."},"7":{"text":"Hichun Saul'in asohpa jah-a, Ahinla ven, eini chelehen mipa chu ipi ichoipeh dingham? Ajehchu ibelsung lhona changlhah la abeisohtan, Pathen mipa choipehding thilpeh dingla aumpon: ipi ineijem, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin sohpa chun Saul adonbut kitnin, Ven, keiman kakhutna dangka shekel khat hoplia hopkhat aume; ilampi lhonding eihil lhon nadingin, hichehi Pathen mipa chu petange, ati."},"9":{"text":"(Masanglaijin Israel gama Pathen thudoh neidinga mi achetengle, Hungin, mitvah neipa henga chehite, ana tijiuve. Ajehchu tu-a themgao kitihi masanga chu mitvah neipa kitiji ahi)."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Sual'in asohpa henga, Naseidih-e; hungin, chehite, ati. Chuti chun Pathen mipa umna khopi-a chun achelhon tai."},"11":{"text":"Chuin khopi jotna lhanga chu akaltou lhona ahile, soh nungah ho twithal dinga hungpot dohho amulhonin, ahenguva chun, Mitvah neipa chu umam? atilhone."},"12":{"text":"Chuin amahon amani chu adonbutnun, Aumnai, ven, ama namasang lhona ache-e; tun kikinsah lhonin, ajehchu ama tunia hi khopi-a hunga ahi; ajehchu tunia hi munsanga mipi ganlhaina umding ahi:"},"13":{"text":"Khopisung nalut lhonlhonle munsanga an ne-a ache masanga namupai jeng lhonding ahi: ajehchu ama ahunglhun masanga mipihon an anehlou dingu ahi, ajehchu aman ganlhaina chu phatthei aboh-a, chujou teng akikouho chun anehdiu ahi. Hijeh chun tun chetou lhonin, tuphat donnahi ama namu lhonding ahi, atiuve."},"14":{"text":"Chuin khopi sunga chun achetou lhontai: amani khopisung ahunglut lhon phatnin, veuvin, munsanga cheding chun Samuel chu amani henglam jonin ahunge."},"15":{"text":"Saul hunglhun masanga nikho-a chu Pakaiyin Samuel nabenga hitia anasei ahitai,"},"16":{"text":"Jing nikho tuphat don hileh Benjamin gama kon mikhat kahinsol ding ahin, amachun Philistine te khutna kona kamite ahuhdoh theina dinga, kami Israelte chunga gallamkai dinga amachu thao nananu ding ahi: ajehchu akanao kaheng ahunglhun tahjeh-in, kamite chu kakhohsah tan ahi, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Saul amuphatnin, Pakaiyin ahenga, Ven! keiman nahenga kanasei mipa chu, hiche mipa hin kamite chunga vai apohding ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Sual'in kotpi phunga chun Samuel chu agah naijin, Katao ahi, mitvah neipa in chu hoilaiham neihilin, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Saul adonbutnin, Keima mitvah neipa chu kahi: munsang lama chun kamasanga chetouvin; ajehchu nangman tunia hi keima toh an ineh khomding, chule jingtengle kasol bepding; nalungsunga um jouse chu kahil ding nahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule nithum masanga anamanga nasangan hou thudola vang, amaho chunga chun lungkham hih-in; ajehchu amahochu amutaove. Chule Israelte ngaichat ho jouse chu koichunga umam? Nangmale napa insung pumpi chunga uma hilouham? ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in adonbutnin, Keima Israel phung jouse lah-a aneopen Benjamin mi kahi louham? chule ka-insung jong Benjamin phunga alhumpen hilouham? achutile ipijeh-a kahenga hitobang chu naseiham? ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Saul le asohpa chu kikhopna in'a ahin puilutnin, akikouho lah-a mun loupi pena atousah-in ahi: amaho chu somthum tobang ahiuve."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in anhonpa jah-a, Nahenga, Atum beh-in koijin, tia kapeh sachan chu hinchoitan, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin anhonpan adah le achunga umhochu adomdoh-in, Saul anga aluitai. Chuin Samuel'in, Ven, anakikhen khenna chu hiche hi ahi, na-anga akiluije; ne-in; ajehchu, Keiman mipi ho kakouve kati-a pat tuchana hi nangma dinga anakikoi ahi, ati. Chutichun hiche nikho chun Saul'in Samuel to anekhomin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin munsanga kona khopi sunga ahungsuh phatnun, Samuel'in indan chunga chun Saul akihoulimpin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin matah-in athouvun; nisa sophat donin ahitin ahi, Samuel'in Saul chu indan chunga chun akou touvin, ajah-a chun, Kasoldoh theina dingin thouvin, ati. Chuin Saul athouvin, amale Samuel chu achedoh gel lhontai.","title":"Samuel'in Saul Leng Dinga Thao Anu"},"27":{"text":"Chuin khopi pam geija achesuh lhon laijin, Samuel'in Saul jah, Sohpa hi imasang lam lhona ache nadingin solin, (ama achetai,) ahin nangma vang Pathen thu kamusah theinadin chomkhat dingdenin, ati."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Samuel'in thaothei khat alan, aluchunga asunglhan, amachu achopmin, ajah-a, Pakaiyin agoulote chunga gallamkai dinga thao nanu hilouham?"},"2":{"text":"Tunia hi nangma keima-a kona nachedoh tengle, Benjamin gamgi Zelzah'a Rachel lhan koma mini namu ding; chule amanin nangma henga, Ahol dinga nache lona sanganho chu akimutai: chule ven, napan sanganho khohsah ding anga-in, nangma dingin alungkhamin, Kachapa dinga hi ipi kabol dingham? atie, ati lhonding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuteng chua konchun masanglama chebe lechun Tabor phaicham lhungin natin, chua chu Bethel'a Pathen henga chetou mi thum nakimuto piding, khatpan kelnou thum, khatpan changlhah thum, chule khatpan lengpitwi haikhat achoiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule amaho chun chibai naboh diu, changlhah ni napeh dingu; hichu akhutnuva kona nakisan ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chujou tengle Philistine sepaiho umna Pathen lhang chu nahung ding; chule hitiding ahi, hiche khopi-a chu nahungtengle, tumging le khongcha, kuli, chule selangdah amasanguva hintho-a munsanga kona hung kumlha themgao honkhat nakitopi ding; amaho chun gaothu asei dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule Pakai lhagao nachunga hungchu ding, amahoto gaothu nasei khomding, chule michombeh nakiso ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule hung hitihen, hiche melchihnahohi nachunga ahunglhun tengle, thil hungso dungjuija nabol jengding ahi; ajehchu Pathen'in na-umpinai."},"8":{"text":"Chule nangma kamasanga Gilgal'a nachesuh ding; chule ven, govam thiltoho tohdingle chamna thilto ganlhaina toh dinga nahenga kahungsuh ding ahi. Nangman ipi nabolding musah dinga nahenga kahung kahse-a, nisagi nakhongai ding ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, ama Samuel'a kona kinungle dinga che akigotchun, Pathen'in ama lungchom khat apen; hicheni chun melchihna jouse chu aguilhung soh heltai."},"10":{"text":"Chuin amani chuche lhang lama chu ahung lhona ahile, veuvin themgao honkhat toh akitoh lhonin; chule Pathen lhagao achunga ahung chutan, chuin aman alah uva chun gaothu aseitan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, masanga ama anahesa jouse chun aman themgaoho lah-a gaothu asei chu amuphatnun, miho chu khatle khat akihouvun, Kish chapa chunga khu ipi hungsoh-a hitam? Saul jong themgaoho lah-a panga hitam? atiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chuin chukoma mikhatnin adonbutnin, Ahin apao chu koiham? ati, hijeh chun Saul jong themgaoho lah-a panga ham? kitihi thuchih ahung hidohtan ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 19:23-24"},"13":{"text":"Chuin athemgao thusei kichai chaijin, ama munsang lama ahungtai."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Saul pangahpa chun amale asohpa henga, Hoilama nache lhonham? ati. Chuin aman, Sangan hola che kahi lhonin: chule hoimacha kamu lhonlou phatnin, Samuel henga kahunglhone, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Saul pangah pan, Katao ahi, Samuel'in nahenga ipi aseijem neihilin, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in apangahpa henga, Aman sanganho chu akimutai tin kichentah-in eihil lhone, ati. Ahinla lenggam thudol Samuel'in aseivang chu ahilpoi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in mipichu Mizpeh'a Pakai henga akoukhomin;","title":"Leng Dinga Saul Kiphondoh"},"18":{"text":"Israel chate jah-a chun, Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, keiman Egypt'a konin Israel kahin puidoh-in, Egypt mite khutna konle lenggam jouse-a kon, chule nasugenthei houva konin kahuh doh-in ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ahin tunin nahesoh naole nagenthei nao jouse-a kona nahuhdoh uva Pathen nanotthap taovin; chule nanghon ama henga, Ahipoi, kachunguva leng khat neitun peh-un, nati uve. Hijeh chun tun nangho tah Pakai masanga aphung phungin, asang sangin hungkipe doh-un, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Israel phung jouse aheng ahin naisah phatnun, Benjamin phungchu alhengtai."},"21":{"text":"Benjamin phung chu a-inko kou-a aheng ahin nai phatnun, Matri insungchu lhen ahin, Kish chapa Saul chu lhendoh ahitai. Ahinla amachu aholule amujou pouve."},"22":{"text":"Hijeh chun amahon mi ahung be ding umnalai em, tin Pakai chu avelin adong kitnun ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin adonbutnin, Veuvin, ama thilkeu lah-a akisele, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin amaho alhaijun chua konin agapuidoh taovin ahi: chuin ama mipi lah-a adin phatnin, alengkouva pat chunglamse chu mijouse sangin asangjon ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in mijouse jah-a chun, Pakaiyin alhenpa, mijouse lah-a amatobang aumlou khu namu uvem? ati. Chuin mijouse chun hatah in asamun, Pathen'in lengpa huhhing hen, atiuve."},"25":{"text":"Chujouvin Samuel'in mipi chu lenggam thudol ahilin, lekhabu khatna asun lutnin, Pakai angsunga chun akoitai. Chuin Samuel'in mipi ho chu ama ama incheh-a asolmangtai."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Saul jong Gibeah'a a-in'a achetan; chule Pathen'in alungu atohkhah mi honkhatnin alhonpiuvin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ahinla Belial chate chun, Hiche pan iti eihuhdoh diuham? atiuve. Chuin amahon ama nahsahmon abolun, thilpeh imacha ahinchoipeh pouve. Ahinla ama athipbeh-in ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Ammon mi Nahasah chu ahung konin, Jabesh-Gilead dounan gebuh asongin ahi. Chuin Jabesh mijouse chun Nahash jah-a, Keihotoh kitepna khat semin, chule keihon nangma kajen dingu ahi, atiuve.","title":"Saul'in Ammon Mite Ajo"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Ammon mi Nahash chun adonbutnin, Hitia hi nang hotoh kitepna kasem ding ahi, namit jetlam jouseu kakaldoh-a, Israel jouse-a dinga jum na hiding ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Jabesh upahon ajah-a, Israel gamkai jouse thangkou kasolthei nadiuvin, ni sagi neikhongai jun; chujouteng eihuhdoh dingu mi aumlouva ahile nahenga kahung kipehlut dingu ahi, atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Hichun thupole ho chu Saul chenna Gibeah ahung lhungun, thuchu miho jah-a aseitaovin ahi. Chuin mijouse awgingin akaptaove."},"5":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, Saul chu louva konin ganchahon nunga ahungin ahi; chuin Saul'in, Ipi hahsatna uma mipi ho khu kapma hiuvam? ati. Chuin amahon Gibeah miho thupoh chu aseipeh taove."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in chuche thuho chu ajah phatnin Pathen lhagao achunga ahungchun, alunghana chu nasatah-in akoujah jengtan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin bongchal ni alan, achenbong bongin, Israel gamkai jouse-a thupole ho khutna athotnin, Saul le Samuel nung hinjuilou chanchu hitabonga hi abongchal chunga kibolding ahi, ati. Chuin mipi chunga chun Pakai ginna achutan, amaho lungkhat tah-in ahung kondoh taove."},"8":{"text":"Chuin aman amahochu Bejek mun'a asimin ahile, Israel chate chu sangjathum ahin, Judah miho chu sangsomthum ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Chuin amahon thupole mi ahungho henga, Jabesh Gilead miho henga chun, Jing nikho nisasat laitahle kithopina namu dingu ahi, tin gaseipeh-un atiuve. Chuin thupole ho chu ahungun, Jabesh miho chu aseipeh-un ahile, amaho akipah lheh-un ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun Jabesh mihon, Jingle naheng uva kahungdoh dingu ahin, nanghon kilominte tia pha nasah bangun kachungu boltaovin, atiuve."},"11":{"text":"Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, Saul'in mipi chu loithumin ahom khenin; jingpi phalvah-in amaho janel lailung tah-a chun alutnun, Ammon miho chu nisa asatdoh kahsen athatnun ahi. Chuin ahitin ahi, mi ni kidalha khoma aumlou kahsen, amoh chengse chu akithe cheh-un ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin mipi chun Samuel henga, Saul chu ichunguva lengchang mongding ham tia seija chu koiham? keihon katha theina dinguvin, amaho chu hinpuijun atiuve."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Tunia hi mi khatcha kithat theilou ding ahi; ajehchu tunia hi Pakaiyin Israel sunga huhhingna na atoh ahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chujouvin Samuel'in mipi ho jah-a, Hungun, Gilgal'a cheohitin, chule chua chun lengam gasemthah-u hite, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin mipi ho jouse chu Gilgal'a acheuvin; chule Gilgal'a chun Pakai masanga Saul chu lengin asemtaove. Chule hiche mun'a chun Pakai angsunga chamna thilto ganlhaina apeuvin; chuachun Saul le Israel mite jouse nasatah-in akipah-un ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Israelte jouse jah-a, Veovin kahenga nasei jouseu chu kangaijin, nachung uva lengkhat kasempeh taove.","title":"Samuel'in Mipi Henga Thu Asei"},"2":{"text":"Chule tun veuvin, lengpa chu namasanguva achei: chule keima tehse lukang kahitan; chule veuvin, kachapate nang hotoh aumui: chule keima kachapan laijapat tunigeija hi namasanguva chejing kahi."},"3":{"text":"Veuvin, keima hikoma kaume; Pakai le athao nupa anga kachung chang thu hettoh sah-un: koi bongchal kalahpeh umkham? koi sangan kalahpeh umkham? koi kajoulhep umkham? koi kasuhgenthei umkham? ahiloule koi khutna kona kamit chotna dinga nehguh kalah umkham? Keiman hichu nangho kalepeh dingu ahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin amahon, Nangman neijoulhep khapouve, nei sugenthei kha pouvin, chule koima khutna konin jong nala khapoi, atiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah uvah, Kakhutnahin adihlou ima namupouve tihi Pakai chu nachung uva ahetoh ahin, athao nupa hi tunia ahetoh ahi, ati. Chuin amahon, Amachu ahetoh ahi, atiuve."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in mipi jah-a, Mosi le Aaron ana gonga, chule Egypt gama kona napu napateu hinpuidoh-a chu Pakai ahi.","ref":"Pot 6:26."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun nanghole napu napateu chunga anabol Pakai chonphatna natoh jouse chu, Pakai masanga nangho toh kagelkhom theina dingin dingdet nun."},"8":{"text":"Egypt'a Jacob alut nungin, napu napateu chun Pakai akouvun, chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron asolin, amanin napu napateu chu Egypt'a kona apuidoh lhona, hiche munahi achensah lhon ahi.","ref":"Pot 2:23"},"9":{"text":"Chuin amahon Pakai a-Pathen'u chu asuhmil phatnun, aman Sisera Hazor janel gallamkai khut le Philistine te khutna, chule Moab lengpa khutna ajoh doh-in, chuin amahon amaho asatnun ahi.","ref":"Thutn 3:12; 4:2; 13:1"},"10":{"text":"Chuin amaho Pakai henga akapmun, ahenga, Keihon Pakai kadalhah uva Baal lim le Ashtaroth kajen jeh-un kachonse taove: ahinla tun kamelma teo khutna konin neihuhdoh uvin, chutile nangma kajen diu ahitai, atiuve.","ref":"Thutn 10:10-15"},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah chule Samuel asolin, ningtina namelmate hou khutna konin nahuhdoh-un, lung mongin nacheng taove.","ref":"1 Sam 3:20; Thutn 4:6; 7:1; 11:29"},"12":{"text":"Chuin nanghon Ammon chate lengpa Nahash nangho douna-a ahung namu phatnun, Pakai na Pathen'u chu nalengpao ahilaijin, nanghon kahenga, Ahipoi; leng khatnin kachunguva vai ahomding ahibouve, nati uve.","ref":"1 Sam 8:19"},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun veuvin, nanghon nalhen ule nangaichatnu lengpa chu hikoma aume; chule veuvin, Pakaiyin nachung uvah leng khat atungtai."},"14":{"text":"Nanghon Pakai nagin uva, ama najen uva, a-aw nangai uva, chule Pakai thupeh chu nadou daova ahile, nangho le nachung uva vaipo lengpan jong Pakai Pathen chu najuijom jing dingu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai awchu nangailou uva, Pakai thupeh chu nadou uva ahile, Pakai khutchu napu napateu chunga anachuh banga, nangho chunga hungchu ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun, dingun lang hiche thil loupitah Pakaiyin namitmuva namasanguva abol dinghi veuvin."},"17":{"text":"Tunihi suhlou chang atni hilouham? leng nakithum jeh uva Pakai mitmu-a nathilbolu nagitlou nao chu lentah ahi ti nahetdoh uva chule namutheina diuva keiman Pakai kakou ding; aman van ginle go ahinsolding ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chutichun Samuel'in Pakai akouvin ahi; chuin hiche nikho chun Pakaiyin van ginle go ahinsolin: chuin mijousen Pakai le Samuel chu nasatah-in aging taovin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin mipi jouse chun Samuel henga, Kathi louna diuvin Pakai na Pathen henga nasohtedin neitao peh-un; ajehchu kachonsetnau jouse belapma hiche lenghi kaki thumu ahi, atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in mipi ho henga, Kicha hih-un: nanghon hiche gitlouna jousehi nabolu ahitai: hitajongle Pakai juina-a konin kiheimang daovinlang, nalung pumpiuvin Pakai chu jenuvin;"},"21":{"text":"Chule kiheimang hih-un; phatchomnabei le huhhing theilou pannabei thilho najui louheldiu ahi; ajehchu hihochu ahomkeo ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Chutile Pakaiyin amin loupina jala amite adalhah louding ahi: ajehchu nangho amite-a semdinghi Pakai kipana ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chukalvalin keiman vang, nangho dinga kataona man kangah-a Pakai chunga kachonset dingchu Pathen'in jahda hen; amavang keiman apha le lamdih chu kahil dingu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Pakai bou gingun lang, nalung pumpiuvin thutah-in ama jenun: itobang thil loupitah nanabolpeh-u hitam ngaitouvin."},"25":{"text":"Ahinla nangho gilou tah-a nachon jingule, nangho le nalengpau nagom uva namanthah dingu ahi, ati."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul kumkhat aleng changin; chuin Israelte chunga kumni alengchan phatnin;","title":"Philistine te Toh Kigal"},"2":{"text":"Saul'in ama dingin Israelte lah-a konin pasal sangthum alhengdoh-in; sangni chu Saul'in Michmash le Bethel molsanga aumpin; sangkhat chu Jonathan toh Benjamin gam Gibeah'a aumun: chule mipi amohho chu apon in cheh uvah asoltan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in Gebah'a Philistine sepai touho chu asatnin, hichu Philistine ten ajataove. Chuin Saul'in, Hebrew miten anajaohen atin, gamsung jouse-a chun sumkon amutnin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Israelte jousen Saul'in Philistine sepai honkhat abulu-in, chule Israelte chu Philistine te hot ahung hitaove ti ajataovin ahi. Chuin mipi ho chu Saul lengpa henga Gilgal'a akikhom taove."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Philistine te chu Israelte toh kisatdin akikhom khomun, sakol kangtalai sangsomthum, sakol sepai sanggup, chule mipi chu twikhanglen kama neldi jat helin atamun ahi. Chuin amaho ahung kondoh-un, Beth-aven'a pat solama um Michmash'a pannun asemun ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chutia Israel miten nochinto-a aumu amuphatnun, (ajehchu mipi chu lungdong lheh jenguva ahi,) mipi chu songko sung, hambohlah, songpiho-a, munsang ho-a, chule kotong dunga akisel gamtaove."},"7":{"text":"Chule Hebrew mi phabep Jordan agalkai jun, Gad le Gilead gama acheuvin ahi. Saul vangchu Gilgal'a aum nalaijin, mipihon kihotpum pummin anung ajuijun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in phat ateppeh dungjuijin, nisagi aumin: ahin Samuel chu Gilgal'a ahunglou phatnin; mipi ho chu ama-a konin akithecheh taovin ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 10:8"},"9":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Hikoma hin kahenga govam thilto le chamna thilto hinchoijun, ati. Chuin aman govam thilto aboltai."},"10":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, aman govam thilto atojou jouvin, veuvin, Samuel ahung lhung paijin; chule Saul chu amatoh kimuto-a chibai bohdin apotdoh-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in, Ipi bola nahim? ati. Chuin Saul'in, Mipi ho keija kona akithe cheh uva, nangla nikho kitep sunga nahung da-a, chule Philistine te Michmash'a akichop khomu kamuphatna;"},"12":{"text":"Hichejeh-a keiman, Tu-a hi Philistine te keima doudinga Gilgal'a hungdiu ahitan, keimanla Pakai henga ngehna kanei louding ahi katin: hijeh-a chu keile kei kachamlouva kakibola, govam thilto kanato ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Saul henga, Nangin ngol hoitah thil nabol ahitai: nangman thupeh nape-a Pakai na Pathen'in nathupeh chu nanit tapoi: ajehchu tuahi Pakaiyin nalenggam chu Israel chunga a-itih-a dinga phudet ding agot ahin;"},"14":{"text":"Amavang tun nalenggam hi chejom louding ahitai: ajehchu nangman Pakaiyin nathupeh chu nanit lou jeh-a, Pakaiyin ama lungput tobang pumi akihol ahitai, chule Pakaiyin ama chu amite chunga lamkai dinga athupeh ahitai, ati.","ref":"Sol 13:22"},"15":{"text":"Chuin Samuel akipat doh-in Gilgal'a konin Benjamin gam Gibeah'a achetoutai. Chuin Saul'in amatoh umkhom miho chu pasal jagup tobang asimdohtai."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Saul le achapate Jonathan, chule amanito umkhom miho chu Benjamin gam Gibeah'a chun aumtaove; ahinla Philistine mihon Michmash'a panmun asemun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Philistine te pan mun'a konchun michom dingho chu loithumin ahung potdoh-un: loikhat chun Shual gam Ophrah jotna lampi chu ajotnun;"},"18":{"text":"Chule loikhat chun Beth-horon jotna lampi ajotnun; chule loikhat chun gamthip Zeboiim phaicham ngatna gamgi chin jotna lampi ajotnun ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tun Israel gampumpia chun thihkheng khatcha anaumpon ahi: ajehchu Philistine ten, Achuti loule Hebrew miten chemjam le tengcha kikhen getnunte, atiu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Israelte jouse chu amitakip alangkon thih-u, alou kalnao, aheichao, chule atuphenghou khenghem dinga Philistinte henga chesuhji ahiuve."},"21":{"text":"Achutijeng vangin amahon tupheng, langkon thih, thihka, heicha, chule gancha hoina thihmol suhhemna aneijun ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chutichun chuche ni-a kidouna-a chun ahitin ahi, Saul le Jonathan toh kiloi miho khutna chun chemjam le tengcha khatcha muding aumpon ahi. Ahinla Saul le achapa Jonathan'in vang aneijin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Philistine sepaihon ho chu Michmash lampi lama achedoh-un ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun nikhat chu ahitin ahi, Saul chapa Jonathan'in agalvon po-a pang gollhangpa jah-a, Hungin, Philistine sepaihon ho umna apang langkhatna khun gache galkai hite, ati. Ahinla apa henga anahet sahpon ahi.","title":"Jonathan Hansanna"},"2":{"text":"Chule Saul chu Gibeah khopam ningkoi Migron'a um kolbuthei phung noikhatna atouvin ahi. Chule ama umpi mihochu pasal jagup tobang ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Shiloh'a chun Pakai thempu Eli chapa, Phinehas chapa, Ichabod sopipa Ahitub chapa Ahiah chu boitong sangkhol akivonin ahi. Chule mipi chun Jonathan chelam chu ahepouve."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in Philistine te sepaihon ho galkai agotna lampi kikah jetle veija chun songpihem ni aumin, khatpa minchu Bozez ahin, khatjopa min chu Seneh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tomasah pachun Michmash sahlam angan, khatjopa chun Gibeah jotna lhanglam angan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in agalvon po-a pang golhangpa henga, Hungin, hiche cheptanlou sepaihon ho heng lama khun galkai hite: Pakaiyin eini dinga na eitoh pehlhon thei ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiya dingin huhdohna natohna-a hin tam le lhomin ima apopon ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin agalvon popan ajah-a, Nalungsunga umjouse chu bolin: kiheijin; ven, nalungdei banga umdingin keima nakoma kaume, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuphatnin Jonathan'in, Ven miho henga khun galkai hitin, amaho gakimusah hite."},"9":{"text":"Amahon eini henga, Naheng lhona kahung kahseovin umtadi lhonin atiuva ahile, i-umna mun lhona idinden lhonding, ahenguva ichetou louding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla amahon, Kahenguva hungtou lhonin, atiuva ahile ichetou ding ahi: ajehchu Pakaiyin ikhutna amahochu eipehdoh lhon ahitan: hiche hi amelchihna hiding ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin anilhonin Philistine sepaihon ho aga kimusah lhontan ahi. Chuin Philistine ten, Veuvin, Hebrew ho khu akiselnao kohoma konin ahungdoh uve, atiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chuin sepaiho chun Jonathan le agalvon popa chu ahin donbutnun, Kahenguva hungtou lhonin, thilkhat vetsah-unge atiuve. Chuin Jonathan'in agalvon popa jah-a, Neihin juitouvin: ajehchu Pakaiyin amahokhu Israelte khutna apehdoh ahitai, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in akhutle akeng tho-a akaltouva ahile, agalvon popan anung ajuitan ahi. Chuin amaho Jonathan masanga chu alhu taovin; anunga agalvon popa chun ahin that peh-in ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan le agalvon popa mitha masatpen hochu mi somni bang ahin, gamneocha bongchal tokhat khoijou theibep acre keh sungbou ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin loujauva mipi janel lah leh mipi ho jouselah'a chun tijatna nasatah aumtan; sepaihon ho le thilchomho jong akihotnun: chule ling akihotnin, chutichun tijatna nasatah aumtan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Benjamin gama Gibeah'a Saul'in khongah akoiho chun aveovin; chuin veuvin, mihopi chu achat melmulun, khat le khat akiphuto saosaovun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in aumpi mipi ho jah-a, Tun kisim unlang ilah uva koi potdoh am veuvin, ati. Chuin amahon asimphatnun, veuvin Jonathan le agalvon popa anaum tapoi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Ahiah jah-a, Pathen thingkhong chu hilama hinpon, ati. Ajehchu hichepetna chu Pathen thingkhong chu Israelte toh uma ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Saul'in thempu henga thu aseipet chun, Philistine te janel husa chu ahagincheh cheh jengtan: chuin Saul'in thempupa jah-a, Nakhut ladohtan, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Saul le akoma um mijouse chu akikhom khomun, galmuna chun ahungtaove. Chule veuvin, mitin chemjam chu aloipa chunga achun, chule boina nasatah aumin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chukalvalin chuche masanga Hebrew miho Philistine te toh ana umkhomho, chuche gamkimvela kona agebuh uva amahotoh anachetouho chu, amaho jongchu Israelte toh apangkhomun, Saul le Jonathan to apangkhom taovin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chubangma chun Ephraim molsanga anakisel Israel mite jouse chun, Philistine te ajam taove tithu ajah phatnun, amaho jong chun galsat na-a amaho chu hatah in anungdelun ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chutichun Pakaiyin chuche nikho chun Israel ahuhdoh-in, chule gal kisat chu Beth-aven geijin agalkaijun ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chun Israelte chu alung genthei lheh-un ahi: ajehchu Saul'in, Kamelmate phu kalahthei nadin, nilhah ahi kahse-a an ne-a chu sapset changhen, tia mipi chu ahahsel ahi. Chutichun koimachan an kiti atep pouvin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin gamsung mi jouse chu gamlah ahunglhung taovin; chule leichunga chun khoiju anaumin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin mipi ho jouse chu gamlah ahunglut phatnun, veuvin, khoiju anakaijin; ahin koiman akhutna alan anepon ahi: ajehchu mipi chun hahselna chu akichatnu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ahinla Jonathan'in apan mipi hahselna-a ahahsel chu anajapon; hijeh chun akhutna achoi molmuh-a chun khoiju lah chu asunlutnin, chuin akhutnin alan akama ahengtan ahile, amitchu hoitah-in ahung hahdoh theitan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuphatnin mipi lah-a khatnin adonbutnin, Napan mipi nasatah-a hahselna-a ahahsela, Tunia an ne-a michu sapset changhen ati ahi, ati. Chutichun mipi alhasam tan ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuphatnin Jonathan'in, Kapan gamsunghi agentheisah ahi: Katao ahi, vetemin, hiche khoiju themkhat katep jeh-a kamithi iti hungha doh-a hitam."},"30":{"text":"Mipi jonghin amelmateu thil achom naova amuhouhi aning anopmin nomtah-in neleu phacheh louding ham? hijeh-a chu tugeija Philistine te tamtah itha theilouvu hilouham? ati."},"31":{"text":"Chule hicheni chun Michmash'a pat Aijalon geijin Philistine te chu athat peh-un; chule mipi chu alhasamlheh taovin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin mipi chu thil kichom chunga achuvin, kelngoiho, bongchalho, bongnouho chu tollhanga athatnun: athisan pumchun anetaovin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuphatnin amahon Saul jah-a, Vetan, mipin thisan aneh uva konin Pakai dounan achonse taove, atiuve. Chuin aman, Nanghon nasukhelun; tuni hin songtum lentah neitahkhum taove, ati.","ref":"Semt 9:4; Thmpu 7:26-27; 17:10-14; Danb 12:16,23; 15:23"},"34":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Mipi lah-a kithecheh unlang, ajah uvah, Amitakipmin nabongchalu, nakelngoiju hinkaijun, chule hikoma hin thatnuvin lang neuvin; thisan puma ne-in Pakai dounan chonse hih-un, ati. Chuin chuche jan chun mipi jouse amitakipmin abongchalu chu ahinkaijun, hikoma chun athat taove."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Pakai dingin maicham khat asemin; hiche chu Pakai dinga maicham asem masat pentah ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Eihon janlaijin Philistine te nung delsuh-u hitin, jingkhovah kahsen chommu hitin, chule amaho khatcha hinghoi pouhite, ati. Chuin amahon, Nangman phante nati tichu bolin, atiuve. Chuphatnin thempupan, Hilamhin Pathen naitadiu hite, ati."},"37":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Pathen adongin; Philistine te satna kakonsuh dingham? Nangman amaho chu Israelte khutna napehdoh dingham? ati. Ahinla hiche nikho chun adonbut tapoi."},"38":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Mipi ho pipui jousen hilam hinai cheh-un: chule tunia hiche chonset hi hoilaija umham heuvin lang vetemun."},"39":{"text":"Ajehchu Israel huhhing-a hingjing Pakai mina kasei ahi, kachapa Jonathan chunga uma hijongle, ama thonlouva thiding ahi, ati. Ahinla mipi ho jouse lah-a konin khatchan adonbut pon ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chuphatnin aman Israelte jouse jah-a, Nangho langkhatna umunlang, keile kachapa Jonathan langkhatna kaum lhonding ahi, ati. Chuin mipin Saul jah-a, Nangman phante nati tichu boltan atiuve."},"41":{"text":"Hijeh chun Saul'in Israelte Pakai Pathen henga, Vang kisan dihtah hintah langin, ati. Chuin Saul le Jonathan chunga achutan, mipi vang ahoidohtai.","ref":"Minb 27:21; 1 Sam 28:6."},"42":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Keile kachapa Jonathan kah-a vang san uvin, ati. Chuin Jonathan chunga achutai."},"43":{"text":"Chuphatnin Saul'in Jonathan jah-a, Ipi nabolham neihilin, ati. Chuin Jonathan'in, Kakhutna um mol leh-a khoiju themcha khat katep ahi, chule ven, kathi teiding ahi, tin ahiltan ahi."},"44":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Pathen'in hitichun chule akalvalin jong boljenghen, ajehchu Jonathan, nangma nathi teiding ahi, ati."},"45":{"text":"Chuin mipi ho chun Saul jah-a, Israelte lah-a huhhingna loupitah bolla Jonathan hi thiding ham? Pathen'in jahda hen: Pakai hingjing mina kaseiju ahi, aluchunga kon samjang khatjon tolla lhalouding ahi; ajehchu tunin aman Pathen toh atongkhomin ahi, atiuve. Chutichun mipin Jonathan chu athilou nadin ahuhdoh taove."},"46":{"text":"Chujouvin Saul chu Philistine te nung adelna-a konin ache toutan; chule Philistine te jong aumnaova achetauve."},"47":{"text":"Chuti chun Saul'in Israelte chunga lengvai apon, ningtina amelmate jouse, Moab, Ammon chate, Edom, Zobah lengho, chule Philistine mite to akidouvin: chule akiheina lam tina gal ajoupeh-in ahi.","title":"Saul Lengvaipoh Le A-insung"},"48":{"text":"Chuin aman mipi janel akhomin, Amalek mite asatnin, chule amaho chom gama miho khutna konin Israelte ahuhdoh-in ahi."},"49":{"text":"Tun Saul chapate chu Jonathan, Ishui, chule Melchishua ahiuvin, chule achanu teni minchu hiche ahi; apeng masa nu min Merab ahin, chule aneojonu min Michal ahi."},"50":{"text":"Chule Saul inneipi min Ahinoam ahin, Ahimaaz chanu ahi. Chule ajanel gal lamkaipa minchu Abner ahin, Saul pangahpa Ner chapa ahi."},"51":{"text":"Chule Kish chu Saul pa ahin, chule Abner pa Ner chu Abiel chapa ahi."},"52":{"text":"Chule Saul nikholai sungse chun Philistine mite toh kidouna chu anasalheh jengin ahi: chutichun Saul'in mihat le mihangsan amu poupouva ahile, amanin ama-a dingin akipui jengjin ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel'in jong Saul jah-a, Pakaiyin ami Israelte chunga leng dinga nangma thao nudingin einasol ahin, hijeh chun tun Pakai thusei hi ngaijin.","title":"Amalek Mite Toh Kisat","ref":"1 Sam 10:1."},"2":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Amalek'in Israel chunga ana thilbol, Egypt'a kona ahungtouva chu lampia iti ana lamtin ham ti kahe jingin ahi.","ref":"Pot 17:8-14; Danb 25:17-19"},"3":{"text":"Tun chenlang Amalek gasatnin, chule aneijouseu sumanghelin lang, amaho khatcha khenhih-in; pasal le numei agomin, naosen le noicheplai, bong le kelngoi, sangongsang le sanganho abonin thatgamin, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in mipi ho chu akhom khomin, Telaim mun'a chun keng sepaiho sangjani leh, Judah mi sangsom asimdoh-in ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Saul Amalek khopi khatna ahungin, phaichama chun achangpang tan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Ken miho jah-a, Cheovin, kipatdoh-un, Amelek mite-a kon chun chesuh-un, achuti loule keiman amahotoh kasuh mangtha dingu ahi: ajehchu Egypt'a kona Israelte ahungtouvu chun hepina nana musah-un ahi, ati. Hijeh chun Ken miho chu Amalek miho-a konin apotdoh taove."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Amalek mite chu Havilah'a pat Egypt toh kigalsai Shur lutna geijin anasuhmang pehtan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin aman Amalek mite lengpa Agag chu ahingin amanin, mijouse chu chemjam monghemin asumang sohkeijin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahin Saul le mipi chun Agag le kelngoi hoipenho, bongchal thao ho, kelngoithao ho le anouhose chu ahing hoijun, ahin aphalou le dei umlou sechu asumang heltan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hichun Samuel henga Pakai thu ahung lhungin, hitin ati,"},"11":{"text":"Saul lenga kanatundoh hi kakisih tai: ajehchu ama eijui na-a konin akileheijin, kathupeh ho atongdoh tapoi, ati. Hichun Samuel alungkham sahtan; jankhovah helin Pakai henga ataotai."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Saul kimupi dinga Samuel jingpitah-a athochun, Samuel henga, Saul chu Carmel lhanga ahungin, chule vetan, minkhat akisemin, chule ache lelen, achedoh-in, Gilgal'a achesuhtai, tin aseipeh-uvin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Saul henga Samuel ahungin: chule Saul'in ahenga, Pakai phattheiboh chang nahi; keiman Pakai thupeh chu kamolso tai, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in, Kanakhanga kelngoi hamgin le bongchal hamgin kajah hi ipi thu hitam? ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Amahon Amalek mite-a kona ahinkaiju ahi: ajehchu mipihon kelngoiho le bongchalho aphapenho chu Pakai na Pathen lhaina dinga ahing hoiju ahi; adangse vang kasumanghel taove, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuphatnin Samuel'in Saul henga, Khongaijin, tujana Pakaiyin kahenga ipi anaseijem nahilinge, ati. Chuin aman, Seijin, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in, Namitmu-a neocha nahilaija chu Israel phungpi luchanga nakisema, Pakaiyin Israel pumpi chunga leng dinga thao nananu hilouham?"},"18":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin kholjinin nasolin, nahenga, Chenlang michonse Amalek mitekhu gasumangsoh helin, chule abeitheng tokah seuvin amaho chu satnin, ati."},"19":{"text":"Achutile ibola Pakai awchu ngailouva, thil kichom chunga nachuhjoh-a, chule Pakai mitmu-a thilse nabol ham? ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Samuel jah-a, henge, keiman Pakai thusei kanitnin, Pakaiyin eisolna lampia chun kachen, Amalek lengpa Agag chu kahinpuijin, Amalek mite chu kasumang heltai."},"21":{"text":"Ahin mipi hin suhmang heldingsa thilkichom kelngoiho le bongchalho, thil lah-a apha chung nungho chu Gilgal'a Pakai na Pathen henga ganlhaina-a dinga ahin kilah-u ahi, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in, Pakaiyin Pakai thusei ngai akipapi banga, govam thilpeh le ganlhainaho akipapi hinam? ven, thuman hi ganlhaina sanga phajo ahin, chule thusei kingaipeh hi kelngoichal thaotah sanga phajo ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile golkeh hi aisana-a chonsetna toh kibang ahin, louchal kitihi khangitlouna le milim houna toh kibang ahi. Ajehchu nangman Pakai thusei napaidoh tah jeh-in, Aman jong leng nahina-a kona napaidoh ahitai, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Samuel henga, Keima kachonse tai: ijeh inem itile Pakai thupeh hole nangma thuho kapalkeh tai. Ajehchu mipi kakichatna, athu-u kanangai ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Hijeh chun, tun, nahenga katao ahi, kachonsetna neingaidamin lang, Pakai chu kahouthei nadingin keima toh kinungle kitnin, ati."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Saul jah-a, Keima nang toh kakinungle kit louding ahi: ajehchu nangman Pakai thu napaidoh ahitan, Pakaiyin Israelte chunga leng nahina-a kona napaidoh ahitai, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Samuel chu chemang dinga akiheija ahile, aman asangkhol chol mong chu amanin, aloi-eh tan ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 28:17; 1 Leng 11:30-31."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in ajah-a, Tunia hi Pakaiyin Israel lenggam chu nanga kona alhetela, nangma sanga phajo naheng nakom khat henga apeh ahitai."},"29":{"text":"Chujongle Israel Thahatna chu jou louding, alung jong aheilou ding ahi; ajehchu ama lunghei ding mihem ahipoi, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuphatnin aman, Keima kachonse tai: hitajongle katao ahi, kamite upaho masang le Israelte masanga neijabolin lang, Pakai na Pathen chu kahouthei nadingin keima toh kinungle kitnin, ati."},"31":{"text":"Chuti chun Samuel chu Saul toh akinunglen, chuin Saul'in Pakai ahou tai."},"32":{"text":"Hichun Samuel'in, Amalek mite lengpa Agag chu kahenga hinpuijun ati. Chuin Agag chu ahenga ti kithing pumin ahungin ahi. Chule Agag chun, Thina tijat umtah chu chemanga ahitai, ati."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in, Nachemjam chun numei ho chabei aso banga, numei lah-a nanujong chabei hiding ahitai, ati. Chuin Samuel'in Gilgal'a Pakai masanga chun Agag chu ahal halin asattel tan ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chujouvin Samuel chu Ramah'a achetan; chule Saul jong Saul umna Gibeah ah achetoutan ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Samuel chu athi nikho geijin Saul kimupi dingin ahungkit tapoi; ahijeng vangin Samuel chu Saul dingin alunghem jingin ahi. Chule Saul chu Israelte chunga lenga anatun chu Pakai akisih tan ahi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Samuel jah-a, Israelte chunga alengchana kona kapaidoh henasa itihchan Saul dinga nalunghem dingham? nasaki-a thao sungdim minlang chen, keiman Bethlehem mi Jesse henga kasolding nahi: ajehchu achapate lah-a khu lengchang ding khat keiman gotsa kakoi ahitai, ati.","title":"Leng Dinga David Thao Kinu"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in, Iti kachethei dingham? Saul'in jadoh leh eithading ahi, ati. Chuin Pakaiyin, Bongla khat kaijinlang, Pakai henga ganlhaina neidinga hung kahi, tin."},"3":{"text":"Chule ganlhaina-a chun Jesse kouvin, chule keiman nabolding chu kahilding ahi: chule nahenga kaminphah pachu keima dinga thao nanu ding ahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Pakai seibang chun abolin, Bethlehem'a ahungtan ahi. Chuin khopi-a upaho chu ahung jehchun atiu akithingin, Chamna-a hunga nahi hinam? atiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chuin aman, Chamna ahinai: Pakai henga ganlhai bola hunga kahi: nangho kisuthengun lang kahenga ganlhaina-a hungun, ati. Chuin Jesse le achapate chu asuthengin, ganlhaina-a din akoutai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, amaho ahung phatnun, aman Eliab chu aven, Pakai thaonupa chu amasanga umpa hi hiteijinte ati."},"7":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakaiyin Samuel jah-a, Nangman amaiso ahiloule asandan chu vehih-in, ajehchu keiman amachu kadeilou ahi; ijeh inem itile Pakaiyin mihem thilvet banga avet ahipoi; ajehchu mihemin polam melput avet ahin, Pakaiyin vang lungsung avet ahi, atipeh-e."},"8":{"text":"Chujouvin Jesse'n Abinadad akouvin, Samuel anga asolin ahi. Chuin aman, Hichepa jong Pakaiyin alhengpoi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chujouvin Jesse'n Shammah asolkitnin ahi. Chuin aman, Hichepa jong Pakaiyin alhengpoi atipeh-e."},"10":{"text":"Avelin Jesse'n achapate sagiho chu Samuel anga asolin, ahi. Chuin Samuel'in Jesse jah-a, Hicheho hi Pakaiyin alhengpoi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Jesse jah-a, Hiche mun'a hi nachate jouse umkim sohkeiju vaham? ati. Chuin aman, Aneopenpa avat nalaije, chule ven ama kelngoi ching ahi, ati. Chuin Samuel'in Jesse jah-a, Gakousah-in; ajehchu ama hikoma ahunglhun masangse-a eiho itou loudiu ahi, ati.","title":"David Thao Kinu"},"12":{"text":"Chuin aman agakou sah-in, ahinpui taove. Tun amachu tahsa phatah, mitha hoitah, chule vetnom umtah ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin, Kipatdoh-in, thao nutan; ajehchu hichehi amapa chu ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Hichun Samuel'in saki-a thaochu alan, asopite lah-a amachu thao anutai. Chuin chuche nikho-a patnin Pakai lhagao David chunga achutai. Hitichun Samuel akipatdoh-in, Ramah'a achetai."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai lhagao chu Saul'a konin achemang tan, chule Pakaiya kon lhagao gilou khatnin asugimtan ahi.","title":"Saul Insunga David"},"15":{"text":"Chuin Saul sohten ahenga, Ven, tuahi Pathen'a kon lhagao gilou khatnin nasuhgim ahitai."},"16":{"text":"Tun ka-pakaiyun namasanga um nasohte hin semjang saithem mikhat agahol nadiuvin thupeh neijin; chule hung hitiding ahi, Pathen'a kon lhagao gilou chu nachunga ahung umteng, aman semjang asai ding, chutengle nangma naphat jiding ahi, atiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in asohte jah-a, Tun asai themtah mikhat neipeuvin, amachu kahenga hinpuijun, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin sohte lah-a khatnin adonbutnin, Ven, Bethlehem mi Jesse chapa semjang saithemtah, gal hat mihangsan, galbolmi, ijakaija hekhen themtah, chule melhoitah, Pakaiyin aumpi khat kamui, ati."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun Saul'in Jesse henga thupole ho solin, ahenga, Kelngoiho toh umkhom nachapa David chu neihinsol peh-in, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Jesse'n changlhah toh lengpitwi haikhat, chule kelnou khat sangan apohsah-in, achapa David khutna Saul athot tai."},"21":{"text":"Chuin David Saul henga ahungin, amasanga adingtai: chule aman nasatah-in alungsetnin, agalvonpon ahung pangtai."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Jesse henga, Katao ahi, David hi kamasanga dingjing hen; ajehchu ama kamitmun lungsetna achange, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Pathen'a kon lhagao gilou chu Saul chunga aumtengle, David'in semjang alan, akhutna asaijin ahi: hitichun Saul chu alimdohjin, aphajitan, chule lhagao gilou chun adalhaji tan ahi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Judah gam Shochoh mun'a chun Philistine galsat ho chu galbol din akikhomun, chule Ephes-damim'a um Shochoh le Azekah kikah-ah ponbuh asongun ahi.","title":"Goliath'in Israelte Achou"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Saul le Israelte jong akikhom khomun, Elah phaicham panga aponbuh-u asongun, Philistine te douna-a galsatdin akigongtoh taove."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Philistine te chu molpang langkhatna adingun, chule Israelte chu molpang khatlama adingun ahi. Chule akah uva chun phaicham khat aume."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Philistine te gebuh-a konin Gath khomi amin Goliath kiti mihat tah khat, tong gup le khap khatna sang ahungdoh-in ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule aman aluchunga sum-eng lukhuh akhuh-in, thih sangkhol aki-ah-in, asangkhol gihdan chu sum-eng shekel sanga agih ahi."},"6":{"text":"Akengteni sum-eng ngaltomin akitomin, chule alengkou teni kikah-a sum-eng tengcha aumin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule atenglung chu ponkhong ho talhang abangin, atengpeh gih chu thih shekel jagup ahi: chule mikhatnin apho apon amasanga achen ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin ama adingin Israel galsat miho jah-a chun asamin, Ipi dinga galsat dinga hung kigola nahiuvem? keima Philistine kahi, nangho Saul sohte nahiu hilouham? nanghodin mikhat lheng unlang, amachu kahenga hungsuh hen."},"9":{"text":"Aman eihung kisatpi jouva, eitha-a ahile, keiho nasoh-u hiuvingting; ahinla ken kajo-a, amachu katha-a ahile nangho kasoh nahiuva, neijen dingu ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Philistine mipa chun, Tunia hi Israel galsat miho kataitom nahiuve; kaki satpi dingin, mi khat neipeuvin, ati."},"11":{"text":"Saul le Israel mijousen Philistine mipa thusei chu ajah phatnun, alungu alhan, akichalheh jengun ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tun David chu Judah gam Bethlehem'a Ephrath mi Jesse chapa ahi; amapan chapa get aneijin, chule ama Saul nikholaija chun tehsetah ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Chule Jesse chapa lenpen thumho chu acheuvin galmuna chun Saul ajuijun ahi. Chule achapa thum galmuna cheho minchu, achapa lenpen Eliab, abanna Abinadad, athumna Shammah ahiuve."},"14":{"text":"Chule David chu alhumpen ahin, chule alenpen thumin Saul ajuiju ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla David chu achen Saul'a konin apa kelngoi ching dingin Bethlehem'a ahung kile kit tai."},"16":{"text":"Chule Philistine mipa chun jingkah nilhah-in ahin naijin, nisomli sungin ahung kilah jingin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Jesse'in achapa David jah-a, Tun na-ute dingin changkanpoh ephah khatle changlhah lhon somkhat choi jinlang, na-ute gebuh lama lhaijin,"},"18":{"text":"Chule hiche bongnoiha somkhat hi sangkhat chunga gal lamkaipa pohpeh-in, chule nasopite iti umuvem gavenlang thu hinle poh-in, ati."},"19":{"text":"Tun Saul le Israel mite jouse chu Elah phaichama Philistine tetoh kisatdinga uma ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chuin David chu jingkah matah-in athouvin, kelngoiho chu achingtup ding khattoh adalhan, Jesse'n athupeh bangchun thilho chu apon achetai. Chuin janelho galkula kon galsat dinga akijotdoh uva, galsat dinga a-ao laitah-un, ngahphol chu agalhungtai."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu Israelte le Philistine te chu galsat mi le galsat mi kisatto din akigol cheh taove."},"22":{"text":"Chuin David'in thil chingtuppa henga athilpohho chu adalhan, galsat miho lah-a alhailutnin, a-ute chu chibai agabohtai."},"23":{"text":"Chuin amahotoh akihou laijin, veuvin, Gath mi Philistine mihatpa, amin Goliath kitipa chu Philistine galsat mihon lah-a konin ahungdoh-in, athusei ngaibang chun ahinsei kitnin ahile, hichu David'in ajatai."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Israel mite jousen mipa chu amuphatnun, ama-a konchun ajamun, hatah-in akichao vin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Israel miho chun, Ahungdoh mipa khu namuvem? Israelte sujum ding mongmonga hungdoh-a ahi; chule hiti ding ahi, ama that penpen chu lengpan haona nasatah-a ahaosah ding, chule amachu achanu jong apeh-a, apate insung chu Israel lah-a a-onthol sah ding ahi, atiuve."},"26":{"text":"Chuin David'in akoma dingho jah-a chun, hiche Philistine mipa thatna, Israel te-a kona minsetna lamangpa chu i-kilo dingham? ajehchu hiche cheptanlou Philistine mipa hi hoi koi hija, Pathen hing galsat miho hi ajumso ham? ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin mihochun hitihin adonbutnun, Amapa that penpen chunga chu, akisei bang banga kibolding ahi, atiuve."},"28":{"text":"Chuin a-upa alenpen Eliab'in miho toh akihoulim chu ajan; David chunga chun Eliab lunghanna chu akoujah jengtan, ajah-a, Ibola hikoma hungsuh nahim? chule kelngoi lhomcha khat chu gamthipma koi nahin chin sah ham? naki letsah na le naphatlou kahei; ajehchu kidouna munoma hungsuh nahi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin David'in tu-a hi ipi kabol em? ajeh uma hilouham? ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin ama-a konin adangho lama akiheijin, chutobangma chun aseijin ahi: chuin mipin amachu amasa bangma chun adonbutnun ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin David thusei ho ajah phatnun, Saul henga aga hetsah taovin ahile, aman akouding ahinsol tai."},"32":{"text":"Chuin David'in Saul jah-a, Ama jehkhun koimacha lunglha hihhel hen, nasohhi kache-a hiche Philistine mipa tokhun kaga kisat ding ahi, ati."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in David jah-a, Hiche Philistine mipa kidoupi dingkhun chethei pon nate: ajehchu nangma khangdong chabou nahin, amakhu aneova patna galbolmi hung hija ahi, ati."},"34":{"text":"Chuin David'in Saul jah-a, Nasohhin apa kelngoi ana chingin, hia chun keipi bahkai le vompi ahunga kelngoihon lah-a konin kelngoi nouho ahunglhoh jiteng;"},"35":{"text":"Anung kadel jin, kakidel pin, akama konin kaloidoh-in kahuh dohjin ahi: chule keima thatdinga ahung kipatdoh-a ahile, akhamula kamanin, kajepmin, kathatjitai, ati."},"36":{"text":"Nasoh hin keipi bahkai le vompi ani-in kathatnin ahi: chule hiche cheptanlou Philistine mipa hi Pathen hing galsat mite ajumso kimu ahin, hiteho khat tobang chu hiding ahi, ati."},"37":{"text":"David'in aseiben, Pakaiyin keipi khophanga konle vompi khophanga kona eina huhdoh ahin, aman hiche Philistine mipa khutna kona jong eihuhdoh ding ati. Chuin Saul'in David henga, Chen, Pakaiyin naumpi hen, ati."},"38":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in agalvon chu David avonpeh'in, aluchanga chun sum-eng lukhuh akhuhpeh-in, thih sangkhol a-ah peh-in ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chuin David'in achemjam chu agalvon chunga akojin, cheding agon ahi; ajehchu hichu anapatep khahlou ahi. Chuin David'in Saul jah-a, Hicheho pumin chethei ponge, ajehchu hichehohi kamangkhapoi, ati. Chuti chun David'in asutlha gamtai."},"40":{"text":"Chuin atenggol akhutna achoijin, vachadunga konin songchang jolsel changnga alhengin, akelngoi chinna sakhao neo sunga akhumin; akhutna ahsongse achoijin, Philistine mipa chu anailut tan ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chuin Philistine mipa ahungin, David chu ahin naipheijin; chule apho popa chu amasanga achen ahi.","title":"David'in Goliath Ajo"},"42":{"text":"Chule Philistine mipan avetle David amuphatnin, amachu anoiselheh-in ahi: ajehchu ama khangdong ahin, tahsa phatah le maiso hoitah ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chuin Philistine mipan David jah-a, Keima uicha kahia kahenga tenggol toh nahungham? ati. Chuin Philistine mipa chun a-pathenhou min panin David chu agaosaptai."},"44":{"text":"Chuin Philistine mipan David jah-a, Kahenga hungin, keiman naphe chu chunga leng vachate le gamlah-a gamsaho kapeh ding ahi, ati."},"45":{"text":"Chuin David'in Philistine mipa jah-a, Nangma kahenga chemjam le tengcha chule lum tho-a nahung ahin, hinlah keima vang nangin nataitom Israel galsat mite Pathen, janel Pakai mina chu hunga kahi."},"46":{"text":"Tunia hi Pakaiyin nangma kakhutna eipehdoh ding; chule nangma katha-a, nalu kalahding; chule leiset pumpin Israelte lah-a Pathen aumme ti ahetna diuva, Philistine sepai janel longchu tunia hi chunga leng vachate le leija gamsaho kapeh ding ahi."},"47":{"text":"Chule hichea kikhom jousehin Pakaiyin chemjam le tengchan ahuhhing poi ti ahetdiu ahi; ajehchu galsat hi Pakaiya ahin, aman nangho kakhut uva eipehlut diu ahitai, ati."},"48":{"text":"Chuin ahung hitin ahi, Philistine mipa ahung kipatdoh-a, David henglam ahin nai phatnin, kintah-in David chu Philistine galsat miho toh kisuto dingin alhaitan ahi."},"49":{"text":"Chuin David'in akhutnin sakhao sung asoh-in, chua konchun songchang khat alan, ahsongse-a chu asea ahile, Philistine mipa chalpanga achun, songchang chu achalpanga alutnin; chuin ama amaijin tolla alhutai."},"50":{"text":"Chuti chun David'in Philistine mipa chu ahsongse le songchang khatnin ajouvin, Philistine mipa chu asepmin, athattai; ahinla David khutna chun chemjam aumpon ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 21:19"},"51":{"text":"Hitichun David alhaijin, Philistine mipa chunga adingin, achemjam chu alan, apaija konchun asatdoh in, athatnin, hia chun alu atanbongtai. Chuin Philistine ten amihatpao athi chu amuphatnun ajamtaovin ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 21:9"},"52":{"text":"Chuin Israelte le Judah miho akipatnun, hatah in a-aovun, phaicham le Ekron kotpi aphah kahseovin Philistine te chu anung delun ahi. Chule Philistine mipi ho chu Shaaraim lampi dunga, Gath le Ekron changeijin alhuchap jengun ahi."},"53":{"text":"Chuin Israel chate chu Philistine te anungdel uva konin ahung kileuvin, aponbuh houchu asumang taove."},"54":{"text":"Ahin David'in Philistine mipa luchang chu alan, Jerusalem'a ahinpotai; ahin agalvon vang apon in'a akoijin ahi."},"55":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in David Philistine mipa satdinga achedoh amuchun, janel gallamkai Abner jah-a, Abner hiche gollhangpa hi koicha ham? ati. Chuin Abner'in, Vo lengpa, nahinna hingjeng hen, kasei theipoi, ati.","title":"Saul Henga David Aphondoh-u"},"56":{"text":"Chuin lengpan, Khangdongpa chu koicha ham? hinkhol toh-in, ati."},"57":{"text":"Chuin David chu Philistine mipa atha-a kona ahung kile phatnin, Abner'in apuijin, akhutna Philistine mipa luchang pumin Saul masanga ahin puilut tai."},"58":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in ajah-a, Gollhang nangma koipen cha nahim? ati. Chuin David'in adonbutnin, Keima Bethlehem mi nasoh Jesse chapa kahi, ati."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Saul henga athusei achai phatnin, Jonathan hinna chu David hinna toh akijopmat tan, chule Jonathan'in David chu ama hinna bang bangin angailutan ahi."},"2":{"text":"Chuin hicheni chun Saul'in ama akipuijin, chule a-in lam apa in'a achesah nom tapoi."},"3":{"text":"Chujouvin Jonathan le David'in kitepna aneilhone; ajehchu aman ama hinna bangin amachu angailun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in achunga kai asangkhol len chu asutlhan, avonho, achemjam le athalpi, chule akongah sannin David apetan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in asolnalam lama David achedohjin, chule chingthei tah-in aumin ahi: chule Saul'in ama chu galbolho chunga lamkaijin atungin, ama chu mijouse mitmu le Saul sohte mitmun deisahna achangin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, David'in Philistine mipa atha-a, atha naova kona ahungkileu chun, Israelte khopiho jouse-a konin numei ho lasa le lam pumin, khongcha le thil gingtheiho thon thanom tah-in Saul lamto dingin ahungpot doh-un ahi.","title":"Saul'in David Athangthip"},"7":{"text":"Chuin numei hon la asaovin, Saul'in asang asang athatnin, David'in sangsom sangja athatne, tin khatle khat akidonbutnun ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 21:11; 29:5"},"8":{"text":"Chuin Saul alung ahanglheh-in, akisei chun alung phatmosah lheh-in; aman, David'in sangsom athan aseijun, chule keiman sangkhat kathan bou aseijuve: lenggam tailou adang ipi alahbe ding umtam? ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in chuche ni-a pat akalse chu David chu amit thiptan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, ajingin Pathen'a kona lhagao gilou chu Saul chungah ahungchun, insunga chun gaothu aseijin: phatdanga bangin David'in akhutnin semjang asaijin; chule Saul khutna chun tengcha khat aumin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in tengcha chun akhon ahi; ajehchu aman, David chu tengchan bangtoh khobeh inge, ati ahi, chuin David ama-a konin nivei ahoidoh-in ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in David chu akichatan ahi, ajehchu Pakaiyin ama aumpin, Saul chu adalha tai."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun Saul'in ama-a konin asoldoh-in, sangkhat chunga gal lamkaijin apansah-in; chule ama mipi masanga chun alutle apotlejin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin David alampi jouse-a chingthei tah-in aumin; chule Pakaiyin aumpin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun Saul'in ama chingtheitah-a aum amuphatnin, amachu akichatan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla Israelte jouse le Judah ten David chu a-angsung uva alutle apotle jeh-in angailuvin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in David jah-a, Ven, kachanu lenjonu Merab hi najidinga kapeh ding nahi: keidin hangtah-in pang poupouvin lang, Pakai galchu satnin, ati. Ajehchu Saul'in, Kakhut hi achunga chuhda hen, amavang Philistine te khut joh chu achunga chuhen, ati ahi.","title":"David'in Saul Chanu Akichenpi"},"18":{"text":"Chuin David'in Saul jah-a, Keima hi koi kahiham? chule kahinkho ipi hija, Israel insunga kapa insung ipi hija, lengpa tupa kahiding ham? ati."},"19":{"text":"Ahinla Saul chanu Merab chu David akipeh ding phatchun ahitin ahi, Meholath mi Adriel jidin amanu akipetan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Saul chanu Michal'in David adeichan; chule Saul jah-ah aseipeh-un ahile ama akipah lheh-in ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Amanu hi amapa dinga thang ahitheina dingle, Philistine te khut achunga achuhthei nadin, amanu chu David penge, ati. Hijeh chun Saul'in David jah-a, Tunia katupa nahi ding ahitai, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in asohte thu apen, ajah uva, David toh guhthim chan kihou unlang, ahenga, Ven, lengpan nachunga kipana aneijin, asohte jousen nangailui: hijeh chun tun lengpa tupa hitan tiuvin, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Saul sohten thuho chu David jah-a aseijun ahi. Chuin David'in, Kei migenthei le mi nahsahmo kahi nahena saova, lengpa tupa hidingchu thil bailama nagelu ham? ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Saul sohten ajah-a, David'in hitin aseije tin aseipeh-un ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Hitia hi David henga nasei dingu ahi, lengpan amelmate phu lahna dinga Philistine chep jakhat tailou numei man imacha angehpoi tin seijun, ati. Ahinla Saul'in David chu Philistine te khutna thisah agot ahibouve."},"26":{"text":"Chuin asohten hichethu chu David aseipeh phatnun, lengpa tupa hiding chu David akipah-in; nikhoho chu akichai hihlaije."},"27":{"text":"Chuin David akipatdoh-in, amale amite acheuvin, Philistine miho jani agathatnun: David'in achepmu ahinpon, lengpa tupa ahithei nadin, lhingkeijin lengpa apetaove. Chuin Saul'in ajidin achanu Michal apetai."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Pakaiyin David aumpi chu ahetan, chule Saul chanu Michal'in amachu angailun ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in David chu akicha cheh tan: Saul chu David melma ahijom jingtan ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chujouvin Philistine pipuiho apotdoh-un: chuin ahitin ahi, amaho potdoh nungun, David chu Saul sohte jouse sangin chingthei cheh-in aumtan; chutichun aminchu nasatah-in akithangin ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in achapa Jonathan le asohte jouse David that dingin ahoulimpi tan ahi.","title":"Saul'in David Abolgenthei"},"2":{"text":"Ahinla Saul chapa Jonathan'in David chu angailu lheh-in: chule Jonathan'in David henga, Kapa Saul'in thadingin nahole: hijeh chun tun, katao ahi, jingkah ahikahsen kichihtheijin, munthipma uminlang kiselin."},"3":{"text":"Chule keima kachesuh-a naumna loujaova chun kapa koma kadina, nangma chungchang thu kaseiding; chule kamudoh chanchu nangma kaseipeh ding nahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in apa Saul henga David chu aseiphan, ahenga hitin aseije, Lengpan asohpa David dounan chonset boldahen; ajehchu nang dounan achonsepon, chule athilbol jouse chu nang dinga phatna ngen ahi:"},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu aman ahinkho akhutna akichoi tho-a, Philistine mipa anatha-a, Pakaiyin Israelte jouse dinga huhhingna loupitah anabol ahi: chuti ahile ajeh beija David chu natha-a, monabei thisan douna-a nachonset ding ham? ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Jonathan thusei angaijin: chule Saul akihahselin, Hingjing Pakai min pana kasei ahi, ama kithat louding ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in David akouvin, chule Jonathan'in thu jouse chu ahiltan ahi. Chule Jonathan'in David chu Saul henga apuijin, masanglaija bangin a-angsunga aumkit tan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin gal aumkit tan: David akondoh-in Philistine tetoh akisatnin, amaho nasatah-in athatnin; chuin amaho ama-a konin ajamtaove."},"9":{"text":"Chuin a-insunga auma, akhutna teng akichoi petnin, Pakaiya kon lhagao gilou chu Saul chunga achutan; chule David'in akhutnin semjang asaijin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in David chu bangtoh khobeh-a thading agon; ahinla ama Saul umna-a konin ajamdoh-in, ateng chun bang akhochang jengin ahi. Chuin David ajamin, hiche janchun ajamdoh tai."},"11":{"text":"Saul'in David inlama jingkah-a anachanga thatdingin sottol leho asolin ahi: chuin David inneipi Michal'in ahenga, Tujanna nahinna nakihuh doh louva ahile, jingle nakithat ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Labu 59 (Thupi)."},"12":{"text":"Chutichun Michal'in David chu bangkotna akhailhan: ama achen, ajamin, ahoidohtai."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Michal'in milim khat alan, jalkhuna chun alupsah-in, aluchang dingin kelcha mul akoijin, hichu ponnin akhun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in David kouding thangkou asolphatnin, amanun, Adampoi atin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in David vedin sottol hochu asolkitnin, ajah uva, Katha theinadin, ajalkhun pumin kahenga hindom touvun, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin sottol ho ahunglut phatnun, veuvin, jalkhuna chun aluchang dinga kelcha mul kikoi milim khat analumin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Michal henga, Ibola hitia hi neijou lhepma, kamelma pa chu ahoidoh nadinga nasoldoh ham? ati. Chuin Michal'in Saul adonbutnin, Aman kahengah, Neiche sah-in; ibola kathading nahim? atin ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin David chu ajamin, ahoidohtan, Ramah'a Samuel koma ahungin, Saul thilbol jouse chu ahiltai. Chuin amale Samuel ache lhonin, Naioth'a acheng lhontai."},"19":{"text":"Chuin hichu Saul ahilun, Ven, Ramah gamsung Naioth'a David aume, atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in David mandin sottol leho asolin: chuin amahon themgao honkhat gaothu aseijuva, chule achunguva Samuel lamkaija ana ding amuphatnun, Saul sottol leho chunga chun Pathen lhagao ahung chun, amahon jong gaothu asei taove."},"21":{"text":"Chuin hichu Saul aseipeh phatnun, sottol dangho asolkitnin ahile, amahon jong chutima chun gaothu aseikit taove. Chuin Saul'in athumveina-a sottol leho asolkitnin ahileh, amahon jong gaothu aseiden kit taove."},"22":{"text":"Hichun amajong Ramah'a ahungin, Sechu'a um twikul lentah phung ahung lhungin, Samuel le David hoija umlhonnam? tin adongin ahi. Chuin mikhatnin, Vetan, Ramah gam Naioth mun'a aum lhone, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin ama Ramah gam Naioth'a achen ahile, Pathen lhagao chu ama chunga jong achutan, Ramah gam Naioth alhun kahsen ache pumin gaothu aseipeh tan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin aponjong ahohlhan, Samuel angsunga chun hitichun gaothu aseijin, chuche nikho nilhum le jankhovah-in asagoh-in alumin ahi. Hijeh chun amahon, Saul jong themgaoho lah-a panga hitam? atiuve.","ref":"1 Sam 10:11-12"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin David chu Ramah gam Naioth'a konin ajamin, Jonathan henga ahungin, ajah-a, Ipi kabol am? kakhan gitlouna ipi umam? chule napa anga kachonsetna ipi uma thadinga kahinkho hi aholham? ati.","title":"Jonathan'in David Akithopi"},"2":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah-a, Nathi ding chu Pathen'in jahda hen: ven kapan keima hetsah louvin, thil len hihen, thilneo hijongle bolponte. Achutile ipi dinga kapan hicheho chu kakoma a-im dingham? Chutiponte, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin David akihahsel kitleuvin, Namitmu-a lungsetna kachanhi napan chentah-in ahen; Jonathan'in hichehi hetda maihen, atiloule lungna getninte ati hinte. Ahinla hingjing Pakai le nangma mina pana kasei ahi, keima le thina kikah-a hi kalkhat sehbou uma ahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Hichun Jonathan'in David jah-a, Ipi hijongle nahinnan angaichat chanchu, nanga dinga kabolpeh ding nahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin David'in Jonathan jah-a, Ven jingkhu lhathah ni ahin, lengpa toh ankonga thonlouva katoukhom tei ngai ahi; ahinla anithum ni nilhah geija gamlah-a kaga kisel theinadin neisolin.","ref":"Minb 28:11."},"6":{"text":"Napan eiholmona aumhela ahile, David'in akhopi Bethlehem'a gache vahdin kakoma phalna khohtah-in athumin ahi: ajehchu insung pumpi-a dinga kumtin ganlhai chukoma aneiju ahi, tin seijin ati."},"7":{"text":"Hitia chu aman, Aphai atia ahile, nasohhi lungmona kanei ding; amavang hatah-a alung hana ahileh, thilse angaitoi ti hejengin."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nasoh chunga hi hepina neitah-a na natoh ding ahi; ajehchu nasohhi Pakaiya kitepna naneipi ahitai. Hijeng jongle keima-a khangitlouna aumle, nangmatah in neithat jengin; ipi khoh-a napa henga neipui dingham? ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in, Hichu nanga konin gamlahen: ajehchu kapan nachunga thilse bol agot kahet monga ahile, kahil louding ham? ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuphatnin David'in Jonathan jah-a, Napan setah-in nadonbut tale, kon eihunghil dingham? ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in David jah-a, Hungin, loujaova chehite, ati. Chuin amani loujao lama achedoh lhontan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in David jah-a, Pakai Israel Pathen chu ahetoh ahi! jing nikho, ahiloule nithum nikho hama kapa kadoh teng, David dinga apha ahia, chuteng nahenga mi kasol louva kahetsah louva ahile,"},"13":{"text":"Pakaiyin chutobang chun, chule akhohjo cheh-in Jonathan chunga boljenghen: ahinla nangma bolset dingchu kapa lunglhaina ahia ahile, lhamonga nachethei nadin nahetsah ingting, nasolmang nange. Chule kapa ana umpi bangchun Pakaiyin nangma naumpi hen."},"14":{"text":"Chule kathilouna dinga kahinlai jenga Pakai phatna neimusah ding hilouvin;"},"15":{"text":"A-itih-a dinga ka-insunga kona naphatna nasat tanhel louding ahi. Pakaiyin David melmate aboncha leiset chunga asuhmanghel nung jongle sattanhih helin, ati.","ref":"2 Sam 9:1"},"16":{"text":"Hitichun Jonathan'in David insung toh kitepna asemin, Pakaiyin David melmate chunga phu lahen, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in angailut jeh-in, David chu akihahsel sah kitnin ahi. Ajehchu aman ama hinna angailut bang banga angailut ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hichun Jonathan'in David jah-a, Jing nikho khu lhathah ni ahin; natouna a-on ding jeh-a nakiholmo ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule nithum naum nungteng, nachesuh loija thukhoh aumtengle nakisel jina mun mama-a chu nahung ding, Ezel song panga chu na-umden ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule keiman doikhat neibanga thalchang thum hiche panga chu kahinkap ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule ven, chapang khat kahinsol ding, Chenlang thalchang ho khu gaholdoh-in, katiding ahi. Chule chapang henga chu, Ven, thalchang ho chu nasih hilam panga aume, hinlan kati-a ahile, hung jengin. Ajehchu Pakai hingjing mina kasei ahi, nangma dingin lungmona aumin, setna aumpoi."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla gollhangpa jah-a chu, Ven, thalchang ho chu nakhel lama aume, kati-a ahile; nalampi-a che jengin: ajehchu Pakaiyin nasolmang ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule nang le kei kikah-a iseidohho jouse chunga chun, ven, Pakai chu nang le kei kikah-a a-itih-in umjing hen, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuti chun David amale ama gamlah-a akiselin: chuin lhathah nikho ahunglhun phatnin, lengpa chu an nedin atou lhatan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin lengpa phat dangho bangin atouna chunga atouvin, bangpanga touna-a chun atouve: chuin Jonathan akipatdoh-in, chule Abner chu Saul panga atouvin, David munchu a-ongtan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ahivangin Saul'in hicheni chun imacha aseipoi: ajeh chu aman, Achunga thilkhat tou soh-a thenglou hinte; thonlouva ama thenglou hinte, tia angaito ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, hichu chuche lha nini channi ahin, David munchu a-ongkit tai. Chuin Saul'in achapa Jonathan jah-a, Jesse chapa chu janhi-a jong, tunia jong ibola hunglou ham? ati."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in Saul adonbutnin, David'in Bethlehem'a chenadin hatah-in kakoma phalna athumin:"},"29":{"text":"Katao ahi, neiche sah-in: ajehchu ka insung miten khopi sunga ganlhaina kaneidiu ahin; chule kasopipan chua umdin eithupeh-in ahi: chule tun, namitmu-a lungsetna kachana ahile, katao ahi, neichesah inlang kasopite gamunge, atin ahi. Hijeh-a chu lengpa dokhanga hunglou ahi, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuphatnin Jonathan chunga Saul lunghana chu akoujah tan, ajah-a, Nang numei vahvei le golkeh chapa, nangman nangmatah jachat nadingle nanu sagohkeu jachatsah nadinga Jesse chapa chu nalhen ahi kahetlouva nabolham?"},"31":{"text":"Ajehchu Jesse chapa leiset chunga ahinlaisea nangma le nalenggam kiphutdet louding ahi. Hijeh chun tun kahenga din mi gakousah-in, ajehchu ama thiteiding ahi, ati."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in apa Saul adonbutnin, ajah-a, Ipi dinga ama kithat dingham? aman ipi abolem? ati."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in thadingin teng khatnin akhon ahi. Hichea konchun Jonathan'in apan David thading agotmong ahichu ahetai."},"34":{"text":"Hitichun Jonathan chu dokhanga konchun lunghang tah-in akipatdoh-in, chuche lha anini nichun an anetapoi. Ajehchu apan ajachatsah behseh jehchun, David chu alungkhampin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Jingkah-in ahitin ahi, David toh akitep phat tah chun Jonathan chu chapang khat toh apotdoh-in, loujaova chun achetai."},"36":{"text":"Chuin aman achapangpa jah-a, Lhaijinlang kathalchang kap ho chu gaholdoh-in atin. Chuin chapangpa chu alhai tolhonin, thalchang khat akal lama chun agah kapmin ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chuin chapangpa chun Jonathan'in akapdoh thalchang phung aphah phatnin, Jonathan'in chapangpa jah-a, Thalchang chu nakal peh-a uma hilouham? tin asame."},"38":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in chapang chu asamin, Kikinnon, gangin, umden hih-in, ati. Chuin Jonathan chapangpa chun thalchang ho chu achom khomin, apu henga ahungtai."},"39":{"text":"Ahin chapang pa chun imacha ahepon: Jonathan le David'in bou thil kibolchu ahelhone."},"40":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in amanchahho chapangpa apen, ajah-a, Chenlang khopi-a anapo lutan, ati."},"41":{"text":"Chuin chapangpa achedoh doh-in, David lhanglama munkhatna konin ahung kipatdoh-in, amai tolla asulutnin, thumvei akunin ahi. Chuin khatle khat akichopto lhonin, David'in alhakang kahse chun hatah-in akika lhontan ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chuin Jonathan'in David henga, Lung mongin chetan, ajehchu ini-a Pakai mina ikihahsela, Pakai chu kei le nang kah-a, chule kei chilhahle nang chilhah ho kah-a a-itih-in ahetoh hijing tahen tia inasei ahitai, ati. Chuin ama akipatdoh-in achetai. Chule Jonathan jong khopi sunga alut tan ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin David Ahimelech thempu henga Nob'a ahungin ahi. Chule David to akimuto chu Ahimelech akichan, ajah-a, Ipidinga nachangseh nahi hija, koimatoh kilhonlou nahim? ati.","title":"Saul'a Kona David Ajam","ref":"Matt 12:3-4; Mrk 2:25-26; Luk 6:3."},"2":{"text":"Chuin David'in Ahimelech thempu jah-a, Lengpan kinkhatna eisola, kajah-a, Keiman kasolna thudol le kathupeh hi koimacha hetsah hih-in, ati ahi. Chule keiman kasohte hilai khulai mun'a chu kasol ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun nakhutna ipi umam? kakhutna changlhah nga ahiloule nakoma um umchu neipen, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin thempu pan David adonbutnin, Kakhutna changlhah lham aumpon, changlhah thengbou aume; gollhangho chu numeija kon beh-a akichintup uva ahile, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin David'in thempu pa chu adonbutnin, ajah-a, Atahbeh-in kahunga pat nithum tobang keiho-a kona numei ho kichomkoi ahin, chule gollhangho belho hi athenga ahi, chule changlhah chu tunia belsunga kisutheng hijongle, gelkhatna alham ahi ati."},"6":{"text":"Hitichun thempupan changlhah theng chu apetai; ajehchu khat akilahdoh tengle changlhah sapeh akhela koidinga Pakai angsunga kona kiladoh vetsahna changlhah tailou changlhah ding umlou ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 24:5-9."},"7":{"text":"Tun hicheni chun Saul sohte khat hia chun Pakai anga anakihenin; aminchu Doeg ahin, Edom mi Saul ganchingho lah-a apipuipen ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin David'in Ahimelech henga, Nakhutna tengcha ahiloule chemjam umlou ham? ajehchu lengpa thuchu thukin ahijeh-in kachemjam le kagal manchah kahin poman tapoi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin thempu pan, Ven, Elah phaichama natha Philistine mipa Goliath chemjam chu hia thempu sangkhol nunga ponin akijelin aume: nadeile hichu kilah-in; ajehchu hiche tailou chu adang aumpoi, ati. Chuin David'in, Chekal lhah chu umding ham; neipe jengin, ati.","ref":"1 Sam 17:51."},"10":{"text":"Chuin David akipatdoh-in, hicheni chun Saul ginna in ajamin, Gath lengpa Achish henga chetai."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Achish sohten ajah-a, Hichehi chuche gam lengpa David hilouham? Mihon achung changa lampuma khat le khat kidonbut to-a la asah uva, Saul'in sangkhat athatnin, David'in sangsom athatne, atiuchu hilouham? atiuve.","ref":"1 Sam 18:7; 29:5"},"12":{"text":"Chuin Davidn'in thuhochu alungsunga aching pai jengin, Gath lengpa Achish chu akicha lheh jengtan ahi.","ref":"Labu 56 (Thupi)."},"13":{"text":"Hitichun amasanguva achondan khelin, amitnuva chun akingolsah-in, kotpi kotkhah ho ajihpol letlut in, akhamul achun achilche akaisah dehduh-in ahi.","ref":"Labu 34 (Thupi)"},"14":{"text":"Chujouvin Achish'in asohte jah-a, Veuvin, mingol ahi henasa ibola kahenga nahin pui uham?"},"15":{"text":"Mingol kangaichat hija, ka-angsunga angolna-a kichem dinga hitobang mihi nahin pui uham? Hitobang miho ka-insunga hunglut diham? ati."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh chun chua konchun David apotdoh-in, Adullam songkoa akiselin; asopitele apa insung mijousen ajah phatnun ahenga achesuh-un ahi.","title":"Thempuho Kitha","ref":"Labu 57 (Thupi)."},"2":{"text":"Chuin alung genthei jouse, leiba neijouse, chule lunglhailouna neijouse ahenga ahung kikhomun; amaho chunga chun ama gal lamkaijin apangin: chule ama toh umkhoma chu mi jali tobang ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chuin David chua konin Moab gam Mizpeh'a achetan: chule Moab lengpa jah-a, Pathen'in kachunga ipi abolding ahi kahet masangsen, nahenga katao ahi, kanule kapa aumna-a hung dohhen lang nangma toh umkhom hen, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin aman amani Moab lengpa anga apuijin; chule David songkoa aumlaisen amato acheng khomun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Gad themgaovin David henga, songko sunga chun umden hih-in; potdoh-in, Judah gamsunga chen, ati. Chuin David apotdoh-in, Hareth gammanga alut tan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Saul'in David le aumpi miho chu akimu dohtai ti ajah phatnin, (tun Saul chu Gibeah gam Ramah kho-a thingphung khat noija aumin, akhutna tengcha akichoijin, akimvela asohte jouse adingun ahi;)"},"7":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in avella ding asohte jah-a chun, Tun nangho Benjamin miten ngaijun; Jesse chapa chun nangho amitakip lou le lengpi honho napeh cheh uva, sangkhat chunga gallamkai le jakhat chunga gal lamkaija napansah cheh dingu hija;"},"8":{"text":"Nabon uva keima douna galguh nabol uva, chule kachapan Jesse chapa toh kitepna anei lam eihetsah-a khatcha naum daova, keima dinga lungkham khatcha naum daova, chule tunia banga hi kachapan kasohpa keima douna-a eichanglhi dinga atildoh jonghi eihila koima umlou nahiuvem? ati."},"9":{"text":"Chujouvin Saul sohte chunga lamkaija kitung Edom mi Doeg chun adonbutnin, Nob'a Ahitub chapa Ahimelech henga Jesse chapa ahung kamui.","ref":"1 Sam 21:7-9; Labu 52 (Thupi)."},"10":{"text":"Chule aman amadin Pakai adohpeh-in, nehding ho apen, chule Philistine mipa Goliath chemjam jong apei, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuphatnin aman Ahitub chapa Ahimelech thempupa le apa insungmi Nob'a um thempuho jouse koudin mi asolin ahi. Chuin amaho abonun lengpa henga ahunguvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Tun nangma Ahitub chapa, ngaijin, ati. Chuin aman, Ka pakai hikoma kaume, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in ajah-a, Tunia banga hi nangma le Jesse chapan ibola keima douna-a galguh nabol lhona, keima douna-a kipatna eichanglhi dinga nangman amachu changlhah le chemjam napeh-a, Pakai nadoh peh ham? ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Ahimelech'in lengpa chu adonbutnin, Lengpa tupa hija, nasolna chana chea, na-insunga ja-umtah David tobanghi nasohte jouse lah-a koi umam?"},"15":{"text":"Achutile ama dinga Pathen dohpeh chu kakipatbep ham? hichu keija konin gamlahen: lengpan nasohpa hi le kapa insung mite jousehi imachan mo neichan hihbeh-un; ajehchu hicheho jouse thudol hi nasohpan alhom hihen atam hileh imacha kahepoi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin lengpan, Ahimelech nangma le napa insung mite jouse nathi teidingu ahi, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin lengpan akoma ding keng sepaiho henga, Kiheijun lang Pakai thempuho chu David toh akikhut jop jeh ule, amahon ajampet ahetnuva keima eihetsahlou jeh-un thatnun, ati. Ahinla Pakai thempuho chunga akhutnu lha dingchu lengpa sohte anompouve."},"18":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Doeg henga, Nangma kiheijin lang thempuho chungachun chun, ati. Chuin Edom mi Doeg chu akiheijin, thempuho chunga achun, hiche nikho chun tupat ponnem thempu sangkhol kivon mi somget le nga athatnin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin thempuho khopi Nob chu chemjamin asatnin, pasal le numei, chapang le noichep laiho, bongchal, sangan, chule kelngoiho chemjamin athat gamin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Ahitub chapa Ahimelech chapate lah-a khat amin Abiathar chu asohchan, David henga ajamin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Pakai thempuho atha chu Abiathar'in David ahetsah tan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin David'in Abiathar jah-a, Chuche ni-a Edom mi Doeg chua anauma chu Saul ahetsah teiding chu kahet ahitai: napa insung mite jouse chu keijeh-a thia ahitaove."},"23":{"text":"Nangma kahenga ummin lang, kicha hih-in: ajehchu keima thadinga eiholpa chun nang jong thadinga nahol ahi. Keitoh na-umle vang nahoidoh ding ahi, ati."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin amahon David jah-a, Ven Philistine ten Keilah asatnun, changphol ho achomun ahi, atiuve.","title":"David'in Keilah Khopi Ahuhdoh"},"2":{"text":"Hijeh chun David'in Pakai adongin, Kache-a Philistine te khu kagasat dingham? ati. Chuin Pakaiyin David jah-a, Chen, Philistine te gasatnin lang, Keilah gahuhdoh-in, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin David loihon ajah-a, Ven, hikom Judah gama bon kikicha-a, Keilah'a ihunguva, Philistine galsat miho igadou diuchu iti kichat umjocheh ding hitam? atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Hichun David'in Pakai adong kitnin ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin adonbutnin, Kipatdoh-in lang Keilah'a chesuh-in; ajehchu Philistine te chu nakhutna kapehdoh ding ahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Hitichun David le aloite Keilah-a acheuvin, Philistine te chutoh akisatnun, agancha hou ahin pui mangun, amaho chu nasatah-in athatnun ahi. Hitichun David'in Keilah miho chu ahuhdoh tan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Ahimelech chapa Abiathar chu David henga Keilah lama ajam phatnin, aman akhutna thempu sangkhol khat ahinchoijin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin David Keilah'a ahungchu Saul henga aseipeh taovin ahi. Chuin Saul'in, Pathen'in ama kakhutna eipehdoh ahitai; ajehchu khopi kulkotpi le kotjol nei alutna chu, ama kikam khum ahitai, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in mijouse chu galsat ding, Keilah'a chesuh-a David le aloite umchah din akoukhom tan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule David'in guhthima Saul'in ama chunga doha abolchu ahen; Abiathar thempu henga chun, Thempu sangkhol chu hinchoi jin, ati."},"10":{"text":"Hichun David'in, Vo Pakai Israel Pathen, keijeh-a Keilah khopi suse dingin Saul ahung suh-e ti kichentah in kajatai."},"11":{"text":"Keilah mihon akhutna eipehdoh diu ham? nasoh-in kajah banga hi Saul hungsuh ding ham? Vo Pakai Israel Pathen, katao ahi, nasoh hi neihet sah-in, ati. Chuin Pakaiyin, Hungsuh ding ahi, ati."},"12":{"text":"Hichun David'in, Keilah miten keima le kamitehi Saul khutna eipeh doh dingu ham? ati. Chuin Pakaiyin, Amahon napehdoh dingu ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuphatnin David le aloiho mi jagup tobang chu akipatnun, Keilah chu adalhaovin, achetheinao lamcheh-a achetauve. Chuin David chu Keilah'a konin ajamdoh tai tichu Saul aseipeh taovin; chule aman amaho kondoh dingchu ajahda tan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin David chu gamthipma mundet tah khatna aumin, Ziph gamthip lhang khatna aumden tan ahi. Chule Saul'in aniseh-in aholin, ahivangin Pathen'in akhutna apedoh pon ahi.","title":"David Gamthipma Aum"},"15":{"text":"Chuin Saul chu ama that dingin ahung kondoh-e ti chu David'in amutan: chule David chu Ziph gamthip gammanga uma ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Saul chapa Jonathan akipatnin, David umna gammanga chun achen, Pathen'a akhut tha agahatsah-in ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah-a, Kicha hih-in: ajehchu kapa Saul khutnin namaidoh louhel ding ahi; nangma Israel chunga leng changding nahin, keima nabantah-a kahi ding ahi; chule hichu kapa Saul'in ahet ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amanin Pakai angsunga kitepna aneilhonin ahi: chuin David gammanga aumin, Jonathan chu a-in'a achetai.","ref":"1 Sam 18:3"},"19":{"text":"Chujouvin Ziph miho chu Gibeah mun'a Saul henga ahungun, ajah-a, Jeshimon lhanglama um Hachelah lhang gammang lah mun dettah khatna David chu keiho toh kisela hilouham?","ref":"Labu 57 (Thupi); Labu 142 (Thupi)."},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun, vo lengpa, nalungin hungsuh ding anangaichat dungjuijin hungsuhtan; chule keiho mopohna chu lengpa khutna pehdoh dingchu hiding ahi, atiuve."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in, Nangho Pakaiya phattheiboh chang hiuvin; ajehchu nanghon keima neilainat piuvin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Cheovin, naheng uva katao ahi, gakhol toh-un, hilai mun'a chu kon amu ham akiselna mun gaveovin lang gahetoh-un; ajehchu ama doha thuhtah ahi ti eikisei peh-e."},"23":{"text":"Hijeh chun akiselguhna mun jouse chu gahetoh-un, chule adihchet chu nahet tengule kahenga hung kitnun, chutengle keima nangho toh kalhon ding ahi. Chule hung hitiding ahi, ama gamsunga um ahi pouva ahile, Judah mi asang asang lah-a chu kaholdoh ding ahi, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin amaho akipat doh-un, Saul angsunga konin Ziph gama ache taovin ahi: ahin David le aloiho chu Jeshimon lhanglam phaichama um Maon gamthipma aumuvin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Saul le amite jong ama holin acheuvin ahi. Chuin amahon David aseipeh-un: hijeh chun ama songpi khat sunga ahung lutnin, Maon gamthipma aumtan ahi.
