Saul'in hichu ajah phatnin, David chu Maon gamthipma ahin nungdel tan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Saul molpang hilam sanga achen, David le aloiho molpang khulam sanga acheuvin; chule David'in Saul ginna jammang loiding agon ahi: ajehchu Saul le aloihon David le amite chu matdinga a-umkolu ahitai."},"27":{"text":"Ahinla Saul henga thupole khat ahungin, ajah-a, Kinonlang hungin; ajehchu Philistine ten gamsunga gal ahinbol taove, tin ahungseijin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hijeh chun David nung adelna-a konin Saul akinunglen, Philistine te satdin achetai. Hijeh chun hiche mun chu Sela-hammah-lekoth asah taovin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin David chua konchun achetouvin, Engedi mun dettah sunga achengtai."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Philistine te nung adelna-a kon Saul ahungkile phatnin, ahenga, Ven, Engedi gamthipma David aume tin aseipeh-un ahi.","title":"David'in Saul Ahinghoi"},"2":{"text":"Hichun Saul'in Israelte jouse lah-a kona kilhengdoh mi sangthum akipuijin, David le amite chu gamkel ho umna songko dung holdin achetaovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin lamdunga kelngoi kotphung songko umna khatna ahungin; chule Saul chu kicholdo dingin alutnin ahi: David le aloiho chu songko sungnung lama chu uma ahiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chuin David loihon ajah-a, Vetan, Pakaiyin nahenga, Ven, namelmate nakhutna kapehdoh ding ahi, nangman phante nati bang banga achunguva nabol ding ahi, tia asei nikho chu tuni ahi, atiuve. Chuin David akipatdoh-in, Saul sangkhol chol mong chu achelhah pehtan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin chuche jouvin ahitin ahi, aman Saul sangkhol chol monglha achelhah jehchun David'in alungthimin phamo asalheh jengtan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin aman aloiho jah-a, Pakai thaonu kapu chunga kakhut kalapma, thaonu ahi ti henasasa hitobang kabolding chu Pakaiyin aphalpoi, ati.","ref":"1 Sam 26:11"},"7":{"text":"Chuti chun David'in asohte chu hiche thua hin asutangin, Saul chunga akhut analha sahpon ahi. Ahinla Saul chu songkoa konin ahungdoh-in, alamjot ban ajomkit tai."},"8":{"text":"Chujouvin David jong akipatnin, songkoa konin apotdoh-in, Saul jah-a, Kapu lengpa tin agah samin ahi. Chuin Saul'in nunglam ahinven ahile, David akunin tolla aboh khupmin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin David'in Saul jah-a, Ibola miho thusei, ven David'in suhsetdin nahole atiuchu nangaiham?"},"10":{"text":"Ven, tunia hi Pakaiyin songko sunga chu itobanga kakhutna eipehdoh hitam ti namit tah-in namutai. Mi phabepmin nangma thatdin eisolun; ahin, Keiman kapu chunga kakhut lhaponge, ajehchu ama Pathen thaonu ahi, tin kamitmun kahing hoijin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chukal valin, kapa, ven, kakhutna um napon chol mong kachetanhi ven: ajehchu naponchol kache lhah-a nangma katha louva konhin kakhutna gitlouna le khelna aumpon, nangma dounan kachonsepoi ti namun, nahen ahi. Ahinla nangin kei hinkho lahdin neidel lelen ahi."},"12":{"text":"Keima le nangma kah-a Pakaiyin thu tanhen lang, Pakaiyin naphu kachunga lamaihen; amavang kakhut hi nachunga chulou ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Gollui thuchih-a kisei bangin, Migilouva konin gitlouna asohdoh-e, akiti: keima vang kakhut nachunga lhaponge."},"14":{"text":"Israelte lengpa hi koi nung dela hung doh ham? nangman koinung nadel ham? uithisa khat nungle uili khat nungbou ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 26:20"},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai chu thutan hihen lang kei le nang kah-a thu tanhen, chule hinve hen, hin kholtoh henlang, nakhutna kona eihuhdoh hen, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, David'in Saul jah-a hiche thuho hi aseijou phatnin, Saul'in, Kachapa David, hichehi nangma aw hija ham? ati. Chuin Saul hakan akaptai."},"17":{"text":"Chuin aman David jah-a, nangma keisangin nachonphajoi: ajehchu nangman apha jenga bou neilethuh-in, keiman vang ase jenga bou kalethuh-e."},"18":{"text":"Chule tunin nangman neiboldan neimusah tai: ajehchu Pakaiyin nakhutna einapeh jengin jong, nangman neithat poi."},"19":{"text":"Ajehchu min amelma amule bitkeicha lampia achemangsah dingham? Hijeh chun tunia kahenga nathilbol jehhin Pakaiyin thilphan nalethuh hen."},"20":{"text":"Chule ven, tun thonlouva nangma leng nahung hia, Israel lenggam hi nakhutna kitungdoh ding ahi, ti kichen tah-in kahetai."},"21":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun kahenga, kanung tengle kachilhah te nasuhbeilou nading le, kapate insunga kona kamin nasuhmang louna dingin Pakaiya kihahsel in, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin David Saul henga akihahsel tan ahi. Chuin Saul a-in'a achetan; David le amite vang aumnao mun'a achetou taovin ahi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Samuel athitan; Israelte jouse akikhom khomun, alunghem piuvin, a-in mun Ramah'a avui taovin ahi. Chuin David akipatnin Paran gamthipma achesuhtai.","title":"Samuel Thi"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Moan kho-a chun Carmel'a anei agouho uma mikhat aumin; chule mipa chu ahao lheh jengin, kelngoi sangthum le kelcha sangkhat aneijin ahi. Chuin aman Carmel'a akelngoi mul avouvin ahi.","title":"David le Abigail"},"3":{"text":"Tun mipa minchu Nabal ahin, a-inneipi minchu Abigail ahi. Chule amanu chu numei lungching tah le melhoitah ahin: hinla mipa vang chu umje helou le gilou tah-a natong ahi: chule ama Caleb insungmi ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin David'in gamthipma chun Nabal'in akelngoi mul avouve ti thu ajan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin David'in gollhang som asolin, David'in gollhangho jah-a chun, Carmel'a chetouvun lang, Nabal henga cheovin, chule kaminin chibai gabolun:"},"6":{"text":"Chule haosatah-a hingpa jah-a chu hitia nagasei dingu ahi, Nachunga lungmon umhen, na-insung chunga lungmon umhen, chule nanei jouse chunga lungmon umhen."},"7":{"text":"Chule tun nangman kelngoimul vouho naneije ti kajaovin ahi: tun nakelngoi chingho chu Carmel'a aum sungseuvin keihotoh kaum khomun, kasugenthei pouvin, amahoa konin jong imacha amanga aumpoi."},"8":{"text":"Nagollhangho dongle chun namusah naovinte. Hijeh chun gollhangho hi namitmun lungsetna changu hen: ajehchu keiho kut nikho-a hung kahiuve. Nakhutna naphal khamkham chu nasohte le nachapa David dingin hinpen tin, gaseijun, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin David gollhangho ahung phatnun, hiche thuho jouse dungjui chun Nabal henga David minin aseijun anga taove."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Nabal'in David sohte chu adonbutnin, David chu koiham? chule Jesse chapa koiham? tulaijin apu thu palkeh-a jam manga soh tamtah aume."},"11":{"text":"Keiman ka-anneh le katwidon, chule ka kelngoi mul vouho dia kathapeh kasa chu kalah-a hoija kon ahiu kahetlou mihochu kapeh dingham? ati."},"12":{"text":"Chutichun David gollhangho chu akinung leuvin, ahungun thujouse chu David ahiltaove."},"13":{"text":"Chuin David'in aloiho jah-a, Amitakipmin nachemjam cheh kikouvin, ati. Chuin amitakip chun ama ama chemjam cheh akiko taovin; chule David'in jong achemjam akikon ahi. Chuin David nunga chun mi jali tobang le, moltum choi mi jani tobang acheuvin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahin gollhang khatnin Nabal jinu Abigail aseipeh-in, ajah-a, Ven, David'in gamthipma konin kapu chibai boh dingin sottol leho ahinsolin ahile, aman amaho anajumson ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla miho chu keihodia phatah ahiuvin, eisugenthei pouvin, amahotoh kakihou theijuva, gamlah-a kaum sungseuvin imacha jong kamansah pouve:"},"16":{"text":"Amaho toh kiloija kelngoi kachin sungseuvin, amaho keihodin sun le janin kulbangin akisungun ahi"},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun nangman ipi nabolding ham henlang ngaiton; ajehchu kapu chung le a-insung pumpi douna-a thilse kingaito ahitai. Ajehchu ama chutobang tah-a Belial chapa ahin, min ahenga thu asei theipon ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuphatnin Abigail akinoloijin, changlhah lhon jani, ju haini, kelngoi semtohsa nga, changkanpoh tena nga, chule lengpithei ga gop boh jakhat, theichang changlhah jani alan, asangan ho chunga agongtai."},"19":{"text":"Chuin amanun asohte jah-a, Kamasanga cheovin; veuvin, nanung uva kahunge, ati. Ahinla ajipa Nabal ahetsahpon ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule anahitin ahi, amanu sangan chunga atouva, lhang dunga ahungsuh laijin, veuvin, David le aloiho amanu dontah-a ahungun; amaho chu akimaitopi tai."},"21":{"text":"Tun David'in, Aneijouse imacha amanlouna dinga gamthipma kanachin tuppeh chu mohseh ahitai; aman apha chu asen eilethuh tai."},"22":{"text":"Pasal tapou ama-a kaiho jouse jingkah khovah geija kahinghoi ja ahile, akalvalin jong Pathen'in David melmate chunga bolhen, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Abigail'in David amuphatnin, sangan chunga konin kintah-in akumlhan, David masanga chun alhun, tolla aboh khupmin;"},"24":{"text":"Akhophang bula alhun, ajah-a, Kachunga, ka pakai, keima chunga hiche themona hi umhen; chule nahenga katao ahi, nasohnu hi nanakhanga thu neiseisah inlang, nasohnu thusei hi neingaipeh-in."},"25":{"text":"Nahenga katao ahi, ka pakai, hiche Belial mipa Nabal hi thupi tah-in lahih-in: ajehchu amin tobang banga ama jong hija ahin; amin Nabal ahin, ama-a ngolna um ahi. Ahinla kapun nahinsol gollhangho chu nasohnun kanamu lou ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun, kapu, Pakai hingjing le nangma hinna panna kasei ahi, Pakaiyin thisanso dinga nahung kon le nangma khut tah-a thisan phuladinga nahung kon hi atuhtang ahitan, tun namelmate le kapu dinga thilse ngaito chanchu Nabal tobang hiuhen."},"27":{"text":"Chule tun kapu henga nasohnun kahinpoh hiche phattheina hohi, kapu nung hinjui gollhangho hi kipehen."},"28":{"text":"Nahenga katao ahi, nasohnu suhkhelna ngaidamin: ijeh inem itile Pakaiyin thonlouva kapu insung hi dettah-a atundoh ding ahi; ajehchu kapun Pakai gal nasat ahin, chule nahinkho sunga hin thilse himhim akimu pon ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin nahin nungdel dingle nahinkho lamang dingin mikhat akipatdoh-in: ahinla kapu hinna hi Pakai na Pathen hinna toh kikan khom ding ahin; namelmate hinnaho vang, aman ahsongse-a kona kisepdoh banga asedoh ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin kapu-a dinga aman nangma chungchanga thilpha anaseiho jouse dungjuija ahintoh chaija, Israel chunga vaipo-a nahin pansah tengle;"},"31":{"text":"Ajeh beijin thisan naso hihen lang, kapu'n ama phu akilahna hijongle, hichu nangma dinga lungkhamna le, kapu dinga lungnatna hitalou ding ahi: ahinla Pakaiyin kapu-a dinga thilpha ahinbol tengle, nasohnu hi neihin geldoh-in, ati."},"32":{"text":"Chuin David'in, Abigail jah-a, Tunia eikimupi dinga nahinsola Israel Pakai Pathen chu nunnom hen."},"33":{"text":"Tunia thisanso dinga kahungna-a kon le, kakhut tah-a kaphu kakilah nadinga kona eihoidoh-a nangmale nathumop chu nunnom hen."},"34":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma eikimupi dinga kino loija nahung lou hile; nangma suhsetna dinga kona eituhtanga hingjing Israel Pakai Pathen min pana kasei ahi, thonlouva jingkhovah teng Nabal'a dinga pasal khatcha jong asohcha umlou helding ahi, ati."},"35":{"text":"Hitichun David'in amanun ahin pohpeh hochu akhutna konin akisanin, amanu jah-a, Na-in'a lung mongin chetan, ven na aw kangaija chule nangma kajabol nahitai, ati."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Abigail chu Nabal henga ahungin; veuvin, aman a-in'a lengpa golvah tobangin golvah anabolin; chule Nabal chu ju akham jeh-in, alungsung akipah lheh-in ahi. Hijeh chun amanun jingkhovah kahsen imacha ahilpoi."},"37":{"text":"Ahin jingkho ahungvah-in ahitin ahi, Nabal juhu atheu phatnin, a-inneipin thuho jouse chu aseipehtan ahile, alungsung athi helin, songtumto abangtan ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chuin nisom jouvin ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin Nabal chu adengin ahile athitan ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chuin David'in Nabal thithu ajah phatnin, Nabal khutna kona i-sah louva eikibolna phu eilah peh-a le asohpa thilse-a kona hoidoh-a Pakai chu nunnom hen; ajehchu Pakaiyin Nabal gitlouna chu ama luchanga achuhsahtai, ati. Chuin David'in Abigail chu ajidinga gahel dingin ahenga mi asolin ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chuin David sohte chu Carmel'a Abigail henga ahung phatnun, amanu henga, David'in ajidinga nangma puidinga nahenga eihinsolu ahi, atiuve."},"41":{"text":"Chuin amanu akipatnin, aboh khupmin amai tolla asulutnin, ven, nasohnu hi kapupa sohte keng sildingin soh-in hungpang inge, ati."},"42":{"text":"Chuin Abigail akipatdoh paijin, sangan chung khatna atouvin, anungjui nungah nga toh ahin; David thupole ho nunga achen, ajin agapang tai."},"43":{"text":"Chuin David'in Jezreel mi Ahinoam jong akipuijin; amani jong anilhonin aji ahilhontai."},"44":{"text":"Ahinla Saul'in achanu David jinu Michal chu Gallim mi Laish chapa Phalti chu apetan ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 3:14-16"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Ziph mite chu Saul henga Gibeah'a ahungun, David chu Jeshimon masanga um Hachilah lhanga kisela hilouham? atiuve.","title":"David'in Saul Avela Ahinghoi","ref":"Labu 54 (Thupi)."},"2":{"text":"Chujouvin Saul akipatnin, Ziph gamthipma David holdingin Israel pasal akilhengdoh sangthum apuijin, Ziph gamthipma achesuh tan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Jeshimon masang lampi pang Hachilah lhanga gebuh asongin ahi. Ahinla David chu gamthipma aumin, Saul'in gamthipma anung ahindel chu amun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hijeh chun Davidn'in mive lhiho asolin, Saul chu ahung monge ti ahechentai."},"5":{"text":"Chuin David akipatnin, Saul gebuh sonna-a chun ahungin ahi: chuin David'in Saul le janel gal lamkai Ner chapa Abner lupna chu aven: Saul chu leiko-a alumin, mipi chun akimvela gebuh akisonun ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin David'in adonbutnin Hit mi Ahimelech jah le Joab sopipa Zeruiah chapa Abishai jah-a, Saul henga agebuh uva keitoh lhonsuh ding koi nahiuvem? ati. Chuin Abishai'in, Keima nangtoh kalhonsuh ding ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuti chun David le Abishai chu jan-in mipi ho henga chun ahunglhonin: chuin veuvin, Saul leiko sunga analumin, alulhun koma chun atengcha tolla akiphutnin ahi: Abner le mipi vangchu akimvela alumun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hichun Abishai'in David jah-a, tunia hi Pathen'in namelmapa hi nakhutna napehdoh ahitai: hijeh chun nahenga katao ahi, tun that jeng inge, tengchan khatvei sutnin tolto kilbeh jenging kate, velni kasut louding ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin David'in Abishai jah-a, Sumang hih-in: ajehchu koiham Pathen thaonusa khat douna-a achunga akhut lha-a themmo changlouva umthei ding? ati."},"10":{"text":"David'in aseiben, Hingjing Pakai min pana kasei ahi, Pakaiyin sumang nante; ahiloule athinading anikho hunglhung nante; ahilou jongle galsatna konsuh intin, mangthah nante."},"11":{"text":"Pakai thaonu chunga kakhut kalha ding chu Pakaiyin aphalpoi; ahinla nahenga katao ahi, tun alulhun koma tengcha le atuipai chu lanlang cheta hite, ati.","ref":"1 Sam 24:6"},"12":{"text":"Chutichun David'in Saul lulhun koma tengcha le twipai chu alan, achemang lhontai; amahon hejong ahepouvin, mujong amupouvin, koimacha akhanga jong aumpoi. Pakaiya kona imutlhuhna nasatah achunguva achuh jeh chun, amaho a-ihmu cheh-un ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chujouvin David agal langkhatna agalkaijin, chule lhang chungvum khatna gamlatah-a adingin; akah uvah gam ong lentah aumin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin David'in mipi le Ner chapa Abner agah samin, ajah-a chun, Abner, nadonbut louding ham? ati. Chujouvin Abner'in adonbutnin, Lengpa hinsama nangma koi nahim? ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin David'in Abner jah-a, Nangma pasal hangsan nahi hilouham? chule Israel sunga nangma tobang koi umam? achutile napu lengpa chu ida nangatup louham? ajehchu miho lah-a khat napu lengpa thatdingin ahungin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hiche nathilbol hi aphapoi. Hingjing Pakai min pana kasei ahi, Pakai thaonu napupa nangatup loujeh-a athidinga lom nahi. Chule tun, lengpa tengcha chu hoija um hitam? chule alulhun koma um atuipai chu hoija uma hitam? ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in David aw chu ahen, Hiche hi nang aw ham? kachapa David? ati. Chuin David'in, Vo ka pakai lengpa, kei aw ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin aman ipidinga ka pakaiyin asohpa nung adel ham? ipi kabol em? ahiloule kakhutna ipi gitlouna umem?"},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun nahenga katao ahi, kapu lengpan asohpa thusei hi ngaihen. Pakaiyin keima doudinga nachothou ahile, aman thilto kisanhen; ahinla amahochu mihem chate ahiule, Pakai masanga sapset changuhen; ajehchu amahon tuni hin Pakai gouloho umna-a konin einodoh-un, pathen dangho gajenin eitiuve."},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun kathisanhi Pakai maikoh-a tolla longhihhen; ajehchu Israelte lengpa chu mikhatnin molsang ho-a vabuh adel bangin, uili khat holin ahung kondohtai, ati."},"21":{"text":"Hichun Saul'in, Keima kachonse tai: hungkile kittan, chapa David: ijeh inem itile keiman nangma kasuh gentheikit louding ahitai, ajehchu tunin kahinna hi namitmun amantan lheh-e: vetan, ngolhoi tah-in kachonin, nasatah-in, kasukheltai, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin David'in adonbutnin, Ven lengpa tengchahi gollhangho khat hung galkaihen lang hunglahen."},"23":{"text":"Pakaiyin amitakip achonphatna le akitahna alethuhjin ahi: ajehchu tunin Pakaiyin nangma kakhutna eipeluttan, hijongle keiman Pakai thaonusa chunga kakhut kalha louding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule ven, tunia nahinkho kamitmu-a manlutah ahibang hin, Pakai mitmun keima hinkho jong manlutah hihen, chule gentheina jouse-a konin eihuhdoh hen, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chujouvin Saul'in David jah-a, Kachapa David, nunnomin, nangin thil loupitah nabol ding, chule jojong najopeh ding ahi. Chutichun David achenading lampia achetan, Saul jong aumna-a akiletai."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin David'in alungthimin, Tun nikhatle Saul khutna kathi teiding ahin; Philistine te gamsunga gangtah-a ka-otdoh tailou keidinga phajo imachadang aumpoi. Chutile Saul'in Israel gamsunga eihol hi ngatantin; akhutna kona kahoidoh ding ahitai, ati.","title":"Philistine Mite Lah-a David"},"2":{"text":"Chuin David akipatnin Gath lengpa Maoch chapa Achish henga aumpi mi jagup chutoh agalkai taove."},"3":{"text":"Chuin David chu amale aloiho, chule amitakip a-insung mite jouse toh, David le ajiteni Jezreel mi Ahinoam le Carmel mi Nabal inneipi Abigail ngei chutoh Gath'a chun Achish toh acheng taove."},"4":{"text":"Chuin David Gath'a ajamtai ti Saul aseipeh-un ahile, aman aholkit tapoi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin David'in Achish jah-a, Tun namitmu-a lungsetna kachana ahile, gamsunga khopiho lah-a hin kachen nadin munkhat eipeuhen; nasohhi ibola lengkhopi sunga nangtoh kachen khom dingham? ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuphatnin Achish'in hiche nikho chun Ziklag chu apetai. Hijeh chun Ziklag chu tulai geihin Judah lengte gam ahijingtai."},"7":{"text":"Chule Philistine te gamsunga David aumna phatchu kum khat le lhali lhingset ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin David le aloiho chu akondoh-un, Geshur mite, Gezri mite, chule Amalek mite agasat taove; ajehchu hiche namhochu Shur jotna lampi-a pat Egypt gam geija masanglaija pat agama chu cheng anahi taove."},"9":{"text":"Chule David'in chuche gamchu asumangin, numei pasal khatcha ahoipon, kelngoiho leh bongchalho, sanganho leh sangongsang ho, chule ponsil ho akilah-in Achish henga ahung kiletai."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Achish'in, Tuni hoilam nagachomu ham? ati. Chuin David'in, Judah lhanglam sang, Jerahmeel mite lhanglam sang, chule Ken mite lhanglam sang, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuti chun David'in Gath henga thu hinpo ding pasal ahin, numei ahin khatcha ahinghoi jipon ahi; ajehchu aman, achuti loule ichungthu-u ahenga gahilun tin, David'in chutin abolin, Philistine gamsunga achengin phatseh-in hiti khatin achonne tiget nunte ati ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Achish'in David atahsanin, Aman ami Israelte chu akihotsah heltai; hijeh-a chu ama a-itih-a kasoh hijing ding ahitai, ati."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin hiche nikho laichun ahitin ahi, Philistine te chun Israelte toh kisatdin asepaiteu galsat dingin akhom khomun ahi. Chuin Achish'in David jah-a, Nangho le namite galsatdia keitoh ikon dohdiu ahi ti kichentah-in nahei, ati."},"2":{"text":"Chuin David'in Achish henga, Thonlouva nasohpa hin ipi kabolthei nahet ding ahi, ati. Chule Achish'in David jah-a, Hijeh-a chu a-itih-a eihongbit dinga kapansah ding nahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Tun Samuel chu athitan, Israelte jouse chun akauvin, ama khopitah Ramah-a chun avuitaove. Chule Saul'in lhakouhole doithemho gamsunga konin anodohtai.","title":"Saul'in Lhakou ho Adoh","ref":"Thmpu 20:27; Danb 18:10-11; 1 Sam 25:1."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Philistine te akichom khomun, ahungun Shunem'a gebuh ahungsong taovin ahi: chule Saul'in Israelte jouse achom khomin Gilboa'a gebuh asongun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Philistine janelho amuphatnin, akichan, alungthim akihot hot jengtan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in Pakai adoh phatnin, Pakaiyin amangin jong, Urim'in jong, themgaohon jong adonbutpon ahi.","ref":"Minb 27:21"},"7":{"text":"Chuphatnin Saul'in asohte henga, Ahenga kache-a kadoh theinadin numei lhakouthei khat neigahol peh-un, ati. Chuin asohten ajah-a, Ven, Endor'a numei lhakouthei khat aume, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in alim akhelin, vonchom akivonin, minitoh jan-in numeinu henga chun ahungtaove. Chuin aman, Nahenga katao ahi, nalha kouthei na-a chun phun neisan peh-inlang, nahenga min kasei penpen chu neihin koudoh peh-in, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin numei chun ajah-a, Ven, Saul'in lhakou ho le doithemho gamsunga kona iti adeldoh helham nangman nahei. Achutile ibola kathi nadinga, kahinkho hi thang neikam peh ham? ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Saul amanu henga Pakaiya akihahselin, Hingjing Pakai min pana kasei ahi, hiche jeh-a hi nachunga engbolna chulou ding ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuphatnin numei nun, Nahenga koi kahin puitou diham? ati. Chuin aman, Samuel neipuitou peh-in, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin amanun Samuel amuphatnin hatah-in apengin: chuin Saul jah-a, Ibola neilhep ham? ajehchu nangma Saul nahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin lengpan amanu jah-a, Kicha hih-in: nangin ipi namu em? ati. Chuin numeinu chun Saul jah-a, pathenho leisetna kona ahung kaltouvu kamui, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin aman amanu jah-a, Aman itobang mel aputnem? ati. Chuin amanun, Tehsepu khat ahungtouvin; sangkhol cholin akivone, ati. Chuin Saul'in Samuel ahi ahetan, amai tolla asulutnin akuntai."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Samuel'in Saul jah-a, Ibola puitoudinga neisuhboi ham? ati. Chuin Saul'in adonbutnin, Kalung genthei behset jenga ahi; ajehchu Philistine ten eisatnun, Pathen keija konin achemang tan, themgao ham, mang hamin jong eidonbut tapon ahi: hijeh-a chu ipi kabolding nangin neihetsah theina dinga kakou nahi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Hichun Samuel'in, Pakai nanga kona achemang henasa le namelma ahitai ti henasa-a ibola keima neidoh ham?"},"17":{"text":"Pakaiyin kakoma aseibanga abol ahitai. Ajehchu Pakaiyin lenggam chu nakhutna kona alhekeh-a, naheng nakom David ngeichu apeh ahitai.","ref":"1 Sam 15:28"},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai thusei nangaipon, chule Amalek mite chunga alunghana tijat umtah chu natongdohpoi; hijeh-a chu tunia hi hichehi Pakaiyin nachunga abol ahitai.","ref":"1 Sam 15:3-9"},"19":{"text":"Achungchona jong Pakaiyin Israel chu nangma toh Philistine te khutna apehdoh ding ahinalaije. Chule jing nikho le nangma le nachapate keitoh i-um khomdiu ahitan: chule Pakaiyin Israel janel jongchu Philistine te khutna apehdoh ding ahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuphatnin Samuel thusei jehchun Saul chu alhun tolla akijamhel jengin, akicha behseh jengtan ahi: chule ama-a chun tha himhim aum tapon ahi; ajehchu sun nilhum jankhovah-a an nelouva um ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin numeinu chu Saul henga ahungin, alunggim behseh chu amun, ajah-a, Ven, nasohnun nathu kanitnin, chule kahinkho kakhutna kakichoijin, kahenga nasei thuho chu kangaijin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun nahenga katao ahi, nangin jong nasohnu thusei ngaijin lang, na-anga changlhah kam khatbeh luipeh ingting; nachena ding lampia nache tengle tha nanei theinadin nen, ati."},"23":{"text":"Ahin ama anomhih-in, Kaneh louding ahi, ati. Ahinla asohte le numeinu akithouvin angeh teitei jengun ahile, athu angaitai. Chutichun tolla konin akipatdoh-in, jalkhun chunga atoutai."},"24":{"text":"Chule numeinu hin a-in'a bongnou thaochet khat aneijin; chuin gangtah-in athatnin, changbong alan ameh halin, chule hichea chun cholso louvin changlhah akangin;"},"25":{"text":"Chuin Saul le asohte anga ahindomin, amahon anetaove. Chuin amaho chuche janchun akipatnun, achetauve."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Philistine ten asepaiteu jouse Aphek'a akhomun, Israel ten Jezreel'a twinah phung khatna gebuh asongun ahi.","title":"Philistine Miten David Apaidoh-u"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Philistine te pakaiho chu aja ajan, chule asang asangin akitol akitol jengun; ahinla David le aloiho chu Achish toh anunung penin ahung kitolun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Philistine pipuihon, Hiche Hebrew miho hin hikoma ipi aboluham? atiuve. Chuin Achish'in Philistine pipuiho jah-a, Amahi Israel lengpa Saul sohpa, ni hijatle kum hijat kakoma um, kei koma ahung lutna pat tuni geija amona kamulou David hilouham? ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Philistine pipuiho chu achunga alunghangun, chule Philistine te chun ahenga, Hiche mipahi nangman aumna dinga napeh mun'a chu achekit theinadin kinungle sahtan, eiho toh galmuna chesuh khom hihhen, achuti loule galkisat na-a chun eiho douvin hungpang getninte. Ajehchu apu toh ipi-a kicham kit dingham? hiche mite luchanga kon hilou dingham?"},"5":{"text":"Mihon khat le khat kilhang lhah-a lam puma la asah uva, Saul'in asang asang athatnin, David'in sangsom sangja athatne, atiuchu hiche David hi hilouham? atiuve.","ref":"1 Sam 18:7; 21:11"},"6":{"text":"Chuphatnin Achish'in David akouvin, ahenga, Hingjing Pakai min pana kasei ahi, nangma nachondih jingin, chule janel lah-a keima toh nalutle napotle hi kamitmun aphalheh-e: ajehchu kahenga nahunga pat tunigei hin nachunga thilse kamupoi: hitajongle pipuihon nadeipouve."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun Philistine pipuiho nalunghansah lounadin kilenlang, lung mongin chetan, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin David'in Achish henga, Hijongle ken ipi kabol em? tuni geija nangma toh kahung um sunga hi nasoh chunga ipi namu-a, kapu lengpa melmate satdinga kache monading ipi umam? ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Achish'in adonbutnin, David jah-a, Kamitmun Pathen vantil khat bangin naphai ti kahei: achuti vangin Philistine pipuihon, Ama eiho toh galmuna chetou louhel ding ahi, ati ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun jingkah matah kho avah vahle napu sohte nahin kilhonpi hotoh thoudoh unlang che jengun, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuti chun David le amite chu kipatdoh-a Philistine gama kiledin matah-in athoutaove. Chule Philistine te chu Jezreel'a achetou taove."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, nithum ni-a David le aloiho Ziklag ahung lhunun, Amalek miten lhanggam le Ziklag ana buluvin, Ziklag kho chu anasatnun, meijin ahalun;","title":"Amalek Mite toh Kigal"},"2":{"text":"Chule asunga um numei ho chu gal hingin akaijun, alen le aneo khatcha thatlouvin akaimangun, achetauve ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hitichun David le aloiho chu khopi ahunglhung taovin, chuin veuvin, meijin ana kihal vamin; ajiteu le achapateu, chule achanuteu gal hingin anakai taove."},"4":{"text":"Chuin David le alhonpi mipi chu ka nadinga tha aneilou geijun, hakan akaptaovin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule David jiteni Jezreel mi Ahinoam le Carmel mi Nabal jinu Abigail chu gal hingin anakai taovin ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 25:42-43"},"6":{"text":"Chule David chu ahesoh lheh jengtan ahi; ajehchu amitakip achapate le achanute dinga alungkham cheh jeh-un, mipin ama songa seding agotauve. Ahinla David amatah Pakai a-Pathen'a akitil khouvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin David'in Abiathar thempu Ahimelech chapa henga, Nahenga katao ahi, thempu sangkhol chu eihin choipeh-in, ati. Chuin Abiathar'in thempu sangkhol chu David henga ahinchoi tai.","ref":"1 Sam 22:20-23"},"8":{"text":"Chuin David'in Pakai adongin, Hiche mihonpi chu kanungdel dingham? del leng kaphah jouding ham? atin ahi. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Delin: ajehchu nangman naphah teitei ding, thonlouva nahuhdoh sohding ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chutichun David le aumpi jagupho chu acheuvin, Besor vachadung ahung lhungun, ami dalhahho chu chuachun aumtaove."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla David le mipi jali chun anungdel uvin ahi; ajehchu mi jani chu alhahsam behseh jeh uva Besor vachadung galkai joulouva umdena ahitaove."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amahon gamlah-a chun Egypt mikhat amuvin, David henga ahinpuijun, changlhah apeuvin ahile aman anen; chule donding twi jong apeuvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin theichang changlhah halkhat le lengpithei gop bohni apeuvin; chuin aman aneh phatnin, atha ahungkile kittan ahi. Ajehchu nithum le janthum an nelou twi donlouhel ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Chuin David'in ajah-a, Koija nahiham? chule Hoilama kon nahim? ati. Chuin aman keima Amalek mikhat soh, Egypt gollhang kahi; kadamlou jeh-in kapun nithum masang chun eidalhatan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chereth mite lhanglam, Judah te gamsung, chule Caleb gam lhanglam kabulu uvin, chule Ziklag chu meijin kahalun ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin David'in, Hiche loiho henga chu neipuisuh theiding ham? ati. Chuin aman, Neitha louding le kapu khutna neipehdoh loudingin Pathen'a kihahsel in, chule hiche loiho henga chun puisuh nange, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin aman apuisuh phatnin, veuvin, amaho tollhanga anakithe jalun, Philistine gam le Judah gama kona thil tamtah achomdoh jeh-u chun, aneovin, adonnun, alamun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin David'in amaho chu khovah tila pat ajing nilhah lam geijin asatnin: sangongsang chunga touva hoidoh gollhang jali tilou mi khatcha asohchapon ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule David'in Amalek miten apoh mangho chu akilelah sohkeijin: David'in ajiteni jong ahuhdohtai."},"19":{"text":"Chule amahon anachomu alen ahin, aneo ahin, achanuteu ahin, achapateu ahin khatcha lhasam umlou helin David'in alelah sohkeijin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin David'in kelngoihon holeh bonghonho chu alasoh keijin, hiho chu gancha dangho masanga ahoijun, Hihohi David galthil chom ahi, atiuve."},"21":{"text":"Chuin David alhahsam behseh jeh-a David juijou louva mi jani ho heng, Besor vachadunga aumsah hou henga chun ahungin; chule amaho David le ahinlhonpi mipi ho chu lamtodin apotdoh-un ahi. Chuin David'in miho heng ahinnai phatchun, amaho chu chibai aboh-in ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hichun David kilhonpi ho lah-a migilouho le Balial miho jouse chun adonbutnun, Amaho ilah uva ahung pantha loujeh-u chun, akipuijuva ache theina ding uva ajiteu le achateu ipeh-u tailou akichom thilho jouse chu khatcha ipeh lou dingu ahi, atiuve."},"23":{"text":"Chuphatnin David'in, Kasopite ho, Pakaiyin eihoidoh uva, eiho doudinga hunga mihonpi chu ikhutnuva eipedoh uva kona eipeh-u thilho hi chutichun bolhih-un."},"24":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche thua hi kon nathu-u angai dingham? galsat dinga konpa chan jatjat chu thilchinga pangpa jong changding ahi: amaho akibang banga kihom dingu ahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chule chuche nikho-a pat tuni geihin, Israelte din chutichun houdan thupeh le chondanin achepehtai."},"26":{"text":"Chuin David Ziklag'a ahung phatnin, agalthil chomho phabep chu Judah upaho, agolho geijin athotnin, ajah uva, Veuvin, Pakai melma te-a kon galthil kichomdoh nangho dinga thilpeh ahi, atin;"},"27":{"text":"Bethel'a umho, Ramoth lhanglama umho, chule Jattir'a umho,"},"28":{"text":"Aroer'a umho, Siphmoth'a umho, chule Eshtemoa'a umho,"},"29":{"text":"Rachal'a umhole Jerahmeel mite khopiho-a umho, chule Ken mite khopi ho-a umho,"},"30":{"text":"Hormah'a umhole, Chorashan'a umho, chule Athach'a umho,"},"31":{"text":"Chule Hebron'a umhole, David amatahle aloiho umna munjouse-a henga chun athot tan ahi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Philistine ten Israelte dounan gal ahinbolun: chule Israel mitechu Philistine te masanga konin ajamun, Gilboa molsanga chun akithat chap jengun ahi.","title":"Saul le Achapate Thi"},"2":{"text":"Chule Philistine ten Saul le achapate hatah-in ajuijun; chule Philistine te chun Saul chapate Jonathan, Abinadab, chule Melchishua chu athat taovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Saul douna gal kisat chu anasa lheh jengin; thalthem ho-a konin nasatah-in amachangtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuphatnin Saul'in agalvon popa jah-a, Nachemjam satdoh inlang neisunpai jengin; achutiloule hiche cheptan louho khu hunguntin eisununtin, eijumso getnunte, ati. Ahinla agalvon popa anompoi; ajehchu kicha behseh jenga ahi. Hijeh chun Saul'in chemjam alan, achung chu abotan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin agalvon popan Saul athi amuphatnin, aman jong achemjam chu abokhumin amatoh athi thatai."},"6":{"text":"Chuti chun Saul le achapate thum, agalvon popa le amiho jouse chu chuche nichun athigam taove."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Israel mipi phaicham pang langkhatna umhole, Jordan pang langkhat lama umhon Israel mite ajama Saul le achapate athiu chu amuphatnun, khopiho adalhaovin ajamtaovin ahi. Chuin Philistine te ahungun, asunga acheng taove."},"8":{"text":"Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, Philistine te akithatho von sutdinga ahung phatnun, Saul le achapa thumho chu Gilboa molsanga alhuh chapmu amutaovin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin amaho alu atanun, agalvon asutlhaovin, amilim hounao inho le mipi ho lah-a phonjal dingin Philistine te gamsunga athot kimvel taovin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin agalvon chu Astaroth insunga akoijun: along chu Beth-shan banga akanbeh-un ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Philistine ten Saul abolnau chu Jabesh-gilead'a chenghon ajah phatnun;"},"12":{"text":"Mihangsan jouse akipatnun, jankhon acheuvin, Saul le achapate longchu Beth-shan kulbanga konin alauvin, Jabesh'a ahungun, hikoma chun ahaltaove."},"13":{"text":"Chuin aguho chu alauvin, Jabesh kho-a thingphung noi khatna avuijun, nisagi an angolun ahi."}}}}},"10":{"info":{"name":"2 Samuel","shortname":"2 Sam","abbr":[],"desc":"Samuel Lekhabu Nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Saul thinungin ahitin ahi, David'in Amalek mite athagamma ahung kinunglekit chun; David chu Ziklag'a nini ana umin;","title":"David'in Saul Thi Ahetdoh"},"2":{"text":"Ahin anithumnin ahitin ahi, hichun veuvin mikhat apon teldehduh le alua leiset nat pumin Saul gebuh-a konin ahungdoh-in; chuin ahitin ahi, ama David kom ahunglhun phatnin tolla alhun chibai aboh tan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin David'in ajah-a, Hoija kona hunga nahim? ati. Chuin aman, Israel gebuh a kona hung hoidoh kahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin David'in ajah-a, Thu iti tam? neisei peh-in, katao ahi, ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Miho galmuna konin ahung jamtaovin, chule mi tamtah jong alhun chule athitan; chule Saul le achapa Jonathan jong athitai, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin David'in gollhangpa henga, Nangman Saul le achapa Jonathan athi iti nahet ham? ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin gollhangpa chun ajah-a, Keima Gilboa molsanga kaga umkhan ahile, ven Saul chu atengcha chunga ana opmin, chule ven sakol kangtalai hole sakol chung themho chun amachu nasatah-in ahindelun ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 31:1-6; 1 Thusm 10:1-6."},"7":{"text":"Chuin aman anunglam ahin vetna ahile keima eimun, chuin eihin kouvin ahi. Chuin keiman kadonbut nin, Hikoma kaume, kati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin aman kahenga, Nang koi nahim? ati. Chuin keiman kadonbut nin, Keima Amalek mi kahi, kati."},"9":{"text":"Aman kahenga aseikitnin, Kachunga dingin lang neithatnin, ajehchu kachunga lunghemna ahunglhung tai; ajehchu kahinkhohi keima-a aum nalaijin ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun keima achunga kadingin, amachu kathat tai; ajehchu ama alhuh nunga ahinjou louding chu kahet ahitai; chule keiman alu-a um alal lukhuh le abanbul ho-a chaokolho chu kagalah-a, ka pakai nangma henga kahinpohlut ahitai, ati."},"11":{"text":"Hitichun David'in avonho abotkeh-in, hitima chun amatoh um miho jouse jong chun aboluvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin amaho chu alunghemun, akapmun, hitichun amahon Saul le achapa Jonathan ding, Pakai miho jouse ding le Israel insung miho jouse dingin nilhah geijin an angolun ahi. Ajehchu amaho chemjam'a louva ahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Chuin David'in athuseipeh gollhangpa jah-a chun, Hoilang mi nahim? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Keima gamchom mikhat chapa Amalek mi kahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin David'in ajah-a, Iti nangman Pakaiyin thao anusa khat chunga chu kichalouhela nakhut nalhah-a nasuhmang jengham? ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin David'in gollhangho lah-a khatchu akouvin ajah-a, Nailutnin lang achunga chun, ati. Chuin aman ama chu athat tai."},"16":{"text":"Chuin David'in ajah-a, Pakai thaonusa kathatne tia nakamtah-a naphon jeh-in, nangma thisan phuchu nachunga chuhen, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin David'in Saul le achapa Jonathan ka-lan akachamin;","title":"David'in Saul le Jonathan Alunghempi"},"18":{"text":"(Chuin aman Judah chate jongchu thalpi manje hilding ahi, tin thu apen, veuvin, hichehi Jasher lekhabua akisunin ahi).","ref":"Josh 10:13."},"19":{"text":"Israel loupina chu namunsangho-a akithat tai; i-atile ahat ho lhu-a hitam!"},"20":{"text":"Gath mun'a seihih-un, Ashkelon lampi dunga phongle hih-un, achuti loule Philistine te chanuho kipah uvintin; chule cheptan louho chanute jong kichoisang getnunte."},"21":{"text":"Gilbao molsang nangho, nachung uva daitwi lhahda henlang, gojong juhdahen, louhon jong aga soda hen; ajehchu mihatpa lumdal chu theng loutah-in lemangin aumin, Saul lumdal chu thao nulou bangin anaumin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Akithatpa thisana konle ahatpa thaova konin, Jonathan thalpi chu akile kitpon, chule Saul chemjam jong agoh keuvin ahung kilepon ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ahinkho sung lhonin Saul le Jonathan hi ngailut umtah le dei um pentah ahilhonin; chule athilhonin jong akikhen lhonpoi; amani muvanlai sangin amangang jolhonin, keipi bahkaiho sangin jong ahat lhonin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Nangho Israel chanute, dei umtah ponsanthipma natompao, sana-a najempao Saul dingin kapmun."},"25":{"text":"Iti ahat ho galmuna lhujenga hitam! Vo Jonathan, namun sangho chunga chun nangma nakithat tai."},"26":{"text":"Kasopipa Jonathan, nangma jeh-in kalung agenthei lheh-in ahi: Keima dingin kipa umtah chu nanahin, keima neingailutna akidangin, numei ho ngailutna sangin asangjon ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ahat ho iti lhuh-a, chule gal manchah ho iti manthah jenga hitam!"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin hiche jouchun ahitin ahi, David'in Pakai adongin, Judah khopiho khatpena chu kachetou dingham? ati. Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, Chetouvin, ati. Chuin David'in hoilama kachetou ding ham? ati. Chuin aman, Hebron, ati.","title":"Judah te Dinga David Lenga Kipansah"},"2":{"text":"Hijeh chun David chukom mun jonin ajiteni Jezreel mi Ahinoam le Karmel mi Nabal jinu Abigail toh achetou tai.","ref":"1 Sam 25:42-43"},"3":{"text":"Chule David'in aumpi amite, amitakip a-insung mite toh ahin puitouvin, chuin amaho Hebron khopiho-a chun acheng taove."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Judah miho ahungun, David chu hikoma chun Judah insung pumpi chunga leng dingin thao ahungnu taovin ahi. Chuin amahon David henga, Saul vuija pangho chu Jabesh-gilead miho ahi ti aseipeh-un ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 31:11-13"},"5":{"text":"Chuin David'in Jabesh-gilead mite henga sottol ho asollin, ahenguva, Pakaiyin phatthei naboh uhen, ijeh inem itile nanghon hitobang lungset themna chu napakai pau Saul navetsah-un, navui jun ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule tun Pakaiyin nangho-a lungset themnale thutah namusah taohen: Chule nanghon hiche thilhi nanabol jeh uva keiman jong nangho ding thilpha kabolding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun nabanthau hatdoh sah-un lang, chule hangsanun; ajehchu napakai pau Saul chu athitan; chujongle Judah insung miten achunguva leng dingin keima thao einutaovin ahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla Ner chapa Abner, Saul janel gal lamkaipa chun Saul chapa Ishbosheth chu Mahanaim'a ahinpuitan ahi.","title":"Israel Leng Dinga Ishbosheth Kipansah"},"9":{"text":"Chuin amachu Gilead Ashurim Jezreel, Ephraim chule Benjamin le Israel pumpi chunga lengin apansahtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Saul chapa Ishbosheth'in Israelte chunga vai ahomchun kum somli ahitan, chule kumni aleng changin ahi. Ahivangin Judah insung mi ten vang David ajuijun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule David Hebron khopi-a Judah insung pumpi chunga lenga apansung chu kum sagile lhagup ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Ner chapa Abner chule Saul chapa Ishbosheth soh ho chu Mahanaim'a konin Gibeon'a apotdoh-un ahi.","title":"Israel le Judah Kikah-a Kidouna"},"13":{"text":"Chule Zeruiah chapa Joab le David soh ho akondoh-un, Gibeon twikul panga akisutou vin ahi: chuin khat ho chu twikul pang langkhatna atouvun, chule khat langho chu twikul pang langkhatna atouvun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Abner'in Joab jah-a, Tun gollhangho chu kipatdoh-u henlang, imasanguva kideluhen, ati. Chuin Joab'in, Amahochu kipatdoh-u hen, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Saul chapa Ishbosheth langa konin Benjamin mi somleni akipat doh-un, chule David sohte-a konin somleni akipat doh-un ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin mikhat chehchun agolpao luchang chu atuh-un, chule aloipa pangpeh chehchu chemjamin akisunto uvin; hitichun amaho thakhatnin alhutaovin ahi. Hijeh chun hiche munchu Helkath-hazzurim asahtaove. Hichu Gibeon'a um ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho-a galkisat chu anasalheh jengin, Abner le Israel miho chu David sohte masanga agal lel taovin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule chumuna chun Zeruiah chapa thumho: Joab, Abishai chule Asahel ajaovun, chule Asahel kaljandan chu gamlah sakhipi tobang ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Asahel chun Abner nungchu adelin, chule achepumin jetle veija kihei louvin Abner nungchu ajuipeh-in ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Abner akinung heijin, Nangma Asahel nahilouham? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Kahinai, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Abner'in ajah-a, Najetlam ahiloule naveilama kiheijin lang nagollhangho khatchu manin lang, agalvon chu lahpeh-in; ati. Ahinla Asahel chun ama ajuina-a konchun akiheidoh dehpon ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Abner'in Asahel jah-a aseikitnin, Keima neijuina-a konin kiheidohtan: keiman nangma ibola hiche munahi kathading nahim? Achutile kamai chu nasopipa Joab angsunga iti kalah dingham? ati."},"23":{"text":"Ahivangin ama kiheimang ding anompon; hijeh chun Abner'in atengcha lhumkeijin amapa nahgu ngachanna noitah chu asunin ahile anunglanga apaidoh jengin ahi: chuin ama alhun, hiche munna chun athitan ahi, chuin ahitin ahi, Asahel alhuh-a athina mun hin phapa chanchu adingden jengun ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ahin Joab le Abishai chun Abner nungchu adel lhonin: chule Giah masanga um Gibeon gamthip jotna lampia um Ammah lhang ahung lhunun nisa alhumtan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Benjamin chate chu Abner nung chun akikhom khomun, chule amaho chu galsatmi honkhat akisouvin, lhang chunga adingun ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Abner'in Joab chu akouvin, ajah-a, chemjam hin a-itih-a avallhum jingding hitam? Khonung akichaina le lungjinna ahung hi ding chu nahetlou ham? Namiho chu asopihou nung adelnauva kona akinungle kitna diuva naseipehna ding phat chu itih hiding ham? ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in, Hingjing Pathen mina kasei ahi, Nangman ima na naseilou, hile thonlouva jingkah lama chu amitakipmin asopi nung adellou dingu ahitai, ati."},"28":{"text":"Hijeh chun Joab'in sumkon amutnin ahile mijouse adingden taovin; chule Israel nung chu adeltapouvin, chule satjong akisatpi tapouvin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Abner le aloiho chu hiche jan chun phaicham ajot peh-un, chule Jordan agalkaijun, Bithron pumpi achonsoh-un, Mahanaim'ah ahungtaovin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Joab chu Abner ajuina-a konin ahung kinungle kittan, miho jouse chu akhop khoma ahile, David sohte mi somleko toh Asahel chu alhasamtan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ahinla David sohte chun Benjamin mi Abner miho chu jathum le somgup athatnun ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin amahon Asahel longchu apuvin, Bethlehem'a um apa kivuina ding lhanna chun avuitaovin ahi. Chuin Joab le amite jankhon akitolun, jingkho vah-in Hebron ahunglhung taovin ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Saul insungle David insung miho kikah-a chun gal sottah aumtan ahi. Ahinla David chu ahatcheh ahatcheh-in, Saul insung chu ahatmo cheh ahatmo cheh jengtan ahi."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Hebron khopi-a David'in chapa phabep ahingin: achapa apeng masapen chu Amnon ahin, Jezreel mi Ahinoam toh ahin ahi.","title":"David Chapate"},"3":{"text":"Chule achapa ni chana chu Chileab ahin, Karmel mi Nabal inneipi Abigail hin ahi: chule athum channa chu Absalom ahin, Geshur lengpa Talmai chanu Maakah chapa ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule ali channa chu Haggith chapa Adonijah ahin, chule anga channa chu Abital chapa Shephatiah ahi:"},"5":{"text":"Chule agup channa chu Ithream ahin, David jinu Eglad hin ahi. Hichengsehi Hebron khopi-a David'in chapa ahin hochu ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Saul insung le David insung kikah-a gal aum sungchun, Abner chu amatah Saul insung miho-a dingin akisuhat nin ahi.","title":"Abner'in David Ajop"},"7":{"text":"Chule Saul'in thaikem khat aneijin, amin chu Rizpah ahin, Aiah chanu ahi. Chuin Ishbosheth'in Abner henga Ipidinga kapa thaikemnu chu naluppi ham? atin aseije."},"8":{"text":"Hichun Abner Ishbosheth thusei jehchun alunghang lheh jengtan, ajah-a, Keima hi Judah te uicha lu beh kahim? Tunin keiman napa Saul insung, asopiho heng, aloi agolho henga kitahna kamusah-in, chule David khutna jong kapedoh pon nahi; ahinla nangman numei khat chungchanga nei themosah nalai ham?"},"9":{"text":"Pathen ahenga akihahselna bang banga keiman David achunga kabol louva ahile, Pathen'in Abner chunga abolnom nom bol henlang, akalvalin jong bolhen;","ref":"1 Sam 15:28"},"10":{"text":"Lenggam chu Saul insunga kona toldoh-a, chule Israel le Judah chunga David laltouna chu Dan'a pat Beersheba geija tundohna dinga."},"11":{"text":"Chuin aman Abner chu thusei cheng khatcha adonbut theipon ahi, ajehchu aman amachu akichan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Abner'in ama thalhengin David henga sottol ho asollin, ajah-a, Gamsung hi koijapen ham? aman aseiben, Keimatoh kitepna neijin, chule ven, Israel jouse nahenga hinpuilut nadinga kakhut hi nangma to pangkhom ding ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin aman, Aphai, keiman nangma toh kitepna kaneiding ahi: ahin keiman nahenga thilkhat kangaichat aume, hichu, Keimatoh kimuto dinga nahung tengle Saul chanu Michal nahin puimasat loule kamai namu louhel ding ahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin David'in Saul chapa Ishbosheth henga sottol ho asolin, ajah-a, Philistine te chep jakhat mana kaji dinga kanahol kajinu Michal chu neipedoh-in, ati.","ref":"1 Sam 18:27"},"15":{"text":"Chuin Ishbosheth'in mi asolin, a-inneipu Laish chapa Phaltiel'a konin agapuidoh-in ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin ajipa chun kappumin amanu nungchu Bahurim geijin ahinjuijin ahi. Hichun Abner'in ama henga, Kinungletan, ati. Chuin ama akilekit tan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Abner chu Israel upaho toh akihou khomin, ahenguva, Phat chomkhat masang jepchun nanghon David chu nachung uva leng dingin nanaholun;"},"18":{"text":"Tun hichu boltaovin; ajehchu Pakaiyin David chungchanga, Kasoh David khutna kona keiman kami Israelte hi Philistinte khutna kon le amelma jouseu khutna kona kahuhdoh ding ahi, tia asei ahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Abner'in Benjamin mite henga jong aseijin ahi. Chuin Abner chu Israel le Benjamin insung pumpi-a dinga apha dinga kilomho seidingin Hebron khopi'a David henga achen ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun Abner chu Hebron khopi-a David henga mi somni toh ahungin ahi. Chuin David'in Abner le amatoh alhonpi miho-a ding chun golvah abolin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Abner'in David henga, Keima kipat in chengting, chule amahon nangma toh kitepna asemtheina dingu le, nalunggot jouse banga vai nahom theina dingin, ka pakai le ka lengpa dingin Israelte jouse gakhom khominge, ati. Hitichun David'in Abner chu asoldoh-in, ama lungnom tah-in achetan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, David sohte hole Joab chu michoma achenaova konin ahung lhungun, chule thil kichomdoh tamtah ahinpouvin ahi: ahin Abner vangchu Hebron'a David toh anaum tapon ahi; ajehchu aman ama chu asoldoh ahitan, lungmong tah-a che-a ahitai.","title":"Abner Kitha"},"23":{"text":"Chuin Joab le aumpi mipi janel chu ahung phatnun, amahon Joab henga, Ner chapa Abner chu lengpa henga ahungin, chuin aman amachu asolmangin, chule ama lungmong tah-in achetai, atiuve."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Joab chu lengpa henga ahungin, ajah-a, Nangma ipi bol nahi hitam? Ven, Abner nahenga ahungin; ipidinga amachu nalesol kitna, chule ama chemanga hitam?"},"25":{"text":"Ner chapa Abner chu nalhemlha dinga, nahunglut napotdoh heding le, nabol jouse hedinga hunga ahichu nangman nahenai, ati."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Joab chu David koma kona ahung potdoh nungin, Abner nunga chun sottol ho asolin, chuin amahon amachu Sirah twikul'a konin ahinlepui kitnun ahi; ahinla hichu David'in ahepon ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Abner chu Hebron'a ahung kilekit phatnin, kotpi phunga chun Joab'in atumbeh-a kihou pidin apuijin, chuin asopipa Asahel thisan phulahnan, anahgu nga channa noitah chu asutna ahile, athitan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin chomkhat jouvin David'in hichu ajahdoh phatnin, hitin aseitai, Ner chapa Abner thisan chungchanga hin keima le kalenggam hi Pakai angsunga a-itih-in themona kaneipouve,"},"29":{"text":"Hichehi Joab chung le apate insung jouse luchunga lhungjohen; chule Joab insunga konin thisan longa damlou, aphah, tenggola kingai, chemjam'a louva, ahiloule changlhah lhahsam ma kichat hihhen, ati."},"30":{"text":"Hitichun Joab le asopipa Abishai chun sopipalhon Asahel chu Gibeon galmuna anatha jehchun Abner chu athat lhontan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin David'in Joab le ama umpi miho jouse henga chun, Naponhou jouse botkeh-unlang, nataiju chu khaodip ponin kigah-un, chule Abner masanga chun lunghemun, ati. Chule David amatah-in mithi kong chu ajuitan ahi.","title":"Abner Kivui"},"32":{"text":"Chuin amahon Abner chu Hebron'a avui taovin: chuin lengpa awsang tah-in Abner lhanna chun akaptan, chule mipi jouse jong akaptan ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Abner chu akachamin, hitin ati, Abner hi mingol thia thiding hitam?"},"34":{"text":"Nakhut teni la akikanpon, nakeng teni jongla akisom poi; miphalouho anga mihem khat alhuh jeng bangin, nangma nalhu jengtan ahi, ati. Chuin mipi chu ama chunga akapkit taovin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chule sun ahipetna an nehsah ding mipi chu David henga ahung phatnun, David akihahselin, Nisalhum kah-a keiman changlhah le thildang katepma ahile, Pathen'in kachunga hitihin bolhen lang akhoh cheh-in jong eibolhen, ati."},"36":{"text":"Chuin mipi ho chun ahethemun, alunglhai taove; lengpan bol jouse-a chu mipi ho lunglhaija ahiuve."},"37":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche nikho-a chu mijousele Israelte chun Ner chapa Abner kitha chu lengpa lunglam ahilou chu ahetnu ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chuin lengpan asohte henga, Tunia hi Israel sunga pipui le milen khat lhuh-a ahi ti helou nahiuvem?"},"39":{"text":"Chule keima lengdinga thao kinu kahi jeng vangin, tuni hin katha alhasam lheh-in ahi; chule hiche miho Zeruiah chapate hi keima dingin akhoh behseh jengun ahi. Pakaiyin thilphalou bolhohi aphatlounao natoh dungjuija alethuh dingu ahi, ati."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Saul chapan Hebron'a Abner athi tai ti ajah phatnin, akhut teni angoilhan, chule Israel pumpi jouse alunggim taovin ahi.","title":"Ishbosheth Kitha"},"2":{"text":"Chule Saul chapan loilah-a gal lamkai mini aneijin: khatpa minchu Baanah ahin, chule khatjopa minchu Rechab ahi, Benjamin phunga Beeroth mi Rimon chapateni ahilhone, (ajehchu Beeroth jonghi Benjamin'a kisim ahi;"},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu Beeroth miho chu Gittaim'a jamlut uva, chule hiche munna chun tunikho geija khopemden ahitaove)."},"4":{"text":"Chule Saul chapa Jonathan'in chapa khat aneijin amachu akengbai ahi. Jezreel'a kona Saul le Jonathan chungchang thu ahungchun amachu kumnga ahitan, ama jenlea pangnu chun amachu apuija ajampi ahi. Chule hitihi hija ahi, amanun mangang tah-a ajampi laitah-a amapa kiseplhu-a, akeng kibai ahi. Chule amapa minchu Mephibosheth ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 9:2."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Beeroth mipa Rimmon chapateni Rekab le Baanah chu akipat lhonin, hiche sun nisa noija chun Ishbosheth in'a ahung lhonin, amapa chu suna alupna-a ana lumin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin amani suhlou chang hamding bangin insunga alutlhonin; amapa nahgu nga channa noitah chu asun lhonin: chuin Recab le asopipa Baanah chu ajamdoh lhontan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu amani insunga ahunglut lhonchun, amapa alupna dansung alupna-a analumin ahi, chuin amanin amachu avo lhonin, athat lhonin, alu atan lhonin, chule alu chu ahinchoi lhonin jankhovah-a phaicham lampia chun ahin jampi lhonin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin amanin Ishbosheth luchang chu Hebron'a David henga ahinpo lhonin, lengpa henga, Ven, nahinkho lahdinga gopa namelmapa Saul chapa Ishbosheth luchang ahi; ka pakai le ka-lengpa dinga hi tunia Pakaiyin Saul le achilhahte chunga phu nalahpeh ahitai, atilhone."},"9":{"text":"Chuin David'in Beeroth mi Rimmon chapateni Recab le asopipa Baanah chu adonbutnin, ajah lhona, Kaki lungdoupi ho-a kona kahinna huhdohpa, hingjing Pakai mina kasei ahi,"},"10":{"text":"Mikhatnin kahenga kipana thupha hinlhut dana akingaitoa, Ven, Saul chu athitai atichun; athupoh jeh-a kipaman kapeh dinga kinempa chu keiman kamanin, Ziklag'ah kathat tan ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 1:1-16"},"11":{"text":"Achutile migilou hon michonpha khat a-insunga alupna chunga atha chungchanga hi ichana khohcheh-a kibolding hitam? Tu-a hi keiman amapa thisan hi nakhut lhona kangeh-a, leisetna kona kasuhmang lhonlou dingham? ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin David'in agolhangho chu thu apen ahile, amahon amani chu athatnun, akhutlhon le akenglhon atanbongun, Hebron'a um twikul chung khatna akhai taovin ahi. Ahin amahon Ishbosheth luchang chu alauvin, Hebron mun'a um Abner lhanna chun avuitaove."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Israel phung jouse Hebron'a David henga ahungun, ahenga, Ven keihohi nagu le naphe jeng kahiuve.","title":"David Israel le Judah Chunga Lenga Apan (1 Thusm 11:1-9 ; 14:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Chule masanga Saul keiho chunga lenga anapan laija patna, Israel gamsunga keiho eipuidoh uva le eipuilut uva nahi; chule Pakaiyin nahenga, Ka kelngoi Israelte hi navah ding, chule nangma Israelte chunga gallamkai nahi ding ahi, tin aseijin ahi, atiuve."},"3":{"text":"Hitichun Israel upaho jouse chu Hebron'a lengpa henga ahungun: chule David lengpan Hebron'a Pakai angsunga amatoh kitepna khat aneipin: chuin amahon David chu Israel pumpi chunga leng dingin thao anu taovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"David alengchan kipatchun ama kum somthum ahitan, chule kum somli aleng changin ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 2:11; 1 Thusm 3:4; 29:27"},"5":{"text":"Hebron'a Judah te chunga kum sagile lhagup aleng changin, chule Jerusalem'a chun kum somthum le kumthum Israel le Judah chunga aleng changin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin lengpa le amite chu chuche gama um Jebus mite chenna Jerusalem'a chun acheuvin; amaho chun David henga, Mitcho le elbai nalahdoh masat loule hichea hi nahunglut theilou diu ahi, atiuvin ahi; ajehchu amahon David chu khopi sunga hin hunglut jou ponte, tia anagelu ahi.","ref":"Josh 15:63; Thutn 1:21."},"7":{"text":"Ahijeng vanginla David'in Zion mundet pen chu alatan: hichu David khopi ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Chuin hiche nikho chun David'in, Koi hijongle twilama kaltouva, Jebus miho le, David hinna-in adou mitcho le elbai ho gathat penpenpa chu lamkai pipuile gal lamkai hiding ahi, ati. Hijeh-a chu amahon, Mitcho le elbai insunga hunglut theilou ding ahi, atiu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hitichun David kulpi sunga chun achengin, chule hichu David khopi asahtai. Chuin David'in Millo'a pat asunglamsea chun kul akaikhum tan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin David chu ahung khangtou chehcheh in, janel Pakai Pathen'in aumpin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Tyre lengpa Hiram'in David henga sottol ho, chule cedar thingho, thingthem bolhole, song kheng themho ahinsolin ahi: chule amahon David dingin in asahpeh uvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin David chun Pakaiyin Israelte chunga lengdinga atundoh ahichu ahetan; chule alenggam jong chu ami Israelte jal-in achoi lheh jengtan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin ama Hebron'a kona ahungdoh jouchun, David'in Jerusalem'a konin aji dingle athaikem akipuiben: chule David'a dingin chapate le chanute apenbe nalaijun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule hichengsehi Jerusalem'a aumsunga pengho achate minchu ahi, Shammuah, Shobab, Nathan le Solomon,"},"15":{"text":"Chule Ibhar, Elishua, Napheg le Japhia,"},"16":{"text":"Elishama, Eliada, chule Eliphalet ahiuvin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahin Philistine ten David chu Israelte chunga leng dingin thao anutaove ti ajah phatnun, Philistinte jouse chu David holding chun ahung taovin; chule David'in hichu ajan, kulpidet lamma chun achesuhtan ahi.","title":"Philistine te Chunga Galjo (1 Thusm 14:8-17)"},"18":{"text":"Philistinte jong chu ahungun Rephaim phaichama chun akithecheh taovin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin David'in Pakai adongin, Keima Philistinte dou dinga kachetou dingham? Nangman amaho kakhutna neipeh doh dingham? ati. Chuin Pakaiyin David henga, Chetouvin; ijeh inem itile keiman tahsanlelna beihela Philistinte chu nakhutna kapeh dohding ahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin David chu Baal-perazima ahungin, chule David'in hilaija chun amaho chu ajouvin, chuin aman, Pakaiyin kamelmate chu kamasanga twi kiphijah bangin asukeh jengtan ahi, ati. Hijeh chun aman hiche munchu Baal-perazim asahtai."},"21":{"text":"Chuin amahon hia chun amilimhou chu adalha taovin ahile, David le aloihon ahalha taovin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Philistine ho chu ahung kontou kitnun, chule amaho Rephaim phaichama chun akithecheh-un ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hijeh chun David'in Pakai adongin ahile, aman, Nangma nakontou louding ahi; amavang nangman amaho nunglama kona nahin velkola, thingtheimi phungho maidon tah-a chu achunguva nachuh ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, nangman thingtheimi phungho chunga mipi kitol gin najah tengle, malam nanoding ahi; ijeh inem itile hiche phat chule Pakai chu Philistine janelho thatgam dinga namasanga cheding ahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin David'in jong Pakaiyin athupeh bangchun aboltan; hitichun aman Philistinte chu Geba'a pat Gezer geijin athat tan ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin David'in Israel mi akilhengdoh sangthum hochu akhom khomin ahi.","title":"Jerusalem'a Kitepna Thingkhong Kipohlut (1 Thusm 13:1-14 ; 15:25—16:43)"},"2":{"text":"Hichun David akipatdoh-in, aumpi jouse toh Juda gam Baale'a konin, Cherubim teni kikah-a um janel ho Pakai minna kikou, Pakai thingkhong chu gapotou dingin ache taovin ahi.","ref":"Pot 25:22"},"3":{"text":"Chuin amahon Pathen thingkhong chu bongkang thah khat chunga akoijun, Gibeah kho-a cheng Abinadab in'a konchun ahin podoh taovin ahi. Hitichun Abinadab chapateni Uzzah le Ahio chun hiche bongkang thah chu ahintol lhonin ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 7:1-2"},"4":{"text":"Chule amahon Pathen thingkhong chu Gibeah kho-a Abinadab in'a konin ahinpodoh-un; Pathen thingkhong chutoh ahung kilhonpeh-un, chule Ahio chu Pathen thingkhong masanga chun achen ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin David le Israel insung mijouse chun Pakai masanga chun chahthinga kisem manchah jatchom chomho, selangdah, tumgingtheiho jouse, khongchaho, sumkon bineiho, chule thih khutbeh ho atum gingun ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin amaho Nacon pholmun ahunglhun phatnun, Uzzah chun Pathen thingkhong lama chun akhut ajahdoh-in, atuh-in ahi: ajehchu bongchal teni chun hichu athin lhon ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Pakai lunghanna chu Uzzah chunga ahung koujah jengin; chuin Pathen'in athemona jeh-in hikoma chun ajepmin; chule ama Pakai Pathen thingkhong koma chun athitan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakai Uzzah chunga achuh jehchun David alung nommo lheh jengtan; hiche mun chu Perezuzzah asah-in, tunigeijin akisah tan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin hicheni chun David'in Pakai akichan, Pakai thingkhong chu kahenga iti hung thei dingham? ati."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun David'in Pakai thingkhong chu ahenga David khopi sunga pohlut ding anomtapon; ahinla David'in hichu Gitt mi Obed-edom insunga chun apolut tan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thingkhong chu Gitt mi Obed-edom in'a chun lhathum aumin; chuin Pakaiyin Obed-edom le a-insung pumpi chu phatthei aboh tan ahi.","ref":"1 Thusm 26:4-5"},"12":{"text":"Chuin David lengpa jah-a, Pathen thingkhong jal-in Obed-edom le a-insung pumpi le anei agou jouse phatthei achang tai, ti akiseipeh tan ahi. Hijeh chun David achen, Pathen thingkhong chu Obed-edom in'a konin kipah tah-in David khopi-a ahin potou tan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin anahitin ahi, Pakai thingkhong puhon kalgup ason jouvun, aman bongchal le gan kivahthaova ganlhainan abolin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin David chu Pakai angsunga chun athanei chasunin alamin; chule David chun tupat ponnem thempu sangkhola atai akigah ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun David le Israel insung miho jouse chun aw thongjeju le sumkon ginto thon Pakai thingkhong chu ahin putouvun ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Pakai thingkhong chu David khopi sunga ahung lhunto lhonin, Saul chanu Michal'in bangkotna konin ahinven ahile, David lengpa Pakai masanga akhut alea alam chu amutan; amanun alungthimin amuneo lheh-in ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin amahon Pakai thingkhong chu ahinpolut nun, aumna dinga David'in anasah ponbuh lailung tah-a chun akoitaovin ahi. Chuin David'in Pakai anga govam thilto le chamna thilto abolin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin David'in athilto, govam thilto le chamna thiltoho achai phatnin, aman mipi hochu Pakai janel minin phatthei aboh tan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin David'in mijouse le Israel mite jouse chu, anumei apasal'in changlhah lum khatcheh le sachan khatcheh, chule lengpitheija kisem changlhah khatcheh ahoppeh'in ahi. Hitichun mijouse chu a-inlam cheh uva achetauvin ahi.","ref":"1 Thusm 16:43"},"20":{"text":"Chuin David chu a-insung miho phatthei bohdingin ahung kiletan ahi. Chuin Saul chanu Michal chu David kimupi dingin ahungdoh-in, ahenga, Tunia Israelte lengpa pannabei mijahmo tah khat asagoh-a aum banga, tunia asoh numei ho mitmu-a asagoh-a aum jengchu iti loupi hitam! ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin David'in Michal jah-a, Pakai mite Israelte chunga vaihom dinga eitungdohpa, napa le a-insung miho jouse khella eilhengdoh pa Pakai masang ahi; hijeh achu Pakai masanga lamding kahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule hiche sunga kamelse cheh ding, chule kamitmu-a kakisuhnem ding ahi. Nangman nasei soh numei ho chungchanga vang, keima amaho jabola kaum ding ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Hijeh chun Saul chanu Michal chun athini geijin cha aneitapon ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, lengpa insunga atouva, Pakaiyin akimvela amelmaho-a konin choldona apeh phatnin,","title":"David Henga Nathan Thuthot (1 Thusm 17:1-15)"},"2":{"text":"Chutichun lengpan themgao Nathan henga, Tun vetemin, keima Cedar in'a kachengin, ahin Pathen thingkhong chu ponbuh maimai sunga aumin ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Nathan'in lengpa henga, Chenlang nalunga umjouse chu gaboltan, ajehchu Pakaiyin na-umpinai, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin chuche janchun ahitin ahi, Pakai thu chu Nathan henga ahungin, hitin ati,"},"5":{"text":"Chenlang kasoh David jah-a, Nangman keima dinga kachenna ding in khat neisahpeh dingham?"},"6":{"text":"Keiman Israel chate Egypt gama kona kahin puidoh ni-a pat tuni geijin in'a kachengpon, amavang ponbuh sungle houbuh sungabou kachen ahi."},"7":{"text":"Keima Israel chateto kana valena mun jouse-a, kami Israelte vahdinga kathupeh Israel phungho henga thu kanaseija, ahenguva, Ipi dinga nanghon keima dinga Cedar thinga in khat neisahpeh louvu ham tia kanasei khah-em?"},"8":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu tuahi nangman kasoh David henga hitia hi nasei ding ahi, Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Keiman nangmahi kelngoi lhatna hamhing lah-a kelngoi najuina-a kona kamite Israelte chunga vaihom dinga kalhendoh nahi:"},"9":{"text":"Chule keiman nachena chana kalhonpin, namitmu-a konin namelmate jouse kasumangin, leiset chunga miminthang ho minkhat bangin namin kathansah tan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hiche chungvuma chu keiman kami Israelte dinga chu munkhat kalhendoh pehding, chule amaho agam mong monguva achenuva, akichon lele tahlou nadinguva kaphudet dingu; chule masanga banga migilou chaten jong asuhgenthei tahloudiu;"},"11":{"text":"Kami Israelte chunga dinga thutan ho kana thupeh laija patna ana chutiu ahin; chule namelmate jouse-a konin kakicholdo sahtan ahi. Chujongle Pakaiyin nahenga na-insung katundoh pehding nahi ati."},"12":{"text":"Chule nahin nikhoho ahunglhina, nangma napu napate toh nalupkhom tengle, keiman nanunga nachilhah, nangma taijola mong monga peng khat katundoh ding, Chule keiman alenggam kaphudet ding ahi.","ref":"Labu 89:3-4; 132:11; Jhn 7:42; Sol 2:30"},"13":{"text":"Ama chun kamina in khat asah ding, chule keiman alenggam chu atonsotna dinga kaphudet ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Keima apa kahi ding, chule ama kachapa hiding ahi. Aman khangit louna aneija ahile keiman amachu mihem sehgimna tenggol le mihem chate kajepna-a chu kasehgim ding ahi.","ref":"Labu 89:26-27; 2 Thusm 6:18; Heb 1:5"},"15":{"text":"Amavang namasanga kona kachondoh Saul'a kona kalahmang banga, kami hepina chu ama-a kona kalahmang louding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule na-insung le nalenggam chu a-itih a dinga namasanga kiphutdet ding; na laltouna jong a-itih-a dinga kiphutdet ding ahi, tin gaseipeh-in ati.","ref":"Labu 89:36-37"},"17":{"text":"Hicheng thuho dungjui le hiche gaothilmu ho dungjui hin Nathan'in David chu aseipeh tan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin David lengpa chu alutnin, Pakai masanga atouvin, hitin aseije, Vo Pakai Pathen, keima koi kahi ham? chule ka-in chu ipiham hija nangman hichan geija neipuiham?","title":"David Thangvahna Taona (1 Thusm 17:16-27)"},"19":{"text":"Chule vo Pakai Pathen, hichehi nangma dinga thil neocha bou ahinalaijin; chule nangman khonungpeh-a nasoh insunga hunglhung ding jong naseijin ahi. Chule Vo Pakai Pathen, hichehi mihem chonna dan ngaimong hinam?"},"20":{"text":"Chule David'in nahenga ipi aseibe dingham? Ajehchu Pakai Pathen nangin nasoh hi nahenai."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu nathu jal le nangmatah lung ngaito dungjuija, hiche thil loupitahhi nasoh-in ahetthei nadinga nabol ahitai."},"22":{"text":"Hijeh chun vo Pakai Pathen, nangma naloupin ahi: ajehchu keihon kanaova kajah dungjuijun nangma tobang aumpon, nangma tailou Pathen dang aumpoi."},"23":{"text":"Chule leiset chunga hi nami Israelte tobanga namkhat Pathen'in nangma-a hidinga Egypt gama kon, namtin le a-pathen hou lah-a kona, namite hiding le namin loupi sah ding, chule nangma dinga thil loupitahho le nagama dinga tijat umtahho boldinga nalhatdoh umkham?","ref":"Danb 4:34"},"24":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma tah-in nami Israelte hi a-itih-a namite hidinga nanamdet ahitan: chule Pakai, nangma a-Pathen'u nahung hitai."},"25":{"text":"Chule tun, vo Pakai Pathen, nasoh chungchang le a-insung chung chang thua nasei thuhi a-itih a dingin phutdet ninlang, naseibang chun boltan."},"26":{"text":"Chule Janel Pakai hi Israelte Pathen ahi tin namin hi a-imatih chanin choisangin umhen lang: chule nasoh David insung hi namasanga kiphutdet hen."},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma Vo janel Pakai le Israel Pathen'in nasoh henga naphong doh-in, Keiman na-insung katundoh ding ahi tin naseije. Hijeh-a chu nasoh hin hiche taona neina dinga hi alungsunga hansana amu ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule tun, vo Pakai Pathen, nangma Pathen nahin, chule nathu hohi thutah ahin, chule nangman hiche phatna hi nasoh henga nahahsel in ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun a-itih-a namasanga aumjing nadin, nasoh insung phatthei naboh dinghi nalung lhaina hihen:ajehchu vo Pakai Pathen, nangman hichehi nasei ahitai; chule nangma phatthei bohna-a chun, nasoh insunghi a-itih-in phatthei changjing tahen."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin hiche jouchun ahitin ahi, David'in a Philistinte chu asatnin, amaho chu asunemin ahi. Chuin David'in Metheg-ammah chu Philistinte khutna konin aladohtan ahi.","title":"David Galjonaho (1 Thusm 18:1-17)"},"2":{"text":"Chule aman Moab asatnin, chule amahochu tolla alupsah-in, khaovin aten; thading ho chu golni in aten, chule hinghoi dingho chu golkhat lhingsetnin aten ahi. Chutichun Moab mite chu David soh-in ahung pangun, thilpeh ahinchoi jiuvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin David Euphrate luidunga agamgi lelah dinga achea chun, aman Zobah lengpa Rehob chapa Hadadezer jong chu athatnin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin David'in amapa-a konchun sakol kangtalai sangkhat le sakol sepai jasagi, chule keng sepai sangsomni ahinlan ahi. Chuin David'in sakol kangkai jouse chu asubaijin, ahinla sakol kangtalai jakhat kaiding vang akhendoh-in ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Damascus'a Syria mite chu Zobah lengpa Hadadezer kithopi dingin ahungun ahile, David'in Syria mite chu sangsomni le sangni athatnin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin David'in Syria'a um Damascus'a chun sepai tampi akoitan ahi. Chuin Syria mite chu David soh-in ahung pangun, thilpeh ahinchoi jiuvin ahi. Chule Pakaiyin David chu achenna jouse-ah aveng jingin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin David'in Hadadezer sohpa khutna um sana lumdal chu alan, Jerusalem'a ahin polut tan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Hadadezer khopi Betah le Berothai'a konin, David lengpan sum-eng tamtah ahinpon ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hamath lengpa Toi'in David lengpan Hadadezer janel jouse athattai ti ajah phatnin,"},"10":{"text":"Hichun aman Hadadezer asatna ajo jehchun, Toi'in ama chibai bohding le phatthei bohdingin achapa Joram chu David henga ahinsolin ahi; ajehchu Hadadezer chu Toi toh anakigal jinga ahi. Chule Joram'in dangka, sana, chule sum-eng kong le belho ahinpon:"},"11":{"text":"Hicheho chengse chu David'in asuhnem namtin jouse-a kona alah dangka le sana jouse chutoh Pakai henga atohdoh-in ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hicheho chu Syria'a kon, Moab'a kon, Ammon chate'a kon, Philistinete-a kon, Amalek'a kon, Zobah lengpa Rehob chapa Hadadezera'a kon galthil kichomho ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin David'in chi phaicham mun'a Syria mite sangsom le sangget atha-a ahung kinunglekit chun amin athang tan ahi.","ref":"Labu 60 (athupi)."},"14":{"text":"Chuin aman Edom'a sepai tampi akoijin, Edom gamsung jouse chun sepai akoisoh keijin, chuin Edom mite jouse David sohte ahung hitaovin ahi. Chule David chu Pakaiyin achena jouse-a avengbit jingin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin David'in Israel pumpi chunga vai ahomin; chule David'in amite jouse chunga chun phatah le dihtah-in na atongin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Zeruiah chapa Joab chun janel chunga vaipo ahin; chule Ahilud chapa Jehoshaphat chu thuching ahin;"},"17":{"text":"Ahitub chapa Zadok le Abiathar chapa Ahimelech chu thempu ahilhonin; chule Seraiah chu danthu sun ahin;"},"18":{"text":"Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chu Chereth mite le Peleth mite chunga vaihomin apangin; chule David chapate chu vaihom pipun apangun ahi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin David'in, Jonathan khohsahna jala hepina kamusah ding Saul insungmi khatbeh akikhendoh umlou ham? ati.","title":"David le Mephibosheth","ref":"1 Sam 20:15-17."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Ziba kiti Saul insungmi lah-a soh khat aumin ahi. Chuin amahon amachu David henga akouvun, chuin lengpan ajah-a, Nangma Ziba nahim? ati. Chuin aman, Nasohhi amachu kahinai, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin lengpan ajah-a, Achunga Pathen mihepina kamusah ding Saul insungmi khatbeh umlou ham? ati. Chuin Ziba'in lengpa henga, Jonathan chapa khat aumin, amachu kengbai ahi, ati.","ref":"2 Sam 4:4."},"4":{"text":"Chuin lengpan ajah-a, Amachu hoilaija umam? ati. Chuin Ziba'in lengpa henga, Ven amachu Lodebar kho-a um Ammiel chapa Machir in'a aumin ahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin David lengpan mi asolin, Lodebar kho-a um Ammiel chapa Machir in'a konchun agapuidoh tan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tun Saul chapa, Jonathan chapa Mephibosheth chu David kom ahunglhun phatnin, ama aboh khupmin jana apen ahi. Chuin David'in, Mephibosheth, ati. Chuin aman, ven nasohhi! tin adonbutnin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin David'in ajah-a, Kicha hih-in: ajehchu keiman thonlouva napa Jonathan khohsahna jala nangma hepina kamusah ding, chule napu Saul gam sese jong kalepeh kitna, nangma tanglou hela kadokhang chunga changlhah naneh jing ding ahitai, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin ama akunin, Nasohhi ipi kahia, chule uicha thisa tobang keimahi nei khohsah ham? ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Saul sohpa Ziba chu akouvin, ajah-a, Saul neijouse le a-in jouse napakai pa chapahi kapeh ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nangma le nachapate, chule nasohten amadinga leiset chu nalhopeh diu, chule napakai pau hin nehding an aneitheina dinga agasoh hochu nahin pohdiu ahi: ahin napakai pao chapa Mephibosheth hin phattina kadokhanga changlhah anehding ahi, ati. Tun Ziba'n chapa somle ngale soh somni aneijin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hichun Ziba'n lengpa jah-a, Ka pakai lengpan asoh athupeh dungjuija hi nasoh-in kabol ding ahi, ati. Mephibosheth chungchanga, lengpan hitin ati, aman kadokhang chunga chapateho khat banga an anehding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule Mephibosheth'in chapa khangdong khat aneijin, amin chu Mica ahi. Chule Ziba insunga cheng jouse chu Mephibosheth soh ahi taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hitichun Mephibosheth chu Jerusalem'a achengin ahi: ajehchu aman tanglou helin lengpa dokhanga anen; chule ama akeng ni-a baija ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin hiche jouchun ahitin ahi, Ammon chateho lengpa chu athitan ahile achapa Hanun chun ama khelin lengvai apotan ahi.","title":"David'in Ammon Mite le Syria Mite Ajo (1 Thusm 19:1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin David'in, Apan kachunga hepina eimusah banga, keima jong Nahash chapa Hanun chunga hepina kamusah ding ahi, ati. Hitichun David'in apa chungchanga ama lhamon ding chun asohte asoltan ahi. Chuin David soh ho chu Ammon chate gama chun ahunglut taovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule Ammon chate pipuho chun apakaipao Hanun jah-a, David hin napa ajana jala lhamonsah hohi ahinsol ahi hinte tia nagelem? David hin khopi hi ajotheina dinga akholtoh dingle, avelhi ding joh-a ahinsol hilou ham? atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Hijeh chun Hanun'in David soh ho chu amanin, akhamulu akeh langkhat avolhahpeh-in, chule aponchenu chu akimlaitah, ato don laitah-u chu achetanpeh-in; chuin amahochu asolmang tan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin hichehi David aseipeh phatnun, aman amaho kimupi ding asolin ahi, ajehchu miho chu jahcha lheh jengu ahi: chuin lengpan, Nakhamulu asaodohkit kahsen Jericho-a umunlang, ahung saodoh tengle hung kinunglekit taovin, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Ammon chaten David angsung kidah umtah ahiu amudoh phatnun, Ammon chate chun Bethrehob'a um Syria mite, Zobah'a um Syria mite keng sepai sangsomni, Maakah lengpa-a kon mi sangkhat, chule Ishtob'a kon mi sangsom le sangni athalah-un ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin David'in hichu ajah phatnin, Joab le amihat janelho chu asoltan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Ammon chate chu ahung kondoh-un, kotpi phung lutna-a chun galsat dingin akigolun: Zobah'a um,Rehob'a um, Ishtob'a um le Maakah'a um Syria mite chu amaho le amaho loujaova aumun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Joab'in galchu anung le ama-a aum amu phatnin, Israel mi lhentum cheh chu alhengdoh-in, amaho chu Syria te toh kisat dingin akigolsah-in:"},"10":{"text":"Chule adangho sese chu asopipa Abishai khutna Ammon chate toh kisat dinga agoltoh dingin apedoh-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin aman, Syria te chu keija dinga ahat behseh uva ahile, nangman neikithopi ding; ahia Ammon chate chu nanga dinga ahat behseh uva ahile, keima kahunga kahung kithopi ding nahi."},"12":{"text":"Hangsanun, eiho imiteu dingleh i-Pathen'u khopiho-a dingin pangu hite: chule Pakaiyin amitmu-a pha asah bang bangin bolhen, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Joab le aumpi miho chu Syria mite to kisat dingin galmun anailut taovin ahile, amaho chu amasanga chun ajam taovin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Ammon chate chun Syria mite jam chu amu phatnun, amaho jong Abishai masanga chun ajamun, khopi sungah aluttaovin ahi. Hitichun Joab chu Ammon chate-a konchun ahung kinunglen, Jerusalem'a ahungtan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Syria miten Israelte masanga agal lel'u chu amuphatnun, amaho akikhom khom taovin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Hadadezer'in mi asolin, luipi galla um Syria mite chu agapuidoh-in ahi. Chuin amaho Helam'a ahungun, chule Hadadezer janel gal lamkai Shobach chu amaho masanga achen ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule hichethu hi David aseipeh phatnun, aman Israelte jouse akhom khomin, Jordan agalkaijun, Helam mun'a ahungun ahi. Chuin Syria mite chu David doudingin amaho le amaho akigol toh-un, ama chutoh akisat taovin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Syriaho chu Israel masanga chun ajam taovin; chule David'in Syria miho sakol kangtalai tolmi jasagi le sakol sepai sangsomli, chule ajanelhou lamkai Shobach jong chu athatnin, hiche mun'a chun athitan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Hadadezer soh-a um lengho jouse chun Israelte masanga agal lel'u chu amu phatnun, Israelte toh chamna abollun, amaho jenle-in apang taovin ahi. Hijeh chun Syria miten Ammon chateho kithopi kit ding chu akicha taovin ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, kum ahung kichaina, lengho galkon phat laitah-in, David'in Joab le aumkhompi asote chule Israel mite chu asolin; chuin amahon Ammon chate asumangun, Rabbah khopi aum uvin ahi. Ahinla David Jerusalem'a aum jingin ahi.","title":"David le Bethsheba","ref":"1 Thusm 20:1."},"2":{"text":"Chuin nilhah langin ahitin ahi, David chu alupna-a konin athoudoh-in, leng in chunga chun avahle len ahi. Chuin aman in chunga konchun numei khat akisilpet amun, chule hiche numeinu chu vetdinga melhoitah ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin David'in mi asolin amanu thudol agakholchil sah-in ahi. Chuin mikhatnin, Hichehi Hit mi Uriah inneipi Eliam chanu Bathsheba hilouham? ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin David'in thupole ho khat asolin, amanu agapuisah tan; chule amanu ahenga ahungin, aman amanu aluppitan ahi; ajehchu amanu chu athen louna-a kona kisuthenga ahin: chuin amanu a-in lama akile kittan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin amanun nao avop phatnin, David henga mi asolin, Nao kavoptai, agati sah-e."},"6":{"text":"Chuin David'in Joab thu athotnin, Hit mi Uriah chu neihin solpeh-in, ati. Chuin Joab'in Uriah chu David henga ahin soltan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Uriah ahenga ahung phatnin, David'in Joab le mipite chu iti naovem, chule galchu itobanga machal jinga hinam tin adongin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin David'in Uriah jah-a, Na-in lama chesuh inlang, nakeng kisilin, ati. Chuin Uriah chu lengpa in'a konin akipatdoh-in, chule lengpa-a kona nehding thilpeh ho-in anung ajuisuh paijin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahivangin Uriah chu lengpa in kotkhah bula chu a-pakaipa sohte chutoh alum denin, a-in lama chun achesuhpon ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin amahon Uriah chu a-in lama achetapoi tia David aseipeh phatnun, David'in Uriah jah-a, Nakholjin na-a kona nahung hilouham? ipidinga na-in lama chu chesuh louva nahim? ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Uriah chun David henga, Pathen thingkhong le Israel chule Judah pon in'a aumun; chule ka pakaipa Joab le ka pakaipa sohten gamlah-a gebuh akisonun; keima ane dingle adonding, chule kaji toh lumkhom dinga ka-in'a kache dingham? Nangma nahina nalhagao ahinlaisen keiman hiche tobang thil hi bolponge ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin David'in Uriah henga, Tunin jong hiche mun'a hin umkit tan, chule jing tengle keiman kipatdohsah nange ati. Hijeh chun Uriah chu Jerusalem'a hicheni chun chule ajing geijin aumtan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin David'in ama akou phatnin, aman ama masanga chun anen adonin, chuin aman ama chu adonkhamsah tan ahi. Chuin nilhah lamin a-pakaipa sohtetoh jalkhuna lum dingin achen, ahin a-inlanga vang achesuh pon ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin jingkah-in ahitin ahi, David'in Joab henga dingin lekha khat asunin, hichu Uriah khutna athottan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin aman lekha chunga chun asunin, Uriah chu galmun khohpen masanga chun pansah-in, amachu akisuhkhah -a athitheina dingin, ama-a konin kinung chonun, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chule ahitin ahi, Joab'in khopi chu aum laijin, Uriah chu galhat miho umna-a ahet munkhatna chun apansah-in ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin khopi sunga um miho chu apotdoh-un, Joab toh akisat taovin ahi: chule hiche mun'a chun David sohte mipi ho lah-a phabep khat alhutaovin; chule Hit mi Uriah jong chu athitai."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in gal chung chang thu jouse David gaseipeh dingin mi asoltan;"},"19":{"text":"Chuin aman thupolepa chu thu apen, Nangman lengpa henga gal umchan thuho jouse nagasei soh tengle,"},"20":{"text":"Lengpa alunghana, nahenga, Ipidinga kisatpi dinga khopi chu nachuti nailut jengu ham? Banga kona nahin kap dingu chu nanghon nahetlouvu ham?"},"21":{"text":"Jerubesheth chapa Abimelech chu koiham athatna? Banga kona numei khatnin sumheisong halkhat aselhah khumleh ama chu Thebez mun'a thia hilouham?
