Ipi dinga nangho bang naija nacheu ham? tia asei tengle nangman, Nasoh Hit mi Uriah jong athitai, tia nasei ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Thutn 9:53"},"22":{"text":"Chuin thupolepa chu achen, Joab'in asol lona jouse chu David henga aseitan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin thupolepa chun David henga, Tahbeh-in miho chun keiho eihinjou jouvin, chule loujaova keiho lah-a lama ahungpotnun, keihon amaho chu kotpi phung lutna geijin kanung delun ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin thalkap hon kulbanga konin nasohte lah ahin kapmun ahile lengpa soh phabep khat athitan, chule nasoh Hit mi Uriah jong chu athitan ahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chujouvin David'in thupolepa henga, Nangman Joab henga, Hicheho hin nangma nalungkham sah dahen, ajehchu chemjamin mikhat ahiloule adangkhat athateiji mong ahi: khopi douna-a chun nagalsat hatsah cheh inlang, khopi chu suse-in, tia naseija amachu natilkhou ding ahi, ati."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Uriah jinun ajipa Uriah athitai ti ajah phatnin, ajipa pul adoutan ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin alunghemna akichai phatnin, David'in amanu chu a-in'a agapuilut sah-in, chule amanu chu a-inneipi ahung hitan, chuin ama dingin chapa khat ahinpeh-in ahi. Ahin David thilbol chun Pakai alung lhaisah tapon ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin David henga Nathan asolin, chuin ama ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, Khopi khatna hin mini aumin, khatchu ahaovin, khatjohpa chu avaichan ahi.","title":"Nathan Thulem le David Lunghei","ref":"Labu 51 (Thupi)."},"2":{"text":"Mihaopa chun kelngoi honle ganchahon tamtah aneijin:"},"3":{"text":"Ahinla mivaichapan akichoh-a avah kelngoinou anu khat tilouvin imacha aneipon ahi. Chule hiche kelngoinou amale achate toh thakhatna hungkhang len ahin, chule ama an ngei chu aneh-a, akhontah-a twi adona, ama angsunga lumma, chule amadinga chanu khat tobang hija ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin mihaopa koma chun kholjin vahlekhat ahungin, chuin aman akelngoi honho lah-a khatjeng chajong chu hiche kholjin ahung lhungpa thapeh dingchun aphalpon; ahin mivaichapa kelngoi chu alan, chuin aman ahenga hung mipa ding chun athapehtan ahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Hiche mipa chunga chun David lunghana chu akoujah jengin, chuin aman Nathan henga, Hingjing Pakai mina kasei ahi, hitobang thil bolla michu thiteiding ahi:"},"6":{"text":"Chule hitobang abola, khotona anei loujeh-a, kelngoi chu ajatlia aleding ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Natha'in David henga, Hiche mipa chu nangma nahi. Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Keiman nangmahi Israel chunga leng dinga thao kanua, chule Saul khutna kona kahuh doh-a;"},"8":{"text":"Chule napakai pa insungle ajiteho chu nangma kapeh-a, chule Israel le Judah insung jong nangma kapeh nahin; ahin hiche chu lhombehseh ahia ahile, keiman nangma adang dang jong kapehbe nalai ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ipidinga nangman amitmua thilphalou bolna dinga Pakai thupeh chu nahsah louva nabol ham? Nangman Hit mi Uriah chu chemjamin nathatnin, a-inneipi chu naji dingin nakipuijin, chule ama Ammon chate chemjamin nathatnin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun tu-a hi na-insunga kona chemjam kiladoh louding ahi; ajehchu nangman nahsahmon neibolin, Hit mipa Uriah inneipi chu najidingin nakipuijin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Vetan, Keiman nangma douna-a na-insunga thilphalou khat kasodohsah ding, chule najiteho chu namitmu-a kalahpeh-a, amaho chu na-inhengho kapeh ding, chule aman najiteho chu sunchang noija aluppi dingu ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 16:22"},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman hichehi guhthima nabol ahin; ahinla keiman hichehi Israel jouse masangle sunchang noija kabol ding ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin David'in Nathan henga, Keima Pakai dounan kachonse tai, ati. Chuin Nathan'in David henga, Pakaiyin jong nachonsetna aladohtai, nangma nathi louding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hijeng jongle hiche nathilbola konahi Pakai melmaten Pathen ataitomna ding uva phat gomkom napeh ahi jeh-in, nangma-a dinga penga nachapa chu thitei ding ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Nathan chu a-in'a dingin akipatdoh tan ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin Uriah inneipin David ahinpeh chapang chu adengin ahile, hanatnin anatan ahi.","title":"David Chapa Thi"},"16":{"text":"Chuin David chapang dingchun Pakai henga ataovin; chule David'in an angolin, chuin insunga alutnin, jankhovah-in tolla alumin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin a-insung upaho akipat doh-un, tolla kona ama gathoudoh dingin ahenga acheuvin ahi: ahinla ama thodoh ding anompon, chule amahotoh anjong anepon ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, nisagi lhinin chapang chu athitan ahi. Chule David sohte chun naosen athitai tia ama seipeh ding chu akichalheh jengun ahi. Ajehchu amahon, Veuvin, chapang chu ahin laija bon ahenga thu iseijuva ahile, aman ithuseiju anangai lou ahin: chapang chu athi tin seipeh leuhen, khohjo cheh louding ham? atiu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ahin David'in asohho kihou lhih chu amu phatnin, David'in naosen chu athi ahi ahetai. Hijeh chun David'in asohte henga, Chapang chu athi hitam? ati. Chuin amahon, Ama athitai, atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Hichun David tolla konin athoudoh in, akisilin, thao akinun, chuin avon akikhelin, Pakai in'a ahung lutnin, Pathen ahou tan ahi. Chuin a-in lama ahung kilen; chuin aman angaichat phatnin amahon a-angsunga an aluipeh-un ahile aman anetai."},"21":{"text":"Chujouvin asohten ahenga, Ipibola hitia hi chona nahim? chapang chu ahinlaisen ama dingin an nangolin nakapmin, ahin chapang chu athi phatnin nathou doh-in an nanen ahi, atiuve."},"22":{"text":"Chuin aman, Chapang chu ahinlaijin keiman an kangol-in, kakapmin ahi: ajehchu keiman, Pathen'in eilungsetna chapang chu hunghing maithei ahi kon ija aseithei dingham? kati ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla tun ama athitai, ipidinga keiman an kangol dingham? Keiman ama kapuikit theiham? Keima amakoma kache ding ahin; ahinla ama keikoma hung kilethei louding ahitai, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin David'in a-inneipi Bathsheba chu alhamonin, chule amanu koma chun achen, aluppin ahi: chuin amanun chapa khat ahingin, amapan amin Solomon asahtai: chule Pakaiyin amachu angailun ahi.","title":"Solomon Pen"},"25":{"text":"Chuin aman Nathan themgaopa khutna thu athotnin ahile; aman Pakai jal-in aminchu Jedidiah asahtan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in Rabbah-a Ammon chate dounan gal asatnin, chuin leng khopi chu alatan ahi.","title":"David'in Rabbah Alah (1 Thusm 20:1-3)"},"27":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in thupole ho chu David henga asolin, ahenga, Keiman Rabbah kasatnin, chule twipi khopiho chu kalatai."},"28":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun mipi adang sese chu khom khomin, chule khopi douna ding chun gebuh kisonun lang, hichu laovin; achutiloule akhopi chu kalah-a kamin kalosah ding ahi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin David'in mipi jouse akhom khomin, Rabbah-a achetauve, chule agasatnun, hichu alataovin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin aman alengpao lallukhuh chu aluchanga konin aladoh-in, hiche agih dan songmantam toh kihal sana talent khat ahin; chuin hichu David luchanga akhuh peh-un ahi. Chuin aman khopi-a thil kichomdoh tamtah ahinpon ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin aman chua um mipi ho chu ahinpui doh-in, chule amaho chu thing-at, thih loukai le thih heicha semin apansah-in, chule cheh dengin apansah-in: hitichun aman Ammon miho khopi jouse-a chun abolin ahi. Chuin David le mipi ho chu Jerusalem'a ahungkile taovin ahi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin hicheho jouse nunghin ahitin ahi, David chapa Absalom chun Tamar kiti sopi nungah hoitah khat aneijin, chule David chapa Amnon chun amanu chu adeicha lheh jengin ahi.","title":"Amnon le Tamar"},"2":{"text":"Chule Amnon chu anaonu Tamar jehchun agenthei lheh jengin anatlo tan ahi; ajehchu amanu nungah thengsel ahin; chule Amnon'in amanu chunga thilkhat abolding chu amadingin hahsa asalheh jengin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ahin Amnon'in David sopipa Shimeah chapa Jonadab kiti gol khat aneijin: Jonadab hi mi lungthim themtah khat ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah-a, Nangma lengpa chapa hija ipidinga ani ania nagon cheh cheh ham? neiseipeh louding ham? ati. Chuin Amnon'in, ajah-a, Keiman kasopipa Absalom naonu Tamar kadeichai, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Jonadab'in ajah-a, Najalkhuna luminlang kinatsah-in: chule napa nave-a ahung tengle, ajah-a, Nahenga katao ahi, kasopinu Tamar chu hunghen lang nehding eihung pehen, chule amanu khutna kona kaneh theina dingin kamitmu in nehding eihung sempeh hen, tin seijin, ati."},"6":{"text":"Hitichun Amnon alumin, chule akinat sahtan ahi. Chuin lengpa avedinga ahung phatnin, Amnon'in lengpa henga, Nahenga katao ahi, kasopinu Tamar chu hung henlang, akhutna kona kaneh theina dingin kamitmu-a changlhah phengni eihung sempeh hen, ati."},"7":{"text":"Hichun David'in in'a Tamar henga mi asolin, ajah-a, Nangma tun na-upa Amnon in'a chenlang, anehding an gagotpeh in, ati."},"8":{"text":"Hitichun Tamar chu asopipa Amnon in'a achen ahile, ama analumin ahi. Chuin amanun changbong alan, ameh-in, amitmun changlhah phabep asemin, chuin changlhah chu akangin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin aman khangbel khat alan, chule hicheho chu a-angsunga asunglhan; ahinla ama nehding anompon ahi. Chuin Amnon'in, Pasal jouse kakoma konin soldoh-in, ati. Chuin amaho amitakip ama koma konin achedoh taovin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Amnon'in Tamar henga, Nakhutna kona kaneh thei nadingin, nehding chu indan sunga hinchoi lutnin, ati. Chuin Tamar'in achanglhah semho chu alan, hicheho chu indan sunga a-upa Amnon henga ahinchoitan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amanun hicheho chu ama nehdinga ahinchoi phatnin, aman amanu chu amanin, ahenga, Kanaonu, hungin neiluppin, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin amanun adonbutnin, Ahipoi, he-o, pumhatnin neibol hih-in; ajehchu hitobang thil hi Israelte lah-a akibol ngaipoi: hiche ngol hoitah thil hi bolhih-in."},"13":{"text":"Chule keiman kajumna hi hoija kachepi ding ham? chule nangma jong Israel sunga mingol khat banga naum ding ahi. Hijeh chun tun, nahenga katao ahi, lengpa henga seijin, ajehchu aman nangma dingin ei-it louding ahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Ahivangin aman amanu thusei chu angaipeh pon: amanu sanga hatjoh ahijeh-in, pumhatnin abolin, amanu aluppitan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hiche jouchun Amnon'in amanu chu hahotnin ahotan, hitichun aman amanu ahotna chu angailutna sangin alenjotan ahi. Chuin Amnon'in amanu jah-a, Thoudoh inlang chemangtan, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin amanun ajah-a, Hichehi angai ahipoi: hitia dihlou tah-a neisol mang hi kachunga nathilbol khatjo sanga chu phaloujo ahi, ati. Ahinla aman amanu thusei chu angaipeh pon ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hichun aman ama jenlea pang asohpa chu akouvin, ajah uva, Hiche numei nuhi kakoma konin kaidoh inlang, amanu nunga kot kamun, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chule amanu chun sangkhol jatchom choma pol khat aki-ah ahi: ajehchu hitobang sangkhol chu leng chanu nungahthengho von ahi. Chujouvin asohpa chun amanu chu ahinpui doh-in, amanu nunga kotchu akamtan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Tamar'in aluchunga vut akinun, chule amanun asangkhol jatchom choma polchu abotkeh-in, alujanga akhut akoijin, kap pumin achemang tan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin asopipa Absalom'in amanu jah-a, Nasopipa Amnon chun naum khompi ham? Ahinla tun, kasopinu lung mongin umin: ama nasopipa ahi; hiche thilhi lungnat nan neihih-in, ati. Hitichun Tamar chu asopipa Absalom in'a chun thomhao tah-in aumtan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ahinla David lengpan hicheho jousehi ajah phatnin, ama alunghang lheh jengin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule Absalom'in asopipa Amnon henga ase jong apha jong imacha aseipon ahi. Ahin Amon'in asopinu Tamar pumhatna abol jeh chun, Absalom'in Amnon chu ahon ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin kumni lhingset jouvin ahitin ahi, Absalom'in Ephraim koma um Baal-hazor mun'a kelngoimul avouvin: chule Absalom'in lengchapaho jouse chu akouvin ahi.","title":"Absalom'in Phu Alah"},"24":{"text":"Chuin Absalom chu lengpa henga ahungin, Tun vetemin, nasoh hin kelngoimul kavo ding ahin; katao ahi, lengpa hu nasoh hito lhonin cheohite, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Absalom henga, Ahipoi, kachapa, tun eiho ibonun chepou hite, achuti loule nanga dingin pohgih hikhao vinge, ati. Chuin aman amachu angeh kitnin, ahivangin ama cheding anompon, phatthei aboh jotan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hichun Absalom'in, Chuti ahilou dingle, nahenga katao ahi, kasopipa Amnon hi keihotoh lhonkhom hen, ati. Chuin lengpan ajah-a, Ipidinga amachu nangma toh lhonkhom dingham? ati."},"27":{"text":"Ahinla Absalom'in angeh teiteijin ahile, aman Amnon le lengpa chapateho jouse chu amatoh alhonkhom sahtan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Tun Absalom'in asohho chu thu apeh-a, hitia asei ahi, Amnon lungthim chu ju-a akipasah tengleh nanghon melchih-un, chule keiman naheng uva, Amnon chu thatnun; kati tengle, amachu thatnun, kicha hih-un: keiman nangho kathupeh nahiu hilouham? hangsanun lang hatnun, ati.","title":"Amnon Kitha"},"29":{"text":"Chuin Absalom soh ho chun Absalom'in athupeh bangu chun Amnon chunga abol taovin ahi. Chuphatnin lengpa chapateho jouse akipat doh-un, amitakip asangan chunga atoudoh-un, ajam taovin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, amaho lampia achepetnun, Absalom'in lengpa chapate jouse athat gamin, amaho khatcha jong ahingdoh aumpoi, tithu David heng ahung lhungtan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Hichun lengpa akipat doh-in, aponsil abotkeh-in, tolla alumin; chule asohte jousenjong aponsilu abotkeh-un akoma adingun ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin David sopipa Shimeah chapa Jonadab'in adonbutnin, Ka pakai amahon lengpa chapate khangthah jouse atha sohkeijin ngaito hih-in, ajehchu Amnon sehseh bou athin ahi. Ajehchu aman asopinu Tamar pumhatna anabol ni-a patna, Absalom thupeh dungjuija hichehi hung kigong pana ahitai."},"33":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun ka pakai lengpan lengchapate jouse thia ahi tin nalungin ngaito hih-in: ajehchu Amnon sehseh bou thi ahi, ati."},"34":{"text":"Hichun Absalom ajamtan ahi. Chuin gollhang khongah-a pangpa chu akhoda-a, avetna ahile, veuvin, anunglam molpang lampia chu mitamtah ahung amun ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Jonadab'in lengpa henga, Ven, Lengpa chapate ahunguve: nasoh-in asei bangbang chu ahi, ati."},"36":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, aman thu asei joujou chun, veuvin, lengpa chapate ahung lhungun, chuin awsang tah-in akapmun ahi: chule lengpa le asohte jong hakan akap taovin ahi."},"37":{"text":"Ahinla Absalom chu ajam mangin, Geshur lengpa Ammihud chapa Talmai henga achetan ahi. Chuin David chu achapa jeh-in niseh-in alunghemin ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 3:3."},"38":{"text":"Hitichun Absalom ajamin, Geshur'a achen, chua chun kumthum aumin ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chule David lengpa hinna chu Absalom henga achenom lheh jengin ahi. Ajehchu ama Amnon thi chung changa ana lungmonga ahitai."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Zeruiah chapa Joab'in lengpa lungthim chu Absalom heng lama aume ti ahetan ahi.","title":"Absalom Hungkile Kitna Dinga Job Thilgon"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in Tekoah'a mi asolin, chuche-a um numei chingtah khat agapuisah-in, amanu henga chun, Nahenga katao ahi, alunghem khat bangin uminlang lunghemna von kivonin, chule thao jong kinu hih-in, ahin phatsottah thi-op numei khat bangin umin."},"3":{"text":"Chutengle lengpa henga hungin lang, ahenga hitobanghin seijin, ati. Hitichun Joab'in amanu kamsunga aseiding thuho chu akoipehtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Tekoah numei nun lengpa henga thu aseichun, amai tolla asulutnin, jana apen, lengpa henga, Vo lengpa, neikithopin, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin lengpan amanu jah-a, Ipin nasuh genthei ham? ati. Chuin amanun adonbutnin, Tahbeh-in keima meithai kahin, ka-inneipu chu thia ahitai."},"6":{"text":"Chule nasohnu hin chapa ni aneijin, chuin amani gamlah-a akidel lhonin, koimacha aphel khending aumpon, khatpan khatjopa chu avon, athattan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule, ven, insung pumpihi nasohnu doudin akipatdoh taovin, chule amahon, Asopipa thatpa chu asopipa athajeh-a katha theina diuvin neipedoh un; chule agou lodingpa jongchu kasuh mangdiu ahi, atiuve. Chule chutia chu akidalha-a kamei-am chu asuhmitnuva, kapasal chu min neilou le, leichunga chilhah himhim neilouva akoi dingu ahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin lengpan numeinu jah-a, Na-in lama chetan, keiman nangma chung chang thu hinhetsah nange, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Tekoah numeinu chun lengpa henga, Ka pakai, O lengpa, hiche khangitlouna chu keimale kapa insunga chuhen: chule lengpa le alaltouna vang themonabei hihen, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin lengpan aseijin, koi hijongle nahenga ikhat seija aumle, amachu kahenga hinpuijin, chule aman avela natohkhah kit louding ahitai, ati."},"11":{"text":"Hichun amanun, Nahenga katao ahi, lengpan Pakai na Pathen hejingin lang, thisan phulapan asuhmangbe louna dingin phalna pehih-in; achuti loule kachapa sumang getnunte, ati. Chuin aman, Hingjing Pakai mina kasei ahi, nachapa samjang khatcha jong tolla lhalou ding ahi, ati."},"12":{"text":"Hitichun amanun, Ka pakai ka-lengpa jah-a nasoh in thukhat seijinge, ati. Chuin aman, Seijin, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin numeinu chun, Chuti ahile ipidinga nangman Pathen mite douna hitobang thil chu nagelham? ajehchu lengpan anomangpa chu in'a apuilut kitloujeh-a, lengpan hichehi themona nei khat thusei banga nasei ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu eiho ithi teitei dingu ahin, tolla twi kisunglha kithaldoh kit theilou tobang ihi dingu ahi. Ahijeng vangin Pathen'in hinkho alamang pon; amavang aman anodoh hochu ama-a kona akipaimang lou nadingun lampi asemin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu, tu-a mipihon eikichatsah jeh uva, keima hiche seidinga hi ka pakai lengpa henga hunga kahi. Chule nasohnu hin, Ijemtia lengpan asohnu taona hi asanpeh khatle, tun lengpa koma thu gaseijinge."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu lengpan eingaipeh intin, asohnu hi Pathen gouloa kona keima le kachapa suhmang dingpa khutna konin eilhatdoh inte, kati ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule nasohnun, Tu-a hi ka pakai lengpa thusei chu lhamona hiding ahi: ajehchu ka pakai leng hi aphale ase sepkhen na-a Pathen vantil tobang hija ahi. Hijeh chun na Pakai na Pathen'in naumpi hen, ati.","ref":"2 Sam 19:27"},"18":{"text":"Chuphatnin lengpan numeinu chu adonbutnin; Nahenga katao ahi, keiman nangma kadoh dingho hi im hih-in, ati. Chuin amanun, Tun ka pakai lengpan seijin, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin lengpan, Hicheng jousehi Joab to kikhut jopna naneijam? ati. Chuin numei nun adonbutnin, Ka pakai lengpa hinna pana kasei ahi, ka pakai lengpan nathuseidoh hohi koimachan jetlam ahiloule veilama aheikon theilou ahi. Ajehchu nasoh Joab'in eisola, hiche thuho jousehi nasohnu kama akoi ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kivaihom danho akikhel nadinga nasoh Joab'in hichehi abol ahi; Pakai vantil chihna bangin, leiset thil umjouse hetna dingin, ka pakai hi achingin ahi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Joab henga, Ven, tun hichehi kaboltan ahi: hijeh chun chenlang, gollhang Absalom chu gapuijin, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Joab aboh khupmin, tolla amai asulutnin, lengpa henga kipathu aseije: chule Joab'in, Tuni hin ka pakai vo lengpa, lengpan asohpa ngaichat asuh bulhitna konhin, nasoh keima namitmun lungsetna kachange ti kahetan ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Hitichun Joab akipatdoh-in, Geshur'a achen, Absalom chu Jerusalem'a ahin puitan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin lengpan, A-in lama kihei henglang, kamai muda hen, ati. Hitichun Absalom chu a-in lama akile heijin, lengpa mai chu amutapon ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ahinla Israelte lah-a chun Absalom banga amel hoina pachat ding koimacha aumtapon ahi. Akengtoa pat aluchanga lallukhuh geijin ama achun nolna aumpon ahi.","title":"David'in Absalom Angaidam"},"26":{"text":"Chule aman asam avolhah tengle (ajehchu kumlhun sehle avolhahji ahi: ajehchu achunga asam chu agihjin, hijeh-a chu avolhahji ahi:) asam chu atejin, lengpa thiltena dungjuijin shekel jani aphajin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule Absalom'a dingin chapa thumle, chanu khat apengin, achanu min chu Tamar ahi. Amanu chu numei melhoi tah ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hitichun Absalom chu kumni lhingset Jerusalam'a achengin, ahinla lengpa mai amupon ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hijeh chun Absalom'in lengpa henga soldingin Joab agakou sah-in; ahinla ama amahenga ahungpon ahi. Chuin aman aniveinan akouding asolkitnin, ahung dehpon ahi."},"30":{"text":"Hijeh chun aman asohte henga, Veuvin, Joab lou khu kei lou komcha-a um ahin, chule aman hilaija chun sakol chang aneijin ahi; cheovinlang meija gahalun, ati. Chuin Absalom sohte chun louchu meijin ahaltaovin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Joab akipatdoh-in, Absalom henga a-in'a chun ahungin, ajah-a, Ipidinga nasohten kalou chu meija ahalu ham? ati."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Absalom'in Joab chu adonbutnin, Ven, lengpa henga, Ipidinga keima Geshur'a kona hunga kahim? tuchan hin chukoma umleng keija dinga phajo ahi: tia seidinga kasol theina dinga hikoma hungin tia nangma kou dinga mi kahinsol ahi; hijeh chun tun lengpa maicha neimusah-un, chule kachunga khangit louna auma ahile, aman eithat jenghen, ati."},"33":{"text":"Hijeh chun Joab lengpa henga ahungin, ahenga aseitai. Chuin aman Absalom akou phatnin, ama lengpa henga ahungin, lengpa angsunga tolla aboh khupmin: chuin lengpan Absalom chu achoptan ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin hiche jouchun ahitin ahi, Absalom'in ama dingin sakol kangtalai ho le sakol ho, chule amasanga lhaiding mi somnga akigot tan ahi.","title":"Absalom Dou lungput"},"2":{"text":"Chule Absalom matah-in athoudoh jin, kotpi phungkom lampia chun anadingjin ahi: chule ahitin ahi, mi khattouvin boina aneija, lengpa henga athu tansah dinga ahung teng, Absalom'in ama chu aheng lama akoulutjin, chule ahenga chun, Hoikom khopi-a kon nahim? atijin, chule amachun, Nasohhi Israel phungho lah-a hiche phung chu kahi, atijin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuteng Absalom'in ajah-a chun, Ven, nathuho hi aphan adih-e; ahinla nathu ngailha dinga mopohna apeh koima aumpoi, atijin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hicheng tilou jongchun Absalom'in, Kaden keima gamsunga thutan dinga eikisem hitavele, chutile kiheh nading ahiloule boina neijouse kahenga hunguntin, chuteng keiman amaho them anachan ji tadinga! tin aseibejin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule ahitijin ahi, mi khattou chibai boh dinga akom anai tengleh, aman akhut alhangdoh jin, amapa chu atuh-in, achopjin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hitobanghin Absalom'in lengpa henga athu tansah dinga hunga Israelte jouse chu anabolsoh keijin ahi. Hitichun Absalom'in Israel miho lungthim chu agumang sohtan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin kum somli jouvin ahitin ahi, Absalom'in lengpa henga, Nahenga katao ahi, Pakai henga kitepnaho gasubulhit dingin Hebron'a neisolin."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu Syria gam Geshur'a kana umlaijin nasohhin kitepna khat kana neijin, Pakaiyin Jerusalem'a eipuilut kitna ahile, Pakai kajen ding ahi, tia kanasei ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin lengpan ajah-a, Lung mongin chen, ati. Hitichun ama akipatdoh-in, Hebron'a achetai."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla Absalom'in Israel phungho jouse lah-a guhthimin mi asolin, ajah uva, Nanghon sumkon gin najah jah tengule, Absalom'in Hebron'a vai ahomtai, nati dingu ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Jerusalem'a kona kikoudoh mi jani chu Absalom toh alhonun; amaho imacha gellouva cheu ahin, imacha ahet louvu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Absalom'in David dinga thumopma pang Gilon mi Ahithophel chu ama khopi Gilon'a ganlhaina thilto abol laitah-in agakou sah-in ahi. Chule galguh chu ahatlheh jengin ahi; ajehchu Absalom dingin mi atamcheh cheh jengtan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin David henga thupole khat ahungin, Israelte jouse lungthim chu Absalom lamma akaitaove, ati.","title":"David Jerusalem'a Kona Ajam"},"14":{"text":"Chuin Davidn'in Jerusalem'a amato umkhom asohte jouse henga, Kipatdoh-un, jamtaohite; ajehchu eiho Absalom'a kona ihoidoh loudiu ahi. Potdoh dingin mangang un, achutiloule aman hetman louvin eihin delkhum diu, chule eiho chunga thilphalou ahin lhutna, khopi hi chemjam'a asat ding ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin lengpa soh ho chun lengpa henga, Ven, nasohte hi ipihile ka pakai lengpan boldinga eithupeh chanu boldinga kigosa dema um kahiuve, atiuve."},"16":{"text":"Chuin lengpa apotdoh-in, chule a-insung miho jouse chun anung ajuijun ahi. Chuin lengpan inngah dingin athaikem numei som adalhan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule lengpa apotdoh-in, mipi jousen anung ajuijun, mun gamlatah khatna aumtaovin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin asohho jouse chu amato akilhonun, chule Gath'a kona anung hinjui Cherth mite, Palet mite, chule Git mite mi jagup chu lengpa masanga acheuvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Gitmi Ittai jah-a, Ipidinga nangjong keihohitoh nalhon ham? Naumna lama kile kitnin lang, lengpa toh gaum khomin. Ajehchu nangma gamchommi nahin, chule nagam sunga kona kinodoh jong nahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule nangma janhi vela bou hung nahin, tunia keima kachena thei thei na-a che ding kahin, iti nangma keiho toh lhonna kachesuh kachetou sah ding ham? nangma kilekittan, chule nasopi ho hi kipuijin: hepina le thutah-in naumpi jinghen, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Ittai'in lengpa adonbutnin, ajah-a, Hingjing Pakai min le ka pakai lengpa min pana kasei ahi, thonlouva hoikom mun hijongle ka pakai lengpa umna-a chu thina hihen, hinna hile, hichelai mun ngeija chu nasoh hi kaumding ahi, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin David'in Ittai jah-a, Chenlang galkaitan, ati. Chuin Git mi Ittai chu amite jousele aumkhompi chapang neoho jouse chutoh agalkai taovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin gam pumpi chu awsang tah-in akapmun, chule mipihochu agalkai taovin ahi. Chule lengpa amatah jong Kedron vachadung chu agalkaijin, chuin miho jouse chu gamthip jotna lampi langa chun agalkai taovin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule veuvin, Zadok le ama koma um Levi hon jong Pathen kitepna thingkhong apouvin ahi. Chuin amahon Pathen kitepna thingkhong chu angaovin; chule mipi ho jouse khopi-a kona apotdoh kahseuvin Abiathar chu achetouvin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Zadok hengah, Pathen thingkhong chu khopi-a nungpoh kitnin: ijemtia Pakai mitmu-a lungsetna kachana ahile, aman eihin lepui kitna, anai-a hiche hile aumna mun chu eimusah kitding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ahinla aman, Nachunga lunglhaina kaneipoi atia ahile; ven, hikoma kaume, aman kachunga pha asah bangbang chun bolhen, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Zadok thempupa henga, Nangma mitvah nei nahi louham? Nangma to umkhom nachapateni, nachapa Ahimaaz le Abiathar chapa Jonathan toh lung mongin khopi sunga kiletaovin."},"28":{"text":"Ven nangma-a kona thu ahung kahse-a keiman gamthip phaichama kaum ding ahi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Hijeh chun Zadok le Abiathar chun Pathen thingkhong chu Jerusalem'a apokit lhonnin; chule hikoma chun amani aum lhontan ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin David chu olive molsang kaltouna-a chun achetouvin, chule akap pum pumin achetouvin, alu akhu khumin, akeng keuvin lam ajotnin ahi: chule akoma um mipi jouse amitakipmin alu akhu khumun, kap pumin achetouvun ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin mikhatnin David jah-a, Ahithophel chu Absalom galguh bolho lah-a ajaove, tin aseipeh-in ahi. Chuin David'in, Vo Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, Ahithophel thumopna chu ngolnan heidoh peh-in, ati."},"32":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, David a-Pathen houna mun molchung ahunglhun phatnin, veuvin, Arch mi Hushai chu sangkhol chol kibotkeh le aluchanga leiset nat pumin ama kimupi ding chun ahungin ahi."},"33":{"text":"David'in ama henga, Nangma keima toh lhon lehen, keima dinga pohgih nahi ding ahi:"},"34":{"text":"Ahinla nangma khopi-a nakile-a, Absalom henga, Vo lengpa, keima nasoh hinge; hichan geija napa soh-a kana um bangin, tunjong nangma soh hingkate, tia nagaseija ahile: nangman keima dingin Ahithophel thumop chu neijopeh ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chule nangman nangma to pangkhom dinga Zadok le Abiathar thempu teni nanei hilouham? Hijeh-a chu hitiding ahi, Ipi hile nangman lengpa in'a kona najah chanchu, Zadok le Abiathar thempupa naseipeh ding ahi."},"36":{"text":"Ven, hikoma chun amani chutoh achapateniu Zadok chapa Ahimaaz le Abiathar chapa Jonathan aumlhone; chule nangman najah takip chu amani-a kona kakoma nahin thotding ahi, ati."},"37":{"text":"Hitichun David lengpa golpa Hushai chu khopi sunga ahungin, chule Absalom chu Jerusalem'a ahunglut tan ahi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin David'in molsang chungvum phabep akhel nungin, veuvin, Mephibosheth sohpa Ziba'in sangan ni apho pumle achunga chanlhah pheng jani, lengpithei gop boh jakhat, chule nipilai theiga jat jakhat, chule ju haikhat toh ana kimupin ahi.","title":"David le Ziba","ref":"2 Sam 9:9-10."},"2":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Ziba jah-a, Hiche nabolhi ipi vetsahna ham? ati. Chuin Ziba'n, Sanganho hi lengpa insung mite touna ding ahin, chule changlhah leh nipilai theigahohi gollhangho nehding ahin, chule juhi gamthipma lhasamho donding ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin lengpan, Chuti ahile, napakai pa chapa lah-em? ati. Chuin Ziba'n lengpa henga, Ven, ama Jerusalem'a aume: ijeh inem itile aman, Tunia Israel insungin kapa lenggam eilosah dingu ahi, ati.","ref":"2 Sam 19:26-27."},"4":{"text":"Hiche phatchun lengpan Ziba henga, Ven, Mephibosheth nei jouse chu nangma-a ahitai, ati. Chuin Ziba'n, namitmu-a lungsetna kachan theina dinga, ka pakai, vo lengpa, nahenga katao ahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin David lengpa Bahurima ahung phatnin, veuvin, chua konchun Gera chapa Shimei kiti Saul insungmi khat ahungdoh-in ahi. Ama ahung potdoh-in, alamjot toh gaosap ahin koppeh-in ahi.","title":"David le Shimei"},"6":{"text":"Chuin aman David le, David lengpa sohte jouse chu songin ahin sepmin: chule miho jousele mihat ho jouse jet le veija aumun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule Shimei'in agaosap laijin hitin aseijin ahi, Hung doh-in, hung doh-in, nangma thisan sopa le Belial mipa :"},"8":{"text":"Akhela navaihom, Saul le a-insung pumpi thisan chu Pakaiyin nachunga ahinle lhunsah ahin; chule Pakaiyin lenggam chu nachapa Absalom khutna apehdoh ahitai: chule ven, nangma thisanso hat nahi jeh-a, nathemmona chu nachunga chua ahitai, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuphatnin Zeruiah chapa Abishai'in lengpa henga, Ipidinga hiche uicha thisa hin ka pakai lengpa hi agaosap ham? nahenga katao ahi, galkaijing ting, alu galange, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin lengpan, Nangho Zeruiah chapate, nangho le kei ikibahnao ipi umam? Eigaosap hen, ajehchu Pakaiyin ahenga, David khu gaosapmin, ati ahi. Chuti ahile, Ipidinga nangin hiti ahi nabol ham? tia aseidinga chu koiham? ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin David'in Abishai le asohte jouse henga, veuvin, ka-oisunga kona hungdoh kachapa jengin kahinna lahdinga ahola ahile; tu-a hi hiche Benjamin miten ichan geija ahol dingu ham? Limsah hih-un, agaosap nom chanin gaosaphen; ajehchu Pakaiyin asol ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuti henlang hile Pakaiyin kagen theina hinve intin, tunia aman eisapset nahi Pakaiyin aphalama eilethuhpeh ding ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chule David le amiho chu lampia ache laijun, Shimei chu molpanga chun ama dontah-a achen, achepum chun agaosapmin, chule songin asepmin leivui athekhumin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin lengpa le aumkhompi mihochun alel taovin; hijeh chun amaho hia chun akicholdo taove."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Absalom le Israel mite jouse chu Jerusalem'a ahungun, chule ama Ahithophel toh ahi.","title":"Jerusalem'a Absalom"},"16":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, David golpa Arch mi Hushai chu Absalom henga ahung phatnin, Hushai'in Absalom henga, Pathen'in lengpa huhhing hen, Pathen'in lengpa huhhing hen, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Absalom'in Hushai henga, Hichehi nagolpa nahepina ham? ipidinga nagolpatoh lhonlou nahim? ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Hushai'in Absalom henga, Ahipoi, Pakai le hiche mite, chule Israel mipi ho jousen alhen paova chu kahi ding, chule keima ama toh kaumding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chujongle, keiman koi kajen dingham? Achapa chu kajen ding hilouham? Napa kajen banga chu nangma kajending ahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuphat chun Absalom'in Ahithophel henga, Ipi kabol dinguham neithumop uvin, ati.","title":"Ahithophel Thumop"},"21":{"text":"Chuin Ahithophel'in Absalom henga, Napan inngah dinga akoi athaikemho henga chun chen; chule Israel mipi ho jousen nangma napa-a dinga kidah umtah nahichu ajahdiu: chutengle nangma toh umho jouse khuttha chu hatdoh ding ahi, ati."},"22":{"text":"Hitichun amahon Absalom dingin in chunga chun pon inkhat asongun, chuin Absalom chu Israel miho jouse mitmun apa thaikem ho henga aluttan ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 12:11-12"},"23":{"text":"Chule Ahithophel thumop, hiche nikho laija Ahithophel anathumopho chu, mikhatnin Pathen athudop banga ana gelu ahi. David le Absalom dinga jong Ahithophel thumop ho jouse chu hitobang chu anahija ahi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hicheng tilou chun Ahithophel'in Absalom henga, Tun keima mi sangsom le sangni lhendoh ingting, tujan mama hin kipatdoh ingting, David ganungdel inge:","title":"Hushai'in Absalom Apuikhel"},"2":{"text":"Chule ama athachola akhuttha alhompet tahle achunga kachuh ding, kasuh kichat ding: chutengle aumpi miho jouse chu jam mang untin, keiman lengpa bouchu katha ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule mipi jouse chu nahenga kahin lepuiding ahi. Nangman naholpa tailou adang jouse ahung kilekit teng, mijouse chu lung mong diu ahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chule akisei chun Absalom le Israel upaho jouse chu alunglhaisah lheh-in ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chujouvin Absalom'in, Tun Arch mipa Hushai jongchu kouvun, chule eihon ama thusei jongchu ngaiju hite, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Hushai chu Absalom henga ahung phatchun, Absalom'in akihoupin, Ahithophel'in hitihin aseije: aman asei bangahi iboldiu ham? Ahilouva ahile, nangman hinseijin, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Hushai'in Absalom henga, Ahithophel thumop hi tuphatna dingin aphapoi."},"8":{"text":"Hushai'in aseiben, Ajehchu nangman napale amiho chu gal hat ahiu, chule vompi gamlah-a anou kilahpeh banga alungsung uva lungsa ahiu nahen ahi; chule napahi galsat mi ahin, miho lah-a jong gehlou ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ven, amahi tu-a leiko khat sung, ahiloule munchom dang khatna kisel ding ahi: chule hung hitiding ahi, amaho lah-a themkhat ahung lhuh masah tengule, hiche jaho jouse chun, Absalom nungjui miho lah-a kitha chapna aumtai atidiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chutengle mihangsan tah, alungchang keipi lungchang tobang jong chu junlha ding ahi: ajehchu Israelte jousen napa chu mihat ahi ahetnu ahin, chule aumkhompi miho chu mihangsan jeng ahiuve."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun Dan'a pat Beersheba geija Israelte jouse luipikama neldi jat banga nahenga nakhop khoma, chule nangmatah chu gala nakon ding chu kathumop nahi."},"12":{"text":"Hiti achu eiho ama kimunathei ding mun'a chu ihungdiu, chule daitwi tolla alhah banga eiho ama chunga ichuh jeng dingu ahi. Chule amale aumpi miho jouse khatcha jong kidalha louding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hicheng chungchona chu, ama khopi sung khat touva alutna ahile, Israelte jousen hiche khopi lama chu khao ahinchoidiu, chule khopi chu song halkhat cha akimulou kahse-a vadung sunga ikailut dingu ahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Absalom le Israel mipi jouse chun, Arch mipa Hushai thumop hi Ahithophel thumop sangin aphajoi, atiuvin ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin Absalom chunga thilphalou ahinlhun sahna dinga, Pakaiyin Ahithophel thumop phaho jona dinga tohgon ananeisa ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Hichun Hushai'in Zadok le Abiathar thempupa henga, Hiti khati hin Ahithophel'in Absalom le Israel upaho athumopmin; hiti tihin keiman kathumop in ahi.","title":"David Agahil Guh-u Chule Ajam"},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun gangtah-in solin lang, David henga, Tujan gamthip phaicham ho-a chun gehhihhen, ahinla mangang tah-in galkaijin; achutiloule lengpa le aumpi miho jouse chu val lhuma umkha diu ahi, tin gaseisah-in, ati."},"17":{"text":"Tun Jonathan le Ahimaaz chu khopisung ahunglut lhon akimulouna dingin Enrogel'a aumlhonin ahi: chuin soh numei khat achen amani agaseipeh-in; chuin amani ache lhonin David lengpa agaseipeh lhontan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin pasal chapang khatnin amaho chu anamun, Absalom chu aseipehtan ahi. Ahin amani mangang tah-in achemang lhonin, chuin Bahurim'a ahongsunga twikul neikhat in'a ahung lhonin; hia chun akumlha lhontan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin numeinu chun twikul kamchu asingin, chuin achunga chun chang aphouvin ahile, hichu akihedoh pon ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Absalom sohte numeinu in'a ahung phatnun, ahenga, Ahimaaz le Jonathan chu hoilama umham? atiuve. Chuin numei nun ajah uvah, Amani vachadung galkailhon tante, ati. Chuin amahon aholmo phatnun Jerusalem'a ahungkile taovin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, amaho chedoh nungin, amani twikul'a konin ahungdoh lhonin, achelhonin David lengpa henga agaseipeh lhonin, ajah-a, Kipatdoh inlang mangang tah-in twi chu galkaijin; ajehchu Ahithophel'in nangma douna-a hitia hi athumop ahitai, atilhonne."},"22":{"text":"Hichun David le aumkhompi miho jouse chu akipat doh-un, Jordan agalkaijun: jingkho vah-in amaho Jordan galkailou khatcha aumtapouvin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Ahithophel'in athumop akijuilou amuphatnin, asangan pho kigotnin, akipatdoh-in, akhopi a-in lama achen, a-insung asemtupmin, chuin amale ama akikhailih-in, athin, apa lhanna akivuitan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hichun David Mahanaim'a ahung lhungin ahi. Chule Absalom le aumpi Israel mite jouse chu Jordan agalkai taovin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Absalom'in Joab khelin Amasa chu janel lamkaijin apansahtai: Hiche Amasa kitipa hi chu Joab nu Zeruiah sopinu Nasah chanu Abigail galuppi pa Israel mi Jithra kitipa chapa ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hitichun Israel le Absalom'in Gilead gama chun pon in akison taovin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, David Mahanaim ahunglhun phatnin, Ammon mi Rabbah kho-a cheng Nahash chapa Shobi le, Lodebar kho-a cheng Ammiel chapa Machir toh, Rogelim kho-a cheng Gilead mi Barzillai'in,"},"28":{"text":"Jalkhunho, twikhonho, leibelho, suhlou chang, sakolchang, changbong, changkanpoh, bepaiho, bechim, belheng kikangho,"},"29":{"text":"Chule khoiju, bongnoi thao, kelngoi le bongnoihaho chu David le aumpi miho nehdingin ahinpouvin ahi: ajehchu amahon, Mipi hi gamthipma gilkel, thachol le dangchah-a umu ahi, atiuve."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin David'in aumkhopi miho chu asimin, chuin aman sangkhat chung lamkai le jakhat chunga lamkai ding alhengdoh-in ahi.","title":"Absalom Gallel le Akitha"},"2":{"text":"Chule David'in mipi hopthum-a hopkhat chu Joab khut noija asoldoh-in, hopthum-a hopkhat chu Zeruiah chapa Joab sopipa Zeruiah chapa Abishai khut noija asoldoh-in, chule hopthum-a hopkhat chu Git mi Ittai khut noija chun asoldoh-in ahi. Chuin lengpan mipi ho henga, Keima tahjong thonlouva nang hotoh kalhonkhom ding ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Ahinla mipin adonbutnun, Nangma nakondoh louding ahi: ajehchu keiho jamta leoveng, amahon keiho gelkhoh-a einei loudiu; chule keiho akehkhat thijong leoveng, amahon keiho gelkhoh-a einei loudiu ahi. Ahinla tun nangma keiho sangsom toh kibang nahi: hijeh-a chu nangman tu-a khopi sunga naum hi phajo ahi, atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chuin lengpan ajah uva, Nanghon aphapen dinga nagelu chu kabol ding ahi, ati. Chuin lengpa kotpi phung koma chun adingin, mipi jouse chu jakhat cheng le sangkhat chengin ahungdoh-un ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Joab, Abishai chule Ittai chu thu apen, ajah uva, Keima ding ngaitonan gollhangpa, Absalom ngeichu lungneng tah-in hindemun, ati. Chule miho jouse chun lengpan Absalom chung changa ja lamkaiho athupeh chu ajaovin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hitichun mipi chu gamlah-a Israelte doudin achedoh taovin ahi. Chuin gal chu Ephraim gammanga kisat uva ahi;"},"7":{"text":"Hiche mun'a chun Israel mipi ho chu David sohte masanga akithat chap taovin, chule hiche nikho chun mi sangsomni athin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu gal chu gamsung jouse-a akithechan soh-a ahitan: chule hiche nikho chun chemjam'a kithat sangin, gammang lah-a ohlih atamjouvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Absalom'in David sohte chu atohkha tan ahi. Chuin Absalom chu sangan chung khatna touva ahin, chule sangan chu gangpi lentah abah kibom noija chun achen ahile, alu chu gangpi-a chun a-ohdentan; chuin ama vanle lei kikah-a akikhai denin; anoija um sangan chu achemang tan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin mikhatnin hichu amun, Joab jah-a, Ven, keiman Absalom gangpi phunga akikhai kamun ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in aseipehpa henga, Ven, nangman ama namu ahin, ipidinga amachu tolla satlhalou nahim? chutile keiman nangma dangka Shekel somleh konggah khat nape tadinga, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin mipa chun Joab henga, Keiman dangka Shekel sangkhat kakhutna kasan ding hijongleh, keiman lengpa chapa dounan kakhut kalha louding ahi; ajehchu keiho jah tah-in lengpa nangma le Abishai chule Ittai nathu peh-un, Gollhang Absalom chu koimachan natohkhah louna dingun chingtheijun, ati."},"13":{"text":"Achuti louva ahile kahinkho douna-a dihlou tah-a na katohding ahi: ajehchu lengpa-a kona ki-ima imacha aumpon, nangmatah ngeijong keima douva nahung panding ahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Hichun Joab'in, Keima nangma toh hitihin umthei ponge, ati. Chuin aman akhutna tengcha thum alan, Gangpi thing lah-a ahinga ana umnalai Absalom alungchang chu asun pailetnin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Joab galmanchah po-a pang gollhang mi somho chun Absalom chu a-umkimvelun, avouvin, athat taovin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in sumkon amutnin ahile, mipi chu Israelte anungdel naova konin ahungkile taovin ahi; ajehchu Joab'in mipi chu akhamtang ahitai."},"17":{"text":"Chuin amahon Absalom chu alauvin, gammang lah kotong lentah khat aseplutnun, chule achunga songlhuh lentah-in aseuvin ahi. Chuin Israelte chu amitakip ama ama ponbuh lam cheh-a ajamtaovin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tun Absalom'in ahinlaijin lengpa phaichama chun amadingin khompi khat anatung doh-in ahi. Ajehchu aman, keiman kamin geldoh jingna dinga koiding chapa kaneipoi, ati: chuin aman khompi chu ama-min aputsah-in ahi. Chule hichu tunigeijin Absalom mun tin akisahtai."},"19":{"text":"Chujouvin Zadok chapa Ahimaaz'in, Tun keima lhaijing kating, Pakaiyin melmaho chunga iti phu analah hitam, lengpa koma athu hi galhut inge, ati.","title":"Absalom Thi David Henga Akiseipeh"},"20":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in ahenga, Tunia hi nangman thu napoh theilou ding, amavang nidang tengle napoh ding ahi. Tunia vanghi nangman thu napoh louding ahi, ajehchu lengpa chapa thia ahi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chujouvin Joab'in Cushi henga, Chenlang nathilmu hi lengpa gaseipehtan, ati. Chuin Cushi chu Joab anga akunin, alhaijeltan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hichun Zadok chapa Ahimaaz chun Joab henga aseikitnin, Ahile hitante, nahenga katao ahi, Cushi nunga chun lhaijing kate, ati. Chuin Joab'in, Kachapa, athupoh ding umlouva ipi dinga lhaiding nakigot jengham? ati."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla aman, Ahile hitante, lhaijeng inge, ati. Hichun aman ajah-a, Lhaitan, ati. Hichun Ahimaaz chu phaicham lampia chun alhaijin Cushi chu akhelpatan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule David chu kotpi teni kikah-a chu touva ahi. Chuin khongahpa chu kotpi phung bang chunga chun akaldoh-in, akhodah in ahile, veuvin, mikhat achanga hunglhai amun ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin khongahpa chun asamin, lengpa henga aseipehtan ahi. Chuin lengpan, Ama achang ahile, akama thu ahinpoh hinte, ati. Chuin ama kintah-in ahunglhaijin ahungnai chehcheh-in ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin khongahpa chun michom dang khat hunglhaija amukitnin: chuin khongahpa chun kotngahpachu akouvin, ahenga, Ven, michom dang khat jong ahunglhaije, ati. Chuin lengpan amajong thu ahinpoh ahi, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin khongahpan, Keiman ahunglhai masapenpa chu Zadok chapa Ahimaaz lhai danin kahen ahi, ati. Chuin lengpan, Amachu mipha ahin, chule thupha toh hungtha ahi, ati."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Ahimaaz'in ahin samin, lengpa henga, Imajouse aphasoh keinai, ati. Chuin aman lengpa masang tolla chun amai asulutnin, Ka pakai lengpa douna akhut lamho jouse pedoh-a Pakai na Pathen chu nunnom hen, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin lengpan ajah-a, Gollhang Absalom chu hoidoh nam? ati. Chuin Ahimaaz'in adonbutnin, Joab'in lengpa sohpa le nasoh keima eisol lhonchun, keiman mipi boilah lah chu kamun, ahinla hichu ipi ahi kahepoi, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin lengpan ajah-a, Kikhindoh inlang, hikoma hin dingin, ati. Chuin ama akikhindoh-in, ading thimbeh-in ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, Cushi ahung lhungin; chule Cushi'n, ka Pakai lengpa thu kahinpoi; ijeh inem itile nangma doudinga kipatdoh ho jouse chunga tuni hin Pakaiyin phu alatai, ati."},"32":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Cushi henga, Gollhang Absalom chu hoidoh nam? ati. Chuin Cushi'n adonbutnin, Ka pakai lengpa melmaho jouse, chule nangma suhkhah nadinga nangma douna kipatdoh jouse chu gollhangpa chutoh bangcheh hen, ati."},"33":{"text":"Chuin lengpa chu alung analheh jengtan, kotpi phunga dan chunga chun akaldoh-in, akaptan ahi: chuin aman achepumin, Ohe! kachapa Absalom! kachapa, kachapa Absalom! Pathen'in nangma khela eithisah joh hile ong! ohe Absalom, kachapa, kachapa, atin ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Joab henga, Ven, lengpa chu Absalom dingin akapmin, alunghemin ahi tin aseipeh-un ahi.","title":"Joab'in David Lengpa A-oimo"},"2":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho-a galjona chu mijouse dingin lunghemna asohtan ahi. Ajehchu mipi jousen, Lengpa ichan geija achapa dinga lung gentheija hitam, tia kisei chu ajauvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule galmuna kona ajamdoh jeh-a jahchatah-a umho bangin, hiche nikho chun mipi ho chu guhthim chan khopi sunga chun ahung lutnun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin lengpan amai akikhun, awsang tah-in, Vo kachapa Absalom! vo Absalom kachapa, kachapa, tin akapmin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Joab chu lengpa in'a ahunglutnin, ajah-a, Nangman tunikho hin nangma hinkho, nachapate hinkho, nachanute hinkho, najite hinkho, nathaikem ho hinkho huhdoh-a nasohte jouse maihi najumson;"},"6":{"text":"Hiche-a hin nangman namelmate nangailun, naloi nagol ho nahotbolin ahi. Ajehchu tuni hin nangman leng chapate le soh ho hi ija naselouna naphongdoh tan: tuni hin Absalom chu hing henlang, keiho jousehi thileuveng nakipah ding ahi ti kamudohtai."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun kipatdoh-in, chedoh-in lang nasohte henga lungmona thu gaseijin: ajehchu Pakai mina kihahsel kahi, napotdoh louva ahile, tujan apat khatcha jong nangma toh umlou ding ahitai: chule hichu nakhangdon laija patna tuni geija nachunga thilse anachuho sanga khohjo ding ahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Hichun lengpa akipatdoh-in, kotpi phunga chun atoutan ahi. Chuin amahon mipi ho jouse henga chun, Veuvin; lengpa chu kotpi phunga atoutai, atiuve. Chuin mipi chu lengpa masanga ahungun ahi: ajehchu Israelte amitakip ama ama pon-in lam cheh-a jamu ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Israel phung jouse lah-a mipi ho chu akiphinun, Lengpan imelmateu khutna konin eihuhdoh-un; chule Philistinte khutna konin eihuhdoh-un; chule tun ama Absalom jeh-in gamsunga konin ajamdoh tai.","title":"Jerusalem Jonna David Ahungkile"},"10":{"text":"Chule ichunguva dinga thao inupao Absalom chu galmuna athitan ahi. Hijeh chun tun ipidinga lengpa lepuikit nadinga thu changkhat beh nasei daoham? atiuve."},"11":{"text":"Chuin David lengpan Zadok le Abiathar thempu henga mi asolin, ajah-a, Judah upaho henga hitin aseijin, Israelte thusei chu lengpa le a-insung ngei tah-a hunglhung tai ti namu nunguva, ipidinga nanghon lengpa a-in'a lepui kitnadinga anunung pena napan uham?"},"12":{"text":"Nangho kasopite nahiuvin, kaguhole kaphe nahiuve. Chuti ahile ipidinga nangho lengpa lepuina dinga anunungpen nahiu ham?"},"13":{"text":"Chule nanghon Amasa henga, Nangma kagule kaphe nahilouham? Nangma kamasang Joab khela janel gallamkai nahijom jing louva ahile, Pathen'in kachunga hitichun, chule akhohjo cheh-in eibolhen, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin aman mikhat lungsung bangin Judah miho jouse lungsung chu asunemin; hitichun amahon lengpa henga thu athotnun, Nangmale nasohteho hungkile taovin, atiuvin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hitichun lengpa ahungkilen, Jordan ahung lhungtan ahi. Chuin Judah chu lengpa kimutopi ding le Jordan galkaipi dingin Gilgal'a ahungtan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Bahurim'a um Benjamin mi Gera chapa Shimei chu Judah miho toh David lengpa kimutopi dingin mangang tah-in ahungsuh-in ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 16:5-13"},"17":{"text":"Chule ama chu Benjamin mi sangkhat to ahin, Saul insungmi sohpa Ziba le achapa somlenga toh, chule asoh somni toh ahiuvin: chuin amaho chu lengpa masanga chun Jordan agalkaijun ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amaho lengpa insungmi le aman boldinga pha-a agel chu boldingin kongneo khatna agalkaijun ahi. Chuin ama Jordan ahung galkai kaijin, Gera chapa Shimei chu lengpa masanga abohkhup jengin;"},"19":{"text":"Chule lengpa henga, Ka pakaiyin khangitlouna chu keija simhih-in, chule ka pakai lengpan Jerusalem adalhah ni-a nasoh kanachonvalna jong chu geldoh danlang, lengpan nalunga jong vophih beh-in.","title":"David'in Shimei Chunga Hepina Amusah"},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu nasoh hin chonse kahi ti kakihetne: hijeh chun ven, tunia hi Joseph insung miholah-a ka pakai lengpa kimutopi dinga hungsuh masapen kahi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Ahivangin Zeruiah chapa Abishai'in adonbutnun, aman Pakai thaonusa agaosap jeh-a Shimei chu thading hilouham? ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin David'in, Nangho Zeruiah chapate, nangho le keima ipi ikibahnao uma, tunia hi keima douva napan uham? Tunia Israel sunga mi kithat ding ham? tunia hi keiman Israelte chunga leng kahihi kahet louva nabolu ham? ati."},"23":{"text":"Hijeh chun lengpan Shimei jah-a, Nangma nathilou ding ahi ati. Chuin lengpa amahenga akiteptan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Saul chapa Mephibosheth chu lengpa kimupi dingin ahungsuh-in, chule aman lengpa akipatdoh ni-a pat lungmonga ahungkit nikho tokah-a hi akeng jong asillou, akhamul jong apolou, avonho jong asoplou ahi.","title":"David'in Mephibosheth Chunga Hepina Amusah","ref":"2 Sam 9:1-13; 16:1-4."},"25":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, ama Jerusalem'a lengpa kimutopi dinga ahung chun lengpan ahenga, Mephibosheth ipidinga keima toh kilhonlou nahim? ati."},"26":{"text":"Chuin aman adonbutnin, Ka pakai, vo kalengpa, nasohhi kengbai kahi jeh-in keima, Achunga katouva lengpa henga kache theina dingin sangan chu kigotninge kati ahi; hinlah kasohpan eijoulhep ahi"},"27":{"text":"Chule aman nasohhi ka pakai lengpa henga eihehsen ahi; ahinla ka pakai lengpa hi Pathen vantil tobang ahi. Hijeh chun namitmu-a pha masah dungjuijin boltan."},"28":{"text":"Ajehchu kapa insung pumpiho ka pakai lengpa masanga athisa ahitan, hijongle nangman nasohhi nangma dokhanga neho lah-a napan sah-in ahi. Hijeh chun lengpa henga taokitna dinga ipi thaneina kaneijem? ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin lengpan ahenga, Ipidinga nangman nathu chu nasei nahlai ham? Keiman, Nang le Ziba gam chu kihomlhontan tin kanaseije, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Mephibosheth'in lengpa henga, Ka pakai lengpa lungmonga a-in'a hung kilekit ahitah jeh-in, abonin aman kilahtahen, ati."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Gilead mi Barzillai chu Rogelim'a konin ahungsuh-in chuin, Jordan gal gei gathah dingin, lengpa toh Jordan agalkai lhonin ahi.","title":"David'in Barzillai Chunga Hepina Amusah","ref":"2 Sam 17:27-29."},"32":{"text":"Tun Barzillai chu mi kum upatah ahitan, kum somget ahitai. Chule aman lengpa Mahanaim'a aumlaija chu nehding ana khan ahi; ajehchu ama mihao tah ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Barzillai henga, Kakoma hungin lang, Jerusalem'a kakoma na-umlaisen keiman navah nange, ati."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Barzillai'in lengpa henga, Keima itih chanpi kahin nahlai ding hija, lengpa toh Jerusalem'a kachetou dingham?"},"35":{"text":"Tuhin keima kum somget kahitai. Chule keiman apha le ase kalhengkhen thei ding ham? Nasoh hin kaneh dingle kadon ding chu atwi atam kahetthei ding hinam? Numei lasathem le pasal lasathem ho lasah awgin chu kajah thei nalaiding hinam? chuti ahile ipi dinga nasohhi ka pakai lengpa dinga pohgih kibe nabep kahiding ham?"},"36":{"text":"Nasoh hi lengpa toh Jordan gal themkhat chebeding kahi: ipidinga hitobang thilpeh-a hi lengpan neilethuh got ham?"},"37":{"text":"Nahenga katao ahi, nasohhi kakhopia kathi-a kanule kapa lhanna kakivui theina dingin, neinungsol tan. Ahinla ven, nasoh Chimham hi; amahi ka pakai lengpa toh lhonhen lang, nangman apha hidinga kilom nasah dungjuijin achunga hin boltan, ati."},"38":{"text":"Chuin lengpan adonbutnin, Chimham hi keimatoh kilhon ding ahin, chule keima ama chunga hi apha hidinga kilom kasah dungjuija kabolding ahi. Chule ipi hitajongle keima-a kona nangaichat chu kabolpeh ding nahi, ati."},"39":{"text":"Chuin mijouse Jordan agalkai taovin ahi. Chuin lengpa ahung galkai phatnin, lengpan Barzillai chu achopmin, chule phatthei aboh-in; chuin ama aumna lama akile kittan ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chujouvin lengpa Gilgal'a achen, chule Chimham chu amatoh alhonin ahi. Chuin Judah mijouse le Israel mipi akehkhat chun lengpa ahin puijun ahi.","title":"Lengpa Chungchanga Judah Le Israel Kinel"},"41":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, Israel mipi ho jouse chu lengpa henga ahungun, lengpa jah-a, Ipidinga Judah mi kasopi hon nangma naguh manguva, lengpa le a-insungmi chule David'in aumpi miho jouse chu apui galkaiju ham? atiuve."},"42":{"text":"Chuin Judah miho jouse chun Israel miho chu adonbutnun, Lengpa hi kakinaipiu ka-insungmiu ahijeh ahi. Chuti ahile ipidinga nangho hiche jeh-a hi lunghanga nahiuvem? Lengpa chohsa ne-a kahiuvem? ahiloule aman keiho thilpeh eipeh khah uvem? atiuve."},"43":{"text":"Chuin Israel miho chun Judah miho chu adonbutnun, Keihon lengpa-a chansom kaneijun, chule keihon nangho sangin David'a thaneina kaneijouvin ahi. Chuti ahile ipidinga lengpa galepui kitna dinga keiho thuhil chu masajo ahi chu i-sah louva bol nahiuvem? tiuve. Ahinla Judah miho thusei chu Israel miho thusei sangin ahatjon ahi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Benjamin Bikhri chapa Sheba kiti boinasem mikhat ana umin ahi. Chuin aman sumkon amutnin, Eihon David'a chan ineipouve, chule Jesse chapa-a konin jong goulo ding ineipouve: Vo Israel, naponbuh cheh uva chetaovin, ati.","title":"Sheba Kiphin","ref":"1 Leng 12:16; 2 Thusm 10:16."},"2":{"text":"Hitichun Israel mite jousen David adalhaovin, chuin Bikhri chapa Sheba chu ajuitaovin ahi. Ahivangin Jordan'a pat Jerusalem geija Judah mite vangchu alengpaova dingin apangdetnun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin David Jerusalem'a a-in ahung lhungin, chuin lengpan a-inngah dinga adalhah, numei thaikem somho chu insung dan khatna akoijin, avah-in, ahin amaho koma chun alut tapon ahi. Hitichun amaho chu athi nikho geijun khakhumin aumun, meithai bangin ahing taovin ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 16:22."},"4":{"text":"Chujouvin lengpan Amasa henga, Nithum sungin Judah mite neikhop khompeh inlang, chule nangma tahjong umin, ati."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun Amasa chu Judah mite khom dingin achen: ahinla David'in atepeh phat sangchun ahung geijotan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin David'in Abishai henga, Tu-a hi Bikhri chapa Sheba hin Absalom'in eibolnao sanga khohjo cheh-a eiboldiu hitam? Napakai sohte kipuijin lang ama chu nungdelin, achuti loule khopi kul kikai khum khat kimuntin, eihoa konin sohcha getninte, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chule ama nunga chun Joab miho, Chereth mite, Peleth mite le mihat ho jouse acheuvin; chuin amaho Bikhri chapa Sheba nung del dingin Jerusalem'a konin akipat doh-un ahi."},"8":{"text":"Amaho Gibeon mun songpilen phunga aumlaijun, Amasa chu amasanguva ahungin ahi. Tun Joab chu galvon'a kivon ahin, chule chu-a chu konggah um, chule akonga chu chemjam apaija kiheng kikhaija ahi; chuin ama malama achea ahile hichu ahung kitanglhan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in Amasa henga, Kasopi pa, nadam hinam? ati. Chuin Joab'in Amasa chop dingin akhut jetlama akhamulin amanin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahivangin Amasa chun Joab'in akhutna chemjam achoi chu ahepon ahi. Chuin aman hichea chun a-oipoh asut peh-in ahile, agil tolla alonglhan, avelin asunkit tapon; chuin ama athitan ahi. Hitichun Joab le sopipa Abishai chun Bikhri chapa Sheba chu anungdel lhontan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Joab miho khat chu Amasa koma adingin, Joab khohsah jouse le, David langa pang jouse chu Joab nunga cheohen, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Amasa chu lamlhong lailunga athin achupmin ahi. Chuin mipa chun mipi adinden chu amuphatnin, Amasa chu lamlhonga konin gamlah-a achondoh-in, chule akom hinhopa jouse adin dennu chu amuphatnin, ama chu ponkhat akhukhumin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ama lamlhonga akichondoh phatnin, mijouse Bikhri chapa Sheba nung del dingin Joab nunga acheuvin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule ama Abel gei le Beth-maachah geijin Israel phung jouse henga le Ber mite jouse henga achen ahi. Chuin amaho akikho khomun ama nung ajuitaove."},"15":{"text":"Chuin amaho ahungun amaho chu Beth-maachah'a um Abel mun'a chun aumkolun, chule amahon khopi dounan leibang asepmun, chule hichu kiselna leiko-a dinga ahin: Joab toh umkhom mipi jouse chun kulbang chu suhchim dingin asusepan ataovin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hichun khopi-a konchun numei chingtah khatnin ahin samin, Ngaijun, ngaijun; Joab henga katao ahi, nangma toh kakihou theina din, hilam hin naijin, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin amapa amanu henga ahungnai phatnin, numeinu chun ahenga, Nangma Joab nahim? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Keima ama chu kahi, ati. Hichun amanun ajah-a, Nasohnu thusei ho hi ngaijin, ati. Chuin aman Kangaije, atin adonbutnin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hichun amanun, Masanglai chun min, Amahon thonlouva Abel kho-a thumop adoh teidiu ahi, tin anasei jiuvin: chule hitichun thu chu achai jiuvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Keima Israel sunga chamna deile tahsan ho lah-a khat kahi. Nangman khopi khat le Israel minu khat suhmangdin naholin ahi. Ipidinga nangman Pakai goulo chu naval lhum ding ham? ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in adonbutnin, Keiman kaval lhum ding ahiloule kasuhmang ding chu keija konin gamlahen, keija konin gamlahen."},"21":{"text":"Athu chu chuti ahipoi: ahin Ephraim molsana kon mikhat Bikhri chapa amin Sheba chun David lengpa dounan akhut alamin ahi. Ama changseh chu hinpe doh-un, chule keiman khopi hi dalhatange, ati. Chuin numei nun Joab henga, Ven aluchang chu bang chunga kona kahin selhahpeh ding nahi, ati."},"22":{"text":"Hichun numeinu chu chingtheitah in mipi ho jouse henga chun achen ahi. Chuin amahon Bikhri chapa Sheba chu alu atanun, Joab henga asepdoh taovin ahi. Chuin aman sumkon amutnin, chuin amaho khopi-a konin ama ama pon-in cheh-a akile taovin ahi. Chuin Joab lengpa henga Jerusalem'a ahung kiletan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tun Joab chu Israel janel chunga ahin: chule Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chu Chereth mite le Peleth mite chunga ahi.","title":"David Milenho"},"24":{"text":"Chule Adoram chu kaidong pipu ahin; chule Ahilud chapa Jehoshaphat chu thuching ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule Sheva chu danthusun ahin; chule Zadok le Abiathar chu thempu ahilhone."},"26":{"text":"Chule Jair mi Ira chu David dinga vaihom pipu ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin David nikho laichun akum kum-in kum thum kel alhan ahile, David'in Pakai chu adongin ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin, Hichehi Saul le thisanso hat a-insung mite jeh ahi, ajehchu aman Gibeon mite chu ana thatnin ahi, tin adonbutne.","title":"Saul Chilhah ho Kitha"},"2":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Gibeon mite chu akouvin, ajah uva hitin ati; (tun Gibeon mite hi Israel chate ahipouvin, amavang Amor mite amoh ho ahiuve; chule Israel chate chu ahenguva ana kihahselu ahi: ahin Saul'in Israel le Judah chate-a dinga atompan nalama thadinga anahol ahi).","ref":"Josh 9:3-15"},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun David'in Gibeon mite henga, Nangho dinga ipi kabolpeh diuham? chule Pakai goulo hohi phatthei nabohna diuva, ipi-a longlhena kabol dingham? ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Gibeon mihon ajah-a, Keihon Saul ahiloule a-insunga kon sana dangka kadeipouvin, chule keiho-a dinga jong Israel sunga mi khatcha natha louding ahi, atiuve. Chuin aman, Nanghon nasei seiju chu kabolpeh ding nahiuve, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin amahon lengpa chu adonbutnun, Israel gamsung munkhat cha-a jong kaum louna diuva suhmang dingle thagam dinga eigopao thudola,"},"6":{"text":"Achapate pasal sagi chu keiho eikipedoh-uhen, chule keihon amaho chu Pakai henga, Pakaiyin analhen Saul umna Gibeah'a chun khaisang uvinge atiuve. Chuin lengpan, Amahochu kapeh dingu nahiuve, ati."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla lengpan Saul chapa Jonathan chapa Mephibosheth chu Pakai hahselna amaho kah, David le Saul chapa Jonathan kah-a aumjeh chun akhendoh-in ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 20:15-17; 2 Sam 9:1-7."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun lengpan Aiah chanu Rizpah'in Saul'a dinga ahinpeh achapateni Armoni le Mephibosheth le, Meholath mi Barzillai chapa Adriel dinga ahin Saul chanu Michal chapa ngaho chu alan,","ref":"1 Sam 18:19"},"9":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho chu Gibeoh miho khutna apedoh-in, chule amahon amaho chu Pakai masanga lhang chunga akhaijun ahi. Chuin amaho abonchauvin mi sagi chu chang-at nikho masapen, sakolchang ki-at tillin thakhatnin athat taovin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Aiah chanu Rizpah'in khaodip pon khat alan, chang-at kipatna pat van'a kona hicheho chunga twi ahung chuh tokahse-a ding chun amanu-a dingin songpi chunga aphan; chule sunle chungleng vachaho, chule janteng gamlah-a gamsaho chu achunguva achuh sahpon ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Saul thaikemnu Aiah chanu Rizpah'in athilbol chu David aseipeh taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin David achen, Saul le achapa Jonathan guho chu Jabesh-gilead mite koma konin agalan; hiche guho chu Philistine miten Gilbao mun'a Saul athajou uva, Beth-shan kholaija akhai naova kona ana guhdoh-u ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 31:8-13"},"13":{"text":"Chuin aman hia konchun, Saul le achapa Jonathan guho chu ahinpodoh-in; chule amahon akhailih hou guho chu alohkhomun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin amahon Saul le achapa Jonathan guho chu Benjamin gam Zelah mun'a apa Kish lhanna chun avuijun: chule amahon lengpa thupeh ho jouse atongdoh sohkeijun ahi. Chuin hiche jouchun Pathen'in gamsung mite taona chu angaipeh tan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hiche chungchon chun Philistine ten Israelte dounan gal ahinbol kitnun; chuin David le asohte chu akonsuh-un, Philistine te toh akisat taovin: chule David chu achol lheh jengtan ahi.","title":"Philistine Milen ho to Kidouna (1 Thusm 20:4-8)"},"16":{"text":"Chuin mihat chapate lah-a khat, atengcha chu sum-eng Shekel jathum-a gih Ishbi-benob kitipa chun, chemjam thah khat akikoijin, David chu thading agotan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahin Zeruiah chapa Abishai'in amachu ahunghuh doh-in, Philistine mipa chu asatnin, athat tan ahi. Chujouvin David miho chu ahenga akihahselun, Israel meivah kisuhmit louna dinga, nangma keihotoh galkona nachekit louding ahitai, atiuve.","ref":"1 Leng 11:36; Labu 132:17"},"18":{"text":"Chuin hiche jouchun ahitin ahi, Gob mun chun Philistine te toh akisat kit taovin; chuin Hushath mi Sibbachai chun Saph athatnin, amachu mihat chapate lah-a khat ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Gob mun'a chun Philistine te toh akisatpha kitnun, hilaija chun Benjamin mi Jaare-oregim chapa El-hanan'in Git mi Goliath sopipa chu athatnin, atenglung chu ponkhong ho pumlong te ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Gath mun'a chu gal akisat kitnun, hilaija chun mi atahsa lentah khat aumin, akhutjung gup chule akengjung gup, agoma somnileli ahin; chule mihat chihlhah ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin aman Israelte achou phatnin, David sopipa Shimea chapa Jonathan chun agathatnin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hicheng liho Gath'a mihatpa ding hungpeng ho, David khut le asohte khutna louho chu ahiuve."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin amelmate jouse khut le Saul khutna kona ahuhdoh nikhon, David'in Pakai koma hiche lachengho hi aseijin ahi.","title":"David Galjona La (Labu 18)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin aman, Pakai hi kasongpi le kakulpi, chule eihuhhingpu ahi;"},"3":{"text":"Kasongpi Pathen ahin; keiman ama katahsan ding ahi: Ama kalum le kasochatna ki, ka-insang le kahoidohna, kahuhhingpu ahin; nangman pumhatna konin neihuhdoh tai."},"4":{"text":"Keiman pachat dinga lomtah Pakai chu kakou ding: hiti achu kamelmaho-a kona huhdoh-a kaumding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Thina twi kinongin eium kimvel teng, Pathen heloute twisoh-in eikichatsah-e;"},"6":{"text":"Thikholkhul lungkham nan eium kimvelin, thina thanghon eikimaitopi-e."},"7":{"text":"Kagenthei tengle Pakai kakouvin, ka Pathen henga kapengin, Chule aman a-houin'a konin ka aw ahinjan, kapena chun anakhang sunga alutnin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hichun leiset akilingin akihotnin; van kibulphuna ho akihotnin, akilinge, ajehchu ama lunghanga ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin anah homa konin meikhu ahungdoh-in, chule akama kona meikong chun aval lhumin; hiche chun meihol ho chu ahal kong tan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aman van ho jong aloi nemin, chule ahung kumlhan; muthim chu akengto noija umin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule ama Cherub chunga atouvin, alengin; chule amachu hui lhavingho chunga akimun ahi."},"12":{"text":"Aman akimvela muthim lhangkhal akihehsah-in, twi thimjeju le van'a meilom satah ho chu."},"13":{"text":"Ama masang vah-a kon chun mei-am ho ahung aldoh-in ahi."},"14":{"text":"Pakaiyin vangin bangin a-aw ahin sodoh-in; chungnung pen chun thu ahin seijin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule aman thalpi ho akapdoh-in, chule athe jal-in; kol aphet sah-in, amaho chu ajoutan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Pakai phosalna le anahhoma ahu alhadoh-a konin; Twikhanglen toho chu akilangdoh-in, vannoi kibulphu naho jong akimudoh-in ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aman chunga konin ahinsolin, keima eiladoh-in; twi tamtah lah-a konin aman eikaidoh-in ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ka melma hattah ho-a konle eithetboltea konin eihuhdoh-in; ajehchu amaho keima dingin ahat behseh-un ahi."},"19":{"text":"Kahamsetna nikhon amahon eikimaitopi-un; ahinla Pakai chu kapanmun ahijinge."},"20":{"text":"Aman munlen tah-a jong eipuilutnin, kachunga akipa jeh-in eihuhdoh tai."},"21":{"text":"Pakaiyin kachon phatna dungjuijin kipaman eipen, kakhut teni thenna dungjuijin aman eilethuh-in ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman Pakai lampiho kajuijin, chule ka-Pathen'a konin giloutah-in kapot pon ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu ama thutan ho jouse kamasanga aumin: achonna dan kisunho thudola vang, keima hicheho-a konchun kapotdoh pon ahi."},"24":{"text":"Keima amasanga chondih tah kanahin; kakhangit louna-a konin kakikangsen ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin kachon phatna dungjui eilethuh-a; amitmu-a kathena dungjuijin eilethuh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hepina neite henga nangman hepinanei nahi namusah ding; michondih ho henga nangma chondih nahi nakimusah ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Mitheng ho henga atheng nahi nakimusah ding; milungkon te henga chingtah nahi nakimusah ding ahi"},"28":{"text":"Chule bolgentheija umte nangman nahuhdoh ding; mikiletsahte chu suhnema aumtheina dingun, namit chu achunguva aumin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ajehchu vo Pakai nangma kathaomei nahin; Pakaiyin kamuthim eisalvah pehding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma jala galmi honkhat douna kalhai ding; ka-Pathen jala bang kachop khup ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Pathen vang, alampi achamkimin; Pakai thu chu akipho chenin; ama tahsan te jouse dingin ama alumdalu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen tailou, Pakai koiham? chule Pathen tailou, koiham songpi?"},"33":{"text":"Pathen chu kathahatna le kathaneina ahin: aman kalampi achamkimsah-in ahi."},"34":{"text":"Aman kakeng sajuhnu keng bangin asemin; kamun sangho-a eitousah-in ahi.","ref":"Habk 3:19."},"35":{"text":"Kakhutnin thih thalpi ho ajetboh nadingin; Aman kakhut galbolje ahilin ahi."},"36":{"text":"Nangman nahuhhinga lumdal neipetan; nanun nem nachun keima lentah-in eisemdohtai."},"37":{"text":"Nangman kalhuh louna dingin, kanoija kakalsona ding neikeh letpeh-in ahi."},"38":{"text":"Keiman kamelmate kadelin, amaho kasumangin; chule amaho kasuh manghel kahsen kahungkile pon ahi."},"39":{"text":"Athokit theilouna diuvin keiman amaho kamavon, kasumang helin; henge, amaho kakengto noija alhusoh taovin ahi."},"40":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman galsatn-a dingin thahat na-in katai neigah peh-in; keima douna-a kipandoh hochu kanoija nakoitan ahi."},"41":{"text":"Nangman keima eihot bolte chu kasuhmang nadingin, kamelmate lolho chu neipedoh-in ahi."},"42":{"text":"Amahon aveovin, ahinla ahuhdohdiu koima aumpon; Pakai jengin jong amaho adonbutpon ahi."},"43":{"text":"Hichun keima amaho chu vutvai bangin kavongoijin, chule lamlen dunga bonlhoh bangin kachotphan, akithejalji taovin ahi."},"44":{"text":"Nangman kamite kiphinna-a konin neihuh doh-in, Pathen hephalouho luchang dingin neikoitai: kahet khahlou mihon eijen nadingu ahi."},"45":{"text":"Gamdang miho kahenga hungkipelut dingu: amahon ajah jah ule kasei angai dingu ahi."},"46":{"text":"Gamchom mihochu hung lhadah untin, chule akikul khupnao mun'a kona kicha ding ahiuve."},"47":{"text":"Pakai chu ahingjingin, chule kasongpi chu nunnom hen; huhhingna songpi Pathen chu choisangin umhen."},"48":{"text":"Kaphu eilah peh-a, mihemte kanoija sunema Pathen ahin,"},"49":{"text":"Chule kamelmate lah-a kona eipuidoh-a chu Pathen ahi: keima douna-a kipandoh ho chungvuma neidomsangin: mihuham ho-a konin neihuhdoh tan ahi."},"50":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu vo Pakai, Pathen hephalouho lah-a nangma thangvah ingting, chule namin vahchoi La kasah ding sange.","ref":"Rom 15:9."},"51":{"text":"Amachu aleng dinga sochatna insang ahin; chule athaonu David le achilhahte henga a-itih chanin hepina amusah-in ahi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun hiche hohi David thusei nunungpen ahitai. Chungnung pena dopsanga umpa le Jacob Pathen'in thao anu, chule Israelte lah-a lathempen Jesse chapa David'in aseitai;","title":"David Thuchaina ho"},"2":{"text":"Pakai lhagao chun keija konin thu aseidoh-in, chule athu kaleija achengin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Israel Pathen'in hitin aseijin, Israel songpin kajah-a hitin aseije, Mihem chunga vaihompa chu thudih ding, Pathen ging puma vai ahomding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule amachu meibol kailouni jingkah, nisa ahungso doh-a khovah tobang hiding; gojuh jouva leisetna kona thengsela hungdon doh h amhing tobang hiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ka-insung hi Pathen'a dingin chutobang chu hihih jongle; aman keimatoh tonsot kitepna asemin, thiljouse thonlou dingin kitoh tah-in akoijin ahi. Ajehchu aman hichehi kahuh hingna jousele kangaichat ho jouse chu ahi; aman akhantousah lou dingham?"},"6":{"text":"Ahinla Belial chapate chu ling kisatlha-a kipaidoh tobang hidingu ahi, ajehchu amaho khutna kiman theilou ahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla amaho gatongkha-a michu thih le tenglung ki-um khumding; chule amaho hiche mun'a chu meija kihalvam ding ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Hichehohi David'in anei mihat ho minchu ahi. Tachmon mite touna-a tou, lamkaiho lah-a pipu chu Ezni mi Adino ahi: aman mi jaget dounan atengcha alamin, amaho chu khatvei tha-in athat gamin ahi.","title":"David Sepai Minthangho (1 Thusm 11:10-14)"},"9":{"text":"Chule ama bantah-a chu ahile, David le amihat thumho lah-a khat, Ahoh mi Dodo chapa Eleazar ahin, amahon galsat dinga galmuna kikhom Philistine te agahchou laijun, Israel miho chu ajam mang taovin;"},"10":{"text":"Chuin ama akipatdoh-in, chemjam le akhut kikhen louvin, akhut angoi tokahsen Philistine te chu athatnin ahi. Chule hicheni chun Pakaiyin nasatah-in gal ajosah-un; chule mipi chu ama nunga thil kichom dingin akileuvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule ama bantah-a chu Harar mi Agee chapa Shammah ahi. Chuin Philistine te chu louthul dimsetna gambih khatna apunin akikhom khomun: chule mipi chu Philistinete-a konin ajamtaovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla ama loujao lailunga chun adingin, ngahtupmin apangin, chule Philistine te chu athatnin ahi. Hichun Pakaiyin nasatah-in agaljo sah-in ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule lamkai pipui somthum lah-a thum chu achesuh-un, chuin chang at laijin Adullam songkoa David henga ahungun: chule Philistine te sepaiho chun Rephaim phaichama gebuh akisonun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule David chu kosung khatna aumin, chule Philistine te sepaihon chu Bethlehem'a umuva ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin David'in ngaicha tah-in, Ohe Bethlehem kotpi phungkom twikul'a twi chu dondin mi khat touvin eihung pethei taveleh! ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin mihat thumho chun Philistine janelho lahchu aphujalun, Bethlehem kotpi phung koma um twikul'a twi chu athalun, chule David henga ahindomun ahi. Ahijeng vangin aman hichu adonpon, ahinla aman Pakai henga asunglhatan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule aman, Vo Pakai hiche kabol dinghi keija konin gamlahen: hiche ahinkhou tijat umtah-a dinga phaldoh miho thisan hilou ham? ati. Hijeh-a chu aman adon tapon ahi. Hiche mihat thumho hin hicheho hi aboldoh-u ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule Zeruiah chapa Joab sopipa Abishai chu thumho lah-a apipuipen ahi. Chuin aman mi jathum dounan atengcha chu alamin, amaho chu athatnin, chuin thumho lah-a chun aminthang tan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Amachu thumho lah-a ja umpen hilouham? Hijeh chun ama amaho gallamkai ahitai. Hijongle amasa thumho lah-a chun apang phapon ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Kabzeel'a mihangtah khat chapa Jehoiada chapa Benaiah, thil tamtah tongdohpa chun, keipi bahkai tobang Moab mini athatnin ahi. Chule aman buh lhahlaijin achesuh-in, kotong sung khatna keipi bahkai khat jong athatnin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin aman Egypt mi miphatah khat athatne: Egypt mipa chun akhutna tengcha akichoi ahin, hinlah aman tenggol khat achoijin achesuh-in, Egypt mipa khutna konchun tengcha chu alahpeh-in, ama tengcha mama-a chun ama chu athatnin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Jehoiada chapa Benaiah'in hiche thilhohi anabolin, chule mihat thumho lah-a chun ama aminthang tan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Amachu somthum hosangin ja aum cheh-in, ahinla amasa thumho chu aphapon ahi. Chuin David'in ama ngahtupho chungvuma akoitan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Joab sopipa Ashahel chu somthum holah-a khat ahin; Bethlehem'a um Dodo chapa Elhanan,"},"25":{"text":"Harod mi Shammah, Harod mi Elika,"},"26":{"text":"Palt mi Helez, Teko mi Ikkesh chapa Ira,"},"27":{"text":"Anathoth mi Abiezer, Hushath mi Mebunnai,"},"28":{"text":"Ahoh mi Zalmon, Netophah mi Maharai,"},"29":{"text":"Netophah mi Baanah chapa Heleb, Benjamin gam Gibeah'a kona Ribai chapa Ittai,"},"30":{"text":"Pirathon mi Benaiah, Gaash vacha dungho-a kon Hiddai."},"31":{"text":"Arbath mi Abialbon, Bahur mi Azmaveth,"},"32":{"text":"Shaalhon mi Eliahba, Jashen chapate lah-a Jonathan,"},"33":{"text":"Harar mi Shammah, Harar mi Sharar chapa Ahiam,"},"34":{"text":"Maachath chapa, Ahasbai chapa Eliphelet, Gilon mi Ahithophel chapa Eliam,"},"35":{"text":"Karmel mi Hezrai, Arbai mi Paarai,"},"36":{"text":"Zobah'a Nathan chapa Igal, Gad mi Bani,"},"37":{"text":"Ammon mi Zelek, Zeruiah chapa Joab galvonpopa Beeroth mi Naharai,"},"38":{"text":"Ithrite mi Ira le Ithrite mi Gareb,"},"39":{"text":"Hit mi Uriah ahiuvin, abonun mi somthum le sagi ahiove."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakai lunghanna chu Israelte dounan ahung koujah kittan, chuin amaho douna-a David atilin, Chenlang, Israel le Judah gasimin, atisah-in ahi.","title":"David'in Amite Asim (1 Thusm 21:1-27)"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu lengpan aumkhompi janel gal lamkaipa Joab henga, Amijat kahet theina dingin, tun chenlang Israel phungho jouse Dan'a pat Beersheba geijin gasimin, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in lengpa henga, Ka pakai lengpa mitnin amutheina dingin, Pakai na-Pathen'in amaho ijat hijeng jongleu ajat jakhat-in punsah hen: ahinla ipi dinga ka pakai lengpan hiche hohi nangaichat ham? ati."},"4":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin lengpa thu chu Joable janel lamkaiho chu anehjou jotan ahi. Chuin Joab le janel lamkaiho chu lengpa mitmu tah-in Israel mipi ho sim dingin apotdoh taovin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin amaho Jordan agalkaijun, Gad vachadung koma uma khopi jetlam Jazer langsang Aroer mun'a chun ponbuh asong taovin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin amaho Gilead le Tahtim-hodshi gam ahung lhungun; chuin amaho Dan-jaan le Zidon veldung ahung lhungun,"},"7":{"text":"Chule Tyre kulpi dettah le Hiv mite khopi jouse le Canaan miho khopi jouse-a ahungun: chuin amaho Judah lhang lamsang Beersheba changeijin acheuvin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hitichun amaho agamsung jouse-a acheleuvin, lhakole nisomni alhinin amaho Jerusalem ahung lhungun ahi"},"9":{"text":"Chuin Joab'in mipi akisimdoh jat chu lengpa apedohtan: chule Israelte lah-a chun mihangsan chemjam lamthei cheh sang jaget aumin, chule Judah miho lah-a chun mi sangjanga aume."},"10":{"text":"Chuin aman mipi asimjou phatnin David chu alung nalheh jengin ahi. Chuin David'in Pakai henga, Kana thilbol chungahin kachonse lheh jengtai: chule Vo Pakai, tu-a hi nahenga katao ahi, nasoh khangit lounahi ladoh in; ajehchu keiman ngolhoi tah-in na kanatongin ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Tun David jingkah-a ahungtho phatnin, Pakai thu chu David mitvah neipa Gad themgao henga ahungin, aseije,"},"12":{"text":"Chenlang David henga, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, keiman nangma thil thum kapei, nachunga kalhunsah dingin, thumlah-a hin khat penpen kilhenin, tin gaseijin ati."},"13":{"text":"Hitichun Gad David henga ahungin, amachu aseipeh-in, ajah-a, Nagam sunga kum sagi kel hunglha ding ham? ahiloule nangma namelmate masanga lhathum najama amahon nanung adeldiu ham? ahiloule nagamsunga hiset nithum lang dingham? Tun eihinsolpa henga kakilea kadonbut theina dingin neihilin, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin David'in Gad henga, Keima nasatah in kagenthei tai; tun eiho Pakai khutna kipelut jenguhite; ajehchu amihepina alenin ahi: chule mihem khutna vang lutpou hite, ati."},"15":{"text":"Hitichun Pakaiyin jingkah-a pat, aphat kitep geichun Israelte lah-a chun natset alhahsah tan ahi. Chutichun mipi lah-a konin Dan'a pat Beersheba geijin mi sangsomsagi athitan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Jerusalem suhmangna dinga vantil'in achunga akhut alap phatnin, Pakaiyin thilphalou abolgotna konin alung aheijin, mipi sumang ding vantil henga chun, Aphaset tai: nakhut chu tuhtang tan, ati. Chuin Pakai vantil chu Jebus mi Araunah pholla chun aumin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin David'in mipi ho sumang dinga vantil chu amuphatnin, Pakai henga, Ven keima giloutah-in kanachonin, kachonse tai: ahinla hiche kelngoiho hin ipiham abollu? nahenga katao ahi, nakhut chu keima le kapa insung dounan chujohen, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chule hicheni chun David henga Gad ahungin, ajah-a, Kipatdoh-in, Jebus mi Araunah pholmuna khun Pakai dingin maicham khat gasemin, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thupeh le Gad seidung juijin David achetoutan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Araunah'in aven ahile lengpa le asohte chu ahenglama ahung amun ahi. Chuin Araunah chu achedoh-in, lengpa masanga chun tolla amai asulut tan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Araunah'in, Ipi dinga ka pakai lengpa hi asoh henga hunga ham? ati. Chuin David'in, Mipi ho-a kona natset suhtanga aumna dinga, Pakaiya dinga maicham khat semna dinga nachangphol chodinga hunga kahi, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Araunah'in David henga, Ka pakai lengpan aman phante atibang chun kilah henlang pejenghen: Ven, hikoma hin govam thilto-a toding bongchal, chule thinga manding changphola manchah ho le bongchal manchah dangho aumin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hicheho jousehi Araunah'in lengpa dinga abola apehdoh ahi, ati. Chuin Araunah'in lengpa henga, Pakai na-Pathen'in nasanpehhen, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Araunah henga, Ahipoi, keiman thonlouva nangma-a kona aman uma kachoh ding ahi: chule keiman imacha suhmang louhela Pakai ka-Pathen henga govam thilto katolou ding ahi, ati. Hitichun David'in changphol le bongchalho chu dangka shekel somnga in achotan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin David'in hia chun Pakaiya dingin maicham khat asemin, govam thilto hole chamna thiltoho atohtan ahi. Hitichun Pakaiyin gamsung taona chu angaipeh-in, chule Israelte lah-a konin natset chu akitolmang tan ahi."}}}}},"11":{"info":{"name":"1 Lengte","shortname":"1 Leng","abbr":[],"desc":"Lengte Lekhabu Khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun leng David chu ateh-in kum tamtah ahitan, chuin pon tamtah asilpeh-un, ahinla lum asajoupoi.","title":"Abishag'in David Lengpa Ajen"},"2":{"text":"Hijeh chun asohten ahenga, ka pakai lengpa dingin khangdong nungah theng khat kihol hen, amanu lengpa anga dinghen lang, vesuihen lang, chule ka pakai lengpa tilumthei nadin, na-anga lumjihen, atiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chutichun amahon Israel gamsung pumpi-a nungah hoitah khat aholuvin ahile, Shunam mi Abishag amuvin, lengpa henga ahinpui taove."},"4":{"text":"Nungahnu chu ahoilheh jengin, lengpa chu avesuijin, ajenletan ahi. Ahinla lengpan amanu chu akitimatpi pon ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuphatnin Haggith chapa Adonijah chu ama akichoisangin, keima kalengchan ding ahi, tin kangtalai ho le sakol touthemho, chule mi somnga amasanga lhaidin akigottan ahi.","title":"Adonijah'in Laltouna Achu","ref":"2 Sam 3:5."},"6":{"text":"Chule apan, ibola hitobang nabol ham? tin adongin alungnatsah khapoi.
