Nithum chan nile nangma Pakai in'a nachetou ding ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Nahinkho kum somle kum nga kajopbea, nangmale hiche khopihi Assyria lengpa khutna kona kahuhdoh ding; chule hiche khopihi keima le keima kikhoh sahna jaleh kasoh David kakhohsahna jala kahonbit ding ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Isaiah'in, theichang pheng khat hinlaovin ati. Chuin ahinlaovin uilut chunga chu akoijun ahile a-ol domtan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Hezekiah'in Isaiah jah-a, Pakaiyin eidamsah dingle nithum ni-a Pakai in'a kachetou nading melchihna chu ipi hintem? ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Isaiah'in, Pakaiyin aseisa chu aboltei ding ahi tihi nangma-a dinga Pakaiya kona namelchihna chu ahi: nilim chu kalsom machon dingham, ahiloule kalsom nungchon dingham? ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Hezekiah'in adonbutnin, nilim dinga kalsom chesuh dinghi thil bailam ahin; hichu hidahen, ahinla nilim chu kalsom kinungchon johen, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Isaiah themgao chu Pakai henga ataovin; Ahaz nidan melchih na-a kumlhasa nilim chu kalsom ahinlepui kitnin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hiche laichun Babylon lengpa Baladan chapa Berodach-baladan'in Hezekiah henga lekhathot le thilpeh ahinthotnin ahi: ajehchu aman Hezekiah chu anai ti ajan ahi.","title":"Babylon'a Kona Thupole ho (Isai 39:1-8)"},"13":{"text":"Chuin Hezekiah'in amahochu ana sasah-in, athillu koina in jouse, dangka, sanaho, gimnamtui ho, thao mantamho, agalvon koina in jouse, chule agou kholna-a umjouse avetsah sohkeijin; a-insungle alenggam jouse Hezekiah'in amaho amusahlou khatcha aumpon ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chujouvin Isaiah themgao chu Hezekiah lengpa henga ahungin, ajah-a, hiche teho hin ipi aseijum? hoija kona nahenga hunguva ham? ati. Chuin Hezekiah'in amaho gamlatah-a Babylon'a kona hunga ahiuve, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin aman, na insunga hi ipipi amutah um? ati. Chuin Hezekiah'in adonbutnin, ka-insunga thil umjouse amutaove; kagouho lah-a kavetsahlou khatchabeh aumpoi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Isaiah'in Hezekiah jah-a, Pakai thuhi ngaijin,"},"17":{"text":"Vetan, na-insunga umjouse le napan tunigeija anakhol khomho chu Babylon gamsunga apohlutna dingu nikho hunglhung ding; imacha khen umlou ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"2 Leng 24:13; 2 Thusm 36:10"},"18":{"text":"Chule nangma nahin, nangma-a kona hungpot ding nachapate chu apuimangdiu; chule amaho chu Babylon lengpa leng insunga Nukiso ho hiding ahiuve, ati.","ref":"2 Leng 24:14-15; Dan 1:1-7"},"19":{"text":"Chuphatnin Hezekiah'in Isaiah henga, nangin naseidoh Pakai thuchu apha ahi. Chule aman, kahinkho sungbeh-a hi chamna le thutah aumle, hichu apha hijeng lou ham? ati."},"20":{"text":"Chule Hezekiah thilbol danghole athaneina jouse, chule twikul le twilam iti asema, chule khopi sunga twi iti ana lahlut ham tiho chu, Judah lengte thusimbua kisunlutna hilouham?","title":"Hezekiah Lengvaipoh Kichai (2 Thusm 33:1-20)"},"21":{"text":"Chuin Hezekiah chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, chule achapa Manasseh chu ama khelin alengchang tai."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh alengchan patchun kum somle kum ni ahin, ama Jerusalem'a kum somnga le kum nga analeng change. Chule anu minchu Hephzi-bah ahi.","title":"Judah Gama Manasseh Lengvaipoh (2 Thusm 33:1-20)"},"2":{"text":"Chule aman Israelte masanga Pakaiyin ananodoh, Pathen helouho thil thet um bolji ho bangchun, Pakai mitmun thilse anabolin ahi.","ref":"Jer 15:4"},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu apa Hezekiah'in asuhmangsa munsang ho atungdoh kitnin; Israel leng Ahab bol bangin Baal maicham atungdoh in, thingbom asemin, van janelpi ahouvin, ajentaovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pakaiyin Jerusalem'a kamin kaum sah ding ahi atina, Pakai in'a chun maicham ho asemin ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 7:13"},"5":{"text":"Chuin aman Pakai in hongsung teni-a chun van janelho jousedin maicham ho aseme."},"6":{"text":"Chuin aman achapa chu meija kilhaina-in amangin, phat ho anitnin, kilhimna ho amangchan, lhakou le doithemho amangin: lungsat sah-a lunghansah nadin, Pakai mitmun khangitlouna tamtah abolin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aman thingbom milim asem chu Pakai in'a chun atungdoh-e, hiche houin chungchang hi Pakaiyin David le achapa Solomon henga, hiche in le Jerusalem hi a-imatih chana kamin umjing nadinga, Israel phung jouse-a kona kalhendoh ahin,","ref":"1 Leng 9:3-5; 2 Thusm 7:12-18"},"8":{"text":"Keiman amaho kathupeh jouse dungjuile, kasoh Mosi'n amaho athupeh jouse dungjuija boldinga anit pou ule, apu apateu kanapehna leisetna kona Israel ten akalu asondoh louhel dingu ahi, anati."},"9":{"text":"Ahinla amahon angaipouvin; Pakaiyin Israel chate masanga anasuhmang namho bolsanga phaloujo cheh-in Manasseh'in miho chu alhemlha tai."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin asoh themgaoho-a thu aseijin,"},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu Judah lengpa Manasseh in hichethil thet umtah abola, amaho masanga Amor mihon abol jouseu vuma giloutah-a abola, Judah jong milim houva achonsetsah jeh hin;"},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, veuvin, hiche thuhi ajapha chanin anakol teni kichih lahlah leuva ajah nadinga, keiman Jerusalem le Judah chunga thilse kalhunsah ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule Samaria tena khao le Ahab insung tena thihkhai chu Jerusalem chunga kaman ding; min kong asoptheng banga Jerusalem kasuhtheng ding, chule kabung butun ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule kagou chan amoh chengse chu kadalhah-a, amelmateu khutna kapehdoh ding; chule amaho amelmateuva dinga anchahle thil kichom hidiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu apateu Egypt'a kona ahungdoh uva pat tunigei hin kamitmun thilphalou jeng aboluvin, kalunghan nadin eilungsat sah-un ahi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chukal vallin Manasseh hin themona bei thisan aso tambeh seh'in, Jerusalem dunglevai adip jengin; ama chonset tilouvin Judah jong achonsetsah-in, hitichun Pakai mitmun thilse jeng abolin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tun Manasseh thilbol danghole chonsetna abol hochu Judah lengte thusimbua kisuna hilouham?"},"18":{"text":"Chuin Manasseh apu apate toh alumkhomin; a-in'a ama honsungtah, Uzza honsunga avuitaovin: achapa Amon ama khelin alengchang tai."},"19":{"text":"Amon alengchan patchun kum somni le kumni ahin, Jerusalem'a kumni alengchange. Anu minchu Meshullemeth ahin, Jotbah kho-a Haruz chanu ahi.","title":"Judah Gama Amon Lengvaipoh (2 Thusm 32:21-25)"},"20":{"text":"Aman apa Manasseh bolbangin Pakai mitmun thilphalou jeng abolin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule apa chena lampi chu ajotnin, apan milim kin abol hochu abolin, amaho chu ahouvin,"},"22":{"text":"Hitichun apu apate Pakai Pathen chu adalhan, Pakai lamlhah chu ajotpon ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Amon sohte chun ama dounan guhthimin thilgon aneijun, lengpa chu ama in'a athat taove."},"24":{"text":"Ahinla chuche gam miho chun Amon lengpa changlhiho chu athatgam helun; chuche gam miho chun achapa Josiah chu ama khelin alengchansah taove."},"25":{"text":"Tun Amon'in anabol anatoh dangho chu Judah lengte thusimbua kisuna hilou ham?"},"26":{"text":"Chuin ama chu Uzza honsunga lhana chun avuijun, achapa Josiah ama khelin alengchang tai."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah chu alengchan kipat chun kum get ahin, ama Jerusalem'a kum somthumle kumkhat aleng changin ahi. Chule anu minchu Jedidah ahin, Boskath kho-a Adaiah chanu ahi.","title":"Judah Gama Josiah Lengvaipoh (2 Thusm 34:1-2)","ref":"Jer 3:6."},"2":{"text":"Chuin aman Pakai mitmu-a thil dihtah abolin, apa David lamlhah jouse ajotnin, jetle veija akiheidohpon ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Josiah lengchan kumsomle kum getna-in, lengpan Meshullam chapa Azaliah chapa Shaphan lekhasun chu Pakai in'a asolin, aseije,","title":"Dan Thu Lekhabu Kimudoh (2 Thusm 34:8-28)"},"4":{"text":"Thempu chungnung Hilkiah henga chetouvin lang, kotngah hon miho-a kona alahkhomu, Pakai in'a kipo dangka chu simhen,"},"5":{"text":"Chule Pakai in'a natongho vesuiho khutna pedoh uhen; chule amahon houin selai semphat nadingin, Pakai in'a um natongho,"},"6":{"text":"Thingthem bol hole insaho chule songthem bolho hengah, insemphat nading thingtumle song kikhengho choh nadingin peson uhen, ati."},"7":{"text":"Ahivangin amahon tahsan umtah-a aboljeh-un, akhutnuva kipelut sumho chu vetsuina aumpoi.","ref":"2 Leng 12:15"},"8":{"text":"Chuin thempu chungnung Hilkiah'in lekhasun Shaphan jah-a, danthupeh lekhabu chu Pakai in'a kamutai, ati. Chuin Hilkiah'in lekhabu chu Shaphan apen, aman hichu asimtan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin lekha sunpa Shaphan chu lengpa henga ahungin hitihin thu ahinlhut tai; nasohten in'a um sumho chu natongho khutna Pakai insa-a natongho apesoh hel taove, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin lekha sunpa Shaphan'in lengpa henga, Hilkiah thempupan lekhabu khat eipei, tin lengpa avetsah tai. Chuin Shaphan'in lengpa masanga hichu asimtai."},"11":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, lengpan danthupeh lekhabua thuchu ajah phatnin, apon abottelin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin lengpan Hilkiah thempu, Shaphan chapa Ahikam, Michaiah chapa Achbor, lekhasun Shaphan, lengpa sohpa Asahiah chu thu apen,"},"13":{"text":"Cheovin, Pakai chu keima dingle mipi ho-a ding, chule Judah te jousedin hiche akimudoh lekhabua thu umho chungchang thuhi neigadop peh-un; ajehchu ijuidiuva hiche lekhabua kijih jousehi ipu ipateovin ajuilou jeh-un, ichunguva Pakai lungsatna deujeju ahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Hitichun Hilkiah thempu, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, Asahiah chu ponsil chingtupma pang Harhas chapa Tikvah chapa Shallum inneipi Huldah themgaonu henga acheuvin,(Amachu Jerusalem vengsahlama cheng ahin,) amanu aga kihoupiu vin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin amanun ajah uvah, Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, kahenga nahinsolpao jah-a chun seipeh taovin,"},"16":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin ati, vetan, Judah lengpan asim lekhabua thucheng jouse banga chu, hikom munle asunga chengho jouse chunga thil phaloutah kalhunsah ding ahi:"},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu akhutsohho jouse-a eilung hansah theina dinguvin, amahon keima eidalhao vin, pathen dangho henga gimnamtui ahaluvin ahi; hijeh-a chu hiche mun douna-a hi kalungsatna deujah jengding, chule kisumit louding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai dopdinga nahin soluvah Judah lengpa henga chun hitihin seijun, Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, nathu jah ho chungchanga;"},"19":{"text":"Hiche mun le asunga chengho chungchanga kathusei, amaho akamhel le sapset chang hung hidiu ahi tia kasei najah phatna nalung anema, Pakai anga nakineosah-a, napon nabotel jenga, kamasanga naka jeh-in; keiman nataona kasangtai tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun vetan, keiman nangma napu napate henga kapuiding, nalhansunga lhamong tah-a kipuilut ding nahin; hiche mun'a thilse kalhunsah dingchu namitna namulouhel ding ahi, tin gaseipeh-un ati. Hitichun hiche thuchu lengpa henga agalhut taovin ahi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin lengpan mi asolin, Judah gam le Jerusalem'a upaho jouse ahenga akhomin ahi.","title":"Josiah'in Milimhou Asuhmang (2 Thusm 34:3-7 , 29-33)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin lengpa chu Judah mi jousele Jerusalem'a cheng jouse, chule thempuho le themgaoho, chule mijouse, alenle aneo agomin amatoh Pakai in'a achetouvun; Pakai in'a kimu kitepna lekhabua thujouse chu nakhang jouse jah dingin asimin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin lengpa chu khompi koma adingin, Pakai nung juidingle, adan thupeh ho, athu hettohsah ho, achondan kisunho chu alungthim pumpi le ahinna pumpi-a juiding le, hiche lekhabua kisun kitepna ho jouse tongdoh dingin, Pakai angsunga chun kitepna aneijin ahi. Chule mipi jouse chun kitepna chu adin piuvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule lengpan thempu chungnung Hilkiah, anoidou thempuho, chule kotngah ho chu Baal ding, thingbom ding, chule van janelpi dinga kisem um le bel jouse Pakai in'a kona ladohdin thu apen ahi. Chuin aman hicheho chu Jerusalem pama Kidron loujaova agouvin, avamho chu Bethel'a apotai.","ref":"2 Leng 21:3; 2 Thusm 33:3."},"5":{"text":"Chule aman milimhou thempuho, Judah khopiho le Jerusalem kimvel munsang ho-a gimnamtui haldia Judah lengten anapansah hou; Baal, nisa, lhathah, vantham jola umho, chule van janelho henga gimnamtui hal hochu, ahaisah gamtai."},"6":{"text":"Chule aman thingbom chu Pakai in'a konin Jerusalem pamlam, Kidron vachadunga apodoh-in; Kidron vachadunga ahalvamin, dijetnin achil ngemin, adi chu mipi ho chate buikhuh chunga apaijin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule Pakai in koma pasal kijoh ho umna, thingbom dinga numei hon pon akhon jinao inho chu asuchim gamtan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule Judah khopiho-a konin thempu jouse apuidoh-in, thempuho ginnamtui halna munsang ho Geba'a pat Bersheba geijin asuboh soh helin; khopi kotpi lutna veilam sanga khopi vaipo Joshua kotpi lutna-a munsang ho chu asuchimin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Munsang thempuho chu Jerusalem'a Pakai maichama ahunglou vangun, asopiteu lah-a chol solou changlhah vang ane naove."},"10":{"text":"Chule koimachan achapa ahiloule achanu Molech koma meija alelut louna din, Hinnom chate phaichama um Tophet chu asuboh'in ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:21; Jer 7:31; 19:1-6; 32:35."},"11":{"text":"Chule Pakai in lutna, lengpa noidou Nathan-melech indan koma um, Judah lenghon nisa dinga apeh-u sakol ho chu aladoh-in; nisa kangtalai ho chu meijin ahalin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule Ahaz indan chungnung vuma Judah lenghon maicham asemhou, chule Manasseh'in Pakai inhong teni sunga maicham asemho chu lengpan avochimin, asubongin, aleivuiju chu Kidron vachadunga apai lutnin ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 21:5; 2 Thusm 33:5"},"13":{"text":"Chule Jerusalem masang, kitahlouna molsang jetlama um munsang ho, Israel lengpa Solomon'in Zidon mite pathen thet umtah Ashtoreth ding, Moab miho Pathen thet umtah Chemosh ding, Ammon chate pathen thet umtah Milcom dinga anasah hochu, lengpan asubohtan ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 11:7"},"14":{"text":"Chuin milimho chu ahal halin asuchipmin, chule thingbomho chu aphuh lhun, amunho chun mihem gubuh-in adipme."},"15":{"text":"Chukal valin Israelte chonsetsah Nebat chapa Jeroboam'in Bethel'a maicham le munsang asem munho chu asuchim soh-in; munsang chu ahalvamin, achil ngemin, thingbom chu ahalvamtai.","ref":"1 Leng 12:33."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Josiah agakiheile mola lhanho chu ahinmun, mi asolin, lhana konin guho chu agalahsah-in, hiche thu anasei, Pathen mipan anaphondoh Pakai thu dungjuijin, maicham chunga chun ahalvamin, asubohtai.","ref":"1 Leng 13:2"},"17":{"text":"Chuphatnin aman, khuche kagah mukhu ipi songphu ham? ati. Chuin khopi miho chun, Pathen mi, Judah gama kona hunga Bethel maicham chunga nathilbol saho hung seichoi masapa lhan ahi, tin ahiluve.","ref":"1 Leng 13:30-32"},"18":{"text":"Chuin aman limsah hih-un, koiman aguchu suloh hih-un, ati. Hitichun Samaria'a kona hung kipotou themgaoho gutoh umkhom louvin, achomkoi taove."},"19":{"text":"Chule Israel lengten Pakai lunghan sahna-a asah-u, Samaria khopiho-a munsang inho jouse jongchu, Joshiah'in alamangin, Bethel'a abol bangin abolsoh keijin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule munsang thempuho jouse jongchu maicham chunga athatnin; mi guho chu achunguva ahalin; chuin Jerusalem'a akiletai."},"21":{"text":"Chuin lengpan mijouse henga, hiche kitepna lekhabua kisun banghin, Pakai na Pathen'u henga kalchuh kut mangun, tin thu apei.","title":"Josiah'in Kalchuh Kut Aman (2 Thusm 35:1-19)"},"22":{"text":"Tabbeh-in Israelte chunga thutan hon thu atan laijuva pat, Israel leng tele Judah lengte nikholai jousen jong, chutobanga kalchuh kut chu ana umkhapon ahi."},"23":{"text":"Josiah lengchan kal kum somle kumget na-in, chuche kalchuh kut chu Jerusalem'a Pakai dingin ananei bepmun ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chukal valin Pakai in'a thempu Hilkiah'in amudoh lekhabua danthupeh kisunho suhbulhit ahina dingin, lhakou ho, doithemho, milimho, alim kisunthu bolho, chule le Judah gamle Jerusalem'a thil thet um amujiho jouse chu Josiah'in asumang soh hele.","title":"Josiah Semthahna Dang Dangho"},"25":{"text":"Mosi danthupeh dungjuija Pakai lama alungthim pumpi, alhagao pumpi, chule athaneinao pumpi-a kipe-a amatobang leng khatcha anaumpon, anungin jong ama tobang khatcha jong aum tapoi."},"26":{"text":"Achuti jeng vangin Pakai chun alunghana tijat umtah, Manasseh'in alunghan sahna jouse jeh-a, Judah chunga alunghana deujejua konchun adai lhadeh pon ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin, Israel kachon mang banga, Judah jonghi kamitmu-a kona kachon mang ding ahin; keiman kalhentum hiche khopi Jerusalem le, chu-a chu kamin umding ahi tia kanaseina hiche houin hi kapaidoh ding ahi, ati."},"28":{"text":"Tun Josiah thilbol dangho le anatoh jouse chu Judah lengte thusimbua kisuna hilouham?","title":"Josiah Lengvaipoh Kichai (2 Thusm 35:20—36:1)"},"29":{"text":"Ama nikho laijin Egypt lengpa Pharoah-nechoh chu Assyria lengpa satdin Euphrates luipi-a akon touvin: chuin Josiah lengpa chu amapa kidoupidin achen; chuin Pharoah-nechoh'in ama amu phatnin Megiddo'a athat tai."},"30":{"text":"Chuin asohten Megiddo'a konin kangtalai khatna athilong chu apouvin, Jerusalem alhutnun, amatah lhana avuitaove. Chuin gamsung mite chun Josiah chapa Jehoahaz apuijun, thao anuvin, apa khelin lengin apansah taove."},"31":{"text":"Jehoahaz alengchan patnin kum somni le kum thum ahin; Jerusalem'a lhathum aleng changin ahi. Anu minchu Hamutal ahin, Libnah'a Jeremiah chanu ahi.","title":"Judah Gama Jehoahaz Lengvaipoh (2 Thusm 36:2-4)"},"32":{"text":"Chule aman apu apate thilbol jouse bangin, Pakai mitmun thilphalou jeng abolin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Pharoah-nechoh chun Jerusalem'a alengchan theilouna dingin, Hamath gama um Riblah'a ahen nin; chule agamu chu dangka talent jakhat le sana talent khat kai apohsah tan ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Pharoah-nechoh chun Josiah chapa Eliakim chu apa Josiah indan sunga chun alengchan sah-in, aminchu Jehoiakim'in akhelin, Jehoahaz chu apuimangtai. Chuin Pharoah'in Jehoahaz chu Egypt'a apuisuh-in, chua chun Jehoahaz athitai.","ref":"Jer 22:11-12"},"35":{"text":"Chuin Jehoiakim'in dangka le sana chu Pharoah apen; ahinla Pharaoh thupeh dungjuija sum pehdingin gamsung chu kai apohsah cheh-in ahi. Aman Pharoad-nechoh pehdinga mitin ateppeh cheh bangtah-in, chuche gam miho chu dangka le sana kaijin apehsah cheh-in ahi.","title":"Judah Gama Jehoiakim Lengvaipoh (2 Thusm 36:5-8)"},"36":{"text":"Jahoiakim chu alengchan tilin kum somni le kum nga ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somle kum khat alengchange. Chule anu minchu Zebudah ahin, Rumah mi Pedaiah chanu ahi.","ref":"Jer 22:18-19; 26:1-6; 35:1-19."},"37":{"text":"Chule aman apu apate bolho jouse bangin Pakai mitmun thilphalou ngen abolin ahi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama nikho laichun Babylon lenga Nabuchadnezzar ahungtouvin, Jehoiakim chu kumthum asoh-in ahung pangin; chujouvin akile heijin chule ama douvin ahung pangtai.","ref":"Jer 25:1-38; Dan 1:1-2."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin ama doudin Chaldea loiho, Syria loiho, Moab loiho, chule Ammon chate asolin, Pakaiyin themgaoho kama anasei thu dungjuijin, Judah douva sumangdingin asoltan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tabbeh-in Manasseh chonsetna ho jouse le athilbolho jouse dungjuija, amitmua kona chondoh nadinga, Pakaiya kona hiche thupeh hi hunglhunga ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule themonabei thisan asojeh jong ahi: ajehchu Jerusalem chu monabei thisan sonan adiptan, Pakaiyin angaidam louding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tun Jehoiakim thilbol danghole atoh jouse chu Judah lengte thusimbua kisuna hilouham?"},"6":{"text":"Hitichun Jehoiakim apu apate toh alumkhomin, achapa Jehoiachin ama khelin alengchang tai."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Egypt lengpa chu agama konin ahungkit tapoi: ajehchu Babylon lengpan Egypt vapidunga kona Euphrates vadunglen gei, Egypt lengpa gamhop jouse alah ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Jehoiachin chu alengchan patnin kum somle kumget ahin, chule Jerusalem'a lhathum alengchange. Chule anu minchu Nehusta ahin, Jerusalem'a um Elnathan chanu ahi.","title":"Judah Gama Jehoiachin Lengvaipoh (2 Thusm 36:9-10)"},"9":{"text":"Chuin aman apa thilbol jouse dungjuijin Pakai mitmun thilse jeng abolin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hiche laichun Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar sohpa Jerusalem dounan ahung touvin, khopi chu aumkul taovin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khopi doudinga chu ahungleh, asohten anaumchah taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Judah lengpa Jehoiachin chu ama le anu, asohte, amilenho, avaipoho toh Babylon lengpa henga achedoh-un; chuin alengchan kumget lhinin Babylon lengpan sohchangin akaitai.","ref":"Jer 22:24-30; 24:1-10; 29:1-2"},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin anasei bangchun, Pakai in'a goujouse le leng in'a goujouse chu hiche mun'a konchun apodoh-in, Pakai houin'a Israelte lengpa Solomon'in sana kong leh bel anasem jouse chu avokeh sohkeijin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Jerusalem'a mijouse, milen jouse, mihatle mihang jouse chu gal hing sangsom jen akaijin, khutthem jousele thih khengho jouse chu apuimang soh helin: gamsunga chun mipi avaicha dehho tailou koimacha aumtapoi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Jehoiachin chu Babylon'a apui mangin, chule lengpa nu, lengpa jiteho, avaipoho, chule chuche gama mihat ho chu Jerusalem'a konin gal hingin Babylon'a akaitai.","ref":"Jer 27:1-22."},"16":{"text":"Chule pasal hatjouse chu sangsagi jen, khutthemhole thih khengho sangkhat ahiuvin, amaho chu mihat le gal bolthei cheh ahiuvin, Babylon lengpan gal hingin Babylon'a akaitai."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Babylon lengpan Jehoiachin pa sopipa Mattaniah chu ama khelin alengchan sah-in, amin akhelpeh-in Zedekiah asahtai.","title":"Zedekiah Lengchan Phatmo"},"18":{"text":"Zedekiah alengchan patnin kum somni le kum khat ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somle kum khat alengchange, chule anu minchu Hamutal ahin, Libnah kho-a Jeremiah chanu ahi.","title":"Judah Gama Zedekiah Lengvaipoh (2 Thusm 36:11-12 ; Jer 52:1-3)"},"19":{"text":"Chule Jehoiakim'in anabol bangin Pakai mitmun thilphalou jeng anabolin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai lunghan na-a kona Jerusalem le Judah gamsung chu a-angsunga kona apaidoh kahse-a chuti chu soh-a ahi. Chuin Zedekiah chu Babylon lengpa dounan akiphin tan ahi.","ref":"Ezek 17:15"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Zedekiah lengchan kal kum ko na, lha somna, chuche lha nisom na-in ahitin ahi, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar chu, amale asepaite toh Jerusalem dounan ahung konun, pal akai khumun, akimvela kul akai khumun ahi.","title":"Jerusalem Khopi Chim (2 Thusm 36:13-21 ; Jer 52:3-11)","ref":"Jer 21:1-10; 34:1-5; Ezek 24:2."},"2":{"text":"Zedekiah lengpa lengchan kal kum somle kum khat na-in, khopi chu aum kimvel taove."},"3":{"text":"Chuin lha lina ni ko nichun khopi-a chun kel alhan, gamsung miho dingin an himhim aumtapoi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin khopi chu asukeh-un, galsatmi jouse chu lengpa honna kulbang ni kikah lampia chun jan-in ajamun; (tun Chaldea te chun khopi chu aum khumu ahin,) chuin lengpa chu phaicham lampi lama chun achen ahi.","ref":"Ezek 33:21"},"5":{"text":"Chuin Chaldea sepaihon lengpa chu anung delun, Jericho phaichama aphapa taovin; asepaite jouse chu ama-a konin akithecheh taove."},"6":{"text":"Hitichun lengpa chu amanun, Babylon lengpa henga Riblah'a apuitouvun; achungthu atan taove."},"7":{"text":"Chuin amahon Zedekiah chapate chu ama mitmu tah-in athatnun, chule Zedekiah chu amit akaldoh-un, sum-eng khaovin akanun, Babylon lama apuitaove.","ref":"Ezek 12:13"},"8":{"text":"Chuin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kal kum somle kumko na, alha ngana, chuche lha nisagi nichun, Babylon lengpa sohpa vetup ho gal lamkai Nebuzaradan chu Jerusalem'a ahungin;","title":"Jerusalem Houin Kisuhset (Jer 52:12-23)"},"9":{"text":"Pakai in le lengpa in, chule Jerusalem'a injouse le milentakip in chu meijin ahallha gamtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin vetup vaipopa henga um chaldea sepai jouse chun, Jerusalem kimvela kulbangho chu asuchim gam taove."},"11":{"text":"Tun khopi sunga kidalha mipi dangho, chule Babylon lengpa henga kona jammangho, chule amoh tamtah ho chu vetuploi lamkai Nebuzaradan'in apuimang sohtai."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla gamsunga mivaichaho chu vetup loi lamkaipa chun lengpilei lhouding le louboldin adalha tai."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakai insunga sum-eng khomho, chule twikongho, Pakai insunga sum-eng twidol, chule atunna sum-eng ho chu Babylon'a apotaove.","ref":"1 Leng 7:15-26; 2 Thusm 3:15-17."},"14":{"text":"Chule bel ho, vutlonaho, chaicheho, thihkheho, chule sum-enga kisem um le bel jouse chu amahon apomang taovin ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 7:45; 2 Thusm 4:16"},"15":{"text":"Chule khangbelho, sumlheng ho, chule chutobang thilho chu, sana chu sana-in, dangka chu dangka-in ngahtup gallamkai pan apomangtai."},"16":{"text":"Solomon in Pakai in dinga anasem khom ni, twidol khat, chule atunna, umle bel ho jouse sum-eng chu tejougol ahipoi."},"17":{"text":"Khompi khat sanje chu tong somle tong get ahin, achunga aluboh chu sum-eng ahi; aluboh sanje chu tong thum ahin, chule aluboh chung kimvel chu kolbuthei lim kigeipol chitchetna, ajepna chu sum-eng jeng hija ahi. Hiche tobangma-a hi khompi nina-a jong chu akigeipol chitchet uma ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin ngahtup vaipopa chun thempu chungnung Seraiah, thempu nina Zephaniah, chule kotngah thumho chu amanin;","title":"Judah Mite Babylon'a Puimanga Aumu (Jer 52:24-27)"},"19":{"text":"Chule aman khopi sunga galbolho chunga vaipo toh, khopi sunga lengpa anga ana umjing mi nga toh, gamsunga mipi ho min sunlutji janelho lekhasun pipuipa toh, khopisunga um gamsung mipilah a mi somgup toh amanin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin ngahtup vaipo Nebuzaradan'in amaho chu akaijin, Riblah'a Babylon lengpa henga apuitai."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Babylon lengpan amaho chu Hamath gamsunga um Riblah'a mun'a chun amaho chu athat gamin ahi. Hitichun Judah chu agamuva konin apuimangtai."},"22":{"text":"Chule Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in adalhah, Judah gama umden hoding chun, aman Shaphan chapa Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu achunguva gamvaipo din asem peh-in ahi.","title":"Judah Gamvaipo Gadaliah (Jer 40:7-9 ; 41:1-3)"},"23":{"text":"Chuin galsat lamkaiho jouse, amahole amiteuvin Babylon lengpan Gedaliah chu gamvaipodin asemtai ti ajah phatnun, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael, Careah chapa Johanan, Netophah mi Tanhumeth chapa Seraiah, Maachath mi chapa Jaazaniah amahole amiteu chu Mizpah'a Gadaliah henga ahunguvin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Gedaliah amahole amiteu henga akihahselin, ajah uvah, Chaldea ho soh hiding kicha hih-un; gamsunga chun chengun lang Babylon lengpa jenmaijun; chutile nangho dinga thilpha hiding ahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Ahinla lha sagina-in ahitin ahi, lengte chilhah-a kon Elisha chapa Nethania chapa Ishmael chu pasal somtoh ahungin, Gedaliah le Mizpah'a aumpi Judah tele Chaldea te chu anokhumun athat taovin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin mijouse, alen aneo, chule galsat vaipoho, akipatnun Egypt'a ahungtaove; ajehchu Chaldea te chu akichatnu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Judah lengpa Jehoiachin sohchan kal kum somthumna, lha somle lhanina, nisomni le sagini na-in, Babylon lengpa Evil-merodach ahung lengchan kum kipat chun, Judah lengpa Jehoiachin chu songkul'a konin alhadoh tan ahi.","title":"Jehoiachin Songkul'a Kon Akilhadoh (Jer 52:31-34)"},"28":{"text":"Chule ahenga lungsetna neitah-in thu aseijin, Babylon'a amatoh umkhom lengho jouselaltouna vuma chun ama laltouna adosangpeh-in;"},"29":{"text":"Asongkul von akhelpeh-in, ahinkho lhumkeijin a-anga an anejom jingtan ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chule alo chu ahile, lengpan niseh-in a-an nehding ape jingin, ahinkho lhumkeijin niseh-in achang neijin ape jingin ahi."}}}}},"13":{"info":{"name":"1 Thusimbu","shortname":"1 Thusm","abbr":[],"desc":"Thusimbu Khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Adam, Seth, Enosh;","title":"Adam'a Pat Abraham (Semt 5:1-32 ; 10:1-32 ; 11:10-26)"},"2":{"text":"Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;"},"3":{"text":"Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech;"},"4":{"text":"Noah, Shem, Ham, chule Japheth."},"5":{"text":"Japheth chapate chu: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech chule Tiras ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Chule Gomer chapate chu: Ashkenaz, Riphath chule Togarmah ahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Chule Javan chapate chu: Elishah, Tarshish, Chittim chule Dodanim."},"8":{"text":"Ham chapate chu: Cush, Mizraim, Put, Canaan ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Cush chapate chu: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah chule Sabtecha ahiuve. Chule Raamah chapate chu: Sheba le Dedan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule Cush'in Nimrod ahingin; Amachu leisetna mihat masapen ahunghitai."},"11":{"text":"Chule Mizraim'in Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,"},"12":{"text":"Pathrusim, Casluhim (ama-a kona Philistine te hungdoh ahi), chule Caphthorim ahinge."},"13":{"text":"Chule Canaan'in chapa masapen Sidon, abana Heth,"},"14":{"text":"Jebush miho, Amor miho, Girgas miho,"},"15":{"text":"Hiv miho, Ark miho, Sin miho,"},"16":{"text":"Arvad miho, Zemar miho, chule Hamath miho ahingin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Shem chapate chu: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether chule Meshech ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Chule Arphaxad'in Shelah ahingin, Shelah'in Eber ahinge."},"19":{"text":"Chule Eber'a konin cha pasal ni apengin, khatpa minchu Peleg ahi, ajehchu ama nikho laijin leiset ana kikhena ahi; chule asopipa minchu Joktan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Joktan'in Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,"},"21":{"text":"Hadoram jong, Uzal, Diklah,"},"22":{"text":"Chule Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,"},"23":{"text":"Chule Ophir, Havilah le Jobab ahingin ahi. Hichengse hi Joktan chapate ahiuve."},"24":{"text":"Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah;"},"25":{"text":"Eber, Peleg, Reu;"},"26":{"text":"Serug, Nahor, Terah;"},"27":{"text":"Abram; hichu Abraham ahi."},"28":{"text":"Abraham chapateni chu: Isaac le Ishmael ahilhone."},"29":{"text":"Hichehohi akhangguiju ahi: Ishmael chapa lenpen chu Nebaioth ahin, chejouchun Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,","title":"Ishmael Chilhah ho (Semt 25:12-16)"},"30":{"text":"Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,"},"31":{"text":"Jetur, Naphish, chule Kedemah ahiuve. Hichehohi Ishmael chapate ahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Tun Abraham thaikem Keturah chapate chu: amanun Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, chule Shuah ahinge. Chule Jokshan chapateni chu: Sheba le Dedan ahilhone."},"33":{"text":"Chule Midian chapate chu: Ephah, Epher, Henoch, Abida chule Eldaah ahi. Hichehosehi Keturah chapate ahiuve."},"34":{"text":"Chule Abraham'in Isaac ahinge. Isaac chapateni chu Esau le Israel ahilhone.","title":"Esau Chilhah ho (Semt 36:1-19)"},"35":{"text":"Esau chapate chu: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam chule Korah ahiuve."},"36":{"text":"Eliphaz chapate chu: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna chule Amalek ahiuve."},"37":{"text":"Reuel chapate chu: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah chule Mizzah ahiuve."},"38":{"text":"Chule Seir chapate chu: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer chule Dishan ahiuve."},"39":{"text":"Chule Lotan chapateni chu: Hori le Homam ahilhonin, Timna chu Lotan sopinu ahi.","title":"Edom Goulo Dihtah ho (Semt 36:20-30)"},"40":{"text":"Shobal chapate chu: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, chule Onam ahiuve. Chule Zibeon chapateni chu Aiah le Anah ahilhone."},"41":{"text":"Anah chapa chu Dishon ahi. Chule Dishon chapate chu: Amran, Eshban, Ithran chule Keran ahiuve."},"42":{"text":"Ezer chapate chu: Bilhan, Zavan chule Jakan ahiuve. Dishan chapateni chu Uz le Aran ahilhone."},"43":{"text":"Israel chate chunga leng khatchan vai ahom masanga Edom gama analengchangte lengho chu tun hichehohi ahiuve. Beor chapa Bela ahin; chule akhopi minchu Dinhabah ahi.","title":"Edom Lengho (Semt 36:31-43)"},"44":{"text":"Chule Bela athiphatnin Bozrah'a um Zerah chapa Jobab ama khelin analeng change."},"45":{"text":"Chule Jobab athiphatnin Teman ho gama Husham ama khelin aleng changin ahi."},"46":{"text":"Chule Husham athiphatnin Bedad chapa Hadad, Moab phaija Midia ho joupa chu ama khelin aleng changin, chule akhopi minchu Avith ahi."},"47":{"text":"Chule Hadad athiphatnin Masrekah'a um Samlah ama khelin aleng changin ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chule Samlah athiphatnin vadung panga Rehoboth'a um Shual ama khelin analeng change."},"49":{"text":"Chule Shual athiphatnin Achbor chapa Baalhanan ama khelin aleng changin ahi."},"50":{"text":"Chule Baalhanan athiphatnin ama khelin Hadad alengchange; chule akhopi min Pai ahi, chule ajinu minchu Mezahab chanu Matred chanu Mehatabel ahi."},"51":{"text":"Hada jong athitan ahi. Chule Edom leng noidouho chu: leng noidou Timna, leng noidou Aliah, leng noidou Pinon,"},"52":{"text":"Leng noidou Aholibamah, leng noidou Elah, leng noidou Pinon,"},"53":{"text":"Leng noidou Kenaz, leng noidou Teman, leng noidou Mibzar,"},"54":{"text":"Leng noidou Magdiel, leng noidou Iram, hichehohi Edom leng noidouho ahiuve."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel chapate chu hichehohi ahiuve: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,","title":"Judah Chilhah ho"},"2":{"text":"Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad chule Asher."},"3":{"text":"Judah chapate chu: Er, Onan chule Shelah ahiuvin, amaho thum chu Canaan mi Shua chanu-a kona peng ahiuve. Judah chapa lenpen Er chu Pakai mitmun agilou lheh jengin, hitichun Pakaiyin athattan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amounu Tamar'in Pharez le Zerah ahinpeh-in ahi. Judah chapate chu abonun mi nga ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Pharez chapateni chu Hezron le Hamul ahilhone."},"6":{"text":"Zerah chapate chu: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calkol chule Dara ahiuvin, abonun mi nga ahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Carmi chapa chu Akar ahin, Israel sunohphah-a sapset thila suhkhel nei ahi.","ref":"Josh 7:1"},"8":{"text":"Chule Ethan chapa chu Azariah ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hezron'a kona hungpeng achapate chu: Jerahmeel, Ram chule Chelubai ahiuve.","title":"Leng David Insung"},"10":{"text":"Chule Ram'in Amminadab ahingin; chule Amminadab'in Judah chate pipu pa Nahshon ahingin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Nahshon'in Salma ahingin, chule Salma'in Boaz ahinge."},"12":{"text":"Chule Boaz'in Obed ahingin, chule Obed'in Jesse ahingin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule Jesse'in achapa peng masapen chu Eliab ahin, anina Abinadab, athumna Shimma,","title":"Jesse Chate"},"14":{"text":"Ali channa Nethaneel, anga channa Raddai,"},"15":{"text":"Agup channa Ozem, asagi channa chu David ahinge."},"16":{"text":"Asopiu numei teni minchu Zeruiah le Abigail ahilhone. Chule Zeruiah chapate chu: Abishai, Joab chule Asahel ahin, mi thum ahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chule Abigail'in Amasa ahingin; chule Amasa pachu Ishmael mi Jether ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule Hezron chapa Caleb'in ajinu Azubah le Jerioth'a konin chate ahingin, achapate chu: Jesher, Shobab chule Ardon ahiuve.","title":"Hezron Chilhah ho"},"19":{"text":"Azubah athi phatnin Caleb in Ephrath akichenpi kitnin Hur ahinge."},"20":{"text":"Hur'in Uri ahingin, chule Uri'in Bezaleel ahinge."},"21":{"text":"Hiche nungchun Hezron Gilead pa Machir chanu henga ache-in, kum somgup ahinungin akichenpin; chule amanun Segup ahinpeh-in ahi."},"22":{"text":"Segup'in Jair ahingin, aman Gilead gama khopi somni le thum aneije."},"23":{"text":"Aman amaho'a konin Geshur le Aram, Jair khopihotoh, chule Kenath toh akhopiho, khopi somgup jen alahpeh-in ahi. Hicheho jousehi Gilead pa Machir chapate-a ngen ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuche nunga Caleb-ephrathah mun Hezron'a athi phatnin, Hezron inneipi Abijah'in Tekoa pa Ashur chu ahinpeh-in ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hezron chapa masapen Jerahmeel sonho chapate chu apeng masapen Ram ahin, chule Bunah, Oren, Ozem le Ahijah ahiuve.","title":"Jerahmeel Chilhah ho"},"26":{"text":"Jerahmeel'in jidang jong aneijin amin Atarah ahi: Amanuhi Onam nu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Jerahmeel chapa masapen Ram chapate chu; Maaz, Jamin chule Eker ahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Onam chapateni chu Shammai le Jada ahilhonin; chule Shammai chapateni Nadab le Abishur ahi."},"29":{"text":"Abishur inneipi min chu Abihail ahin, amanun Ahban le Molid ahinpeh-e."},"30":{"text":"Nadab chapateni chu Seled le Appaim ahin, Seled vang chahing louvin athitan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Appaim chapa chu Ishi ahin; Ishi chapa chu Sheshan ahi. Chule Sheshan chapa chu Ahlai ahi."},"32":{"text":"Shammai sopipa Jada chapateni chu Jether le Jonathan ahilhone. Chule Jether chu chabeijin athitan ahi."},"33":{"text":"Jonathan chapateni chu Peleth le Zaza ahilhone. Hichehohi Jerahmeel chapate ahiuve."},"34":{"text":"Tun Sheshan'in chanuho tailou cha pasal aneipon ahi. Chule Sheshan'in Egypt mi Jarha kiti soh khat aneijin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Sheshan'in asohpa Jarha jidingin achanu apen, amanun Attai ahinpeh-e."},"36":{"text":"Attai'in Nathan ahingin, chule Nathan'in Jabad ahingin,"},"37":{"text":"Jabad'in Ephlal ahingin, chule Ephlal'in Obed ahingin,"},"38":{"text":"Obed'in Jehu ahingin, chule Jehu'n Azariah ahingin,"},"39":{"text":"Azariah'in Helez ahingin, chule Helez'in Eleasah ahingin,"},"40":{"text":"Eleasah'in Sisamai ahingin, chule Sisamai'in Shallum ahingin,"},"41":{"text":"Shallum'in Jekamiah ahingin, chule Jekamiah'in Elishama ahingin ahi."},"42":{"text":"Tun Jerahmeel sopipa Caleb chapate chu: achapa masapen chu Mesha ahin, amachu Ziphte pa ahin; chule Hebron pa Mereshah chapate ahiuve.","title":"Caleb Chilhah Dangdang ho"},"43":{"text":"Hebron chapate chu; Korah, Tappuah, Rekem chule Shema ahiuve."},"44":{"text":"Shema'in Jorkeam pa Raham ahingin, chule Rekem'in Shammai ahinge."},"45":{"text":"Shammai chapa chu Maon ahin; chule Maon chu Beth-zur pa ahi."},"46":{"text":"Caleb thaikemnu Ephah'in Haran, Moza chule Gazez ahinge, chule Haran'in Gazez ahingin ahi."},"47":{"text":"Jahdai chapate chu; Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah chule Shaaph ahiuve."},"48":{"text":"Caleb thaikemnu Maachah'in Shebor le Tirhanah ahinge."},"49":{"text":"Amanun Madmannah pa Shaaph toh Machbenah pa Sheva chule Gibeah pa ahingin: chule Caleb chanu chu Achsah ahi."},"50":{"text":"Caleb chilhah ho chu: Ephrathah chapa masapen Hur chapate, Kirjath-jearim pa Shobal,"},"51":{"text":"Bethlehem pa Salma, chule Beth-gader pa Hareph ahiuve."},"52":{"text":"Kirjath-jearim pa Shobal'in chapate aneijin: Haroeh le Manaheth miho akehkhat ahiuve."},"53":{"text":"Kirjath-jearim insungmiho chu Ithra miho, Puth miho, Shumath miho, chule Mishrai miho ahiuve: amaho-a konchun Zareath miho le Eshtaul miho ahungdoh uve."},"54":{"text":"Salma chapate chu; Bethlehem chule Netophah miho, Netophah miho, Joab insungmi Atroth, chule Manaheth mite akehkhat le Zor miho ahiuve."},"55":{"text":"Jabez'a cheng danthusunho insung mite chu; Tirath miho, Shimeath miho, chule Suchath miho ahiuve. Hicheho hi Rechab insung pa Hamath'a kona hungdoh Ken mite ahiuve."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun hichehohi David chapate Hebron'a pengho ahiuve: Acha masapen chu Amnon ahin, Jezreel numeinu Ahinoam'a kon ahi; anina Daniel ahin, Karmel numeinu Abigail'a kon ahin,","title":"David Lengpa Chate"},"2":{"text":"Athum channa chu Geshur lengpa Talmai chanu Maachah chapa Absalom ahin, ali channa chu Haggith chapa Adonijah ahi:","ref":"2 Sam 5:4-5; 1 Leng 2:11; 1 Thusm 29:27"},"3":{"text":"Anga channa chu Abital chapa Shephatiah ahin; agup channa a-inneipi Eglah'in ahinpeh Ithream ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hiche guphohi Hebron'a peng ahiuvin; chule ama hia chun kum sagi le lhagup alengchange. Chule ama Jerusalem'a kum somthum le kumthum aleng changin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Ammiel chanu Bath-shua'in Jerusalem'a ahin achapate li hochu: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan chule Solomon ahiuve:","ref":"2 Sam 11:3"},"6":{"text":"Chujongle Ibhar, Elishama chule Eliphelet,"},"7":{"text":"Chule Nogah, Nepheg le Japhia,"},"8":{"text":"Elishama, Eliada chule Eliphelet, mi ko ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Hichengsehi athaikemho chapate tilouvin David chapate ngen ahiuvin, chule asopinu-u Tamar toh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Solomon chapa chu Rehoboam ahin, Rehoboam chapa chu Abia ahin, Abijah chapa chu Asa ahin, Asa chapa chu Jehoshaphat ahin,","title":"Solomon Lengpa Chilhah ho"},"11":{"text":"Jehoshaphat chapa chu Joram ahin, Joram chapa Ahaziah ahin, Ahaziah chapa chu Joash ahin,"},"12":{"text":"Joash chapa chu Amajiah ahin, Amajiah chapa Azariah ahin, Azariah chapa chu Jotham ahin,"},"13":{"text":"Jotham chapa chu Ahaz ahin, Ahaz chapa chu Hezekiah ahin, Hezekiah chapa chu Manasseh ahin,"},"14":{"text":"Manasseh chapa chu Amon ahin, Amon chapa chu Josiah ahin,"},"15":{"text":"Chule Josiah chapate apeng masapen chu Johanan, anina Jehoiakim, athum channa Zedekiah, ali channa chu Shallum ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Jehoiakim chapateni chu: Jeconiah le Zedekiah ahilhone."},"17":{"text":"Chule Jeconiah chapate chu; Assir, achapa Salathiel,","title":"Jehoiachin Lengpa Chilhah ho"},"18":{"text":"Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazar, Jekamiah, Hoshama chule Nedabiah ahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Chule Pedaiah chapateni chu Zerubbabel le Shimei ahilhonin; chule Zerubbabel chapateni chu Meshullam le Hananiah ahilhonin, asopinulhon chu Shelomith ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah chule Jushabhesed mi nga ahiuve."},"21":{"text":"Hananiah chapate chu Pelatiah le Jesaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapate, Arnan chapate, Obadiah chapate, Shechaniah chapate ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Chule Shechaniah chapa chu Shemaiah ahin, Shemaiah chapate chu Hattush, Igeal, Bariah, Neariah chule Shaphat, mi gup ahiuve."},"23":{"text":"Neariah chapate chu Elioenai, Hezekiah chule Azrikam, mi thum ahiuve."},"24":{"text":"Chule Elioenai chapate chu Hodaiah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah chule Anani, mi sagi ahiuve."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah chapate chu; Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur chule Shobal ahiuve.","title":"Judah Chilhah ho"},"2":{"text":"Shobal chapa Reaiah'in Jahath ahingin, chule Jahath'in Ahumai le Lahad ahinge. Hichehohi Zorath miho insung mite ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chule hichehohi Etam pa chapate ahi: Jezreel, Ishma chule Idbash ahiuvin, asopinu-u minchu Hazzelelponi ahi."},"4":{"text":"Gedor pa Penuel le Hushah pa Ezer toh, hichehohi Bethlehem pa Ephrathah cha masapen Hur chate ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chule Tekoa pa Ashhur'in ji ni, Helah le Naarah aneijin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Naarah'in Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni chule Haahashtari ahinpeh-in ahi. Hichehohi Naarah chapate ahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Chule Helah chapate chu Zereth, Zerer chule Ethnan ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Coz'in Anub, Zobebah le Harum chapa Aharhel insung mite ahinge."},"9":{"text":"Jabez vangchu asopi dangho sangin ja aumpenin, anun lung hesoh puma kavop ahi atijeh-a amin Jabez asah ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Jabez Pathen henga ataovin, O, nangman phatthei neiboh teiding hihen lang, kagamsung nasuh letna, nakhut chu kakoma umjinga, thilphalouvin eilungdon sahlou nadinga hiche-a kona chu neihuhdoh ding hitavele! ati. Hichun Pathen'in angeh chu aphal pehtai."},"11":{"text":"Chule Shuah sopipa Chelub'in Eshton pa Mehir ahingin ahi.","title":"Insung Dangdang ho"},"12":{"text":"Eshton'in Beth-rapha, Paseah chule Irnahash pa Tehinnah ahinge, hichehohi Rekah mite ahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Kenaz chapateni chu: Othniel le Seraiah ahilhone; chule Othniel chapa chu Hathath ahi."},"14":{"text":"Meonothai'in Ophrah ahingin, Seraiah'in Charashim phaicham semdohpa Joab ahinge. Amahohi khutthem mi ahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Jephunneh chapa Caleb chapate chu: Iru, Elah chule Naam ahiuvin; chule Elah chapa chu Kenaz ahi."},"16":{"text":"Jehalelel chapate chu: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria chule Asareel ahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Ezrah chapate chu: Jether, Mered, Epher chule Jalon ahiuvin; chule Mered inneipin Miriam, Shammai chule Eshtemoa pa Isbah ahinge."},"18":{"text":"A-inneipi Jehudijah chun Gedor pa Jered, Socho Pa Heber, chule Zanoah pa Jekuthiel ahingin ahi. Hichehohi Mered'in akichenpi Pharaoh chanu Bithiah chapate hochu ahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Chule Naham sopinu Hodiah inneipi chapate chu; Garm mite pa Keilah ahin, chule Eshtemoa mite pa Maachath ahi."},"20":{"text":"Shimon chapate chu: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan chule Tilon ahiuvin; chule Ishi chapateni chu Zoheth le Benzoheth ahilhone."},"21":{"text":"Judah chapa Shelah chapate chu: Lecah pa Er, Mareshah pa Laadah, chule Ashbea inkon tupat ponnem khong insung miho,","title":"Shelah Chilhah ho"},"22":{"text":"Jokim le Chozeba mite, Joash, Moab gam chunga thuneina ananei Saraph, chule Jashubi-lahem ahiuve. Tun hichehohi khanglui thu ahitai."},"23":{"text":"Hichehohi beldengho ahiuvin, amaho chu thingbil lah-a achengun; hiche mun'a chu lengpa natong dinga cheng ahiuve."},"24":{"text":"Simeon chapate chu: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zarah chule Shaul:","title":"Simeon Chilhah ho"},"25":{"text":"Achapa Sahllum, achapa Mibsam, chule achapa Mishma ahiuve."},"26":{"text":"Mishma chapate chu: achapa Hamuel, achapa Zaccur, achapa Shimei ahiuve."},"27":{"text":"Shimei'in chapa somlegup le chanu aneije, ahivangin asopihon cha tampi aneipouve, Judah chate bangin a-insung miteu apungpon ahi."},"28":{"text":"Amaho Beersheba, Moladah, chule Hazarshual'ah achengun ahi.","ref":"Josh 19:2-8."},"29":{"text":"Bilhah, Ezem chule Toladah,"},"30":{"text":"Bethuel, Hormah, chule Ziklag'ah,"},"31":{"text":"Bethmarcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbirei, chule Shaaraim'a jong achengun ahi. Hicheho chengsehi David lengchan geija akhopihou ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule akhohou chu; Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen chule Ashan, khopi len nga ahin;"},"33":{"text":"Chuche Baal changeija khopilenho kimvela um khoho jouse ahi. Hichehohi achennao chule akhangguiju ahi."},"34":{"text":"Meshobab, Jamlech le Amaziah chapa Joshah,"},"35":{"text":"Joel le Joshibiah chapa Jehu, Seraiah chapa, Asiel chapa,"},"36":{"text":"Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel chule Benaiah,"},"37":{"text":"Shiphi chapa Ziza, Allon chapa, Jedaiah chapa, Shimri chapa, Shemaiah chapa:"},"38":{"text":"Hiche amin kikut hohi a-insunguva pipui ngenchang ahiuve, chule apu apateu insung chu ahapun lheh jengin ahi."},"39":{"text":"Agan honu lhatnading holin solam phaicham langsang Gedor lutna mun geijin acheuvin ahi."},"40":{"text":"Hitichun gan hon lhatnading mun phatah, nehding hamhing tamna, gam lentah, munthip le gamhoina mun agamudoh-un ahi; ajehchu masanga chu hiche munna chu Ham mite anacheng uva ahi."},"41":{"text":"Hiche amin kisunlut hohi Judah lengpa Hezekiah nikho laijin ahungun, aponbuh hou asuseuvin, chuche munna anachengho chu tunichan geijin asugam helun, amaho munna chun acheng taove: ajehchu chuche munna chu agan honu lhatnading hamhing mun uma ahi."},"42":{"text":"Alah uva Simeon chapate ngeija kon mi janga chu, Ishi chapate Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah le Uzziel lamkaina-in Seir molsanga acheuvin ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chule amahon ahoidoh Amalek mite amohse chu asatgamun, hitichun tunichan geijin chuche munna chun achengden taove."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Israel cha masapen Reuben chapate chu, ama chu (cha masapen hijeng jongle, apa jalkhun asuhboh tahjeh-in upa hina chu Israel chapa Joseph chapate chu kipe ahitan; chule akhanggui thu chu upa hina dungjuija kisut talou ding ahi.","title":"Reuben Chilhah ho","ref":"Semt 35:22; 49:3-4."},"2":{"text":"Ahin Judah chu asopite sangin achung nungin, hitichun ama-a konin vaipo pipu ahungkon doh-in: ahivangin upa hina chu Joseph'a hijaa hi.)","ref":"Semt 49:8-10"},"3":{"text":"Israel cha masapen Reuben chapate chu: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron chule Karmi ahiuve."},"4":{"text":"Joel chapate chu: achapa Shemaiah, achapa Gog, achapa Shimei,"},"5":{"text":"Achapa Micah, achapa Reaiah, achapa Baal,"},"6":{"text":"Achapa Beerah, ama chu Assyria lengpa Tilgath-pilneser in gal hinga akaimangpa ahin; Reuben mite lamkaipa ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 15:29"},"7":{"text":"Akhangu khanggui thu akisutlaija a-inko ko-a asopihou lah-a pipui chu Jeiel le Zekeriah,"},"8":{"text":"Chule Aroer, Nebo le Baalmeon geija cheng Joel chapa, Shema chapa, chule Azaz chapa Bela ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule amaho chu solamsang Euphrates vadunglen'a pat gamthip ma lutnachan geijin anachengun ahi. Ajehchu Gilead gama chu agancha honu punglheh jenga ahi."},"10":{"text":"Saul damlaijin Hagar mite toh akidouvun, amaho chu anajouvun, Gilead solam sese-a aponbuh uva anachengun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Gad chu Bashan gamsunga Salcah changeijin amahotoh akigalsaijin achenge.","title":"Gad Chilhah ho"},"12":{"text":"Apipuiju chu Joel ahin, aban Sapham chule Bashan, Jaanai le Shaphat ahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Apu apateu insunga asopihou chu: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jachan, Zia chule Heber; mi sagi ahiuve."},"14":{"text":"Hichehohi Buz chapa, Jahda chapa, Jeshishai chapa, Michael chapa, Gilead chapa, Jaroah chapa, Hur chapa, Abihail chate ahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Guni chapa, Abdiel chapa Ahi hi apu apateu insunga pipupen ahi."},"16":{"text":"Amahohi Bashan gama Gilead le akhopihou, chule Sharon kimvel changeijin achengun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hicheho sesehi Judah lengpa Jotham nikholai le Israel lengpa Jeroboam nikholaija akhanggui thubu houva ana kisun ahi."},"18":{"text":"Reuben chapate le Gad mite chule Manasseh phung kehkhat, mihang cheh, chemjam le lum thothei, thal kapthem le galdou them, galla kontheiho chu sangsomli le sangli le jasagi le somgup ahiuve.","title":"Solama Chengho Mite Sepaiho"},"19":{"text":"Chuin amahohin Hagar mite, Jetur, Naphish chule Nodab chunga gal abolun,"},"20":{"text":"Chule amaho douna-in panpi achangun, Hagar mite le apankhompi jouse chu akhutnuva akipelut taove: ajehchu kidouna munna Pathen akou jeh uva aman ataonao asanpeh ahi. Ajehchu amahon Ama-a atahsanao angamun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hitichun aganchahou, asangonsangu sangsomnga, kelngoi sangjani le sangsomnga, sangan sangni, chule mihem sangjakhat akai mangun ahi."},"22":{"text":"Kidouna chu Pathen'a ahijeh-in mitamtah athiuvin ahi. Chule amaho gal hinga akikaimang kahseuvin agamuvah chun acheng taovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule Manasseh phung kehkhat chate chu chua chun anachengun; Bashan'a kipat Baal-hermon le Senir chule Hermon mol geijin anapunguve.","title":"Solama cheng Manasseh Mite"},"24":{"text":"Chule hichehohi apu apateu insunga apipupen cheh ahiuve: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah chule Jahdiel, amahohi mihatle hangsan, mi minthang le apu apateu insunga aluchang cheh ahiuve."},"25":{"text":"Chuin amaho apu apateu Pathen douna-in achonkhelun, amaho masanga Pathen'in anasuh mangsa, chuche gama miho pathenho chu ajon thanghoipi taovin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hijeh chun Israel Pathen'in Assyria lengpa Pul, hichu Assyria lengpa Tilgath-pilneser ahin; amachu ahintildoh-in, aman Reuben mite, Gad mite chule Manasseh phung kehkhat chu gal hingin akaijin; Halah, Habor, Hara chule Gozan vadunglen geijin ahinpuijin, tunigeijin achengden taove.","title":"Solam Chengho Kikaimang","ref":"2 Leng 15:19,29; 17:6."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Levi chapate chu: Gershom, Kohath chule Merari ahiuve.","title":"Thempu Insung Khanggui"},"2":{"text":"Kohath chapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron chule Uzziel ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chule Amram chate chu: Aaron, Mosi chule Miriam ahiuve. Aaron chapate jong chu: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar chule Ithamar."},"4":{"text":"Eleazar'in Phinehas ahingin, Phinehas'in Abishua ahingin,"},"5":{"text":"Abishua'in Bukki ahingin, Bukki in Uzzi ahingin,"},"6":{"text":"Uzzi'in Zerahiah ahingin, Zerahiah'in Meraioth ahingin,"},"7":{"text":"Meraioth'in Amariah ahingin, Amariah'in Ahitub ahingin,"},"8":{"text":"Ahitub'in Zadok ahingin, Zadok'in Ahimaaz ahingin,"},"9":{"text":"Ahimaaz'in Azariah ahingin, Azariah'in Johanan ahingin,"},"10":{"text":"Johanan'in Azariah ahinge, (amahi Jerusalem'a Solomon'in asah houin'a thempu tohmun hintongpa chu ahi.)"},"11":{"text":"Chule Azariah'in Amariah ahingin, Amariah in Ahitub ahingin,"},"12":{"text":"Ahitub'in Zadok ahingin, Zadok'in Shallum ahingin,"},"13":{"text":"Shallum'in Hilkiah ahingin, Hilkiah'in Azariah ahingin,"},"14":{"text":"Azariah'in Seraiah ahingin, Seraiah'in Jehozadak ahingin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Judah le Jerusalem Nebuchadnezzar khutna akaimang laichu Jehozadak hi gal hinga kikai ahi."},"16":{"text":"Levi chapate chu: Gershom, Kohath chule Merari ahiuve.","title":"Levi Chilhah Dangdang ho","ref":"Pot 6:16-19."},"17":{"text":"Chule Gershom chapateni minchu Libni le Shimei ahi."},"18":{"text":"Kohath chapate chu: Amram, Izhar, Hebron chule Uzziel ahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Merari chapateni chu: Mahli le Mushi ahilhone. Chule hichehohi apu apateu dungjuija Levi insung mite ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Gershom'a konin achapa Libni, achapa Jahath, achapa Zimmah,"},"21":{"text":"Achapa Joah, achapa Iddo, achapa Zerah, achapa Jeaterai apengin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Kohath chapate chu: achapa Amminadab, achapa Korah, achapa Assir,"},"23":{"text":"Achapa Elkanah, achapa Ebiasaph, achapa Assir,"},"24":{"text":"Achapa Tahath, achapa Uriel, achapa Uzziah, chule achapa Shaul ahiuve."},"25":{"text":"Chule Elkanah chapate chu: Amasai le Ahimoth ahi."},"26":{"text":"Elkanah ahile; Elkanah chapate chu: achapa Zophai, achapa Nahath,"},"27":{"text":"Achapa Eliab, achapa Jeroham, achapa Elkanah ahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Chule Samuel chapateni chu: Apeng masa Vashni le Abiah ahilhone."},"29":{"text":"Merari chapate chu: Mahli, achapa Libni, achapa Shimei, achapa Uzzah,"},"30":{"text":"Achapa Shimea, achapa Haggiah, achapa Asaiah ahiuve."},"31":{"text":"Chule hichehohi David'in Kitepna thingkhong akikoihe nunga Pakai houin'a la lama natohna neidinga akoiho chu ahiuve.","title":"Houin'a Lasaho"},"32":{"text":"Chule Jerusalem'a Solomon'in Pakai houin asah masangsen houkhom ho houbuh umna masanga chun amahon la asajiuvin, atohding kinu chu aban banin atong jiuvin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Hichehohi achateu toh kinbola pangho ahiuve. Kohath miho chapate-a kon: lathempa Heman, Heman hi Joel chapa, Shemuel chapa,"},"34":{"text":"Elkanah chapa, Jeroham chapa, Eliel chapa, Toah chapa,"},"35":{"text":"Zuph chapa, Elkanah chapa, Mahath chapa, Amasai chapa,"},"36":{"text":"Elkanah chapa, Joel chapa, Azariah chapa, Zephaniah chapa,"},"37":{"text":"Tahath chapa, Assir chapa, Ebiasaph chapa, Korah chapa,"},"38":{"text":"Izhar chapa, Kohath chapa, Levi chapa, Israel chapa ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chule ajet lama ding chu asopipa Asaph ahin, Asaph hi Berechiah chapa, Shimea chapa,"},"40":{"text":"Michael chapa, Baaseiah chapa, Malchiah chapa,"},"41":{"text":"Ethni chapa, Zerah chapa, Adaiah chapa,"},"42":{"text":"Ethan chapa, Zimmah chapa, Shimei chapa,"},"43":{"text":"Jahath chapa, Gershom chapa, Levi chapa ahi."},"44":{"text":"Chule veilama ding chu asopi Merari chapate lah-a kon Kishi chapa Ethan ahin, Kishi hi Abdi chapa, Malluch chapa,"},"45":{"text":"Hashabiah chapa, Amaziah chapa, Hilkiah chapa,"},"46":{"text":"Amzi chapa, Bani chapa, Shemer chapa,"},"47":{"text":"Mahli chapa, Mushi chapa, Merari chapa, Levi chapa ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chule asopiteu Levi mite dangho chu Pathen in Houbuh-a tohding tincheng tong dinga kipansah ahiuve."},"49":{"text":"Ahivangin Pathen'in alhacha Mosi ana thupeh jouse dungjuijin Aaron le achapate chun maicham chunga govam thilto atoh-un, gimnamtui ahalun, muntheng chungnunga tohding jouse tongding le, Israel dinga longlhena bolpeh dinga pansah ahiuve.","title":"Aaron Chilhah ho"},"50":{"text":"Chule hichehohi Aaron chapate ahiuve: achapa Eleazar, achapa Phinehas, achapa Abishua,"},"51":{"text":"Achapa Bukki, achapa Uzzi, achapa Zerahiah,"},"52":{"text":"Achapa Meraioth, achapa Amariah, achapa Ahitub"},"53":{"text":"Achapa Zadok, achapa Ahimaaz ahiuve."},"54":{"text":"Tun hichehohi Kohath mite insung miho, Aaron chapate agamsung hop sunga achennao ahi. Ajehchu hichehi achannu ahi.","title":"Levi Mite Chennaho"},"55":{"text":"Chule amaho chu Judah gamsunga um Hebron le khopipam kimvel sese anapeuve."},"56":{"text":"Ahinla khopi naija gamho le khoneoho chu Jephunneh chapa Caleb anapeuvin ahi."},"57":{"text":"Chule Aaron chapate chu Judah khopiho, hoidohna khopi Hebron, Libna le khopi kimvel, chule Jattir le Eshtamoa le akhopi kimvel ho sese toh anapeuve."},"58":{"text":"Chule Hilen le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Debir le khopi kimvel ho,"},"59":{"text":"Ashan le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Bethshemesh le akhopi kimvel sese anapeuve."},"60":{"text":"Chule Benjamin phunga konin: Geba le akhopi kimvel ho, Alemeth le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Anathoth le akhopi kimvel ho sese anapeuve. A-insung pumpiuva akhopihou chu khopi somlethum ahi."},"61":{"text":"Chule Kohath phunga chapa dangho chu, Manasseh chapate phung akehkhatna konin vang sanin khopi som apeuvin ahi."},"62":{"text":"Chule Gershom chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin Issachar phunga kon, Asher phunga kon, Naphtali phunga kon chule Bashan'a Manasseh phunga konin khopi somlethum apeuve."},"63":{"text":"Merari chapate henga chun a-insungu dungjuile vangkivet dungjuijin Reuben phunga kon, Gad phunga kon, chule Zebulun phunga konin khopiho somleni akipen ahi."},"64":{"text":"Israel chaten hiche khopi somleni hohi akhopiu kimvel ho pumin Levi mite anapeuve."},"65":{"text":"Chule vangvet na-in Judah chate phunga kon, Simeon chate phunga kon, chule Benjamin chate phunga kon, hiche aminuva kivo khopihohi anapeuvin ahi."},"66":{"text":"Chule Kohath chapate insung mi amohho chun Ephraim phunga konin gam le khopilen aneijuvin ahi."},"67":{"text":"Chuin amahon amaho chu Ephraim molsanga hoidohna khopi Shechem chu akhopi kimvel ho to apeuvin, chule Gezer le akhopi kimvel ho,"},"68":{"text":"Jokmeam le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Beth-horon le akhopi kimvel ho,"},"69":{"text":"Aijalon le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Gathrimmon le akhopi kimvel sese apeuvin ahi."},"70":{"text":"Manasseh phung kehkhatna konin, Kohath chapate insung amoh ho-a dingin Aner le akhopi kimvel ho, Bileam le akhopi kimvel sese apeuve."},"71":{"text":"Manasseh phung kehkhat insungho-a kona Gerahom chapate kipe chu Bashan'a um Golan le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Ashtaroth le akhopi kimvel sese ahi."},"72":{"text":"Issachar phunga konin Kedesh le akhopi kimvel ho, Daberath le akhopi kimvel ho,"},"73":{"text":"Ramoth le akhopi kimvel ho, Anem le akhopi kimvel sese apeuvin:"},"74":{"text":"Chule Asher phunga konin Mashal le akhopi kimvel ho, Abdon le akhopi kimvel ho,"},"75":{"text":"Hukok le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Rehob le akhopi kimvel sese apeuvin ahi."},"76":{"text":"Chule Naphtali phunga konin Galilee gama um Kedesh le akhopi kimvel ho, Hammon le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Kirjathaim le akhopi kimvel sese apeuvin ahi."},"77":{"text":"Zebulun phunga kona Merari chate amohchengse henga kipe chu Rimmon le akhopi kimvel ho, Tabor le akhopi kimvel sese ahi."},"78":{"text":"Chule Reuben phunga kona amaho kipedoh chu Jordan gal langkhat Jericho kom Jordan solamsang gamthipma um Bezer le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Jahzah le akhopi kimvel ho,"},"79":{"text":"Kedemoth le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Mephaath le akhopi kimvel sese ahi."},"80":{"text":"Chule Gad phunga kon Gilead'a um Ramoth le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Mahanaim le akhopi kimvel ho,"},"81":{"text":"Chule Heshbon le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Jazer le akhopi kimvel sese apeuvin ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Issachar chapate chu: Tolla, Pu-ah, Jashub chule Shimron, mi li ahiuve.","title":"Issachar Chilhah ho"},"2":{"text":"Chule Tolla chapate chu: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Jibsam chule Shemuel, Tolla sonho apu apateu insunga luchang cheh ahiuvin; akhanguva mihat le mihangsan cheh ahiuve: David nikholaijin amijatnu chu sangsomni le sangni le jagup alhinguve."},"3":{"text":"Chule Uzzi chapa chu Izrahiah ahin chule Izrahiah chapate chu: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, Isshiah, mi nga ahiuvin, abonchauvin pipui jeng ahiuve."},"4":{"text":"Amaho le akhanguva chu, apu apateu insung dungjuija galdouthei sepaihon ngen ahiuvin, mi sangsomthum le sang gup ahiuve: ajehchu amahon ji tamtah tah le chapa tamtah tah aneiju ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Issachar insung mite jouse lah-a asopiteu chu mihat mihangsan cheh ahiuvin, akhangthu sutna dungjuija sutnin abonun sangsomget le sangsagi ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Benjamin chapate chu: Bela, Becher chule Jediael, mi thum ahiuve.","title":"Benjamin le Dan Chilhah ho"},"7":{"text":"Chule Bela chapate chu: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth chule Iri, mi nga ahiuvin; apu apateu insunga luchang cheh, mihat mihangsan ngen ahiuve;, akhangguithu sutna dungjuijin sangsomni le sangni le somthum le li ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Chule Becher chapate chu: Zemira, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth chule Alemeth ahiuvin, hicheho chenghi Becher chapate ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Amijatnu, akhangu khanggui thu kisutna dungjuijin apu apateu insunga luchang cheh, mihat mihangsan cheh sangsomni le jani ahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Jediael chapa jong chu Bilhan ahin; chule Bilhan chapate: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish chule Ahishahar ahiuve."},"11":{"text":"Hichehohi Jediael chapate, apu apateu insunga luchang chehho sima mihat mihangsan cheh sangsom le sangsagi le jani ahiuvin, galmuna galsatna konthei cheh ahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Shuppim le Huppim chu Ir chapateni ahin, chule Hushim chu Aher chapa ahi."},"13":{"text":"Naphtali chapate chu: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer chule Shallum ahin, Bilhah chapate ahiuve.","title":"Naphtali Chilhah ho"},"14":{"text":"Manasseh chapa chu Asriel ahin, amahi athaikemnu Aram numei nun ahinpeh ahi; (amanuhin Gilead pa Machir jong ahinge.","title":"Manasseh Chilhah ho"},"15":{"text":"Chule Machir'in Huppim le Shuppim sopinu Maakah chu ji in aneije;) chule anichanna pa chu Zelophehad ahin, chule Zelophehad'in chanu jengbou aneijin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Machir inneipi Maakah'in chapa khat ahingin, amanun amin Peresh asah-in ahi; chule asopipa minchu Sheresh ahin, chule achapateni chu Ulam le Rakem ahilhone."},"17":{"text":"Ulam chapa chu Bedan ahi. Hichehohi Manasseh chapa Machir, Machir chapa Gilead chapate ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Chule asopinu Hammoleketh in Ishod, Abiezer chule Mahalah ahingin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Shemida chapate chu Ahian, Shechem, Likhi chule Aniam ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Ephraim chapate chu: Shuthelah chule achapa Bered, achapa Tahath, achapa Eladah, achapa Tahath,","title":"Ephraim Chilhah ho"},"21":{"text":"Chule achapa Zabad, achapa Shuthelah, chule achapa Ezer le Elead, aganchahou gudinga ahungsuh jeh lhona agama peng Gath mihon anatha teniu chutoh ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Hitichun apau Ephraim chun nitamtah alunghempi-in, hijeh chun asopite ama lhamon dingin ahunguvin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chujouvin ama a-inneipi henga alutnin, amanun nao ahinvop min, chule chapa khat ahingin a-insunga thilse aumtahjeh-in amin Beriah asahtan ahi."},"24":{"text":"(Chule achanu Sherah ahin, Beth-horon noinung le chungnung chule Uzzen-sherah sadohnu ahi)."},"25":{"text":"Achapa Rephah ahin, Resheph jong ahin, Resheph chapa Telah chule Tahah chapa Tahan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tahan chapa Laadan, Laadan chapa Ammihud, Ammihud chapa Elishama,"},"27":{"text":"Elishama chapa Nun, Nun chapa Joshua ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule aneiju le achennahou chu Bethel le akhopihose, solam sanga Naaran, lhumlama Gezer le akhopihose toh, Shechem le akhopiho, chule Gaza le akhopiho changei ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chule Manasseh chapate gamgi china um Bethshean le akhopise, Taanach le akhopise, Megiddo le akhopise Dor chule akhopise ahi. Hicheho ahin Israel chapa Joseph chate achengun ahi."},"30":{"text":"Asher chapate chu: Imnah, Ishuai, Ishuai, Beriah chule asopinu-u Serah ahiuve.","title":"Asher Chilhah ho"},"31":{"text":"Beriah chapateni chu Heber le Birzavith pa Malchiel ahilhone."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Heber'in Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham chule asopinu-u Shua ahingin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule Japhlet chapate chu: Pasach, Bimhal chule Ashvath ahiuve. Amahohi Japhlet chate ahiuve."},"34":{"text":"Shemer chapate chu: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah chule Aram ahiuve."},"35":{"text":"Chule asopipa Helem chapate chu Zophah, Imna, Shelesh chule Amal ahiuve."},"36":{"text":"Zophah chapate chu: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,"},"37":{"text":"Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran chule Beera ahiuve."},"38":{"text":"Chule Jether chapate chu: Jephunneh, Pispah, chule Ara ahiuve."},"39":{"text":"Chule Ulla chapate chu: Arah, Hanniel chule Rezia ahiuve."},"40":{"text":"Hicheho chengsehi Asher chate, apu apateu insung luchang cheh, lhendoh le mihat mihangsan ngen, lamkai pipui cheh ahiuve. Chule akhanggui thu apumpia kisutna dungjuija galdouna-a gala konthei chu mi sangsomni le sang gup ahiuve."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Benjamin'in acha masa Bela, anina Ashbel, athumna Aharah,","title":"Benjamin Chilhah ho"},"2":{"text":"Alichana Nohah, chule anga chana Rapha ahinge."},"3":{"text":"Chule Bela chapate chu: Addar, Gera, Abihud,"},"4":{"text":"Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,"},"5":{"text":"Gera, Shephuphan chule Huram ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Chule hichehohi Ehud chapate ahiuvin: Geba'a chengho pate luchang cheh ahiuvin, chule amahon amaho chu Manahath'a atolmangun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule Naaman, Ahiah, chule Gera, amahohi atolmangin, chuin Uzza le Ahihud ahingin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule Shaharaim'in ajiteni Hushim le Beera asolmang nungin, Moab gama chate ahingin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule aman a-inneipi Hodesh'a konin; Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcham,"},"10":{"text":"Jeuz, Sachia chule Mirma ahingin ahi. Hiche achapateho hi apu apateu insunga luchang cheh ahiuve."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Hushim'a konin Abitub le Elpaal apengin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Elpaal chapate chu: Eber, Misham, chule Ono le akimvela khopiho sadohpa Shema."},"13":{"text":"Gath'a chengho nodoh-a, Aijalon'a chengho pate luchang cheh Beriah le Shema;","title":"Gath Le Aijalon Mun'a Benjamin te"},"14":{"text":"Ahio, Shashak le Jeremoth,"},"15":{"text":"Zebadiah, Arad le Ader,"},"16":{"text":"Chule Michael, Ishpa le Joha, amahohi Beriah chapate ahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chule Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki chule Heber,","title":"Jerusalem'a Benjamin te"},"18":{"text":"Ishmerai, Izliah le Jobab, hichenghi Elpaal chapate ahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Chule Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,"},"20":{"text":"Chule Elienai, Zilthai le Eliel,"},"21":{"text":"Adaiah, Beraiah chule Shimrath, hichenghi Shimhi chapate ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Ishpan, Heber le Eliel,"},"23":{"text":"Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,"},"24":{"text":"Hananiah, Elam le Anthothijah,"},"25":{"text":"Iphdeiah chule Penuel, hichenghi Shashak chapate ahiuve."},"26":{"text":"Shamsherai, Shehariah le Athaliah,"},"27":{"text":"Jaresiah, Eliah chule Zichri, hichengsehi Jeroham chapate ahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Hichehohi apu apateu insunga aluchang cheh, akhanguva pipui ngen ahiuve. Amahosehi Jerusalem'a cheng ahiuve."},"29":{"text":"Chule Gibeon'a Gibeon pa achengin, a-inneipi min chu Maachah ahi.","title":"Gibeon le Jerusalem'a Benjamin te"},"30":{"text":"Chule achapa peng masapen chu Abdon ahin, chule Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,"},"31":{"text":"Gedor, Ahio chule Zecher ahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Chule Mikloth'in Shimeah ahinge. Amaho jonghi asopihou toh kigalsaijin Jerusalem'a achengun ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule Ner'in Kish ahingin, Kish in Saul ahingin, Saul'in Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab chule Eshbaal ahingin ahi.","title":"Saul Insungmi ho"},"34":{"text":"Jonathan chapa chu Merib-baal ahi, chule Merib-baal'in Micah ahingin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chule Micah chapate chu; Pithon, Melech, Tarea chule Ahaz ahiuve."},"36":{"text":"Chule Ahaz'in Jehoadah ahingin, chule Jehoadah'in Alemeth, Azmaveth, chule Zimri ahingin, Zimri'in Moza ahingin,"},"37":{"text":"Chule Moza'in Binea ahingin, Binea chapa chu Rapha ahin, Rapha chapa chu Eleasah, Eleasah chapa chu Azel ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chule Azel'in chapa gup aneijin, hicheho minchu: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, chule Hanan ahi. Hicheho jousehi Azel chapate ahiuve."},"39":{"text":"Chule asopipa Eshek chapate chu Ulam acha masa, Jehush anichanna, chule Eliphelet athum channa, ahiuve."},"40":{"text":"Chule Ulam chapate chu mihat mihangsan, thal kapthem mi ahiuvin, chapate tamtah aneijun, achapateu chapate mi jale somnga ahiuve. Hicheho jousehi Benjamin chapate ahiuve."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hitichun Israelte jouse akhanguijuva konin akisimin; chule veuvin, amaho chu Israel lengte le asuhkhel jeh uva Babylon'a kikaimang Juda lengte lekhabua akisune.","title":"Sohchan na-a Kona Hungkilekit Miho"},"2":{"text":"Tun achanu khopiho-a cheng masapen ho chu; Israelte, thempuho, Levi ho, chule Nethinim ho ahiuve.","ref":"Ezra 2:27; Neh 7:73"},"3":{"text":"Chule Jerusalem'a Judah chate, Benjamin chate, chule Ephraim le Manasseh chate achengun; amaho chu:"},"4":{"text":"Judah chapa Pharez chapate lah-a kon Bani chapa, achapa Imri, Imri chapa, Omri chapa, Ammihud chapa Uthai."},"5":{"text":"Shilon mite lah-a kon; acha masa Asaiah le achapate."},"6":{"text":"Chule Zerah chapate lah-a; Jeuel le asopite mi jaguple somko."},"7":{"text":"Chule Benjamin chapate lah-a kon: Hasenuah chapa Hodaviah, Hodaviah chapa Meshullam, chule Meshullam chapa Sallu,"},"8":{"text":"Jeroham chapa Ibneiah, Michri chapa Uzzi, Uzzi chapa Elah, Ebnijah chapa Reuel, Reuel chapa Shephatiah, Shephatiah chapa Meshullam,"},"9":{"text":"Chule akhangu dungjuija asopiteu jakole somnga le gup ahiuve. Hicheho sesehi apu apateu insunga aluchang cheh ahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Chule thempuho lah-a kon; Jedaiah, Jehoiarib le Jachin,","title":"Jerusalem'a Cheng Thempuho"},"11":{"text":"Chule Pathen in'a vaihompa Ahitub chapa Meraioth, Meraioth chapa Zadok, Zadok chapa Meshullam, Meshullam chapa Hilkiah, Hilkiah chapa Azariah,"},"12":{"text":"Chule Malchijah chapa Pashhur, Pashhur chapa Jeroham, Jeroham chapa Adaiah, chule Immer chapa Meshillemith, Meshillemith chapa Meshullam, Meshullam chapa Jahzerah, Jahzerah chapa Adiel, Adiel chapa Maasia,"},"13":{"text":"Chule asopiteu, apu apateu insunga luchangcheh sangkhat le somgup ahiuvin, Pathen insunga kinbolna-a natong hatcheh ahiuve."},"14":{"text":"Chule Levi ho lah-a kon: Merari chapate lah-a Hashabiah chapa Azrikam, Azrikam chapa Hasshub, Hasshub chapa Shemaiah,","title":"Jerusalem'a Cheng Levi Mite"},"15":{"text":"Chule Asaph chapa Zichri, Zichri chapa Micah, Micah chapa Mattaniah, Galal, Haresh, chule Bakbakkar,"},"16":{"text":"Chule Jeduthun chapa Galal, Galal chapa Shemaiah, Shemaiah chapa Obadiah, chule Netophah mite khoho-a chengho Elkanah chapa Asa, Asa chapa Berechiah ahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chule kotngah ho chu Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman chule asopiteu jong ahi. Shallum chu apipuipen ahi.","title":"Jerusalem'a Cheng Houin Ngahho"},"18":{"text":"Lengpa solam kotpi chu tumasang sen angah jiuvin, amahohi Levi chate kiloikhom lah-a kotngah ho chu ahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Chule Korah chapa Ebiasaph, Ebiasaph chapa Kore, Kore chapa Shallum le asopite, apa insunga kon Korah mite chu Houbuh kotngah-a panga, kinbolna-a natonga pang ahiuve. Chule apu apateu chu Pakai janelho ngahmun lutna ngahtupma anapang ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chule Eleazar chapa Phinehas chu tumasanga amaho chunga vaihoma pang ahin, Pakaiyin aumpin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule Meshelemiah chapa Zakariah chu Houkhom ho Houbuh kotngahpa ahi."},"22":{"text":"Kotphungho ngahdinga lhendoh ho jousehi mi jani leh somleni ahiuve. Hichehohi akhohouva akhangguiju kisut dungjuija David le themgao Samuel'in atohmunu tongdinga anasuhdetsa ahiuve."},"23":{"text":"Hitichun amahole achateu chun Houbuh Pakai in kotphungho chu avetup mun, angahtup mum ahi."},"24":{"text":"Kotngah ho chu aningli: solam, lhumlam, sahlam chule lhanglama umuva ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule asopihou akhoneo houva umho ni sagi sehle aphat phatna amahotoh umdinga hungji dingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hiche Levi mi ngahtup pipui li hochun akingansenao Pathen in indanho le goukholna indanho chu avetupmun ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule jingkah seh-a kot hongdinga kinganse ahijeh-un Pathen in kimvela chun ageh jiuvin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule alah uva abang um le bel kinbol ahiuvin, akoilut alahdoh tengule asimcheh jiu ahi.","title":"Levi Mite Dangdang ho"},"29":{"text":"Amaho abang chu um le bel ho le munthenga manchah ho jouse: changbong, lengpitwi, sathao, bego chule gimnamtui ho vetup dinga kipansah ahiuve."},"30":{"text":"Chule thempuho chapate phabep chun nuding gimnamtui asemun ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule Korah mi Shallum chamasa Levi mikhat Mattithiah kitipa chu khangbel ho-a kikang thilto chunga natohna neidinga kinganse ahitai."},"32":{"text":"Chule asopihou loikhat Kohath mite chapate chu vetsahna changlhah chunga tohmun nei ahiuvin, cholngahni seh-a asemdingu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule hichehohi lasaho ahiuvin, Levi ho pate lah-a pipui, indan sunga um a-ongthola umjingho ahiuve; ajehchu amahon chuche nachu sunle jana atoh-u ahi."},"34":{"text":"Levi pate pipui hohi akhangu lhumkeija pipui ahiuvin; amaho Jerusalem'a achengun ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chule Gibeon'a chun Gibeon mite pa Jehiel achengin, a-inneipi minchu Maakah ahi.","title":"Saul Lengpa Hungkondohna le Achilhah ho"},"36":{"text":"Chule achapa masapen chu Abdon ahin, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,"},"37":{"text":"Gedor, Ahio, Zekeriah chule Mikloth toh ahiuve."},"38":{"text":"Chule Mikloth'in Shimeam ahinge. Chule amaho jong asopihou toh kikotmai ngatnin Jerusalem'a achenguve."},"39":{"text":"Chule Ner'in Kish ahingin, Kish'in Saul ahingin, Chule Saul in Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab chule Eshbaal ahingin ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chule Jonathan chapa chu Merib-baal ahin, Merib-baal'in Micah ahingin ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chule Micah chapate chu; Pithon, Melech, Tahrea chule Ahaz ahiuve."},"42":{"text":"Chule Ahaz'in Jarah ahingin, Jarah'in Alemeth, Azmaveth chule Zimri ahingin, chule Zimri'in Moza ahinge."},"43":{"text":"Chule Moza'in Binea ahingin, Binea chapa chu Rephaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapa chu Eleasah ahin, Eleasah chapa chu Azel ahi."},"44":{"text":"Chule Azel'in chapa gup aneijin, aminu hiche ahi: Azrikam, Bokheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah chule Hanan. Hicheho jousehi Azel chapate ahiuve."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Philistine ten Israelte ahinsatnun; Israel mite chu Philistine te masanga ajam taovin, chule Gilboa molsanga chun mi tamtah athiuvin ahi.","title":"Saul Lengpa Thi (1 Sam 31:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Chule Philistine ten Saul le achate chu hadelin adelun; hitichun Philistine te chun Saul chapate Jonathan, Abinadab, chule Malchishua chu athat taovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin gal chu Saul dingin ahahsalheh jengtan, chuin thal themhon ahinkap khauvin, thalthem hon amavotaovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Saul'in agalvon popa jah-a, Nachemjam satdoh inlang, hiche cheptan louho khu ahunguva eihung jumso louna dingun, neisun pailet jenggin, ati. Ahivangin agalvon popa chu anompoi; ajehchu ama akichalheh jengin ahi. Hijeh chun Saul'in achemjam alan, achung chu abotan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule agalvon popan Saul athi amuphatnin, chutobang machun achemjam chungchu abon, athitan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hitichun Saul le achapate thum, chule a-insung jouse chu athikhom taovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin phaichama um Israel miho jousen, amaho ajamuva, chule Saul le achapate athiu chu amu phatnun, akhopihou adalhauvin ajamtaovin ahi. Chuin Philistine te ahungun, hicheho-a chun acheng taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, Philistine te mithiho von sutlha dinga ahunguva ahile, Saul le achapate Gilboa molsanga anathiu chu amudoh taovin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin avon asutlhah phatnun, aluchang le agalvon alauvin, amilim semthuhou le mipite henga thupha pole dingin Philistine te gamsunga athot kimvel taovin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule agalvonho chu a-pathen houin'a akoijun, aluchu Dagon houin'a atah-un ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Jabesh-Gilead mite jousen Saul chunga Philistine te thilbol jouse ajah phatnun,"},"12":{"text":"Mihangsan sese akipatnun, Saul le achapate longchu agalamangun, Jabesh'a ahinpouvin, aguhou chu Jabesh'a gangpi thing noija chun avuijun, chule nisagi an angolun ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hitichun Saul chu Pakai thu angailou jeh le, lhakou ho henga thumop adoh-a, Pakai douna suhkhelna aneitah jeh-in athitan ahi;","ref":"Thmpu 19:31; 20:6; 1 Sam 13:8-14; 15:1-24; 28:7-8."},"14":{"text":"Chule aman Pakai adongpon: hijeh chun aman ama chu athatnin, chule alenggam chu Jesse chapa David henga apetan ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Israelte jouse David henga Hebron'a ahung kikhom khomun, ahenga, Ven keiho nagule naphe kahiuve.","title":"David Judah le Israel Chunga Lenga Kipansah (2 Sam 5:1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Chujongle tumasanga Saul lengchanlaijin jong Israel puidoh'a puilutjia chu nangma nahin: chule Pakai na Pathen'in naheng-ah, Nangman kami Israelte navah-a, kamipi Israelte chunga vai napoh ding ahi, ati'e atiuvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun Israel upaho jouse Hebron'a lengpa henga ahungun; David'in Hebron'a chun amahotoh Pakai masanga kitepna asemin; chuin Pakaiyin Samuel mangcha asei thucheng dung juijin, David chu Israel chunga leng hidingin thao anutaovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin David le Israelte jouse Jerusalem'a acheuvin, hichu Jebus ahin; chuche gama anachengho chu Jebus mite ahiuve.","ref":"Josh 15:63; Thutn 1:21"},"5":{"text":"Chuin Jebus'a chengho chun David hengah, Nangma hilama nahunglou helding ahi, atiuve. Ahijeng vangin David'in Zion kulpi chu alan, hichu David khopi ahung hitai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin David'in, Koihile Jebus mite gasat masapen pen chu lamkaiho pipui hiding ahi, ati. Hitichun Zeruiah chapa Joab chu akontou masapenin, apipuipen ahitan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin David chu kulpi-a chun achengin; hijeh chun amahon hichu David khopi asahtaovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin aman khopi chu Millo'a pat akimvelse geijin asadoh-in; chule Joab'in khopi amohse chu asemphan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hitichun janel Pakaiyin aumpi jeh chun; David akhangtou chehcheh jengtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hicheho hi Israelte chungchanga Pathen'in anaseidoh dungjuija David'in anei mihat pipuiho, alenggam sunga ama le Israel pumpi to kisuhat hochu ahiuve.","title":"David Galhangho (2 Sam 23:8-39)"},"11":{"text":"Chule hichehi David'in anei mihat jat ahi: gal lamkaiho pipuipen Hachmon mi Jashobeam ahin: aman atengcha alamin phat khatseh'in mi jathum jen athatgam helin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule ama bana chu Ahoh mi Dodo chapa Eleazer ahin, amahi mihat thumho lah-a khat ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ama David toh Pasdamim'a umkhom ahin, chule hiche mun'a chun Philistine te galsat dingin anakikhom khomun, chule hiche mun'a chu sakol chang dimsetna akena leiset beh khat aumin ahi. Chuin mipi ho chu Philistine te masanga konin ajamtaove."},"14":{"text":"Chuin amaho chu loulaija chun dettah-in apangun, ahuhdoh-un, chule Philistine te chu athatnun; chule Pakaiyin amaho chu huhdohna loupitah-in ahuhdohtai."},"15":{"text":"Tun gal lamkai somthum lah-a mi thum chu, songpi lama Adullam songko sunga David henga chun achesuh-un; chule Philistine sepai janel chun Rephaim phaichama chun pon in akison uvin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule hichepetna chu David kulpi-a uma ahin, chule Philistine te galsat miho chu Bethlehem'a pansaova ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin David'in ngaicha tah-in, Oh Bethlehem kotpi phung twikul'a twi chu dondinga eipethei khattou umtave leh! ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin mi thumho chun Philistine sepai janel chu aphu vangun, Bethlehem kotpi phung twikul'a konin twi agakhaijun, ahin domun, David henga ahinchoijun ahi: ahinla hiche donding chu David anompon, ahinla Pakai henga asunglha jon,"},"19":{"text":"Hitin ati, Hiche kabolding hi ka Pathen'in eijahda maihen: ahinkhou tosetna-a dinga pedoh hiche miho thisanhi kadon dingham? Ajehchu ahinkhou tosetna puma ahinchoiju ahi, ati. Hijeh-a chun aman adon tapon ahi. Hichehohi mihat chungnung thumho bol ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Joab sopipa Abishai hi thumho pipui ahi: ajehchu aman mi jathum chunga atengcha alamin, athat gamhelin, thumho lah-a minphatna achangtai."},"21":{"text":"Mi thumho lah-a chun ni teni sangin amachu ja-aumjon ahi; ajehchu ama alamkaiju ahi. Hijongle amasa mi thumho chu aphajoupoi."},"22":{"text":"Kabzeel kho-a mihangsan pa chapa Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chun tohdoh tampi aneijin; keipi bahkai tobang Moab mi ni athatnin; chule achesuh-in buhbang lhah laijin kokhuh sunga keipi bahkai khat jong athatnin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule aman milen pitah, tong nga-a sang Egypt mi khat athatnin; chule Egypt mipa chun ponkhong ho talhang tejen tengcha khat akichoi ahin; chule aman atenggol akichoijin ajonsuh-in, Egypt mipa khutna konchun atengcha asalhah peh-in, ama tengcha mama chun athattan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hichehohi Jehoiada chapa Benaiah thilbol ahin; mihat chungnung thumho lah-a chun minphat achangtan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Veuvin, ama somthum lah-a jana achangin, ahin amasa mi thumho vang chu aphadehpoi; amachu David'in ama ngahtupho chunga apansah-in ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chujongle agalsat ho lah-a mihangsan ho chu, Joab sopipa Asahel, Bethlehem'a Dodo chapa Elhanan,"},"27":{"text":"Haror mi Shammoth, Pelon mi
