ajehchu miphalhem koimacha a-anga lutlou ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Kathuseihi phatechan ngai phaovin, chule kaphondoh hi nanakhangun ngaijun."},"18":{"text":"Tun veuvin, kathuhi kagong tuptai; keima them eiki chanding ahi ti kakihetne."},"19":{"text":"Keima eiseihu ding koiham? ajehchu tun keima thiptaleng kalhagao kalhadoh ding ahitai."},"20":{"text":"Kadingin thilni sehseh hi boldan, chutengle nangma-a konin keima kiselmang taponge.","title":"Job Kineosah Tah-a Atao"},"21":{"text":"Keija konin gamlatah-in nakhut lamangin, chule natijat na-in neikichat sah hih-in."},"22":{"text":"Chutengle nangman neikouvin, keiman donbut nange, ahiloule keiman seijing ting chule neidonbut in."},"23":{"text":"Kachonsetna le kakhan gitlounaho hi ijatloma tama hitam? Kasuh khelnale kachonsetna hohi neihetsah-in."},"24":{"text":"Ipijeh-a namai nasela, namelma-a neingaito ham?"},"25":{"text":"Nangin suhle touva huijin alhohle thingna chu nahe ngem ding ham? Chule chang kung gosa nadel lele ding ham?"},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman keima douna-in thilse tah najih-in, chule kakhang donlaija khangitlouna jouse chu neichansah tai."},"27":{"text":"Nangman kakeng jong thinghom sung ho-a nakoijin; chule kalamlhah ho jouse hoitah-in navejingin, nangin kakengto teni-a din teptena nakoijin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule keima thil monsa tobang kahin, ngetnin aneh chaisa ponse tobang kahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Numeija hung penga mihem hinkho hi nichomcha bou ahin, chule lungkham nan adimsetne."},"2":{"text":"Pahcha bangin ahung pahdoh jin, chule akisat tan jitai; ama nilim kihei bangin alhaijin, atangden jitai."},"3":{"text":"Hitobang bep mi khat hi nangin namit lhuh jinga, chule nahenga thu kitan dinga neipui lutjiham?"},"4":{"text":"Kon thilthenglou lah-a kona thiltheng alahdoh theijem? koima cha aumpoi."},"5":{"text":"Ama hin nikho hi tepsa ahin, ahinkho lha ho jong nangkoma umah ahin? aman akhokhel louna din nangin agamgi nasempeh-in;"},"6":{"text":"Thalah tobang ahin nikho hi, aman lhumkah-a acholdo theina din, ama-a konin kiheimangin."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu thingphung khat chu kiphuh lhu jongle, ajih ahung dondoh kitding le, chule hiche abah kisepthah chu atanden louding kinepna aneijin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajung chu leinoi'a motgam henlang, aphungbul chu leinoi'a thi jongle;"},"9":{"text":"Twija konin hichu hung mumdoh kitnintin, chule thingphung banga abah ahinsepdoh nahlai ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahin mihem athin, manthei louvin paimang ahijitai: henge, mihemin alhagao alhajin, hoija umji-a hitam?"},"11":{"text":"Twipia kona twiho alhahsam bangle, twisoh lai akana agot jeng bangin;"},"12":{"text":"Hitichun mihem chu a-imu miljin, athoudohji tapoi; vanho jouse abeito kahse-a amaho khang taloudiu, alupnaova kona thou jong thou taloudiu ahitai."},"13":{"text":"O nangin nalungsatna abeikah-a guh thima neikoija, lhan khuh sunga hi neisel ding hija; nangin keija dinga phat khat neitep peh-a, chule neigeldoh kit ding hitavele!"},"14":{"text":"Mihem khat athile ahingkit dem? kakikhelna ding nikho ahung lhun kah-a, keiman eikiteppeh phat nikho ho chu kanga ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nangman neikouvin natin, keima kahou ding; nangman nakhutsem chunga hi ngaichat nahin neiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu tun nangin kakalse jat nasima; chule kachonsetna hi navet lhih jing hilouham?"},"17":{"text":"Kasuhkhelna hi sakhao sunga khumtupmin aumin, chule kakhan gitlouna nangin nakhui chahjin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule thonlou hella molsang hung chimma ahal halla mang ding, chule songpi chu aumna-a kona kitoldoh ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Twijin song ho alhoh mangin; nangin leivui lah-a kona hung kehdoh thil jouse chu twijin nasumangin, chule mihem kinepna chu nasumang tan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Nangin ama a-imatih-a din najouvin, ama achetai; nangin amaiso nakhel peh-in chule nasolmangtan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Achapate chu jabolna pedin ahungun, ahin aman hichu ahetapoi; amaho suhnemin aumtaovin, ahin aman amaho ageldoh tapon ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla atahsa chun natna athoh ding, chule ama-a um hinna chun pul adou ding ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Teman mi Eliphaz'in adonbutnin, aseije,","title":"Eliphaz: Job'in Sakho I-sah louva Abol Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Michingin pannabei thu aseidohjia, chule solam huija asung asuhdim ji-em?"},"3":{"text":"Aman phatchomna umlou thu kisei chu anel ding ham? ahiloule thilpha bolna theilou thu aseiding ham?"},"4":{"text":"Ahi, nangin kichatna napaimangin, chule Pathen anga taona nasutange."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu nakamin nakhangit louna aphondoh-a, chule doha lheplhahna lei chu nakilhen ahitai."},"6":{"text":"Nakamin nangma themmo nachan ahin, keima kahipoi; henge, namuh-in nangma dounan thu ahettohsah-in ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ana peng masapenah mihem chu nangma nahim? ahiloule mol le lhangho masanga ana kisema chu nangma nahim?"},"8":{"text":"Nangin Pathen thuguh chu najahkhah am? chule chihna hi nangma sehseh-in naneija nangaito ham?"},"9":{"text":"Keihon kahet louvu nangin ipi nahet em? keiho-a umlou nangin ipi hetthemna naneijem?"},"10":{"text":"Kalah uvah napa sanga gamchenga upajo, lukangle, tehsejo a-umui."},"11":{"text":"Pathen'a kona lhamona hohi nadinga thilneo ham? nadinga aguh-a um thil ipi umem?"},"12":{"text":"Ipi dinga nalungin nangma napuimang hitam? chule namit nin ipi aphet lhap lhap piham?"},"13":{"text":"Hitia chu nalhagao Pathen douna-a naleheija, chule nakama kona hitobang thuho hi naso dohsah hitam?"},"14":{"text":"Mihem chu ipi hija theng tei ding hija ham? numeija kona penga chu chonpha teiding hija ham?","ref":"Job 25:4-6."},"15":{"text":"Veovin, aman amithengte lah-a tahsana akoipoi; henge, ama mitmun van ho jong atheng pouvin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Khan gitlouna twi banga donna mihem hi, ichanna lenjo-a thet umle theng lou jocheh-a hitam?"},"17":{"text":"Ngaijin, keiman navetsah-inge; chule kamu tah chu kaphon doh ding ahin;"},"18":{"text":"Miching hon apateova kona anaseiju, chule aselmang louvu;"},"19":{"text":"Hitobang miho henga bou chun leiset hi anakipen, gamchom mi alah uva vahlea aumpoi."},"20":{"text":"Mi khang gilou chun ahinkho lhum keijin natna athoh-in, chule ahinkho kum jat chu misugenthei pa-a akiselin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tijat umtah awgin chu anakhanga agingin; aphatthei laitahle mi sumangpa achunga hung lhung ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Muthima kona kiledoh ding kahi ti aman atahsan joupon, aman alouna ding chemjam chu angah-in ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ama an holnan avah kimvelin, hoija uma hitam? atin, thimjin nikho gotsa chu ahungnai tai, ti ahen ahi."},"24":{"text":"Lungkhamna le lung genthei na-in ama akichatsah ding; leng khat galsat dinga akigot banga, amahon ama ajokhupdio ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ajehchu aman akhut Pathen dounan alhangdoh-in, hat chungnung pen douna-in amale ama aki suhatnin,"},"26":{"text":"Ama, ama chungle angong chang chung gei, chule alum satah ho chunga chun alhailen ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu aman amai chu athaovin atomin, ataija chun athao akikhol khome."},"28":{"text":"Suhmanga umdinga gotsa, koimacha chen khah louna, khopi kamhelsa-a um inho-a chun ama achengin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ama haodoh lou ding, anei agou jong umjing lou ding, aman leisetna hiche ho-a chu ninglhinna aneisot lou ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ama muthima kona potdoh talou ding; meikongin abahho chu aleo got ding, chule akama ahaina hu-a chu ama jammang ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ama chu ahomkeo tahsan dinga kilhemlha-a hihih hen; ajehchu ama kilethuhna ding chu ahomkeo ahibouve."},"32":{"text":"Hiche hi ama phat masanga kisu bulhit ding, chuleh ama bah chu ana hing lou ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Aman lengpithei banga amin lou agaho chu aholhah ding, chule apah chu olive banga apaidoh ding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Ajehchu miphalhem kikhomho chu kamhel ding, nehguhna houbuh chu meija kisumang ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Amahon thilphalou naovop in avopmun, ahomkeo ahungsoh-in, lheplhahna chu a-oijuva akigongjin ahi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"chuin Job'in adonbutnin, aseije,","title":"Job'in Themona Bei Ahi Avelsei"},"2":{"text":"Keiman hitobang thil ho tamtah kajai, mi sugenthei dinga lhamon sah-a panga chu nangho nahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Pannabei thuho hin akichaina aneijem? ahiloule ipin nasuh thouva hitia chu nadonbut ham?"},"4":{"text":"Nahinnao hi keima hinna khela hinga hileh, kenjong nangho bangin kaseithei ding ahin; nangho douna-a thuho kasei doh ding, chule kalu hi kathin khum ding nahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Ahin kakamin nangho suhatning ting, kakama kona pot thu chun nahahsat nao angaijang ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Keiman seijong leng kahesohna hi oldom dehponte, chule keiman thoh thoh jong leng ipiham kanopna ding?"},"7":{"text":"Ahin, tun aman eithacholsah ahitan, nangin kagol kapai ho jouse nasuh kamhel ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Chule keima douna-a hettohsah din nangman kapuma tivoijin neikoijin; chule kamaija hettohsahna hidin, katahsa agong lhan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aman alung hanna-a eibottelin, keima eihotai; aman kachunga aha eigel khumin; kamelman mitsal tengin eive-e."},"10":{"text":"Amahon kachunga akamu lentah-in akah-un; isahlou tah-in kabengphe abengun; keima dounan amaho akikhom khomun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pathen'in ama ngaisah lou mite henga eipedoh-in, khang giloute khutna eipaidoh tan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Keima nom-in kana umin, ahin aman ahal halin eisuchiptan; aman kalollin jong eimanin, eithingin, ama bidoija din eitungdoh-e."},"13":{"text":"Athal kap hon eium kimvelun, aman kakalteni khenlouhellin asukhenin; kathinkha tolla asung lhan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Aman setna chunga setna-in eisusetan, kachunga milen mihat tah bangin alhailen ahi."},"15":{"text":"Katahsa vou chunga hin khaodip pon kakikhun, chule leivui lah-a hin kaki asuboh tai."},"16":{"text":"Kamai hi kaka kanan asan dohtan, kamitgeiho hi thina le-lim alange."},"17":{"text":"Kakhut tenihi thildihlou imacha-a din kamangpon; kataona jong hi atheng ahi."},"18":{"text":"Vo leiset, nangin kathisan hi vuhmang hih-in, chuleh kaka nahin mun neihih hen."},"19":{"text":"Chujongle tun, veuvin, keima hettohsahna chu van'a aume, chuleh kathu kichinna bu chu chungsanga aume.","ref":"Job 19:25."},"20":{"text":"Kagol tehon nasahmon eibolun; ahinla kamit lhihi Pathen heng lama along jinge."},"21":{"text":"Mihem khat a-inheng dinga atao bangin, mihem khat dinga mikhat Pathen'a taopeh ding uma hile o!"},"22":{"text":"Kum phabep ahung lhunteng, hung kile kit lounading mun'a chu keima kache ding ahitai."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kahaina hi akemtan; kahin nikho hojong alhasuhtan, keima dinga lhan khuh ho chu gotsa ahitai.","title":"Thoh olna Dinga Job Taona"},"2":{"text":"Mi nelpeh ho chu kakoma um hilou ham? ami phin lunghang nao hi kamitnin avet lhih jing hilou ham?"},"3":{"text":"Tun, keima nanga dinga kitepna khat nin nei umsah-in; keima to kikhutsan ding chu koiham?"},"4":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangman alung thimu chu hetthem theina-a konin nasel mangpeh-in; hijeh-a chu amaho nachoisang louding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Agol apaiho henga pachat lhem thuseipa chu, achate mit ngeijong khomulouva umding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Mite seichah thei din jong aman eisem dohtan; chule phat masalaija chu min achil aset khum mi tobang kana hi."},"7":{"text":"Kahesoh na jeh in kamit jong hi athimin, katibah hojong nilim kihei abangtan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Milungdih hochun hiche hi kidang saovintin, themona neilou michu miphalhem dounan amale ama kitildoh inte."},"9":{"text":"Michonphan alampi jong kituh chah intin, chule akhutho thengsella umsah jingpa chu hatcheh cheh ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahin nangho jouse vang, tun hungkile kitnun lang, hungun,; ajeh chu keiman nalah uva hin miching khat jong kamu doh joupoi."},"11":{"text":"Kahin nikhoho achetan, kathil gon hole kalunga kagelho jeng jong abonin achavaitai."},"12":{"text":"Hicheho chun jan chu sun aso-un; muthim jeh-in khovah achome."},"13":{"text":"Keiman ngah taleng, lhankhuh chu ka-in ahitan; ka jalkhun chu muthim lah-a kakisemtan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Keiman monmang thei jah-a chun, nangma kapa nahi; lung jah-a chun, nangma kanule kasopinu chu nahi, kati."},"15":{"text":"Achutile tu-a kakinepna chu hoija umtam? kakinepna vangchu kon amuding hitam?"},"16":{"text":"Leivui toh kichoh halla kicholdo kahung hitenguleh, amaho aki khahtup kotong lam jona chu chesuh ding ahiuve."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Shuh mi Bildad nin adonbutnin, aseije,","title":"Bildan: Pathen'in Migilou Chu Gotna Apejin Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Thuho nachaina ding chu itih chan hiding ham? melchih-in, chujouteng keihon seijuvinge."},"3":{"text":"Ipijeh-a keiho gamsa-a eiki simuva, chule namitmu-a man mo-a eikigelu ham?"},"4":{"text":"Alung hanna-a amale ama kimal teljia; nang dinga leiset hi kidalha ding ham? chule songpi chu aumna-a kona kichondoh ding ham?"},"5":{"text":"Henge, mi khang gilou meivah chu kisumit ding, chule ameikonga meisi chu vahdoh louding ahi.","ref":"Job 21:17."},"6":{"text":"Ahoubuh sunga meivah chu thimding, chule athaomei chu ama puma kisuhmit thading ahi."},"7":{"text":"Athahat lai kalsena ho chu kisu chom ding, amatah thumopna chun ama asotlhah ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajeh chu amatah kengchun ama lenthang sunga akhumlutna, chule ama thang kikam chunga vahlea ahi."},"9":{"text":"Thangin akhotal jum-a akhi khah ding, chule gucha michompa chun ama ajo ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ama dinga thang kikam chu leinoi'a akivuijin, athangchu lampia akidoi."},"11":{"text":"Tijatna hon ning jouse-a ama akichatsah ding, akeng geija ahin no ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Athahatna chu gilkel thohna hung hintin, chule manthah na chu ama-a gotsa hiding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hichun atichung vun thaneina chu aval lhum ding; thina peng masapen ngeichun athahatna avallhum ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ama thil tahsana chu a houbuh sunga kona kila dohding, hichun ama tijat umtah lengpa henga ahin lhut ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hichu ama houbuh sunga hung cheng inte, ajeh chu ama-a khatcha ahitapoi; ama chena chunga chu meile kaat kithejal ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajung ho chu noilanga gopgamin tin, chule chung langa abah chu kisat lha ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ama kigeldoh jingna chu leisetna kona mangding, chule aman khopi lamlena min kiphah pohna aneilou ding ahitai."},"18":{"text":"Ama khovah-a konin muthim lah-a nodoh-in umintin, chule vannoi'a kona kideldoh hiding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Aman amite lah-a achapa le asopiten ahin chapate aneilou ding, chujongle achena sung ho-a ahinga um umlou ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ana che masa hon tijatna ana nei banguva, ama nunga hung ho chu ama nikho nileh kidang asah diu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tahbeh-a hitobang hi mi khang gilouho chena chu ahin, chule hiche hi Pathen hepha louho mun chu ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Job'in adonbutnin, aseije:","title":"Job: Kahuhhingpu Ahinge Ti Kahei"},"2":{"text":"Nanghon itihchan kahina hi nasuhgenthei uva, chule thua ahal hala suhchip ding neigotnu hitam?"},"3":{"text":"Hiche somvei jenhi i-sah louvin neibolun; kahenga hetkhah lou mibanga nachonu hi jachatnan naneipouvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule bolkhel kanei hijeng jongle, kadihlouna chu keima-a umding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tahbeh-a keidouna-a nangho kichoisang nahiule, i-sah louva eikibol nahi keima douna-a nelkalna mang nahiule;"},"6":{"text":"Tun heovin, Pathen'in keima eisot lhah ahitan, chule alen thang chun eiumkivel ahitai."},"7":{"text":"Veovin, keiman dihlou na-a konin kasamin, ahin eikijah peh tapoi; hatah-in kasamin, ahinla thutana ima aumpoi."},"8":{"text":"Keima kache thei louna din, aman kalamlhah na-ah pal agenin, chule kalam lhahna-a thim ajin sah-in ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aman kaloupina eiho lhah peh-in, chule kalua konin lallukhuh aladoh-in ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aman keima lam jouse-a eisumang tan, keima akichai kahitai, chule aman kakinepna hi thingphung banga abodoh ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Aman keima dounan alungsatna jong akoudoh sah-in, chule amelma holah-a khat bangin eisimtai."},"12":{"text":"Agalsat mite ahung khomun, keima douna din lampi akisemun, chule kahoubuh kimvela gebuh akisonun ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aman kasopite keija konin gamlatah-in akoijin, chule keima kimel hetpi hojong tahbeh-a keija kona achoma umdoh ahitaove."},"14":{"text":"Ka-in kote alosamtan, chule kaki ngailutpi gol le paihon eisumil taovin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Keima in'a cheng mite le kasoh numei hon gamchom min eisim taovin; amitmu uvin gamchom mi kahitai."},"16":{"text":"Keiman kasohpa kakouvin, ahin aman eidonbutpon; kakam tah-in ahenga kataovin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Kahaina hu hi ka-inneipi-a dingin ajatchom tan, ka-insungmite dinga jong deimo-um kahitai."},"18":{"text":"Ahi, khangdong chapanghon i-sah louvin eibolun; kakipatdoh in ahile, keidouna thu aseijun ahi."},"19":{"text":"Kaki ngailutpi tah golle paihon eihot bolun; kangailut ho chu keima douvin apang taovin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kagu hi kavunle kaphe toh akikamat tan, keima kahani vun sehseh toh hoidoh kahi."},"21":{"text":"O nangho kagol kapaiten neilungset nun, neilungsetnun; ajeh chu Pathen khut chun eitong khatan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ipi dinga Pathen'in eibol genthei banga nanghon neibol genthei uva, katahsa thoh nahohi phaset nasah loulai uham?"},"23":{"text":"Ohe, tun kathu hohi sutlutnin umtavele! Ohe, hiho chu lekhabua kitat doh-a hita vele!"},"24":{"text":"Hiho chu thih lekhabu sutna mol chule ngenin songpi chunga, a-itih-a dinga kigeitong hitavele!"},"25":{"text":"Ajeh chu eilhatdohpa chu ahingin, chule ninunung lamle leiset chunga hung ding ding ahi, ti kahei."},"26":{"text":"Chule kavun bannin hiche katahsa hi lunghon ne manghel jeng jongleu, katahsa tah-a Pathen chu kamu ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Kasunga kalung thimgil jun manghel tajongle, keima-a dinga ama chu kamu ding, chule kamit teni-a kavet ding, adang ima kamulou ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ajehchu keija thiljouse bul akimudoh chu namudiu ipidinga eihon ama isuh genthei diuham? nati diu ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chemjam chu nanghon kichaovin; ajeh chu thutana aume ti nahet theina dinguva, lung hana chun gimbolna chemjam ahin lhut ding ahi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Naamath mi Zophar'in adonbutnin, aseije;","title":"Zophar: Gitlouna-in Lethuhna Asan Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Hijeh chun kalunggel hohin eidonbut sah-in, hiche thua ka kinon ahi."},"3":{"text":"Keima ima eikisahlouna thu kajan, kahetthem theina lhagao chun donbutnin eitin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Leiset chunga mihem aki koija pat, nangman hiche thului hi nahetlou ham?"},"5":{"text":"Hitia chu migilou kichoisang na hi chomcha bou ahin, chule miphalhem kipana jong mitphetkah bou hilou ham?"},"6":{"text":"Alul nachun vanho chan pha henlang, aluchun meibol ho lah phajongle;"},"7":{"text":"Ama a-imatih chana a-eh banga mangthah ding; ama anamu kha-a miho chun, ama hoija um hitam? atidiu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ama mang banga leng manga, kimudoh lou ding ahitan; jana gaothilmu banga ama delmanga umding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ama anamua mit jong chun ama amukit tah louding; chujongle ama ana-umna mun jong chun ama amukit lou ding ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Achaten mivaicha lunglhaina ding hin holuntin, chule akhutnin athilhou alepeh kitding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Aguho chu akhang dong laija chonsetna adimin, hiche chu amato leivui lah-a luptha ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Gitlouna chu a akam sunga lhumlheh henlang, aman hichu alei noija seljongle;"},"13":{"text":"Aman hichu khendoh hen, chule notthap dahen, akamsunga chuti koiden tajongle;"},"14":{"text":"A-oija um anchu akikhelin, asungah gulse thinkha asohtan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Aman haonaho aval lutnin, chule ahin lohdoh kit ding; Pathen'in a-oija kona ahin paidoh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Aman gulseho gu achepding; gulse leijin ama atha ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aman vadungho le twisohho, khoiju le bongnoi lona vachadung ho amulou ding ahitai."},"18":{"text":"Aman acholna man alepehdoh kitna, chule hichu aman aval lhum louding; athil nei dungjuija alepeh kitna jong hiding, aman hichea chu lung lhaina anei louding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ajeh chu aman mivaicha agotchepmin, anungsunin; chule aman asahdoh hilou in chu pumhatnin alapeh-in ahi."},"20":{"text":"Thonlou hella aman asunga damna aneilou ding, chule angaichat ho imacha ahuhdoh jou louding ahi."},"21":{"text":"A-anneh na-a amoh kidalha khatcha umlou ding; hijeh-a chu koiman aphatna amulouding ahitai."},"22":{"text":"Aninglhina pentah chun ama agentheisah ding, khang gilou ho khut jouse chu achunga hung chuding ahi."},"23":{"text":"A-oipoh suhdim ding agot petle, Pathen'in alungsatna chu achunga ahin selhah-a, a-anneh laitah leh hichu achunga go banga julha ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ama thih-a kisem manchah-a kona jam ding, chule thihtah-a kisem thal chun ama asut pailet ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Akiloidoh-in, atahsa-a kon chun ahung dohtan ahi; ahi, chemjam val lahlah chu athinkha-a konin ahung doh-in; tijat umtah ho chu achunga achutai."},"26":{"text":"Muthim jouse chu guthim muna selmanga umding; huijin asemmit joulou meikongin akah vamding; aponbuh sunga kidalha chu ama dinga natna hiding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Van'in ama khangitlouna chu hin phongdoh-in tin; chule leiset chu ama dou dinga hung thoudoh ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"A-insung khantouna chun adalhah ding, chule athilkeo ho chu Ama lungsatna nikhole long mang ding ahitai."},"29":{"text":"Hiche hi migilou pa chanding Pathen'a kon chu ahin, chule Pathen'in ateppeh goulo chu ahitan ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahinla Job'in adonbutnin, aseije:","title":"Job: Mikhang gilouho Gotna Changlouvin Aumjiuve"},"2":{"text":"Kathusei hi lunglut tah-in ngaijun, chule hiche hi nangho kilhamona hihen."},"3":{"text":"Keiman kasei theina din thoh hamham tadiuvin; chule kasei chai tengle nei nelpeh naovin nate."},"4":{"text":"Keima vang, kakiphina hi mihem lama ham? chuti chu hia ahile, ipi dinga kalhagao suhboija umlou ding ham?"},"5":{"text":"Neimel chih unlang kidang saovin, chule nakhut nun nakam simun."},"6":{"text":"Keiman kageldoh teng jongle kati ajan, chule katahsa hi akithing jin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ipi dinga migilouhi hing jinga, hung tehji-a; chule thahat thaneitah hijiuva ham?"},"8":{"text":"Achateu chu amaho mitmu tah-in amaho toh phudoh than aumin, chule achilhahteu chu amaho maikoh-a phudoh-in aume."},"9":{"text":"A-in hou chu kichatna-a konin ahoidoh-in, achunguva Pathen lungsatna moljong achujipon ahi."},"10":{"text":"Abongchal houvin anou ahinsah-un, athona aumpon; abongpiu houvin anou ahingun, anou adalha khapon ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amahon achateu chu ganchahon bangin asoldoh jiuvin, acha teo alam alam jiuvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Amahon khongcha le selangdah akichoijun, tumging kitumgin na-a chun akipah-un ahi."},"13":{"text":"Amahon ahin nikhou chu haosatnan amang jiuvin, chom louvin lhan khuh-a achesuh ji taove."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun amahon Pathen henga, keiho-a konin potdoh tan; ajeh chu nalampi ho hetkhen theina chu keihon kangaicha pouve, atiuve."},"15":{"text":"Keihon kajendiu Hat chungnung amachu ipiham? Keiho ahenga kataovule ipi phatchomna kanei diuham?"},"16":{"text":"Veovin, athilu chu akhutnuva aumpon; migilou thumopna chu keija konin gamla tah-in aumin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mikhang gilou thaomei chu ichana kimutmit matchet jinga hitam! chule amanthahna chu achunguva ichana lhung matchet hitam! Pathen'in alungsatna-a lung gentheina hi ahom dohjie."},"18":{"text":"Amaho huipi masanga chang kong gosa tobang ahiuvin, chule hui leh gon apohmang changsi tobang ahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Pathen'in amapa khansetna chu achateuva din akholpehjin, amapan ahetthei nadin lethuhna apejin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Amit tenin ama kisuh mangna chu amuding, chule Hat chungnung lungsatna chu adon ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ajeh chu ahin nikho lhajat ho akimlaitah-in sattanin umtaleh, anunga ipi nopna insunga anei ding ham?"},"22":{"text":"Aman mi chunglama umho thu atanji-e ti munasa-a, Pathen chu hetna kon ahil dingham?"},"23":{"text":"Mikhat chu lung nomsa chamkimin, athalhin laitah-in athi jin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Anoi teni chu noitwi adimin, chule aguho chu lhintwi adimin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule mi abangchu hinkho hahsa tah-in athijin, kipah-in ima anekha pon ahi."},"26":{"text":"Amaho chu leivui lah-a thakhatna lumdiu, chule lungin amaho atomchah ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Veovin, keiman nalunggel hou, keima douna-a thilgon dihlou nangaito hou jouse chu kahen ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ajeh chu nanghon, leng chapa in chu hoiche hija? chule migiloute chenna mun chu hoilai ham? nati uve."},"29":{"text":"Lampia chelea miho chu nanghon nadoh khah lou uham? chule amaho melchihna chu nahet lou uham?"},"30":{"text":"Mikhang gilou chu manthah nikho-a dinga kikoija hilouham? amaho chu lunghan nikho-a hung kipuidoh ding ahiuve."},"31":{"text":"Koiham alampi ding amaikoh-a phondoh peh thei dinga? chule kon athilbol na chunga lethuhna apeh ding ham?"},"32":{"text":"Hijeng jongle ama chu lhan khuh-a kipui ding, chule buikhuh sunga umding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Phaichama leilhang ho chu ama dinga lhumtah hiding, amasanga simjoulou miho ache banga, mitinin ama nungchu ajui ding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Achutile nathil donbut naovahin jouthu aume ti namunasaova, ipi dinga pannabei ja neilhamonu ham?"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Teman mi Eliphaz'in adonbutnin, aseije;","title":"Eliphaz: Job Khangitlouna hi Lentah Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Achinga jong chu ama dinga bou phachomthei ahijeh-in, Pathen'a dinga mihem hi phachom dingham?","ref":"Job 35:6-8."},"3":{"text":"Nangma chonphatna hi Hat chungnung dinga lunglhaina hinam? ahiloule nalampi ho nachamkim sahna hin ama aphatchom sah hinam?"},"4":{"text":"Nangma nagin jeh-a aman napho ding ham? ama nangto thupi tanna-a lutkhom ding ham?"},"5":{"text":"Nakhan gitlouna hi lentah hilou hija, nakhansetna hohi akhon nabei hilou ham?"},"6":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangin nasopipa-a konin pannabei jin kitepna thil nala-in, chule aponsil ho nahoh lhan sagoh keovin naum sah-in ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nangin thachol techu donding twi napepon, chule changlhah chu agilkel ho-a dingin naphalpon ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahin mihatpan vang leiset aneijin, hia chun gin umtah mihem chu achengin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nangin meithai ho chu khutgoh keovin nasol mangin, chule paneiloute thahat chu aki subong tai."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun nakim vela thangho akikamin, hetmanlou kichatnan nasuboi tai;"},"11":{"text":"Ahiloule kho namu thei louna din thim ajingin; chule twisoh chun nachup tan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Pathen hi vanchung sanga um hilou ham? chule ahsi ho sandan khu vetemin, amaho iti sanna sang hitaovem!"},"13":{"text":"Chule nangin, Pathen'in iti ahet hija? aman meipi thim lah-a thu iti atan theiham? tin naseijin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Meilhang satah ho khu aman amuthei louna dinga akhukhuma pang ahin; chule ama van'a avahkimvel lejin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Mi khang gilouvin ajotji lamlui chu namel chihji em?"},"16":{"text":"Hiho chu aphatnu lhin masangin satlhah-in aumjin, akingapna bul chu twisoh-in achuptai."},"17":{"text":"Hiho chun Pathen henga, keiho-a konin potdoh-in, Hatchung nungin amaho-a dinga ipi abol thei dingham? atiuve."},"18":{"text":"Hijongle aman a-in ho chu thilphan adippeh-in; mikhang gilou thumopna vang chu keija kona gamlatah ahi."},"19":{"text":"Michonphan hichu amun akipahjin; chule themona neilou michun, i-sah loutah-in anuisat khumjin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hichan chun eiho neilegou suhmangin aumpon, ahinla amaho-a amoh chengse meijin akavamtai."},"21":{"text":"Tun nangma amatoh kiheton lang, chule lung mongin umin; hichun nangdinga thilpha ahin lhut ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Nahenga katao ahi, akama kondoh danthu chu kisanin, chule athu chu nalungthim sunga khol khomin."},"23":{"text":"Hat chungnung pen henga nakile kitna ahile, nangma kisadoh-in natin, nangin khansetna chu nahoubuh ho-a kona gamla tah-a nakoi mang ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuteng sana chu leivui banga nakhola, chule Ophir sana chu vachadunga songho banga nakhol khom ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hiteng chule Hat chungnung chu nahongbitna hintin, chule dangka ninglhing setna naneiding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chutengle nangman Hatchung nungpen nachun kipana neijin natin, chule Pathen lama namai nangat ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Nangman ahenga taona neijin natin, aman nataona angaiding, chule nakitepna chu napeh ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Nangman thupeh khat jong naphondoh ding, hichu nachunga tohdoh-a hung umding; chule vahchun nalampi ho asalvah ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Mihem hi akisuh lhah tengle, kitundoh-na aum jie, tia naseiding; aman mi kineosah chu ahuhhing ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Aman themona neilou mi chu ahuhdoh ding ahin, nakhut teni thenna-a chu kihuhdoh ahi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Job'in adonbutnin, aseije.","title":"Job: Kakiphina hi Akhan Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Kakiphina hi tuni chanin akha-in; kakhoisatna sangin kahesohna hi agihjon ahi."},"3":{"text":"Oh ama touna mun ngeija kahung lut theina dingin; keiman ama chu hoijah kamu doh thei tadem?"},"4":{"text":"Keiman amasanga kachung thu lhut ingting, chule kakam sung nelkal na-a kadip ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aman eidonbutna ding thuho chu kihetning ting, chule kahenga asei ding chu ipi ahi, kahetchet ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Aman athahat thunei na-in kachung thu eiseipeh dem? Chutiponte, aman keija hi thahatna ahinkoijoh ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Michonphan chua chu amato thu aseikhom ding; hitia chu thutana-a kona keima a-imatih-a dinga huhdoh kahiding ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Veovin, keima malama kachen, ahin ama hia chun aumpoi; nunglama kachen, ahin ama kahe dohpon ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aman akhut veilama na atongin, ahin ama kamupon; ama kamu theilouna dingin akhut jetlama akiselin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahin aman kakalsena lampi ahen; aman eipatep teng keima sana toh kahungbah ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Kakeng phangin ama kholhahna ho achonin; ama lampi chu kaching jingin, kavah doh khapoi."},"12":{"text":"Ama thupeh-a konin keima nungjong kanungchon kitpon; ama kamsung thuchengho chu ka anneh thilkhoh pen sanga twijon kangai sangin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahin ama lungthim khatseh pu ahin, aman angaitoa bolding ati chu kon aheikon jouding ham?"},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu keima dinga kitepsa thil chu aman atongdohjin, chule hitobang thilho chu akoma tamtah aume."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun lungkhamin amasangah kaumin; kangaiton ahile keiman ama kakichan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen'in kalung asu nemin; chule Hatchung nungin eilung khamsah-e,"},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu keima muthima kona suhmang kanahipon, kamai jong muthim ana khu khum sahpoi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ipi dinga phat hi hat chungnung pa-a kona selmanga aumlou munasa-a, ama he-a miten ama nikho ho chu amulouvu ham?","title":"Leiset Chunga Pumhat Aumjeh-a Job Kiphina"},"2":{"text":"Mi konkhat in gamgi achonji-un; amahon pumhatnin gancha hon alamang jiuvin, hia chun akivah jiuve."},"3":{"text":"Amahon paneiloute sangan chu ahoi mangun, meithai bongchal chu kitepna thil dingin amang jiuve."},"4":{"text":"Amahon angaichate chu lampia konin anodoh-un; leisetna vaichate chu akisel mangji taove."},"5":{"text":"Veovin, nelgama gam sangan bangin, amaho anatoh naovadin apot doh-un; neh ding holin akipat doh-un; gamthip gam chun amaho dingle achateu dingin neh asodoh-e."},"6":{"text":"Amaho amitakipmin louva chang aki-at cheh-un; chule amahon khansetna lengpiga chu aloh khomun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Amahon sagohkeo chu pon beijin ajan gesah-un, hitia chu amaho daplaija silding neilou ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Amaho molsang ho-a gotwijin akotnun, kiselna ding deinan songpi akolun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Amahon pa neilou chu anu-anga konin asat lhaovin, vaichate-a konin kitepna thil ala jiuve."},"10":{"text":"Amahon pon beijin sagoh keovin ache sah-un; chule gilkelpa-a konin changphal alah mang peh-un;"},"11":{"text":"Abang hou sunglama thao aheh-un, alengpiga hou achilun; dangchah athoh-un ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mihem hi khopi sunga konin khoisan aumun, akimavo miho hinna ataovin; hijongle Pathen'in amaho chu ngaipeh-in aneipoi."},"13":{"text":"Amaho khovah douna-a kiphin mite ahiuvin; alampihou ahethei pouvin, hiche lampia chun umjong aumthei pouve."},"14":{"text":"Tolthat ho khovah le athouvun, vaichale ngaicha jingte athat jiuvin, janle gucha abangun ahi."},"15":{"text":"Jonthanhoi bolnom mit jongchun khothim angah jingin, koiman eimu ponte tin, amaiso akikhelsah jin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Sunteng melchihna akisemu in hochu janteng avut jiuvin; amahon khovah kiti ahepouve."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho din jingkah chu thina le-lim toh abangin; khat touvin amaho ahetnule, thina le-lim kichan aumjiuvin ahi"},"18":{"text":"Ama twi banga ganga ahin; achanu chu leisetna gaosap ahin; aman lengpilei ho lampi chu amuphapon ahi."},"19":{"text":"Gamgot le nichang satnin buhbang twiho ajunsah tan, hitobanga chu lhankhuh-in jong michonse te chu abol ahi."},"20":{"text":"Naobun amachu asuhmil ding; lungin amachu nomsa tah-a kivahnan neijintin; ama geldoh-a umtalou ding, chule khan gitlouna chu thingbanga phuhlhuh-a umding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Aman cha neilou achinga chu kivahnan mangchan tin; meithai chunga thilpha abolpeh louding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Aman mihatpa jong chu athaneinan akaijin; ama akipat dohjin, chule hinkho kicheh tah mihem koiman aneipoi."},"23":{"text":"Akicholdo nadin, bitkeicha aumna ding kipe jongle, amit chun alampi hou avetjing ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Amaho phat chomcha dinga kichoisang ahiuvin, ahinla suh nemin aumin akichaijitaove; amaho alampiuva kona midangho banga kimandoh ahiuvin, changvuileh kisih tan banga kisattanji ahi taove."},"25":{"text":"Chule tun hichu ahilouva ahile, koiham keima eijousah-a, chule kathusei pannabei ahi tiding chu?"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Shuh mi, Bildad'in adonbutnin, aseitai.","title":"Bildad: Thithei Mihem Chu Pathen Anga Iti Chonphatthei Dingham?"},"2":{"text":"Vaihom nale kichatna chu ama-a aumin, aman amunsang ho-a chamna aumsah-in ahi."},"3":{"text":"Agalsatmite ho ajat umthei ngaijem? chule achunguva avahsodoh louna mite umem?"},"4":{"text":"Achutile mihem hi Pathen angsunga iti themchang thei dingham? ahilouleh numeija kona peng mihem chu iti thenjou ding ham?"},"5":{"text":"Lha jeng jong khu veuvin, avahjipon ahi; henge, ama mitmu-a ahsi ho jong athengpon ahi."},"6":{"text":"Lungtol bangbep mihem hi ichan geija lhasamjo ham? mihem chapa hi, lungtol bangbep hia hitam?"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahinla Job'in adonbutnin, aseije:","title":"Job: Pathen Chungnun nahi Holdoh Jouhoi Ahipoi"},"2":{"text":"Nangin tha neilou mi chu iti nakithopi-a, tha neilou ban chu iti nahuhdoh-am?"},"3":{"text":"Chihna neilou mi chu nangin iti nathumop ma? chule ahina banga thilchu iti lhingsetna naphondoh am?"},"4":{"text":"Koi koma nangin thuho naseijam? Chule nanga kona koi lhagao hungdoh am?"},"5":{"text":"Thil thiho jousele chuche-a chengho jouse chu, twinoija kona kisem ahi."},"6":{"text":"Damun chu ama masanga agohkeo ahin, chule suhmangna chun akhu ding ima aneipoi."},"7":{"text":"Aman sahlam chu ahomkeo mun chunga ajah doh-in, chule leiset chu imacha umlouva akhaijin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Aman twiho chu meilom satah-in atomchah-in; chule amaho noija chun meilhang chu akehpon ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aman alaltouna maichu akhukhumin, chule ameilhang chu achunga chun akijal sah-e."},"10":{"text":"Sunle jan ahung kichai kahsen, aman twiho chu gikhatnin aumkim velin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Aman apho tengle van khompiho akithing jin, chule kidang asaovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Aman athaneina-in twipi ahom khenin, chule ahetthem na-in kiletsah ajepjin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aman alhagaovin vanho ajem hoijin, ama khut chun dihna neilou gul chu aseme."},"14":{"text":"Veovin, hiche hohi ama lampiho ahin, ahinla ama thudol hi ichana kija lhoma hitam? athaneina van kithing tobanghi kon ahetthem thei ding ham?"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche chung chon chun Job'in athulem sei ajomin, aseije;","title":"Job'in Adihna Atuhdet Jing"},"2":{"text":"Kathu kitana ding eilahmang peh-a hingjing Pathen, chule kahinna suboija Hat chungnung;"},"3":{"text":"Kasunga haina thei aum laise le, Pathen lhagao kanahkohom teni sunga aum laisen;"},"4":{"text":"Kakamin khangitlouna thu sei pongting, kaleijin jong lheplhahna thu phongdoh ponge."},"5":{"text":"Nangma them kachansah ding Pathen anompoi; kathi kahse-a keiman kadinna kachondoh louding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Kachon phatna hi tuhdet jinging ting, kalhaso louhel ding; kahin lai chansen kalung thim hin eithemmo sah louding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Kamelma chu mikhang gilou tobang hihen, keima dou dinga hung kipatdohpa chu chonpha louteto banguhen."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen'in ahinna alahdohteng, phatchomna neijongle mipha lhemin ipi kinepna aneiding ham?"},"9":{"text":"Lungkhamna achunga ahung lhunteng ataona chu Pathen'in angaipeh na dem?"},"10":{"text":"Hat chungnungpa-a chun amatah alung lhaina dem? phattinin aman Pathen akou nadem?"},"11":{"text":"Pathen khut thahat dan nangho seipeh-unge; Hat chungnungpa koma um chu keiman ka-imchah lou ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Veovin, nangho tah-in hichu namu taovin; achutile ipi dinga nangho nabon chaova hitia hi pannabei, nahiu hitam?"},"13":{"text":"Hiche hi mikhang gilouvin Pathen'a achan chu ahin, misugenthei ho goulo ding, Hat chungnung pa-a kon amudio chu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Achateu apunna ahile hichu chemjam'a lou ding bep ahiuvin; chule achilhahteu chu changlhah-a oiva loudiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ama nunga ana umnalai ho chu thi uva kivui diu; chule ameithai hou chun aka loudiu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Aman dangka leivui bangin kholkhom henlang, kivona pon leiset bangin gong jongle;"},"17":{"text":"Hichu aman gong theijinte, ahinla hichu midih-in akivon ding, chule dangka chu themona neilou ho kihom diu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Aman a-in chu maimom bangin asan, thil ngah-a pangpan akisah lhambuh bangbep ahi."},"19":{"text":"Mihaopa chu lumintin, ahin ama gopkhoma umlou ding; aman amit ahahsahle, ama anaum tapoi."},"20":{"text":"Tijatna hon ama twibangin achuptan, huipin jan-in ama alhoh mangtai."},"21":{"text":"Ama solam huijin apomangin, ama achemang tan; chule aumna mun'a konin khopi huijin alhoh mangtan ahi"},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen'in achunga ahin selhah-a, ama akhendoh louhel ding; ama khutna kona ama lhasama jamdoh ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Mihon ama khut abeh khumuva, chule aumna mun'a kona aphisanuva anodoh dingu ahi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tahbeh-in dangka-a dingin akhuh aumin, chuleh sana-a dingin akilhit thengna mun aumin ahi.","title":"Job'in Chihna Thu Asei"},"2":{"text":"Thih hi leisetna kona kiladoh ahin; chuleh sum-eng hi song lah-a kona kiladoh-a kilhajol ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ama muthim akhona geijin achen, muthim le thina le-lim changei songho chu agaholin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aman mihem umlouna-a le chotkhah louna mun'a leiko avutnin, mihem'a konin gamlha tah-in akikhaijun, suh le tunga akivat leuvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Leiset hi ahileh, hichea konhin neh ahungdoh-in, anoilang vang meikong tobanga hungsoh doh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hiche mun'a songho chu khisongdum ahin, chule hia chun sana di aumin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chungleng vachan ahetkhahlou, muthong mitnin amukhahlou, lampi khat aumin;"},"8":{"text":"Keipi bahkai nouvin achotkhahlou, keipi hangtah-in jong ahokhahlou lampi khat aume."},"9":{"text":"Aman akhutchu songpi chunga akoidoh-in, aman molsangho chu abula konin alehkhup jenge."},"10":{"text":"Aman songpiho lah-a vadung alaidoh-in, thil manlutah hojouse chu amitnin amun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Aman alonlet louna dingin twisoh ho chu atingin, chule anakisel thilho chu aman khovah-a ahinpodoh-in ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla chihna chu hoija kimu ding ham? Chule hetkhen themtheina munchu hoilai ham?"},"13":{"text":"Mihemin hicheho manlut dan chu ahedoh joupoi, ahiloujongle mihing gamachun hichu akimudoh jou dehpoi."},"14":{"text":"Hiche chu keija aumpoi, tin twi thuhtah chun aseijin, hiche chu keija aumpoi, tin twipin aseije."},"15":{"text":"Hiche chu sana-a jong chohjou ahipon, ahilou jongle hiche manding chu dangka-a jong lepjou ahipoi."},"16":{"text":"Ophir sana mantam tah ahilouleh khisongdum manlutna toh tethei ahipoi."},"17":{"text":"Sana le songval toh kibanga ahipon, chule sana-a kilhatheng thil mantam tah tojong lhehthei ahipoi."},"18":{"text":"Songmantam san ahiloule twikohchang hojong gahmin phahthei ahipoi; ajehchu chihna manlutdan chu song mantam phapen sanga lujo ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ethiopia khi song engtoh kibanga jong ahipon, ahilou jongle sanatheng manlutna tojong kibanga ahipoi."},"20":{"text":"Achutile chihna hoija hungkon hija, hetthem theina munchu hoilaiham?"},"21":{"text":"Ahingthei jousele mitmu jouse-a kon kisel ahin, chungleng vacha jouse-a kona akiselmang ahi."},"22":{"text":"Manthahnale thina-in, hiche chungchang thulhut hi kanakhang hona kajalhonin ahi, ati lhone."},"23":{"text":"Pathen'in hiche lampi chu ahekhenin, chule aman hiche laimun chu ahen ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ajeh chu aman leiset kichaina ding gei aven, vannoi pumpihi amun ahi."},"25":{"text":"Huidingin agih tena ding asemin, chule aman twiho chu agih tena-a aten ahi."},"26":{"text":"Aman go henga thupeh anapeh-a, van ginle kolphe dinga lampi anasemachun:"},"27":{"text":"Chua chun aman chihna chu amun, aphong doh-in; aman agongin, henge, chule hichu aholdoh-in ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule mihem jah-a chun aman aseijin, veuvin Pakai ginhi chihna chu ahin, chule setna a kona jamdoh chu hetkhen themna chu ahi.","ref":"Labu 111:10; Thuch 1:7; 9:10."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chukal valin Job'in athulem ajompeh-in aseije.","title":"Job'in Akihona Thu Asei Achaina"},"2":{"text":"O Pathen'in eichintup nikhoho, achesa lhaho-a chu keima ana uma hileng;"},"3":{"text":"Kalu chunga athaomei anavah-a, chule amavah-a muthim lah kanajotle lai;"},"4":{"text":"Kakhang donlai nikhoho, Pathen thuguh chu kahoubuh chunga aumlai;"},"5":{"text":"Hatchung nungpen pan kakoma eiumpia, kachate kakimvela ahung umlaiju;"},"6":{"text":"Kakholhah naho bongnoi thaova kana soplai, chule songpin kadinga thaotwi vadung long banga asodohsah lai;"},"7":{"text":"Khopi sung kotpi phunga kapotdoh le-a, khopi lamlen laija katouna kadole laichun!"},"8":{"text":"Khangdong hon eimuvin, akiseluvin, chule tehse ho chu akipat doh-un, ading jiuvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Pipuiho chu ahoulim laiju atang jiuvin, chule akhutnun akam akisip jiuve."},"10":{"text":"Milen milal ho athipchet jiuvin, chule aleiju chu adanguva abehjin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nakhangin eijahteng, phatthei eiboh-in, mitnin eimuteng, hichun keima hettohsahna eipen ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman mivaicha pengpenga umle, paneiloute, chule kithopi ding neiloupa chu kahuh doh-in ahi."},"13":{"text":"Mangthah dinga umpa phattheina chu keima chunga ahungchun, keiman meithainu lungsung chu kipanan la kasah sahjin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chonphatna chu kakivonin hichun eitomin, kathutan lhah chu sangkhol len le lukhuh tobang ahi."},"15":{"text":"Mitchodin mit kanahin, kengbaiho din keng kanahi."},"16":{"text":"Mivaichate din apau kahin, chule kahet khahlou thu chu kaholdoh jin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Khang giloute khagu chu kasuhboh peh-in, chule akamuva konin anehdoh houchu kasadoh peh-in ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin keiman, neldi banga kahin nikhohohi kapunsah-a, kabuh sunga kathi ding ahi, kati."},"19":{"text":"Twipanga kajung ajamin, kabahho chunga jankhon daitwi alhan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kaloupina chu keija athah jingin, chule kakhutna kathalchang chu akisuthah jinge."},"21":{"text":"Mihon kahenga anakhangu ado-uvin, chule angah jiuvin, kathumop teng athipchet jiuve."},"22":{"text":"Kathusei joutengle amahon aseikitji tapouvin, chule kathusei chu achunguva achun ahi."},"23":{"text":"Gotwi angaichat bangun keima eingaicha jiuvin; gotwi nunung ngah bangin, amahon akamu akalen jiuve."},"24":{"text":"Keiman amaho nuisat jongleng, amahon atahsan loudiu; chule kamaiso vah chu amahon asulha pouvin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Alampihou kalhen peh-in, apipu uvin kapange, chule sepai lah-a lengpa bangin kaumin, lhasete lhamonsah khat bangin kaumin ahi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahinla tun, apateu kaganhon ngah-a uichate toh pangkhom dinga jong kadeilou, keisanga khangdongjoho chun i-sah louvin eibolun ahi."},"2":{"text":"Henge, akhut thahatnaova kona ken ipi kaphatchompi ding ham? athahatnao chu beija ahitai."},"3":{"text":"Lhahsap jehle keljeh-in amaho achang lhatnun, masanga ana kamhel le agohkeo gamthipma chun ajamlutnun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amahon nangboh lah-a vandol, chule theimi jungchu anehdiuvin abotdoh un ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amaho chu miho lah-a konin aki deldoh-un, (amahon gucha kihoh bangin hatah-in a-aovun;)"},"6":{"text":"Phaicham khikah dungle, leiset kotong sung, chule songpiho lah-a umdin adeldoh-un ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hamboh lah-a amaho chu apengun, lingphung noi dunga amaho akisukhomun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Amaho mingol chate le, milung lhomho chate ahiuvin, amaho leiset sangin aphamo jouve."},"9":{"text":"Tun keima amaho la chu kahin, henge, keima aseichah-u kahitai."},"10":{"text":"Amahon eihotaovin, keija konin gamlatah-a ajamun, chule kamai chil setkhum dingjong akiphalam pouve."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu aman kakhao alhanenga chule eisuhgenthei jeh-in, amahon jong ka-angsunga kamdal alha nengun ahi."},"12":{"text":"Kakhut jetlama khangdongho akichoisangun, kakeng asonmangun, chule amanthahna lampihou chu keima dounan aboldoh uve."},"13":{"text":"Amahon kakeng lampi asuseuvin, kahamset nading kamasanga akoijun, amaho akithopi ding aumpoi;"},"14":{"text":"Amaho twipi pohjah bangin kachunga ahungun, setna lah-a kachunga ahung kitoluve."},"15":{"text":"Tijatnaho kachunga ahung kihei lutnin, amahon kahinna chu huibangin ahin delun, kaphat theina chu meibol bangin achemang tai."},"16":{"text":"Chule tun kahinna kachunga akisunglhan, suhgenthei nikho hon eikolchah tai."},"17":{"text":"Jantengle kaguhon eichipjin, katha junghon choldona aneipoi."},"18":{"text":"Kanatna hoisetna jehchun kavon akikhelsah-in, kasangkhol chol ngong bangin eikanbeh tai."},"19":{"text":"Aman bonlhoh lah-a eileh lutnin, keima vutle leivui kabang jengtai."},"20":{"text":"Keiman nangma kakouvin, ahinla nangman neingai pehpoi: keima kading doh-in, chuleh nangman iman neigelpoi."},"21":{"text":"Nangma keima dingin nahung giloutan: na bantha hattah chun nangman neidouve."},"22":{"text":"Nangin huijin neidom touvin; achunga chun neitou sah-in, kahinnaho nasujun lhatan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman thina-a neipuilut ding, chule ahing jouse dinga kitepsa ina chu neipuiding ahi, ti kahei."},"24":{"text":"Itin iti jongle amaho kisuhgepna-a kapjongleu, aman lhan geija akhut ajahdoh louding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Boina neiho dinga kanaka hilouham? kahinna hi amaho dinga analungna-a hilouham?"},"26":{"text":"Apha kagaldot teng, kahenga setna ahungjin, khovah kanga tengle muthim ahung lhungjie."},"27":{"text":"Kalung agimlheh jin, akicholdopoi, genthei hesohna nikhon eikimai topi jinge."},"28":{"text":"Nisa beijin lunghemin kavahlen, mipi kikhomho lah-a chun kading doh-in kakapme."},"29":{"text":"Keima dragon ho sopile, sumbupi ho kiloipi kahi."},"30":{"text":"Katichunga kavun adupmin, kaguhohin eileusa henhune."},"31":{"text":"Ka selangdah jong lunghemna, chule kamut gingjong akapho ogin asohtai."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keiman kamit tenitoh kitepna kasemin, achutile ibola nungah kageltah dingham?"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu chunga Pathen'a kona chanding ipi umam? chungsang Hatchung nunga kona gou chan ding ipiham?"},"3":{"text":"Mi khanggilou dinga manthah na um hilou ham? engbolna kidangtah chu khansetna bolteho-a ding hilou ham?"},"4":{"text":"Aman kalampiho amulou hija, chule kakho lhahnaho asim hilouham?"},"5":{"text":"Keima pannabei ja kanavalea, ahiloule lheplhahnaho-a kakal kanason gangtah-a ahile,"},"6":{"text":"Pathen'in kadihna ahettheina dingin, khaikotnin eilep hen."},"7":{"text":"Kakalson nahi lampia kona akiheimanga, kamitnin amuchu kalungin ajuile, anen khattou kakhutna abetahle;"},"8":{"text":"Chutengle muchi tungting adangin nehen; henge, kason kapahho chu ajungah kibotdoh hen."},"9":{"text":"Numei khatnin kalung alheplhah-a, ahiloule ka-in heng kotphunga ka chanlhih-a ahile;"},"10":{"text":"Chuteng ka-inneipin midang ding chang suhen, chule midangho amanu chunga bohkhup uhen."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu hichehi thet umtah khansetna ahin; henge, hichehi thutan hon engbolna apehding khansetna chu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu hichehi manthah na geija kavamtheija meichu ahin, chule kaphat touna jouse ajunga kibodoh ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Kasohpa ahiloule kasohnu thu chu i-sah louva kabola, amahon keima eikinahpi tengule;"},"14":{"text":"Pathen ahung kipatdoh tengle ikatiding hitam? Aman aviltengle ipi-a kadonbut dingham?"},"15":{"text":"Naobu sunga keima einasempa chun ama asem hilouham? chule khatseh-in naobu sunga einasemu hilouham?"},"16":{"text":"Keiman mivaichate ngaichat ka-itpeh-a, ahiloule meithainu mit chu kalosamsah khah-a ahile;"},"17":{"text":"Ahiloule ka-an chu kachanga kakineh-a, chule paneilou ten hichu anehkhah loule;"},"18":{"text":"(Ajehchu kakhangdon laijapat amachu keimatoh hung khanglen khom ahin, pa banga, kanu naobu sunga patna amanu kahin lamhil ahi);"},"19":{"text":"Koihamkhat ponsil lhahsam jeh-a mangthah-a, ahiloule silding neilou mivaicha khattou kamua;"},"20":{"text":"Alungin keima phatthei eibohlouva, chule kakelngoi mulla aman lum asah loule,"},"21":{"text":"Kotpi phunga eikithopi kamua, paneiloute douna-a kakhut kalapma ahile,"},"22":{"text":"Chuteng kabanhi kalengkouva konin lhonglha henlang, chule kaban guhi bonglha jeng hen."},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen'a kona manthah na chu keidinga tijat umtah ahin, chule alalna jeh-in, kathoh joupon ahi."},"24":{"text":"Keiman kakinepna chu sana kahi sah-a, ahiloule sana theng jah-a, nangma katahsana nahi, kanati-a ahile;"},"25":{"text":"Kagou tamjeh le, kakhut hin tamtah amujeh-a kakipa-a ahile;"},"26":{"text":"Keiman nisa ahungvah kavetna, ahiloule lhathah vahtah-a ache kavetna;"},"27":{"text":"Chule kalungthimhi aguh-a jol lhah-a auma, ahilouleh kakamin kakhut achopleh;"},"28":{"text":"Hiche jonghi thutanpan engbolna apehding khansetna chu ahi; ajehchu chunga um Pathen chu keiman kasanlou ahitai."},"29":{"text":"Keima eithetbolpa kisuhmang nikho-a kakipa-a, thilsen alhunkhum teng kakichoi sanga ahile;"},"30":{"text":"Kakamhi chonsetna, ama hinna sapset sahna dingin jong kaphalpon ahi."},"31":{"text":"Kahoubuh mihon, Oh atahsa chu kaneilouva ahile! kalungnao chimlou ding ahi, atiuve."},"32":{"text":"Gampam mi khopi lamlena agehpon, ahin kholjinleho dingin kakotho kahonpeh-in ahi."},"33":{"text":"Keiman Adam banga kasuhkhelna leh, kakhan gitlouna chu ka-angsunga kakhu khuma ahile;"},"34":{"text":"Keiman mihonpi kakichatna, ahiloule insung mite i-sah louna chun eikichatsah-a, thipbeh-a kauma, kotpama potlouva kaum-em?"},"35":{"text":"O khattouvin eingaipeh hitaveleh! vetan, kangaichat chu, Hatchung nungin eidonbutna, chule kaki doupin lekha ajihding chu ahi."},"36":{"text":"Thonlouva hichu kalengkouva kaputna, chuleh lallukhuh banga kakhuh ding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Kakholhah jatchu ahenga kaphon doh-a, vaipo khat banga ahenga kahin nailut ding ahi."},"38":{"text":"Kagam chu keima douna-a apenna, ahiloule langkonho jong chu hitobanga chu akiphina ahileh;"},"39":{"text":"Keiman hiche lougaho chu sum pelouva kaneh-a, ahiloule aneiho hinkho chu kachansah-a ahileh;"},"40":{"text":"suhlouchang khelin meithai seltholing, sakol chang khellin hampa kehhen. Job thusei akichaitai."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hitichun hiche mithumho chun Job chu ama le ama mitmu-a achonphat jehchun, adonbutnu chu anga taovin ahi.","title":"Elehu'in Job Golho Apho"},"2":{"text":"Chujouvin Ram inkon Buz mi Barachel chapa Elihu lunghanna chu akoujah-in, Job douna-a ama deojah-a ahi, ajehchu ama Pathen sangin akithem chanin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amagolte thum ho douna-in jong alunghan adeujah-e, ajehchu amahon adonbutna ding amujou pouvin, hinlah Job chu themmo achanun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Tun amaho chu ama sanga upajo cheh ahijeh-un, Elihu'n Job thusei kichai chu angahjing nalaijin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Elihu'n hiche mi thumho kamsunga donbutna aumlou amu phatnin, alunghana adeujah tai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Buz mi Barachel chapa Elihu chun adonbutnin: keima khangdong kahin, nangho upatah cheh nahiuve; hijeh-a chu keima kakichatna, kalunggel nangho kavetsah ngamlou ahi."},"7":{"text":"Upaho chun seijuntin, chule kum tamtah ho chun chihna hilinte, katin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla mihem'a hi lhagao uma ahin, chule Hatchung nungpen hu haikhumna chun amaho chu hetkhenthem theina apeh ahi."},"9":{"text":"Milenho chu ching jing jengu ahipon, mi kumtam hon jong thutanlhah themna ahetdeh-u ahipoi."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun kathusei ngaijun, keiman jong kalunggel vetsah uvinge, kati."},"11":{"text":"Vetan, nathuho chu kangah-in, ipiseiding ham tia nanghon nahol laiju chun nakihoulim naova kanakhang kanasungin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Henge, lunglut tah-in nathuseiju kangaijin, chuleh veuvin, nalah uva Job noplhah sahthei, ahiloule athuho donbut theiding khatcha na-umpouve."},"13":{"text":"Keihon chihna kamudoh taove, tin seikhaovin nate, mihem ahipon Pathen'in ama asuhlhuh ahibouve."},"14":{"text":"Tun aman athuho chu keima douna ahipon, hijeh-a chu nangho thusei ho-a chu ama kadonbut louding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Amahon kidang asauvin adonbutbe tapouve, thu asei tapouve."},"16":{"text":"Keiman kanga-a chun, (ajehchu amahon thu aseitapouvin, ading dennun, adonbut be tapouve;)"},"17":{"text":"Kadonbut dingdol chu donbut ningting, kalunggel jong vetsah ingkate, kanatie."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu keima thu-in kadimsetnin, kasunga kalhagao hin eisol teitei tan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Veuvin, ka oipoh hi akising chah ju toh abangtai, hichehi juhai thah pohkeh ding kigo tobang ahitai."},"20":{"text":"Kahaldoh kit theina dingin keiman thu seijinge; kakam kangting donbut ning kate."},"21":{"text":"Nahenga katao ahi, mi koimacha langneina musah dang ting, Pachat lhem thucheng mihem'ah pejong peponge."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman pachat lhem thucheng pehje kahepon, hitichun bol taleng eisempan eilahdoh loiding ahi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh chun Job, nahenga katao ahi, kathuseiho ngaijin, chule kathu jousehi neingaipeh-in."},"2":{"text":"Vetan, tun keima kakamkan, kalei hin kakama thu aseije."},"3":{"text":"Kathuhohi kalungsung chondih na-a kon hiding ahin, chule kakamin hetna chu thengtah-a aphondoh ding ahi.","ref":"Job 12:11."},"4":{"text":"Pathen lhagaovin einasemin, chule Hatchung nungpen haina hu chun hinna eipeh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nangman neidonbut thei dinga ahile, nathuho chu kamasanga koitoh inlang, dingdoh-in."},"6":{"text":"Vetan, keimahi nadeisah dungjuija Pathen khela um kahin, keijong leinganna kisemdoh kahi."},"7":{"text":"Vetan, tijat kaumna-in nakichat sah pontin, kakhut jengjong nachunga gihponte."},"8":{"text":"Tahbeh-in, kajah theijin thu naseijin, chule keiman nathusei awgin chu kajatai;"},"9":{"text":"Keima suhkhelna beija thenga kahin, themona neilou kahin, khansetna jengjong keija aumpoi."},"10":{"text":"Vetan, aman keima douna ajehho chu amun, aman keima amelma khatnin eisimtai,"},"11":{"text":"aman kakengteni ahennin, kalampi jouse amelchih-e."},"12":{"text":"Vetan, hichea hin nangma nadihpon ahi; keiman nangma donbut-inge, Pathen chu mihem sanga lenjo ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ipidinga ama douna-a nakiphin ham? ajehchu aman ama chungchang thuho khatcha apepon ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen'in khatvei thu aseijin, henge nivei, ahijeng vangin mihemin ahetheipon ahi."},"15":{"text":"Jan manga, janna muneina-a, mihemte chunga imut lhuhna ahung chuh-a, lupna chunga imutsona alhun tengle;"},"16":{"text":"Chuteng aman mihem nakhang ahonpeh-in, chule amaho kithupehna chu asinkhumpeh-in,"},"17":{"text":"Athil gona kona mihem alahdoh theina dingle, mihem'a konin kiletsahna aselmangpeh jin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Kokhuh-a konin ahinna, chule ahinkho chu chemjam'a amanthah nadinga konin ahuhdoh peh-in ahi."},"19":{"text":"Aman ajalkhun chunga natna, chule agu achangho jouse hachang natna natna-in asugimin,"},"20":{"text":"Hitia chu ahinkho chun changlhah, chule ahinna chun anneh ahot nadinga abol ahi."},"21":{"text":"Akimutheilou nadingin, atipum chu ajunmang tan, chule agu anakimulouho chu adoh setsot tai."},"22":{"text":"Ahi, ahinna chun lhankhuh lam, chule ahinkho chun suhmangna chu anaijin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Achondihna chu mihem musahna dinga, thupole khat, paoledoh khat, sangkhat lah-a khat amatoh auma hileh,"},"24":{"text":"Chuteng amachu ama lungset them ahin, hitin aseije, kokhuh-a lhahlutna dinga konin aman ahuhdoh-in, keiman lhatdohna kamutai."},"25":{"text":"Ama tipum chu chapanga sanga noujo ding, ama akhangdonlai nikho-a kilekit ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ama Pathen henga taoding, chule ama chu amadinga lunglhaina hiding, chule aman kipah-a amai amuding ahi: ajeh chu aman chonphatna chu mihem apehding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Aman mihemho aven, khattouvin, keima kachonsetan, adih-a konin kakiheimang tan, chule hiche hin eiphatchom sahpoi, atia ahileh;"},"28":{"text":"Aman ahinna chu kokhuh-a alhahlutna dinga kona alhatdoh ding, chule hinkho chun vah amuding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ven, hiche thil ho jousehi mihem dingin Pathen'in abol jingin,"},"30":{"text":"Kokhuh-a kona ahinna puidoh nading, hinna vah-a vahsah nading ahi."},"31":{"text":"Vo Job, phatah in melchih in, kathu ngaijin, thipmin, thu kaseiding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Nangin seiding khattou naneija ahile neidonbut in, seijin ajehchu keiman nangma kathem chansah nome."},"33":{"text":"Ahiloule kasei ngaijin, thipmin, chule keiman chihna kahil ding nahi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Elihun adonbut kitleuvin aseije:","title":"Elihu'in Pathen Dihna Aphondoh"},"2":{"text":"Vo miching nanghon; kathuhi ngaijunlang, hetnanei nanghon nanakhangu hinsung uvin,"},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu kamin an atepbangin, nakhangin thu apatepmin ahi.","ref":"Job 12:11."},"4":{"text":"Eihon thutanlhah dih kilhenu hitin, ilah uva apha chu ipiham kihetnu hite."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Job'in keima michonpha kahin, Pathen'in kadihna alahmang ahitai, ati."},"6":{"text":"Keima kadihna chunga kajou ding ham? suhkhel bei kahivangin kamaput hi damtheihoi ahipoi."},"7":{"text":"Job banga mi-isahlouna twibanga dontheijah koi umam?"},"8":{"text":"Ama khangitlouna bolhotoh akiloijin, chule miphalou hotoh akilhonlen ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu aman, mihem Pathen'a kipah-a aumhin imachan aphatchom pipoi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun hethem na nei mi nanghon kathuhi ngaijun; Pathen'in khansetna abol louding, chule Hatchung nungin khangitlouna abol louhel ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu mihem chu atoh dungjuija achunga alhunsah ding, chule mijouse achonna dungjui cheh a lethuhna amusah ding ahi.","ref":"Labu 62:12."},"12":{"text":"Henge, Pathen'in khan gitlouna abol louhel ding, Hatchung nungin jong thu akaleh-a atan louding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Leiset chunga thunei dinga kon mopohna apeh ham? ahiloule vannoi pumpi kon achunga akoiham?"},"14":{"text":"Aman mihem chunga alung koihen lang, alhagao le ahaina hu chu kilah taleh;"},"15":{"text":"Tipumpi mangthah khomuva, chule mihem leivuija kilekit ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tun nangma hetkhen themna nei nahile, hichehi ngaijin: kathusei hohi ngaiphan."},"17":{"text":"Thudih hotbolpa chun vai ahomding hija? chule kitah chungnung pen chu nangin themmo nachan dingham?"},"18":{"text":"Lengpa jah-a, nangma khangse nahin, chule pipuiho jah-a, Pathen helou nahiuve, tiding kilomnam?"},"19":{"text":"Ahin ama pipuiho langa alangnei chompon, chule mivaichaho sangin mihaoho ajachom dehpoi; ajehchu abonchauva akhutsem ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Amaho mitphetkah louvin thiuvintin, chule mipi ho chu jan khangkim le suhboija umdiu, chemang diu, chule mihat hochu mihem khutjao louva kaimanga umdiu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu aman mihem lamlhah avejingin, achenachan amusoh keijin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Khangitlou bolho kiselna dingin, muthimle thina le-lim aumpon ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen angsunga thutana-a lutna dinga, aman adih kalval mihem chunga akoilou ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Aman simthei louva mihat ho chu asuhbonga, akheluva midangho atunding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hijeh chun aman atohhou chu ahen, amaho chu suhmanga aumtheina dinguvin, jankhat sungin alehkhup heltan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Aman amaho chu migilouho bangin midangho mitmu tah-in ajepmin;"},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho ama-a konin akinung heijun, chule alampi khat jengjong agelphata pouve;"},"28":{"text":"Chutichun ahenga amahon mivaichaho kana chu alhunsah-un, aman bolgentheiho kana chu angaipeh tan ahi."},"29":{"text":"Aman asuhcham tengleh koiham boina boldinga? nampi douna hihen lang mikhat douna-a kibol hijongle, aman asel tengle koiham amai muthei dingah?"},"30":{"text":"Chutiachu mipha lhemin vai ahomlou ding, achutiloule mipi ho thanga ohding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Tahbeh-a mihemin Pathen koma, suhgimna chu kathohtan, doumah bolkit taponge,"},"32":{"text":"Kamu khahlou chu nangman neihilin, keiman khan gitlouna kaboljongle, bolkit taponge, tia aseiding chu kilom ahi."},"33":{"text":"Keima hilouvin nangma gel bang ahidem? nangma danlang nomjongle chun, aman nalethuh ding ahi; hijeh chun nahetchu seijin."},"34":{"text":"Hetthemna neihon eihilen, chule michingin kathusei ngaihen."},"35":{"text":"Job'in hetna jaolouvin thu aseijin, athuseiho jong chihna jaolou ahi."},"36":{"text":"Khang gilouho dinga adonbut jeh-in, Job chu akhona geija achungthu tanding hi kalung ahi."},"37":{"text":"Ajehchu aman achonsetna chunga akiphin ben, aman ilah uvah akhut abengin, chule Pathen douna athu apun sah-in ahi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche kalvalin Elihun aseiben, chule hitin aseije:","title":"Eimale Eima Chonpha-a Kisim Elihu'in Themo Achan"},"2":{"text":"Kachon phatna hi Pathen'a sangin asangjoi, tia nasei chu dih dinga nagellem?"},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman, kachonsetna kona theng kahile, nang dinga phachom ipi hiding hija, keiman aphachom ipi kamuding ham? tin naseije."},"4":{"text":"Keiman nangmale naumpi naloiho chu donbut-inge."},"5":{"text":"Van lama dah inlang vetemin; chule nangsanga sangjo meibol ho khu vetemin."},"6":{"text":"Nachonsetle, ama douna-a ipi nabol em? ahiloule nasuhkhelna apunbeleh, nangman ama henga ipi nabol ham?","ref":"Job 22:2-3."},"7":{"text":"Nachon phatna ahile ama ipi napeh-em? ahiloule nakhutna kona ipi amu-em?"},"8":{"text":"Naphatlouna chun nangtobang mihem khat asuna theijin, nachon phatna chun mihem chapa chu aphatchom sah thei ahi."},"9":{"text":"Suhgentheinaho atamjeh-in, akisugen theiho aka sah-un, mihat ho ban thahat jeh-in, apeng doh-un ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla koimachan jong eisempa Pathen, janteng la eipepa chu hoija umam? atipouve."},"11":{"text":"Leija gamsaho sanga eiha hiluva, chungleng vachate sanga chingjoa eisempao chu, hoija umem? atipouve."},"12":{"text":"Chua chun apengun, ahinla miphalouho kiletsah jeh-in, koimachan adonbut pouve."},"13":{"text":"Tahbeh-in Pathen'in pannabei chu ngai pontin, Hatchung nungin jong nahsah-a aneilouding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nangin amachu muponge tijongle chun, amasanga chu thutana umnalai ahin; hijeh chun ama chu tahsan nin."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla tun hitichu ahilou jeh-in, lunghan na-in agavilin, hijongle nasabehsetnin ahehhih laijin,"},"16":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Job hi pannabei ja kamka-a, hetna jaolouva athusei apunsah ahi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Elihun aseijompeh-in, hitin aseije.","title":"Elihu'in Pathen Phatna Aphondoh"},"2":{"text":"Neikhongai nalaijun, chule Pathen khella seiding kanei nahlai chu, vetsah-unge."},"3":{"text":"Gamla tah-a konin kahetna galangting, eisempa chonphatna phongdoh inge."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu kathuhi nolnabei jou hilouhel ding ahin, hetna chamkimpa chu nangma toh uma ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vetan, Pathen chu thaneitah ahin, koimacha nahsahmon akoipoi; Ama thahatna le chihna-a thaneitah ahi."},"6":{"text":"Aman migilou hinkho ahoidoh pehpon, mi genthei chu dihna apen ahi."},"7":{"text":"Michonpha ho-a konin amit aheimangpon, ahinla amaho lengho toh laltouna chunga atouvun; aman amaho chu a-itih-in atungdohjin, chule choisangin aumjiuvin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule amaho bulkituh ahiuva, bolgentheina khaova kihen ahiule;"},"9":{"text":"Chuteng aman athilbolule, asuhkhel nao chonvalna chu amusahjin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aman abilkolu chu sehgimna angaina diuvin ahonpeh-in, khansetna kona ahungkile theina diuvin thu apejin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amahon thu angaijuva, ama ajenule, anikhohou phattheina, chule akumhou nopsahna-a amandiu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahinlah thu angailou vangule, chemjam'a mangthah uva, chule hetna beija thidiu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahinla miphalhem hon lunghanna lungthima akikhol khomun, aman amaho ahen tengle atao jipouve."},"14":{"text":"Amaho akhandon laijun athiuvin, ahinkhou chu mithenglouho lah-a aumjin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Migenthei chu bolgentheija aumna-a konin ahuhdoh-in, suhgentheina-a anakhangu ahonpeh-e."},"16":{"text":"Hitima chun aman hahsatna-a konin napuidoh intin, suhboina umlouna mun lentah-a nachon lutding, chule nadokhanga kiluiding chu nehtuitah dimset ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahinla nangin migiloute thutanna chu nagui lhunsahtan, thutannale thudih chun namandet tai."},"18":{"text":"Lunghanna aumjeh-in chingtheijin, achutiloule ajepna-a chun nalhoh mang intin; chuteng lhatna loupitah chun nahuhdoh joulou ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Aman nahaona jabol intem? ajabol louding, sana ahiloule thaneina jouse jong angaisang louding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Miho aumnao mun'a akisuhmangu janchu ngaicha hih-in."},"21":{"text":"Chingtheijin, khangitlouna ngaito hih-in, ajehchu gimbolna sangin hichehi nalheng jotai."},"22":{"text":"Vetan, Pathen'in athaneina-in achoisangtan, amabanga kon ahil theijem?"},"23":{"text":"Alampi chu koijin aseipeh-am? ahiloule, nangin khangitlouna nabole, tia kon asei theijem?"},"24":{"text":"Mihon avetjingu, anatoh choisang dingchu geldoh jingin.","title":"Elihu'in Pathen Chungnuna Aphondoh"},"25":{"text":"Mitinin hichu muthei jintin; mihemin gamlatah-a konin muthei jinte."},"26":{"text":"Veuvin, Pathen chu aloupin, eihon ama ihepouve, akum jatho jong holdoh jouhoi ahipoi."},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu aman twi vatneocha cha anasemin, twimeija konin go ajulhajin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hichu meibolin gomal asema, chule mihem chunga nengtah-a julhaji ahi."},"29":{"text":"Meibol kithejal leho, ahiloule ahoubuh gingho khu mihemin ahetkhen thei jem?"},"30":{"text":"Veovin, aman achunga chun avah ajalin, twipi todop chu akhu-in ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ajehchu aman hitiho-a konhin mipi thu atanin, an neh nengtah-in apen ahi."},"32":{"text":"Aman vah chu meibolin atomin, akikah-a hungdoh meibola kona avahlou nadin thu apen ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chua hu gin chun aumdan chu avetsah-in, twimei umchan jong ganchaho ahetsah-e."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hichea jonghin kalung chang akihotnin, chule achomdoh dehdeh jenge."},"2":{"text":"A-awgin le akama kona hungpot chu lunglut tah-in ngaijin."},"3":{"text":"Aman hichu van pumpi noi-a asolin, akolphe chu leiset kolmong geija dingin aphet sah-in ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hiche jouhin aw khat ahung kitumin, aloupina aw-a chun ahung ging dumdumin, chule a-aw akijahteng jongle amaho chu atuhtang louding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pathen chu kidang tah-in a-aw'in ahung kithongin; eiho hetjouhoi hilou thil loupitah abole."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu aman buhbang henga, leija umin atin; chubangma chun athahatna gophinle gohong henga jong aseijin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Mijousen athilbol ahettheina diuvin, aman mitin khutchu amelchih-in ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuphatnin gamsaho akul sunguva alutnun, amuncheh-a aumtaove."},"9":{"text":"Lhanglama konin huise ahungnungin, sahlama konin dap ahunge."},"10":{"text":"Pathen hu-a konin buhbang aumin, chule twilentah jong akang jin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Meibol satah jengjong chu twihu achun asunouvin, ameibol bangleh chu athejalin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Aman athupeh jouseu vannoi leiset chung jouse-a abolna dingun, athumopma chun akipeikol lele-un ahi"},"13":{"text":"Aman suhdih nading ham, agam ding ham, ahiloule hepina ding hama hichu asosah ahi."},"14":{"text":"Vo Job, hichehi ngaijin; dingdet jinginlang, Pathen natoh kidangho chu ngaiton."},"15":{"text":"Pathen'in itih-a amaho agoltoh-a, ameilom vah chu avahsah, nangin nahet em?"},"16":{"text":"Meilhang ho gihdan, hetna chamkimpa thilbol kidangtah chu nahet em?"},"17":{"text":"Lhanglam huija leiset athipsah teng, navon iti lummaham, nahet em?"},"18":{"text":"Phatvet kilhajol bangtah-a nasa-a vanlaijol hi, nangin amatoh naphajal ham?"},"19":{"text":"Muthim jeh-a kaseidiu kaseidoh theilou jeh-un, Ama henga kaseidiu neihilun."},"20":{"text":"Kathusei dingchu hilding kangaijem? mikhatnin thu seile, thonlouva ama vallhuma umding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tun mihem hon meilhang ho lah-a vah vahtah chu amupouvin, ahinla huijin amuttheng jitan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Sahlama konin van ahung thengselin, Pathen chu janale tijatnan adime."},"23":{"text":"Hat chungnung thudol chu imudoh joupouve, ama thilboltheina, thutanlhahna, dihna-a chungnung pen ahin, aman sugenthei ponte."},"24":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu mihon aginu ahin, milungching khatcha aman ajabol aumpoi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin chimpei lah-a kon chun Pakaiyin Job ahindonbut nin, aseije.","title":"Pathen'in Job Adonbut"},"2":{"text":"Hetna bei thuho-a thumop thimsahpa chu koiham?"},"3":{"text":"Pasal tah bangin nakong kigah-in; nangma thu kadoh ding nahin, neidonbut ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Leiset bul kaphupetna chu hoilai ja nana umem? hetkhen themna naneile phongdoh-in."},"5":{"text":"Alet aneo koijin atotoh ham, nahet nam? ahiloule achunga khau chu kon ajandoh ham?"},"6":{"text":"Abul chu ipi chunga kihendet naham? ahiloule aning song chu kon agaphu ham?"},"7":{"text":"Itih tengle jing valpa hon La asah khomuva, Pathen chapate jouse kipah tah-a ao dingu ham?"},"8":{"text":"Ahiloule naobu-a kon potdoh ding banga, alonjal dingteng twipi kotpiho kon akha ham?","ref":"Jer 5:22."},"9":{"text":"Aponsil dingin meilhang kasema, chule akitomna dingin muthim satah kasema,"},"10":{"text":"Hiche dinga chu akhonna kasema, kotgol hole kotpiho kasema,"},"11":{"text":"chule hichangei nahunga, nakhokhel louding; chule hilaija hi nahoithona twikinong chu kingading ahi kati louham?"},"12":{"text":"Nakhohetna patna jingkah hi thupeh napeh khah-a, chule jingphalvah hi amun kihetnin kitikha em?"},"13":{"text":"Hitia chu leiset kolmong gei atuh theija, chua kona mikhangseho thinlhah ahi nadiu nabol khah-am?"},"14":{"text":"Namdet namna henga bonngan bangin heidoh in aumun; chule ponsil bangin adinguvin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Migilou ho-a konin avah uchu lahpeh-in aumin, chule banjang nasatah chu kihehbong ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Twikhanglen nahho-a nalutkhah tah-em? ahiloule athuhdan kholla nachekhah tah-em?"},"17":{"text":"Nang dinga thina kotpiho kihongtam? ahiloule thina lim kotkhah ho namukhah tah-em?"},"18":{"text":"Leiset letdan hi nahet em? nahetsoh keile phongdoh temin."},"19":{"text":"Vah umna lampi chu hoilai ham? chule muthim aumna mun hoilai hija,"},"20":{"text":"Agamgi geija chu cheding hitale chun, hiche a-in lampi chu naga hekhen nadem?"},"21":{"text":"Chuche phat laija nanapen tahjeh-a chu nahet nam? ahiloule nanikho ho jong atamtah jeh-a nahet nam?"},"22":{"text":"Buhbangho kikhol na-a nalut khah tah-em? ahiloule gel kikholna namu khah-a;"},"23":{"text":"Genthei nikho, kidoule kisat nikho-a dinga kakheh hokhu namu khah-am?"},"24":{"text":"Ipi lampia vah chu kikhenna, nisolam huihi leichunga kithecheh ham?"},"25":{"text":"Twi lonlet nading twilam kon ahop khenna, ahiloule van ginle kehlhah nading lampi;"},"26":{"text":"Mi umlouna leichung, mihem umlouna gamthipma gojuh nadinga;"},"27":{"text":"Akham helsa gam donlouva umchu kidodoh sah kitdingle, hamdong hindoh sah kitdinga alampi chu kon asem ham?"},"28":{"text":"Gotuijin pa aneijem? daitwi hohi koi hin ham?"},"29":{"text":"Buhbanghi koi naobu-a hung pengdoh ham? chule van dai bang jonghi koi hin ham?"},"30":{"text":"Twiho chu song bangin atah-in, chule twithuh chungchu akanin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Nangman bombel khu nakan khom theija, ahiloule Juheisuhtun khu nalhap lhah theijem?","ref":"Job 9:9; Amos 5:8."},"32":{"text":"Ahsi somleng khu aphatna napuidoh theija, ahilou le sahlam Ahsilen le achate nalam kaithei jem?"},"33":{"text":"Nangman van chondanho nahet em? hicheho kivaipohna chu leisetna nachesah theijem?"},"34":{"text":"Twi tamtah in nachup theina dinga, meilomho chu na awsoa nakou theiding ham?"},"35":{"text":"Kolpheho chu achena dinguva nasol theija, chule nahenga, hilaija kaumuve ahinte thei dingu ham?"},"36":{"text":"Sung gil lama chihna chu koijin akoi ham? ahiloule lungsung hetkhen themna chu koijin apeh ham?"},"37":{"text":"Chihna-a meibol hokhu asimtheija koiham? ahiloule van twibom khu kon alheilhah thei dingham?"},"38":{"text":"Itih-a leivui chu hungtah-a, chule alomho chu hung kimatchetna ham?"},"39":{"text":"Keipi bahkai chu asaneh ding naholpeh theija, keipi bahkai nou gilkel chu navahva thei dingham?"},"40":{"text":"Itihteng akosunguva koljiuva, achangpan naova itihleh changpang jiuham?"},"41":{"text":"Va-ah noute khu Pathen henga apen penna, nehding lhasama alenlele tenguleh, kon neh apehji-ham?."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangin songpi lah-a gam kelchaho itih-a asoding phat nahetnam? ahiloule sajuh-in nou itih-a aneiding namelchih theijem?"},"2":{"text":"Nangin, avoplai lhaho nasim theijem? ahiloule itih phatna asodiu nahet em?"},"3":{"text":"Amaho aboh-un, anouvu asoh-in, agentheinau akoidoh jiuvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Anousenhou chu ahung maldoh-un, hamlah-a ahung khang doh-un, achedoh-un, ahungkile kitji tapouve."},"5":{"text":"Gam sanganho chu kon alhadoh ham? ahiloule akihennao khao chu kon asutlhah ham?"},"6":{"text":"Gamthip chu a-inding, chule gamtem gamchu achenna munin kasemin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aman khopi-a mihonpi chu ima asahpon, ahoijipa husa jongchu ajajitapoi."},"8":{"text":"Moljol ho chu ama lhatlena ahin, chule aman hamhingho jouse chu ahollen ahi."},"9":{"text":"Sakol kinei chun nangma najennom ding hinam? ahiloule nagankula umnom ding hinam?"},"10":{"text":"Sakol kinei chu angonga khao nakhithei dingham? ahiloule loukaina nabuto-a, phaicham chu akaibot thei dingham?"},"11":{"text":"Athahat nasat jeh-a chu nangman ama chu natahsan dingham? ahiloule natohding chu ama nanot khum ding ham?"},"12":{"text":"Namuchi hochu na-in'a ahinpoh lutna, nachangsala kholkhom dinga natahsan ding ham?"},"13":{"text":"Vahong hochu lhaving hoitah napeh hilou ham? ahiloule vachalen chu lhaving le amulho napeh hilou ham?"},"14":{"text":"Aman leija atuiho adalhan, leivuijin alumsah-in,"},"15":{"text":"chule mikhat touvin akenga alhokhah theiding, ahiloule gamsa khat touvin asukeh theiding ahi jong ageldoh jipoi."},"16":{"text":"Ama nou hilou bangtah-in anousenho chunga a-engsen, atohgimna chu kichatna beija mohseh ahi;"},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen'in amanu akonin chihna chu aladoh-in, ahetkhen themna jengjong amanu apepon ahi."},"18":{"text":"Amanu ama le ama sangtah-a akidopsang phatle, sakol le achunga toupa chu ataitomjin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Nangman sakol khu thahatna napeh em? angonga along gingjeng jung navopeh ham?"},"20":{"text":"Nangman khaokhopi ho banga nakichat sah theijem? anahko loupitah chu tijat umtah ahi."},"21":{"text":"Aman tolgo atinin akhotjin, athahatna-a athanomin; gal manchah choiho to kimuto dingin apotdohjin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Kichat chu anuisatnin, akicha pon, chemjam'a konin jong anungchon ngaipon ahi."},"23":{"text":"Livathei ama dounan aginglah lah-in, tengcha le lumho aval lahlah-in ahi."},"24":{"text":"Aman leiset chu tijat-umtah le lunghang tah-in aval lhumin; hiche hi sumkon gin ahi tijong aman atahsanpoi."},"25":{"text":"Aman sumkon ginho lah-a chun, haha, atin; chule gamlatah-a konin gal husa ajan, gal lamkaiho husan leh akithong gin ajan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Nangma chihna jeh-a muthi chu lengji-a, alhaving teni chu lhanglam nga-a ajahji ham?"},"27":{"text":"Muvanlai chu nangma thupeh-a lengtouva, chule chungsanga abuh aset ham?"},"28":{"text":"Ama kol lah-a achengin, songkol chunga mundet tah-a chun acheng jin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hia konchun thading sa aholin, chule amitnin gamlatah amun ahi."},"30":{"text":"Anousen houvin thisan achopmun, chule sa kithat umna mun'a chun, amanu aumjin ahi.","ref":"Matt 24:28; Luk 17:37."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chukalvalin Pakaiyin Job adonbutnin, aseije:"},"2":{"text":"Hatchung nungpen kinahpi pachun ama ahilding ham? Pathen themmo chansah pachun hichu donbut hen."},"3":{"text":"Chule Job'in Pakai chu adonbutnin, aseije:","title":"Job'in Pathen Adonbut"},"4":{"text":"vetan, keima miphalou kahin, ipi kadonbut dingham? keiman kakhutnin kakam kisip tange."},"5":{"text":"Khatvei kana seitan, ahinla donbut ponge, henge, nivei; hijongle seibe taponge."},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakaiyin chimpeija konin Job ahindonbut nin, aseije.","title":"Pathen'in Job Achou"},"7":{"text":"Pasal tah bangin nakong kigah-in; nangma thu kadoh ding nahin, neidonbut ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Kathutan jonghi ima hilou neisopeh got ham? chonphat nachan theina dinga keima themmo neichan got ham?"},"9":{"text":"Nangin Pathen banga ban naneijem? ahiloule ama awgin banga nangma aw naginsah theijem?"},"10":{"text":"Tun nangma lalnale chungnun na-in kijem inlang, hoina le loipina-in nangma kijemin."},"11":{"text":"Nalung hanna chungnung chu bunglhan lang, mikiletsah tapou chu venlang, sunemin."},"12":{"text":"Mi kiletsah tapou chu venlang, loilha-in, chule migilou hochu aumnaova lholhan."},"13":{"text":"Leivui lah-a amaho selkhomin; chule guhthimin amaiju kanpeh-in."},"14":{"text":"Chutengle keiman jong nahenga nakhut jetlamin nahuhdoh jouding ahi tia kaphondoh ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Tun vetan, Behemoth khu nangma toh kasemkhom ahin, aman bongchal bangin hamhing anen ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tun ven, athahat nachu akonga um ahin, chule ahatna chu a-oipoh laimu-a um ahi."},"17":{"text":"Amei chu Cedar thing bangin achaloh sah-in; akhelbuh-a aphelom hochu akitomchah kheh-in ahi."},"18":{"text":"Agu chu sum-eng hal tahbet tobang ahin, aguho chu thihlhon tobang ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ama Pathen lampiho lah-a alupen ahin, asempa chun ama nailut nading chemjam asem thei ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tahbeh-in gamsaho jouse kichepna molhochun, a-an nehding ahin sodohpeh-in ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ama thingphung limnoi, pumpengle hamling neiho noija akoljin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Thinglimho chun ale-limuva ama akhu-vin, vachadunga huisum hochun ama aum kimvelun ahi."},"23":{"text":"Veovin, aman vadung chu achipkangin, akinopoi; aman Jordan chu akama achipkang joudingin atahsanin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Amit tenin alaji-in, anahkuijin thangho chu aphujalpai jin ahi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngakoija Leviathan nakoidoh theiji em? ahiloule nakhao khaisuh-a chu alei nakhithei dingham?","ref":"Labu 74:14; 104:26; Isai 27:1."},"2":{"text":"Nangin anah kohom sunga ngakoi nakoithei dem? ahiloule linga akha nasunpai thei dem?"},"3":{"text":"Nahenga ngehna tampi anei ding ham? nahenga aw nemma thu aseiding ham?"},"4":{"text":"Aman nangma toh kitepna asem dingham? a-imatih chana soh dinga nakipui thei dingham?"},"5":{"text":"Nangman ama chu vacha banga nakicheppi dingham? ahiloule nasoh numei ho dinga nahending ham?"},"6":{"text":"Agolhon golnop abolpeh dem? sumkolvei ho lah-a chu chan aneisahdiu hinam?"},"7":{"text":"Nangin avunchu thih hema nadimsah theija, ahiloule aluchu nga tenga nadimsah thei ding ham?"},"8":{"text":"Achunga nakhut ngaminlang, galchu geldoh inlang, bolkit tahih in."},"9":{"text":"Veovin, ama thajo dinga kinepna chu moh ahin; ama akimu sehseh jongleh mihem chu pailhah-a umji-a hilouham?"},"10":{"text":"Ama tildoh dinga kingapcha mihang koima aumpoi, achutile koiham Ka-anga dingjou dinga?"},"11":{"text":"Ama kalepeh kitna dinga koiham eikhamah? Vannoi pumpia thil umjouse hi keija ahi."},"12":{"text":"Keiman atibahho hihen, athahatna hihen, amellom naho hijongle selgu ponge."},"13":{"text":"Koiham aponsil chungnung hohlhah thei dinga?
