ahiloule kamdal ni puma akoma hung ngamding koiham?"},"14":{"text":"Ahaho chu tijat umtah-a kigol ahin, amaichang kotkhah hong ngamdinga koiham?"},"15":{"text":"Alipho chu akiletsahna ahin, sinkhana kinamkhum banga kikha khuma ahibouve."},"16":{"text":"Akah uva hu alutthei louna dingin, khat le khat hanaijin akinaijin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Amaho suhkhen ahilouna diuvin, khatle khat kijom matnin, akilompelun ahi."},"18":{"text":"Achit tengle vah ahung kikapdoh jin, amit ho chu jingkah ninel toh abange."},"19":{"text":"Akama konin thaomei kong, chule meisi pahlahlah ahungdoh jin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Belle khangbela kona twi asou bangin, anah homa konin meikhu ahungdoh jin ahi"},"21":{"text":"Ahaina huchun meihol hochu ajap-am min, chule akama konin meikong apotdoh jin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Angonga hatna aumin, amasanga lungkham nachu kipanan akilejin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Aphe hal hochu akijop matcheh-in, amaho chu adet chetnun, suhlonghoi ahipoi."},"24":{"text":"Alung chu song banga tah ahin, song sumhei noinung banga tah ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ama ahung kipatdoh tengle mihat hojong akichauvin, kichatna anatsat jehchun, ama hotah jong akisutheng jiuvin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Min chemjamin sat jongle ajolou ding, tengcha, tuljum, tenghem injong anang joupoi."},"27":{"text":"Aman thih chu changpol bangin agelin, chule sum-eng jong thingmot bangin agel bepmin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Thalpin ama ajamsah ngaipon, ahsongse jong ama dingin changkung tobang bep ahi."},"29":{"text":"Tenghem hochu poljang abahsah bepmin, tengcha akilo khumteng aman anuisat jin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Songhem hochu anoija aumin, aman bonlhoh chunga chun tenghem hochu athecheh jin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Aman twi thuhtah chu bela twibangin asou sah-in, aman twikhanglen jong chu lou theikhat tobang asosah-e."},"32":{"text":"Aman anunga lampi chu avahsah-in, min twithuh chu samkang bangin ageljiuvin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Leichunga akibahpi ama tobang aumpoi, amahi kichat na beija kisema ahi."},"34":{"text":"Aman thil sang kiti jouse amun, ama akiletsah chateho chunga leng ahi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Job'in Pakai adonbutnin, aseije:","title":"Job Lunghei Chule Akiledohkit"},"2":{"text":"Nangin ijakai nabol theijin, chule nalung ngaito jouse chu imachan adaltan theilou ahi, ti kahei,"},"3":{"text":"Hetna neilouva thumop sella chu koiham? hijeh chun kahetkhen theilou, keija dinga thil kidang behsehho chu kanaseidoh-in ahi.","ref":"Job 38:2."},"4":{"text":"Ngaijin, nahenga katao ahi, keiman seijinge; keiman nahenga kangeh ding, chule nangin neiphondoh peh-in,","ref":"Job 38:3."},"5":{"text":"Kakhojah theina nakhanga konin nangma chung changthu kanajan, tunvang kamitnin nangma amutai."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun keima le keima kaki ki-dah in, leivuile vutlah-a kakisih-in ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pakaiyin hiche thuho Job henga aseijou phatnin ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin Teman mi Eliphaz henga aseijin, nangmale nagolteni dounan kalungsatna akoujahtai. Ajehchu nanghon kasoh Job bangin keima chungthua thudih naseipouve."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun nanghon bongchal sagile kelngoichal sagi kaijunlang, kasoh Job henga cheovin; nangho dinga govam thilto gatoh uvin; chule kasoh Job nangho dingin taovintin, ataona chu ama jeh-a kasanpeh ding ahi. Achutiloule kasoh Job banga kachung changthu adih-a naseilou jeh uva, nangolnao dungjuija kabolding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hitichun Teman mi Eliphaz le Shuh mi Bildad chule Naamath mi Zophar chu acheuvin, Pakaiyin athupeh dungjuijin abolun, Pakaiyin Job chu asampehtai."},"10":{"text":"Chuin agolho dinga atao phatnin Pakaiyin Job asohchanna-a konin akiledoh sahtan; Pakaiyin jong Job chu anei masah sanga ajatnia tamin abetan ahi.","ref":"Job 1:1-3."},"11":{"text":"Chujouvin asopi pasal ho jousele asopi numei ho jouse, chule masanga ama kihetpiho jouse ahenga ahungun, a-in'a chun changlhah anekhom mun; chuin amahon alunghem piuvin, chule Pakaiyin achunga thilse abol hojouse jehchun alhamonun, amitakipmin jong sumle sana bilba khatcheh apeovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hitichun Pakaiyin Job chu ahinkho masalama sangin, ahinkho nununglama phatthei abohjon ahi. Ajehchu aman kelngoi sangsom le sangli, sangongsang gup, chule loukaithei cheh bongchal sangkhat, sanganpi sangkhat aneijin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aman chapa sagi le chanu thumjong aneijin,"},"14":{"text":"Chule aman apeng masapennu chu amin Jemima asah-in, chule aninanu minchu Kezia, cule athum nanu minchu Keren-happuch asah-in ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule gamsung pumpi-a chun Job chanute bangtah-a hoi aumpoi; chule amaho chu apauvin asopihou lah-a agouchan diu apecheh-in ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hiche jouchun Job kum jakhatle kum somli ahingin, achapate le, achapate chate khangli geijin amun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hitichun Job tehkem keile, nikho lhingsetnin athitan ahi."}}}}},"19":{"info":{"name":"Labu","shortname":"Labu","abbr":[],"desc":"Labu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen ngaisahlouho thumopma chonlou, michonse te lamlhah-a jong dingle lou, i-sah louho touna-a jong toulou michu anun nome.","title":"BU KHATNA (Labu 1—41) Michonpha ho Lampi leh Pathen Helouho kichaina Ding"},"2":{"text":"Amavang alung lhaina chu Pakai danthu-ah aumin; adanthu chu sunle janin angaito jin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amachu vadung panga thingphung kiphut tobang, aphatcha aga sodoh jia, anajong gop louding; chule abol jousea lolhing ding ahi.","ref":"Jer 17:8."},"4":{"text":"Pathen ngaisah louho vang chutobang ahipoi. Ahin huijin amut mangji changvai tobang bou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pathen ngaisahlouho chu thutan na-a ding jouloudiu, chujongle chonseho chu michonpha ho houkhom na-a pangloudiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin michonpha ho lampi chu ahen, hinla Pathen ngaisahlouho lampi vang mangthah ding ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ibola Pathen hephalouho lunghanga, chule mihon mohthu homkeo angaitou ham?","title":"Messiah Galjona leh Alenggam","ref":"Sol 4:25-26."},"2":{"text":"Leiset lengho atoukhomun, vaipoho akihoutoh-un, Pakai leh athaonu dounan hitin aseijuve,"},"3":{"text":"Eihon akikana akhao holhou suhtanpeh-u hitin, akhaohou eihoa konin paimangu hite."},"4":{"text":"Van ho-a toupa chu nui jintin, Pakaiyin amaho chu nuisat inte."},"5":{"text":"Chutengle ahenguva lunghangin thu seijintin, lung nommo-a achunguva lunghang ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hitajongle kalhang theng Zion chunga kalengpa katousah-e."},"7":{"text":"Thupeh chu keiman phongdoh inge, Pakai chun kahenga, nangma kachapa nahin; tunia hi kahin nahi, ati.","ref":"Sol 13:33; Heb 1:5; 5:5."},"8":{"text":"Kahenga thumin, keiman namtin chu nagoulo dinga kapeh ding, chule leiset kolmong geichu nagouchan dinga kapeh ding nahi."},"9":{"text":"Nangin amaho chu thih tenggola navohcheh-a; beldengpa bel banga ahal ahala nasuhchip ding ahi.","ref":"Tph 2:26-27; 12:5; 19:15."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun, vo nangho lengho, tuhin kichih theijun; nangho vannoi thutan ho kihilphaovin."},"11":{"text":"Pakai chu kichapumin jenunlang, kithing pumpumin kipah-un."},"12":{"text":"Chapa chu chopmun; achutiloule lunghang intin lamdunga konin mahthah getnun nate, alunghan chu neocha a deujahji ahi. Ama-a atahsan koiho chu anunnom ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"O Pakai, eidouhohi iti pun hitam! Eidouva kipanho chu atamlheh uve.","title":"Pakaiyin Amite Boina Tohho Apanpiji"},"2":{"text":"Pathen ama kithopi ding aumpoi, tia kahina thudol seija chu tamtah ahi. Selah"},"3":{"text":"Ahinla, vo Pakai, nangma chu keidinga lumdal nahin, kaloupi nale kalu eidop sangpeh-a chu nahi."},"4":{"text":"Keima ka Pakai henga aw gingin kataovin, aman alhang thenga konin eihin houve. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Keima kalumin, ka-imujin; Pakaiyin eihoi damjeh-in, kahung thoudoh kitne."},"6":{"text":"Eidouva eium kimvel mipi sangsom hi kicha taponge."},"7":{"text":"Hung thouvin, O Pakai; vo ka Pathen, neihuh doh-in! Ajehchu kamelmate jouse chu abeng gu-u najep pehjin; Pathen ngaisah louho ha chu navoh pulpeh jie."},"8":{"text":"Huhhingna chu Pakaiya ahi. Na phatthei bohna chu namite chunga um ahi. Selah"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo kachon phatna Pathen, kakou tengle neihouvin, gentheija kaum tengle nangin neipanpijie, ka chunga hepina neijinlang, kataona ngaijin.","title":"Mikitah ho Hoidohna"},"2":{"text":"Vo nangho mihem chapate, kaloupi nahi itihchan jachatna a nahei diuham? Itih changei mohthu homkeo nangailut uva chule jouthu naholdiu ham? Selah"},"3":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai chun ama dinga Pathen ngaisahho chu amadin akhendohtai ti hethemuvin; keiman ama kakou tengle Pakaiyin ajahding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kichageuvin dingun lang, chonse hih un; najalkhun chunga lungthimin kihou unlang, thipbeh chan umun. Selah","ref":"Eph 4:26."},"5":{"text":"Chonphatna le ganlhainaho chu peuvinlang, chule Pakaiya natahsanu ngamdetnun."},"6":{"text":"Mi tamtah-in thilpha kon eimusah untem? atiuve; Pakai namaiso vah chu kachunguva hindomsangin."},"7":{"text":"Nangin, midanghon changle lengpitwi tamtah aneilaijuva sanga chungnungjo kipana kalungsunga nakoije."},"8":{"text":"Keima lungmong tah-a kalupma chuleh ka-imut ding ahi: Ajehchu Pakai, nangma bou bitkeija eichensah nahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"O Pakai, kathusei neihin ngaipeh inlang, kalunggel neingaito peh-in.","title":"Puihoile Nadinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Ka lengpa leh ka Pathen, kakouna aw hi neingaipeh-in; ajehchu nahenga katao ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ka-aw hi jingkah le najah ding ahi; O Pakai jingkahle chunglam vea nahenga taona kahin lhutding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma gitlouna-a kipahji-a Pathen nahipon; thilse tojong chengkhom thei nahipoi."},"5":{"text":"Namitmu-a mingol dingthei louding; nangin khansetna boljouse nahot ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nangman jou seiho chu nasuhmang ding; Pakaiyin thisanso hat le milhemlha chu athet ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla keivang, namilungset haotah jeh-in na insunga chun hunglut ingting; chule nangma kichapumin na houin theng lam ngan nahin houvinge."},"8":{"text":"O Pakai, kamelmate jeh-in nadihna-a chun neipuijin; kamasanga nalampi hinlhung jangin."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu akam sunguva kitahna aumpon, asunglamu gitlouna adimin, alol homu lhan kihongsa ahin, aleijuvin amaho akiphatsei juve.","ref":"Rom 3:13."},"10":{"text":"O Pathen, amahohi, sumangin, athu hiluva amaho lhuhsah-in, Nangma nadoujeh ule asuhkhel nao tamtah jehchun, mipi lah-a konin amaho paidoh jengin."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla atahsanu nangma-a ngamdet jouse kipah uhen; Nangman amaho nahonbit jal-in kipanan ao vuhen, namin ngailuho jouse jong nanga kipah uhen."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai, nangman, michonpha phatthei boh-in natin, khotona-a lum banga nadal kimvel ding ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai lunghangin neipho danlang, lungphamon jong neijep hih-in.","title":"Lungkham Laitah-a Tahsana Taona","ref":"Labu 38:1."},"2":{"text":"Vo Pakai kalhahsam jeh-in nei hepin, vo Pakai, kaguhon eichi natsoh jeh in neidamsah in."},"3":{"text":"Kahinna jong agenthei behsehtai: ahinla, O Pakai, itihchan hiding ham?"},"4":{"text":"O Pakai, hung kinunglen lang kahinna huhhingin; oh nahepinaho jal-in neihuhhing in."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu thina-a chun nangma geldohna aumtapon, lhankhuh sunga nangma kon nathangvah ding ham?"},"6":{"text":"Kakhoisat satna-in kalel lhehtan; Janseh-in kajalkhun kijapnan kaneijin, kalupna kamitlhin kachap lhop-in ahi."},"7":{"text":"Kamit jong lungkhamna jeh-in angui lhatan, Kamelmaho jouse jeh-in atehsetan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pakaiyin kataona eingaipeh tah jeh-in; khansetna bolteho jouse kakoma konin chemang uvin.","ref":"Matt 7:23; Luk 13:27."},"9":{"text":"Pakaiyin kathumna eijah pehtan: Pakaiyin kataona eisanpeh ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kamelmate jouse jahchao henlang thohgim lheh uhen. Hungkileu henlang photlot louvin jahchao hen."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai ka Pathen, nangma-ah katahsan kangame, eibol gentheiho jouse-a konin neihuh doh-in lang, neihoidoh in.","title":"Thu adih-a Kitana dia Taona"},"2":{"text":"Achutiloule, eihuhdoh ding umloupetnahi, keipi bahkai banga kahina abotela, ahal hala akoiding ahi."},"3":{"text":"O Pakai ka Pathen, hichehi kabol ahia, kakhutna khansetna uma ahile;"},"4":{"text":"kaki champi khat chu thilse-a kalethuh-a ahileh, (henge, ajehbeija kaki champi khat chu kamelma dinga kapehdoh ahitan):"},"5":{"text":"Melma chun kahinna hi bolgenthei henlang kilahjeng hen; henge, kahinkhohi, tolto lhobeh henlang, kaloupina hi leivui toh chil halhen. Selah"},"6":{"text":"O Pakai, nalung hanna-a, hung kipat doh-in, kamelma teho lunghana jeh-in nangma hung kidomsangin; chule nangman nathupeh banga thutandin keima dingin hung thoudoh-in."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu mipi kikhomho chun nangma naum kimvel diu ahin; amaho khohsahna jal chun chungsang lama kiletan."},"8":{"text":"Pakaiyin mihemte thu atanding ahi: O Pakai, kachon phatna dungjuile keija um dihna dungjuijin kathu tanin."},"9":{"text":"Oh migiloute gitlouna chu kichai hen; ahinla midihte chu tung doh-in; ajehchu Pathen chonphatna chun lungsungle lunggel apatepjin ahi.","ref":"Tph 2:23."},"10":{"text":"Eingah tupma chu, lungsung dihtah huhdohji-a Pathen'a kon ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pathen chu michonpha ho thutan ahin, Pathen chu niseh-in migilouho chunga alunghangin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Amachu akilehei louva ahileh, Aman achemjam anol hema, athalpi ajet kona, kigosa dema umding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Thina manchah ho jong chu amandin agongtoh demin; misugenthei ho dounan athalchang ho asemtohtai."},"14":{"text":"Veovin, khansetna chu naosonat in anan, thilphalou chu avopmin, thujou chu ahung penglhatai."},"15":{"text":"Aman kotong asemin, alaithuh in, akotong sema chun ama alhalutne."},"16":{"text":"Agitlouna chu ama luchang ngeija hungkilentin, a hunam thilbol chu alujanga hung chuding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Achonphatna dungjuijin keiman Pakai chu vahchoi jing ting, chungnung pen Pakai minin vahchoinan la sange."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai ka Pakaiyu, leiset pumpi sunga naminhi iti lula lul hitam! vanho chunga naloupina nakoijin ahi.","title":"Thilsem na-a Pakai Loupina"},"2":{"text":"Nangman melmate phulapa suhthipna dingle nangma melmaho jeh-in, naosen hole naonoichep laiho kama konin thahatna chu nasudet tan ahi.","ref":"Matt 21:16."},"3":{"text":"Keiman nakhut junga nasemsa, navan munho kavetle-a, nangman nasuhdetsaho lha leh ahsi ho kavetji teng;"},"4":{"text":"Mihem hi ipi hija nangin hibanga nagelkhoh-a? chule mihem chapa hi ipiham hibanga nakhohsah?","ref":"Job 7:17-18; Labu 144:3; Heb 2:6-8."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu nangin vantil ho sangin themkhat bou nanoinun sah-in, chule jana leh loupina lallukhuh nakhuh peh-in ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nangman ama chu nakhutsohho jouse chunga vaihomin nasemin; thiljouse ama kengto noija nakoije:","ref":"1 Cor 15:27; Eph 1:22; Heb 2:8."},"7":{"text":"Kelngoile bongchal jouse, henge, gamlah a gamsaho;"},"8":{"text":"Chunga leng vachate, twikhanglen'a ngaho, chule ipi hijongleh twikhanglen'a lamlha ho jouse chunga vaipodin nasemin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Vo Pakai ka Pakaiyu, leiset pumpi sunga naminhi iti lulla lul hitam!"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, kalung pumpin nangma vahchoi jingting; nathilbol kidang jouse katah lang ding ahi.","title":"Thu Dih Tah-a Atanjeh-a Pakai Thangvahna"},"2":{"text":"Nangma-a kipah-in thanominge: Vo chungnung pen Pakai, namin vahchoilan sange."},"3":{"text":"Kamelmate anungjam tengule, na-angsunga lhu uva mangthah diu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman kathemnale kachungthu navetup in; dihtah-a thutanin laltouna-a chun natouve."},"5":{"text":"Nangin Pathen hephalouho naphohjin, migilou chu nasumangin; aminu chu tonsotnadin nanoimang jin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Vo nangho melmate, manthah na ho chu kumkho-a din suhmangin aumin; chule nangin khopi ho nasumangin; amaho hetjingna chu amahoto amantha tan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai chu tonsotna umding ahin; Aman alaltouna chu thutanna dingin adotoh tan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Aman chonphatna-a vannoi hi athu atanding, aman lungthengsela mipi ho thutanna aneiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Suhgentheija umte dingin Pakai chu kiselna ahin, lungkham laija kiselna mun ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule nangma min heho chun atahsanu nanga angapdiu ahi. Ajehchu nangma holte chu, Pakai, nangman nadalha ngaipon ahi."},"11":{"text":"Zion'a chenghon Pakai vahchoi La saovin; Athilbolho chu mipi lah-a phongdoh-un."},"12":{"text":"Aman thisan kholchilna aneiteng amaho chu ahe jingin; aman mi kineosah ho ka awgin asumil ngaipoi."},"13":{"text":"O Pakai, kachunga hepina neijinlang; thina kotpi-a kona eikaidohpa, eihot te-a kona kathohnahi neigel peh-in."},"14":{"text":"Zion chanu kotpi phungho-a nangma thangvahna jouse kamusah theina dingin, nami huhhingna-a chun kipah inge."},"15":{"text":"Pathen hephalouho chu amaho sem kotong sunga alhalutnun; alenthang kamuva amaho keng mama a-oh jiuve."},"16":{"text":"Pakai chu athutan lhah natohna-a hetdoh-in aumjin, migilou chu ama khutsohho ngeija a-oh jiuve. Haggaion. Selah"},"17":{"text":"Migilou chu damuna kilehlutding, chule Pathen sumil namjouse jong kilehlut ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu alhasama chu suhmilin umjing pontin, migenthei te kiholna tonsotnin mangpai ponte."},"19":{"text":"Thouvin, vo Pakai, mihem kijosah hihhelin, namitmu tah-in Pathen hephalouho thu kitanhen."},"20":{"text":"Vo Pakai, namtinin mihem bou akihi ti ahettheina diuvin amaho chu kichatsah-in. Selah"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, ibolla gamlatah-a ding nahim? Lungkham laija ibola kisela nahim?","title":"Pathen'in Agilou Chunga Galjona Aneiding Tahsana La"},"2":{"text":"Migilou chun ahoithona lamin mivaicha asugentheijin; athilgonu chun amaho kipalsah jinghen."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu migilou chun alung ngaichat asongin, Pakaiyin ahotlam kilosetna-a chun amaho anun nomui."},"4":{"text":"Migilou chun ahoithona maiso-a konin Pathen holponte: Pathen chu ama ngaitona jouse-a aumpoi."},"5":{"text":"Alamlhah jouse phattinin lungkhamna jeng ahin; nathutan lhahho chu sangtah-a um ahin, amuphapon; amelmate jouse chu anuisatnin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Aman alungsunga, keima kiling ponge; ajehchu kidoupi kanei louding ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Akamsung chu gaosapna, joulhepna, dohabolna adimsetnin; alei noija setnale mohthuhomkeu bou aume.","ref":"Rom 3:14."},"8":{"text":"Ama khotina kichanlhih na munho-a atoujin; munthip ho-a themona neilouho athatjin: amit tenin panpibei ho guhthimin avelhin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Akosunga keipi bahkai bangin guhthimin akiselin achanglhi jin; migenthei chu matdin achangin, alensunga aloilutnin amanjitan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Migenthei chu amihatpa koma alhuh nadin, ama akineosah-in tolla abohkhup jin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Aman alungthimin, Pathen'in asumilin, amai aseltai atin, aman itih-in mutaponte, ati."},"12":{"text":"Vo Pakai, vo Pathen, thouvin lang nakhut domsangin, mikineosah ho chu sumil hih-in."},"13":{"text":"Ipidinga mikhang gilouvin Pathen anoise ham? Aman alungsunga, nangin hichehi ngaichapon nate atin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu ven thilphaloule thangthipna nakhutna phulahding chu nangin namutai. Migenthei chu nahenga ahung kipelutnin; nangma pabeiho panpi chu nahi."},"15":{"text":"Mi engsele miphalou banjang suhboh peh-in, agitlouna naholmohel kahsen holin."},"16":{"text":"Pakai chu atonsot atonsotna leng ahin; Agamsunga kona Pathen hephalouho amangthah uve."},"17":{"text":"Pakai nangin mi kineosah ho ngaichat najah peh-in, nangman alungthimu nagot pehding, chule najahna dinga nakol nasun ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Leiset mihemin abolgenthei kitlouna dinga, paneilou leh bolgentheija umho thu chu natanpeh ding ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiya katahsan ngaminge; iti dana nanghon kahinna jah-a, vacha bangin namolsang lama jamin neitiu ham?","title":"Pakaiya Kison"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu, veuvin, mikitah ho lungchang guhthima kapna dingin, migilou hon athalpiu ajebongun, athal changu akhaoto asuto taove."},"3":{"text":"Abulpiho akisuh mangle, michonphan ipi abolthei tahding ham?"},"4":{"text":"Pakai chu a-houin thenga achengin, Pakai laltouna chu van'a um ahin, amit tenin ahinven, mihem chatehi apatepmin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pakaiyin michonpha chu apatepjin, migiloule pumhat mangho chu ahinna in ahon ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pakaiyin migiloute chunga chu meihol, mei le kaat ajuhsah-a, chule kichat umtah khopihui anunsah ding; Hichehi achandiu khon chu hiding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu chonphatna Pathen chun chonphatna chu angailun; milungthengin ama mel amujin ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai, neipanpin, ajehchu Pathen he-a mi aumtapoi; ajehchu mihem chate lah-a konin tahsan um mi alosamjin ahi.","title":"Panpina dinga Thumna"},"2":{"text":"Amitakipmin aheng akomah thumanlou jeng aseijun, pachat lhemna muh leh lungtho neipumin thu aseijui."},"3":{"text":"Pakaiyin pachat lhemna muhle hoitho thu seina lei chu atanmui ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amahon, ileijun eihon jona neiju hite, imuhhoula eihoa ahin, ichunguva Pakai koiham? atiuvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pakaiyin, vaichaho kisuh gentheina jehle, lhasamho khoisatjeh-in, tun kipat ingting, noise-a nuisatpa-a konin amachu huhdoh-in koijinge atin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pakai thusei ho chu thu thengtah ahin; dangka leiset lhumpi sunga vel sagivei kisutheng tobang ahi."},"7":{"text":"O Pakai, nangman amaho chingjingin natin, amaho chu tukhanga pat tonsot geijin vetupnan nate."},"8":{"text":"Miphalouho chu akichoisang teng, khangitlouna chu muntina avahlen ahi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, itihchan neisuhmil ding ham? Tonsot geijinem? Keima-a kona namai itihchan nasel dingham?","title":"Pakai Mihuhhing na-a Kinep"},"2":{"text":"Niseh-a lungsunga lunggimna neija kahinna-a itihchan kagelgel dingham? Kamelmate kachunga itihchan choisanga umdiu ham?"},"3":{"text":"Vo Pakai ka Pathen, ngaitonlang neingaipeh in, kamitteni vahsah in, ajole mithi ihmutnin ihmu khaget inge."},"4":{"text":"Ajole kamelma chun ama kajoutai, tintin; chule kalonle tengle eidouva chu kipah getninte."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla nahepina ka tahsantan; nami huhhingna-a kalung kipahding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Aman thil ninglhing set eibolpeh jeh-in, Pakai vahchoinan keiman la sange."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mingolin alung thimin Pathen aumpoi, tin aseije. Amaho akisuboh-un, thil thet um abolun, thilpha bola khatcha aumpoi.","title":"Mihemte Gitlouna","ref":"Rom 2:10-12."},"2":{"text":"Ahetoh them milungching leh Pathen hola aumkhatle, tin Pakai chun van'a konin mihem chate ahinvesuh-in ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amaho ahilou lama achegam taovin, abonun aboh soh gamtaove: thilpha bola aumpouve, khat jengcha jong aumpoi."},"4":{"text":"Khangitlouna bolho jousen hetna himhim anei lou uham? Amahon achanglhah neh bangun kamite abahgamun, Pakaila akoupouvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chua chun amaho kichatah-in aummui; ajehchu Pathen hi michonpha khang sunga aumin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nanghon migenthei thuhil chu najachat piuvin, hinla Pakai chu ama kiselna ahi."},"7":{"text":"Israelte kihuh hingna chu Zion'a kona hitavele o! Pakaiyin amite asohchan naova kona ahin lepuikit tengle, Jacob chu thanom intin, Israel chu kipah ding ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai nahoubuh-a koi aumin? nalhang thenga koi acheng tadem?","title":"Pathen Inthenga Umding Mi"},"2":{"text":"Lungdih-a chonale, chonphatna bola, chule alungsunga thudihsei."},"3":{"text":"Akama mi seise lou, aheng akom chunga jong thilse bollou, chule aheng akom i-sah louva douva bol hilou."},"4":{"text":"Amitmua miphalou vetda, ahia Pakai gingho vang jabol; ama le ama kisuhkhah nadia kihahsel leh lungkhel kitlou."},"5":{"text":"Apung dinga sumpa hom ngailou, monabei chunga nehguh la ngailou mi. Hicheng thilho bolla chu imatih-a longlou ding ahi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen neiching phan, ajehchu nangah katahsan kangamin ahi.","title":"Mikitah Taona"},"2":{"text":"Vo kahinna, nangin Pakai henga, nangma ka Pakai nahin, nangma kom tailouva thilpha kaneipoi, nati."},"3":{"text":"Ahinla leisetna mithenghole milul ho henga, amaho-a chun kakipana jouse aumji-e nati."},"4":{"text":"Pathen dang nung del loiho chu alung hesohnao pungding; don thilpeh dinga apeh-u thisan jong katodoh louding, ahilouleh aminu jong kaphahpoh louding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pakai chu kagouchanle kakhon ahi, nangman kachanvou chu neivettup peh-e."},"6":{"text":"Tena khaoho chun munpha lai ho eikitedoh pehjin, henge, keiman gouphatah kaneitai."},"7":{"text":"Keima thumop eipepa Pakai chu phatthei boh inge, jan tengle kalungthimin eihiljin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Keiman Pakai chu kamasanga kaumsah jingin, ama kajetlama aumjeh-in keima kiling ponge.","ref":"Sol 2:25-28."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun kalung akipah-in, kaloupina akipah-in; Katahsa jonghi kinepna-a choldo ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman kahinna hi damuna nadalhah lou ding; namitheng chu mon mangna jong namusah louding ahi.","ref":"Sol 13:35."},"11":{"text":"Nangin hinna lampi neimusah-in; naumna chu kipanan adimin, nakhut jetna chu tonsot kipana uma ahi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, adihchu ngaijin lang ka kana hi ngailhin, alhem hilou ka kama kataona ngaina din nana hinsungin.","title":"Nolnabei mipa Taona"},"2":{"text":"Kachunga thulhuhna chu nanga kon hihen lang, namit tenin thil kibangho chu vehen."},"3":{"text":"Nangin kalungthim nakhol chilin, janteng nei vilin, nangman neipatep in, ima namu louding ahi; kakamin suhkhel aneilou dinghi kakigel lhahna ahi."},"4":{"text":"Mihem natohho thudol, nakama thusoh jal-in, mi sumang jingho lampiho-a konin kakiveng tupmin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kakalsona kalhuh lounadin, nalampi ho kajotna-a neituh-in."},"6":{"text":"Vo Pathen, keiman nangma kakouvin, nangman neingaipeh innate; keima lama nakol hinsungin lang kathusei neingaipeh-in."},"7":{"text":"O nanga atahsanu ngam jouse, amaho douho khutna kona khut jetna huhhingji-a chun, nangailut kidang chu neimusah-in."},"8":{"text":"Nalungset khat bangin neihongin lang, nalhalim noija neiselin,"},"9":{"text":"Eisumang thei migilouva konle, thitheina melma eium chahho-a konin neihongin."},"10":{"text":"Amahon alungthimu thaotah chu akhahtupmun; akamun kiletsah tah-in thu aseijuve."},"11":{"text":"Amahon tun kakalsonao chana ei-umun; tollhanga suhngem dingin, amitnun eiveuvin,"},"12":{"text":"Keipi bahkaijin asatha apetel got bangle, keipi donglaijin munthip ho-a achanlhih abanguvin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Vo Pakai, thouvin, ama chu lunglhah sah-in, nachemjamin migilouva konin kahinkho huhdoh-in,"},"14":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nakhutna um mihemte-a konle vannoi mihem hiche hinkho-a chan neiho, atumpiu nagou sela nadip dimpeh ho-a konin kahinkho huhdoh-in; amaho chapang tamtah ahiuvin, athilu amoh chu achasen hou adalhahpeh taovin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Keiman vang namai chu chonphatna-a kahinvet ding; Nangma bangtah-a kahungtho teng keima kalungna chimtante."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, kathahat nan, keiman nangma ngailunge.","title":"David Galjona La"},"2":{"text":"Pakai chu kasongpile kakulpi chule eihuh hingpa ahi; ka Pathen, kathahatna, achunga katahsana kangap ding ahi; ka lumle, kahuh hingna ki, chuleh ka kulpidet ahi."},"3":{"text":"Vahchoi dia lomtah Pakai chu kou ingting, chutichun kamelma te-a konin huhdoh in umtange."},"4":{"text":"Thina lung genthei nahon eiumkimvelin, Pathen nahsahlouho twisoh-in eikichatsah-e."},"5":{"text":"Thikholkhul lung genthei nahon eiumkimvelin, thina thangho chun ei kimaito pi-e."},"6":{"text":"Kagen theina a Pakai chu kakouvin, ka Pathen kasamin; Aman a-houin'a konin ka aw ajan, kakana chu a-angsung geijin aluttan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chujouvin leiset akilingin, akihottai; Ama lunghan jeh-in lhangbul ho chu achatnin akihottai."},"8":{"text":"Anah homa konin meikhu akitung doh-in, akama kona mei chun akavam heltan, hichun meihol a-al lenglung sah-in ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aman vanho jong asonkunin, ahung kumlhan; muthim lhangkhal chu akengto noija aumin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ama Cherub chunga atouvin, alenge, henge, hui lhavingho chungah alengin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Aman muthim lhangkhal chu ama munthip min asemin; akimvela apon in chu twipi thimjejule van'a meilhang satah chu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Amasanga vahpem puma chun meilhang satah achen, gelchangle meikong alhan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Pakaiyin vanho jong thongjejun aginsah in, chungnung pen chun a-aw asodoh in ahile gelchangle mei alhan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Henge, aman athal changho chu asoldoh-in ahile akithe chehtai, aman kolpheho akapdoh in, chule amaho chu ajoutan ahi."},"15":{"text":"O Pakai nangman napho-a nanah nakhon khum tengle twilona jouse akimujin, chule vannoi leiset bulpi jouse jong akilangdoh jin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Aman chunglama konin asolin, eituh in, twi tamtah lah-a konin eikaidoh-e."},"17":{"text":"Aman kamelma hattah-a kon leh eihot bolho-a konin eihuhdoh-e; ajehchu amaho keidingin ahat lheh jengun ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hamsetna kato-nin amahon eikitopiuvin, ahinla Pakai chu kaki ngaina ahi."},"19":{"text":"Aman mun lentah khatna jong eipuidoh-in, kachunga akipajeh-in eihuh dohtan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kachon phatna dungjuijin Pakaiyin kipaman eipen, kakhut then dungjuijin eilethuhnai."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman Pakai lampiho chu kajui jingin, ka Pathen'a konin giloutah-in kapotdoh khapoi."},"22":{"text":"Athutan lhahna jouse kamasanga aumin, adan kisemho chu keija konin kapaidoh khapoi."},"23":{"text":"Ama anga chondih jong kahin, kakhan gitlouna-a konin kakihongbit jinge."},"24":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin chonpha kahinale, amitmua kakhut athen dungjuijin eilethuh jin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Mihepi themho chu hepina musah-in natin; mi chondihho chu nachondihna vetsah-in nate;"},"26":{"text":"Athenga chu nathenna musah-in natin, lung gilouho chu nalung gitlouna musah-in nate."},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu nangin aki bolgenthei hochu huhdoh-in natin; akichoisangho chu nasotlhah ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ajehchu nangin kathaomei neivah peh-in natin, Pakai ka Pathen'in keija um muthim hi salvah-inte."},"29":{"text":"Ajehchu nang jal-in sepaihon lah-a kalhaijin, ka Pathen jal-in kulbang kachopkhupme."},"30":{"text":"Pathen dingin alampi apha chamkimin; Pakai thu chu patepmin aumin; Ama tahsan jousedin ama chu lumdal ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai tailou koiham Pathen? ahiloule i-Pathen'u tailou songpi koiham?"},"32":{"text":"Hatna-a kakong eigehpeh-a leh kalampi sempha chamkima Pathen ahi."},"33":{"text":"Aman kakeng chu sajuhpi keng bangin asemin, kamunsangho chunga eiumsahjie.","ref":"Habk 3:19."},"34":{"text":"Kaban teni-a thih thalpi kaheboh theinadin, aman kakhut teni gal bolje ahile."},"35":{"text":"Nangin nahuhhingna lumdal jong chu neipen; nakhut jetlamin neikai doh-in nanun nemna chun lentah eisoi."},"36":{"text":"Kalhuh louna dingin, kakho lhahna ding neisem letpeh-in ahi."},"37":{"text":"Kamelmate nung kadelin, kaphan, amaho kasuh manghel kahsen kahungkile jipon ahi."},"38":{"text":"Amaho athodoh joulouhelna diuvin kamavon, kakengto noija alhusoh helun ahi."},"39":{"text":"Ajehchu nangin galsatna-a ding thahatna kong neigah peh-in; keima douna-a hungkipatdohho chu kanoija nasunem hele."},"40":{"text":"Eithetbol ho chu kasuhmang theinadin, nangman kamelmate ngong hochu neipetan ahi."},"41":{"text":"Amaho apengun, ahinla ahuhdoh dingula khatcha aumpon; Pakai jengjong akouvun, ahinla aman adonbut dehpouve."},"42":{"text":"Chu jouvin huinung masanga vutvai bangin amaho kavogoijin; lamlena thilboh bangin kapai doh-in ahi."},"43":{"text":"Nangin miho kisat tona lah-a konin neihuh doh-in; chule nangin keima Pathen hepha louho luchangin neisemin, kahetkhah lou mihon eijendiu ahi."},"44":{"text":"Kathulhut ajah jah-uleh eijoppai juntin; gamdang miho chu kahenga hungkipelut diu ahi."},"45":{"text":"Gamdang miho chu hung lhasam untin, akulpi houva kona kithing pumpuma hung dohdiu ahi."},"46":{"text":"Pakai ahing jinge; kasongpi chu nunnom hen; eihuh hinga Pathen chu choisangin umhen."},"47":{"text":"Kaphu eilahpeh-a, miho kanoija sunema chu Pathen ahi."},"48":{"text":"Aman kamelma te-a konin eihuhdoh-e; henge, keima douna-a hung kipatdoh ho chung vuma neidom sangin; hunam mipa-a konin neihuh doh tai."},"49":{"text":"Hijeh chun O Pakai, Pathen hephalou ho lah-a chun nangma na thangvah ingting, chutengle nangma min vahchoi la sange.","ref":"Rom 15:9."},"50":{"text":"Aman huhhingna lentah chu alengpa apen, chule athaonu David leh achilhahte chunga chun ahepina tonsotna din amusah-e."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vanhon Pathen loupina aphong doh-un; chule vanthamjolin akhutsem amusah-e.","title":"Pathen Kiphon dohna Chamkim"},"2":{"text":"Sunin sun jah-a thu aseijin, chule jan-in jan jah-a hetna amusah-in ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hichea chun thu kisei aumpon, paole oginjong akijapoi."},"4":{"text":"Atena khao chu leiset pumpi-a chule athu uchu vannoi leiset kolmang geijin akikhon; Hicheho-a chun aman nisa dingin ponbuh khat asongin,","ref":"Rom 10:18."},"5":{"text":"Hichu moulang a-indana kona hungdoh tobang ahin, kilhaitetna-a lhaiding pasal hat bangin athanome."},"6":{"text":"Apotdohna chu van mong langkhatna kipan ahin, alhuna chu among langkhat chan ahi; chuche asatna-a kona kisela imacha aumpoi."},"7":{"text":"Pakai dan chu achamkimin, hinna sempha-a ahi; Pakai thu hettohsah chu athengin, mimol ho achih sah-e."},"8":{"text":"Pakai dan kisemchu adih-in, lungsung akipasah-in; Pakai dan thupeh chu athengin, mit teni avahsah-in ahi."},"9":{"text":"Pakai ginchu athengin, a-imatih channa aumjingin; Pakai thutanlhahho chu thutah le chonphatna ahisoh keije."},"10":{"text":"Hicheho chu sana sangin jong dei aumjon, henge, sana thengsel sangin jong athengjoi, khoijule khoiphang sanga jong lhumjo ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chukalvalin nasohhi nagihsalin; chule hicheho chintupna-a chun kipaman lentah aumin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ama suhkhel ho kihetkhen jouva koiham? Guhthima kasuh khella konin neisuthengin."},"13":{"text":"Nasohhi kihoitho sahna chonset ho-a konin jong neituh-in; hitiho chu kachunga vaihomsah hih-in; chutengle keima kalung thenga, chule keima suhkhelna lentah-a kona monabei kahiding ahi."},"14":{"text":"O Pakai, kahatnale eilhandampu, kakama thupot hole kalungthim sunga kagelhi, namitmun santhei doltah hihen."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nalungkham nile Pakaiyin nadonbut henlang; Jacob Pathen min chun nahongbit hen!","title":"Galjona Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Munthenga konin nakithopi hinsolhen lang, Zion'a konin natha hatsahhen;"},"3":{"text":"Nathilpeh jouse hejing henlang, chule na govam thilto jong sanghen. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Aman nalungdei dungjuijin nape henlang, chule nathilgon jouse nabulhit peh hen."},"5":{"text":"Keiho nami huhhingna-a chun kipah-uving ting, ka Pathen'u minin kaponlap hou tungdoh-uvinge! Nathum jouse Pakaiyin nasuh bulhitpeh hen."},"6":{"text":"Pakaiyin athaonu ho ahuhdoh-e ti tun kahetai; akhut jetlam huhhingna thahat chun, avanthenga konchun hin ngaipeh inte."},"7":{"text":"Abangin sakol kangtalai ho, chule abangin sakol ho atahsanun; keihon vang Pakai ka Pathen'u min chu kageldoh jingjeng diu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Amaho suhnem ahiuvin alhuve, keihovang kithoudoh uving ting, lungtheng sela kadindiu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Pakai, huhhingin! keihon kakou tengule lengpan neihin ngaipeh-un."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nahatna-a lengpa kipah intin, nahuhhing na-a ama iti akipa tadem!","title":"Pathen Mihuhhing na-a Kipana"},"2":{"text":"Nangin alung ngaichat napen, akama athumho chu na-it pehpoi."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu Nangin ama chu phatnale phattheina ho in navengbit in, sana thengtah lallukhuh alua nakhuh peh-e."},"4":{"text":"Aman nahenga hinkho athumin, nangin tonsot hinkho saona jengjong napetan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nami huhhingna jana loupi chu anasata ngeijin, janale lalna chu achunga nangam tai."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman tonsotna phattheina chungnung changdin ama nasemin; na-umpina chun kipana chungnung apen ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu lengpan Pakai atahsanin, chule chungnung pen hepina jeh-in ama chu kiling ponte."},"8":{"text":"Nakhutnin namelmate jouse holdoh intin, nahote chu nakhut jetnin holdoh inte."},"9":{"text":"Nalunghan tengle amaho chu lhumsung meikong banga nasemding; Pakaiyin alunghana-a aval lhumuva, chule meichun ahalvam gamdiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Amaho ga chu leija konin, chule achilhah-u chu leisetna mihem chate lah-a konin sumangin nate."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon nangma douna-in thilse bol agouvin; amahon aboldoh joulou dingu thilphalou angaitouvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun nangin nathal changho akhaoto nasuhto-a amai dungu nadoitengle, nangin amaho nakinungle sah ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Pakai, nathahatna achun, nangma kichoisangin, chutia chu keihon nathahatna chu vahchoina la-a kasahdiu ahi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pathen, ka Pathen ibola neidalhah hitam? Ipidinga eipanpi dingle gimthoh-a kapena awchenga kona nahiti gamlat hitam?","title":"Genthei pehna Kana le Vahchoina La","ref":"Matt 27:46; Mrk 15:3."},"2":{"text":"Vo ka Pathen, suntengle nangma kasamjin, ahinla neijah pehpoi; chule jankhon jong thiptih kanei jipoi."},"3":{"text":"Ahinla nangma atheng nahin, Israelte pachatna-a chengjinga chu nahi."},"4":{"text":"Kapu kapa teovin nangma natahsan uvin, amahon natahsanun, chule nangin amaho nahuhdohjin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amaho nangma henga ataovun, nahuhdohji-e; amahon nangma natahsan jeh-uchun, akisudong jipouve."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla keima lungtol bep kahin, mihem kahipoi; chule mihemte i-sah loule mite nahsahlou kahi."},"7":{"text":"Eimu chanin nahsahlouvin einuisatnun; amuh aholpumun, alu athingun, aseijiuvin,","ref":"Matt 27:39; Mrk 15:29; Luk 23:35."},"8":{"text":"Aman eihuhdoh-inte tin Pakai chu atahsanin; Achunga akipa amujeh-in aman ama huhdoh tahen.","ref":"Matt 27:43."},"9":{"text":"Ahinla nangma naobu sunga kona einaloi doh-a chu nahin, kanu anga kaumlaija neina kinepsahsa ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Keima naobu-a kona nachunga eina sekhumu ahin, kanu oisunga kona ka Pathen nahitai."},"11":{"text":"Keija konin gamlahih-in, ajehchu lungkhamna anaije; ajehchu eipanpi ding khatcha aumpoi."},"12":{"text":"Bongchal tamtah-in eiumkimvelun; Bashan bongchal hattahhon eiumkimvel sohtai."},"13":{"text":"Keipi bahkai hangtah kitum bangin, akam eikat hom khumun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Keima twibangin eikisunglhan, kagu kachang jouse akikhensoh in; kalunghi khoilu bangin kagilpi sunga ajollha tai."},"15":{"text":"Kathahat nahi leibel chipsa bangin agolhatan; chule kalei jong kadanga abehchah in, nangin thina leivuija neipuilut tai."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu uicha hon eiumkimvelun; khangilou mipi kikhom hon eium naijun, kakhutle kakenghohi asunun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Kagujouse kasimtheijin, amahon eiveovin eigaldot uve."},"18":{"text":"Amaho kavon jouse akihomun, chule kaponsil changding jong vang akisan taove.","ref":"Matt 27:35; Mrk 15:24; Luk 23:34; Jhn 19:24."},"19":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangma keija konin umgamla hih-in, vo kathahatna, eipanpi dingin kinon."},"20":{"text":"Kahinna hi chemjam'a konin huhdoh-in, kahinkho manlutah hi uicha thanei na-a konin huhdoh-in."},"21":{"text":"Keipi bahkai kamsunga konin neihuh doh-in, ajehchu sakol kinei kiho-a konin jong neina ngaipeh-in ahi."},"22":{"text":"Kasopite henga namin phongleng ting; mipi kikhomho lah-a nangma kavahchoi ding nahi.","ref":"Heb 2:12."},"23":{"text":"Pakai ginga nanghon ama vahchoijun, Jacob sonho jousen ama choi-anun, Israel sonho jousen ama chu gingun."},"24":{"text":"Ajehchu aman bolgenthei thohho chu nahsahmole hotnin abol gentheipon, ama-a konin jong amai aselpoi; ahinla ahenga athumteng angaipehjie."},"25":{"text":"Mipi kikhomho tamtah lah-a kapachatna chu nanga hintin, ama gingte angsunga kakitepna ho lhutninge."},"26":{"text":"Minunnem hon neovintin, lunglhaijunte; ama holho chun Pakai chu vahchoi unte; nalungthim chu tonsotna hingding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Leiset kolkimvelin Pakai ageldoh-a Pakai henga kilediu; chule chitin namtin jousen ama ahou dingu ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ajehchu lenggam chu Pakaiya ahin; chule ama namtin lah-a vaihompa ahi."},"29":{"text":"Leichunga khangtouho jousen neovintin chule ama ahoudiu; leivuija kileding jouse a-anga kuncheh ding; koimachan ama hinna akihuhjou louding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chilhah khatnin ama jenintin, hichu Pakai henga khangkhatna kisimding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Amaho hunguva, ahung pengding miho henga hiche athilbol aumchan chonphatna hi aphondoh dingu ahi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu kelngoi chinna eichingpa ahin, keima lhasamponge.","title":"Amite Chingpa Pakai"},"2":{"text":"Aman hamhing lah-a eikolsah jin, twi damdidei pang dunga eipuilei.","ref":"Tph 7:17."},"3":{"text":"Aman kalhagao akiledohsah jin; amin jallin chonphatna lampiho-a eipuilei."},"4":{"text":"Henge, keiman thina phaicham lim jotjongleng, thilse gingtaponge; ajehchu nangman nei umpin, namol lhon le natenggolin eilhamonjin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nangman kamelmate angsunga dokhang neigon peh-in; kalu thao nanun, kakhon alonglet tai."},"6":{"text":"Thonlou hella phatnale hepina-in kahinkho lhungkeija eijuiding; chule atonsotna keima Pakai in'a kachenjing ding ahi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vannoi leisetle asunga cheng jouse, aboncha Pakaiya ahi.","title":"Loupina Lengpa Leh Alenggam","ref":"1 Cor 10:26."},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu aman twipiho chunga atundoh-a, twisohho chunga aphudet ahi."},"3":{"text":"Pakai lhanga kaldinga koi hija, amunthenga gading dinga koiham?"},"4":{"text":"Khut thengle lungtheng neija, ahinna pannabei dinga pedohlou, jouva kihahsel louhel mi chu ahi.","ref":"Matt 5:8."},"5":{"text":"Aman Pakaiya kona vangbohna le, ahuhhingpa Pathen'a kona chonphatna amuding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Vo Jacob hichehi ama holtele namai holte khanggui chu ahi. Selah"},"7":{"text":"Vo kotpi ho, nanghon nalu-u domsangun, chule tonsot kotpi nangho kikhang sangun, chutile loupina leng chu hunglut ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hiche loupina leng chu koiham? Pakai thahat tah le thaneitah, gal hattah Pakai chu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Vo kotpiho, nanghon nalu-u domsangun, chule tonsot kotpi nangho kikhang sangun, chutile loupina leng chu hunglut ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hiche loupina leng chu koiham? Janel Pakai, ama loupina leng ahi. Selah"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, na-anga, kalhagao kadom sange.","title":"Huhdohna dingle Chonset Ngaidamna Dinga Atao"},"2":{"text":"Vo ka Pathen, nangma katahsane, nei jachatsah danlang, kamelmate neijosah hihhelin."},"3":{"text":"Henge, nangma ngahjinga um chanchu jumso hih-in, ajeh beija suhkhelna neiho vangchu jachatsah-in."},"4":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nalampi ho neimusah-in, na lamlhahho neihilin."},"5":{"text":"Nathutah-a neipuijin lang, neihilin, eihuh hinga Pathen nahi jeh-in nilhumkeijin nangma kangeh-e."},"6":{"text":"Vo Pakai, masang laija anaumjingsa nahi jeh-in, nahepi khotonale nangailut lungsetna chu geldoh in."},"7":{"text":"Kakhang donlai chonset hole suhkhelnaho geldoh hih-in, Vo Pakai naphatna jehle nahepina dungjuijin neigeldoh in."},"8":{"text":"Apha le akitah chu Pakai ahin; hijeh-a chu aman michonse te chu alampi ahilding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aman milungnengho thutan na-a kaihoi jintin, milungneng chu alampi ahilding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Athulhunale athu hettohsahna tuhdet ho dingin, Pakai lamlhah jouse chu hepinale thutah ahi."},"11":{"text":"O Pakai, namin jal-in kakhan setna nasatah hi ngaidamin."},"12":{"text":"Pakai ginga mi chu koiham? Aman akilhending lampi chu aman ahilding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahinkho-a nomtah-a chenga, achilhah ten leiset alodiu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Pakai thuguh chu ama gingho-a uma ahin, akitepna chu amaho amusah ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Aman kakengteni lenna kona asutlhah ding jeh-in, kamitnin Pakai lamjeng akat jingin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Kaheng lama hung kiheijinlang kachunga khotona neineijin, ajehchu lung thomhaole thohgima um kahitai."},"17":{"text":"Kalunga lungkhamna ho anasa behsehtai; O kahesohna ho-a konin neipuidoh tan."},"18":{"text":"Kahesoh nale kathoh nat nahi hin venlang, chule kachonsetna jouse neingaidamin."},"19":{"text":"Kamelma tehi ngaito temin, ajehchu tamtah ahiuvin, nasatah in eihouvun ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kahinna hongbit ninlang, neihuhdoh tan, nangma-a katahsan kangapjeh-in, neijachat sah hih-in."},"21":{"text":"Nangma ngah-a kahijeh-in, lungthen le dihcham kimna chun eivengtup hen."},"22":{"text":"Vo Pathen, alungkhamnao jouse-a konin Israel hi lhatdoh tan."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungdet tah-a kachon jeh-in, Vo Pakai kathu tanin, katahsan jong Pakaiya kangaijin, hijeh-a chu keima kalhuh louding ahi.","title":"Mipha Pa Taona"},"2":{"text":"Vo Pakai, neikhol chilin lang neiphochenin, kalunggel leh kalungsung patepmin."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu nangailut lungsetna kamasanga aumin, chule nathutah-a kachonlen ahi."},"4":{"text":"Moh mimaimaitoh katoukhom ngaipon, miphalhem ho henga jong lut hihhel inge."},"5":{"text":"Thilse bolho kikhopna chu kahot ahin, michonse tojong toukhom ponge."},"6":{"text":"Kakhut teni hi nolna beijin sopming ting, hitichun o Pakai, namaicham kimvela vahlenge."},"7":{"text":"Thangvahna awgina kaphondoh theina dingin, nathilbol kidang jouse hil lenge."},"8":{"text":"Pakai, naumna in leh loupitah nachenna mun chu kangailun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Kalhagao hi michonseho, ahiloule kahinkhohi thisanso ho toh umkhomsah hih-in."},"10":{"text":"Akhut houva chonphat louna aumin, akhut jetlam uva nehguh adimsetnin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla keima vang lungdih tah-in vahleng ting, neilhatdoh inlang, neihin hepitan."},"12":{"text":"Kakenghi muncham tah-a adingin, kikhopnaho-a Pakai choi-an inge."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu kameivah le eihuh hingpa ahin; koi kagin dingham? Pakai chu kahinkho-a kathahatna ahin; Koi kakichat dingham?","title":"Kipahtah-a Tahsana Phondoh"},"2":{"text":"Mikhangse, kamelmahole kagalte jengin jong, kasa hi nehgop dinga kachunga ahungchuh tengule akipalun alhuji taovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Janel hon keima dounan gebuh songjong leu, kalung kicha pontin; eidoudin gal hungkon jongle hichea jongchu tahsan um kahiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Keiman Pakai henga kadeichat thilkhat thuming ting; hichu kaholjing ding, chutileh Pakai insunga kahinkho lhungkeija kachen theija, Pakai melhoina kavetjing ding, chule a-houin sunga thu kakhol jingthei ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu kalungkham tengle apon insunga eiselintin, ahoubuh munthip sunga aman eisela, asongpi chunga eitousah ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tunvang kakimvela kamelmate chungvuma kaluhi dopsanga umding ahitan; hijeh-a chu ahoubuh-a kipa ganlhaina ho kapeh-a, la kasah ding, henge, Pakai vahchoi La tumgingto tho-a kasah ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Vo Pakai, ka aw gina kasap tengle neingaipeh-in, kachungah hepina neijinlang, neidonbut in."},"8":{"text":"Kamai holun nati laichun kalungin nahenga, Pakai namai holinge kanatin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Keija konin namai selgamla hih-in, lunghanin nasoh hi notdoh hih-in, nangma eipanpi nahin, vo eihuh hinga Pathen, neidalhah danlang, neipaidoh hih-in."},"10":{"text":"Kanule kapan eidalhah tengle Pakaiyin eikipomding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nalampi neihilin, chule kamelmaho jeh-in lamjolsela neipuijin."},"12":{"text":"Kamelmate deilamin neipedoh loujenin; ajehchu keima dounan, nunset thujeng aseijun, chule hettohsah lhemho asohdoh tan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Mihing gama chu Pakai phatna muding tahsanlou anahileng vang alhasama kahitai."},"14":{"text":"Pakai chu ngahjingin, hangtah in umin, chutile nalungthim ahatsah ding ahi; Pakai chu ngahjingin, kati ahi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai le kasongpi, nahenga hungtaovinge, keima neithipsan le, kotong sung kijotlut ho tobang kahiding ahitai.","title":"Panpina Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Nahenga kaka-a, namun theng lam nga-a kakhut kahindop teng, kathumna aw neingaipeh-in."},"3":{"text":"Migiloule khanset bolho chutoh neikaimangtha hih-in, amahon aheng akom henga chamna thu aseijiuvin, ahinla alunguva thilphalou aumjinge."},"4":{"text":"Athilbollu dungjuile athil gilou bollu dungjuijin pen, akhutnuva atoh bangun lethuh inlang, aset mannu musah-in.","ref":"2 Tim 4:14; Tph 18:6; 22:12."},"5":{"text":"Amahon Pakai natohle akhutna athilbol angaisahlou jeh un, aman amaho sumang intin, semphakit ponte."},"6":{"text":"Kathumna eingaipeh jeh-in Pakai chu vahchoijin umhen."},"7":{"text":"Pakai chu kathahatle kalumdal ahin; kalungin ama atahsanin, chule panpin kaumme; hijeh chun kalung akipah lheh-in, chule ama chu lan vahchoi tange."},"8":{"text":"Pakai chu athahatnao ahin, ama chu athaonu dinga huhhingna thahat ahi."},"9":{"text":"Namite huhhingin lang chule nagoulote phatthei boh-in; amaho chu vah inlang chule tonsotna din domsang tan."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu vahchoina peovin, vo, van mite Athahat aloupina chu vahchoijun, Pakai chu loupina leh thahatna peovin.","title":"Athenna le Athaneina Jeh-a Pathen Vahchoina","ref":"Labu 96:7-9."},"2":{"text":"Pakaiya amin loupina chu peuvin; athen hoina-in Pakai chu houvun."},"3":{"text":"Pakai aw chu twiho chunga aumin; Pathen loupinachu ahung kitumjah-in; Pakai chu twiho chunga chun aumin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pakai aw chu thaneitah ahin; Pakai awchu lal loupina-a dimset ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pakai aw chun Cedar thingho amanthah sah-in; henge, Pakaiyin Lebanon'a Cedar ho asumang gamtai."},"6":{"text":"Aman amaho bongnou bangin akichopsah-in; Lebanon le Sirion chu sakol kinei nou abahsah-e."},"7":{"text":"Pakai aw chun meika al-lenglung aphelkhen-in ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pakai aw chun gamthip gam ahotlingjin, Pakai chun Kadesh ahotlingtai."},"9":{"text":"Pakai aw chun sajuhpi bongnou asosahjin, gammangho jong achaisah in, a-houin sunga umho jousen aloupina aseijuve."},"10":{"text":"Pakai chu twisohho chunga chun atouvin; henge, Pakai chu tonsot lengdin atouvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pakaiyin amite henga thaneina pentin, Pakaiyin amite chu chamna-a phatthei abohding ahi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangin neidopsanga, kachunga kamelmate nakipasah loujeh-in, keiman nangma choi-an inge.","title":"Taona Kidonbut Nunnom Ahina"},"2":{"text":"Vo Pakai ka Pathen, nahenga kataovin, nangin neidamsah tai."},"3":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nangin kahinna lhankhuh-a konin napuitouvin, kokhuh-a kakumsuh lounadin, nangin neihinghoi tan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Vo nangho amithengte, Pakaiya tumgingto thon vahchoi La saovin lang, athenna hetdohnadin ama thangvahna peovin."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu alunghana chu chom chakhat bou ahin, alungsetna-a chun hinna aume; kana hi jankhatbou ahin, jingkah teng kipana ahunghiji tai."},"6":{"text":"Chule kaphatthei laijin, itih hijongle kiling ponge, kanatin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pakai, nei khohsahna jal-in, kamolsang nadindet sah-in, namai nanaselin, kana lungkhame."},"8":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangma kanasamin, chule Pakai henga kana thumin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Kokhuh-a kakumlhah tengle, kathisan nahi ipi phatchomna umding ham? Leivuijin navahchoija nakitahna aphondoh ding ham?"},"10":{"text":"Vo Pakai ngaijin lang, kachunga hepina neijin, Pakai nangma eipanpia chu hin."},"11":{"text":"Nangin kalung hemna lamnan naheidoh-in, kakhaodip pon nahohlhan, kipanan kong neigahpeh tan,"},"12":{"text":"Kaloupina beikahsea nangma vahchoi La tanglouva kasah ding, kathip louding ahi. O Pakai, ka Pathen, keiman atonsot atonsotnin nangma vahchoi jinge."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nanga katahsan kangamin, imatih-in nei jachatsah hih-in, na chonphatna-a chun neihuh doh-in.","title":"Pathen Tahsana Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Kahenglama nana hin sungin, gangtah-in neihuh doh-in, keidinga songpi dettahle eihuhhing dinga hoidohna in hunghin."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma kasongpile kakulpi nahin, hijeh chun naminjalin neikaijinlang neilamkai jin."},"4":{"text":"Guhthima lenthang eikampeh uva konin neiloidoh-in, ajehchu nangma kahatna nahi."},"5":{"text":"Nakhutna kalhagao kapei; Vo Pakai Pathen dihtah nangin neilhatdoh tai.","ref":"Luk 23:46."},"6":{"text":"Mohseh thil ngaisahho chu kahon; Pakai vang chu katahsane."},"7":{"text":"Nahepina-a kipah-ing ting thanominge, ajehchu nangin kalung hesohna neigelpeh in, kahinna hi vangsetna-a aume ti nahei."},"8":{"text":"Chule eidouho khutna neikha khumpon, kakenghohi mun lentah-a nakoije."},"9":{"text":"Vo Pakai, lungkhama kaum jeh-in neihepin, kamit hi lunggim na-in akhamtan, ahi, kahinna leh katumpi jong ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu hinkhohi lunggim na-in kamangin, kakum hohi khoisatna-in kamange; Kakhangitlou jallin katha abeijin, kaguho alhong lhatai."},"11":{"text":"Kamelmate lah, adeh deh-in kaheng kakomho lah-a i-sah louvin kaumin, chule kamel hetho din kichat kaumin; Eimuho chun eijamsan taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mithi bangin suhmilin kaumin, belkehsato kabangtai."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu mitam tah-in eihehsetna kanajan; Kakimvelah kichatna aumtai; keima douna-a akihoukhom laijun, kahinkho lah nadin doha abolui."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla vo Pakai nangma kanatahsane, nangma ka Pathen nahi, kanatin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Kaphat ho nakhutna um ahin, kamelmatele eibolgiloute khutna konin neihuh doh-in."},"16":{"text":"Nasoh chunga namai hinvahsah-in, nahepina jal-in neihuhhing in."},"17":{"text":"Nangma kakou jeh-in, vo Pakai neijachat sah hih-in, migilouho jachatsah-in lang, thikholkhul sunga thipbeh-in umuhen."},"18":{"text":"Jouseinale midih ho chunga, musitnale hoithona thu tamtah seina kam chu paomon umhen."},"19":{"text":"O, naphatna, nangma gingte dinga nakhol khom, mihem chate masanga nanga atahsan ngamho dinga nanabol chu iti letna hitam?"},"20":{"text":"Nangin amaho chu mihoitho ho-a konin naumna munthipma naselding; nangin kinelkalna-a konin pon-in sunga koithipbeh in nate."},"21":{"text":"Pakai chu nunnom hen, ajehchu akhotona kidangtah chun khopi dettah sunga eimusahtai."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu namitmu-a konin paidoh-in kaumtai, kana tiloijin; hijengjongle lungset kangehna aw-a nangma kakou chun neina ngaipehtan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Vo nangho amithengte jousen, Pakai chu ngailuvin, ajehchu tahsan umho chu Pakaiyin avetupmin, chule hoitho bol hochu lhingkeijin alethuhjin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hangtah-in umun, chutile nangho Pakaiya kinem jouse chu aman nalungu ahatsah ding ahi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Koihile asuhkhelna kingaidama, achonset kikhukhuma chu anunnom ahi.","title":"Ngaidam Chanjeh-a Kipana","ref":"Rom 4:7-8."},"2":{"text":"Pakaiyin achonset asimlou, chule alhagaova themona umlou mi chu anunnom ahi."},"3":{"text":"Thipbeh a kauma, nilhumkeija kasunga ka-ao na lammin kaguho manlou asohgam tai."},"4":{"text":"Sunle jannin nakhut gih-in eidelphan, kati lhop jong nipi laija gamgo asohjitai. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Nahenga kachonsetna kahetsah in, kakhan gitlouna kaselpoi. Pakai hengah suhkhelna phongtange katin, nangin kachonset khan gitlouna chu neingaidam tai. Selah."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu, Pathen ngaisah jouse chu mutheija na-umpet hin nahenga taovuhen, tahbeh-in twilentah soh hon ahengu ahinnai louding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma ka kiselna mun nahin, lungkham na-a kona neiventup ding; huhdohna la ho-a nei-um kimvel ding ahi. Selah"},"8":{"text":"Keiman nangma kahilchah ding chule nachena ding kahilding; keiman kamitna nangma kapuile ding nahi."},"9":{"text":"Hetna neilou, kamdal le thihkola kituhtangji sakol ahiloule sangan toh banghih-un, achuti loule naheng hinnai junte."},"10":{"text":"Migilou din lung gentheina adimin, ahinla Pakai tahsan vang chu hepina-in aumkimvelin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangho michonpha ho, Pakaiya kipah unlang thanomun, milungtheng nangho jouse kipah-in ao-vun."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo nangho michonpha ho Pakaiyah kipah jingun, ajehchu milungtheng dinga pachat lasah hi lomtah ahi.","title":"Pakai Vahchoina La"},"2":{"text":"Selangdah in Pakai chu vahchoijun, manchah tumging khao somnei toh thon vahchoi La saovin."},"3":{"text":"Ama vahchoina lathah khat saovinlang, aw thongin themtah-in tumging uvin."},"4":{"text":"Pakai thu chu adih-in, athilbol jouse chu dihtah-a kibol ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aman chonphatna-a thutanlhah angailun; leiset hi Pakai phatna adimin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pakai thua vanhohi kisema ahin, chule amaho janelpihi akamsoh ahua kon ngen ahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Aman twipia twiho chu lomkhat bangin akoikhomin, twi thuhtah chu khol khomna in'a akholkhome."},"8":{"text":"Leiset pumpin Pakai chu gingu hen, vannoi'a cheng jouse Pakai janan dimuhen."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu aman thu aseile akibol jengin, aman thu apehle aumden jenge."},"10":{"text":"Pakaiyin Pathen hephalouho thuhil chu imahilou asosah in, mipi ho thilngaito chu phatchomna bei ahisah-e."},"11":{"text":"Pakai thumop chu tonsotnin ading jingin, alungngaito chu akhang akhanga ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Pathen chu Pakaiya neija nam mite, chule ama agoulo dinga kilhen mihochu anun nom ahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Pakai chun van'a konin ahinven mihem chate jouse chu amui."},"14":{"text":"Aman aumna mun'a konin leisetna chengho jouse chu ahinven ahi."},"15":{"text":"Aman alungthim melputna akibahsah-in, athilbolhou jouseu agelpeh-e."},"16":{"text":"Mipi janelin ahuhhing thei leng aumpoi, mihat tah jong ahatjeh-a kihuhdoh aumpoi."},"17":{"text":"Sakolhi hoidohna dingin pannabei ahin; athahatna jeh-a jong koima ahuhdoh louding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Veovin, Pakai mit chu ama gingte chunga, chule ahepina-a kinemho chunga aumjingin;"},"19":{"text":"Thina-a kona ahinnao huhdoh dingle, kellhah teng ahinna diu akoipeh-e."},"20":{"text":"Ihin naohin Pakai chu angah-in; ama eipanpiule ilumdalu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu ama mintheng itahsan jeh uva, ama-a ilungu kipahding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Vo Pakai nanga kakinepnao dungjuijin hepina kachung uvah umhen."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Phat jousen Pakai chu vahchoi jingting: Ama vahchoina chu kakam toh kichat louding ahi.","title":"Pathen'a Atahasan Ngam Mite Kipana"},"2":{"text":"Kahinna hi Pakaiya kisong ding, mi kineosah ho chun ajah uva kipahdiu ahi."},"3":{"text":"O, Pakai chu neichoi-atpiu vinlang, amin choi-an khom uhite."},"4":{"text":"Pakai chu kaholin aman eingaipeh-in, kakichatna jouse-a konin eihuhdoh tai."},"5":{"text":"Amahon ama lam aveovin ahile avah uvin; chule amaijuva jachatna-a aumpoi."},"6":{"text":"Hiche migenthei hin akouteng, Pakaiyin angaipeh-in, alungdonna jouse-a konin ahuhhingtai."},"7":{"text":"Ama gingho chu Pakai vantil'in aumkim velin, chule amaho ahuhdoh-in ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pakai phatje chu patepmun lang veuvin, ama tahsan michu anunnom ahi.","ref":"1 Pet 2:3."},"9":{"text":"O mitheng teho Pakai chu gingun, ajehchu ama gingtedin lhahsamna himhim aumpoi."},"10":{"text":"Keipi bahkai donglaiho jong alhasamin, agilkel jiuve; ahin Pakai holte vang chu thilpha himhim lhasamloudiu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hunguvin, chateho, kathu ngaijuvin; keiman Pakai ginje hiluvinge."},"12":{"text":"Phatna amutheina dinga nikho tamtah ngailu-a, hinkho ngailu-a michu koiham?","ref":"1 Pet 3:10-12."},"13":{"text":"Thilse-a konin nalei, chule lheplhah thusei na-a konin namuh tuhtangin."},"14":{"text":"Ase dalhanlang apha bolin, chamna holinlang hichu nungdelin."},"15":{"text":"Pakai mit chu michonpha ho chunga achun, ataonao ngainan ana asunge."},"16":{"text":"Pakai maichun thilse bolho dounale, leisetna kona amaho kigeldohna suhtanga aum nadin angat jinge."},"17":{"text":"Michonpha ho taona Pakaiyin ajahpeh in, ahesohna jouseuva konin ahuhdoh ji-e."},"18":{"text":"Lungthim kisihte henga Pakai anaijin, lhagaova kisihho chu ahuhhingin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Michonpha thohgimna atamin, ahinla Pakaiyin chucheho jouse-a konchun ahuhdohji."},"20":{"text":"Aman aguho jouse aching phan, khatcha jong abongpoi.","ref":"Jhn 19:36."},"21":{"text":"Thilphalouvin migilou athading; chule midih hotbola chu mangthah heldiu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Pakaiyin asohte lhagao chu lhatdoh intin, ama tahsan ho chu mangthah loudiu ahi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, kakidoupi ho chu neiseitohpeh-in, eikisatpiho chu kisatpin.","title":"Amite Phu Lahpehpa Pakai"},"2":{"text":"Lumdal leh pho paninlang, ikithopidin dingin."},"3":{"text":"Tengcha jong satdoh inlang eidouva eisugentheiho lampi khah in, kalhagao jah-a, nahuhhingpa kahi tin seijin."},"4":{"text":"Kahinna suhmang dinga holho chu kisuh dongsah inlang jachat sah-in, suhset eigoho chu sunohphah inlang kinungle sah-in."},"5":{"text":"Amaho hui nung masanga changsi bahsah-in, chule Pakai vantil nungdel sah-in."},"6":{"text":"Alampiu thimhen lang nal hen, chule Pakai vantil'in amaho bolgimhen."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon ajeh beijin keidingin alen'u kotong sunga aselun, ajehbeija hichu hinna lahna dinga alaiju ahi."},"8":{"text":"Kigingman louvin manthah na achunga lhunghen lang, alenthang sela chun amatah ohhen, chuche manthah na-a chun lhalut hen."},"9":{"text":"Chutile kahinna Pakaiya kipah intin, ami huhhing na-a thanominte."},"10":{"text":"Ama dinga hatbeh sehpa-a kona migenthei pa huhdoh-a; henge, achomgam dingpa-a kona migenthei milhasam huhdohpa, Pakai nang tobang koi umem? tia kagu kachang houvin asei dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hettohsah lhemho akipat doh-un, kahet phahlouhel thil ho-a mo eichan uve."},"12":{"text":"Kahinna suhmang nadin apha khelin ase kipamandin eisan sah uve."},"13":{"text":"Keimavang amaho anat tenguleh kaponsil khaodip pon ahijin, an ngolin kahinna kasunemin, kataona ka angsung ngeija ahung kilahjin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Kagol ham ahiloule sopi ham bangin kanaboljin, mi anu puldouho bangin kakhai khulele jin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla kahesoh tengle akipah-un akikhom jiuvin, ahin panna beijin eidou dingin akikhomun hichu kenla kahepon, tang louvin eisam seuvin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Golvahna-a phatlhem tothon, ahao eigel khumun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Pakai itihchan navet thim ding ham? Kangailut tah kahinkhohi asumang ding keipi bahkaihoa konin huhdoh-in."},"18":{"text":"Mipi kikhopna munna chun nangma thangvahna peng kating; mi tamtah lah-a nangma vahchoi jinge."},"19":{"text":"Kamelmate chu adihlou lamin kachunga kipa daohen, ajehbeija eihotbol teho chu amitnun kihou daohen.","ref":"Labu 69:4; Jhn 15:25."},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon chamna thu him him aseipouvin; ahinla amahon gamsunga lungmonga um mongho dounan doha lungthim agongun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Henge, keima dounan amaho hatah-in akam kaovin, chule amahon aha, aha, kamitnun kamutaove, atiuve."},"22":{"text":"Vo Pakai hichehi nangin namutan, thipbeh in umhih-in, vo Pakai keija konin gamla hih-in."},"23":{"text":"Ka Pakai leh ka Pathen, kathu tan dingin nang le nang hung kitildoh-in lang, hung thoudoh-in."},"24":{"text":"Vo Pakai ka Pathen, chonphatna dungjuijin kathu tanin lang, amaho kachunga kipah hih uhen."},"25":{"text":"Alunguvin amahon, kate! eiho ichandiu ahi tidaohen, eihon ama ival lhumtaove tidaohen."},"26":{"text":"Kakisuhkhah na-a kipahho chu jahchale lungdongin umkhom sah inlang, keima douna-a kiloupisah ho chu jachatnale jalounan kivonuhen."},"27":{"text":"Ka chonphatna natoh-a lunglhaiho chu, kipahle thanomin ao-vin la saohen: asoh phattheina chunga kipahji Pakai chu, loupitah-in umhen tin seijom jing taohen."},"28":{"text":"Chutile kaleijin chonphatna nilhumkeijin seitante."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migilou suhkhelna chungchanga kalungsunga kathusei; amitmua Pathen ginna himhim aumpoi.","title":"Mihem Gitlouna Leh Pathen Chamkimna","ref":"Rom 3:18."},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu akhan gitlouna kidah umtah chu akimudoh kahsen, ama mitmun amale ama akiseiphajin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Akama thusoh ho chu khangitlouna leh lheplhahna ngen ahin; chihnale thilpha bolding chu adalhatan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aman jalkhun chunga thilse agongtoh-in, lampi phalou laitah a akitungin, thilse ahopon ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vo Pakai, na mihepina chu van ho-a aumin, chule nakitahna chun meilom lah aphan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nachon phatna chu molsang lenho abangin, nathutan lhahho chu athuhlheh-e, vo Pakai, nangman mihem le gamsa navengbit nin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangailut nahi itilutna hitam, hijeh-a chu mihem chaten na lhavingho limnoi atahsanu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Na insung aninlhin jehchun amaho lunglhai lheh-untin, nalunglhaina vachadung twi chu amaho nadonsah ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu hinna twinah nanga aumin; navah-a chu khovah kamudiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma heho henga nangailutna chu umsah jinginlang, chule milung thengho henga chonphatna chu umsah-in."},"11":{"text":"Mi kiletsah kengin ei chotkhahda henlang, migilou khutnin einodoh dahen."},"12":{"text":"Khukoma engse bolho alhulhop mun, lelhah ahiuvin, kithoujou tapouvinte."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thilse bolho jeh-in lungkham hih-in, khangitlouna bolho chunga jong thangset bolhih-in.","title":"Chonphaho Gouloding leh Gilouho Manthah na ding"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho hampa banga kivatlhu loidiu ahin, hamhing banga goploi diu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Pakai tahsanin lang, thilpha bolin, chutile nangma gamsunga nachen ding, chule tahbeh-a suhlung lhaija naum ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pakaiya jong kipah thanomin, aman nalung ngaichat jouse napeh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nalampi Pakai henga pedoh jengin; ama jong tahsanin chutile aman nabolpeh nante."},"6":{"text":"Chutile aman nachon phatna chu vah bangin vahdoh sah intin, chule nathem chana chu sunlai bang ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pakaiya cholngan, chule amachu lungneng tah-in ngah-in mi alamlhahna jouse-a akhantou jehle, thil gilou hinpodoh pa jeh-in lungkham hih in."},"8":{"text":"Lunghan na-a konin tanginlang, chule lungsatna chu dalhan; ase bolna ding poupouvah kisugim hih-in."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu thilse bolte chu kipaidoh hel ding ahiuvin; hinla Pakai ngah jingte vang chun leiset chung alodiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu chomkhat joule migilou umtalou ding, henge, lungthim themtah-in aum namun chu vele chun, ana umta ponte."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla milung nengin vang leiset chung aloding, chule amaho chamna lhingset chunga kipah ding ahiuve.","ref":"Matt 5:5."},"12":{"text":"Migilouvin midih dounan thil agongjin, chule achungah aha agoiji."},"13":{"text":"Pakaiyin ama anuisat ding ahi; ajehchu aman anikho hunglhung ding chu amun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Migilouvin chemjam asatdoh-in, vaichale lhasam suhlhahna dingle thudih-a houlimho tha nadin athalpiu ajekonin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Achemjamu amahotah lungchanga lutnintin, athalpihou kihebohpeh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Mi chonphan lhomcha aneichu migilouho haona tamtah sangin aphajoi."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu migilou banjang kihebohpeh ding; midihtah ho vang Pakaiyin ageldoh jingding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Midih nikhoho chu Pakaiyin ahen, agoulo ding chu tonsotna ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Amaho phat phatloulai jongle jahcha loudiu; Kel lhahlai jongle ninglhing diu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla migilou vang chu mangthah ding chule Pakai melmaho chu kelngoinou thao tahho bangdiu; amaho meikhu lah-a manghel diu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Migilouvin batnin alan, asakitjipoi, michonphan vang hepina amusah-in, ahomji-e."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu ama phattheiboh changhon leiset chung louvintin; chule ama gaosap changte chu suhmanga umdiu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Mipha kalsonnaho chu Pakai thusah ahin; alampia chun ama akipah lhehjin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ama lhutajongle kilehlhapai louhel ding ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin akhutnin atuhjinge."},"25":{"text":"Khangdong kanahin, tunvang katehtai: ahivangin michonpha akinungsun kamukhapon, achilhahte khutdo-a apanlam kamukhapoi."},"26":{"text":"Ama a-itih-a hepina dimle hongphalji ahin, achilhahte phatthei achangun ahi."},"27":{"text":"Setna dalhanlang chule thilpha bolin, a-imatih channin cheng jingtan."},"28":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin thutandih angailun amithengte adalha jipoi, amaho tonsotna dinga kikheh ahiuve. Ahinla migilou chilhahte vang kisumang ding ahiuve."},"29":{"text":"Michonpha hon gamsung louvintin, asunga tonsotna chengdio ahi."},"30":{"text":"Michonpha ho kamsungin chihna thu aseijin, chule aleijin thutanlhah thu aseijin ahi."},"31":{"text":"A Pathen dan chu alungsunga aumin, akalsona channa alhonal khapoi."},"32":{"text":"Migilouvin michonpha avelhijin, chule thadin aholjin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Pakaiyin amachu akhutna dalhapontin, athu kitanteng themosah ponte."},"34":{"text":"Pakai chu ngah-in lang, alampi chu juijin, chutile gamsung lodinga nachoisang ding ahi: migilouho akisuhmang teng, hichu namu ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Migilou chu thanei tah-a, bong thinghing bahjamkai banga aum kamui."},"36":{"text":"Ahinla ama akitol mangtai, veuvin, aumtapoi; henge, kahol holin, ahinla akimujou tapoi."},"37":{"text":"Michamkim chu melchih inlang, milungdih chu ven, ajehchu chuche mipa kichaina chu chamna ahi."},"38":{"text":"Ahinla suhkhelna neiho chu thakhatna kisumang diu, mikhang gilou kichaina chu, suhmanga umding ahi."},"39":{"text":"Ahivangin michonpha huhhingna chu Pakaiya ahin; lungkham laija atha hatnao ama ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin amaho apanpi-a ahuhhing ding, aman khangitlouho-a kona ahuhdoh-a, chule ama atahsan jeh uva, amaho ahuhdoh ding ahi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai nalunghanna-a neiphoh hih-in; nalungsat natah-a jong neisehgim hih-in.","title":"Gimbola Umlaija Taona"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu nathal changho kasungah alutnin, chule nakhutnin eimeh nasabehseh jengin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nalunghanna jeh-in katichung-ah damna himhim aumtapoi, kachonsetna jeh-in jong kaguho-a choldona himhim aumtapoi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu kakhan gitlounahon eichuptan; poh gihsatah khat bangin keidin agihsa behseh taovin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kangolna jeh-in katina mahaho auijin amon lhasoh tai."},"6":{"text":"Kalung akhamin, hatah-in kakunsuh in, nilhum keijin kalunghemin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu kakong dungho jouse adul soh gamin, chule kati chunga damna aumpoi."},"8":{"text":"Keima lhasamle akisugepma chu kahitan; Kalung montheilou jeh-a peng penga chu kahitai."},"9":{"text":"Pakai kangaichat jouse namasanga uma ahi, kakhoisat jong nanga kona kisellou ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kalung aphulin, katha abeitan; kamit vah jengjong, keija kon achemang tan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Eingailuho leh kagolte katina-a kon ading gamlha taovin; ka-inkote jong gamlatah-a adingun ahi."},"12":{"text":"Kahinkho suhmang dinga hol hon jong thang eikampeh uvin, chule kasetna ding hol hon jong lamvaina thujeng aseijun, nilhum keijin thilphalou jeng ageljiuve."},"13":{"text":"Ahin keimanla na-ngong bangin kajapon, akamka ngailou mipaomo kana bangtan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hiti chun kho jaloule, akama phona sohngailou bangin kana umin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ajeh chu o Pakai, nangah kakinemin, o Pakai ka Pathen, nangin jan nate."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman, nei ngaipeh-in, achuti loule kachunga kipah getnunte kati ahi, kakenga kalhonalteng keima dounan amaho kiloupisah getnunte."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu, kalung gentheinahi tanglouvin kamasanga aumin, chule alhu paiding kahitai."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu kakhan gitlouna hi phonging ting, kachonsetna jeh-a kalung khamding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ahinla kamelmate khu ahingtheijun, ahatnuvin, dihlou tah-a eihot bolte chu apunguve."},"20":{"text":"Thilse thilphato kilheh ho jong kakidoupi ahiuve; ajehchu keiman thildih chu kajuijin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Vo Pakai, neidalha hih-in, vo Pathen, keija konin gamla hih-in."},"22":{"text":"Eipanpi dingin hung kinon; Vo Pakai eihuh hingpa."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kaleija kachonset lounadin kalampiho-a kihong phange, kati; migilouho kamasanga aumlaijun kakamhi kamdalin tuhchah inge.","title":"Chihna leh Ngaidamna Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Apha-a konin jong thipbeh-in paolouvin kana umin; chule kalung gimna apong bepmin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Kasunga kalungchang asadoh-in, lung kangaito laijin, meijin akongdohtan; chuin kaleija thu kaseijin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pakai, kanikhoho teptena le kaki chaina hedin neisemin, chutile itobanga thalhom kahi hetange."},"5":{"text":"Vetan, kanikho hohi khutpeh chanbep bangin nasemin, chule kahinkhohi namasanga imacha hilou ahi; Tahbeh-in mitinhi aphat pettah laijong abona ahomkeo bou ahi. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Tahbeh-in mitinhi ahomkeova vahlea ahiuvin; tahbeh-in amaho ahomkeova lunglinglao ahiuve; aman haonaho ase khomin, chule kon ahin lokhom ding ahepon ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule Pakai tu-a hi ipi kanga em? Kakinepna nanga uma ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ka suhkhelna jouse-a konin neihuh doh-in; mingol ho noisedin neisem hih-in."},"9":{"text":"Nangma bol anahijeh-in kana paomon, kakam kanakehpoi."},"10":{"text":"Namivohna keija konin ladohtan, nakhut gua athipai ja kahitai."},"11":{"text":"Mi akhangitlou jeh-a napho-a nasuhdih teng, ahoina chu nget banga nejoudin nasemji, tahbeh-in mitinhi pannabei ahi. Selah"},"12":{"text":"Vo Pakai, kataona ngaijin, chule kakounahi neijah peh-in; kamitlhi lonhi neithipsan hih-in, ajehchu keima kapu kapateu banga nangma toh kholjinle khopembou kahi."},"13":{"text":"Kachemanga, kaumtah lou ding masanga, katha akiledoh theinadin, O neikhongai tadin."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thohhat tah-in Pakai chu kangah-in; chule aman ana eisunpeh-in, kakouna ajatai.","title":"Patepna-a Tahsana Aumdet"},"2":{"text":"Aman kokhuh gimneitah-a konle bonlhoh lah-a konin jong eiloidoh-in, chule songpi chunga kakengin eidinsah-in, kachena dingho eisuhdet peh-in ahi."},"3":{"text":"Aman i-Pathen'u pachatna dingin jong lathah khat kakamsunga eikoipeh-in; mi tampin hichu amuva akichatdiu, chule Pakai chu atahsandiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Mihoitho hole joulama kiheite ngaisahlouva, Pakaiya atahsanna kisem mi chu anunnom ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vo Pakai ka Pathen, thil kidang nanabol ho leh keiho lam nangaitona hohi atamlheh-in, hicheho chu nahenga kisimdoh joupontin; hicheho chu phondoh-a seiding tileng simjouhoi hilouding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ganlhaina leh thilpeh nangailu pon, kakolho neihonpeh tan; govam thilto leh chonset thilto jong nangailu poi.","ref":"Heb 10:5-7."},"7":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman ven kahunge kati; lekhajol bu-a chun kachung chang thu akisune,"},"8":{"text":"vo ka Pathen, nalunglhaina bolding katha anomin; henge, nadan thu chu kalung sungah aume."},"9":{"text":"Houkhom na loupitah-a chun chonphatna thu kalhangsapmin; vetemin vo Pakai, kakamhi thip ponte ti nahei."},"10":{"text":"Nachon phatna kalungsunga kaselpon; nakitahnale nami huhhingna keiman kaphonglen; nalungset ngailutna le nathudihna chu mipi kikhom tamtah lah-a chun ka-im jipoi."},"11":{"text":"Vo Pakai nami hepina lutah chu keija dingin it hih-in; nangailutna leh nathutah-in neivetup jingin."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu simjoulou setna-in eiumkimvelin; kakhan gitlouna chun eituh-in, chutichun kadahdoh theitapoi; hicheho chu kalua sam jangho sangin atamjon, hijeh chun kalungthimin eilosam sahtai."},"13":{"text":"Vo Pakai, lungset tah-in neihuhdoh in, vo Pakai, eipanpidin kikinno loijin."},"14":{"text":"Kahinna manthah sah ding go-a holho chu jahchale maimoh-in umhen, kasetna ding ngaitoho chu kinungno kitnu henlang jahchao hen."},"15":{"text":"Ajachat manuva aha, aha, eitihou kipaman chu manthah na hihen."},"16":{"text":"Nangma naholte jouse chu nanga kipah-uhen lang thanomuhen; nami huhhingna ngailuho chun tanglouvin Pakai chu choi-atnin umhen, tiuhen."},"17":{"text":"Ahinla keivang vaichale lhasam kahi, ahinla Pakaiyin keimading agelnai, nangma eipanpile eihuhdoh-a nahin, vo ka Pathen, geisang loujenin."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migenthei khotopa chu anunnom ahi; Pakaiyin boina ato phatle ahuhdoh ding ahi.","title":"Pathen Miho Gentheina Anunnom Dan (Labu 70)"},"2":{"text":"Pakaiyin ama chu ahonbitna ahinsah ding; chule leiset chunga phattheina chang ding; chule nangman ama chu melmate deilama napehdoh louding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Lungkhamna jalkhun chunga chu Pakaiyin ama ahatsah ding; nangman ajalkhun chunga nasemthah ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Keiman Pakai neihepin, nei damsah-in, ajehchu nangma dounan kachonse tai kati."},"5":{"text":"Kamelma ten keima eisamse jingun, itihle ama athin, amin amangdem? atiuvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule eivedinga ahung jongle, manlou thu jeng aseijin alungsunga khan gitlouna adimin, apotdohle teng aseithang sohjin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Eihotbol jouse chu keidounan akihou lhiuvin; keima dingin asecheh angaitouvin,"},"8":{"text":"Nat phalou tah-in ama aphah ahitai, alupna-a kon thoudoh talou ding ahi, atiuve."},"9":{"text":"Henge, kagol ngaitah, katahsan pen, ka changlhah nepa tah-in jong kachunga akengto alamtai.","ref":"Matt 26:23; Mrk 14:18; Luk 22:21; Jhn 13:18."},"10":{"text":"Ahivangin vo Pakai, amaho kalethuh theina dingin neihepin lang neiphong dingin."},"11":{"text":"Kamelma ten eijolou jeh-un, nangma kachunga nalung lhaije ti hichea konhin kahei."},"12":{"text":"Chule keima vang, kadih chamkimna-a nangin neituh jingin, namai koh-a tonsotnadin neitousah tan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Pakai Israel Pathen chu tonsotna pat tonsot geijin nunnom jinghen, Amen chule Amen.","ref":"Labu 106:48."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sitwi ngaija sakhichal haisama bangin, vo Pathen nangma ngaijin kahinna hi ahaisam-e.","title":"Genthei Petna Pathen Ngaicha-a Dangchah"},"2":{"text":"Kahinna hi Pathen, Pathen hing ngaijin adangchah-e; itih tahle kahunga Pathen anga kakilah dingham?"},"3":{"text":"Kamitlhi hi sunle janna ka-an ahin; amahon kahengah tanglouvin na Pathen hoibaham? eitiuvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hiche thilhohi kageldoh tengle kahinna kasungah kabunglha ji-e; ajehchu mipi lah-a kachen, amahotoh kipana le vahchoina aw tothon Pathen in'a kacheuvin, nitheng nitna mihonpi chuto kahiuvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vo kahinna, ipi dinga nangma kisonlha-a nahim? chule ipi dinga nangma lung olmoa nahin? Nangma Pathen'a kinemmin, ajeh chu amaiso-a kithopina jeh-a ama kavahchoi ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Vo ka Pathen, kasunga kahinna hi alengvaijin; hijeh chun Jordan gama kon, Harmon munsang ho-a kon, chuleh Mizar lhanga konin nangma geldoh inge."},"7":{"text":"Natwi lon gin'a chun twithuh le twithuh akidongton, natwi kinong le husa gin chun eichuptan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hijongle Pakaiyin alungset ngailutna chun sunle thu pentin, janle ala chun eiumpi ding, chule kahinna Pathen henga chu katao ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Keiman Pathen kasongpi henga chu ibolla neisuhmil ham? kamelmate suhgentheina jeh-a ibola lunghemma vahlea kahim? katiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kagusunga chemjam um banghelin, kamelma ten i-sah louvin eibolun; niseh in kahenga na Pathen hoiba ham? atiuvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Vo kahinna, ibolla lengvaija nahim? Chule ipidinga kasunga lung olmoa nahim? Pathen'a kinemmin, ajehchu kamel eidamsahpa le ka Pathen, ama chu vahchoi nalaiding kahi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen kathu neitan peh-inlang Pathen ngaisahlou nam mite chunga kathuhi neiseitoh peh-in, O milhem lhaho le midihlou ho-a konin neihuh doh-in.","title":"Genthei Petna Pathen Henga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma kathahatna Pathen nahin, ibolla neipaidoh hitam? Kamelmateho suhgentheina jeh-a, ibola lunghemma kavale dingham?"},"3":{"text":"O navah le nathutah chu hinsol doh-in, hicheho chun eipuile henlang, chule hichun nalhang theng le na houbuh chu eilhut hen."},"4":{"text":"Chujou tengle Pathen maicham lamma kakipana chungnung Pathen henga chun chenge, henge, selangdah-in nangma vahchoi jinge, O Pathen, ka Pathen,"},"5":{"text":"Vo kahinna, ibolla lengvaija nahim? Chule ipidinga kasunga lung olmoa nahim? Pathen'a kinemmin, ajehchu kamel eidamsahpa le ka Pathen, ama chu vahchoi nalaiding kahi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen kapu kapa teovin khangluilaija nanatoh nathilbol einahilu chu, kanakhang houvun kajauvin ahi.","title":"Tulaija Phatlouna-a Huhdohna Geldoh"},"2":{"text":"Nangin nakhutna Pathen hephalouho chu nanano manga, chule kapu kapateu chu naphudetna, chuche gam miho chu iti nasuh gentheija, napaidoh jeng hitam."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon achemjamuva gam chu alah uva alou ahipon, ahiloule aban thahatnuva kihuh hinga jong ahipouvin; hinla achunguva nakipa jeh-a nabanjet le namai vah-a konjoh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Vo Pathen nangma kalengpa nahi, Jacob huhdohna dingin thu pe-in."},"5":{"text":"Nangma jala kamelma teo kasot kundiu ahin; namin jala keiho douna-a kipatdoh ho chu kachotpha diu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu kathalpi hi katahsan pon, ahilouleh kachemjamin jong eihuhdoh ponte."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla kamelma teova konin nangin neihuhhing jouvin, chule eihot bolteu chu najumso jotan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nilhum keijin Pathen jenga kisongung kating, chule namin chu tonsotnin vahchoi uvinge. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Ahinla nangin neipaidoh-un, neijumso taovin; chule kagalsat mite toh nakondoh khom tapoi."},"10":{"text":"Melma-a konin nangin neikinung lesah-un, chule eihotbol teo chun amahodin
