thil akichomuvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangin Pathen hephalouho lah-a neithe cheh-un, nehdinga kigong kelngoi bangin neipedoh taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Namitehi imalouvin najohdoh-in, aman nu jong haonan nanei chom dehpoi."},"13":{"text":"Nangin kaheng kakomhou noise din neisemun, kakim vel uva miho musit le nuisat nin neiumsah taove."},"14":{"text":"Nangin Pathen hephalouho lah-a seichah dingle, miho lah-a lu thinkhum din neisem taovin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Lunggimna tanglouvin kamasanga aumjingin, chule kamai jong jachatnan akhu tan ahin,"},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu melmale phulapa i-sah louna le taitomna aw-so jeh chu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hichengse chu kachunguva alhungin, ahinla nangma kasumilkha pouvin, chule nathu lhuna jong kapalkeh khapouvin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Kalungthimu akile hei pon, kakalseu jonghi nalampi-a konin apetmang khapoi."},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin nangin dragonho mun'a neisuchip deh-un, thina le-lim chun neikhu uvin ahi"},"20":{"text":"Ka Pathen'u min chu kasuhmil uva, gamchom pathen henga kakhut kajahdoh uva ahile;"},"21":{"text":"Pathen'in hiche chu aholdoh louding ham? ajehchu aman lungsung thuguhho chu ahen ahi."},"22":{"text":"Henge, keiho nangma jeh-in nilhum keijin eikithat jingui, thadinga kigo kelngoi bangin eikisim taove.","ref":"Rom 8:36."},"23":{"text":"Vo Pakai khangin, ibola imua nahim? kithouvin tonsotnadin neipaidoh loujenun."},"24":{"text":"Ipijeh-a namai naselmanga, chule eikibol gimnaole eiki suhgenthei naohi nasuhmil hitam?"},"25":{"text":"Ajehchu kahinnao hi leivui lah-a akunin, ka-oiju hi leisetna abehtan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Eipanpi diuvin kipatdoh-in, chule nahepina jal-in neilhat doh-un."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kalungthim sunghi thuphan akisun dimtan, lengpa chung changa thil kanabol chu kaseijin, kaleihi gotsa thusunpa lekhamol ahi.","title":"Lengpa le Amounu Loupina"},"2":{"text":"Mihem chate sangin nahoijon, lungsetnahi nakama akisunglutne; hijeh-a chu Pathen'in tonsotna phatthei naboh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Vo hat chungnung, nachemjam chu nataija kigah inlang, nalalna le ja naum na-a chun kivonin."},"4":{"text":"Chule thutah le nunnem na chule chonphatna jal-in, nalalna-a chun khangtou tah-in touvin; chule nakhut jetnin thil gimneitahho nahilding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Lengpa melmate lung sunga nathalmuh chu ahemin, hichea chun mite nanoija alhu jiuvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Vo Pathen nalaltouna chu atonsot atonsotna ahin; nalenggam tenggol chu leng tenggol dihtah ahi.","ref":"Heb 1:8-9."},"7":{"text":"Nangman chonphatna nangailun, chule gitlouna nahot bolin; hijeh chun Pathen, na Pathen chun, nagol ho chung vuma kipana thao nanutan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Navonho jouse chu saiha-a kisa leng inpiho sunga konin myrrh le aloe chule cassia anam hiuheu vin hicheho chun nakipa sah-in ahi."},"9":{"text":"Lengho chanute chu numei ja-umtah ho lah-a aumun, najet lama lengnu chu Ophir sana-a kijemin adingin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Vo chanu, ngaiphan lang geltoh-in, chule nana sungin, namite le napa insung jong chu sumilin;"},"11":{"text":"Chutile lengpan nahoina nasatah chu adeichat ding ahi; ajehchu ama na Pakai pa ahin, chule nangman ama chu houvin."},"12":{"text":"Chule Tyre chanu chu thilpeh khat choija hungding, miho lah-a mihaoho jengin jong nalungsetna angeh diu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Lengpa chanu chu loupina adimin; aponsil chu sana-a kijempah ahi."},"14":{"text":"Amanu chu lengpa henga pon kikhui pahsel kivona apuidiu; aloi anungjui nungah thengho chu nahenga ahinpuidiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Kipahtahle thanom tah-in amaho hin kipuijintin, amaho leng inpi sunga lutdiu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Leiset pumpi-a leng chapa-a nasem diuchu, napateu khela nachateo hiding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Akhang akhanga geldoh jing dingin namin seming ting, hijeh-a chu mihem ten atonsot, atonsotna navahchoi diu ahi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen chu ikiselnao le itha hatnao ahin, lungkham pettah a eipanpiu ahi.","title":"Amite Hoidohna le Namtin Chunga Galjou Pathen"},"2":{"text":"Leiset hi kichon mang henlang, chule twikhanglen lailung-ah molsang hohi kipolut hen;"},"3":{"text":"chu-a twiho chu ginglul lulin kinong henlang, chule molsangho kihotlingsoh jongle keiho kicha pouvinge. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Vadung khat aumin, chu-a luidungho chun Pathen khopi akipasah ding, Hatchung nungpen houbuh umna muntheng chu akipasah ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Alailunga chun Pathen aumin, ama longlou helding; jingpi tah-a Pathen'in akithopi ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pathen hephalouho alunghangun, lenggam ho akilongsoh-in; Aman a-aw aginsah le leiset ajunlha tai."},"7":{"text":"Janel ho Pakai chun eiumpiuvin, Jacob Pathen chu ikiselnao ahi. Selah"},"8":{"text":"Leiset hi itobanga agohkeo asosah hitam, hungun lang Pakai thilbolhohi vetemun."},"9":{"text":"Aman kolmong geija gal kisat asutangin, thalpi ahehbongin, tengcha asubongin, sakol kangtalai meijin ahalvamtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Thipkhen chan umunlang Pathen kahi heuvin, Pathen helou namtin vaipi lah-a choi-at na kauma, leisetna choisanga kaum ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Janelho Pakai chun eiumpiuvin, Jacob Pathen chu ikiselnao ahi. Selah"}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo nangho mipite jousen nakhut bengun, Pathen henga galjona aw thongin samun.","title":"Leiset Lengvaipi Pathen Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu hat chungnung Pakai chu gimneitah ahin, leiset pumpi chunga leng loupitah ahi."},"3":{"text":"Aman mitin chu inoijuva asuh nemding, namtin chu ikengto noijuva akoiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aman angailut Jacob loupina chu igoulo diuva alhending ahi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Pathen chu aw ging pumin, Pakai chu sumkon gin pumin akitol toutai."},"6":{"text":"Pathen vahchoi La tumgingto thon saovin, vahchoi La saovin ilengpao vahchoi La saovin, vahchoi La saovin."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen chu leiset pumpi leng ahin, hetnatoh thon tumgingin vahchoi La saovin."},"8":{"text":"Pathen chu namtin chunga aleng changin, Pathen chu alaltouna theng chunga atouvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mipi lah-a pipuho akikhom khomun, Abraham Pathen mite lah-a pipuho geijin akikhom khomun ahi. Ajehchu leisetna lumdal jouse Pathen'a ahin, ama chu nasatah-a choisanga uma ahi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Alen na chu Pakai bou ahin, chule athenna molsang, i-Pathen'u khopi-a chu loupi tah-a vahchoi ding ahi.","title":"Zion'a Pathen Loupina"},"2":{"text":"Amun dinga hoitah, leiset pumpi kipana chu sahlam sanga Zion molsang, leng loupitah khopi chu ahi.","ref":"Matt 5:35."},"3":{"text":"Aleng inpiho sunga chun, Pathen chu kiselna-in akihei."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu veuvin, lengho chu akikhomun achemang gamtaove."},"5":{"text":"Amahon hichu amuvin, chutichun adatmouvin; amaho alung khamun ache mangloi taove."},"6":{"text":"Chuachun kichatle natna-in, numei anaoso natnin amat bangin amanchah taove."},"7":{"text":"Nangman solama huijin, Tarshish kong inneiho chu nasumang gamtan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Keihon kanajah bangun, janelho Pakai khopi sung, Pathen khopi sunga chun kamu taovin; Pathen'in atonsotna dinga atundoh ding ahi. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Vo Pathen nahouin sung lailunga chun, nalungset ngailutna thu kana ngaitouvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Vo Pathen, namin dungjuija napachat na chu kolmong geija umding ahin, nakhut jetlam chu chonphatna-a dimset ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nathu tanlhah naho jal-in Zion lhang chu kipah henlang, Juda chanute chu thanomu hen."},"12":{"text":"Zion chu velkolun lang, akimvela kijotnun, chua insangho chu hilun."},"13":{"text":"Ahung umkitding khangho henga nahil theina diuvin, nanghon akulpiho chu melchih-un lang, aleng inpiho chu ngaito temun."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche Pathen hi tonsot atonsotna i-Pathen'u ahin; thi geija jong eipuihoi pau hiding ahi."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nanghon mipite jousen hichehi ngaijunlang, vannoi'a cheng nangho jousen nanau hin sungun.","title":"Mingol ho Kitahsan na"},"2":{"text":"Misangle minem, ahaole avai, kigomin hichehi ngaijuvin."},"3":{"text":"Kakamin chihna thu seijintin, chule kalung ngaito chu hetkhen themna thu hiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Thulem thuah kana sungin ting, kathugil sei chu selangdah-in hilchen inge."},"5":{"text":"Nikho phatlou lai, kakhotal ho-a khanset na-in eiumchah teng ibola kakichat ding ham?"},"6":{"text":"Anei agouvu tahsan ho, chule ahaona houva kisongho chu;"},"7":{"text":"koimachan iti nama jongle asopi alhat thei louheldiu, Pathen henga ama lhatdohna dingjong apehthei louheldiu ahi."},"8":{"text":"(Ajehchu alhagaovu lhatdohna ding chu manlutah ahin, hichu a-imatih chana dinga kikhah ahitai)."},"9":{"text":"Ama chu a-imatih chana hingjinga, chule thina jong atepkhah louding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu aman michingho jong athiu amun, hitobangma chun angola milungselho jong amangthah-in, anei agouho midangho adalhahpeh jiuve, ti amutan ahi."},"11":{"text":"A-in hou chu a-imatih chana umjing ding bangle achennao munho chu akhang houva umjing ding bangin, asunglamuva agelun, chule agamu chu amaho mincheh asah jiuvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hijeng jongle mihem hi jatah-in aumjing jipon, ama chu amangthah ji gamsa tobang ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hiche alampiuhi angolnao ahin; hinla, asonhouvin amaho thusei chu aphochenun ahi. Selah"},"14":{"text":"Kelngoi bangin lhankhuh-a alumin, thinan amaho chu avahding, chule jingkah lamle michondih hon achunguva vai ahomdiu; chule achen naova kona ahoinau chu lhankhuh-a mangthah ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla Pathen'in kahinna hi lhankhuh thanei na-a kona alhatdoh ding ahi: ajehchu aman einasan ding ahi. Selah"},"16":{"text":"Mi khattou ahung haova, a-insung loupina chu ahungkhan cheh cheh tengle nangman kicha hih-in;"},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu chu ama athi tengle imacha apohtheilou ding ahin, aloupina chun ajui louding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Adamlaijin ahinna ho chu amale ama phatthei kiboh jongle, nangman nangmatah dinga thilpha nakibol tengle min navahchoi diu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ama apateu chilhah ho henga chentin, a-itih-a khovah amulouding ahitai."},"20":{"text":"Mihem choi-at changa, ahia hetkhen themna neilou chu amangthahji gamsaho bangbep ahi."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hat chungnung Pakai Pathen chun thu aseitan, leiset hi niso-a pat nilhum geijin akouvin ahi.","title":"Pathen Chonphatna Thutan"},"2":{"text":"Zion'a konin Pathen hoi chamkimna chu avahdohtai."},"3":{"text":"I Pathen'u chu hungintin thipbeh-in umponte; Amasanglam chu meijin halvam intin, chule akimvel chu huile go kitho hiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aman amite thu atan theina dinga, vanho chule leiset pumpihi chungsanga kona akoukhom ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ganlhaina-a keima toh kitepna nei kami thengte chu kahenga hinkhomin."},"6":{"text":"Chule vanho hin achonphatna chu aphon doh ding ahi; ajehchu Pathen amatah chu thutan ahi. Selah"},"7":{"text":"Vo kamiteho ngaijun, keiman thu seijinge: vo Israel, chule nangma nahin hilchen inge, Keima Pathen, na Pathen'u chu kahi."},"8":{"text":"Kamasanga tanglouva umjing nagan lhainaho le nagovam thilpehho jeh-in nangma naphohsal ponge."},"9":{"text":"Na-in'a konin bongchal chule nahonga konin kelchal himhim ladoh ponge."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu gamlah-a gamsa jouse chule lhangho jouse chunga gancha jouse keija ahi."},"11":{"text":"Molsang ho-a chungleng vacha jouse kahesoh keijin, loulaija gamsaho jousehi keija ahi."},"12":{"text":"Kagil akela ahijongle nahenga seiponge; ajehchu vannoi leiset leh asunga thil um jouse keija ahi."},"13":{"text":"Bongchal ho sa kaneh-a ahiloule kelchaho thisan kadon ding ham?"},"14":{"text":"Pathen hengah thangvahna peuvin, chungnung pen hengah nakitepnao lhutjouvin."},"15":{"text":"Chule lungkham nile neikouvun, keiman huhdoh ingting chule nangin neichoi-at ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla Pathen'in migilou hengah, kadan kisunho naphon doh-a ipi-a napan sah-a, ahiloule ija pang dinga kathulhun nakama nakoiding ham? ati."},"17":{"text":"Kihilna nahotna kathuho nanung lama napaiji kamun ahi."},"18":{"text":"Gucha namule ama chu najopmin, chule mijonghotoh chan nanei khomjin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Nakam chu setna-a napedoh-in, nalei chu lhep lhahnan nasemtoh-e."},"20":{"text":"Natoumun in nasopi douna thu naseijin, nanu chapatah chu naseisejin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hichehohi nabolin, keima kathipbeh-in, nangin nang tobangin neingaiton ahi. Ahinla keiman kaphosala hihochu namitmu tah-a katahlang ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tun nangho Pathen sumiltehon, hichehi ngaito phaovin, achutiloule ahal halla kabotel uva, nahuhdoh diu umlou ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Vahchoina thilto banga toh chanchun keima eichoi-at ahin; chule ahoulimna kisemtohpa henga chu Pathen mi huhhingna kavetsah ding ahi."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai na ngailut phatna dungjuijin neihepin lang, nami hepi haotah dungjuijin kasuh khelnaho noimangin.","title":"Lungheina Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Kakhan gitlouna-a konin neisil ngim selinlang, kachonsetna-a konin neisuthengin."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu kasuh khelnaho kakihet nin; chule kachonsetna chu kamasanga aumjingin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nangman thu naseiteng them nachan theina dingle, thu natan teng akichet theina dingin, nangmatah dounan kachonsen, hiche thilse hi namitmun kana boltan ahi.","ref":"Rom 3:4."},"5":{"text":"Vetan, gitlouna-a anakijila kahin, chule kanun chonset na-a einavop ahi."},"6":{"text":"Vetan, nangin asung gil lama thutah chu nangailun; chule lunggil lama chu nangin chihna thu neihetsah ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hyssop'in neisuthengin chutile ngimtange; neisilin chutile buhbang sanga kaban joh ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nasuh bohsa guho akipana diuvin, kipana le thanopna chu neijah sah-in."},"9":{"text":"Kachonsetna ho-a konin namai selin, chule ka gitlouna jousehi noimangin."},"10":{"text":"Vo Pathen, keima-a lungtheng khumin lang, kasunghi lhagao dihtah-in semthah-in."},"11":{"text":"Naum na-a konin neipaidoh danlang, keija konin nalhagao theng ladoh hih-in."},"12":{"text":"Nami huhhingna kipana chu neipekit ninlang, chule nalhagao hongphal tah-a chun nei tuhdet jingin."},"13":{"text":"Chutengle suhkhel neiho chu nalampi hil ingting, chule michonse hon alungu nangma heng lamma ahin aheidiu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nang eihuh hingpa Pathen, thisanso mona-a konin neihuh doh-in chutile kalei hin nachon phatna aw thongin lan sante."},"15":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangin kakamhi kat sah in, chutile kakamin navahchoina aphonjal ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu nangin ganlhaina nangaichapoi; chutilou hile kapeh ding nahin, nangma govam thilpeh-a jong nalunglhai pon ahi."},"17":{"text":"Pathen'in adei ganlhaina chu lhagaova kisuhchip hi ahin; Vo Pathen, lungsung pohkeh le kisih ho chu nangin nahsah louva nakoi louding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Zion dinga apha nadeilamtah chu bolin, Jerusalem kulbang chu saphan."},"19":{"text":"Chutengle chonphatna ganlhaina, govam thilpeh chule govam thilto pumpi-a chun lunglhai tan natin; chutengle namaicham chunga chun abongchal hou chu hintoh taovinte."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo mithahatpa, nangmale nangma ibola thilphalou va naki thang-at ham? Pathen phatna chu tanglouva umjing ahi.","title":"Migilou Manthah na le Pathen Mite Lungmon na"},"2":{"text":"Nalei hin samchem hemtah bangin jonchihna na atongin, chule lamvaina chu agongin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nangin thilpha sangin thilse nangailun, chule chonphatna seisangin jouthu nangailu jon ahi. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Vo lheplhahna lei, nangman bahgam thu jouse nangailun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chutobanga chu Pathen'in a-itih-a dinga nagamsah-a nalahmang ding, chule na chenna mun'a kona nabodoh-a, mihing gama kona nakaldoh ding ahi. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Michonphan jong amua, chule akichatna, anuisat ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Veovin, Pathen chu ahatna-a semloupa, ahi-a ninglhing setna ahaonaho tahsan na, gitlouna-a kisuhat mipa chu amahi ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla keimavang Pathen insunga olive thinghing tobang chu kahin, keiman Pathen hepina chu a-imatih channa din katahsanin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hichu nabol jeh-in a-imatih chanin nangma vahchoi jing ting, chule namin chu ngahjing tange; ajeh chu namithengte mitmu-a hichu phatah ahi."}}},"53":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mingolin alung sungah Pathen aumpoi atijin ahi. Amaho akisuboh-un, chule thet umtah khan gitlouna aboluvin, koimacha thilpha bola aumpouvin ahi.","title":"Pathen Helou Mite Ngolna le Israel Kithahsemkit (Labu 14)","ref":"Rom 3:10-12."},"2":{"text":"Ahethem le Pathen hola umkhat touvem tin, Pathen'in van'a konin mihem chate ahinvesuh-in ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amaho abonun akinung heijin, abon chaovin abohgam taove; thilpha bola khatcha aumpoi, khatcha jong aumpoi."},"4":{"text":"Khan gitlouna natongho chun hetna himhim anei lou uham? amahon changlhah aneh bangun kamite abahgam taovin; Pathen la akou him him pouve."},"5":{"text":"Kichat umlouna-a chun amaho akicha lheh-un ahi; ajehchu Pathen'in nangma douna-a gebuh sunga umpa guho chu athechehtan; Pathen'in amaho i-asahlou jeh-in, nangman amaho najachat sahtai."},"6":{"text":"Pathen'in amite asohchan naova kon ahin lepui teng, Israelte huhhingna chu Zion'a kon hitavele, Jacob thanomin tin, Israel kipah ding ahi."}}},"54":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen, naminin neihuh hingin, chule natha hatnin kathu neitan peh-in.","title":"Melma te-a kon Huhdohna Dinga Taona Kidonbut"},"2":{"text":"Vo Pathen, kataona ngaijin lang, kakama thupot ho-a hin nana neisun peh-in."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu gamchom miho keima doudingin akigotaovin, chule misugenthei hon kahin nahi aholun; Pathen chu amasanguvah akoipouve."},"4":{"text":"Vetan, Pathen chu eipanpia ahin; Pakai chun kahinna eituh peh ho aumpin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aman kamelmate chu setna-a alelutding ahin; nangman amaho chu nathutah-a chun sumangin."},"6":{"text":"Nahenga manbeijin ganlhaina neijinge, O Pakai, hichehi thilpha ahijeh-in, namin vahchoi jinge."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu aman lungkhamna jouse-a konin eihuh dohtan; chule kamelmate chunga kamitnin angaichat chu amutai."}}},"55":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen, kataona-a nana hinsungin; chule kathumna-a konin nangma kiselmang hih-in.","title":"Loi le Gol Lungthim Phatlou Laile Pathen'a Kingai"},"2":{"text":"Kakoma uminlang, chule kataona nei ngaipeh-in, kagenthei na-a kalunghemin, hichun eisunoh phah-in,"},"3":{"text":"Melma aw jehle migiloupa suhgentheina jeh-in na satah-in kamaovin ahi. Ajehchu khan gitlouna kachunga eisekhumun, chule lunghang tah-in eihot boluvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kalungthim sunggil lamhi analheh jengin; chule thina kichat umtah chu kachunga achutai."},"5":{"text":"Kichatna le kithinna kachunga ahung lhungin, chule kichatna melse tah-in eichuptai."},"6":{"text":"Chule keiman kaseije, O keima vakhu banga lhaving nei hitaveleng! lengmang ingting gakicholdo tange."},"7":{"text":"Veovin, gamla tah-a vah lengting, gamthipma kaumding ahi. Selah"},"8":{"text":"Huipi hattah le khopihuija kona hoidohna dingin kikin nonge."},"9":{"text":"Vo Pakai aleiju sukhen inlang, sumangin, ajehchu khopi sunga khun hunam le kinahna kamun ahi."},"10":{"text":"Sunle jan-in chua kulbang chunga chun amaho avahle leuvin, asunga chun lungkhamna le thilphalou jeng aumin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Alah uva chun khan gitlouna aumin; lheplhahna le doha bolnan akhosung lamlen adalha khapoi."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu eiseisea chu melma ahipoi; hijo ngaple kathoh joujoh ding ahi. Keima douna-a ama kiloupi sahpa jong chu eihotbol ahipoi; hijo ngaple ama-a kona kiselding kahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahinla kakibahpi mi, eipuija, chule kamelhet mi, nangma nahi,"},"14":{"text":"kithu hilna ngeitah ingaikhom jin, chule Pathen houin'a ichekhomji-e."},"15":{"text":"Thinan achungu lhunkhum hen, chule thikhol khulah kumsuh loijuhen, ajehchu gitlouna chu achennao le alah uvah aume."},"16":{"text":"Keivangin Pathen kou vingting, Pakaiyin eihuhhing ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Jingkah le nilhah, chule sunnin taovingting, hatah in saminge; Chule aman ka aw ajahding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Eidounao galmuna konin aman kahinna mongtah-in eihuhdoh-in ahi; ajehchu eidouho chu tamtah ahiuvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Pathen, khanglui laija umjingpa tahchun, ngaijintin, abol hesohdiu ahi. Selah Ajehchu amahon kikhelna aneilou jeh-un Pathen agingpouve."},"20":{"text":"Amatoh kichamna neiho dounan akhut alhangin, akitepna chu asukehtan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Akama thuho chu bongnoiha sangin analjon, alungsungla kidouna bou ahin; athuho chu thao sangin ajoljon, ahinla chemjam kisatdoh ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Napohgih Pakai chunga seplhan, aman napanpi ding ahi; Aman michonpha chu suhling dingin itih hijongle phal ponte.","ref":"1 Pet 5:7."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla vo Pathen, nangin amaho chu manthah na kokhuh sunga napuisuh ding; thisanso mile milhem lhaho chu anikhou kehkhat jong hing joulou dingu ahi; Hijongle keiman nangma katahsan ding ahi."}}},"56":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen, neihepin, ajehchu min vallhum din eigon, aman niseh-in eikisatpin eisugenthei jinge.","title":"Gimbolho-a Kona Lha Ongna Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Kamelma ten niseh in vallhum dingin eigouve; ajehchu eidouho chu tamtah ahiuve, vo chungnung pen."},"3":{"text":"Kakichat tengle nangma tahsan inge."},"4":{"text":"Pathen chu athu-in vahchoi jinge, mihemin i-eilo theiding ham? Pathen'a katahsan kangamtan kicha ponge"},"5":{"text":"Niseh in kathuho alakoijun, alunggel jouseu keima douna le setna ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amaho akikhom khommun, kahinna ladinga eichan tengule, akiselun, kakholhah amelchih jiuvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Khan gitlouna-a kona ongthol diu hinam? Vo Pathen, nalunghanna miho chu seplhatan."},"8":{"text":"Nangin kavalenaho namelchih-in, kamitlhiho nahai sungah nakhumin, hiho chu nalekhabu-a umcheh louham?"},"9":{"text":"Nahenga kaka phatle, kamelmate chu anungchon jiuve; hiche hi kahei, Pathen chu keija ahi."},"10":{"text":"Pathen chu athu-in vahchoi jinge; Pakai chu athu -in vahchoi jinge."},"11":{"text":"Keima kicha taponge mihemin i-eilo thei dingham? Pathen'a katahsan kangam tai."},"12":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nakihahselnaho kachungah aumin; keiman, nangma vahchoinaho peng kate."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu kahinna hi thina-a konin nahuhdoh tan; Pathen masanga hinna vah-a kavale theina dinga, kakenga kalhuh louna dinga nangin neihuhdoh lou ding ham?"}}},"57":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Neihepin, vo Pathen, neihepin, ajehchu kahinna-in natahsanin ahi. Hiche vangsetna ho kichai kahse-a, nalhalima kahoidoh na kasemding ahi.","title":"Melma te-a kona Hoidohna Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Pathen thil jouse eibol pehpa, chungnung pen Pathen henga chun taovinge."},"3":{"text":"Vallhum dinga eigopa i-sah louva konchun, aman van'a konin hinsol intin eihuhhing ding ahi. Selah Pathen'in amihepinale athutah chu ahinsoldoh ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kahinnahi keipi bahkaiho lah-a aumin, chule mei kihal khumho lahle, ahahou tengcha le thallung bang, aleiju chemjam hemtah tobang mihem chapate lah jenga jong chun kalumjin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nangma vanho chungvuma kichoisangin, naloupina chu leiset pumpi chungvuma umhen."},"6":{"text":"Amahon kakholhah na din lenthang aphaovin, kahinna hi alhadah-in; kamasanga kokhuh alaijun, chuche-a chun amaho alhalutnuve. Selah"},"7":{"text":"Kalungthim dettah ahi, vo Pathen, kalungthim dettah ahi, la sang ting chule vahchoina penge."},"8":{"text":"Thoudoh-in, kaloupina, tumging le selangdah kithou vin, keima tah jong matah-in thouvinge."},"9":{"text":"Vo Pakai, mipi ho lah-a nangma vahchoi jing ting; namtin lah-a nangma henga la sange."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu nahepina chun vanho apha-in; chule nathudih chu meilhang ho aphan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nangma vanho chungvum geijin kichoisangin, naloupi chu leiset pumpi chungvum ma umhen."}}},"58":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo mipi ho, nanghon tahbeh-a chonphat thu naseiju hinam? Vo nangho mihem chapaten, lungtheng sela thu natanu hinam?","title":"Migilouho Chunga Thutan Dihtah"},"2":{"text":"Henge, nalunguvin gitlou nabolun, leisetna hin nakhut-un hunam napan jiuvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Migilou chu naobu-a kona khensa ahin, apen penule jouthu seijin avahmangpai jitaovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Agu-u chu gulgu tobang ahin, amaho gulsum na-ngong kolseh tobang ahiuvin;"},"5":{"text":"cheho chun guldoi themhon itobang themin lhim jongleu jou pouvinte."},"6":{"text":"Vo Pathen, akamuva aha-u chu subongin lang, vo Pakai, keipi bahkai donglaiho hapiho chu subongsoh-in."},"7":{"text":"Tanglouva longjing twi bangin amaho junmang sah-in, athalchang kapdoh dinga athalpi ajetkon teng, ahal ahala kisat bahsah jengin."},"8":{"text":"Twilung ajunmang bangin amaho abonchauvin mangthah uhen, aphatlouva nupi naonei, nimel mutheilou bang hiuhen."},"9":{"text":"Nabel houvin lingsut ahet masang uva, aman alunghana-a ahing le ago abona chimpeija alhohmang ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Michonpha chun phulahna amutenguleh kipah intin, migilou thisana chu akeng akisil ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chutia chu mihemin michonpha din tohphat man aum mong monge atidiu ahin; tahbeh-a leiset chunga thutan Pathen chu ama ahi."}}},"59":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo ka Pathen, kagalte-a konin neihuh doh-in, eidouva dinga kipatdoh ho-a konin neihuh doh-in.","title":"Migiloute Thu Kitanding"},"2":{"text":"Khan gitlou bolho-a konin neihuhdoh in, chule thisanso mi-a konin neihuh hingin."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu vetan, amaho kahinna ngah-in aumjingun; Vo Pakai kasuhkhel jehle kachonset jeh jong hilouvin, mihat ho chu keima dounan akikhomun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kasetna beijin akigouvin alhaijun ahi. Ven kithoudoh inlang eipanpin."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun vo janel Pakai, Israel Pathen, Pathen hephalouho vildin thouvin, mikitahlou suhkhel neihohi khatcha jong hepihih helin. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Nilhahle ahung kileuvin uicha bangin apeng setsot jiuvin, chule khopi chu avelvel jiuve."},"7":{"text":"Veovin amahon akamuvin aphong doh-un; amuh uva chemjamho aumin; hitichun, koiham ajah-a? atiuve."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla vo Pakai nangin amaho chu nuisatjon natin, Pathen hephalouho chu nuijat nan neijinate."},"9":{"text":"Atha hatna jeh-in nangma ngah inge; ajehchu Pathen kakihonbitna ahi."},"10":{"text":"Eihepi Pathen chun eihoidoh intin, Pathen'in kamelmate chunga kangaichat eimusah inte."},"11":{"text":"Amaho chu that hih in, ajole kamiten sumil getnunte, vo Pakai kalum dalu, nathaneina in thecheh inlang loi nemin."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu akamuva asetnao le amuh uva thuho jeh, chule athuseiju gaosapna le jouthu jeh-in, akiletsah naova matnin umuhen;"},"13":{"text":"Amaho chu lung hana-a sumangin, aumlouna diuvin amaho chu sumangin, chule leiset kichaini geija Pathen'in Jacob'a vai ahomchu amahon heuhen. Selah"},"14":{"text":"Chule nilhahle hungkile sah inlang; uichaho bangin peng setsot nuhen lang, chule khopi chu velleu hen."},"15":{"text":"Amaho chu nehding holin sahle lhanga vaveisah-in, chule achim louvule phunphun taohen."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla keiman nathahatna chu lan sangting, henge, jingkahle nahepina la gingtah in sange; ajehchu nangma lungkham ni-a kahoina le kakiselna nahi."},"17":{"text":"Vo kathahatna, naheng-ah la sange; ajeh chu Pathen hi kahoina le eihepia Pathen chu ahi."}}},"60":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen nangin neipaidoh-un nei thecheh taovin, nalung phamotai; O nangma keiho lammah hung kile kitan.","title":"Pathen'in Atundoh Kitna Dinga Kinotah-a Taona"},"2":{"text":"Nangin leiset nahot lingin, nasukehjin; akhikeh jouse thoi bitnin, ajehchu akilingin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Namite hi thil hahsatah namusahtan; lungdonna lengpitwi neidonsah taovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Thutah jeh-a tah langa aumtheina diuvin, nangma gingho chu ponlap khat napetan ahi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Nalungset ho nahuhdoh theinadin nakhut jetnin huhhingin lang, chule neingaipeh in."},"6":{"text":"Pathen'in athenna-in thu aseijin, keima kipah ingting, Shechem chu kahop khenna chule Succoth phaicham chu kahopdoh ding ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Gilead le Manasseh hi keija ahin, Ephraim jonghi kalu thahatna ahin, Judah chu ka danthu pepa ahi."},"8":{"text":"Moab hi kakisilna bel ahin, Edom chunga chu ka kengkoh kaledoh ding; Philistia, keima jal-in jona changin."},"9":{"text":"Edom'a chu kon eilamkaija, khopi dettah-a chu kon eipuilut ding ham?"},"10":{"text":"Vo Pathen, eina paidoh uva chu nang nahilou ham? chule kagalsat houtoh kondohji Pathen chu nang nahilou ham?"},"11":{"text":"Lungkham na-a konin neipanpin, ajehchu mihem panpinahi ahomkeo ahi."},"12":{"text":"Pathen jala hangsan tah-a iboldiu ahi; ajehchu kamelma teo chotpha dinga chu ama ahi."}}},"61":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen, ka kana ngaijin lang, kataona neingaipeh-in.","title":"Tonsotna Hoidohna Pathen"},"2":{"text":"Kalungthim alhahdah tengle, leiset kolmonga patnin hinkou vingting, kei sanga sangjo songpi-a chun neipuijin."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma bou kahoidoh na nahin, melma te-a kona insang det tah chu nahi."},"4":{"text":"A-imatih chana keima nahoubuh sunga kaum jing ding; nalhaving noi kiselna chu tahsan inge."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu vo Pathen, nangin kakitepna neijah pehtan; namin gingho gamlo ding chu neipetai."},"6":{"text":"Nangin lengpa hinkho nasaosah ding; chule akumho chu khang tamtah tobang hiding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ama Pathen anga tonsotna umjing ding; ama vettup ahithei nadin hepina le thutah chu gongtoh-in."},"8":{"text":"Chutichun kitepnaho niseh-a kabol theina din, a-imatih chanin namin vahchoi La sajing tange."}}},"62":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tahbeh-in kahinna hin Pathen angah-in, huhhing-a kaum nahi ama-a kona hung ahi.","title":"Pathen Mihoidohna Tahsan"},"2":{"text":"Amabou kasongpile eihuh hingpa ahin, ama kahoidohna ahin, keima kiling louhel ding kahi."},"3":{"text":"Itihchan mi khat douna-a thilphalou nangaito diuham? Nabon chaova kithatgam ding nahiuvin; bang on tobang le pal chim kon tobangbou nahidiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ama athupina-a kona sotlhah dingbou akihouvun, jouseihi athanopnao lamtah ahin; akamun phatthei aboh-un asung gilun vang agaosapmun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kalhagao, na Pathen bou ngah-in, ajehchu kagin chatna chu ama-a konbou ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amabou kasongpi le eihuh hingpa ahi; ama kahoidohna ahin, keima longlou ding kahi."},"7":{"text":"Pathen'a kahuh hingna le kaloupina aumin, kahatna songpi, chule kahoina chu Pathen'a uma ahi."},"8":{"text":"Phat tinin ama tahsanun lang nanghon nalung thimmu a-angah sunglhaovin, Pathen chu eiho dinga hoidoh na ahi. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Tahbeh-in minoi nungte hi pannabei ahin, milenho jonghi jou thubuh ahibouve; khaikotna khaidin abonchauvin ahomkeo sangin ajang jouve."},"10":{"text":"Suhgentheina tahsan hih-un, chule mohseh-a mi chom jong bolhih-un, haona apunleh, hiche chunga chun nalung koihih-un."},"11":{"text":"Pathen'in khatvei aseitan, hiche hi nivei kana jatai; thahatna hi Pathen'a ahi."},"12":{"text":"O Pakai hepina jonghi nangma-a ahije; ajehchu nangman mitin anatoh dungjui cheh-in lethuhna napejin ahi.","ref":"Job 34:11; Jer 17:10; Matt 16:27; Rom 6:2; Tph 2:23."}}},"63":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nangma ka Pathen nahin, jingpi matah-in nangma holinge; Twi beina gamgo dangchah na gama hin, kalhagao nang ngaijin adang chah-in, katahsan jong nangma nangaichan ahi.","title":"Pathen to Kiloikhom Kipana"},"2":{"text":"Nathuneinale naloupi munadin, munthenga chun nangma kana velen ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu nalungset ngailutna hi hinkho sanga aphat joh jeh-in, kakamin nangma navahchoi ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hitichun kahinlai chansen nangma vahchoi jingting; namina kakhut kadop sang ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kahinna hi lhin le thaova lunglhai ding, chule kakam hin kipah-in nangma navahchoi tante."},"6":{"text":"Kajalkhun chunga nangma kageldoh teng, jankho lhonin nangma kangaito jin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma eipanpi jia nahin, hijeh-a chu nalha limnoija keima kipah kahi."},"8":{"text":"Kahinna hin nanung naichan ajuijin; nakhut jetlamin neituh jinge."},"9":{"text":"Kahinna sumang dinga holho vang chu, leiset noinung geija kumlha diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Amaho chemjam'a loudingu ahiuvin; amaho sial ho chanvou dingbou hidiu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla lengpa chu Pathen'a kipah ding, ama-a kihahsel takip chu loupi ding ahiuvin; ahinla jou thusei ho kam vang kisimbing ding ahi."}}},"64":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen, kataona-a ka aw ngaijin, melmate ginna-a konin kahinkho hi neiventup peh-in.","title":"Hoidoh-a umna Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Mikhangse kithuhilna-a konle, khan gitlou natongho thilgona konin jong neiselin."},"3":{"text":"Amahon aleiju chemjam bangin anol hemun, chule thu khatah ho kap nadin athalpihou ajekon uvin,"},"4":{"text":"Nolnabei mi chu guhthima akaptheina diuvin; amahon photlot louvin, kichalou helin ama chu akapmun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Thilse lama amahole amaho akitil khouvun; guhthima thang kam nadin akihou jiuvin, kon amuding ham? atiuve."},"6":{"text":"Amahon khan gitlounaho chu aholun, gunchu tah-a athil holu chu amolsouve. Amaho sunggil lam ngaitona le lungthimho chu thuhtah ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla Pathen'in amaho thalla akapding, photlot louva machangdiu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hitichun aleigui jeh uvin amaho mangthah-un tin, amaho mutapou chu jammang jengdiu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule mijouse kichaovintin,Pathen natoh chu aphondoh diu ahi; ajehchu ama thilbol chu lungching tah-a angaitodiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Michonpha hochu Pakaiyah kipah untin, chule ama atahsan diu; milung dih ho jouse chu loupidiu ahi."}}},"65":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"O Pathen, Sion'ah pachatnan na-ngah jingin, chule kitepna chu nahenga kimolso ding ahi.","title":"Ami Huhhingna le Athilpeh Jeh-a Pathen Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"O nangma taona sang nahin, tahsa phe jouse nahenga hungdiu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Khan gitlouvin eijou jing jengin; ka suhkhelnaho vang nangman nasop ngim ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Na-in hong sunga achentheina dinga, naheng nailut dinga nalhentum mi chu anunnome. Na insung phatna na houin theng ngeija chu kalungnao chimding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vo eihuh hingpao Pathen, chonphat na-a gimneitah thil kibol ho-a nei donbut nin natin; nangma kolkimvela jouse le, twipi chunga gamlatah-a miho tahsan chu nahin;"},"6":{"text":"Thanei na-a kong akigah-a, athahat na-a molsang ho tungdoh pa;"},"7":{"text":"Twipiho husan le twikinong husan, chule mipi tamtah husa gin suthip pa nahi."},"8":{"text":"Kolmonga chenghon jong namelchihna ho chu akichauvin; nangman jingkahle nilhah jong thanom tah-a potdoh din nasemin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nangin leiset hi navilin, chule twi nachap kot jin; naning lhinset sah-in, Pathen vadung chu twi dimset ahin, nangin chutabang chu napeh phat chun, chang ahung umdoh-in ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nangin damkom ho chu twi nanen sah-in, langkon mahaho naum sah-in, hichu gohongin nachapnemin, chua kehdohho chu phatthei naboh-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangin kum chu naphatna-in nakhu-in, chule na lampiho chun sathao navat khumin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Amaho chu gamthipma hampaho chunga avalhan, lhang neoho chu amun cheh-a akipah un ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hamhina mun jouse-a chun gancha hon adimin; phaicham ho jong changin akhusoh-in, thanomin a-aovun, lajong asauve."}}},"66":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangho gamjousen, Pathen na kipa aw thon sah-un.","title":"Anatoh Kidangho Jeh-a Pathen Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Amin jana la saovin, ama vahchoi chu loupi sah-un."},"3":{"text":"Pathen henga, nathilbol chu iti gimnei hitam! nathilbol theina loupi jala, namelmate nahenga kipelut ding ahiuve, tin seijuvin."},"4":{"text":"Leiset pumpin nangma nahouvun tin, chule nahenga la asah uva, namin vahchoi La asahdiu ahi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Pathen thilbol hohi hungvetemun, mihem chate chunga athilbol hohi tijat umtah ahi."},"6":{"text":"Aman twipi tolgo asosah in, twisoh chu kengin apal galkaijun, hia chun ama-ah kakipah uvin ahi.","ref":"Pot 14:21; Josh 3:14-17."},"7":{"text":"Aman athaneina-in tonsotnin vai ahomin, amitnin namtin chu amui; dou bolho chu kichoisang daohen. Selah"},"8":{"text":"Vo nangho mipin, i-Pathen'u chu vahchoijun, chule apachatna awgin chu kijahdoh sah-un."},"9":{"text":"Aman mihing lah-a ihinnao hi eituhdet peh-un, chule ikengu achaloh ding jong aphalpoi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen, nangin neipatep un, dangka bangin nei suthengun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangin len sunga chun neipui lutnun, kakong uvah suhgentheina nangame."},"12":{"text":"Nangin kalu chunguva mi natousah-in, keihon meilah le twilah kapal galkaijun; ahinla nangin munphatah khatna neipuilut taove."},"13":{"text":"Keima govam thilpeh choija na in'a kalut ding ahin; kakitepna ho chu nangma kapeh ding,"},"14":{"text":"hichu kahesoh laitah-a kamuh-in aseidoh-a, ka kamin anaphondoh ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Sathao tah-a govam ganlhaina le kelngoichalho gimnamtui chu nahenga toh ingting, bongchalho le kelcha hotoh tothange. Selah"},"16":{"text":"Nangho Pathen gingho jouse, hung unlang ngaijuvin, chule kahinna dinga ipi eibol peh-em phongdoh inge."},"17":{"text":"Kakamin ama kakouvin, kaleijin ama achoi anjin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Keiman kalungthima gitlouna kangaitole, Pakaiyin eingaipeh ponte."},"19":{"text":"Ahinla tahbeh-in Pathen'in eingaipeh in, aman kataona aw eingaipeh tan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kataona le amihepina keija kona heimanglouva Pathen chu nunnom hen."}}},"67":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen'in eihepiu hen, phatthei eiboh uhen, chule amaivah chu ichunguva salvah hen. Selah","title":"Taona le Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Hichu leiset chunga nalampi akihetna ding, chule nahuhhingna damna chu namtin lah-a akihet nading ahi."},"3":{"text":"Vo Pathen, mitinin navahchoi hen, mijousen nangma navahchoiju hen."},"4":{"text":"O namtin kipah henlang kipanan la saohen, ajehchu nangin chonphatna-a miho thu natana, chule leisetna cheng namtin chunga vai napoh ding ahi. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Vo Pathen mitinin navahchoi hen, mijousen nangma navahchoiju hen."},"6":{"text":"Chutengle leisetnin aga tampi sodoh intin, Pathen, ka Pathen'u chun, phatthei eiboh taovinte."},"7":{"text":"Pathen'in phatthei eiboh-untin, chule kolkim vella mijousen ama ging taovinte."}}},"68":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen chu kipat henlang amelmate kithecheh uhen, ama hote jong chu amasanga jamuhen.","title":"Israelte Chunga Aphatna Jeh-a Pathen Loupina"},"2":{"text":"Meikhu alencheh bangin, amaho lenmang sah-in, mei koma khoilu jollha bangin, Pathen anga migilouho chu mangthah uhen."},"3":{"text":"Ahinla michonpha ho kipah-u henlang, Pathen anga thanomuhen; henge, nasatah-in thanom uhen."},"4":{"text":"Pathen henga la saovinlang, tumgingto thon amin vahchoi La saovin; vanho chunga touva amina JAH kitipa chu choisangun lang a-anga kipah un."},"5":{"text":"Achenna munthenga um Pathen chu, pabeite pale meithaiho thutan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pathen'in michangkhat chu inko lah-a akoijin, akihenho alhadoh-in; golkehho vang chu gamgoa achensah-in ahi."},"7":{"text":"Vo Pathen, namite nahin lamkaija, gamthip nahinjot laichun, Selah"},"8":{"text":"Leiset akihotnin, vanho jong Pathen angah achimlhan, Israel Pathen anga chun Sinai jengjong chu akihot tan ahi.","ref":"Pot 19:18."},"9":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nangin go nengtah-in najuhsah-in, hichea chun nagoulote ahatmo laitah-un nasudet tan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma mipi ho chu chua chun anachengun, vo Pathen nangin naphatna chu mivaichate dingin nagon peh-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pakaiyin thu apen; chuche thu phongjal ho chu hon lentah ahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Lengte galmiho chu gangtah-in ajamtaovin; chule in'a um numei ho chu galla kichom dohho akihom taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Belho lah-a lumji jongle chun, vakhu lha dangka-a kitom tobang le amul ho sana enga kitom tobang nahi nahlai dingu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hatchung nungin chua lengho athehcheh laichun, Salmon'a buhbang bangin abangin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Pathen lhang chu Bashan lhang tobang ahin, lhang sangtah chu Bashan lhang tobang ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nangho lhang sangho, ibolla kichom nahiuvem? Hichehi Pathen'in achenna dinga adei lhang chu ahi; henge, Pakai chu chukoma atonsotna chengding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Pathen kangtalai chu sangsomni, vantil asang asangho ahin, Pakai chu muntheng Sinai'a tobang chun alah uva aume."},"18":{"text":"Nangma chungsanga nakaltouvin, gal hing chu gal hingin nakaijin, nangin miho din thilpeh nasangin, henge, doubolho-a dingin jong nasangin; hitia chu Pakai Pathen chu alah uva achentheina ding ahi.","ref":"Eph 4:8."},"19":{"text":"Niseh-a iphat chomna diu eipeuva Pakai, eihuh hingpao Pathen chu nunnom hen. Selah"},"20":{"text":"I-Pathen'u chu huhhing-a Pathen ahin, thina-a kona hoidohna chu Pakai Pathen chun anei ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ahinla Pathen'in amelmate luchang le, suhkhel na-a chejing pa samphatna lulei chu amavoding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Pakaiyin, Bashan gama konin hinpuikit ningting, kamite chu twikhanglen thuhtah-a konin pui kitninge, ati."},"23":{"text":"Hitia chu nakengu namelmate thisanna nadelut uva, chule na uichateu lei jongchu chutima hiding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Vo Pathen, amahon nache chu amuvin, ka Pathen le kalengpa, munthenga nachelaitah chu amuvin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Lasaho amasauvin, tumging tumhon anungu ajuijun, alah uva chun nungah khongcha bengho aumuvin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Mipi kikhom lah-a Pathen vahchoijun, tonsot Pakai chu Israel twinah-a konchun vahchoijun."},"27":{"text":"Chua chun Benjamin phungneo leh, avaipoteu; Judah pipuiho le avaipoteu, Zebulun pipuiho chule Naptali pipuiho chu aumuvin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Na Pathen'in nathahat chu thu apen; Vo Pathen, kadiuva neithil bolpeh-u chu hatsah-in."},"29":{"text":"Jerusalem'a na houin jala lenghon nahenga kipaman ahinchoi diu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Mijouse dangka nongho to ahung kipehlut masang seuvin; tengcha choi mihon ho, mipi ho bongnou jaonan bongchal tamtah ho, chu phohsalin lang, galbol ding dei miho chu thecheh-in."},"31":{"text":"Egypt'a konin pipuho hungdoh untin, Ethiopia'in Pathen lamah akhut jahdoh vah tante."},"32":{"text":"Leiset lenggam hon Pathen vahchoi La saovin, Pakai vahchoina la saovin. Selah"},"33":{"text":"Golluilai vanho le, vanho chunga toupa henga chun; veuvin, aman a-aw, thaneitah aw ahin lhadoh-in ahi."},"34":{"text":"Pathen henga nahatnao chu peuvin, athupina chu Israelte chungah aumin, chule ahatna chu meilom ho lah-a aumme."},"35":{"text":"Vo Pathen, namun thengho-a kona nangma tijat umtah nahi. Ama Israelte Pathen ngeitah chu amite thahatna le thilboltheina peji-a ahi. Pathen chu nunnom hen."}}},"69":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen, neihuhhing in, ajehchu twi hohin kahinna gei ahin phatan ahi.","title":"Thohgim Laija Pathen Henga Panpina Ngeh"},"2":{"text":"Dinna ding umlou bonlhoh thuhtah-a chun kalhalut tan; twisoh in eichupmin, twi thuh lama chun kahunglut tan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Kaka kanan katha acholin, kadang agotan; Ka Pathen kanga jing lai hin kamit alosam tan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajeh beija eihotbol te chu kalua kasamho sangin atamjouvin; dihlou tah-a suhmang dinga eigo kamelmate chu hattah ahiuvin; hiti chun kalah khah louhel chu kalepeh jin ahi.","ref":"Labu 35:19; Jhn 15:25."},"5":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nangin kangolna nahen, chule kachonsetna ho nanga konin akiselpon ahi."},"6":{"text":"Vo tonsot Pakai, janel Pathen, nangma ngahte chu keima jeh in jachat sah hih-in, vo Israel Pathen, nangma holte chu keima jal-in maimoh daohen."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma jal-in keima i-sah louvin ka umin, jachatnan kamai akhutan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Kasopite lah-a maljin kasohtan, chule kanu chate lah-a gamchom mi kahitan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu na in dinga katom pana-in einechai jin, chule nahouse hon na housetnao chu keima chungah achutan ahi.","ref":"Jhn 2:17; Rom 15:3."},"10":{"text":"Keima kaka ka-a chule an ngola kahinna kasuhgim tengle, hichu eiki houset nabep ahijin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Khaodip pon jong kavonin kasemtan, amahodin thuchihbep kahijitai."},"12":{"text":"Kotpi phunga touho chun keima douna thu aseijun, chule jukhamho la bou kanahi jin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahinla vo Pakai, keima vang lah phatchan nahenga kataojin, vo Pathen nahepina tamtah, nahuh hingna thutah jal chun nei ngaipeh-in."},"14":{"text":"Bonlhoh-a konin neiloidoh inlang, neilhah lhumsah hih-in, eihot bolte leh twi thuhtah-a konin neihuh doh-in."},"15":{"text":"Twisoh chu neichupsah danlang, twithuh chu neival lhumsah hih-in, chule kotongin jong akam eichikhum hih hen."},"16":{"text":"Vo Pakai nalungset ngailutna hi aphatjeh-in, neingaipeh in, nahepi khotona chamkim dungjuijin kaheng lama hung kiheijin."},"17":{"text":"Nasoh-a konin namai sel hih-in, ajeh chu lungkhamin kaume; gangtah-in neingai peh-in."},"18":{"text":"Kahinna hin naijin chule lhatdoh-in, kamelmate jeh-in neilhat doh-in."},"19":{"text":"Nangin eikisei setnale kajachatna chule eikija louna hohi nahen; kakidoupi jouse abonun namasanga aumuve."},"20":{"text":"Houset nahin kalungthim asukeh-in, chule lungkham na-a kadimset nin; ei khoto ding kaholin, khatchala kamupon, chule lhamon naho kaholin khatcha jong kamujoupon ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ka-an dingin gilkha eipeuvin, chule kadang chah-a kadondin lengpitwi thuh eipeuve.","ref":"Matt 27:48; Mrk 15:36; Luk 23:36; Jhn 19:28-29."},"22":{"text":"Adokhangu chu amasanguva thang hihen, chule aphat theinadiu tahho jong chu, thang kisoh hen.","ref":"Rom 11:9-10."},"23":{"text":"Amulouna diuvin amitnu thimhen lang, chule akongu chu tanglouvin kithin sah-in."},"24":{"text":"Nalungsat na chu achunguva bunglhan, chule nalunghan lungsatna chun amaho manchah hen,"},"25":{"text":"achennao chu kamhel henlang, aponbuh uva koimacha cheng hihhen.","ref":"Sol 1:20."},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu nangin navoh chu abol gentheijun, chule namavona-a lungkhamho chu houlim nan anei jiuvin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Akhan gitlounao chu khan gitlouna-in belapmin, chule amaho chu nachon phatna sunga hunglut hih-u hen."},"28":{"text":"Amaho chu hinna lekhabua konin noimangin, chule chonpha hotoh sunhal hih-in.","ref":"Pot 32:32; Tph 3:5; 13:8; 17:8."},"29":{"text":"Ahinla keima genthei tahle lunggimtah kahin, o Pathen nami huhhingna chun mun sang-ah eikoihen."},"30":{"text":"Pathen min chu la khatnin vahchoi jingting, chule thangvah tothon choi-an inge."},"31":{"text":"Hiche hin ki le tin nei bong ahiloule bongchal sanga Pakai chu alung lhaisah joh ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Mi nunnemin hichu muntin chule kipahding; chule nangho Pathen hol ho, nalungthimu hingding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pakaiyin migenthei te angaipeh-in, chule asoh changho nahsah louvin abolpoi."},"34":{"text":"Van le leiset, twipiho chule asunga achatle thei jousen, ama chu vahchoi cheh hen."},"35":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen'in Zion ahuhhing ding, chule amaho chua achenuva, gouloa anei na dinguva, Judah khopiho asahdoh ding ahi."},"36":{"text":"Asohte sonho jong chun hichu ahinlodiu; Amin ngailuho chu asunga chu chengdio ahi."}}},"70":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen eihuhdoh dingin kino-inlang, vo Pakai eipanpi dingin kikinno loijengin.","title":"Melma ho-a Kona Onthol Nadinga Taona (Labu 40:13-17)"},"2":{"text":"Kahinna suhgep dinga holho chu, jahchao henlang maimoh uhen; kakisuhkhah ding deiho chu, kinungle sah inlang kisudongu hen."},"3":{"text":"Aha, aha, tiho chu ajachatnau lethuh na-in nunglama kilesahtan."},"4":{"text":"Nangma holjouse chu nangma-a kipahle thanom muhen, na huhhingna ngailuho jouse chun tanglouvin, Pathen chu choi-at nin umhen tiuhen."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla keivang vaichale lhasama kahi, vo Pathen, kahenga hungloijin, nangma eipanpi-ale eihuh hingpa nahi; vo Pakai, geisang loujenin."}}},"71":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangma ah katahsan kangame, a-imatih chanin nei lungdonsah hih helin.","title":"Huhhingna Songpi Pathen"},"2":{"text":"Na chonphat na-in neihuhdoh inlang, neihoidoh sah-in, kaheng lama nana hin sung inlang, neihuh doh-in."},"3":{"text":"Nangma kachenna dettah, kapansat jom jingna nahin, keima huhhing dingin nangman thupeh napei; ajehchu nangma kasongpile kakulpi chu nahi."},"4":{"text":"Vo ka Pathen, migilouho, chonpha louho, chule mi-engse ho khutna konin neihuh doh-in."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu vo Pakai Pathen, nangma kakinepna nahin; kakhangdon laijapat nangma katahsanpa chu nahi."},"6":{"text":"Nang jala naobu-a kona eina kituh-a ahin, kanu oisunga kona eiladoh-a jong nangma nahin; kavah choina tanglouva nanga hijing ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Mi tamtah-in kidang eisah-u ahin, ahinla nangma kakiselna dettah nahi."},"8":{"text":"Nilhum keijin kakamhi nangma vahchoina le jabolna-in dimset jing hen."},"9":{"text":"Kateh nungle neipaidoh hih-in, kathabei phatle neidalha lou jenin."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu kamelma ten keidouna thu aseijun, chule kahinna changlhiho akihou somun,"},"11":{"text":"Pathen'in ama adalhatan, manin lang bolgen theijun, ajehchu ahuhdoh ding koima aumtapoi, atiuve."},"12":{"text":"Vo Pathen, keija konin gamla hih-in, vo ka Pathen, eipanpi din hung loijin."},"13":{"text":"Kahinna douho chu kisuh dongsah-in lang sumangin, kakisuh khah nading hol ho chu seisetle maimohna-in khukhum uhen."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla keima vang kakinep jing ding, chule nangma kaha vahchoi cheh cheh ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Kakamin nilhum keijin nachon phatna le nami huhhingna phongdoh inge; ajehchu keiman ijat tah mong ahi kahepoi."},"16":{"text":"Keima Pakai Pathen thahatna songin cheng ting, nangma chonphatna, nangma-a sehbou phapoh inge."},"17":{"text":"O Pathen, kakhangdon laija patnin nangin neina hilin, tugeijin nathilbol kidangho chu kaphong doh-in ahi,"},"18":{"text":"kahatna hi hiche khang mite hengle, nathaneina hi ahung lhung dingho jouse henga kahetsah masangsen; vo Pakai tu kateh-a kalu akan phat jonghin, nangin neidalha hih-in."},"19":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nang thil loupitah bolpa chu, nachon phatna jong asanglheh jenge, vo Pathen nang tobang koi umintem!"},"20":{"text":"Nangma Lungkhamna lentahle nasatah eina musah pan, neisuh hal kit ding ahin, leiset thuhtah-a kona neipuitou kitding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Nangin kaletna punsah-in natin, lamjousea eilhamon nin nate."},"22":{"text":"Tumging tothon navahchoi jinge, Vo ka Pathen, na thutah ngeichu vahchoi jinge; vo nang Israelte mithengpen, selangdah in nangma vahchoi jinge."},"23":{"text":"Nangma henga la kasah tengle, kamuhhi hapan kipah intin, chule nalhatdohsa kahinna hi hapan kipah inte."},"24":{"text":"Kalei jonghin nachon phatna nilhum keijin seijinte; ajehchu kasetna ding holho chu jachatna ah achutaovin ahi."}}},"72":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nathutanna chu lengpa penlang, nachon phatna chu lengpa chapa petan.","title":"Messiah Vaihom Loupina"},"2":{"text":"Aman namite chu chonphatna-a thu atanna, chule nami vaichaho chunga thudih-a thu atanding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Molsang hon namite henga chamna hinpou vintin, chule lhang neohon chonphatna ahinpoh dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aman milah-a vaichaho chu athu-u atanna, milhasam ho chate chu ahuhdoh ding, chule misugenthei te chu ngemsela asuhchip ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amahon nile lha aumlaise-a akhang akhanga nagindiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ama gohongin lei achapnou banga, hampa chunga goju banga hung ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ama nikholaile chonphatna chu pungin tin, chule lha aumlaisea chamna bulhing setna umding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Aman twikhanglen'a pat twikhanglen gei, chule vadunga pat leiset kolmong geija lengvai apohding ahi.","ref":"Zech 9:10."},"9":{"text":"Gamthipma chengho chu a-anga bohkhup muntin, chule amelma teovin leivui ale diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tarshish lenghole twikol gamhon thilpeh ahinchoidiu, chule Seba lengho le Seba'n thilpeh apehdiu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Henge, lengjouse a-anga bohkhupdiu, nam jousen ama ajendiu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu aman angaichaho, mivaicha le panpiding neilou mi chu atao tengleh ahuhdoh ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aman mivaichale lhasamho ahoidoh ding, alhasamho hinna chu ahuhhing ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Aman amaho hinkho chu lheplhahna le hunam na-a kona alhatdoh ding, chule athisannu chu amitmua manlutah hiding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule ama hingintin, ahenga Sheba sana chu kipe ding; amadinga taona tanglouva uma, niseh-a ama kivahchoi ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Leiset molsang ho chungvuma chun chang ga tamtah umintin, Lebanon banga aga chu kiling ding, khopi sunga miho chu leisetna hampa banga pungdiu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Amin chu tonsotna umding ahin; amin chu nisa umlaisea umjing ding ahi: chule ama-a mitin phattheina changding; Namtinin nunnom ati dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Pakai Pathen, Israelte Pathen chu nunnom hen, ama bou thilkidang bolpa chu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule amin loupi chu tonsotnin nunnom hen; leiset pumpihi aloupina in lodimhen, Amen chule Amen."},"20":{"text":"Jesse chapa David taonaho akichai tai."}}},"73":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Dihtah-in Pathen hi Israelte dingin aphan, milung thengtah hodingin jong aphan ahi.","title":"BU THUMNA (Labu 73—89) Migilouho Lhuhna Dingle Pathen'a Kingaiho Nunnomna"},"2":{"text":"Ahinla keimadingin vang, kakengho amui lhagam kon ahitan, kakalsonho kalhonal ding koncha ahitai."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu migilouho phattheina kamuteng, mingol ho kathangse jin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu athi tengu jongle thohnatna himhim aneipouvin, ahin athahatnao adetjon ahi."},"5":{"text":"Midang bangin hahsatna imacha anei pouvin, midang bangin thohgimna jong aneipouvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun kiletsahnan thihkhao bangin a-um kimvelu vin, hunam chun ponsil bangin atomuvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Athao jeh un amitnu alotdoh-in, lungin angaitophah kalval aneijun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Amahon nehguh abolun, giloutah-in suhgentheina thu aseijun, hoithotah in apaovui."},"9":{"text":"Van douna in akamkaovin, aleijun leiset pumpi achonsoh uvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun amite hilanga ahung akileuvin, chule twi khon dimset adon kangun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule amahon, Pathen'in iti ahetna, chule chungnung pena chu hetna umam? atiuve."},"12":{"text":"Veovin, hiche hohi Pathen ngaisah louho ahiuve, amaho vannoi'a alolhingun, ahao cheh cheh uvin ahi,"},"13":{"text":"Tahbeh-in keiman kalunghi mohseh-in kasuthengin, kakhut hohi mona beijin kasile."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu nilhum keijin kathohgimin, chule jingsehle eikisehgimjin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Keiman, chutobang chun seijinge, tijongleng, vetan, nachate khanggui kipalsah kahiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Keiman hichu hetdinga kangaito tengle, keidin anabehseh-in;"},"17":{"text":"Pathen munthenga kagalutna, akichainao kaga hetthem masangsen, kachutin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Atahbeh-in nangin amaho mun nal ho-a nakoijin, manthah na-a napailhan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chomkah louva iti amaho mahthah hel jenga hitaovem! amaho tijat umtah-in akisumang heltaovin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Mangnei khat ahung khah doh banga; vo Pakai nakhahdoh tengle, chutobang chun alimu chu geldao tannate."},"21":{"text":"Hitichun kalungthim ahesoh-in, chule kalunggil asunalheh-in ahi."},"22":{"text":"Keima mingol tah le kho hephalou kahin; namasanga gamsa tobangbou kahi."},"23":{"text":"Hijeng jongle nang toh kaum khom jingin, kakhut jet lamin neituh jingnai."},"24":{"text":"Nathumop machun neipuijin natin, chujoule loupi na-ah neisangin nate."},"25":{"text":"Van'a nang tailou koi dang kaneijem? Chule leisetna jong nang tailou kangaichat dang aumpoi."},"26":{"text":"Katahsa le kalungthim alosamtan; ahinla Pathen chu kalungthim thahatna le, tonsotna kachan ding chu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu vetan, nanga kona gamla ho mangthah diu ahin; nangma najon san jouse chu nasumang tan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Keidin vang Pathen naihi apha ahin; nathilbol jouse kaphondoh theinadin, Pakai Pathen'a katahsana kangam tan ahi."}}},"74":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen ibola tonsotna dia neipaidoh hitam? Ibola nahamhinga kivah kelngoite douna-a nalung hanna khudoh-a hitam?","title":"Migimbol ho-a Kona Ontholna Dinga taona"},"2":{"text":"Masanglaija nachoh dohsa namipi kikhomho, nalhatdohsa nagou nam mite le asunga nachenna hiche Zion molsang hi hingel doh-in"},"3":{"text":"Kumkho-a manthah helna lama chun nakal hinsongin; melmaten engse tah-in munthenga na atongun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Namelmate chu namite kikhom ho lah-a chun akitumun, aponlap hou chu melchihnadin atungdoh taove."},"5":{"text":"Thing lentah ho chunga aheichaho lamma mikhat tobang ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla tun athil suiho chu thakhat tah-in, heichale sehtumin asuchim taovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Namun theng jong meijin ahaluvin, namin chena ho tollah aseplhaovin, asuboh soh hel taove."},"8":{"text":"Amahon alungthimun aseijun, eihon amaho abonchan sumangu hite; gamsunga Pathen hou khomna in jouse meijin ahalvam taove."},"9":{"text":"Keihon kamelchihna hou kamu tapouvin, themgao himhim aumtapon; itihchan hiding ham he-a kalah uva khatcha jong aumtapon ahi."},"10":{"text":"Vo Pathen, itihchan melman eihouset dingu ham? Namin chu tonsotna melmaten ataitom ding hitam?"},"11":{"text":"Ipidinga nakhut natuhtanga, nakhut jetlam ngeichu ibola natuh tang ham? na-opma konin lhangdoh inlang amaho khu sumangin."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen chu tonna patna kalengpa ahin, leiset lailunga huhhingna na tongji chu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nangin nahatna-in twikhanglen chu nalheh khennin, nangin twilah-a Dragonho lu nasukeh-in ahi.","ref":"Pot 4:21."},"14":{"text":"Nangin Leviathan luchang ahal halin navochip in, amachu gamthipma cheng miho anchah din napen ahi.","ref":"Job 41:1; Labu 104:26; Isai 24:1."},"15":{"text":"Nangin twinah le twisoh nahom khenin, vadunglen ho jongchu nasukangin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Sunhi nanga ahin, jan jong nanga ahi; Nangin vah le nisa nanasemin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nangin leiset gamgiho jouse nakoijin, nipi le phalbi nasemme."},"18":{"text":"Vo Pakai, melmate i-sah louna le, mingolin namin ataitom naohi geldoh jingin."},"19":{"text":"Oh, navapal hinna chu migilou mipi henga pedoh hih-in, a-imatih-in namigenthei kikhom hohi sumil hih-in."},"20":{"text":"Kitepna neija peh-in, ajehchu leiset munthim laihohi engsetna adimin ahi."},"21":{"text":"O, akibolgimho chu jachatnan kilesah hih-in, vaicha le lhasamhon namin vahchoi hen."},"22":{"text":"Vo Pathen, thouvin lang nathuhi seitoh-in, mingolin niseh-a iti nahouset nem geldoh jingin."},"23":{"text":"Namelmate awgin chu sumil hih-in, nangma douna mipite husa chu tanglou helin akhang jingin ahi."}}},"75":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangma kathangvah uve, Vo Pathen, nangma kathangvah uve, nathil kidang bolhon namin anaihi aphong doh-e.","title":"Pathen Chonphatna Thutan Jala Thangvahna"},"2":{"text":"Phat kijenpet kalhendoh teng, dihtah-a thu katan ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Leisetle asunga cheng jouse ajunmang tan, keiman akhom chu dettah-in katungdoh tai. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Mingol ho henga chun ngolhoi tah-in umhih-un katin, migilou hengah naki domsang hih-in kati."},"5":{"text":"Naki chu domsang hih-in, ngei pukonin thu seihih-in."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu choisangna chu solama kon, lhumlama kon, ahiloule lhanglama kona jong hung hilou ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla Pathen chu thutan ahin; aman khat asotlhah-a chomkhat adopsangji ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai khutna chun khon khat aumin, chule ju chu asan ahin; hichu akihalchop dimset ahin, hiche mama chu ahinsunglhan; ahinla leisetna migilouho jousen aning geija adon kanghel diu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahinla kenvang a-imatih chanin phongdoh ingting, Jacob Pathen vahchoi La chu sange."},"10":{"text":"Migilouho jouse ki kasuhlhuh ding, michonpha ho ki vang kichoisang ding ahi."}}},"76":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah te lah a-Pathen chu hetnin aumin, Israelte lah-a amin chu aloupin ahi.","title":"Thutan na-a Pathen Choisang Ahina"},"2":{"text":"Salem'a jong ahou buh aumin, chule Zion'a achenna mun aumin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hiche mun'a chun aman thalpi thalchang ho, lumdal le chemjam, chule gal asubong gamin ahi. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Nangma sadelna molsang ho sangin naloupin nachung nungjon ahi."},"5":{"text":"Milunglenho chu akisuse gamun, a-imut naova a-imulhu paijun; chule mihat ho koimachan akhut hou amujou tapouvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Vo Jacob Pathen, naphosalna jeh-in sakol kangtalai le sakol jong a-imu millhon tan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nang, nangmatah chu gindingtah nahin, chule nangma lunghan teng namitmu-a koiham ading theidinga?"},"8":{"text":"Nangin nathutanna thu van'a konin najahsah-in, leiset akichan athip behtan,"},"9":{"text":"Pathen thutanlha dinga ahung kipat doh-a, leisetna gimbola um jouse ahuhdoh ding teng. Selah"},"10":{"text":"Tahbeh-a mihem lunghanna chun nangma navahchoi ding, lunghanna amohchengse-a chu naki gah ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen nu henga kihahselun, chule peuvin; akimvella umjousen ginding dolpa henga chun kipaman hinchoijun."},"12":{"text":"Aman pipuiho lhagao asuhmang ding; ama chu leiset lengho dinga kichat umtah ahi."}}},"77":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka awn Pathen kakouve, ka aw-in Pathen ngei chu kakouvin, chule aman keilama ana asungin ahi.","title":"Pathen Lhatdamna Natoh Lungmonga Hetjingna"},"2":{"text":"Kalung khamnin Pakai chu kaholin, kanatna kajanthoh lel-in, oltih kanei theipoi, kahinna jong lhepbi ding anompoi."},"3":{"text":"Pathen kanageldoh-in, chuin kalungkhamin; kana kiphin in, chuin kalhagao lungdongin aumin ahi. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Kamit nahasah jingin, thusei theilou khopmin kalungkhame."},"5":{"text":"Khangluilai thu, masanglai kumho chu kagah gelin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Jana kalasah chu kageldoh kitnin, kalungsunga keile kei kakihouvin, kalhagaovin gunchu tah-in aholin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pakaiyin a-itih-a dinga aledoh dingham? chule akhohsahna chu umkit louhel ding hitam?"},"8":{"text":"Ahepina theng chu a-itih-a dinga kichai hitam? Athutep chu atonsotna dinga thonna hitam?"},"9":{"text":"Pathen'in lungsetna aneiding chu asuhmil hitam? ahepina lainatna chu alunghanin akhachah hitam? Selah"},"10":{"text":"Chule hichehi keima lhahsam ahi kanatin, ahinla chungnung pen khut jetlam kumho chu geljinging kate."},"11":{"text":"Pakai thilbolho chu kageldoh ding ahi; khanglui laija nathilbol kidangho chu geldoh tahbeh ingkate."},"12":{"text":"Nanatoh ho jouse jong ngaito ingting, nathilbol ho houlimnan neijinge."},"13":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nalampi chu munthenga aumin; i-Pathen banguva lentah Pathen koiham?"},"14":{"text":"Nangma thil kidangho bolji Pathen chu nahin nangman nathahat mitin lah-a naphong doh-e."},"15":{"text":"Nabanin namite, Jacob le Joseph chate chu nalhatdohtan ahi. Selah"},"16":{"text":"Twiho chun namutaove, vo Pathen, twiho chun namutaove; amaho akichauvin, twi thuhho jong aki tihotsoh taove."},"17":{"text":"Meilhang hon twi ahinlha lha uvin, vanthamjol hon aw ahinsodoh-un, nathalchangho aleng lahlah jenge."},"18":{"text":"Navan ginchu van'a akithong lhungin, kolphen vannoi asalvah soh-in, leiset akithingin, akihotnin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Nalampi twikhanglen'a aumin, nalam lhah twilenho sunga um ahi, chule nakhonung ho het ahipoi."},"20":{"text":"Nangin namite kelngoi hon bangin, Mosi le Aaron khutna nanapuijin ahi."}}},"78":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo kamite kadanthu-a hin nana hinsungun, kakamsung thuho-a hin na-nakhangu hinsung uvin.","title":"Thungailou Israel Chunga Pathen phatna"},"2":{"text":"Thulem seinan kam kangting, malai thu ki-im ho seidoh-ing kate.","ref":"Matt 13:35."},"3":{"text":"Inajah uva inahetsao, ipateovin eina hil hou chu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hicheho chu achateuva henga i-im loudiu, khangthah hung umdingho henga Pakai vahchoinaho le athahatna chule thilkidang ana boldohho chu ihetsah diu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Jacob hengah photchetna aphutdoh-in, chule Israelte lah-a danthu atungdoh-in, hichu achateu ahetsah diuvin ipu ipateu thu apen ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chutia chu khang hunglhung dingho, chate hungpeng dingho chun ahet diu; chutia chu amaho chu thoudoh uva achateu ahilson jing dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Akinepnao chu Pathen'a angapmuva, chule Pathen natohho chu sumil louva, amavang athupeh ajui nadiu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Apateu louchal le golkeh khangmite, alungputnu janglou khangmite, alhagaovu Pathen'a detlouho bang ahilouna diu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ephraim chaten galvon akivonun, chule thalpi akikenun, galsat nikhon akiheijun akinungle taove."},"10":{"text":"Amahon Pathen thutep chu achingtup pouvin, adanthua chonding anompouve."},"11":{"text":"Chule aman avetsah anatohho le athilkidang bolho asumilgam taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Egypt gam Zoan munah apateu mitmun, Pathen'in datmo umtahtah thil anabolin ahi.","ref":"Pot 7:8—12:32."},"13":{"text":"Aman twikhanglen ahom khenin, chuin amaho chu agalkaisah-in, chule twiho chu alhuh-in adinsah-in ahi.","ref":"Pot 14:21-22."},"14":{"text":"Amaho chu sunle meilhangin apuijin, janle meikongin apuilejin ahi.","ref":"Pot 13:21-22."},"15":{"text":"Gamthipma songpiho chu akhitkeh sah-in, chule thuhtah-a kon hungdoh bangin amaho donding twi apen ahi.","ref":"Pot 17:1-16; Minb 20:2-13."},"16":{"text":"Aman songpi-a konchun luiho alondohsah-in, vadungho bangin twiho alonlhah sah-e."},"17":{"text":"Chule gamthipma chun chungnung pen phinsetnan achonset bebe nalaijun ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule amahon atahsao ngaichat an thumnan alungthimun Pathen apatepmun ahi.","ref":"Pot 16:2-15; Minb 11:4-23,31-35."},"19":{"text":"Henge, amahon Pathen douna thu aseijun, gamthip mahi Pathen'in dokhang adothei dingham? atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Veuvin, aman songpi avon, twiho ahung kikhodoh-in, vachadung chu along letset tan; changlhah jong apetheidem? amitedin sa ape theidem?"},"21":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hichu ajan, chuin alunghangin; Jacob dounan mei akongdoh-in, Israel dounan jong lunghanna ahung kongdoh-e."},"22":{"text":"Pathen atahsan lou jeh-u le, ahuhhingna atahsan loujeh-u ahi."},"23":{"text":"Aman chunga kona meilhang ho thu apeh-a, van kot ho ahonjeng vangin,"},"24":{"text":"Chule aneh diuvin mana achunguva alhahsah-in, van an chu amaho anapen ahi.","ref":"Jhn 6:31."},"25":{"text":"Mihemin vantil ho an aneuvin, amaho avaset nadiuvin an anapen ahi."},"26":{"text":"Aman solam hui chu van'a anunsah-in, chule athaneina-in lhanglam hui ahin puilutne."},"27":{"text":"Sa chu leivui jat bangin achunguva ajuhsah-in, vacha lhaving nei chu twikhanglen'a neldi jat tobang ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule achennao kimvel, agebuhhou lailunga alhahsah-in ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hitichun aneuvin, avasetnui; ajehchu mahon angaichat uchu ape ahi."},"30":{"text":"Amaho ngaichatna toh akikhendeh pouvin, akamuva asaneh-u aumpetlai chun,"},"31":{"text":"Pathen lunghanna achunguva achun, amaho lah-a athaopenho chu athatnin, Israel pasal lhendoh ho chu asumangtan ahi."},"32":{"text":"Ajehchu chuche geijong chun achonse jing nalaijun, chule athil kidang bol ho jong atahsan pouve."},"33":{"text":"Hijeh chun akumhou mohseh-in, chule anikhohou lungkham na-in asuhbei pehtan ahi."},"34":{"text":"Aman amaho atha phatnin amahon ahinholun, chule ahung kileuvin Pathen chu ahol loi uvin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chule amahon Pathen chu asongpiule, Pathen chungnung chu alhatdohpau ahi ahingeldoh uvin ahi."},"36":{"text":"Ahivangin akamuvin ama apahcha lhemun, chule aleijun amachu ajoulhep jiuvin ahi."},"37":{"text":"Ajehchu alungu ama lama aum pon, chujongle akitepna-a chun jong alungdet pouvin ahi."},"38":{"text":"Hijongle ama lungsetna dimset ahijeh-in, akhan gitlounao angaidamin, chule asumang pouve; henge, vel tamtah alunghana aheimangjin, alunghana jouse asodoh pon ahi."},"39":{"text":"Ajehchu tahsaphe bou ahiu ageldoh-in, khohui anunmanga hungkile kitlou ahiuchu ageldoh-in ahi."},"40":{"text":"Gamthipma iti alunghansah jinguva, chule nelgama iti alung phatmosah jingu hitam!"},"41":{"text":"Henge, akinung heijun Pathen alhemjiuvin, chule Israel mitheng pa chu asulung na-un ahi."},"42":{"text":"Amahon akhut ageldoh pouvin, melma-a kona alhatdohna nikho jong chu ageldohdeh pouvin ahi."},"43":{"text":"Egyp gama melchihna ho abola, chule Zoan phaija thil kidang iti abol hitam,"},"44":{"text":"chule aman avadunghou thisan asosah-in, chule atuisoh hou chu adonthei tapouvin ahi.","ref":"Pot 7:17-21."},"45":{"text":"Aman alah uva thousi jatchom chom asolin, hichun amaho anejouvun, chule uphoh chun amaho asumanguvin ahi.","ref":"Pot 8:1-6,20-24."},"46":{"text":"Aman amuchi hou chu lungtol apen, chule atohgau chu khaokhopi ho apen ahi.","ref":"Pot 10:12-15."},"47":{"text":"Alengpi guihou gellin asusen, chule atheiba phunghou buhbangin asumangtan ahi.","ref":"Pot 9:22-25."},"48":{"text":"Aganchahou jong gelchang henga apen, chule akelngoihou keh nasatah henga chun apen ahi."},"49":{"text":"Aman vantil engseho asolin, alungsatna kichat umtah, alunghana le lungthahna, chule thangtom nale gentheina chu achunguva achutan ahi."},"50":{"text":"Alunghana lampi asem peh-in, ahinnao chu thina a konin akhendoh pon, ahinkhou chu hise apedoh jotai;"},"51":{"text":"chule Ham Houbuh ho-a ahatnau chungnung pen, Egypt cha pengmasa jouse chu athatnin ahi.","ref":"Pot 12:29."},"52":{"text":"Ahinla amite chu kelngoi banga chedoh dingin asemin, ganchahon bangin gamthipma chun alamkaijin ahi.","ref":"Pot 13:17-22."},"53":{"text":"Chule akichat louna diuvin bitkeijin apuijin, ahinla amelmateu chu twikhanglen'in achupgam taovin ahi.","ref":"Pot 14:26-28."},"54":{"text":"Chule aman muntheng gamgi gei, akhut jetlama anachoh molsang geijin, apuilhung tan ahi.","ref":"Pot 15:17; Josh 3:14-17."},"55":{"text":"Amasanguva Pathen hephalouho jong anodohpeh-in, chule agoulodin ahoppeh-in, Israel phungho aponbuh cheh uva achensahtai.","ref":"Josh 11:16-23."},"56":{"text":"Achuti vangin chungnung pen Pathen chu apatepmun, alunghansah uvin, aphotchetnaho achingtup pouvin ahi.","ref":"Thutn 2:11-15."},"57":{"text":"Ahinla akinung heijun, apateu bangin tahsan umloutah-in akhangun, kitahlouna thalpi bangin akiheimang taovin ahi."},"58":{"text":"Hitichun amunsang houva alunghan nachu achoh thouvun, amilim semhouvin athangsetsah taove."},"59":{"text":"Pathen'in hichehi ajah phatnin alunghangin, Israelte chu akidah behsehtai:"},"60":{"text":"chutichun aman Shiloh Houbuh, mihem ho lah-a akoi ponbuh chu adalha tan;","ref":"Josh 18:1; Jer 7:12-14; 26:6."},"61":{"text":"chuin aman athahatna chu sohchang din apedoh-in, chule aloupina chu melmate khutna apedoh tai.","ref":"1 Sam 4:4-22."},"62":{"text":"Amite chu chemjam'a loudin jong apedoh-in, chule agou lote chunga chun alunghangtai."},"63":{"text":"Meikongin agollhanghou akavam gamin, chule anungah hou kichena himhima akipe tapouve."},"64":{"text":"Athempuhou chemjamin alouvun, ameithai houvin jong akapouve."},"65":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakai chu mi a-ihmut na-a kona hungkhang bangin ahung khangdoh-in, chule lengpitwi jeh-a mihat tah khat hung kisen abangin ahi."},"66":{"text":"Amelmate ale sat kitnin, kumkho-a i-sah louva umdingin akoitan ahi."},"67":{"text":"Chulou jong chun Joseph houbuh chu adeitapon, Ephraim phung jong alheng tapoi."},"68":{"text":"Ahivangin angailut Zion molsang, Juda phung chu alheng jotai."},"69":{"text":"Aman leiset a-imatih channa dinga atundoh bangin, amuntheng chu leng inpi sangtah ho bangin asadoh tan ahi."},"70":{"text":"Aman asoh David chu, kelngoi honga konchun alheng dohtan ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 16:11-12; 2 Sam 7:8; 1 Thusm 17:7."},"71":{"text":"Anou tamtah kai kelngoipi ho juija konin, amite Jacob phungle agoulo Israelte vahdin apuitai."},"72":{"text":"Chutichun alungthim dihtah-in amaho chu avah-in, chule akhut themna-in amaho chu analamkaijin ahi."}}},"79":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nangma helouho nagoulona sunga ahung lutnun, na houin theng asuboh uvin, Jerusalem chu alhuh-in asetaove.","title":"Israel Nampi Huhdoh-a Umna dia Taona","ref":"2 Leng 25:8-10; 2 Thusm 36:17-19; Jer 52:12-14."},"2":{"text":"Amahon nasohte thilong chu chungleng vachate an dingin apeuvin, namithengte sa chu leija gamsaho apeuve."},"3":{"text":"Athisanu chu Jerusalem kimvela twi bangin alongin, chule avui dingu koimacha aumpoi."},"4":{"text":"Kaheng kakomhou housetnin kaumun, kakimvel uvaho nuisatle totnop nabep kahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Itih channem, Pakai? Atonsotna nalunghang ding hitam? Nathangthipna chu mei banga kongding ham?"},"6":{"text":"Nangma hephalou namho chung le, chule namin phapohlou lenggam ho chunga nalung hanna chu bunglha tan."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon Jacob chu abah gammun, achenna mun kamhelin alha taove."},"8":{"text":"Oh, masanglai kakhan gitlouna houchu geldoh hih-un, nahepinaho thahat chun neihoidoh loijun, ajehchu keiho hatah-a eikisu nemu ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Vo eihuh hinguva Pathen, namin loupina dingin neipanpi uvin, namin jal-in kachonsetnahou sungimin lang, neihuhdoh uvin."},"10":{"text":"Ipidinga Pathen hephalouhon a-Pathenu hoibaham atidiuham? Sohte thisan kiso phulah na-in, kamitmuvin Pathen hephalouho lah-a hin amachu hetnin umhen."},"11":{"text":"Akihenho khoisatna chu na-angsung hung lhung hen, nathil bolthei natsat bangtah-in, thidinga gotsaho chu huhdoh-in;"},"12":{"text":"Chule vo Pakai amahon nahouset nao chu, ajat sagin kaheng kakomte angsunga lethuh-in."},"13":{"text":"Chuti chun namite keihole nahamhing lah-a kelngoiten, a-imatih chanin nangma thangvahna peuving ting, akhang akhangin napachat na musahjing taovinge."}}},"80":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Israel kelngoi chinna chingpa, Joseph ganhon banga ana lamkaipa nangman, nana sungin, Cherubim ho kah-a chengpa nangma vah bangin vah doh-in.","title":"Israel Kisem phatkit Nadinga Taona","ref":"Pot 25:22."},"2":{"text":"Ephraim le Benjamin miho, chule Manasseh masanga nahatna chu hintildoh-in, chule hungin lang neihuh doh-un."},"3":{"text":"Vo Pathen, neisemthah kitnunlang, namai vahsah-in, chutile huhhing-a kaum dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Vo janelho Pakai Pathen, itihchan namite taona douva nalunghang dingham?"},"5":{"text":"Nangin amaho chu mitlhi-a kisem changlhah-in navah-in, adon dingun tena lentah-in mitlhi napejin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nangin kaheng kakomhou dingin kiphinna-in neisemun, chule kamelma teo lah-a nuisat kahitaove."},"7":{"text":"Vo janelho Pathen, neisemthah kitnunlang, namai vahsah-in, chutile huhhing-a kaum dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nangin Egypt'a konin lengpigui khat nahinpon; Pathen hephalouho nanodoh-in, hichu naphut tan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nangin ama dingin mun nasem peh-in, ajung thuhtah-in nakikhosah-in, gam leiset alosohtai."},"10":{"text":"Lhangho chu alimin akhusoh-in, chule hiche abahho chu cedar thing phatah abange."},"11":{"text":"Abahkai hochu twipi geijin asolin, chule hiche abahho chu vadung lama asole."},"12":{"text":"Ibola apal ho chu naphet lhah-a, chuche lampi jot chanin akilou hitam?"},"13":{"text":"Gamlah-a kon hungpotdoh ngalchangin asuse-in, chuleh gamlah-a gamsan anejou tan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Vo janelho Pathen, katao ahi, hungkile kitnin, van'a konin hinvenlang, hiche lengpi guihi hinvilin;"},"15":{"text":"Nangman nakhut jetna naphu lengpi leihi, chule nangma dinga dettah-a nasem abahchu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hichehi meijin akihallhan akiphuh lhutan; namaiso-a phosal na-a amangthah taovin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nakhut chu najetlama mi, nangma dinga nahatsah mihem chapa chunga chun umhen."},"18":{"text":"Chutichun nanga konin kinunghei tapouving ting; neisuhalun, chuteng keihon namin kakoudingu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Vo janelho Pakai Pathen neisemthah kitnunlang, namai vahsah in, chutile huhhing-a kaum dingu ahi."}}},"81":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Itha hatnao Pathen hengah gingtah-in la saovin, Jacob Pathen henga kipa aw thonsah-un,","title":"Israelte Lungheina Dinga Ngehna"},"2":{"text":"vahchoi La saovinlang, khongcha tum gingun, selangdah ngeitoh, tumging toh tho uvin."},"3":{"text":"Lhathah, kitepna phat, i-kutpi nikho houva sumkon mut uvin.","ref":"Minb 10:10."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Israelte dinga hichehi chondan kisem chu ahin, Jacob Pathen dinga dan chu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hichehi Joseph chunga photchetsah na-a, Egypt gam sunga achedoh laija anasuhdet chu ahin, chu-a chun kahetlou paokhat kanajan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Alengkou chu pohgih-a konin kalahdohpeh in, akhut chu belho-a konin akihuhdoh tai."},"7":{"text":"Lungkham nin neikouvin chule kahuh doh-e, keiman munthipma kithong lenglung ginin kahin donbutne, Maribah twija chun nangma kana patepme. Selah","ref":"Pot 17:7; Minb 20:13."},"8":{"text":"Ngaijuvin, vo kamite kapatep dingu nahiuve, vo Israel, kathu nangai uva ahile,"},"9":{"text":"Nalah uva gamdangmi Pathen himhim umlou ding ahin, gamchom pathen himhim nahoulou dingu ahi.","ref":"Pot 20:2-3; Danb 5:6-7."},"10":{"text":"Keimahi Egypt gama kona napuidoh uva, tonsot Pakai na Pathen'u chu kahi; Nakam kalen uvin chule keiman kadipdim ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla kamiten ka aw angaipouvin, chule Israelte khatchan eideipouve."},"12":{"text":"Chutichun alung ngaichat nao lama kapedoh-in, chule amahotah kithumop dungjuijin achontauve."},"13":{"text":"Ohe, kamiten kathu ngaijuhen, chule Israel hi kalampi ho-a che hitavele!"},"14":{"text":"Agalteu kasot kun loija, chule akidoupiteu chunga kakhut kanalap ding ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Pakai hotbolte chu ahenga kipelut chehdiu; ahivanga aphatnu chu a-imatih channa umjing ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Aman suhlou chang tuipena amaho avahding; chule keiman songpi-a kon khoijua chu nangma ka lunglhaisah ding nahi."}}},"82":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen chu thaneitah houkhom ho lah-a chun adingin, pathen ho lah-a thu atantai.","title":"Thutah Dih Ngehna"},"2":{"text":"Itihchan dihlou tah-a thu natan uva, chule migilouho chunga langneina nanei dingu ham? Selah"},"3":{"text":"Vaichate le pabeite chu hongbitnun, bolgenthei thohho le lhasamte henga adih chu bolun."},"4":{"text":"Vaichate le ngaichate chu huhdoh-un, migiloupa khutna konin amaho chu lhadoh-un."},"5":{"text":"Amahon ahepouvin chujongle hetkhen themna jong aneipouve; muthima vahle jing ahiuvin, leiset bulho jouse akilongtai."},"6":{"text":"Nangho pathenho nahiuvin, chule nabon uva chungnung pen chate nahiuve, kanatin ahi.","ref":"Jhn 10:34."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla mihem banga nathiuva, chule pipuiho khat banga nalhuh dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Vo Pathen thouvin lang leiset thuhi tanin, ajehchu namjouse hi nalo ding ahi."}}},"83":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen, paolouvin umdan lang, thip beh-in umhih beh hih-in, chule vo Pathen umthim hihbeh-in.","title":"Israel Suhgentheina Chung Changa Taona"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu vetan, namelma ten thunoh aboluvin, chule nangma hotbolte akiletsah-un ahi."},"3":{"text":"Namite dounan amahon lungthim phalou agelun, chule naselguhte dounan akihousom taove."},"4":{"text":"Hungun namkhat ahinaova konin sumangu hitin, Israel minhi geldohkit louhel nadingin bolu hite, atiuve."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho lungkhat kisan akihoutoh-un, nangma dounan kiloikhomna akisem taove."},"6":{"text":"Edom le Ishmael mite houbuhho, Moab le Hagar mite,"},"7":{"text":"Gebal la Ammon chule Amalek, Philistine te le Tyre'a chengho toh,"},"8":{"text":"Assur jong amahotoh apangkhom taovin, amahon Lot chate akithopiuvin ahi. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Midian ho nabolna bang, Sisera nabolna bangin amaho chu bolin.","ref":"Thutn 4:6-22; 7:1-23."},"10":{"text":"Amaho Endor'a amangthah taovin; leisetna din eh tobang ahitaove."},"11":{"text":"Amilen hou chu Oreb le Zeeb bangin bolin; henge, apiputeu jong Zebah le Zalmunna bangin bolin,","ref":"Thutn 7:25; 8:12."},"12":{"text":"Pathen inho chu eiho chan dingin kilah uhite, atiuve."},"13":{"text":"Vo ka Pathen amaho chu chimpei bangle, khohui masanga changpol bangin semin."},"14":{"text":"Meijin gammang akah bangle, molsangho mei kihal deujeju bangin;"},"15":{"text":"Hitichun nahuipi chun sugen theijin lang, nahuipi le gopi achun kichatsah-in."},"16":{"text":"Vo Pakai namin aholna diuvin, amaiju jachatnan dipmin."},"17":{"text":"A-itih-in jahchale lungdongin umsah-in, henge, jahchao henlang mangthah jengu uhen."},"18":{"text":"Chutia chu mihem ten, nangma bouseh Jehovah minpu, leiset pumpi-a chunga chungnung pen nahi ti ahethei diu ahi."}}},"84":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo janel Pakai, na houbuh hochu iti ngaichat umtam!","title":"Pathen In'a Chending Lhangai"},"2":{"text":"Kahinna hin alhangai jin, henge, Pakai inpi indan ngaijin kalhasam heltan, kalungthim le katahsa hi hingjing Pathen henga akapme."},"3":{"text":"Henge, vasoh injong in akimun, chule pelpan jong anou akoina dingin amading bu aneije; Vo janel ho Pakai, kalengpale ka Pathen hichu namaicham ho ngei chu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma in'a chengho chu anunnom ahiuve, amahon navahchoi jing taovinte. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Nanga hatna neipa chu anunnomin, alungthimu gamtheng jotna dinga pedoh hochu anunnome."},"6":{"text":"Amahon Baca phaicham ajot lhungun, twikul asemun, gotwi jong chun twikhuh hochu adip dime."},"7":{"text":"Amaho hat cheh, hatcheh-in acheuvin, Zion'a Pathen anga chun amichang cheh-in akilah-un ahi."},"8":{"text":"Vo Pakai Janel Pathen, kataona ngaijin lang, Jacob Pathen, nana hinsungin.
