Selah"},"9":{"text":"Vo kalumdal'u Pathen, vetemin, nathaonu mai hi hinven."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu nahong sunga chun nikhat chu kum sangkhat sangin aphajon; gitlouna pon buho-a chensangin, ka Pathen in kotngah-a pan kanomjoi."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai Pathen chu nisale lumdal ahin, Pakai chun lungsetna le loupina apeh ding, thildih'a chonteho-a dingin thilpha himhim it ponte."},"12":{"text":"Vo janelho Pakai, nangma tahsana michu anunnom ahi."}}},"85":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai nagam chunga lungsetna naneijin; sohchanga Jacob chu nahin lepui kittan ahi.","title":"Pakaiyin Gamsung Akiledohsah Kit Nadinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Nangin namite khan gitlouna nangaidamin, achonsetnao jouse namelkhutan ahi. Selah"},"3":{"text":"Nalunghanna jouse naladoh-in, nalungsat gimneitah chu nakihei mang khumtai."},"4":{"text":"Vo eihuh hingpao Pathen, neilehei jinlang, kachunguva nalunghan bangtan."},"5":{"text":"A-imatih channa kachunguva nalung hanjing ding ham? Nalunghan chu khangjousea naso dohsah jing ding hitam?"},"6":{"text":"Nangman namite kakipana diuva, neisuhhal kit loudiu ham?"},"7":{"text":"Vo Pakai nahepina chu neimusah unlang, nahuhhingna chu neipeuvin."},"8":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in ahin thusei ding chu ngaijing kate, ajehchu amite le amithengte henga chamna thu aseiding ahin; ahinla amaho ngolna lama kiheikit daohen."},"9":{"text":"Adihtah-in igam uva loupina aumtheina dingin, ami huhhing na chu ama gingte henga ahungnaijin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hepina le thutah akimuto lhonin, chonphatna le chamna akichopto lhone."},"11":{"text":"Leisetna konin thutah kehdoh intin, chule chonphat na-in van'a kona ahinvet suh ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Henge, Pakai chun thilpha chu hinpentin, chule igamuhin aga ahin punsah ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chonphatna chu amasanga chentin, chule akholhahna lampia eichesah diu ahi."}}},"86":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai nana hin sung inlang neingaipeh-in, ajehchu keima vaicha le lhasam kahi.","title":"Pathen Hepina Ngeh-a Taona"},"2":{"text":"Kahinna hi neikheh peh-in, ajeh chu keima atheng kahi; vo ka Pathen, nangma tahsana nasohhi huhhingin."},"3":{"text":"Vo Pakai neihepin, ajehchu niseh-in nangma kakoujinge."},"4":{"text":"Nasoh hinkhohi kipasah-in; ajehchu vo Pakai, nangma-a kahinna kapedoh-e."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai nangma naphan, ngaidam dinga kigojing nahin, nangma nakoute jouse chunga hepina dimset nahi."},"6":{"text":"Vo Pakai kataona-a hin nana hinsungin, chule kathumna awcheng hi ngaiphan."},"7":{"text":"Kalungjina nikho leh nangma kakou ding nahi; ajehchu nangman neidonbut ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Vo Pakai pathen ho lah-a nangtobang khatcha aumpon; chujongle nathilbol tobang bola jong khatcha aumpoi."},"9":{"text":"Vo Pakai nasemsa nam jouse chu hungintin, na-anga chibai aboh uva, namin achoi-at diu ahi.","ref":"Tph 15:4."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma naloupin, thil kidangtah naboljin; Nangseh bou Pathen nahi."},"11":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nalampi neihilin, na thutah-a chon inge, namin kagin theina ding lungthim pumkhat neipen."},"12":{"text":"Vo Pakai ka Pathen, kalung pumpin nangma vahchoi jing ting; chule a-imatih chana namin kachoi-at jing ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu nahepina keidingin alenin; chule kahinna hi thikholkhul noinung penna konin nahuhdoh tai."},"14":{"text":"Vo Pathen, keima dounan mi kiletsahho akipanun, pumhat manga mipi kikhom mihon kahina aholun, chule amasanguva nangma nakoipouve."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla vo Pakai, nangma lainatpina le lungsetna, thoh hat, thutah, chule hepina dimset Pathen chu nahi."},"16":{"text":"O, kahenga hungkiheijin lang neihin hepin, nasohhi nahatna penlang, nasohnu chapahi huhhingin."},"17":{"text":"Aphatna dingin melchihna neimusah-in, chutile eihot bolten hichu muvintin, chule jahcha taovinte; ajehchu Pakai nangman neina kithopin chule neina lhamonin ahi."}}},"87":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Akibulphuna chu moltheng ho-a aumin ahi.","title":"Pathen Khopi Loupina"},"2":{"text":"Pakai chun Jacob chennaho jouse sangin, Zion kotpiho chu angailujoi."},"3":{"text":"Vo Pathen khopi, nachung chang thu loupitah-in akiseitai. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Keima eiheho henga Rehab le Babylon phapoh inge, Philistine le Tyre toh Ethiopia khu veuvin, hichepahi chua chu penga ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Zion chungchang thu hitia kiseiding ahi; hiche mipa le khuche mipa chu amanu-a peng ahin, chule chungnung penin amanu chu atun dohding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pakai chun mipi ho min chu asutdoh tengle, hiche mipahi chua chu peng ahi, tia asut ding ahi. Selah"},"7":{"text":"Lasathemho le tumging themho chua umdiu, katwisam jouse chu nanga um ahi, ati dingu ahi."}}},"88":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo eihuh hinga Pakai Pathen, sunle jannin na-anga kanataovin ahi.","title":"Kiphina Khohtah puma Panpina Ngeh-a Taona"},"2":{"text":"Kataona na-angsunga hunglhung hen; kapenna-a hin nana hinsungin."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu kahinnahi lungkham nan adimin; chule kahinkho hin lhan khuh lam anaitan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kokhuh sunga kumlha ho toh eikisimtha tan, thabei hel mitoh kabangtai."},"5":{"text":"Nangin nageldoh kit tahlou, Mithilah-a ongthol, akithatsa lhana lum tobang kahin chule amaho nakhutna kona kisatlha ahitaove."},"6":{"text":"Kotong noinungpen, muthim lah, mun thutah-a chun neikoijin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nalung hanna kachunga agihsan, chule natwi kinonghon eibol gentheitan ahi. Selah"},"8":{"text":"Kamel het ho chu keija konin gamla tah-a nakoimangin, amaho henga thet umtah in neisemin, khakhumin kaumin, kapotdoh theipoi."},"9":{"text":"Thohgimna jeh-in kamit athimtai, Pakai, nitinin nangma kakouvin, naheng lama kakhut kajah jingin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Mithi henga thil kidangho namusah-a, mithiho hung thouva navahchoi diu ham? Selah"},"11":{"text":"Vuikhuh-a chu nalungset ngailutna kiphonga, ahiloule tahsan naumna hi manthah na mun'a kiphong ding ham?"},"12":{"text":"Muthima chu na thilkidang ho kihe theija, chule na nachon phatna chu suhmilna-a dim gama kihe ding ham?"},"13":{"text":"Ahinla vo Pakai, nahenga kap pumin kangeh-e, chule jingkah teng kataona chu naheng ahung lhunge."},"14":{"text":"Pakai idia kahinna hi naledoh-a, idia keija kona namai nasel hitam?"},"15":{"text":"Kakhangdon apat kathohgimin athikoncha kahitai, kichat naum naho kathoh laijin, kapangjou him himpoi."},"16":{"text":"Nalunghan gin umtah kachunga achun, kichat naum naho chun eisumang heltai."},"17":{"text":"Hicheho chu twibangin niseh-in kavela ahungun, amahon eiumchah soh taove."},"18":{"text":"Ngailut gol le paihola keija konin agamlatan, chule kamel hetho chu muthim lah-a aumtaovin ahi."}}},"89":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai hepinaho chu a-imatih chanin lan sangting; kakamin tahsan aumje khangjouse-a hetsah inge.","title":"Nampi Genthei lai La"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu hepinahi a-imatih chana dinga kisadoh ding, nakitahna chu vanmun jouse-a naphudet ding ahi, kanatin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Keiman kamilhen chutoh kitepna kasemin, kasoh David henga kaki hahsel in,"},"4":{"text":"Nachilhah a-imatih chana dingin phutdoh ingting, chule nalaltouna chu khangjousea dinga katundoh ding ahi. Selah","ref":"2 Sam 7:12-16; 1 Thusm 17:11-14; Labu 132:11; Sol 2:30."},"5":{"text":"Chule vo Pakai vanhon nathil kidang bolho avahchoi ding; nakitahna jong mitheng kikhomho lah-a umtante."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai toh tepithei van'a koi uma? Mihat chapate lah-a Pakai kibahpi thei koi umjou ding ham?"},"7":{"text":"Mithengte kikhopna sunga Pakai chu sangtah-a ginding, chule akimvelaho jouse lah-a jana sangpen peh ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Vo janelho Pakai Pathen, nang tobang Pakai hat koiham? ahiloule nakimvelaho lah-a nakitahna phading koi umam?"},"9":{"text":"Twikhanglen chunga vai nahomin, hichu ahung kinon teng nasuthip jin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Mi khat kithat bangin, nangman Rahab chu ahal halin nasuchipmin, namelmate chu naban thahatnin nathe cheh-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Vanho nanga ahin, leiset jong nanga ahi; vannoi le asunga um jouse hi nangma phudoh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Nangin sahlam le lhanglam nasemin, Tabor le Hermon namina kipah ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nangin ban thahat tah naneijin, nakhut chu thahatna ahin, chule nakhut jetlam chu choi-atna achangin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chonphatna le thudih chu nalaltouna kibulphuna ahin; hepinale thutah chu namasangah aumin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Kipana hethema mite chu anunnom ahiuve! O Pakai, amaho namaivah-a vahle diu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Amaho namina nilhum keija kipah diu; chule nachon phatna-a amaho choisanga umdiu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma athahatnao loupina nahin; chule naphatna jeh-a ka ki'u choisanga umding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai chu ihoidoh nao ahin, chule Israel mithengpa chu ilengpao ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin gaovin namitheng khat henga thu naseijin: mihat tah khat chunga panpina kangamin, milah-a kona kilhengdoh khat kachoi-an tai, nati."},"20":{"text":"Keiman kasoh David kamutan, kathaotheng chu ama kanutai.","ref":"1 Sam 13:14; Sol 13:22; 1 Sam 16:12."},"21":{"text":"Ama-a chun kakhut hi thahatnin umintin, kabanin jong ama ahatsah ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Melman achunga hunam bolpontin, chujongle gitlouna chapan jong ama sugim ponte."},"23":{"text":"Chule amaikohtah-a amelmate kavoh lhuh-a, chule ama hote chu kasuhgim ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Amavang kakitahna le kahepinan ama aumpi ding; chule kamina aki chu choisanga umding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Akhut twikhanglen chunga kangapsah ding, chule akhut jetlam chu vadunglen hochunga kangapsah ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Aman kahenga, nangma kapa, ka Pathen, chule eihuhhing songpi nahi tia kikou ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Kenjong ama kachapa masapenle, leiset lengho sanga chungnung jo-a kasem ding ahi.","ref":"Tph 1:5."},"28":{"text":"Kahepinan atonsotnin kivoppintin, kakitepna-in ama dettah-a adinpi jingding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Achilhah jong atonsotna umdinga kasemding; alaltouna vangam nikhoho banga kasem ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Achate chun kadanthu apallhah uva, chule kathutan lhah banga achon lou uleh,"},"31":{"text":"Amahon kadan kisemho asuhkeh uva, chule kathupeh ho anitlou-uleh,"},"32":{"text":"Chutengle asuhkhelnau jeh-a mola kajep ding, chule akhan gitlounao jeh-a jepna-a kajep ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Hijeng jongle ama-a konin kalungset ngailutna hi ladoh soh hel pongting, tahsan kaumna hi thonsah ponge."},"34":{"text":"Kakitepna chu sukehpongting, chujongle kakamsunga sohsa jong khelkit ponge."},"35":{"text":"Kathenna-a khatvei kaki hahselsa ahin, David henga jouponge."},"36":{"text":"Achilhah a-imatih chana umjing ding, chule alaltouna ka-anga nisa banga umding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Hichu a-itih-a lha banga kiphutdoh ding, chule van'a hettohsah tahsan umtah banga kiphutdoh ding ahi. Selah"},"38":{"text":"Ahinla nangman napaidoh-in nakidah tan, nathaonu chunga chun nalunghangtan ahi."},"39":{"text":"Nangman nasohpa kitepna chu imalouvin nabolin, alal lukhuh tolla naseplhan, nasuhminset pehtan ahi."},"40":{"text":"Nangin apaljouse navoh lhuhpeh-in, akulpidet chu manghel-in nalhatai."},"41":{"text":"Chuche lam hopa jousen amachu achom mun, a-inhengho-a dingin i-sah louvin aumtan ahi."},"42":{"text":"Nangman akidoupiho banjetlam chu nahatsah-in, amelmate jouse chu nakipa sahtan ahi."},"43":{"text":"Nangman achemjam ha jong nalehei peh-in, chule galmuna chun nadindet sah tapoi."},"44":{"text":"Nangin aloupina nasutangin, chule alaltouna tolla naseplhatai."},"45":{"text":"Nangin akhangdonlai nikhoho nasuchomin, jachatna-in nakhutai. Selah"},"46":{"text":"Pakai itih chanem? tonsotna nakisel mang ding hitam? nalung hanna chu meibanga kongding ham?"},"47":{"text":"Kaphat hi ichana choma ham geltemin, ipidinga mijousehi panabeija nasemham?"},"48":{"text":"Thina mulouva hingjing dinga mi koi umam? aman lhankhuh-a konin ahinna kihuhdoh thei jintem? Selah"},"49":{"text":"Pakai malaija nalungset ngailutna, David henga nakitah na-a naki hahselna chu hoiba hitam?"},"50":{"text":"Pakai nasohte kihouset nahi hingeldoh temin, mijouse housetna chu ka-anga kapoh hi geltemin;"},"51":{"text":"Vo Pakai namelma ten anoisenao, nathaonupa kholhahna chana ataitom naohi geltemin."},"52":{"text":"Pakai chu atonsot atonsotnin nunnom tahen. Amen, chule Amen."}}},"90":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai nangma khangjousea kachennao mun nahi.","title":"Tonsot Pathen le Thithei Mihem"},"2":{"text":"Molsangho jouse kitundoh masang, leiset le vannoi jeng jong nasuhto masanga, tonsotna kipat tonsotgeija nangma Pathen nahi."},"3":{"text":"Nangin mihem chu manthah na-a nakilesah-in, nangho mihem chate kileuvin natin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma mitmun kum sangkhat jonghi akichai tengleh janhi bangbep ahijin, chule janna khongah ho phat dankhat bepbou ahijie.","ref":"2 Pet 3:8."},"5":{"text":"Nangin twisoh bangin amaho nalhoh mangjin, a-ihmu bangbep ahiuvin; jingkah-a hampa khangdoh bangbep ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Jingkahteng adon doh-in akhangtoujin, nilhah lamle akisatlhan agopjitai."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu nalungsat na-a suhmang kahiuvin, chule nalunghanna-a kalung khamun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Kakhan gitlounao namasanga nakoijin, guhthima kachonsetnao namai vah-a natah langin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu kanikho hou jouse nalunghannan achemang gamtan; kakumhou jong thusim kiseibangin kamangtaovin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kahin kumho nikho hou chu kum somsagi, chule atha hat ho chu kum somget jong ahitheije; hijongle ahatnau chu tohgimna le lungkhamna bou ahin, akisatlha loijin kalengmangji taove."},"11":{"text":"Nalungsat thaneina he-a koiham? nangma gin naum bangtah ngeijin nalunghan jong chuti chu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hitichun kalungthimu hi chihna-a kaman theina diuvin, kanikho hou simje neihilun."},"13":{"text":"Hung kiheijin, vo Pakai itih chan em? chule nasohte chungchanga nalung hin heitan."},"14":{"text":"Kahin laiseuva kakipauva kathanopna diuvin, O nahepinan neilunglhai sah loijun."},"15":{"text":"Neisuh gentheinao nikhoho sungle, thilse kamu-u kumho sung dungjuijin neikipa sah-un."},"16":{"text":"Nanatoh chu nasohte henga, chule naloupina chu achateu henga kilanghen."},"17":{"text":"Chule Pakai ka Pathen'u hoina chu kachunguva umhen, chule kakhutsoh-u natoh chu kachunguva tung doh-in, henge, kakhutsoh-u natoh chu tung doh-in."}}},"91":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chungnung pen munthip mun'a chenga chu, hatchung nungpen dailim noija umding ahi.","title":"Pathen'in A-angsunga Umte Avenbitdan"},"2":{"text":"Keiman Pakai chu, kakiselna le kakulpi ahin, ka Pathen chule ama katahsan ding pa ahi, ting kate."},"3":{"text":"Tahbeh-in aman thangkampa thanga kon, chule hise phalou tah-a konin nahuhdoh-inte."},"4":{"text":"Aman amulho in nahui jintin, chule alhavingho noi natahsan ding, akitahna chu nalumdal le napho hiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Janteng tijatna kicha tapon natin, chule suna thalchang hung lengji jong,"},"6":{"text":"Ahilou jongle muthima hise lang, chule sunlaija manthah na hungleng jong kicha tapon nate."},"7":{"text":"Nasihlama sangkhat lhu-a, chule najetlama sangsom lhuding, ahinla hichun nahin nai ponte."},"8":{"text":"Migilou kilethuhna chu namit sehseh-a navetna namu ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman kakiselna Pakai, chungnung pen chu, nangma chennan naseme."},"10":{"text":"Thilphalou himhimin nalhun khum pontin, hise himhimin jong nachenna hinnai ponte."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu nalampi jouse-a nachingtup dinga, aman avantilte nangma chunga mopo dinga thu apeh ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 4:6; Luk 4:10."},"12":{"text":"Songa nakeng nakisuh louna dinga, amahon akhutnuva nadop dingu ahi.","ref":"Matt 4:6; Luk 4:11."},"13":{"text":"Keipi bahkai le gulsum chung nachot ding, keipi gollai le dragon chu nakengto noija nachilding ahi.","ref":"Luk 10:19."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu angailutna kachunga akoijeh-in amachu huhdoh ingting; kamin ahetjeh-a mun sanga kakoiding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Aman eikou ding, keiman kadonbut ding; lungkham na-a kaumpia, kahuh doh-a, jabolna kachansah ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hinkho saona-in lunglhaisah ingting, kahuh hingna chu kamusah ding ahi."}}},"92":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo chungnung pen, namin vahchoi La sah-a, Pakai henga thangvahna peh hi thilpha ahi.","title":"Angailutna Leh Tahsan Aumna Jeh-a Pakai Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Jingkah-a nalungset ngailutna, chule janseh-a nakitahna musah dingin,"},"3":{"text":"Manchah jang som nei toh, tumging leh, selangdah gin ngeija nangma vahchoihi thilpha ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai nangin nathilbolla neikipasah ahin; nakhutsoh thilbolho-a jona la sange."},"5":{"text":"O Pakai nanatoh ho iti loupia hitam! chule nalunggel ho athuh-in ahi."},"6":{"text":"Milungsel hon hichu ahethei pouvin, mingolin jong hichu ahethem theipoi."},"7":{"text":"Migilouho hampa banga ahung kedoh-a, khan gitlou bolho jouse aphat thei tengule, tonsot geija suhmanga umding ahitaove."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai, nangma vang tonsotna chungnung pen nahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu, vo Pakai, namel mate khu vetan, ajehchu ven, namelmate khu mangthah untin, khan gitlou bolho jouse kithecheh diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla ka-ki hi sakol kinei banga nachoisang ding; keima thaotwi thah eikinuding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Kamit hin kamel mate chunga angaichat chu muntin, chule kanakhang hin keima douna-a kipan khangitlou bolho ngaichat chu ajahding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Michonpha chu tum phung banga khangtou ding; Lebanon lhanga Cedar thing banga khangtou ding ahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Pakai in'a kiphut hochu i-Pathen'u hong sunga khangtou diu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Amaho atehgeijuva jong ga jinguva, amaho chu thao uva khang toudiu;"},"15":{"text":"Pakai chu chondih ahi avetsah diu, ama chu kasongpi ahin, chule ama-a chun chonphat louna himhim umpoi."}}},"93":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chun lengvai apon, ama loupina-in akivonin, Pakai chu thahat na-in akivonin, hiche-a chun aman atai akigah-e; leiset jonghi akilin louhelna dingin akitung detnin ahi.","title":"Tonsotna Pakai Vaihom"},"2":{"text":"Nalal touna chu malaija kiphut doh-a ahitan; nangma tonsotna umsa nahitai."},"3":{"text":"Vo Pakai twisoh akinong sangin, twisoh akinong gingin, twisoh akinong lenin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Twi tamtah gin sangin Pakai chungnung chu ahatjon; henge, twikhanglen kinong hattah sangin ahatjon ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nathu hetoh sahna chu adihlheh-in; Vo Pakai a-imatih chanin thenna chu nangma in ahunghitai."}}},"94":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Phulahna neija, vo Pakai Pathen, phulahna neija vo Pathen, hung kiphong doh-in.","title":"Michonpha ho kiselna Pathen"},"2":{"text":"Leiset chung thutanpa, nangmatah kichoisangin lang, mikilet sahho lethuhna pen."},"3":{"text":"Pakai itihchan migilou hon, itihchan migilou hon ajodingu ham?"},"4":{"text":"Itihchan thil hahsaho aseidingu ham? chule khangitlou bolte chu amaho le amaho kiletsah dingu ham?"},"5":{"text":"Vo Pakai namite ahal hallin aheh goijun, nagouloho asugentheijuvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amahon meithaile kholjin asat lih-un, chule pa neilouho athatnun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin amahon Pakai chun mupontin, Jacob Pathen'in jong ngaisah hih inte atiuve."},"8":{"text":"Mipi lah-a milungselho, nanghon hekhenuvin, chule mingol ho, nangho itihle nachih dingu ham?"},"9":{"text":"Kol sempa kho jalouva uma? Mit sempa kho mulouva umding ham?"},"10":{"text":"Pathen hephalouho gimbolpan, asuhdih louding ham? Mihem chihna hilpa chun, iti ahet da ding ham?"},"11":{"text":"Pakai chun mihem lunggel ho chu pannabei ahi ti ahenai.","ref":"1 Cor 3:20."},"12":{"text":"Vo Pakai nasehgimpa, nadanthu-a kona nahilpa chu anun nome;"},"13":{"text":"migilou dinga kokhuh kilai kahse-a, akidoupi ho nikho-a kona nacholnga sah ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin amite paimang hel pontin, chule agoulo mite chu adalhah lou ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla thutanlhahna chu chonphatna-a hung kilentin, chule lungdihpu jousen hichu ajuidiu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Thilse bolho eidoupeh dinga koi kipatdoh-a, ahiloule khanset bolho eidoupeh dinga koi dingdoh dingham?"},"17":{"text":"Pakai chu eipanpi anahilou hileh, kahinna hi thipbeh-a ana umding ahitai."},"18":{"text":"Kakeng kalho nale katichun, vo Pakai nahepina-in nei natuh-e."},"19":{"text":"Kasunga lungkhamna tamtah kaneilai chun, nalhamona-in kahinna akipasah-in ahi."},"20":{"text":"Danthu-a phatlouna semdohji khan gitlouna laltouna chun, nangma toh kiloikhomna neijin tem?"},"21":{"text":"Michonpha hinna douna-in akikhom khomun, monabei thisan chu themo achanuvin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Amavang Pakai chu eihong bitna ahin, chuleh ka Pathen chu kakiselna songpi ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule aman akhan gitlounao chu amahotah chunga alhutna, chule agitlou naova chu asuh manghel diu ahi: henge, Pakai i-Pathen'un asuh manghel diu ahi."}}},"95":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hungun, Pakai henga la saote, eihuh hingpao songpi henga kipana awthong tah-in samu hite.","title":"Pathen Houding le Athu-a Nungdinga Kouna"},"2":{"text":"Thangvah tothon a-angsunga hungu hitin, kipana aw thongin la saohite."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai chu Pathen lentah ahin, pathen jouse chunga leng lenpen ahi."},"4":{"text":"Leiset mun thuhtah ho chu akhutna um ahin, lhangho thaneina jong ama-a ahi."},"5":{"text":"Twipihi ama-a ahin chule asemsa ahin; chule tolgo chu akhutna asuhtoh ahi."},"6":{"text":"O hunguvin, ama houvin kun-u hitin; eisempao Pakai anga dilsu-u hite."},"7":{"text":"Ama i-Pathen'u ahin, eiho aganlhatna mun'a amitele akhutna kelngoite ihiuve. Tunia a-awgin najah uva ahile;","ref":"Heb 3:15; 4:7."},"8":{"text":"Lunghansahna-a bangle, gamthipma kipatep ni-a bang chun nalungu tahsah hih-un.","ref":"Heb 3:7-11."},"9":{"text":"Hichelai chun napu napateu vin eipatepmun, eiphochenun, kathilbolho amutaove.","ref":"Pot 17:1-7; Minb 20:2-13."},"10":{"text":"Kum somli jen hiche nam mite chunga kana lungkhamin, alungthim uva lungdihlou gela mite ahiuvin, kalampi ahepouve, kanatin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun amaho kacholngah na-a lutloudiu ahi, tia kalunghan na-a kana hahsel ahitaove.","ref":"Minb 14:20-23; Danb 1:34-36; 12:9-10; Heb 4:3-5."}}},"96":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiya lathah khat saovin, leiset pumpin Pakai henga la saovin.","title":"Thutan Dinga Hung Pathen Vahchoina La (1 Thusm 16:23-33)"},"2":{"text":"Pakai henga la saovin, amin choi annun, ani anin ahuhhingna phongdoh-un."},"3":{"text":"Pathen hephalouho lah-a aloupi, mijouse lah-a thilkidang ho phongdoh-un."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai chu aloupi-in, loupitah-a vahchoi ding ahi; pathen jouse chungvuma ja ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu namtinho pathen jouse chu milim semthu ahin; ahinla Pakaiyin vanho asemin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amasanga janale lalna aumin, amuntheng sunga hatnale hoina aume."},"7":{"text":"Vo nangho phungtina miten Pakaiya peuvinlang, Pakai henga loupina le hatna peuvin.","ref":"Labu 29:1-2."},"8":{"text":"Pakai chu achandia lom amin loupi chu peuvinlang, thilto hinchoijun lang, ahong sunga hunglut uvin."},"9":{"text":"O, Pakai chu thenna le hoina-in houvun, leiset pumpi amasanga kichauvin."},"10":{"text":"Pathen hephalouho lah-a chun Pakaiyin lengvai apoi tiuvin, vannoi leiset jong akilin louna dinga kiphutdet ding ahin, aman chonphatna-a mitin thu atanding ahi, tiuvin."},"11":{"text":"Vanho kipah uhen, leiset jong thanom hen, twipi le asunga umjouse aodoh uhen."},"12":{"text":"Loujao le asunga um jouse kipah uhen, chuteng gammanga thingphung jouse jong Pakai masanga thanom diu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu ama ahunge, amachu leiset thutan dinga hung ahi; aman vannoi chonphatna-a thu atanding chule mitin athudih na-a atanding ahi."}}},"97":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin lengvai apotai, leiset thanom hen, twikol gamho jouse kipah uhen.","title":"Thaneipen Pakai Henga Vahchoi La"},"2":{"text":"Meilhangle muthimin aumkimvelin; chonphatna le thutandih chu alaltouna kibulphuna ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amasanga meikong ache-in, chule akimvela amelmate akavamtai."},"4":{"text":"Akolphehon vannoi asalvah-in, leiset hin amun, akithing thinguve."},"5":{"text":"Leiset pumpi Pakai anga, Pakai anga chun, lhangho chu khoilu bangin ajol lhan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Vanhon achonphatna aphong doh-un, chule mijousen aloupina amuvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Alim semthu jenjouse le milima kison na nejouse lungdonguhen, nangho pathen jousen, Ama houvun."},"8":{"text":"Zion'in ajan akipah-in, chule vo Pakai nathutanlhah jeh-in Judah chanute athanomuve."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai, nangma leiset pumpi chunga chungnung pen nahin; pathen jouse chunga choisanga um nahi."},"10":{"text":"Pakai ngailu-a nanghon thilse hotbolun, aman amithengte hinna akheh doh-in, amaho chu migilouho khutna konin ahuhdoh-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Michonphate din kho ahungvah tan, milungdihho din kipana ahunglhung tai."},"12":{"text":"Michonpha ho Pakaiya kipah-un, chule athenna hetjingna-in ama-a thangvahna peuvin."}}},"98":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Oh, Pakai vahchoinan lathah saovin, ajehchu aman thilkidang tah aboltai; akhut jetlam le abantheng chun jona achansah tai.","title":"Ami huhhing na le Athutan Jeh-a Pakai Vahchoina la"},"2":{"text":"Pakaiyin ami huhhing na chu ahetsahtan; Pathen hephalouho mitmun achonphatna chu phongtah-in amusahtai."},"3":{"text":"Israel insung chunga amihepina le athutah chu ageldohtan; i-Pathen'u mihuhhing na chu leiset kolmong geija mijousen amusoh taovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Leiset pumpin Pakaiya kipana aw thonsah-un, aw gingtah-in sam unlang, kipah-un, chule vahchoi La saovin."},"5":{"text":"Selangdah tothon Pakaiya la saovin, selangdahle vahchoi awgin thouvin."},"6":{"text":"Sumkon binei le pengkulto thon lengpa, Pakai anga chun kipana aw thonsah un."},"7":{"text":"Twipi le asunga umjouse, vannoi leisetle asunga cheng jouse aodoh uhen."},"8":{"text":"Twisoh hon akhutnu benguhen, lhangho jouse thakhatnin Pakai masanga kipah uhen."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu ama leiset thutanna hungding ahin; chonphatna a vannoi chule khanggilou mite thu atanding ahi."}}},"99":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin lengvai apotai: Mitin kihot lhu hen, ama Cherub ho kah-a atouve; leiset kilinghen.","title":"Athenna Jeh-a Pakai Vahchoina","ref":"Pot 21:22."},"2":{"text":"Pakai chu Zion'a aloupin, chule mijouse chunga chungnung pen ahi."},"3":{"text":"Namin loupile gimneitah chu vahchoi uhen, ijeh inem itile hichu atheng ahi."},"4":{"text":"Lengpa thahatna jongchun thutanlhahna angailun, nangin adih chu naphut doh-in, Jacob henga chonphat na-in thutanna naboldoh-e."},"5":{"text":"Nanghon Pakai i-Pathen'u chu choi-an nun, chule akhophang bulla houvun; ijeh inem itile ama athengin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Athempuho lah-a Mosi le Aaron apangin, chule aman amina akouho lah-a Samuel apangin ahi; amahon Pakai akouvun, chule aman amaho chu adonbutnin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Meibang khompi-a konin ahenguva thu anaseijin, ahettoh sahho le ahoudan thuho amaho anapeh chu achingtupmun ahi.","ref":"Pot 33:9."},"8":{"text":"Vo Pakai ka Pathen nu, nangin amaho nana donbutnin; atohkhelnao chunga phu anala jongle chun, nangma amaho ngaidampa Pathen chu nahi."},"9":{"text":"Pakai i-Pathen'u chu choi-an nun, chule alhang thenga chun ama houvun, ajehchu Pakai i-Pathen'u chu athengin ahi."}}},"100":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangho gamjousen, Pakaiya kipa awgin thonsah-un,","title":"Amite Chunga Akitahna Jeh-a Pathen Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Kipahtah-in Pakai chu jennun, lasahto thon amasanga hunguvin."},"3":{"text":"Nanghon Pakai chu Pathen ahi ti heuvin, einasem uva chu ama ahin, eiho eiho-a tum ihipouve; eiho ama mitele ahamhing mun'a akelngoite chu ihiuve."},"4":{"text":"Thangvah pumin akotpi sunga lutnun, chule vahchoi pumin ahongsunga lutnuvin, ama thangvah unlang, amin vahchoijun."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai chu aphan, ahepina chu a-imatih chana umjing ahin; chule akitahna chu khangjouse geija umding ahi.","ref":"1 Thusm 16:34; 2 Thusm 5:13; 7:3; Ezra 3:11; Labu 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11."}}},"101":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hepinale thutanlhahna chu lan sange, Vo Pakai naheng-ah la sange.","title":"Pakai Kitahna Thutep"},"2":{"text":"Chamkimna lampia chingthei tah-in chon ingting; O itihle kahenga nahung ding ham? ka-insunga lungthim phachamkim in choninge."},"3":{"text":"Thil gilou poupou kamitmun koiponge; vahkoiho thilbol chu kahon, hichu keija umlou ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Lung gitlouna keija kona kiheimang ding; keiman khang gilou kahet louding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aheng akom guhthima seise-a chu kasuhmang ding; mi kiletsah le hoitho lungpu chu kathohthei louding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Keimatoh kachen khom theina dinguva, tahsan gamchu ngailutna mitna kavet ding; chamkimna lampia chepa chun, keima eijending ahi."},"7":{"text":"Lheplhahna thilbolla chu ka insunga chenglouding; jousei jong kamitmu-a umlou ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Thilgilou bolho jouse Pakai khopi-a kona kasuhmang theina dinga, gamsung migilouho jouse kasuhmang loiding ahi."}}},"102":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai kataona ngaijin lang, kakouna naheng hunglhung hen.","title":"Tonsotna Pakai Ngailutna"},"2":{"text":"Kalungkham nileh keija konin namai selmang danlang, keilam ngan nana hinsungin, nangma kakou nileh neidonbut loijin."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu kahin nikhoho hi meikhu bangin akitol mangin, chule kaguhohi thuhsunga mei bangin akan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kalunghi agentheijin hampa bangin agolhatan, ka changlhah nehding kasuhmil lotan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kahimsat husa gin jeh-in, kaguho jong kavunna abehchah gamtai."},"6":{"text":"Keima gamthipma vamuhsao bang kahitan nelgama sumbupi bang kahitai."},"7":{"text":"Kahah jingin, intingvuma pelpa changlhat bangbep kahitai."},"8":{"text":"Kamelma ten eihouse nilhum jiuvin, chule kachunga kingolsah ho keima dounan akihahsel jiuvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu vut hi changlhah bangin kanejin, chule kadon ding chu ka-na toh kachoh haljin,"},"10":{"text":"hichu nalung nopmo le nalunghan jeh ahi; ajehchu nangin neidom sangin chule neiseplhan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Kanikhoho jong le-lim kiheimang bep ahin, chule hampa bangin kagopjitai."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla Vo Pakai nangvang a-imatih chana umding nahin, chule nangma khang jouse-a kigeldoh jingding nahi."},"13":{"text":"Nangma thouvinnatin, Zion chunga hepina nanei ding; ajehchu ama lungsetna phat, henge, phat kitepsa chu ahunglhung tai."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu nasohte amanu songho-a chun alunglhaijun, chule chua leivui chu akhohsah-un ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chutia chu Pathen hephalouhon Pakai min chu agin diu, chule leiset lengho jousen naloupina chu agindiu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Pakaiyin Zion asahdoh tengle, aloupi na-a hungkilah ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aman milengvai ho taona angai ding, chule ataonao ngaisah louva akoi louding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hichehi khangkitna dinga kisun ding; chule ahung kisem ding miho chun Pakai chu avahchoidiu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ajehchu aman amuntheng sanga konin ahin vesuh-in, Pakaiyin van'a konin leihi ahinmui;"},"20":{"text":"Sohchangho himsatna ngaidingle, thidinga thu kitepsaho lhadohnadin;"},"21":{"text":"Zion'a Pakai min le Jerusalem'a ama pachatna chu phondohna dingin;"},"22":{"text":"Lenggam ho le mitin Pakai jenna dinga akikhopkhom tenguleh, hichu hiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Aman lamdunga kahatna asudoijin, kanikhoho asuchomin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Keiman, Vo ka Pathen, kahinna akimtuh in neilamang hih-in, nangma kumho chu khang jouse lhumkeija uma ahi, kati."},"25":{"text":"Leiset bul kingapna chu malaija nakoisa ahitan, chule vanho jong nakhutsoh ahi.","ref":"Heb 1:10-12."},"26":{"text":"Amaho mangthah diu ahin, ahinla nangvang umjing ding nahi, henge, amaho ponlui banga sesohdiu, von banga nangin amaho nakhela, chutia chu amaho kikheldiu ahitai."},"27":{"text":"Ahinla nangvang angai nahi jingin, nakumin jong kichaitih aneilouding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Nasohte chateho chu umjing uva, chule achilhahteu chu namasanga kitungdoh diu ahi."}}},"103":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo kalhagao, Pakai chu choi-an nin, chule kasunga umjousen amintheng choi-an nun.","title":"Pathen Hepina Jeh-a Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Vo kalhagao Pakai chu choi-an nin, chule aphatchom naho jouse sumil hih-in."},"3":{"text":"Nakhan gitlouna jouse ngaidama, nanatna jouse damsah-a,"},"4":{"text":"Nahinkho manthah na-a kona lhatdoh-a, ngailut phatna le hepina lal lukhuh banga nakhuh peh-a,"},"5":{"text":"Nakhang donlai muvanlai banga semthah ahina dinga, thilphaho-a nakamsung lunglhaisahpa chu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pakaiyin chonphatna atah langin, suhgentheija umho jouse dingin thu adih-in atan peh-e."},"7":{"text":"Aman alampiho Mosi henga ahetsah-in, anatohho Israel chate ahetsah-in ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pakai chu hepina le lungsetna-a dim, lunghangvah lou chule ngailutna-a dimset ahi.","ref":"Jac 5:11."},"9":{"text":"Aman phatjousen eiho eiphohjing pouvintin; chujongle a-itih in alunghana chingjing ponte."},"10":{"text":"Aman ichonsetnao bangin eibol pouvin, chujongle ikhan gitlounao dungjuijin jong eilethuh pouve."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu leisanga van asan banga, ama gingte chunga ahepina chubanga chu lena ahi."},"12":{"text":"Solam le lhumlam akigamlat banga, hichan gamla-a chu ikhan gitlounao eihoa kona achonmang ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Mipan achate akhoto banga, Pakaiyin ama gingte akhoto ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu aman ikisuhto dannu ahen, eiho leivuibou ihiu aman ageldoh jingin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Mihem vang, anikhoho chu hampa bangbou; jaova pahcha bangbep bou ahin, hitichun ahung khangin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu huijin achung ahin mutle amang gamin, chule aumna mun chun ahepha ji tapoi."},"17":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai hepina chu ama gingte chunga atonsot atonsot geija umding, chule achonphatna jong achateu chateho geija;"},"18":{"text":"Akitepna chingtupma, chule athupehho juidinga geldoh jingho chunga umding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Pakaiyin van ho-a alaltouna atungdoh-in, aleng gamin imajouse chunga vai apoi."},"20":{"text":"Nangho thahat chungnung nei, athupehho bola, a-thu ngaija avantil hon, Pakai chu vahchoijun."},"21":{"text":"Nangho ama janel ho, ama lhachaho, ama lunglhaina bolho jousen, Pakai chu vahchoijun."},"22":{"text":"A vaihomna muntina athilbolho jousen, Pakai vahchoijun. Vo kalhagao Pakai chu vahchoijin."}}},"104":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo kahinna, Pakai chu vahchoijin. Vo Pakai ka Pathen, naloupi lheh jengin, janale loupina-in nakijeme.","title":"Athilsem Leh Athilpeh Jeh-a Pakai Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Vanho pondal banga kaijal pan, khovah chu ponsil bangin naki sile."},"3":{"text":"A-in danho-a inkamho chu twilah-a ajama, meilhang ho kangtalai jin akiseme, hui lhavingho chunga vahle pa."},"4":{"text":"Avantilho lhagaoho sempa, alhachate jong meikong sosah jipa.","ref":"Heb 1:7."},"5":{"text":"Nangma tonsotna akichon lounadinga, leiset bulho anaphut detpa."},"6":{"text":"Nangman hichu thutah-in ponsil bangin nakhu khumin, twiho chu molsangho vuma akiting uve."},"7":{"text":"Nangman naphoh-in ahile amaho ajamun, na van ginho-a amaho ajammang loiji taove."},"8":{"text":"Amaho molsang ho-a akaltouvun, amaho dinga nagonpeh namun, phaicham ho-a chun achesuh jiuvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Leiset chupdinga ahungkile louna diuvin, ahin khelthei loudiu gamgi nasempeh-in ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aman lhang ho-a twisam longho chu, phaicham lama asolin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hicheho chun gama saho jouse donding apeuvin; gam sangan dangchah hon dangnou nan aneijuve."},"12":{"text":"Apang chu chungleng vachaten chenna-in aneijun, thingbah holah-a chun la saove."},"13":{"text":"Aman a-in danho-a konin lhangho achapnouvin, leiset hi nanatoh ga ho-a alunglhai uve."},"14":{"text":"Aman leisetna kona nehding akondoh nadingin; ganchaho dingin hampa akedoh sah-in, chule mihem neh dingin anche akesah-in;"},"15":{"text":"chule mihem lung kipasah lengpitwi, chule amaivahna ding thao, chule mihem lungthim hatsah-a changlhah jong ahinsodoh sah-in ahi."},"16":{"text":"Aman Lebanon'a Cedar thing aphuho; Pakai thingphung ho chu twi akichap nou jinge;"},"17":{"text":"Hia chun vachaten bu asaovin, twiva dingin vang chahthinglah chu a-in ahi."},"18":{"text":"Lhangsang ho chu gamkelcha ho ding ahin, jupi ho dingin songpiho chu kiselna ahi."},"19":{"text":"Phatbih hetnading lhathah aumsah-in, nisan alhum phat akihetne."},"20":{"text":"Muthim nasemin hichu jan ahin, hia chun gammanga sajouse ahung kitholdoh jiuve."},"21":{"text":"Keipi donglaihon asamat dingu akitum khumun, Pathen'a konin anehdiu akiholuve."},"22":{"text":"Nisa asoteng akikhom khomun, akulsung cheh uva akolji taove."},"23":{"text":"Miho chu natong dingin akon doh-un, nilhah kahsen na atong jiuvin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Vo Pakai nathilsem hohi iti tamma tam hitam! abonchauva chihna-a nasem ahin, leiset hi nahaona-a dimset ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chutia chu hiche twikhanglen lentahle jaotah hi uma, asunga akithol thoho simjoulou uma, ganhing alen le aneo agoma uma ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hia chun kong innei akitolin, chuche sunga kichem dinga nangin nasem Leviathan chu aume.","ref":"Job 4:1; Labu 74:14; Isai 27:1."},"27":{"text":"Hicheho jousen aphatcha a-an'u napeh theinadin, nangahcheh uvin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Napeh ho chu amahon akhom tupmun, nakhut najalin neh tuitah-in avaset uve."},"29":{"text":"Namai naselin alungkham jiuvin, ahaitheinau na lahmang peh-in, athi jiuvin chule leivuijin akileji taove."},"30":{"text":"Nalhagao nasoldoh-in amaho akisem doh jiuvin, chule leiset chunghi nasemthah kitjin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Pakai loupina chu tonsotnin umintin, Pakai chu athil bolho-a kipahding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Aman leiset chung aven ahile akihot jengin; lhangho atongkhan ahile mei akhun ahi."},"33":{"text":"Kahinlaisen Pakai henga la sangting, kahinpet nin ka Pathen vahchoi la sange."},"34":{"text":"Ama chung chang kangaito nahi ahenga lhumin tin, Pakaiya kipahding kahi."},"35":{"text":"Michonse ho chu leija konin suh mangin umhen, chule migilou ho umkit tahih uhen. Vo kahinna, Pakai chu choi-anin. Vahchoijun Pakai chu."}}},"105":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai henga thangvahna peuvin! aminin taovun; mihemte lah-a athilbol hetsah-un.","title":"Tonsotna Pakai Kitahna"},"2":{"text":"Ahenga la saovin, Ahenga vahchoi La saovin, athilkidang bol ho jouse thu kihoulimun."},"3":{"text":"Amintheng chu loupihen, Pakai holho lungsung kipahhen."},"4":{"text":"Pakai le ahatna holunlang, tanglouvin amai chu holjingun."},"5":{"text":"Akamsung thutan lhahho, athil kidangho, atohsa anatoh kidangho geldoh-un,"},"6":{"text":"Vo nangho Abraham chilhah asohte, alhentum nangho Jacob chaten sumil hih-un."},"7":{"text":"Amachu Pakai i-Pathen'u ahin, athutan lhahho chu leichung jouse-a aumme."},"8":{"text":"Atonsotnin akitepna ageldoh jingin, kum asang asang dinga aman anatep ahitan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Abraham toh asem kitepna, chule Isaac henga akitepna;","ref":"Semt 12:7; 17:8; 26:3."},"10":{"text":"Chule hiche mama chu Jacob dinga danthua din, Israel henga tonsot kitepna din asuhdetpehtan,","ref":"Semt 28:13."},"11":{"text":"Kanaan gamchu nachan ding gouva nahenga kapeh ding ahi ati;"},"12":{"text":"Amaho lhomcha bou anahiuvin; henge, lhomcha khat le khopem mi anahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Amaho nam khatna kona nam khatna, lenggam khatna kona midang henga achele laijun,"},"14":{"text":"Koiman jouva aboldiu aphalpon, amaho jeh-in lengho aphohsaljin;","ref":"Semt 20:3-7."},"15":{"text":"Kathaonupa chu tongkha hih-un, chule kathemgao ho susehih-un, ati."},"16":{"text":"Achung chonin chuche gama chun kel alhahsah-in; changkung jouse amanthahsah soh heltan ahi.","ref":"Semt 41:53-57."},"17":{"text":"Amasanguva mi khat asolmasan, sohdia kijoh-a Joseph chu ahin,","ref":"Semt 37:28; 45:5."},"18":{"text":"Akengho chu bullin asunaovin, thihkul sunga ahenun ahi.","ref":"Semt 39:20—40:23."},"19":{"text":"Ama thu aguilhun kahsen, Pakai thu chun ama apatepmin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Lengpan mi asolin alhadoh-in, miho vaihompatah chun agalha dohtai.","ref":"Semt 41:14."},"21":{"text":"Aman a-insung pakai jin apansah-in, chule aneijouse chunga vaihom din;","ref":"Semt 41:39-41."},"22":{"text":"Pipuiho chu anop nopma kan dingle, vaihomho chihna hil din apansah tai."},"23":{"text":"Israel jong chu Egypt'a ahungtan, Jacob chu Ham gama ahung jintan ahi.","ref":"Semt 46:6; 47:11."},"24":{"text":"Aman amite nasatah-in apunsah-in, amelmate sangin ahatsah jotai.","ref":"Pot 1:7-14."},"25":{"text":"Asohte doha thuhtah-a abolna dingun, aman alungu chu amite hotbol din aheimangpeh tai."},"26":{"text":"Aman asoh Mosi, chule amilhen Aaron chu anasolin ahi.","ref":"Pot 3:1—4:17."},"27":{"text":"Amanin amelchihnaho alah uva abol lhonin, chule thilkidang ho Ham gamsunga avetsah lhone."},"28":{"text":"Aman muthim asolin mu athimsahtan, chuin athu chu adou tapouvin ahi.","ref":"Pot 10:21-23."},"29":{"text":"Aman atwi hou thisan asosah-in, anga hou athat gamtai.","ref":"Pot 7:17-21."},"30":{"text":"Agamu chun uphoh tamtah ahin pendoh sah-in, leng teho indan sung geijin adimtan ahi.","ref":"Pot 8:1-6."},"31":{"text":"Thu aseile thousi jatchom chom tamtah ahungun, chule kha jong agamkol sungu ahung dimtan ahi.","ref":"Pot 8:16-17,20-24."},"32":{"text":"Aman amaho chu go khelin gel apen, chule agamuva meikou jengjung apen ahi.","ref":"Pot 9:22-25."},"33":{"text":"Aman alengpi guihoule atheichang phunghou jepna apen, agamkol sunguva thingphung ho amanthahsah gamheltai."},"34":{"text":"Aman thu aseile khaokhoho ahunguvin, khaokho noute simjoulou ahungdoh uvin,","ref":"Pot 10:12-15."},"35":{"text":"Chuin agamsung uva hampa louhing jouse anejouvun, aleisetnu theiga jouse anechai taovin ahi."},"36":{"text":"Aman agamsung uva athahatna jouse bulpi, apengmasa jouse jongchu asumang heltan ahi.","ref":"Pot 12:29."},"37":{"text":"Aman amaho sana le dangka pumin ahinpui doh-in, aphung sunguva chun achatmo khatcha aumpoi.","ref":"Pot 12:33-36."},"38":{"text":"Amaho apotdoh uva chun Egypt akipah-e; ajehchu amaho kichatna chu achunguva chu-ah ahitai."},"39":{"text":"Akhu diuvin meilhang apha jal-in, janteng asalvah diuvin meikong apen ahi.","ref":"Pot 13:21-22."},"40":{"text":"Mipi hochun athumun, vengke ahinpen, van changlhah-in alungu alhaisah tai.","ref":"Pot 16:2-15."},"41":{"text":"Songpi ahonle, twi ahung kikhodoh-in, gamgo munho-a vadung lonin alongin ahi.","ref":"Pot 17:1-7; Minb 20:2-13."},"42":{"text":"Ajehchu aman athutep thengtah le, asoh Abraham chu ageldoh jing ahi."},"43":{"text":"Amite thanom tah-in ahin puidoh-in, chule amilhenho kipahtah-in apuidoh-e."},"44":{"text":"Aman Pathen hephalou te gam chu amaho apen; amahon chua miho tohdohsa chu alotauve;","ref":"Josh 11:16-23."},"45":{"text":"Chutia chu amahon achondan kisemho ajuijuva, adan thupeh ho anit nadiuva apeh ahi. Pakai chu vahchoijun."}}},"106":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu vahchoijun. Oh, aphatna jeh-in Pakai chu thangvahna peuvin; ajehchu amihepina tonsotna umjing ahi.","title":"Israel Chonsetna Kingaidam Jeh-a Kipana","ref":"1 Thusm 16:34; 2 Thusm 5:13; 7:3; Ezra 3:11; Labu 100:5; 107:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11."},"2":{"text":"Pakai natoh thahatna chu kon seithei jintem? Avahchoina jouse kon aphondoh jouding ham?"},"3":{"text":"Thutandih tuhchah-a chule phat tinna chonphatna bolho chu anunnom ahiuve."},"4":{"text":"O Pakai, namite chunga nanei lungsetna-a chun neigeldoh jingin, O nahuhhing nan neivilin,"},"5":{"text":"Chutile nami lhentumte hamphatna kamuthei ding, namite kipana-a kathanop thei ding, nagou chan toh kaloupi ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Kapu kapateu toh kana chonseuvin, kana khang gilouvun, kana khanse taove."},"7":{"text":"Kapu kapa teuvin Egypt'a nathil kidangho ana hethei pouvin; nahepina tamtah chu ageldoh pouvin, amavang twipi le twipi san ngeija chun ama ana lungsat sah taovin ahi.","ref":"Pot 14:10-12."},"8":{"text":"Hijeng jongle athil boltheina loupitah chu hetdoh ahina din; amin jal-in amaho chu ana huhdoh-e."},"9":{"text":"Twipisan jongchu apho-in ahile akang tan; chutichun amaho chu gamthip laija apui bangin, twi thuhtah-a chun apui galkai tai.","ref":"Pot 14:21-31."},"10":{"text":"Ahotbolteu khutna konin ahuhdoh-in, melma khutna konin alhatdoh-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuche twi chun amelmateu achupmin; khatcha asohcha aum pouve."},"12":{"text":"Chujouvin athu chu atahsanun, ama vahchoi la asaove.","ref":"Pot 15:1-21."},"13":{"text":"Anatohho asumil loijun; athumop chu angah tapouvin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Gamthipma chun tahsa ngaichatnin adimun, nelphaija chun Pathen apatep taovin ahi.","ref":"Minb 11:4-34."},"15":{"text":"Chuin athil thumu apen, ahivangin asunguvah gamna hise alansah in ahi."},"16":{"text":"Amahon gebuh sunga Mosi, chule Pakai mitheng Aaron jong chu athangset taovin ahileh;","ref":"Minb 16:1-35."},"17":{"text":"Leiset akhikeh-in Dathan aval lhumin, Abiram loiho akhukhum tai."},"18":{"text":"Aloi lah uva mei ahung kadoh-in, meikong chun migilouho chu akalihtai."},"19":{"text":"Amahon Horeb'a akilhajol bongnou lim asemun, alim semthu uchu ahou taove.","ref":"Pot 32:1-14."},"20":{"text":"Chutobang chun aloupinao chu bongchal hampane bangbepmin akhel taovin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Egypt'a thil loupitah tah bola Pathen, ahuhhingpao chu asumil taovin;"},"22":{"text":"Ham gama thilkidang tahtah le, twipisana kichat umtah bolpa chu asumil taovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hijeh chun mipi chu sumang khante tia alunghana heimang dinga alhentum Mosi chu amasanga chu akah uva ding louva hile, amaho chu sumang tange anati ahitai."},"24":{"text":"Henge, amahon gam nomtah chu i-sah louvin abulun, athu chu atahsan pouve.","ref":"Minb 14:1-35."},"25":{"text":"Ahivangin apon in sunguva aphunchel uvin, Pakai aw chu angai pouvin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hijeh chun gamthip laija amaho suhlhuhna dingin, amaho dounan akhut alam tan,"},"27":{"text":"Achilhahteu jong namtin lah-a asuhlhuh nadingle, namtin lah-a athecheh nadinga akhut alap ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 26:33."},"28":{"text":"Amaho Peor mun'a baal lama abeh-un, athiho dinga ganlhaina kibol chu anetaove.","ref":"Minb 25:1-13."},"29":{"text":"Chutichun anatohho uva chun ama aphinseuvin, chule achunguva hise alengtai."},"30":{"text":"Chujouvin Phinehas adingdoh-in thu atantan; chuin hise chu atangtan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Hichu ama dingin a-imatih chana khang jouse-a dingin chonphatna-a sim ahitai."},"32":{"text":"Kinahna twiphunga jong chun alunghan sah-un, chutichun amaho jeh-in Mosi chunga thilse alhunlo helin;","ref":"Minb 22:2-13."},"33":{"text":"Alhagao aphinset jeh-un, akamin thilsetah anaseitan ahi."},"34":{"text":"Pakaiyin amaho thu apeh bangun, amahon namho chu anasumang pouve.","ref":"Thutn 2:1-3; 3:5-6."},"35":{"text":"Ahivangin Pathen hephalouho toh akihalun, athil bolhou chu ajil jotaovin ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chule amilimhou chu ajenun, hichu amaho dingin thang ahung hitai."},"37":{"text":"Henge, amaho thilha henga achapateu le achanuteu chu ganlhai thilto dingin apedoh-un,","ref":"2 Leng 17:17."},"38":{"text":"monabei thisan, achapateule achanuteu thisantah chu asouvin, hicheho-a chun Canaan milimho henga akilhaijun; chuche gam chu thisana suhboh-in aumtan ahi.","ref":"Minb 35:33."},"39":{"text":"Chutichun anatohtah uchun akisuboh-un, athil boldoh uva chun noti'n apang taovin ahi."},"40":{"text":"Hichejeh-a chu Pakai lung hanna chu amite chunga meikou banga anakou doh-a, chubang tah-a agoulote tah chu athet ahitai.","ref":"Thutn 2:14-18."},"41":{"text":"Chuin amaho chu Pathen hephalouho khutna apedoh-in, ahotbolteu chun achunguva vai ahomtai."},"42":{"text":"Amelmateu jongchun asugentheijun, akhut noijuva suhnemin aum taovin ahi."},"43":{"text":"Amaho chu avel velin anahuhdoh-in, ahinla alung ngaitouvin alunghan sah-un, khangitlouna jeh-in suhnemin aumjiuve."},"44":{"text":"Hijeng jongle aka-u ajah jiteng, ahesohnau akhohsah jin;"},"45":{"text":"Akitepna chu amahodin ageldohjin, ahepina hao dungjuijin alung aheijitai."},"46":{"text":"Sohchanga akaihou jouse jong chun amaho akhotosah-un ahi."},"47":{"text":"O Pakai ka Pathen'u, neihuhhing un, chule namin theng thangvah dingle navahchoi na-a galjou dingin, Pathen hephalouho lah-a konin neipui khom un.","ref":"1 Thusm 16:35-36."},"48":{"text":"Pakai Israel Pathen chu tonsotnapat tonsot geijin vahchoijin umhen: chule mijousen, Amen, tiuhen. Pakai chu vahchoijun."}}},"107":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"O aphatna jeh-in Pakai henga thangvahna peuvin, ajehchu ahepina a-imatih chanin aum jingin ahi.","title":"Ami Huhdohna Loupitah Jeh-a Pathen Thangvahna","ref":"1 Thusm 16:43; 2 Thusm 5:13; 7:3; Ezra 3:11; Labu 100:5; 106:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11."},"2":{"text":"Melmaho khutna kona alhatdoh, Pakai lhatdamsaten hitichun seijuhen;"},"3":{"text":"chule gamtin solam le lhumlam, sahlam le lhanglama konin amaho kikhomuhen."},"4":{"text":"Amaho gamthip mi chekhah louna lampia avahleuvin, chenna ding khopi khatcha amu pouve."},"5":{"text":"Gilkel le dang chah-in, asunguva ahinnao alhasamtai."},"6":{"text":"Chuphatnin Pakai henga lungkhamin ataovun, aman ahesoh naova konin anahuhdoh tai."},"7":{"text":"Mi chenna khopi-a achetheina diuvin, lampi dih-a apuijin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Mihemte hin mihem chate henga, aphatna jehle athil kidang bolho jeh hin Pakai chu vahchoi taveleu, o!"},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu aman lhagao ngaichat alunglhai sahjin, lhagao gilkel an pha phan avahvajin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Muthim le thina le-lima touva, suhgentheina le thihkhaova kihenho chu,"},"11":{"text":"ajehchu amahon Pathen thu douna-a gol akeh-un, chungnung pen thuhil anahsah pouve."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun alungu tohgimna-in ason kun-in, apanpidiu khatcha aumpon, alhasuh taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chutengle lungkhamin Pakai henga apengun, aman ahesoh naova konin ahuhdoh jin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Aman muthima konle thina lima konin apuidoh in, chule akihen nahou chu asuchip jin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Mihemte hin mihem chate henga, aphatna jehle athil kidang bolho jeh hin Pakai chu vahchoi taveleu, o!"},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu aman sum-eng kotpiho aphusen, thih banggolho asatkhen tan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mingol ho chu asuhkhel nao jehle, akhanset jeh uvin suhgentheijin aumuvin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ahin naovin an jatjouse atheuvin, chule thina kotpiho lam chu anai jiuvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chutengle lungkhamin Pakai henga apengun, aman ahesoh naova konin ahuhdoh jin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ama thu asolin, amaho asudamjin, amanthah naova konin ahuhdoh jin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Mihemte hin mihem chate henga, aphatna jehle athil kidang bolho jeh hin Pakai chu vahchoi taveleu, o!"},"22":{"text":"Amahon thangvahna ganlhaina-in ganlhaina neiju henlang, athilbolho chu thanom tah-in phongjal uhen."},"23":{"text":"Twikhanglen lama kong inneija chesuh-a, twipi nasatah chunga sumkolvei ho,"},"24":{"text":"Amahon Pakai thilbolho le, twi thuhtah sunga athilkidang bolho chu amuvin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ajehchu aman thu apeh leh huile go nasatah ahung kithojin, hichun twipi kinong chu adomsang jin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hicheho chu van lama akinongtou jin, twi thuhtah-a akumsuh kitjin; ahinnao lungkham jeh-in ajunlha jitai."},"27":{"text":"Suhle tungin akipeijun, jukham bangin alon lele uvin, achihnao kichaina-a um ahitaove."},"28":{"text":"Chutengle lungkhamin Pakai henga apengun, aman ahesoh naova konin ahuhdoh jin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Aman huile go athipsah-in, chutichun twipi kinongchu atangtan ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin athiptah jehchun akipah-un, chutichun adeinau kaimun geichun apui lhungtan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Mihemte hin mihem chate henga, aphatna jehle athil kidang bolho jeh hin Pakai chu vahchoi taveleu, o!"},"32":{"text":"Amahon amachu mipi kikhom lah-a jong choisangu henlang, upaho kikhopna-a ama chu vahchoi uhen."},"33":{"text":"Aman vadungho gamthip asosah-in, twisamho tolgo asosah-in;"},"34":{"text":"Asunga chengho khangitlou jeh-in, gam phalai chu gamtem asosoh tan ahi."},"35":{"text":"Aman gamthip chu twikul asosah-in, tolgolai chu twinah putna asosah jin ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chenna ding khopi akigon theina diuvin, chua chun gilkelho achensah-in;"},"37":{"text":"Chule ga tamtah punsah dingin, lou aboluvin, chule lengpithei aphut uvin ahi."},"38":{"text":"Amaho nasatah-a apuntheina dingun phatthei jong aboh-in, aganchahou akemsuhsah nompoi."},"39":{"text":"Avelin, amaho suhgentheina, hesohna, chule lungdona jeh-in, amuisuh tultulun suhnemin aumuve."},"40":{"text":"Aman lengchapate chunga noisena abunglhan, lampi kamhel gamthipma avale sahtai."},"41":{"text":"Ahinla gentheiho chu hesohna-a konin munsanga akoijin, kelngoihon tobangin insung asempeh-in ahi."},"42":{"text":"Michonpha hon hichu amu uva kipah diu, chule khan gitlouna jousen akam akihup diu ahi."},"43":{"text":"Michingho jousen hiche hohi anit dingu, chule Pakai mingailut khotona chu ahet dingu ahi."}}},"108":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pathen, kalunghi adetne; keiman la sangting navahchoi jinge, kaloupina jengin jong.","title":"Melmate Douna-a Kon Panpina Ngeh-a Taona (Labu 57:7-11 ; 60:5-12)"},"2":{"text":"Tumging le selangdah ho khangun, keiman thingjangvah chu sukhang inge."},"3":{"text":"O Pakai mipi lah-a nangma vahchoi jingting, namtin lah jenga jong nangma vahchoi la sange."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu nahepina vanho sangin asangjon, nakitahna chun meibol holah aphan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pakai nangma vanho chungvuma choisangin umin; chule naloupina chu leiset pumpi chungvuma umhen."},"6":{"text":"Nami ngailut ho chu huhdoh-a aumtheina dingin, nakhut jet lamin neihuhhing in lang, nei donbutnin."},"7":{"text":"Keima kipah ingting, Shechem chu kahop khending, chule Succoth phaicham katedoh ding ahi, tin Pathen'in athenna-in anaseije."},"8":{"text":"Gilead keija ahin, Manasseh jong keija ahi; Ephraim jonghi kalu thahatna ahin, Judah hi kadanthu pepa ahi;"},"9":{"text":"Moab kakisilna bel ahin, Edom chunga ka kengkoh kaselhah ding, Philistine chunga jona kanei ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Khopi dettah-a koiham eipuilut dinga? Koijin Edom sunga eipuilut ding ham?"},"11":{"text":"Vo Pathen, eipaidoh uva nang nahi hilou ham? Vo Pathen, kajanel houtoh nakondoh khom hilou ham?"},"12":{"text":"Lungkham na-a konin neipanpi uvin, ajehchu mihem panpina chu pannabei ahi."},"13":{"text":"Pathen jal-in hangtah-in pangu vinge, ajehchu kagalteo chotphading ama ahi."}}},"109":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kavahchoi jing, vo Pathen, neithipsan hih-in;","title":"Mihehse te Chunga Thutana Ngeh-a Taona"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu kei douna-in mi khang gilouhole mi lhemlha ho akamkaovin; aleijun keima dounan jou aseijun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amahon hotna thun eium kimvelun, ajeh beijin eikisat piuve."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu kangailut amaho kamelman apangun, ahinla keima taona lama kakipen ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amahon phatna chu setna-in, ngailutna chu hotnan eilethuh taovin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ama chunga mikhang gilou koijin lang, akhut jet lama Satan dinghen."},"7":{"text":"Athu kitan tengle themmo chansah inlang, ataona chu chonset soh hen."},"8":{"text":"Ahin nikho lhom henlang, anatohna mun midang changhen.","ref":"Sol 1:20."},"9":{"text":"Achate pabei hiuhenlang, ajinu meithai hihen."},"10":{"text":"Achate chu tanglouva vahveile khutdo hiuhenlang, mun gohkeoho-a chun changlhah kihol uhen."},"11":{"text":"Hunam thilchom hon aneijouse lahpeh hen, gamchom min atohgimga kichomhen."},"12":{"text":"Ahenga hepina musah koimacha umhih hen, pabei chate lainatpi ding jong umda hen."},"13":{"text":"Aphattheina suhtanin umhen lang, khang hunglhung dinga aminu noimangin umhen."},"14":{"text":"Apateu khan gitlouna Pakai anga geldoh-in umhen, chule anu chonset noimangin umhih hen."},"15":{"text":"Leisetna kona amaho hetjingna asuhtan theina dingin, amaho Pakai anga umjomjing taohen."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu hepina musah ding geltah sangin, vaicha lhasam abol gentheijin, aman alunghesohho jong chu athatnin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mi gaosap ding adeibang chun, hichu amachunga chuhen, phattheiboh adeilou bangin, hichu ama-a konin gamlahen."},"18":{"text":"Ponsil banga gaosapna akivon ahin, chutichun hichu a-oi sunga twi bangin luthen, chule agu sunga thao bangin luthen."},"19":{"text":"Hichu amadin akikhu khum ponsil bangin umhen lang, akigah jing konggah dingin umjing tahen."},"20":{"text":"Hichu Pakaiya kona kamelmate leh, kahinna douna-a thuse seiho lethuhna hihen."},"21":{"text":"Ahinla vo Pakai Pathen, namin jal-in neibol peh-in, ajehchu nahepina aphat jeh-in neihuh doh-in."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu keima vaichale lhasam kahin, kalung thim hi mavo-a uma ahitai."},"23":{"text":"Keima le-lim kiheimang banga chemanga kahitan; khaokhopi banga chungle noija kipeile kahitai."},"24":{"text":"An ngol jal-in kakhup angoijin, kasa hin thaona apu tapoi."},"25":{"text":"Keima jengjong amaho i-sah louvin kaumtan; eiveovin alu eithinkhum jiuvin ahi.","ref":"Matt 27:39; Mrk 15:29."},"26":{"text":"Vo Pakai ka Pathen, neipanpin, nami hepina dungjuijin neihuhhing in."},"27":{"text":"Hichehi nakhut ahi ti amahon ahet theijuva, Pakai, nangman nabol ahi, ti ahetna diu ahi."},"28":{"text":"Amahon gaosap muhen, ahinla nangin phatthei boh-in, amaho ahungtho tengule, jahchao hen, ahinla nalhachapa kipahhen."},"29":{"text":"Eidouho chu jachatna-in kivon henlang, sangkhol len ah bangin akisuhdong naova kikhu khumu hen."},"30":{"text":"Keiman kakamin Pakai chu nasatah-in vahchoi jinge, henge, mipi lah-a amachu ka vahchoi ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ajehchu ahinna themmo chansahho-a kona huhdoh dinga, ama migenthei ho jetlama ding ding ahi."}}},"110":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin ka Pakai hengah, namelmate nakeng chotpha-a kaneisah masangsen, kajetlama toujingin, ati.","title":"Messiah Lengvaipoh Ding Kiphondoh","ref":"Matt 22:44; Mrk 12:36; Luk 20:42-43; Sol 2:34-35; 1 Cor 15:25; Eph 1:20-22; Col 3:1.  ; Heb 1:13; 8:1; 10:12-13"},"2":{"text":"Pakai chun Zion'a kona nathahatna mol lhon chu ahinsolding ahi. Na melmate lah-a vaihomin."},"3":{"text":"Jingkah naobu-a kona thenna hoinaho-a, namite chu natha neina nikho-a kiphal tah-a kipedoh diu ahi, nangman nakhang donlai daitwi chu naneije."},"4":{"text":"Pakai chu akihahseltan, alung akhel kit louding ahi; Nangma Melchizedec banga tonsot thempu nahi.","ref":"Heb 5:6; 6:20; 7:17,21."},"5":{"text":"Pakai nakhut jetna umchun, alunghan nikho leh lengho chu avoh lhuhding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Aman Pathen hephalouho lah-a thu tan intin, munjouse chu thilonga adipsetna, gam tamtah luchangho chu amavoding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aman lampi dunga vachadung twi adonding, hijeh-a chu aman luchang chu adopsang ding ahi."}}},"111":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu vahchoijun; Mi kitah ho kikhopnale mipi kikhomho lah-a, kalung pumpin Pakai chu vahchoi jinge.","title":"Akitahjeh Leh Athutandih Jeh-a Pathen Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Pakai thilbolho chu alenin, chule akipah hon hihochu akholdoh sohkeijuve."},"3":{"text":"Athilbol chu ja umtahle loupitah ahin, achonphatna chu tonsotna umjing ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aman athil kidang bolho chu geldoh jing dingin asemin; Pakai chu lungset them le lainatna-a dimset ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ama gingho anneh apejin, akitepna chu tonsotna ahet jingding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pathen hephalouho gouchu amaho apeh theinadin, anatoh thaneije amite amusahtai."},"7":{"text":"Akhutna anatohho thutah le thutandih ahin, athupeh jouse chu atahbeh ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hicheho chu tonsot atonsotna din dettah-in ading jingin, chuleh hicheho chu thutah le chondih na-a tohdoh-a um ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aman amite henga lhatdamna ahinsolin, akitepna chu tonsotnadin thupeh apen, amin chu atheng le ja um ahi."},"10":{"text":"Pakai ginhi chihna kipatna ahi; athupeh bolho jousen hetthemna phatah aneijun, ama thangvahna chu tonsotnin aumjinge.","ref":"Job 28:28; Thuch 1:7; 9:10."}}},"112":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu vahchoijin umhen. Pakai ginga chule athupehho jouse-a kipah-a michu anunnom ahi.","title":"Michonpha ho Nunnomna"},"2":{"text":"Leichunga achilhahte hung hatdiu, mikitah ho khang chu phattheiboh changding ahi."},"3":{"text":"A-insunga neile gou le haona umding, achonphatna chu imatih chana umding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Mikitah ho dingin muthim lah jenga jong kho avahjin; ama lungset them, milainatpina dimset le chonphatah ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mipha chun mi asulunglhaijin, thilpha ahomin; chingtheitah-a akhosahdan akivetphat ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tahbeh-a ama a-imatih chana longlou ding; michonpha chu atonsotna hetna umjing ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aman thuse akichat louhel ding; alung adetnin, Pakai atahsanin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Alungthim kiphut detna ahin, amelmate chunga angaichat amukahse-a, ama kichalou ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Aman athe jal-in, mivaichate apen, achonphatna chu a-imatih chana umjing ding; aki chu jabolna-a choisanga umding ahi.","ref":"2 Cor 9:9."},"10":{"text":"Migilouvin hichu muntin lungkham ding, aha agela, junmang ding ahi; migilou ngaichat chu mangthah ding ahi."}}},"113":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu vahchoijin umhen; Vo Pakai sohten vahchoijun, nanghon Pakai minchu vahchoijun.","title":"Pathen Phatna Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Tua patnin tonsot geijin Pakai min chu nunnom hen."},"3":{"text":"Niso apat nilhum geijin Pakai min chu vahchoijin umhen."},"4":{"text":"Pakai chu namjouse chunga asangpen ahin, aloupina chu van ho jouse chungvuma uma ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chungsanga cheng Pakai i-Pathen'u tobang koi umma,"},"6":{"text":"van'a leh leija thil umho vedinga, ama tobanga kineosah jeng koi umintem!"},"7":{"text":"Leivuija konin mivaicha akaithouvin, alhasamho vutbol lah-a konin aphong dingin;"},"8":{"text":"Chutia chu pipuiho toh, amite lah-a pipuiho ngeitoh atou khomsah thei nading ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chate neija minu kipahtah bangin, aman numei ching chu in apen ahi. Pakai chu vahchoijin umhen."}}},"114":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt'a kona Israel ahungpot doh-u, chule paomah ho-a kona Jacob insung mite apotlai chun,","title":"Israel Huhdohna-a Pathen Thahatna","ref":"Pot 12:15."},"2":{"text":"Judah chu amuntheng anahin, Israel chu alenggam anahi."},"3":{"text":"Twikhanglen'in hichu amun, ajam mangin, Jordan alelon kit tai.","ref":"Pot 14:21; Josh 3:16."},"4":{"text":"Molsangho chu kelngoichal bangin akichomun, lhangneohochu kelngoinou bangin akichomuvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vo nang twikhanglen, ipi nathohlela najam mang ham? Nang Jordan, ijeh-a nalelon kit ham?"},"6":{"text":"Nangho molsangho kelngoichal banga, chule nangho lhang neoho kelngoinou banga idia nakichopmu ham?"},"7":{"text":"Nang leiset, Pakai Jacob Pathen anga chun kithingin,"},"8":{"text":"Songpi twikul'a heidoh thei, meituh song twinah sosah thei Pathen ahi.","ref":"Pot 17:1-7; Minb 20:2-13."}}},"115":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keiho heng hilouvin, vo Pakai keiho heng hilouvin, amavang nami hepina le nathutah jal-in nangma minin loupina pen.","title":"Milim Pannabei Ahidan Leh Pathen Tahsan Aumdan"},"2":{"text":"Ibola Pathen hephalouten, a-Pathen'u tu-a hoiba hitam? atiu ham?"},"3":{"text":"Ahinla i-Pathen'u van ho-a uma ahin, aman adeichan abol ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amilimu chu dangka le sana ahin, mihemho khutsoh ahi.","ref":"Labu 135:15-18; Tph 9:20."},"5":{"text":"Amahon kam aneijun, apaothei pouvin; mit aneijun, ahinla kho amupouve."},"6":{"text":"Amahon bil aneijun, ahinla ajapouvin; nah aneijun, ahinla imacha nam ajapouve."},"7":{"text":"Amahon khut aneijun, imala akhoithei pouvin; keng aneijun, achethei pouvin, alolhomuva konin jong apaothei pouve."},"8":{"text":"Amaho semho chu amaho bangbep ahin; amaho tahsan chan jong chutichu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Vo Israel, Pakai chu tahsanun, ama chu apanpiule alumdalu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Vo Aaron insung mite, Pakai chu tahsanun, ama chu apanpiule alumdalu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pakai ging nanghon, Pakai chu tahsanun, amachu apanpiule alumdallu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Pakaiyin eikhohsah jingun phatthei eibohdiu ahi; Aman Israel insung phatthei abohding, aman Aaron insung phatthei abohding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aman Pakai gingho chu alen aneo agoma phatthei abohding ahi.","ref":"Tph 1:18; 19:5."},"14":{"text":"Pakaiyin nangho hapuna napunsahdiu, chule nachateo apunsah chehdiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nangho chu vanle leiset sem, Pakai phattheiboh nahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Vanle vanho tah chu Pakaiya ahin, leiset vanghi mihem chate anapeh ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mithin Pakai avahchoipon, thipchetna chesuh-in jong avahchoipoi."},"18":{"text":"Ahivangin eihonvang tua pat tonsot geijin Pakai chu vahchoi ute. Pakai chu vahchoijun."}}},"116":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keiman Pakai kangailui; ajehchu aman ka aw leh kataona eijahpeh tan ahi.","title":"Thina-a Kon Huhdoh Jeh-a Thangvahna"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu aman kahenglama ana asungin, hijeh-a chu kahin laise-a ama kakoujing ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Thina lung gentheina-in eium kimvelin, thilkholkhul thohlel nahon eimanin, lungkhamna le lungdonna katoh-in ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman Pakai min kakouvin, vo Pakai, kangeh nahi, kahinna huhhingin, kati."},"5":{"text":"Pakai chu lungset themle chonphatah ahi; henge, i Pathen'u hi hepina-a dim ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pakaiyin milhamho ahoitupmin, keima eiki sunem in, ahin aman eipanpie."},"7":{"text":"Vo kahinna nacholngahna-a kiletan, ajehchu Pakaiyin naning lhinsah tan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu nangin kahinkho thina-a kon, kamit mitlhi-a kon, chule kakeng jong lhahmangna-a konin, nahuhdoh tan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing gamsunga chu, Pakai masanga kavale ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Keiman katahsanin, hijeh-a chu kasei ahi, nasatah-a bolgenthei kanahi.","ref":"2 Cor 4:12."},"11":{"text":"Mijouse hi ajouve, tin kana seiloi chelle."},"12":{"text":"Keidinga aphatchom naho jeh-a, Pakai chu ipi kapeh ding hitam?"},"13":{"text":"Huhhingna khon chu domsang ingting, Pakai minchu kou ing kate."},"14":{"text":"Tun amite jouse masanga, Pakaiya kakitepna ho jouse peng kate."},"15":{"text":"Pakai mitmu-a amithengte thichu manlutah ahi."},"16":{"text":"Vo Pakai keima nasoh tahbeh kahi, nasohnu chapa nasohpa kahin, kakihen naho neisutlhah peh tai."},"17":{"text":"Thangvahna chu kilhaina bangin nahenga toh ingting, Pakai minchu kouvinge."},"18":{"text":"Tun amite jouse angsunga, Pakai inpi hongsunga,"},"19":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem, nalailung laitah-a, Pakai henga kakitepna chu kapeh ding ahi, Pakai chu vahchoijun."}}},"117":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Oh, namtin jousen, Pakai chu vahchoijun, mijousen ama vahchoijun.","title":"Nam jousen Pathen Vahchoi uhen","ref":"Rom 15:11."},"2":{"text":"Ahepi lungsetna ichunguva aletjeh-in, chule Pakai thutah chu tonsotna umjing ahi. Pakai chu vahchoijun."}}},"118":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu aphat jeh-in, thangvahna peovin, ajehchu ahepina a-imatih chana umjing ahi.","title":"Atonsot Hepina Jala Pathen Vahchoina","ref":"1 Thusm 16:34; 2 Thusm 5:13; 7:3; Ezra 3:11; Labu 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11."},"2":{"text":"Ahepina a-imatih chana umjing ahi, tin Israel'in tun seijuhen."},"3":{"text":"Ahepina imatih chana umjing ahi tin, tun Aaron insung miten seijuhen."},"4":{"text":"Ahepina a-imatih chana umjing ahi tin, tun Pakai gingten seijuhen."},"5":{"text":"Pakai chu lung gentheijin kakouvin, Pakaiyin eidon butnin mun lentah-a eikoije."},"6":{"text":"Pakai chu keilama pang ahin, keima kicha ponge, mihemin i-eilo thei ding ham?","ref":"Heb 13:6."},"7":{"text":"Pakai chu keimale eipanpi hoto pangkhom ahin; hijeh-a chu eihot bolte chunga kalungtup kamuding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Mihem'a kingai sangin, Pakaiya tahsan ngap aphajoi."},"9":{"text":"Pipuho-a kingai sangin, Pakaiya tahsan ngap aphajoi."},"10":{"text":"Nam jousen keima eiumkim velun; ahivanga keiman Pakai mina amaho kasuhmang ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amahon eiumchah taove, henge, amahon eiumchah taove; ahivanga keiman Pakai mina amaho kasuhmang ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Khoi bangin eitomchah un, meisi lingnei banga suhmit ahiuve; ajehchu keiman Pakai mina amaho kasuhmang ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nangin kalhuhna dingin hatah-in neihin sonin; ahinla Pakaiyin eikithopin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Pakai chu kathahatna le kala ahin, ama kahuhhingpa ahung hitai.","ref":"Pot 15:2; Isai 12:2."},"15":{"text":"Kipanale huhhingna aw ginchu, michonpha houbuho-a chun aumin; Pakai khutjet nin hangsan tah-in aboljin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Pakai khutjet chu choisangin aumtan, Pakai khutjet nin hangsan tah-in aboljin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Keima thilouva kahin ding, chule Pakai thilbolho chu kaphondoh ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Pakaiyin eisehgim behsehtan; hinla thinagei lomin eina pedohpon ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chonphatna kotpiho chu neihon peh-in, asunguva lutning ting, Pakai chu vahchoi jinge."},"20":{"text":"Hichehi michonpha lut nading, Pakai kotpi ahin."},"21":{"text":"Nangma vahchoi jinge, ajehchu nangman neingaipeh-in, kahuhhingpu nahunghitai."},"22":{"text":"In sahon anot thapmu song chu, inning songpi penin ahung pangtai.","ref":"Luk 20:17; Sol 4:11; 1 Pet 2:7."},"23":{"text":"Hichehi Pakai thilbol ahin, imitnuva kidangtah ahi.","ref":"Matt 21:42; Mrk 12:10-11."},"24":{"text":"Hichehi Pakai sem nikho chu ahin, hichea hi ikipa thanop diu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tun huhhingin, vo Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, vo Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, tun phattheina hinsolin.","ref":"Matt 21:9; Mrk 11:9; Jhn 12:13."},"26":{"text":"Pakai mina hungpa chu anun nome, Pakai in'a konin phatthei kahinboh uve.","ref":"Matt 21:9; 23:39; Mrk 11:9; Luk 13:35; 19:39; Jhn 12:13."},"27":{"text":"Pathen hi vah eimusah-u Pakai chu ahi; ganlhaina chu maicham kiho-a khao ho-a chun henuvin."},"28":{"text":"Nangma ka Pathen nahin kavahchoi ding nahi; nangma ka Pathen nahin kachoi sang ding nahi."},"29":{"text":"Oh, aphatjeh-in Pakai chu thangvah un, ajehchu ahepina a-imatih chana umjing ahi."}}},"119":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lamlhah-a kisubohlou, Pakai danthua chonpa chu anunnom ahi.","title":"Pakai Danthu"},"2":{"text":"Ahettohsah naho tuhdetna, chule lungthim pumpi-a ama holla chu anunnom ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amahon khangitlou jong abol pouvin, ama lamlhah-a chun acheuvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chingthei tah-a nachon danho nitdingin, nangin thupeh neipeuvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nachon danho kajuina dinga kachon dingdan eikihila hitavele o!"},"6":{"text":"Nathupeh jouse kajabol tengle keima jahcha taponge."},"7":{"text":"Nachon phatna thutan naho kakihil tengle, lungtheng tah-a kavahchoi ding nahi."},"8":{"text":"Nachon danho kanitjing ding ahin; nangman neidalha manghel hih-in. BETH","title":"Pakai Danthu Ngaiding"},"9":{"text":"Khangdongin alampi iti asuhtheng thei ding ham? Nathu dungjuija chingthei tah-a hinkho amana kon hiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kalung pumpin nangma kanaholle, O nathupeh ho-a konin neilam vaisah loujenin."},"11":{"text":"Nangma douna-a kachonset kit lou nadin, nathu kalung sunga kaselle."},"12":{"text":"Vo Pakai anunnom nahi, nadanthu kisunho neihilin."},"13":{"text":"Nakama nathutan lhahho jouse, kamuh-in kaphongdoh tan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Haona jousetoh kikotnin, nathu hettohsah naho lampi achun kana thanomin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nachon danho keiman ngaito ingting, nalampi ho jabolinge."},"16":{"text":"Nachondan kisunho-a kipah jinging ting; nathu chu kasuhmil louding ahi. GIMEL","title":"Pakai Danthu-a Kipana"},"17":{"text":"Kahin theina dingle, nathu kanit nadin, nasoh chunga hin kiphal tah-in na tongin."},"18":{"text":"Nachondan thua kona thilkidang ho kamu theinadin, kamit hasah inlang hin."},"19":{"text":"Leisetna kholjin kahin, nathupeh ho chu keija konin selhih-in."},"20":{"text":"Nathutanlhah phattina lhangai na-in kahinna hi suhlam vaijin aumtan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Nathupeh ho-a kon vahmanga, mikiletsah sapset changho chu naphohsalin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Keija konin i-sah lounale housetna ho lamangin; ajehchu keiman nahettohsahna ho kanit jinge."},"23":{"text":"Pipuiho jong atouvun chule eiseiseuvin, ahinla nasoh hin nadan kisunho kangaiton ahi."},"24":{"text":"Na hettohsahna jong chu kakipanale eithumopma ahi. DALETH","title":"Pakai Danthu Juidinga Kigellhahna"},"25":{"text":"Kahinnahi leivuija abehchah tan; nathu dungjuijin neisuhalin."},"26":{"text":"Kalamlhah ho kaphong doh-in, nangin neijahpeh tai; Na danthu kisunho neihilin."},"27":{"text":"Nachondan lampiho neihet them sah-in; chutichun nathilbol kidangho seichoi lenge."},"28":{"text":"Kahinna lungkhamin ajunlha tai; nathu dungjuijin neihatdoh sah-in."},"29":{"text":"Jouseina lampi keija konin chondoh-in; lungsettah in nadanthu neipejotan."},"30":{"text":"Thudih lampi chu kana lhengin; Nathu tanlhah ho kamasanga kakoije."},"31":{"text":"Nathu hettoh sahho katuh jinge, O Pakai, neijumso hih-in."},"32":{"text":"Kalung nakhantou sah tengle, nathupeh lampia chun lhaijinge. HE","title":"Hetthemna Dinga Taona"},"33":{"text":"Vo Pakai na danthu kisunho lampi neihilin, chutile akhonna geija kachintup ding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Nadanthu kanit theina dingin hetkhen themna neipen, henge, kalung pumpin nit ing kate."},"35":{"text":"Na thupeho lampia neiche sah-in, Ajehchu hichea chu kipah kahi."},"36":{"text":"Kiloset lam hilouvin, nathu hetohsahna lama chun neilunglut sah-in."},"37":{"text":"Manmo vetna-a konin kamit heimangin, chule nalampi-a neisuhalin."},"38":{"text":"Nangma ginna-a lunglut, nasohpa henga nathu sudetnin."},"39":{"text":"I-eikisah louna kakichat hi heimangin, ajehchu nathu tanlhahna chu aphan ahi."},"40":{"text":"Vetan, nachondan thuchu kalhangai jinge, nachon phatna-a neisuhalin. VAU","title":"Pakai Danthu-a Kison"},"41":{"text":"Vo Pakai nami hepina kahenga hunghen, nathudih dungjuijin nahuhhingna jong hunglhung hen."},"42":{"text":"Nathu katahsan jala, i-sah louva eibolho chu adonbutna kaneiding ahi."},"43":{"text":"Kakama kona thutah thu chu lamanghel hih-in, ajehchu nathu tanna-a kinema kahi."},"44":{"text":"Chutia chu nadanthu tanglouva, atonsot atonsot geija kanit ding ahi."},"45":{"text":"Nachondan thuho kahole jeh-in, keima chamlhat tah-in choninge."},"46":{"text":"Lengho angsunga jong nathu hettohsah ho seijing ting, chule keima jahchaponge."},"47":{"text":"Chule kanangailut jing, nathupeh ho-a chun kipah inge."},"48":{"text":"Kanangailut jing, nathupeh ho lama chun kakhut jong domsang inting, nadan kisunho ngaitonge. ZAYIN","title":"Pakai Danthu-a Tahsana Ngap"},"49":{"text":"Achunga neikinep sahna, nasoh thusei chu geldoh-in."},"50":{"text":"Nathun hinna eipeh jala, hichehi kahesohna-a kalhamona hiding ahi"},"51":{"text":"Mikiletsah-in nasatah-in einuisatnin, ahinla nadanthu-a konin kalhadah dehpoi."},"52":{"text":"Vo Pakai malaija nathu tanlhah ho chu kahejingin, lhamon nan kaneijin ahi."},"53":{"text":"Nadanthu nungsun mikhang gilouho jeh-in, kichatnin kadimtan ahi."},"54":{"text":"Ka kholjina insunga dinga la chu, Nadanthu kisunho chu ahi."},"55":{"text":"Vo Pakai namin chu janteng kageldohjin, nadanthu chu kanit jingin ahi."},"56":{"text":"Nachon danthu kavetup jeh-in, hichehi kanei ahi. HETH","title":"Pakai Danthu-a Lunglut"},"57":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangma keija nahi; nathu kanit ding ahi tin kanaseije."},"58":{"text":"Kalung pumpin nalungsetna kangeh-e; nathu dungjuijin hepina neineijin."},"59":{"text":"Kalampi ho kangaiton, nathu hettohsahna lama kakeng kahei tai."},"60":{"text":"Nathupeh ho nitdingin kakinon, kageisangpoi."},"61":{"text":"Mikhang gilou kiloihon eichomun; ahivangin nadanthu chu kasumil pon ahi."},"62":{"text":"Nachon phatna thutan ho jeh-in, khangkim laijin thouving ting nangma thangvah inge."},"63":{"text":"Nangma ginghole nachondan thu nit ho jouse dinga loile gol kahi."},"64":{"text":"Vo Pakai, leiset hi nahepina dimset ahi; nadanthu kisunho neihilin. TETH","title":"Pakai Danthu Amantamdan"},"65":{"text":"Vo Pakai nathu dungjuijin, nasohhi neibol phalheh jengin ahi."},"66":{"text":"Thutan dihtah leh hetna neihilin, ajehchu nathupeh katahsanin ahi."},"67":{"text":"Eiki bolgim masang chun kana vahmangin, hinla tunvang nathu kanit tai."},"68":{"text":"Nangma naphan, thilpha nabole; Nadan kisun ho neihilin."},"69":{"text":"Mi kiletsah-in kei dounan jou asemthun, kenvang kalung pumpin nadanthuho vetup inge."},"70":{"text":"Alungu sathao bangin athaovin, keivang nadanthu-a kipah inge."},"71":{"text":"Nadanthu kisun ho kahet theina dinga, eiki bolgim chu keidingin aphan ahi."},"72":{"text":"Sanale dangka sang tamtah sangin, nakama danthu sohdoh chu keidin aphajon ahi. YOD","title":"Pakai Danthu Adih Dan"},"73":{"text":"Nangman nakhutna neisema neigontoh ahin; nathupeh kahet theina din hetkhen themna neipen."},"74":{"text":"Nathu-a kinema kaumjing jeh-in, nangma ginghon eimu tengule kipah unte."},"75":{"text":"Vo Pakai nathu tanlhah ho adih-in, tahsan umtah-a neibolgim ahi ti kahei."},"76":{"text":"Katao ahi, nasoh henga nathusei dungjuijin, nahepi lungsetna chu kalha mona hihen."},"77":{"text":"Kahin theinadin, nahepina thah chu kahenga hunghen; ajehchu nadanthu chu kakipana ahi."},"78":{"text":"Ajehbeija eibolval jeh uvin, mi kiletsahho chu jahchao hen, keiman vang, nachondan thuho chu kangaito jinge."},"79":{"text":"Nangma gingho, nathu hetohsah heho chu keima lama hungkihei juhen."},"80":{"text":"Kajachat louna din, kalunghi nadanthu kisun ho-a det hen. KAPH","title":"Huhdohna Dinga Taona"},"81":{"text":"Nahuhhingna ngaichan, kahinna alhasamtai; ahinla nathun kakineme."},"82":{"text":"Nathu-a dingin kamit alosamtai, itihle neilhamon ding ham? kati."},"83":{"text":"Meikhu lah-a hai um tobang kahitai; hijongle nadanthu kisun chu kasumilpoi."},"84":{"text":"Nasoh nikho hohi ijat-ham, eisugentheiho chunga itihle thu natan ding ham?"},"85":{"text":"Mi kiletsah nadanthu banga umlouhon, kokhuh eilaipeh uvin ahi."},"86":{"text":"Nathupeh ho jouse tahsan um ahin, amahon dihlou tah-in eibolgimuve, neipanpin."},"87":{"text":"Amahon leiset chungahi eisuhmang konu ahitan; kenvang nachondan thuho kadalhapon ahi."},"88":{"text":"Nalungset hepina bangin neisem thah-in, chutichun nakamsung thu hettohsah chu juijinge. LAMED","title":"Pakai Danthu Tahsan"},"89":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nathuhi a-imatih chanin van'a aumjinge."},"90":{"text":"Nakitahna chu khang jouse-a aumin; nangman leiset naphut doh-in, hichu aumjingin ahi."},"91":{"text":"Nahou danthupeh dungjuijin amaho tulai geijin aumjinge; ajehchu abonchauva nasohte ahiuvin ahi."},"92":{"text":"Nadanthu hi kakipana hilou hile, kalung hesoh-a chu anamangthah ding kahitai."},"93":{"text":"Nachondan thuho chu a-itih in sumil pong kate, ajehchu hicheho-a chu hinna neina peh ahi."},"94":{"text":"Nanga kahi, neihuhhing in, ajehchu nachondan thuho kanaholin ahi."},"95":{"text":"Mi khangilou chun suhmang dingin eingah-e, ahivangin nathu hetohsahna ho kagel jing ding ahi."},"96":{"text":"Chamkimna jouse akhonna kamutai; ahin nathupeh vang ajao lheh jengin ahi. MEM","title":"Pakai Danthu Ngailut"},"97":{"text":"Oh, nadanthu hi iti kangailut hitam! nilhumkeijin kangaitojin ahi."},"98":{"text":"Nathupeh ho-a kona kamelmate sanga chingjoa neisem ahi; ajehchu hichu keitoh aum jingin ahi."},"99":{"text":"Eihilho jouse sangin hetthemna kaneijoi; ajehchu nathu hettohsah naho chu kangaiton ahi."},"100":{"text":"Nachondan thuho kavet tup jal-in, malai miho sangin hetkhen themna kaneijoi."},"101":{"text":"Nathu kanit theina din, setna lampi ho-a konin kakeng kakangsen ahi."},"102":{"text":"Nathu tanlhah na-a konin kana kihei mangpoi; ajehchu nangma tah-in nei nahilsa ahi."},"103":{"text":"Nathuhohi keija dinga iti lhuma hitam! Henge, kakama khoiju sangin alhumjon ahi."},"104":{"text":"Nachondan thuho-a konin hetkhen themna kaneijin; hijeh chun lampi dih lou jouse kathen ahi. NUN","title":"Pakai Danthu-a Kon Vah"},"105":{"text":"Nathuhi kakeng dinga thaomei ahin, ka lampi dingin vah ahi."},"106":{"text":"Keima nachonphat nathutan ho nit dingin, kaki hahsel in kaphut det tai."},"107":{"text":"Vo Pakai eiki bolgim behsehtan; nathu dungjuijin neisuhalin."},"108":{"text":"Vo Pakai kangeh ahi, kakama lungcham thilpeh hi sangin lang, nathu tanlhah naho chu neihilin."},"109":{"text":"Kahinna kakhutna aumjingin; hijongle nadanthu kasumil dehpoi."},"110":{"text":"Mi khang gilou chun thang eikampeh-in; hijongle na danthuho-a konin kavahmang dehpon ahi."},"111":{"text":"Nathu hettohsah naho chu katonsot goudin kakilah-e; ajehchu hicheho chu kalung kipana ahi."},"112":{"text":"Akhonna geija nadanthu kisunho tohdoh nadin, kalungthim kapetan ahi.
