SAMEK","title":"Pakai Danthu-a Hoidohna"},"113":{"text":"Mohthil ngaitohi kahon, ahin, nadanthu vang kangailun ahi."},"114":{"text":"Nangma kakiselna munle kalumdal nahin, nathu-a kakineme."},"115":{"text":"Nangho khanset bolho, keijakonin potdoh-un, ajehchu ka Pathen thupeh ho chu kanga tup ding ahi."},"116":{"text":"Kahin theinadin nathu dungjuijin neituh-in, kakinepna-a neijachat sah hih-in."},"117":{"text":"Neituh detnin chutileh kahoidoh ding ahi; chule nadanthu kisun ho tanglouva kajabol ding ahi."},"118":{"text":"Nadanthu kisunho-a kona vahmangho jouse chu nachotpha tai; ajehchu amilhep lhahnao chu jou ahi."},"119":{"text":"Nangin migilouho jouse chu thih-eh bangin nasumangin, hijeh chun nathu hettohsah naho kangailun ahi."},"120":{"text":"Katahsa nangma ginan akihotnin, chule nathutannaho chu kakichan ahi. AYIN","title":"Pakai Danthu Nun"},"121":{"text":"Thutandih le chonphatna kabole, eibol gentheiho hengah eidalha hih-in."},"122":{"text":"Nasoh phatnadin kitungin lang, mihoitho chu eisuh genthei sah hih-in."},"123":{"text":"Nahuhhing nale nachon phatna thu holna-a konin, kamit hi alhasam tai."},"124":{"text":"Nami hepina dungjui jin nasoh hi bolin lang, nadanthu kisemho neihilin."},"125":{"text":"Keima nasoh kahin; nathu hettohsah naho kahet khen thei nadin, het themna neipen."},"126":{"text":"Pakai nang dinga natoh phat ahitai; ajehchu nadanthu anotthap taovin ahi."},"127":{"text":"Hijeh chun sana sangin nathupeh kangailun; henge, sana thengsel sangin kangailu jon ahi."},"128":{"text":"Hijeh chun nachondan thuho jouse, adih ding thil jouse kajabolin; lampi dihlou jouse kathen ahi. PE","title":"Pakai Danthu Juinom"},"129":{"text":"Nathu hettohsahnaho chu kidangtah ahin; hijeh-a chu kahinna-in hiho chu anitding ahi."},"130":{"text":"Nathu lutna chun vah apejin, hichun milhamho hetkhen themna apejin ahi."},"131":{"text":"Kakam kan, kahaihai jenge; ajehchu nathupeh ho kangaichan ahi."},"132":{"text":"Namin ngailuho nabolnaji bangchun, keima neivenlang, neihepi tan."},"133":{"text":"Nathu-a kakholhah ho thu penlang, kachunga khansetna himhim vaipohsah hihbeh-in."},"134":{"text":"Mihem suhgentheina-a konin neihuh doh-in, chutichun nachondan thuho nit inge."},"135":{"text":"Nasoh chunga hin namai vahsah inlang, nadanthu kisun ho neihilin."},"136":{"text":"Amahon nadanthu anit loujeh-un, kamit lhi vadung twi bangin alonglhan ahi. TSADDE","title":"Pakai Danthu Dihdan"},"137":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangma chonpha nahin, nathutan ho chu dihtah ahi."},"138":{"text":"Nangin napeh nathu hettohsah naho chu, chonpha le kitah ahi."},"139":{"text":"Kamelma ten nathu asuhmil jeh-un, katompan na-in eisumang tan ahi."},"140":{"text":"Nathuhi athenglheh jengin, hijeh-a chu nasoh-in kangailun ahi."},"141":{"text":"Keima neochale isahlou kahin, hijongle nachondan thuho chu kasumil pon ahi."},"142":{"text":"Nachon phatna chu tonsot chonphatna ahin, nadanthu chu thutah ahi."},"143":{"text":"Lungkhamnale natthoh lel-in eituhchah-in, hijongle nathupeh ho chu kakipana ahi."},"144":{"text":"Nathu hettohsah naho chonphatna chu tonsotna ding ahin; hetkhen themna neipen, chule hingjing tange. KOPH","title":"Huhdohna Dinga Taona"},"145":{"text":"Kalung pumpin kakouve, neingaipeh-in, O Pakai, nadanthu kisun hi kanit ding ahi."},"146":{"text":"Nangma kakouve, neihuhhing in, chutia chu nathu hettohsah naho kanit ding ahi."},"147":{"text":"Khovah masangin kathouvin, chuin nang kakouvin, nathu-a kaki nem-e."},"148":{"text":"Nathu kagelthei nadin, jankhon mitsing louvin kaumin ahi."},"149":{"text":"Nalungset hepina dungjuijin ka aw ngaijin, vo Pakai nathutandih dungjuijin neisem thah-in."},"150":{"text":"Thilphalou nung juiho chun eihin naijui; amaho nadanthu-a kona gamla ahiuve."},"151":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangma nailamcha nahin, nathupeh jouse thudih ahi."},"152":{"text":"Nathu hettohsah chungchanga, nangman tonsotna dinga naphudetsa ahitai, ti malaija pat kahet ahitai. RESH","title":"Panpi Dinga Ngeh-a Taona"},"153":{"text":"Kathoh gimje hi ngaitonlang, neihuh doh-in, ajehchu nadanthu kasumilpon ahi."},"154":{"text":"Kachungthu neisei lhahpeh inlang neihuh doh-in, nathu dungjuijin neisem thah-in."},"155":{"text":"Huhhingna chu migilou ho-a kona gamlatah ahi; ajehchu amahon nadanthu kisun aholpouve."},"156":{"text":"Vo Pakai nahepinaho chu nasatah ahi; Nathutanlhah dungjuijin neisem thah-in."},"157":{"text":"Eisugentheile kamelma atam lheh-un; hijongle nathu hetohsah na ho-a konin kalhasam dehpoi."},"158":{"text":"Suhkhel neiho kaven, nathu achintuplou jeh-un kalung akhamin ahi."},"159":{"text":"Ngaito temin, nadanthuho iti kangailut hitam; vo Pakai nalungset hepina dungjuijin neisem thah-in."},"160":{"text":"Atil abula pat nathu hi adih-in; chule nachon phatna thutan ho chu tonsotnin aumjingin ahi. SCHIN","title":"Pakai Danthu-a Kipehdoh"},"161":{"text":"Ajehbeijin pipuihon eisugentheijun; ahinla kalunghi nathu-a tijatah-in ading jingin ahi."},"162":{"text":"Thil tamtah chomdohho bangin, nathu-a hin katha anomlheh jie."},"163":{"text":"Jouhi kathen kakidah-in, Na danthu vang kangailun ahi."},"164":{"text":"Nachon phatna nathutan naho jeh-in, nikhatnin sagivei nangma kathangvah-e."},"165":{"text":"Nadanthu ngailuhon chamna loupitah aneijun; imachan amaho asuhmo louding ahi."},"166":{"text":"Pakai nami huhhingna-a kakinemin kangah-in, nathupeh ho kabolin ahi."},"167":{"text":"Kahinna-in nathu hetohsahna ho anitjingin, nasatah-in kangailun ahi."},"168":{"text":"Na danthu kisunhole nathu hetohsahna kanitjinge; ajehchu kalampiho jouse na masanga aumin ahi. TAU","title":"Panpiding Ngeh-a Taona"},"169":{"text":"Vo Pakai kakana nakom hunglhung hen, nathu dungjuijin hetkhen themna neipen."},"170":{"text":"Kataona na-ang hunglhung hen, nathu dungjuijin neihuhdoh in."},"171":{"text":"Kakamin navahchoina aphondoh ding ahi, ajehchu nangman nadanthu kisunho neihile."},"172":{"text":"Kaleijin nathuho aseiding ahi; ajehchu nathupeh jouse chonphatna ahi."},"173":{"text":"Nachondanthuho kalhen jeh-in, nakhut chun eiki thopihen."},"174":{"text":"Vo Pakai nami huhhingna kalhangaijin, nadanthu hi kakipana ahi."},"175":{"text":"Kahinna hinsah in, chuteng kavahchoi ding nahi, chule nathutan lhahna-a chun neipanpin."},"176":{"text":"Kelngoi mang bangin kana vahmang tai; nasohhi neihin hollin, ajehchu nathupeh kasumilpon ahi."}}},"120":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kagenthei teng Pakai kakoujin, aman eingaipeh jin ahi.","title":"Melma Thaneitah akon Huhdohna Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Vo Pakai jouseina kamle, lheplhahna leija konin, kahinna huhdoh-in."},"3":{"text":"Jou seija leigui, nangma ipi kapeh-a, ahilouleh ipi kabolpeh dingham?"},"4":{"text":"Mihat thalchang ho hemtah leh makeithing meihol ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ohe ada kahi! Meshech gama kana kholjin le-a, Kedar ponbuh-a kanachen."},"6":{"text":"Kahinnahi chamna hotbolho toh sottah anacheng khomin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Keiman chamna kadeijin, hinla thu kaseidoh teng, amahon galbol ding agojiuve."}}},"121":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hoija kona eipanpi hung ham tin, lhangho lam ve-in khodah inge.","title":"Ama Holte Jouse Panpi Pathen"},"2":{"text":"Vanle leiset sempa Pakaiya kona eipanpi hungah ahi."},"3":{"text":"Aman nakeng achaloh sah louding, nachingpa chu lulhu louding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Vetan, Israel chingpa chu lulhu louding; imu jong imulouding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pakai chu nachingpa ahin; Pakai chu nakhut jetlam nalima pang ahi."},"6":{"text":"Sunle nisan nasangkha pontin, janteng jongle lha-in nasalkha ponte."},"7":{"text":"Pakaiyin thilse jouse-a kona nahongbit ding; nahinna jong ahonbit ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pakaiyin tua pat atonsot geija navaikon navailhun ahonbit ding ahi."}}},"122":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihon kahenga, Pakai in'a cheu hite, atiu chun, katha anom lheh-in ahi.","title":"Pakai In'a Che Kipa Aumdan"},"2":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem, nakotpi sunga kakeng uva kadin dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem hi abilla chengkhom khopi banga kisem ahin,"},"4":{"text":"Chukoma chu Israel hettohsah na-a phungho, Pakai phungho chu Pakai minna thangvahna pedinga, chetou jiuva ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu chumuna chu thutanna laltounaho, David insung laltounaho chu kido-a ahi."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem'a chamna aum nadin taovun, nangailu hou chu khangtou dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nakulsunga cham lenghen lang, na leng-inpi sunga khantouna umhen."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu tu-a hi kasopite le kaloiho jala, nalah uva cham lenghen katiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai ka Pathen insung jeh-a, naphatnadiu kahol ding ahi."}}},"123":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"O nang van ho-a cheng, nangma henglam ven kakhodah-in ahi.","title":"Noise-a Umna-a kon huhdohna Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Vetan, sohte mitnin apakai teo khut avetjing bangle, sohnu mitnin a-pakainu khut avetjingji bangin, kachunguva hepina einei masang seuvin, kamitnuvin Pakai ka Pathen'u ave jingin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hepina neineijun, O Pakai, hepina neineijun, ajehchu noisena-in kadim behseh taove."},"4":{"text":"Mi kinomsahho mitaitomna, chule mikiletsahho midem na-in, ka hinnao hi nasatah-in adip tan ahi."}}},"124":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Israel ten seijuhen, Pakai chu eiho lama anapanglou hileh:","title":"Pakaiyin Amite Ahonbit"},"2":{"text":"Mihon eina dou uva chu, Pakai chu eiho lama anapanglou hileh:"},"3":{"text":"Ichunguva hatah-a alunghan laitah uva chu, eina vallhum diu ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Chuche laija chu twijin einachup manguva, ihinnao chungaho luidung analong ding ahitai."},"5":{"text":"Chuche laija chu hoithona twi chu ihinnao chunga hi analong ding ahitai."},"6":{"text":"Aha uva dinga anneh-a eina pedoh louvu Pakai chu nunnom hen."},"7":{"text":"Thang kamho thanga kona vacha kitoldoh banga ihinnao hi kitoldoh ahitan, thangkhao atanin, ikitoldoh taove."},"8":{"text":"Eipanpiuva chu, Vanle lei sempa Pakai minna uma ahi."}}},"125":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai tahsanna mite chu Zion molsang tobanga, suhlonghoi hilouva a-imatih channa umjing diu ahi.","title":"Pakai Amite Thahatna"},"2":{"text":"Molsang hon Jerusalem a-umkimvel bangin, tua pat tonsot geijin Pakaiyin amite a-umkimvel jinge."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu miphalouho moltum chu michonpha ho chunga chulouding, achutiloule chonphaten khangitlou na-a khut lhang getnunte."},"4":{"text":"Vo Pakai miphaho dingin thilpha bolin, alungthim dih ho-a din thilpha bolpeh-in."},"5":{"text":"Alampia vahkoija kihei mangho vang, Pakaiyin thilse bolho toh puidoh thantin, Israelte chunga vang chamna umding ahi."}}},"126":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin sohchangho Zion'a alepuikit laichun, eiho mang neiho toh ibangun ahi.","title":"Kipahtah-a Zion Hungkile Kit"},"2":{"text":"Chuche laichun ikamu chu nuinale ileijuva lasahna anadimin ahi. Chujouchun amahon Pathen hephalouho lah-a Pakaiyin amaho thil loupitah abolpeh uve, anatiuvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Pakaiyin thil loupitah einabolpeh-un, chua chun eiho ikipah uve."},"4":{"text":"Vo Pakai, lhanglam luidungho bangin, kasohchang hou hinlepui kitnin."},"5":{"text":"Mitlhi puma tu hochun kipahtah-a a-atdiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Muchi lutah choija, kapumma kondohpa chun, achangphal ahin kipoh-a, thanom tah-a hungkile kitding ahi."}}},"127":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"In sa-a Pakai apanlouleh, asaho tohgimna chu moh ahin; Khopi ngah-a Pakai apanlou leh, angahpa janha chu moh ahibouve.","title":"Pakai toh Tohkhom leh Khantoukhom"},"2":{"text":"Matah-a natho-a, jan sottah natouva, lungkhamna changlhah neh chu, nangdinga pannabei ahi: ajehchu aman angailut chu a-imutsah jin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Veovin chatehi Pakaiya kon gouchan ahin, chule laigilga jonghi akipaman thilpeh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Khangdon laija chate hi, Galhatpa khutna thalchang ho tobang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Alivathei dimsetna hicheho neija mi chu anunnom ahi; amaho jahcha loudiu, ahivanga amelmateu toh kotpi phunga kihoujo diu ahi."}}},"128":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai ging jouse leh alampiho-a chonchan chu anunnom ahi.","title":"Pathen Gingho Phattheinan Ajui"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu nakhutna natohgim ga naneh ding; nangman nomsan natin, chule hichu nang dinga phading ahi."},"3":{"text":"Na inneipi chu na-in vella lengpigui ga phatah bangintin; nachate chu nadokhang kimvela Olive phung tobang hidiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Vetan, chutia Pakai ginga mi chu phatthei chang ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pakaiyin Zion'a konin phatthei naboh intin; chule nahin laise-a Jerusalem phatna chu namu ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Henge, nachateo chatele Israelte chunga chamna chu namu ding ahi."}}},"129":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuhin Israel ten seijuhen; kakhangdon laijapat tamtahvei einabol gimuve.","title":"Zion Melmaho Chunga Galjona Jeh-a Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Kakhangdon laijapat tamtahvei einabolgim uvin; hijongle amahon eijoudeh pouve."},"3":{"text":"Loukaihon katungtun chunga akaijun; akainau nung saotah-in akigolin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pakai chu chonphatna ahin; migilouho khaojang chu aman asatan tan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Zion hotbolho jouse chu jahchao henlang hung kinung leuhen."},"6":{"text":"Amaho chu akhandoh kah-a goppai jia in chunga hampa tobang bep hiuhen."},"7":{"text":"Hiche achun chang at pan akhut adip pon; chujongle changphal kanpan jong a-ang adip poi."},"8":{"text":"Avahleho koiman, nangho Pakai phatthei boh changun, Pakai Minna phatthei kaboh nahiuve, tia seija aumpoi."}}},"130":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, kokhuh thuhtah-a konin nangma kahinsamme.","title":"Pakai Lhatdamna Kinema Nga"},"2":{"text":"Pakai ka aw ngaijin, kangehna aw hi ngai nadin nana hinsungin."},"3":{"text":"Pakai nangin khangit lounaho namelchih-a ahile, O Pakai koiham adingjou dinga."},"4":{"text":"Ahinla ginna naum theinadin nahenga ngaidamna chu aumme."},"5":{"text":"Pakai chu kangah-in, kahinna hin angah jingin, athu-a chun kinemin kaume."},"6":{"text":"Jingkhovah ngahho sangin nasajon, kahinna hin Pakai chu angah-e. Henge, jing khovah ngah ho sangin kamasajoi."},"7":{"text":"Israel chu Pakaiya kinemhen; ajehchu Pakaiya hepina leh lhatdamna chamkim aumin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule aman akhangit lounao jouse-a kona Israel chu alhatdoh ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 1:21; Tit 2:14."}}},"131":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai kalungthim hi akiletsahpon, kamit jong akichoisangpoi. Keidinga thil len hole thil sang behsehho-a jong kakijil ngaipoi.","title":"Pakaiya Kingai"},"2":{"text":"Tahbeh-in anu noichep bangsa naosen bangin, thip khinkhen chan kaumin, ka hinna hi naosen noichep bangsa tobanghel ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tu-a kipat a-imatih chana din, Pakaiya chun Israelte kinem uhen."}}},"132":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai David leh athoh hahsatna jouse chu geldoh-in.","title":"Tonsotna Pakai Chenna Zion"},"2":{"text":"Pakai henga iti ama kitepma, chule Jacob Pathen hat chungnung henga iti ana kihahsela hitam."},"3":{"text":"Atahbeh-in ka insunga lutpong ting, kajalkhuna jong kicholdo din lutponge;"},"4":{"text":"Kamit ho imutsah pongting, ahiloule lulhuh jong lulhuh sah ponge."},"5":{"text":"Pakaiya dinga munkhat kamudoh kahsen, hat chungnung Jacob Pakai dinga chendetna in kamudoh kahsen."},"6":{"text":"Veovin, hiche thuchu Ephratah'a kajauvin; gammang lah-a chun kamutaove.","ref":"2 Thusm 6:41-42."},"7":{"text":"Ama houbuh sunga eiho cheohitin; eihon akhophang bullah houvu hite."},"8":{"text":"O Pakai, thoudoh-in, nacholdona sunga lutnin; nangmale nathahatna thingkhong toh kipatdohtan."},"9":{"text":"Nathemputeu chonphat na-in kivonuhen; chule namithengte kipah-in ao vuhen."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu nasoh David jal-in, nathaonupa mai chu heimangpeh hih-in."},"11":{"text":"Pakai chu David henga thutah in akihahselin; chua kona kiheimang lou ding; nanga kona hung doh khat, nalaltouna chunga katousah ding ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 7:12-16; 1 Thusm 17:11-14; Labu 89:3-4; Sol 2:30."},"12":{"text":"Keiman amaho kahilding kathu lhunle kathu hetohsah nahi, nachaten anit uva ahile amaho jongchu a-imatih chana nalal touna chunga touding ahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin achenna ding anadeitan; Zion chu analhengtan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hichehi a-imatih channa kacholngah na ahin; kadeitah anahijeh-in, hia hin chengjing tange."},"15":{"text":"Aneh dingu nengtah-in phungvuh ingting; ami gentheite changlhah-in vah vange."},"16":{"text":"Athemputeu huhhingna-in von ingting, chule amithengte kipa aw-thonga ao dingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chukoma chu keiman David ki kadotdoh sah ding; kathaonu dinga chun thaomei khat kaphudet pehtai.","ref":"1 Leng 11:36."},"18":{"text":"Amelmateu jachatna-in voning ting; ahinla ama tah chunga vang alallukhuh chu khangtou jing ding ahi."}}},"133":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Veovin, sopi kitohtah-a chenkhomhi iti phatna iti nopma hitam!","title":"Pathen Mite Kipunkhom Phatchomna"},"2":{"text":"Hichu luchunga thao mantam tah tobang ahin, khamula longlha-a, Aaron khamul geija longlhasuh tobang; aponchen mong geija jollha suhpeh tobang ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hermon daitwi bangle, Zion molsangho chunga hunglhajia dai twiho tobang ahi. Ajehchu chua chun Pakaiyin tonsotna hinna ding phattheina thupeh chu apen ahi."}}},"134":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Veovin, nangho Pakai sohte jouse, janna Pakai in'a dinghon Pakai chu vahchoijun.","title":"Pathen Thangvahna dinga Tilkhouna"},"2":{"text":"Munthenga chun nakhut domsangun lang, chule Pakai chu vahchoijun."},"3":{"text":"Van leh leiset sempa Pakai chun Zion'a konin phatthei naboh-uhen."}}},"135":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu vahchoijun, nanghon Pakai minchu vahchoijun, vo nangho Pakai sohte, amachu vahchoijun.","title":"Pathen Vahchoi Dinga Kouna"},"2":{"text":"Nangho Pakai insunga dingteho, Pathen in hongsunga dingteho,"},"3":{"text":"Pakai chu aphat jeh-in, Pakai chu vahchoijun, nomtah ahijeh-in, aminin vahchoina la saovin."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin ama ding tumin Jacob akilhenin, chule agou tum mong dingin Israel akilhentai."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai chu loupitah ahi kahen, chule I-Pakaiyu hi Pathen jouse chunga ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pakaiyin alunglhaina chan chu van'a, leija, twikhanglen sunga chule mun thuhtah ho jouse-a aboljin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aman leiset kolmang ho-a konin twimeiho ajamdoh sah-in, go juhna dingin kolphe asemin, akholna in'a konin khohui ahin lhadohjin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Aman Egypt gama mihem apeng masa mihem le gancha, agomin athat gamin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Vo Egypt gam, Pharaoh chung leh asohte jouse chunga, aman melchihna le thil kidang nalah uva ahinsolin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Namlenho asumangin, chule leng hattaho athat gamin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amor mite lengpa Sihon leh Bashan lengpa Og, chule Canaan lenggam ho jouse;"},"12":{"text":"Chule agammu chu goulo din, ami Israelte gouchan din apetan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Vo Pakai, namin chu tonsotnin aumjingin, chule vo Pakai, nahetjingna chu khangjouse lhumkeijin aumjinge."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin amite thu atanding ahin, chule asohte chungchanga alung aheiding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Pathen hephalouho milimhou chu dangka le sana, mihem khutna kisem ahi."},"16":{"text":"Amahon kam aneijun ahinla apaothei pouvin, mit aneijun ahinla kho amupouvin;"},"17":{"text":"Amahon nakhang aneijun ahinla kho ajapouvin, akam sunguva jong haina himhim aumpon ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hicheho semho chu amaho tobangbou ahin; Chucheho tahsan chan jong chu chutima chu ahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Vo Israel insung mite, Pakai chu vahchoijun; vo Aaron insung mite, Pakai chu vahchoijun."},"20":{"text":"Vo Levi insung mite, Pakai chu vahchoijun; Pakai gingte nanghon, Pakai chu vahchoijun."},"21":{"text":"Jerusalem'a cheng Pakai chu, Zion'a konin nunnom hen, Pakai chu vahchoijun,"}}},"136":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"O aphat jeh-in Pakai henga thangvahna peuvin: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahin,","title":"Ahepina Dih Jeh-a Pathen Thangvahna","ref":"1 Thusm 16:34; 2 Thusm 5:13; 7:3; Ezra 3:11; Labu 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; Jer 33:11."},"2":{"text":"O pathenho Pathen henga thangvahna peuvin: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"3":{"text":"O pakaiho Pakai henga thangvahna peuvin: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amabou thilkidang loupitah bola ahi: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chihna-a vanho sempa henga chun: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.","ref":"Semt 1:1."},"6":{"text":"Twipi chunga leiset phajalpa henga chun: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.","ref":"Semt 1:2."},"7":{"text":"Vah loupitah sempa henga chun: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.","ref":"Semt 1:16."},"8":{"text":"Sunna vaihom dinga nisa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"9":{"text":"Janna vaihom dinga lhale ahsi ho: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"10":{"text":"Egypt'a apeng masa jouse thatgam pa henga: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.","ref":"Pot 12:29."},"11":{"text":"Chule amaho lah-a kona Israelte puidoh: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.","ref":"Pot 12:51."},"12":{"text":"Khut thahat tah le aban lhangdoh pa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"13":{"text":"Twipisan hopni-a homkhenpa henga chun: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.","ref":"Pot 14:21-29."},"14":{"text":"Chule chuche lailung Israelte palgal kaisahpa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla Pharaoh le ami janelho twipi san sunga lehlutpa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"16":{"text":"Gamthip lhonlhunga amite puilhung helpa henga: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"17":{"text":"Leng loupitah ho sumang helpa henga chun: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule leng minthangho that gampa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"19":{"text":"Amor mite lengpa Sihon: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.","ref":"Minb 21:12-30."},"20":{"text":"Chule Bashan lengpa Og: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.","ref":"Minb 21:31-35."},"21":{"text":"Chule agamu goulo dinga pe-a: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"22":{"text":"Asoh Israel henga goulo dinga pepa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ilhahsam laitah uva eina geldoh pao: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule imelmateuva kona eilhat dohpao: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"25":{"text":"Tahsa-a hung jouse nehding pepa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."},"26":{"text":"O van Pathen henga thangvahna peuvin: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi."}}},"137":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon vadungho pama chun katouvun, Zion kageldoh phatnun kakap taovin ahi.","title":"Sohchana-a Zion Alhangaiju"},"2":{"text":"Huisum chungho-a chun ka selangdah hou kakhaijun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu chukoma gal hinga eipuimang houchun la khat angeh-un; chule eibolgenthei houchun kipahtah-in eijolun, Zion la khat neisah peh-un atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Mi gama keihon Pakai la chu iti kasah dingu ham?"},"5":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem, nangma kasuhmila ahile, kakhut jetlam hin akhut themna sumil jenghen,"},"6":{"text":"nangma kageljing louva, kakipana pipen sanga Jerusalem kalhenjoh loule, kaleihi kadang chunga behden jenghen."},"7":{"text":"Vo Pakai Jerusalem chim nikho-a, Edom miten anatoh-u chu geldoh-in; suchimun, a-inbul songho chu suchimun, tin asamui."},"8":{"text":"Suhmang dinga uma vo, Babylon chanu, keiho neibolnao banga nale thuhpa chu kipah hen.","ref":"Tph 18:6."},"9":{"text":"Nachasenho man khoma songho jepna-a neipa chu kipah hen."}}},"138":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kalungthim pumpin nangma vahchoi jinge, pathenho masang-ah keiman nangma vahchoi La sange.","title":"Akitah ho Chunga Pathen Phatna"},"2":{"text":"Na houin thenglam ngan na houvingting, chule nalungset ngailutna le nathupeh jallin namin vahchoi jinge; ajehchu namin jouse chungvuma, nathu nachoisangtai."},"3":{"text":"Katao nikhon nangman neidonbut in, chule kahinna thahat napen, nahatsah tai."},"4":{"text":"Vo Pakai, amahon na kama thusoh ajah tengule, leiset leng jousen navahchoi diu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Henge, amahon Pakai lampiho lan saovinte; ajehchu Pakai loupi nachu nasatah ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pakai chu sanglheh jongle, mi noinungho ajaboljin, mi kiletsah vang gamlatah-in ahei."},"7":{"text":"Lungkhamna lah-a vahle jongleng, nangin neisuhalin, kamelmate lunghanna chunga nakhut nalhan ding, chule najetlama nei huhhing ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pakaiyin kachung chang thu chamkimsah inte, vo Pakai, nahepina tonsotna umjing ahi: Na khuttah-a nanatoh ho chu nungsun lou jenin."}}},"139":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangin neikhochillin neihetai.","title":"Pathen'in Mihem Ahet Chamkim"},"2":{"text":"Nangin katoulhah le kadindoh jong nahen, gamlatah-a konin ka lunggel ho jong nahen ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nangin kalampi le kaluplhah nakhol toh-in, chule kalampiho jouse nahechen sohkeije."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu, vo Pakai, kaleija thu khatcha aumpon, ahinla vetan abonin na hesoh-in ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nangin kanungle kama-a nei-um ton, kachunga nakhut nangamjin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chutobang hetna hi keidin akidang behseh-in, asangin, kasoh phajou poi."},"7":{"text":"Nalhagaova kona hoilama kache-a, ahilouleh na-angsunga kona hoilama kajamding ham?"},"8":{"text":"Van'a kaltou jongleng chu-a chun naumin, thikhol khul'a jalkhun kido jongleng, vetan, chumuna jong chun na-umme."},"9":{"text":"Jingkah lhavingho kilah ingting, twikhanglen mongpeh-a gacheng jongleng,"},"10":{"text":"Chukom jenga jong chun nakhutnin neikaijin natin, nakhut jetna neituh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Thonlouva muthimin eikhuding ahi tijongleng, jan jengjong chu kavela vah hiding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Henge, muthim chu nanga konin akiselpon, jan chu sun bangin avahjoi, nangdia muthimle khovah ania kibang ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu kasungil jouse jong nangma gontoh ahin, nangin kanu naobu sunga neinakhu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Kichat um le kidangtah-a kisem kahi jeh-in, nangma Kavah choije; nanatoh hohi datmo aumin, chule hichu kahina hin ahechen lheh-e."},"15":{"text":"Aguh-a eikisema chun ka gong hi namasanga akiselpoi, kidang tah-a leiset noinung pena eikisem ahi."},"16":{"text":"Katibah jouse hi khatcha aum masang, chamkim loulai ka gong hi namitnin namun; nalekhabu-a chu hicheho jouse hi akisemjou masanga kisun sohkei ahitai."},"17":{"text":"Vo Pathen nalunggel ho hi keidia iti mantam hitam! akisuhto khom chu iti natsatna hitam!"},"18":{"text":"Kasimding hitale neldi sanga tamjo ahiuvin; kakhahdoh jengin jong nangto kaum khom nalaije."},"19":{"text":"Vo Pathen, migilou chu thonlouva nathatei ding ahin, hijeh chun nangho thisan sohatte, keija konin potdoh-un."},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma dounan giloutah-in thu aseijun, chule namelma ten mohseh-in namin apanuve."},"21":{"text":"Vo Pakai nahote chu kahotbol louham? Chule nangma douna-a kipatdoh ho chunga kalungphatmo louham?"},"22":{"text":"Amaho chu hot atin kaho-in; kamelma-a kasimu ahitai."},"23":{"text":"O Pathen, Neikhol chilin chule Kalungthim hi he-in; nei patepmin, chule kalunggel hohi hechenin."},"24":{"text":"Chule ven keija hin khangitlouna lampi khattou aumdem, chule tonsot lampia chun neipuijin."}}},"140":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, miphalouva konchun neihuh doh-in, hunam miho-a konchun neiveng tupmin.","title":"Migilou ho-a Kon Huhdohna Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Alunguvin lheplhahna angaitouvin, tanglouvin galboldin akikhom khom jiuve."},"3":{"text":"Aleiju gul bangin anol hemun, alei noijuva gulsum gu aumme. Selah","ref":"Rom 3:13."},"4":{"text":"Vo Pakai migilou khutna konin neingahphan, kachena suhboi ding eigo-a, hunam miho-a konin neihongphan."},"5":{"text":"Mi kiletsah hon thang le khaohol eikampeh-un, lamsih-a lenthang aphaovin, amahon thang eikam khumuve. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Keiman Pakai henga chun, nangma ka Pathen nahi kati, vo Pakai kataona aw hi ngaijin."},"7":{"text":"Vo Pakai Pathen, kahuh hingna thahat; nangman gal kisat nikhon kalu neikhu peh-e."},"8":{"text":"Vo Pakai, migilou ngaichat chu phalpeh hih-in, aduha lungthim gilou chu pilhinsah hih-in, achutiloule kichoisang getnunte. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Eium chahho luchang chu, amaho kamtah-a lheplhahna chun khukhumhen."},"10":{"text":"Mei am lenglung chu achunguva hungchu hen, ama ahung kithodoh kitna loudiuvin, kotong thuh tahle meikong lah-a chun kisep lutnu hen."},"11":{"text":"Thuse seija leisetna kitungdoh hihhen, hunam mang chu setna-in suhlhuh dia anungjui ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Akibol gentheite thu leh vaichate dihna chu, Pakaiyin suhdih peh inte ti kahei."},"13":{"text":"Michonphan thonlouva namin athangvah ding; Midih chu na angsunga cheng ding ahi."}}},"141":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai nangma kakouve, nangma kakou tengle ka aw-a hin nana hinsung loijin.","title":"Agilou Bolho-a Kon Venbitna Umna Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Kataona ginnamtui bangin na-anga kitungdoh hen, chule kakhut dopsanghi nilhah lam ganlhaina bang hihen.","ref":"Tph 5:8."},"3":{"text":"Vo Pakai, kakam kamdal neikoi peh in, kakam nei ngatup peh-in."},"4":{"text":"Kalungthim hi thilse lama lutsah hih-in, khanset bol mihem natoh phalou kijildin nopsah hih-in, chule a-anneh tuihou neinehsah hih-in."},"5":{"text":"Michonphan eivohen, hichu lungsetna hinte, chule eiphohsal hen, hichu thao nasatah hiding ahi, hichun kalu suheh ponte, ajehchu avangsetnao sanna kataopeh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Athutanhou songhol lah-a akipailhah tengle, hiche hochu alhum jeh-in, kathu ngaitao vinte,"},"7":{"text":"Khattouvin tolla thing atanna a-ea bangin, kaguhou lhankhuh kama akithecheh gamtai."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla vo Pakai Pathen, kamitnin nangma lam akatjingin, nangma-a katahsan kangame, ka hinna hi gentheijin dalha hih-in."},"9":{"text":"Keidinga athang kamhouva konle, khangitlou bolho-a konin neihongbit in."},"10":{"text":"Keima kakitoldoh laitah-in, migilouho chu amahotah lensunga lhalut uhen."}}},"142":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka aw-in Pakai kakouvin, ka aw in Pakai henga ngehna kaneije.","title":"Kithopi Ding Taona"},"2":{"text":"Amasanga kalunglhai louna kasam phongin, a-angsunga kalung khamna kamusah-e."},"3":{"text":"Kasunga um lhagao agenthei tengle, nangin kalampi nahejinai. Kakeng lamlhahna-a guhthimin amahon keidin thang eikampeh-un ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kakhut jetlam kavetle, veuvin eihuhding mi khatchala aumpon; belding kaneipoi; Koimachan kahinna akhohsahpoi."},"5":{"text":"Vo Pakai nahenga kataove; Nangma mihing gama kakiselna ding le kachan nahi katin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Eikisuhneo behseh jeh-in, ka kana ngaijin, amaho kei sanga ahatjoh jeh-un, eibol gentheiho-a konin neihuh doh-in."},"7":{"text":"Namin kavahchoi theinadin sohchan na-a konin kahinna puidoh in, nangman ninglhing keija neibolphat ding jeh-a, michonpha ten eiumkim veldiu ahi."}}},"143":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai kataona ngaijin lang, kangehna-a nana sungin, nakitahna leh nachon phatna-a chun neidonbut in.","title":"Pathen Puina Dingle Kithopi Dinga tao"},"2":{"text":"Chule nasohhi thutan na-a nei lutpi hih-in, ajehchu namitmu-a mihing khatcha chonpha aumpoi.","ref":"Rom 3:20; Gal 2:16."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu melman kahinna abolgimin, kahinkho hi tolla avolhun: sotna anathisaho bangin muthima eichen sah-e."},"4":{"text":"Hijeh chun kalhagao kasunga athoh gimmin, kalungthim hi kasunga agoh ahitai."},"5":{"text":"Khanglui nikhoho kageldoh in, nathilbol ho jouse kangaitojin, nakhut thilbolho kasutjin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nahenglam kakhutnin kahin sange, kahinna hi dangchah na gam bangin, nangma ngaicha-in adangchah-e. Selah"},"7":{"text":"Vo Pakai neidonbut loijin, kalhagao alhasamtai, leiko sunga kumsuh ho kabah lounadin, keija konin namai selmang hih-in."},"8":{"text":"Nangma katahsan jeh-in, jingkah teng nalungsetna neijah sah-in, kahinna naheng lama kadop sang jing jeh-in, chena ding lampi neihetsah-in."},"9":{"text":"Vo Pakai kamelma te-a konin neihuh doh-in, nahenga kisel dinga hungjam kahi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma ka Pathen nahi jeh-in nadeilam bolje neihilin, Na Lhagaohi aphai, chondihna gama neipuijin."},"11":{"text":"Vo Pakai namin jal-in neihin sah-in, ajehchu nachon phatna jal-in, lungkham na-a konin kahinna hi puidoh-in."},"12":{"text":"Chule nahepina-a kamelmate subei jinlang, kahinna bol gentheiteho jouse sumangin, ajehchu nalhacha kahi."}}},"144":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kakhutho galboldan, kakhut jungho galsatdan hillah; kahatna Pakai chu nunnom hen.","title":"Galjo jeh-a Lengpan Pathen Athangvah"},"2":{"text":"Kahatnale kakulpi, ka insang le kakihuhdohna, kalumdal le katahsan kingapna, kamite kanoija kunsahpa."},"3":{"text":"Pakai, mihemhi ipi hija, nahiti lungvil tenna! ahiloule mihem chapahi ipi hija, nahiti khohsah ham!","ref":"Job 7:17-18; Labu 8:4."},"4":{"text":"Mihemhi pannabei tobang ahin, anikhoho jong nisalim kiheimang bangbep bou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vo Pakai navanho sonkunin hungkum lhan lang, molsangho chu tongkha lechun, meikhun lengunte."},"6":{"text":"Kolphetsah inlang amaho sucheh-in, nathalchangho kapdoh inlang amaho sumangin."},"7":{"text":"Chunga konin nakhut hin lhangin lang, neilha doh-in, twipi nasatahho lah-a konle, gamdangmi chate-a konin neihuh doh-in;"},"8":{"text":"Akamun thu manlou aseijun, akhut jetlamu chu joujou khut jetlam ahibouve."},"9":{"text":"Vo Pathen, nahenga lathah khat sange; tumging le manchah jangsom neijin nangma vahchoi La sange."},"10":{"text":"Lengho henga huhhingna pe-a ama ahin, aman asoh David kisuhkhahna chemjam'a konin ahuhdoh-e."},"11":{"text":"Gamchom chate-a konin neilha doh-in, neihuh doh-in, akamun mohthu aseijun, akhut jetnu chu khutjet dihlou ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ka chapateu khangdong ho chu thingphung khangtou bang uhen, ka chanuteu chu leng in ninga song kipotjola bang uhen."},"13":{"text":"Kachang inhou adima, akikholna jouse anenchet nadin, ka kelngoi teovin kakholai lamlen houva sang sangle sangsom cheng hinguhen."},"14":{"text":"Kabongchal hou natoh-a ahatnuva, kakholai houva thunoh asolouna din, golkeh louleh potdoh louvin umuhen."},"15":{"text":"Chutobanga um miho chu avangpha ahiuve, henge, a-Pathen'u Pakai hia mite chu avangpha ahiuve."}}},"145":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pathen, vo lengpa nangma vahchoi jingting, chule atonsot atonsotnin namin choi-an inge.","title":"Pathen Mihepina chunga David La bol"},"2":{"text":"Aniseh-in choi-an ningting, chule atonsot atonsotnin namin vahchoi jinge."},"3":{"text":"Pakai chu aloupi-in, sangtah-a vahchoi ding ahi; chule aloupinahi holdoh jouhoi ahipoi."},"4":{"text":"Nanatoh hohi khang khatnin, akhangkit geija avahchoija, chule thanei tah-a natohho aphon dohdiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nalal loupina le jana chu keiman seijing ting, nathilbol kidangho seijing kate."},"6":{"text":"Miten nathilbol gimneitahho thaneije seijuntin, chule keiman naloupina kaphonjal ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Amahon lhingsetnin naphatna loupitah geldoh untin, chule nachon phatna chu la'n saovinte."},"8":{"text":"Pakai chu lungsetna le khotona-a dimset ahin, lunghang vahlou, chule hepina dimset ahi."},"9":{"text":"Pakai chu mitin din aphan; chule ahepina chu anatoh jouse chunga aume."},"10":{"text":"Vo Pakai nathilbol jousen navahchoi juntin, chule namitheng ten nachoi-at dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amahon nalenggam loupije seijuntin, chule nathaneije asei dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Athilbol thahatje mihem chapate ahetsah ding; chule alenggam lal loupi ahetsah ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nalenggam chu tonsot lenggam ahin, chule navai homna akhang khanga um jingding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Pakaiyin alhu jouse akaidingin, chule aki sonkunho jouse akaithouvin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nangma velhijinga um mitjouse chu; aphatchan anehdiu napejin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nangin nakhut najah-in, ahingthei jouse angaichat cheh-un nalung lhaisahjin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Pakai chu alampi jouse-a chonpha ahin, anatoh jouse-a athenge."},"18":{"text":"Pakaiyin akoute jouse heng anaijin, dihtah-a ama koute jouse heng anaije."},"19":{"text":"Aman ama gingte ngaichat suhbulhit peh intin, ataonao asan peh-a, ahuhhing diu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Pakaiyin ama ngailuho jouse hongbit nintin, migilou jouse vang asuhmang ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Kakamin pakai vahchoina thu asei ding ahi; tahsa mihing jousen amintheng atonsot atonsotnin vahchoi uhen."}}},"146":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu vahchoijun, Vo kahinna Pakai chu vahchoijin.","title":"Apanpiu Pathen Ahijeh-a Kipana"},"2":{"text":"Kahinlaisen Pakai chu vahchoi jingting, limle mel kanei laisen Pakai vahchoi la sange."},"3":{"text":"Pipuiho chunga natahsana ngam hih-in; ama-a panpina umlou mihem chapate jong tahsan hih-in."},"4":{"text":"Ahaina achedohjin ama aleisetnah akilejin; hiche ni chuleh alunggel jouse abeiji tai."},"5":{"text":"Akithopi dinga Jacob Pathen neikha-a; akinepna Pakai a-Pathen hikha-a michu anunnom ahi."},"6":{"text":"Vanle leiset chule twikhanglen le asunga umjouse sempa; a-imatih channa thutah tuhjingpa chu ahi.","ref":"Sol 4:24; 14:15."},"7":{"text":"Aman akijoulhepho thu atanlhah peh-in; aman agilkelho an apen ahi. Pakai chun sohchangho alhatdoh tan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pakaiyin mitcho ho ahasah-in; Pakaiyin akineosah hochu akaithouve: Pakaiyin michonpha ho angailui."},"9":{"text":"Pakaiyin kholjin miho ahongbitnin, aman pabeiho le meithaiho a-olsahtai; migilouho lampi vang akhup athallin alehjin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Vo Zion na Pakai na-Pathen tah chun khangjouse chunga lengvai apoh ding ahi. Pakai chu vahchoijun."}}},"147":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu vahchoijun, ajehchu i-Pathen'u henga vahchoi la sah hi anomin; kipa aumin, chule vahchoi dinga lomtah ahi.","title":"Athu Jal Leh Athilpeh Jeh-a Pathen Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Pakaiyin Jerusalem asadoh-in; aman akinodohsa Israelte chu akhom khome."},"3":{"text":"Aman lungthima natna neiho asudamin; chule amaha puthou atompehjin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aman ahsi ho jat aseijin; abonchauvin aminu avo soh keijin ahi."},"5":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu alenin, thahat tah ahi; ahetkhen themna chu akhonna bei ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pakaiyin mi kineosah ho adomsangin; migiloute chu tolla aseplhan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Thangvah pumin Pakai henga la saovin; i-Pathen'u henga selangdah tothon vahchoi la saovin."},"8":{"text":"Aman van chu meilom'in atomin, leiset dingin go agongtoh-in, molsangho chunga kehdin hampa aseme."},"9":{"text":"Aman gamsaho a-an nehdiu apen; va-ah nou gilkelho aneh dingu apen ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ama sakol ho hatna-a akipahpon; mihem kenga jong kipana aneipoi."},"11":{"text":"Pakai chu ama gingte chunga akipah-in; ahepina-a kinemho chunga akipah-in ahi."},"12":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem, Pakai chu vahchoijin; vo Zion na Pathen chu vahchoijin."},"13":{"text":"Aman nakul kotpi kotgol ho ahamsah-in; nasunga nachate phatthei aboh-in ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nagam gi ho-ah cham alensah-in; suhlouchang phapenin nadipdim tan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Aman leiset chunga athupeh ahinsol doh-in; Athu chu gangtah-in alhaijin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Aman buhbang kelngoi mul bangin apen; buhlhah chu vutvam bangin athejaovin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aman abuhlhang ankong bangin athejalin; hiche adap masanga chu koi dingjou dingham?"},"18":{"text":"Aman thu apehleh hichu ajunlha tan; Ahui anunsah-in ahile twi ahung longtai."},"19":{"text":"Aman athu chu Jacob henga amusah-in; adan thuho le athutan chu Israel amusah tan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Aman koima nam achutibol khapon; ama thutan lhahho jong amahon ahepha pouve. Pakai chu vahchoijun."}}},"148":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu vahchoijun, van ho-a konin Pakai vahchoijun; chungsang ho-a chun vahchoijun.","title":"Vannoi Pumpi Pakai Vahchoi dia Kouna"},"2":{"text":"Avantil jousen, Pakai vahchoijun; ami janelten ama vahchoijun."},"3":{"text":"Nisa le lhathah-in ama vahchoijun; nangho ahsi vahho jousen ama vahchoijun."},"4":{"text":"Nangho vanlaijola vanhon ama vahchoijun; vanho chungvuma twipihon ama vahchoijun."},"5":{"text":"Amahon Pakai min vahchoi uhen; ajehchu aman thu apeh-a, amaho kisem ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Aman amaho tonsot atonsotna din aphutdetnin; apalkehlou diuvin thupeh apen ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nangho dragon ho le twithuh ho jousen; Leisetna konin Pakai chu Vahchoijun;"},"8":{"text":"Mei le gel, buhbang le meijun; khopi huijin athu aguilhunsah-in ahi."},"9":{"text":"Molsangho le lhangho; thingphung ga phaho le cedar thingho:"},"10":{"text":"Gamsaho le gancha jouse; tolla kitholho le chungleng vachaho:"},"11":{"text":"Leija lengho le mihem jouse; pipuiho le leiset thutan ho jouse:"},"12":{"text":"Gollhangho le nungah ho; tehse ho le chapangho:"},"13":{"text":"Amahon Pakai minchu vahchoi uhen: Ama minbou chu chungnunpen ahin; aloupina leile van chungvuma uma ahi."},"14":{"text":"Mithengte jouse choi-at nan; Israel chate, ama kinaipi mite choi-at nan; Aman amite ki adomsangtai. Pakai chu vahchoijun."}}},"149":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai vahchoijun. Pakai vahchoina lathah khat saovin lang; mithengte houkhom na-a ama vahchoina la saovin.","title":"Ami Huhhingna Leh Athutan Dih Jeh-a Pathen Vahchoina"},"2":{"text":"Israel chu ama hinsem Pa-ah kipah hen; Zion chate chu alengpao chunga thanomu hen."},"3":{"text":"Lam to thon amin vahchoi uhen; khongchale selangdah-in avahchoila saohen."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai amite chunga alunglhaijin; Aman mi nunnem chu huhhingna-a ajephoi ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mithengte chu loupi na-in kipah uhen; ajalkhun hou chunguva gingtah-in la saohen."},"6":{"text":"Akamuva Pathen sangtah-in vahchoi uhen; akhutnuva hemto chemjam kidop uhen;"},"7":{"text":"Pathen hephalouho chunga phulahna chuhsah dingle mitin chunga engbolna chuhsah ding;"},"8":{"text":"Alengteu thihkhaova hen dingle, amilalteu thihbul tuh ding;"},"9":{"text":"Thutanlhah kijihdohsa achunguva tongdoh dingin, hiche jana hi amithengte jousen aneijun ahi. Pakai chu vahchoijun."}}},"150":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai chu vahchoijun. Amuntheng sunga Pathen vahchoijun, athil boltheina vanthamjol lah-a ama vahchoijun.","title":"Thiljousen Pakai chu Vahchoijun"},"2":{"text":"Anatoh kidangtahho jal-in ama vahchoijun, alet loupina dungjuijin ama vahchoijun."},"3":{"text":"Sumkon ginnin ama vahchoijun, tumgingto selangdah-in vahchoijun."},"4":{"text":"Khongchale lamin ama vahchoijun, tumging tho-a manchah le semjang binei tho-in vahchoijun."},"5":{"text":"Khutbeh ginnin ama vahchoijun, khutbeh gin thong jejun ama vahchoijun."},"6":{"text":"Haitheina neijousen Pakai chu vahchoi uhen, Pakai chu vahchoijun."}}}}},"20":{"info":{"name":"Thuchihbu","shortname":"Thuch","abbr":[],"desc":"Thuchihbu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel leng David chapa Solomon thuchih ho;","title":"Thuchih ho Manlut Dan","ref":"1 Leng 4:32."},"2":{"text":"Chihna leh kihilna hetna ding, hettheina thuho kimudohna ding;"},"3":{"text":"Chihna, thutah, thutan lhahna chule thudih kihilnaho kisana ding:"},"4":{"text":"Milhamho gelchet theina, khangdongpa hetnale thil hetkhen them theina pehnading ahi."},"5":{"text":"Michingin ngaijin tin ahetna kibeding, chule hetthem theina nei michun themna akimuding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Thuchih le aledohna hetnading; miching thusei ho le giltah-a thu kiseiho hetkhenthem theina ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pakai gin kitihi hetna bulpi kipatna ahin, ahinla mingol hon vang chihna le kihilna asang pouvin ahi.","ref":"Job 28:28; Labu 111:10; Thuch 9:10."},"8":{"text":"Kachapa napan nahilna ngaijin, chule nanu thupeh chu nahsahmon koihih-in,","title":"Khangdong Hilchahna"},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu hicheho chu naluchanga dinga kijep hoina hiding, chule nangonga dinga khivui tobang hiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kachapa, michonse hon jollhah ding nagot tenguleh nomhih helin."},"11":{"text":"Amahon naheng-ah, hungin keihotoh thisanso ding ngah-u hitin, mona neilouho chu ajeh beijin guhthimin changu hite atiuva ahileh,"},"12":{"text":"Kokhuh sunga lhalut ho bangin, eihon amaho khu ahing sanun, apumchangin lhankhuh sunga vallutnu hite."},"13":{"text":"Eihon chutia chu thillu jouse ikimudoh dingu, thil kichom doh-a chu i-in'u idipdim dingu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Keiholah-a navang hung kisanin; ibonun sumdip khat neikhomu hite."},"15":{"text":"Kachapa amahotoh alamlhah uva chekhom hih-in; amaho lampia konin nakeng tuhtangin."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu akenghou chu aselama alhaijin; chule thisan sona lamah ajangkai uvin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tahbeh mongin vacha jouse mitmun panna beijin len chu akijal tan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule amahon amahole amaho thisan kiso dingjoh angah-un; amahole amaho hinkhojoh chu guhthimin achangun ahi."},"19":{"text":"Mipapseho lampi chu chutobang ding ahibouve; hichun aneiho tah hinkho jongchu alamangjin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chihnan lamlhong dunga asamlen, amanun lamkon tinchenga awthongin asamlelen ahi.","title":"Chihnan Kholhang Asap","ref":"Thuch 8:3."},"21":{"text":"Amanun lamthompi dungle kotpi lutna ho-a alhang samlen, khopi sunga amanun thu hitihin aseije,"},"22":{"text":"Nangho milhamhon, itihchan milhama umding nangai nahlai dingu ham? chule mitaitom ho amitaitom naova thanom jinguva, chule mingolten hetna ahotnahlai dingu ham?"},"23":{"text":"Kaphosalna hi nanghon ngaijun: veuvin, keiman nachung uva kalhagao kahin buhlhah ding, chule kathu kahin hetsah ding nahiuve."},"24":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman kakouvin, nangho nanom pouve; Keiman kakhutnin kahinsangun, koiman nei ngaisah pouve."},"25":{"text":"Ahinla kahilna jouse nanghon lahlou nahisah taovin, chule kaphosalna jong iman nasep pouve."},"26":{"text":"Keiman jong nangho hamsetna chu kanuisat ding, natijat nao ahunglhun teng nahsah-a kaneilou ding;"},"27":{"text":"Natijat naochu manthah na banga ahunglhuna, chule nakisuhmang naochu chimpei banga ahung lhunteng, gentheina le lungdonna nachung uva ahungchuh tengleh khohsahna kanei louding nahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Chutengle amahon thonlouva keima eihinkou dingu, hijongle keiman kadonbut louding; amahon keima eihinhol loi dingu, hijongle eimudoh loudingu ahi."},"29":{"text":"Achuti theina dinga amahon hetna chu anahotnu ahin, chule Pakai gin kitichu anakilhen louvu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Amahon kathumop angainom pouvin, amahon kiphosalna jong anahsah pouvin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu amahon achonnau ga akineh dingu, chule athil gonhouva chu dimding ahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Ajehchu milhamho chu akihei mangnao chun atha dingu, chule mingol ho chu aphat theinao chun asuhmang dingu ahi."},"33":{"text":"Ahin koi hijongleh keima sei ngaija chu bitkeija cheng ding, chule thilphalou kichatna-a kona hoidoh teiding ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kachapa, nangman kathuseiho nakisana, chule kathupeh ho nakichin tupma ahile;","title":"Chihna Neijeh-a Kipaman"},"2":{"text":"Chutia chu chihna lama nanakhang nasun geh-a, hetkhenthem theina lama nalung naman chah-a;"},"3":{"text":"Chule nangman hetna ding gunchu tah-a nahola, hetkhenthem theina dinga aw thong jena nasapma;"},"4":{"text":"Nangman amanu chu dangka banga nahola, chule gou kiselu banga nakhol chila ahileh;"},"5":{"text":"Chuteng nangman Pakai gin kitihi nahet khending; chule Pathen hetna hi nakimudoh teiding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin chihna apen, akam sunga konin hetna leh hetkhenthem theina asodoh-in ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aman michonpha ho dingin chihna phatah akoipeh-in; dihtah-a chonteho dingin ama chu lumdal'in apangin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Aman thu adih-a kitana lampiho chu aching tupmin, chule amithengte lampi chu aveng tupmin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuteng nangman chonphatna, thutandih, thildih, chule lampipha ho jouse hethem tan nate."},"10":{"text":"Chihna nalung sunga alutna, chule hetna chu nahinna-a dinga kipana ahunghi tengle;"},"11":{"text":"Chihtheina chun nangma nahoitup ding, hetkhenthem theinan nangma naventup ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hichun migiloupa lampia konle, jouthu thilho seipa akon;"},"13":{"text":"Milungdih lampiho peldoh-a, muthim lampiho joh-a chepa-a kon;"},"14":{"text":"Thilse bolna-a kipah-a, chule khangitlouna le engsetna-a thanom ho-a kon;"},"15":{"text":"Alampihou koile-a, chuleh alampi houva vahlon leho-a kona, huhdoh-a naum ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma numei phalounu-a konle, numei phalou akama pachat lhem seinu-a kon;"},"17":{"text":"Akhan donlaija apuihoipa dalha-a, chule Pathen toh akitepna sumildelnu a kona huhdoh-a naum ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu amanu in chun thina lama apuijin, chule lampi chun thina alhutnin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Amanu koma lutapou chu koima ahung kinungle pon, amahon hinna lampiho jong chu atuhdet pouve."},"20":{"text":"Chutia chu nangman miphaho lampi najot theiding, chule michonpha te lampiho nakichin tup thei ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu milungdih chu gamsunga chengintin, chule michamkim chu chua chengden ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahin migilouho vangchu leisetna kona suhgama umding, chule suhkhel neiho chu chua kona kaldoh-a umding ahiuve."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kachapa keima danthu sumil hih-in, ahinla kathupeh ho nalung thimin kichintup jingin;","title":"Khangdong Thuhilna"},"2":{"text":"Hichun nahin nikho, nahin kumkho, chule lungmona napehbe ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hepinale thutah chun nangma nadalha hihhel hen; hiteni chu nangonga khivui on ki-onlang, nalungthim sunga lekhajem kijihlut bangin jihlutnin."},"4":{"text":"Chutiachu nangman Pathen leh mihem mitmu-a, khohsahna le hetkhen themna chu nakimudoh teiding ahi.","ref":"Luk 2:52."},"5":{"text":"Nalungthim pumpin Pakai chu tahsanin; chule nangma chang hetkhen themtheina-a kingai hihbeh-in."},"6":{"text":"Nalampi jouse ama hetsah-in, chutile aman nalampi ho nahil ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma chang mitmu-a kichihsah hih-in; Pakai chu gingin, chule agilouva konin jammangin.","ref":"Rom 12:16."},"8":{"text":"Hichu nalaimu dinga damna, chule nagu nachang jouse dinga lhintwi hitei ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nathil lupen le nalhosoh ga masapen chu, Pakai janan tohdoh jengin."},"10":{"text":"Chutile nachangsal ho kidip letsetna; chule nalengpiga hehna-a chu lengpitwi thah hung longlet ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Kachapa Pakai gimbolna chu nahsahmo loujenin, aman mi asuhdihna jong chu chimchah hih-in.","ref":"Job 5:17.  ; Heb 12:5-6"},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu mipan alunglhaina chapa abolna bangin, Pakaiyin angailut mi chu asudihjin ahi.","ref":"Tph 3:19."},"13":{"text":"Chihna kimudoh-a, chule hetkhenthem theina kisanpa chu anun nom ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu hichea kivei chu dangka-a kiveina sangin aphan; chule ahung gadoh chu sana thengsel sangin jong aphajon ahi."},"15":{"text":"Amanu chu songmantam ho sangin alujon; chule nangai chat thilho jouse jongchu amanu chutoh tekah hoi ahipon ahi."},"16":{"text":"Amanu khut jetlama hinkho saona aumin; chule akhut veilama haona le jana aume."},"17":{"text":"Amanu lampiho chu nopna lampijong ahin, chule alampiho jouse chu chamna ahi."},"18":{"text":"Amanu kituhchah khahte dingin amachu hinna thingphung ahin; chule amanu kichinjing tapou chu anunnome."},"19":{"text":"Pakaiyin achihna-in leiset anaphutdoh-in; ahetkhen themna-in van ho anatung doh-in ahi."},"20":{"text":"Aman ahetna-in munthuh ho ahong jal-in; chule meilomho daitwijin ahin lhahsah-in ahi."},"21":{"text":"Kachapa hiche hohi namit mu-a konin jam mangsah hih-in; gellhuh them theina le chihna chu ngah tupmin."},"22":{"text":"Hichu nalhagao dinga hinna, chule na-ngong chang dinga kijepna hiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuteng nangma nalampi-a bitkeija nava le-a, chule nakeng jong kipal louding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Nangma nalup tengle nakichat tahlouhel ding, chule nangma lumin natin, nomsa tah-a na-imut ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Photlot louva tijatna, ahiloule khang gilouho chunga manthah na ahunglhun teng jongle kicha hih-in."},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai chu nakisonna hintin; chule nakeng chu akisuh khahna dinga kona nachintup pehding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Nakhutna boltheina thahat aum petnin, amahon thilpha amudingu chu suhtangpeh hih-in,"},"28":{"text":"Nahenga gahpehpai jengthei thil aumle, na-inhengpa jah-a, chetan, jingle hungkitjon, petei nange tin seihih beh-in."},"29":{"text":"Ama nakoma mongtah-a achen namu manin, na-inhengpa chunga thil gilou gonghih beh-in."},"30":{"text":"Aman nangma chunga setna abol louva ahile, ajeh beijin mikhat kidoupi hih-in."},"31":{"text":"Nangman misugenthei pa chu thangse hih-in; chule alampiho chu kilhen ding gohih-in."},"32":{"text":"Ajehchu milung dihlou chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, hinla ama thuguh chu michonpha te henga aumme."},"33":{"text":"Pakai sapsetna chu khan gitlouna insunga achun: ahinla aman midihtah chenna chu phatthei aboh-in ahi."},"34":{"text":"Tahbeh-in aman mi i-sah louva bolho chu i-sah louvin abolin; ahinla mi kineosah ho chu khotona apen ahi.","ref":"Jac 4:6; 1 Pet 5:5."},"35":{"text":"Miching chu loupina changding, hinlah mingol hon vang jum na ato dingu ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngaijun, chateho, hetkhen themtheina nakimudoh theina dingun, napan nahilnao hi ngai phaovin.","title":"Chihna Phatchomna"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman nangho thuhilpha kapeh nahiuve, ka danthu dalha hih beh-un."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu keima kapa chapa kahin, khangnou chitchet le kanu mitmu-a ngailut khatseh chu kahi."},"4":{"text":"Aman keima hiljong einahilin, chule kahenga hitin anaseije; nalungin kathuho chu kichintup min, kathupeh ho kituh detnin lang hinnan neijin."},"5":{"text":"Chihna kimun, hetkhen themtheina kimun, sumil hih beh-in; kakama thusohdoh ho-a konin jong kiheidoh hihbeh-in."},"6":{"text":"Amanu dalha hih-in, chule amanun nangma nahoitup ding ahin; amanu ngailun chutile amanun nangma navettup ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chihna hi thil lupen ahi, hijeh chun chihna chu kimun; chule nathil mu jouse chu hetkhen themtheina toh mudohtha teijin."},"8":{"text":"Amanu choisangin, chutile amanun nangma nadopsang ding ahi. Nangman amanu nakikolchah teng, amanun nangma jabolna mun'a nalhut ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Amanun naluchang chu ngailutna-a ajepding; amanun loupina lallukhuh nahenga ahinlhut ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ngaijin, vo kachapa, chule kaseihohi kisanin; chutile nahin kumkho sot ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Keiman nangma chihna lampi kahiltan, keiman nangma lamdih ho-a chun kalamkai tai."},"12":{"text":"Nangma nachele teng nakalson kisudong pontin; chule nalhaiteng jongle nangma kipal lhu ponnate."},"13":{"text":"Hilchahna chu tuhdetkheh-in, amanu chu lhaso hih in; kivet tupmin, ijeh inem itile amanu chu na hinna ahi."},"14":{"text":"Khang giloute lampia nangma lut hih-in; chule miphaloute lampia cheloujenin."},"15":{"text":"Peldoh-in, anaija chehih in, chua konin kihei mangin, chule chemang jengin."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu thilse abol louvule amaho a-imu pouvin; chule amahon khattou lhuhna ding abol masang seuvin a-imuthei pouvin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon khan gitlouna changlhah chu aneuvin, chule thisan sona lengpitwi adonun ahi."},"18":{"text":"Amavang midihtah te lampi chu vah bangin a-emselin; nikho hoitah asodoh changeija vahcheh cheh tobang ahi."},"19":{"text":"Mikhang giloute lampichu muthim tobang ahin; amaho ipi-a kipal lhu hiuvem aheji pouvin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kachapa kathuseiho phaten ngaijin; kathusei ho-a nanakhang hin sungin."},"21":{"text":"Hicheho chu namitmu-a konin jam mangsah hih-in; hiche chu nalunggil sunga kichintup min."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche chu akimudohte dinga hinna, chule atahsa pumpi diuva damna ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chingthei tah-in nalungsung kivet tupmin; ajehchu chua kona chu hinkho-a thilsoh ho hungsoh doh ji ahi."},"24":{"text":"Nanga konin jouthu sei chu koimangin; chule alam louva muhthem nachu gamla tah-in koijin."},"25":{"text":"Namit chun vejangpet henlang, chule namitnel honjong namasang vejang keihen."},"26":{"text":"Nakeng phangin achot nading lampi kivet phatnin; chule nalampi jouse chu semtupmin umhen.","ref":"Heb 12:13."},"27":{"text":"Jetlam ahiloule veilama kiheidoh hihbeh in; setna a konin nakeng sepdoh jengin."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kachapa kachihna hi lunglut tah-in ngaiphan; chule kahetkhen themtheina lama hin nanakhang hin sungin.","title":"Jonthanhoi Chungchanga Gihsalna"},"2":{"text":"Chutile thil datkhen je nahetding, nakamin jong hetna achintup thei ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu miphalou nu muh chu khoiju abangin; chule amanu kamsung chu thaosangin analjon ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahinla amanu kichaina chu gamsai bangin akhan, hemto chemjam bangin ahemin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amanu kengin thinalam ajonsuh in; akalseho chun thikholmun achonlut tan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nangman hinna lampi chu lunggil tah-a nangaito louva ahile, amanu lampiho chu kikhel thipthap ahin, chutia chu nangin lampiho chu nahet theilou ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun chateho tun kathu ngaijun, chule kakamsung thuho-a konin nangho kiheimang hih-un."},"8":{"text":"Amanu-a konin nalampi khin gamlan, chule amanu kotphung jong hin nailut hih-in."},"9":{"text":"Achuti louleh jabola naumna chu midangho kipedoh intin; chule nahinkumkho chu engseho henga kipedoh ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nahaona jouse jong gamdang mihon haonan neijuntin chule natohgim ga jouse jong gamdang mi inna lut ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Natahsa leh naphe suhmanga aumteng, achaina keija lunghema naum ding;"},"12":{"text":"Chule nangman seijin natin, itobanga hilchahna kana hotna, chule kalungin phona donse louva anakoi hitam?"},"13":{"text":"Chule jilkung hon eihilnao kana ngaida-a, eithumop ho thupeh-a kanakhang kanasunlou hitam!"},"14":{"text":"Keima houkhom nale khoppi lah-a jong, agilouva mangthah paidin kana ume nati ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nangma twibel'a konle nangma twikhuh-a kon hung longdoh twiho bouchu donin."},"16":{"text":"Natwinah ho chu thejalin umhen lang, chule vadung twiho chu lamlhongpi dunga longhen."},"17":{"text":"Amaho chu nangma changseh-a bou hihen lang, naum khompi gamdang miho-a hida hen."},"18":{"text":"Natwinah chu phatthei boh-in umhen; chule nakhang donlai na-inneipitoh kipahkhom lhonin."},"19":{"text":"Amanu chu dei umtah sajuh leh lunglhai umtah sajuh chal tobang hihen, amanu anglum chun phatjousen nalung lhaisah hen; chule amanu ngailutna chun nangma a-imatih chanin lung mongin nakoi jinghen."},"20":{"text":"Chule kachapa ipi dinga hetkhahlou numei khat toh nakikolchah-a, chule hetkhahlou khatchu nangman nakikoipi ding ham?"},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu mihem lampi jouse Pakaiyin amu sohkei ahin; chule aman amapa chena jouse chu avelhi jingin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Khan gitlouna bolpa chu athepmonan amatchah ding, chule amatah chonsetna chun khao banga akanchah ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Amachu hilchahna beija thiding, chule angol behseh jeh-a vahmang ding ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kachapa nangma nagol dinga kitepna thila kitung nahi tah-a, gamdang mitoh kikhutsan nahitahle,","title":"Gihsalna Belap"},"2":{"text":"Nakam sunga kon naseidoh thuchengho chun nangma namat den ahitai."},"3":{"text":"Kachapa, tun hichehi bolin, nangma le nangma kihudoh-in; nagolpa khutna chu naum tengle, chen, gakisunem min, nagolpa chu galung lhaijin."},"4":{"text":"Namit chu nguisah hih-in, chule namitteni jong kisin sah hih-in."},"5":{"text":"Gamlengpa khutna kon sajuhchal akitol doh bangle, thangkampa khutna kona vacha khat akitol doh bangin, nangma kihuhdoh in."},"6":{"text":"Vo mithase, sihmi henga gachen, alamlhah ho ngaiton lang, chihnan neijin."},"7":{"text":"Aman apuihoi, avesui, ahiloule vaihom aneipon;"},"8":{"text":"Aman nipilai leh nehding akisuh tupmin, chule chang at laile neh le chah akikhol khomjin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Vo mithase, itihchan na-imut nahlai ding ham? Itihle na-imutna-a kona nahung kithodoh ding ham?"},"10":{"text":"Chom chakhat na-imun nalulhu kitjin, imudingin nakhut nalhepton;","ref":"Thuch 24:33-34."},"11":{"text":"Chutia chu vaichatna-in kholjin vahle banga, chule lhahsamna-in hem le thal kikenpa banga nahin lhunkhum ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Seingailou mi, mikhang gilou chu jouthu seijin avah lejin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aman amit teni asat lhaplhap jin, akengin thu aseijin, akhutjunghon mi ahilji;"},"14":{"text":"Aman alungsunga jouthu jeng agelin, thilphalou chu agongjom jingin, kitolouna atun ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh achu achunga vangsetna phulou helouva hunglhung ding; phulou helouva ama jendam thei louva kisuse ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hiche thil gup hohi Pakaiyin ahot ahi; Henge, sagi chu amadinga thet umtah ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Ahot Thilsagi"},"17":{"text":"Kiletsah maiso, jouseina leigui, chule mona neilou thisan sona khut,"},"18":{"text":"Thil gilou gongji-a lungthim, agiloulam delna-a kaljanga keng,"},"19":{"text":"Hettohsah lhem jouthu seija, chule sopite lah-a kitolouna muchi banga tulut jia mihem."},"20":{"text":"Kachapa napa thupeh nitnin, chule nanu danthu lhaso hih-in,","title":"Jonthanhoi Chungchanga Gihsalna"},"21":{"text":"Hicheho chu nalungsunga kichin jingin; chule nangonga khivui on ki-o jingin."},"22":{"text":"Nachele teng hichun nalamkai ding, na-imut teng hichun nachintup ding; chule nakhahdoh tengle hichun nakihou limpi teiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu thupeh chu meivah ahin, danthu chu vah ahi, chule kihila kiphosalna chu hinna lampi ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hicheho chun numei gilounu-a konle, gamdang numeinu pachat lhemna thuho-a kona nahoitup ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Amanu hoina chu nalungin ngaicha hihbeh in; chule amit hadan jong kilhep lhahsah hih-in."},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu jonthanhoi bol numeinu chu pasal khatnin changlhah halkhatna akichoh thei ahin; chule mijongnu chun hinkho manlu tahchu asuhmang ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Mikhatnin a-opma mei achoija, apon kalouva um theijem?"},"28":{"text":"Mikhat song meihol kitih-am chunga chea, akeng kalouva um theijem?"},"29":{"text":"Hitia chu a-inhengpa inneipi henga galutna michu, koihile amanu tongkha chan chu themo changding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Mikhat touvin agilkel pet tah-a ahinna suhlunglhai nadinga guhchat abola ahileh, min guchapa chu amusit ngaipoi."},"31":{"text":"Akimatdoh vangle amachun ajat sagi-a aditding; a-insunga thiljouse apeh ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Ahinla koihile numei khat toh jonga vangchu het themna lhasama ahin, chutobang bolla chun ama hinkho akisuhset ahitai."},"33":{"text":"Amachun mavo nale kijumsona akimuding; chule ama i-sah louva aumna chu kitheh mang joulou ding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Ajehchu kithangset hi mihem lunghanna ahin; hijeh-a chu phulahna nikho ahung lhunteng aman khen aneilouhel ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Aman kilhatdohna thil khatcha adonpeh louding; thilpeh tamtah pejongle chun, ama lunglhai louding ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kachapa kathuho kichin tupmin, chule kathupeh ho kikhol khom minlang hin,"},"2":{"text":"kathupeh ho kichintup minlang hingin, chule ka dan chu namit mu-a alupen hihen."},"3":{"text":"Hicheho chu nakhut jungho-a kibunlang; nalungsunga kijih lutnin,"},"4":{"text":"nangman chihna henga chun kasopinu nahi tin, chule hetkhen themtheina chu na inkonu hisah-in,"},"5":{"text":"Chutile hicheho chun gamchom numei nu-a konle, gamdang mi pachat lhem seinu-a kona nahuhdoh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu ka-in bangkotna bangvang kah-a kagah ven,","title":"Numei Chon chavainu"},"7":{"text":"milhamho lah chu kaven, khangdongho lah-a chun, hetkhenthem theina neilou golhang khat kagah lhengdoh theijin,"},"8":{"text":"Amanu umna ningkoi lamlhah-a achepai jengin, chule amapan amanu inlam ajonjelin,"},"9":{"text":"nilhah lam, khothim chipchep in, jan muthim jing noija,"},"10":{"text":"veuvin, numei kijoh vona kivonle, dohathuh numei khatnin amapa chu ana kimupi tan ahi."},"11":{"text":"(Amanu chu husetah le louchaltah ahin, akengchu a-in'a angaman hihbeh-in;"},"12":{"text":"abang komle amanu apama aumin, abang komle lamlhah-a aumin, chule ningkoi tinchenga achanglhi jingin ahi.)"},"13":{"text":"Hitichun amanu chun amapa chu amanin, achopmin, chule jah motah in amapa henga aseije,"},"14":{"text":"keiman chamna kilhaina thilto kaneije, tuni hin keiman kakitepna ho kapetan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hichejeh-a chu nangma kimupi dinga, gunchu tah-a namaiso holdinga kahung vadoh ahin, chule nangma kamudohtan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Kajalkhun jemhoitah khaodip ponin, akigeitho thilho-in, chule Egypt tupat ponnemjetnin kajem joutan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Kajalkhun chu myrrh, aloes chule thingthal gimnamtuiho-a keiman kasu namtuisoh keijin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hungin jingkhovah kahsen eini chimsetnin kinou hitin, mongtah-in kinou chimset hite."},"19":{"text":"Ka inneipao la ina aumpoi, gamlatah-a jindoh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Aman sum dip khat akisemin, nikho atepni lebou in hunglhung ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Amanun thu ngeitah seijin, amapa chu ajol lhatan, amuh nal-heu pachatna lhemin amapa chu athujo tan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Bongchal khatnin akithana ding mun, ahiloule mingol khatnin bul akituh nading bangin; amapan amanu nungchu ajuijel tan;"},"23":{"text":"Thalchangin athinlung asutpai bangle; vacha khat kikin sah tah-a thanga a-o tobangin, amapan ahinkho manthah ding akihet pon ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hijeh chun vo nangho chapangho kaseihi kingaijun; chule kakama hungsoh doh thuho hi kigel phatnun."},"25":{"text":"Amanu chena lama chun nalung onsah hih-in; amanu lampiho a chun kiheimangin lut hihbeh-in."},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu amanun mi tamtah ama put sahtan; chule mihat tamtah jong alousahjou ahitai."},"27":{"text":"Amanu in chu thikholmun jotna lampi ahin; thina indanho jotsuhna ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chihna chun kholhang asapji hilouham? chule hetkhen themtheina-in a-aw ahin sodohji hilouham?","title":"Chihna Vahchoina","ref":"Thuch 1:20-21."},"2":{"text":"Amanu munsang vumlai tah-ah, lamthom tina adingin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amanun kotpi phungho, khopi lutnaho chule kotna hung lutna ho-a asamlen ahi."},"4":{"text":"Vo miho kahinkou nahiuve, chule ka awgin hin mihem chapate chu akou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vo nangho milhamte, chihna kihet themun; chule nangho mingolte, hetkhen themtheina lungthim neijun."},"6":{"text":"Ngaijun, ajehchu thilpha chung nungho kahinsei ding ahin; chule kakamsoh chun thilpha ngen aseiding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu kakamin thutah aseiding, chule phatlouna chu kakam dinga thet umtah ahi."},"8":{"text":"Kakama kon sohdoh thucheng jouse chu chonphatna ahin, hicheho-a chun khan gitlouna leh vakoina aumpon ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahekhen themtheipa dingin hicheho chu akicheh-in; chule hetna kimudoh tedin adih chu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Dangka sangin hilchahna chu kisanin lang, chule sana deitah sangin jong hetna chu kisanin,"},"11":{"text":"ajehchu chihna hi songmantam sangin aphajon; chule deithei thilho jouse chutoh tekah theihoi ahipoi."},"12":{"text":"Chihna kiti keima hi datkhenthem natoh kacheng khomin, chule keiman hetna leh chihnaho kamudoh in ahi."},"13":{"text":"Pakai gin kitihi thilse hot bolding hi ahin; Kiletsahna, hoithona, setna lampi, chule jou seina kam hi keiman kahot ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chihna giltah leh thumop chu keija ahin, keima hetkhenthem theina chu kahin, chule thahatna kaneije."},"15":{"text":"Keima jal-in lenghon vai apouvin, chule pipuihon dihtah-in thutana abolun ahi."},"16":{"text":"Keima jal-in pipuiho, milal ho, leiset pumpi-a thutan ho jengin jong vai ahomun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Keima eingailute chu kangailun; chule matah-a eiholte chun eimudiu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Haonahole jana keija aumin, henge, haosatna le chonphatna jong keijah aume."},"19":{"text":"Kaga hi sana sangin aphajon, ahi, sana phapen sangin aphajoi, katoh dohsa jong hi dangka lhentum sangin aphajoi."},"20":{"text":"Chonphatna lampi-a kalamkaijin, Thutanna lampiho lah-a kalamkaije."},"21":{"text":"Chutia chu eingailute chu keiman gou kalosah ding; chule agouho chu kadimsetsah ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Khanglui laija Pakaiyin na anatoh masang, chule alampiho kipat tilla, aman keima einanei ahitai.","ref":"Tph 3:14."},"23":{"text":"Keima tonsotna pat, abula pat, ahilouleh leiset ana kisemdoh masanga pat eina kitungdoh ahitai."},"24":{"text":"Munthuh tah anaum masang, twinengtah-a akikholna twinaho ana um masanga pat, keima anakipodoh kahitai."},"25":{"text":"Mol le lhangho anaum masanga, keima einakipo doh-a kahitai."},"26":{"text":"Aman leisetle gamho, vannoi leiset sangpen asemdoh masang peh-a jong anaum kahitai."},"27":{"text":"Aman vanho anagona, munthuh akolkhum laichun, keima kana ummin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Aman chunga meilomho anaphudoh-a, twinah thuhho anahatsah laichun,"},"29":{"text":"Aman twiho akiveina kalval akhokhel louna dinga, leiset bul aphudoh a chu twikhanglen thupeh ananei ahitai."},"30":{"text":"Chuti chun amatoh thilkhat hung kikhoukhah bangin ama koma kana ummin; chule ama anga kipah jingle, nitinna ama dei kanahin,"},"31":{"text":"Pathen semsa leiset chen nathei munkhatna chun kanakipah-in; chule kalunglhaina chu mihem chapate chunga anaumin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun vo chateho, kathu sei hi kichintup mun; ajehchu kalampiho nit chan chu anunnom ahi."},"33":{"text":"Hilchahna kingaijunlang, chihnan neijun, hichu pampai hih-un."},"34":{"text":"Kathusei phatecha ngaija, nitina kakotpiphung velhijing, kakot bulho-a ngahjingpa chu anunnom ahi."},"35":{"text":"Ajehchu koihile keima eikimudoh-a chun hinna akimudoh ahitan; chule Pakai lunglhaina chu changding ahi."},"36":{"text":"Ahinla keima douna-a chonsepa vang chun, amatah hinkho chu dihlouva akibol ahi. Keima eihotbol chanchun thina joh angailut ahi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chihna in a-in akisah doh-in, chule khompi jong sagi atungdohtai.","title":"Chihna leh Ngolna"},"2":{"text":"Amanun aganchaho akitha-in; ajuho jong ahaltoh-in, adokhangho jong ajem joutai."},"3":{"text":"Amanun asoh numei ho asoldoh joutai; amanun khopi sunga munsangpena kon asamin,"},"4":{"text":"Milham koi hile hilama hungkile heihen, hetthem theina ngaichaho henga chun amanun aseijin,"},"5":{"text":"hungin, ka changlhah nenlang, kahalsa juhi hungdonin ati."},"6":{"text":"Ngolna chu dalhanlang hingin; chule hetkhen themtheina lampia chen."},"7":{"text":"Mitaitom hat ho phoh-a, adih bolsah ding gopa chu ama le ama akijumso jin, chule agilou phohsala chun gimna akimun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Mitaitom hatchu suhdih ding gohih-in; aman nahot loding ahi. Miching chu phoh le chun aman nangailut ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Miching chu hilchah lechun ama ching cheh ding: Midihtah pa chu hil lechun, chutile ama hetna lama khangtou ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Pakai gin hi chih kipatna chu ahin; Mithengpa het kiti jonghi hetkhen themna chu ahi.","ref":"Job 28:28; Labu 111:10; Thuch 1:7."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu keima-a nahin nikhoho kipunsah-a; chule nahinkumho kisutam ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Nangma aching nahile, nangma dingabou ching nahin; ahinla nangman nataitomle, hichu nangman nachanga nakipoh ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Numei ngolchu akam atamin, mimol ahin, chule hetna imacha aneipoi."},"14":{"text":"Amanu akotphunga atouvin, khopisunga munsang ho-a touna-a jong atouji-e."},"15":{"text":"Achena ding lampia jangpetna chehon ahin jotpa tengule akoujin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Milham koi hile hilama hungkile heihen, hetthem theina ngaichaho henga chun amanun aseijin,"},"17":{"text":"Twi kigu chu alhumin, chule changlhah aguh a kine chu atuije."},"18":{"text":"Ahinla amapan hia chun thina aume, chule amanu jinho chu thikholmun thuhlaija um ahiuve ti ahepon ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chapa chingin apa akipasah in; amavang chapa ngol chu anu dinga hesohna bep ahi.","title":"Solomon Thuchihho"},"2":{"text":"Khan gitlouna gouho chun koima aphatchom sahpon; ahinla chonphat na-in thina-a konin ahuhdoh theije."},"3":{"text":"Pakaiyin michonpha hinkho chu kel thoh dinga asuhgenthei louding; amavang khan giloute thil le lo vang asuhmang peh ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Khut thase tah-a natongpa chu ahung vaichan, hinla migunchu khutnin haona amujie."},"5":{"text":"Nipi laija kikholkhoma chu chapa ching ahin, ahinla chang at laija ihmupa vangchu jachat konsah chapa ahi."},"6":{"text":"Phattheina chu michondih tah luchunga aumin, migiloute kamsunga vang hunama thuseijin atomchah-in ahi."},"7":{"text":"Midihtah hetjingna chu phattheina ahin, amavang mikhangilou chu amin mangthah ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Milungching chun thupeh ho akisan ding, mingol moh paopao vangchu lhutei ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Dihtah-a kalsongpa chu mongtah-in achejin; alampiho-a vahveija chu hetdoh-a umding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Amit satlaplap pachun gimna asosah-in; ahinla mingol moh paopao vangchu lhuding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Michonpha kamchu hinna twikhuh ahin; migiloute kamsunga vang hunama thuseijin atomchah-in ahi."},"12":{"text":"Kihotna-in kinahna akondoh sah-in; ahivangin ngailutnan chonset jouse akhujin ahi.","ref":"Jac 5:20; 1 Pet 4:8."},"13":{"text":"Hetkhenthem theina neipa kamsunga chun chihna akimudoh in; ahinla mol chu het khenthem theina neiloupa tungtuna ding ahibouve."},"14":{"text":"Miching hon hetna akikholun, ahinla mingol kam vangchu manthah na toh naicha ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahaopa haona chu akhopidet ahin; migenthei ho suhgemna chu avaichatnau ahi."},"16":{"text":"Michonpha te tohgimna chun hinna asodoh in, agiloute toh ga vang chonsetna ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hilchahna kichintup pa chu hinna lampia aumin, ahinla phona sangloupa chu avahthai jin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ami hotna selgu chanchu mijou ahin, chule thujouva mi seise-a chu angol ahi."},"19":{"text":"Thucheng tamna-a chun chonsetna alhasampon, ahin akam kihupthem thei michu miching ahi."},"20":{"text":"Midihtah lei chu dangka thengsel tobang ahin; migilou lungthim vang pannabei ahi."},"21":{"text":"Michonpha kam chun mi tampi avah-in; ahinla mingol hovang chihna lhahsam jeh-in athijin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Pakai phattheiboh na-in haosatna asodoh sah-in; chule hiche-a chun gimna abelap pon ahi."},"23":{"text":"Gitlouna hi mingol dingin kichep golseh tobang ahin; ahinla hetkhenthem theina neipan chihna aneijin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Migilouvin akichat jing kichatna chu amachunga hunglhung ding; ahinla michonpha ngaichat chu kipeding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chimpei kitolmang bangin agiloupa chu aumtapon; ahinla michonpha chu tonsotna kiphutdet ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ha dinga lengpitwi thuh, mit dinga meikhu ahibangin, mithase chu asolleho dingin chutobang chu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Pakai ginna chun nikhoho asaosah-in ahi, ahinla agiloute kumho vangchu kisuchom ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Michonpha te kinepna chu kipana hintin, migiloute kinepna vang manthah na hiding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Pakai lampi chu midih dingin thahatna ahi, ahinla khansetna tongho dinga suhgemna hiteiding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Michonpha te chu imatihchana suhlonga umlou helding, ahinla migilou ten leiset alo loudingu ahi."},"31":{"text":"Midih kamsungin chihna asodohsah-in; ahinla jouthusei lei vangchu ki-atdoh ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Michonpha kamsung chun santhei ahen; ahinla mikhang gilou kamin vang jouthu bou aseijin ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khaikot dihlouva kite hi Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, ahinla dihtah-a kite chu ama lunglhaina ahi."},"2":{"text":"Kiletsahna ahunglhun teng, jum na ahung lhungin, ahinla mi kineosah koma chihna aum jinge."},"3":{"text":"Mikitahte phatna chun amaho apuihoi ding, ahinla suhkhelna neiho louchalna chun amaho asuhmang ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Lungsat nikhoteng haonaho pannabei ahin, chonphat na-in vang thina-a konin ahuhdoh-e."},"5":{"text":"Chamkimsel mihem chu achonphatnan lamdih-a apuiding; amavang khanggilou chu akhangit louna-a lhuding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Milungdih ho achonphatnao chun amaho ahuhhing ding, amavang mi kitahlouho chu amahotah suhkhelna chun amatden diu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Migilou athiteng akinepna chu mang ding ahin; chule midihlou ho kinepna chu amangjitai."},"8":{"text":"Michonpha chu lungkham na-a konin huhdoh-in aumin; chule migiloupa chu michonpha pa thakhelin lungkham na-a ahunglutjin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mipha lhemin aheng akom chu akamin asumangin, ahinla hetnavanga midihtah chu huhdoh-a umding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Michonpha ho akhantou tengle khopi akipahjin, amavang mikhangilou amanthah teng min a-eu jie."},"11":{"text":"Midih phatthei achan jal-in khopi choisangin aumjin; ahinla migilouho kamso jeh-in suhchimin aum jitai."},"12":{"text":"Chihna notthapma koi mihem chun a-inheng iman agelpon; ahinla hetkhenthem theina neipa vang chun chamna akituh chah-in ahi."},"13":{"text":"Guhthima thuseijin thuguhho aphong dohjin, hinla tahsan umtah mihem vang chun thuguh chu a-imjouvin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Kithumop umlouna-a chun mipi alhujin, ahinla mithumop tamna a chun hoidohna aume."},"15":{"text":"Gamdang mikhat dinga bat thila ama le ama kitunga chun lunggimna akimu teiding, hinla midinga bat thila kitunding nomlouva chu hoidoh teiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Lungsetna dim numei jin jana akilamdoh-in chule pasal thahat hon haonaho akilamdoh ji-e."},"17":{"text":"Hepi nadim pasal'in alhagaodin napha atongin; mi engsepa vangin atahsatah ngeijong asugime."},"18":{"text":"Agiloupan lheplhahna dimset na atongin, ahinla chonphatna muchi tupa ding chun thonlou kipana aumme."},"19":{"text":"Chonphatna in hinna apuilut bangin, thilse delpa chun amatah thina dinga adel ahi."},"20":{"text":"Khangitlouna lung puho chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; chutobanga chu nolnabei miho lamdih-a acheu chu ama lunglhaina ahi."},"21":{"text":"Migiloute khat le khat akhutnun kituhto jongleu talen manlouva umloudiu; ahinla michonpha chilhah vang kihuhdoh ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Numei melhoitah hetthem theina neilou chu, vohpi nahkuija sana thengsel kibapeh tobang bep ahi."},"23":{"text":"Michonpha lungdei chu aphalam jengbou ahin; amavang migilou kinepna chu lungsatna ahibouve."},"24":{"text":"Mihem khatnin manbeijin ahomdohjin, hinlah akhangtouvin ahaocheh cheh jin; mihem khat apehdingdol jong pelouva it aumin, hinlah hiche chun vaichatna lam alhutjon ahi."},"25":{"text":"Mihongphal hinna chu suhthaova umding; chule midinga twi chappeh chan chu ama jong kichap pehding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ahop ding chang itna michu mipin agaosap ding, ahinla chuche johdohpa lujanga chu vangbohna chuding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Gunchu tah-a apha holpa chun khohsahna akimudoh-a, thilphalou holpa henga vang ase hunglhung ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ahaona-a kisongpa chu lhutei ding ahin, ahinla michonpha vang thingbah banga khangtou ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ama insungtah suboipa goulo chu hui hiding; chule mingol chu milungchingpa soh-a pangding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chonphat ga chu hinna thingphung ahin; chule lhagaoho huhhingpa chu miching ahi."},"31":{"text":"Veuvin, chonphate chu leisetna lethuh-a umding ahiuvin, migiloute leh chonsete jongchu chuche sanga tamcheh-a kilethuh ding ahiuve.","ref":"1 Pet 4:18."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Koi hile hilchahna ngailu-a chun hetna angailut ahin, kiphona hotbolpa vangchu mingol ahi."},"2":{"text":"Mipha chu Pakai khohsahna achangin, ahinla khangitlou thil gongpa vangchu themmo achanding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Phatlouna-in mikhatcha atundoh louding, ahinla michonpha te kijung khona vangchu suhlonghoi hilouding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Numei chonchan pha chu a-inneipu dinga lallukhuh ahin, hinla jachatna hinlhut numei vangchu amapa ding aguho monlha tobang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Michonpha lunggel ho chu adih-in, amavang mikhangilou thumop chu kijou lhepna ahibouve."},"6":{"text":"Mikhang giloute kamcheng vang thisanso ding chanlhih ding thu ahin; ahinla midihte kamsungsoh vang chun amaho ahuhdoh ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Agiloute chu lekhupmin aumin, abeiji taovin, ahinla michonpha in vangchu dingjing ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Mikhat chu ama lungsung chihna dungjuija pachat hintin, ahinla lungdihlou kengpa vangchu isahlou hiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ama le ama kijabola nehding lhasampa sangin mi i-sah louva um, ahia soh neija michu aphajon ahi."},"10":{"text":"Michonphan agancha hinkho akhoh sah-in; ahinla migiloupa nemheuva mikhotona chu engsetna ahibouve."},"11":{"text":"Agam kilhopa chun nehle chah lhingsetna amuding, ahinla pannabei miho juilepa vangchu hetthem theina lama ahomkeo ahibouve."},"12":{"text":"Mikhangilou vin miphalouho lenthang adeichan, ahinla chonphatna jungchun ga asodoh-e."},"13":{"text":"Mikhang gilou chu ama thusei dihlouva chun a-oh jin, ahinla midihtah pachu boina-a kona ongdoh ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Akamsunga thupot vanga mikhat chu aphalama lunglhai ding, chule akhut tah-a natongpa chu atohga ama kipetei ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Mingolin achena lampi chu ama mitnin adih-in amun;
