ahinla hilchahna ngaipa chu miching ahi."},"16":{"text":"Mingol khat lungsatna chu apettah-a kihedoh ahin, milungchingin vang jum na akhukhumin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Thutah seidohpa chun chonphatna atah langin, ahinla hettohsah lhem vang chun lheplhahna avetsah-e."},"18":{"text":"Chemjam'a kisun banga thusei aumin, ahinla miching thusei chu damna ahi."},"19":{"text":"Thutah sei kamsung chu a-imatih chana kiphutdoh ding ahin, ahinla thujou seina leigui vangchu chomkhat kah dingbou ahi."},"20":{"text":"Lheplhahna hi ase gelho lunga aumjin, ahinla chamna thuhil ho-a vang kipana aume."},"21":{"text":"Midihtah chunga thilse sohlou ding ahin; ahinla agilou chu setna-a dimding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Thujou seina kamchu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, ahinla thutah a kimangchaho vang chu ama lunglhaina ahi."},"23":{"text":"Michingin hetna akikoi tupmin, ahinla mingol ho lungin vang ngolna asamlen ahi."},"24":{"text":"Gunchupa khutnin vaihomna achoiding ahin, hinla thasepa vangchu hunama na kitohsah ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Lungsung pohgih na-in mi alungkham sah-in, ahinla thupha cheng khatnin akipasah-e."},"26":{"text":"Michonpha chu aheng akom sangin gamchengin apha chung nungjon, hinla migilou lampi chun amaho apuimangji-e."},"27":{"text":"Mithase chun agam lenna-a atha sa chu agou jipoi, hinla agunchupa thil vang chu manlutah ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chonphatna lampia chun hinna aumin, chule chuche lampia chun thina himhim aumpoi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chapa chingin apa thuhilna angaijin, mi i-sah loupan vang phona angaipon ahi."},"2":{"text":"Min akamsoh ga tuitah akineh ding ahin, hinla suhkhelna neiho hinna-in vang hunama kibol anehdiu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Akam kituh tuppan ahinkho akivettup ahin, hinla akamtampa vang chun suhgemna ato teiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Mithasen alungin angaichan hinla aneijipoi; ahivangin migunchu pa hinna chu haosatah-a umding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Michonphan joule nala thu kisei aho-in; hinla migilou vang kidah umtah ahin, jachatnan achuji-e."},"6":{"text":"Lamdih-a chepa chu chonphat na-in avetupmin, hinla gitlou na-in michonse alehkhup jin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ama kihaosah-a, imacha neilou aumin, ama kivaichatsa-a neile gou tamtah neijong aumin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Mihem khat hinkho chu haona-a kilhatdoh ahin, hinla vaichahon vang kiphosalna chu angai pouvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mi chonphate vah chu akipah-in; migiloute thaomei vang kisumit ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kiletsah nahin kidouna alhunsahjin, hinla kihilna pha umna-a chun chihna aume."},"11":{"text":"Lamdih louva kimu neile gou chu kemsuh teiding ahin, tohgimna-a kona kikholdoh neile gou vang chu pung ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Kinepna thonin lungsung adammo sah-in, hinla ngaichat akimolso teng vangleh, hichu hin thingphung ahi."},"13":{"text":"Koi hile thu i-sah louhela koija chu suhmanga umding, hinla thupeh gingpa vangchu kipaman kipeding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Miching dan thupeh chu hinna twinah ahin, hichu thina thangho-a kona hoidohna ahi."},"15":{"text":"Thilpha hetthem theina chun khohsahna akimun; hinla suhkhelna neiho lampi chu ahahsan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Milung chingin hetna akisah lelpi-in; hinla mingolin vang angolna chu atahlangin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Thupole-a pang migilou chu boina-ah alhalut jin; hinla tahsan umtah palai chun damtheina ahinpolut jin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Vaichatna le jum na chu hilchahna kisan nomloupa chanding ahin; hinla phona kichin thempa vang chu ja-a umding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ngaichat khat suhbulhit hi hinkho nopna ahin; hinla thilse-a kon kiheimang dinghi mingolte dinga thet umtah ahi."},"20":{"text":"Miching toh chekhom chu chingding ahin; hinla mingol hotoh kiloija chu suhmanga umding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Setna-in michonseho anungdeljin; hinla michonpha chu phatna-a kilethuh ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mipha chun achate chate ding neile gou adalhah pehjin; chule michonse te neile gou vangchu midih ho dinga kikhol khom ahi."},"23":{"text":"Vaichate loulhona-a neh tamtah aumin, hinla thutanna lhahsam jeh-a suhmanga umjong aumin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Mol panlou chun achapa ahot ahin; hinla achapa ngailupa vang chun asehgimjin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Michonphan alungnachim setnin anen; hinla agiloupa vangchu gilkel ding ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Numei chingin a-in akisahdoh-in; hinla numei ngolin vang akhutnin aloilhuji-e."},"2":{"text":"Chondih tah-a kalsongpa chun Pakai agin ahin; hinla alampiho hokhelpa chun Pakai chu i-sah louva abol ahi."},"3":{"text":"Mingol kamsunga konin kiletsahna jeng apotnin; hinla miching kamin vang amaho ahoidoh sah ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Bongchal umlouna-a gan ankong chu athengin; hinla bongchal thahat vanga ga tamtah kiso ji ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tahsan umtah hettohsah chun jou seipontin; hinla hettohsah lhemchun joule nal jeng seijinte."},"6":{"text":"Mi i-sah loupan chihna aholin, ahivangin amupon; hinla hetna kitihi ahekhenthem theidingin bailamtah ahi."},"7":{"text":"Mingol kamsunga chihna aumlou nahetdoh tengle, ama-a konin chedoh jengin."},"8":{"text":"Milungching chihna chu alampi akihetkhen themtheina chu ahin, hinla mingol ho ngolna chu lheplhahna ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mingol hon chonset hi totnan amangun; hinla chonphaho lah-a vang khohsahna aume."},"10":{"text":"Lungsungin amatah hesoh genthei chu akihetnin, chule midangin akipana-a jong chan aneipi poi."},"11":{"text":"Migilou in chu lekhupma umding ahin, hinla mikitahpa ponbuh vangchu khangtou jing ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mihem dingin adihtobang lampi khat aumin, hinla achaina le hiche lampi chu thina lampi ahiji-e.","ref":"Thuch 16:25."},"13":{"text":"Nuina jenga jong lungsung gimna aumin, chule hiche thanopna kichaina chu lunghemna ahijin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Lamdih-a kon kinunghei pa chu ama lunggot lampi jenga achen, chule mipha chu chunga kon kilunglhaisah ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Mimolin thujouse atahsanin, hinla mi chingtheipan vang achena ding akivettup jingin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Miching akichajin, setna adalhan, hinla mingol vangchu alungsajin chule amale ama akisong ji-e."},"17":{"text":"Lunghangbai mi chu ngolhoi tah-in akimang chajin, chule thil gilou tamtah gongpa chu hotnin aumjitai."},"18":{"text":"Mimolin ngolna goulo bangin alon, hinla miching vang hetna chu kikhuhpeh ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Migilou chu mipha anga bohkhup ding, chule migiloute chu michonpha te kotphunga bohkhup ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Mivaicha chu aheng akom jengin jong ahon, hinla mihao chun gol le pai tamtah aneijin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Aheng akom noise-a chun chonset abol ahin, mivaicha hepina neipa vangchu anunnom ahi."},"22":{"text":"Thilse gongho chun asuhkhelu hilou ham? hinla hepina leh thutah chu thilpha gongho-a ahi."},"23":{"text":"Tohgimna jouse-a aphat chomna aumin, hinla kama seitho maimai vang chun vaichatna alhutjin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Michingho lallukhuh chu ahaonau ahin; hinla mingol ho ngolna chu angol naohi ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hettohsah tahsan umtah chun hinkho ahuhdoh-in; hinla hettohsahna lhem chun jou le nal jeng aseije."},"26":{"text":"Pakai ginna-a chun kisona dettah aumin, chule achate chun kiselna ding mun aneiteidiu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Pakai ginhi hinna twinah ahin, thina thanga kona hoidohna ahi."},"28":{"text":"Mipi tamtah umhi lengpa-a dinga loupina ahin; hinla mihem lhahsamna-a vangchu lengchapa-a dia manthah na ahi."},"29":{"text":"Milung nengchun hetkhenthem theina lentah anei ahin; hinla mikino thethun angolna achoisang ahi."},"30":{"text":"Lungdamsela umhi tahsa dinga hinna ahin, hinla kithang thipna hi gule chang monsahna ahi."},"31":{"text":"Mivaicha bolgentheija chun ama sempa anoise ahin, hinla ama jabol chanchun vaichate chunga khotona anei ahi."},"32":{"text":"Migilou chu ama gitlouna a delmangin aumin, hinla michonphan vang thina chunga jong kinepna aneijin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Hetkhen themtheina neipa lungsunga chun chihna achengin, hinla mingol ho lungthim sunga umchu akihedoh teijin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chonphat na-in namkhat achoisangin, hinla chonsetna hi nampi dinga themmo chana ahi."},"35":{"text":"Lengpa khohsahna chu sottol milung chingpa chunga aumjin, hinla alunghana chu jachatna sodohsahpa chunga aumin ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aw nemheuva kidonbutna hin lungsatna aheimangin; hinla thucheng ngeimotah chun lunghanna asuthouve."},"2":{"text":"Miching leijin hetna chu dihtah-in amangcha jin; hinla mingolte kamin ngolna ngen aphongdoh-in ahi."},"3":{"text":"Pakaiyin munjouse amusoh keijin; ase leh apha ave jingin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kamdam awnema thu kisei chu hinna thingphung tobang ahin; hinla thugilou sei leigui vang lhagao suse-a ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mingolin apan ahilchahna i-sah louvin akoijin; hinla phona kisanthem michu miching ahi."},"6":{"text":"Michonpha te insunga chun neile gou tamtah aumin; hinla migilouho phatchomna vangchu boinabou ahi."},"7":{"text":"Miching kamin hetna athejalin; hinla mingol lungin vang chutin abolpoi."},"8":{"text":"Migilouvin kilhaina abol chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; hinla milungdih taonachu ama lunglhaina tah ahi."},"9":{"text":"Migilou lampi chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; hinla chonphatna nung juipachu aman angailun ahi."},"10":{"text":"Suhdihna hi achena lampi dalhapa dingin athohhah-in; chule phona nahsah loupa chu thiteiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Thikholkhul leh manthah na chu Pakai anga aumin; achutile mihem chate lungthim jong chusanga khohcheh louding ham?"},"12":{"text":"Mi i-sah loupa chun aphohpa chu angailupon; ama michingte koma jong cheponte."},"13":{"text":"Lungsung kipana chun kipana maiso asosah-in; hinla lungjin nahin lhagao asusen ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hetkhenthem theina neipa lunggil chun hetna aholin; hinla mingol ho kam vangchu ngolna-in akivah-in ahi."},"15":{"text":"Suhgentheija umte dingin nikhojouse chu aphalou jeng ahin; hinla lungkipah-a umten tanglouvin golnop anei jinguve."},"16":{"text":"Pakai gingpuma themcha neichu, neile gou tampi boina toh neitha sanga phajo ahi."},"17":{"text":"Kidou puma bongchal thaotah neh sangin; ngailutna puma anche me neh aphajoi."},"18":{"text":"Lungsat kengpan kinahna achoh thouvin; hinla milung nengin kinahna asuchamin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Mithase chenalampi chu lingtho kikaitobang ahin; hinla michonpha lampi chu lamphei ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chapa chingin apa akipasah-in; hinla chapa ngolin anu anoise-in ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ngolchon kitihi chihna-a lhasampa dingin thanopna ahin; hetkhen themna neipa vang dihtah-in achon jinge."},"22":{"text":"Thumopna umlouna-a thil kigongho chu alhasamjin; hinla thumopthem tamna-a chun hicheho chu akimolso jin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Mihem chu dihtah-a donbutna akipeh jallin thanopna aneijin; chule thucheng khat aphatcha kiseidoh chu iti phatna pha hitam!"},"24":{"text":"Noilam thikhol khul'a kona akiheimang theina dingin; hinna lampi chu milungching dingin chunglama aume."},"25":{"text":"Mi kiletsah insung chu Pakaiyin alhuhsah ding ahin; hinla aman meithainu gamgichu aphudoh ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Migilou lunggel ho chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; mitheng thusei ho vangchu thucheng ngeitah ahi."},"27":{"text":"Mikilose chun a-insung asuhboi bep ahin; hinla nehguh thilho thetbolpa chu kihinso teiding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Michonpha lungin adonbutna ding akigeltoh in; migilou kam invang thilseho asodoh jingin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Pakai chu migiloute-a konin agamlan; hinla michonpha taona vangchu aman angaipeh-in ahi."},"30":{"text":"Mit ha hoi selin lungsung akipasah-in; chule thulhut phatah chu gule chang ho dinga damna ahi."},"31":{"text":"Hinna dinga kiphona ngailha nakhang chu michingte lah-a achengin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hilchahna donloupa chun amatah-in hinna chu i-sahlouva akoi ahin; phona kingaipa vang chun hetthem theina akimudoh-in ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chihna hilchahna chu Pakai ginding hi ahin; chule jana masanga chun kineosahna aume."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihem in alungthimin tohgon aneijin,; hinlah kamsunga kon donbutna chu Pakaiya konbou ahi."},"2":{"text":"Mihem khat-in ama mitvetnin alampi jouse chu athengselin amun; ahinla Pakaiyin lungsung chu akholchilin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nanatoh jouse chu Pakaiya pedohjengin, chutile nalunggel ho chu lolhingtei ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pakaiyin thiljouse ama dinga asem ahi, henge, migiloute jengjong nikho phalou ni-a dinga asem ahi."},"5":{"text":"Lungsunga kiletsah tapouchu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, khutle khut kituhmat to jengjongle, ama chu talen manlouva umlou helding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hepina leh thutah-in khangitlouna asuthengin; chule Pakai ginna jal-in mihem ten setna adalhaove."},"7":{"text":"Mi achondanin Pakai akipasah tengle, amelmate jengjong amatoh akichamsah-in ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chonphatna puma thil themcha khat neichu, alamlouva kimu thil tamtah sangin aphajoi."},"9":{"text":"Mihem khat lungsungin ama lampi agongin, ahinla Pakaiyin vang amapa kalsonna dingho akopeh-in ahi."},"10":{"text":"Pathen thutanlhahna chu lengpa kamsunga konin apotnin; akamin jong thu atankhel louding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Agih dihtah leh khaikot dihtah chu Pakaiya ahin; dip sunga um thilgih kitedoh jouse jong ama boljeng ahi."},"12":{"text":"Phatlouna tohdohhi lengte dinga thet umtah ahi, ajehchu laltounahi chonphatna-a kitungdoh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Dihtah-a thu kisei chu lengho lunglhaina ahin, chule amahon thudih seija chu angailuvin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Lengpa lunghana chu thina thupole tobang ahin, ahinla michingin vang hichu asulungdam jin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Lengpa maiso vah-a chun hinna aumin, chule aman akhohsah mi chu gotuilha nunung twimei tobang ahi."},"16":{"text":"Sana sanga chihna kimudoh hi iti phatna pha hitam! chule dangka sanga hetkhen themtheina kilhenjohhi iti phatjoh hitam!"},"17":{"text":"Midih lamlhongpi chu agilouva kona kiheimang hi ahin, alampi kituhdetpa chun ahinkho akivettup ahi."},"18":{"text":"Manthah na masanga kilet sahna achen, chule lhuh nading masanga hoithona achen ahi."},"19":{"text":"Mikiletsahho toh thil kichomdoh kihop sangin, kineosah puma minoinung hotoh umkhom aphajoi."},"20":{"text":"Koihile hilchahna ngaipha-a chun thilpha akimudoh-in; chule koihile Pakai tahsan chanchu anunnom ahi."},"21":{"text":"Alungsunga chihna nei mi chu thil hekhen them kitiding ahin, chule nemheuva thu kiseijin hetna apunsah-e."},"22":{"text":"Hetthem theina hi aneijoupa dingin hinna twinah ahin, ahinla mingol ho hilchahna chu ngolna ahibouve."},"23":{"text":"Michingin alungsunga chihna mangchan thu aseijin; chule amuh dingin kihilna abepeh-in ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ngainom um thuchengho chu khoiju tobang ahin, hinna-a dinga lhumkei le gule changho dinga damna ahi."},"25":{"text":"Mihem dingin adih tobang lampi aumin, ahinla chuche lampi chu akhonna thina ahijin ahi.","ref":"Thuch 14:12."},"26":{"text":"Natong gimma chun amadinga atohgim ahi, ajehchu agilkel chun atohsah ahi."},"27":{"text":"Pathen ngaisahlou michun setna alaidohjin; chule athusei jong meikong tobang ahi."},"28":{"text":"Jon lunggelin kinahna atun, guhthim thu seile pan golcha phatah ho asukhenjin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hunam panpa chun aheng akom atilsejin; chule lampi phalouva apuilutjin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Aman hoitho thil mitsing leuvin agongjin, akam achaloh sah-in thilse ahinlhutjin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Tehse samkang hi loupina lallukhuh ahin; Hichu chonphatna lampia kon bou kimu ahi"},"32":{"text":"Lunghan nalama ngaikhampa chu thahattahpa sangin aphajon, chule alungsung kivaihom joupa chu khopi khat lapa sangin aphajon ahi."},"33":{"text":"Pheichunga chun vang akisang jin; hinla thulhahna jouse chu Pakaiya ahi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lunglhai sela an-gum kamkhat neh hi, kinah puma insung dimset golvah an neh sanga phajo ahi."},"2":{"text":"Soh chingtah-in jachatna semdoh chapa chunga vai ahop ding; chule sopiho goulona lah-a chu chan aneiding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Dangka dingin lhit thengna bel, chule sana dingin lhummei akimangin; ahinla Pakaiyin vang lungsungho apatepjin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Khanset bolpa chun jouthu jeng angaijin, chule mijouvin thil gilou ngaina dingin ana asunge."},"5":{"text":"Koihile mivaicha daichavaija chun ama asempa i-asahlou ahin, chule midang vangsetna chunga kipahpa chu talen manlouva umlou helding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Achate chate chu tehse hodinga lallukhuh ahin, chule achateu loupina chu apateu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Mingolin thugiltah aseidohle akilompon; chusanga chu leng chapan jou aseiding chu kilommo cheh ahi."},"8":{"text":"Kipamana kipe thil hi aneipa mitna songmantam tobang ahin, amachu akiheinalam tina akhangtouve."},"9":{"text":"Suhkhel khukhumpa chun ngailutna ahol ahin; ahinla thilkhat velphoh jingpa chun golphatah jong asukhenjin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Mingol khatnin jakhatvei jepna atosangin, miching khatnin khatvei kiphona chu na asajon ahi."},"11":{"text":"Mi gilouvin kiphinna ding jengbou aholin, hijeh-a chu mi engse thupole khat ama doudinga kisol ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mingol khat angolpet tosangin, vompi anouho kilohpeh khat toh kimaito abaijon ahi."},"13":{"text":"Koi hile apha chu ase-a lethuh chanchu, insunga kona ase kichoidoh louhel ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Kinah kipatnahi mikhatnin twi agah londohsah tobang ahin, hijeh chun kinahna asodoh masangin kinelna chu dalhan."},"15":{"text":"Miphalouho themchan sah-a, chule midihtah ho themmo chansah-a chu anilhona Pakai dinga thet umtah ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chihna-a alunglut lou mingol chun, ipikhoh-a chihna chohna dinga akhutna sum achoi dingham?"},"17":{"text":"Loile gol chun phat jousen angailun, sopi vang genthei nikho-a dinga peng ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hetthem theina neiloupa chun akhut abengton, chule loile gol anga kitepna neija dingpa-in ahungpang jitai."},"19":{"text":"Suhkhelna ngailupa chun kinahna adei ahin, chule akotpi choisanga chun manthah na ahol ahi."},"20":{"text":"Khangitlouna lung neipa chun thilpha amupon; chule joule nal seijingpa vang thilphalou va alhalut jitai."},"21":{"text":"Mingol chu ahingpa din gimna ahin; chule mingolpa pa chun kipana aneipoi."},"22":{"text":"Lungsung kipana hi loule ai phatah abangin; ahinla lung gentheina vang hin gu le changho agotsah-in ahi."},"23":{"text":"Migilouvin thutanna lampiho heikoina dingin, guhthima thilpeh akilahjin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hetkhenthem theina neipa masanga chihna aumin, ahinla mingolpa mit vang chun leiset mong gei ave lelen ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chapa ngolchu apa dinga gimna ahin, chule anu dinga hesohna bep ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chujongle midih gotna peh-a, ahiloule thu adih-a tanjeh-a pipuiho jepna kipe jongchu dihlou ahi."},"27":{"text":"Hetna neipa chun ngaikham tah-in thu aseijin; chule hetkhenthem theina neija michu milungchingtah ahi."},"28":{"text":"Mingol jengjong thipbeh-a aum tengleh michinga sim ahin; chule akam kihup pa chu hetkhenthem theina neimi ahi tin akive sange."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mipi lah-a kon kikangse mihem chun, ama phatchomna ding maimai bou aholin, thudih jouse douvin apangin ahi."},"2":{"text":"Mingol chun chihna le hetna-a kipana aneipon, hinlah ama lunggel jengbou phondoh ding adeije."},"3":{"text":"Migilou ahungtengle i-sah louna jong ahung jin, chuleh minsetna ahungteng jum na ahungjin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Mihem khat kamsunga kon thupot chu twithuh tahho tobang ahin, chihna twinah jonghi vadung longjing tobang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Thutanna munna migiloupa panpi-a, chuleh michondih pa themmo chansah jongchu phaloutah ahi."},"6":{"text":"Mingol thusei chun kinelna asosahjin, chule akamsungin ama kijepnading akiseidoh ji-e."},"7":{"text":"Mingol kamsungsoh chu amadinga manthah na ahin, chule athusei chu ahinkho kisuh mangna dinga thang ahi."},"8":{"text":"Guhthima kisei thucheng chu nehle chah tuitah tobang ahin, chule oisunggil lampeh a alutjin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Anatoh na-a thasepa chu, ijakai susepa toh sopi khat ahi."},"10":{"text":"Pakai minchu insang dettah ahin, hia chun michonpha te alhailut alhailutnun ahoijuve."},"11":{"text":"Mihaopa dinga anei agouchu akhopi dettah tobang ahin, chule akiletsahpi tah kulpi sangtah tobang ahi."},"12":{"text":"Suhmangna masanga chun mihem lungthima hoithona aumin, chule jana masanga kineosahna aumin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Thu angailhah masanga donbut jengpa chu, amadinga ngolna leh jachatna ahi."},"14":{"text":"Mihem lhagao chun mihem adammo na-a kon adamsah jou ahin, ahinlah koiham lhagao damlouna thohjou dinga?"},"15":{"text":"Milung chingin hetkhena akimudoh-in, chule miching nakhangin hetna aholin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Mihem khat chu athilpeh-in ama dingin mun asem peh-in; chule amachu milen, milal ho masanga ahin puilut jin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ama chungthu kisei masatpa chu adihtah danin akilangin; ahinla aheng akom chu ahungin ama ahung kholchiljin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Vang san nahin kinelnaho asuthipmin, chule mithahat te jong asukhenin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Sopi kisunohsa jollut kitna chu khopi dettah lahsangin ahahsajon; chule amaho kibaona chu kulpi pal kigenho bangjeng ahi."},"20":{"text":"Mihem chu akamsung soh jala oiva setna umding, athusei phatchomna jala ama vaset ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Leigui hin thina le hinna thahatna aneijin, chule chuche ngailuho chun aga akineh dingu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Koihile jinu kimu-a chun thilpha akimu ahin; chule Pakai khohsahna chu changa ahitai."},"23":{"text":"Mivaichan taona jeng amangchan, ahinla mihaovin vang hoithotah-in adonbutnin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Golle pai tamtah nei mikhat chu amajong agolho dinga golphatah hiding, hinla sopi tah sanga ikinaipi goljong aumin ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Genthei jongle kitah tah-a hinkho mangpa chu, thugilou seija mingolpa sangin aphajon ahi."},"2":{"text":"Hetna beija umhi aphapon, chule chonset na-a kaljangpa jongchu aphadeh pon ahi."},"3":{"text":"Mihem angolna chun alampi aheimangpeh-in, chule alungthim sunga Pakai adouvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Neile gouvin loile gol tampi asemdoh-in, ahinla vaichapa chu aheng akom jengin jong adalha jitai."},"5":{"text":"Hettohsah lhem chu talen manlouva umlou ding ahin, chule jou le nala thusei jongchu hoidoh louhel ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pipuiho khohsahna chu mitam tah-in angeh dingu ahin, chule thilpepa din mitin chu agol apai ahijitai."},"7":{"text":"Mivaicha chu asopite jousen jong ahot boluvin, agolho chu ama-a konin iti agamlat tadiuvem? Aman amaho chu ngehna le taona pumin anung delpeh-in, hinlah amahon adon tapouve."},"8":{"text":"Chihna kimudohpa chun ahinna angailut ahin, hetkhen themtheina kichin pachun thilpha amuteiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hettohsah lhem chu talen manlouva umlou helding, chule jouthu seipa chu mangthah teiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nomsa tah-a hinkho mandinghi mingol dingin akilompon, soh khatnin pipuiho chunga vai ahomding jong akilompoi."},"11":{"text":"Mihem lunggel themnan alunghana asudamin, chuleh ama douna-a thil kibol angaidam jouchu aloupina ahi."},"12":{"text":"Lengpa lungsatna chu keipi kitum tobang ahin; ama mikhohsahna vang chu hampa chunga daitwi lha tobang ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chapa ngol chu apadinga hamsetna ahin; chule kinel kalna dimset inneipi chu tanglouva vajing gotwi tobang ahi."},"14":{"text":"Inle lou, chule neile gou jouse hi pate-a kon kilason gou chu ahin, chule numei ji phatah vanghi Pakaiya kon ahi"},"15":{"text":"Thasetna hin mihem a-imut lhuhsah-in; chule mi thase chun kel athoh ding mong ahi."},"16":{"text":"Thupeh nitpa chun ahinkho akichintup ahin, ahinla alamjot na-a chingtheilou chu thitei ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mivaicha chunga khotona neipa chun Pakai apeh ahin; chule aman anapehdohsah chu alepeh kitding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Kinepna aumpetnin nachapa bolgimin, chule suhmanga aumding jong gel hih-in."},"19":{"text":"Milungchomin talen amat teiding ahi; ajehchu nangman ama huhdoh jengle chun avela abolkit teiding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Khonunga nachih theina dingin, hilthemnale hilchahna hi ngaijin lang kisanin."},"21":{"text":"Mihem lungsunga thilgon tampi aumin, ahijeng vangin Pakai thilgon leh phatsah bouchu kiphutdet ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mihem khatnin angaichat chu lungsetna chan hi ahin, chule joule nal sei mihem hisangin mivaicha hiding aphajoi."},"23":{"text":"Pakai ginna-in hinna-a apuilutnin, chuche Pakai ging mi chu lunglhai ding ahin, thilsen alhunkhum louhel ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Mithasen akhutnin abukong asohlut jin, akam sung geija hin dop ding jong angapcha poi."},"25":{"text":"Mitaitompa akijepleh, mimolpan chih theinan aneijin, chule hetkhenthem theina neipa chu phohsal lechun hetna-a khangtou ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Apa lamlouva engbola chule anu delmanga chu jum nale jachatna hinpolut chapa chu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Kachapa, hetkhen themna-a kon nachekhelsah thumop ho chu ngaita hih hellin."},"28":{"text":"Pathen jalou hettohsahpan thutanlhahna dihtah chu ataitomin, chule migilou kamsungin khangitlouna chu avalhume."},"29":{"text":"Gotna hohi mitaitom ho dinga kisem ahin; chule kijepnahohi mingol ho tungtuna ding ahi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ju hi midai chavai ahin, chule akidontho khamnathei jong kinahna ahibouve. Hicheho kipui mangsah chu miching ahipoi."},"2":{"text":"Lengpa lungsatna hi keipi kitum tobang ahin; koihile ama lunghan sah-a chu amatah hinkho achanlo teiding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Mihem khat dinga kinahna-a kon akikangse thei chu, ja achan na ahin; ahinla angol tapouvin kinahna asosah theije."},"4":{"text":"Thasepan daplai ahijeh-in lou alhoupon, hijeh-a chu chang at tengle aman khut adolea imacha neilouva umding ahije."},"5":{"text":"Mihem lungsunga um hilthem theina hi twi thuhtah tobang ahin; ahinla hetkhentheina neipan akithaldoh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Mitam tah-in ama changseh phatna aphongjal len, ahinla mi kitah tah chu kon amu jouding ham?"},"7":{"text":"Midih chu ama kitahna-a achon lejin, ama nunga achate jong phat theina achanguve."},"8":{"text":"Thutanna laltouna a tou lengpan amit tenin thil gilou jouse chu athecheh-in ahi."},"9":{"text":"Koiham kalungsung kakisop thengtan, kachonsetna-a konin kathengtai, tia aseithei ding?"},"10":{"text":"Thilgih kibanglou leh thilgih tena dihlou chu, kibangtah-a Pakai dinga thet umtah ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chapang khat jengjong anatohchu atheng ham, adih ham, athilbola konin akihekhen jenge."},"12":{"text":"Khojah theina kol leh, khomutheina mit jengjong, ania Pakaiyin asem cheh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Imut dingjeng ngailu hih-in, vaichatlo getnin nate, namitteni hasah jingin,chutile changlhah-a naneija, nalunglhai ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Thilchopan hichehi apanna aumpoi, hichehi apanna ding aumpoi, tin aseijin, ahin achedoh tengle vang akithang-at jie."},"15":{"text":"Sana aumin chule songmantam tampi aumnai, ahinla hetna hungsodohna kam vangchu songmantam lutah khat ahi."},"16":{"text":"Gamdang mikhat dinga kitepna thilla kitungpa ponsil chu lahpeh un; chule gamdang numeinu khat dingin kitepna thilin mangun."},"17":{"text":"Mihem khat dingin lamdih louva kimu changlhah hi atuijin; ahinla chomkhat joutengle akamsunga chu songbong dimding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Thilgon tapouhi thumopna in aphudoh ahin; chule kihilna phatah in gal asat ahibouve."},"19":{"text":"Guhthimthu seija vahlelepa chun thu ki imho aphongdoh jin; hijeh chun akama thuphalou seile hotoh kitimat hihbeh in."},"20":{"text":"Koihile apa ahiloule anu samse-a chu; ameivah muthim lah-a kisuhmit pehding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Neile gou chu abul lang gangtah-a gahlothei ahinai; ahinla akichaina chu phattheibohna hilouhel ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Keiman setna chu kalethuh teiding ahi, tin seihih beh in; amavang Pakai chu ngah-in, aman nangma nahuhdoh teiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Thilgih dihlou chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; chule thilgih tena dihlou jongchu thilpha ahipoi."},"24":{"text":"Mihem chenahohi Pakaiya kon ahin, achutile mihemin ama lampi iti akihet khenthei ding ham?"},"25":{"text":"Kinotah-a thilkhat chu atheng ahi tia, chule kitepna ineijouva nungkhol kitding kiti hi mihem dinga kipal lhuhna thangkol ahibouve."},"26":{"text":"Leng chingtah chun migilouho athe cheh-in, chule achunguva changvohna kanglum chu atangjin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Mihem lhagao chu Pakai meivah ahin, hichun mihem lungsung jouse akhol chilsoh ji-e."},"28":{"text":"Hepinale thutah-in lengpa chu achingtup jingin, chule ngailutna-in alaltouna chu achoisang jinge."},"29":{"text":"Khangdongte loupina chu athahatnao hi ahin; chule tehse ho melhoina chu asam kannu hi ahi."},"30":{"text":"Thoh hahsatah kijepnan agilou chu asopthengjin; hibang chun kijepna-in sunggil laiho jouse asuthengin ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lengpa lungsung chu Pakai khutna um ahin, twi lonna vadungho bangin aman agot nalam lama aheijin ahi."},"2":{"text":"Mihem khat mitmun ama lampi tapouchu adih-in amun, ahinla Pakaiyin lungsungho joh akholchil jin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Dihtah-a thil kibole, dihtah-a thutan nahi, kilhaina sanga Pakaiya dinga santhei joh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Eima chang kivetsangna leh kiletsahna lungsung, chule migilou chalohna jousen chonset aboldoh jin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Gunchupa lunggel ho chun ninglhin namun alhunsah-in, ahinla kikinsah tapou chu lhasam dingbou ahi."},"6":{"text":"Joule nala kimu neile gou chu thina holho dinga pannabei suhle tunga lengle ahibouve."},"7":{"text":"Migilou ten aguhdoh-u thil hochun amaho asuhmang teiding ahi; ajeh chu amahon thudih ajuinom pouve"},"8":{"text":"Chonsepa lampi chu alam jangpon, hinlah chonphapa natoh vang adihjeng ahi."},"9":{"text":"Inn lentah sunga numei nelhat khatto chenkhom sangin, in chung ningkoi khatna chen joh aphajoi."},"10":{"text":"Migilou lunggel chun thilse adeijin, aheng akomin ama mitna khohsahna amujoupoi."},"11":{"text":"Mitaitompa gimbolna akipeh tengle milhamin chihtheina aneilo jin; chule miching chu akihil teng aman hetna akimujin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Michonpha pan agiloute insung chu alungthima chingthei tah-in angaitojin; hinla Pathen'in agiloutechu agitlounau jal-in alehkhup jitai."},"13":{"text":"Koi hijongle vaichate kapetna akol kisipma chu, amajong hungkap mintin hinla kijahpeh talou ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Aguh-a thil kipe hin lunghanna adailhah sah-in; chule pon noija nehguh kipe hin lungsatna nasatah asudaijin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Thu dihtah-a tanding hi midihte kipana ahin, Hinlah thilgilou bolte chunga manthah na hung lhungding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hetthem theina lampia kona vahmangpa chu, athiho kikhop khom nalah-a umding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nopsahna ngailu-a chu vaicha teiding ahin, koihile jule thaova lop chu haosa louhel ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Migiloute chu michonpha te dinga kilhatdohna-a pangdiu, chule mikitahloute jong mikitahte lhatdoh na-a pangdiu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Numei nelhat jingle lunghang jingtoh chenkhom sangin, gamthipma chending aphajoi."},"20":{"text":"Michingtah chenna in'a chun deichatthei neile gou, chule thao aumin, ahin mingolin vang akisuhmang joujitai."},"21":{"text":"Koi hile chonphatna le hepina juija chun hinna, chonchan phatna chule jana akimudoh-in ahi."},"22":{"text":"Miching chun mithahat ho khopi jong atedoh jouvin, chule amahon akisonpiu athahatnao jousejong asuchim jouvin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Koi hile akamle alei kitimthem chun, alhagao lungjinna-a kona akivenbit ahi."},"24":{"text":"Kiletsah tah-a lunghangpa minchu kiletsah leh taitomhat ahi."},"25":{"text":"Mithase chu angaichat nan athatjitan ahi, ajehchu akhutnin na atonggim nompoi."},"26":{"text":"Nilhum keijin aman neipap leh kiloset abolin, ahinla chonpha pan vang apedoh in khen ima aneipoi."},"27":{"text":"Khangitloute kilhaina chu thet umtah ahin, aman lungthim phalou puma ahinchoi teng iti thet umcheh ding hitam?"},"28":{"text":"Hettohsah lhem-a pang michu mangthai teiding ahin, hinla thukisei ngaithempan vang tanlouhela thu aseiding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Migiloupa chu akimoh hansan sah-in, hinla mi kitahpa vangin alampi akigeltoh jingin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chihna hihen, hetkhen themna hihen, thumopthemna hijongle Pakai douthei dinga aumpoi."},"31":{"text":"Sakol chu gal kisat nikho-a dinga gotsa ahitan, hinla galjona chu Pakaiya kon bou ahi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minphatna hi haona tamtah ho sanga kilhending aphajon, chule ngailutna a kikhohsah nahi dangkale sana sanga kilhenjoh ding ahi."},"2":{"text":"Ahaole avai aumkhomin, abonuva sempa chu Pakai ahi."},"3":{"text":"Milung chingin thilse hunglhung ding chu amu masan, hijeh chun akiselin, ahinla mimolhochu achepaijun talen amanjitaove."},"4":{"text":"Kineosahnale Pakai ginna-a chun haona, jana chule hinna aumin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Khanggilouho lampia chun lingle thang aumin, ahinkho kichintuppa vang hicheho-a kona chu gamlading ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chapang chu achena dingdol lampia khoukhah-in; chutile ama ateh teng jongle hia kona chun kiheimang taponte."},"7":{"text":"Mihaovin mivaicha chunga vai ahomin, chule abatpa chu abatsahpa soh-in apangin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Khangitlouna tupa chun ahomkeo aki at ding ahin, chule alunghana mol chu thon ding ahije."},"9":{"text":"Mihongphal chu phatthei kiboh teiding ahi; ajehchu aman achanglhah jengjong vaichate din apedoh jin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Mitaitompa chu deldoh un chutile kinelna beitante; henge, kinahnale kihousetna jong tang tante."},"11":{"text":"Lungthenna ngailupa chu akamdam jeh-a lengpa gol hiding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Pakai mit tenin hetna avetupmin, chule aman suhkhelna neipa thusei ho chu alehkhup helin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Mithasepa chun, polama keipibahkai aumin, lampi kahlah ho-a keima eithat ninte, tin aseije."},"14":{"text":"Hetkhahlou numei ho kamsung chu kotong thuhtah ahin, Pakai hotna umpa chu chua chu lhalutding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chapang khat lungsunga chun ngolna aumin, ahinla sudihna molchun ama-a kona gamlatah-a anomang ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahaonaho puntheina dinga vaichaho joulhepma, mihaoho pehbepa vangchu thonlouva lhasam teiding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nanakhang hinsungin lang miching thuseihohi ngaijin, chule keima hetna lama nalungthim hinmang chan."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman nasunga hicheho chu nakichin tupma ahile, lunglhaina ahin, hicheho chu nakama jong naseiding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Pakaiya natahsana aumtheina dinga, tuni nikho-a keiman nangmatah henga hetsahna kabol ahitai."},"20":{"text":"Hetna thu hihen thumop phatah hijongle, thilpha chungnung chu keiman nahenga kahinsut hitalou ham?"},"21":{"text":"Thudihho chu thutahbeh mong ahi nangma kahetchetsah nadingle nahenga hungkisol ho henga thutah hochu nadonbut theina dinga keiman nahenga kahinsut hitalou ham?"},"22":{"text":"Mivaichaho chu chomhih-un, ajehchu ama mivaicha ahi; kotpi phunga jong gentheiho chu bolgim hih-in."},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin amahothu chu aseitohpeh-a, chule vaichaho chomho hinna chu aman achom ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Milung hang jingtoh kigolcha hih-in; chule milungkhoh toh nangma chekhom hih in."},"25":{"text":"Achuti loule nangman ama lampiho hekhan natin, chule nahinkho-a din thang hikhante."},"26":{"text":"Kitepna chunga khut lhaho lah-a nangma khat nin jong pang hih-in, ahiloule sum kibat jeh-a midinpeh ho lah-a jong pang hih-in."},"27":{"text":"Nangman pehding imacha naneilou ahitahle ipi dinga aman nalupna jalkhun chu alahmang dingham?"},"28":{"text":"Gollui laija napu napateu vin anatun dohsao, gamgi chu chon mang hih-un."},"29":{"text":"Atohna lama gunchu mi namu em? amachu lengho anga dingtei ding, mi maimai anga dinglou helding ahi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangma thunei vaihomho khat toh an nedinga natoutengle, na anga ipi ummam ti phatechan gellin."},"2":{"text":"Chule an dutah mi nahile nalol la chemcha kidojingin."},"3":{"text":"A-anneh tuitahho chu ducha hih-in, ajehchu hicheho chu kilheplhahna an ahibouve."},"4":{"text":"Haoding tupnan kisulung gimval hih-in, nangma chang kichihsah hih-in."},"5":{"text":"Nangman aumlou thil chu namit teni-a navet dingham? Ajehchu thonlouvin haona hohin lhaving akisemun, van lama muvanlai bangin alengmangji taove."},"6":{"text":"Michip pa changlhah chu nangman nehih beh-in; ama antuiho jong ducha hih-in."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu amachu alunga agel bangbang hija ahin; nenlang donin tin nahenga aseijin, ahinla alungthim chu nangma toh aumkhom pon ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nangman nanehsa anchu nalohdoh ding; chule thu ngeitah naseiho jong pannabei hiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mingol nakhanga imacha seihih beh-in, ajehchu chihna thu naseiho jong i-sah louva akoiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Gollui laija gamgi lui melchihna ho chu ladoh hih-in, chule pabei ho gamsunga jong lutdan."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho lhatdohpa chu thaneitah ahin, aman athuchu nahenga aseitoh ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hilchahna lama nalungsung mangchan lang; chule nanakhang teni chu hetna thu lama mangchan."},"13":{"text":"Chapang kisuhdih nahi tuhtang hih-in, ajehchu nangman ama molin jep jongle chun thiponte."},"14":{"text":"Nangman ama mola najepding, chutile ama lhagao thikhol khul'a kona nahuhdoh johding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Kachapa nalung achih-a ahile, kalung kipahlheh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Henge, nangman nakama thil dihho naseidoh tengle, kalung gilla kakipa ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nalungin michonseho thangse hih-in, ahinla nangman nilhumkeijin Pakai chu gingin."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu tahbeh a akichaina khat uma ahin, chule nakinepna chu kisei tanlou ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Kachapa nangman ngaijin lang chihnan neijin, chule hiche lampia chun nalung puihoijin."},"20":{"text":"Judon hole saneh hat ho lah-a nangma lhahih in."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu jukhamho leh milopho chu vaicha teiding; chule imutsona chun mipa chu ponse avonpeh ding ahije."},"22":{"text":"Nahinga napa thu kingai jinlang, nanu ateh phatteng jongle nahsahmon bolhih-in."},"23":{"text":"Thutah chu kichoh-in, chule chihna, hilchahna hetkhen themtheina, jong kichoh inlang johdoh tahih-in."},"24":{"text":"Michonpha chu apa hapah-in kipah intin; chule chapang ching hingpa chun amajalla kipana aneiding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Nanu leh napa kipah inte, chule nahinga nanu chu kipah thanom ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Kachapa nalungthim neipen, chule namitnin kalampiho vetupmin."},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu notinu chu kokhuh thuhtah tobang ahin; chule hetlou numeinu chu kokhuhjim ahi."},"28":{"text":"Amanun jong gucha michom bangin mi achanglhin; chule mihem ho lah-a chun suhkhel neiho apunsah-in ahi."},"29":{"text":"Koiham dana nei? Koiham gimna nei? Koiham kinahna nei? Koiham kiphina-a nei? Koiham ajehbeija tina maha pu-a? Koiham mit san dehduh neija?"},"30":{"text":"Amaho chu juphola khongaisotna ju kihalna hola vahle ho chu ahiuve."},"31":{"text":"Ju chu asanphat laitah vetdan, khonjong asansah-a achama naljella alonlhah jongle nangman vehih-in."},"32":{"text":"Akhonnale hichun gul bangle gulsum gu hattah bangin achujin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Namit tenin hetkhahlou numei ho avetna, chule nalunggilla jong thildihlou jeng nagelding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Nangma twipi lailunga lumpa nabahding, ahiloule kongsunga kitungdoh khom sangtah leh-a lumpa nabah ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Amahon eivouvin ahinla keima kanapoi; amahon eidengun ahinla kahephapoi; itihle kei kakhangdoh tadem? Kaholbekit nahlaiding ahi, tia naseiding ahi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migilouho chu thangset hih-in, amahotoh umkhom ding jong ngaicha hihbeh-in."},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho lungsungin manthah na lamjeng agelin; chule akam sungun aphalou aseijuve."},"3":{"text":"Chihna vangin in akisahdoh-in, chule hetkhenthem theina jal-in akiphutdetne."},"4":{"text":"Chule hetna jala indanho chu manlutah thil le lo, chule lungdei umtah neile gou dimsetna ahi."},"5":{"text":"Miching chu atha ahatnin; henge, hetna neipa thahatna chu khangtou ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu chihna puma thumopthemna vanga nangman gal nasatding ahin, thumopthem ho tamna lah-a hoidohna aume."},"7":{"text":"Mingol dingin chih gilnahi asang behsetnin, aman kotpi phunga akam akehpoi."},"8":{"text":"Thilse bolding gongdohpa chu, miphaloupa kitiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Lunga ngolhoi thu geljing hi chonset ahin, chule mitaitompa chu miho dingin thet umtah ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kidouna nikho-a nalung alhah-a ahile, natha chu lhoma ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangman thina lam jonna kijot hole, akithat dinga gotsa umteho huhdohna dinga pohnatna nanei louva;"},"12":{"text":"Nangman, keihon kanahepha pouve nati vangle, ven, ama milungsung vetuppa chun hichu agelkhoh louding ham? chule nahinkho hoituppa chun ahetlou dingham? chule aman mijouse chu anatoh dungjuija lethuhna apehlou ding ham?"},"13":{"text":"Kachapa khoiju chu ne-in, ajeh chu tuitah ahi, chule khoiju phang jongchu ne-in, nakam sung dinga lhumtah ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chihna le hetna jong chu nalhagao dinga khoiju tuitah tobang ahin, nangman hichu nakimudoh teng kipaman nasanding, chule nakinepna jong thon louding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Vo migiloupa, michonpha chenna mun dounan changlhi hih-in, akicholngahna munchu suse hih in."},"16":{"text":"Midihtah pa chu sagivei lhu jongle athoudohkit jin, ahinla migilou vangchu setna-a lhalut teiding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Namelmapa alhuhteng nangma kipah hih-in, chule ama akipal lhuh tahjongle nalung kipasah hih-in."},"18":{"text":"Achuti loule Pakaiyin hichu muntin, hichun ama alung hansah-a, chule ama-a kona alunghana aheimang louding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Thil gilou bolte jeh-in nangma lungkham hih-in, migiloute umchan jong thangse hih-in."},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu thil gilou bolpa dinga kipaman umlou helding, chule migiloupa meivah chu kisumit ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Kachapa Pakai le lengpa chu gingin, chule vaihom gilouho lah-a jong kikumlut hih-in."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho chunga hamsetna photlot louva hungsoh ding ahin, amani manthah na hinlhut ding chu kon ija ahet em?"},"23":{"text":"Hiche thilho jonghi miching ho-a ahi. Thutan na-a sihnei langnei bolding apha poi.","title":"Chihna Thu Kiseibe"},"24":{"text":"Migiloupa jah-a, nangma michonpha nahi tia seipa chu, amachu mipin asapset ding, namtinin ahotbol dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ahinla migilou phohsalho chunga chu kipana umtei ding, chule phattheina chu achunguva chuding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Dihtah-a donbutna pepa chu mijousen abengchop ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Polama nanatoh ding gotsan koijin, chule naloulaija nanatohna ding jong kigottup masatnin, chujou tengle na in kisah-in."},"28":{"text":"Ajeh beijin naheng nakom dounan hettoh sah-in panghih-in, chule nakamin koima lhemlha hih-in."},"29":{"text":"Aman eibolna bangin keiman ama bolinge tin seihih-in, anatoh dungjuijin keiman lethuh inge tin seihih-in."},"30":{"text":"Keiman mithasepa loumun leh, hetthem theina neiloupa lengpilei chu kagah jotpan:"},"31":{"text":"Chule ven, apumpin lingle khaovin adipsohtai, chule sachih-in apheng alhangin akhujeng tan, chule songtho kisejong achimlha joutai."},"32":{"text":"Chuin keiman hichu kamu phatnin, phatechan kagelin, hiche kavetna-a konchun hilchahna kachangin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chom chakhat imutna, chom chakhat lulhuh-a, chom chakhat khut gahlhepto-a imut;","ref":"Thuch 6:10-11."},"34":{"text":"Hitobanga chu kholjinpa banga vaichat nan nangma nahin lhunkhum ding, galmanchah choipa banga gentheinan nahin phah ding ahi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hicheho jonghi Solomon thuchihho; Judah lengpa Hezekiah mitehon anasutdoh-u chu ahi.","title":"Solomon Thuchih Sei Belap"},"2":{"text":"Pathen'in thilkhat aselguh hi ama loupina ahin; ahinla thilkhat holdohhi lengho ja achan nao ahije."},"3":{"text":"Van asan bangle leiset athuh banga hi, lengho lungsung jong holdoh hoi ahipoi."},"4":{"text":"Dangka-a konin a-eh ladohle chun, thih khengpa dinga bel hung sohdoh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Lengpa angsunga konin mikhang gilou chu puidoh lechun, alaltouna chu chonphatna-a kiphutdet ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Lengpa angsunga nang le nang gavahlut hih-in, chule milen milal ho umna mun'a gading hihbeh-in.","ref":"Luk 14:8-10."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu namitna namu lengchate masanga suhnema naum sanga, hilama hungtouvin tia nahin kou diuchu nang dinga phajo ahi."},"8":{"text":"Kinah nadinga kino tah-in che hih-in, ijemtin naheng nakomin najumso khale, achainale nangma jong bolding helouvin umkhaget in nate."},"9":{"text":"Nachung chang thuchu na inhengpa toh seikhom lhonin, chule midang henga thuguh himhim seidoh hih-in."},"10":{"text":"Achutiloule hiche thuguh hedoh chanchun nahin jumson tin, chule naminsetna chu mang talouhel ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Thu dihtah-a kisei hi dangka kigol lah-a sanatum tobang ahi."},"12":{"text":"Thu kisei ngaipa dinga kiphona dihtah hi, sana bilba le sanathenga kisem kijepna tobang ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tahsan umtah thupole-a mihem chu, asolpa dinga chang at laija buhbang dapjen tobang ahi; ajehchu aman alamkaite hinna asunou vin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Koi hile thilpeh dihlou kithang atpi-a michu, meibol jingleiloi le hui nunga go julou tobang ahi."},"15":{"text":"Thohhat na-in vaihom khat ajol lhajouvin, chule awnema thu kiseihin gule chang jong asubong theijin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nangman khoiju namu em? naneh jou khambep ne-in; achutiloule vavalin natin lodoh khagetnin nate."},"17":{"text":"Naheng nakom insung hachot lut behseh hih-in, injole natheichim valintin, nahotlo khante."},"18":{"text":"Aheng akom douna-a hettohsah lhem-a pangpa chu, moltum lentan, chemjam chule thalchang hemtah tobang ahi."},"19":{"text":"Lungjinpetna kitahna neilou mikhat chunga kinep hi, habongle kenggu kipel tobang ahi."},"20":{"text":"Lunggim gentheija umkhat henga la sapa chu; daplaitah-a mi ponsil lahmang pehpa tobangle, lengpitwi thuhtah kisuhkhahna maha chunga kisunglha tobang ahi."},"21":{"text":"Namelma chu agil akela ahile nehding penlang, adang achahle donding twi pe-in;","ref":"Rom 12:20."},"22":{"text":"Chutia chu nabola ahile nangman ama lujanga mei-am nasunlhah peh hiding ahin, Pakaiyin nangma tohphat man napeh teiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Sahlam huijin go asem mangin, hitobang chun kiseisetna hin lunghanna maiso asodohsah-e."},"24":{"text":"Numei hansetah toh inlen khatna chenkhom sangin, in chung ningkoija chending aphajoi."},"25":{"text":"Gamlatah-a kona thupha hunglhung hi, adangchahpa dinga donding twidap tobang ahi."},"26":{"text":"Migilou angsunga michonpha abohkhup dinghi, twinah phalou le twinen putna twisam tobang ahi."},"27":{"text":"Khoiju tampi neh aphatlou bangin, mihem hon amachang loupina akiholu jonghi aphapon ahi."},"28":{"text":"Amatah lhagao thunun jouloupa chu, khopi chimlhasa le kulpi umlou tobang ahibouve."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nipilaija buhbang alhah bangle, chang-at laitah-a go ajuh bangin, jana hi mingol dingin akilompoi."},"2":{"text":"Vacha lengle le pelpa lengle bangin, ajehbeija kisapsetna jong atang deh poi."},"3":{"text":"Sakol dinga jepna, sangan dinga kamdal, chule mingol tungtun dinga mol uma ahi."},"4":{"text":"Mingolpa chu angol dungjuijin donbut hih-in, amatoh bang khagetnin nate."},"5":{"text":"Mingol chu ama mitmu-a akichihsah louna dingin, angol dungjuijin donbutnin."},"6":{"text":"Mingol khat khutna thuthotpa chun, amatah keng akitanboh-a chule setna twi adon tobang ahi."},"7":{"text":"Kengbaipa keng tenichu akibang ngaipon, mingol ho kamsunga kon kisei thulem jong chutobang chu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Mingol jana pepa chu, ahsongse-a songchang khitpa tobang ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mingol ho kamsunga kon hungpot thulem chu, ling hemjet khatnin jukham khat akhut adotlut tobang ahibouve."},"10":{"text":"Thiljouse sema Pathen loupitah chun, mingol hole chonkhelte tohman apecheh-e."},"11":{"text":"Uichan aloh lhahsa anehkit ji bangin, mingol jong angolna-a akile kitjin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mihem ama mitmu-a kichang chihsah namu khah em? hichepa sangchun mingolpa din kinepna aumjoi."},"13":{"text":"Mithasepan, lampia keipi bahkai aumin, khopi lamlen ho-a keipi bahkai aume, ati."},"14":{"text":"Kotkhah chu akikam na-a akiheilele bangin, mithase chu ajalkhuna akiheilelejin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Mithasen akhutnin abukong asohlut jin, akam sung geija hin dop ding jong angapcha poi."},"16":{"text":"Thil hethem le lunggel them mi sagi sanga, mithase chu ama mitmu-a chingjo-a kigel ahi."},"17":{"text":"Akikumna ding jong hilouva kikumma kinahna-a jaopa chu; uicha abila manpa tobang bep ahi."},"18":{"text":"Milung chavai thingkho-am, thalchang, chule thina, seplele pa chu,"},"19":{"text":"aheng akom lhemlha-a, chule katot ahibouve, tia mitobang ahi."},"20":{"text":"Thing umlouna-a mei amitji bangin, misuto umlouna-a kidouna atangji tai."},"21":{"text":"Songmeihol-am min songmeihol akahvam bangle, meijin thing akahvan ji banga; minelkal hatpa chu kinahna sosah-a pang ahi."},"22":{"text":"Misuto hat thusei ho chu tina maha tobang ahin; oisunggil lampeh-a jong hiche hochu alutjin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Muhnaljetle lungsung gilouchu, leibel dangka-a kitomjol tobang ahi."},"24":{"text":"Koi hile mihotbola chun akamin aseithem jin, hinlah alungsunga lheplhahna ngen akikhol khom ahin;"},"25":{"text":"Aman damheocha thu aseidohteng, tahsan hih-in, ajehchu alungsunga thet umtah thil sagi aumin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Mi ahotbolna chu joulhepna-a atomkhum hijongle, mipi kikhom khom masanga kitahlang ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Koi hile kokhuh laija chu, chua chu ama lhalut teiding; chule song tangpa chunga chu, asong tah chu hungkilekit ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Jousei leiguijin asuhgim ho chu ahokit jin, chule pachat lhem seidoh kamsung hin manthah na atongdoh-e."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jing nikho-a din kithang at hih-in, ajehchu hiche nikho chun ipi ahinlhun sah ding nangman nahepoi.","ref":"Jac 4:13-16."},"2":{"text":"Nang le nang nakamsunga nakivahchoi sangin, gamdang mikhatnin nangma navahchoi johen."},"3":{"text":"Song agih in chule neldi agihcheh-e, ahinla mingol lungsatna chu hicheteni sanga chu gihjonalai ahi."},"4":{"text":"Lungsatna hi thil phaloutah ahin, chule lunghana hi thil nasatah ahi; ahinla thangthipna masanga dingjou ding koiham?"},"5":{"text":"Guhthima kingailut sangin phongtah-a kiphosal aphajoi."},"6":{"text":"Gol le paijin amavona chu tahsan umtah ahi, amavang melman eichop chu lheplhahna ahibouve."},"7":{"text":"An vasa hodin khoiju jengjong kidah aumin, ahinla agilkel dingin vang thilkha jouse jong alhumjie."},"8":{"text":"A-in'a kon vahmangpa chu, vacha abuh-a kon lengmang tobang ahi."},"9":{"text":"Thaole gimnamtuijin lungsung akipasah-in, chutobang chun lungsunga kona kihilna phatah chun loile gol akipasah theije."},"10":{"text":"Nangma loile gol ahin, napa loile gol ahin jong dalha hih-in; hamset nikhoteng jongle nasopipa in'a chelut hih-in; ajehchu gamlatah a um napenpipa sangin na-in hengpa aphachomjoi."},"11":{"text":"Kachapa limgeh inlang, eitamsepa kadonbut theinadin kalung kipasah-in."},"12":{"text":"Milung chingin thilse hunglhung ding amumasan, hijeh chun akiselin, ahinla mimolhochu achepaijun, talen amanjitaove."},"13":{"text":"Gamdang mikhat dinga kitepna thilla kitungpa ponsil chu lahpeh-un; chule gamdang numeinu khat dingin kitepna thilin mangun."},"14":{"text":"Jingkah matah-a thouva awsangtah-a agolpa phatthei bohpa chu, amadinga gaosapna-a kilading ahi."},"15":{"text":"Gohajuh nikho-a gomal lha jengjung toh, numei nelhat tahchu kibang bep ahi."},"16":{"text":"Koihile amanu tuhtang jouva chun huipi jong atuhtang jou ahin, chule akhut jetlama thao jong asip thei ahi."},"17":{"text":"Thih in thih mama anol hemthei bangchun, mihem khatnin agolpa maiso chu avahsah theijin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Koihile theichang phung kivettupma chun theichang ga chu aneh teiding ahin; chutobangma chun a-pakaipa ngahjingpa chu jana changtei ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Twilah ivet le ilim akimudoh ji bangin, mihem lungthimin jong mihem hina aphongdoh jin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Thikholmun le manthah na chu imatih-in adim ngaipon, chutobang chun mihem mitnin jong chimtih anei ngaipoi."},"21":{"text":"Dangka dinga sontwina bel, chule sana dinga lhummei ahin; hinlah mihem chu mi apachat nadung juija kipatep ji ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mingol khatchu nangman sum sunga changbong toh suhtha jongle chun, angolna chu ama-a konin beichomdeh ponte."},"23":{"text":"Nakelngoi hon umdan nahet nadingle, nagancha hon phatecha navettup nadingin pontho tah-in pangin."},"24":{"text":"Ajehchu haonahohi tonsotna ding ahipon, lallukhuh jeng jonghi akhang akhanga umding ahipoi."},"25":{"text":"Changpol akilahdoh teng hamjing ahung nouthah-in, chule molsang ho-a hamhingho akichomkhom jin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Kelngoiho chu navonding ahiuvin, chule kelchaho chu louman ding ahiuve."},"27":{"text":"Chule nangman nadon khopset le na-insungmi nehkhop set, chule nanungah umpi chengse khoukhah nadinga lhingset kelcha noi nanei ding ahi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migilou chu koimacha dellouvin ajamin, midihtah pa vangchu keipibahkai bangin ahang san-e."},"2":{"text":"Gamkhat suhkhel jeh-in pipui tamtah ahung umji, ahinla hetkhen themtheina le hetna nei mikhat jala gamsung chu chesotding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Mivaicha khatnin mivaicha khatma asuhgenthei chu, nehding khenlou hela lhohmang jeng goju tobang ahi."},"4":{"text":"Dan pailhaho chun migilouho chu apahchaovin, ahin dan juiho chun amahochu akinelpi jiuvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Miphalou hon thutanlhah nahi ahekhen themthei jipouvin, Pakai holte vang chun thiljouse ahekhen them jiuve."},"6":{"text":"Mivaicha chondih na-a lamjotpa chu, alampi ho-a vahkoi le mihaopa sangin aphajoi."},"7":{"text":"Koihile dan tuhdetna chu chapa ching ahin; ahinla boina semho toh kivoppa vang chun apa ajumsahjin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Lamdih louva sumpung lajia chule adihlouva nejipa chun anei apunsahbejin; hinla amapa chun vaichate khotothempa ding-a akhol khompeh ahibouve."},"9":{"text":"Dan thupeh ho-a kon anakhang heimangpa taona jengjong chu thet umtah ahibouve."},"10":{"text":"Koihile midih aselama kiheimangsahpa chu, amatah-in asem kokhuh sunga chu lhalutteiding; ahinla midihpa vang chun thilphaho aneiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Mihao chu amachang mitmun akichih sah-in, ahinla hetkhenthem theina nei vaichapan ama akholdoh sohjin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Michonpha te akipa tengule loupina nasatah aumjin; ahin migiloute ahung letdoh tengle mi akisel gamjitai."},"13":{"text":"Koi hile achonsetna selguh-a chu lolhing louding; amavang koihile hicheho phongdoh jenga chule dalha jenga chun hepina akimuding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Pathen ging jinga umpa chu anunnom ahin; ahinla alung tahsahpa vangchu vangsetna-a chuding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Mivaichate chunga vaihom gilou chu, keipi bahkai kitumle vompi midel hat tobang ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hetkhen themtheina neilou pipuichu misugenthei tah jong ahin, hinla papsetna hotbolpa chun ahinkho akisuhsao ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Pumhatna thisan so-a chu kokhuh-a jamlut ding; chule koiman apanpi louhel ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Koihile nolna beija chonlea chu huhhing-a umding ahin; alampiho-a vahkoilepa vangchu lhupai ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Alou kilhopa chun nehle chah ninglhingsetna aneiding ahin, ahinla pannabei miho nungjuipa vang chun vaichatna akimutei ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Mikitah chu phattheiboh changintin, ahinla hetman louva haoding gopa chu themmo changtei ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Sihnei langnei bolhi aphapoi, ajehchu changlhah halkhat jeh-a jong mi chonkhelji-a ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mikilosen hetman louva haoding jeng agelin; achunga vaichatna ahunglhun ding agelpha jipon ahi."},"23":{"text":"Akama pachatna lhem seipa sanga, miphohsal pa chun nungtengle khohsahna akimutam johding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Koihile anule apa choma hichehi chonset ahipoi tipa chu, misugampa toh golcha ahi."},"25":{"text":"Kiletsahna lungthim neipan kidouna achoh thouvin, Pakaiya atahsanna koipa vangchu phatthei changding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ama chang lunggela kisongpa chu mingol ahin; ahinla chingtah-a kalsongpa chu huhdoh-a umding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Koihile mivaicha kithopi-a chu lhasam louding; mivaicha kimumosah vang chun sapsetna tampi akimuding ahije."},"28":{"text":"Migilou adindoh teng miho akiseljin, amaho amanthah tengule vang midih apungjin ahi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamtahvei akihilchah nunga jong louchal nalaipa chu, hetmanlouva manthah na-a chuding, chule boldamo hella umding ahi."},"2":{"text":"Michonpha te vaihoma apanteng mipi akipah-in; ahinla khang gilouten vai ahomteng mipi alunghem jiuve."},"3":{"text":"Koihile chihna ngailu-a chun apa akipasah-in, notiho toh kivopma vang chun anei agou jouse asuhmang ahi."},"4":{"text":"Lengpan thutandih na-in agam aphutdetnin, ahin nehguh kilahpan vang agamchu alehkhup jin ahi."},"5":{"text":"A-inheng pahcha lhempa chun akeng dinga thang akampeh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Migilou chu asuhkhelna-a a-oh jin, ahinla michonpha hon la asaovin akipah uve."},"7":{"text":"Michonphan mivaicha khankho ding angaitopeh-in, ahinla migilouvin hetpeh dingjong agopoi."},"8":{"text":"Midaichavai hon khopi chu meijin ahal vamun, ahinla miching hon lungsatna aheidoh-un ahi."},"9":{"text":"Miching khatnin mingol khat chu kinahpi henglang, mingolpa chu kitomhen lang nuijongle chamna umdeh louding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Thisan sohatpan milungdihpa ahotbolin, ahinla midihtah pan vang alhagao huhdoh ding agon ahi."},"11":{"text":"Mingolin alungthima agel jouse aseidoh sohkeijin, miching pan vang akichintup-in ahi."},"12":{"text":"Vaihom khatnin jouthu jeng akhohsah-a ahileh, asohho jouse jong migilou asohji taove."},"13":{"text":"Mivaichale milhem hatpa akimuto lhonnin, amitlhon jong Pakai hasah ahicheh-e."},"14":{"text":"Dihtah-a mivaichate thu tanpeh lengpa laltouna chu, atonsot geija kiphudet ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Mol le phosal na-in chihna ape-in, ahinla achama kilha chapang chun anu ajumson ahi."},"16":{"text":"Migilou apunteng dan suhkhelna apungjin, ahinla michonpha ten amaho lhuhchu amudiu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nachapa nathun nunsah-in, chutile aman nangma olna napehding; chule aman nalung akipasah ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Khonungthu i-atiding ngaitophah louna achun mipite amangthah jitan; ahinla dan kituhchahpa chu akipah-in ahi."},"19":{"text":"Soh chu kamcheng keovin akisudih theipoi, ajehchu aman hethem jongle adonbut louding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ngaikham le geltoh umlouva thusei namu em? amasangin mingol din kinepna atamjon ahi."},"21":{"text":"Asoh aneovapat demchatah-a hinkhou khah-a chun, khonung teng hiche sohpa chu chapa-a ahin neiding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Milung chompan kinahna achoh thouvin, chule milungkhoh pan suhkhelna ahaolo jitai."},"23":{"text":"Mihem khat kiletsahna chun ama anoinunsah teiding, ahinla jana chun lungsunga kineosahpa chu atundoh ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Koihile migucha toh kithokhompa chun ama hinna jong ahot ahin, sapsetna ajanan ahin imacha aseipon ahi."},"25":{"text":"Mihem ginna hi thangkol kido ahibouvin, ahinla koihile Pakai tahsanna chu hoidoh ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Mitamtah in vaihompa khohsahna chu aholun, ahinla amitakip chunga thutanna chu Pakaiya kon ahibouve."},"27":{"text":"Mikitah loupa chu midihpa dingin thet umtah ahin, chule achena lampia nolnabei michu agiloupa dinga thet umtah ahi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakeh chapa Agur thusei ho, themgao thusei ngeichu: hiche mipan Ithiel henga, Ithiel le Ucal heng ngeija thu aseijin;","title":"Agur Thuchih seiho"},"2":{"text":"Tahbeh-in hi midang sangsanga ngoljo kahin, mihem khatnin hetna aneibangin keiman kaneipoi."},"3":{"text":"Chihna kitijong kajil khapon, mithengpa hetnajong kananeipon ahi."},"4":{"text":"Koiham van'a kaltouva ahiloule hungkum lha-a? Koiham hui akhutna huikhom theija? Koiham twi ponna chuntheija? Koiham leiset kolkimvel anaphut detna? Ama minchu ipi hija, chule achapa minchu ipiham, nangman nasei theijem?"},"5":{"text":"Pathen thu jousehi atheng ahin, chule ama tahsan ho jouse dingin ama chu lumdal ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nangman athuho chu belap hihbeh-in, achuti loule aman nangma phohsalin natin, thujou seipa nahilo ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Keiman nanga konin thilni kangeh-in, kathi masangin hiche teni chu nei-itpeh hihbeh-in;"},"8":{"text":"Keija konin thumanlou le jouthu gamlatah-a neikoi mangpeh jengin; vaichatna ahin haona hijongle neipehdan, keima dinga kakitopibep an achun neivah-in."},"9":{"text":"Neng behsehleng nangma seilep inting, Pakai chu koiham? katiding; ahiloule vaicha behseh leng kaguhchat ding, ka Pathen min chu mohseh-a kaphah pohding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Apupa henga asottolpa chu hehse hih-in, aman nasapset lontin themo changkhan nate."},"11":{"text":"Mihem tamtah apa gaosapma, chule anu jong phatthei bohlou aumin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mihem tamtah ama mitmu-a athenga kigel aumin, ahinla athenlou naova chu kisoptheng lou ahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Mihem tamtah aumin, Oh, amit houchu ichana sanga hitam! amit gei ujong dopsangin aumin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Mihem tamtah aumin, amaho hachu chemjam tobang, chule aha noinung houchu chemcha hemthet tobang ahin; leiset chunga kona vaichate vallhum dingle, mihem lah-a kona lhasamte sugam dinga kigo ahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Votnin chanu ni aneijin, neipen, neipen tin apengin ahi. A-itih-a chimjoulou thilthum aumin, henge, aphatai, tilouhel thil li aume."},"16":{"text":"Lhankhuh le nao neilou naobu; twi dim theilou hel leiset, chule aphatai tilouhel meikou ahi."},"17":{"text":"Apa noisena mitna vea, chule anuthua nunding i-sah loupa mit chu,, phaichama va-ah hon achuhdoh ding, chule mulaopi nouhon anehdingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Keima dingin datmo umtah thil thum aumin, kahetlou thil li aume;"},"19":{"text":"van'a mulaopi lenna lampi, songpi chunga gul kithollena lampi, twikhanglen lailunga kong kitolna lampi, chule pasal khatle nungah khat chena lampi ahi."},"20":{"text":"Notinu lampi jong chutobang chu ahi; amanun anen chule amuh akitheh-in, agilou kabol hihbeh-e, atin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Thilthum jeh in leiset athip theipon, chule thil li athoh theipoi:"},"22":{"text":"Soh khatnin vai ahinpoh-a, mingol khat-in sa vasetna ahin neh-a;"},"23":{"text":"Mi hotbol jing numei khatnin ji ahin neija, chule soh numei khat apinu goulo dinga ahung umhi ahi"},"24":{"text":"Leiset chunga neocha cha thil li aumin, ahinla hicheho chu aching cheh ahiuve;"},"25":{"text":"Sihmi hohin mihem sanga thalhomjo ahivangun, nipilaile amahon anehdiu akigonun;"},"26":{"text":"Jupihohi lhasam tah ahivangun, songpiho-a buh akisah uvin;"},"27":{"text":"Khaokhohon leng aneipouvin, ahijeng vangin abonchauvin ahonin achelejiu ve;"},"28":{"text":"Maimom in akhutnin atuh-in, chule leng inpiho-a aumin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Phatah a chekhom thilthum aumin, chule thil li kitoh della chekhom jong aume;"},"30":{"text":"Keipi bahkaihi gamsa jouse lah-a ahatpen ahin, koima otdohlou ahi;"},"31":{"text":"Uichal ahin, kelchal ahin, chuleh ama dou dinga koima dingdoh khalou lengpa ahi."},"32":{"text":"Nangle nang kichoisang na-a ngolhoi tah-a nachon khah-a, ahiloule nangman thilphalou nagelleh, nakhutnin nakam kisimin."},"33":{"text":"Bongnoi khu icho thipthap le bongnoiha asohjin, inahlhong iheh jongle thisan apotjin, chutobanga chu ilung ihansah jingle kinahna asohjin ahi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lemuel lengpa thusei ho, anun ahung guilhung dingthu anahilho.","title":"Leng Lamuel Nu Thusei ho"},"2":{"text":"Ipiham kachapa? Iham kanaobua kon peng kachapa? Chule ipiham kakitepna ho-a kahin kachapa?"},"3":{"text":"Nathahatna chu numei ho pedoh hih-in, nalampi ho jongchu lengte sumangho pedoh hih-in."},"4":{"text":"Hichehi lengho ding ahipoi, Vo Lemuel, lenghon ju adonding ahipon, leng chateho dingin jong juchih donding ahipoi."},"5":{"text":"Amahon donnu henlang danthu sumil taleu, suhgentheija umte chungchang thua lamdih louva thutan na aneikhah diu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amangthai ding hochu juchih donsah-un, chule lunggimho chu ju donsah-un."},"7":{"text":"Aman don henlang avaichatna sumil hen, chule agimnaho geldohda tahih hen."},"8":{"text":"Mangthah dinga lhuhsahsa umho chungchanga, paomoho dingin nakam keh-in."},"9":{"text":"Mihem apaomo amadia thu kisei theilou jeh-a suhmanga umtadingho panpinan, nakam keh-inlang seipeh-in."},"10":{"text":"Numei chondihtah koijin akimujou tadem? ajehchu amanu manlutdan chu songmantam ho sangin asangjon ahi.","title":"Numei pha"},"11":{"text":"A-inneipu chun lungmong selin atahsanin, hitichun amapa dingin lhahsamna kitimong mong umponte."},"12":{"text":"Amanun ahinkho lhumkeijin amapa dingin thilpha bolin tin, chule thilse bolpeh ponte."},"13":{"text":"Amanun samul le tupat aholin, alungcham tah-in akhut tah-in na atongin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Amanu chu sumkolvei ho kong innei tobang ahin, gamla tahtah-a konin aman nehle chah ahin polutjin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Amanu janlai jengin jong athoudoh jin, chule a-insungmite chu nehding sa apen, aumpi soh numei ho jong achanding apejin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Amanun loumun khat avechilin, hichu achon, akhutsoh mangchan lengpilei abolin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Amanun thahat na-in atai akigeh-in, chule abantha ahatsah-in ahi."},"18":{"text":"Amanun aveipungho chu aphai ti ahen, amanu meivah jong janle amit ngaipoi."},"19":{"text":"Amanun akhutnin muikung atuh-in, chule akhutnin patkong kung atuh-in ahi."},"20":{"text":"Amanun vaichate le, lhasamte dingin akhut alhangdoh jin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Amanun a-insungmite dingin buhbang hunglha dingjong akichapoi; ajehchu a-insungmite jouse chu ponsanthip cheh-a kivon ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Amanun amadingin ponsil jemnei akikhonin, amanu von chu lungpon le ponsandup ahi."},"23":{"text":"A-inneipu chu gamsung upaho toh khopi kotpiphunga atouteng mijouse het ahijin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Amanun tupat ponnemjet akhongin, ajohjin; chule konggah jong sumkolveipa henga akijoh jin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Amanu chu thahatna le jana-in akivonin, ahunglhung ding phatna jong ama kipah thanom ding ahi"},"26":{"text":"Amanun chingthei tah-in thu aseijin, athusei jong khotona dimset ahi."},"27":{"text":"Amanun a-insung chena lampiho phatechan aven, chule thasetna changlhah jong anepon ahi."},"28":{"text":"Achate ahung thoudoh-un anunnom nahi atiuve; a-inneipun jong amanu apahcha lheh jengin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chanu tamtah-in chonphat abolin, ahinla nangman amaho chu nakhokhel sohkeije."},"30":{"text":"Deisahna hi kilhep lhahna ahin, chule hoinahi pannabei ahi; ahinla Pakai gingjing numei vangchu, choi-atna umding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Akhutsoh chu amanu peuvin, chule kotpi phunga anatoh jousechun amanu vahchoi cheh hen."}}}}},"21":{"info":{"name":"Thuhilpa","shortname":"Thulp","abbr":[],"desc":"Thuhilpa Lekhabu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem lengpa David chapa thuhilpa thusei ho.","title":"Hinkho hi Pannabei ahi"},"2":{"text":"Pannabei ho pannabei ahi tin thuhilpan aseije, pannabei ho pannabei; ijakai pannabei ahi."},"3":{"text":"Mihem khatnin nisa noija atohgimna jouse-a kona ipi phatchomna aneinah em?"},"4":{"text":"Khang khat achemangjin, chule khangchom khat ahunglhung kitji-e; ahinla leiset a-imatih-in aum jingin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nisa jong ahung sohdoh-in, nisa alhumkit jin, chule ahung sodohna lam mama-a akileloi jitai."},"6":{"text":"Hui chu lhanglam ngan anungin, chule sahlam ngan ahung lennun jin; tanglouvin akipei pei jengin, chule anundan kisem dungjuijin ahunglenun kitjin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Vadung jouse twipia alonglut nun, ahijeng vangin twipi chu adimdehpoi; vadungho chu ahung londohna lama chun akile kitnun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Thil jousehi tohgimnan adimsetnin, mihemin aseidoh theipoi; mitla thilmu achinpon, nakol jong athujah-a adim theipoi."},"9":{"text":"Thil anaumsa chu, ahung um kitding mama chu ahin; chule anakibolsa chu, ahung kibol kitding chu ahije; chule nisa noijahin thilthah ima aumpoi."},"10":{"text":"Ven thilkhat chungchanga, hichehi athah ahi-e, tia gahsei thei umem? Eiho masangpeh, gollui laija ana umsa jeng ahi."},"11":{"text":"Masanglai thilho geldohna aumpon; khonunga hung umding honjong ahunglhung ding thil ho geldohna neideh pouvinte."},"12":{"text":"Thuhilpa keima hi Jerusalem'a Israel chunga leng kanahi.","title":"Thuhilpan Hinkho-a Athilto-a Kona Ahetdoh ho"},"13":{"text":"Chule keiman vannoi'a thil kitongdoh ho jouse chung changhi chihna-a hola kholdoh nadin kalung kanapen ahi; hichehi Pathen'in akisinsah nadiuva mihem chapate chu thohgimna nasatah hi anapeh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Keiman nisa noija nakitongsa jouse chu kamutai; chule veuvin aboncha keijin pannabei le lhagao sunohphah ahibouve."},"15":{"text":"Akonsa chu kisujang thei louding; chule akisama chu kisimtha theilou ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Kalungthimin keima le keima kakihoulim jin, hitin kati; veuvin, keiman mun jaotah chu kahin phatai, chule Jerusalem'a keima masanga anaumho jouse sangin chihna kakimube tai: Tahbeh mongin kalungin chihna le hetnalam hetdohna lentah aneitai.","ref":"1 Leng 4:29-31."},"17":{"text":"Keiman chihna, ngolna, chule ngolchona hetdoh nadin kalung kanapen; hiche jonghi lhagao sunohphah ahi ti kamudoh-in ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu chihna tamna-a gimna atamin; chule hetna haopa chun lungkhamna ahaove."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keiman kalung sunga, tun chen, keiman nangma thanop na-in napatep inge, hijeh chun nopsahna hinkho mangin, tin kaseije: ahin, veuvin, hiche jonghi pannabei ahi."},"2":{"text":"Keiman nuina hi, ngolna ahi kati; chule thanopna hi, ipin ahin sodoh ham?"},"3":{"text":"Chihna toh kalungsung kiheto-a kakoi jeng vangin, keiman kalung sunga ju lama kakipeh nading; chule mihem chapatehon ahin nikho lhumkei uva, vannoi'a amaho ding atohdoh uva pha kamudoh kahsen, ngolchon nalama kipenge tin, kangaiton ahi."},"4":{"text":"Keiman natohlen len katongin; keima din in tampi kakisah-in; chule lengpigui hon tampi kakibolin ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 10:23-27; 2 Thusm 9:22-27."},"5":{"text":"Keiman hon le theilei tampi kakibolin, hiche sunga chun thei namkim kaphutnin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Keiman gammang hinsodoh-a thingphung ho twichap dingin, twikul tampi jong kakilaijin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Keiman soh pasal le soh numei tampi kaki choh-in, ka-insunga pengden soh tampi kaneijin; keima masanga Jerusalem'a anaum ho jouse sangin gancha alenle aneo kanei tamjon ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 4:23."},"8":{"text":"Keiman dangka le sana, chule lengho le gamkai ho neile gou kidang dangho jong kakichom khomin; Keiman numei lasathem le pasal lasathem, chule mihem chapate kipana thei, tumgingthei manchah ho jatkim keijin kakichom khomin ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 10:10,14-22."},"9":{"text":"Hitichun keima kanaloupi-in, chule kamasanga Jerusalem'a ana umho jouse sangin kanakhang touvin; chule ka chihna jong aum aumpeh-in ahi.","ref":"1 Thusm 29:25."},"10":{"text":"Chule kamit tenin amunom tapou chu musah louvin kakoipon, kipana-a konin kalungthim kakham chah poi; ajehchu katohgim najousea kalung akipah-in, chule hiche chu katoh gimna jouse-a kona kachan chu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman kakhut teni-a kanatohdoh ho jousele, tohgimna-a katohdoh ho kaven; chule, veuvin, aboncha chu pannabei le lungthim kisuhboina anahi bouvin, chule nisa noija hin imacha aphachom aumpoi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin keima chihna le ngolna chule ngolchona ngaitodin kakiheitan ahi: ajehchu lengpa nunga hungpa chun ipi aboldoh dingham? ana kiboldoh sajeng bou hiding ahi.","title":"Miching Leh Mingol Kichaina Ding"},"13":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman vah-in muthim akhokhel banga, chihna-in ngolchon na akhokhel chu kanamudoh tan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Michingpa mit teni chu aluchunga aumin; ahinla mingol vang chun muthim lah-a lam ajotnin ahi. Chule thilsoh khatchu abonchau chunga asoh-e ti keima tah-in kamudoh tai."},"15":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman kalung sunga kaseijin, mingol chunga thilsoh tobang, keima chung jenga jong asoh-in; achutile ipidinga ching jep kahim? kati; chuin kalung sunga, hiche jonghi pannabei ahi kati."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu a-imatih chanin miching chu mingol sangin geldoh-in aumdehpoi; tu-a umho jousehi ahunglhung ding nikho hole suhmila umsoh keiding ahi. Chule mi michingpa chu iti thi ham? mingol tobanga thi ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun keiman hinkho kahon ahi; ajehchu nisa noija nakitong doh hi keima dingin lungkhamna jeng ahi. Ajehchu imajouse pannabei le lungthim kisuhboina ahi."},"18":{"text":"Dihtah-in keiman nisa noija katoh gimna jouse kahon ahi; ajehchu keiman kanunga hungpa dinga kadalhah pehding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule amapa chu miching ahi mingol ahiding koijin ija ahetnem? hijeng jongle keiman nisa noija kachihna vetsahna-a, gimtah-a katohdoh ho jouse chung, aman vai ahop ding ahi. Hiche jonghi pannabei ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun nisa noija katohgimna ho jouse-a chun kalung kathoi sah-in ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu chihna, hetna chule thudih-a tong gima mi aumin; ahijeng vangin amapan tonggim louhelpa chan dinga adalhah pehding ahi. Hiche jonghi pannabei le thil phaloutah ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu mihem khatnin atohgimna jousele, alunggimna chule nisa noija atohgim naho-a ipi amu-em?"},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu anikhoho jouse chu gentheina ahin, chule athohgimna jong lunghemna ahi; tahbeh-in, janteng jongle alungsung aolpoi. Hiche jonghi pannabei ahi.","ref":"Job 5:7; 14:1."},"24":{"text":"Mihem khatnin an aneh-a, twi adona, chule ahinna-in atohgimna chunga nop asah sanga phajo aumpoi. Hiche jonghi Pathen khutna kon anahi ti, keiman kana mudoh-e.","ref":"Thulp 3:13; 5:18; 9:7; Luk 12:19; 1 Cor 15:32."},"25":{"text":"Ajehchu keima sanga koijin an neh akimu joh-a, ahiloule koijin nom asah joh-am?"},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen'in ama mitmun mipha chu chihna le hetna chule kipana apen; ahinla michonse vang chu, Pathen ang sunga miphapa peh ding chomkhom ding le sevum dingin, thoh hahsa apen ahi. Hiche jonghi pannabei le lungthim kisuhbohna ahi.","ref":"Job 32:8; Thuch 2:6."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thil jouse din phat aumcheh-in, chule vannoi'a chule thil kigong jousen phat anei cheh-e.","title":"Thil Jousen Phat Anei"},"2":{"text":"Penphat aumin, chule thi phat aume; aphu phat aumin, chule akiphutsa bodoh phat aume."},"3":{"text":"Thaphat aumin, chule boldam phat aume; phetlhah phat aumin, chule sahdohna phat aume."},"4":{"text":"Ka phat aumin, chule nui phat aume; lunghem phat aumin, chule lam phat aume."},"5":{"text":"Songho paidoh phat aumin, chule songho lokhom phat aume; kikolchah phat aumin, chule kilhakang phat aume."},"6":{"text":"Amu phat aumin, chule mansahna phat aume; chintup phat aumin, chule paidoh phat aume."},"7":{"text":"Bo-eh phat aumin, chule khuibit phat aume; thipchetna umphat aumin, chule paodoh phat aume,"},"8":{"text":"Kingailut phat aumin, chule kimuda phat aume; kigal phat aumin, chule kicham phat aumin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Atongpa chun atohgimna-a kona ipi phatchomna aneijem?","title":"Pathen'in Tohdinga Apeh Natoh"},"10":{"text":"Keiman mihem chapate kisinsahna dinga Pathen'in apeh thoh hahsat nachu keiman kamutai."},"11":{"text":"Aman thil ijakai jouse aphatchan hoitah-in asemin ahi: chujongle koimachan Pathen'in abula patna ajona geija ipi atoh doh-em ahetdoh joulouna dingun, alungthim sunguva vannoi thu akhumpeh tan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla mihem chu akipa thanopma, ahinkho-a thilpha abol tilouvin, amaho-a thilpha aumpoi ti keiman kahen ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chujongle mihem jousen aneh-a, adona chule atohgimna jouse-a kona thilpha nomtah-a amanchah ding ahi, hichu Pathen thilpeh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Pathen'in abol tapou chu a-imatih chana ding ahi, ti keiman kahei; chuche chunga chu belapthei, chule lahdohthei jong aumpoi. Chule hichehi Pathen'in mihemte ama angsunga kicha tah-a aumna diuva abol ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ana umsa chu tu-a umhi ahi; chule ahung umding jong chu anaumsa chu ahin; chule Pathen'in achesa chu anung holin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule chuche chungchon chun keiman nisa noija thutan na mun chu kamun, chua phatlouna aum; chule chonphatna mun'a khangit louna aum kamun ahi.","title":"Thudihlou Achungnun Joh"},"17":{"text":"Pathen'in michonpha hole migiloute chung thu atanding ahi; ajehchu thil kigong le thil kiboldoh chengse dingin phat khat aumcheh-e, tin keiman kalungsunga kaseijin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Mihem chapate umdan chungchanga hin, Pathen'in amaho hinphong doh henlang, chule amahotah in jong sahem ahiuhi kimudoh theileu, tin kalung sunga kaseijin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ajehchu mihem chapate chunga thil lhungchu sahemho chunga alhungin; thilkhat jeng jong amaho chunga alhung gellin ahi: khat athi bangin, khatjong athin; tahbeh-in, abonchauva haitheina kibang neicheh ahiuve; chutichun mihemin sahem chunga chungnunna aneipoi. Ajehchu aboncha pannabei ahi."},"20":{"text":"Abon chaovin munkhat ajon cheh-un, abon chaova vutvaija kon ahiuvin, chule abon chaovin vutvai asoh kit jiuve."},"21":{"text":"Mihem lhagao chunglama kaltouva, chule sahem lhagao leisetna akumsuh koijin ahet khah-em?"},"22":{"text":"Hijeh chun mihem chu anatoh ho-a kipah thanoma aumding sanga phajo adang aumpoi ti keiman kahedoh tai; ajehchu hichu ama chan ahin; chule ama nunga ipi asoding ve dinga koijin ama apui ding ham?"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti chun kahung kilen, nisa noija suhgentheina jouse chu kangaitoi: chule veuvin, joulhepma umte mitlhi chu, amahon lhamonsah aneipouvin; chule amaho sugentheite henga chun thaneina aume, ahinla amahon lhamonsah aneipouve."},"2":{"text":"Hijeh chun keiman ahingho tu-a hing nalaiho sangin, athiho tu-a athisaho kapah chajon ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tahbeh-in, amani sangin, tuchan geija umkha loulai, chule nisa noija thilse kibol mukhalou laipa chu aphajoi."},"4":{"text":"Avelin, keiman mihem khat aheng akomin amit thip lona thohgimnaho jouse le natohphaho jouse chu kangaiton; hiche jonghi pannabei le lungthim kisuhboina ahi.","title":"Kiloset Pannabei Ahidan"},"5":{"text":"Mingolin akhut asim tumin, chule ama le ama tahsa akineh jin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Thohgim tahle lungthim kisuhboi puma khut ni dimsei neisangin, lungdam sella tah-a khut khat dim nei aphajoi."},"7":{"text":"Chujouvin keima kahung kile kitnin, chule nisa noija pannabei chu kamu doh-e."},"8":{"text":"Khatsehbou aumin, anina aumpoi: henge, aman cha aneipon sopi pasal jong aneipoi; ahinla atohgimna aki ngahtih aumpon; amit jong chu haonaho-a alunglhai joupon; koidinga katoh-a, chule kahinna thilpha kachansah louham? tin aseidehpoi. Hichejonghi pannabei ahin, nasatah-a thohgimna ahi."},"9":{"text":"Khat sangin ni aphajoi; ajehchu atoh gimna lhona kipaman phatah amulhonin ahi.","title":"Loile Gol Phatchomna"},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu alhuh hon jongle, khat chun aloipa aphohding ding ahi; ahinla achanga umpa chu alhuh teng ada ahi; ajehchu aman akithopi ding aneipon ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chukitle mi ni alupkhom lhonle, akinehlum to lhonin; ahinla khat changseh chu iti kisuh lum thei ding ham?"},"12":{"text":"Chule khat touvin ama hindou taleh, mi nin amapa chu anan jouding ahi; chule khaohol thum kiheh kop chu atanbai pon ahi."},"13":{"text":"Leng tehse ngoltah, thumop sangthei lou hisangin; chapang vaichatah le chingtah hi aphajoi.","title":"Minthan Najong Abeiji-e"},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu amachu songkul'a konin leng chang dingin ahungpot doh-in; hijongle ama lenggam sung mama-a peng khatchu ahung vaicha theije."},"15":{"text":"Keiman nisa noija kalsong hinna neiho jouse chu, ama khela lenga hung pangding cha ni lhinna chutoh kagah ngaito khomin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Mipi jouse leh amaho masanga anaumho jouse kichaitih aumpoi; nunga hung dingho jong ama chunga kipah deh loudingu ahi. Tahbeh-in hiche jonghi pannabei le lungthim kisuhboina ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen in'a nache tengle nakeng kivet phatnin, chule mingol ho longlhenna thilpeh sangin thu ngai dingin kigo jingin umjon; ajehchu amahon thilse aboluve ti angaito phapouve.","title":"Pathen Gingin, Nakitepna Molson"},"2":{"text":"Nakam tamsah hih-in, chule Pathen angsunga thilkhat phongdoh dingin nalung kino dahen; ajehchu van'a Pathen aumin, nangma leiset chunga uma nahi; hijeh chun nathu seidoh chu lhom sah-in."},"3":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile kisah lelna tamtah jala mang umji ahin, chule mingol aw chu athu tamseija konin akihen ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pathen henga kitepna khatna nakitep teng, peh ding ngongkai hih-in; ajehchu aman mingol ho-a kipana aneipoi; nathutep chu pe jengin.","ref":"Labu 66:13-14."},"5":{"text":"Nakitepna pelouva naum sangin, nakitep louma apha jon ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nakam chu natahsa chonsetsah nadingin phal hih-in; vantil masanga jong hichehi suhkhel ahi tin seihih in.
