Ipidinga Pathen chu na aw-soa lunghanga, nakhutsoh thilho asuh manghel dingham?"},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu mang tamnale thu tamna-a chun pannabei tampi jong aumjie; ahinla nangman Pathen chu gingin."},"8":{"text":"Nangman gamsunga mivaichate kisuh gentheina, chule thutanlhahna le thudih pumhatna akibol namu-a ahile hichu datmo hih-in; ajehchu asang penpa sanga sang jopan akhohsah nan; chule amaho sanga sangjo aumnai.","title":"Hinkho Hi Pannabei Ahi"},"9":{"text":"Hiche chungchon chun leiset phatchomna hi mijouse dinga ahi, lengpa tah jengjong louma-a hinga ahi."},"10":{"text":"Dangka ngailupa chu dangka-a lunglhai joulou ding, ninglhin na ngailupa chu punbe na-a lunglhai louding ahi; hiche jonghi pannabei ahi."},"11":{"text":"Thil le lo apunbe teng, aneding jong apunben; chule chuche neiho dinga chu, amitnuva amu-u tilouva aphat chomna ipi umam?"},"12":{"text":"Tamtah nehen lhomcha nejongle natong gimpa imut chu anomin; ahinla mihaopa haosatna chun ama a-imut sahpon ahi."},"13":{"text":"Keiman nisa noija thil phaloutah khat kamu aume; hichu haonahi aneipa kisuhkhah nadinga kikoija ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla chuche haonaho chu thoh hahsatna phaloutah jeh-in amangthah jin, chule aman chapa khat ahingin, chule imacha akhutna aumpoi."},"15":{"text":"Amapa anu naobu-a kona ahungpot banga chu, ahung bang banga sagoh keova kile kitding, chule akhutna akichoi mang thei, atohgimna-a kona ima aki kenthei louding ahi.","ref":"Job 1:21; Labu 49:17; 1 Tim 6:7."},"16":{"text":"Chule hiche jonghi thilsetah ahin, lamjouse-a ahung bang banga, kinungle cheh ding ahi. Chule ahomkeo dinga tonggimpan ipi phatchomna aneijem?"},"17":{"text":"Aman ahin nikho jousen muthim lah-a an anen, chule hesoh tampi, lungsatna tampi chu anatna to athoh than ahi."},"18":{"text":"Veovin, keiman kamudoh hi; Pathen'in mihem khat apeh ahinkho lhumkeija; nisa noija atohgimna jouse-a, an aneh-a, twi adona, akipa thanop dinghi thil phatah le kilomtah ahi; ajehchu hichu ama chan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Amitakip henga Pathen'in haona le neile gou apen; chule chuche-a kona chu neding le, achan kilah nading, chule atohgimna-a akipa theina dingin thaneina apen ahi; Hichehi Pathen thilpeh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile aman ahinlai nikhoho chu hageldoh theiponte; ajehchu Pathen'in alungsung kipana-in adonbut tan ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nisa noija thilse khat keiman kamui; chule hichu mihemte lah-a umjing thil ahi.","title":"Manchah Louva Haonaho Pannabei"},"2":{"text":"Pathen'in mihem khat ahinan angaichat jouse imacha alhahsam louna dinga haosatna, neile gou, chule jana apen, ahijeng vangin Pathen'in chuche ho-a kona chu aneh theina ding tha apepon, ahinla gamdang min bou anen ahi. Hichehi pannabei, nat phaloutah ahi."},"3":{"text":"Mihem khatnin cha jakhat hinghen lang, chule kum tampi hing hen, hitichun ahin nikhoho tamtah hihen lang, ahin ahinna chun thilpha-in lungkimna neihih hen, chule vui louvin jong umtaleh; keiman amapa sangchun aphat louva pen aphajoi kati."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu ama pannabei to ahung lutnin, chule muthim lah-a achemang tan, chule aminchu muthimin akhukhum ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chukal valin aman nisa anamu pon, imacha jong anahe poi; aman khatjopa sangin olna akimu joh-in ahi."},"6":{"text":"Henge, kum sangkhat nivei hing henlang, thilpha mu hihleh, mijouse abonchauva munkhatna checheh hilouham?"},"7":{"text":"Mihem tohgimna jousehi akamsung ding ahin, ahijeng vangin aduchat achim dehpoi."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu michingin mingol ho sanga ipi atamnei deh em? ahing nalaiho masanga kalsonje he-a vaichaten, ipi aneideh em?"},"9":{"text":"Gamtin ngaichat sangin, mitna mu joh chu aphajoi; hiche jonghi pannabei le lungthim kisuhgimna ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aumsa chu minvosa ahitan, chule hichu mihem ahije ti akihen; ama sanga thahatjo toh ama kitet theihoi ahideh poi."},"11":{"text":"Pannabei punsah-a thil tampi akimudoh tolhonin, mihem dinga hichu ipiham aphat chomna?"},"12":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile mihem hinkhon nisa lim banga kitol mang loithei sung ajot laija, ama dia aphachom koijin ahetdoh ding ham? Ajeh chu ama athi nungle hiche nisa noija ipi ahungso ding koijin aseitheijem?"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minphat hi thao mantam tah sangin aphajon; chule thi nikhohi pen nikho sangin aphajon ahi.","title":"Chihna Natoh-a Kipohdoh Amanlut Dan","ref":"Thuch 22:1."},"2":{"text":"Lunghemna in'a gachehi, golvahna in'a gache sangin aphajoi; ajehchu hiche chu mijouse hinkho kichaini ahin, chule ahing nalai chun alung sunga achin jing ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hesohna hi nuina sangin aphajoi; ajehchu lunghemna melput vangin lungsung semphat cheh in aum jie."},"4":{"text":"Miching lungsung chu lunghemna insunga aumin, ahinla mingol ho lungsung vang chu kipana inabou aum jie."},"5":{"text":"Mihem dinga michingin mi aphona jah chu, mingol lasah kijah sangin aphachom jon ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu mingol nuigin chu linga belto kikhot gin poh lenglung tobang ahin; hiche jonghi pannabei ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tahbeh-in suhgentheina hin miching asungolin, chule nehguh thilpeh hin lungsung asusen ahi."},"8":{"text":"Thilkhat kichaina chu akipatna sangin aphajoi; chule lhagaova thohhat chu lhagaova kiletsah sangin aphajoi."},"9":{"text":"Lunghang dingin nalungthima kino loihih-in, ajehchu lunghan hi mingol ho angsunga bou auma ahi.","ref":"Jac 1:19."},"10":{"text":"Tulai sanga malai nikho ho aphatjoh chu ipi jeh hintem, tin nangman seihih-in; ijeh inem itile nangman hiche chung changhi chingthei tah-in nakhol pon ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chihna hi gou kilo bangin dingin aphan; chule hiche jal hin nisa mute dingin phatchomna aume."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu sum hi kihon bitna ahibangin, chihna jonghi kihon bitna ahin; ahinla hetna achungchon na chu, chihna hin ama neiho chu hinna ape-in ahe."},"13":{"text":"Pathen natoh hohi gah ngaiton, ajehchu aman akhonsa-a asem chu, kon ajansah thei dingham?"},"14":{"text":"Hamphat nikhon kipah thanomin, ahinla hahsat nikhole ngaiton; mihemin khonung leh amanunga imacha amudoh louna dingin, Pathen'in mihem khatjoh banga achom joh jong chu asem cheh ahi."},"15":{"text":"Keiman pannabei nikhoho sunga hin imajouse kamusohtai. Midih khat achonphatna-a mangthah aumin, chule migilou khat agitlou vanga sottah hinga aumin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Tamtah chunga kichon phatsah hih-in; chih jong kichihsah hih-in; ipidinga nangma nangle nang nakisuhset dingham?"},"17":{"text":"Phatlou bolval hih-in, ngoljong ngolval hih-in; ipidinga naphat masanga nathi jeng ding ham?"},"18":{"text":"Hichehi nangman nakimat khah a pha ahi; henge, nakhut jong hichea konchun loidoh hih-in: ajehchu amaho jouse lah-a kona Pathen ginga chu hungdoh teiding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Khopi sunga um mithahat som sangin, chihna hin miching athahatsah jon ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu leiset chunga thilpha bolla, chonselou, midihtah khatcha aumpon ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chujongle thu kiseiho jousehi abonchan ngaikhoh hih-in, ajole nasohpan nasapsetna kijah getnin nate."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu chutobanga chu nangman jong midangho masapsetji chu nalung sungin ahe matchet jin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hitiho jousehi keiman chihna-a kaphot chet ahitai. Keiman ching taveleng kanatin, ahinla chihna chu keija konin anagamla lheh-e."},"24":{"text":"Gamlatah-a um, chule hathuh-a thuh chu, kon amudoh jou dingham?"},"25":{"text":"Hetna dingle kholchil nading, chule chihna holdohna ding le thilho umjedan holdoh nading, ngolna phatlou dan hetdohna dingle ngolna le lung chatvaina hetdoh nadingin, keiman kalungthim kana mangchan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule keiman alungsung Thangkol le Len ho ngen hia, chule akhut teni khaohol ho bangjeng, thina sanga khajo numei kamudoh-in ahi. Koi hileh Pathen lung lhaisahpa chu amanu-a kona hoidoh jouding, ahinla chonse vangchu amunun amat khahding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Veuvin, hiche hi kamudoh ahi, tin thuhilpan aseije: thil ahung kipat dan mudoh ahina dingin, khat khatnin kasimin;"},"28":{"text":"Kahinnan ahol nahlai pentah chu keiman kamudoh poi. Sangkhat lah-a pasal khat kamudoh-in; ahinla amaho jouse lah-a chun keiman numei khat jengjong kamudoh poi."},"29":{"text":"Veovin, hibouhi kamu doh-e, Pathen'in mihem dihtah-a asem ahin, ahinla amahon semdoh thu tamtah aholdoh-un ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Miching tobang ding koiham? chule thilkhat aledohna he-a koiham? mihem khatchu achihna-in amai avahsah-in; chule amai ngalna jongchu kikhel jengding ahi."},"2":{"text":"Keiman, nangma kathumop nahi, Pathen'a nakitepna jalchun, lengpa thupeh chu chingtupmin.","title":"Pathen Jal-in Thunei Vaihomho Thu Nungun"},"3":{"text":"Amitmua kona chedoh dingin kikinsah hih-in; thilse-a pang teitei hih-in; ajehchu aman adeichan chu aboljeng ahi."},"4":{"text":"Lengpa thu umna-a chun thahatna aumin; chule amahenga nangman ipi nabol ham tia seithei dinga koiham?"},"5":{"text":"Koi hileh ama thupeh nitchan chun thilse atolouding ahi; Chule michingpa lungthim chun phat le thu tanlhahna adatkhen theije."},"6":{"text":"Thil kigong jouse-a dingin phat le thutanlhahna aumcheh-in, hijeh chun mihem hamsetna hi amachunga lentah in aumjingin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile aman ipi ahung soding ahepoi; ajehchu itih phatna ahungso ding koijin ama aseipeh theidem?"},"8":{"text":"Lhagao henden na dinga lhagao chunga tha neija mihem koimacha aumpon; thi nikhon jong aman thaneina aneideh poi. Chule hiche gal kisat sunga jong chun ontholna aumpon; khangit louna-in jong chuche-a kipelut hochu ahuhdoh louding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hicheho jousehi keiman kamutan, chule nisa noija thil kibol jouse gelnan kalungsung kamangchan; mikhatnin ama le ama kisuh khahna dinga midang khat chunga thunei phat khat aumjin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hitichun keiman migilou akivui kamun, amaho chu munthenga kona hunglut uva potdoh-u ahin, chule amaho chu chutobang abolnao khopi sunga chun suhmilin aumun ahi. Hiche jonghi pannabei ahi.","title":"Thina Hi Mijouse Chunga Lhung Ahi"},"11":{"text":"Natoh phalou chunga thu kitanlha chu gangtah-a tohdoh-a aumloujeh-in, mihem chapate lungsung chu thilse boldingin kigojou depmin aumjin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Michonse khatnin thilphalou jakhat veijen bolhen lang, chule ahin nikho kisaosah jongleh, Pathen ginga, ama anga gingkhen cha umho vang chun phatna amutei dingu ahi ti keiman kahei."},"13":{"text":"Ahinla migilou dinga vang phalou helding ahi; ajehchu aman Pathen anga kichatna aneilou jeh-a, nilim tobang ahin nikhoho chu sao louding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Leiset chunga pannabei ja kitongdoh thil aume; hichu mihem khat chu midih tah ahivanga, migiloute chunga thilsoh tobang achunga soh umin; chukitle, migilou tah ahivanga, michonpha te chunga thilsoh tobanga achunga soh aumin ahi. Hiche jonghi keiman pannabei ahije kati."},"15":{"text":"Chujouvin mihemin aneh-a, adona, chule nomtah-a aum sanga phajo nisa noija aneilou jeh-in, keiman nopsahna kalheng jotai. Ijeh inem itile Pathen'in nisa noija apeh ahinkho lhumkeija, hiche hi atoh gimna-a umjing ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Keiman chihna hetna dingle, leiset chunga kin kitongdohho mun'a dinga kalungthim kimanchah phatnin; (ajehchu sun hile jan hijongle amitsing lou aume);"},"17":{"text":"Keiman mihem khatnin nisa noija na kitonga kona amudoh joulou, Pathen natoh jouse chu kamun ahi. Ajehchu mihemin tonggim tah-in holdoh ding go jongle, amudoh louding ahin, chukal valin; miching khatnin het dingin ngaito jongle, aman amudoh joulouhel ding ahi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ajehchu hitiho jouse hi gah phondoh jeng dingin keiman kalungin kagelin, michonpha te le michingho chule anatoh houchu Pathen khutna um ahin; mihem koimachan amaho angsunga thil umho jouse jal-in kingailutna hile kihotna hile ahedoh thei pouvin ahi."},"2":{"text":"Thil jouse kibangin mijouse henga alhung cheh-e: michonpha le migilou chunga; apha chung le atheng chung chule athenglou chunga; ganlhai bolpa le ganlhai bol loupa chunga thilkhat alhung khom cheh-in ahi: michonse pa jong miphapa tobang ahin; chule akihahselpa jong kihahsel kichapa tobang ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nisa noija kitongdoh jouse lah-a hin ase khat aumin, mijouse henga thilsoh khat aumin ahi: Tahbeh-in mihem chapate lungsunghi setna-in adimsetnin, chule ahinlai jengun jong alungsung uva lung chatvaina aumin, chujouteng amaho athiho henga acheji taove."},"4":{"text":"Ahinla mihingho jousetoh kijopmat pa dingin kinepna aume; ajehchu uicha hingchu keipi bahkai athisa sangin aphachom jon ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile ahingho chun athidingu akihetnuve; ahinla athihon vang imacha akihet pouvin, amahon tohman jong anei tapouve. Ajehchu amaho suhmila um ahi taove."},"6":{"text":"Chujongle tu-a hi amaho mingailutna, mihotna, chule mi mitthipna chu manga ahitan; Nisa noija kitongdoh thil ipi hileh, amahon a-imatih chana dinga chan anei louvu ahitai."},"7":{"text":"Chen, kipah thanomin na an kineh inlang, chule lungnom selin nalengpi twi kidonin; ajehchu tun Pathen'in nanatoh ho asangtai."},"8":{"text":"Naponsil ho chu bangleh jing jenghen; chule nalujanga jong thao lhasam hihhel hen."},"9":{"text":"Pathen'in nisa noija napeh, pannabei nahinkho lhungkeijin, nangailu tah na-inneipi toh kipah thanomin chengkhom lhonin; ajehchu hichehi nahinkho sunga nisa noija nanatoh gimna-a nachan chu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ipi hijeng jongle nakhutnin tohdinga amaiphah chan chu, natha jesal teh-in tongin; ajehchu nangman najot jing lhankhuh asunga chun, tohding jong, tohgon jong, hetna jong, chihna jong aumtapoi."},"11":{"text":"Keima kahung kile kitnin, nisa noija kamudoh tai: kilhaitet jong alhai ajangkhaipa-a ahipon, gal kisat jong ahatpa-a ahipon, changlhah jong michang pa-a ahipon, haona jong hetthemna neipa-a ahipon, khohsahna jong khut thempa-a ahipoi; Ahinla abonchauva dinga phat le phatpha kitoh khaji ahibouve."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu mihemin ama phat akihet theipoi: thina thei lenthang giloutah sunga ngaho akimat bangle, vachaho thangkol sunga oh bangin; hicheho chu photlot louva achunguva achuhteng, mihem chapate chu phat phalouva a-ohji taove."},"13":{"text":"Hiche chihna jonghi keiman nisa noija kamu ahitan, hichehi keidin sangtah abange.","title":"Ngolna Sanga Chihna Achungnun"},"14":{"text":"Khopi neocha khat ana umin, chule asunga jong mi lhomcha anachenge; chuin leng lentah khat hiche khopi dou dingchun ahungin, aumkim veltan, chule pal nasatah tampi atungdoh tai."},"15":{"text":"Tun hiche khopi sunga chun mivaicha miching khat anaumin, amapan achihna jal-in hiche khopi chu ahuhdohtan ahi. Achuti jeng vangin koimachan chuche mivaichapa chu geldoh-in aneipoi."},"16":{"text":"Hichun keiman kanaseije, chihna hi thahat sangin aphajoi; ahijeng vanginla mivaichapa chihna chu i-sah louvin anaumin, chule athuseiho jong ngaipeh louvin aume."},"17":{"text":"Mingol ho lah-a vaihompa khosap awgin sangin, michingho thusei chu thipbeh chan akingaipeh jon ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chihna hi galmanchah tampi sangin aphachomjoi; ahinla michonse khatnin thilpha tampi asusen ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thousi thisahon thao namtui sempa thaonam a-uisah-in, chutobang chun ngolna themkhat-in achihna le aja umna jeh-a kijabolpa chu asuminsen ahi."},"2":{"text":"Miching lungthim chu akhut jetna aumin, ahinla mingol lungthim chu aveilama aume."},"3":{"text":"Mingol chu alampia akalsonteng jongle, achihna chun alosam sah-in; chule mijouse henga mingol kahi tin aseilen ahi."},"4":{"text":"Vaihompa lungthim chu nangma douna-a ahung kipatdohle, nangman naum namun dalha hih-in, ajehchu kipehlutna hin suhkhelna lentah asemphan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vaihompa-a kona suhkhel hungdoh banga, keiman nisa noija thilse kamudoh aume:"},"6":{"text":"Ngolchon nahi jatah-in akikoi sangin; chule mihao chu mun nema atouvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Sakol ho chunga soh ho atouva, chule pipuiho tolla soh ho banga avaleu kamun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Koi hile khuh laija chu, akokhuh laija ama lhalut ding; chule koi hile tho kikai tumsepa chu, gul'in achuhding ahi.","ref":"Labu 7:15; Thuch 26:27."},"9":{"text":"Koihile songho ladoh-a chu, chua chu kisukha ding; chule koihile thing chenna chu, chua chu kisukha ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Heicha chu amola, amangcha pa chun aha chu akinol hem loule, atha ahaje ding ahi; ahinla chihna hi lamhil dinga phatah ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tahbeh-a gul'in lhimlouva achuh pai bangin, kamtam jonghi aphat chomna aumpoi."},"12":{"text":"Miching kamsoh thuchengho chu lungsetna ahin, hinla mingol kamsoh vang chun amatah aval lhum ding ahi;"},"13":{"text":"Akamsoh thubul hochu ngolna ngen ahin, ahoulim kichaina chu lung bulhinglou setna ngol thubuh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Mingol jong chu thua dim ahi; mihemin ipi ahunglhun ding asei theipon, chule ama nunga ipi ahunglhung ding kon aseipeh theijem?"},"15":{"text":"Mingol tohgimna chun amaho jouse asulung jing game; ajehchu aman khopisung jona iti che dingham ti ahepoi."},"16":{"text":"Vo gamsung, nalengpa chapang neocha ahia, chule napipui hon jingkah-a nehkhom na aneijule, ohe ada nahi!"},"17":{"text":"Vo gamsung, nalengpa chu milunlaiho chapa ahi-a, chule napipui hon khamna ding hilouva, thaneina dingjoh-a, aphatcha nehkhom na aneijule, anunnoma nahi!"},"18":{"text":"Thaset behset jeh-in in angot lhajin, chule khut thaset vangin in alhujin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Golvah hi nuina dinga kibol ahin, chule ju hin mi akipa sah-in ahi; ahinla sumin thiljouse ahisah theijin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Nalungthim jengin jong lengpa chu samse hih in; chule nalupna dansunga jong mihao samse hih-in: ajehchu chungleng vachan na aw po khan tin, chule lhaving neikhatnin athu galhut khante."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nachanglhah twi chunga seplhan; ijeh inem itile nikho tamtah jouteng namu kitding ahi.","title":"Pottho Manlut Dan"},"2":{"text":"Mi sagi henga, chule get henga jong chanvou pe-in; ajehchu nangman leiset chunga itobang thilse ahunglhun ding nahe poi."},"3":{"text":"Meilomho go adimset tengle, amaho le amaho leiset chunga ahung kilhei-ong jiuve; chule thingphung chu lhanglam ngan, ahiloule sahlam ngan lhutaleh, alhuhna mun laitah-a chu, kijamden jengding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Huinun vejing pa chun muchi atulouding, chule meilomho khohsah jing pa chun chang a-at louding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nangman hui chena lampi nahetlou bangle, numei naovop sunga aguho iti khanlet ham nahetlou bangin; ijakai sema Pathen natoh ho jong nahepon ahi."},"6":{"text":"Jingkah lamle namuchi kitun, chule nilhah lam jongle nakhut umthimsah hih-in; ajehchu hichepa ham, khuchipa ham, hoichepen chu hung phatou dingham, ahiloule ania kibanga phading ham ti nangman nahepoi."},"7":{"text":"Tahbeh-in vahhi anomin, chule mit dingin nisa vet hi anomta ngeije."},"8":{"text":"Hijongle mihem chu kum tampi ahina, hicheho jouse-a chu akipa le; muthim nikhoho chu kigeldoh hen, ajehchu hicheho chu tamtah hiding ahi. Ahunglhung jouse chu pannabei ahi."},"9":{"text":"Vo gollhang, nakhangdon na-a kipah-in; chule nakhangdon lai nikhon nalung thimin nakipasah jinghen, nalungin adeilam le namitnin amu nomna lam chu juijin; amavang thil hichengse jeh-a hi Pathen'in thupi tanna-a napuilut ding ahi, tihi nangman kihet nin.","title":"Nakhangdon Laijin Pathen Holin"},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun nalungthima konin hesohna koidoh in, chule natahsa-a konin aphalou koimangin; ajehchu chapanlai le khangdonlai hi pannabei ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nikho phalouho hunglhun masang, hicheho-a hin thanopna himhim kaneipoi, tia nasei nading kum phalouho ahung nai masangin; tu nakhangdon lai nikho sunghin nasempa geldoh-in."},"2":{"text":"Nisa ahin, vah ahin, lha ahin, ahsi ho ahin, athimsoh masang, meilom ho jong gojuh jouva akilekit masang;"},"3":{"text":"In ngahho kithing thinga ahung um nitengule, mihat ho amaho chama ahung kunlhah diu, sumhei hehhon alhom behseh jeh uva atoh-u angahdiu, chule bangkotna kona khodahho thimdela umdingu,"},"4":{"text":"Chule khopi lamlena kot ho kha-a hung umding, sumhei kiheh gin anemsuh teng, chule mihem khat chu vacha husa-a hung thoudoh ding, chule lathem chanuho jouse suhnema hung umdingu ahi;"},"5":{"text":"Chujongle amahon munsang akichat tengule, kichatna lamtina hung umding, almond thing hung pahdoh ding, khao khopi chu pohgih hung hiding, chule ngaichat hungbei ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile mihemin atonsot in chu ajot ahin, chule lunghemho chu lamlhah ho-a acheleuvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahiloule dangka khao ahung kilhap, ahiloule sana lheng ahung kisuhkeh masang, twinah phunga bel ahung kisukeh, ahiloule twikhuh phunga twikhai dohna kang ahungbal masangin, nasempa geldoh-in."},"7":{"text":"Chuteng leivui chu ahina ngai leisetna kile kitding; chule lhagao chu apepa Pathen henga kilekit ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pannabei ho pannabei, ijakai pannabei ahije, tin thuhilpan aseije."},"9":{"text":"Chule achungchonin, thuhilpa chu miching ahi jeh-in, miho chu hetna anahil nalaijin; henge, aman phatah-in alungin angaiton, aholdoh-in, chule thuchih tamtah asutoh-in ahi.","title":"Mihem Tohding Kin Apumpi"},"10":{"text":"Thuhilpan, santhei thuho, chondihna thu kisunho, thutah ho jengjong anaholdoh-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Miching thusei ho chu thihtul monghem tobang ahin; kelngoi chingpa khatnin apehdoh-a, khoppi lamkaihon akhet detnu thingkil tobang ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chujongle, kachapa, hicheho-a hin kitil khouvin; lekha tamtah semsem jong achaina aumpon, chule lekha hasim behset jonghi tahsa cholna ahi."},"13":{"text":"Eihon athu pumpi khumkhana chu ngaiju hite: Pathen gingin, chule athupeh chengse nitsoh keijin; ajehchu hichehi mihem tohding pumpi chu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen'in nakitong jouse chu, thil kiselguh jouse toh, apha hihen ase hijongle, thupi tana-a ahin pohlut ding ahi."}}}}},"22":{"info":{"name":"Solomon Labu","shortname":"SLabu","abbr":[],"desc":"Solomon Labu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Laho lah-a la, hichehi Solomon la ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 4:32."},"2":{"text":"Aman ami chopna akama chun eihinchop hen, ajehchu nangailutna chu lengpitwi sangin atuijon ahi.","title":"Mounu le Agolho Kihoulim La Khatna Shulam Nungahnu"},"3":{"text":"Nangma thaotwi phatah ho namtui jeh-in, na min chu thaotwi hung longdoh abangin; hiche jehchun nungah thenghon nangma nangailu uve."},"4":{"text":"Neikai jin, keihon nanunga hung lhaijunge; lengpan keima a-indan sung eilhuttai. Keiho nangma-a kakipaova kathanop diu ahin, chule neingailut nao chu lengpitwi sanga kageldoh jingdiu ahi, lungdih tah-in nangma nangailu uvin ahi.","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"},"5":{"text":"Keima kavome, ahinla vo nangho Jerusalem chanute, keima Cedar ponbuh ho le Solomon pondal hobangin kamellome."},"6":{"text":"Kavom jehle, nisan eisah jeh-in, neive hih-un; kanu chapateho alung hangun; lengpilei ho eingah sah-un; ahinla keima tah-in lengpilei kangahpoi."},"7":{"text":"Vo kalhangai, nangman nakelngoi hon hoilaija navah-a, sun teng hoija nagakol sah jiham, neisei peh-in; ipijeh-a nagol ho kelngoihon lah-a mikhat vahlele banga kaum dingham?"},"8":{"text":"Vo numei ho lahlah a melhoipennu, nangman nahetlouva ahile, nakelngoihonho cheche nalama chenlang, chule kelngoi chingpa ponbuho komdunga chun nakelngoi nouho chu vah-in.","title":"Moulang"},"9":{"text":"Vo kangainu, keiman Pharaoh kangtalai kai sakol honkhat toh nangma kahin tekah-e.","title":"Moulang, Agol ho, Chule Mounu Kihoulim"},"10":{"text":"Nabeng teni-a kijepna kigolho chu nakilompin, nangonga sana khivuiho chun namel lomsah-e."},"11":{"text":"Keihon sana-a kijepna kasem pehdiu, chule akilmatnaho dangka-a kasem dingu ahi.","title":"Jerusalem Chanute"},"12":{"text":"Lengpa adokhanga atou chun, kathao namtui namchu ahung potdoh-in ahi.","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"},"13":{"text":"Kangaitah chu keija din myrrh lomkhat ahin, jankhovah-a kanoi teni kah-a lumding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Kangai chu keijadin Engadi lengpilei honsunga ponlou thingphung abilla kehto bang ahi."},"15":{"text":"Kangainu, ven, namel ahoije, ven, namel ahoije, namit teni vakhu mit abange.","title":"Moulang"},"16":{"text":"Kangaipa, ven, namel ahoije; henge, dei-umtah nahi! ijalkhun jong a-eng selin ahi.","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"},"17":{"text":"I-inkam jouse cedar thingjeng ahin, chule i-insung jouse jong chahthing jeng ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima Sharon pah le, phaicham ho-a lily pah chu kahi."},"2":{"text":"ling le khaoho lah-a Lily pah bangin, chutobang chun kangainu chu nungah ho lah-a aume.","title":"Moulang"},"3":{"text":"Theithup thing gammang thinglah-a aumbangin, chutobang chun kangaipa chu golhangho lah-a aume. Keima alimnoija chun kipah tah-in katouvin, chule aga chu kateple alhum keijin ahi.","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"},"4":{"text":"Amapan keima nehkhom na ina eipuilutnin, chule kachunga apondal chu ngailutna ahi.","title":"Shulam Nungah nun Jerusalem Chanute Henga"},"5":{"text":"Lengpitwi jin neilhon lang, theithup changhon neilung monin, ajehchu ngailut natna-a na-a kahitai."},"6":{"text":"Akhut veilam kalu noija aumin, chule akhut jetlama chun eikoije."},"7":{"text":"Vo nangho Jerusalem chanute, loulaija sakhigol anuho le achalho panna kathupeh nahiuve, ngailutna hi ama chamtah-a ahung um tilouvin, nanghon suhthou tho dingle suhkhah thoding gohih-un."},"8":{"text":"Kangaipa aw kajai! Veovin, ama molsang ho chunga kichom pumle, lhangho chopkhup pumin kaheng lama ahunge.","title":"La Nina Chavanglai Jaila Shulam Nungahnu"},"9":{"text":"Kangaipa chu sakhigol ahiloule sakhinou tobang ahi; ven, ama kabang tomuva adinge, bangkot ho-a konin aven, bang vangkah-a konin ahung khodah-e."},"10":{"text":"Kangaipa chun thu ahin seijin, chule keima henga: hungthouvin, kangainu, keija dia melhoinu, hungpot dohtan."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu vetemin, phalbi akichaitan, gojuh phat akichaijin chule kho aphatan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Leiset chunga pahchaho ahung kilang doh-in, lasah phat ahung lhung tan, chule igam sunguva vahui ham gin akijatai."},"13":{"text":"Theichang phung jong ahung gadohtan, chule lengpiguiho jong aga dongset toh agim namtuitah ahin pedoh tai. Thouvin kangainu, keidia melhoinu, hungpotdoh jengtan."},"14":{"text":"Vo ka vakhu, songpi khikehkah le, songkol kalbi kidona mungil laiho-a chengnu, namaiso neimu sah inlang, na aw neijah sah temin, ajehchu na aw angeijin, chule namaiso jong amel lomin ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Lengpilei suse-a sial ho, chule sial nouho neimatpeh un, ajehchu kalengpigui gahou adongset nalaijin ahi.","title":"Asopi Pasal ho"},"16":{"text":"Kangaipa chu keija ahin, chule kei ama-a kahi. Aman Lily pahho lah-a akelngoi hon avah-in ahi.","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"},"17":{"text":"Kho ahung vah-a, chule le-limho akitolmang kahsen, hung kiheijin, kangaipa, Bether mol chunga lhale sakhi chalgol, ahiloule sakhinou bangin hung umin."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Janle kajalkhun chunga keiman kalhangaipa chu kaholjin; ama kahol lelen, ahinla kamu joupon ahi.","title":"Lungkhamna Jan Shulam Nungahnu"},"2":{"text":"Keima, tun thouving ting, khopi sunga vahleng ting, kholai dung le lamlen ho-a kalhangaipa gaholinge, katin; ama kahol lelen, ahinla kamu joupon ahi."},"3":{"text":"Khopi vil le-a khongah ho chun eimuvin, keiman ahenguva, keiman kalhangaipa nanamu uvem? tin kadongin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amaho themcha khatbou kagahkhel panbep nalaijin, keiman kalhangaipa chu kakimudoh paitai: keiman amapa chu eihinga kanu in, eina vopna indan sung kalhut kahsen katuh detnin kalhakang pon ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vo nangho Jerusalem chanute, loulaija sakhigol anuho le achalho panna kathupeh nahiuve, ngailutna hi ama chamtah-a ahung um tilouvin, nanghon suhthou tho dingle suhkhah thoding gohih-un."},"6":{"text":"Meikhu khompi banga, myrrh le thao namtui gim namsela, sumkolvei pa thao namtui jouse pumma gamthipma kon hungdoh-a khu koiham?","title":"La Thumna Moulang Leh Aloi Agolho Hunglhun Shulam Nungahnu"},"7":{"text":"Veuvin, Solomon talai ahi; chuche kimvella chun pasal hangsan cheh somgup aumuvin, Israel lah-a ahangsan cheh ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Galsat themsa cheh ahijeh-un, abonchauvin chemjam akichoijun; Jan kichat tijatna jeh-in, amijousen achemjamu ataijuva akiko cheh-un ahi."},"9":{"text":"Solomon lengpan Lebanon thingin, talai khat akisemin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Aman akhom jouse dangka-in, alhong sana-in, chule achung khuse chu ponsandup min asemin, alailung chu Jerusalem chanuten dei umtah-in asemun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Vo nangho Zion chanute, potdoh unlang, ajinei nikho, alungsung kipa nikho-a anun lallukhuh akhuhpeh kikhuh-ah Solomon lengpa khu gaveovin."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ven, kangainu, namel ahoije! ven, nahoilheh jenge, namai khuna pon kah-a namit teni vakhu mit abangin, nasam jong Gilead molsanga kona hungkumlha kel hon abange.","title":"Mounu Melhoina Kichoisang Moulang"},"2":{"text":"Nahaho chu kelngoipi hon amul akivojoutil akisil joutil uva ahungpot doh-u toh abangun; amaho asohkop cheh ahiuvin, alah uva nouneilou khatcha aumpoi."},"3":{"text":"Nane teni jong patsan abangin, nakam jong ahoilheh jengin; nadeh pang jong nasamlom lah-a kolbuthei uma abangin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Na-ngong jong mihat ho lumdal sangkhat kikhaina, David'in galvon koinadinga asah insang abangin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Na noi teni jong sakhinou ni pengkop, lily pah lah-a lhale abange."},"6":{"text":"Kho ahungvah-a nilimho akitolmang kahsen, keima myrrh molsang lama chule bego molsanga gaum ingkate."},"7":{"text":"Namel akilome, kangainu, natichung-ah nolnading ima aumpoi."},"8":{"text":"Labanon'a konin chekhom hite, kajiholnu, Lebanon'a konin kilhon hite; Amana lhangvuma konin, Shenir le Hermon lhangvuma konin, keipi bahkaiho kul-a konin, chule lutnu molsang ho-a konin vetemin."},"9":{"text":"Kasopinu, kajiholnu, nangman kalungsung nalajoutai; nangman namitna khatvei neihinvet le, na ngonga khivui khatna konin kalungsung nalajoutan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kasopinu, kajiholnu, nei ngailutna hi iti noptam! na ngailutna hi lengpitwi sanga iti phatjoh hitam! Nathao kinujol jong gimnamtui jouse sanga iti namtui joh-a hitam!"},"11":{"text":"Vo kajiholnu, nane teni, khoiphanga kon khoiju tobangin ahung valhan; khoijule bongnoi naleigui noija aume; chule naponsil ho namtui dan Lebanon gimnamtui abang jengin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Kasopinu, kajiholnu chu hon kiget khum ahin; twisam kiting, twinah kihuh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Na thingphung ho jong kolbuthei hon, aga hoitah-a ga, ponlou namtui thing le thao namtui thing,"},"14":{"text":"Thao namtui le thing namtui, Aigeju le thingthal, begothing jouse toh; myrrh le aloe, chule anamtui penhotoh,"},"15":{"text":"Twiputna honleiho, hintwi twikhuh, chule Lebanon'a hungkona luidungho abang jengin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Vo sahlam hui, khangin, chule lhanglam hui, hungin; kahon sunghi gimnam tuihon alosohna dingin hung nungin. Kangaipa chu ahon sunga hunglut henlang, atheiga hoitahtah hohi hung nehen.","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kasopinu, kajiholnu, keima kahonsunga kahunglut tan; ka myrrh le ka gimnamtui kakikhol khomtan; kakhoibal le kakhoiju kanetan; kalengpitwi le kabongnoi kadontai. Neovin, vo loile golte; donun, nengtah-in donun, vo kangailut teho.","title":"Aloi agolho jah-a"},"2":{"text":"Keima kalumin, ahin kalungthim akhangjinge; kangailutpa aw kajai, aman kot akiuvin, kot neihonin, kasopinu, kangailutnu, ka vakhu, keija dia chamkimnu; ajehchu kaluchang daitwijin atomin, kajang sam kisom jong jandaitwi lha-in adimtai.","title":"La Lina Avela Lungkhamna Jan Shulam Nungahnu"},"3":{"text":"Kasangkhol chol kasutlha tai; iti kaki-ah ding hitam? Kakeng kakisop joutai; iti kasuhbohkit ding ham?"},"4":{"text":"Kangaipan kot-hom kah-a akhut ahin lhunglut nin, ama gelnan kalungsung akihot jengin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kangaipa kot honpeh dinga kathodoh leh, kakhutna myrrh avalha-in, chule kakhutjung ho-a gimnamtui avalhan, kotkilna chunga chun achu-in ahi."},"6":{"text":"Kangaipa chu kot kahonpehtan, ahinla kangaipa chu akihei mangin, anachetai. Aman thu aseichun kahinna alhasam jengin ahi. Keiman ama kahol holin, ahinla kamujou dehpoi; keiman ama kakouvin, ahinla eidonbut tapoi."},"7":{"text":"Khopi sunga vahle khongah hon eimudoh-un, eivouvin, eimavo taove; kulpi ngahhon kaponlukhu eilah mangpeh uvin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem chanute, keiman thu kapeh-u nahi, nanghon kangaipa namu-ule, ama ngaina-a na-a kahitai, tin neinasei peh-un."},"9":{"text":"Midangin adeipa sanga nangin nadeipa chungnungjo dehham, Vo nangma numei lah-a hoichungnung nu? Midangin adeipa sanga nangin nadeipa chungnungjo dehham, nangman chuto bangtah-a nei gahchah-u chu?","title":"Mounu Leh Aloile Golho Kihoulim Jerusalem Chanute"},"10":{"text":"Kangaipa chu angou seh-in avouso asan heovin, sangsom lah-a achungnung penin ahi.","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"},"11":{"text":"Aluchang jong sana thengset abangin; asamho jong aboh litlet nin, chule va-ah bangin avomsetnin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Amit teni jong vadung panga uma vakhu mit, bongnoija kisop thenga kitoh chetna kibut abangin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Abeng teni jong gimnamtui kikholna, pahcha namtuitahho abangin; aneho jong myrrh gimnamtui tah valha le, lily pahcha abange."},"14":{"text":"Akhutteni jong sana khutjem achunga khisong engdum abangin; atahsa jong saiha kisuitoh bangleh khisong duma kilut abange."},"15":{"text":"Akengteni chu songval khompi bangleh sana thengset khom tunna chunga kitung abangin; Amelput chu Lebanon thing bangle cedar thing hoipentah toh abange."},"16":{"text":"Akam jong aphata ngeijin, amachu lamjousea dei aumin ahi. Vo Jerisulem chanute, hichehi kangaipa chu ahi, hichehi kagolpa ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangaipa chu hoilamma chemanga hitam? Vo nang numei lah lah-a hoichungnung nu, keihon ama kaholhu theina diuvin, nangaipa hoilanga kihei manga ham?","title":"Jerusalem Chanute"},"2":{"text":"Kangaipa chu Gimnamtui umna honsunga, aganhonho vah dingle, lily pahho loukhom dingin, ahon sunga achelutnin ahi.","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"},"3":{"text":"Keima kangaipa-a kahi, chule kangaipa chu keija ahi; ama lily pah lah-a aganhon avah-in ahi."},"4":{"text":"Vo kangai Tirzah bangin nangma nahoije, Jerusalem bangin namellomin, ponlap dom galmi honpi bangin tijat na-ume.","title":"La Ngana Mounu Hoina Atepi Ding Aumpoi Moulang"},"5":{"text":"Keijakonin namit teni heidoh-in, ajehchu hiho chun eisuboije. Nasam chu Gilead'a kona hungkumlha kel hon abangin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nahaho chu kelngoipi hon amul akivojoutil akisil joutil uva ahungpot doh-u toh abangun; amaho asohkop cheh ahiuvin, alah uva nouneilou khatcha aumpoi."},"7":{"text":"Nadeh pang jong nasamlom lah-a kolbuthei uma abangin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Lengnu somgup, thaikem somget, chule nungah theng simjoulou aume."},"9":{"text":"Kavakhu, keija dia chamkim, keija dia khatseh bou ahi; anu-a dia cha changkhat ahin, chule ahingnu deilhenpen ahi. Nungah ho, lengnu ho chule thaikem hon amanu amuvin, nunnomnu atiuvin, chule apahchao vin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Jingkah banga hung vahdoh-a, lhabanga hoi, nisa banga thengset, chule galmi ponlap domhon khat banga tijat umhi, koi numei ahitabep dem?"},"11":{"text":"Phaicham theiga ho ve dingin, lengpiguiho mumtam ve dingle, kolbuthei ho pahtam ti ve dingin, keima beleilut honsunga kachesuh-in ahi.","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"},"12":{"text":"Kahetmanlou hellin kahinna-in, Amminadib sakol kangtalai bangin eina semtan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hungkilen, hungkilen, vo Shulam nungahnu; keihon nangma kavet theina dingun; hungkilen, hungkilen. Shulam nungah nu-a hi ipi navet dingu ham? Galsatmi hon ni umkhom banga?","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo leng chapa chanu, nakeng teni chu kengkoh naseteng iti hoija hoi hitam! namalbul teni kisuhtona jong sana-a kisem abangin mikhut themtah ho khutsem abange.","title":"Pachatna Kiphondoh Moulang"},"2":{"text":"Nalai jong jutuitah lhasam khalouhela dimjing khon bempel abangin; na-oi jong suhlouchang kihuivum lily pah-a kijem abange."},"3":{"text":"Na noi teni jong sakhinou ni pengkop, lily pah lah-a lhale abange."},"4":{"text":"Na-ngong jong saiha insang abangin; namit teni jong Heshbon'a Bath Rabbim kotpiphunga twikul abangin; nanah jong Lebanon insang Damascus lam nga-a abange."},"5":{"text":"Nachunga naluchang chu Karmel abangin, naluchanga nasamjong ponsandup abangin; Nasam lom phatah chun lengpa soh henin ahenin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Iti hoija nahoija chule iti dei naum hitam, Vo kangainu, kipana dinga!"},"7":{"text":"Natun jong tumphung bangin asangin, chule nanoi teni jong lengpiga bohthet abang jenge."},"8":{"text":"Keima tumphung chunga kalingting, abahho gatuh inge, katin: Tun nanoi teni chu lengpiga lomho bangen lang, nanah-a hu hungpot gimnam chu theithup namtui banghen,"},"9":{"text":"Chule nakam chung chu lengpitwi phapen tobang hihen. Lengpitwi chu kangaipa-a dingin tuitah-in alongsuh'in, a-imu pa muh chu nemheu chan achaloh sah-in ahi.","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"},"10":{"text":"Keima kangaipa-a kahin, chule angaichat chu keima-a uma ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hungo, kangaipa, loulama chedoh hitin; khoneo ho-a gageh hite."},"12":{"text":"Jingpi matah-in lengpi hona chehitin; lengpigui mumtam gave hitin, lengpiga mumho pahlha tam gave hitin, chule kolbuthei ho pahtam gavetem hite; chua chu kangailut na kapeh ding nahi."},"13":{"text":"Kangaipa, Joldei-ai hon jong anam tuitah alhadoh-un, chule ka kelkot phunguva theiga tuitahtah namkim athah le alui nanga dia kakoisa aume."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Oh, nangma kanu noi hinchepma kapenpipa ana hitavele chun katitave! Pamlama kahinmu teng jongle kahinchop ding nahi; henge, i-sah louva kaumlou ding ahi."},"2":{"text":"Keiman nangma kalamkaija kapui puiding eina hil jinga kanu insunga kapui lutding, ka kolbuthei twija kon kisem ju gimnamtui kadonsah ding nahi."},"3":{"text":"Akhut veilam kalu noija aumin, chule akhut jetlama chun eikoije.","title":"Jerusalem Chanute henga"},"4":{"text":"Vo nangho Jerusalem chanute, keiman nangho kathupeh nahiuve, ngailutna hi ama chamtah-a ahung um tilouvin, nanghon suhthou tho dingle suhkhah thoding gohih-un."},"5":{"text":"Angainu chunga kingaija gamthipma kona hungdoh khu koi ahitadem? Theithup phung noija kathodoh nahi; chua chu nanun nanahin ahin, chua chu nahingnun nahin hindoh ahi.","title":"La Gupna Inlam Hinjot A-insung Mite"},"6":{"text":"Suhdetna kinamkhum bangin nalungsunga neinam detnin lang, nabanna jong neinam detnin; ajehchu ngailutna hi thina bangin athaneijin, thangthipna jong lhankhuh bangin a-engse-e; amei chu meikong ahin, meikong nasa pentah ahi.","title":"Shulam Nungah nun Angailutpa Henga"},"7":{"text":"Twi tamtah in ngailutna asudai joupoi, twisang lenho jengin jong alhoh joupoi; min ngailutna dingin a-insunga anei jouse pedohsoh jongle, ima-a simkham hilou lai ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Keihon sopi numeinu khat kaneijuve, amanun noi aneihih laije; amanu min ahungdoh nikho teng kasopinu diuvin keihon ipi kabolpeh tadiuvem?","title":"Shulam Nungahnu Sopi Pasal ho"},"9":{"text":"Amanu hi bang hitale, achunga leng inpi dangka-a kasah diu ahi. Chule amanu hi kotkhah hitale, cedar thingpeh-a katom dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Keima bang kahi, chule kanoi teni jong insang tobang ahi; chuin keima ama mitteni-a lungmonna mu-a tobang kahung hitai","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"},"11":{"text":"Solomon'in Baal-hamon'a lengpihon khat ananeijin; aman lengpihon chu angahho angansen; mitinin ahonsoh ga man dangka sangkhat cheh ahin pehlutdiu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Kalengpihon keima angsunga aumme. Vo Solomon, nangma sangkhat nachan ding, chule aga ngahho chu jani changding ahiuve.","title":"Solomon Henga Ding"},"13":{"text":"Nangho hon leilaija chengho, golle paiten na aw angai juve hichu keijong nei jahsah-in.","title":"Moulang"},"14":{"text":"Hung kikinsah in kangaipa, gimnamtui molsang ho chunga chun nangma sakhi chalgol ahiloule sakhinou tobangin hung umin.","title":"Shulam Nungahnu"}}}}},"23":{"info":{"name":"Isaiah","shortname":"Isai","abbr":[],"desc":"Isaiah Themgao Lekhabu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah lengho Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz chule Hezekiah nikholaija Judah leh Jerusalem chungchang thudolla, Amoz chapa Isaiah munei;","title":"Pathen'in Amite Aphosal","ref":"2 Leng 15:1-7; 15:32—16:20; 18:1—20:21; 2 Thusm 26:1—32:33."},"2":{"text":"Vo, vanho ngaijun, chule vo leiset, nana hinsungin. Ajehchu Pakaiyin thu aseitai: keiman chapangte chu kahinkhoukhah-a kahinseilet dohsah ahitan, hinlah amahon keima dounan na atong taove."},"3":{"text":"Bongchal'in apu akihetnin, chule sanganin apun an apehna kong akihet-in; ahinla Israel'in vang ahepon, kamiten angaitopha himhim pouve."},"4":{"text":"Ohe chonse nam mite, khansetna pohgihpo mite, thilsebol chilhahte, manthah sah chate; amahon Pakai chu adalhaovin, Israel dinga Mithengpa chu lunghan sahdin achoh thouvun, nunglama akitolmang taove."},"5":{"text":"Ipidinga nangho kivoto jingjeng nalai nahiuvem? Nakisatto nahlai ding'uham? luchang apumin anatan, chule lungthim apumin acholtai."},"6":{"text":"Kengto apat luchang geijin adamkom aumtapon; ahinla mapule kivodup, chule tina monsa ahin; amahon jenla ajen pouvin, tomla atom pouvin, thaojong anu pouve."},"7":{"text":"Nagam sungu akamdeltan, nakhopihou jong meijin akihalha gamtai. Gamdang mihon nagamu na-angsung tah uva abahgamun, chule akamhelin, gamdang mihon alehkhuphel taove."},"8":{"text":"Zion chanu chu lengpi leija buhcha bangle changmai leija buh kisong bang, khopi kiumkim vel tobang ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Janel Pakai chun amoh themcha khat eikhen louvu hileh, Sodom toh ibah uva, Gommorah dung isun jengdingu ahi.","ref":"Semt 19:24; Rom 9:29."},"10":{"text":"Sodom kho-a vaihomten, Pakai thuhi ngaijun! Gommorah mite nanghon i-Pathen'u danthupeh-a nanau hinsung uvin!"},"11":{"text":"Pakai chun, naganlhai nao hijatpihi keidia iphatsah naham? ati. Keiman kelngoichal govam thilto lhingset le gancha kivah thao tahtah kaneije. Keima bongchalho thisan hihen, kelngoinou ho thisan ahilouleh kelchate thisan'ah kalunglhaipon ahi.","ref":"Amos 5:21-22."},"12":{"text":"Nangho ka-angsunga nahung kilah tenguleh, ka inpi chonthanghoi dinga koiham nangai chaovah?"},"13":{"text":"Thilto pannabei ho chu hinchoikit tahih hel'un; gimnamtuijong keidia thet umtah ahibouvin; lhathah nikhoho le cholngah nikhoho chule khoppi kikouho jong kadou theipon, chujongleh khoppitheng kikouho jong gitlouna ngen ahibouve."},"14":{"text":"Nalhathah nikhohoule naphat kitepmu kutho chu kahin nan ahot ahi. Eilunggim sahbep ahiuvin abonchan kapochim set tai."},"15":{"text":"Chule nakhut nahin lhandoh tengu jongle, nangho-a kona kamit kaselding, tamtahvei taona hinnei jeng jongleu chun kangaipeh louding nahiuve; ajehchu nakhut hou thisan dimset ahi."},"16":{"text":"Kisilthengun lang, kisuthengu vin; kamitmu-a konin nathilbol phalouhou chu koimang unlang; thilse bolda taovin,","title":"Alunghei Nadiuva Atilkhou"},"17":{"text":"thilphabol kithemchuh-un, thu adih-a tanding gouvin, akibol gentheiho panpiuvin, panei loute thu tandih unlang, meithaiho seihuvin."},"18":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije: tun hungun lang gelkhomu hite, Nachonset nao santhip bangjongle, buhbang banga bangding; sandup jeju tajongleh kelngoimul bangding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Nangho nanop uva thu nangai ule, gamsung phatna chu nanehdiu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla nadaova nadeh uvangle, chemjam'a nalou gamdiu ahi. Ajehchu Pakai kamin aphondoh ahitai."},"21":{"text":"Khopi tahsan umtah chu i-atile noti hungsoh-a hitantem! Thudih tanna anadimin, chonphatna analengin; hinla tun tolthat jeng ahitaove.","title":"Chonset na-a Dim Khopi"},"22":{"text":"Nadangka thih eh asoh in, nalengpi twila twitoh kihal ahitai."},"23":{"text":"Napipui houla dou lungpu jeng ahiuvin, chule guchaho kiloipi ahiuve. Amitin-in pehguh angailuvin, chule kipaman del le ahiuve. Amahon panei loute thu atanpeh pouvin, meithaiho thujong atan diuvin ahengu ahunglhung khatapoi."},"24":{"text":"Hijeh chun janel ho Pakai, Israel dia mihatpa chun hitin aseije; Ahi! Keiman kakidoupi teho lhadoh ingting kamelmate phu kalah teiding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Keiman nachungah kakhut lam ingting, chule nathih eh chu thengtah a kalhah thenga, nasum lhahjol jouse kalah mangding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule keiman nathutan ho kaki ledoh sah-a, chule nathuhil ho jong akipat tilla banga kaumsah kitding ahi. Chuche joutengle chonphatna khopi, tahsan um khopi tia naki minvo ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Zion chu athu kitanlha-a kilhatdoh ding, chule amanu kisihna chu chonphatna hiding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ahin doumah bolteho le achonseho chu mangthah khomintin, chule Pakai dalhahho chu suhmang hela umdiu ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ajehchu nangaichatnu gangpi phungho chu ajachat piuvin, naki lhensao honlei chu nalungjinpi diu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ajehchu nangho gangpido pulsa bangle, twi umlouhel honlei tobang nahi dingu ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule mihat chu saikhao nem bangintin, hiche sempa chu meisipah bangding, chutia chu kavam lhonding, koimachan aphelmit louding ahitai."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amoz chapa Isaiah'in Judah le Jerusalem chungchang thudol chu anamu.","title":"Tonsotna Chamna (Mica 4:1-3)"},"2":{"text":"Ninunung lamle hitiding ahi, Pakai inmun molsang chu molsang chung vum ho-a hung kiphutdoh ding ahin, lhang vum ho-a kichoisanga; chutengle namtin vaipi chu kijotlutdiu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hiteng chule chitin, namtin hunguva hitia aseidingu ahi; hungun Pakai Molsang chunga kaltouvu hitin, Jacob Pathen inna chun cheu hite; chutia chu aman alampi thudol eihil uva, ama lampia chu ichediu ahi, tiuvinte. Ajehchu Zion'a kona dan thupeh le Jerusalem'a kona Pakai thuchu hungpotdoh ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chutia chu aman namtin vaipi kah-a thu atana, mitamtah aphosalding; amahon achemjamhou loukaina, chule atengchahou kangkuija akikhendiu; namkhat douna-a namkhat nin chemjam lamtalou ding, galbolje jong kijilna umlou ding ahitai.","ref":"Joel 3:10."},"5":{"text":"Vo Jacob insung miteho, hunguvin, Pakai vah-a chun cheleu hite."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman nami Jacob insung chu napaitai, ajehchu amaho solam mite chona dimset ahiuvin, Philistine ho bangin gaothu aseijun chule gamdang mite chate toh kipa thanop abolkhom jiuve.","title":"Alouchalte Kisumang Ding"},"7":{"text":"Agamujong sanale dangka adimsetnin, chule agou khol hou jong angahna bei ahin; agamsungu jong sakol adimset'in, chule asakol kangtalai hou jeng jong akichaitih aumpoi."},"8":{"text":"Agamsung jong milim semthu adimsetnin; akhut tah uva aboldoh-u akhutjung ngeijuva asemsao chu ahouvun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Milham hon chibai aboh-un, milen ama le ama akisuneovin, hijeh chun ngaidam changlou diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Thahat tah Pakai ginna le alal loupi masanga chun songko sunga lutning lang leivui lah-a gakiselin.","ref":"Tph 6:15; 2 Thess 1:9."},"11":{"text":"Mihem kivetsangna chu kisunem intin, mihem kiletsahna chu kisulha ding, chule Pakai changsehbou chuche niteng chule choisanga umding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu ahoithole akiletsah chan chule akichoisang chan chunga chu janel Pakai nikho hunglhung ding, chule amaho chu kisunem ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Lebanon Cedar thingsang hole adoh sangho jouse chung le Bashan gangpiho jouse chunga,"},"14":{"text":"molsang ho jousele lhang kichoisangho chunga,"},"15":{"text":"in-song sangtin hole galpal kikaiho chunga,"},"16":{"text":"Tarshish kong inneiho jouse chungle, khutthem kisem thilho jouse chunga hunglhung ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule mihem kichoisang nachu kisulhantin, mihem kiletsahna chu kisunem ding ahi. Chule chuche ni chule Pakai changsehbou choisanga umding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chutengle semthu milimho jouse asuhmanghel ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Tijat umtah a leiset hotling dinga akipatdoh tengle, Pakai ginjehle alal loupina jeh-a, amahochu songpiho kohomsung le leikoho sunga lutding ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Hicheni chule mihon adangka milimhou le asana milimhou, ama ama houding cheh-a akisem houchu, bui hole bah ho henga ahinse manguva,"},"21":{"text":"tijat umtah-a leiset hotling dinga ahung kipatdoh tengle Pakai ginjehle alalna loupijeh-a songpiho khikeh sungle songpiho pohkeh sunga chu lutdiu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mihem anah-a hai maimaipa-a konin kikangseuvin, ajehchu ama ijapang dingham?"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile, veuvin, Pakai janel Pakai chun, Jerusalem'a konle Judah a konin, anehnao lampile adonnao lampi jouse aladohsoh heltai.","title":"Jerusalem'a Nohphahna"},"2":{"text":"Mihatpa le gal hatpa thutanpa le themgao, milungching le upapa ahin,"},"3":{"text":"mi somnga kaihoipa le mija umpa, thumopthempa le khutthempa, chule kamthem mitpheldoi thempa ahiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chule keiman chapangho chu apipuiho diuva kapeh ding, naosen hon achunguva vai ahomdiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule mipichu suhgentheija umding, amitakip chu midangin chule amitakip aheng akomin asuhgenthei ding; Chapang chu upa chunga chule pannabei michu ja-umtah chunga kiletsah tah-a umding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Min apa insungmi asopi khat atuh-a, nangin ponsil naneijin, kavaihom-un panginlang hiche amangsahi nakhut noija umhen atitengle,"},"7":{"text":"hiche nikhoteng chule aman asap phonga, keima midamsah hiponge; ajehchu ka in'a nehdingle ponsil ding aumpoi. Mipi vaihomin neipansah hih-in, hin tinte."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu athuseijule anatoh-u chu Pakai dounale aloupi mithipsah bou ahitah jeh-in, Jerusalem kipal lhu-a chule Judah chu lhu-a ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Amel lhona kilang chun amaho adou ahettohsah-in; hicheho chun Sodom'a tobang achonsetnao aphongjalin, aselpeh pouve. Amanitah-in thilse akilamthu lhon jeh-in ahinna lhonchu ohe ada na-e!"},"10":{"text":"Michonpha chu seipeh-un, hichu ama dinga apha ahi, Ajehchu amahon atohgao chu anehtei dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Migilou chu ada ahi! amadin hamsetna ahi. Ajehchu akhut teni-a atohdoh chu kipeding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Kamitehi amaho bolgentheija pang chate jeng ahitaovin, numei hon achunguva vai ahom uve. Vo kamite, napuihouvin napuiseuvin, nachennao lampiho asumanguve."},"13":{"text":"Pakai chu thutan din ahung kipanin, miho thutan ding chun adingtai.","title":"Pakaiyin Amite Thu Atan"},"14":{"text":"Pakai chu amite upaho le milen milal ho toh thutanlha dinga lutding ahi. Ajehchu nanghon lengpilei chu nanejouvun; migenthei ho thil kichomdoh chu na-in uva aumme."},"15":{"text":"Kamite navoh ngem uva migenthei te maichangtah sumheija natahgoijiu chu ipi natinao ham? tin janelho Pakai chun aseije."},"16":{"text":"Chuche kalvallin Pakaiyin aseije; Zion chanute chu hoithotah-a aumuva, ngong vaiputna le jonmit puma avaleuva, akengu jangjet jetna chule gingdet detna achejeh-u ahi.","title":"Jerusalem Numei ho Chunga Gihsalna"},"17":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu Pakaiyin Zion chanute lujang khichet chutna ajepma, Pakaiyin atahsao aselguh laihou chu ahodoh pehdiu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule Pakaiyin akenguva jephoina gingselsel, haona a alukophou, lhathah tobang angong ou chu asutlhah ding ahin,"},"19":{"text":"Sumgui ho, chaojangho chule ngongvei ho,"},"20":{"text":"Lutomna ho, keng jephoina ho chule lukanna ho, gimnamtui ho bomho, chule bilba ho,"},"21":{"text":"khutjem ho le nahkuiba sana ho,"},"22":{"text":"von khelthei ho, sangkhol chol ho, ponsil ho chule dipho,"},"23":{"text":"phatvet ho, tupat ponnem ho, delkop ho chule ponlukhuh ho, asutlhah peh diu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule hunghiti ding ahi: gimnamtui khella a-ui; konggah khella khaojang; sam pojolsel khella lutol leolou; ponchol hoitah sanga khaodip pon; melhoina sanga meikah umjoding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Napasal hou chemjam'a, namihat hou galla thigamdiu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule amanu kul kotpiho chu lunghema kapdiu; amanu ahomkeo ahitahjeh-a tolla touding ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule numei sagin pasal khat atuh uva, keihon ka-annu kineh uving ting, kaponnu kisil naovinge; eiki housetnao lahmangna dingin namin sehseh neiput sah-un, atidiu ahi."},"2":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule Pakaiya kona abah jamdoh chu hoitahle loupitah hiding ahin, chule Israel, ahoidoh hodinga leiset gachu nasatahle hoitah hiding ahi.","title":"Jerusalem Kithahsem Kitding"},"3":{"text":"Chule hunghiti ding ahi, Zion'a kadalha-a, Jerusalem'a umdenpa chule Jerusalem'a ahingho lah-a kisunlut chasun geija chu atheng kitiding ahin,"},"4":{"text":"Pakaiyin Zion chanute nen asoplhah-a, chule Jerusalem lailunga patna lhagao thutanlhah nale, lhagao meikonga Jerusalem'a thisan behho chu asopthengsoh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Zion lhanga chenna jouse chungle, akikhopnahou chunga chun, sunle meilhangle, meikhu janle meikong vahtah asempeh ding ajehchu loupi jouse chunga chu ahongah umding ahi.","ref":"Pot 13:21; 24:16."},"6":{"text":"Chutengle sun nisatna kona limding le belding khopihuile gellhah a kona hoinading houbuh khat umding ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun keima kangailutpa henga alengpilei thudollin kangailut nan la sange. Kangailuttah pan thinglhang leiphalaija lengpilei khat aneije.","title":"Lengpilei Lhoupa La","ref":"Matt 21:33; Mrk 12:1; Luk 20:9."},"2":{"text":"Aman alhou ngimin, chua songho alohdoh in lengpigui phapentah aphutnin, alaitah-a insang khat asan, asunga chun lengpiga chilna khatjong asemin; chule aman hichun lengpi ga hinsepdoh teijinte tin angah jingin; ahin hichun gam lengpi ga ahin sepdoh tai."},"3":{"text":"Chule tun, vo Jerusalem'a chenghole, Judah pasal ho keile kalengpilei kah-a thuhi neihin tanpeh temun tia kangeh nahiuve,"},"4":{"text":"kalengpilei dinga bolthei kanabol loulai ipi uma ham? Lengpithei ahung gadohding kingah-a ibolla gam lengpithei ga ahinsepdoh ham?"},"5":{"text":"Chule tun, kalengpi leija kabolding chu hil unge; alingtho kaphetlhah'a, min anehjou ding; asongpal chu kasuhchima, michot pha-a umding ahitai."},"6":{"text":"Chule keiman agoh a kakoija, lho-ngimlou le lailouva uma; lingle khao hung kehdoh ding ahin; meibol ho jong thu kapeh-a achunguva go ahinjuhsah louhel ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu janel Pakai lengpilei chu Israel insungle adeitah a aphu Judah mitehi ahiuvin; aman thudih joh aven, ahinla veuvin bolset najoh ahin; chonphatna chu veuvin ka najoh ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Ohe! ada ahiuve, in le in jopmatho, lou keh bebe ho, mun beihela koiho, leiset lailunga achangseh uva chengding ahiuve.","title":"Mihemin Abol Gitlouna"},"9":{"text":"Janel Pakai chun kanabenga aseitai, atahbeh-in; in tamtah, lentah tahle hoitahtah chu achengding beija kamhel gamding, ahi tin aseije,"},"10":{"text":"chule lengpilei ching soma bath khatbou sohding, muchi homer khat kituna ephah khatbou soh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ohe! ada ahiuve, Khamnathei dondinga jingkah matah-a thouva, lengpitwi jin achupkah seuva jankhang geija touho."},"12":{"text":"Amahon selangdah chule semjang, khongcha, kuli, chule lengpitwi jin golnop abollun; ahinla Pakai thilbol lah akhohsah pouvin, akhutna atohdohho jong angaito himhimpouve."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun kamiten hetna aneilou jeh-un sohchangin acheuvin, amija-umteu agilkelun, amipiteu dangchah in adango gamtaove."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun, te joulou khopma lenin thikholkhul chu akam akahommin; aloupinahou, amipiteu, akichoisangho, chule athanompa jengjong chuche sunga chu kumsuh diu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Minoinung chu kisonkun ding, mithaneipa jong kisunem ding, mikiletsah te mit jong nguilha ding ahi"},"16":{"text":"Ahinla janel Pakai chu thutanlhahna-a choisanga umding ahin, chule Pathen, athenga chu chonphatna-a suhthenga umding ahitai."},"17":{"text":"Chuteng kelngoinou ho chu hamhing lah-a lhaleuvintin, chule mun gohho-a leiphalaiho chu gamdangmin anehdiu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ohe! ada ahiuve, imacha hilou khaoholla khangitlouna chule kangtalai khaova kiheh chonsetna kaikhomho."},"19":{"text":"Keihon kamutheina diuvin kigansah henlang, anatoh kino hen; chule kahet theina diuvin Israel mithengpa thumopna chu hungnai hen, tia seiho chu!"},"20":{"text":"Ohe! ada ahiuve, aphalou apha tia, apha aphalou tia; khovah dinga muthim koija, muthim dinga khovah koiji, alhum dinga akha koija, akha dinga alhum koiho."},"21":{"text":"Ohe! ada ahiuve, ama mitna ching kisa-a, ama mitmu-a lungching kisaho."},"22":{"text":"Ohe! ada ahiuve, lengpitwi donna mihat tah hija, khamnathei donding halna-a thahat tah ho."},"23":{"text":"Chuho chun migilouho kipaman peh them achanun, midihtah dohna chu ama-a konin aladohjiuve."},"24":{"text":"Hijeh chun meijin chang ki-atna kung akahvam bangle, meikongin changsi aleumang banga, chutia chu ajungu monlha a, apah-u leivui banga kitungdoh diu ahi. Ajehchu amahon janel Pakai danthupeh apaimangun, Israelte mithengpa thu chu anahsahpouve."},"25":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Pakai lunghan amite douna-a deujah jeng ahi. Amaho douna-a chun akhut alamin adengtan, chule athi longu khopi lamlen laidunga akisat telin ahi. Ajehchu hiche jousehin alunghan naho chu abeidehpon, akhut chu akilamjing nalaije."},"26":{"text":"Aman gamlatah-a kona namtin dinga ponlap atahsang ding, kolmonga kona amaho asapkhom tengle amaho gangtah-a hung lhungloi jengdiu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Alah uva athacholle akipalhu khatcha umpou vinte; khatcha alulhu, a-ihmu umpontin, akonguva konggah kikang ahiloule akengkoh khao tanna umlou helding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Athalmuh-u ahemthet-in, athalpi jouseu kaosan akichoijun, asakol tin houchu meituh song bangjeng, chule asakol kangtalai kanghou chu chimpei kiheh bangding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Akitum ginu keipibahkai bang hiding, keipi noute banga kitumdiu; hitia chun kitum muntin, sahing kimat untin, phatecha alhoh manga, koimachan ahuhdoh louding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule amaho twikhanglen kitumgin banga amaho douna-a kitumdiu ahi. Khatouvin hiche gamchu gahvele, veuvin muthimle lung hesohna, khovah chu van'a muthimin ahin lekhuding ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uzziah lengpa athikum chun Pakai chu laltouna sangtah chunga atouva alalpon chun houin alodimset chu kana mun ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Isaiah Themgao Dinga Akou","ref":"2 Leng 15:7; 2 Thusm 26:23."},"2":{"text":"Achunga chun alha gupcheh nei Seraphim'ho anadingun; alhaving ni in amai akhun, ni in akengteni akhun, ni in alengin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule khatchun khat henga, ATHENG, ATHENG, ATHENG, chu janelho Pakai chu ahi. Leiset pumpihi aloupina adimsetne tin asamin ahi.","ref":"Tph 4:8."},"4":{"text":"Chuin ahinsampa Ogin chun kotpi khomho akihotnin, chule in chu meikhun adimtai.","ref":"Tph 15:8."},"5":{"text":"Chujouvin kaseitai: ohe ada kahi! ajehchu keima kamtheng lou kahin, mi kamtheng loute lah-a cheng kahi. Ajehchu kamitnin leng janel Pakai chu amutai, kati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin maicham-a kona akhutna mei-am chaichea hinchoija, Seraphim holah-a khat kahenga ahung lengin,"},"7":{"text":"chuin kakam-ah ahinkoijin aseitai; ven, hiche hin nane teni atongkhatan; nakhansetnaho akilamangin nachonset naho jong suhthengin aumtai."},"8":{"text":"Hichun Pakai awginin hitia asei kajai: keiho dinga koi chedingham? Hichun keiman kaseijin; keima hia kaume, neisolin kati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin aman chenlang, hiche mitehi gahilin, nanghon jaovin natin, ahinla nahetkhen theilou dingu; chule mu uvin natin, ahinla nahetdoh loudiu ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 13:14-15; Mrk 4:12; Luk 8:10; Jhn 12:40; Sol 28:26-27."},"10":{"text":"Hiche mite lunghi thao tomsah inlang, anao ngonsah in, chule amitnujong kisinghen; achutiloule amitnun muvintin, anaovin jauvintin, alungun hekhen-uvintin, lung heijuntin, chule damget nunte."},"11":{"text":"Chuphatnin keiman Pakai itih chan hiding ham? Katile aman eidonbutnin; khopiho acheng beija agohkeo ahikahsele, inho-a mi acheng abeihela, agamchu akamhel kahse-a,"},"12":{"text":"chule Pakaiyin mite chu gamlatah a achon manga, agamlailunga mun kidalha lentah umding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahinla hiche sunga chun somlah-a khat umintin, hichu kile-a kinejouding, chahthing phungle gangpi thing ana apultengle akungbul umnalai banga muchi theng chu akungbul umjing ding ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Jotham chapa, Uzziah chapa, Judah lengpa Ahaz lallaijin, Syria lengpa Rezinle lengpa Pekah Remaliah Israel lengpa chapa chu Jerusalem satdingin akontou lhonin, ahivangin anajou joulhon tapoi.","title":"Leng Ahaz Dinga Thu Kisei","ref":"2 Leng 16:5; 2 Thusm 28:5-6."},"2":{"text":"Syria chu Ephraim toh apangkhome ti David insungmite akihiltai. Chuin amale amite lungchu gammang thingho huijin amutling bangin alinglao gamtai."},"3":{"text":"Hichun Pakaiyin Isaiah henga, nangle nachapa Shear-jashub chu twikul sahnung twilam monga ponsoppa lamlhonga khun Ahaz to kimutodin potdoh lhoninlang;"},"4":{"text":"Ahenga, chingtheijin lang thipbeh-in Syria toh Rezin le Remaliah chapa engset lunghanna maiso mei khuthethu ni tobang chu kicha hih-in, lunglhah nanjong neihih beh-in ati."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu, Syria, Ephraim, chule Ramaliah chapan nangma dounan thil gilou angaitouvin aseijuve,"},"6":{"text":"Judah doudingle nokhum dingin chetou uhitin, khopi chu suchimu hitin, chutengle alaija chun Tabel chapa chu lengin tung uhite."},"7":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, hichu ding joulou ding, guijong guilhung louding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajeh chu Syria luchang chu Damascus ahin, Damascus luchang chu Rezin ahin; kum somgup le kumnga sunga Ephraim chu namkhat hiloudinga kisucheh ding ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Chule Ephraim luchang chu Samaria ahin, Samaria luchang chu Remaliah chapa ahi. Natahsan lou uleh atahbeh-a naki phudet louhel ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chukalvalin Pakaiyin Ahaz henga aseijin,","title":"Immanuel Melchihna"},"11":{"text":"Nangman Pakai na Pathen henga melchihna kithumin; hathuh-a thuh ahiloule hasana sangkhat kithumin, ati."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla Ahaz in, keiman thumponge, Pakai jong patep hihhel ing kate, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin aman aseitai, David insung mite, tun nanghon ngaitemun! mihem cholsah hi thilneova nagel uva, ka Pathen sana nacholsah jeng dinguham?"},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai amatah-in melchihna khat hinpeu vinate; veuvin, nungah theng khat gai jintin chapa khat ahinding, aminchu Immanuel kitiding ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 1:23."},"15":{"text":"Aman bongnoi thaole khoiju aneh ding ahi, chutia chu aman aselam hotbola aphalam lhenje ahetding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu chapang chun aselam thetbol dingle aphalam kilhen dingje ahetthei masanga nanaginu gamhochu aleng teniu chun adalhah diu ahitai."},"17":{"text":"Judah'a kona Ephraim achemanga patna ana lhungkhalou nikhoho chu Pakaiyin nangle namite chung, chutengle napa insung mite chunga Assyria lengpa nahin lhutpeh ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho teng chule hung hiti ding, ahi. Pakaiyin Egypt vadunga thousi ho mutkhom minintin, chule Assyria gamsunga khoiho akoukhom ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule amaho hunguntin, abon chaova phaicham gohkeu laija songpi kohomho-a, lingho chung jouse-a, chule hamhing ho chung jouse-a umdiu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hicheni mama-a chu Pakaiyin samchem alap'a vadung gal lamho toh Assyria lengpa chu aluchangle akengmul ho ahet namding ahi; chule akhamul sanna jong ahet chaiding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuche nikhole hung hitiding ahi, pasal khatnin bongla khatle kelngoi ni avulding ahin;"},"22":{"text":"chule hung hiti ding ahin, chuche teng chule bongnoi nengtah-a apehdiu jeh-a amapan bongnoi thao anehji ding ahi. Ajehchu chuche gama kidalha chanchun bongnoi thaole khoiju jeng anehdiu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule chuche nikholai chule hung hitiding ahi, dangka sangkhat man cheng, lengpilei sangkhat umna munchana chu lingle khao jengbou kehding ahitai."},"24":{"text":"Agam pumpi lingkhaole lingphung ahung dimtah ding jeh in chulama chu thalpi le thalchang puma miho hungdiu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule tuphenga kilai lhang jouse chunga linglekhaoho ginna-a chulama hunglou ding, ahin, bongchalho le ganchaho lhatna hung hiding ahitai."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chukalvallin Pakaiyin kahenga Maher-shalal-hash-baz chung thudol, lekha jol lentah khat lanlang asunga chun mihem twi-mollin sunin eiti.","title":"Isaiah Chapa Mipi Dia Melchihna"},"2":{"text":"Chuin thuching ding hettohsah tahsan umtah Uriah thempulen le Jaberekiah chapa Zekeriah chu kapansah in ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin themgaonu henga kagachen; ahile amanu ahung gaijin chapa khat ahinge. Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga amin Maher-shalal-hash-baz sah-in ati."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu naosen chun hepa heno tije hetna anei masanga, Damascus haonale Samaria thilchomdohho chu Assyria lengpa anga kipomang ding ahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Pakai chun kahenga thu ahinsei kitnin,","title":"Assyria Lengpa Hung"},"6":{"text":"hiche mite hin Shiloah twi longdel delho adeimouva, Rezin le Remaliah chapa akipapi jeh uvin;"},"7":{"text":"hijeh tahchun tun vetan, Pakai chun vadung twiho hattahle tamtah, Assyria lengpa le aloupina jouse jengjong achunguva alonvuhsah ding, twilam jouse ahinchupma avakam jouse-a letlha ding,"},"8":{"text":"chule Judah gama longlutna achupsoh-a letlha ding, ngong geihel aphahding chule alhaving jahchun nagamu avai akhokhong ding ahi, vo Immanuel, ati."},"9":{"text":"Vo miteho nangho ahal hala chiplhading nahiuve! gamlhatah miho nabonchaovin nanau hinsungun, natai kigah-uvin, achutiloule ahal halla nachipdingu ahi,","title":"Pathen Thilgon Nanjou Ahilou"},"10":{"text":"Ngaito khomun phachomponte, thuchu seijun dingjou pouvinate. Ajehchu Pathen'in eiumpiuve."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu khut thahat tah-in, Pakaiyin kahenga aseijin, hiche mite lamlhah a kavale lounadin eithumop in, hitin aseije;","title":"Pathen'in Themgaopa Agihsal"},"12":{"text":"hiche miten guhthima thilphalou agonu ahi tia asei-ujong guhthim tohgon ahi tin seidao henlang, agihnao jong kichat nale gentheinan neidaohen.","ref":"1 Pet 3:14-15."},"13":{"text":"Janel Pakai amatah chu thensah-un lang, naginnu ama hisah unlang, natijat naochu ama hihen."},"14":{"text":"Chule amachu muntheng hiding, Israel insungteni dinga vang kipalna songle kisuhmona songpi hiding, Jerusalem'a chengho dinga thangle pel hidingbou ahi.","ref":"Heb 2:13."},"15":{"text":"Alah uva mi tamtah kipala lhuhna le kisuhgepna hiding; thanga oh-uva kimandohdiu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hettohsahna chu kantup minlang danthupeh chu kaseijuite lah-a namdet jengin,","title":"Mithisaho Kihoupi Jeh-a Gihsalna"},"17":{"text":"chule keiman Jacob insunga kona amai selmangpa Pakai chu ngah ingting, amabou vengkate."},"18":{"text":"Veuvin keile Pakaiyin eipeh chapangtehi, Israel insunga melchihna leh thilkidang hidinga Zion molla cheng janel Pakaiya hungkon kahiuve.","ref":"Heb 2:13."},"19":{"text":"Chule amahon naheng uva mithisa lha kouho le doithemho guhthima vea, phuisam ho chu hollun atitengule miten athi khella ahina dinga a-Pathen'u chu ahollou dingu ham?"},"20":{"text":"Amahon dan thupeh le hettohsahna thu dungjuija asei lou uleh, asunguva khovah umlou ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule amahon hesohtahle gilkeltah in gamchu jotpaovintin, chule hitiding ahi. Gilkella aumtenguleh, lungsa tuntun untin, alengpaole a-pathen'u gaosap untin chunglam avetdiu ahi.","title":"Genthei Hesoh Phat"},"22":{"text":"Hiteng chule amahon tollam hinveuvintin, lungkhamnale muthim, lungnat khojin amudiu chule amahochu muthim lah-a kinolutding ahiuve."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin lunglha-a ana um amanu dingin nguina umta ponte. Phatmasa laija chu aman Zebulun gam le Naphtali gam chu olla ana gimbol ahin, chule khonungle Jordan gal, twikhanglen lampi-a namdangte Galilee chu nasatah-a abolgim be cheh ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 4:15."},"2":{"text":"Muthima vahle mihochun vah loupitah amutaove, thina lim gama chengho chunga chun kho avahtai.","title":"Khonunga Hunglhung ding Lengpa","ref":"Matt 4:16; Luk 1:79."},"3":{"text":"Nangman namtin vaipi chu napunsah-in, kipana napunsahtai; nangma masanga chang-at laija kipana bangin akipah-un, chule thilkichom akihoptenguva akipau bangin akipah uve."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu nangman amapa pohgih namkoljon le alengkouva mol lhon, chule sugentheipa moltum chu Midian ho nikho laija bangin nasuhbohpehtai."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu gal hatpa galbol jouse ginchu kisuhnohna awginin ajuijin, chule galvonho chu thisan abehjin, ahinla hichehi kavama meikhu sohding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile eihodingin naosen khat apengin, chapa khat eikipeuve, chule vaipohna chu alengkouva aputding, chule aminchu kidangtah, thumopthem, hat chungnung Pathen, tonsot Pa, chamna leng chapa kitiding ahi."},"7":{"text":"David laltouna chung leh alenggam chunga avaipohna le chamna khangtou ding, akichaitih umlou ding ahi. Tua pat atonsot geija thutanna le thudih atundoh ding ahi. Janel Pakai tompanna chun hichehi abolding ahi.","ref":"Luk 1:32-33."},"8":{"text":"Pakaiyin Jacob thukhat athotnin, hichu Israel chunga alhungtai.","title":"Israelte Chunga Thutanna"},"9":{"text":"Chule mijousen hichu aboncha ahetdiu ahin, Ephraimle Samaria'a cheng hoithotah le kiletsah tah-a seija:"},"10":{"text":"cheh ho achimlhatan ahinla song kikheng in kisah taovinge; Theiba akiphuhlhun ahinla cedar thingin kheltao vinge, tihochun hetao vinte."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Rezin kidoupiho chu ama doudin tungdoh intin, amelmate chu apankhompi ding ahin;"},"12":{"text":"amasanga Syria ho, anunglama Philistine hon kamka-a Israelte avallhumdiu ahi. Hicheng jouse jehhin alunghan abeidehpon akhut alamjing nalaijin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuteng jongleh mipi ho chu abolgimpao heng lama akihei dehpouvin, janel Pakai jongchu aholdeh pouve."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Israel'a kona alu le amei, abah le apumpeng chu nikhatleh asatlhah ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Miluile mija-um, amachu alu ahin. Jouthuhil themgao amachu amei ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche mite lamkaihon asuhkhelsah uvin, chule alamkai houchu suhmangin aumuve."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun agollhangho chunga chun Pakai chu akipahpon, apabeiho le ameithaiteu hepinajong anei louhel ding ahi. Ajehchu amitakip aphalhemle khansetbol ahiuvin, akamuvin ngolthu aseicheh uve. Hicheng jouse jehhin alunghan abeidehpon, akhut alamjing nalaijin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu dihlou nahi mei bangin akadohjin; hichun lingle khaoho akahvam ding, chule gammang thim letlut lah-a kongdoh a; chule meikhu kitungdoh banga kaltou diu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Janel Pakai lunghan na-a kona gamsunga thim jinga, mihochu meija tiding thing tobang hidiu ahin, koimachan asopipa jong akhen louding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Aman akhut jetnin manloi chelintin, hijongle agilkel phachom louding; Chule akhut veilamin nentin, oivadeh louding ahi, amitakipmin ama banphe cheh akineh dingu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Manasseh, Ephraim; chule Ephraim, Manasseh: pangkhoma Judah te adoudiu ahi. Hicheng jouse jeh hin alunghana abeidehpon akhut alamjing nalaijin ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ohe! ada ahiuve, adihlouva thu lhuhsahhole athu gonsao dihloutah a sun miho;"},"2":{"text":"Alhasamho thutanlhah dih-a kona hoidoh a, kami gentheite-a kona achanu suhchatvaipeh, meithaiho abahgam theina diule paneiloute chomding goho chu!"},"3":{"text":"Chule vilna nikhoteng chule gamlatah-a kona suhmangna hung nikhotengle ipipen naboldiuvem? Napanpi diu, koipen henga najam uva naloupi nao hoija nadalhah diuham?"},"4":{"text":"Keima beija amaho sohchangho noija kun uva, chule akithat ho noija lhumat diu ahi, Hicheng jouse jehhin alunghan abeidehpon, akhut alamjing nalaijin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vo, Assyria, kalunghana moltum? akhut uva um tenggol khu kathangtomna ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Assyria Lengpa Amanchah","ref":"Isai 14:24-27; Nah 1:1—3:9; Zeph 2:13-15."},"6":{"text":"Keiman kiphat lhemsah nam mite le kalunghana mite doudinga, chule thil suhchat vaisaho ladingle bahgam dinga, chule hicheho chu kholai bonlhoh banga chotpha dinga amachu kasolding ahi."},"7":{"text":"I-hijongle aman chutobang chu atup ahipon, alungin jong chutin agelpon; ahinla namtin chu themkhat hilouva suhmang hel dinghi hiche-a alunggel chu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu aman aseije, kalengchapate chu abonchauva lengho hilou uham?"},"9":{"text":"Kalno chu Karchemish tobang hilou hija? Hamath chu Arpad tobang hilou hija? Samaria chu Damascus tobang hilouham?"},"10":{"text":"Kakhut hin amilim houho lenggam, Jerusalem le Samaria ho-a sanga nasajo ahin holdohtan;"},"11":{"text":"Keiman Samaria le ahou milimhou kabolna banga chu, Jerusalem le amilim houho kabollou ding ham?"},"12":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu hunghiti ding ahi, Pakaiyin Zion molchungle Jerusalem chunga anatoh pumpi achai tengle, Assyria lengpa lung hoithona ga, chule akichungvet loupina-a chu talen kapeh ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu aman, hetkhenna kathemjeh-a kakhut thahatna le kachihna a hichehi kanabol ahin, miho gamgi kachonpeh in, agou khollu kanachom in, mihangtah bangin achengho chu kanasonlhan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule kakhutnin mite haona chu vacha buh bangin amudoh-in; chule min vacha tui kidalha alokhom bangin leiset pumpi kachom khom sohkei tai; Ahin alhaving hinjapma le akam ka-a avelhia jong khatcha aumpon ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Heicha chu amangpa chunga kithang-at ngaijem? Ahiloule thing-at chu a-atpa chunga kichoisang ngaijem? Moltum chu adomsangpa khutna kon akithinlhah got banga, ahiloule tenggol chu thing hilou, adomsang beija akikhantou banga chu!"},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai, janel Pakai chun, amithaote lah-a chun gonna solintin, chule aloupi na noija chun meikong bangin ama meijin konginte."},"17":{"text":"Chule Israelte salvah chu mei hung hintin, mitheng chu meikonga hung pangding ahin chule hichun nikhatle lingle khaohi akahvama aval lhumding ahin;"},"18":{"text":"Chule gammang loupi nale agamphalai hinna le tahsa agoma asuhmanga, amaho chu ponlap dompa tha angoilhahpet bang hidiu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule agam manga thing aumsun chu chapang lekha jih-in ajih kham bepma lhom hiding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule hiche nikholai chule hung hitiding ahi, Israel amoh chengsele Jacob insungmi asohchaho chu amaho sumangpa chunga kingaikit louheldiu Israel mithengpa Pakai chung joh-a dihtah-a kingaidiu ahitai.","title":"Lhomcha Hungkile Kitdiu"},"21":{"text":"Amoh chengse Jacob mite amoh chengse chu Hat chungnung Pathen henga hungkilediu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu nami Israelte chu twikhanglen neldi bangjongleu alah uva amoh chengbou hungkilediu ahi. Amangdinga umsaho chu chonphatna-a longletdiu ahi.","ref":"Rom 9:27."},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu janel Pakai Pathen chun suhmangna ahinlhun sah ding hichu gamjouse lailung tah-a bol dinga agelhuh ahitai."},"24":{"text":"Hijeh chun janelho Pakai Pathen'in hiti hin aseije, Zion'a cheng kamite, Assyria ho chu kicha loujenun, aman Egypt mite abol banga chu moltum khatna navoh uva nachung uva atenggol alapsang ding ahi.","title":"Pakaiyin Assyria Gotna Apehding"},"25":{"text":"Ajehchu chomkhat kahlouva lung hilouna hi kichaija, kalungsatnahi amaho manthah na hiding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu janel Pakaiyin Oreb songpi-a Midian ho athachaplai banga chu mivohna achothouva; chule amoltum twikhanglen chunga adopma, chutia chu Egypt'a banga chu adopsang ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule hiche nikholai chuleh hunghiti ding ahi. Ama pohgih chu nalengkouva kona chule anamkoljon chu nangonga kona kilamang ding ahi. Chule thao kinujeh-a chu anamkoljon chu kisumang ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ama Aiath'a ahungin, ama Migron'a agalkaijin; Michmash'a apoh asekhomin;","title":"Galmiten Abulu"},"29":{"text":"Amahon lampi ajot galkaijun, amaho Geba'a ajangeh taove, Ramah ho akichan; Saul khopi Gibeah mite ajamtaovin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Vo Gallim chanu, awging tah-in samin, Laish lama kijahsah-in, vo khoto um Anathoth."},"31":{"text":"Madmenah ho akichontan; Gebim'a chengho jamdingin akichomkhom taove."},"32":{"text":"Chuche ni chuleh ama Nob'a anaumden nalaijintin; Jerusalem lhang Zion chanu molsang douna-a akhut athin khum ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Veovin, Pakai, janelho Pakaiyin tijat umtah a abah chu asatlhah ding ahin; adunglang sangtah kiphuh lhu-a, chule akiletsah kisunem ding ahitai."},"34":{"text":"Chule aman thih-a gammang thimletlut chu atuhlhuh-a, Lebanon chu mihat tah-a kona lhuding ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesse phungbula konin adon khat hungdoh intin, ajunga kona abahkhat hung khangdoh ding ahi;","title":"Cham Lenna Lenggam","ref":"Tph 5:5; 22:16."},"2":{"text":"Chule Pakai lhagao chihna le hetkhenna lhagao, thumopthem le hatna lhagao, hetnale Pakai ginna lhagao achunga hung chuding ahin;"},"3":{"text":"chule amachu Pakai ginna-a hetna gangtah asem ding, chule amitna amubanga thu atan louding, anakhanga ajahbang maimaija jong aphosal louding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amavang chonphatna-a vaichate thu atanding, leisetna mi nunnem te chu dihtah-a aphoding ahi. Chule aman leiset hi akamsung molla ajepma migiloute chu akam hu-a athading ahi.","ref":"2 Thess 2:8."},"5":{"text":"Chonphatna chu akonggah hintin, kitahna chu alunggil gahna hiding ahi.","ref":"Eph 6:14."},"6":{"text":"Ngeile kelngoinou chengkhom intin, lutnu chu kelnoutoh kolkhom ding ahin; chule bongnoule keipibahkai gol chule gan kivahthaoho lhakhoma; chapang neuchan apuilediu ahi.","ref":"Isai 65:25."},"7":{"text":"Chule bongpile vompi kivahkhomintin; anouteo kolkhom ding ahin; chule keipi bahkai jengin jong bongchal banga changpol ahin nehding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nao noicheplai gulse ko kotna kichema, noichep bang naosen in gulsum kosung asoding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Amaho kalhangthenga chu kisukha louhel le kisumang louhel ding ahiuve. Ajehchu twijin twikhanglen akhusoh banga leiset hi Pakai hetna-a dimset ding ahitai.","ref":"Habk 2:14."},"10":{"text":"Chule hicheni chule Jesse jung hung umdoh intin; hichu mitin melchihna dinga hung dingdoh-a, chidang namdang hon ahinholdiu ahi. Chule acholdona chu loupitah hiding ahi.","title":"Sohchanga Kikaiho Hungkile Kitding","ref":"Rom 15:12."},"11":{"text":"Chule hicheni chule hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin amite amoh chengse, akidalha dingho, Assyria'a kon Egypt, Pathros, Kush, Elam, Shinar, Hamath'a kon, twikol gamho-a kona lakit dingin aniveina-a akhut alhankit ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule namtin vaipi dingin aman melchihna tungdoh intin, Israel nodohsa ho achomkhoma, chule leiset ningli-a kona Judah mi kithecheh ho chu akhopkhom ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ephraim mite thangsetna jongchu kitol manga, Judah te douho chu kisatlha ding, Ephraim min Judah thangset dantin, Judah'in jong Ephraim sutan taponte."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla amaho lhumlang sanga Philistinte lengkouho chunga leng uva, kigomuva solam miho achom dingu ahi, amahon Edom le Moab chunga akhutnu alhah uva, chule Ammon chaten amaho thu angai dingu ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Egypt vadunglen Lei chu asuh manghela chule huipi hattah-a luipi chunga akhut athinkhuma, luidung sagiho chu ajepma, chutengle achunga chu mihon kengto kot louva lam ajot dingu hi.","ref":"Tph 16:12."},"16":{"text":"Chule Egypt gama kona ahungdoh niuva Israel ten lampi ahin jui banguva; amite amoh kidalha ho dinga chu, lamlhongpi khat Assyria'a kona hungki lhung ding ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hicheni chule nanghon vo Pakai keiman nangma vahchoi jinge, kachunga analunghang tajongle chun nalunghanna akichonmangin neilhamon tai;","title":"Thangvahna La"},"2":{"text":"Vetan Pakai chu eihuh hinga ahin; keiman tahsaning ting kichataponge, Ajehchu Pakai Jehovah chu kahatnale kala ahin; amachu eihuh hingpa jong ahunghitai.","ref":"Pot 15:2; Labu 118:14."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu huhhingna twikul'a kona kipahtah-a twi nathaldiu ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Hiche nikhoteng chule nanghon Pakai chu vahchoijun lang aminin taovun, athilbolho mitinlah a phongjalun lang aminchu choi-atnin aumtai, tin seijuvin, natidiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aman thil loupitah aboltahjeh-in Pakaiya la saovin; hichehi leiset pumpi het ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nangho Zion'a chengten kho sam unlang aovun ajehchu nalah uva um Israelte mithengpa chu loupitah ahi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon pohgih, Amoz chapa Isaiah'in amuchu ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Babylon Asuhmang ding","ref":"Isai 47:1-15; Jer 50:1—51:64."},"2":{"text":"Milalte kotpi phunga aluttheina diuvin, molsang chunga chun ponlap domsangun lang, awsang tah-in sam unlang, khutnin japmun."},"3":{"text":"Kathensosa mihochu thu kapen, Kalunghana-a dingin kamihat ho jong kakouvin, kaloupina eikipapiho jengjong kakouve."},"4":{"text":"Molchunga mitamtah husan chu mipi nasatah husan tobang ahin; namtin lengam kikhomkhomho kinah kisao husan toh abangin ahi.
