Janel Pakai chun galmi janel ho chu galmuna din akhomtup tai."},"5":{"text":"Amaho gamlatah gama kon, van monga konin, Pakai amatahle lung hilouna manchah hotoh chuche gampumpi sumang dingin ahunguve atiuve."},"6":{"text":"Penguvin, ajehchu Pakai nikho chu ahungnai tai; Hatchung nunga kona manthah na tobang chu hunglhung ding ahi.","ref":"Joel 1:5."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu khut jouse ngoilha-a mitin lungsung junlhading ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule amaho kichaovintin; natna le lungkham na-in manchom untin; numei naosonat thoh banga thohgima umdiu amaho khatnin adang chu adatmouva, amaiju meikong bangjeng ding ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Vetan, Pakai nikho lunghanale lungsatna khohtah toh kithokhom engsetna, chuche gam sugamhel dingchu ahunglhung tai. Aman chuche-a kona michonseho chu asuhmang helding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu van'a ahsi ho le chua bombel ho chun avah-u apehtahloudiu, nisa chu asodohna-a thimdeldul jengding ahitan, chule lhavah injong avahchu asalvah louding ahitai.","ref":"Ezek 32:7; Matt 24:29; Mrk 13:24-25; Luk 21:25; Tph 6:12-13."},"11":{"text":"Chule keiman vannoihi asetnao jeh-a chule migiloute chu akhansetnao jeh-a talen kapeh ding; mikiletsahho ahoithanau kasuhbei ding, chule kiletsahna tijat umtah chu nemcha kakoipeh ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Keiman sanatheng sanga lujo mihem khat, Ophir sanahal sanga lujohel mihem khat kasemding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu janel Pakai lunghan ni-a alungsat khohtah nikho chule vanho kaho lingsoh-a, leiset jong amuna kona kichondohding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule hichu sakhi nung kidel bangle, ahoitupbei kelngoi tobang hiding ahin; mitin chu amaho mite cheh lama, kiheija, ama gamcheh-a jamlutdiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Koihile akimudoh chanchu kidot kamhel helding, chule amaho jopchan chu chemjam'a loudiu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Achateu jong amitmu tah uva kichil ngema a-inho kichom theng ding, chule ajiteu jong achamlou uva kisusedingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Vetan, amaho doudin Mede mite tildoh ingting, amahon dangka angaisah loudiu; chule sana-a jong kipahlouding ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Athalpihou chun gollhangho hinkaplih untin; laigil gaho chunga khotona himhim aneilou diu; amitmuva naosen ho jong akheh louheldiu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule Babylon lenggam ho loupina Chaldea mite melhoina chungnung chu Pathen'in Sodom le Gomorrah asuhmang tobang chu hiding ahi.","ref":"Semt 19:24."},"20":{"text":"A-itih a jong koima cheng talouhel ding, akhang akhanga jong chengkit talouhel ding. Arab miten jong chuche munna chu apon innu asonloudiu; kelngoi chinghonjong chua akelngoi hongu asemlouheldiu ahitai."},"21":{"text":"Amavang nelgama gamsaho chua chu koldiu; a-inhou chu kichat um ganhingho dimsetna; sumbupi ho chua chu chenga, lhomiho hunglam diu ahi.","ref":"Isai 34:14; Zeph 2:14; Tph 18:2."},"22":{"text":"A-in homhou sunga chu twikol gamsaho chule aleng in nomhou sunga chu Dragonho hung hamdiu ahin; chule amanu phat hunglhun nading chu anaitan, anikhoho jong kijopsao talouhel ding ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin Jacob hepintin, chule Israelte chu lheng nalaijintin, agamsung tah uva achensahdiu chule gamdang mihon amaho ahinjopmuva, Jacob insunga behdiu ahitai.","title":"Sohchana-a Kon Hungkilekit"},"2":{"text":"Chule mihochun amaho ahinpuijuva, apate mun ahinlhut ding, chule Israel insung chun Pakai gama amahochu sohpale sohnu-a avuluva; chule gal hinga akaihouchu gal hinga akaijuva; asugentheiteu chunga chu vai ahomdingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule nalungkham na-a konle nakichat na-a kona chule soh suhgenthei natoh hahsa naki tohsah na nasohchanna-a kona Pakaiyin nacholdosah nile hung hitiding ahi.","title":"Mithi Kholkhula Babylon Lengpa"},"4":{"text":"Chutia chu nangman Babylon lengpa douna-a hiche thuchih hi naman chah-a naseiding ahi. I-atileh misugenthei pa chu iti beija hitam! sana khopi chu kichai hitam!"},"5":{"text":"Pakaiyin mikhang giloupa tenggol le vaihomho laltengdop chu aheboh pehtai."},"6":{"text":"Miho lunghanna tanlouva veijingpa, lungsa tah-a namtin chunga vaihompa chu bolgimin aumin, koimachan asutangpoi."},"7":{"text":"Leiset pumpi akicholdon, athipdeltan; amahon la asadoh-uvin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi, nachunga chah thinghole Lebanon'a cedar thingho akipah-un, suhlhah-a na-uma patnin eiphuh lhudiu khatcha kahenguva ahungtapoi, atiuve."},"9":{"text":"Noilama konin thikholkhul chu nahunglhun lamdot dingin ahung kichonnin; hichun nangma dingin mithihole leiset pipui jouse jong achoh thouvin; namtin lengho jouse alaltounaova konin akaithou tan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Amahon nahenga, nangjong keiho banga nahung lhahsam hitam? keihotoh nahungbah hitam? atidingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Naloupina le naselangdah husa chu lhankhuh-a poh lhah-in aumin; lungtol chu nanoija akiphan, hiche lung chun natomchah tan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Vo Lucifer, jingkah chapa! van'a kona iti hunglhahmanga nahim! namtinho hatmosahpa chu leisetna iti nahung kisatlhah jeng hitam?","ref":"Tph 8:10; 9:1."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu nangin nalungsunga keima van'a kaltouving ting; Pathen ahsi ho chungvuma kalaltouna kidopsanging katin; mipi kikhomho lhangchung sahlam sanga touving kate, natin ahi.","ref":"Matt 11:23; Luk 10:15."},"14":{"text":"Meilhang ho chungvuma kaltouving katin; chungnung penpa toh banging kate, nanatin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla nangma kotongthuh lama thikholkhula kipui lhading nahijobouve."},"16":{"text":"Namu jousen neochan namuvintin, leiset kithinsah-a lenggam ho hotlinga ngaito-a chu hiche mipahi hijaham? tin ngaitouvinte;"},"17":{"text":"Amachun vannoihi gamthip banga asema, chule akhopihou sumanga sohchangho in honpehlou chu hiche mipahi hilouham? atiuve."},"18":{"text":"Namtin vaipi lengho jouse abonchauvin, ama ama insungcheh-a loupitah-in alum ihmuvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ahinla nangma thet umtah abah khatna hungkon chemjam'a kisatlih, akithatsaho ponsil, kokhuh-a songho lah-a kipailha, kenga kichonpha thilong bangin, nalhana konin paidoh-in na-umtan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Nangin nagam nasuhmanga, namite nathagam jeh-in, amahotoh nakivuitha louhel ding ahi. Khanset bolho chilhahte chu kiminphah kitlouhel ding ahiuve."},"21":{"text":"Amaho akipatdoh lounadiule, gam alo lounadiu, leiset chung khopiho achendim louna diuvin apateu khansetna jal-in achateu chu thagamdin gotan."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu janel Pakaiyin amaho dounan kipat ingting, Babylon'a konin kachapa le katupa amohchengse minchu kasuhtan ding ahi, ati, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","title":"Pathen'in Babylon Asuhmang Ding"},"23":{"text":"Keiman vakang chenna mun le twikulho-a kasema, manthah na muntheh-a katheh doh ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"24":{"text":"Kangaito bang banga guilhunga, kagon bang banga ding teiding ahi; tin janel Pakai chu aki hahselin aseitai.","title":"Pathen'in Assyria Asuhmang Ding","ref":"Isai 10:5-34; Nah 1:1-3; Zeph 2:13-15."},"25":{"text":"Chutia chu keiman kagamsunga Assyria mite kasuhmanga, kamolsangho chunga kachotpha ding; chujou tengle anamkoljon chu amaho-a kona kiheimanga, apohgih-u alenguva kona aselhah dingu ahitai."},"26":{"text":"Hiche thilgonhi leiset pumpi chunga thilgon ahin; chule hichehi namtin vaipi jouse chunga kijahdoh khutchu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Janel Pakai gonsa ahin, koiham ajahda dingah? Chule akhut kijahdohsa chu kon atimsahkit dingham?"},"28":{"text":"Ahaz lengpa thi kum-a chu hiche pohgih hi uma ahitai.","title":"Pathen'in Philistine Asuhmang Ding","ref":"2 Leng 16:20; 2 Thusm 28:27."},"29":{"text":"Nangma kivohna mol abohtah jeh-in, nang Palestine pumpi kipah hih-in, ajehchu gul sonna kona chu gulsum hungsoh-a, chule ama guchu meija lengthei gul hunghi ding ahi.","ref":"Jer 47:1-7; Ezek 25:15-17; Joel 3:4-8; Zeph 2:4-7; Zech 9:5-7."},"30":{"text":"Chutengle migenthei cha pengmasa kivah intin, milhasam mongtah-in lumintin; najung chu kella katha-a, nami amoh chengchu aman athading ahi."},"31":{"text":"Vo kotpi samin; vo khopi pengin; nangma Palestine pumpi najun lhatai. Ajehchu sahlama kona meikhu hungdoh-a; aphattep sunga chu koimacha achanga umlou ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Nampi thupole ho chu khatnin iti adonbut dingham? Pakaiyin Zion aphutdoh tan, hijeh-a chu mivaichaten hichu atahsan dingu ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moab gam pohgih chungchanga, chuche jana chun Moab khopi Ar chu suhmangle kamdelin akilhan; chuleh Moab gama Kir khopi jong kamhel leh thipdelin akikoitai.","title":"Pathen'in Moab Asuhmang Ding","ref":"Isai 25:10-12; Jer 48:1-47; Ezek 25:8-11; Amos 2:1-3; Zeph 2:8-11."},"2":{"text":"Bajith le Dibon munsang ho-a chun ama kapdingin achetoutan: Nebo chungle Medeba chunga Moab peng pengding, aluchung jouseu chaijin tin akhamulhou jouse kivou ngim ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Akhopi lamlen dunguva amahon khaodip pon akigah uva, a-inchunghou le alamlen houva amitin penguva haka-a kapdingu ahiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chule Heshbon le Elealeh te kapmuva, Jahaz geisana a-aw kijading ahi. Hijeh-a chu galvon kivon Moab sepaiho chu awsangtah-a pengdoh uva; ahinna chu amadinga lungkham umtah hiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kalungsung Moab dingin kapdoh intin; ajamleleho chu kumthum kijoma Zoar'a jamlutdiu ahi. Ajehchu Luhith kaltouna-a chu kap puma chetoudiu chule Heronaim lampia chu suhmangna-a pengjahdiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nimrim twiho akangin, hamdongho agopmin; hampa akehpon; hamhing himhim aumtapoi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun amahon amujouseu le akholkhom jouseu chu huisum vachadung lama akipoh mangdiu ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu Moab gamgi muntina kana aumin. Eglaim le Beerelin'a jong apen ginu chu akithangsoh tai."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu Dimon twiho thisan dimding ahin, ajehchu Dimon chunga chu akhoh jocheh kalhunsahbe ding, Moab gama hoidohnale chuche gama amoh chengse chunga keipi bahkai kalhalut ding ahi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gamsung vaihomho dingin, Sela a konin, gamthip lam Zion chanu lhanga chun kelngoinou ho chu hinsolun.","title":"Moab Dinmun Kinepnabei Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Chutia chu Moab chanute chu vacha abuh-a kona kinodoh leng lele banga, Arnon kaimuna chutidiu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Thumop unlang, thutan boldoh-un; sunkim laija nalelim chu jan bangin seminlang; akinodohsa selinlang; vahvei chu matsah hih-in."},"4":{"text":"Akinodohho chu chenkhompin, Moab misumang pa maija akiselnao hitan, hunama lapa chu akichaija, migamsah pa akingah jehchun gamsunga konin misugenthei ho akisumang tai."},"5":{"text":"Chule hepina-in laltouna chu kitungdet nintin, hiche chunga chu thudih-a David ponbuh sunga vai ahomding, thu atanding, thutana dih aholding chule chonphatna-a kinoding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Moab hoithonahi thu kanajaovin; ama ahoitho lheh jengin; akiletsah nale ahoithona chule alunghan naho jengjong kanajaovin; ahinla ajounaho chu chutilou dingdol ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun Moab pengjah hen, mitinin Moab ka cheh hen. Ajehchu Kirhareseth kiphudoh jala nalunghempiu; amaho chu akivolhu tahmonga ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu Heshbon loujao le Sibmah lengpigui alhasamtai, aphung lhungpiho chu Pathen hephalou pakai hon anasubongun, Jazer alhung taove. Chuin gamthip lailunga ajamle leuvin ahi. Abahho ajamdoh un, twikhanglen galla ajamgalkai taove."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun Sibmah lengpigui chu Jazer chunga kana bangin kacham-inge; vo Heshbon le Elealeh kamitlhi-in twichap nange; nanipi lai theiho dingleh nachang at nadinga khosap chu athip tai."},"10":{"text":"Chule lou phatah-a kona kipanale thanopna akilamang tan; lengpilei laija penga lasah le khosap jong umlou ding ahitai. Achilhon jong lengpitwi achildoh loudiu ahitai. Alengpiga lonao khosap jong atansahtai."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun kagiljang hohi Moab te dingin, chule kasung hohi Kirhares dingin selangdah bangin ging'inte."},"12":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi. Moab chu munsanga alungkham akimutengle munthenga tao dingin hungintin, hijongle lolhing louding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hichehi Pakaiyin chuche laija patna Moab chungchang thu aseichu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla tun Pakaiyin ana seijin, natongho kumsim dungjuija, kumthum sung Moab loupina chu amipite tamtah puma kinoise ding; amoh umsun chu lhomchale doitah hidiu ahi, ati."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Damascus pohgih veuvin, Damascus hi khopi khat ahina-a konin akilamang tan, in-gem kiselom hunghidingbou ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Syria le Israel Gotna Apehding","ref":"Jer 49:23-27; Amos 1:3-5; Zech 9:1."},"2":{"text":"Aroer khopichu dalhah-in aumtan, kelngoihonte kolna ding maimaibou hung hintin, koimachan akichatsah loudiu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ephraim'a konin kulpidet beijintin, Damascus'a lenggam le Syria amoh chengjong beiding ahitai. Amaho chu Israel chate loupina tobang hidiu ahi, atin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"4":{"text":"Hicheni chule hitiding ahi. Jacob loupina chu kemsuh-in tin, chule atahsa thaotah chu jol lha-a gongding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hiche chu chang atpan changho ahuikhom, akhutna changvuiho a-at banga Rephaim phaichama changvuiho alokhom tobang hiding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla olive thingphung kihotlinga, abah sangpen tah vuma aga nile thum umdenna, abah ga phapena lile nga umden bep banga lengpigui kidalha ding ahi, tin Israel Pakai Pathen'in aseije."},"7":{"text":"Hicheni chule min asempa ahinvet ding, chule amitnin Israel mithengpa chu ajabol ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule aman amakhutsem maicham ho chu avet tahlou ding, akhutna asemsa thingbomho hihen, milimho hijengjongle, ajaboltah louhel ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hicheni chule akhopi dettahho chu thingbah kidalha Israelte jeh-a abah chungnung pen adalhah-u tobang hiding ahin, hikom chu kamdel ding ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu nahuhhingpa Pathen nasumilin, nahatna songpi nageldohtapoi. Hijeh chun thingkeh hoihoi kiphun natin, hetkhah lou kiselhuhna koijinate."},"11":{"text":"Naphuni maman khandohsah in natin, natu jingkah mama chun khantul tulsah-in nate, ahinla aga lokhomchu lungkhamna kisekhomle lungdon ngahnabei hiding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mipi tamtah twikhanglen kitumging banga ahusao kitol guiguile, twipi kinong lullul banga kinonga, namtin kinongho chu ohe adau ahi!","title":"Melma Nam Mite Kijo"},"13":{"text":"Namtin vaipi chu twipi kinong tamtah bangin kingong untin, hijongle Pathen'in amaho phoh intin, amaho gamlatah-a jamdiu; chule lhanga huipin changsi amutlonle bangle chimpei masanga thil kipeimang bangdiu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule vetan nilhah lamle lungkhamna ahijin, jingkah masangin ama anaumjitapon ahi. Hichehi eisuchavai hou chanchu ahin chule eigumang hou vangchan chu ahi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen'in Sudan Jepna Apehding:","ref":"Zeph 2:12."},"2":{"text":"Nam thechehsa le ahomsa henga, akipatnuva lhah tugeija tijat umtah mite henga, twikhanglen le vadunglen chunga lekha thing kongsaova palai kisolho tedohsa le kengto chotbehsa, twijin agamu asuhsette nam henga chun thupole kaljangho cheovin ati-e."},"3":{"text":"Nangho vannoi'a umho jouse le leichunga chenghon, lhang chunga galponlap ahung kidopsang tengle, veovin lang aman sumkon ahinmut tengle ngaijuvin."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin kahenga, keima kicholdong ting, kachenna mun hampa louhing chunga hin chang-at kholum laija daitwi meikai bangin hingel nange ati."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu aga lophat masang, amum ahung pilhina, apahjong lengpiga minsa ahunghi tengle, aman abah sipah jam hole abah lenho chu agoma hampa vatna chema abahho asat lhah-a, apaidoh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hicheho chu molsang ho-a vachaho dingle leisetna ganchaho kidalhah peh ding ahiuvin, vachate chun hichehochu nipilai man na-a, chule gamsaho chun phalbilai man na-a, aneidingu ahitai."},"7":{"text":"Hichephat teng chule janel Pakai heng, Janel Pakai min umna Zion lhanga a chu: mipi thechehsa le ahomsaho-a kon, akipat uva lhah tugeija tijat umtah mite-a kona, tedohsa le kengtoa chotbehsa nam mite-a kon, twijin agamu asuhsetho-a kona, thilpeh chu hung kipelut ding ahitai."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt pohgih chu veuvin, Pakai chu mei kitol gangtah chunga touva, Egypt gama hungding: chule ama angsunga Egypt gama milim ho chu kichon diu, Egypt mite lungchang chu asunga jun lhading ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Egypt Gotna Apehding","ref":"Jer 46:2-26; Ezek 29:1—32:32."},"2":{"text":"Keiman Egypt mite doudin Egypt mite ma tilingting, amitakipmin asopi adoudiu, amitakipmin aheng akom adouva, khopile khopi, lenggamle lenggam hungkidouto diu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hichesung chule Egypt mite lhagao chu hungthon nintin, chule hilchahna chu kasuhbei ding ahi. Chutengle amahon milimho le ailhimho, lhakou ho le doithemho henga aholdiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule keiman Egypt mite chu vaipo engsetah khat khutna kapehdoh-a; kichat umtah pakai khatnin achunguva vai ahomding ahi; tin Pakai janel Pakai chun aseitai."},"5":{"text":"Chule vadunglen ho-a kona twiho hungkanga; vadungho longmanga gothetding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule amahon vadunglen ho chu gamlatah-ah heimang untin, kinga tupna luidunga chu kanga gothet ding: Pumpeng hole aigeho jong golha ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Luidung pang le vapangho akeova kijamding; chule luidung panga kithe chanchu golha-a huija lengmang ding; umkit louhel ding ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Ngamanho jong lunghemuva, luidung ho-a ngakoiho jouse lunghem untin; chuhtwi chunga lensep ho lhasamdiu ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Hiche chungchon chun tupat pon khongho le ponvang khongho chu lungjing diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Akibulphuna songho kisubong ding; natong dinga kigongho jouse jong lungjinga umdiu ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Thonlouva Zoan lengchapate chu ngoldiu; Pharaoh thumopthem michingho thuhil chu lungsetna neilou ahung hitai. Keima miching cha leng luiho chapa kahi tia, Pharaoh henga iti naseiju ham?"},"12":{"text":"Amaho hoilamba hitaovam? namichingho hoiba hitaovam? Amahochu tun kihilsah inlang, Egypt chunga janel Pakaiyin ipi agon chu amaho hetsah in."},"13":{"text":"Zoan lengchapate chu angoltaovin, Noph lengchapate akilhemlha gamtai; amahon jong Egypt mite, chuche phung mite chendetnaho geijin apuimanguve."},"14":{"text":"Alah uva chun Pakaiyin lamvaina lhagao achoh halin; chutichun jukhama alohna-a lonlele bangin Egypt mite chu atohnao channa asuhkhelsah uve."},"15":{"text":"Egypt dingin alu hihen amei hijongle, lusu bah hihen phaipheng phung hijongle, abolpeh theiding aumpoi."},"16":{"text":"Hicheni chule Egypt chu numei tobang hidiu ahin; janel Pakai khut thin chu achunguva athin ahijeh-a kichaova tijading ahiuve.","title":"Egypt'in Pakai Ahouding"},"17":{"text":"Chule Judah gamchu Egypt tedin tijat umtah hintin, chuche douna dinga janel Pakaiyin agontoh athuhiljeh-a aminphah chu kichacheh diu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule Egypt gama khopi nga in Kanaan pao athouva, janel Pakai henga chu kihahsel ding ahiuvin; khatchu manthah na khopi kitiding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hicheni chule Egypt gamlailunga chu Pakai maicham khat, chule agamsunga chu Pakaiya songphu khat umding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule Egypt gamsunga janel Pakai dinga hichu melchihna le hettohsahna hiding ahi; ajehchu misugenthei ho jeh-a Pakai henga taoding ahiuvin, chule aman huhhingna le hat chungnung khat ahinsolpeh-a, amahochu ahuhdoh ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chutengle Pakai chu Egypt ho het hitantin, hiche nikho chule Egypt ten Pakai chu ahetdohdiu, chule ganlhaina le thilpeh aneidiu ahi; ahi, Pakai henga kitepna khatna kitep uva asuhbulhitdiu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin Egypt ajepding, ajepna-a asuhdam ding ahi. Amaho Pakai hengtah-a chu hungkileuva, chule aman ataonao angaipeh-a, chule aboldamdiu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule Egypt'a kona Assyria geija lamlhongpi khat umding Assyria te Egypt'a, Egypt Assyria a, hunguva Egypt mite chun Assyria mite toh ajenkhomdiu ahitai."},"24":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule Israel hi Egypt le Assyria bana athumna hiding, chule gamlailunga phattheiboh changtah hunghi ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Janel Pakai chun kami Egypt te leh kakhutsoh Assyria te chule kagoulo Israelte chu phattheiboh changu hen tia aseiding ahi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tartan Ashdod na ahunga (Assyria lengpa Sargon in asol lai) Ashdod asatna alah kumchun;","title":"Themgao Akeuchanga Umpa-a Kon Melchihna"},"2":{"text":"Hichephat mama chun Pakaiyin Amoz chapa Isaiah hengah aseijin, chenlang nataija khaopon chu sutlhan lang, nakeng phanga konin nakengkoh sutlhan, ati. Chuin aman chutichun abolin, asagoh-in akeng keuvin lam ajottai."},"3":{"text":"Chutin Pakaiyin, kasoh Isaiah Egypt le Ethiopia te chunga melchihna le thilkidang dinga kumthum sunga sagohle akeng keuva aumbangchun;"},"4":{"text":"chutia chu Assyria lengpan Egypt te sohchang dinga, Ethiopia gal hing ding, khangdong laile tehse cheng, sagohkeu le kengkeuva Egypt mite jachatsah dinga akhelbuhgei san uva kihohdoh-a, apuimang ding ahi, tin aseije."},"5":{"text":"Chule amaho akinepnao Ethiopia le aloupinao Egypt jala kichaova jahchadiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule hiche twikol gama umho hin hicheni chule, vetaovin ikinepnao chutichu ahi, Assyria lengpa-a kona ikihuhdoh nadiuva kithopina hola hoilama ijamdiu hija, iti ihoidoh diuham? atidiu ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Twipi nelgam pohgih, lhanglam chimpei hungkipei bangin chutichun nelgamle tijat umtah gama konin ahunge.","title":"Babylon Lhuhding Kimu Masat"},"2":{"text":"Lungkham umtah thilmu khat kahenga akiphongin, kitahlou bolpan kitahlouvin abolin, misumang pan mi asumange. Vo Elam kaltouvin, vo Media gaum kimvelun, khoisatna jouse kasuhtang ahitai."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun kataihohi natna-in adimin; numei naosonat in aheh bangin, natna chun eiman chomtai. Hichu kajan kakunin kho mutheilou jennin kalungkhamtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kalungsung ahaisamtan, thil gimneitah khatnin eikichat sahtai. Kanopna janchu aman kadingin kichatnan aleheitai."},"5":{"text":"Dokhang chu dovin, daiveina insanga chun ve jingin, neuvin, donun; kipat un, nangho pipuiho, lumdal chu thao uvin."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu hitihin kajah-a aseijin, Pakaiyin kahenga, chen, khongah khat koijin amu muchu phondoh sah-in ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin aman kangtalai khat sakola tou mi kopkhat toh, sangan kangtalai khat, sangongsao ho kangtalai khat amun, chuin gunchu tahle lunglut tah in angaijin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin ama keipi bahkai bangin apengin, Pakai keima insang chunga kading jingin, chule jankhovah in kapansatna-a kaume."},"9":{"text":"Chule vetan, hiche munahin miho kangtalai khat, sakol chungtou kopkhat toh ahungin ahi. Chuin aman ahindonbut nin, Babylon achimtai, achimtai, amanu pathen semthu milim jouse aman tolah avobong gamtai, ati.","ref":"Tph 14:8; 18:2."},"10":{"text":"Vo kachang mola kavohsa kaphola kachang ho, Israel Pathen, janel ho Pakaiya kona kanajah chu naheng uva kaphondoh ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Dumah pohgih chu, Aman Seir'a konin eihin kouvin, khongahpa, jana ipi soh am? Khongahpa jana ipi soh am? ati.","title":"Edom Chungchanga Thu Kisei"},"12":{"text":"Khongahpa chun jingkah, chule janjong ahung naitai. Nakholtoh nomule kholtoh-un, hungkileuvin, hungun, ati."},"13":{"text":"Arabia te pohgih chu, Vo Dedanim kholjinho, nangho Arabia gammang sunga nagedingu ahi.","title":"Arabia Chungchanga Thu Kisei"},"14":{"text":"Tema gama chengho chun adangchahpa twi ahindop peh-un, galjampa chu amahon changlhah-in avah uve."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho chemjam'a kon, chemjam kisatdohsa-a kon, chule thalpi kijebongsa-a kon, chule gal nasatah-a kona hungjam ahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin kahenga hitihin aseije; kithalah kumho dungjuija kumkhat sunga Kedarte loupina jouse beisohding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu Kedar chate thal kapthem le galhat hochu kilhomsah ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakai Israel Pathen'in hichehi aseisa ahitai."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thilmuna phaicham pohgih. Tu-a ipi hahsatna uma, in chunga nabon chaova nakalu hitam?","title":"Jerusalem chungchanga Thu Kisei"},"2":{"text":"Nangma husagin na dimset, khopi pohcheichoi, kipahtah khopi; napasal kithat ho chu chemjam'a kithat le galsatna a thi ahipouve."},"3":{"text":"Navaihom hou abonun ajamkhomun, thalthem hon amaho akan khomun; nanga kona gamlha tah-a jamdoh jouse chu abonin akangomun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu kati ahi, keija konin achomlam veuvin; kamite chanu kisuhmang jeh-a haka-a kakading ahi, lhepbi dingin neigo hih-un."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu tuni hi lungkhamna le kengto-a kichil thangna chule gao thilmuna phaichama janelho Pakai Pathen dinga lungnohphahna le, kul bangho kisuhchimna le mol chungho-a kana nikho chu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Elam mihon livathei akengun, mihem touna sakol kangtalai le sakolchung touhotoh alhonuvin, Kir mihon lumdal chu ahohdoh-uvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, Na phaicham deichungnung chu kangtalai dimset ding ahi, sakolchung touho chu kotpiphunga galvonpuma kigoldiu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin aman Judah pondal kikhuna chu ahohdoh-in, chule hiche nikho chun gammanga galmanchah in chu navetai."},"9":{"text":"Nanghon David khopi selaiho jongchu namutaove, hichu tamtah ahi. Chuin twikul noinunga twiho chu nagom khom taove."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Jerusalem in hochu nasim uvin, chule in hochu kulbang semna dingin naphe lhaove."},"11":{"text":"Twikul luija hunglong dingin kulbangho kah-a chun twilam khatjong nalaijun; ahinla chuche sempa lamchu nave hih-un, sotna patna hingong tohpa jong chu nanahsah pouve."},"12":{"text":"Hiche laichun janel Pakai Pathen'in akapdin, alunghemdin, alu voutoldin chule khaodip ponna atai kigahdin mi akouve."},"13":{"text":"Chule ven thanopnale kipanaho, bongchal ho kithana le kelngoi ho kithana, sanehna le lengpitwi dona hohi hungun neuhitin, donuhite, ajehchu jingle ithidiu ahitai.","ref":"1 Cor 15:32."},"14":{"text":"Chule hichehi janel Pakaiyin kanabenga anaphondohsa ahin, thonlouhella hiche khansetnahi nathi kahseuva nangho-a kona kisutheng louhel ding ahi, tin janel Pakai Pathen'in aseije."},"15":{"text":"Janel Pakai Pathen chun hitin aseije, chenlang hiche neichingpa hengle insung chunga vaipo, Shebna heng ngeija chun gaseijin,","title":"Shebna Kigih salna"},"16":{"text":"Ama dinga sangtah-a lhan kilaija, amadinga songpi sunga chendetna in kisem banga, hichemunahi ipi naneija, koi naneija lhan nakilai ham?"},"17":{"text":"Vetan, Pakaiyin thahat tah-a gal hinga nakaimanga, nakhu khum teiding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Aman nangma thonlouva pumhatna gamlen lama lumbeng banga kipeibong bonga napeiding ahin, chua nathiden ding, chua chu naloupina kangtalai chu napupa insung jachatna sohding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Keiman naum na-a konin nangma deldoh ingting, napipui na-a kona aman naloilhah ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule hitiding ahi: Keiman kalhacha Hilkiah chapa Eliakim chu kakouding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Keiman nasangkhol chol ama ahpeh ingting, nakonggah-in ama hatsah ingting navaipoh na akhutna kapeh ding ahi. Chule ama Jerusalem'a chenghole Judah insung mite pa-a pangding ahitai."},"22":{"text":"Chule David insung kot heh alengkouva kakhaija, chutia chu aman ahonle koimachan akha theilou ding, aman akhale koimachan ahontheilou ding ahi.","ref":"Tph 3:7."},"23":{"text":"Chule keiman amachu mundet tah-a kikilbeh banga kasuhdet ding; amachu apa insung dinga laltouna loupi chu hiding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule amahon amachunga chu apa insung loupina jouse, atu achate le asonho, bel neocha jouse belcha khonho-a pat twipai geija achunga akhaidiu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin aseije, hiche nikho chule, mundet tah-a kikildet thihkil chu kibotdoh intin, kisatlha-a lhamang ding ahi. Chule achunga um pohgih chu kisatlhading ahi. Ajehchu hichehi Pakaiyin aseisa ahitai."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tyre pohgih. Nangho Tarshish kongho, pengun! Ajehchu in umlou hel, alutna ding umlouhel ahinadinga hiche chu kisukamhela ahitai. Chittim gama kona hichehi ahenguva hung kiphonga ahi.","title":"Tyre Chungchang Thu Kisei","ref":"Ezek 26:1—28:19; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:9-10; Zech 9:1-4; Matt 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14."},"2":{"text":"Twikol gama cheng nangho thipchetnin umun, Zidon mi sumkolvei, twikhanglen palgalkai lehon alodimsoh taove."},"3":{"text":"Chule twilenho panga Sihor muchi, luipang dunga chang ki-at chu amanu chanding ahin, amanu chu namtin kailhang ahi."},"4":{"text":"Vo Zidon, jahchan umin; ajehchu twipin thu aseijin, twipi hatna ngeichun naoso natna kathoh khapon, chate jong kahingkhapoi, gollhangho jong kavahdoh khapoi, nungahthengho jong kaseiletsah khapoi, atin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt thudol thulhut kijabanga chu, Tyre thulhut na chu amaho lungna lhehdiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nangho twikol'a chengte, Tarshish a galkai junlang samun."},"7":{"text":"Hichehi gollui khanglui nikho-a mi chuham? Akengphangin gamlatah-a chedinga alhohmang ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Lallukhuh khuh khopi, chua sumkolvei ho pipuiho jeng hija chua kiveihojong leisetna ja umtejeng hija, hiche Tyre khopi douna gong'a chu koiham?"},"9":{"text":"Janel Pakai chun leisetna kiletsah le ja-umtah ho suhnemna dinga hichehi anagon ahi."},"10":{"text":"Vo Tarshish chanu, vadung khat bangin nagamsung chu jotpaitan, nahatbe nading dang aumtapoi."},"11":{"text":"Aman twikhanglen chunga akhut ajah-in, lenggam ho ahotlinge. Pakaiyin chuche sumkolveipa khopi douna kulpidet suhmangna dingin thu apetai."},"12":{"text":"Chuin aman vo genthei thoh nungah theng, Zidon chanu, nangma nakipajom louhel ding ahi. Kipat inlang, Chittim'a galkaijin, chua jongchu choldona namulouhel ding ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chaldea gamhi vetan! Assyria miten amaho dinga gamthipma chengho amu kahseuvin hiche mitehi aumtapouve. Amahon insangho leng inpiho asauvin, ahin hichun manthah na-a ahin lhuttai."},"14":{"text":"Nangho Tarshish kong inneiho; pengun, ajehchu nathahatna beihela suhmang ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule hitiding ahi, lengkhat nikhoho dungjuija Tyre chu kum somsagi suhmila hung umding, kum somsagi kichaitengle noti banga Tyre'in la asahding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Suhmila anaum notinu, nangman selangdah choi jinlang, khopichu velin, nangma geldoh-a naum theina dingin aw nguiheu vin, la tamtah san."},"17":{"text":"Chule kum somsagi akichai joutengle hung hitiding ahi. Pakaiyin Tyre chu vilintin, amanu athalahnu henga hungkile ding, chule leiset chunga vannoi lenggam ho jouseto jong hungchonthanghoi ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule amanu kiveina thilho le athalah chu Pakaiya dinga atheng hiding: hichu kikhol louding, koijong kikoikhom louding ahi; ajehchu kiveina thilho chu Pakai masanga chenghon nengtah-a anehdiu chule sottah aneidiu ponsiljoh hiding ahi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Veuvin, Pakaiyin leiset hi keuhel le agoh-in anasemin, chule akhup athalin aleh-in, chua chengho chu athecheh tai.","title":"Pakaiyin Leiset Gotna Apehding"},"2":{"text":"Chutia chu, mipi aum banga thempu uma; sohpa aum banga pakaipa uma; sohnu aum banga pakainu uma; achopa aum banga ajohpa uma; ahompa aum banga abatpa uma; sumthoi lapa aum banga sumthoi pepa uma; batna lapa aum banga batna pepa umah ahi."},"3":{"text":"Leiset chu keuhela suhchatvai gam hela umding ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin hiche thuhi anasei ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Vannoihi alunghemin agolhatai. Vannoihi akemsuh-in agolhatai. Leisetna mikiletsahho akemsuh taove."},"5":{"text":"Leiset hi achengho noija suhboh-in aumtai; ajehchu amahon danho chu asukhelun, chondanthu akhelun, tonsot thulhun asukehtaove."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun leiset hi gaosapmin avalhumtai, asunga chengho chu akamdeltai; hijeh chun leija chengho akavamun, mi lhomcha bou aumtai."},"7":{"text":"Lengpitwi thah alunghemin, lengpitwi alhasamin, lungsunga kipahho jouse akhoisataove."},"8":{"text":"Khongchaho thanopna akichaijin, kipahtah-a umho husa chu abeijin, selangdah thanopna atangtai."},"9":{"text":"Amahon judon le lasah akop loudiu ahi; khamnathei donhi adonho dinga khatah ahi."},"10":{"text":"Lung nohphahna khopi chu akisumang tai; Koimacha alunglut thei louna dingin in jouse akikhahchahtai."},"11":{"text":"Ju jeh-in lamlhongpi ho-ah kho akisame; kipana jouse athimin, gamsung thanopna jouse abeitai."},"12":{"text":"Khopisung ahomkeovin akidalhan, chule kotpi chu manthah na-in akivosen ahi."},"13":{"text":"Gam lailung miholah-a hitia ahung um tengtah le, Olive thingphung kihotling tobangle lengpiga loujaova apul kilohkhom tobanga chu hung umding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Amahon a-aw hinsam doh-un tin, Pakai loupina lan saovintin; twikhanglen'a kona gingtah-a asapdohdiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun nanghon Pakai, Israel Pakai Pathen min ngeichu mei le twipi chule twikol gamho-a chun choi-an uvin."},"16":{"text":"Leiset kolmonga konin la kisaho ijaovin, michonpha te henga loupina umhen. Ahinla keima kalhasam tultul, kalhasam tultul tai; ohe! ada-a kahi, jouva mibol hon jouvin eiboluvin; adihlouva mibol hon jouvin eihabol lheh-un ahi, katin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Vo leisetna chengho, kichatna le kokhuh, chule thang nachung uva aume."},"18":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi: Tijatna husa-a kona jam-a chu kokhuh-a lhalutding, chule kokhuh-a kona hungdoh-a chu thanga ohding ahi; ajehchu chungsanga bangkot ho akihongin, chule leiset bulho akihotlinge."},"19":{"text":"Leiset nasatah-in akehlhan, leiset hi ajunlha thengin, leiset hi nasatah-in akilong tai."},"20":{"text":"Leiset hi jukham banga kipei lonle-a, buh neocha banga kichon mangding ahi. Chule chua suhkhelna chu gihsatah-a achunga umding, chule hichu lhu-a kiphongkit louhel ding ahitai."},"21":{"text":"Chule hicheni chule hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin chunga um janel le leiset lengho chu talen apehding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule sohchangho kokhuh sunga akikoikhom banga, amaho kikhom khomdiu, songkul sunga kikhachah khumdiu, nitamtah joule amaho kivil ding ahiuve."},"23":{"text":"Chutengle janel Pakai chu Zion lhang le Jerusalem'a chule upaho anga loupitah-a alengchan tengle lha thimintin, nisa maimoh ding ahi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nangma ka Pathen nahin, nangma choi-an ningting, namin vahchoi jinge; ajehchu nangin datmo um thilho nabolin; malaija nathumop ho chu tahsan umle thudih ahi.","title":"Pathen Vahchoina La"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu khopijong leivui nasosah-in, hoidohna khopi chu nasumangin, khopi umlouna dinga gamdang mite leng in-piho chu nasusen, hichu kisadohkit louhel ding ahitai."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun mihatten nangma loupisah-un natin, tijat um namtin vaipiho khopi'n nagindiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma vaichate din thahatna nahin, alhasamte hesoh laija thahatna nahin, khopihui hatlaija belding nahin, nisa noija lim nahin, khopihuijin kulbang anuh tobangkhu nahije."},"5":{"text":"Gamdang miteho husa chu mun go laija nisa sat banga nasuhnem ding; meilhang lima asa jengjong chu nasuhnem ding ahi. Kichat umtah abahho chu kisunem ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hiche molsanga hi janel Pakaiyin, lengpituichih-a mijouse golvah, thil thaova golvah, thil thao lhintwi dimsetna, lengpitwi chih kilhithengsella golvah abolding ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Moupui Golvah Ding Agon"},"7":{"text":"Aman hiche molsang hi namtin jouse chunga kikhukhum maikhule, namtin jouse chunga kidah ponlukhuh chu asuhmang ding ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Aman thina chu jona-a aval lhuma; chule Pakai Pathen'in mai jouse-a kona mitlhiho atheh hulding, chule leiset pumpi jouse-a kona amite kiphona alahmang ding ahi: ajehchu Pakaiyin hichehi asei ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 15:54; Tph 7:17; 21:4."},"9":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule hitia kisei ding ahi. Veuvin, hichehi i-Pathen'u eihon ingao, eihuhhing dinguva amahi ahi. Hichehi eihon ina ngajingu Pakai chu ahi. Ami huhhing na-a eiho ikipaova itha nopdiu ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai khutchu hiche lhanga hi kingama, changpol eh-molla kon akilholhah banga, ama noija Moab chu chotbeh-a umding ahitai.","title":"Pathen'in Moab Gotna Apehding"},"11":{"text":"Twijap pan twijapna dinga akhut ajah banga, aman alah uva akhut ajahding ahi. Chule aman akiletsah naochu akhutnuva achomdoh houtoh asotlhahtha ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule akulpidet kulbang sangho chu asuhnempeh-a akoinema, tolgeija, leivui changeija asotlhah ding ahi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuche nikho tengchule hiche la hi Judah gamma kisading ahi; keihon khopi dettah khat kaneijun; Pathen'in huhhingna chu kulbanghole kulpiho dinga agetding ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Amite Jona Apehding","ref":"Heb 10:27."},"2":{"text":"Nam chonphate, thutah nit mite alut theina dingun, nanghon kotpi chu hong lennun."},"3":{"text":"Nachunga alungthim chensah chu chamna kimkeija navet tupding ahi. Ajehchu aman nangma natahsanin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nanghon Pakai chu a-imatih chanin tahsanun. Ajehchu Pakai Jehovah'a chu tonsot thahatna chu uma ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu sangtah-a chengho chu aman ahinpolhan; khopi sangtah chu akoinemin, tol geija akoinemtai; aman leivui geijin ahinpolhai."},"6":{"text":"Mivaichate kenghole, lhasamte kalsonho, ngeichu akenga achotbeh ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Michonpha te lampi chu kitahna ahin, nang, lungdihpen chun mikitah lampi chu naleptohjin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi, nathutanlhahna lampia chun, vo Pakai, nangma kangah jingui; kahinnaovin alha ngaipen chu namin le nangma geldohjing ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Janteng kahinna-in nalhangaijin ahi. Ahi, kasunga um lhagao chun jingkah matah-in nangma nahol inge. Ajehchu nathutanlhahnaho leija aumteng, vannoi'a chengten chonphatna chu kijil unte."},"10":{"text":"Migilou khohsahna musah jengle chun chonphatna kimudoh dehponte; lungdihna gama chun aman dihlou tah-in thilbol'intin Pakai lalna chu mudohponte."},"11":{"text":"Pakai, nakhut nadopsang tengle amahon mupouvinnate. Ahinla mihochunga athangset jeh-un mudoh untin; jahchadiu ahi. Ahi, namelmate meichun amaho akahlih gamdiu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Pakai, nangman keiho dinga chamna neisuhdet peh dingu ahi. Ajehchu nangman kanatoh jouseu jong neitohpeh taove."},"13":{"text":"Vo Pakai, ka Pathen'u nang hilou pakai danghon kachunguva vai ahomtai."},"14":{"text":"Amaho athi ahiuvin, hing loudiu ahiuve: Amaho athi ahiuvin, thou talou ding ahiuve. Hijeh chun nangin amaho navilin, nasumangin, ahettheinao jouse jong naman sah-in ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hiche nam mite chu napunsah-in; O Pakai, nangman hiche nam mite chu napunsah tan; Nangma choi-atnin na-umtai; Nangin hichu gamlatah leiset kolmang geijin nakithan sahtai."},"16":{"text":"Pakai, lungkhamin amahon nangma naholun, nagimbolna achunguva aumteng hatah-in ataovun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nupi naovop asophat ahung naija, anatna nachoi choija ahung pendoh bangin; Vo Pakai, nangma mitmun chutobang chu kanahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Keihon nao kavopmun, kana-uvin, hui lhohdohle kabangui, leijahin huhhingnadol ima kabolpouvin; vannoi'a cheng hojong lhujong alhupouve."},"19":{"text":"Namithiho chu kamithilong toh thoudoh uva, hing khomdiu ahi. Leivuija cheng nangho thou vunlang la saovin. Ajehchu nadaitwi chu hampa louhingho daitwi bang ahin, leijin mithiho chu ahinledoh ding ahi.","ref":"Dan 12:2."},"20":{"text":"Hungun kamite, na-indan sunguva lutnun lang, nakotnu kikha khum uvin; lungnat natah akichai kah-in, chomkhat tobang kiselmang uvin.","title":"Thutanna le Semthahna"},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu veuvin, leisetna chengte akhansetnao jeh-a talen pedingin Pakai chu aumna mun'a konin ahung potdoh tai. Leisetnin jong athisan chu asellou ding ahin; chule amithiho jong akhutah louding ahi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule Pakaiyin achemjam hemtah lentahle lhoutah-a chu leviathan gul ngongle leviathan gul kiveikol ngeng nung chu talen apeh-a; chule twikhanglen'a um dragon chu athading ahi.","ref":"Job 41:1; Labu 74:14; 104:26."},"2":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule; lengpitwi san lengpilei, amanu henga la saovin."},"3":{"text":"Pakai kiti keimahi, tuhdetpa kahin; phat tinin twichapminge, achutiloule min sukhante, tia sunle jana kavettupding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Keija lungsatna aumpoi, galla eidou dinga koijin lingle khao chu akoiding ham? Keima alah uva kache-a, kahalchap ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahiloule eikichampi theina dingin, kahatnahin kivonhen, chutile eikichampi ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Aman Jacob mite ahungho chu ajung khosah ding ahin; Israelte mum doh-a pahlhading, chule leiset chunghi aga dimset ding;"},"7":{"text":"Ama jepho ajep bangtah a chu avoh hitam? Ahiloule ama thatte kitha banga chu amachu kithatna hitam?"},"8":{"text":"Solam hui anun banga, nangman amanu chu nalungsat na-a nanodoh-a, chule gal le sohchan na-a naumsah ding ahi"},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun hiche hin Jacob khansetna chu asop ngima, hichehi achonset lahmangna ding chu ahin, ngunsong kivochip jengjung banga maicham songho abol tengle thingbong hole, milimho dingdoh talou ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kulpi kikhokhum khopi jongchu kamhel intin, chenna munchu kidalha-a gamthip banga umding; chua bongnou kivah-a, chua chu kolding, hichea thingbaho chu anehjou ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Abahho chu agot tengle mangthah intin, numei ho hunga meija atidiu ahi. Ajehchu hetkhen themna neilou mite ahijeh-un, asempao chun achunguva hepina aneilouding, agongdoh paovin khohsahna amusah louhel ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule hitiding ahi: Pakaiyin vadunglen kama pat Egypt vachadung geijin long'intin, chule vo Israel chate nangho khat khatna naki khopdiu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule hitiding ahi: Sumkon lentah chu hung kimut intin, Assyria gama mangthah dehdeh hole, Egypt gama akinodohho chu hunguva, Jerusalem lhangthenga Pakai chu ahoudiu ahi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ohe Ephraim, jukhamho hoithona lallukhuh chu ada ahi! Ahoina loupi chu pahcha pultheibou ahin, hichu phaicham gampha ho-a anemsesa ho luchung chu ahi.","title":"Ephraim Kigihna"},"2":{"text":"Vetan, Pakaiyin thahat le hat chungnung khat aneijin, hichu huile gelin, thil sumangthei khopihui tobang, twilen nasatah let thethu banga akhutna tolla aselhah ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ephraim jukhamho hoithona lallukhuh chu kengtonoija kilhobeh ding ahiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chule damphai, amel hoina loupitah chu pahcha pullha hung hintin, nipi masanga theiga masa pulbang hiding; hichu avepan amua akhutna um nalaija anehjoupai tobang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule janel Pakai chu loupina lallukhuh le, amite amoh umcha sun dinga hoina lallukhuh-a hungpang ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule thutanlhahna-a toupa dinga thutanna lhagao le, kotpi phunga gal lenokit ho dinga thahatna hungpang ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla amahon jong ju-a konin jong setna aneijun; jukhama konin lampama apetnun, thempuho le themgao hon ju-a konin setna aneijun; jukhama konin lampan apetnun amaho athilmuhouva aseuvin, amaho thutan na-a akipaluve.","title":"Isaiah le Judah Themgao Jukhamho"},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu dokhang jouse chu loh le thilboh adimin; hitichun muntheng aumtapoi."},"9":{"text":"Koichun hetna ahila, koichun tahsan lhongpi ahetkhensah dingham? Noichep banghole noija kona kiloidohho chu ahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu chondan chunga chu chondan, umtei ding, chondan chunga chodan, thugol chunga thugol, thugol chunga thugol; hia themkhat khu-a themkhat."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche mite hengahi aman kam-oh le paochoma thu aseiding ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 14:21."},"12":{"text":"Aman ahenguva, hichehi thachol te nakicholdo sah theinao choldona chu ahin, hichehi kilha jangna ahi. Amahonla angaisahdeh pouve, ati."},"13":{"text":"Ahinla amaho henga Pakai thu vangchu; chondan chunga chondan, chondan chunga chondan; thugol chunga thugol, thugol chunga thugol; chule hia themkhat, khu-a themkhat, amaho cheova nunglhuh uva, chule mangthah diu, thanga oh-uva akimatdoh theinadiu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hichejeh chun nangho nahsalou mite, Jerusalem'a chengho chunga vaihomten Pakai thuchu ngaijun.","title":"Zion'a Dinga In-ning Khompi"},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu nanghon thina toh kitepna kasemun, thikholkhul toh kitepna kaneitaovin; kivohna twipi alonlet teng jongle kahengu ahinphah tahlou dingu ahi. Ajehchu keihon jouthu beldingin kamangun, jouthun kakisel uve nati uve."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin ati, veuvin keiman Zion'a inbul songkhat patepna song, manlutah in-ning song, inbulphu tahbeh khat kakoije, atahsanchan chu kicha louding ahi, ati.","ref":"Labu 118:22-23; Rom 9:13; 10:11; 1 Pet 2:6."},"17":{"text":"Thutandih chu gol kaina-a kaman ding, chonphatna chu thil vettohna-a kaman ding ahi. Gellin jouthu umna mun chu alhohmang ding, kiselna ding munchu twijin achup mangding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule thina toh nakitepnao chu kisubeija, thikholkhul toh nakinopto nao chu dinglou ding ahi; vohna twipi alonlet tengle hiche chun nachotpeh dingu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hichu ahung kitola patna, hiche chun nalah khah jing dingu ahi. Ajehchu jingkahsim jingkah seh-a; asun ajanna hung kitolding; thulhut hetkhen dingchu kisuh boina bou hiding ahitai."},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu jalkhun chu mikhat kilhon nathei sangin achomjon; akichuna jongchu ama kijelnathei sanga neojo ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu aman anatoh kidangchu atohthei nadingle, athilbol kidangchu amolso theina dinga; Pakai chu Perazim molsang banga hungthouva, Gibeon phaija banga chu lunghang ding ahi.","ref":"Josh 10:10-12; 2 Sam 5:20; 1 Thusm 14:11."},"22":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun nelpeh hat ho chu hidaovin, nakihen nao lhoucheh sah getninte, ajehchu janel Pakai Pathen'a konin, leiset pumpi geija suhmang nading kigong chu kajatan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Nana sung unlang, ka aw ngaijun; ngaijunlang, kathusei jaovin.","title":"Pathen Chihna"},"24":{"text":"Muchi thena dinga loukaipan nilhum keija akai hinam? Aman aleilhangho akaldoh-a avohngem hinam?"},"25":{"text":"Aman atol alaicham tengle lengmusel le Pathikhom athehih-a, sakol changpi le suhlouchangpi, chule butun jong amuncheh-a athe hilou ham?"},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu a-Pathen'in ama ahila, gellhuh theinadia amachu ahilchah ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu lengmusel ho chu changmola kivo ngailou; pathikhom chunga chu kangtalai kang kitang jilou ahi. Ahinla lengmusel chu tenggola chule pathikhom chu moltuma bou kivoji ahi."},"28":{"text":"Changlhah ding changchu akisubongjin; ajehchu a-itih-a vohtho louding, akangtalai kanga jong kitangkeh louding, asakol chungtouho jong asuh bongsah deh louding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hiche jonghi thumopthem kidangtah; thilbol lama nasapenpa janel Pakaiya hung kondoh ahi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ohe Ariel, Ariel, David chenna khopi nada ahi! Akum kum-in belap unlang, ganlhaina sa thasah uvin.","title":"Jerusalem Hamsetna"},"2":{"text":"Ariel chu kabolgentheija, chua gihsalnale lungdonna umding ahin, chule hichu keija dinga Ariel tobanga hiding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule nangma dounan nakimvela ngahmun sangting, galkul sangtah kakaikhuma, kulpiho kakhokhum ding nahi."},"4":{"text":"Chutia chu kisulha ding nahin, tolla kona nahung paodoh-a nathusei chu leivuija konin olcha gingding, na aw chu tolla kona thilhavop khat aw bang hintin, nathusei chu leivuija kona aw thopma gingdoh dingbou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chukalvalin nagamchom mipi ho chu leivui sipahbep hintin, tijat umtah mipite chu changsi lengmang bangbep hintin: henge, gangta-a chutiphung ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin van ginna, chule inlingle husa kithong, hui le go chule khopihuija, chule kavam helthei meikonga nahungvil ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule Ariel douna-a galsat namjouse-a kon mipi ho, amale agal manchah sat ho jouse, chule abolgenthei jouse geija janmang bangbep hiding ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Chule mi gilkelin mang aneija, chule veuvin, amanga chu an aneh-a, ahivanga akhahdoh phatna la vachom dehlou: ahiloule midangchah in mang aneiteng vetan twi ana donna, ahivanga akhahdoh phatna la ngoideh jeng, asunga adangchah abangbep ahijing jeng banga: Zion lhang douna-a galsat namjouse mipi chu chutobangbep hiding ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Nanghotah khongai unlang, datmouvin; kapmun lang, pengdoh uvin; amaho akhamun, ju-a konvang ahipouve; alon lele uvin khamnatheija konvang ahipoi.","title":"Nahsah Louva Kikoi Gihna"},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin nachung uva imutsetna lhagao abuhlhah-a, namitnu asinsah ahitai. Themgaoho le navaipo hou, mitvah neiho akhuchahtan ahi.","ref":"Rom 11:8."},"11":{"text":"Chule nanghodin mu neijousehi lekhabua thuchengho kisinkha khum tobang ahung hitan, hichu lekhathem khat henga kichoija; hichehi simin, tia nahenga katao ahi: Chule aman akisinkha jeh-in kasimtheipoi, ati tobang ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Chuin lekhabu chu athemlou khat akipen, katao ahi, hichehi simtemin atile, aman keima kathempoi, atin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin aseije: hiche mite hin akamuvin einaijun, amuh uvah eijabollun, ahinla alungu vang keija kona gamlatah ahin, keima eiginu jong mihem chondan thuhila konbou ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 15:8-9; Mrk 7:6-7."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun ven, hiche mite lah-a hi thilbol kidangtah, thilbol kidangle datmo umtah jong kasodoh ding ahi. Ajehchu amichingteu chihna chu mangthah ding, chule ahegilho hetnachu kiselding ahitai.","ref":"1 Cor 1:19."},"15":{"text":"Pakaiya kona selding giltah-a holtechu ohe adau ahi. Anatoh-u chu muthim lah ahin, kon eimuvem? kon eihetnum? atiuvin ahi.","title":"Ahunglhung Ding Kinepna"},"16":{"text":"Tahbeh-in thil akhup athala naleu chu beldengpa khutna hahlei banga naki ngaitou ahi. Ajehchu athilsem chun asempa chu aman eisem hibeh am? atia ahiloule thil gontohsa chun agongtohpa chu aman hetkhenna aneipoi atiji em?","ref":"Isai 45:9."},"17":{"text":"Lebanon chu leiphatah sosah-a aumdingle, leiphatah chu gammang banga akigelding chu chom chakhat kahbou hung hitalou dingham?"},"18":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule na-ngongin lekhabua thuchu ajah-a, mitcho ho mitnin khojinle muthim lah-a kona jong amudiu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Minunnemho jong Pakaiya halna-a akipanao pungding, milah a mivaichate jong Israel mithengpa-a kipahdiu ahitai."},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu gin umtah khatchu imalou akisotan, mi i-sah loupa chu akisutanin, khan-gitlouna velhi jingho chu akisubeitan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hicheho chun thu cheng khatnin mi akipalsahjin, kotpi phunga phosal achan nadin thang akampehjin, midihtah chu ima hilouhela koijin aumtan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hijeh chun hitihin Jacob insung thudolla Abraham lhatdoh-a Pakai chun aseitai, tu-a Jacob jahcha talou ding, amaijong dang talou ding ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla achate kakhutsohho chu alah-a amutengle, kamin thensah-un tin, Jacob'a mithengpa chu athen sah uva, Israel Pathen chu agindiu ahitai."},"24":{"text":"Lhagaova suhkhel neihon jong ahin hetkhen themuva, aphunchel ho jong tahsan lhongpi kihildiu ahi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin doubolnom chate, midang kithumop kisan-a, keija nahsahlouva koiho, chonset chunga chonset bolbe theina dinga keima lhagaova hilouva khukhumna dang khatna khukhum ho; ohe, adau ahi!","title":"Egypt to Kitepna Sem Pannabei Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Kathusei ngaicha louva Egypt'a chengdinga chesuh ho, Pharoah hatna-a kihatsah dingle, Egypt le-lim tahsan dinga cheho, ohe, adau ahi!"},"3":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Pharoah hatna chu najachat nao hungsoh-a, Egypt le-lim tahsan nachu nakisuhmo nao hung hiding ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu amilenteu Zoan'a aumun, apalaihou Hanes-a ahunguve."},"5":{"text":"Amaho jousen amaho phatchomsah joulou miho chu ajachat piuvin, panpina le phatchomna hilouvin jachatnale housetna joh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Lhanglam gamsaho pohgih; lungkhamnale lungnatna gam, chua konchun keipi noule keipitah, gulse le gulsum ahungin, amahon aphatchom sah loudiu miho henga, sangan golho lengkou chunga ahao naole, sangongsao tinghem chunga agouho chu pouvinte."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu Egypt miten pannabei jin panpiuvintin, chule apanajong umponte. Hijeh-a chu keiman hiche thua kasei ahi, athahatnao chu thabei pannabei ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tun chenlang, atonsot atonsot phat hunglhung dingin, amasanguva dokhanga chun suninlang, lekhabua chingin.","title":"Thumanglou Mite"},"9":{"text":"Hichehohi kiphin mite, joubol chate, Pakai danthupeh ngailouding chate ahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Amahon mitvah neiho jah-a, muhih un; themgaoho henga thildih neigaopeh hih-un lang, kahenguva thungei ngei neisei peh-un alhembou neigaopeh-un."},"11":{"text":"Lampi dalhan, lamsih-a kiheidoh unlang, Israel mithengpa chu keiho masanga konin phapoh tahih-un atiuve."},"12":{"text":"Hijehhin Israel mithengpan aseitai, nangho hiche thu nanah sahmo uva suhgenthei nale golkehna natahsan uva chua na-umden jeh un;"},"13":{"text":"hiche jehchun hiche khangitlouna chu nachung uva bang sangtah aselai pohjah dingkon, photlot mitphet kahlouva hung chimlha ding tobang nahidiu ahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chule aman hiche beldengpa bel suhkeh ahal halla achip banga asuhchipma; akhen louding, apokehna halchu meithuh-a kona mei-am lonading, ahiloule kokhuh-a kona twi thaldohna ding jeng jong kimulouding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai Pathen Israel mithengpan, hungkilea choldona chu huhhing nachan na hiding; thipbehnale tahsanna chu nahatnao hiding ahin, nangho nanompouve, ati."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon ahipoi sakol chunga katou uva kajamdiu ahi, nati uvin, hijeh-a chu nangho najamdiu, chule gangtah-a kajamdiu ahi nati uvin, hijeh-a chu nanungdel hou jong gangtah hidiu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mikhat phosala; sangkhat jamding, minga phosala; molvum'a melchihna kitah bangle, lhang chunga galponlap banga nakidalhah kahseuva najamdiu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nangho nakhoto theinadiuva Pakaiyin nangao ahi, ajehchu nachung uva hepina aneitheina dinga ama kichoisang ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakai chu thutan Pathen ahin; ama ngahte jouse anunnom ahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Ajehchu mitechu Jerusalem'a Zion'a chenguntin: nakakit louheldingu ahitan; napennao awginna chu aman nakhoto lheh dingu ahin; aman hichu ajahtengle nadonbut jengdiu ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Amite Phatthei Abohding"},"20":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin hesohna changlhah, suhgimna twi napejeng jongleu, nahil hou chu ningchonga kichonlut louheldiu, namitnun nahil hou chu amujoh dingu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule nangho nakijet heijuva chule nakiveihei tengule, nanunglam uva thakhatna hichehi lampi ahi, jotnun, tia nanunglam uva thukhat kiseichu nanauva najahdiu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Nanghon dangka milim kikhegho tomnale, sana milim kilhaho kijepna nasuhboh diu ahin, pon thenglou napai uva, ahenguva hia konin chemangin tia naseidingu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chutengle aman namuchi diuvin gotwi hinpeuvin natin, chutia chu nangin leisetna nathe-a, leija anneh pungding, hichu phatahle nengtah hiding ahin; chuche nitengle na ganchate chu ganlhaina munlen tah-a kivahdiu ahitai."},"24":{"text":"Chutobangma chu bongchal hole sangan nou lou kaihon, chang japnale changlona-a kijapchilsa ngen gancha antheng anehdiu ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Chule kithana nasatah nikho-a insangho chimtengle, molsang chungle lhangsang chung tina, vapile vadungho chule luidungho hung longdiu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chukalvala jong Pakaiyin amite maput atoma, akijepnau mahaho adamsah nitengle, lhavah chu nisa vah bangjenga, nisa vah chu ajat sagi jenna nisagi vah kigom bangkhopma vahding ahitai."},"27":{"text":"Veuvin Tonsot Pakai minchu gamlatah-a konin lunghang tah-in ahunge, chule hiche pohgih chu gihtah ahi. Akamsung chu thangtomna adimsetnin; alei chu kavamjengthei meikong tobang ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Assyria Gotna Apehding"},"28":{"text":"Ahu hai chu ngong geija longlet vadungsoh abangin, namtin vaipi manthah na tengsa-a lochildin agon, chule suhkhelsah nadinga mitin kama kamdal umcheh ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Nanghon kutpitheng kimanjan banga la khat najah dingu ahin, chule mikhat kuli mutpum ma; Israelte thahatpa Pakai molchunga chebanga lungkipa najong nanei dingu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Pakaiyin a-aw loupitah kijahna ding bolintin, lunghan nasatah toh, halvam thei meikong toh, huipi le gopi toh, chule gel'a alunghana khut chu alhahding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai awgin'a kona Assyria te chu molla kinolhu ding kisumang ding ahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin achunga angapding kivohna tenggolin aphahding, munjouse-a chu khongchale selangdah kithoding ahi. Aman gal mun kihotling mun'a chu akisatpi ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Ajehchu Tophet hi malaija anakisudetsa ahitan; ahi, hichu lengpa dinga kigongsadem ahin; thuh tahle lentah-a asem ahi. Chua kikhol chu meile thing tamtah ahin, Pakai hu-hai chu meile kaat luija long deujeju bang ahi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Panpi hola Egypt'a chesuh-a, sakol ho chunga kingaija, sakol kangtalai ho tamjeh-a tahsan; sakol touthemho hatbehseh jeh-a tahsana, Israel mithengpa lam velou, Pakai hollou helho chu, ohe! ada ahiuve.","title":"Pathen'in Jerusalem Avenbit Ding"},"2":{"text":"Achuti vangin amajong michingtah ahin, thilse hinlhun sah intin, athu ho chu alekou louding: thilsebol insungho douva hung kipana, khanset bolte panpiho chu adoujoh ding ahibouve."},"3":{"text":"Tun Egypt mite chu mihem bou ahiuvin, Pathen ahipouve; Asakol-hou jong tahsaphe bou ahin, lhagao ahipouve. Pakaiyin akhut ahinlhandoh tengle mipanpipa chu lhu-a, chule akipanpipa jong lhuding ahin, ania lhukop lhonding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin aseitai, keipi bahkai chule anou asaneh hon chunga akitumhon banga, kelngoi chingho tamtah adou dinga akikoudoh tengle, a-aw uchu kichadeh pontin, ahusaova jong nemlha deh louding ahi. Chutia chu janel Pakai chu Zion mol le alhang dinga galsatna hung kumlha ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vachate alenlele banga, chutia chu janel Pakaiyin Jerusalem ahonbit ding ahin; ahonbitna ahuhdoh ding; chule akalchuh-a akhehdoh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Israel chaten nasatah-a adoupao heng lama hung kilekit teijuvin."},"7":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile, hiche nikho chule mitinin nadangka milimhou le nasana milimu chonsetna dinga nakhut tah uva nakisem muchu ahin paimang cheh dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chutengle Assyria chu chemjam'a louding, mihatpa chemjam jong hilou, minoinung pa chemjam jong hilou chun ama avallhum ding; ahinla ama chemjam'a kona jamdoh-a, akhangdongteu chu suhnohphah-a umding ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Chule aman tijatna-a akulpidet akalchuh-a, chule pipuihon ponlap chu akichatdiu ahi, tin Zion'a ameikong uma, Jerusalem'a alhumpi umpa Pakai chun aseije."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Veuvin, leng khatnin chonphatna-a vai ahomding, chule pipuihon thutan dihtah-a vai ahomdiu ahi.","title":"Chonphatah Lengpa"},"2":{"text":"Chule mikhat chu khohuija kona kiselna munle huipi le gopi-a kona kivenbitna hiding; gamgolaija twi umna vadung le cholna gama songpi lenkhat lim tobang hunghi ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule khomuho mit chu thimlouva, khojaho chun angaidiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Lungkinon jong hetkhen themtheina hetna aneija, pao oh hon jong kichentah-a thu aseidingu ahitai."},"5":{"text":"Mikhangse chu mihongphal kiti talou ding, migenthei chu ninglhing dehlouhel ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Migilou chun gitlou thujeng aseijin, ajehchu phatlhemna kijil dingle, Pakai douna-a adihlou seidingin, gilkelte oisung akeova umsahdingle dangchah te donding thonsah dingin mi nunse chun thusese seijintin, alungsunga khan gitlou abolding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Migenthei chu amanchahho jong phaloutah ahin, milhasam hon thudihtah aseiteng jongle, mivaichaho suhmang hela aum nadingin, thujouva jona thet umtah lungthim giloutah apodohjin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla mihongphal tah-in hongphalin, hongphalna thilho agongdohjin; ama hongphalna thilho-a chu ding jingding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nangho numei ho thoudoh uvin; khohsahna bei chanuten ka-aw ngaijunlang; kathusei jahin nana sungun.","title":"Thutanna le Semthahna"},"10":{"text":"Khohsahbei numei nangho nikhoho le kumho tamtah-a nalungkham diu ahi. Ajehchu lengpithei hungga louding, aga lona hung umlou ding ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Numei nangho kithinguvin, khohsah bei nangho lungkham mun, kihoh lhaovin, nakeuvin umun lang, nakong uvah khaodip pon kigah-un."},"12":{"text":"Loumun pha le, lengpigui gapha dinga, lunghem ding ahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Kamite gama lingle khao hungpou doh ding ahin; henge, khopi kipana pena insung kipah jouse-a jong chutiding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu leng inpiho kidalha-a; mitamna khopi chu dalhah-a umding; galkul hole daivei insangho jong a-itih-a dinga gam sanganho, kinomtol nale ganchahon ho hamnehna mun hung hiding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chunga kona lhagao ichunguva ahung kibuh lhah-a, gamthip lou mun pha ahungsoa, lou mun pha gammanga akigel kahse-a;"},"16":{"text":"Chutengle gamthipma chu thutan lhahna uma, loumun pha-a chu chonphatna umden ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chonphatna natohchu chamna hintin; chule hiche chonphatna chun a-itih-a ol-heuna le aphotchena asodohsah ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Kamite chu chamdela umnale dettah-a chendetna inmun, chule ol-heuva choldona mun'a cheng taovintin;"},"19":{"text":"gellhah tengle gammang chunga hunglhantin; chule khopi chu mun nema kikoiding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Twipang dunga muchi tu-a nangho anunnom nahiuvin; chukoma bongchal le sangan lhatlutsah-a nangho anunnom nahiuve."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangla kichom khalouva michompa; amahonla nangma tahsanlel louva, mikitahlou pa; nada ahi. Michom nangah phatle, nangma nakichom ding; nangman kitahlouna nangah phatle, amahon nangma natahsan leldiu ahi.","title":"Kithopi Ngehna-a Taona"},"2":{"text":"Vo Pakai, neilungset in, keihon nangma kangah jinguve, jingkahsehle aban nu hinlang, thohgenthei laile eihuh hingpao vin hung pangin."},"3":{"text":"Thunoh husagin chun miho ajam mangun; nangma nakichoi sangna-a chun namtin thecheh-in aumtai."},"4":{"text":"Nathil chomdoh chu lungmul kikhol khom banga kikhol khom ding ahi. Khaokhopi suhle tunga achoplele banga achunguva lhai lele ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chungsanga um ahijeh-in Pakai chu akichoisangtai. Aman Zion chu thutandih nale chonphat na-in adipsohtan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chihnale hetna chu nahinkhodetna le nahuhhingna thahat hunghi ding ahin, Pakai gin chu ama-a dinga goukhol ahi."},"7":{"text":"Veuvin, amihangsan hou pama penguntin; chamna palaiho chu lhasetah-in kapmunte."},"8":{"text":"Lamlhongpiho chu akeoheltan, chule vahlea athipdeltai. Aman thulhuna asukeh-in, khopiho i-asahpon, koimacha anahsahtapoi."},"9":{"text":"Leiset hi alunghemin ahesoh-e, Lebanon ajahchan lhamlhah ahitai, Sharon chu gamthip abangin; Bashan le Karmel'in aga hou ahotpul taovin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tonsot Pakaiyin; tun keima thouving ting; tun kichoisang inting; tun kidomsang tange; ati.","title":"Pakaiyin Amelmate Agihsal"},"11":{"text":"Nanghon changsi navop uva, chang kung nahindingu, nahaiju husa chun mei tobanga nakahvam dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mitin chu ngunsong kihal kong banguntin, ling kisatlha-a meija kihal tobang hidiu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Gamlatah-a um nanghon ipi kabol em ngaijun; chule naicha umhon jong kathahatdan heuvin."},"14":{"text":"Zion'a michonseho akichauvin, miphalhem ho tijatnin alungdongun ahi. Ilah uva halvamna meikongto chengdinga koiham, ilah uva tonsotna kongjing meito chengdinga koiham?"},"15":{"text":"Chonphatna-a vahlea dihtah-a thuseipa, bolgentheija kona phatchomna i-sah loupa, nehguh lahna-a kona akhut thinglhapa, thisona ding thu jah-a kona akol kisipma, thilse mu-a kona amit singpa chu;"},"16":{"text":"amachu chungsanga chengintin; akihuhna munchu songa kisem kulpi hiding, nehding changlhah ama kipe-a adonding twi jong amuteiding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Namitnin lengpa hoina amu-a, gamlatah-a um gamchu amudoh dingu ahi.","title":"Ahunglhung ding Loupina"},"18":{"text":"Nalungsungin kichatna nasatah nangaito ding ahi. Danthusunpa hoiba hitam? Alalutpa hoiba hitam? Daivei insangho simtohpa hoiba hitam?"},"19":{"text":"Nangin kichat umtah mi namutahlou ding, giltah-a paodoh mi nahetchen theilou lei-oh mi namutah louhel ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kut loupiho kiman nading Zion khopi chunglam chu vetemin, namit tenin mongtah-a chenna Jerusalem; phetlhah louding houbuh kisonna akhom khatcha kibotdoh louhel ding; akhaojang jong khatcha kibottan louding chu munnate."},"21":{"text":"Ahinla loupi Pakai chu eiho dinga luidung lenho le luidung neoho hiding ahin, Chua chu kong innei kongtol ho chelouding ahin, kong innei hattah jong chelouding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Pakai chu ithu tanpao ahin, Pakai chu danthu eipepao ahin, Pakai chu ilengpao ahin; aman eihuh hingdiu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Nakong tolna ponkhao ho akikangin; apondalu khombul chu ahendet theipouvin, pondal chu ajahthei pouve. Chuin gala thil kichom tamtah akihomun, elbaijin jong akilah-e."},"24":{"text":"Chule chua chenga chun kadampoi atilouding, chua cheng mitechu akhansetnao kingaidam ding ahi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Namtin vaipi thungaidin hungnai junlang, nangho mipite ngai phaovin, leisetle asunga cheng jousen, vannoi le ama-a kon hungkondoh thiljousen ngaijuhen.","title":"Pathen'in Amelmate Gotna Apehding"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai thangtomna chu namjouse chunga, chule alunghana chu agalsat jousete chunga aumtan, amaho chu asumangsoh helin, thagamheldin mithat ho hengah apedohsohtan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amiteu kithat ho jong kipaidoh ding, chule athilonguva kona a-uiju kikhong doh-a, lhangho chu athisan utoh junlhah thading ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule vanlaijola thil um jouse junlha-a, vanho chu lekha kijelbanga hung kijelding; chule avan janel jouse chu lengpiguija kona ana pulbanga, chule theichang phunga aga apulhah banga pullha diu ahitai.","ref":"Matt 24:29; Mrk 13:25; Luk 21:26; Tph 6:13-14."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu kachemjam chu van'a notvala umding, veuvin, hichu Edom chungle kagaosap te chunga thutanlha dinga hung khumlha ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Ezek 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Obad 1-14; Mal 1:2-5."},"6":{"text":"Pakai chemjam chu thisanin adimtan, chule chemjam chu thaovin atomtan; hichu kelngoi le kelchal thisanto, kelngoichal kal thao ahi. Ajehchu Pakai chun Bozrah'a ganlhaina aneijin, Edom gama kithana nasatah aume."},"7":{"text":"Chule gambongchal kineiho chu amahotoh hungsuh thantin, bongchal til kilalouho chu bongchal atil kilaho toh, chule agamu chu thisanin chup mintin, aleivui chu thaova jollha ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu hichehi Pakai phulahna nikho ahin, chule Zion kinepna le khohsahna kum chu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule chua vachadung ho chu thingnaivom hungsoh-a, chule aleivuiho chu kaatsong hungsoh ding, chuche gamchu thingnaivom kadeujeju hungsoh ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hichu sunle jana mitlouhel ding, ameikhu chu tonsotna kitungdoh ding, akhang akhanga agoh-a uma, atonsot atonsotna koimachan ahopa louhel ding ahi.","ref":"Tph 14:11; 19:3."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla twivamuhsao le vakeng'in lo intin; sumbupi le vavom asunga chengdio ahin; hiche chunga chu lungnohna khaole khaidihna songho kikhaiding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chua milal ho chu lenggama dingin kou untin; koimacha vang umtalou ding, chule aleng chapate jouseu imacha hilouding ahitaove."},"13":{"text":"Amanu leng inpiho-a lingphung, chule akulpidet hou sunga sachah le theimi hung kehdoh ding, Dragonho chennale sumbupi ho honsung hung hiding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Neldi gam, gamsaho jong twikol gama gamsahoto kitoh untin, chule lhomi chun agol kou intin, sumbupi chu chua chun kicholdontin, amadinga choldona mun amuding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chua chu sumbupi lentah-in buh ase-a, atwi athah ding, alhaving noija ahuikhom ding ahi. Chua chu muthong ho jong akopcheh-a hung kikhom ding ahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Pakai lekhabu holdoh-un lang simun; hichehohi khatcha thonlou ding ahi; akopto lhasam umlou ding ahi. Ajehchu kam'in thu apeh-a ama lhagao ngeichun akhopkhom ahitai."},"17":{"text":"Chule aman amahodin vang asanin, akhut tah-in khaovin aten, ahopkhen pehtai. Amahon hichu atonsotna alouva, akhang akhanga hichea chu chengding ahiuve."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gammang lah le gamthip lah chu amaho dingin hungkipah intin, chule neldigam chu thanoma pahchapah banga pahding ahi.","title":"Thenna Lampi"},"2":{"text":"Nengchetnin pah-intin, kipah le lasah-in thanominte. Lebanon loupina ama kipeding, Karmel le Sharon ahoinapen, Pakai loupina le i-Pathen'u gunchena chungnung penchu amudingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Khut hatlouho hatsah-un lang, khup ngoiho chu dindet sah-un.","ref":"Heb 12:12."},"4":{"text":"Mi meidoite chu hitin seipeh-un, kicha hih-un! veuvin, phula dingle lethuh dinga na Pathen'u hungding; ama hunga nangho nahuhdoh diu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chutengle mitchote mit kihasah intin, chule na-ngongte kho kijahsah ding ahitai.","ref":"Matt 11:5; Luk 7:22."},"6":{"text":"Chutengle elbai chu sakhi banga kichoma, paomo leichun la asahding, ajehchu gamthipma twiho chule neldi gama vachadung ho hungput doh ding ahi.","ref":"Ezek 29:6-7."},"7":{"text":"Chule tolgo chu twikul hungsoh doh-a, chule dangchah na gama chu twisam hungsoh ding, Dragon ho chenna le akolnaova chu hampa toh pumpeng le phaipheng hungkeh ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chua chun lamlhongpi khatle lampi khat umintin, chuche lampi chu thenna lampi kitiding ahi. Atheng louvin achung aho louding; amavang hichu amaho ding ahi. Chule vahle ho ngoljong leu hichea chu adihlou abolloudiu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chua chu keipi khatcha umtalou ding; sahingne gamsa khatcha jong hichea chu kaltou louding; hichea chu kimulouhel ding ahitai. Ahinla hichemun chu lhatdamsaten bou aho dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule Pakai lhatdohsate hungkileu vintin, Zion'a hunguva tonsot kipana aluchung uva umding ahi. Amahon kipanale thanopna aneijuva, lungdon nale khoisatna jam mangding ahitai."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun, Hezekiah lengpa lengchankal kumsom le kumli alhinin, ahitin ahi, Assyria lengpa Sennacherib chu Judah gam khopi satdin ahungtouvin, alasohtan ahi.","title":"Assyria'in Jerusalem Agih (2 Leng 18:13-27 ; 2 Thusm 32:1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Assyria lengpan Lachish'a konin Rabshakeh chu sepai tamtah toh Jerusalem'a Hezekiah lengpa henga asoltan ahi. Chuin ama ponsoppa lou lamlhongpia twikul sahnung twilam panga chun anadinge."},"3":{"text":"Chuphatnin insung vaipo Hilkiah chapa Eliakim le Danthusunpa Shebna chule thuchingpa Asaph chapa Joah toh ahunguve."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Rabshakeh-in ahenguva aseijin, tun nanghon Hezekiah jah-a, leng loupitah Assyria lengpa chun hitin aseije, natahsan kingapna chu ipi ham? ati, tin gaseijun ati."},"5":{"text":"Keiman kati ahi, nangin (ahinla hicheho chu mohthu maimaibou ahi) galsatnadin lunggelna le thahatna kaneije natin ahi. Tun koichunga natahsana, keima douna-a gal naboljeng hitam?"},"6":{"text":"Ven, nangin hiche peng tenggol chipsa Egypt mitehi natahsan ahin, achunga chu mi akingaile akhutna lutna asutding ahi. Egypt lengpa Pharoah chu ama tahsan jouse chunga chutiji ahi.","ref":"Ezek 29:6-7."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla nangin kahenga keihon Pakai ka Pathen'u katahsanu ahi, tijongleu chun; ama chu Hezekiah'in amunsangho le amaichamho alahmangpeh-a, Judah le Jerusalem mite jah-a nanghon hiche maicham masanga bou nahoudiu ahi ati hilouham?"},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun kangeh nahi, ka Pakai pa Assyria lengpa henga kitepna neijin, nangin achunguva touding mi naneiding poule sakol sangni pengkate."},"9":{"text":"Kapu sohte sepai lamkai neopen khat maichu iti naheimanga, sakol kangtalai le sakol galmiho jeh-a Egypt chunga natahsan na-ngap jeng ham?"},"10":{"text":"Tu-a keima Pakai panglouva hiche gam douva sumang dinga hungtouva kahiham? Pakaiyin kajah-a hiche gam doudin chetou vinlang, gasumangin eiti."},"11":{"text":"Chujouvin Eliakim le Shebna, chule Joah chun Rabshakeh jah-a nahenga katao ahi, nasohte hengahin Syria te paovin thu seijin; ajehchu hichu keihon kaheuve, palvuma um miho hetthei Judah paovin seihih-in, atiuve."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla Rabshakeh chun kapu chun napule nang hengabou hiche thuho seidinga eihinsol ham? Aman palvuma touho khun aeh-u akineh theina diule, ajunu akidon theina diuva ahenguva eihinsol hilouham?"},"13":{"text":"Chuin Rabshakeh adingin gingtah-in, Juda te paovin asamin; lengloupi Assyria lengpa thuseihohi ngaijun:","title":"Rabshakeh Taitomna"},"14":{"text":"Assyria lengpan hitihin aseije; Hezekiah'in nahuhdoh jouloudiu jeh in ama kilheplhahsah hih-un."},"15":{"text":"Hezekiah chun nangho Pakaiyin thonlouvin eihuhdoh untin hiche khopihi Assyria lengpa khutna kipedoh louhel ding ahi, tin natahsan sah daohen."},"16":{"text":"Hezekiah thu ngaihih un; Assyria lengpan thilpeh khatnin kinoptona neipeuvinlang, kahenga hungdoh-un; nalengpilei cheh kineh unlang, natheichangphung cheh kineh-un, chule mitinin natwikula twicheh kidonun;"},"17":{"text":"keiman nagam tobangu gam khatna changle lengpitwi umna gam changlhah le lengpitwi umna gam khatna kahungpui kahseuvin ati."},"18":{"text":"Chingtheijun, achutiloule Hezekiah'in Pakaiyin eihuhdoh naovinte tintin najollha getnunte. Assyria lengpa khutna kona namtin vaipi pathenho khattou agam huhdohpeh-a umkha tam?"},"19":{"text":"Hamath le Arphad mite pathenho hoiba ham? Sepharvaim pathenho chu hoija umam? Amahon kakhutna kona Samaria ahuhdoh beh-um?"},"20":{"text":"Hiche gamho pathen lah-a kakhutna kona agamu huhdoh-a koiham? Hitia chu Pakaiyin kakhutna kona Jerusalem ahuhdoh dingham? ati."},"21":{"text":"Ahinla amaho athipchetnun, thucheng khatchan adonbut pouve, ajehchu amachu donbut hih-un tin lengpa thulhahna aumtai."},"22":{"text":"Hitichun insung vaipo Hilkiah chapa Eliakim le lekhasunpa Shebna chule thuchingpa Asaph chapa Joah chun aponu kibottel pumin, Hezekiah henga ahungun Rabshakeh thusei ho chu ahung seipeh un ahi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Hezekiah lengpan hiche thuho chu ajah phatnin, apon abottelin, khaodip pon akikhuh-in, Pakai insunga aluttai.","title":"Hezekiah lengpan Isaiah Themgao Thumop Angeh (2 Leng 19:17)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin insung vaipo Eliakim le danthusunpa Shebna, chule upa thempuho chu khaodip pon silpumin, Amoz chapa Isaiah themgao henga asoltai."},"3":{"text":"Chuin amahon ajah-a, Hezekiah'in hitin aseije, tunihi hesoh nikho, kipho nikho chule taitom nikho ahi. Ajehchu chate pengding ahitan, ahinla apenlhah nadiu thahat aumpoi."},"4":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'in Rabshakeh thusei ho ajah theina dinga, amachu apu Assyria lengpan Pathen hing jumso dinga ahinsol ahin, Chule Pakai na Pathen'in athujahho chu abehlhah ding ahi. Hijeh chun akidalha amoh chengse dingin hatah-in taovin."},"5":{"text":"Chutichun Hezekiah lengpa sohte chu Isaiah henga ahungtaove."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Isaiah'in, ahenguva, napupao henga hiti ahi nasei dingu ahi, Pakai chun hitin aseije, Assyria lengpa sohten eitaitom nathu najah hou jehchun kichahih beh-un."},"7":{"text":"Veuvin, keiman achunga hui hattah solingting, chule aman thuthang khat jantin, agamlama kilekit ding, ama agamsung tah-a chemjam'a kalousah ding ahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chutichun Rabshakeh chu akilekitnin ahile Assyria lengpa Libna douna-a agalsatpet agatohtai. Ajehchu aman Lachish adalhatai ti thu anajatan ahi.","title":"Assyria'in Gihsalna Dang Ahinsolkit (2 Leng 19:8-19)"},"9":{"text":"Chuin Ethiopia lengpa Tirhakah nangtoh kisatdin ahung kondoh-e ti chungchang thukisei ajatai. Hichu ajah phatnin Hezekiah henga thupo khat asollin, ajah-a;"},"10":{"text":"Hitia hi Judah lengpa Hezekiah henga naseiding ahi. Assyria lengpa khutna Jerusalem kipedoh louding ahi tin nangin natahsan pa Pathen chu kilheplhahsah hihbeh-in."},"11":{"text":"Veuvin, Assyria lengten gamjouse iti asuhmang hellem, tithu najatai. Hichu ahile nangma huhdohna hideh ding hinam?"},"12":{"text":"kapateuvin anasuh mangho Gozam, Haran, Rezeph chule Telassar'a anaum Eden chate banga chu namtin vaipite pathenho chun amaho chu anahuhdoh nah um?"},"13":{"text":"Hamath lengpa, Arpad lengpa, Sepharvaim khopi lengpa Hena chule Ivah khopi lengpa hoija umtam?"},"14":{"text":"Chuin Hezekiah'in lekhathot chu thupole ho khutna konchun alan hichu asimtai. Chuin Hezekiah Pakai inlama achetouvin Pakai angsunga chun aphajaltai."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Hezekiah Pakai henga ataovin aseije,"},"16":{"text":"Vo janel Pakai, Israel Pathen, Cherubim ho kah-a chengjing pa, leiset lenggam jouse-a nangma Pathen nahin; nangma ngeibou nahi. Nangin vanle lei nanasemme.","ref":"Pot 25:22."},"17":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nana sungin lang ngaijin, vo Pakai, namit hasah inlang hinvetan, chule Senacherib'in hingjing Pathen housetna-a ahinthot thu jousehi ngaijin."},"18":{"text":"Atahbeh in Pakai, Assyria lenghon namjousele agamsunghou ahomkeovin akoi gamtaove."},"19":{"text":"Chule apathenhou meilhum sunga alehlutnuve, ajehchu amaho pathen hilouva mihem khutsem thingle songbou ahiuvin, hijeh-a chubou asuhmangu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun tuhin, vo Pakai, ka Pathen nu, akhutna konin nei huhdoh-un, chutile leiset lenggam jousen nangma Pakai, nangma sehbou Pakai nahichu hethei taovinte, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chujouvin Amoz chapa Isaiah chun Hezekiah henga mi asolin, Assyria lengpa Sennacherib douna-a kahenga nataona chu, Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije,","title":"Hezekiah Lengpa Henga Isaiah Thusei (2 Leng 19:20-37)"},"22":{"text":"ama chungchang Pakaiyin aseithu chu hichehi ahi. Nungah theng Zion chanun nangma nanoisen, nahsahmonan nanuisat in, Jerusalem chanun alu nathin khume."},"23":{"text":"Nangin koi nahousetna nataitom ham? Koi douna-a na aw nasansah-a chungsang lam nangatna navettou ham? Israel mitheng patah douna ahi."},"24":{"text":"Nasohte-a konin Pakai chu nahousen hitin naseije, ka kangtalai tamtah toh molsang ho geijin Lebanon lhang pangho-a hungtou vingting, cedar thingphung sanghole chahthing hoiho phuhlhung ting, agamgi munsang ho le Karmel gammanga kalhut ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Keiman kotong kalaijin twi kadontai. Chule kakengton aki-umkul munho-a vadung jouse kalho kangtai."},"26":{"text":"Hichehi iti kanabol hija, malaija patna iti kagontohsah-am, tichu sotna nanajah hitalou ham? Tu-a hi kagui lhunsah ahitai, Kulpi kikaikhum khopi ho akeova umsah-a, manthah na-a sevum dinga chu nangma nahiding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Hijeh chun achengho chu thalhom tah ahiuvin, amaho alungthoijun alungdonguve. Amaho chu loujaova hampa tobangle chang aphung lhin masanga huise semgot tobang ahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Hinla keiman naumna, napotdoh, nahunglut chule kachunga nalunghan kahenai."},"29":{"text":"Ajehchu kachunga nalunghannale, nahusa ginchu kanasunga ahunglut tai. Hijeh chun ka ngakoi nanah homa sutongting, nakama kakamdal kabuding, nahungna lampia chu kalehei kitding nahi."},"30":{"text":"Hichehi nangdinga amelchihna hiding ahi. Tukum achama kehho naneh ding, kum nina jongle chuche-a dondoh chu nen natin, chule kumthum nateng nanghon kitun lang, ki-atnun, chule lengpilei kibolin lang aga nen."},"31":{"text":"Chule Judah insungmi asohcha ahoidoh chengsen, jung akhosuh-a chule achunglamin ga aneiding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Ajehchu Jerusalem'a kona ahoidoh chengsele Zion'a kona asohchaho hung sohdoh ding ahiuve. Janel Pakai tompana-in hiche aboldoh ahi."},"33":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Assyria lengpa thudol hitihin aseijin, ama hiche khopi sunga hunglut louding, thalchang khatjong akap louding, amasanga lumdal puma jong hunglou ding, hiche satna dinga leikul jong asetlouding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Ahungna lampi mama-a chu kinungle-a, hiche khopiahi hung louhel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"35":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche khopihi keimajeh le kasoh David jeh-a kahuhdoh ding ahi, ati."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Pakai vantil chu apotdoh-in, Assyria ho ngahmuna sang jakhatle sangsomget le sanga athattai. Chuin jingpi-a ahungtho phatnun vetan; mithilong jeng anahitaove."},"37":{"text":"Chutichun Assyria lengpa Sennacherib chu apotdoh-in achen akilekitnin Nineveh'a achengtai."},"38":{"text":"Chutichun ahitin ahi. Aman a-pathen Nisroch insunga pathen ahoupetnin achapateni Adram-melech le Sharezer'in chemjamin athatlhonin, Armania gama ajamlut lhontai. Chuin achapa Esar-haddon chu akhelin alengchang tai."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hichelai chun Hezekiah chu thidingin anatan ahi. Chuin Amoz chapa Isaiah themgao chu ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, na-insung kisemtuptan, ajehchu nangma damdoh joulouva nathiding ahitai, ati.","title":"Hezekiah Dammo le Adamdoh (2 Leng 20:1-11 ; 2 Thusm 32:24-26)"},"2":{"text":"Chujouvin Hezekiah'in banglama amai aheijin, Pakai henga ataovin."},"3":{"text":"Vo Pakai kengeh nahi, namasanga thutah le lungdih po-a, chule namitmu-a thilpha kanabolho chu tun neigeldoh peh tan, ati.
