Chuin Hezekiah hakan akaptai."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thuchu Isaiah henga ahung lhungin."},"5":{"text":"Hezekiah henga chun chenlang gaseijin, Pakai napa David Pathen'in hitin aseije, nataona kajan, namitlhi lon kamutai; vetan, keiman nahinkho kum somle kumnga kajopbe ding ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chule keiman nangmale hiche khopihi Assyria lengpa khutna kona kahuh doh-a hiche khopihi kahonbit ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pakaiyin aseisa chu aboltei ding ahi, tihi Pakaiya kona namelchihna ding chu ahi;"},"8":{"text":"Vetan, keiman nisa lim chu hinlepui kitningting, Ahaz maikoh-a lhumsuhsa chu kalsoma kanungchon ding ahi. Chutichun alhumsuhsa-a konchun nisa chu kalsom anungchontan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Judah lengpa Hezekiah damlouva auma ahung damdoh phatna athilsut chu hichehi ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kahin nikho kisumanga thikholkhul kam jonding kahitan, kahin kumkho umnalai ho chu lahpeh kahitai, kanatin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pakai muponge, chule mihing gamachun Pakai le vannoi'a cheng mihemchu mukit taponge kanatin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Kakhanghi achemangin, kelngoi chingpa pon in bangin akichonmangtai. Kahinkhohi pon kikhong bangin akijel doh tai. Natah-a kisuh natna-a eisuhmang ding ahi. Sun-apat jankhang geija neikichai sah ding ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Jingkah geijin kakou kouvin, keipi bangin chutichun kagu jouse subongintin, sun-apat jangeija neikichai sah ding ahitai."},"14":{"text":"Chule pelpa le vakengsang bangin kaham hamin, vahui bangin kamao maove. Chunglam vetnan kamit teni akhamtai. Vo Pakai eiki sugenthei tai, neivesui jin."},"15":{"text":"Ipi seitang em? Aman kahenga aseijin, ama maman abolchai tai. Kahinna hi gimtah-in kahinkho lhumkeijin oltah-in chejingjeng tange."},"16":{"text":"Vo Pakai hitiho jal hin mite ahingjingin, hicheng thil jouse-a hi kalhagao hinna hi uma ahi. Chutichun nangin neidamsah kitnin natin, neihinsah kitnin nate."},"17":{"text":"Vetan chamnahi kana hotbol lheh-e; Ahinla kalhagao hi ngailutna-in setna kokhuh-a konin nahuhdoh tai. Ajehchu kachonsetna jouse nanung lama nasep mangtai."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu thikhol khulin navahchoi theipon, thina in nakipapi theipoi. Kokhuh-a kumlha hon jong nathudih akineppi theipouve."},"19":{"text":"Mihing, mihingin vang tunia kabol banghin vahchoi jinnate, pan chate chu nathudih hetsah unte."},"20":{"text":"Pakai chu eihuhhing dinga phasadem ahi. Hijeh chun tumging tothon kahinkho lhumkeijun Pakai insunga la saovinge."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu Isaiah'in theichang bohkhat laohen lang uilut chunga chun louvin nu-uhen chutile damkit tante, ati."},"22":{"text":"Hezekiah'in Pakai inna kachetou nading melchihna ipiham? tinjong anaseije."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hichelai chun Babylon lengpa Baladan chapa Merodach-baladan'in Hezekiah anan adamkit tai, ti thu ajah jeh-in lekhathot tampile thilpeh agahthotnin ahi.","title":"Babylon'a Kona Thupolepa"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Hezekiah'in hicheho chu akipapin, amaho chu athil lu ho in chu avetsah sohkeijin; sana, dangka, gimnamtui mantamho chule agal manchah ho in, chule agou kholna-a umjouse avetsahsoh heltan ahi. A-insung le avaihomna sunga Hezekiah'in avet sahlou khatcha jong aumtapoi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Isaiah themgao chu Hezekiah lengpa henga ahungin, ajah-a, miho hin ipi aseijuva? hoija kona nahenga hunga hiuvam? atin ahi. Chuin Hezekiah'in, amaho gamlatah Babylon gamlampeh-a kona kahenga hunga ahiuve, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin aman, amahon na-insunga ipipi amuvem? ati. Chuin Hezekiah'in adonbutnin, amahon ka-insunga umjouse amuvin, kagou thil lah-a amaho kamusahlou khatchabeh aumpoi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Isaiah'in Hezekiah henga, janel Pakaiyin asei thuhi ngaijin."},"6":{"text":"Vetan, na-insunga umjouse le napu napaten tunigeija akhol khomho jouse Babylon'a akipoh mangna nikho hung lhungding ahi; imacha akikhena umlou helding ahi, Pakaiyin aseije."},"7":{"text":"Chule nachate, nanga kona pengdoh dingle nangin nahindingho jong apuimangdiu ahin; chule amahochu Babylon lengpa inpisunga nukiso hiding ahiuve.","ref":"Dan 1:1-7; 2 Leng 24:10-16; 2 Thusm 36:10."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Hezekiah'in Isaiah henga, nangin naseidoh Pakai thuchu aphai, ati. Aman chukalvalin keima hinkho sungin chamnale thudih lenghen, ati."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangho lungmongun, nangho lungmongun, kamite, tin na Pathen'un aseijin ahi.","title":"Kinepna Thucheng ho"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem henga damheochan seijun, agalbol lah molso ahitan, akhan git louna akingaidamtai tin ajah-a samun, ajehchu amanun achonsetna jouse jal-in Pakaiya konin ajat ni akimutai."},"3":{"text":"Gamthipma khosam aw chun nanghon Pakai lampi semtoh-un, nelgama chun i-Pathen'uva din lamlhongpi semjangun, ati.","ref":"Matt 3:3; Mrk 1:3; Jhn 1:23.  ; Luk 3:4-6"},"4":{"text":"Damphai jouse kidomsanga, molsangtin le lhang jouse kisunem ding ahi. Akonlai kisujanga, aphonlai chu kisunamding ahi"},"5":{"text":"Chuteng Pakai loupinachu hungkilang intin, tahsaphe jousen amukhom sohkei diu ahi. Ajehchu Pakai kamin hichu asei ahitai."},"6":{"text":"Ogin chun samin, atin ahi. Chuin aman ipi kasap dingham? ati. Tahsaphe jousehi hampa tobang ahin, aphatna jouse jong loujaova pahcha pah tobang bou ahi.","ref":"Jac 1:10-11; 1 Pet 1:24-25."},"7":{"text":"Hampa agopjin, pahcha apuljie, ajehchu Pakai lhagaovin ahinsemji ahi. Tahbeh mongin mihem hi hampa tobang ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hampa agopjin, pahcha apuljie, ahinla Pathen thu vang atonsotna ding jingjeng ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Kipana thupha hinpo-a, vo Zion, molsanga khun kaltouvin; kipana thupha hinpo-a, vo Jerusalem, nathanei chasunin na aw sansah-in, sansah-in; kicha hih-in, Judah khopiho henga, veuvin, na Pathen'u khu? tiuvin."},"10":{"text":"Veuvin, Pakai Pathen chu khut thahat tah-a hungding ahi, chule abantha-a avai ahomding, atohphat man chu akoma uma chule anatoh chu amasanga umding ahi.","ref":"Isai 62:11; Tph 22:12."},"11":{"text":"Aman kelngoi chingpa banga aganchahon avah ding ahi. Aman abana akelngoiho chu ahoikhoma, a-opma akipomding, anousen puma hicheho chu olchacha apuile ding ahi.","ref":"Ezek 34:15; Jhn 10:11."},"12":{"text":"Akhut phang tonga twivei ho tetheija, akhapma van tethei, leija leivuiho tena khatna hedohtheija, tena-a molsangho tedoh-a, chule lhangho khaikotna khaija koiham?","title":"Atepidingbei Israel Pathen"},"13":{"text":"Pakai Lhagao chu hila, thumopma panga, hilchah-a koiham?","ref":"Rom 11:34; 1 Cor 2:16."},"14":{"text":"Koito kithumoptoa, ama kon ahila, thutandan lampi kon ahila, chule chihna thu ahila, chule hetkhen themna lamlhah kon ama amusah khah-em?"},"15":{"text":"Vetan, namtin vaipihi baltina twi vatkhat bangbep ahin, chule khaikotna leivui sipah bangbepma asim ahin, vetan, twikol gamho chu thil neochakhat bangin alan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Lebanon chu meija tikham ahipon, asunga ganhingho jeng jong govam thil to-a tokham ahipouve."},"17":{"text":"Namtin vaipi a-angsunga ima ahipouvin; amaho chu amadinga imacha hilou, agohkeo ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Achutile Pathen chu koito nakibahsah uva? Ipi akibahpito natekah dingu ham?","ref":"Sol 17:29."},"19":{"text":"Mikhut themin milim asemjin, sana khengin achunga sanan atomjin, chule dangka sumgui akhengjin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Todoh ding neiloi mivaicha tah chun amotlouding thing akilhenin; achatloh theilou ding semthu milim semsah dingin, mikhut themtah akiholjin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Nahet khah, najahkhah loulai uham? Semtila patna kihilkha loulai nahiuvem? Leiset bulkiphu-a pat nahetkhen thei loulai uham?"},"22":{"text":"Leiset kikol lum chunga touva ama ahin, asunga cheng ho jong khaokhopi tobang ahiuvin; vanho ponjal banga jeldoh-a, chenna inding pon-in banga jahdoh-a ama ahi."},"23":{"text":"Aman leng chapate imalouvin akoijin; aman leiset thutan ho agohkeovin asemtai."},"24":{"text":"Henge, amaho kiphut lou ding ahiuvin; tu jong kitulou dingu; aphungu leija jungkho manlou ding; chule Aman amaho amut teng jongle amaho gop lhading, chule changpol banga chimpeijin apeimang dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Achutile koito neikibah sah uva, ahiloule koito kakibah dingham? tin mithengpan aseijin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Namtinin chungsang lam nganlang, hichengse sempale ajanelu ahon hona puidohpa khu vetemun; aman aletnale athahatnan amincheh-in akouvin, Ama thanei na-a hattah ahijeh in khatcha akhenpoi."},"27":{"text":"Vo Jacob, vo Israel, kalampihi Pakaiya kona kisel ahin, kathutanhi ka Pathen'a kon ahipoi tia ipidinga naseiham?"},"28":{"text":"Pathen, Pakai, leiset kolmong geija sempa, nahetkhah-a najahkhah louham? Lhasam khalou, choljong cholkhalou, ama hetkhen themna holdoh jouhoi hilou ahi."},"29":{"text":"Aman milhasam chu hatna apen; chule thaneilou chu athahat nao akalsahjin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Khangdongho jengjong lhasama choldingu, gollhangho jong kipala lhuding ahiuve."},"31":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai ngahjingho chun athao kisem thah-un tin; muvanlai bangin alhaovin lengtou untin; amaho lhaijuva chollou dingu; chule vahleuva lhasam louding ahiuve."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo twikol gamho, ka-anga thipchetnun; miten athao semthah-uhen; amaho hungnaiju henlang, chuteng thu seijuhen, thutanna mun chu naicheh-u hite.","title":"Pathen'in Israelte Akinep sah"},"2":{"text":"Solama kona michonpha pa chu hintungdoh-a, akhophang bulla kou-a, namtin vaipi a-angsunga pe-a, lengho chunga ama vaihomsah chu koiham? Amahochu leivui kisoh dingin chemjam ma apedoh-in; changpol kithethang bang thethang din athalpi henga apedoh tan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amaho chu anungdelin bitkeijin agalkaijin; lampia chun akengin jong achepoi."},"4":{"text":"Hichehi koijin atoh-a chule abol hintem; semtila patna akhang akhanga miho kou-a natong jouva chu koiham? Keima Pakai amasale anukhah, ama chu keihi kahi."},"5":{"text":"Twikol gamhon hichu amuvin, akichauve; leiset kolmangho jong akitihot hot-un, ahung kikhin naijun ahing taove."},"6":{"text":"Amaho amitakipmin aheng akomcheh akithopiuvin; chule amitakipmin asopipa jah-a, hangtah-in pangin, atiuve."},"7":{"text":"Chutichun khut thempan sana khengpa atilkhouvin, chule sehcha-a khenpan thihnoidou khenpa atilkhouvin, ajah-a, solmat dinga phasadem ahitai atin, akilon lounadin thihkilin akildetne."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla, Israel nangma kagolpa Abraham chilhah-a kalhacha Jacob chu nahi.","ref":"2 Thusm 30:7; Jac 2:23."},"9":{"text":"Leiset kolmonga kona kalah-a, chukoma milenho-a kona kakouva, najah-a kasei ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma kaumpi jeh-in kicha hih-in, keima na Pathen kahijeh-in lunglha hih-in; henge, keiman kahatsah ding nahin; Keiman nakithopi nange, chule keiman nangma kachon phatna khutjetna katuh ding nahi."},"11":{"text":"Vetan, nangma douva lunghansah jouse chu jahchaova, kisudongdiu ahi. Amaho imalouhel banguntin, nakinahpiho chu mangthah ding ahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Nangman amahole nakinahpiho ngeichu nahola namu louding; nangma douva galbolho chu imalouhel leh pannabei sohding ahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu keima Pakai na Pathen'in nakhutjetna katuh-a, kicha hih-in, keiman nangma panpi nange kati ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nangma lungtol Jacob, chule nangho Israel mite kicha hih-un; keiman panpinange, tin Pakai nalhandam pu Israel Mithengpan aseije."},"15":{"text":"Vetan, keiman nangma chang chilna manchah hanei hemtah-a kasemthah ding nahi. Nangin mol ho nachila, navoh ngemding, chule lhangho chu changvai nabahsah ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nangin amaho najapma, huichun alhoh mangdiu, chule chimpei chun athecheh diu ahi. Chule nangma Pakaiya halna-in kipah-in natin, Israel Mithengpa-a chun loupitan nate."},"17":{"text":"Avaichale alhasamin twi athuma, koimachan pelouva aleiju dangchah-a agotteng, Pakai keiman nousah ingting, Israel Pathen keiman amaho kapaidoh louding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Keiman munsang ho-a vadunglen holeh phaicham lailunga twinahho kahonding ahi. Keiman gamthiplai twikul'a chule gam golai twisam putna-a kasemding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Keiman gamthipma cedar thing, thinggi thing, le pahcha thing chule thao thing kaphua; neldi gama chahthing, phan thing chule thingkhang thing kaphu ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chutia chu amahon amuva, ahetnuva, angaitouva, chule ahetthem cheh theina diuva Pakai khutnin hichu abola, chule Israel mithengpan hichu anasem ahi."},"21":{"text":"Pakaiyin nakibaonao hinpolutnun ati; nathu hahsao hinpolutnun tin Jacob dinga lengpan aseije.","title":"Pakaiyin pathen lhemho Achou"},"22":{"text":"Amahon hicheho chu hinpolutnu henlang thil hunglhung ding eimusah uhen; amahon thil masaho chu ipiham? kangaitouva, akichaina kahet theina dingun eimusah-uhen; ahiloule ahunglhung dingho eiphon dohpeh uhen."},"23":{"text":"Nangho pathen ho nahiuve ti kahet theina dingun, tununga thil hunglhung dingho tahlangun; ahi, kalung thoijuva kamucheh nadiuvin apha ham aseham boluvin."},"24":{"text":"Veuvin, imacha hilou nahiuvin, natoh-u jong pannabei ahi. Naki lhanpao chu thet umtah ahi."},"25":{"text":"Keiman sahlam gama konin mikhat katungin, ama chu hungding ahi: aman niso-a pat kamin akouding; Songchung kichonpha tobangle beldengpan leingan achil banga ama pipuiho chunga hungchu ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ihettheina diuleh ama chonpha ahi iti theina diuva abula patna kon aphonkhah-em? ahi, khatchan atahlangpon; ahi, khatchan aphongdoh poi; ahi, nathu ja-a khatcha ana umpoi."},"27":{"text":"Amasan Zion henga, ven, ven, amahokhu tinnate; Jerusalem chu kipana thupha pole-a khat kapeh ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ajehchu kagah vetleh koimacha kamupon; amaho kadohjongle thukhat donbut theijong alah uvah kamupoi, khatcha aumpouve."},"29":{"text":"Vetemun, abonun pannabei jeng ahiuvin; atoh-u jong mohseh ahin; amilim kilhajol ujong hui lhi le ahomkeo ngen ahiuve."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Veovin, kasottol, katuhjing, kalhentum; achunga kalung kipanakhu; achunga kalhagao kakoijin; aman chidang namdang ho henga thutanna anei ding ahi.","title":"Pakai Lhachapa","ref":"Matt 3:17; 17:5; Mrk 1:11; Luk 3:22; 9:35.  ; Matt 12:18-21"},"2":{"text":"Aman kho asaplouding, a-aw asodoh louhel ding, khopi lamlena jong a-aw kija louhel ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Pumpeng kihehchip ahebohpai louding, thaomei patkhu athamit pailou ding ahi. Aman thudih-a thutanna apohdoh ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Leiset chunga thutanna aumsah masangse-a losam louding chule lungjong lunglhalouding; twikol gamhon ama danthupeh angaidiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Vanho sema jahdohpa, leiset le asunga kona hungsoh ho phajaopa; chule achunga mite henga haina hule asunga vahle miho henga lhagao pe-a Pakai Pathen chun hitin aseije.","ref":"Sol 17:24-25."},"6":{"text":"Keima Pakai hin chonphatna-a kakou nahin, nakhut katuh-a kavet tupma, mitin dinga kitepna chule chidang namdangte vah hidinga kasem ding nahin;","ref":"Isai 49:6; Luk 2:23; Sol 13:47; 26:23."},"7":{"text":"mitcho ho mit hasah ding, sohchangho songkulla kon puidoh ding, chule songkulsung muthim lah-a touho puidoh dinga kapansah nahi."},"8":{"text":"Keima Pakai chu kahin; hichu kamin ahi. Kaloupina chu midang kapehlouding, eiki vahchoina jong milim semthuho henga pelouding kahi."},"9":{"text":"Veuvin, phatmasa thilho chu ahung lhungtan, thilthah ho kaphong doh-in; ahung dotdoh masanga athu dollu kahil masatdem nahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Nangho twikhanglen'a kumsuh hole asunga umho jousen; twikol gamle asunga cheng, leiset kolmonga patnin Pakai henga lathah khat saovin.","title":"Pathen Vahchoi La"},"11":{"text":"Gamthip le akhopiho Kedar chan geija kho ho pengu hen a-aw sansah uhen, songpi-a chenghon kipa la saohen lang, molsang hon chungvuma konin samu hen."},"12":{"text":"Amahon Pakaiya loupina peuhenlang, twikol gamho-a chun a thangvahna phongjal uhen."},"13":{"text":"Pakai chu mihat tah bangin kondoh intin, galsat mi banga thangthipna acho thouva, kholhang asapding; ama hat tah-a kituma, amelmate ajoding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Sottah thipbeh-in kaumtan; kathipbeh-in, kakitimkit hamhame, tunvang naosonat thohlel bangin peng ingting; kasuhmanga kavalhum ding ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Amite Panpi Dinga Kitepna Anei"},"15":{"text":"Mol le lhangho agoh-in koi jingting, ahampaho gotsah gaming ting, vadungho twikol gammin semingting, chule twikulho kansah soh inge."},"16":{"text":"Mitcho ho chu ahetkhah lounao kenglampia puijing ting; ahetkhah louvu lampia kaijinge; amasanguva muthim chu vahsah ingting, akonlaiho ka jansah ding ahi. Hicheng hi ahenguva kabolding, kadalhah louding ahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Milim semthu tahsan ho, milimho jah-a, nangho kapathen'u nahiuve tiho chu hung kinungle uva, jahcha lheh ding ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Na-ngong ho, nanghon ngaijunlang, nangho mitcho hon namutheina dinguvin veuvin.","title":"Israel ten Hilchahna Asanthei Louvu"},"19":{"text":"Mitcho koiham, kalhachapabou hilouham? atiloule kasottol kasolpa banga nangonga koiham? michamkim pa banga mitcho koi hijam? Pakai sohpa banga mitcho koiham?"},"20":{"text":"Thiltampi namun ahinla najuipoi; nakhangho chu avangnan ahinla ajapon ahi."},"21":{"text":"Achonphatna jal-in Pakai alunglhai tangeije; aman danthupeh chu aloupisah-a ja uma asemding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla amahohi agumanga leh asuthanghoi ahiuvin; amaho jouse kohoma thangkol ho ahiuvin, songkul inho-a kisela ahiuve. Amaho akithatgam ding ahiuvin, ahuhdoh dingu khatcha aumpon; suhchatvai ding ahiuvin, lepeh kitnun tia khatcha aumpoi."},"23":{"text":"Hichea nakhang sungdinga nalah uva koi nahiuvem? Ahunglhung ding phat ho dinga kon nangai uva, najahdiu ham?"},"24":{"text":"Galthil kichom banga chomdinga Jacob pe-a, guchaho henga Israelte pedoh-a koiham? chonset iboluva idoupao Pakai chun apehdoh hilouham? ajehchu amaho alampiho-a achenom pouvin, adanthu jong ajuipouve."},"25":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu achunguva alunghana meikongle galkisat hattah chu abuhlhah khum ahi. Hichun akimvel meija ahalin, ahin amanla ahethei dehpon; hichun aka-in, ahivanga alungsungah aching dehpon ahi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahinla tun, Vo Jacob, nasempao Pakaiyin, vo Israel natungdoh paovin kicha hih-un atin ahi. Ajehchu keiman kalhatdoh nahin, naminin kakouvin, keija nahitai.","title":"Amite Huhdohdinga Pathen Kitepna"},"2":{"text":"Twipi napalteng jongle umping ting; vadunghon jong nachup louding; meilah najot teng jongle, nakah louding ahi. Meikou deujejun jong naleogop louding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu keima Pakai na Pathen, Israel mithengpa nahuhhingpa chu kahi nangma lhatnadin Egypt kapen, nangma khelin Ethiopia le Seba kapei."},"4":{"text":"Kamitmu-a lutah nahin, ja-umtah nahina jeh-in kangailun ahi. Hijeh chun nakhelin miho pengting nahinna dinga mitin kapeh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kicha hih-in, ajehchu keiman kaumpi nai, nachilhah solama konin hinpui jingting, lhumlama konin dongkhom inge."},"6":{"text":"Keiman sahlam jah-a, hin pedoh-in, lhanglam jah-a, henden hih-in; gamlatah a konin kachapate, leiset kolmonga konin kachanute hinpuijin tinge."},"7":{"text":"Kamina kikouchan chu kaloupina dinga kasema kagon ahin; henge, keiman ama kasem ahi."},"8":{"text":"Mit neija khomulou leh, nakhang neija khojalou ho chu hinpui doh-un.","title":"Pakai Dinga Hettohsah-a Pang Chu Israel Ahi"},"9":{"text":"Namtin vaipi jouse kikhom khomuhen, chule mipite kikhom khomuhen, alah uva koiham hiche phongdoh dingle thil um masa cheng eivetsah thei uva koiham? Athem chana dingun ahettohsah ho hinpuijuhen; ahiloule ngaijuhen chule adih ahi, tiuhen."},"10":{"text":"Nangho keima hettohsah nahiuve tin Pakaiyin aseije: chule kalhendohsa kalhacha nahi; hitia chu keima neihet uva neitahsan uva, keimahi Ama kahi neihet nadinguva: keima masanga Pathen dang akisempon, keima nunga jong khatcha kisem louding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Kei, keima bou Pakai chu kahi, keima tailou huhhingpu dang aumpoi."},"12":{"text":"Nalah uva gamdang pathen aum masangin keiman kaphong doh-in, kahuhhingun, chule kamusah-un ahi. Hijeh chun nangho keima hettohsah nahiuve, tin keima Pakaiyin aseije, keima Pathen kahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi, nikhoho umasanga keima Ama chu kahi; kakhutna kona ladohjou khatcha ana umpoi; keiman katohding chu koiham ajada dinga?"},"14":{"text":"Pakai na lhatdampu Israel mithengpan hitin aseije; nangho khohsahna jal-in Babylon'a sepai kasolin, amilaltehou jousele Chaldea ho kong-innei sunga peng jenjunin kahin puisuh-e.","title":"Babylon'a Kon Jamdoh"},"15":{"text":"Keima Pakai na Mithengpao, Israelte sempa nalengpao chu kahi."},"16":{"text":"Pakai twikhanglen'a kenglampi semaleh twihat sunga lampi sempan hitin aseije;"},"17":{"text":"Sakol kangtalai le sakol, sepaiho le athahat ho puidohpa Pakai chun hitin aseije. Amaho lumkhom uva thoutaloudiu ahin; amaho amit adelun, thaomei pat bangin akimutmit taove."},"18":{"text":"Thil masaho geldaovin lang, tonlai thil jong ngaito daovin."},"19":{"text":"Veuvin, keiman thilthah khat kabolding ahin, tu-a hungpotdoh ding ahitan; nahetlou diuham? Gamthiplai geija lampi khat kasema, nelgama jong vadungho kalonsah ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kamite, kalhentumho dondinga gamthipma twiho chule nelgama vadung ho kapeh jeh-a, gamlah-a gamsaho, dragon ho chule sumbupi hon eijabol dingu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hiche mitehi keiding tumtah-a kasem ahin; amahon keima vahchoina atahlang lediu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla Vo Jacob, nangmanla neikou pon, Vo Israel, nanghon neitheichim un ahi.","title":"Israel Chonsetna"},"23":{"text":"Nagovam thilpeh-a din ganchaneo neihin choipehjipon, ganlhaina injong neijabol jitapon ahi. Thilpeh-in nangma kana kijenkhahsah pon, gimnamtui jinjong kasugim khapoi."},"24":{"text":"Nangin sumin kolchulhum nachokhapon, naganlhai na sathaovin jong neivahva khapon ahi. Ahinla nachonset nao neipohsah-un, nakhangitlou naova neisugimun ahi."},"25":{"text":"Kei, keimong monghin, keile kei kikhohsah najala nasuhkhelnao thehmanga chu kahin, nachonset nahou kageldoh kit tahlou ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Neigeldoh jingun; hungun ngaito khomu hite; them nachan theina dingun kisei phongun."},"27":{"text":"Napa masapen anachonsen, chuin nahil hou keima douna-in anasukhelun ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hijeh chun munthenga pipuiho chu kanasuboh-in, Jacob chu sapsetna-a, Israel chu i-sah louvin kana umsah tai."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuvangin Vo kalhacha Jacob, Vo kalhenchom Israel, ngaijun;","title":"Pakai Bouseh Hi Pathen Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Nasema leh naobu-a kona nahin gonga napanpi ding Pakai chun hitin aseije; Vo kalhacha Jacob chule vo kalhenchom Jerusalem, kicha hih-in."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu adangchah chunga twi kasuna, tolgolaija twi kasosah ding ahi. Nachilhah ho chunga kalhagao chule nasonho chunga kaphat theina kabuh lhah ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amaho hampalah banga hungdon doh diu, twipanga huisum thingho bangdiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Khatnin, keima Pakaiya kahin; achomkhatma Jacob mina kikou ding; chule adang khatnin akhut tah-a Pakaiya ding tia ajih ding, chule Israel mina kiminvo ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pakai Israelte leng, alhatdampu janel Pakai chun hitin ati; Keima amasale anukhah kahin, kei tailou Pathen dang aumpoi, ati.","ref":"Isai 48:12; Tph 1:17; 22:13."},"7":{"text":"Malai miho katundoh laija chu keima bolbanga koiham aboldingle aphongdoh dinga? chule abancha umsah ding? chule thil ahunglhung dingle ahunglhung saho chu amaho musah-u hen."},"8":{"text":"Tija hih-un, kijong kicha hih-un; chuche laija patna kahilkhahlou, kaseipeh khahlou nahiuvem? Nangho kathu hettoh sahmong nahiuvin ahi. Keitailou Pathen dang umem? ahi, Pathen dang aumpoi, khatcha jong kahepoi."},"9":{"text":"Alim semthuho abonun ahomkeo ahiuvin; anopsahnao thilho jong pannabei ahin; amaho chu amaho hettohsah ahiuve, ajachat theina diuvin amahon amupouvin, hejong ahepouve.","title":"Alim Semthuho Pannabei Ahi"},"10":{"text":"Aphat chomna bei pathen le alim semthu milim sema koiham?"},"11":{"text":"Vetan, aloiho jouse jahchao vintin, chule anatong amaho jong mihem bou ahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Thih khengpan achoiche toh meihola agouvin, sehcha'n avotoh-in, aban thahatnin atongjin ahi; henge, ama agilkelin, ahatna angoilhajin, twila adonpon, alhadahjitai."},"13":{"text":"Thingthem bolpan agolkaina ahinladoh-in; gol akaijin, amelchih-in; tolnam na-in atoltoh-in, vettohna-in amelchih-in, mihem gong bangin mihem hoina dungjuijin a-insunga aumden nadingin amelchih-in ahi."},"14":{"text":"Aman cedar thingho aphuh lhun, khengthing le gangpi thing amadingin gammang lah-a akhansah-in ahi. Aman meila thing aphutnin gotuijin achapnoujin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chujoule hichu mihem dinga tiding hintin; ajehchu aman thing lah-a akehkhat chu akitikouvin a-oilumjin; changlhah akangjin; a pathen lim sem angsunga chun abohkhupmin ahoujin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Aman phabep chu meija atih-in; sa go nan aneijin oiva nan anen; meisa chu a-oilumin, katejo, keiman lum kasatai, meimu-a kahitai atijin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule thing moh chu pathen khatnin semthu milim ngeijin asemjin, a-anga aboh khupmin, ahouvin, ahenga ataovin, ka-pathen nahi jeh-in neihuh doh-in atijin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Amahon anahepouvin, hetjong ahethem pouve; ajehchu amulouna diuva amitnu achotsah-a, ahetkhen themlouna diuva alungthimu akhachah ahi."},"19":{"text":"Abang meija katih-in, henge, chua mei mama chun changlhah kakangin, sa kakigon kanei; achutile amohchu thet umtah khatna kasema, thingbul khat anga kabokhupma kahou diham? tin koiman alungin chihnale hetkhenna injong angaitopoi."},"20":{"text":"Ama vutna kivah ahin; lheplhahna lungthimin aheikon ahin, ahinna aman ahuhdoh theilouna dia kakhutjetna jou uma hilouham, atin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Nangma kalhacha nahi jeh-in vo Jacob, le Israel hichehohi geldoh-in; kasemsa nahin, kalhacha nahi, Vo Israel, nangma kasuhmil theihoi nahipoi.","title":"Pakai Chu Ijakai Sempa le Huhhingpu Ahi"},"22":{"text":"Keiman meilhang satah tobang nasuhkhelnaho le nachonset naho meibol tobang chu katheh mang tai; kahenga hung kile kitnin, keiman kalhatdoh nahitai."},"23":{"text":"Vo vanho hichu Pakai ahijeh-in la saovin; lei noilama umhon aovun; nangho mol ho, Vo gammang chule chua thingphung tinnin la san aodoh uvin, ajehchu Pakaiyin Jacob alhatdoh-in, Israel lentahle loupitah-in akichoi antai."},"24":{"text":"Pakai nalhatdohpao naobu-a kona nagongtoh paovin hitin aseije, keihi thiljouse sema, Pakai achangseh-a vanho jahdoh-a, leiset phajaopa chu kahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Mi jouho melchihna imalou so-a, doi-aithemho ngolsah-a; michingho nungnokit na, ahetnao ngolna-a sosah-a;","ref":"1 Cor 1:20."},"26":{"text":"Asohpa thusei sudetpa, asottol ho thumop molsopeh-a; Jerusalem jah-a nangho chenna ding ahin; chule Judah khopiho jah-a, nangho kasahdoh kitna, alhusa munho kaphoh ding kitding ahi atipeh-e."},"27":{"text":"Twithuh jah-a kangin, navadung ho jong kakansah kitding ahi tipa,"},"28":{"text":"Cyrus jah-a, ama kakelngoi chingpa ahin, kadeijouse asuhbulhit ding ahi, Jerusalem heng jenga jong nangma, kisapha ding nahi tin, chule houin jah-a, na-inbul kisem phading ahi tipa chu kahi, ati.","ref":"2 Thusm 36:23; Ezra 1:2."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, athao nu Cyrus jah-a namtin vaipi a-anga sunem dingle, lengho konggah lhamkang ding, amasanga pehni kisuto kotpiho hongdingle, khahkit loudingin, akhut jetna katuh chahpa henga chun hitin aseijin;","title":"Pathen'in Cyrus Anganse"},"2":{"text":"keima namasanga chengting, akonlaiho kajansah ding; sum-eng kotpiho kavohchima, thih kotgol ho kasatkhen ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule keima Pakai, namina nakoupa, Israel Pathen chu kahin, keima neihet theina dinga goukhol le munthipma kiselgu sumjong kapeh ding nahi."},"4":{"text":"Kalhacha Jacob le kalhen chom Israel jala namin monga kakou nahi, nangin neihetlou vanga keiman kaminvo nahi."},"5":{"text":"Keihi Pakai chu kahin, adang aumpoi, kei tailou Pathen dang himhim aumpoi; neihetlou vanga nakong kagahpeh nahin;","title":"Thunun Dinga Achouna"},"6":{"text":"Kei tailou adang aumpoi. Keima Pakai chu kahi, adang him him aumpoi, ti nisolama pat nilhum lam geija miten ahet theina diu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Keiman khovah kagong doh-in, muthim jong kaseme, chamna kasemin, setna jong kaseme, kei Pakaiyin hitiho jousehi kabol ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nangho vanho, chunga konin hung julhaovin, chule vandum hon chonphatna hinsunglhaovin, leiset kihonghenlang huhhingna sodoh-u hen, chonphat nato hung kedoh thaohen; keima Pakaiyin hichu kasem ahi."},"9":{"text":"Asempa kinelpi chu ohe! ada ahi: beldengpa bel hal chu leiset bel hal to kinel hen. Bon nganin asempa henga, ipi sema nahim? ahiloule nathilbol chun aman khut kaneipoi tintem?","title":"Thilsem le Khang Thusim Pakai","ref":"Rom 9:20."},"10":{"text":"Apa jah-a ipi hinga nahim? ahiloule anujah-a ipi nana hindoh hitam? tiachu ada ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pakai Israel mithengpa le asempaovin hitin ati, kachate chungchanga thil hunglhung dingchu neidongun, chule, kakhut natoh chungchang thu neipeuvin."},"12":{"text":"Leiset hi kasem ahin, achunga mihem jonghi kasem ahi, Kakhut ho-a vanho kajahdoh-a, janelho jong kathupeh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ama chu chonphat na-in kakhou khah-in, alampi jouse hilinge. Aman kakhopi asahdoh-a, kasohchang ho alhadoh ding, kipamanle tohphat man thil peh-a ding ahipoi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"14":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin, ati, Egypt tohgimna le Ethiopia le Sabea mite sumkolvei ho, misang tahtah ho chu naheng lama hunguva nanga hidiu ahitai. Nanung ahin juijuva, thihkhaova kihenpuma hung galkaijuva, na-anga bohkhup uva, chibai nabohdiu, nahenga lungsetna angeh uva tahbeh-in Pathen nangma-a aum monge, adang aumpoi, Pathen dang himhim aumpoi atidiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Vo Israel Pathen, huhhingpa kisel thipbeh Pathen tahbeh mongchu nahi."},"16":{"text":"Amaho jahchaova abonchauva kisudongdiu; milimsem amaho chu lungnoh phah puma lutkhom diu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Israel vangchu Pakaiya tonsot huhhingna-a huhhing-a umdiu ahin; nangho tonsot geija jahchalouva akhonna beija kisudong louding nahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu vanho sempa, Pakai, leiset sutoh-a, sema tungdohpa, aman agohkeo asem hilouva chenna dinga anagong dohpa Pathen amatah chun hitin ati; Keima Pakai chu kahin koima cha dang aumpoi,"},"19":{"text":"keiman leiset munthim mun'a guhthimin thu kaseipoi, keiman Jacob chilhahte henga agohkeovin neiholun katipoi, Pakai keiman chonphatna kaseijin, thudih bou chu kaphondoh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Nangho namtin lah-a asohcha chengse kikhom munlang, hungun, hinnai cheh-un. Thing semthu milim tungdoh-a, ahuhhing theilou diu Pathen henga taoho, amahonla hetna aneipouvin ahi.","title":"Vannoi Pakai le Babylon Semthu pathen"},"21":{"text":"Seipeh unlang hinpui naijun; thu kimopna chu sang uhen, masang laija patna kon aphondoh khah em? chulai apat kon nanahil um? Pakai keimahi kahilou ham? Pathen dihle huhhing-a Pathen dang aumpoi, kei tailou adang aumpoi."},"22":{"text":"Leiset kolkimvela mi jousen keilam hinveuhen lang huhhingin umuhen; keima Pathen kahin, koimacha dang aumpoi."},"23":{"text":"Keile kei kaki hahsel in, kakama kona chonphatna thu potnachu hungkilekit louding ahi. Chutia chu khup jouse ka-anga dilsua, lei jouse kihahsel ding ahi,","ref":"Rom 14:11; Phil 2:10-11."},"24":{"text":"dihtah-in min Pakaiya chun chonphat nale thahatna kaneije tin seijinte; ama henga mi hunga; ama douva lunghansah jouse chu jahcha ding ahiuve."},"25":{"text":"Israel chilhah jouse chu Pakaiya them changa loupidiu ahi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bel chu akunin, Nebo chu abungin, amilim hou chu sahole aganchahou chunga aumuve; nathilpoh-u pohgih tah ahin, gancha thachol dinga pohgihsa ahi."},"2":{"text":"Amaho abungun, akuncheh uve; amaho pohgih-a chun ahoidoh pouvin, gal hinga kaimangin aumjo taove."},"3":{"text":"Vo Jacob insungle Israel insung amohchengse, ka-oisunga patna kavopma, naobu-a kona kapensah hon kathu ngaijun."},"4":{"text":"Nateh geija jong kei Ama chu kahin; nasamkan geija jong kapoh ding nahi; kasemsa nahin, chule keiman vop ingting kapoh-a; kahuh hingding nahi."},"5":{"text":"Koito kilo neisah uva, neikibah sah uva, neitekah uva, chule kakibah thei dinguham?"},"6":{"text":"Amaho dipma kona sana anopnopma manga, dangka akitena-a kitedoh-a, sana khengkhat thalah-a; pathen akisemsah-a, a-anga bohkhup jia chibai bohjia ahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Amahon hichu aleng kou uva adomdoh uvin, apojiuvin, ama munna atungjiove, ama akitung denin; aumna-a konin akichon jitapon ahi. Ahi, min ama kou intin, amanla donbut theilou ding, agimna-a kona jong ahuhdoh theilou ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Vo suhkhel neiho, hichehi geldoh-un; miho kimusah unlang lungin geldoh kitnun."},"9":{"text":"Khanglui laija thilmasaho geldoh-un, keima Pakai kahijeh in adang khatcha aumpoi, keima Pathen kahin, keitobang himhim aumpouve."},"10":{"text":"Abula pat akichainagei, chule masang laijapat akibol loulaiho jong kaseiphong ahitai, kathumop ding jingintin, kanopchan kabolding ahitai, ati."},"11":{"text":"Solama kona vacha lol hattah khat gamlatah-a kona kathumopsa tongdoh dingpa chu kouvin; henge, kaseisa ahin, kagui lhunsah ding ahin, kangaitosa ahin boljong kaboldoh ding ahi, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chonphatna-a kona gamla-a lungtah-a nanghon kathu ngaijun;"},"13":{"text":"kachon phatna hi kahinpo naitan, hichu gamla talou ding, ka huhhingna jong umjing louding ahi. Kaloupina Israelte dinga huhhingna chu Zion'a kakoiding ahi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo nungah theng chanu, hungkum lhanlang leivuilah-a touvin, laltouna aumpon, Vo Chaldea mite chanu; ajehchu nangma nouchetle nomsa kitikit talou ding nahi.","title":"Babylon te Chunga Pathen Thutan","ref":"Isai 13:1—14:23; Jer 50:1; 51:64."},"2":{"text":"Sumhei songho lanlang chang goijin napon lukhuh hoh-inlang, kengkeuvin umin, na pheipi hohdoh inlang, vadungho palgalkai jin."},"3":{"text":"Nasagohkeo chu khulouvin umintin; najamo kisel chu kimuding ahi. Phu langting, mihembanga nangma kakimupi louding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Eilhatdohpao chu Israel mithengpa, janelho Pakai chu amin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chaldea te chanu thipbeh in touvin lang, muthima lutnin, ajehchu lenggam ho pakainu kitijom louding nahitai."},"6":{"text":"Kamite chunga kalungsan, kagouloho kasuboh-in, amaho chu nakhutna kanapeluttai; nanginla hepina nanamusahpon; golluiho chunga napohgih tah namkoljon chu na-ngapkhum tai."},"7":{"text":"Nangin imatihchanna pakainu kahijing ding ahi nanatin; chutichun nangin hiche hohi nalunga nanakoi pon khonunga akichaina diujong nanageldoh him himpoi."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun anop nopma uma, chavaitah-a chengnu, alungsunga keitailou adang aumpon, keibou kahin; meithai banga toulou ding kahi, chate thi thu jong hehih helinge, tia seinun ngaijin;","ref":"Tph 18:7-8."},"9":{"text":"ahinla hiche thilni, chate thinale meithai hinahi nikhatsunga hetmanlouva nachunga hungchu ding ahi. Hicheho chu namitpheldoi ho tamjeh le, kilhim ngolna bulhin lheh jeh-a nachunga lhingsetna hungchu ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu nakhansetna natahsanin, koiman eimupoi natin ahi. Nachihnale nahetna in naheimangtan; nalungsunga keima kahi keitailou adang himhim aumpoi natin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh-achu thilse nachunga hungchua hi hoija hung kipan ahi nahetlouding; setna nachunga hungchu ding; hichu nasuhmang joulou ding; chule nahet loubeh ding manthah na nachunga hung chuphung ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tun naki lhim ngolnale namitpheldoi themna tamtah, naneolaija patna nahinjilna chun naphat theipi jouva, najo thei khattou dingle dinpi tan,"},"13":{"text":"nathumop tamjeh-in nacholtan ahi. Tun ahsi lekhathem ho, ahsi velhi jingho, lhatina khonunga hunglhung ding melchih themho dingdoh uhenlang, nachunga hung chudingho-a konin kihuhdoh sah-in."},"14":{"text":"Veuvin, amaho changpol bangbep hiuvintin; meijin akahvamdiu; meikong thahat na-a kona amahole amaho kihuhdoh loudiu; kisahlum nading mei-am tobang hilouva, amasanga tounangam mei tobang jong hilouding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nangdinga naneolaija patna nasumkol veipiho, chule nanatoh gimpi amaho jengtah jong chutichu hintin, amaho khatcheh-a a-inlam cheh-a vahmanga, koimachan nahuhhing louding ahi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Jacob insung Israel mina kivo-a Judah twiho-a kona sohdoh-a, Pakai mina kihahsel, thutah le chonphatna-a hilouva Israel Pathen min panho: hichehi ngaijun.","title":"Pathen Chu Ahunglhung ding Phatna Pakai Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu amahole amaho khopitheng mi akihisah-un, Israel Pathen chunga akingaijui; ama minchu janel ho Pakai ahi."},"3":{"text":"Masanglai thilto chu abula patnin kaseiphongin; kakama kona sohdoh ho chu amaho kamusahtai; hiche ho chu kabol phunga guilhung jeng ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma milouchal nahi ti kahen, na-ngong chu thih khao ahin, nachalpang chu sum-eng ahin;"},"5":{"text":"Hichu atila patna nahenga kaseija, ahung guilhun masanga kamusah nahitai. Achutiloule nangin kahou milim, alim semthu, kamilim kilhajolin abol ahi tikhan nate,"},"6":{"text":"nanghon najataovin, hicheho jousehi namutaovin; chule naseiphong loudiu ham? tua patnin thilthah ho, thil kisel ho, nanghon nanahetlouho chu kamusah ahitai."},"7":{"text":"Amaho tun akisemtai, abula patna ahipoi; najah masang nikho jongchu ahipoi; achutiloule nangin, veuvin, ken amaho kahei, tikhan nate."},"8":{"text":"Ahi, nanaja khapon, nanahe khapoi; hichelaija patchun nanakhang ana kihongpon ahi; tahsanlel nahin, naobu-a patna suhkhelnei nakiti dingchu kanahen ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu kamin jala kalungsatna-a kakitima, eikipachat nading jeh-a nangma kasuhtana dinga kona kitima kahi."},"10":{"text":"Vetan, keiman nangma kalhah theng nahitai, sum-eng bang hilouvin, suhgentheina meilhum sunga kalhah nahi."},"11":{"text":"Keimajal leh keimatah jala kabolding ahi; Ajehchu kaminhi ibola suhboh a umding ham?"},"12":{"text":"Vo Jacob le kakou Israel, kathu ngai phaovin; keihi amachu kahin; amasale anukhah jong kahi.","title":"Cyrus, Pathen'in Alhen Lamkai","ref":"Isai 44:6; Tph 1:7; 22:13."},"13":{"text":"Kakhutnin leiset bul jong hi aphudoh ahin, kakhut jet hin vanho chu akaijala, amahochu kakoutengle dingdoh khom jengjiuva ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nangho nabon chaovin kikhomun lang ngaijun; hiche thil ho hi alah uva koipenin aphondoh khah em? Pakaiyin ama alungsetnin; aman Babylon chunga anopnop abolin, akhut chu Chaldea miteho chunga chuding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Kei, keimatah mongin kasei ahitai; amachu kakouvin; kahinpuijin, aman alampi akhantousah ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nanghon neihin naijun lang hichehi ngaijun; atila patnin keiman guhthimin thu kaseipon; phat aumtila patnin hia chun keima kaumin; chule tuhin Pakai Pathen le alhagaovin eisoltai."},"17":{"text":"Pakai nalhatdohpao Israel mithengpan hitin aseije, keihi Pakai na Pathen, naphatnadiuva hila, nachenadiu lampia puihoipa chu kahi."},"18":{"text":"Vo nanghon kathu peh ho chu nangaiju hitavele! nachung uva chamna vadung banga longa, nachon phatnao twikhanglen kinong bang hitading!"},"19":{"text":"Nachilhah-u jong neldi jat phantin, nalaigilgao sonho jong nel bongsilsel bang ding, kamasanga kona aminu kithai mang louding, suhtanga jong umlouheldiu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Babylon'a konin potdoh-un, Chaldea mite-a konin jam mangun, hichehi lasah ginnin phongjal unlang, leiset kolkimvel geijin seiphongun, Pakaiyin asoh Jacob chu alhatdohtai tiuvin.","ref":"Tph 18:4."},"21":{"text":"Aman nelgam jotpaija apuilaijin adangchah pouvin; songpi-a konin amahodin twi alondohsah-in, songpijong akesah-in, twi chu ahung kikhodoh jengin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Pakaiyin migiloute dingin chamna himhim aumpoi, ati.","ref":"Isai 57:12."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo twikol gamho, kathusei ngaijun; gamlatah-a konin miten ngaijuvin; Pakaiyin naobu-a kona einakouva; kanu oisunga kona kamin anasah sa ahitai.","title":"Israel, Namti Vaipi ding Vah"},"2":{"text":"Aman chemjam hemtah bangin kakam anasemin; chule aman akhut lima einaselin, thalchang kinot dulin einasemin, alivathei sunga einaselin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Kahenga, Vo Israel, nangma kalhacha kaki choi-atna dingpa chu nahi anatin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin keiman, mohseh-a tonggima kahitan, kathahatna imacha hiloule mohseh-a kaman ahitai. Hitajongle kathutana chu Pakai toh um ahin, kathilbol chu Pathen to uma ahi, kati."},"5":{"text":"Chule tun Israel chu anakikhom khomlou hitajongleu, naobu-a patna alhacha-a pangdinga einagonga, Jacob chu ahenga hinlepuikit dinga, Pakai mitmu-a keima loupinalai dingle ka Pathen chu kathahat hidinga einagongpa Pakai chun aseije."},"6":{"text":"Chuin aman Jacob phungho tungdoh dingle, Israel vetupma lepehkit dinga kalhacha-a napanding chu thil jangkhaicha ahi, ati. Leiset kolmong geija nangma kahuhhing nahiding, chidang namdangte salvahna dingjong kapeh ding nahi."},"7":{"text":"Tahsan umtah Israel lhatdohpale, amithengpa, mite i-sah loupa, namtin hotbolpa, vaipoho sohpa henga chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Tahsan umtah Pakai Israel mithengpa aman nang nalhendingjehin: lenghon amuteng thoudohdiu, leng chapatenjong chibai abohdiu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, lahphat chan natao nao kangaijin, huhhing nikhon nangma kapanpin, chule nangma nahongbit ningting, Leiset tungdoh dingle goulo kamhelsa gam lodinga miho thulhun hidinga kapeh ding nahin;","title":"Jerusalem Kithah Tundohkit"},"9":{"text":"chutia chu sohchangho jah-a potdoh taovin, chule muthima umho jah-a hungkilahdoh un natiding ahi. Lamdunga kivah-untin, munsang jouse-a alhatlenao mun umding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Amaho gilkel dangchah talou ding; alumle nisanjong akahnat loudiu ahi. Ajehchu ahepi paovin puihoi jintin, twisam putna pang dunga apuilediu ahi.","ref":"Tph 7:16-17."},"11":{"text":"Chule kamolsang jouse lampin semingting, kalamlhongho kadop sang ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Veovin, hiche hohi gamlatah-a kona hungdiu ahin; chule vetan, hiche hohi sahlamle lhumlama kon; chule hiche hohi Sinim gama kona hungdiu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Vo vanho; kipala saovin; Vo leiset, thanomin umin; Vo molsang ho awthong jeju-a lasahnan pohjah-un. Ajehchu Pakaiyin amite alhamonin, akibol gentheinao chunga ahepiding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla Zion'in, Pakaiyin eidalhan, ka Pakaiyin eisumil tai, ati."},"15":{"text":"Numei jin anao noicheplai asuhmiljouva, ataijola peng achapa lainat louva umthei dingham? henge, amahon sumil theijunte, hijengjongle kenvang nangma kasuhmil louhel ding nahi."},"16":{"text":"Ven, kakhut phang chunga kasemdoh nahin, nakulbang ho kamasanga aumjinge."},"17":{"text":"Nachate chu ki kino uvintin; nasumanghole panabeija nakoi houchu nanga kona potdoh ding ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Khoda-in lang nakimvel vetemin, hiteho jousehi akikhom khomun, nahenga ahunguve. Pakaiyin keima kahingjingnai, nangin amaho jousehi thonlouhela kijepna-a naneiding, mounu kijep banga nachunga kijepna-a nanei ding ahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Ajehchu mun ongle namun kamhelsa ho, chule namanthah nao gamhochu tu-a chengho dinga chu neo behseh ding ahin, chule naval lhum hou chu gamlatah-a kitolmangdiu ahitai."},"20":{"text":"Adangho namansah nunga nacha nahin dingho chun, munhi kadingin aneubehseh-in, kachenna ding mun neipen tia nanakhanga aseikitdiu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuteng nangin nalungsunga, kon eihinpeh hitantem? Kachatela kachan joutan, akamhela kahin, sohchanga suhle tunga kichonlea kahilouham? vetan, kachang seh-a eikidalha-a, amahohi hoija anaum hiuvintem? natiding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, veuvin chidang namdangho chunga kakhut kadopsanga, miho dinga kaponlap katundoh ding; chule amahon nachapateo akhutnuva ahinpuijuva, alenguva nachanuteu ahinkitot dingu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Lengho chu nadontup uva pate hung hiuvintin, chule lengnu ho jong chu nadontup nu-u hiding ahiuve. Amaho na-ang uva amaiju tolam ngatna bohkhup uva, nakenga leivui ahinle ngimdiu ahin; chutia chu keihi Pakai chu kahi ti nahet jengding ahi. Ajehchu keima eingah ho chu jahcha louhel ding ahiuve."},"24":{"text":"Mihatpa-a kona anehban kilahpeh theija, ahiloule dandih-a gal hinga kikai chu, sohchathei ding ham?"},"25":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakaiyin hitin aseije, sohchang mihat tahho jeng jong kilamanga, gin umtah nehban jong kisalhah peh ding ahi. Ajehchu nangma kinelpipa chu kinelping ting, nachate chu kahuhhing ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule nangma sugenthei hochu amaho tahsa tah-a kavah-a, ju lhumtah banga amaho thisantah chu adonkhamdiu ahi. Chutengle tahsa hing jousen keima Pakai chu nahuhhingpa, nalhatdohpa le Jacob mihatpa kahi ahetdiu ahi."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin, ati, nanu kadana lekha chu hoija umtam? ahiloule kalei-bapa koipen koma kajohdoh nahiuvem, veuvin nakhangitlou jeh uva nanghole naho nakijoh uva, chule nasuhkhelnao jeh-a nanu kida ahi."},"2":{"text":"Ipijeh-a kahunga chu pasal khatcha naum lou uham? Kakouva chu eihouding khatcha umlou ham? Kakhut hin mi ahuhdoh lelhel nadinga kisuchoma ham? veuvin, twipi kaphoh-in agohelin, vadungho chu gamthip kasosah-in, anga'u hochu twi beijeh-in a-uijin, dang chah-in athiuvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Keiman vanho avomin kajemin, akhunaovin khaodip pon kaseme."},"4":{"text":"Athachol ho chu aphatcha thukhat seipehje kahetnadin Pakai Pathen'in seithemna lei eipen; jingseh-in eisukhangin mithem banga ngainadin kakol avansah-e."},"5":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in kakol eihonpeh in, kahuhelpon, kakinung heikit tahih helle."},"6":{"text":"Katungtun mivoho kadopeh-in, sambot ho kabengteni kadopeh-in, jachatnale chil setkhuma konin kamai kaselpoi."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in eipanpin tin, hijeh chun kisudong ponge. Hijeh chun kamaihi meituh song bangin kadon, jachatna kato louding chu kahei."},"8":{"text":"Them eichan sahpan einaije, koiham eikinelpi dinga? Eiho dingkhomu hite; koiham eikidoupia chu? kahenga hungnai hen."},"9":{"text":"Vetan, Pakai Pathen'in eipanpi ding ahin; themmo eichan dinga amachu koiham? Veovin, amaho abonuva pon banga chuldiu ahin, ngetnin aneh chaidiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nalah uva Pakai ginga alhachapa thusei jopma, muthima vahlea, vah himhim neilouva chu koiham? Pakai minchu tahsan henlang, a-Pathen chunga kingaihen."},"11":{"text":"Meisel de-a meisia kiumkim vel nangho jouse; nameivah-ule nameisel detnu mei sipahlah-a chun vahleuvin. Hichehi kakhutna namudingu chu ahin, lungkham tah a nalup dingu ahi."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chonphatna nung juija Pakai holte nanghon kathu ngaijun; nakikhendoh nao songpile nakilaidoh nao kokhuh lamchu veuvin.","title":"Jerusalem Kilhamona Thuho"},"2":{"text":"Napao Abraham le nahingu Sarah lam veuvin; ajehchu achang seh-in kakouvin, phatthei kanaboh-in kapunsah-e."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin Zion lhamon nintin, amunthip jouse lhamon inte, agamthip chu Eden bangin semintin, chule aneldigam chu Pakai hon bangin semintin, asunga chu kipanale thanopna, thangvahnale la ngei gin kijading ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kamiten kathu ngaijunlang, Vo kanam mite nanakhang hinsung uvin; ajehchu keija kona danthu hung kondoh-a, mitin salvah dinga kathutan na chu kakicholdo sah ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kachon phatna nikho ahungnaijin; kahuh hingna apotdohtan, kabantenin mitin thu atanding; twikol gamhon eingah untin, kabanna hi atahsan nao angap dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Van lama khodah-un lang, chule noilam leiset chung hinveuvin; ajehchu vanho chu meikhu banga jam manga, leiset hi ponsil banga chulding ahin, chutobanga chu asunga chengho thidiu ahin, kahuh hingna vang atonsotna umjinga, kachon phatna kisumang louding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chonphatna he-a alunga kadanthu he-ah nanghon kathusei ngaijun; mihem seiset ginghih-un, ahousetnau jong kicha hih helun."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu ponsil banga amaho ngetnin aneh uva, samul banga lungin anehdiu ahin, kachon phatna vang a-imatih chana uma, kahuh hingna akhang akhanga umding ahi."},"9":{"text":"O Pakai banjang; Khangin, khangin, thahat na-in kivonin; masanglai nikhole khanglui laija bangin khangin, Rahab sat na, Dragon mavo-a chu nang nahilouham?"},"10":{"text":"Nanghi twipi thuh nasatah twikhanglen kansah-a, lhatdohsate galkai nadinga twikhanglen thuhtah laija lampi sema chu nahilouham?"},"11":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Pakai lhatdohsate hungkileuva, lasahpuma Zion lama hungdiu, aluchung uva tonsot kipana chu umding ahi; amaho kipanale thanopna chang-un tin; lungkhamnale lunghemna jam mangding ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Keima, keimong monghi nangho lhamon na chu kahin; athiding mihem, hampa bangbepma kisem mihem chapa kichading koi nahiuvam;"},"13":{"text":"Vanho kijaldoh sah-a, leiset bul phutdetpa, nasempa Pakai na Pathen sumila, suhmang dinga nanago jing misugenthei pa lungsatna jeh-a niseh-a tanglouva kichajing nang koi nahim? Misugenthei pa lungsatna chu hoiba hitam?"},"14":{"text":"Kokhuh sunga athilouna dingle anehjong alhahsap lounadingin, gal hinga kikaimang chu lhadoh-a aumna din ama akinon ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla akinong ginglellul twipi homkhenpa Pakai na Pathen chu kahin, kamin janelho Pakai ahi."},"16":{"text":"Vanho kaphudetna, leiset bul kavui detna, Zion henga nangma kamite nahi kati theina din, kathuho nakam sunga kakhumin, kakhut limmin nangma kakhu khumin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Pakai khutna alungsatna khona dona, vo Jerusalem, khangin, khangin, dingdoh-in, kichat jeh-a kitihona khona kon aningkai geijin nadonin, nadon kang hele.","title":"Jerusalem Gentheina Kichai Ding","ref":"Tph 14:10; 16:19."},"18":{"text":"Amanun ahindoh chapa jouse lah-a, amanu puihoi ding khatcha aumpoi; ahin vahdoh chapaho jouse lah-a jong akhutna akaile khatcha aumpoi."},"19":{"text":"Hiche thilni hin nahin lhunkhum ding ahin, kon nalungkham peh tantem? Gamnale suhmangna, kel lhahna le chemjam; koijin nang nalhamon tan tem?"},"20":{"text":"Nachapate alhadah taovin, gam bongchal len thanga oh bangin khosung lamlen laija alumchap mun; amaho Pakai lungsatnale na Pathen'u phosalna dimset changa ahitaove."},"21":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun lengpitheija hilouva, suhgentheina-a khampan hichehi ngaijin."},"22":{"text":"Pakai na Pakai, amite thu seitohpeh-a na Pathen chun hitin ati, vetan, lamvaina khonle, kalungsatna ningkai khontah chu nakhutna konin kaladohtai; nadonkit tahlouhel ding ahitai, ati."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla nahinna jah-a, nachunga kache theinadiuvin bohkhupmin, tia nasugenthei ho khutna chun tollhang bangle kholai lamlen bangin nachunga lamjot ho dingin natahsa nadotan ahi."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khangin, khangin, vo Zion nathahatnin kivonin; Vo Jerusalem, khopitheng navon hoijin kivonin; ajehchu tua pat cheptanloule aboh nasunga lutlou hel ding ahitai.","title":"Pathen'in Jerusalem Ahuhdoh ding","ref":"Tph 21:1,27."},"2":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem, leivuija konin kithing ngimin, thoudoh-in lang, toulhan. Vo sohchang Zion chanu, nangonga nakihenna khaoho-a konin kisut lhamin."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin ati, ima hilouhel dinga kijoh nahiuvin, sumbeija kilhatdoh ding nahiuve, ati."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in hitin ati, masangin kamite Egypt'a khopemdin anachesuh uvin; ajeh beijin Assyria ten abol gentheijun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun Pakaiyin aseitai, hikoma hi keiman ipi kanei tah-em? Kamitela ima hilouhelin apuimang taovin, achunguva vaipoten la apensahsah uvin, chule ka min jong niseh-in tanglouhelin ataitom jinguve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Rom 2:24."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun kamiten keima min heovintin; hicheni chule amahon thuseipa chu keima kahi hetaovinte; veuvin keima kahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Molsang chungho-a kipana thupha pole pa kengphang chu iti hoi hitam? chamna thu phongle; thupha-a kipana thupha pole-a, huhhingna thu phonglea, Zion henga, na Pathen alengchang tai, tia seilepa chu!","ref":"Nah 1:15; Rom 10:15; Eph 6:15."},"8":{"text":"Khopi ngahhon aw sangtah-a asapdohdiu ahi: thakhat tah-a penga la asahdiu ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin Zion ahinpuikit tengle amitcheh uva akimudiu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Jerusalem mun kamhelsa ho thanomun lang, kipa la sakhom un, ajehchu Pakaiyin amite alhamonin Jerusalem alhatdohtai."},"10":{"text":"Pakaiyin abantheng chu namtin jouse mitmun agohkeo ahisah-in; chule leiset kolmong jousen i-Pathen nu mihuhhing na amudiu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Potdoh-un, potdoh-un, hiche-a konin chedoh-un lang, thilboh tongkha hih-un; alah-a konin potdoh-un, Pakai manchah ho choija nangho kisuthengun.","ref":"2 Cor 6:17."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu kintah-a, napotdoh loudiu, jamtho-a jong nache louheldiu, ajehchu Pakai nama sang uva chentin; Israel Pathen'in nanungu adelding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Vetan, kasohpan chingthei tah-in bolintin, ama choi-at le choisanga uma, sangtah-a umding ahi.","title":"Soh Hesoh Gentheipa"},"14":{"text":"Mitam tah-in adatmou bangin, amaiso mihem dang jouse-a sangin ase-in, chule apendan amelput mihem chapate ngaija sangin suhmelsetnin aumin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chutia chu aman namtin vaipi tamtah athe khuma; ama chungchanga leng hon akamu akisip dingu ahi. Ajehchu akihil khahlouhelu amuva, ajahkhah louhelu jong agelthem dingu ahi.","ref":"Rom 15:21."}}},"53":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kathulhut nu kon atahsana? Pakai bantha koihenga kilah-am?","ref":"Jhn 12:38; Rom 10:16."},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu ama amasanga chun hamdong kehthah bangle leigo-a ajung kikhodoh bangin hungkhangdoh-in tin, aman limle melhoina himhim aneipon, ideina diu hoina himhim aumpon ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ama chu mihemte nahsahmole paidoh-in aumin; lungdon le lung genthei he mi ahin; eihon ama-a konin imaiju ina selmangun, amachu nahsahmon ana umin, eihonjong ina gelsangdeh pouve."},"4":{"text":"Atahbeh-in aman ilungkhamnahou apon, chule ilung gentheinahou apotai, ahinla eihon aki engbol, Pathen vohle sugentheijin ingaitouve.","ref":"Matt 8:17."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla ama eiho suhkhel jeh-in akimavon, eiho khangitlou jeh-in akisugepmin, eiho lungmona dingin gimbolna chu amachunga achutai. Ama kijepna chun eidamsah taove.","ref":"1 Pet 2:24."},"6":{"text":"Eiho ibon chaovin kelngoi bangin ivah mangun, eiho amitakip inop nalam cheh-a ikiheijun, ahin Pakaiyin eiho khangitlouna jouse achunga angamtai.","ref":"1 Pet 2:25."},"7":{"text":"Ama akisugen theijin, ama akibolgimtai, ahijeng vangin ama akamkapoi. Ama thadinga kikai kelngoi bangin akaijun, kelngoi amulvouho anga athipbeh bangin chutichun akamkapoi.","ref":"Tph 5:6."},"8":{"text":"Ama sohchan nale thutan na-a konin akilamang tai. Kon ama khanggui thu asut thei dingham? Ajehchu ama mihing gama kona kisumanga ahitai. Ajehchu kamite suhkhel jeh-a ki-engbola ahitai.","ref":"Sol 8:32-33."},"9":{"text":"Aman hunamin ima abolpon, akamin jong lheplhahna thu khatcha aseikhapoi; aman alhankhuh chu migiloute-a toh asemgomin, athi-a chun mihaopa toh aumkhom me.","ref":"1 Pet 2:22."},"10":{"text":"Hitajongle suhgep dingchu Pakai lunglam chu ahitan; aman natna athohsahtai. Nangin ahinna chonset thilto-a nasemtengle, aman achilhah kimuntin, anikhoho asaosah ding, Pakai lunglhaina chu akhutna khangtou ding ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Aman ahinna thohgimna chu amua, lunglhai ding ahitai. Aman agitlounau apohpeh dingjeh-a kasohdih tah chun ahetna-a mitamtah them achanding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu keiman amachu milenhotoh chan kahop peh-a, aman mihat ho chu thil kichom akihoppi ding ahi. Ajehchu aman thina geijin ahinna abunglhan ahi. Chutichun ama suhkhel hotoh akisimthatan; mitamtah chonsetna apon, achonkhelho dingin ataopeh-in ahi.","ref":"Mrk 15:28; Luk 22:37."}}},"54":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo achinga chaneilou nun kipah-in la san lang, hatah-in samin; naosonat thohkhalou nu nangma, ajehchu jineiho chate sangin achingnu chate atamjoi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","title":"Pakaiyin Israel Angailut","ref":"Gal 4:27."},"2":{"text":"Napon in mun kehlenin lang, chule nachen detna pon in chungchu kijalsah-in, khen neilouvin nakhao chu saosah-in lang, chule ahenna mol ho chu khendetnin;"},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu jetle veija kithejah intin, nachilhah hon chidang namdangte chu louvintin, khopi gamho chu chenna-a aneidiu ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Kicha hih-in; ajehchu najachat louding, nakisuhdong louhel ding ahi. Ajehchu naneo laija najachatna nasuhmila, na meithai nahsah louva aumna chu nageldoh kit louhel ding ahitai."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu nasempa chu najipa ahin, janelho Pakai chu amin ahi. Nalhatdohpa chu Israel mithengpa ahin, ama chu leiset pumpi Pathen kitiding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu akidalha lhagaova lungnatah neogol ji kideitalou numei khat tobanga Pakaiyin nakoukit ahitai, tin na Pathen'in aseije."},"7":{"text":"Phat chomcha dinga kadalhahsa nahitan, ahinla hepina lentah-a kakhopkit ding nahi."},"8":{"text":"Lungkhamna neochakhat jeh-in mitphehkah louvin nanga kamai kanaselin, ahinla tonsot khotona-a kahepi nahi, tin nalhat doh-a Pakai chun aseije."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu keidin hichu Noah nikho tobang ahi, Ajehchu Noah twi chun leiset achupkit louding ahitai, tia kahahsel bangchun nachunga lunghangkit, phohsal kit taponge tia kaki hahsel ahitai.","ref":"Semt 9:8-17."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu lhangho kitoldoh-a, mol ho kitolmang ding ahin, ahinla kakhotona chu nanga kona kitoldoh louding; kachamna jong nanga kona kichondoh louhel ding ahi, tin, nahepi-a Pakai chun aseije."},"11":{"text":"Vo nang bolgenthei khopi hui mutlon lele, lhamong lou, vetan, nasongho chu ajemhoija kaphua, na inbul chu saphir songa kaphu detding ahi.","ref":"Tph 21:18-21."},"12":{"text":"Chule nabangkot ho song sandang, chule nakotpiho song santhip, chule nagamgi jouse song hoitah-a kasemding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule nachate jouse chu Pakai hildoh hidiu, nachate chamna chu nasatah hiding ahitai.","ref":"Jhn 6:45."},"14":{"text":"Chonphatna-a naki phudetna, suhgentheija kona gamlatah nahiding ahi. Ajehchu tijatna-a kona nakichat louding ahi. Ajehchu hichun nahin nailouding ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Vetan, amaho kikhom khom teidiu ahin, keija konvang hiloudiu ahi. Nangma douna-a kikhom chanchu nangma vanga lhudiu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Vetan, keiman pummeija meihol japma, thihkhengpa anatoh nading manchah kikhendohpa chu kanasem ahin, asumang ding thilsumanghelpa jongchu kanasem ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nangma douna-a galmanchah kigon ho chu lolhing louding; chule thutan na-a nangma douva leigui takipchu themmo nachang ding ahi. Hichu Pakai sohte goulo ahin, achonphatnao chu keija ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."}}},"55":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khaije, adangchah channin twiphung hinjon hen, chule sum neilou chan hungun lang kichoh-un, chule neovin; henge, hungun, lengpitwi le bongnoi sum beija manbeijin hung kichoh-un.","title":"Pathen lungsetna Thilpeh","ref":"Tph 21:6; 22:17."},"2":{"text":"Ipijeh-a changlhah hilouva sum nasuh manguva? chule van'a louhella natohgim uham? Kaseihi lunglut tah-in ngaijun, nanghon apha chu neuvin, chule nahinnao chu thaona-a chun kipah hen."},"3":{"text":"Nanakol-u hinsungun lang kahenga hungun; ngaijun, chutile nahinnao chu hing ding ahi. Chutile David kihepina tahbeh chu naheng uva tonsot kitepna-a kasem ding ahi.","ref":"Sol 13:34."},"4":{"text":"Vetan, miho dinga hettohsah hidingin amachu kapen, miho dinga lamkainale thuneina amachu kapei."},"5":{"text":"Ven, nahetkhahlou namkhat kouvin natin, Pakai Pathen vangle Israel mithengpa jala nangma hekhalou namhochu nahenga hungjam diu ahi. Ajehchu aman nachoi-at ahitai."},"6":{"text":"Mutheija aumpetnin Pakai chu hollun, nailama aumpet nin amachu kouvun."},"7":{"text":"Migilouvin alampi dalha hen chule chonpha loupan alungngaito dalhahen; Pakai hengle i-Pathen'u henga hung kilehen, chutile hepina changa chamkimtah-a ngaidam hiding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ijeh inem itileh kangaito hohi nangho ngaito ahipon, nalampi hou jong kalampi ahipoi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu leiset sanga vanho asanjoh bangin, keima lampiho jong nangho lampi ho sangin asangjon, chule keima ngaito hojong nangho ngaito ho sangin asangjoi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu gotwi le buhbang van'a kona ahunglhah-a, chunglama kilekitlouva, leiset achapnou joh-a thil akedohsah-a chule amumdohsah ahin, muchi thepa muchi-a apeh nadingle, anneh-a hingpa changlhah apehnadinga ahi.","ref":"2 Cor 9:10."},"11":{"text":"Kakam sunga kona potdoh thuchu chutiding ahin, hichu agoh-a hungkile louhel ding, kadeichu asuhbulhitna, kasolna thilla chu lolhingjo ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu kipah-a kondoh a chamdela nakipuidoh diu, molle lhanghon namasanguva penga la asahdoh jenguva, chule loujaova thingphung jousen khut abehcheh diu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Lingthing khella chahthihg kehdoh-a, khao lingnei khella lenmuipah phung kehdoh ding, chule Pakai dinga minphatnale suhtan hi louhel ding tonsotna melchihna ding chu hiding ahi."}}},"56":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tonsot Pakaiyin hitin ati, thukitan chu nit uvin lang, adih chu bollun; ajehchu keima mihuhhing na hunglhung loiding ahitai, chule kachon phatna hungkiphong doh ding ahitai.","title":"Namtin Vaipi Jouse Pathen'in Amite-a Asim"},"2":{"text":"Hiche bolpa hi anunmon ahi; mihem chapa hiche tuhchah jingpa; suboh louva cholngah nikho nitjingpa, chule akhut thilse bolna-a kona tuhtang jingpa chu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Gamdangmi chapa, Pakai to kijop matsa chun Pakaiyin amite-a konin eichom khomheltai tin seida hen, nukiso jongchun, vetan, keima thinggo kahitai tin seidahen."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nukiso keima choldo nikho jouse nitjinga, kalungdeilam kilhenna, chule kakitepna tuhjingpa chu;"},"5":{"text":"keiman amahotah chu ka-insungle kakulbang sunga munkhat, chapate le chanute sanga phajohel munkhat le minkhat kapeh ding ahi. Keiman amaho amangkit louheldinga tonsotna umjing ding min kapeh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Gamdang mi chapate Pakai toh kijopmat ho, ama jenna dingle Pakai min ngailutna dinga, ama soh hidinga, choldoni suhbohlouva nitjinga, chule kakitepna tuhchah chanjong chu;"},"7":{"text":"amaho ngei chu kalhangthenga kapuija, kataona insunga kipana kadimsah ding; agovam thiltohoule akithoina houchu ka maicham chunga sanpeh hiding ahi. Ajehchu ka-in chu mijouse dinga taona in kitiding ahi.","ref":"Matt 21:13; Mrk 11:17; Luk 19:46."},"8":{"text":"Israel kinodohho chomkhom Pakai Pathen chun aseije, ahenga kichomsaho tailouva, adangho jong ahenga kachom khombe nahlai ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Loujaova gamsaho jousen hungne jouvun; ahije, nangho gam manga gamsaho jousen jong hungneovin.","title":"Israel Lamkaiho Themo Kichan"},"10":{"text":"Akhongah hou chu mitcho ahiuve, ima heloucheh, abonchauva uicha hamma hamtheilou, mijong haptheilou cheh ahiuvin; lumma ihmunom ahiuve."},"11":{"text":"Ahi, amaho chimtih neilou uichalop le hetkhenna neitheilou kelngoiching ahiuvin; abonun achennaova koncheh-in, ama deilam chehle aphat chomna dingcheh akivet taove."},"12":{"text":"Amahon, hungun keiman lengpitwi galangting, khamnatheija idimsoh diu ahin, jing jongkhu tuni tobang hintin, nengjocheh ding ahi, atiuve."}}},"57":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Michonpha amangthah jin, koiman lunga akoipoi. Mihepiho akipui mangin, thilphalou hunglhung dinga kona michonpha kipuimanga ahi, tin koiman agelpoi.","title":"Israel Milim hou Demna Akinei"},"2":{"text":"Ama chamna-a lutnintin: amaho ajalkhun uva choldodiu, ama dihsahna-a lamjotcheh ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Nangho gaothusei them chapate, mijigem le mijong sonho hilama hungnai jun,"},"4":{"text":"koi douna-a golsehbol nahiuvem? Koi douna-a kamka-a leilha doh-a nahiuvem? Nangho suhkhel neiho chate, mijouho son nahi lou uham?"},"5":{"text":"Thing hing phung noi tina milim hotoh Nachon thanghoi juva, phaicham dunga songpi khikeh ho noija naosen ho thatgama nahilou uham?"},"6":{"text":"Vachadung song jolpet ho lah-a nachan aumin; amaho, amahotah chu navang chan ahin, amaho hengtah-a chun donding thilto nalhei lhan anneh thilto natohji-e. Hicheho-a hi lhamon na kamu ding ham?"},"7":{"text":"Nangin munsangle molsang chunga najalkhun nadon; chulamtah-a chun ganlhaina tohdingin nakaltouve."},"8":{"text":"Kot hole khomho nunglama chun naki melchihna natung doh-e; ajehchu keisanga achom nahi chu nangle nangin neikhe doh-in, nakaldoh-e. Nangin najalkhun nakeh lenin amahotoh kitepna nasemin ahi, nangin nagahmu ajalkhun hou chu nangaichan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule nangma lengpa henga nuding thao nachoijin nachen, nanamtui behseh-in, chule nasottol gamlatah-a nasolin, thikholkhul geijenin naki suneme."},"10":{"text":"Nalampi saojeh-in nachol lhehtai, ahinla nangin kinepna aumpoi natidehpoi. Nangin nakhutna hinna nakimutai; hijeh chun nalungkham poi."},"11":{"text":"Chule koi nakichat na ahiloule naginna jou nasei hija, keima neigeldoh louva, nalunga jong koilouva nahim? sottah kathipbeh hilou hija neigin louhel ham?"},"12":{"text":"Nachon phatna le nanatoh phongdoh inge, ajehchu hicheho chun phatchomsah ponnate."},"13":{"text":"Nakatengle naloihon nahuhdoh-u hen; ahinla amaho abonuva huijin alhohmang gamuva, mohseh-a alenmang pidiu, ahinla atahsan keija ngampan bou gamsung chu aneija, kalhangtheng chu aloding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule sepsangun, sepsangun, lampichu semtoh-un, kamite-a konin kipalna bul ladoh-un tinte.","title":"Kithopi Dingle Suhdam Dinga Pathen Kitepna"},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu tonsot munlo-a asangle chungnung pen amin atheng chun, hitin aseije; keima munsangle mun thenga cheng kahi, lhagaova lungnempa suhal dingle, chonset lungkham pipa lung suhhalna dingin, chonset lungkhampipa le lhagaova lungnempa kachen khompi-e."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu tonsotnin doujing pongting, lungjong lunghang jingponge, ajehchu kasemsa lhagaole hinna chu kamasanga hungthon getnunte."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu akhangit louna kilosetna-a chun kana lunghangin, kanavon ahi; kamai kasela kalunghan ahin, amachu alung gotna lampia seingailou hella chepeh-a, ahi."},"18":{"text":"Keiman alampiho kamutan, kadamsah ding ahi, ken amajong chu kapuija, amale alhaset piho chu lhamona kapeh ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Keiman kamsung ga chu kasem ahin, gamlatah-a umpale naija umpa henga chamna, chamna umhen, keiman ama kadamsah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla migilouho chu twikhanglen kinong tobang ahiuvin, aumthimbeh louteng bonlhohle bohse jong anuhdohjin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ka Pathen chun migilouho dinga chamna himhim aumpoi ati."}}},"58":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khenlou helin ging tah-in kho samin, sumkon bangin na aw sansah-in, kamite suhkhelnale Jacob insung mite chonsetna chu musah-in.","title":"An-ngol Dihtah"},"2":{"text":"Chonphatna bolla, a-Pathen chondanho dalhakhalou namkhat tobangin, amahon nitinin eihol holun, kalampiho hetding anomuve. Amahon thutah chondan ho angeh jiuvin, Pathen hinnai dingjong athanomun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ibolla an ka ngolule neimupeh daova, ibola kahinnao kasuh gentheijule neihetpeh daoham? atiuve. Veuvin, na-anngol niuchun nopsahna naholun, namigoihou jouse nabolseuve."},"4":{"text":"Veuvin, nanghon kinahnale kinelnan, chule gitlouna khut tuma kisuhto nan an na ngoluve. Chunglama na aw kijahna dinga, tunia banga hi an na ngol loudingu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Keiman kalhen chu hitobang an ngol hi hija ham? mikhatnin ahinkho asuhgentheiding nikho chu hibanghi hia ham? Lekha phaipheng banga alu kun-a, anoija khaodip pon le vut pha chu an ngol kiti theija ham? Chule hichu Pakai dinga santhei nikho hiding hinam?"},"6":{"text":"Keiman kanalhen an-ngolchu hitihi hilouham? Khansetna-a kikanho lhaplhah ding, pohgih poho doplhah ding, suhgentheija umho jalensah ding, namkoljon tincheng suhboh dinghi hilouham?"},"7":{"text":"Agil kelho nachanglhah nahoppeh-a, genthei inna kon kikaidoh ho na-inna napuilut ding hilouham? asagoh-a um namuteng pon nasilpeh-a, nangma tahsa tobang neiho-a kona nakiselmanglou chu hilouham?","ref":"Matt 24:35."},"8":{"text":"Chutengle jingkah bangin navah kikhodoh-in tin, nadamtheina gangtah-in hung kilang doh-intin, nachon phatna namasanga chentin, Pakai loupina chu nanungdal hiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuteng nangin kouvin natin, Pakaiyin nahouding, nangin samin natin, aman hikoma kaume atiding ahi. Nangin nalah uva kona namkoljon le khutjunga kikotona, chule pannabei thu kisei nalah manga;"},"10":{"text":"Nahinna chu agilkelte henga nabuh lhah-a, akibol gentheiho nalung lhaisah leh, navah chu athimlah-a vahdoh intin, navela muthim jong sunlai bangding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin tanglouvin puijin natin, nahinna chu gamgo laija jong lunglhaijintin, naguho athaosah ding: nangma twi kichapnou jing honsung bangin natin, twinah banga atuichu kanglou ding ahi,"},"12":{"text":"chule nangma-a hidingho chun munsesa luiho chu sephaovintin, khang tamtah-a inbul kiphut chu natundoh ding ahin; nangchu aselai semphapa, chena ding lampiho semphapa nakitiding nahi."},"13":{"text":"Nangin nakeng chu cholngah nikho kanitheng ni-a nadeilam bolna dinga kona naheimanga; cholngah nichu kipani nati-a, Pakaiya atheng chu ja-uma nagela, ama najabola, nangma nopna lam bolouva, nangma nopsahna dinglam holouva, nangma thu seilouva na-umle:","title":"Choldo Nikho Nit ho Chanding"},"14":{"text":"Pakaiyah kipah-in natin, leichung munsang ho-a chun tousah ingting; napa Jacob gou lo-a chu kavahding nahi. Ajehchu Pakai kamin hichu aseidoh ahitai."}}},"59":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Veuvin, Pakai khutchun mi ahuhhing joulou dingin akisuchompon; anakhang jong kho ajah theilouna dingin angong hih hele.","title":"Themgaopan Mipi ho Chonsetna Themmo Achan"},"2":{"text":"Ahinla nakhansetnao chun nanghole na Pathen'u kikah-a nachomkhenu ahin, nachonset nao chun ajahlouna dinga nangho-a kona amai asel ahibouve."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu nakhut hou thisanna, chule nakhut junghou khansetna-a kisuboh-ah ahitai; namuh-un thujou aseijin, naleigui uvin jong thukaleh jeng asodoh jin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Koiman adihtah aseipon, koima thutah dinpi aumpoi. Amahon ahomkeo atahsanun, thujou aseijuve. Amahon umchan phalou avopmun, khansetna ahin jiuve."},"5":{"text":"Amahon gulse tui a-opkeuvun, maimom pan akhongjiuve; hiche tui nechanchu athijin, akikhedoh penpen chu gulse-in akeujiuve."},"6":{"text":"Amompan ho chu ponsil sohdoh louding, athilbollu chu kihuina anei louheldiu ahi. Athilbol hou khansetna thilbol ahin, hunam thilbol chu akhutnuva um ahi."},"7":{"text":"Akengu thuphalou lama alhaijin, amaho thisan sonan akinojiuve. Angaitou chu suhmangna ngaito ahin, alampiuva gamnale manthah na aumme.","ref":"Rom 3:15-17."},"8":{"text":"Amahon chamna lampi ahepouvin, achele naova thudihtah aummong mongpoi. Amahon lampikon akisemun, chua che chanchun chamna ahet loudingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun thutah chu eihoa konin agamlan, thudih-in jong eipha joupouve. Eihon khovah ingah-un, ahinla muthim akimui, khovah khelin muthim lah joh-a ivahle taove.","title":"Mipihon Chonset Aphonu"},"10":{"text":"Keihon mitcho bangin bang kachulun, mit neilou bangin kakimai lele uvin ahi. Janlai bangin sunlai tah-in kakipalun; mithiho bangin mungemsa laitah-a kaum jiuve."},"11":{"text":"Vompi bangin kakitum letlut cheh-un, vakhuho bangin lhasetah-in kamao mao-uve, thutanna kangah-un, khatcha aumpoi. Huhhingna kangah-un, keiho-a kona gamlatah ahijoi."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu kakhangit lounao namasanga apungcheh cheh-in, kachonsetnu hin eiphochen jiuvin ahi. Ajehchu suhkhelna hoto kaum khomun, kakhan setnao dolchu kakihetnun ahi;"},"13":{"text":"Pakai douna-a chonkhelnale thujouva, ka Pathen uva kona chemangin, suhgenthei nale kidouna thuseijin, jouthu kalunguva kavopmun, kasodoh jiuve."},"14":{"text":"Chule thutanna chu akinung chonin, thudih chu gamlatah-a adingtai. Thutah chu lamdunga alhupan, adih chu alut joutapoi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi, thutah chu athonjin, aphalouva kona kikangse chu anchah-in apangjitai. Hichu Pakaiyin amun, thudih tanna himhim umlou chun alung phamotan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin mi aumlouhel chu amun, midinga taopeh abeihel chu adatmo lheh-e, hijeh chun abantenin huhhingna apohpeh-in; ama chonphatna chun adinsahtai.","title":"Pathen'in Amite Huhdoh ding Agon","ref":"Isai 63:5."},"17":{"text":"Hichechun aman chonphatna ompho bangin akivonin, alua huhhingna lukhuh akhuh-in, phulahna ponin akivonin, tompanna chu sangkhol chollin aki ah-e.","ref":"Eph 6:14,17; 1 Thess 5:8."},"18":{"text":"Anatoh-u dungjuijin kibang tah-in lethuh unte, akidoupiho chu lungsat na-in, amelmate lethuh inte, twikol gamhojong lethuhna-in lethuh inte."},"19":{"text":"Kichaovintin, chutia chun amahon lhumlama konin Pakai minchu, chule nisolama kona aloupisah diu ahi. Melma chu twisoh banga ahung kondoh tengle chuche douna-a Pakai lhagao chun ponlap khat atundoh ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule lhatdampu chu Zion huhdoh dingle Jacob sunga suhkhelna-a kona kilete henga hungding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Rom 11:26."},"21":{"text":"Keidin vang hiche hi amahotoh kakitepna ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Nachunga um kalhagao chule nakamsunga kathuho chu, nachilhahte kama konle nachilhahte chilhahte kama kona jong tua pat atonsot ageija potdoh louding ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."}}},"60":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thoudoh inlang Salvah tan; ajehchu navah chu ahunge, Pakai loupi chu nachunga ahungsohtai.","title":"Ahunglhung Ding Phatna Jerusalem Loupina"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu ven, muthimin leiset ahinkhu-a, muthim lhangkhal in amite ahinkhu ding; hijongle nachunga Pakai chu hungsohdoh-intin, aloupina chu nachunga hungkilang ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule chidang namdangte chu navah-a hungun tin, chule lengho navah dohna vah-em lama hungdiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Khodah inlang vekimvel temin, chule vechenin; akichom khomun, nahenga ahunguve. Nachapate gamlatah-a konin hunguntin, nachanute chu nakoma kijending ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chuteng nangin munatin, hicheho chu thakhatnin hungsoh doh inte. Chule nalungsung kicha-a, suhjaova umding ahi. Ajehchu twikhanglen ninglhina chu nahenga hungding, chidang namdangte hatna chun nahinphah ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Sangongsao tamtah le, Midian le Ephah gam sangongsao golbepho chun nahinlonvuh ding ahin; abonuva Sheba-a kona hungdiu ahin, amahon sanale gimnamtui ahinchoidiu; abonuva Pakai loupina chu atahlangdiu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Kedar te gancha honho jouse nahenga hung kichom khomuntin; Nebaioth kelngoichal hon najendiu ahi. Amahochu ka-maicham chunga santhei doltah-a hungtou uva, chule ka loupina in chu kachoi-at ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Meilhang banga lengle-a, vakhuho banga abangkot dunguva lengle-a hichehohi koi hiuvaham?"},"9":{"text":"Aman loupina-a nachoi-at tahjeh-in, Pakai na Pathen mindingle, Israel mithengpa ding jala nachapate chu adangka hou le asana houtoh gamlatah-a kona puidinga, thonlouhela twikol gamhon einga dingu ahin, Tarshish konglen ho chu masapen dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule gamdangmi chapaten nakul banghou hinsa doh-uvintin, chule alenghouvin jong nangma najendiu ahitai. Ajehchu kalunghana-a kajep nahin, hijeng jongle khohsah na-a nachunga kanahepi nahi."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun miten chidang namdangte thaneina chu nahenga ahinpoh lutnuva, alenghou ahinpui theina diuvin nakotpiho tanglouvin kihong intin, sunle jana kikhah louhel ding ahiuve.","ref":"Tph 21:25-26."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma jenlou ding nam le lenggam chu mangthah diu ahin; henge, hiche namho chu mahthah helding ahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Kamun theng jephoina dinga Lebanon loupina chu nahenga hunglhunga, chahthing, phanthing, meila thingho kehkhoma, kakeng ngapna munchu loupina-a kaki choi-atna ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nabolgenthei ho chapate nahenga kun uva, i-nasahlouho jousechu nakengto noija hungkun uva chibai nabohdiu ahi. Amahon Pakai khopi Israel mithengpa Zion chu nangma nahi, atidiu ahi.","ref":"Tph 3:9."},"15":{"text":"Koiman nahin jotpa lou khopma dalhahle hotna nana um ahin, tonsot chungnunna khangtamtah kipana-a kasemding nahi."},"16":{"text":"Nangin chidang namdangte noitwi jong nachepma, lengho noijong nachep ding ahi. Nangin keima Pakai chu nahuhhingpa le nalhatdohpa Jacob mihatpa kahichu nahetding ahi,"},"17":{"text":"keiman sum-eng khela sana, thih khela dangka, thing khela sum-eng chule songho khela thih kahinpohlutpeh-a, navaipo te jong chamna kapeh-a, navaihom te chonphatna kapeh ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Nagamsunga thuse kija louding, chule nagamgi sunga gamna le suhmangna kijalouhel ding ahitai. Nangin nakulbang ho chu huhhingna ahin, nakotpiho chu pachatna ahi, nahin tiding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Sun teng nisa chu navah-a pangchom talouva, vahdinga lhathah-in jong vah napehchom louding ahitai. Ahinla Pakai chu natonsot vah leh na Pathen loupina-a pangding ahitai.","ref":"Tph 21:23; 22:5."},"20":{"text":"Na nisa lhumtalouhel ding, na lhathah mangtalouhel ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakai chu natonsot vah hija, nalunghemna nikhoho kichaisoh ding ahitai."},"21":{"text":"Namite jouse michonpha hiuvintin, atonsotna gamsung alodingu ahin, choi-atna kaum theina dinga amahochu kathingphu bah kakhutsoh chu hiuva ahi."},"22":{"text":"Lhom chakhat chu sangkhat hungsoh intin, aneucha khat chu nam hattah khat hunghi ding ahi. Keima Pakaiyin aphatcha kalhunsah loiding ahi."}}},"61":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai Pathen lhagao chu kachunga aume; ajehchu Pakaiyin milung nengte henga kipana thupha seiphong dinga thao einu ahin; lungna teho suhdampeh dinga eisol ahi, sohchangte henga chamlen nathu lhangsam ding, chule sohchang ho henga songkul kihondoh thu hillhang dinga eisol ahin,","title":"Huhdohna Kipana Thupha","ref":"Matt 11:5; Luk 7:22.  ; Luk 4:18-19"},"2":{"text":"Pakai santhei kumle, i Pathen'u phulah nikho hillhanga, alunghemte jouse lhamonsah dinga;","ref":"Matt 5:4."},"3":{"text":"Zion'a lunghemte henga lhamonsahna, vut khella hoina, lunghemna khella kipana thaotwi, lhagao pohgih khella pachatna ponsil pe dinga, hitia chu amaho Pathen thingphu, chonphatna thingphung tia akikouna diu, hitia chu ama choi-atna amutheina dinga eihinsol ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule amahon agamlui sesao asah phatnuva, masanga akamhelsa atundoh kitdiu, chule khopi gamsaho khangtamtah-a kamhelsa asemphat dingu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule gamdangmi hung kipatdoh uva nakelngoi honnu avah uva, gamdangmi chapate chu nalou kaijule nalengpilei lhouvuva hungpang ding ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla nangho Pakai thempuho nakisah uva, mihon Pathen kinbolho natidiu ahin; nanghon chidang namdangte haona naneh uva, aloupinao chu nakisonpi diu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Najachat nao khella ajatni namudiu, chule lungnoh phah khella achanuva kipahdiu ahin, hijeh-a chu agamsung uva chu chan nijen alodiu, achunguva tonsot kipana umding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai keima hin thutah kangailun, govam thilto dinga thil kichom kimangcha kathen; chule dihtah-a anatoh-u lamkai jingting, amahotoh tonsot kitepna kasemding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule achilhahteu chu chidang namdangte lah-a hetna uma, chule achateu chu mipite lah-a hetdoh-a umdingu ahi. Amaho mujousen amaho ahetkhendiu, hitia chu Pakai phatthei boh chilhahte hidiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Keima Pakaiya hapan kipah ingting, kahinna ka Pathen'a kipah inte. Ajehchu aman huhhingna pon eisilpehtan, moulang akijep bangle, mounu sana vona akivon bangin aman chonphatna ponlenin eihuije.","ref":"Tph 21:2."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu leisetnin apahmum ahinsodoh bangle, honin asunga thil kituho adondohsah banga, hitia chu Pakai Pathen'in chonphatna le vahchoina namjouse masanga ahinsepdoh ding ahi."}}},"62":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ajehchu chonphatna chu vah banga asodoh-a, huhhingna chu meivah banga akondoh masangsen, Zion jal-in umthimbeh pongting, chule Jerusalem jallin cholnga ponge."},"2":{"text":"Chule chidang namdang ten nachon phatna, leng jousen naloupina amuteidiu, chule nangma Pakai kama kisah minthah khatna nakikou ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nangma Pakai khutna loupina lal lukhuh leh, na Pathen khutna leng lukhuh jong nahi ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nangma akidalha naki tikit talou ding, nagam jong agohkeo kitikit talouhel ding ahi. Ahinla nangma Hephzi-bah nakisah-a, chule nagam Beulah kisah ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakai nangma chunga akipah-in, chule nagam chu hung jineiding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu gollhangin nungah theng khat akichenpi banga, hitia chu nachapaten nahin kichenpi diu ahin; chule moulang mounu chunga akipa banga hita chu na Pathen nachunga kipahding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem, nakulbang ho chunga khongah ho kakoije, amahon sunle jana thiptih aneiloudingu, Pakai geldoh jinga nangho thip hih helun."},"7":{"text":"Aman Jerusalem atundoh-a, leisetna phatthei chang khatna asemdoh kahsen, kicholdosah hihhelun."},"8":{"text":"Pakai chu akhutjetlam leh aban thahatnin akihahseltai.
