Tahbeh-a nachang chu namelmate an dinga kapehkit tahlou ding ahi, chule gamdang mi chapaten natohgim ga lengpitwi chu adonloudiu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahinla alhoh khom hon hichu aneh uva, Pakai chu avahchoidiu ahin, chule ahin pokhom hon kathenna in hongsunga adondiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Jotpaijun, kotpiho chu jotpaijun; mipi ho lampi gontohpeh uvin; dipsangun, dipsangun lamlhongpi chu; song hochu loh doh-un, mipidin ponlap khat domsangun."},"11":{"text":"Veuvin, vannoi leiset kolmong geijin Pakaiyin ahillhangtai. Nanghon Zion chanu jah-a seijun ven, nahuhhingna ahung lhungtai; vetan, atohphat man le anatoh ahin kengin a-anga aume.","ref":"Isai 40:10; Tph 22:12."},"12":{"text":"Chule amahon amaho chu mithengho Pakai lhatdamsate atidiu, chule nangma holdohsa, dalhahlou khopi khat kitiding nahi."}}},"63":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Edom'a kona hungpa Bozrah-a kona ponsandup kisila hungahi koiham? Akivon na loupi tah, thahatna nasatah banga hunga chu, Keima chonphatna-a thuseija, huhhingna dinga hattah chu kahi.","title":"Namtin Vaipi Chunga Pakai Galjo","ref":"Isai 34:5-17; Jer 49:7-22; Ezek 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Obad 1-14; Mal 1:2-5."},"2":{"text":"Ipidinga naponsil hitisan hija; chule naponsil chu lengpithei chilpa-a tobanga ham?"},"3":{"text":"Keiman kachangin lengpithei kachillin, miholah-a khatchan eihupoi. Ajehchu amaho chu kalunghana-a kachotpha-a, chule kalungsatna-a kachil ngem ding; athisannu kaponsil ho-a kithekhuma, kavon jouse-a kasuhmat ding ahi.","ref":"Tph 14:20; 19:13,15."},"4":{"text":"Ajeh chu phulahna nikho chu kalunga uma ahin, kalhatdam kum chu ahung lhunge."},"5":{"text":"Chuin keiman kaven, eipanpi ding koimacha aumpon, eikai ding ding koimacha aumlou chu kalungdonge: hijeh chun kakhut tah-in keima dingin huhhingna eihin pohpeh-in, kalunghan na chun eikaiding tai.","ref":"Isai 59:16."},"6":{"text":"Chule kalung hana-in miho chotphang ting, kalunghan na-in amaho khamsah ingting, ahatnau tolsena kanei ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ichunguva Pakai thilpeh jouse dungjuile, Israel insung mite dinga aphatna nasatah dungjuija, amihepina dungjuija athilpeh ho jalleh, ami lungset phatna ho jallin; keiman Pakai lungset phatna chu seijing ting, Pakai vahchoina thu kaseiding ahi.","title":"Israel te-a dinga Pakai Phatna"},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu aman aseije, amahohi keima mite mongmong, chule jouloubeh ding chate ahiuve, ati. Chutichun ama amaho huhhingpu anahi."},"9":{"text":"Amaho kibol gimna channa ama jong kibolgimji ahin, a-anga um vantil chun amaho ahuhhing tai. Aman angailutna leh akhotona-in amaho chu alhatdoh-in; aman khangluilai jousen amaho avopmin, apolen ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla amahon adouvun, alhagao theng chu ana lungphatmosah-ui. Hijeh chun ama amaho melmadin ahung kihei doh-in, amatah-in amaho akisatpitai."},"11":{"text":"Chuphatnin aman khanglui lai, Mosi le amite ageldoh-in, twikhanglen'a kona akelngoihon chingpatoh puidohpa chu hoija umham? asunga A-Lhagao Theng khumpeh pachu hoija umtam?"},"12":{"text":"Loupitah-a Mosi khut jetlama amaho puilea, tonsot amin aumjing nadinga amasanguva twipi sukhenpa hoilam ham?","ref":"Pot 14:21."},"13":{"text":"Amaho akipal louna dinguva gamthip laija sakol banga twi thuhtah laija puigalkai pa hoiba hitam?"},"14":{"text":"Phaichama gancha kumsuh bangin, Pakai lhagaovin ama acholdosah-in; chutichun namin loupina dingin namite nakaihoijin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Van'a konin hinvesuh inlang, chule nathen nale naloupina umna mun'a konin hinven; natompan nale nagunchuna keidinga nalainatnale nahepina hoi hitam? kituhtanga hitaovam?","title":"Hepi leh Panpinadia Taona"},"16":{"text":"Abraham'in eihe hih-u henlang, Israel'in eihehih jongleu, nangma kapau nahi-e. Vo Pakai nang kapau eilhandampu nahi; naminhi a-itih-a patna umjing ahi."},"17":{"text":"Vo Pakai ibolla nalampi ho-a kona nei chekhel sah uva, nangma kakichatna diuva kona neilungtah sah-u ham? nagoulo phungho, nasohte jal-in hungkiletan."},"18":{"text":"Nathenna miten hichu chomcha khatbou aneijun; kakidoupi teovin namun thengchu achotpha taove."},"19":{"text":"Keiho nanga kahiuvin, amaho chunga vai nahom khapoi; amaho namina kikou ahipouve."}}},"64":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Molsang jouse chu na-angsunga twi lonna alonlhah suh theina dinga, O nangin van ho chu nasatella, nahung kumlhah nom hileh,"},"2":{"text":"nakidoupi ho namin hetsahna dingle, na angsunga namtin kithingthinga aumna diuva, meijin akahjola akonbanga, meijin twi asousah bangin!"},"3":{"text":"Kakinep pilouvu tijat umtah thil naboltengle, nahung kumlhajin na-angsunga molsang ho alonglha jeng jiuve."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu vannoi kipatna pat nangma tailou Pathen dang, ama ngah ho dinga natonga; mihemin aja khapon, nakhangin jong ajahkhapon, mitnin jong amukhapoi.","ref":"1 Cor 2:9."},"5":{"text":"Kipahtah-a uma chonphatna bolpa, nangma hejing puma nalampi jotpa nakimupin, vetan, kachonset jeh-un, nalung ahangin, chuho-a chun kaum jom jingun, huhhing kahidiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla kabonun thilboh kabang sohkeijun, kachon phatna jouse jong ponsenen bangbou ahin, kabon chaovin nathel bangin kamol lhaovin, kakhanset naovin huibangin eilhohmang gamtaove."},"7":{"text":"Chule namin panna nangma kolchah dinga kitilkhouva khatcha aumtapoi, ajehchu keiho-a konin namai naselin; kakhan setnao jeh-in neisumangtaovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla tun, vo Pakai, nangma kapao nahin; keiho bel kiden na leiset kahiuvin, nangma beldengpa nahi; chule keiho kabonun nang khutsoh jeng kahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Vo Pakai, lunghang behseh hih-in, khanset najong tonsotnin geldoh jinghih-in; ngaijin, vetemin, kangeh-u nahi, keiho namite jeng kahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Nakhopi thengho gamthip asohgamin, Zion jong gamthip ahin, Jerusalem jong akamheltai."},"11":{"text":"Kapu kapa teovin nangma navahchoi nao ka-inthenghou leh ka inhoi houjong meijin akavam gamtan; kathildeihou jouse jong manlou asoh gamtai."},"12":{"text":"Vo Pakai, hicheho-a dingahi nangma nakitim ding hinam, nangma nathip beh-a, neisuhgenthei teitei diuham?"}}},"65":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kahenga thumlou hon eiholun, eihol louhon eimuve; kamina kikoulouhel nam mite henga chun, neiveuvin, neiveuvin, kati.","title":"Pathen'in Thumanglouho Gotna Apeh","ref":"Rom 10:20."},"2":{"text":"Amaho lunggella achona lampi phalou houva vahlea, doupanho chunga chun kakhut kajah nilhum lhumjin ahi;","ref":"Rom 10:21."},"3":{"text":"Tanglouva lung hansah dinga kamaija eilung phatmo sah-a; honsunga kithoija, chehsong maicham chunga gimnamtui hal mite;"},"4":{"text":"Lhanho lah-a umdena, songko sung ho-a geh-a, vohsa ne-a, Abel sunguva thet umtah satwi kitunna;"},"5":{"text":"Nachang seh-in dingin, neihin nai hih-in; ajehchu keima nang sangin kathengjoi, tiho chu ahiuve. Hicheho chu kanahko homsunga meikhu jing ahiuvin, nilhumkeija kongjing meikou ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Veuvin, hichehi kamasanga akisune: Thipbeh in umponge. Ahinla lethuh ingting, a-opkong sungtah uva kalethuh ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nakhanset naole napu napateu khansetna agoma, molsang ho chunga gimnamtui ahal uva, lhangho chunga eitaitomu ahin, hijeh-a chu anatoh masah hou chu a-opkong sunguva katepeh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"8":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin ati, lengpiga lomlah-a kon lengpitwi akimu bangin, mikhat touvin asungahi phattheina aumjeh-in sumang hih-un ati banga: chutobanga chu kasohte jala abonchauva kasuhmang louding ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Chule keiman Jacob'a kona sonkhat, chule Judah'a kona kalhangtheng loding khat ka hinpuidoh ding; chule kamilhen hon hichu lovintin, chua kasohte chengden diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule Sharon chu ganchahon dinga hongsung hintin, chule Achor phaicham chu ganchaho dinga kolna mun hiding; ajehchu keima eihola kamite jong chutobang ding ahi.","ref":"Josh 7:24-26."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla nangho Pakai dalha-a, Ka molsang theng sumila, chuche sepaihon ho dinga dokhang gonpeh-a, chule chuche mijat ho donding thilpeh bulhitpeh nahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun chemjam'a kasimding nahiuvin, athatpa anga nakundiu ahi. Ajehchu kakoupetnin neihou pouvin, kahoupet un neingaipeh pouvin; ahinla kamitmun thilse nabol jouvin, keima deilou joh nakilhen taove."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin ati, veuvin, kasohten anehdiu, nangho vang gilkela naum diu; veuvin, kasohten adonuva, nangho vang nadangchah diu ahi. Veuvin, kasohte kipah untin nangho vang najachatdiu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Veuvin, kasohten lungsung kipa la saovintin, nangho vang gentheijeh-a nakadiu ahi. Chule lhagao bolsetjeh-a napenjah diu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule naminu chu kamilhendohpa henga sapsetna-a nadalhah diu ahi. Ajehchu Pakai pathen'in nangma natha-a, asohte minchoma akouding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Leisetna amale ama phatthei kiboh-a chu, Pathen dihna-a amale ama phatthei kiboh ding ahin, chule leisetna kihahsela chu Pathen dihna-a kihahsel ding ahi. Ajehchu lungkhamna masaho akisumilin, chule kamitmu-a konin akisel mang taove."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu veuvin, vanho leh leithah kasemin ahi. Chule thilmasa chu kiheta louhel ding, lunga jong langtalouhel ding ahi.","title":"Thilsem Thah","ref":"Isai 66:22; 2 Pet 3:13; Tph 21:2."},"18":{"text":"Ahinla kathilsema chun nangho a-itih-in halna in kipah unlang thanomun; ajehchu veuvin keiman Jerusalem chu kipa na-in, amite chu thanop na-in kasemtai."},"19":{"text":"Chule Jerusalem'a chun kipah ingting, chule kamite lah-a jong thanominge, Chule hia chu kana aw gin, penna aw gin jong kijalouding ahitai.","ref":"Tph 21:4."},"20":{"text":"Chuteng chua chun naosen nikho lhomcha bou hinga leh tehse adamsung hin nikho lhinglouho umta ponte. Ajehchu chapang chu kum jakhatna thiding; ahinla michonse kum jatamtah hingho chu sapset chang hiding ahiuve."},"21":{"text":"Amahon inho saovintin, hiho-a chu chengdio, chule amahon lengpihon bolluntin, aga anehdingu ahi."},"22":{"text":"In asah uva midang cheng talou ding; thingphung aphu uva midangin aneh tah louding: Ajehchu thingphung khat hinkho banga chu kamite hinkho jong hiding, kalhendohten akhut tah uva atohgao phatsotpi anopsahpidiu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Amahon moh-a atohgim loudiu, lungjina dingbepma jong cha ahinloudiu ahi, ajehchu amaho Pakai phattheiboh son ahiuvin, ason apah houtoh umkhoma ahiuve."},"24":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, amahon keima eikou masang uva kahouding, chule thu aseijing nahlai uva jong kajahpai ding ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Kamkeile kelngoinou lhakhoma, bongchal banga keipin changpol anehding, leivui chu gulho dinga sa hiding ahi. Kalhangtheng chung jouse-a chu amahon asukhah-u, asuhmangu umlou ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Isai 11:6-9."}}},"66":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, vanhi kalaltouna ahin, leihi kakengto ngapna ahi. In nei sahpeh-u chu hoi ham? Kacholdona ding mun hoiba ham?","title":"Pakaiyin Namtin Vaipi Thu Atan","ref":"Matt 5:34,35; 23:22.  ; Sol 7:49-50"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu thiljouse chu kakhutna kasema, thiljouse chu uma ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ahivangin hiche migenthei pa, lungsung kisih-a kathua kihot hotpa bouhi kavet ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Bongchal thatpa chu mithat tobang ahin, kelngoinouva kithoipa chu ui ngong sattan tobang ahi; Pathen'a thilpeh toh-a chu vohcha thisan tobang ahin, gimnamtui halpa jong chu milim semthu pathen phattheiboh tobang ahi. Ahi, amahon alampidiu akilhenun, thet umtah ahinaova chun alungu akipah-in ahi."},"4":{"text":"Keiman amaho bolgentheina lhenpeh ingting, chule achunguva akichatnao chuhsah inge, ajehchu kakoupetnin khatchan eidonbut pouvin, thu kaseipetnin angaipouve. Ahinla kamitmun thilse bou abollun, kakipana louhelbou akilhenuvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pakai thuhi ngaijuvin, athua kithing thinga nangho, nasopiu nangho nahotbol houle keima min jeh-a nangho napaidoh hou chun, Pakai chu choisangin umhen tiuhen; ahinla ama nakipa naova hung kilah-in tin, chule amaho jahchajo ding ahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Khopi-a kona husagin, houin'a kona husagin chu Pakai husagin ahin, amelmate lethuhna dinga Pakaiyin hiche chu asodoh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Naosonat athoh masangin cha ahingin, anat thohgim masangin, naosen pasal khat ahingtai.","ref":"Tph 12:5."},"8":{"text":"Hitobang chu kon ajahkhah-a, hitobang chu kon amukhah-em? Leiset nikhat sunga kisemdoh-a, namkhat hi khatvei so-a sohjeng theijem? Ajehchu Zion hin naosonat athoh thoh-in achate ahingdoh jenge."},"9":{"text":"Pakaiyin cha kahindoh sah-a, kapen lhahsah louding ham? ati. Keiman kasolhah sahji ahin, naobu kakha-ji dingham? tin na Pathen'in aseije."},"10":{"text":"Nangho ama ngailu jousen Jerusalem kipa thanop piuvin lang, ama lunghempi nanghon halna-in kipa thanop piuvin."},"11":{"text":"Hitia chu nangho ama lunghempi ho jousen alhepbina noitwi chu nachep uva, nachim theina diuva, aloupi chamkimna lhingset chu nakipapi theina dingun, ati."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin ati, veuvin, amanu henga chamna vadung long banga, chule chidang namdangte loupina chu twilong banga kalonsah-a, chuteng nachep uva nangho amanu pangteni-a nakipoh uva, akhup chunga nakichop diu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Anun alhepbi mikhat banga hitia chu kalhepbiuva, Jerusalem'a lhamonga naum dingu ahitai."},"14":{"text":"Hichehi namu tengule nalungu kipah-a, nagu nachang jouse jong hamhing banga nouding, Pakai khutchu asohte lama kilanga, alung himona amelmate chunga kilangding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu vetan, Pakai chu meikong banga, huipi nung tobanga akangtalai ho puma, alunghana lungsatna sodoh dingle, aphosalna meikong banga hungding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin meile achemjama tahsahing jouse thu atanding, chule Pakai mitha chu tamtah hiding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Amaho acham chama kisuthenga, chule honsung lailunga thingphung khat nunglama amale ama kisuthenga, vohsa phe thet umtah chule juchasa neho chu mangthah khomdingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu athilbol houle alung ngaitohou kahenai, keiman namjousele paojouse kakhopkhoma, kaloupina amunadiuva hunglhung ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chutengle keiman alah uva melchihna khat koijing ting, chuleh alah uva asohcha hochu namtin vaipi keima minthan jakha louhel ho, kaloupina mukha loulaiho: Tarshish lam, Put lam, chule thalthem Lud lam ahin, Tubal leh Javan lam chule gamlatah twikol gamho geija kasolding ahiuve. Chuteng chule amahon chidang namdang lah-a kaloupina aphonjal dingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule amahon, Israel chaten Pakai insunga lheng thengsel sunga thilto ahinchoi banguva, nasopiteu jouse Pakai henga thilto toh dinga namtina kona, sakol kangtalai chunga, talaija, sakol pol ho chunga, ganhing gangho chunga ka mol theng Jerusalem'a ahintollut dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"21":{"text":"Chule kenjong alah uva chu thempuho dingle, Levi ho ding kalhen ding ahi, tin, Pakaiyin aseije."},"22":{"text":"Van thah hole leithah kasem dingchu kamasanga aumjing bangin, nasonhoule naminu chu umjing ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Isai 65:17; 2 Pet 3:13; Tph 21:1."},"23":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, lha ahungthah-a patna ahungthah kitchan, choldoni-a patna choldoni kit chan mijouse kamasanga keima hou dinga hung dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"24":{"text":"Chutengle amaho chedoh uva, kachunga chonkhelna neiho thilong chu avetjing dingu ahi. Ajeh chu alungu thilouhel ding, ameikong jong mitlouhel ding, chule amaho tahsa hing jouse dinga kidah umtah hiding ahiuve.","ref":"Mrk 9:48."}}}}},"24":{"info":{"name":"Jeremiah","shortname":"Jer","abbr":[],"desc":"Jeremiah Themgao Lekhabu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin gamsunga Anathoth'a um thempuho lah-a Hilkiah chapa Jeremiah thuho,","title":"Jeremiah"},"2":{"text":"Judah te leng Amon chapa Josiah nikholaija alengchan kal kum somle thumna in akoma Pakai thu ahung lhunge.","ref":"2 Leng 22:3—23:27; 2 Thusm 34:8—35:19."},"3":{"text":"Judah te leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim nikholai jin jong, Judah te leng Josiah chapa Zedekiah kum somlekhat kichailam gei, Jerusalem gal hinga kikaimang lha nga lhinna geijin hiche thuhi ahung lhungin ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 23:36—24:7; 7:18—25:21; 2 Thusm 36:5-8; 11:21."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu kakoma ahung lhungtan,","title":"Jeremiah Kikou"},"5":{"text":"Keiman nangma naobu sunga kasem masanga kanahetsa nahin, naobu-a kona nahung potdoh masanga kanasuh thengsa, chule namtin themgao dinga kapansah nahitai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin keiman, kate, Pakai Pathen! ven, chapang kahi jeh-in, ima kasei theipoi katin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai chun, chapang kahi tihih-in, ajehchu keiman nangma kasolna jouse-a nache ding, keiman kathupeh chan naseidoh ding ahi, tin kajah-a aseitai."},"8":{"text":"Chuin aman, amaho mai khu kicha hih-in, ajehchu keiman nang huhdoh dingin kaumpi e, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pakai chun akhut alhangin, kamuh akhoije. Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, Ven, keiman kathuhohi nakam sungah kakhum luttai, tin aseije."},"10":{"text":"Ven, tunia hi ajungho kaldoh dingle, aloilhu ding, asumang ding, asuchim ding, chule aphutdoh dinga namtin vaipihole lenggam ho chunga kapansah nahitai."},"11":{"text":"Chukalvalin, Pakai thuchu kakoma ahung lhungin, Jeremiah, ipi namu em? eiti e, chuin keiman, Almond thing tenggol khat kamu e, katin ahi.","title":"Jeremaih'in Gaova Thil Ni Amu"},"12":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, namuchen lheh-e, ajehchu kathu tohdoh-a aumna dinga kavetlhih jing ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu aniveinan kakoma ahung lhungin, ipi namu em? eiti e, keiman bel soulahlah amai sahlam ngat khat kamui, tin kaseije."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, sahlama pat thilphalou khat hungpotnintin, gamsunga chengho jouse chunga hung chuding ahi, tin aseije."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu ven, keiman sahlam lenggam ho jouse kakou ding, amaho hung dingu, Jerusalem lutna kotpiho phungle akimvele kulbangho, chule Judah khopiho jouse douna-a alaltounao atundoh cheh dingu ahi, tin Pakai jin aseije."},"16":{"text":"Chule keiman, keima eidalhah uva pathen dangho houna-a gimnamtui ahalu, chule akhut uva kisemho joh ahou uva, agitlounau chunga thutanlhahna kanei ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun, nangman nakong kigah-in, chule kipatdoh-in lang, keiman kathupeh jouse chu amaho lah-a seijin, a-angsung uva meidoi hih-in, achutiloule keiman amasanguva nangma kisuh dongsah get inge."},"18":{"text":"Ijeh inam itile, ven, tunin keiman nangmahi kihuh dohna khopi kasema, chule thihkhompi, gamsung pumpi, Judah lengho, pipuiho, thempuho chule agam miteu douna sum-eng kulpi detna kasem nahitai."},"19":{"text":"Amahon nangma nadou diu, hijongle najolou dingu ahi. Ajehchu nangma huhdoh dinga keiman kaumpi nahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chukalvalin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,","title":"Pathen'in Israel Akhohsah"},"2":{"text":"Chenlang Jerusalem nakhanga gasamin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije; tin seijin; nakhangdon laija namikhotonale, najite nangailutna, lholou gama, gamthipma kanung najuilai chu kahe jinge."},"3":{"text":"Israel chu Pakaiya atheng ahin; Ama puntheina ga masaho anahi. Ama vallhum jouse themo changa; achunguva thilse chuding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"4":{"text":"Vo Jacob insungle Israel insungho jouse, Pakai thuhi ngaitemun,","title":"Israel Mimasaho Chonset"},"5":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, napateu vin kagitlouna ipi amu uva, keija kona chegam lhaova, pannabei nung ajuijuva, pannabei soh-u hitam?"},"6":{"text":"Egypt gama kon eipuidoh uva, gamthip nelgam lhunga, nelgamle kokhuhho lah-a, gamgo gama, thina limnoi, koima chekhah lounale mihem chenlouna gam lhungkeija einapuihoi leuva Pakai chu hoijaba um hitam? tin jong aseipouve."},"7":{"text":"Chule keiman nangho ninglhinna gam, chu-a gamga le aphatnaho nedingin kanapuilutnin; ahinla nangho chu-a nalut phatnun kagam nasuboh-un, kagouho chu kidah um nasosah taove."},"8":{"text":"Thempuhon, Pakai chu hoija umtam? atipouve, dan tuhhon keima eiheta pouve. Hou lamkaiho jong kachunga achonkhel taove, chule themgao hon Baal thu aseijun phatchomna bei thilho nung ajuijun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh achu, Pakai keiman nathu kasei jingding, chule nachateo chateho thu jong kasei ding ahi.","title":"Amite Chunga Pathen Thutanna"},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu Chittim twikol gam chonsoh in lang ven, Kedar geijin mi solin, hitobang thilhi umnam, gunchu tah-in ngaiton."},"11":{"text":"Nam khatnin pathen hilou a-pathen ho akhelkhah uvem? Kamiten vang aphachom lou dingin aloupi nao chu akikhel taove."},"12":{"text":"Vo nangho vanhon, hiche hi datmouvin, tijat umtah in kichauvin, nangho kamhelun, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu kamiten manthah na thil ni aboluve; amahon hinna twinah keima eidalhaovin, twi veithei louna twikul akilaijuve."},"14":{"text":"Israel chu soh khat ham? In le lou neilou soh hija ham? Ijeh-a ama suhsetna uma hitam?","title":"Israelte Kitahlouna Jeh-a Hungsohdohho"},"15":{"text":"Keipibahkai chalgolin angih-in, ahamin chule agam chu asumangin; akhopiho acheng beihelin ahalvamin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Noph le Tahapanes chaten jong nalu-a lallukhuh asukeh taove."},"17":{"text":"Hichehi Pakai na-Pathen'in lamdunga napuihoile laija ama nadalhah jeh-a nangle nangin nakilamdoh hilouham?"},"18":{"text":"Chule nangin Egypt lampia hi Sihor twi dona dinga ipi nabol dingham? Ahiloule vadung twiho donna dinga Assyria lampia hi ipi nabol ding ham?"},"19":{"text":"Nangmatah gitlouna chun nangma nasuhdih ding, nanungchona chun nangma naphosal ding ahi, hijeh achu Pakai na-Pathen nadalhah-a, keima ginna nasunga aumlouhi thilphaloule thilkha ahi, ti nahetna namu ding ahi, tin janel Pakai Pathen'in aseije."},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu sotlaipeh-a na namkoljon kasuhboh-a, naloiho kasuhmangthah ahitai. Chule nangin, keima chonval taponge natin, molsang chung takiple thingphung hing noi takipma numei kijoh bangin navahlen, nakijoh-in ahi.","title":"Israel ten Pakai Ahounom Louvu"},"21":{"text":"Ahinla keiman lengpigui pha, muchi dihtah-a kanaphu nahi. Achutile ibola keidinga mansuhna, gamlah lengpigui keh naso jeng hitam?"},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu nangma chang-alin kisopmin lang, sabon tamtah mangjong lechun, nakhangitlouna chu kamasanga kimelchih ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije."},"23":{"text":"Nangman kakisuboh poi, Baal kajuipoi iti nati ngam ding ham? phaichama nalampi ven, ipi nabol kihetnin, nangmahi mangang tah sangongsang nu acham chama che;"},"24":{"text":"Gamthipma um gamlah sangan anopnopma hui donlele, ahuhlai chu kon asuhkih thei ding ham? Aholte jouse lungkham daohen, alha lhinteng amutei dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Kengchot beija naum louna din chule nadang gotlouna din umin, ahinla nangman, Kinepna aumtapoi, Aumtapoi, ajehchu keiman gamdang mi kangailun, anungu kajui ding ahi, tin naseije."},"26":{"text":"Gucha akimatdoh phatle ajachat bangin, Israel insung mite ajahcha taove. Amaho, alenghou, aleng chapatehou, athempuhou chule athemgao houvin,","title":"Israel Chu Gotna Chang Dinga Lom Ahi"},"27":{"text":"Thingbul jah-a, nangma kapa nahin, song jah-a nangin neihin vahdoh ahi, atiuve. Ajehchu amahon eimaingat louvin einungsun taove. Ahivangin amahon agenthei phattah ule, kipat in, neihuh doh-un, tiuvinte."},"28":{"text":"Ahinla nangman nakisemthu na-pathen ho chu hoija umtaovem? Amaho chu kipatdoh uhen, nagenthei pet uva nahuhdoh jou uvem? ajehchu vo Judah, nakhopi jouse jatna na-pathen ho umsa ahije."},"29":{"text":"Ijeh-a nangho keimatoh kinelkal ihiuvem? Nangho nabonchaovin keima dounan nachonkhel taove, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"30":{"text":"Nachateo chu mohseh-a kajep bep ahitai, kisuhdihnan anei tapouve. Nangho chemjam maman nathemgao hou chu, misugam keipibahkai bangin asugamtan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Vo, khang mite, nangman Pakai thuhi veuvin, Keima Israel dinga gamthiple muthim gam kahi hitam? Ijeh-a kamiten, keihohi pakaiho kahiuve, nahenga kahunglou dingu ahitai, atiu hitam?"},"32":{"text":"Nungah in akivona ho asuhmil theija, ahiloule, mouvin avonho asuhmil theijem? Hinla kamiten nikho simjoulou khopmin eisumil taove."},"33":{"text":"Ijeh-a dongma holna-a nalampi nakisuhjol ham? Hijeh chun migilou chu nalampi ho nahiltan ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chule napon mongho-a jong chaga monabei hinnaho thisan beh akimun ahi. Keiman hichehi holguh-a kamu ahipon, phongtah-a kamudoh ahi."},"35":{"text":"Ahinla nangman, themona bei kahi jeh-in alunghana keija konin kiheimang teijinte nati-e. Ven, keima kachonsepoi nati jeh-a nathu katan ding ahi.","title":"Judah te Pannabei Tahsan Kilahlou"},"36":{"text":"Nalampi khelna dinga ibola vahle humhal nahim? Assyria-a najachat lheh banga Egypt jeh-a jong najachat ding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi, nakhut naluchunga nangapma, ama-a kona nachedoh ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin natahsan ho jouse chu alahlousa ahin, amaho-a chu lolhinna nanei lou ding ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amahon, pasal'in ajinu dahenlang, amanu ama-a konin pot hen, pasal chom khatna hitale, amapa chu amanu koma akilekit dem? Chuche gam chu hatah-a suhboh-a umlou ding ham? atiuve. Ahinla nangma dongma tamtah toh noti'n nakichemin, kahenga nahung kilekit nalaije, tin Pakai jin aseije.","title":"Kitahna Neilou Israel"},"2":{"text":"Munsang ho lam ngan dah-in, pasal tincheng to nalup louna mun umam? Gamthipma Arab ho bangin, amaho din lam tinna natoulen, najon thanhoi nale nagitlou nan gamsung chu nasuboh tan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun gohong tuhtangin aumtan, go nunung jong ajutapoi; noti dehpang naneijin, jachat ding nanompon ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nangman tu-a patnahi, Hepa, nangma hi kakhangdon laija patna eipuihoija chu nahi, tia neikou louding ham?"},"5":{"text":"Ama a-itih-a lunghang jing ding ham? Akhonna geija akoiding ham? vetan, hihochu naseijin thilse najo chanin naboltan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Leng Josiah nikholaijin Pakai chun keikoma jong anaseijin, Israel kinungchonin abolkhu namu tah-em? Amanu molsang chung jousele thingphung hing noi tina achelen chule akijoh-in ahi.","title":"Israel le Judah'in Alung Aheiju Angaikhoh"},"7":{"text":"Chuin keiman, amanun hicheho jousehi aboljou phatnin, keilama hungkilen, kanatin ahi. Ahinla ahung kihei dehpoi, mikitahlou asopinu Judah'in hichu amutan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule keiman, kinungchon Israel chu jonthanhoi jouse jeh-a kapaidoh-a, kadana thu kapeh jing vangin, mikitahlou asopinu Judah chu kichadeh louva, noti'a akichepjing jong kamun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, numei kijoh ahina jalchun gamsung chu asubohtan; chule thingle songhotoh ajongin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule hicheng jouse jeh-in tahsanbei asopinu Judah chu alung pumpin kahenga ahung kilehei dehpoi; akilepjo bouvin ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"11":{"text":"Pakaiyin kajah-a, nungchon Israel chu mikitahlou Judah sangin them akichanjoi, tin aseije."},"12":{"text":"Chenlang hiche thuho hi sahlam sanga seiphonglen, tin Pakaiyin aseije, Kitahna neilou Israel, hungkinungle kitnin, chule kalunghana nachunga chuhsah taponge. Ajehchu keima mikhoto them kahin, a-itih-in lunghang jing ponge, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"13":{"text":"Nakhangitlouna bou kihetnin, nangma Pakai na Pathen dounan nasukheltai. Chule nalampi ho chu gamchom miho ding thingphung hing noi tina nathe jah-in, keima aw nangai pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"14":{"text":"Vo, nungchon chate hung kileuvin, ajehchu nangma kakichenpi nahin, keiman nangho khopi khatna kon khat, insung khatna kon ni ladoh ingting, Zion'a kapui ding nahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"15":{"text":"Keiman kalungtoh kelngoiching ho peuvinge, amahon chihnale hetthemna-a nangho navah dingu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, chuche nikho laiteng, chuche gama nahung punuva, nahungtam phatnile, amahon Pakai thulhun thingkhong tia aseitah lou dingu, geljong ageldohtah lou dingu, viljong avillou diu chule semphatna jong umtalou ding ahi, tin Pakai chun aseije."},"17":{"text":"Chuphatle Jerusalem chu Pakai laltouna atidiu, namtin jouse chu, Jerusalem'a Pakai mina kikhom dingu, alungu gitlouna ngaitona banga chontalou ding ahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Chu nikho chule Judah insung chu Israel insungtoh lhakhom uva, sahlam gama kona hungpot khomdiu, napateu vin alodiuva kapeh gam lamchu ahin jot dingu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ahinla keiman chate lah-a nangma iti kaumsah-a, namtin janelho gouhoile gam nom chu kapeh ding ham? kanatin ahi. Chule nangin, Hepa tia neikouva, keija kona nakihei mang lou ding ahitai, kanatin ahi.","title":"Pathen Miten Milim semthu Ahouvu"},"20":{"text":"Tahbeh-in mikitahlou in-neipi khat, ajipa-a kon apotdoh bangin, Israel insungin jong keima angsunga gilouna aboltai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"21":{"text":"Israel chate kanale taona munsang ho chunga akijadoh tan ahi, ajehchu amahon alampio akaleh-in akisemun, Pakai a-Pathen'u chu asumil taove."},"22":{"text":"Hung kileuvin, nungchon Israel chate, chutile nanung chon nao suhdampeh tange. Ven, keiho nahenga kahunguve, ajehchu nangma Pakai ka Pathen'u nahi."},"23":{"text":"Adihtah-in, lhang ho-a konle mol tamtah ho-a kona huhhingna mudin kakinem kheluve. Dihtah-in, Pakai ka Pathen uva Israel huhhingna chu aume."},"24":{"text":"Ajehchu kakhang donlai juva pat kapateule achapateu, achanuteu le aganchahon hou chu jachatnan avallhumtan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Eiho jahchan i-umun, lungnoh phahnan eikhu taove. Ajehchu eihole ipateu, ikhangdon uva pat tuni geihin Pakai i-Pathen'u dounan ichonseu vin, Pakai i-Pathen'u awchu inangai tapouve."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin, Vo Israel nangma nahung kile-a, kahenga nahunga nalampi kidah umho chu kamitmu-a kona naheidoh leh, nangma kichonle tapon nate, tin aseije.","title":"Pathen'in Alungheina Diuva Akou"},"2":{"text":"Chule nangman, Pakai chu thutah-a, thutan na-a chule chonphatna-a hinga ahi tia nakihahsel ding ahi. Chutengle namtinho chu ama-a phatthei changa, ama-a loupi ding ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin Judahte le Jerusalem jah-a, hitin ati, naleiset lholouhou chu kal let uvin, chule ling lah-a tu hih-un, tin aseije.","ref":"Hos 10:12."},"4":{"text":"Nangho Judah mitele Jerusalem'a chengten Pakaiya nachep tanunlang, nalungsung chep kitanun, ajole nathilbolu phatlou jeh-in, keima kalungsatna phelmit joulouvin mei bangin kongdoh getninte, ati."},"5":{"text":"Judah'a seichoijin lang, Jerusalem'a phongjalin, gamsunga sumkon mut un pengun lang kikhom khomun, khopi kulneiho-a lutnuhite, tiuvin.","title":"Melmaten Ahin Bulu Dingu Ahi tia Judah Kigihna"},"6":{"text":"Zion lama ponlap tahdoh-un, kikhin unlang umden hih-un, ajehchu keiman sahlama kona thilphalou, manthaina kahin pohlut ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Keipibahkai chu aumna hamthing lah-a konin ahungdoh-in, chule chidang namdangte sumang dingpa ahung pheitai, nagam sungu kamhelsah dingin aumna-a konin akipatdoh tai. Chule nakhopihou chu chenna louva agoh-a umding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh hin khaodip pon kisilun, kapmun lang pengun, ajehchu Pakai lungsat tijat umtah chu eihoa kona kiheimang lou ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuni chule hung hiti ding ahi, lengpa le pipuiho lungthim mang intin; thempuhon adatmouva, themgao hon kidang asahdiu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"10":{"text":"Chuin keiman, hekate, Pakai Pathen! nangman hiche mitele Jerusalem hi nalhep tahbeh ahitai. Chamna naneidiu ahi natin, hinlah chemjamin ahinnao chu asunkhatai, katin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuchephatle hiche mitele Jerusalem jah-a, gamthip munsang ho-a huigo chu kamite chanu umna lama, ajap ngim dingle athehngim ding hilouhel,"},"12":{"text":"chuche munho-a kona huipi hattah kahenga hungnung ding; tu-a jong keiman achunguva thu katanlhah ding ahi, hung kiti ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ven, amachu meibol ho banga hung touva, akangtalai chu chimpei bang ding, asakolho chu mulaopi ho sanga gangjo ding ahiuve. Suhmanga um ihi jeh-un, ohe idau ahi!","title":"Melmaten Judah A-umkimvelu"},"14":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem, huhhing-a naum theina din, gitlouna-a konin nalung sopthengin. Nalung ngaito pannabei ho chu itihchan nasunga umding ham?"},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu Dan-a konin awkhatnin aphongdoh-in, Ephraim mola kon suhgentheina hung lhading aphongjale."},"16":{"text":"Namtinho jah-a seilen; veuvin Jerusalem dounan phongdoh-un, gamlatah-a konin galbolho ahungun, Judah khopiho dounan ahinsam uve."},"17":{"text":"Keima eidou jeh uvin, loujao hongho bangin, amahon dounan a-umkimvel taove, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"18":{"text":"Nachonnale nathilbolin hichehohi nachunga ahinsodoh ahin; hichehi nagitlouna ahin, anasalheh jenge, ajehchu hiche hin nalungsung ahinphah ahitai."},"19":{"text":"Vo kalungsung, kalungsung! kalungchang tah anai; kalungphut husa aginge; kigalgin husa sumkon ginchu, vo kahinna, nangin najah jeh-in kaumthim thei tapoi,","title":"Amite-a Dinga Lunghemna"},"20":{"text":"suhmangna chunga suhmangna in kho asamin, gamsung pumpi chu suhsetnin aumin, photlotnin kaponbuh, mitphet kahin kapondal akisusetai."},"21":{"text":"Itih chanpi hiche ponlap hi kavetna, sumkon gin chu kangai jing ding ham?"},"22":{"text":"Kamitehi angol jeh-un eiheta pouvin, ju-ngolvei chate ahiuvin, hetchet aneipouve. Thilse bolna din achingun, thilpha bolnadin hetna aneipouve."},"23":{"text":"Leiset chu kagahven, vetemin, alimle agong bei ahin; chule vanho chu, amahon vah anei pouve.","title":"Suhmangna Ahung lhunding Jeremiah'in Gaova Amu"},"24":{"text":"Molsangho kagahven, vetemun, akihot hotnun, lhang jouse kangchan akitol tolun ahi."},"25":{"text":"Kagahvetle, vetemun, mihem aumtapoi, chungleng vachate jouse alengmang gamtaove."},"26":{"text":"Kagahvetle, vetemun, gamphalai chu gamthip asohtan, khopiho jouse chu Pakai le alungsatna tijat umtah anga chun achimlha gamtan ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu gamsung pumpi chu kamhel ding; achainahel vang kahisah loulai ding ahi, tin Pakai chun aseije."},"28":{"text":"Hiche jeh ahi leiset lunghema, chunga vanho hung thim ding ahiuve; hichehi kaseisa ahijeh-in kalunggot ahin, kisih ponge, nungjong kinung heideh ponge."},"29":{"text":"Sakol chung touhole thal choiho husa-a khopi jamgam diu ahin; hamhing lah-a lutnuva, songpiho chunga kaldiu ahi, khopi tin kidalha-a, chua koimacha cheng lou ding ahiuve."},"30":{"text":"Nangma nakisuhmang phatle ipi nabol ding ham? Ponsandup min kivonin lang, sana jemin kijemin lang, namai jempol jongle chun, mohseh-a kihoisah nahiding ahi, nadongma hon nanah sahmo uva, tha dinga nahol diu ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ajehchu numei naosonat thoh tobangle, chanei masapen natthoh pet banga Zion chanu aw kajai, amanu natthoh in apengin, akhut ajahdoh-in, ohe tuhin ada kahitai! ati. Ajehchu tolthat ho jeh-in kahinna alhasamtai, ati."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangho Jerusalem kholaiho-a suhle tungin lhaijun, tun veuvin lang heuvin, chule munlen ho-a holun, dihtah'a thutan mi khattou namule, keiman amanu ngaidaminge.","title":"Jerusalem Chonsetna"},"2":{"text":"Chule amahon, Pakai chu ahinge tinama jongleu, jouva kihahsel tahbeh ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Vo Pakai, thutah chu navet lhihjing hilou ham? Nangin amaho chu najepjin; amahola alunghem pouve; nangin nachaihel tan, ahinla kisuhdihsah ding anomdeh pouve, amaiju songpi sangin atahsah cheh-un, kile ding anompouve."},"4":{"text":"Hijeh achu keiman, hitehohi vaicha tahbeh; mingol tahbeh ahiuve kati ahi. Ajehchu amahon Pakai lampi le a-Pathenu thutanna ahepouve."},"5":{"text":"Keima miloupiho henga chengting, ajah uva thu seijinge; ajehchu amahon Pakai lampi, a-Pathenu thutanlhahna ahethemun, ahinla hiteho hin anamkoljon'u ahehbongun, akikan gomnahou atumtan taove."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh achu gamlah-a keipibahkai'in athaova, nilhah lang sial'in asuhmang diu, lutnu in akhopihou anga-a, chua kona vahdoh tapou chu asitel jeng ding ahije. Ajehchu asuhkhel nao atamin, anungchon nao apungin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh-achu nangho iti kangaidam diu ham? Nachateovin eidalhaovin, pathen hilouho-ah akihahseluvin; amaho kavahva petnin jonthanhoi abolun, ahon honin notiho ina akikhomun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Amaho jingkah kivahva sakol ho abangun; mitin aheng akom inneipi henga angih lhehlhut-uve."},"9":{"text":"Hitiho jeh-a hi kavil lou dingu ham? Hitobang nam mitehi kahinnan aphulah lou ding ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"10":{"text":"Akulbang hou chunga kaltouvin lang suchimun; achaina helvang hisah hih-un; apal hou lamangun; ajehchu hiho chu Pakaiya ahipouve."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu Israel le Judah insung chu keima dounan akhangse lheh taove, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"12":{"text":"Amahon Pakai chu ajoulhep mun, amahi ahipoi, ichunguva thilse jong chupontin; chule chemjam ahiloule kellhah jong tohpouhite atiuvin ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Israel Apaidoh"},"13":{"text":"Chule themgaoho chu hui hungsoh uva, asunguva thu umlou ding ahi; hitia chu amaho kibol ding ahiuve."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun janel ho Pakai Pathen chun hitin aseije, nanghon hitia nasei jeh-un, veuvin, kathuhohi nakam uva mei kahisah-a, hiche mitehi thing hiuva, meichun akahvam dingu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ven, vo Israel insung, gamlatah-a kona vaipi khat kahinpoh khumding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ama chu nam hattah ahin, khangluilai nam, a-pauvu jong nahetlou, chule ipi aseiju jong nahethei lou nam hiding ahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Alivatheiju lhankot kihong tobang ahin, amaho mi hattah jeng ahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chule nachanuteu le nachapateo nehding, nalousohle changlhah chu aneh chaidiu, nakelngoi hon, nagancha hon aneh chaijuva, natheichang phung hou anehjou dingu, natahsan tah-u kul kithodet nakhopihou chu chemjam'a asuhchatvai dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hijengta jongle, chuche nikhoho-a chu kichaihel loulai dingu nahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"19":{"text":"Chule Pakai i-Pathen'un ibola hicheho jousehi ichunguva alhunsah ham? tia nasei tengule hung hiti ding ahi, Chuteng amaho chu nadonbutna, nanghon neidalhah uva, nagamsunguva gamchom pathenho nahou banguva chutobanga chu nangho-a hilou gamchom khatna midangho najen diu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hichehi Jacob insunga phongdoh unlang, Judah gama phongjalun lang, hitin seijun,","title":"Pathen'in Amite Agihsal"},"21":{"text":"Tun hichehi ngaijun, lungthimbei, mit neija mulou; nakhang neija jalou; vo mingol ho,","ref":"Isai 6:9-10; Ezek 12:2; Mrk 8:18."},"22":{"text":"neigin louvu ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije. Agalkai joulouna dinga, twipi gamgi dinga, a-itih-a thupeh-a neldi umsahpa keima anga nakithin loudiu ham? Twinong chu kinuh nuh jongle ajolou ding, kitum lullul jongle achunga galkaijou loulai diu ahi.","ref":"Job 38:8-11."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla hiche mite hin dounale lungchang huhel aneijuvin; dou apanun, achemangji taove."},"24":{"text":"Amahon alungthim uva, go masale go nunung aphatcha eipeuva, eiho dinga chang-at phat ho eikheh tuppeh uva Pakai i-Pathen'u ama chu tun gingtao hite, tinjong aseidoh pouve."},"25":{"text":"Nakhan gitlouna houvin hiche hohi aheimanga, chule nachonsetna houvin nangho-a kona thilpha ho atuhtang ahitai."},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu kamite lah-a, migilouho aumin, thang kam bangin mi achang lhiuvin, thang akamun, mi apojiuve."},"27":{"text":"Bom sung vachaho adimset abangin, a-in jouseu lheplhahna adimsetne, hijeh chun amaho alendoh-un, chule ahaodoh gamtaove."},"28":{"text":"Amaho athaovun, akiti theijun; chule amahon khang gilouho natoh chu akhokhelun, pabeiho ding agelpouve, ahinla aphatheijun, alhasamho chanding agelpeh pouve."},"29":{"text":"Hitiho jeh-a hi kabolgim louding ham? Hitobang nam chungahi kahinna-in phu alah louding ham? tin Pakai chun aseije."},"30":{"text":"Datmo umtahle tijat umtah thilkhat gamsunga hin akiboltai."},"31":{"text":"Themgaoho jouvin agaovun, themputen anopnop mun vai apouvin, kamiten chutia bol ding adeijuve, ajonale ipi nabol diu hitam?"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Benjamin chate, Jerusalem lailunga kona jamdoh dingin kikhomun lang, Tekoah'ah sumkon mut un chule Beth-haccerem 'ah melchih mei domsangun. Ajehchu sahlama konin thilphaloule suhmangna lentah khat ahung kilang doh-e.","title":"Melmaten Jerusalem A-umkimvelu"},"2":{"text":"Keiman Zion chanu chu numei hoitah le nouchet toh kakilo sah-e."},"3":{"text":"Kelngoi chingho chu akelngoihon utoh amanu henga hungun tin, amanu doudinga akimvela ponbuh asondiu, amahon ama ama muncheh a avahdiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amanutoh kisatdin kigouvin, kipat un, chule sunin kontouvuhite. Ohe! idau ahitai; ajehchu sun achemangin nilhah lam alep heihoi tai."},"5":{"text":"Kipat un, janle cheohitin, aleng inpihou gasuseu hite."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, thingho phuhlhu uvin lang, Jerusalem dou nadin kul khouvin, hichehi hunama gotna kipeding khopi chu ahi. Amanu apumpia kisugenthei ahi."},"7":{"text":"Twinah in twi asodoh bangin, agitlounaho ahinsodoh jin ahi. Hunamle suhmangna amanu-ah akijadohin, kamasanga hin thohgimnale maha aum jingin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem, kichih theijin, ajole nanga konin kahinna kichondoh khantin, chennalou gam akamhel kaso lounadin, gamgoh-in umsah khange."},"9":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin ati, amahon Israelte amoh-aumsun chu lengpigui khai banga alokhumuva, lengpiga loupan pochaho sunga alelut banga nakhutnu ale kaleh ding ahi.","title":"Thua Nunglou Israel"},"10":{"text":"Ajahtheina diuva koi henga kaseija kagihsal dingham? Veuvin, akol aseh-un, ajathei pouve, veuvin, Pakai thu chu isahlou vin aneijun, kipanan anei pouvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai lunghanna chun kadimsetnin, kakitim timnan kacholtai. Keiman hichehi pama um chate chungle khangdong kikhomho chunga kabuh lhah ding ahi, ajehchu ajipa ajinu geija, tehse le atehkem geija kikaidoh ding ahiuve."},"12":{"text":"A-inhou chu alouhou puma midangho kipe ding ahiuve. Ajehchu gamsunga chengho chunga kakhut kalhandoh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Jer 8:10-12."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho aneopena pat alenpen geija, amitakip kilosetna lama akipeuvin, chule themgaova pat thempu geijin dihloutah in akimangun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Amahon chamna umlou petnin chamna, chamna atiuvin, amite chanu kisuhkhahna chu adamsah bolluve.","ref":"Ezek 13:10."},"15":{"text":"Amahon thil thet um abol tengule jahcha jiuvem? achutipoi, ajahcha naisai pouve, amaiju jong asanji poi. Hijeh chun amaho alhu ho lah-a lhu-u vintin; keiman amaho kagasuh gim phat tengle amaho sotlhah-a umdiu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"16":{"text":"Pakai chun hitin aseije, keng lampiho-a dingun lang, veuvin, chule lamluiho chu dongun, hia chun lampha aume, nahinnaova choldona namu dingu ahi. Ahinla amahon, hichea chun chepouving-e, atiuve.","title":"Israel'in Pathen Lamlhahho Apaidoh-u","ref":"Matt 11:29."},"17":{"text":"Nachung uva khongah ho jong katundohpeh un, sumkon gin chu ngaijun, atiuve. Ahivangin amahon ngaipou vinge, atiuvin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hijeh chun nangho namtin hon ngaijun, chule vo Houkhom ho, alah uva ipi um ahi, heuvin."},"19":{"text":"Ngaijin, vo leiset, ven, hiche mite chungahi thilphalou, alungputnu ga thilse kalhutkhum ding ahi. Ajehchu amahon kathule kadanthupeh nitlouvin, anotthap jotaove."},"20":{"text":"Ipi ngaitona-a Sheba'a kon bego le gamlatah-a kona kolchu lhum kahenga hung kipolut ham? Nagovam thiltoule naganlhai nao tuitah jong chu kei dinga santhei ahitapoi."},"21":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan, hiche mite anga kipal lhuh naho kakoipeh ding, achunga chu pate le chapate lhukhom diu, aheng akomle agolhou mangthah diu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Pakai chun hitin aseije, Veuvin, sahlam gama kon mipi ahung kitolin, leiset ningtin ho-a kona namlentah khat tundoh-a umding ahi.","title":"Sahlama Kona Kibuluna Hungkon"},"23":{"text":"Vo Zion chanu, amahon thal le teng apat diu, mi engse le hepinabei ahiuvin, ahusao twipinong abangin, nangma dounan galsat miho bangin sakol chunga atou vun akigoltoh taove."},"24":{"text":"Aminthanjeu kajataovin, kakhut hou angoilha gamin, hesohnan kadimtauve, chule numei naosonat bangin kanasoh taovin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Loujaova potdoh hih-un, lampia jong vahle hih-un, ajehchu melmate chemjamle tijatna-in ningtin alotai."},"26":{"text":"Vo kamite chanu, khaodip pon kigah-in, vut kinun, chapa changkhat jeh-a lunghem lheh jeng bangin lunghemin, ajehchu michomgampa chu phulou helouva ichunguva hunglhung ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Nangin alampiu nahetna, napatep theina dinga kamite lah-a inchungsang khatle kulpidet khatna katun nahitai."},"28":{"text":"Amaho abonchauva lunggim umtah chohchi bol, miseisea vahlea, sum engle thih ahiuvin, abonuva misuboh ahiuve."},"29":{"text":"Pumlong teni akatan, ngen chu meijin ahaljol lhan, asuhthengna bul chu amoh junlhah jengin ahi, ajehchu migilouho akipaidohpoi."},"30":{"text":"Amaho chu mihon dangka lahtheilou asahdiu ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin amaho chu adeilou ahitai."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hung lhung chun, hitin aseije.","title":"Jeremiah'in Houin Mun'a Thu asei"},"2":{"text":"Pakaiyin kotpi phunga dingin lang, hiche thuhi phongjalin chule seijin, nangho Judah mijouse, Pakai hou dinga hiche kotpi phungho sunga lut hon Pakai thu chu ngaijun."},"3":{"text":"Janelho Pakai, Israelte Pathen chun hitin aseije, nalampiule nanatoh hou kisem phatnun, chule keiman hiche munahin chensah unge."},"4":{"text":"Pakai houin, Pakai houin, Tonsot Pakai houin tia jouthu seiho chu tahsan hih-un;"},"5":{"text":"ajehchu nanghon nalampiu chule nathil bolhou chu apuma nakisem phatnuva, mikhatle aheng akom kah-a thudih nasodoh uva,"},"6":{"text":"kholjin mi, pabeiho leh meithaiho sugenthei louva, hiche munahi monabeiho thisan nasodauva, chule nasuse dingu pathen dangho jong najoulhepmuva ahile,"},"7":{"text":"chutengle keiman napateu kanapeh nagam hiche munahi atonsot atonsotna kachensah ding nahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Veuvin, phatchomna bei thujouho chu natahsanun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nanghon guchat, toltha, jouva kihahsel, Baal houna-a gimnamtui hala, nahetlouvu pathen dangho najuijuva,"},"10":{"text":"chule naheng uva kamina kivo hiche in'a kamasanga nadin uva, chule thet umhohi bol dinga eikipedoh uva ahitai, nati dingu ham?"},"11":{"text":"kamina kivo hiche inhi nangho mitmu-a michomho kokhuh hitam? Veuvin, hiti chun kamubepme, tin Pakai chun aseije.","ref":"Matt 21:13; Mrk 11:17; Luk 19:46."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla tun nangho kamina kaphudoh masahna Shiloh-a kaumna mun'a chun cheovin, chule kami Israelte gitlou jeh-a chua ipi kanabolem gaveovin.","ref":"Josh 18:1; Labu 78:60; Jer 26:6."},"13":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin aseije, nanghon hitobang jousehi naboltah jeh-un, chule matah-a katho-a kanaseipeh vanguva nangaitahlou jeh-un, chule kakou vang uva neina donbut tahlou jeh-un,"},"14":{"text":"hijeh achu nanghole napu napateu kanapehna mun, nanghon nana tahsanu, kamina kivo hiche in'a hi Shiloh a kabol tobang chu kabol ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Keiman nasopiteu Ephraim chilhah apumpia kana paidoh banga nangho jong kamitmu-a kona kapaidoh ding nahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun, hiche mite dingin taohih-in, amaho dingin kho samhih-in, taojong taohih-in, kahenga jong thumpeh hih-in, ajehchu kajahpeh louding nahi.","title":"Mipihon Thu Angailou-u"},"17":{"text":"Amahon Judah khopiho sungle Jerusalem lamlen ho-a ipi abolu chu mulou nahiuvem?"},"18":{"text":"Chaten thing achomun, paten mei atih-un, numei hon changbong ameh-un van lengnu din changlhah asem gouve, chule keima phin lunghan theinadin pathen dangho din donthei thilto alheilha jiuve.","ref":"Jer 44:7-19."},"19":{"text":"Amahon keima eiphin lunghanu ham? Amaho maiso kisuhmona ding bepma amahole amaho kiphin lunghangu hilouham? tin Pakai chun aseije."},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun tonsot Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, veuvin, kalunghana hiche mun chunga, mi chunga, sa chunga, thingphung ho leiset gaho chunga kabuh lhah ding, hichun akah-a kasuhmit tahlou ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Israelte Pathen janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, naganlhai naova govam thiltoho chu kikoijun lang apheho chu neuvin."},"22":{"text":"Ajehchu napateu Egypt'a kona kipuidoh nichun govam thilto le ganlhai thudol amaho jah-a kanaseipon, thupeh jong kananeipon ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla hichehi amaho thu kanapen, ka aw ngaijun chutile keima na Pathen'u hing ting, nangho kamite nahi dingu ahi. Nangho thu kapeh jouse-a chun chonun, chutile nangho dinga phathei ding ahi, katin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ahinla angai hih-un, anau asungpouve, alung gilou ngaitonaole alunggelun achon jouvin, machon louvin anungchon jotaove."},"25":{"text":"Napateu Egypt gama kona ahung potdoh uva pat tuni geihin kasoh themgao jouse naheng uva, kahinsolin, jingkah matah-in athouvun kasolen,"},"26":{"text":"Hinla amahon kathu angai hih-un, anau jong asungpouve, angei apukonun, alouchal uvin, apateu sangin asejouvin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Hijeh chun, nangin ajah uva thu jousehi seijin natin, na ngaipeh loudiu, Nangin amaho kouvin natin, amahon nadonbut louding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ahinla nangin ajah uva hiti ahi nasei ding ahi, hiche nam mitehi Pakai a-Pathen aw ngailou, hilna jong sangdeh lou nam ahiuve, thutah chu amanghelin, akamuva konin pailhah helin aumtai."},"29":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem, nasam kitanin lang, munsang ho-a kapmin, ajehchu Pakaiyin alunghana khang mitehi adeitapon, adalhatai.","title":"Hinnom Phaichama Chonsetna"},"30":{"text":"Ajehchu Judah chaten kamitmun thilphalou aboluve, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Kamin kivona insung suhbohna dingin, athet umtah hou chu apolut taove."},"31":{"text":"Chule keiman kanathupeh louhel, kalung sunga jong umlouhel, achapateule achanuteu meija gona dingin Hinnom chapa phaicham, Topheth munsang ho asadoh taove.","ref":"Thmpu 18:21; 2 Leng 23:10; Jer 32:35."},"32":{"text":"Hijeh chun Tonsot Pakaiyin, veuvin hiche munchu Tophet kiti talou ding, Hinnom chapa phaicham jong kitikitlouva, tolthana phaicham kiti johna ding nikho ahung lhunge, Ajehchu mun abeihel kahse-a Topheth'a kivuigam ding ahiuve, ati."},"33":{"text":"Hiche mite thilongho chu chungleng vachaho, tolla gamsaho an hiding ahi. Chule koimachan amaho anomang lou ding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chutahle Judah khopiho-a chule Jerusalem lamlen ho-a thanopna aw chule kipana aw, moulang le Mounu aw beisoh ding ahi. Ajehchu gamsung chu kamhel ding ahitai.","ref":"Jer 16:9; 25:10; Tph 18:23."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche phatchule amahon Judah te lengho, leng chapateho, thempuho, themgaoho chule Jerusalem'a chengho guho chu abuikhuh uva kona ahinpoh doh dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"2":{"text":"Chule amaho chu nisa le lhathah chule vanmi janel jouse, amahon anangailutnu, anajenu, anajuijuva, anaholu chule anahouvu ho angsunga ahinthejah dingu ahi. Amaho kigomlou ding, kivuilou ding ahiuve, chule leiset chunga eh-a umding ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chule keiman kanodohna mun jouse-a hiche insung phalou sunga umden amohho jouse chun hin sanga thina akilhenjoh dingu ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"4":{"text":"Hiche kalvalchun, nangman amaho jah-a nasei ding ahi, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, amaho lhuva thoudoh talou diu ham? Aman aheimanguva, hung kinungle lou dingu hitam?","title":"Chonsetna Le Jepna"},"5":{"text":"Chuti ahile, hiche Jerusalem mitehi ijeh-a tanglouhel nungchon na-a nungchon uva ham? Thujou atuhchah-un, hung kinungle ding anompouve."},"6":{"text":"Keiman kangaijin kajai, ahinla thudih aseipouve. Ipi kabol beh em? atiuvin agitlou naova kona kisih-a koima aumpoi. Sakol galmuna alhailut jeng bangin, mitin ama ama lampia akiheitai."},"7":{"text":"Ahi, van'a leng twiva injong ama phat kitepsa akihetnin, vakhu, vakengsang chule vasilih hon amaho hungna phat akihet uve. Ahivangin, kamiten Pakai thupi tanlhahna dinghi ahepha pouve."},"8":{"text":"Nanghon kachinge, Pakai dan chutoh kaum khomnai, iti natiu ham? Veuvin tahbeh-in, aman hichehi mohseh-a abol ahin, danthupeh sunho lekhamol chu moh ahi."},"9":{"text":"Michingho chu ajahchauvin, alungthoijun, akiman taove, veuvin, amahon Pakai thu chu athetbolun chule amaho-a ipi chihna umem?"},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun a-inneipi teo midangho kapeh-a chule alouhou chu ahinlo dinghou kapeh ding ahi. Ajehchu amitakip aneopena pat alenpen geijin kilosetna-a akipeuvin, themgaova pat thempu gei sanin jou aboluve.","ref":"Jer 6:12-15."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon kamite chanu kisuhkhahna chu adamsah boluvin, chamna umlou helin, chamna, chamna, atiuve.","ref":"Ezek 13:10."},"12":{"text":"Thet umtah thil aboluva chu jahchabeh uvem? Achutipoi, ajahchahih beh uve, amaiju jong asan sinpoi. Hijeh chun alhuho lah-a lhuhtha diu, gotna akipeh phatnule kipailha ding ahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"13":{"text":"Keiman amaho kasuhmang tei ding, lengpiguiho-a aga umlou ding, theichang phungin jong ga neilouva, ado pulding, amaho kapeh thilho chu amaho-a kona kitol mang ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"14":{"text":"Ibola itou thim beh-u ham? Hung kikhomun, kul kikhodet khopiho-a lutnu hite. Ajehchu Pakai douna-a ichonset jeh uva Pakai i-Pathen'un thipchetna eikoijuva, donding thinkha twi eipeh-u ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Lungmona kaholun, ahin thilpha ahungpoi, chule damtheina phat kaholun, veuvin gentheina bou ahi!"},"16":{"text":"Asakolho nahkhon gin Dan'a pat akijan, asepai hat ho kholhah ginin gam pumpi akihottai. Ajehchu amaho ahungun, gamsungle asunga umho jouse, chule khopihole asunga chengho jouse abahgamuve."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu veuvin, keiman nalah uva, gulho chule suhngoi theilou gulsumho kahin sollutna amahon nachuh dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"18":{"text":"Lungdona-a kona kilhamon kagot teng kalungsung alhoplha jitai.","title":"Amite-a Dinga Jeremiah Lunghem"},"19":{"text":"Veuvin, gamlatah-a chengho jeh-a kamite chanu ka awgin khu, Pakai chu Zion'a umlouva hitam? Alengpa asunga umlou hitam? Amahon ipijeh-a semthu milimhole mohthil kidangho-a eiphin lunghangu ham?"},"20":{"text":"Chang-at phat akichaijin, nipi phatla akichaitan, eihola huhhingin i-um tapouve."},"21":{"text":"Kamite chanu kimavo jeh-in mavon kaumin kadup lhatai, lungdona-in eikolchah-in ahi."},"22":{"text":"Gilead gamsunga damna dinga, nuding thingnai lou umlou hitam? Achutile ipijeh-a kamite chanu chu suhdam louva uma hitam?"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ohe, kamite chanu kithajeh hin sunle jana kaka theina din kalu twijeng hihen lang chule kamit tenihi mitlhi luipi sohjeng tavele kati!"},"2":{"text":"Ohe, kamite dalha-a, amaho-a kon kapotdoh theina dinga gamthipma chele vahle ho gebuh khat kanei hitavele! ajehchu abonchauva mijong ngen, misumang kisukhom bou ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chule amahon jou seinan athalpiu bangin aleiju amangun, ahinla leiset chunga thutah dingin ahangsan pouve. Ajehchu amahon aphalouva konin aphalou asodohun, keima eiheta pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"4":{"text":"Mitin aheng akoma chingtheihen, asopi tahsan hih hen, ajehchu sopi takipmin ahinson manghel ding, henglekom chu misumin se-a vahle ding ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Amaho mitinin ahenglekom cheh alheplhah diu, thutah aseilou dingu ahi; Aleiju jou seije ahilun, dihloutah bolna-in akisuchol uve."},"6":{"text":"Nachenna chu lheplhahna lah ahin; lheplhahna jeh-in keima eihetnom pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun janelho Pakaiyin hitin aseije, veuvin, keiman amaho junlhahsah ingting, kapatep ding ahi, ajehchu kamite chanu chu iba kalo ding ham?"},"8":{"text":"Aleiju thalchang kikapdoh abangin, hichun lheplhahna thu aseije. Khatnin aheng akom jah-a akamin chamna thu aseijin, hinla alungsungin achanglhi keovin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hitiho jeh ahi keiman amaho gotna pelouva kakoi dingham? Hitobang namho chungahi hitia hi kahinna-in phu alahlou ding ham? tin Pakai jin aseije."},"10":{"text":"Molsangho dinga kaka-a kamao ding, gamthipma umho dinga kalunghem ding ahi. Ajehchu amaho akavamtan, koimachan ajotpai thei tapon, ganchaho hamgin jong akijatapoi. Chungleng vachate le gamsaho ajamun, achemang taove."},"11":{"text":"Keiman Jerusalem chu ingem jeng kasoa, dragon kokhuh-a kasem ding, chule Judah khopiho chu acheng beihela kakam helsah ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hiche hekhenthem thei dinga miching koiham? Hiche gam chu amanthaija, gamthip banga akahvama, koimachan ajotpai thei louding ahi, tia phongdoh dinga Pakai kamin aseinapa chu koiham?"},"13":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin aseije, ajehchu amahon amasanguva kakoipeh kadan thupeh chu adon tapouve, chule ka aw angaipouve, hia chun chonjong achonpouve."},"14":{"text":"Amaho lungsuhto-a bou achonjo taove, apateuvin anahilu, Baal houna nung ajuijo taovin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun janel Pakai, Israel Pathen'in hitin aseitai! Veovin keiman amaho, hiche miho tahhi thinglungin vah ingting, thinkha twi kadonsah ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Keiman amaho chu, apateule amahon anahetkhah louvu, Pathen helouho lah-a kathecheh ding, chule amaho kasuh manghel kahse-a anungu chemjam kajuisah ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hitihin janel Pakai chun aseije, nanghon ngaitouvin, ahung theina dingun numei lunghemho chu kouvun lang, ahung theina dingun numei dohathuh ho gakou sah-un.","title":"Jerusalem Mite Panpi Ngaicha-a Aka-u"},"18":{"text":"Amaho chu kinouhen lang, chule eiho dingin himsao hen, chutiachu imitnuva kon mitlhi alonlhah-a, imit nel uva kona twiho akikhodoh jeng nadingin,"},"19":{"text":"ajehchu Zion'a konin maon'a aw chu akijan, suhmanga iti i-umu hitam? Igamu idalhah uva ichendetna houvin einotthap jeh-un, ikisumo lheh taove."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla, vo numei ho, Pakai aw chu ngaijun, nanakhang uva akam thucheng chu lutsah-un, chule nachanuteu chu maoje, chule amitakipmin aheng akomho lunghemje hilun."},"21":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile chate polama umhole khangdong lamlen ho-a umho sumang dingin, thina chu bangkot ho-ah ahungkal touvin chule ileng inpihouva ahung luttan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Seijin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Mihem thilongho chu gam onga eh tobanga pul lhadiu, chule chang atpa nunga khutdim khat chang kidalha banga koiman amaho aga chomkhom lou ding ahitai."},"23":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, michingho chu achihnauva, mihat ho chu ahatnauva, chule mihaoho chu ahaonauva kithang-at daohen."},"24":{"text":"Ahinla akithang-at michu hichea hin kithang at-uhen, keimahi leiset chunga ngailut lungsetna, thutanlhahna, chule chonphatna a vaihom Pakai chu kahi ti hehen chule hethemhen, ajehchu hitiho ahin keima kakipahjie, tin Pakaiyin seije."},"25":{"text":"Veovin Pakaiyin hitin aseije, keiman cheptanho jouse chu cheptan louho toh kagimbol thading nikho ahung lhunge!"},"26":{"text":"Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon chate, Moab chule gam ningchong penaho, gamthipma chengho jouse chunga, ajehchu hiche nam miho jousehi cheptanlou loi chu ahiuvin chule Israel insung jouse jong lungsunga cheptanlou ahiuve."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel insung naheng uva Pakai thusei chu ngaijun.","title":"Pathen le Milim Kibahlouna"},"2":{"text":"Hitihin Pakaiyin aseije, Pathen hephalouho lamlhah chu kihil hih-un, van melchihna ho jeh-in jong lungthoi hih-un, ajehchu Pathen helouho hitiho ahin alungthoi jiuve."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu miho puchon pachon chu moh ahi. Ijeh-inem itile khatnin gammanga konin thing aphuh-in, hichu heicha-a natongpa khutsoh ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amahon hichu dangkale sanan ajemuvin, akilonlou nadin thihkille seh-in amandetnuve."},"5":{"text":"Amaho lusu thingphung bangin akitung jangpetnun, ahinla apaothei pouve. Achetheilou jeh uva poh ngaitei ahiuve. Amaho ginghih uvin, amahon thilse abolthei pouve, thilpha bolna dingjong amaho-a aumpoi."},"6":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nangma tobangtah koimacha aumpoi, nangma loupitah nahin, naminhi thanei na-a loupi ahi."},"7":{"text":"Vo namtin vaipi lengpa, nangma kichalou ding koi ham? Ajehchu nangma-a hichu uma ahin, ajehchu nampiho michingte jouse lahle alenggamhou jouse-a, nangma tobang khatcha aumpoi.","ref":"Tph 15:4."},"8":{"text":"Amaho lungselle angol ahiuvin, lim semthu ahouvu jong chu manthah na lhongpi ahibouve."},"9":{"text":"Tarshish'a konin dangka kikhen pheng chule Uphaz'a konin sana ahinpouvin, khutthemho khutsohle thihkheng themho khutsohho, adumle asandup akivonun, aboncha chu doha thuh khutthemho khutsoh ngen ahi."},"10":{"text":"Pakai vang chu Pathen dihtah ahin, ama hingjing Pathen le tonsot leng ahi. Alunghana-a leiset kihot ding! athangtomna chu namtin vaipin anan joulou diu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hiti ahi nanghon ajah uva, vanle lei sem hilou pathenho, amahotah chu leisetna konle hiche vanho noija konahi mangthah ding ahiuve, natidiu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Aman athaneina-in leiset asemin, achihna-in vannoi atungdoh-in, ahetthem na-in vanho ajandoh-e.","title":"Pathen Vahchoina La"},"13":{"text":"Aw aso tengle, van'a twi tamtah aging lullul jin, kolmonga pat twimei ajamtousah jin, kolphele gotwi asemin, agou boma konin hui ahin nundoh sah jin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Mitinhi ahetna-a lungsel ngen ahin, asemdoh takip milim kilhah tho-a akisudongun ahi. Ajehchu amilim kilhahtho hochu jouthubuh ahin, asunguva haitheina aumpoi."},"15":{"text":"Amaho pannabei le natoh dihlou ahiuvin, gotna akipeh tengule mangthah ding ahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Jacob chan chu hicheho bangchu ahipoi; ajehchu Ama thil jouse sempa hin; Israel hi agoulo nam tenggol ahin, amin chu janel Pakai ahi."},"17":{"text":"Vo kulpi sunga chengho, gamsunga konin nakiveina thilho chom khomin.","title":"Sohchanga Ahung Kikaidiu"},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan, agamsunga chengho chu khatveihi hinpaidoh inting, amahon chutia amutheina diuva amaho kasuhgenthei ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Kakisuh natna jeh-in ada kahitai, kamaha put hi analheh jenge, ahinla keiman, hichehi thohgimna tahbeh ahin, chule kathoh teiding ahi kati."},"20":{"text":"Kahoubuh asetan chule kakhao jouse atantai. Keija konin kachate achedoh-un, aumtapouve chule kahoubuh songdoh dingle kapondal ho tungdoh ding koima aumtapoi."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu kelgnoi chingho la alungsel ngen ahiuvin, Pakai hola aumpouve. Hijeh-a chu lolhing loudiu, akelngoiteu jouse chehchao ding ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Veuvin, Judah khopiho kamhelsah dingle, Dragon ho kokhuh sosah dingin, sahlam gama konin thuthang le husa nasatah ahunge."},"23":{"text":"Vo Pakai mihem chondanhi ama-a um ahipoi ti kahetai, akalson hil dinga chu mihem sunga um ahipoi."},"24":{"text":"Aw Pakai imacha hilou munna neilhut louna dingin, nalunghanna-a hilouvin nathu tan najoh-in neisu dih-in."},"25":{"text":"Nangma hephalouho chungle, namina taolou insungho chunga nalungsatna bunglha tan, ajehchu amahon Jacob anejouvun, abahgamun, asumangun, chule achenna mun kamhelin alhauve."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jeremiah henga Pakai thu hunglhung chun aseije,","title":"Jeremiah le Pathen Thulhun"},"2":{"text":"hiche thulhun thuhi ngaijun lang, Judah mitele Jerusalem'a chengho henga seipeh-un."},"3":{"text":"Chule nangman amaho jah-a seijin, Israel Pathen Pakai chun hitin aseije, hiche thulhun thuho ngailoupa chu sapset changhen."},"4":{"text":"Hichu napateu Egypt gamma thih meilhuma kona kahin puidoh ni-a kana thupeh a kanasei, Ka aw ngaijun lang chule kathupeh ho dungjuijin bollun. Hitia chu nangho kamite nahiuva, chule keima na Pathen'u kahi ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chutia chu napateu henga, khoijule bongnoi lonna gamkhat pehdinga tunia bangahi kakitepma kahahselna chu katohdoh thei ding ahi, ati. Chuin keiman, hihen, Pakai tin kadonbutne."},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakaiyin kahengah aseije, Judah khopihole Jerusalem khopi lamlen ho-a hiche thuho hi phongjalun lang, hiche thulhun thuho hi ngaijunlang, boluvin, ati."},"7":{"text":"Egypt gama kona amaho kanapuidoh nikhon napateu henga hatah-in kana kiphin in, tuni chan geijin jong, matah-a kipatdoh pumin kagihsal lin, ka-aw ngaijun katijingin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla angaipouvin, anau jong sunglouvin, amitakip alungaito gitlouna-a achonun, hijeh chun abol dinguva kana thupeh-a, ahivanga ana bolou-u, hiche thulhuna thucheng ho jouse hi achunguva kahin lhunsah ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, Judah mitele Jerusalem'a cheng mite lah-a thilguh kigong akimudoh-in ahi."},"10":{"text":"Apu apateu, kathu ngainomlouho khangitlouna lama akilehei gamun, pathen dangho jen dingin anungu ajuijun, Israel insungle Judah insungin, apateutoh kanasem thulhun chu asukeh taove, ati."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, veuvin, ahoidoh theilou hel nadiu thilse achunguva kalhunsah-a, kahenga hungpeng jongleu kangaipeh louding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuteng Judah khopihole Jerusalem'a chengho chu, gimnamtui ahalnau pathenho henga chun cheovintin, ahenguva pengdiu, hijongle alungdon petnuva hiho chun ahuhdoh louhel diu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu vo Judah, nakhopihou jat dung juijin pathen naneijun, Jerusalem khosung lamlen jat dung juijin jachat umtah Baal henga gimnamtui halna maicham natung doh-un ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun hiche mite dinghin taohih-in, kanale thumna jong bolhih-in, ajehchu alungkham jeh uva kahenga atao tengu jongle kangaipeh louding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Kangainun thil thet um tahtah bolpumle, nanga kona tahsa theng achemang munasasa a ka-insunga ipi abol nahlai dingham? Nangin aphalou nabol tengle nakipah jilheh-e."},"16":{"text":"Pakaiyin namin chu Olive thingphung hing, ga hoitahle phatah tin nanaminvon, mipi hugin thong chu achunga meijin akongin, ahin abahho chu abong gamtai."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu Kei phinset na-a lunghansahna dia Baal henga gimnamtui hal Israel insung le Judah insung setna jeh'in, Janel Pakai nangma phutpa chun, nachunga thilgilou ahinbol ding aphongdoh tai."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin eihetsah-in, kahetan, chuphatnin nangin athilbolu neimusah tai.","title":"Jeremiah Thana Dinga Thilgon"},"19":{"text":"Ahinla keima kelngoinou, ahiloule bongchal tha dinga kikai bangbou kahin, amin kihetkit louhel nadin mihing gama konin ama chu sumangu hitin, thingphung chu aga pumin subeiju hite, tia kachunga adoha bolu chu kanahe hihhelin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla Vo janel Pakai dihtah-a thutanpa, lungsung gille lungthim sung patep jipa, achunguva naphulahna chu neimusah tan, ajehchu kachung chang thu nangma-a kaphondoh ji ahi."},"21":{"text":"Kakhut uva nalou louna dingin Pakai minin gao thu seitahih-in tia kahin na suhmang dinga chang lhijing Anathoth mite chungchanga Pakaiyin hitin aseije."},"22":{"text":"Hijeh chun janel Pakai chun hitin aseije, vetan, amaho chu talen pengting, gollhangho chu chemjam'a louvuntin achapateule achanuteu chu kela thidiu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule amaho amoh himhim umpou vinte. Ajehchu Anathoth mite chunga thilse kalhunsah ding, gotna achan kum-u jong hiding ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nahenga kaphun teng jongle vo Pakai, nangma chonphatah nahin, hijongle nathutan dol neiseisah tadin, ipi dinga migiloute lamlhah lolhinga? hatah'a kitahlouhon nom asahsoh keiju ham?","title":"Jeremiah'in Pathen Thudoh Anei"},"2":{"text":"Nangma phu ahiuvin, henge, ajungkho gam taove, akeh-un, henge, ga asodoh taove. Amahoto naichan naumin, alung giluva konin nagamlan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ahinla Vo Pakai keima neihetan, neimutan, chule nangma lama kalung napatep ahitai. Amaho chu tha dinga kigo kelngoi bangin kaidoh'in lang, athana ding nikho gotpeh tan."},"4":{"text":"Chua chengho gitlouna jeh-a gamsung chu itihchan lunghema loujao tina hampaho golha dingham? Aman kaki chainao amulou ding ahi ati jeh-un, gamsahole vachate amangthah gamtaove."},"5":{"text":"Nangma kenga lhai miho toh nalhaikhoma amahon nachol sah-u leh, sakolto iti naki lhaitet thei ding ham? Nangman natahsan, Chamna gama bon amahon nachol sah-u leh, achutile Jordan kinonga chun iti tan natem?"},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu nasopihole napa insung mite tah-in jong, kitahloutah-in nabol uve; henge, amahon nanungsanga mipi akouvuve. Amahon nahenga thungei tah seijongleu tahsan hih-in."},"7":{"text":"Ka-inle kagoulo kadalhatai, kahinna ka-itchah kangaitah chu amanu melmate khutna kapedohtai.","title":"Amite Jeh-a Pathen Lunghem"},"8":{"text":"Kei dinga kagoulo chu gammang sunga keipi tobang ahin, keima dounan apengdoh-in, hijeh-a chu kahot ahi."},"9":{"text":"Kagoulohi vacha pol litlet tobang ahin, akimvela um vachaten ama adouvun ahi, hunguvin, gama gamsa jouse hung kikhomun lang anegamdin hungtauvin."},"10":{"text":"Kelngoiching tamtah-in kalengpilei asumangun, kachan achotphauvin, kachan deitah chu gamthip gohkeo asosah taove."},"11":{"text":"Amahon hiche akamhel sah-un, hichu kahenga alunghemin, agam pumpi agohkeo asotaove, ahinla koimachan anahsah poi."},"12":{"text":"Gamthip lhonlhung munsang jouse-a thilsuseho ahunglhung taove. Gammong langkhatna pat gammong langkhat gei Pakai chemjamin bahgam intin, mi koimachan chamna aneilou ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Amahon suhlouchang atheuvin, hijongle lingho bou a-atdiu, amahole amaho akisucholun, ahinla phachom ponte, Pakai lungsat nasatah jeh-a chu, nalhosoh-u ajachatpi diu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Kami Israelte losah dinga kagotsa gou tongkha-a, ka-inheng gilouho jouse douna-in Pakai chun hitin aseije, vetan, keiman agamuva konle Judah insung mite lah-a kona kalolhah ding ahiuve.","title":"Israel Gamhengho Koma Pakai Kitepna"},"15":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, amaho kalolhah joutengle kahung kile-a, amaho kalungsetna, amitakip agoulo nale agamcheh-a kalepui ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule hiti ding ahi, Baal henga kamite kihahselje ahil banguva, ahingjinga Pakai kamina, kihahselna dinga kamite chondan gunchu tah-a akijiluva ahile, chuteng amaho kamite lah-a kisadoh ding ahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Ahinla amahon kathu angailou vangule, hiche nam mite chu kabodoh-a, kasuh manghel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin kahenga, tupatpon konggah gakilah-in lang, twija sukot louvin, nakonga kigah-in, ati.","title":"Tupatpon Konggah"},"2":{"text":"Hitichun Pakai thu dungjuijin konggah khat kaga kilah-in, kakonga kaki gah-in ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin anivei channan Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin aseije,"},"4":{"text":"Nagalah nakonga um konggah chu choijin lang, kipat in, Euphrates lama chenlang, chukoma songpi kosung khatna gaselin, ati."},"5":{"text":"Hitichun Pakaiyin thu eipeh bangin kachen, Euphrates koma kagaseltai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin ni tamtah jouvin Pakaiyin kajah-a, kipat in Euphrates lama chenlang chua konin, chukoma sel dinga thu kanapeh konggah chu hinchoijin, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Euphrates lama kachen kalaidoh-in, kaselna mun'a kon chun konggah chu kaladoh-in, chule vetan, konggah chu anangot tan, imachan aphachom tapoi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu kahenga ahung lhungin aseije,"},"9":{"text":"Pakai chun, Judah hoithonale Jerusalem hoithona chu hiti ahi kasuhset ding ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Kathu ngailouva alung ngaito to-a chonna, pathen dangho jenna, chule houva, hiche nam phaloutehi imacha phachom lou konggah tobang bepbou chu ahiuve."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu konggah mikonga abechah banga Israel insung pumpile Judah insung pumpi chu keima-a kabechahsah ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, hitia chu amaho kei dinga kamitele kaminthana, kahoinale kaloupina dinga kasem ahin, ahinla amahon angainom pouve."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu ajah uva hiche thuhi naseija, Israelte Pakai Pathen'in hai jouse chu lengpitwi sung dimun, ati, nati ding ahi. Chuteng amahon najah-a, hai jouse lengpitwi dim dinghi kahetchen lou uham? atidiu ahi.","title":"Lengpitwi Hai"},"13":{"text":"Chuteng nangin ajah uva, Pakai jin hitin aseije, vetan, hiche gama chengho jouse David laltouna-a tou lengho, thempuho, themgaoho, chule Jerusalem'a chengho jouse chu khamna-a kadip ding ahiuve."},"14":{"text":"Chule keiman amaho khatle khat, pate leh chapate tahjong kahin tato ding, kalainat louding, kakhen louding, ahiloule kahepi louhel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"15":{"text":"Ngaijun, nanau sungun, kithahatsah hih-un, ajehchu Pakaiyin thu aseitai.","title":"Kiletsahlouna Dinga Jeremiah'in Gihsalna Anei"},"16":{"text":"Aman kho ajinsah-a, chule molchung muthim lah-a nakipal lhuh masangin, Pakai na Pathen chu loupina peuvin, chule vah nangaichat laitah-un, thina le-lim asosah-in, muthim lhangkhal in aseme."},"17":{"text":"Ahinla hichu nangailou diule, nahoitho jeh uva kahinna sunthipma kap kapmin tin, Pakai kelngoite gal hinga kikaimang jeh-a kamit teni jong mitlhin achupding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Lengpa le Lengnu jah-a, kineosah lhonin, toulha lhonin, ajehchu nathupina lhonle naloupina lallukhuh lhon jengjong lhamang ding ahitai, tin aseije."},"19":{"text":"Lhanggam khopi lenho kikhah chah gamintin, koimachan ahontheilou ding, Judah aboncha gal hinga kikaimanga, apumpiuva gal hinga kikaimang diu ahitai."},"20":{"text":"Dahdoh-un lang sahlama kona hungho khu veuvin, nangma kipe kelngoihon, nakelngoi hon hoitah ho chu hoi hitam?"},"21":{"text":"Aman nangma na-engbol teng ipi nasei ding ham? Ajehchu nangin gal lamkai dia nanahil chu, nachunga vaipon apangtai. Numei naosonat banga na nasah louding ham?"},"22":{"text":"Nangin nalunga hiche thilho ibola kachunga hung lhung ham? tia naseile, hichehi nangma nakhansetna alet behset jeh ahin, hijeh-a chu nanih kihoh-a, nakhotal doh-a ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ethiopia min avun akheltheija ahiloule lutnun ajem akhel theijem? Achutile angaina-a thilse boljing nanghon jong thilpha nabol thei diu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hijeh chun gamthipma huijin pol amutcheh banga chu kathecheh diu nahi."},"25":{"text":"Hichehi keija kona nakite-a navang chanchu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, ajehchu nangin neisumilin, joubulom joh natahsan tai."},"26":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu najachat kilahna dinga, namai changa nanih kahodohpeh ding nahi."},"27":{"text":"Loujao lhangchung dunga najon thanhoina, nanahkhon, nahuhna awgin, na noti chon naho, nathet um thilbolho chu kamutai. Ohe Jerusalem, nada ahi, naki suhtheng louding ham? Itih tahle ahitadem?"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Twihah thudola Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin ahi.","title":"Twi Hah Nasatah"},"2":{"text":"Judah alunghemin, akotpihou chu anguije, amaho tolla aduplha taovin, Jerusalem khopi ka ogin akitol toutai."},"3":{"text":"Amilal houvin asohteu twikhaijin asolun, luikhuh-a ahungun, twi amupouve. Atuibelu keo pumin akileuvin, amaho jahchan akisujumuvin ponlu akikhuvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Leija go juhlou jeh-a, leiset akhit jeh-in, loukaiho ajahchauvin ponlu akikhuh taove."},"5":{"text":"Henge, sajuh pin jong hamlah-a nou aneijin, hamhing umlou jeh-in adalhatai."},"6":{"text":"Gam sanganho munsang ho-a adingun, dragonho bangin hui ahoplut helhol-un, hamhing umlou jeh-in amitnu athabei gamtai."},"7":{"text":"Vo Pakai kakhangitlou naovin eilansan jongleu, namin jal-in hichu boljengin, ajehchu kakinungtol nao atamin, nangma dounan kachonse taove."},"8":{"text":"Vo Israel kinepna pa, lungkham laija huhhingpu, ibola gamsungahi kholjin banga jankhat gehdia kiheimang lamjot nabah ding hitam?"},"9":{"text":"Ibola milungthoile pasal hat kihuh hing theilou bang bepma naum ding ham? Vo Pakai kalah uva naum nalaijin, naminin katao jiuve, neidalha hih-un."},"10":{"text":"Pakaiyin hiche mite thudol hitin aseije, amahon vavei ding adeijun, akengu atuhtang pouvin, hijeh chun Pakai jin amaho asang tapouve. Tu-a aman akhang gitlounao ageldoh-a, asetnao jeh-a gotna apehding ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, hiche mite phattheina dingin taopeh hih-in,"},"12":{"text":"an ngola apennau kangaipeh louding, govam thilto atotengu jongle kasanpeh louding, chemjamle kela chule hise-a kasuhmang johdiu ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin keiman kaseije, Pakai Pathen vetan, themgaoho chun ahenguva, chemjam nato loudiu, keljong nahet loudiu, chamna mong mong kapehjoh ding nahiuve, atiuve."},"14":{"text":"Chuphatnin Pakaiyin kahenga, themgaoho chu kamina jouva ahiuve, keiman kasolpon, thujong kapepoi, houjong kakihoupi poi. Naheng uva thilmu dihloule, gaothu chule mohthu pannabei aseijuva, alungu alheplhah-u ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun hiche gama hin chemjamle kellhah chuponte tia, keiman kasol louva gaothusei themgaoho chungchang chu chemjamle kellhah in hiche themgaoho chu asuhmang ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"16":{"text":"Chule agao thuseinao miho chu kel lhahle chemjam jeh-a, Jerusalem khosung lamlena kipaidoh diu, amaho ajiteu ahiloule achapateule achanuteu vuiding koimacha aneilou diu ahi. Ajehchu agitlounau achunguva kabuh lhah ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nangin hiche thuhi ajah uva nasei ding ahi: sunle jan-in kamitlhi longhen lang, kanghih behhen. Ajehchu kamite chanu nungah theng chun mavona hoisetah, manthah na nasatah athohtai."},"18":{"text":"Keima loujaova kagapot dohle, chemjam'a kithat ho pikhu vetan! chuin khopi sunga kagalut le kel lhah naho pikhu vetan! henge, themgaoho le thempuho chu ahetlou nau gama avah leuve, nati ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Judah chu napaidoh hel hitam? Zion chu nahinnan akidah hitam? Kadamna diu umlou hela ibola neivoh-u hitam? Chamna kaholun apha imacha aumpoi, damna ding phat chu, vetan lungkhamna bep ahitai.","title":"Mipiten Pathen Henga Ngehna Aneiju"},"20":{"text":"Vo Pakai kagitlou naole kapateu khangitlou naho kakihet taove. Ajehchu nangma douna-in kachonse taove."},"21":{"text":"Namin jal-in neithet bol hih-un, naloupina laltouna chu jaboldan umhih hen, keihotoh nasem nathulhun chu hejingin lang, sukeh hih-in."},"22":{"text":"Chidang namdang pannabei ho lah-a, go juhsah theija umam? ahiloule van'in gohong ajuhsah theijem? Vo Pakai ka Pathen ama chu nangma nahilou ham? Hijeh-a chu nangma kanga diu ahi. Ajehchu hicheho jouse nangma sem ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuphatnin Pakaiyin kahenga, Mosi le Samuel ka-anga dinglhon jongle kalunghi hiche mite lama umthei ponte. Kamitmu-a konin paidoh-un lang chemang taohen, ati.","title":"Judah te Chunga Thutanna"},"2":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, amahon nahenga hoilama ipotdoh diuham? atiuva ahile, nangman amaho chu naseipeh ding ahi, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, athidingho chu thina-a, chemjam'a loudingho chu chemjam'a, kelhah-a thiding hochu kelhah-a, sohchang dingho chu sohchan na-a,"},"3":{"text":"Chule achunguva thil jatli, athana diu chemjam, abottel diu uichate, abahgam diule asumang dingu chungleng vachate le gamsaho chu kasol ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"4":{"text":"Chule keiman Judah leng Hezekiah chapa Manasseh in Jerusalem'a athilbol jeh-a, leiset lenggam jouse-a amaho kachao lesah ding ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 21:1-16; 2 Thusm 33:1-9."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Vo Jerusalem, koijin nangma nakhotoa, koijin nalhasetpi-a, ahiloule iti nahi hitam tia dongle dinga koi chedohle dingham?"},"6":{"text":"Pakai chun, nangin neidalhan, nanung chontai, hijeh-a chu nachunga kakhut kajah-a, kasuhmang ding nahi, kakitimtim jong kakhoptai."},"7":{"text":"Amahohi gamsung kotpiho-a changjapmin japming ting, achonnau akhel loujeh uva, chate-a kona kakhena, kamite kasuhmang ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Twipi lah-a neldi sanga tamin ameithaihou apungin, sunchang laijin gollhangho nute chunga misumang kapuilut khumin, chucheho leh khopi chunga chun photlotnin tijatna kachuhsah jin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Cha sagi hingnun, alhagao alhan, sun ahipetnin nisa alhumin, ajah achan akisudongtai. Amoh umnalai ho chu amelmateu chemjam'a kapehdoh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"10":{"text":"Leiset pumpi-a kinahnale kikalsetna-a neina hinhi, Ohe heno, kadatave! sumthoila kalha khapon, minjongla sumthoi eilahsah khapon, ahinla amitakipmin eigaosap uve.","title":"Jeremiah Kiphin"},"11":{"text":"Pakaiyin, tahbeh-a nunga naphatna ding hintin, tahbeh-a melmaten phat hahsat laile genthei laija nabolphatna diu ahi, ati."},"12":{"text":"Thih-in sahlam thihle thihtah chu asuhboh dingham?"},"13":{"text":"Nachonsetna jouse jeh-a, naneile nagouho, nagam pumpi sung jouse geija, gallaija thil kichom khom banga manbeija kapehdoh ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nahetlou gama namelmate toh kachesah ding nahi, ajehchu kalunghana mei akongin, hichun nakahvam ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Vo Pakai nangin nahenai, neigel doh-in lang neivilin, eibolgimho phu neilahpeh-in, nathahatna-a neipuimang hih-in, nangma jala houset kato neihet peh-in."},"16":{"text":"Nathu kamun, keiman kanetai, nathu chu keidin kipanale lungsung thanopna ahi. Ajehchu vo janel Pakai Pathen, keima namina kikou kahi."},"17":{"text":"Minelpehho kikhopna-a katoupon, pahjong kakipah poi; nakhut jeh-in kachangin katouve, ajehchu nalung hilouna-in neina dipsettan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ibola kanat kumkho sotna, katina damthei louva damding nomlou ham? Nangma kei dinga mijoule akangthei twi tobang nahi ding hitam?"},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nahung kile-a ahileh keiman puikit ningting, kamasanga nadin ding ahi. Thilse-a kona thil lutah nasodoh-a ahile, kakam sung bang ding nahi. Amaho nahenga hungkileu hen, nangvang amaho henga kile hih-in."},"20":{"text":"Chule keiman nangma hiche mite dinga sum-eng kulbang kigena kasema, amahon nakisatpi diu ahi.
