Ajehchu keima nahuhhing dingle nahuhdoh dinga um kahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"21":{"text":"Chule keiman migiloute khutna kona kahuh doh-a, tijat umtahho khutna kona kalhatdoh ding nahi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai thu chu kahenga ahunglhung kitnin aseije.","title":"Juda te Manthah Ding"},"2":{"text":"Nangin hiche munnahi ji naneilou ding, chapate chanute jong naneilou ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin, hiche munna pengho chapatele chanute thudol, chule ahinguva anuteo thudol le hiche gama ahinguva apateu thudol hitihin aseije."},"4":{"text":"Amaho hesohtah-a thiuva, kikalou diu, vuijong kivui louva tollhanga ehbang bep hidiu, amaho chemjamle gilkela mangthah uva alongu chu chunga leng vachate le leija gamsaho anneh hiding ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, lunghemna insunga lut hih-in, akapi dingle alunghempi dingin jong che hih-in, ajehchu keiman hiche mite-a konin kacham nale kahebolna chule kahepina kaladohtai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"6":{"text":"Alen aneu hiche gamahi thicheh diu, amaho kivuilou diu, minjong aka loudiu, atahsao jong ki-at pop louding, luchaija jong umlou diu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Thi jeh-a lhamonsahna dinga mite kapma lhisoh lou ding, koimachan anu ahiloule apa lungmonsahna dinga donding khon apeh louhel ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nang jong amaho toh nedingle dondinga golvahna insunga nalut louhel ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu Israel Pathen janel Pakai chun hitin aseije, vetan, namitmule nahinkho uva hiche nuina oginle kipana ogin, moulang nopna oginle mounu ogin katansah hel ding ahi.","ref":"Jer 7:34; 25:10; Tph 18:23."},"10":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, thu jousehi hiche mite nahetsah tengle, amahon najah-a, ipijeh-a Pakaiyin thilse nasatahhi keiho douna-a aphondoh hitam? Pakai ka-Pathen'u douna-a kakhangit lounao leh kachonsetnau ipiham? ati dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuteng nangin ajah uva nasei ding ahi, ajehchu napateu vin eidalhaovin, pathen dangho nung ajuijun, amaho ajenun, ahouvun keima eidalhaovin, kadan thupeh anitpouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije, natiding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Nanghon napateu sanga sejocheh nabol taove, ajehchu veuvin, amahon kathu angaida theina diuvin amitakip ama ama lunggel gilou dungjuijin achonuvin,"},"13":{"text":"hijeh-a chu keiman hiche gama kona nahetkhah louvu, nanghole napateu vin ahetkhah louvu gama kapaidoh-a, chua chu sunle jana pathen dangho najen diu, hia chu lungsetna kamusah loudiu nahiuve."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun vetan, Egypt gama kona Israel chate puidoh-a Pakai chu ahing jinge, tia akiseikit tahlouhel na nikho hochu ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","title":"Sohchana-a Kon Ahungkile Kitdingu"},"15":{"text":"Ahinla, Israel chate sahlam gama konle, aman anochehna gamho-a kona hinpuidoh-a Pakai chu ahing jinge. Chule apateu kanapehsa amaho gama chu kahin lepuikit dingu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ven, ngamanho tamtah kasol ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, amahon ahinmat dingu, chujoule sadelho tamtah solingting, amahon moltinle lhangtin chule songkoho-a kona adel lele dingu ahi.","title":"Ahunglhung Ding Gotna"},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu alampiu jouse kamitnin amun, amaho kamaija konin akisel pouvin, akhangit lounao kamitmu-a konin akiselpoi."},"18":{"text":"Chule amasatah-a keiman akhangitlou naole achonsetnao ajatnia kalethuh ding ahi. Ajehchu amahon kagam asuboh un, kagoulo chu ki-dah le thet umtah athilongu chun adipset taove."},"19":{"text":"Vo Pakai kahatnale kakuldet, chule bolgenthei ni-a jamlutna, leiset kolmonga konin chidang namdangte nahenga hunguntin, ipateovin jouthule ahomkeo phatchomna beihel ana kisan-u ahi atidiu ahi.","title":"Jeremiah Kisongtah-a Pakai Henga Ataona"},"20":{"text":"Pathen la hilou, pathenho mihemin akisem dingham?"},"21":{"text":"Hijeh chun vetan, keiman amaho hichehi khatvei hetsah ingting, kakhutle kathahat hetsah inge, chutile amahon kamin hi Pakai ahi ti hetao vinte."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah chonset nahi thih lekhamol le song mantam muhhema kisunlut ahin, alungsungu dokhang chungle namaicham sakiho chunga kikhenga ahi.","title":"Judah te Chonsetna Le Jepna"},"2":{"text":"Achateuvin thinghing phungho leh molsang chungho-a amaicham hou leh adoikhom hou ageldoh jiuve."},"3":{"text":"Vo gama kamolsang, naneile nagou jouse gal laija thil kichom banga kapehdoh ding chule nagam pumpi lhung keija namun sangho, chonset mana kapeh ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule nangma, nangma ngeijin, nagoulo kapehsa chu nalo jomlou ding, nahetphah lou gama namelmate jena kapansah ding nahi. Ajehchu kalunghana meikong nakou sah-un, a-itih-a kongjing ding ahitai, ati."},"5":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin ati, mihem'a atahsan na ngama, atichunga abantha kisema, chule Pakaiya kona alungthim petmang mipa chu sapset chenghen.","title":"Thuchom Chom Kiseiho"},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu ama nelphaija phaipheng keh banga thilpha ahungteng amulou ding, ahinla gamthipma gambeh neoho chi umna gamle mihem chenlouna gama cheng ding bou ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pakai tahsana, akinepna Pakai hia mipa chu anun nom ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu ama twipanga thing kiphut, vapanga ajung jamdoh-a, nisa satnin sangkha louva ana jong hingjing tobang chu hiding ahi, gamgot kum-a olmo louva, aga jong geongai louding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Lungthimhi thil jouse chunga joulhepna dimset, gitlouna-a sesoh hel ahin, hichehi kon hethei jintem?"},"10":{"text":"Mitin ama ama lamlhah dungjuile atohga dungjui cheh-a kapeh theina dingin, keima Pakaiyin lungsung kakholin, lunggil ho kapatepjin ahi,","ref":"Labu 62:12; Tph 2:23."},"11":{"text":"vabuh-in atwi athah-a khelouva adalhah banga, adihlouva haojong chu chutobang ahin; chule ahinkho kimtuh-a adalha-a, akichaina chu mingol hiding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Atila pat laltouna sang loupi khat umchu kamun theng laiju chu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Vo Israelte kinepna Pakai, nangma dalha jouse jahchaova keija kona kidalseho chu tolla kijihlut ding ahiuve, ajehchu amahon Pakai hinna twi longjing chu adalha taove."},"14":{"text":"Neidam sah-in, Vo Pakai, chutile dam tange, neihuh-in chutile huhhing hitange, ajehchu nangma kavahchoi jing pa nahi.","title":"Jeremaih'in Pakai Henga Panpina Athum"},"15":{"text":"Vetan, amahon kajah-a, Pakai thusei chu hoiba ham? Tuhin hung guilhung hen, atiuve."},"16":{"text":"Keima vang, kelngoichingpu kahina-a nakoma kon kavah mangpon, dana nikho jong kangaichapoi, namasanga kakama thupot chu, adih ahi nangin nahenai."},"17":{"text":"Kei dingin manthah na hihih-in, nikho phalou ni-a kakinepna nahi."},"18":{"text":"Eibolgimho jahchaohen lang, keivang nei jachatsah hih-in, amaho lungthoijuhen lang, keivang neilungthoi sah hih-in, achunguva nikho phalou lhunsah inlang, manthah na jatni-in sumangin."},"19":{"text":"Pakaiyin kajah-a hitihin aseije, Jerusalem kotpi jouse, Judah lengte lutle potlena, mihem chate kotpi phunga khun gadingin,","title":"Cholngahni Manding dan"},"20":{"text":"Chule ahenguva, hiche kotpi-a lutji nangho Judah leng tele, Judah mite, chule Jerusalem'a chenghon Pakai thusei hi ngaijun."},"21":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, kichihtheijun lang cholngah nin pohgih pohdaovin, chule hichu Jerusalem kotpi-a jong hinpolut hih-un.","ref":"Neh 13:15-22."},"22":{"text":"Na inhouva konin jong cholngah nile pohgih podoh hih-un, najong imacha tong hih-un, napateu thu kapeh bangin cholngahni chu jabol uvin.","ref":"Pot 20:8-10; Danb 5:12-14."},"23":{"text":"Ahinla amahon ajuipouve, anaujong asungpouvin ahi, ajahlouna diule hilchahna asanlouna diuvin alouchal uve."},"24":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, Pakai jin cholngah ni-a hiche khopi kotpi-a pohgih pohlut louna dingle, na imacha tohlouna dinga choldoni najabol joh uva, lunglut tah-a neijop ule,"},"25":{"text":"David laltouna-a tou lenghole lengchate, kangtalai le sakolchung chongho, amahole amilenteu Judah mitele Jerusalem'a chengho chu, hiche khopi kotpi sunga lutnuntin, hiche kotpihi a-imatih-a umjing ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule amaho Judah khopiho-a konle, Jerusalem kimvela konin, Benjamin gama konle phaichama konin molsang ho-a konle, lhanglama konin govam thil tole ganlhaiho Pakai ina hinpouvinte."},"27":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon choldoni jabolna dingle, choldoni-a Jerusalem kotpi-a lutna-a, pohgih pohlouna dinga kathu nangai lou uleh, chuche kotpiho phunga chu mei kakonsah-a, hichun Jerusalem'a leng inpiho akahvama, mitlouhel ding ahitai, ati."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hung lhung chun hitin aseije,","title":"Beldengpa Akona Kihilna"},"2":{"text":"kipat in, beldengpa ina chesuh-in, hikoma chu kathu kajahsah ding nahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin beldengpa ina kachesuhle, vetan, aman bel dena akang kikola chun na anatonge."},"4":{"text":"Chuin bonngana abelden chu beldengpa khutna chun asedentan, hitichun beldengpan den dinga aphatsah bangin, belchom khatnin adengtai."},"5":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin aseije,"},"6":{"text":"Vo Israel insung, beldengpa banga kabolmo nahiu vem? tin Pakaiyin aseije. Veuvin, beldengpa khutna bonngan banga khu kakhutna um nahilouvu ham? Vo Israel insung."},"7":{"text":"Itih phat hama namkhat ham ahiloule lenggam khat ham chungchanga, bodoh ding, suhlhuh ding, suhmang ding tia kaseija,"},"8":{"text":"adouna-a kana seisa, chuche nam chu asetnaova kona akisih uva ahile, achunguva thilse bolding kagotsa-a kona kalung kakhelkit ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Itih phat hama namkhat ham ahiloule lenggam khat ham chungchanga semdoh dingle phudet dinga kaseina ding techun,"},"10":{"text":"kamitmu-a thilse aboluva, kathu angailou-ule, phatchom sah-u vinge kana tisa, thilpha-a kona chu kalung kisihkit jengding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun, Judah mitele Jerusalem'a chengteho henga Pakai jin hitin aseije, veuvin, nangho dounan thilse kagongin, nangho dounan thil gilou kagonge. Tuhin mitin nakhangitlou naova konin hung kileuvin lang, nachonnaole nathil bolu aphacheh hisah-un, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin amahon, kinepna aumpoi, kalung gotnu bang chehle mitin ama lung gilou ngaito bang cheh-a kachonjoh dingu bou ahi atiuve."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, tun nanghon Pathen helouho lah-a dong temun, hitobang chu kon ajah khah em? Israel nungah theng chun thil tijat umtah khat aboltai.","title":"Mipihon Pakai Apaimangu"},"14":{"text":"Loujao songpi-a kona Lebanon buhbang hunglong chu, min dalhantin, twidap jenjen munchoma kona hunglong chu kidalhan tem?"},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu kamiten eisumilun, pannabei jin gimnamtui ahalun, chule keng lampiho-a chena din, lamluiho-a konin apetnun alampi houva akipalun ahi."},"16":{"text":"Agamu kamhelna dingle, a-itih-a leihit khongleu dingin asemun, ajotpa chanchu king vutna alu apei ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Melma masanga solam hui thecheh banga amaho kathecheh uva, ahamset niule ang-ngat louva kanungsun ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amahon, hungun, Jeremiah dounan thilgon khat gong-u hite, ajehchu thempu-a kona danthupeh chu manglou ding ahin, miching ho-a kona thumop, themgaova kona jong thu beilou ding ahi. Hungun kamsungin ama vouhitin, athu khatcha ngaipou hite, atiuve.","title":"Jeremiah Tha Nading Tohgon"},"19":{"text":"Neikhoh sah-in, Vo Pakai, eikinahpiho ogin khu ngaitemin."},"20":{"text":"Ase chu aphan kilethuh intem? Ajehchu amahon kei thana dingin ko alaitauve. Amaho-a kona nalunghana nalahdohna dinga, amaho dinga thupha kisei chu geldoh-in."},"21":{"text":"Hijeh chun achate chu kellhah na-a pedoh-in lang, athisanu chemjam hatna-a bunglha tan, chule ajiteu chu meithai soh uhen, apasalteu thisah inlang, agollhanghou gala chemjamin lousah-in."},"22":{"text":"Photlot louva achunguva galmihon napuilut tengle, a-inhouva jong kana kijahen, ajehchu kei thana din ko alaijun, kakeng o-nadin thang akamuve."},"23":{"text":"Ahijengvangin Pakai kei thana dinga kachunga akihousomu nangin nahenai, akhangit lounao ngaidam hih-in lang, achonsetnao jong namitmu-a konin noimang hih-in. Namasang-ah gal lelsahjon lang, nalunghan tengle hitichun bolin."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, chenlang beldengpa lei halkhat galanlang, miho lah-a tehse ho le thempu luiho gapuijin.","title":"Belkeh-a Kona kihilna"},"2":{"text":"Solam kotpi lutna-a Hinnom chapa phaicham lama potdoh-in lang, kaseipeh ding thuho chu gaphong jal-in.","ref":"2 Leng 23:10; Jer 7:30-32; 32:34-35."},"3":{"text":"Chule Vo Judah lengte le Jerusalem'a cheng nanghon, Pakai thu chu ngaijuvin, janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, vetan, hiche mun chungahi thilse kalhunsah-a, ajachan akolu thah tuntun ding ahi, tin seijin;"},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon eidalhaovin, hiche munhi ahotbolun, asunga chun amahole apateu chule Judah lengten anahetkhah louvu pathen dangho din gimnamtui ahalun, hiche munhi setna neilouho thisan adiptauve."},"5":{"text":"Amahon kei thupeh loule kei seilou, kalunga jong lutkhalou Baal henga govam thilpeh nadingle, achateu meija gona dingin Baal munsang ho jong asemun,","ref":"Thmpu 18:21."},"6":{"text":"hijeh chun vetan, hiche munhi Tophet, ahiloule Hinnom chate phaicham kiti talouva kithana phaicham joh kitina ding nikhoho hunglhung ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"7":{"text":"Chule keiman hikoma Judah le Jerusalem kithumopna moh kahisah-a, amelmateu masangle ahinnao holte khutna chemjam'a kalousah-a, alongu chu chunga vachate le leija ganhingho anneh hiding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Keiman hiche khopiho akamhel le leihit khongleuva kasema, hiche suhgamnaho jouse jeh-a chu ajotpa chan king vutna chesa diu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule achapateu sa leh achanuteu sa kanehsah-a, khopi kiumkim vel sunga mitinin agolpa sa aneh uva, hikoma chu amelmateule ahinnao holten ano chinto diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chutengle nangman nalhonpi ho mitmu-a hai chu nasuhkeh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule ajah uva, janel Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, min beldengpa bel bitkit theilou dinga asuhkeh tobang ngeija hiche mitele khopihi kivuina ding abeihel kahse-a kasuhsetna Topheth'a kivui ding ahiuve, nati ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hiti achu hiche khopile asunga chengho chunga kabola, Tophet khopi kabahsah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"13":{"text":"Amahon inho jouse chunga van janelpi houna-a gimnamtui ahal uva, pathen dangho henga don thilpeh asunlhah jeh uvin Jerusalem inhole Judah lengte inho chu Tophet mun banga kisuboh ding ahitai, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuphatnin Topheth'a konin Jeremiah chu Pakaiyin gaochanga asolna lama chun ahungin, Pakai inhong sunga chun adingin, mijouse henga aseitai."},"15":{"text":"Israelte Pathen'in hitin aseije, amahon kathusei ngailouna dinga angongu avaiput jeh-un, veuvin, hiche khopile akhopi jouse adouna-a kaseisa thilse jouse chu kalhunsah ding ahi, ati."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Pakai insunga vaipo pipuija pang Immer chapa Pashhur Thempu'n, Jeremiah hiche thuho-a agao chu ajatan,","title":"Pashhur Thempu le Jeremiah kiboina"},"2":{"text":"chuin Pashhur in Jeremiah Themgao chu avon, Benjamin kotpi sunga soulah-a ahenin, hichu Pakai inkom ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, Pashhur in soulah-a kon chun Jeremiah chu ahin puidohtai. Chuin Jeremiah in ajah-a, Pakaiyin namin Pashhur hilouvin “Magor-missabib” asahtai, ati."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, ven, nangma tahle nagol ho jouse dinga tijat umtah-a kasem ding nahin, amaho chu amelmateu chemjamin louvuntin, nangin namitna navet ding, chule Judah te jouse Babylon lengpa khutna kapeh-a, aman gal hinga Babylon'a akaija, amaho chu chemjam'a atha ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chukalvala chu hiche khopi haona jouse, atohdoh jouseu, thil manlu jouse, Judah lengte gou jouse chu amelmateu khutna kapehdoh-a, hichu asuh chatvaijuva akilah uva, Babylon'a apoh diu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule nang, Pashhur na-insunga cheng jousetoh gal hinga Babylon gama nacheuva, chuachu nathi ding, nangle jouthu nanaseipeh nagol ho jousetoh chu-a nakivuiden diu ahitai, ati."},"7":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nangin neijou lhepmin, joulhep kahitai, nangma kei sangin nahatjon, neinajou tai. Keima nisehle i-sah louvin kaumin, mitinin eitotnop naove.","title":"Jeremiah Pakai Henga Akiphin"},"8":{"text":"Kathusei chanin kapeng doh-in, hunamle suhmang jeng katijin ahi. Ajehchu Pakai thu chu kei dingin niseh-a mihouset nale i-sah louna ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Chuin keiman ama chu phahpoh dangting, aminin jong thu seitaponge kati. Ahinla ama thu chu kalungsunga hin, kaguho sunga meikong kilhakhum abangin, kathohlel behsetnin kaumthei tapoi."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla mi tamtah-in eiminset sahnao kajan, ningtina tijatna adime, amahon hehseuvin, hehseuhite akitiuve. Kakihet gilpiho jousen eichanglhi uvin, ijemtin lheplhah-in umintin, eihon ama jouvuhitin, achunga iphu kilah uhite akitiuve."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai chun mihangsan tijat umtah bangin eiumpin, hijeh achu eibolgimho kipal lhuva eijo lou diu, alolhin loujeh uva chu jahcha lheh diu ahin, tonsotna akisuh dongnao chu suhmila umlou ding ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla Vo janel Pakai, midih patepna lungsungle lunggil muletsohji, achunguva naphulahna neimusah-in. Ajehchu kachung chang thu nahenga kakhe lhahsoh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Pakai henga la saovin, Pakai chu vahchoijun, ajehchu aman thilse bolho khutna konin migenthei ho hinna-a ahuhdoh-e."},"14":{"text":"Kapenni chu sapset hihen lang, kanun eihin ni chu vangboh hidahen.","ref":"Job 3:1-19."},"15":{"text":"Kapa henga nang dingin chapa khat apengtai tia thu hung lhutna, kapa kipasah pa chu sapset changhen."},"16":{"text":"Hiche mipa chu Pakaiyin asuhchim, lungheilou khopiho toh banghen lang, jingkahle kana, sunphatle kho kisap jahen."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu kanu chu kalhankhuh anahi theina dingle, chule phattina anaobu keima dinga alet jingna dingin, aman naobu-a konin einathat tapon ahi."},"18":{"text":"Kahinkho jachatna-a lhum mang ding, tohgimna le lunggimna mubep dinga, ibola naobu-a kona kahung pendoh hitam?"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah lengpan Jeremiah henga Melchiah chapa Pashhur le Maaseiah thempu chapa Zephaniah asol laija Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hunglhung chun aseije,","title":"Jerusalem Gallel Ding Kisei Masah"},"2":{"text":"Kangeh nahi, keiho dingin Pakai chu neidoh peh-un, ajehchu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in kachunguva gal abolin, chuti ahile athilbol kidangho jouse dungjuijin Pakaiyin eihuvintin, ama keiho-a konin chetouthei nante, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah'in ajah lhona, nangnin Zedekiah henga hitin seilhonin:"},"4":{"text":"Israelte Pakai Pathen'in vetan, kul polama nangho na-umkol khumuva, Babylon lengpa le Chaldea mite nadouna diu, nakhut uva gal manchah ho chu kanung heiding, chule amaho chu hiche khopi sungahi kahin khopkhom ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule keimatah-in khut lhangdoh le banthahat toh, lunghangle lungsa tah-a, chule lungnatah puma nangho kasatdiu nahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Chule hiche khopi sunga chengho mihem le ganhing agoma katha ding, hise nasatah-a kona thiding ahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Hichejou chun Pakaiyin aseije, keiman Judah lengpa Zedekiah le asohte, chule mipi ho, chule hiche khopi-a hise-a, chemjam'a, kela kona hoidohho chu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khutna, amelmateu khutna, ahinnao holte khutna kapehdoh ding, aman amaho chemjam'a atha-a, akhenlou diu, achunga hepina anei louhel ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule hiche mite henga hiti ahi nasei ding ahi, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, veuvin, keiman namasanguva hinna lampile thina lampi kakoije."},"9":{"text":"Hiche khopi sunga uma chu chemjam'a, kela, hise-a thiding: ahinla chedoh-a nangho hin um khuma Chaldea miho henga kipelutpa chu hingintin, chule ahinna chu ama dinga gala kichomdoh bangbep hiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman hiche khopi hin thilse atona dinga kamaingat ahitai, thilpha dinga ahipoi, tin Pakai jin aseije. Hichehi Babylon lengpa khutna kipedoh-a, aman meija ahalvam ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Judah lengpa insung thudola, Pakai thu ngaijun, tin seijin.","title":"Judah Leng Insung Chunga Thutanna"},"12":{"text":"Vo David insung mite, jingkahle thu tannun lang, misugenthei pa khutna konin hunama kichompa chu huhdoh-un, ajole thilse nabol jeh uvin, koima phelmit theilou kalunghana meikong tobang potdoh getninte, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"13":{"text":"Vetemin, eidou diuva koi hungsuh-a, ichen naova koi hunglut dingham? tia seija, vo damphaija chengpa, chule phaicham songpi, Pakai keiman nangma kadouve, ati."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla Pakaiyin natohga dungjuija kabolgima, gammang sunga mei kakousah-a, hichun akimvela thil jouse akahvam ding ahi, ati."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Judah lengpa ina chesuh-in lang, hiche thuhi gaseijin,","title":"Judah Leng Insung Henga Jeremiah Thusei"},"2":{"text":"Vo David laltouna-a tou Judah lengpa, nangle hiche kotpiho sunga lut nasohte le namite, Pakai thu chu ngaijuvin:"},"3":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nanghon thutan nale chonphatna bolunlang, nanghon mibolgima konin hunama kichompa chu huhdoh un: gamdang mi paneilou ahiloule meithai henga adihloule pumhat boldaovin, hiche mun'a hin setnabei thisan jong sohih-un."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu nanghon hitichu nabol uva ahile, kangtalai le sakola amale asohte, chule amite hiche kotpi ahi hunglut uva, David laltouna-a toudiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla hiche thuho hi nangai louvule, keimatah kaki hahsel ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, hiche inhi akeohela hung umding ahi.","ref":"Matt 23:28; Luk 13:35."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla Pakaiyin, Judah leng insung jah-a hitin aseije, nangma kei dinga Gilead nahin Lebanon luchang nahi: hijengjongle gamthiple mi chenlouna khopi-a kasem teiding nahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule nadou ding misumang ho, gal manchahto kithocheh kagona, na cedar thing deichomho aphuh uva, mei sunga aselut dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nam tamtah-in hiche khopihi ahin hopaova, amitakip min aheng akom henga, ibola Pakaiyin hiche khopi lentah hi ahitibol hitam? atidiu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuteng amahon, ajehchu amahon Pakai Pathen thulhun adonpouvin, pathen dangho ahouvuva ajen jeh-u ahi, tia adonbut dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nangho mithi dingin kaphih-un, lunghempi jong bolhih-un: apotdohpa ding joh-in lhasetah-in kapmun, ajehchu ama hung kilekit talou ding, apenna gam jong mukit lou ding ahitai.","title":"Shallum Dinga Jeremiah Thusei"},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin ati, hiche mun'a kona potdoh apa Josiah khela lengchang Judah leng Josiah chapa Shallum thudola, ama chulama hung kilekit louhel ding ahitai, ati.","ref":"2 Leng 23:31-34; 2 Thusm 36:1-4."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla gal hinga akaina lamu mun'a chu thia, hiche gamhi amukit louding ahitai.","title":"Jehoiakim Dinga Jeremiah Thusei"},"13":{"text":"Chonphat louna-a a-in kisah-a, adihlouva a-indan kisempa, aheng akom manbeija goija, atohman peloupa chu, Ohe! ada ahi."},"14":{"text":"In lentahle indan lentah chule bangkot ho umin kisah inge, tia cedar thinga sa-a, sandul jetna naloi ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nangin cedar jenga najo jeh-a chu nalengchan ding ham? Napa chun aneh-a, adonna, thutannale thudih anabolla, hichu ama dinga anaphalheh hilou ham?"},"16":{"text":"Aman vaicha lhasamho thu anatandih jin, hichu amadin anaphalheh ji-e: hichehi keima hetna hilou ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"17":{"text":"Ahinla namitle nalungthim chu nakiloset na dingle, setnabei thisan sona, suhgenthei nale pumhat manna ding bep ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin, Judah leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim thudol hitihin aseije, amahon Vo kasopipa, vo kasopinu tia alunghempi loudiu, amahon ama dinga, vo pakai, ahiloule vo jana-a aloupina, tia alunghempi loudiu ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 23:36—24:6; 2 Thusm 36:5-7."},"19":{"text":"Ama sangan kivui banga kivui ding, Jerusalem kotpi kallama kikaija kipaidoh ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Lebanon'a chetouvin lang, gakap temin, chule Bashana gakisenin lang, Abarim'a konin gakapmin. Ajehchu nangai jouse kimanthahsah ahitai.","title":"Jeresulem Chunga Vangsetna Hunglhung ding Chungchanga Jeremiah Thusei"},"21":{"text":"Keiman naphatna ding kasei ahin, ahinla nangman ngaiponge nati. Hichehi naneolaija na-umchan ahin, hitia chu kathu nangailou ahi."},"22":{"text":"Huijin nakelngoi chin jouse semlih intin, nalungsette gal hinga chediu, nagitlouna jouse jeh-a najachat ding, chule nakisuhdong ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Vo cedar phunga bu kiset, Lebanon'a chengte, numei naosonat banga natna nachunga ahungchuh phungteng, iti lungset naum tadem?"},"24":{"text":"Keima kahing jinge tin Pakaiyin aseije, Judah leng Jehoiakim chapa Koniah chu kakhut jetlama melchihna hijongle chun, kasutlhah ding nahin:","title":"Koniah Chunga Pathen Thutana","ref":"2 Leng 24:8-15; 2 Thusm 36:9-10."},"25":{"text":"Nahinna holtehole amaiju nagin jingho, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khut ngeija, chule Chaldea miho khutna kapehdoh ding nahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule keiman nangmale nahinga nanu chu napenna hilou gamchombeh-a kapuilutna, hia chu nathi ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ahinla amaho akilekit nomnao gama chu kilekit louhel ding ahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Hiche mipa Koniah hi mi isahlou milim chipsa chu hijam? Amahi deilouhel hitam? Ibola amale achilhahte kipaidoh-a, amahon ahetlouvu gama kipaidoh-a hiuvaham?"},"29":{"text":"Vo leiset, leiset, leiset, Pakai thu chu ngaitemin."},"30":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hiche mipahi chaneilou, ahinkho sunga lolhing lou ding ahi, tin suntaovin: ajehchu achilhah khatcha lolhing lou ding, David laltouna-a touva Judah gama vaihom umlou ding ahi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kakelngoite hamset na-a sugamle thecheh-a kelngoiching ho adau ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","title":"Ahunglhung ding Phatna Kinepna"},"2":{"text":"Hijeh chun kamite vah-a kelngoiching ho douna-in Israelte Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, nanghon ka kelngoi hon nathe cheh-un, nano mangun, navil pouve: veuvin, nathil gilou bolu chunga gotna kapeh ding nahiuve, tin Pakai jin aseije."},"3":{"text":"Chule ka kelngoi hon amohho chu kadeldohna gamho jouse-a kona kachom khoma, ahong sunguva kalepui kitna, amaho gatheijuva pungthei diu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Keiman amaho vahdinga achunguva kelngoiching ho katundoh ding, amaho kichatalou ding, lungjong lungthoitalou diu: imacha jong lhasam talou diu ahi, tin Pakai jin aseije."},"5":{"text":"Vetan, keiman David dinga chonphatna bah khat katundoh-a, leng khatnin vai ahoma lolhing ding, leisetna thudih-a thu atan ding nikhoho ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Jer 33:14-16."},"6":{"text":"Ama nikho sunga Judah kihuh hinga, Israel bitkeija cheng ding ahin: chule ama kikouna ding min chu Ichon phatnao Pakai kitiding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun ven, Egypt gama kona Israel chate hinpui dohpa Pakai chu ahing jinge, atikit louna diu nikhoho chu ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"8":{"text":"Ahin sahlam gamkaija kona kanadelmangna gamkaiho jouse-a kona, Israel insung chilhah hinpui touva, kaihoipa chu ahing jinge, chule amaho agamtah uva cheng dingu ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Themgaoho jeh-in kalunghi kasunga apohkeh tan, kagu jouse akilong gamin, Pakai jehle athenna thuho jeh-in, jukhampa jun ajo mipatoh kabangtan ahi.","title":"Themgaoho Douna Jeremiah Thusei"},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu gamsunghi jonthanhoi adimsetnin, kihehsetna jeh-in gamsung alunghemin, gamthip nomlaiho agolhan, alamlhah-u asetan, ahetnao adihtapoi."},"11":{"text":"Themgaole Thempu agomin aboh geltan ahi; henge, ka-insunga jong agitlounau kamudohtai, tin Pakai chun aseije."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu alampiu chu amaho dinga muthima lamnal tobang hintin, amaho kino lele uva, chua lhugam diu: achunguva thilse kapohlut ding, gotna achan kum-u hiding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"13":{"text":"Samaria Themgaoho lah-a ngolna kamudoh-in, amaho Baal jenga agao vun, kami Israelte achonsetsah taove."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem themgaoho lah-a jong tijat umtah thil kamu doh-e: amahon jonthanhoi abolun, jou amangun agitlounauva kona khatcha ahung kile louna din, thilse bolho khuttha ahatsah-un, amaho abonun kei dingin Sodom abangun, chule asunga chengho chu Gomorrah tobang ahiuve.","ref":"Semt 18:20; Ezek 16:49."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun janel Pakaiyin themgaoho thudol chu hitin aseije, ven, keiman amaho thinglunga kavah-a, thinkha twi kadonsah diu ahi. Ajehchu Jerusalem themgaoho-a konin gamsung pumpi-a kisuhbohna ajaltai."},"16":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, naheng uva gao thusei themgaoho thu chu ngaihih-un, amahon manmo nasouva agaothu seiju jong amaho lunggela kon ahin, Pakai kamsunga kon ahipoi."},"17":{"text":"Amahon einahsah louho henga, Pakaiyin asei ahi, nanghon chamna nanei diu ahi, atiuve. Chule amahon amaho lungngaito banga chonho mitin henga chun, nachunga thilse imacha chuponte, atiuve."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai thumop na-a koi gadinga, athu ja-a koiham?"},"19":{"text":"Vetan, Pakai lungsatna chimpei khohtah ngeichu ahung nunge, hichu migilou luchunga khohtah-a chuding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Pakai lunghanna chu atohdoh kahsehle, alung ngaito amolso kahse-a kilekit louding ahin, ninunung tengle chamkimtah-a nahet them diu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hiche themgaohohi kasol ahipon, hijongle alhaijun, kenla amaho thu kamoppon, ahinla agaochanguve."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla amaho kathumopna-a dinga hiuhenlang, kamite kathu ajahsah-u hile, amahon alampiu phalouva kon chule athilbolu phalouva kona alehei diu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Keima naitah-a um Pathen, gamlatah-a umlou Pathen chu kahilou ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"24":{"text":"Kamuthei louna dinga munthipma kiseljouva mi umintem? Pakai jin ati. Keima vanle leisetna dimsoh kahilouham? tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"25":{"text":"Kamina jouva gaova themgaoho thusei kajan, mang kaneije, mang kaneije, atiuve."},"26":{"text":"Jouva gaothusei themgaoho lungsunga itih chanpi hichehi umding ham? Henge, amaho alungsung uva mijoulhep themgaoho ahiuve."},"27":{"text":"Apateuvin Baal jeh-a kamin asuhmil banguva, aheng akomuva mitinin amang aseijuva, kamite chu kamin suhmilsahna ding angaitou ahi."},"28":{"text":"Mangnei themgaovin mangthu seihen lang, kathu neija chun kathu tahsan umtah-in seihen: suhlouchang dinga asi chu ipi ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"29":{"text":"Kathuhi meikong tobang hilou ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije. Songpi disela vokeh sehtum tobang hilou ham?"},"30":{"text":"Hijeh chun vetan, keiman aheng akoma kona kathu gumang themgao takip chu kadou ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"31":{"text":"Veovin, aman aseije, tia aleiju mangcha-a themgaoho chu keiman kadouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"32":{"text":"Veovin, mang dihlou gaothua seija miho hille-a, ajounaole anahsahmo naova kamite puise-a, keisola hilou, thu kapeh jong hilouho chu kadou ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Hijeh achu hiche mitehi aphatchom sah louhel diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"33":{"text":"Hiche mitele themgao, ahiloule thempu khattouvin, Pakai pohgih chu ipiham? tia nadoh ule, chuteng nangin ajah uva, ipi pohgih ham? Nangho tahhi kapaidoh ding nahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije, tin seijin.","title":"Pakai Pohgih"},"34":{"text":"Chule Pakai pohgih, tia seiding themgaole thempu mipa thudol chu, chuche mipa tahle a-insung chu talen kapeh ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Mitinin aheng akomchehle asopipa cheh henga, Pakaiyin ipi adonbut nem? Chule Pakaiyin ipi aseijem? tia nasei diu ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chule Pakai pohgih tia naphahpoh kit loudiu ahitai. Ajehchu amitakip thu chu ama pohgih hiding, ajehchu i-Pathen'u janel Pakai Pathen hingjing thu chu akaleh-in nahei gamtaove."},"37":{"text":"Themgaopa henga chu hiti ahi nasei ding ahi, Pakaiyin ipi nadonbut nem? Chule Pakaiyin ipi aseijem?"},"38":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai pohgih chu, nati uva pat hiche thu nasei jeh-un, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Pakai pohgih chu tia nasei jeh-un, Pakai pohgih chu natikit loudiu ahi, tia naheng uva thu kahinthot ahi."},"39":{"text":"Hijeh chun, ven kei keimatah-in nangho kasuhmil uva, nanghole napateu kapehsa khopi chu kapaidoh-a, ka-angsunga kona kaledoh diu nahiuve."},"40":{"text":"Chule a-itih-a nachung uva housetnale tonsot jachatna kahin pohlut khumuva, hichu suhmiltih umtalou ding ahi, ati."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon lengpa Nabuchadnezzer in, Judah leng Jehoiakim chapa Jeconiah le Judah milenho, thingthem hole thihthem ho Jerusalem'a kona Babylon'a apuimang nungin Pakaiyin Pakai houin maija chun theichang pocha ni einamu sah-in ahi.","title":"Theichang Aphale Ase","ref":"2 Leng 24:12-16; 2 Thusm 36:10."},"2":{"text":"Pocha khat chu theichang phatah, theichang gamasapen tobang hel ahin, pocha khatjoh chu theichang phaloubeh, nehthei louhel, phamo behseh jeng ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakai chun kajah-a, Jeremiah ipi namu em? eiti, chuin keiman theichang ho kati; theichang phaho chu aphalheh-in, chule phaloutah nehthei louhel, chuti phatmo jeng ahi, kati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin aseije,"},"5":{"text":"Pakai Israelte Pathen'in hitin aseije, hiche theichang phamoho bangahi Judah mite, hiche mun'a kona Chaldea gama kasoldohho, gal hinga kikaiho chu aphatna diuva kahet ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu achunguva aphatna diuva kavet lhih jinga, hiche gamahi kahinlepui ding: kasahdoh-a kasotlhuh lou ding, kaphudetna kabodoh lou ding ahitai."},"7":{"text":"Keima Pakai kahi ahetdohna diu lungthim khat kapeh-a, amaho kamite hiuva, keima a-Pathen'u kahi ding ahi. Ajehchu amaho alung pumpiuva kahenga hungkile diu ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Theichang phalou, nehthei hilou, chuti phatmo bang chun tahbeh-in Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Judah lengpa Zedekiah le amilenho Jerusalem'a umden, hiche gama amohho, chule Egypt gamsunga chengho chu, chutia chu kapehdoh ding:"},"9":{"text":"chule kanomangna ding mun jouse-a, seisetle thuchih dinga seichahle gaosap dinga, leiset lenggam jouse-a akisuh khahna diuva chaulele dinga kapehdoh ding ahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Chule keiman amahole apateu kanapehsa gama kona amanthah hel kahseuva alah uva chemjam, kellhah, hiset kasolpeh ding ahiuve."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah lengpa Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchan kal kumli channa-a, Judah mite jouse chungchang thudol Jeremiah henga hung lhung chu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kumkhatna ahin,","title":"Sahlam Gama Kon Melma","ref":"2 Leng 24:1; 2 Thusm 36:5-7; Dan 1:1-2."},"2":{"text":"hichu Jeremiah themgaovin Judah mite jousele Jerusalem'a chengte jouse henga aseije."},"3":{"text":"Judah leng Amon chapa Josiah kum somle kumthum na-a pat tuni geijin hichu kum somni le kumthum ahin, Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, keiman naheng uva kaseijin, matah-in kathouvin, kaseijin, ahinla nangaipouve."},"4":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin naheng uva asohte themgaoho jouse ahinsolin, jingpi-a thouvin ahinsolin, ahinla nanghon nangaipeh pouvin, jahdin jong nanau nasung pouve."},"5":{"text":"Amahon aseijun, amitakip tuhin alampi phalouva konle thilphalou nabol uva konin hungkileu hen lang, Pakaiyin nanghole napateu atonsot tonsotna dinga anapeh gama chun chengtauvin."},"6":{"text":"Chule pathen dangho chu jendingle hou dingin juidaovin lang, nakhutsoh uva lunghansah din neiphinse hih uvin, chutile bolsetda taovinge."},"7":{"text":"Ahijengvangin kathu nangaipouvin, hitichun nakisuh khahna diuva nakhutsoh uva lunghansah din neiphinse uvin, ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun janel Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, nanghon kathu nangailou jeh un:"},"9":{"text":"Veuvin, mi solingting sahlam gama insung jousele kasoh Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar hiche gam dou dingle asunga chengho, chule akimvela namho jouse sumanghel dinga kahinpuija, amaho chun kidang asah-va cheh sasa diu, chule a-itih-a kamhela kalha ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"10":{"text":"Chukalvala amaho-a kona kipana ogin, thanopna ogin, moulang ogin, mounu ogin, sumhei song kiheh gin, chule thaomeivah kasuhbei ding ahi.","ref":"Jer 7:34; 16:9; Tph 18:22-23."},"11":{"text":"Hiche gam pumpihi kamhelle datmotah-a umding, hiche namho chun Babylon lengpa chu kum somsagi ajendiu ahi.","ref":"2 Thusm 36:21; Jer 29:10; Dan 9:10."},"12":{"text":"Chule kum somsagi lhinteng hiti ding ahi, akhangit lounao jeh-a Babylon lengpa chule hiche Chaldea mite gam chu talen kapeh-a a-itih-a dinga kamhela kalha ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"13":{"text":"Chule hiche gam douna-a kaseisa thuho jouse nam jouse douna-a Jeremiah themgaovin anasei, hiche lekhabu kisun jouse ngei chu kahin lhunsah ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon nam tamtah le leng lenho ajendiu, atoh-u dungjuile akhuttah uva athilbolu dungjuija kalethuh ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu Israelte Pathen Pakai chun kahenga hitin aseije, kakhutna lunghanna khonhi lanlang, kasolna ding namho jouse chu donsah in."},"16":{"text":"Chule amahon adonuva alah uva kasol ding chemjamho jeh-a chu lonle leuva ngoldiu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Pakai khutna khon chu kalan, Pakaiyin eisolna namho jouse chu kadonsah in ahi.","title":"Namho Chunga Pathen Thutana"},"18":{"text":"Jerusalem le Judah khopiho, chua lenghole milenho chu tulai bangahi kamhela, datmo uma, leihit khongleuva gaosapma umsah dingin,"},"19":{"text":"Egypt lengpa Pharaoh le asohte, chule amilentele amipite:"},"20":{"text":"Mi kichoh hal ho jousele Uz gamsunga lengho jouse, Philistine gamsunga lengho jouse, chule Ashkelon, Azzah, Ekron chule Ashdod na amoh um jouse,"},"21":{"text":"Edom le Moab, chule Ammon chate,"},"22":{"text":"Trye lengte jousele Zidon lengte jouse, chule twipi gala twikol gamho lengte,"},"23":{"text":"Dedan, Tema, Buz chule gamningkoi kikhonnaho jouse,"},"24":{"text":"Arabia lengho jousele nelphaija cheng michoplop ho jouse,"},"25":{"text":"Zimri lengte jousele Elam lengte jouse, chule Media lengte jouse,"},"26":{"text":"Chule naija gamla sahlam gamkai lengho jouse khat khatna, lei chunga vannoi lenggam jouse, chule amaho nunga chu Sheshach lengpan adon ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Hijeh achu ajah uva Israel Pathen janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, donun lang kham uvin, chule phidohun lang lhu uvin, thoukit tahih un. Nalah uva kahinsol ding chemjam jehchun, tia nasei ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule hiti ding ahi, amahon nakhutna khon chu lah-a donding adaova ahile, nangman ajah uva, janel Pakaiyin nadon teidiu ahi ati, nati ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ajehchu ven, kamina kivo hiche khopi chunga thilse kahin pohlut patding ahitan, nangho talen manlouvin umun natem? Nangho talen manlouvin umpouvin nate: ajehchu leiset chung cheng jouse chunga chemjam kakou ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"30":{"text":"Hijeh chun amaho jouse dounan hiche thuho hi gaovin, ajah uva seijin, chunga konin Pakai hung kitumin tin, achenna munthenga konin a-aw hinsodohin tin, thanei tah-a muntheng chunga kituma, lengpiga chilho banga, leiset chunga cheng jouse douna-a aoding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Leiset kolmong geija aw khat kitollele ding ahi, ajehchu Pakaiyin nam jouse toh kinelna aneijin, aman tahsa hing jouse thu atanna, migiloute jouse chemhema apehdoh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"32":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan, setna chu nam khatna kona nam khatna kitollele ding, chule leiset kolmonga kona chimpei nasatah hungnung ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule chuche ni-a Pakai mitha chu leiset kolmong langkhatna pat langkhat gei hiding ahin, amaho chu kilunghempi louding, kichom khom lou dingu, vui jong kivui louding, amaho leichunga eh-a pangdiu ahi."},"34":{"text":"Nangho kelngoiching ho pengun lang kapmun, nangho kelngoihon lah-a pipuiho vut lah-a kilih leuvin, ajehchu nakithana diule naki thecheh na diu nikho abulhing tai. Chule dei umtah um le bel banga nalhahmang diu ahi."},"35":{"text":"Kelngoichingpan jamna ding ahetlou ding, kelngoihon lah-a pipuipan jong hoidohna ding aneilou ding ahi."},"36":{"text":"Kelngoiching ho ka awgin le, kelngoihon pipuipa pen awgin kija ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin ahamhing jouse asuhmang pehtai."},"37":{"text":"Chule tijat umtah Pakai lungsat jeh-in mongtah-a chennaho akisumang tai."},"38":{"text":"Aman keipibahkai chal bangin akiselna adalhatai. Ajehchu suhgentheina tijat umjehle, alungsatna tijat umtah jeh-in gamsung chu akamheltai."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah lengpa Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchan kipat in, Pakaiya konin hiche thuhi ahung lhungin,","title":"Jeremiah Thutana Anga Akipuilut","ref":"2 Leng 23:36—24:6; 2 Thusm 35:5-7."},"2":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Pakai houin leitola dingin lang, Pakai insunga chibai boh-a hung, Judah khopiho jouse jah-a, ajah uva sei dinga kathupeh thujouse chu cheng khatcha lhajah louvin seijin."},"3":{"text":"Hiti achu amahon angaijuva, alampi phalouva kona amitakip akileheijule, amaho thilse bol jeh-a achunguva bol dinga kagotsa thilse akona kalung kisih thei ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule nangin ajah uva, Pakaiyin hitin ati, nanghon namasanguva kakoi kadanthupeh najuidinguva;"},"5":{"text":"naheng uva kahinsol kasohte themgaoho, matah-a thouva hungkisol ho thuho ngai ding golouva nadon daole,"},"6":{"text":"chuteng hiche inhi Shiloh kabahsah-a, leiset nam jouse gaosap kahisah ding ahi.","ref":"Josh 18:1; Labu 78:60; Jer 7:12-14."},"7":{"text":"Hitichun thempuho le themgaoho chule mijousen Pakai insunga Jeremiah thusei chu ajataove."},"8":{"text":"Tun ahitin ahi, mipi ho jouse henga sei dinga Pakaiyin athupeh Jeremiah in aseichai phatnin, thempuho le themgaoho, chule mijouse chun ama chu amanun, nathitei ding ahi, atiuve."},"9":{"text":"Ibola nangma Pakai mina nagao chana, hiche inhi Shiloh bang ding, chule hiche khopiho chenna louva kamhel ding ahi natiham? atiuve. Chuin mipi ho chu Pakai insunga chun Jeremiah dounan akikhom taove."},"10":{"text":"Judah milenhon hiche thu chu ajah phatnun, leng ina konin Pakai ina ahung touvun, Pakai in lutna kotpi thah-a chun atoutaove."},"11":{"text":"Chuin thempuho le themgaoho, milenhole mipi jouse jah-a chun, hichepahi thi dinga lom ahi. Ajehchu nanghon nanauva najah bangu chun hiche khopi dounan gaothu aseije, atiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah in milenho jousele mipi jouse jah-a, Pakaiyin hiche inle hiche khopi douna-a nanghon najah-u thu jousehi gao dinga eihinsol ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun nalampiule nathil bolu kisem phatnun lang, Pakai na-Pathen'u thu ngaijun, chutile Pakaiyin nangho douna-a thilse aphondohsa chu alung kisih kit ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Keidin vang, veuvin, nakhut uva um kahi. Pha nasah bangule nadei bangun neibol taovin."},"15":{"text":"Ahinla kichentah-in heuvin, keima neithauva ahile nanghotah leh hiche khopi chule asunga chengho chungahi setnabei thisan nakipohlut teidiu ahi. Ajehchu hiche thu jouse naheng uva sei dinga Pakaiyin eihinsol tahmong ahi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chujouvin milenhole mipi jousen thempuho le themgaoho henga chun, hichepahi thi dinga lom ahipoi. Ajehchu aman ihenguva Pakai i-Pathen'u mina thu asei ahi, atiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chujouvin gamsunga upa phabep akipatdoh- un, mipi akikhomho jouse henga chun aseijun,"},"18":{"text":"Judah lengpa Hezekiah nikho laijin Morasthih mi Micah anagao changin, Judah mite jouse jah-a janel Pakaiyin hitin anati, Zion chu lou banga kikaija, Jerusalem chu alhuh-a umding, chule insahna mol chu gammang munsang bang ding ahi, anatin ahi.","ref":"Mica 3:12."},"19":{"text":"Judah lengpa Hezekiah le Judah mijouse chun anatha beh monguvem? Aman Pakai agingin, Pakai chu angeh in, Pakaiyin amaho douna-a thilse anaphondohsa chu alung kisih kit hilouham? Hiti achu ihinnao douna-a thil setah ikilhut khumdiu ahi, atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chule Kirjath-jearim mi, Shemaiah chapa Urijah kiti mi khat jong Pakai minin anagaovin, aman hiche khopi dounale hiche gam douna in, Jeremiah thusei dungjuijin anagaovin:"},"21":{"text":"Chuin Jehoiakim lengpan, agal hat ho jousele milenho jousen ajah phatnun, lengpan ama chu thadin aholtai. Ahinla Urijah in hichu ajah phatnin, akichatan, ajamin Egypt gama achetai."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Jehoiakim lengpan Achbor chapa amin Elnathan chu mi phabep khatto Egypt gama chun asolin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Urijah chu Egypt gama konin agamandoh-un, Jehoiakim lengpa henga ahinpuijun, aman chemjamin athatnin milhamho lhan sunga athilong chu asepluttai."},"24":{"text":"Ahijengvangin amahon ama chu mipi khutna tha dinga apehdoh louna dingun Shaphan chapa Ahikam khut chun Jeremiah chu aumpin ahi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchan kipat in Pakaiya konin Jeremiah henga hiche thuhi ahung lhungin aseije.","title":"Jeremiah'in Bongchal Namkoljon Apoh","ref":"2 Leng 24:18-20; 2 Thusm 36:11-13."},"2":{"text":"Pakaiyin kahenga hitin aseije, namkoljon kisemin lang nangonga kivonlang,"},"3":{"text":"hiho chu Edom lengpa, Moab lengpa, Ammon lengpa, Tyre lengpa, Zidon lengpa henga, Jerusalem'a Judah lengpa Zedekiah henga palai hungjiho khutna gahthot temin,"},"4":{"text":"chule apakaiteu henga asei diuvin thu pen, janel Pakai Israelte Pathen'in hitin aseije, tia apakaiteu henga nasei diu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Keiman kathilboltheina nasatahle kaban lhang doh-a, leiset chule achunga um mihemle ganhinghohi kasema, hichu pha kasahsah kapehji ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule tuahi keiman hiche gamhohi kasohpa Babylon leng Nebuchadnezzar khutna kapehdoh ahitai. Chule gamlah-a, ganhingho jong ama jen dinga kapehtha ahitai."},"7":{"text":"Chule ama gam mongmong chu ahunglhun kahsen nam jousen ama, achapa, achapa chapa ajen diu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar jen nomlou chuche namle lenggam, chule Babylon lengpa namkoljon noija angong donomlou, chuche nam chu chemjam'a, kela, hise-a, ama khutna chu kasuh manghel kahse-a talen kapeh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseijin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun nathemgao hou, na-aisan hou, namang neihou, ailhim themho, doithemho, naheng uva Babylon lengpa najen lou diu ahi, tiho thu ngaihih-un."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon, nagam uva kona gamlatah-a nakichona diu, kanomangna diu, namanthaina diuva thujouva gaova ahiuve."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla Babylon lengpa namkoljon noija angong do-a, jenho chu, agamuva kaumden sah-a, aleisetnu akilhouva, chengden diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"12":{"text":"Hiche thuho jouse banghin Judah lengpa Zedekiah henga jong kaseijin, Babylon lengpa namkoljon noija na-ngong donlang amale amite jenin lang, hingin tin kaseije."},"13":{"text":"Babylon lengpa jen nomlou nam douna-a Pakaiyin anasei chemjam, kel, chule hise-a kona nanghole namite ibola nathi jeng diuham?"},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun, Babylon lengpa najen lou diu ahi, tia themgaoho thusei chu ngaihih-un, ajehchu amahon naheng uva jouva gao ahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu keiman amaho kasolpoi, tin Pakaiyin aseije; ahijengvangin amahon kaminin, nangho kanomang theina dingule namanthah theina dinguva, nanghole naheng uva gaochangho, namanthah theina dinguva jouthu-a gaochang ahiuve, ati."},"16":{"text":"Keiman thempuho le hiche miteho jouse henga jong kaseijin Pakaiyin hitin ati, veuvin, Pakai ina umle belho chu Babylon'a kona hung kiletol vahding ahitai, tia gaova themgaoho thu ngaihih-un, amaho thujouva gao ahitaove, kati."},"17":{"text":"Amaho thu ngaihih-un, Babylon lengpa jenun lang, hinguvin, ibola hiche khopi kamhela umding ham?"},"18":{"text":"Ahinla amaho themgao ahiuve, Pakai thu amaho-a auma ahile, janel Pakai henga tuhin Pakai ina kidalha umle bel ho, chule Judah lengpa insungale Jerusalem'a ho Babylon'a akitol louna dingin, tuhin taovuhen."},"19":{"text":"Ajehchu khomho, twikongho, akitun naho, chule hiche khopi sunga um le bel amoh kidalha ho chungchang thu chu janel Pakaiyin aseijin;"},"20":{"text":"Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in, Jerusalem'a kona Babylon gamgeija Judah lengpa Jehoiakim chapa Jeconiah le Jerusalem'a umle bel ho, milenho jouse gal hinga akai laija anapoh lou ahi."},"21":{"text":"Pakai ina kidalha, Judah lengpa inle Jerusalem'a umle bel ho chungchang thu chu janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije."},"22":{"text":"Hitiho chu Babylon'a kipoding, keiman amaho kavil kahse-a, chuachu umdiu ahi, tin Pakai chun aseije; chujoule keiman kale poh-a hiche munahi avela kakoi kitding ahi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Judah lengpa Zedekiah lengchan kipat, kum mama chun ahitin ahi, akumlina lha nga lhina-a chun, Gibeon'a mi Azur chapa Hananiah themgao chun, Pakai insunga thempuho le mipi ho angsung tah-a kahenga thu aseijin,","title":"Jeremiah le Hananiah Themgao","ref":"2 Leng 24:18-20; 2 Thusm 36:11-13."},"2":{"text":"Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitihin aseije, keiman Babylon lengpa namkoljon kasubong tai, atie ati."},"3":{"text":"Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in hiche mun'a kona alahdoh-a, Babylon'a apoh Pakai ina umle belho jouse chu, kumni lhin sunga hiche munahi kahin pohlut kit ding ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Keima Judah leng Jehoiakim chapa Jeconiah le Judah mi sohchang jouse Babylon'a cheho chu, hiche munahi kahin puikit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, ajehchu Babylon lengpa namkoljon kaheboh ding ahitai, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah themgaovin Hananiah themgao henga chun themgaoho le Pakai insunga ding mipi jouse mitmu tah in aseijin:"},"6":{"text":"Jeremiah themgao tahchun, hihen, Pakaiyin chutin bolhen, Pakai ina umle belhole gal hinga kikai jouse chu, Babylon'a kona hiche mun'a hinlelhut kit dinga nagaona thu chu Pakaiyin molsohen."},"7":{"text":"Hijongle tu-a hiche nangle mijouse nakhanga jah dinga kaseihi ngaitemin."},"8":{"text":"Nangle kei masanga themgao luiho chun, gam tamtah le lenggam tamtah douna thule thilse chule hise thu anagao jiuve."},"9":{"text":"Themgao chamna thu gaopa chu, chuche themgaovin asei chu aguilhun tengle, themgaopa chu Pakai hinsol tahbeh ahi akihejie, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Hananiah themgaovin Jeremiah themgao ngonga kona namkoljon chu alan, ahehbongtai."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Hananiah-in mijouse anga chun, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar namkoljon chu nam jouse ngonga kona kumni lhingset sunga hiche bang ngeijahi kasuhboh ding ahi ati. Chuin Jeremiah themgao chu alampia akichetai."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah themgao ngonga namkoljon chu Hananiah themgaovin aheboh jouvin Jeremiah themgao henga Pakai thu chu ahung lhungin aseije."},"13":{"text":"Chenlang Hananiah gahilin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije. Nangman thing namkol ho chubou naheboh ahin, hicheho khela chu keiman thih namkol kahin semdoh ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije. Amahon Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar kin aboltheina diuva hiche namho jouse ngonga thih namkoljon hi kabucheh ahitai. Amahon ajencheh diu ahi, gamsa jouse jong kapeh ahitai, ati ahungtin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah themgaovin Hananiah themgao henga, ngaijin tun Hananiah, Pakaiyin nang nasolpoi, nangin hiche mitehohi jou khat natahsan sah ahibouve."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin ati, vetan, leiset chunga kona kapaidoh ding nahi: Pakai douna-a douna thu nahil jeh-in, tukuma nathitei ding ahi, ati."},"17":{"text":"Hitichun Hananiah themgao chu chuche kum mama lha sagina in athitan ahi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun Nebuchadnezzar'in Babylon gama gal hing akaimangho, sohchang upaho, thempuho, themgaoho chule mipi ho jouse henga Jeremiah themgaovin Jerusalem'a kon lekha athot thuchengho chu hichehohi ahi.","title":"Jeremiah'in Babylon'a um Juda ho Lekha Athot","ref":"2 Leng 24:12-16; 2 Thusm 36:10."},"2":{"text":"(Jeconiah lengpa le lengnu, nukiso ho, Judah le Jerusalem'a milenho, thingthemho, thih suho, Jerusalem adalhah nungu chun):"},"3":{"text":"Shaphan chapa Elasah, Hilkiah chapa Gemariah khutna lekha chu apohsah-in ahi (amani chu Judah lengpa Zedekiah'in Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar henga asol ahin):"},"4":{"text":"Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in Jerusalem'a kona Babylon gama puimanga aumsah, akipuimang sohchangho henga hitin aseije."},"5":{"text":"Nanghon in kisah-un lang, hia chun chengun, chule hon kibolun lang aga chu neuvin."},"6":{"text":"Ji neijun lang chanu chapa hingun, nachapateo jiding puipeh unlang, nachanu teo inneipu ho peovin, chutile chanu chapa hinguntin, hia chun pungun natin kemsuh pouvin nate."},"7":{"text":"Sohchanga kapuimang sahna lama khopi ho-a chun chamna chu holun, chule hiche ding chun Pakai henga taovun, ajehchu chukom cham na-a chu nanghon jong chamna nanei diu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, nalah uva um nathemgao hou le na-aisan hou chu kilheplhah sah hih helun; nahin mangmat diu namang hou jong nahsah hihhelun."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu amaho thujouva kamina aisan ahiuvin, amaho kasol ahipouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Babylon'a kum somsagi alhin jouteng, kahin viluva hiche munahi nahung kilekitna dinguva, nangho dinga kathupha kasuh bulhit ding ahi.","ref":"2 Thusm 36:21; Jer 25:11; Dan 9:2."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu nangho dinga kagon chu thilse hilou chamna, khonunga peh dinga kagon chu kahenai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"12":{"text":"Chuteng neikouvun natin, kahenga hung taovun natin, keiman sanpeh taovinge."},"13":{"text":"Nanghon neiholun natin, nalung pumpi-a neihol tengule neimu diu ahi.","ref":"Danb 4:9."},"14":{"text":"Namudoh-u hitange, tin Pakaiyin aseije, chule kadel mangnao mun jouse-a konle nam jouse-a konin chomkhom ungting, nasoh chanao kaheimang ding, kasoh chansah naova kona kahin lepui kit ding nahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu nanghon Babylon gama jong Pakaiyin themgao eitundoh peh uve, nati uve."},"16":{"text":"David laltouna-a tou lengpa le hiche khopi sunga cheng mijouse, chule nang hotoh sohchanga chekhom lou nasopiteu Pakai chun hitin aseije, tiuvin."},"17":{"text":"Janel Pakai chun hitin aseije, vetan, amaho chunga chemjam'a, kel lhah-a, chule hise kasola, nehthei hilouhel aphatna phamo theichang banga kasem diu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule amaho chu chemjam, kel lhah-a, hise-a kasuhgentheija, leiset lenggam jouse-a chaulele dinga keiman kanochehna nam jouse lah-a chu gaosap dinga, datmo umleh chehsatna, seisetna tohding bepma kapehdoh diu:"},"19":{"text":"Ajehchu jingpi-a thouva kisoldoh kasohte themgaoho-a kona ahenguva kathu kathotho chu angaipouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ahinla nangainom pouve, tin Pakai jin aseije."},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai thu chu, nangho Jerusalem'a kona Babylon'a sohchang hon ngaijun,"},"21":{"text":"Israel Pathen janel Pakai chun Kolaiah chapa Ahab le Maaseiah chapa Zedekiah kamina jouthu-a gaoho chungchang thua chun hitin aseije, veuvin, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khutna amaho chu kapehdoh ding, aman namitmu tah uva atha diu:"},"22":{"text":"Amanu thu chu Babylon'a Judah sohchang jousen, Babylon lengpan meija asahgop Zedekiah le Ahab bang helin Pakaiyin nachunga bolhen."},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu Israel gama setkhona hel amahon abolun, aheng akom jiteutoh ajongun, kathupeh louva kamina jou asei jeh-un, keima ngei ahe ale hettohsah kahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"24":{"text":"Nehelam mite le Shemaiah henga jong hiti ahi nasei ding ahi, atin:","title":"Shemiah Lekhathot"},"25":{"text":"Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, ajehchu nangin Jerusalem'a um mijouse hengale Maaseiah chapa Zephaniah thempu chule thempu jouse henga naminin lekha nathotnin hitin naseije."},"26":{"text":"Pakaiyin Jehoiada thempu khelin thempun napansahtan, Pakai insunga vaipole-a pang ding nahin, ngolla kithemput sah tapou chu songkul'a nakhuma nahen ding ahi, ati."},"27":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun ibola amale ama neheng uva kithemput sah Anathoth mi Jeremiah chu napholou ham?"},"28":{"text":"Ajehchu Babylon gama kahenguva sohchana hi asotnin, in kisah unlang asunga chengun, hon kibolun lang aga neuvin, tin thu eihin thotnuve."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Jephaniah thempun Jeremiah themgao jahdia lekhathot chu asime."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin, aseije."},"31":{"text":"Sohchangho jouse henga chun Nehelam mi Shemaiah thudol chu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Shemaiah'in kasol louva naheng uva jouthu natahsan sah jeh uvin:"},"32":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, veuvin, keiman Nehelam mi Shemaiah le achilhah ho talen kapeh-a, hiche mite lah-a cheng ding khatcha aneilou ding, kamite dinga thilpha kabol ding jong chu amulou ding ahi, tin Pakai chun aseije. Ajehchu aman Pakai dounan thu anahilin ahi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jeremiah henga Pakaiya kona thu hunglhung chu,","title":"Amite Henga Pathen Kitepna"},"2":{"text":"Pakai Israel Pathen chun hitin aseije, nahenga kathusei jouse chu lekhabu khatna sunin."},"3":{"text":"Vetan, nikhoho chu ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije, kamite Israel le Judah sohchangho chu kalepui kit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin ati. Apateu kapehna gama kakilesah kitna hichu alo dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hichehohi Israel le Judah chungchanga Pakai thusei chu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, keihon chamna thu hilou tijatna, awgin kithing selsul khat kajauve."},"6":{"text":"Dong leuvin lang veleuvin, pasal'in nao avop ngaijem? I-atile pasal tapouvin numei naosonat thoh banga atai akisot cheh uva, amaiju dangdih deh-a sohdoh gama hitam?"},"7":{"text":"Ohe, hiche nichu aloupi lheh-in, hitichun akibahpi aumpon, hichu Jacob hesoh phattah chu ahin, ahinla hichea kona chu ama huhdoh-a umding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche ni chule hiti ding ahi, nangonga kona namkoljon chu kaheboh-a, ahennaho kasuhtan ding, chule gamdang min amaho soh-a aneitah lou diu ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"9":{"text":"Ahinla Pakai a-Pathen'ule, katundohpeh ding alengpao David ajenjoh diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun Vo kasoh Jacob, kicha hih-in, chule vo Israel, lungthoi hih-in, ajehchu ven gamlatah-a kona nangmale nachilhahte kahuhdoh ding, Jacob chu hungkile kitna koimachan akichatsah lou ding ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Jer 46:27-28."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu nahuhhing dingin kaumpi jinge, tin Pakaiyin aseije: nangho kathecheh nao nam jouse akichainao boljong leng nangho kichaina vang bolhih laijing ting atin, ahinla thutah-a kasuhdih ding nahin, hijongle talen pelouva kalhadoh louhel ding nahi."},"12":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nakimavona chu damdoh theilou namaput chu nase behset ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nakikanchah theina din nathu seilhap pehdinga khatcha aumpoi, damna ding lou nanei hihhele."},"14":{"text":"Nangailu jousen nasumil tan, nadon tapouve; nakhangitlouna atam behset jeh le nachonsetna punbe jing jeh-in, melma kimavona in kamavon, mi engse gimbolna in kagimboltai."},"15":{"text":"Ibola nagim jeh-a kap nahim? nakhangit louna tambehset jeh-a, nalungkham nachu suhdam theihoi hilou ahitai. Nachonsetna apun jeh-a hichehi kabol ahitai."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh achu nabahgamho jouse chu kibahgama, nakidoupi jouse khat khatna sohchanga chediu, chule nachomgam ho kichomgama, anchah-a nanei jouse chu anchah-a kapehdoh ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu nachunga damna kalhunsah kitna, namaha ho kadamsah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ajehchu amahon nangma akinodoh ahi nati uvin, hichehi koimachan adonlou Zion chu ahi, atiuve."},"18":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin ati, Ven keiman Jacob ponbuh sohchangsa chu kahin puikitna, achenna mun'a kahepi ding, akisetvumna chunga chu khopi chu kasahdoh-a, leng inpi chu aumdan bang banga umkit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"19":{"text":"Amaho-a kon chun thangvahnale kipana husa gingdoh-in tin, amaho chu punsah ingting, lhomcha hilou diu, loujong loupisah ingting, neocha hilou diu ahitai."},"20":{"text":"Achateu jong masanga bangin umuntin, akikhopnao kiphutdet ding, chule amaho sugenthei hojouse talen kapeh ding ahiuve."},"21":{"text":"Amilunhou chu amaho-a kontah hiuvintin, avaipopau chu amaho lah-a hung hiding, ama chu kinaisah ingting, aman eihin naija hung lutngam jengthei ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"22":{"text":"Chuteng nangho kamite nahiuva, keima na-Pathen'u kahi ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ngaijun Pakai lungsatna huipi, tanglouva nungjing huipi chu ahung nunge, hichun migiloute luchang asuhnat ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hichu abolchai kahsehle alunggot phalou chu amolso kahse-a, Pakai lungsat tijat umtah chu dailha louhel ding ahi. Ninunung lamteng hin ngaito taovinate."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche phat tah chule, keihi Israel pumpi Pathen hingting, amaho jong kamite hitaovinte, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","title":"Israelte In Ahungkile Kit"},"2":{"text":"Israel choldosah dia kachelaitah chun, chemjam'a thimoh hochun, gamthipma lungsetna akimutaove, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"3":{"text":"Masangin Pakai kahenga akilah-in, hitin aseije, keiman nangma tonsot lungsetna-in kalungsetnin: hijeh chun lainatna-in kakaile jinge."},"4":{"text":"Vo nungah theng Israel, keiman nasaphang ting sahphat nahi ding ahitai: na cha'ngeng ho-a nakijephoi kitna, kipah thanop bolho lamna-a nachedoh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Samaria molsangho chunga lengpigui nakiphuna laija aphuthon aphuva, agachu aneh diu ahi.","ref":"Semt 35:16-19; Matt 2:18."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu Ephraim mol chunga khongah hon, nangho kipat un Pakai i-Pathen'u heng, Zion'a chetou vuhite, tia asapna diu nikho khat hungum ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Jacob din kipah-in la saovin lang, namtin haosaho lah-a aodoh-un: phongjalun, vahchoijun lang, Vo Pakai, Israel amoh umsun namitehi huhdoh-in, tiuvin."},"8":{"text":"Veuvin, sahlam gama konin hinpuijing ting, leiset kolmonga konin khoming ting, alah uva chun mitcho elbai, numei naovop, numei naoso natna na, mihon atama tam hung kilekhom diu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Kappum pumin hunguntin, kalhep lhepma kapui ding, vadunglen twilah lamdih tah-a chesah ungting, hia chu kipalhu loudiu ahi. Ajehchu keima Israel pa kahin Ephraim chu kachapa lenpen ahi."},"10":{"text":"Vo nangho namtinho, Pakai thusei ngaijun lang, twikol gam gamlatah-a phongjalun, Israel thechehpa chun achopkhom kitna, kelngoi chingpa banga amaho chu achin ding ahitai, tin aseije."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin Jacob alhatdoh-in, asanga hatjopa khutna konin alhatdohtai."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh achu hunguva Zion chungvuma la ahinsah diu, Pakai phatna, suhlouchang, lengpitwi, thaotwi, kelngoihon noutele ganchahon noute chunga kipah uva, ahinkhou chu hon twi kichapnou jing bang hiuva, lunghem kit talou hel ding ahitaove."},"13":{"text":"Chuteng nungah theng chu gollhanghole tehse ho toh lamna-a kipah khomdiu ahi. Ajehchu alunghem nao kipana-a kaheidoh-a, kalhamona, alunghem naova kona kakipasah ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Thempuho hinna chu tahsa damtheina-a kalunglhai sah-a, kamite chu kaphatna-a lunglhai diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"15":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin ati, Ramah-a lunghemnale nasatah-a kana awgin akijai, Rachel'in achate aka akan, aumlou jeh uvin lhepbi ding anomtapon ahi.","title":"Israel Chunga Pakai Hepina"},"16":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, naka awginle namitlhi lonna-a konin haijin, ajehchu nathilbol kipaman umding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, chule amaho amelmate gama kona hung kilekit diu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nakhonung ding thua kinepna aume, tin Pakaiyin aseije, chutia chu nachate agamsung lamuva hungkit teidiu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Keiman Ephraim kagin kaja monge, nangin neiseh gimin, bongchal namkoljon pokhalou bangin neiseh gimtai. Nei lehei lechun kihei kit tange, ajehchu Pakai ka Pathen nahi."},"19":{"text":"Tahbeh-in kakilehei nungin kakisih tai. Eikihil nungin kapheipi kabengin, kajah achan, kaneo laija minsetna chu kapohjing jeh-in, kakisudong heltai."},"20":{"text":"Ephraim kachapa deitah ham? Ama kalungtoh kacha ham? Ajehchu ama douna-a thu kasei chanin lungset tah-in kageldoh jing nalaije, hijeh chun ama dingin kasung akithingin, ama kahepi mongding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"21":{"text":"Lampi melchihna kisemin lang, sangtah-in kiset vumin, nagachena lampi, lamlhongpi lam geljingin, Vo nungah theng Israel, hung kihei kitnin, hiche nakhopi lama hung kiheijin."},"22":{"text":"Vo nang chanu nungchonnu, itihchan navale ding ham? Pakaiyin leisetna thilthah khat asemin, numei jin pasal adei ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, asohchan naova kona kalepui kit tengle, Judah gamle akhopiho-a chu hitobang kamso, Vo thudihtah chenna, Vo thenna mol, Pakaiyin phatthei boh-in, tihi amankit diu ahi.","title":"Pathen Mite Hungkhantouding"},"24":{"text":"Chuachu Judah tele akhopi jouse-a mite, loubol mihole kelngoihon vahho chengkhom diu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ajehchu cholte kavahva-in, lungkhamte kahaldohsah tai."},"26":{"text":"Hiche thua hin kahung khangin, kavelen, chule ka-imut chu anomlheh-e."},"27":{"text":"Vetan, Israel insungle Judah insunga mihem muchile sahem muchi katuna ding nikho chu ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"28":{"text":"Chule hiti ding ahi, amaho botdoh-a, subonga, pailha-a, sumanga chule suhgenthei dinga kachan jing bangahi, sadoh dingle phutpha dinga kachan jing ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"29":{"text":"Hiche nichule paten lengpiga thuh aneuvin, chate ha ajatai atikit louhel dingu ahi.","ref":"Ezek 18:2."},"30":{"text":"Ahinla amitakip ama amacheh khangitlouna-a thia, lengpi ga thuh nechan chu, ama hacheh jading ahitai."},"31":{"text":"Vetan, Israel insungle Judah insungtoh thulhun thah khat kasemna ding nikho ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Matt 26:28; Mrk 14:24; Luk 22:20; 1 Cor 11:25; 2 Cor 3:6.  ; Heb 8:8-12"},"32":{"text":"Keima amaho dinga ajipau hijongleng, apateu Egypt gama kona puidoh dinga akhutnuva kakai ni-a thulhun kanasem asuhkeh-u tobang chu hilou ding ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"33":{"text":"Ahinla chuche nikhoho jouva Israel insungtoh thulhun kasem ding chu hichehi ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Asunguva kadanthupeh koijing ting, alungsung uva kasutlut ding, chule a-Pathen'u kahia, amaho kamite hidiu ahitai.","ref":"Heb 10:16."},"34":{"text":"Chule koimachan aheng akomle asopi takip jah-a Pakai chu hen, atilou diu ahitai. Ajehchu aneopena pat alenpen geija eihet soh hel diu ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ajehchu akhangit lounao kangaidam-a, achonsetnao kageldoh kit louhel ding ahitai.","ref":"Heb 10:17."},"35":{"text":"Suna vahdinga nisa pe-a, jana vahdinga lhathahle ahsi ho vahding dan sempeh-a pepa, twipi kinong ginglul lula homkhenpa, Pakai chun hitin aseije, janel Pakai chu amin ahi."},"36":{"text":"Hiche danho chu kamasanga keija kona achemangle, Israel chilhah jong namkhat ahina-a kona, a-itih-a dinga kamasanga beihel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"37":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, chunga van khu akite theija, noija leiset kingapna hohi holdoh thei ahilebou, kenjong Israel chilhah jousehi, athilbolhou jouse jeh-a kapaidoh diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"38":{"text":"Vetan, Hananeel insanga patna kul ning kotpi geija Pakai khopi kisahdohna ding nikho chu ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"39":{"text":"Chule thil tena khao chu Gareb lhangchung jona kilhung jangpetna chule Goath akolkhum ding ahi."},"40":{"text":"Thilonghole vut kinotna damphai pumpile Kidron luipi gei loujao jouse, solam sanga sakol kotpi, ning geija chu Pakai dinga atheng hiding ahin, a-imatih-a kibotdoh-a kiseplha kit louhel ding ahitai."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah lengpa Zedekiah lengchan kum som lhin kum, hichu Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kal kum somle kum get lhin kum chun, Jeremiah henga Pakaiya konin thu ahung lhungin ahi.","title":"Jeremiah'in Phailei Achoh","ref":"2 Leng 25:1-7."},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu hichelai chun Babylon lengpa sepaihon Jerusalem aumkulun, Jeremiah chu Judah lengpa inhong sunga, mihenna ina akulkhupmun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu Judah lengpa Zedekiah chun ama chu ahentupma hitia asei ahi, ibola nangman gaothu naseija, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Veuvin, keiman hiche khopihi Babylon lengpa khutna kapeh-a, aman ahinlah ding ahi;"},"4":{"text":"Chule Judah leng Zedekiah chu Chaldea miho khutna kona hoidoh lou ding, Babylon lengpa khutna kapehdoh joh-a, akamtah-a akihoupia, amitnin ama mit avet ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Zedekiah chu Babylon'a apuija, keiman kavil kahse-a chu umding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Chaldea miho chu kisatpi jongleu chun lolhing pouvinte, tin Pakaiyin aseije, tia naseiham? ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah chun Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin hitihin aseije, ati."},"7":{"text":"Vetan, napangah Shallum chapa Hanameel nahenga hungintin, Anathoth'a um kalou kichoh-in, ajehchu chohna ding lhatdohna thahat naneije ati ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hitichun kapangahpa chapa Hanameel chu, Pakai thu dungjuijin kihenna hongsunga kahenga ahungin, kajah-a aseije, Benjamin gama Anathoth a kalou chu goulo thei nahijeh-a nalhatdoh ding ahi, nang dingin kichoh-in, ati. Hichun hichehi Pakai thu ahi kahetai."},"9":{"text":"Chuin kapangahpa chapa Hanameel lou, Anathoth a um chu kachon, sumchu katepeh-in dangka shekel somlesagi jen ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin lekha kajih-in kamin kasunin, namdet kanamun ahetoh kakouvin, sumchu agihdan katepehtai."},"11":{"text":"Chuin kichohna lekha chu chondanle angai dungjuijin, akichohdan kisutna namdet kinamsa lekha chu kaladoh-in hichu akiphong dohsa ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin kichohna lekhabu chu Maaseiah chapa Neriah chapa Baruch chu, kapangahpa chapa Hanameel mitmule akichohna-a minchong ahettohho mitmun chule kihenna hongsunga tou Judah te jouse anga chun kapetan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin amasanguva Baruch chu thu kapen,"},"14":{"text":"Israel Pathen janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hiche kichohna lekha, sinkhana kinamle kichohna lekha kihonghi akopmin lanlang, sottah aumtheina dingin leibel sung khatna koijin."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, hiche gama inho, louho, lengpilei ho hi hinkilo kit ding ahi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Tun kichohna lekha chu Neriah chapa Baruch kapeh phatnin Pakai henga kataovin,","title":"Jeremiah Taona"},"17":{"text":"Vo Pakai Pathen, vetan, nathilboltheina nasatahle naban jahdoh-in, leile van nasemin, nangma dingin ahahsa ima aumpoi."},"18":{"text":"Asang asang henga lungset le khotona namusah-in, chule pate khangitlouna chu anunguva achateu chunga nalethuh jin: Loupitah, Pathen Hattah, janel Pakai chu amin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Thumop themtah, thilbol hattah, mihem chapate jouse atoh dunjui cheh-a lethuhna pedinga alamlhah jouseu vejing nahi,"},"20":{"text":"Egypt gama melchihna le datmo bola, tuni geija Israel le midangho lah-a boljom jinga, tunia bang banga min khat hin kiboldoh-a,"},"21":{"text":"Egypt gama kona nami Israelte melchihna hole datmoho-a, khut thahattahle banjahdoh-a, chule tijatna nasatah puma hinpuidoh-a,"},"22":{"text":"hiche khoijule bongnoi lonna gam, apateu pehdinga anakihahsela, amaho anapepa,"},"23":{"text":"chuin ahung lutnun alotauve, ahinla nathu angai hih-un, nadanthupeh-a jong achonpouve. Aboldiuva napeh jouse khatcha abolpouve. Hijeh achu hiche thilse jousehi achunguva nalhunsah ahitai."},"24":{"text":"Mol ho khu vetemin, khopi lodingin amaho ahungtaove, chemjamle kellhah, chule hise jeh-in, galla hinsatna Chaldea mite khutna khopihi pehdoh-in anaumtan, naseisa chu aguilhung tai, vetan, nangin namun ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule Vo Pakai Pathen, nangin kahenga, lou chu sumin kichoh inlang, khopihi Chaldea mite akipehdohtah jeh-in, ahetoh ding mi kikoijin, natin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin, aseije,"},"27":{"text":"Ven, keima Pakai tahsahing jouse Pathen kahi, keima dinga thil hahsa behseh ipi umam? ati."},"28":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan, hiche khopihi Chaldea mite khutna, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khutna pengting, aman alah ding ahitai.","ref":"2 Leng 25:11; 2 Thusm 36:17-21."},"29":{"text":"Chule hiche khopi hinsat Chaldea mite chu hunguntin, hiche khopihi ahal uva, lunghansahna dinga eiphinset nao, Baal dinga gimnamtui ahalnau, inchunghole Pathen dang dinga don thilpeh asunlhah nao chu akahvam gamding ahitai."},"30":{"text":"Ajehchu Israel chatele Judah chaten aneulaijuva pat kamasanga thilse jengbou aboluve. Ajehchu Israel chaten akhutnuva athilbol jaluvin eiphin lunghang jinguve, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"31":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche khopihi asahdoh uva pat tuni geija kalunghana le kalungsatna dinga phinsetna khopi anahin, kamasanga kona kachon mang ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Israel chatele Judah chate amaho, alengteu, amilenhou, athempuhou, athemgaohou, chule Judah mihole Jerusalem'a chengten, keima lunghan sah-a phinsetna dinga thilse abol jeh-u ahi."},"33":{"text":"Matah-a thouva kahil vangin, akihilnao kisanding agelkhoh pouve, anung eingatnun, eimaingat pouve."},"34":{"text":"Kamina kivo in chu suhbohna dingin, thet umhou chu atunglut jiuvin ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 23:10; Jer 7:30-31; 19:1-6."},"35":{"text":"Amahon Hinnom chapa phaicham, kathupeh louhel kalunga jong chengkhalou, Judah chonsetsah nadingin thil thet umtah abolun, achapateule achanuteu Molech henga meija pehdohna dingin Baal munsang ho asadoh-un ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:21; 2 Leng 23:10; Jer 7:31."},"36":{"text":"Hijeh chun tuhin Pakai Israelte Pathen'in, hiche khopihi chemjam, kel, hiset jeh-a Babylon lengpa khutna kipedoh ahitai, natiu thudola chun hitin aseije,","title":"Kinepna Kiteppeh"},"37":{"text":"Vetan, keiman amahohi kalungnatna, kalungsatna, kalunghana nasatah jeh-a, kana nomangna gamtina kona kakhop khom kitna, hiche munahi kahinpui kitna, mongtah-a kachensah ding ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chule amaho kamite hiuva, Keima a-Pathen'u kahi ding ahi."},"39":{"text":"Keiman amahole amaho nunga achateu phatna dinga, a-itih-a eigin theina diuva lungthim khatle lampi khatseh kapeh diu ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chule amaho phatna ding kabolpeh-a kona kakiheimang louna dinga, amahotoh tonsot thulhuhna kasemdoh-a, amaho keija kona akiheimang louna diuva, alung sunguva eikichatnao kakhum peh dingu ahi."},"41":{"text":"Ahi, aphatnao bolpeh chu kakipana lam hintin, kalung pumpile kahinna pumpi-a hiche gamhi kaphudet mongding ahi."},"42":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hiche mite chunga thilse nasatah jouse kahin pohlut khum bangahi, amaho kanateppeh thilpha jouse chu kahin pohlut peh ding ahiuve."},"43":{"text":"Nanghon mihemle ganhing beina gamgo hi, Chaldea mite khutna kipedoh ahitai, tia nasei laiju gamho chu kichodoh soh ding ahitai."},"44":{"text":"Benjamin gamle Jerusalem khopi vel munho-a, chule Judah khopiho-a, lhang gama khopiho-a, chule phaicham khopiho-a louho chu mihon suma achoh uva, kichohna lekha asutnuva, namdet anamuva, hettohsah ho akoicheh diu ahi. Ajehchu keiman asohchannau chu kakilesah kit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chukalvalin kihenna hongsunga akulkhup laijun Jeremiah henga, Pakai thu chu aniveina in ahung lhungin, aseije,","title":"Kinepna Thutep Dangkhat"},"2":{"text":"Leiset hinsempa, ijakai hingong tohpa Pakai chun hitin aseije, Pakai kiti chu ama min ahi."},"3":{"text":"Neihin kouvin, keiman donbut-ing ting, nahetkhah louvu thil lentahle loupitah vetsah inge,"},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu molhole chemjam'a kisuchim hiche khopi inhole Judah lengte inho chungchang thudol chu Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije,"},"5":{"text":"Amaho Chaldea mite toh kisat dingin ahungun, ahinla kalungnatnale kalungsatna-a kathagam thilongho chun adipjoh dingu, chule agitlounahou jouse jeh-a hiche khopi-a kona kamai kasel ahitai."},"6":{"text":"Vetemin, damtheina le damdohna hinpong ting, amaho damsah ingting, chamnale thudih lhingset kamusah ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Keiman Jadah le Israel sohchana chu kinunglesah ingting, amasa-a banga kasahphat kitding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Keima douna-a achonsetnao, athemo nao jouse-a konin thensah ingting, akhangit lounao jouse kachunga achonsetnao leh kachunga asuhkhelnau jouse ngaidam tange."},"9":{"text":"Chule hiche khopihi leiset nam jouse, adiuva kabolphat jouse muho masanga chu, kei dinga kipanale vahchoina, chule loupina hintin, phatnale khantouna kalhunsah jouse jala kicha-a kithing thing diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hiche mun, nanghon mile sa umlouna ahomkeo ahi natinao mun Judah khopihole Jerusalem khosung lamlen mile sa, acheng beina natiu mun ahi,"},"11":{"text":"thanopnale kipana aw, moulangle mounu aw, janel Pakai chu vahchoijun tia aseidiu aw, ajehchu Pakai chu aphan, ahepina itih-in aumjinge, chule Pakai in'a vahchoina ganlhaina hinchoiho hugin kija kit ding ahi. Ajehchu masanga banga, gamsunga sohchangho chu kakinungle sah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"1 Thusm 16:34; 2 Thusm 5:13; 7:3; Ezra 3:11; Labu 100:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1."},"12":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, mile sa umlouna gamgoh, hiche munahi, chule chuche khopiho jouse sung chu, kelngoihon ho kolsah nale kelngoiching ho chenna mun hung hiding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Mola khopiho-a, phaicham khopiho-a, lhanglam khopiho-a, Benjamin gamsunga, Jerusalem kimvel munho-a, Judah khopiho-a chu ahilteu khutnoija kelngoihonho kijotjot jengdiu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"14":{"text":"Vetan, Israel insungle Judah insung chungchanga thilpha kathutep chu kamolso ding ahi, ati nikhoho chu hunglhung ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Jer 23:3-6."},"15":{"text":"Chuche nikhoho-a, chuche phatteng David dinga chonphatna bah kajamdohsah-a, aman gamsunga chu thutannale chonphatna apohdoh ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hiche laichule Judah huhhingin umintin, Jerusalem bitkeija umding ahi; chule akihouna ding min chu Ichon phatnao Pakai kitiding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Israel insung laltouna-a touding chu David lhasamkha louhel ding ahi,","ref":"2 Sam 7:12-16; 1 Leng 2:4; 1 Thusm 17:11-14."},"18":{"text":"Ahiloule thempuho, Levi ho jong kamasanga govam thilto chule anneh thilto le tanglouva ganlhaina bolding lhasamkha louhel ding ahi.","ref":"Minb 3:5-10."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah heng ahung lhungin, aseije."},"20":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nanghon sun le jantoh kakitepna nasukeh jou uva chule hiti achu sunle jan aphatcha aumthei louva ahile,"},"21":{"text":"Chuteng kalhacha David toh kakitepna jong kehthei bouvinte, alaltouna-a touding chapa aneilou ding bou ahin, Levi ho thempuho, kalhachaho toh kakitepna jong chuti ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Van janelpi kisim joulou bangle, twipi neldi kitejoulou banga, kasoh David chilhahle kahenga kinbol jing Levi te chu, hitobanga chu kapunsah ding ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chukalvalin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin, aseije."},"24":{"text":"Insung ni Pakaiyin alhen chu apaidoh geltai, tia hiche miten aseiju chu nangaito khahlouvu ham? Amahon kamite i-sah louvin abolun, chutia chu amaho masanga namkhat hikit louhel diu ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, sun le jantoh kakitepna chu aumdet louva, leile van umding dan kana gontoh lou hile,"},"26":{"text":"Jacob chilhahhole kasoh David chu kapaidoh hella, Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob chilhah chunga vaihom ding achilhah khatcha kalhen louding ahi. Ajehchu keiman asohchannau kakinungle sah-a, achunguva hepina kanei ding ahi, ati."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hunglhung chu, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar le asepaite jouse alengvai pohna leiset lenggam jousele amijousen, Jerusalem le khopiho jouse chu asatnun, aseijui.","title":"Zedekiah Dinga Thuthot","ref":"2 Leng 25:1-11; 2 Thusm 36:17-21."},"2":{"text":"Pakai, Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, Judah lengpa Zedekiah henga chenlang hitin gaseijin, vetan, hiche khopihi Babylon lengpa khutna kapeh ding, aman meija ahallhah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije gatin ati."},"3":{"text":"Chule nangma akhutna kona nahoidoh louhel ding, nakiman na, ama khutna kipedoh ding nahi, namitnin Babylon lengpa mit chu avetna, aman akamtah-a nakihoupi ding, chule Babylon'a nache ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahinla Vo, Zedekiah, Judah lengpa, Pakai thusei ngaijin, Pakaiyin nachung thu hitin aseije, chemjam'a nathi lou ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Lungmong tah-a nathi ding ahi, namasanga leng masaho, napate gimnamtui ahalpeh banguva, nangma dinga jong gimnamtui ahaluva, ohe hepu atiuva, nakacham diu ahi.
