Ajehchu keiman thu kaphongdohtai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin Jeremiah themgaovin, thujousehi Jerusalem'a um Judah te lengpa Zedekiah henga aseitan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Babylon lengpa sepaihon Jerusalem le Judah khopi aumuva, Lachish le Azekah asat laijuva chu kulpi kikai khum hichengse chu Judah khopiho lah-a umnalai ahi."},"8":{"text":"Zedekiah lengpan Jerusalem'a um mipi jouse toh, jalenna thu phongdoh dinga thulhun asem jouva Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hunglhung chu hichehi ahi.","title":"Soh ho Jouva Akibol"},"9":{"text":"Hitihin mijousen asohnu ham, asohpa ham chu Hebrai numei ham, Hebrai pasal ham ahile lha-ong hen, asopipa Hebrai mi kijensah-a koimacha umlou ding ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Tun mitinin asohpale asohnu alha-ong ding, koimachan amaho akijensah kit louding ahi, ti ja-a thulhuna-a lut milen ho jousele mipite jouse chun ajuijun, alhadoh taove."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla khonungin akileheijun, alhadohsao soh pasal hole soh numei ho chu avelin soh na atohsah kitnun, sohpa le sohnu hidingin thununna noija akoitaove."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai thu chu Pakaiya konin Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin aseije,"},"13":{"text":"Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, keiman Egypt gama sohchana in'a kona amaho kapuidoh ni chun, napateu toh thulhun kanasemin, hitin kanaseije."},"14":{"text":"Hitihin asopipa, Hebrai mi, ahenga kijohsa, kum gup ama anajensa chu kum sagi kichaile alha-ong ding ahin, chule aman kum gup najen tengle nanga kona nalha ong ding ahi, kanatin: ahinla napateu vin kathu angaihih un, anau jong asungpouve.","ref":"Pot 21:2; Danb 15:12."},"15":{"text":"Chuin nangho nahung kiheijun, adih chu nabolun, mitinin asopi henga jalenna naphongun: kamina kivo in'a kamasanga chun kitepna nasem uvin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla nakilehei kitnuvin, kamin nasuboh-un, anoptah uva nalha-ong nungun, nasohnule nasohpao chu napuipha kitnun, nasohpaole nasohnu hidingin thununna noija napuilut kitnuve."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, mitinin asopipale aheng akom henga chamlhatna thu phong dingin kathu nangai hih un, veuvin, keiman chemjam'a din, hise-a din, chule kel lhah-a din, chamlhatna kaphong doh-e. Leiset lenggam jouse-a kichonlele dingin semtao vinge, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"18":{"text":"Chule keiman thulhun suhkeh-a, kamasanga kitepna asemsao nitlouho chu, bongnou kihapsatna, akah-a mi kijotpai jengtheija uma,"},"19":{"text":"bongnou kihapsat kah-a kijotpai Judah milenhole Jerusalem'a milenho, nukiso ho, thempuho, chule gamsung mipite jouse;"},"20":{"text":"Keiman amelmateu khutna, chule ahinnao holte khutna amaho chu kapehdoh-a, athilongu chu chunga leng vachate le, leija ganhingho anneh dingbep hiding ahitai."},"21":{"text":"Chule Judah lengpa Zedekiah le amilenho chu, amelmateu khutna, ahinnao holte khutna, chule nangho-a kona kinungtol louva Babylon lengpa sepaiho khutna kapehdoh ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Vetan, keiman thu kapeh-a, amaho chu hiche khopi-a kahin kilesah kit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Amahon hiche khopihi ahinsat naova, alahdiu chule meija ahaldiu, chule keiman Judah khopihohi chenna louva kamhela kalha ding ahi, ati."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah lengpa Josiah chapa Jehoiakim nikho laija, Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hung lhung chun hitin aseije,","title":"Jeremiah le Rechab Mite","ref":"2 Leng 23:36—24:6; 2 Thusm 36:5-7."},"2":{"text":"Rechab mite insunga chenlang, kihoupinlang, Pakai insunga indan khatna amaho chu puilut inlang, lengpitwi donding pen, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Habazziniah chapa, Jeremiah chapa Jaazaniah le asopite, achapate jouse, chule Rechab mite insung pumpi kapuijin,"},"4":{"text":"Pakai insung kotngah-a pang Shallum chapa Masseiah indan chunga, milenho indan koma um, Pathen mi Igdaliah chapa, Hanan chapate indan-a kapuilutnin,"},"5":{"text":"Rechab mite insung chapate anga chun lengpitwi dimset cheh belhole, khonho katungin, ajah uva, lengpitwi donuvin, kati."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla amahon lengpitwi donpou vinge. Ajehchu kapau Rechab chapa Jonadab'in, nanghole nachapa teovin a-itih-a lengpitwi nadon louhel diu,"},"7":{"text":"in nasah loudiu, muchi natu loudiu, lengpilei jong nabol louhel diu, imacha nanei loudiu, napennao leisetna nitamtah nachen theina dinguva, nahinkhou lhumkeija pon in'a bou nachen diu ahi, tin thu eipeuve atiuve."},"8":{"text":"Keihon kapau Rechab chapa Jonadab'in, kahinkhou lhumkeija, keiho, kajiteu, kachapa teole kachanu teovin lengpitwi don louhel dinga eithupeh-u kanitnun,"},"9":{"text":"Kachenna diuvin in jong kakisah pouvin, lengpilei hihen, loumun hihen, muchi hijongle kaneipouvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kapau Jonadab eithupeh-u jouse banga kaboluva, kanit uva, pon in'a bou kachenu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla ahitin ahi, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar gamsunga ahunglut phatnin, Chaldea mihole Syria miho kichat jeh-in, hungun Jerusalem'a cheohite katiuvin, hitia chu Jerusalem'a kachenu ahi, atiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije;"},"13":{"text":"Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, kathu ngaina dinga kahilna nasan loudiu ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije, tin Judah mitele Jerusalem'a chengho gahilin, ati."},"14":{"text":"Rechab chapa Jonadab thu achate henga apeh, lengpitwi donlou ding chu anitnun, tuni geijin imacha adon hih-un, apau thupeh bou chu anit tup chetnun, ahijengvangin naheng uva thu kaseijin, matah-a kathouvin kahilun, ahinla neingaipeh pouve."},"15":{"text":"Kalhachate themgaoho chu matah-a thouvin naheng uva kasolin, pasal tapou alamlhah phalouva konin tuhin hung kileuvin lang, nachonnao kisem phatnun, pathen dangho jen dingin anung lejui hih-un, nanghole napu napateu kapeh gamachu nachen diu ahi. Ahinla nanau nasung hih-un, ngai jong neingaipeh pouve."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu Rechab chapa Jonadab chapaten, apau thupeh amaho thu apeh chu anit-uvin, hiche miten vang hin kathusei angai pouve."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun, Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, ahenguva thu kaseija angai louvu, amaho kakouva eidonbut lou jeh-un, vetan, Judah le Jerusalem'a chengho jouse chunga, kaphondohsa thilphalou jouse chu achunguva kahin lhunsah ding ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah chun Rechab insung mite jah-a chun, janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije ati, napau Jonadab thupeh nanit uva, adanho naman uva, aman thu napeh-u jouse dungjuija nabol lun ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, Rechab chapa Jonadab chu a-itih-a kamasanga ding ding mi lhasam louhel ding ahi, ati."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"1 Judah lengpa Josiah chapa Jehoikim lengchankal kumli lhina in ahitin ahi, Pakaiya konin Jeremiah henga hiche thuhi ahung lhungin, hitin aseije.","title":"Baruch-in Houin'a Lekhajol Asimdoh","ref":"2 Leng 24:1; 2 Thusm 36:5-7; Dan 1:1-2."},"2":{"text":"Lekhajol bukhat lanlang, nahenga Israel thudol, Judah thudol, chule nam jouse thudol Josiah nikho laija patna tuni geija nahenga kanasei jouse chua chun sunlutnin."},"3":{"text":"Achunguva thilse bol dinga kagot jouse Judah insung miten ajah theina diuva, hiti achu mitin achonphatlou naova kona akiletheijuva, akhangitlou naole achonsetnao kangaidam theina diu ahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah chun Neriah chapa Baruch chu akouvin, Baruch chun Pakai thu jouse ahenga anaseisa chu Jeremiah kama konin lekhajol bukhatna ajihlut tai."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah chun Baruch chu akouvin, keima kikulkhup kahin, Pakai insunga kache theipon ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun chenlang, kakama kona najah Pakai thu lekhajol nasut chu anngol nile, Pakai ina mipi ho jahdin gasim doh-in, akhopiuva kona hungdoh Judah te jouse jahdia nagasim doh ding ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chutile ataonao Pakai angsung hung lhungintin, amitakip achonphatlou naova kona hung kilehei thei diu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Neriah chapa Baruch chun Jeremiah themgao thupeh jouse bangtah chun, Pakai in'a Pakai lekhabua thu chu asimdohtai."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Judah leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchankal kum nga lhina lhako na-in ahitin ahi. Jerusalem'a mijousele Judah khopiho-a kona Jerusalem'a hungho jouse jahdin Pakai masanga, anngol thu aphong taove."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Baruch in Pakai in'a chun Jeremiah thu chu lekhabua, lekhasun Shaphan chapa Gemariah indan-a, inhong chungnung jo-a, Pakai in kotpithah lutna-a chun, mijouse jahdin asimdohtai."},"11":{"text":"Shaphan chapa Gemariah chapa Michaiah chun, Pakai thu jouse lekhabua kona ajahdoh phatnin,","title":"Milen Milal ho Jahdinga Lekhajol Kisimdoh"},"12":{"text":"Lengpa insunga lekhasunpa indan sunga chun achesuh-in ahile, vetan hia chun milen jouse lekhasun Elishama tahjong, Shemaiah chapa Delaiah, Achbor chapa Elnathan, Shaphan chapa Gemariah, Hananiah chapa Zedekiah chule milen jouse anatouvun ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuphatnin Michaiah chun mipi ho jahdinga lekhabu asim, athu jouse chu ajah uva aphongdoh tai."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun Kushi chapa, Shelamiah chapa, Nethaniah chapa Jehudi chu milenho jousen Baruch henga asolun, mipi jahdinga nasim lekhajol bu chu hinchoi jinlang, hungin, atiuve. Hitichun Neriah chapa Baruch chun lekhajol chu ahenguva ahinchoijin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin amahon, tun touvin lang, keiho jahdin hinsimin, atiuve. Hitichun Baruch chun amaho jahdin asimtai."},"16":{"text":"Tun ahitin ahi, amahon thu jouse chu ajah phatnun, amaho khatle khat akicha taovin, Baruch jah-a chun keihon hiche thu jousehi lengpa kaseipeh tei dingu ahi, atiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chuin amahon Baruch chu adongun hitin aseijuve, hiche thu jousehi akama kona itijong najih ham? neihilun atiuve."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Baruch chun, hiche thu jousehi akamin eihilin, lekhatuija lekhabua kasutjeng ahi, tin adonbutne."},"19":{"text":"Chuin milenho chun Baruch henga, chenlang nangle Jeremiah kisel lhonin, koiman na-umnao hetdahen, atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chuin inhong sunga lengpa henga alut lhonin, lekhajol vang chu lekhasunpa Elishama indan sunga adalha lhonin, thu jouse chu lengpa jahdin ahil lhone.","title":"Jehoiakim'in Lekhajol Ahal"},"21":{"text":"Hitichun lekhajol ladin lengpan Jehudi chu asolin, lekhasunpa Elishama indan-a konin agaladoh tai. Chuin lengpa le lengpa vela ding milenho jah dingin Jehudi chun asimin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tun lhako na-in lengpa Phalbi laile aumjina insunga atouvin, amasanga meikhuh-a chun mei akongin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Jehudi'n phengthum phengli asimjouvin, chemcha khatnin a-at tanin, thuh-a mei chun akahvamhel kahsen, thuh meija chun asepluttan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ahinla lengpa le akinbolho, hiche thu jouse ngaiho koimacha akicha pouvin, apon bottela jong aumpouve."},"25":{"text":"Ahijengvangin lekhajol chu ahal louna din Elnathan, Delaiah chule Gemariah chun lengpa chu angeh un, ahinla amaho thu angaipehpoi."},"26":{"text":"Ahin lengpan lekhasun Baruchle Jeremiah themgao mandin, Hammelech chapa Jerahmeel, Azriel chapa Seraiah, Abdeel chapa Shelemiah thu apen, ahinla Pakaiyin amani chu aseltai."},"27":{"text":"Chuin lekhajol le Jeremiah kama kona Baruch in ajih thuho jouse lengpan ahalvam jouvin, Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin ahi.","title":"Jeremiah'in Lekhajol Dang Asutkit"},"28":{"text":"Lekhajol bu adang lanlang, lekhajol bu masa-a thu jouse, Judah lengpa Jehoiakim ahalvam saho chu jihdoh kitnin ati."},"29":{"text":"Chule Judah lengpa Jehoiakim henga chu hiti ahi nasei ding ahi. Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Babylon lengpa chu hungtei ding hiche gamhi asuhmanga, hichea patna chu mile sa kisubei ding ahi, tia kijihna chu, ibola chutobang thu najih ham? natin lekhabujol kisun chu nana halvamtan."},"30":{"text":"Hijeh chun Judah lengpa Jehoiakim thudol chu Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, aman David laltouna-a touding, koimacha aneilou ding, along jong sun nisatah noile jan buhdap lah-a kipaidoh ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Akhangit lounao jeh-a, amale achilhah chule asohte talen kapeh-a, amahole Jerusalem'a chengho, chule Judah mite chunga chu, achunguva kaphondohsa anahsah louvu, thilphalou jouse chu kalhunsah ding ahi, ati."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah chun lekhabujol dang alan Neriah chapa Baruch chu apen, hia chun aman Jeremiah kama kona lekhabu jihsa jouse, Jehoiakim'in meija ahalsa thuho chu ajih-in, chuche tilou jong akibahpi tamtah abelapme."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Josiah chapa Zedekiah chu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in Judah gam lenga anasem Jehoiakim chapa Koniah khelin alengchang tai.","title":"Jeremiah Henga Zedekiah Thilngeh","ref":"2 Leng 24:17; 2 Thusm 36:10."},"2":{"text":"Ahinla ama ahin, asohte ahin, gamsunga mite ahin, Jeremiah themgao kama asei Pakai thuho chu angai pouvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Zedekiah lengpan Shelemiah chapa Jehucal le Maaseiah chapa Zephaniah thempu chu Jeremiah themgao henga Pakai ka Pathen'u henga tuhin neitao peh-un, ti dingin asole."},"4":{"text":"Tun Jeremiah chu mipi ho lah-a chun alutle apotle in ahi. Ajehchu ama songkul'a akhum loulaiju ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pharaoh sepaiho Egypt'a konin ahung kondoh taove; chuin Jerusalem kul-a Chaldea miten amaho thulhut ajah phatnun, Jerusalem adalha taove."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah themgao henga ahung lhungin aseije;"},"7":{"text":"Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, eidop dinga nahinsolpao Judah lengpa henga hitihin seijun, vetan, nahu dinga hungkondoh Pharaoh sepaiho chu, agam lamu Egypt'a kilekit diu ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Chule Chaldea mite hungkit uva, hiche khopihi ahin satnuva, meija ahallhah diu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin ati, Chaldea mite chun eidalhah teidiu ahi, tin nanghole nangho kilhemlha hih-un, nadalhah louhel diu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu nahin dou uva Chaldea sepai pumpihi satchai jongleu chun, alah uva machang umnalai ho jengjong, apon ina kona kipatdoh uva, hiche khopihi meija ahaldiu ahi, tin seijin."},"11":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Pharaoh sepaiho ginna Chaldea sepaiho Jerusalem'a kona akitoldoh phatnun,","title":"Jeremiah Amat uva Songkul'a Ahenu"},"12":{"text":"Jeremiah chu, mipi ho lah-a kona chom umdingin, Jerusalem'a konin apotdoh-in, Benjamin gam lama achetai."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Benjamin kotpi agei phatnin, chuche veng lamkai khat, Hananiah chapa, Shelemiah chapa, amin Irijah chu anaumin, ama chun Jeremiah chu amanin, Chaldea miho henga jam nahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah chun, jou ahi, Chaldea mite henga jammang kahipoi ati. Ahinla aman angaipeh hih-in: hitichun Irijah chun Jeremiah chu amanin, lamkaiho henga apuitai."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun pipuiho chu Jeremiah chunga analunghang lheh-un, avouvin, lekhasun Jonathan insunga songkul'a chun akhumtaove. Ajehchu hichu songkul'a akisemu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Jeremiah chu leinoi'a, lhambuh sunga alutphatnin, chua chun nisottah aumtan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chujouvin Zedekiah lengpan mi asolin, Jeremiah chu agapuidoh tai. Chuin lengpan a-insunga guhthim chan adongin, Pakaiya kona ipi thu umam? ati. Chuin Jeremiah chun, aume, atin ahi; ajehchu Babylon lengpa khutna kipedoh ding nahi, tin aseije."},"18":{"text":"Chukalvalin Jeremiah chun Zedekiah lengpa henga, nangma chungle nasohte chunga, ahiloule namite chunga ipi kasuhkhel uma songkul'a neikhum ham?"},"19":{"text":"Babylon lengpa nangma satdin ahiloule hiche gam satdin hungponte tia gaochangho nathemgao ho chu tu-a hoijaba um hitaovam?"},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun, ngaijin, katao ahi. Vo kapu lengpa, katao ahi, kangeh nahi na-angsunga neisanpeh in, hitichun lekhasun Jonathan ina neikilesah hih-in, ajole chukoma thidenget inge, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Zedekiah lengpan Jeremiah chu songkul hongsunga akoina dingun, chule changlhah semho lamlena kona changlhah halkhat, khopi sunga changlhah abeihel kahse-a niseh-a apehjing diuvin thu apen ahi. Hitichun Jeremiah chu songkul hongsunga chun aumdentan ahi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Mattan chapa Shephatiah, Pashhur chapa Gedaliah, Shelemiah chapa Jucal, chule Malchiah chapa Pashhur in mijouse henga Jeremiah thusei ho chu ajaovin,","title":"Twi umlouna Twikul Sunga Jeremiah"},"2":{"text":"hiche khopi sunga umdenpa chu chemjam'a, kella, chule, hise-a thiding ahi. Ahin Chaldea miho henga chedohpa chu hingding ahi. Ajehchu ahinkho chu gal anchah-a anei ding ahin, hijeh-a chu hingding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"3":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hiche khopihi Babylon lengpa sepaiho khutna kipe-a, amahon alahdiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hijeh chun pipuiho chun, lengpa henga, kangeh-u nahi, hiche mipahi thatjengin, ajehchu aman hiche khopi sunga umnalai ho henga chutobang thu sei jeh-in sepaiho khutle mipi ho jouse khut hi angoisah-e, hiche pan hiche mite phatna ding aseipon, akisuhmona diu bou aseije, atiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Zedekiah lengpan veuvin, ama nakhut uva um ahi. Lengpa hi nabolgot-u sutang thei ahipoi."},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin amahon Jeremiah chu amanun, songkul hongsunga Hammelech chapa Malchiah leiko-a chun alehlutnun ahi. Ahin leiko-a chun twi aumpon, bonngan bou aumin, hitichun Jeremiah chu bonngan lah-a alhalut tai."},"7":{"text":"Tu-a lengpa in'a um Ethiopia mi, nukiso ho lah-a mi khat Ebed-melech chun, amahon Jeremiah chu leiko sunga akhum taove ti ajatan, hiche petna chu lengpa chu Benjamin kotpi phunga touva ahin,"},"8":{"text":"Ebed-melech chu leng in'a konin apotdoh-in lengpa akihoupin aseije;"},"9":{"text":"Kapu lengpa, hitehon Jeremiah themgao chunga abol jouseu khu thilsetah abolu ahitai. Amahon leiko sunga alehlutnun, aumna mun'a chu thiding kon ahitai. Ajehchu khopi sunga changlhah umlou ahitai, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chujouvin lengpan Ethiopia mi Ebed-melech chu thu apen, hia konin mi thum kipuijin lang Jeremiah themgao chu, athi kah-in leiko-a konin gapuidoh un, ati."},"11":{"text":"Hitichun Ebed-melech chun miho chu akipuijin, lengpa ina thil kholna noija chun achen, ponlui ehsaho chu ahinlan, hicheho chu Jeremiah henga leiko-a chun khaovin agah khailhan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Ebed-melech Ethiopia mipa chun Jeremiah henga hiche ponluihole asesahohi najahnoija khaohi ngapsah-in, ati. Chuin Jeremiah chun chutichun aboltai."},"13":{"text":"Hitichun Jeremiah chu khaovin aloidoh-un, leiko-a kon chun aladoh-un, Jeremiah chu songkul honsunga chun aumdentai."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Zedekiah lengpan Jeremiah chu akouvin, Pakai in-lutna thum na-a chun ahenga apuilut tai. Chuin lengpan Jeremiah jah-a, thilkhat donging ting, keija konin imacha imhih-in, ati.","title":"Zedekiah'in Jeremiah Thumop Angaichat"},"15":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah'in Zedekiah jah-a, nahenga kaphondohle neithada mongding hinam? Chule thu kamopma nahile neingaipeh mongding ham? atin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hitichun Zedekiah lengpan Jeremiah henga guhthim tah-in hiche hinna eisempeh pau, Pakai chu ahinlaisen, nangma that ponge, nahinna hola hiche mite khutna jong pedoh ponge, tin akihahselin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuphatnin Jeremiah chun Zedekiah henga Pakai, janel Pathen Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, nangma Babylon lengpa pipuho henga nakipehlut poupouva ahile hingin natin, hiche khopi jong meija kihal lou ding, nangle na-insung mite nahindiu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ahinla Babylon pipuiho lengpa henga nakipehlut loule vang, hiche khopihi Chaldea mite khutna kipedoh intin, meija ahaldiu, amaho khutna kona nahoidoh louhel ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Zedekiah lengpan Jeremiah henga, Chaldea miho khutna lutsa Judah ho khu kakichai, ajole amaho khutna eipedoh khauvintin eijapi getnunte, ati."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla, Jeremiah chun pedoh pouvin nate, najah-a kasei Pakai aw hi juijengin, kangeh nahi, chutile nang din phantin, nahin ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Nakipehlut nomloule vang, hichehi Pakaiyin thu eimusah chu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule vetan, Judah lengpa ina numei um jouse chu Babylon lengpa pipuho henga kipuija, hiche numei ho chun, aseidio ahi, nagolten natung doh-un, amahon najou taove. Nakengho bon lah-a alhalut tan, amaho akinungle taove."},"23":{"text":"Hiti achu najite jousele nachate jouse Chaldea miho henga apuidoh diu, akhutnuva kona nasochat louhel diu, Babylon lengpa khutna kikaijo ding nahin, nang jeh-a hiche khopihi meija kihal lhading ahitai, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Zedekiah chun Jeremiah henga, hiche thuho hi koimacha hetsah hih-in, nangma nathi lou ding ahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Ahinla pipuhon nangma kakihoupihi heleu, nahenga hunguva, najah-a, lengpa henga naseijouse leh lengpan nakoma aseijouse tun keiho henga phongdoh-in, keiho-a konin imhih-in, nangma that pouvinge,"},"26":{"text":"chuteng nangin ajah uva, Jonathan in'a eikilesah da-a, chua kagathiden louna dinga lengpa henga ngehna kanei jeng ahi, nati ding ahi, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chujouvin pipuho jouse Jeremiah henga ahungun, ama adong taove. Aman amaho chu lengpan thu apeh jouse bang chun ahiltai. Hitichun akihouvu chu anga taove. Ajehchu amani kihouna chu ajahlou-u ahitai."},"28":{"text":"Hitichun Jeremiah chu Jerusalem kilahni geijin songkul hongsunga chun aume. Chule Jerusalem kilahni geijin aumin ahi.","ref":"Ezek 33:1."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah lengpa Zedekiah lengchan kal kumko lhinna, lha som alhinna chun, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar le asepaite Jerusalem satdin ahungun, aumkul taove.","title":"Jerusalem Chim"},"2":{"text":"Chule Zedekiah lengchankal kum somlekhat lhina, lha li na-a ni ko lhinnin, khopi chu akeh tan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Babylon pipuiho jouse ahung lutnun, Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rabmag, Babylon lengpa pipuiho dang jouse toh kulpi lailha penachun atoutaove."},"4":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Judah lengpa Zedekiah le asepaiho jousen, amaho amu phatnun, jan-in khopi-a kon chun apotdoh-un, lengpa honlei lampia acheuvin, kulbang teni kikah-a kotpi-a chun ajamdoh taove; chule ama phaicham lampia achetai."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla Chaldea sepaihon anung delun, Zedekiah chu Jericho phaichama aphapao vin, ama amat phatnun Hamath gama Riblah ah Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar henga apuijun, hia chun aman athu atanlhatai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Babylon lengpan Riblah'a Zedekiah mitmu tah-in achapate chu athatnin, Babylon lengpan Judah milun jouse jong athatgam heltai."},"7":{"text":"Chukalvalin Zedekiah mitchang teni jong akaldoh-in, Babylon gama kaidin thihkhaova ahentai."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Chaldea mihon lengpa inle mipi ho inho chu ahalun, Jerusalem kulbangho asuchimgam taove."},"9":{"text":"Chuin sepaiho lamkai Nebuzaradan chun khopi-a mipi umnalai ho, ahenga hungkipelut hole mipi amoh chengse chu Babylon'a sohchang din akaitai."},"10":{"text":"Ahin sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan chun, Judah gamsunga imacha neilou mivaichaho chu adalhan, amaho chu apetpetnin lengpilei le loumun apen ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tun Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in Jeremiah chungchanga sepai lamakai Nebuzaradan henga,","title":"Jeremiah Kilhadoh"},"12":{"text":"amahi puijin lang, vetupmin, bolse hihhelin, nahenga asei ding bang bangin bolpeh-in, tin thu apei."},"13":{"text":"Hitichun sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan chun Nebushazban, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rabmag chule Babylon lengpa pipuiho jouse asolin,"},"14":{"text":"amaho ngeijin Jeremiah chu songkul hongsunga konin mikhat agapuidoh sah-un, Shaphan chapa, Ahikam chapa, Gedaliah chu a-in'a puidin anganse uvin, hitichun miho lah-a achengtai."},"15":{"text":"Tun songkul hongsunga akulkhup laijun Jeremiah henga Pakai thu ahung lhungin, aseije,","title":"Ebed-melech Dinga Kinepna"},"16":{"text":"Ethiopia mi Ebed-melech henga janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitihin aseije, vetan aphatna ding hilouva, hiche khopi setna ding joh-a kathu kahinlhut ding ahi. Hicheho chu namasanga hicheni chule guilhung ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hicheni chule nangvang huhdoh nange, chule nakichat miho khutna kipedoh pon nate, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu tahbeh-a kahoidohsah-a, chemjam'a naloulou ding, nahinkho chu gal anchah banga naneijoh ding ahi. Ajehchu kachunga natahsan na-ngap ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah le Jerusalem'a kon sohchang jouse, sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan chun Babylon gama sohchang dia kikaiho lah-a Jeremiah chu thihkhaova kihenpuma apuija Ramah a kona alhadoh nungin Pakaiya konin Jeremiah henga thu ahung lhungin ahi.","title":"Jeremiah Gedaliah Toh Aumkhom"},"2":{"text":"Chuin sepai lamkaipan Jeremiah apuijin ajah-a, Pakai na Pathen'in hiche mun'a thilphalouhi aphondoh ahitai."},"3":{"text":"Tun Pakaiyin ahinlhun sahtan, asei bangin aboltai. Pakai douna-a nachonset uva, athu nangailou jeh uva hiche thil hi nachung uva hunglhung ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Chule tun, vetan, tuni hin nakhutna thihkhaova konin kalha-ong tai. Babylon'a kei toh hung nanople hungin, ken nangma vetup nange, ahinla Babylon'a kei toh hung nanop loule hung datan, ven, gam jouse namasanga aume, nang dinga phale kitup nasahna lama chun chejengtan, ati."},"5":{"text":"Tun ama akilekit masangin, Babylon'a lengpan Judah khopiho-a vaipo dinga atun Saphan chapa Ahikam chapa Gadaliah toh gacheng khomtan; ahiloule pha nasah-a nache nomna lam lama chetan, ati. Hitichun sepai lamkai chun nehtheihole tohphat man apen asoltai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah chu Ahikam chapa Gedaliah heng Mizpeh-ah achen, akidalha miho lah-a ama toh achengtai."},"7":{"text":"Tun gamlah-a um sepai gallamkai jouse le amiteuvin, Babylon lengpan Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu gamsung vaipon apansah-in, pasal ho, numei ho, chapangho chule Babylon'a sohchanga kipuilou gamsung vaichaho vetupdin angansetai ti thu ajah phatnun,","title":"Judah Gamvaipo Gadaliah (2 Leng 25:22-24)","ref":"2 Leng 25:22-24."},"8":{"text":"Amaho Nethaniah chapa Ishmael, Kareah chapa teni Johanan le Jonathan, Tanhumeth chapa Seriah, Netophah mi Ephai chapaho, Maachath mi chapa Jezaniah, amahole amiteu chu Mizpah'a um Gedaliah henga ahung taove."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Shaphan chapa, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu amahole amiteu henga akihahselin, Chaldea mite jending kicha hih-un, gamsunga chengun lang, Babylon lengpa kin bolun, hichu nangho dinga phading ahi."},"10":{"text":"Keidin vang veuvin, ihenguva hung ding Chaldea miho jendin Mizpah a cheng ingting, nangho vang lengpitwi, nipilai theiga ho le thao holkhom unlang nabel sunguva kikoijun, chule nalahsao khopiho-ah chengtauvin, ati."},"11":{"text":"Hibang chun Moab'a Judah te jouse Ammon mite lah-a umho, Edom mite lah-a umho chule gamsung jouse-a umhon, Babylon lengpan Judah mi phabep adalhan, achunguva vaipodin Shaphan chapa, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah apansah-e, ti ajah phatnun,"},"12":{"text":"Judah te jouse akino mangnao gamho-a konin, Judah gama, Gedaliah heng Mizpah-ah ahungun lengpitwi le nipilai theiho tamtah akiholkhomun ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chukalvalin Kareah chapa Johanan le gama um sepaiho gallamkai jouse, Gedaliah heng Mizpah a ahungun,","title":"Gadaliah Kitha (2 Leng 25:25-26)"},"14":{"text":"Ahenga, Ammon lengpa Baalis chun Nethaniah chapa Ishmael chu nangma that dinga asol chu nahet chennem? atiuve. Ahinla Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chun amaho atahsanpon ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chujouvin Kareah chapa Johanan chun Mizpah a Gedaliah henga, katao ahi, neisol jengin, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael chu gathat jeng'inge, koiman heponte, Judah mi nahenga umkhomho jouse acheh chauna dingle Judah'a amohho manthah na ding bepma ibola aman nangma natha ding ham? tin guhthim chan ahung seije."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chun Kareah chapa Johanan henga, nangin hichehi nabol lou ding ahi; ajehchu Ishmael thu naseihi adihlou ahi, ati."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun lha sagi lhinin ahitin ahi, lengte chilhah lah-a Elishama chapa, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael le lengpa pipuiho, amatoh mi somjen, Mizpah ah Ahikam chapa Gedaliah henga ahungun, chukom Mizpah a chun changlhah anekhomuve.","ref":"2 Leng 25:25."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Nethaniah chapa Ishmael le alhonpi mi som akipatnun, chemjamin Shaphan chapa, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah Babylon lengpan vaipo-a apansah chu athat taove."},"3":{"text":"Ishmael'in Mizpah a Gedaliah toh um Judah miho jousele chua anaumkha Chaldea te sepai jong athatgam helin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin aman Gedaliah athajou nini na-a chun ahitin ahi, chule hichu koiman ahetlou ahin,"},"5":{"text":"Shechem'a kon, Shiloh'a kon, Samaria'a konin mi somget jen, akhamul hetsa cheh aponsilu kibot tela, amale ama ki-atchen chenna, akhutnuva thilpehle gimnamtui choija, Pakai in'a tohdoh din ahunguve."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Nethaniah chapa Ishmael chu Mizpah a konin amaho kimupi din, kappum pumin ajah uva, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah henga hungun, ati."},"7":{"text":"Hitichu anahin, khopi lailung ahunggei phatnun, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael'in, amipuiho toh amaho chu athatnun kotong lailunga alehlut taove."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla alah uva, mi somho chun Ishmael jah-a, neithat hih-un, ajehchu keihon suhlouchang, sakol chang, thao, chule khoiju selguh kaneijuve, atiuve. Hitichun ama atangin, amaho chu asopihou lah-a chun athat tapon ahi."},"9":{"text":"Tun Ishmael'in Gedaliah jeh-a amithaho long apaina kotong chu Asa lengpan Israel lengpa Baasha agin jeh-a alai ahin, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael'in amithaho longin adippeh in ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Ishmael'in Mizpah a amoh umsun leng chanute, Mizpah a sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan'in Ahikam chapa Gedaliah apehdohho, Mizpah a um jouse apuimangin, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael'in amaho chu sohchangin akaimangin, Ammon mite gam kalpeh-a din akipatdoh tai."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla Kareah chapa Johanan le aumpi sepai gallamkai jousen, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael thilbol phalou jouse ajah phatnun,","title":"Johanan'in Sohchangho Ahuhdoh"},"12":{"text":"mijouse apuijun Nethaniah chapa Ishmael satdin akonun, Gibeon'a twi tamtah umna-a chun aphapa taove."},"13":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Ishmael umpi mi jousen Kareah chapa Johanan le ahinpui sepai gallamkai jouse amu phatnun akipah behseh jenguve."},"14":{"text":"Hitichun sohchanga Mizpah a kona Ishmael'in apuimang mi jouse ahung kinunghei cheh uvin, Kareah chapa Johanan heng lama achetauve."},"15":{"text":"Nethaniah chapa Ishmael vang chu mi get toh Johanan'a konin ahoidoh-un Ammon mite henga achetauve."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Kareah chapa Johanan le aumpi sepai gallamkai jouse chun, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael'in Ahikam chapa Gedaliah atha jouva Mizpah a kona Nethaniah chapa Ishmael''a kona Johanan'in ahuhdoh mijouse, gal hat ho, numei ho, chapangho, nukiso ho, chu Gibeon'a konin ahin lepuisoh kit tai."},"17":{"text":"Akipat doh-un, Egypt jotlutna Bethlehem koma Chimham achun acheng taove."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu, gamsunga vaipo dinga Babylon lengpan anapansah Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael'in anatha jeh-a chu Chaldea miho akichatnu ahi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin sepaiho gal lamkaiho le Kareah chapa Johanan, Hoshaiah chapa Jezeniah, chule mipi ho jouse, chule mijouse aneopena pat alenpen gei ahung naijun,","title":"Pathen Henga Ataopeh Diuva Mipihon Jeremiah Angeh-u"},"2":{"text":"Jeremiah themgao jah-a nahenga kangeh-u ahi, kataonaohi neisan peh-un lang Pakai na Pathen henga neitao peh-un, ajehchu neimu-u banga hi keihohi tamtah lah-a themcha bou kidalha kahitao vin;"},"3":{"text":"chutia chu Pakai na Pathen'in kachena diu lampile kabol diu thil eihil theina diuvin, atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah themgaovin ajah uva, nathu-u chu kahei, veuvin, nathu-u bangin Pakai na-Pathen'u henga thuminge, chule hiti ding ahi, Pakaiyin nadonbutna diu thil chu ipi hijongle naheng uva phongdoh nange, nangho-a konin imacha imponge, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin amahon Jeremiah henga Pakai na-Pathen'in kahenguva nasolna thu jouse banga kabol louvule kalah uva Pakai chu hettohsah dihtahle tahsan umtah hihen."},"6":{"text":"Ahenga kasolnapao Pakai ka-Pathen'u aw chu apha hihen ase hile juinao vinge, hitia chu Pakai ka-Pathen'u aw kajui tengule keiho dinga phattheina hiding ahi, atiuve."},"7":{"text":"Chuin nisom jouvin ahitin ahi, Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahungtai.","title":"Pakaiyin Jeremiah Taona Adonbut"},"8":{"text":"Chuin Kereah chapa Johanan le aumpi sepaiho gallamkai jousele sepai jouse, aneopena pat,"},"9":{"text":"alenpen geijin akouvin, ajah uva, Pakai na Pathen'u a-anga nathumnao lhut dinga neisolna pao chun hitin aseije."},"10":{"text":"Hiche gamahi tuni geija naum jing nahlai diule, tungdoh ungting sonlhu ponge, chule naphutnu vingting, botdoh pouvinge, ajehchu nachung uva thilphalou kalhunsah chu kakisih tai."},"11":{"text":"Babylon lengpa naginnu chu ging tahih-un, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, ajehchu ama khutna kona huhhing dingle huhdoh dinga kaumpi nahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chule nachung uva hepina anei theina dinga, naheng uva hepina kavetsah-a, nangho naleiset uva kakilesah ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon, hiche gama cheng pouvinge, Pakai na Pathen thu jong ngai pouvinge, nati uve,"},"14":{"text":"kanom pouve, Egypt gama chejovinge, chua galthu jata pouvinge, sumkon gin jong, changlhah-a gilkelna jong umta ponte, chua kache diu ahi, nati uve."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun, nangho Judah te amoh chengin Pakai thu chu ngaijun, janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, Egypt'a lutdingle chua pem dinga namaiju napum ngat helu ahitahle,"},"16":{"text":"hung hiti ding ahi, naginnu chemjam chun Egypt gama nahinphah diu, chule nakichatnu kel chun naitah-a Egypt gama nahin juijuva, chua chu nathi diu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt gama pem dinga amaiju pumngat hel ho chunga chutobanga chu umding ahi. Amaho chemjam'a, kela, hise-a thiuva, achunguva thilse kalhunsah dinga kona chu khatcha amohle asohcha umlou helding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, kalunghana le kalungsatna Jerusalem'a chengte chunga kasunlhah jeng banga chu, nachung uva kalungsatna chu Egypt gam nalhun tengule kasunlhah-a ki-dah le datmo, sapsetle mi houset nahiuva, hiche gamhi namukit loudiu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Vo nangho Judah amoh chengse, Pakaiyin nachung chang thu-u hitin aseije, Egypt'a che hih-un: tunia kahin hilchah naohi kihet chenun."},"20":{"text":"Pakai ka-Pathen'u henga neitao peh-un tia Pakai na Pathen'u henga neisol petnu chun nalung gelu na-im uvin, Pakai ka-Pathen'un asei ding jouse dungjuijin, neiphondoh peh-un, juijuvinge, nati uve."},"21":{"text":"Keiman tuni hin naheng uva kaphongdohtan, Pakai na Pathen'u aw ahiloule naheng uva eihinsol lona khatcha najui pouvin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun pemna dinga nache nomnao mun'a chu chemjam'a, kela, hise-a nathi teidiu ahi ti kihetchen jotaovin, ati."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah chun miho jouse henga Pakai a-Pathen'u thu jouse Pakai Pathen'in sei dinga asolna thu, hicheng thu jouse chu aseichai phatnin ahung hitin ahi.","title":"Jeremiah Egypt Akipui"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Hoshaiah chapa Azeriah le Kereah chapa Johanan chule mihoitho ho jouse chun Jeremiah henga, Pakaiyin Egypt gama pem dinga nache loudiu ahi tia sei dingin nasolpoi."},"3":{"text":"Tha dinga Babylon'a eipui theina diuva, Chaldea miho khutna pedoh dinga, Neriah chapa Baruch in natun ahibouve, atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Hitichun Kareah chapa Johanan le sepaiho gallamkai jouse chule mipite jouse chun, Judah gama chenna dingin, Pakai thu chu angai tapouve."},"5":{"text":"Hitichun Kareah chapa Johanan le sepaiho gallamkai jouse chun; amoh umsun Juda ho jouse, Judah gama cheng dinga akinomang nao namtin lah-a kona hungkileho,","ref":"2 Leng 25:26."},"6":{"text":"pasal ho, numei ho, chapangho, leng chanute chule Shaphan chapa, Ahikam chapa, Gedaliah toh sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan'in adalhah amitakip, chule Jeremiah themgao le Neriah chapa Baruch jaonan abonchauvin apuidoh taove."},"7":{"text":"Hitichun Egypt gamsung ahung lhung taove. Ajehchu amahon Pakai thu angai pouvin, hitichun Tahpanhes mun ngei chu ahung lhung taove."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Tahpanhes achun Jeremiah henga Pakai thu ahung lhungin, aseije,"},"9":{"text":"nakhutnin songchang len hochu lanlang Juda mite mitmu tah-in Tahpanhes a Pharaoh inlutna lampi-a kipha songpeh noija khun gavuijin,"},"10":{"text":"chule ajah uva hitin seijin, janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, ngaijun kalhacha Babylon leng Nebuchadnezzar chu kakouva, hiche songchang kivuisaho chungahi alaltouna atundoh-a, chule aleng pondal loupi chu ajahdoh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule ama ahung teng Egypt gam ahin bolset ding athi dinga chu thina-a, sohchang dinga chu sohchan na-a, chemjam'a loudingho chu chemjam'a apehdoh ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule keiman Egypt gama pathenho insunga mei kachokaija, hichun ahallhah ding, amaho chu sohchanga akaimang ding, kelngoichingpan avon chunga hit le kha aphetngim banga amanjong Egypt gam chu asuhtheng hella, chua kona mongtah-a potdoh ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aman Egypt gama Beth-shemesh'a um song milimho jong chu asuhchima, Egypt mite pathen inho chu meija ahallhah ding ahi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt gama Judah umjouse Migdol gama chengho, Tahpanhes chule Noph khoho, Pathros gama chengho chungchanga Jeremiah henga thu ahung lhungin hitin aseije,","title":"Egypt Gama Um Israelte Dinga Pakai Thusei"},"2":{"text":"Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, Jerusalem le Judah khopi jouse-a thilphalou kalhunsah jouse chu namutaovin, chule veuvin, amaho tuhin akamhelun, chuachun koimacha acheng tapouve."},"3":{"text":"Lunghansahna dinga eiphinset uva, agitlou jehu'n, amahon ahetphah louvu amahole nangho, chule napateu vin jong ahetkhah louvu pathen dangho jen dingin gimnamtui hal dingin acheuve."},"4":{"text":"Hijengjongle naheng uva kalhacha themgaoho jouse chu, Ohe, hiche thil thet um kakidah tahhi bolhih helun, tidingin matah-a thouvin kahinsolin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla amahon angaideh pouve, Pathen dangho henga gimnamtui ahallouna dingule, agitlounauva kona akileheina dingun anao jong asungdeh pouve."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun kalunghana le kalungsatna chu Judah khopihole Jerusalem khopi lamlena kabunglhan, akadohtai. Chule hichu tunia banghin akisumangin, akamheltan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun Pakai janel Pathen, Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, ibola nalah uva kona pasal le numei, naosen le nao noicheplai Judah gamsunga kona paidoh-a aum nading bepmin hiche thilsehi nabol uve,"},"8":{"text":"chenna dinga nachenao Egypt gamsunga pathenho henga gimnamtui nahal uva, leiset chunga nam jouse lah-a sapsetle seiset nachan theinadiu le satlhah nahitheina diuva nakhutsoh tah uva neiphin lunghangu ham?"},"9":{"text":"Judah gamsungle Jerusalem khosung lamlena napateu leh Judah lengte gitlouna, ajiteule nanghotah gitlouna, chule najiteuvin gitlouna anabolhou chu nasuhmilu hitam?"},"10":{"text":"Amaho tuni geijin jong akineo sahdeh pouvin, akichadeh pouve, nanghole napateu masanga kakoijing keima danthu le chondan ho-a jong achon pouve."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, keiman nangho douna-a thilse dingle Judah te satlhahna dinga kamaingat diu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Egypt gamsunga pem dinga maingat Judah amoh umsun chu kamatna kasuh manghel soh ding, Egypt gama lhalut uva, chemjam le kela thigamhel diu, aneopena pat alenpen geija chemjam le kela thidiu, thet le datmoa, gaosap le seisetna umdiu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Keiman Jerusalem chu chemjam'a, kela, chule hise-a talen kapeh banga Egypt gamsunga chengho chu talen kapeh ding ahin,"},"14":{"text":"Hitichun Egypt gamsunga cheng dinga che Judah mi a-umsun hochu, chenna dinga angaitun tunu Judah gama chu kilekit dinga khatcha ahoidoh le avaldoh umlou ding, aguh-a jamdoh ho tilou khatcha akilekit umlouhel dingu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule pathen dangho henga ajiteuvin gimnamtui ahaluve ti he-a mijousen akoma ding numei jouse mihonpi atama tam, Egypt gama cheng mijouse, Pathros-a chun Jeremiah chu adonbutnun, aseijun,"},"16":{"text":"Pakai mina kahenguva nathusei chu ngaipou vinge, atiuve."},"17":{"text":"Keihole kapateu, kalengteo le kapipui houvin, Judah khopihole Jerusalem khopi lamlen dunga anabol banguva, van lengnu henga gimnamtui hal le, ahenga don thilpeh sunlhah ding kakamsung tah uva kaseinao bangcheh-a kaboltei teidiu ahi. Ajehchu hichelai chun nehding tamtah kaneijun, aphan, thilse imacha kamupouve."},"18":{"text":"Ahinla van lengnu henga gimnamtui halla don thilpeh sunlhah katan uva pat ijakai kalhasamun, chemjam le kelin eiki sumangun ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule van lengnu dinga gimnamtui kahal uva, don thilpeh kasunlhah laijuva chu, kapasalteu thu louva amanu houna dinga changlhah kasemuva, don thilpeh kasunlhah-u hibeh-em? atiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chujouvin Jeremiah chun mijouse hengale pasal ho, numei ho, ama donbutho jouse henga chun aseijin,"},"21":{"text":"Judah khopihole Jerusalem khopi lamlen ho-a, nanghole napateu nalengteu chule gamsunga miten, gimnamtui nanahalu chu, Pakaiyin ahetlou hija alungsunga akhumlou hibeh-am?"},"22":{"text":"Nathilse boljeh-u le nathilbolu kidah um jeh-a, Pakaiyin athohjou tahlou ahin, hiche jeh-a chu, nagamu tu-a bangahi kamdela, datmo uma, sapset changa achenga umlouhel ahitai."},"23":{"text":"Gimnamtui nahal uva, Pakai douna-a nachonset uva, Pakai thu nangai daova, adan kisun thupeh le achondan najuilou jeh uva, hiche jeh-a chu tu-a bangahi nachung uva hiche thilsehi hungchua ahitai, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chukalvalin Jeremiah chun mijousele numei jouse jah-a aseijin, Egypt gama um Judah te jousen Pakai thuhi ngaijun."},"25":{"text":"Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, nanghole najiteuvin van lengnu henga gimnamtui hal le don thilpeh sunlhah ding, kanakitepnao banga kabol teitei dingu ahi, tin nakamun naseijun, nakhut un namolso taove. Nakitepnao bulhitnun lang, nakitepnao molsouvin."},"26":{"text":"Hijeh chun Egypt gama cheng Judah te jousen Pakai thu chu ngaijun, veuvin, Egypt gamsung pumpi-a Judah mi koimachan kamin aphahpoh tahlou ding ahi tia kamin thengtah pana kakitep ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije, Pakai ahing jinge."},"27":{"text":"Veuvin, aphatna ding hilou, asetna dinga kachan jingding, Egypt gamsunga Judah mijouse akichai soh hel kahseuva chemjam le kel lhah-a kisumanghel ding ahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Ahinla chemjam'a sohcha themcha khat Egypt gama konin Judah gama kileuvintin, Judah mi umsun jouse Egypt gama cheng dinga chesate chun, kei thuham, amaho thuham, koi thujoh atah ahiding hetaovinte."},"29":{"text":"Hichehi nangho dinga melchihna hiding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, hiche munahi nangho talen kapeh uva, nanghon kathuhi nangho douna-a, aselama dingjing ding ahi ti nahet theidiu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan, Judah leng Zedekiah chu ama thadinga holjing amelmapa, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khutna kapeh banga, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh hophra jong amelmate, ama that dinga holjingho khutna kapehdoh ding ahi, ati.","ref":"2 Leng 25:1-7."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchankal kumli channa-a Jeremiah kama hiche thuho asutlaija Keriah chapa Baruch henga Jeremiah themgaovin asei thu chu,","title":"Baruch Henga Pathen Kitepna"},"2":{"text":"Vo Baruch, Pakai Israel Pathen'in nahenga hitin aseije,"},"3":{"text":"Nangman Ohe, tun ada kahitai, Pakaiyin kalungkhamna chunga lung gentheina eibelappeh-in, khoisatna-in kalhutan, choldona kaneipoi, nati-e."},"4":{"text":"Nangin ajah-a hiti ahi nasei ding ahi, Pakaiyin vetan, keiman kasah chu kaphelhan, kaphu chu hiche gam pumpi geijahi kabodoh ding ahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Nangin thil lenlen nachangseh dinga nahol ham? Bol hih-in, ajehchu mihing jouse chunga thilse kalhunsah ding ahi, Pakaiyin nahinkho hi nachena muntina nangma dinga anchah bepma bou kapeh ding nahi, ati."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chidang namdangho chungchanga Jeremiah henga Pakai thu hunglhung chun;","title":"Karchemish Mun'a Egypt Gallel"},"2":{"text":"Egypt chungchang Euphrates luipi kama Karchemish kho-a chun, Judah leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchankal kumli lhinna in Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar chun Egypt lengpa Pharaoh-Neko sepaiho chu anajoutan ahi.","ref":"Isai 19:1-25; Ezek 29:1—32:32."},"3":{"text":"Pho leh lum kigotnun lang, gal lam nailutnun."},"4":{"text":"Sakol phoho semtupmun lang, nangho sakol chungchongho kipatdoh-un, nathih lukhuh-u toh dingdoh uvin, tengcha kinol hemun lang, thih sangkhol ki-ah uvin."},"5":{"text":"Ibola lungthoija anungjamu kamuham? Agal hatteu alhugamun, nunglam velouvin gangtah-in ajamuve. Avelu tijatnan alotai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"6":{"text":"Akaljanga jammang dahen, mihat jong sohcha hihhen, amaho Euphrates luipi kom sahlama kipat uva lhugam diu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Vadung banga atwi pomtultula, twisoh banga hung kinong lullul khu koiham?"},"8":{"text":"Egypt hi twisoh atuiho pomtultul luipi abangin, kakhan touva leiset kalosoh ding, akhopile asunga chengho kasuhmang ding ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Sakol nangho hung touvun, kangtalai nangho kino uvin, mihat ho hungdoh-u hen, lum choija Ethiopia mite le Egypt mite, thalpi kaosa-a choija Lydia mite."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu hichehi janel Pakai Pathen nikho phulah nikho ahin, akidoupiho chunga phu chu alah theina ding ahin, chemjamin aneh chaija, lungnachima athisanu adonkham ding ahi. Ajehchu Euphrates luipi pang sahlam gamkaijah janel Pakai Pathen'in ganlhaina abolin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Vo Egypt chanu nungah theng, Gilead'a chetouvin, nuding thingnailou gakilah-in, ajehchu nadampi louding loule ai tampi naman ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Namtin vaipin najachatna ajauvin, nakana in gamsung alosohtai. Mihatle mihat atatton, tolla alhugel lhontai."},"13":{"text":"Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar iti ahunga Egypt gam ajo ding thudol chu Pakai chun Jeremiah henga aseije.","title":"Nebuchadnezzar Ahung","ref":"Jer 43:10-13."},"14":{"text":"Egypt gama seichoijun lang, Migdol le Noph chule Tahpanhes ah phongjalun, dingdet unlang, kigal ginun, ajehchu chemjamin nakimvel uva miho ahinsatgam ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ipi jeh-a namihatteu kiphet manga hitaovam? Amaho Pakaiyin anojeh uva ding joulou ahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Aman mi tampi alhuhsah-in ahi, khat chunga khat alhuvin, amahon, kipat un, suhgentheina chemjam'a konin imiteu heng, igam lamuvah chekit taohite, atiuve."},"17":{"text":"Hia chun amahon asamun, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh vang ahu gin keubou ahin, phat kitepsa amoh suhmange, atiuve."},"18":{"text":"Amin janel Pakai lengpa chun keima kahing jinge, tahbeh-in mol ho lah-a Tabor bangle luipi panga Karmel banga ama hung ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Vo Egypt'a cheng chanu, nangma sohchanga chedin kigojengtan, ajehchu Noph chu keuhela chenna louva kamhel ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Egypt hi bongla hoitah abangin, ahinla manthah na ahungin, hichu sahlama kona hunga ahi."},"21":{"text":"Bongchal thaotah bangin amithalah houjong chu alah uva aumin, ajehchu amaho jong akinung heijun, ajamkhom taove. Ajehchu amanthah nau nikhole atosetnao phat achunguva ahung lhun jeh-a ding joulou ahitaove."},"22":{"text":"Chua husa chu gul kitholgin abangin, amaho chu gammang thingtuho banga heicha kenga galmiho toh hungdiu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Amaho khaokhoho sanga tam ahiuvin, simjouhoi ahilou jehu'n, kholtoh hoi hihih jongleu agammang chu atuhchaihel diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"24":{"text":"Egypt chanu kijumso-a, sahlam gamkai mite khutna kipedoh ding ahi.","title":"Pakaiyin Amite Ahuhdoh ding Ahi"},"25":{"text":"Janel Pakai Israelte Pathen'in aseije, vetan, Amon mi No mihonpi, Pharaoh le Egypt chu a-pathenho le alengteu puma, Pharaoh amatah le ama tahsan jouse talen kapeh ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Keiman amaho chu ahinnao holtele Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar le asohte khutna kapehdoh ding, chujou tengle masanga banga Egypt gama chu mi cheng ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"27":{"text":"Ahinla Vo kalhacha Jacob, nangma kicha hih-in, ajehchu vetan, nangma gamlatah-a kona chule nachilhahte asohchannau gama kona kahuhdoh ding, Jacob chu hung kinungle-a ongthol tah-a choldoa, koimachan akichatsah lou ding ahi.","ref":"Jer 30:10-11."},"28":{"text":"Kicha hih-in, Vo kalhacha Jacob, tin Pakaiyin ati, ajehchu keiman kaumpinai, keiman nangma kadel mangna namho jouse kichaina chu kabolpeh ding ahin, nangma kichaina vang kabolpeh lou ding, tena-a vang kasuhdih ding nahi, hijengjongle talen manlouva vang kakoi louhel ding nahi, ati."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pharaoh'in Gaza ajo masangin Philistine te thudola themgao Jeremiah henga Pakai thu ahung lhunge.","title":"Philistine Te Chungchanga Pakai Thusei"},"2":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan sahlama kona twisang hunglena, gamsungle asunga um jouse akhopile asunga chengho achup gamhel ding, chuteng miho chu kapmuva gamsunga chengho jouse pengdiu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Asakol hat hou kholhah ginin, akangtalai ho lhaiginle akangho kipei pohlahlah chun, pate khut ngoisah-in tin, achateu cheng nungvet pouvinte."},"4":{"text":"Hichu Philistine te kisuhgamna le Tyre le Zidon'a panpi umsunho suhmanghel nikho ahijeh in, Pakaiyin Philistine te Caphtor gamsunga amoh umsun chu asuhmanghel ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Gaza chunga luchaina alhungin, Ashkelon chu phaicham amoh umsun pumin akisumang heltai. Itihchan naki-at chenchen ding hitam?"},"6":{"text":"Vo nangma Pakai chemjam, itihchan mong nathip dingham? Napaija kikhumlutnin lang, kicholdon lang thipchet tan."},"7":{"text":"Pakaiyin Ashkelon le twipi pamma ho sat dinga thu apeh-a, apansah ahile, iti umthim thei ding ham? ati."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in Moab dounan hitin aseije; Ohe Nebo, ada ahi, ajehchu akisusea nahitai; Kiriathaim akijumson, akilatai; Misgab ajahchan, alungthoi tai.","title":"Moab Kisuhmang","ref":"Isai 15:1—16:14; 25:10-12; Ezek 25:8-11; Amos 2:1-3; Zeph 2:8-11."},"2":{"text":"Moab kivahchoina umta ponte, Heshbon dounan thilse agonguve, hungun, namkhat ahina-a konin sutanhel uhite. Vo Madmen namho, nangho jong kisatlha ding nahiuvin, chemjamin najuidiu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Horonaim'a kona chomna le suhmangna nasatah kana awgin sohdoh ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Moab akisumang tai, achasen hou ka-na akijan,"},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Luhith chetouna-a kap kapmin acheuvin, Horonaim kumsuh na-a melmaten asuhmangna jeh-a kana ajaove."},"6":{"text":"Jamun, nahinna kihuhhingun lang, gamthip hamhing bangin umun,"},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu nathilbol le nahaona natahsan jeh-a, nangma jong kiman ding nahin, Chemosh chu athempuhou le apipuiho puma sohchanga chediu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Khopi tina misumang hungintin, khopi khatcha hoilou ding, Pakaiyin asei banga damphai jong mangthah-a phaicham jong kisumang ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Alenmang theina din Moab chu lhaving peuvin, ajehchu acheng beija akhopi chu kamhel ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Jonchihtah-a Pakai na tonga chu sapset changhen, thisan sona dinga achemjam tuhkihpa jong chu sapset chenghen."},"11":{"text":"Moab hi aneuva pat nomsa ahin, ajuninga kivah-a, ajubel khatna khat jong keukhalou, ama jong sohchanga chekhalou ahi, hijeh achu atuina ama-a umden dena, anamtui jong kikhel lou ahi.","title":"Moab Khopiho Kisuhmang"},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun veuvin, nikho chu hunglhung ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, ahenga vahveiho kasola, amahon avaveisah dingu, chule jubelho avoh chippeh uva ahaihou asuhchippeh diu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Israel insungin atahsan Bethel ajachatpiu banga Moab miten Chemosh ajachatpi diu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Keiho gal hat le mihang kahiuve, iti natiu ham?"},"15":{"text":"Moab akisumang tan, akhopiho-a konin abeidoh tai. Alhentum khangthah ho jong akithat ho lah-a apanggam taove, tin amin janel Pakai hija lengpa chun aseije."},"16":{"text":"Moab hamsetna chu hunglhung vah ding ahitai, chule athohgimna chu kinoloi chela ahitai."},"17":{"text":"Nangho avela um jousen lunghem piuvin, amin heho jousen, mol lhon hamtahle moltum hoitah chu iti boh-a hitam? tiuvin!"},"18":{"text":"Dibon'a cheng chanu nangma, naloupi na-a konin hungsuh-in lang, dang chah-in touvin, ajehchu Moab sumanga chun nahin satna, nakulpi det ho asuhmang diu ahitai."},"19":{"text":"Vo Aroer'a cheng lampia dingin lang velhin, ajampale ahoidoh nu chu ipi soh-a hitam? tin dongin lang seijin."},"20":{"text":"Moab chu achimlhah jeh-in ajahchatai. Pengchoi choijin kapmun, Moab akisumang tai tin Arnon hilleuvin."},"21":{"text":"Phaicham gama Holon le Jahazah chu chule Mephaath chunga, thutanlhahna aumin,"},"22":{"text":"Dibon le Nebo, chule Beth-diblathaim chunga,"},"23":{"text":"Kiriathaim le Beth-gamul, chule Beth-meon chunga,"},"24":{"text":"Kerioth le Bozrah chule Moab khopiho jouse naijale gamla-a chunga thutanna ahung lhungtai."},"25":{"text":"Moab ki akisatlhan, abanjang akihehbongtai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"26":{"text":"Pakai douna-a akiloupisah jeh-in, ama chu khamsah uvin, Moab jong alohlhahna-a kibola anuiho totna jong ahi.","title":"Moab Kisuhnem Ding"},"27":{"text":"Israel chu nang dinga nuijatna bep hilou ham? Ama gucha lah-a kimukha am? Ama thudol nasei poupoule kipah-in nakichom chomjin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Vo Moab gama chengho, Khopiho dalhauvin, songkoa chengun, kohom panga bu kiset vakhu bangin umun."},"29":{"text":"Keihon Moab kiletsahna thu, ama akiletsah lheh-e; akichoisangin, ahoithoji-e, akiletsah jeh le alung hoithodan kamuvin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Alungsatna chu kahei, tin Pakaiyin aseije; ahinla chutilou ding ahi, ajounaho chun ima sodoh ponte."},"31":{"text":"Hijeh chun Moab din penging ting, Moab pumpi din kapdoh inge, Kirheres mite chu lunghem pinge."},"32":{"text":"Vo Sibman lengpigui Jaazar ka-na in nangma dingin kapminge, naguiho twipi ajam galkaijin, Jaazar twipi chan geihel ajame, na nipitheile lengpiga sumangpa nachunga achutai."},"33":{"text":"Neh nenna le Moab gama konin thanopnale kipana akilamang tan, lengpiga chilna-a konin lengpiga kabeisahtai. Koimachan kipa awgin to tho-a achiltah louding, a-ao nau chu kipana hitalou ding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Heshbon'a kona Elealeh gei peh-a kho kisam chu Jahaz gei peh-in a-awginu athongin, Zoar apat Horodnaim geijin kum thum bongla abangin, ajehchu Nimrim twiho jong kamhel ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chukalvalin Moab'a munsang ho-a thilto bolpale a-pathen hou henga gimnamtui halpa kasuhthip ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"36":{"text":"Hijeh chun kalunghi Moab te dingin thih bangin gingintin, kalunghi Hirheres mite dingin theile ho bangin ginginte, ajehchu aman anei haonaho beigama ahitai."},"37":{"text":"Ajehchu lu jouse chaija, khamul jouse kivou ding, khut jouse-a ki-at ding, kongho chunga khaopon akiveitai."},"38":{"text":"Moab intingvum jousele khosung lamlen ho-a tanggola lunghemna jeng umding ahin, ajehchu asunga lunglhaina umlouhel bangin kavochiptai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"39":{"text":"Amaho penguva, iti hichu kisu chipma, Moab chu jahcha geuva iti kinungheija hitam atidiu ahi. Hitia chu Moab chu nuisat le akimvella umho dinga lungthoina hiding ahi."},"40":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Veuvin, ama mulaopi bangin hunglengin tin, Moab chunga alhaving ahinjah ding ahi.","title":"Moab Dinga Sochatna Aumlou"},"41":{"text":"Kerioth chu akila ahitan, akuldet hou achim sohtan, chuche ni-a Moab mihangsan ho lungthim chu numei naonei pet lungthim tobang bep ahi."},"42":{"text":"Moab chu Pakai douna-a amale ama akichoisang jeh-a mite khat ahinaova kona kisumang ding ahitai."},"43":{"text":"Vo Moab'a cheng, nachunga tijatna le kokhuh chule thang hungchu ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"44":{"text":"Tijatna-a kona jam-a chu kokhuh-a lhalutnin tin, kokhuh-a kona hungdoh-a chu thanga ohding ahi. Ajehchu achunga Moab chungtah-a talen kapeh kum kalhunsah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"45":{"text":"Heshbon lim noija galmiho jeh-in ajamho adingden taovin; ahinla Heshbon'a konin mei chule Sihon'a konin meikong hungintin, Moab ningkoile samel mula umho lallukhuh akahvam ding ahi."},"46":{"text":"Vo Moab ada nahitai! Chemosh mite amangthah taove. Ajehchu nachapate sohchangin akikaijin, nachanute asohchang taove."},"47":{"text":"Hijongle ninunung lamle Moab sohchangho chu kahinlepui kit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Hichan geihi Moab thu kitanlha chu ahi."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ammon mite thudol chu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Israel'in chapa aneilou ham? Aman goulo aneilou ham? achutile ibola alengpauvin Gad alo-a, amite akhopiho-a chenguva ham?","title":"Ammon Chunga Pakai Thutanna","ref":"Ezek 21:28-32; 25:1-7; Amos 1:13-15; Zeph 2:8-11."},"2":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin aseije, Vetan, nikho ahung lhunge, Ammon mite kho Kabbah a galkisat thuthang kajahsah ding, hichu agohkeo kisevum hija, achanuteu meija kigou ding; chuteng ama gouloho chu Israel ten alodiu ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"3":{"text":"Vo Heshbon, Ai kisuhmang jeh-in pengun, Rabbah chanute kapmun, khaodip pon kigah-un lang lunghemun, hamkhul lah-a suhle tungin lhaijun, ajehchu alengpaule athempuhou chule apipuiteu agoma sohchanga chediu ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Vo chanu nungchonnu, ibola na phaichamm phalai chuleh phaicham ho-a nakiloupi sah-a nagoukhol ho-a nakisona, kahenga koi hung ding hija? nati ham?"},"5":{"text":"Vetan, nachunga tijatna, navela umho jouse-a kona kahinlhunsah-a, nangho amitakip kinomang jeng ding, alamvaipa chu koimachan akhopkhom lou ding ahitai, tin janel Pakai Pathen'in aseije."},"6":{"text":"Khonungle Ammon chate sohchangho kalepui ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"7":{"text":"Edom thudol chu janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Teman'a chihna beihela hitam? Milungchinga kona thumopna mangthah-a hitam? ahetkhen themnao mangdela hitam?","title":"Edom Chunga Pakai Thutanna","ref":"Isai 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Ezek 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Obad 1-14; Mal 1:2-5."},"8":{"text":"Vo Dedan'a chengte, jamun, kinung leuvin, chengdetnun, ajehchu keiman Esau chunga hamsetna kahinlhut ding, ama gotna kapeh ding phat kahin lhunsah ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Lengpiga louho nahenga hungleu akhai themkhat dalha pouvintem? Jan-in guchaho hungu le achim kahseuva aneh mang loudiu ham?"},"10":{"text":"Ahinla Esau ahomkeovin kalhan, amunthip ho kahohdoh gamtan, kisel thei lou ding ahitai. Achilhahte leh asopiho, chule aheng akomho akisumang sohtan, ama abeihel tai."},"11":{"text":"Paneilou nachateho chu dalhan, keiman hinso nange, chule nameithai hon eitahsanu hen."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin ati, Vetan, khona kon adonlou dinga athu kitanlhah hon adonjeng tah-ule, talen manlou ding pa chu nangma nahim? Talen manlouvin chepon nate, ahinla hichea chu nadon tei ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Keima kaki hahsel tai, tin Pakaiyin aseije, Bozrah chu kamhela, seisetna uma, keohela, sapsetna umding; chuche khopi jouse a-itih-a keohel ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Pakaiya konin thuthang khat kajan, Pathen helouho henga palai khat akisolin, kipun khomun, chule ama satnun, galbol din kipatdoh-un."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu vetan, keiman nangma Pathen helouho lah-a kaneosah-a, mite nahsahmo-a kasem ding nahi."},"16":{"text":"Vo nang lhangsanga song khikah-a cheng, kichat umtah banga nakigelna le nalunga kiletsahna chun nalheplhah ahitai. Nangman muvanlai banga sangin nabu sepjongle chun, chua kona kaloilhah ding nahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"17":{"text":"Edom jong kamhel intin, koi hile ajotpa chan atosetna jeh-a chehsa diu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Sodom le Gomorrah chule avela khopiho akisuhmang helbanga, chua koimacha umlou ding, mihem chapa jong cheng louhel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin ati.","ref":"Semt 19:24-25."},"19":{"text":"Veuvin, Jordan twisoh akonin ama chu kuldet nokhum dingin keipibahkai bangin hungtouvintin, ahinla ama-a kona hetman louva kadelmang ding ahi, chule achunga vaipo dinga kalhenthei pasal lhentum koiham? Kei tobang koi umam? Koijin phat eiteppeh ding ham? Ka anga dingding kelngoi chingpa chu koi ham?"},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun Edom douna Pakai thumopte, Teman'a chengte chunga athilgon, bol dinga agot ho chu ngaijun, thonlouva ganhon neopen geija kilhoh manga amaho puma achennao akamhelsah tei ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Alhuh-u ginin leiset ahot lingin, aka ginu jong twipi geijin akijaphan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Veuvin, mulaopi bangin ama hungleng touvintin, Bozrah chunga alha ajah ding ahin, hiche nikho chuleh mihat te lungthim jong numei jin naosonat athoh petna alungthim tobang hiding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Damascus thudola chun Hamath le Arpad akisudongtai; amahon thuse ajah jeh-un alungu alha lhoptai; twipi chunga lungkhamna aumin, hichu athip thei tapoi.","title":"Damascus Chunga Pakai Thutanna","ref":"Isai 17:1-3; Amos 1:3-5; Zech 9:1."},"24":{"text":"Damascus hi angoilhatan, jam dingin kigon akiheijin, tijatna-in amanchomtai; lungkhamnale natnan numei naosonat bangin abomtai."},"25":{"text":"Kanopsahna khopi, vahchoina khopi chu iti kikhen louva ham?"},"26":{"text":"Hijehchu agollhanghou khosung lamlena chu lhugama, hicheni chule agal hat hou jouse kithatgam hel ding ahiuve, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"27":{"text":"Chule Damascus kulbanga mei kachokonga Benhadad leng inpi akahvam ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in asuhmang ding Kedar thudolle Hazor lenggam thudol chu Pakaiyin hitin ati. Kipat un Kedar a chetouvun lang, solama miho chu gachomun.","title":"Kedar Nam mite Le Hazor Khopi Chunga Pakai Thutanna"},"29":{"text":"Aponbuh houle agancha honnu atol manguva, apondal houle aumlebel jouseu, asangongsao ho akilah uva, amahon ajah uva, ningtina tijatna jeng ahi, tia ahenguva asap diu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Vo Hazor a cheng mite, jamun, gamlatah-a umun lang, chengdetnun, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ajehchu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in nachung thu agel lhutan, nangma douna-in ngaito aneitai."},"31":{"text":"Kipat un, khohsah louhela cheng kul kotpile thih kotgol jong neilouva achanguva cheng, nam haotah ho sat ding khun kontouvun, tin Pakaiyin aseijin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Asangongsao ho chu galthil chomding hija, aganchau tampi chu chomgam dingbep hintin, kolmong geija hui jouse-a amaho kathecheh-a, ningtina kona ahamsetnau kahinpoh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"33":{"text":"Hazor chu dragon ho chenna hiding, a-itih-a kamhel ding ahin, chua mihem khatcha umlou ding, mihem chapa khatcha jong cheng lou ding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Judah lengpa Zedekiah leng chantila Elam douna-a Jeremiah themgao henga Pakai thu hunglhung chun hitin aseije.","title":"Elam Chunga Pakai Thutanna"},"35":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Veuvin, Elam thalpi athahatnao kona pen chu kaheboh ding ahi."},"36":{"text":"Elam dounan chua van ningli-a konin huilhi hinlhun sah ingting, chuche huiho lama chu kathecheh ding, akinodoh Elam mite lhunlouna nam umlou ding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Ajehchu Elam mite chu amelmateu masangle ahinnao holte masanga kalungthoisah-a, achunguva thilse kalunghana, tijat umtah ngeichu kapohlutna, kasuh manghel kahse-a, anung nunguva chemjam kasol ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin ati."},"38":{"text":"Chua kona lengpa le pipuiho kasuhmanga, Elam'a chu kalaltouna kado ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"39":{"text":"Ahinla ninunung lamle hung hiti ding ahi, Elam sohchangho chu kalepui kit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon le Chaldea te gam chungchanga Jeremiah themgaova kona Pakai thusei chu ahi.","title":"Babylon Gallel Ding","ref":"Isai 13:1—14:23; 47:1-15."},"2":{"text":"Namtin lah-a phongjalun lang thejah-un, ponlap domsangun, thejah-un, imhih-un, Babylon akilatai, Bel akisudongtai, Merodach ahal halin achiptai; asong milimhou ajahchatan, amilimhou ahal hallin achiptai, tiuvin."},"3":{"text":"Sahlama konin nam khatnin ahinsatnun, hichun agam akamhelsah-a, koimacha chua chenglou ding, mile sa agoma kichonuva adalhah diu ahi."},"4":{"text":"chuche nikhole chuche phatna chu, Israel chate, amahole Judah chate chu kappuma hungkhom uva, Pakai a-Pathen'u chu agahol diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","title":"Israelte Hungkilekit"},"5":{"text":"Zion lam amaingat uva alampi adoh dingu, hungun, suhmil kit louhel dingin tonsot thulhunna eihotah-in Pakai chu jomuhite, atidiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Kamite chu kelngoi mang ahiuvin, achinghouvin alamvaisah-uvin, molchung ho-a akihei manguvin, mola konin lhang danga acheuvin, ahongsungu asumil taove."},"7":{"text":"Amuchanin amaho avallhumun, akidoupihouvin hitin aseijuve, keihon kasukhel pouve, ajehchu amaho thudihtah chenna Pakai, apateu kinepna Pakai ngei douna chun achonseuvin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Babylon lailunga konin potdoh unlang, Chaldea te gama konin chedoh-un, chule kel hon lah-a kelchal bangin umun.","ref":"Tph 18:4."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu, veuvin, Babylon satding sahlama konin namho loupitah-a kikhom khom chu choh thouving ting, ama dou dinga kigoltoh uva, chua patna alah diu ahin, athalchangu chu mihat galbol thema tobang hintin, khatcha kimohle lou ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chaldea chu kichom ding ahin, achom jouse chu lunglhaisel diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"11":{"text":"Nakipa jeh-un, nathanop jeh-un, Vo kagoulo sumanga nangho, hamhing ne bongla banga hung thaodoh-in bongchal bangin naham lutlut jenge.","title":"Babylon Lhuhding"},"12":{"text":"Nanu chu hatah-a kijumsah ding ahi, nahingnu chu jahcha lheh ding ahi; Veuvin, namho lah-a anukhah pen chu gamthip gam, gamgo, chule neldi gam hiding ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Pakai lunghan jeh-a chenna mun hilou ding, apuma kamhel joding, Babylon'a chechan asetnaho jouse jeh-a adatmouva chehsasa cheng ding ahiuve."},"14":{"text":"Babylon kimvela kigolun lang, thalpi kamsa kichoi jousen ama chu kapmun, thalchang khatcha khen hih-un; ajehchu Pakai dounan achonsetai."},"15":{"text":"Akimvela hatah-in aovun, aman akhut apedohtai, akhopibul jouse alhutan, akulpihou achimlhatai, Pakai phulah ahijeh in achunga phu lauvin, aman abol bangin ama jong bolun."},"16":{"text":"Babylon'a konin muchi thepa chule chang atlaija koite choipa sumang uvin, suhgentheina chemjam jeh-a amaho amitakip amite lamcheh-a kiheija, amitakip agamcheh-a jamdiu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Israel hi keipin adelmang kelngoi vahcheh chu ahin, Assyria lengpan abahgam masapenin, achainan Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in aguho asubongin ahi.","title":"Israelte Hungkilekit"},"18":{"text":"Hijeh chun janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, Veuvin, Babylon lengpa le agam chu Assyria lengpa talen kapeh banga talen kapeh ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule Israel chu aumna-a kapuikitna Karmel le Bashan'a kivah-a, Ephraim le Gilead mol chunga ahinnao lunglhaisel ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Pakaiyin, chuche nikhole chuche phat tengle Israel khansetna chu kikhola, khatcha kimu lou ding, Judah setna jong kimu lou ding ahi. Ajehchu keiman kakhehho chu kangaidam ding ahi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Merathaim le Pekod'a chengho tah chu doudin kontouvun, amaho chu thatnun, sumanghelun, kathupeh jouse bangin bolun, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","title":"Babylon Chunga Pathen Thutanna"},"22":{"text":"Chuche gama gal kisatle suhmangna nasatah husa aginge."},"23":{"text":"Leiset pumpi sehtum iti kikehso-a, kisu bonga hitam? Namtinho lah-a Babylon iti hung kamhela hitam?"},"24":{"text":"Vo Babylon thang kakampeh-in, na-ohtan, nangin nakihetpon; nangma nakiholdoh-in nakimantai. Ajehchu Pakai nakisatpin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Pakaiyin agalvon kholna chu ahongin, alungsatna galvonho aladohtai. Ajehchu hichehi Chaldea te gamsunga janel Pakai Pathen natoh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Gamgi monglhapena konin adouvin hungun, athilkholna inho hongun, sepkhomun lang sumang helun, a-imacha khen hih-un."},"27":{"text":"Abongchal jouse akisuhmang nao nikho ahunglhun jeh-in, Ohe adao ahi!"},"28":{"text":"Pakai i-Pathen'u phulahna, a-houin dinga phulahna Zion'a phongdoh dinga Babylon'a kona hungjamdohho awgin khu ngaijun."},"29":{"text":"Babylon doudin thalthem ho koukhom un; thalkap jousen akimvela ponbuh kisonun, koimacha hoidohsah hih-un; athilbol dungjuijun lethuh un, athilbol jouse dungjuijin achunga bolun, ajehchu ama Pakai dounale, Israel mithengpa douna-a ahoithon ahi.","ref":"Tph 18:6."},"30":{"text":"Agollhanghou kholaija lhulhop diu, chuche nile agal hat jouseu kisumanghel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"31":{"text":"Vetan, mihoitho penpa, kadou nahi, ajehchu nangma gotna kapeh ding phat, nanikho chu ahung lhungtai, tin janel Pakai Pathen'in aseije."},"32":{"text":"Mihoitho pen chu kipala lhuding, koimachan akaithou lou ding ahi. Chule akhopi sunga mei kachokonga, akimvel jouse akahchai ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Israel chate leh Judah chate suhgentheijin aumkhomun, sohchanga kaiho jousen atuhdetnun, lhadoh ding anompouve."},"34":{"text":"Alhatdohpao chu ahatnin, janel Pakai chu amin ahi. Gamsunga olna aumtheina dingle Babylon'a chengte asuhboi theina dinga, ama amaho lama pang ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chaldea te chungle Babylon'a chengte chule apipuiteu, amichingteu chunga chemjam achutai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"36":{"text":"Mijouho chunga chemjam achun, amaho lunglhom diu; amihatteu chunga chemjam achun, amaho lungthoi diu ahi."},"37":{"text":"A sakol houle akangtalaihou, chule alah uva michoplop ho chunga chemjam achutan, amaho numei ho bang diu ahitai. Agoukhol hou chunga chemjam achun, chule hicheho chu kichom mang ding ahi."},"38":{"text":"Atuiho chunga twikana alhungin, hichu kanghel ding ahi. Ajehchu milim semthu gam ahin, asong milimhouvah angolgam taove."},"39":{"text":"Hijeh achu nelphai gamsahole twikol gamsaho chua chenguva, sumbupi jong cheng ding ahin, a-itih-a kilokit talou ding, akhang akhanga kilo talouhel ding ahitai.","ref":"Tph 18:2."},"40":{"text":"Pathen'in Sodom le Gomorrah chule nai vela khopi ho asuhmang banga, chuachu koimacha umlou ding, mihem chapa jong khatcha cheng louhel ding ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Semt 19:24-25."},"41":{"text":"Veovin, sahlama kona mipi honkhat hunguntin, chule nam lentahle leng tamtah, leiset kolkimvela konin hung kitol touvunte."},"42":{"text":"Amahon thalle teng apatdiu ahi. Engsetahle hepina beihel twipi kinong banga kitum lenglunga, sakola touvuva, mitin galbolmi banga kivona, Vo Babylon chanu, nahin satdiu ahitai."},"43":{"text":"Babylon lengpan athulhutnu ajan, akhut tha angoilhatai. Numei naosonat bangin, hesohnale natna-in naman chomtai."},"44":{"text":"Veuvin, ama Jordan twi kinonga kona mihat umna lama keipibahkai banga hungtou ding, ahinla keiman ama-a kona kajam mangsah paiding ahi. Achunga vaihomna katun ding pasal lhentum koiham? Keitobang koi umam? Koijin phat eiteppeh ding ham? Ka anga dingding kelngoichingpa chu koiham?"},"45":{"text":"Hijeh chun Babylon douna-a Pakai thumop, Chaldea te douna-a alunggot, anangaito chu ngaijun, kelngoihon lah-a aneopen jong kikai manga, thonlou hella aumnao chu amaho toh kamhela alhatei ding ahi."},"46":{"text":"Babylon kilah dohna hu-ginin leiset ahot lingin, akanao namtin vaipi lah-a akijai."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Babylon chunga chule alah uva cheng Keima eidouva pangho chunga, suhmangna huipi katildoh ding ahi.","title":"Babylon Chunga Pathen Thutan Banjom"},"2":{"text":"Keiman Babylon'a chang jap ho kasola, amahon ajap childiu; ajehchu lungkham nile aveluva adouvuva pang ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ama douva thal choile ama douva janel lah-a kisong thal hemin athal lhahen; agolhanghou khen hih-un, ajanelpi chu sumangsoh helun."},"4":{"text":"Hitia chu Chaldea gamsungle khosung lamlen ho-a akithatho lhuchap ding ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Israel mithengpa douna-in agamu chonsetnin dimjongle, Israel le Judah chu a-Pathen'u janel Pakaiyin adalhapoi."},"6":{"text":"Babylon na konin jamdoh un lang, mitinin ahinna kihuh hinghen; akhangit lounao thipi hih-un, ajehchu hichehi Pakai phulah phat ahin, aman alethuh ding mong ahi."},"7":{"text":"Babylon chu leiset pumpi khamsah, Pakai khutna sana khon chu ahi, namtin vaipin aju chu adon khamuva, hichea chu ngolgama ahitaove.","ref":"Tph 17:2-4; 18:3."},"8":{"text":"Babylon chu alhu phungin akisumang tai; ama chu kouvin, ama chu damthei ding ahile, anatna nuding thingnailou lauvin."},"9":{"text":"Babylon chu kadamsah nom-in, ahinla adam chompoi; dalhauvin, igam cheh-a kicheo hite. Ajehchu athu kitan lhah na-in van asun, vandum gei sana kidomsang ahitai.","ref":"Tph 18:5."},"10":{"text":"Pakaiyin ichon phatnao aphongdoh tai. Hungun, Pakai i-Pathen'u thilbol Zion'a seichoi juhite."},"11":{"text":"Thalchang ho notvalun, lumho chom khomun, Pakaiyin Mede lengte lung asuthoutai. Ajehchu atup chu Babylon dinga suhmang ding chu ahi, ajehchu hichu Pakai phulah, a-houin phulahna ahi."},"12":{"text":"Babylon kulbang vuma ponlap tungdoh-un, khongah hatsah-un, khongah ho tungdoh-un, ajehchu Babylon mite douna-a Pakaiyin asei chu agongtoh-in, atong chaitai."},"13":{"text":"Vo nang twi tamtah chunga chenga, gou haotah pa, nakichainale nakiloset tetohna chu ahung lhungtai.","ref":"Tph 17:1."},"14":{"text":"Janel Pakai chu amatah akihahselin, aseije, khaokhoho tobang hela mihem'a kahindip teitei ding nahi, amahon nangma douna-a ahin aodiu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Pathen'in athaneina-a leiset asema, achihna-a vannoi atundoh-a, ahetchetna-a kona jong aphajal ahitai.","title":"Pathen Vahchoina La"},"16":{"text":"Aman a-aw asodoh teng, van ho-a twipi tamtahpi ahung umjin, kolmong ho-a konin twimei akaltou sahjin, kolphele go asemin, hui chu akikholna-a konin alhadoh jin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Mitin ahetnaova ngola ahiuvin, thil podoh takip semthu milima kijumso ahiuve. Ajehchu amilim semthu uchu joubulom ahin, amaho-a haitheina hu aumpoi."},"18":{"text":"Hicheho chu mohseh, thilbol dihlou ahin, gotna akipeh phat tengule mangthah cheh diu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Jacob chanvang hicheho tobang chu ahipoi, thil jouse kipatna ahi. Israel chu agoulo moljol ahin, amin chu janel Pakai ahi."},"20":{"text":"Nangma kagal heichale kagalvonho chu nahi. Ajehchu namdangho chu nangma-a kasuhchipma, nangma-a lenggam ho kasuhmang ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule nangma-a sakolle achunga toupa kasuh chip ding, chule nangma-a kangtalai le achunga atoupa kasuhchip ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Nangma-a pasal le numei kasuhchipma, tehse le khangthah kasuhchip ding ahi, chule nangma-a nungah le gollhang jong kasuhchip ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Nangma-a kelngoichingpa le akelngoihon jong kasuhchip ding, nangma-a loubolpa le abongchalho koljon, chule agal lamkaiho le vaihomho kasuhchip ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule nangma mitmu tah-a Zion chunga athilsebol jouseu chu Babylon'a le Chaldea te chunga kachuhsah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"25":{"text":"Leiset pumpi sumanga vo suhmangna mollen, vetan kadou nahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, nachunga kakhut kalhan doh-a, songpi ho-a kona kejel lhah-a, akavamsa mol kaso ding nahi."},"26":{"text":"Nanga kona in-ning song dingle inbul song ding alah lou diu ahitan, ahinla a-itih-a kamhel ding nahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"27":{"text":"Gamsunga ponlap khat tahdoh-un lang, namtin vaipi lah-a sumkon mut un lang, ama doudin namho gongun lang, Ararat, Minni, chule Ashchenaz lenggam ho ama doudin gallamkai semun lang, khaokhoho bangin sakol ho hungtou sah-un."},"28":{"text":"Ama doudin namho, Mede lengte, agal lamkaihou, avaihomho jouse, aloinehna gam jouse gonguvin."},"29":{"text":"Chuche Babylon gam chu kihot hotna lungdong diu ahi. Ajehchu Babylon gam chu chenna louva akamhelna dinga Pakai thilgon jouse guilhung ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Babylon gal hat ho galsat ahaijun, akul sunguva aumden taove. Ahatnau adailhatan, numei asohgam taove. Achendetnau ahal lha uvin, akotgol hou abong gamtai."},"31":{"text":"Thusep khat chu achomto kisuto ding, thangkou khat chu achom khatto kisuto-a, akhopi chu among khatna konin akilatai ti hil dingin Babylon gama alhaijun ahi."},"32":{"text":"Lampiho atutanun, pumpeng aneihou meija akihal lhan, gal hat ho akichagam taove."},"33":{"text":"Ajehchu janel Pakai, Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, Babylon chanu chu phol tobang ahin, ama kivoh phat ahitai. Hijengjongle chomcha khat joule achang atphat hunglhung ding ahitai."},"34":{"text":"Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in einechaijin, eisugoijin, belhomkeo eisotai, dragon bangin eival lhumin, kasa atuilai jouse anevasetnin, aman eipaidoh tai."},"35":{"text":"Keile katahsa chunga hunama eikibol naho, Babylon chunga umhen tia Zion'a chengten aseijuva, Jerusalem in kathisan Chaldea te chunga chuhen, atidiu ahi."},"36":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin, Veovin, nangma lama pangin ting, naphu lahpeh inge, chule atuipi gotsah ingting, atuinah kansah inge, ati.","title":"Pakaiyin Israelte Apanpiding"},"37":{"text":"Babylon chu hung kilhu vuma, dragonho chenna mun, datmo umle chehsatna, mi chen louna hung hiding ahi."},"38":{"text":"Amaho keipiho banga kitum khomuva, keipibahkai nouho banga ngih ngihdiu ahi."},"39":{"text":"Akhampetnule agolvah-u kabolsah-a kakhamsah ding, hitia chu kipah thanomuva, a-itih-a ihmuva, thoukit talouhel ding ahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"40":{"text":"Athat dingpa henga kelngoinou kakaisah-a, kelngoi chalto kelchal kikai banga amaho chu kapuisuh ding ahi."},"41":{"text":"Sheshach chu iti kimat ham? Leiset pumpi vahchoipa chu iti datmo um hitam? Babylon chu datmo um iti hungsoh hitam?","title":"Babylon Hamsetna"},"42":{"text":"Babylon chu twipin achuptan, chuche twinong tamtah chun akhutai."},"43":{"text":"Akhopiho chu akamhelin, gamgo, gamthip, mi khatcha chenlouna gam, mihem chapa khatchan ajotpa louhel asohtai."},"44":{"text":"Chule Babylon sunga Bel chu talen kapeh-a, aval lhumsapa kamsunga kona kiloidoh ding; chule namtin vaipi chu ahenga hung kilhonlut khomkit talou ding ahiuve, Babylon kul chu chimlha ding ahitai."},"45":{"text":"Kamite, alah-a konin potdoh-un lang, Pakai lungsat tijat umtah-a konin nangma cheh hinna kihuhhingun."},"46":{"text":"Ajole nalungu hopmintin, chuche gama kijading thuthang jeh in tijagetnun nate, kum khatle thuthang khat hung lhungin tin, chujou kum khatle thuthang khatma, chule gamsunga hunam patna, vaipole vaipo kidouna hunglhung ding ahi."},"47":{"text":"Hijeh chun veuvin, Babylon'a milim kikhengho thu katanna ding nikho ahung lhunge, agam pumpi jahcha-a, ami kithat jouse agamlaija lhuchap ding ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chuteng vanle lei, chule asunga umjousen Babylon jeh-a penga la asahdiu ahi. Ajehchu sahlama kona asumangho ahenga hung ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Tph 18:20."},"49":{"text":"Babylon'in Israel atha-a alhuhsah banga chu, leiset pumpi kithat chu Babylon'a chudiu ahi.","ref":"Tph 18:24."},"50":{"text":"Nangho chemjam'a hoidohho chemangun, dingden hih-un, gamlatah-a konin Pakai galdoh un, nalunguva Jerusalem chu geldoh jingun.","title":"Babylon'a Um Israel Chate Dinga Pathen Thusei"},"51":{"text":"Houset kajah jeh-un kajum-un, jachatna-in kamaiju akhutai. Ajehchu Pakai ina muntheng sunga gamdang mi ahung lutnuve."},"52":{"text":"Hijeh chun veuvin, nikho alhunge, Pakaiyin aseije, amilimhou chunga thu katan ding, chule agam pumpi-a mapuho peng ding ahiuve."},"53":{"text":"Babylon chu van'a kaltouhen lang, akulsung chu detsah jengjongle, keija kona ahenga misumang ho hungnalai diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"54":{"text":"Babylon'a kona kana le Chaldea gama kona suhmangna nasatah husa athongin,","title":"Babylon Chunga Manthah na Kisuhjom"},"55":{"text":"Pakaiyin Babylon asim jeh-a, a-awginu nasatah chu athipsah-a, akinon ginu chu twi tamtah nasatah kinon gin tobang ahin, a-awginu chu a-ong jeju jengin ahi."},"56":{"text":"Ajehchu misugam ahenga ahungin, Babylon chungtah-a chun achun, amihatteu aman gamun athalpiu cheh-u abong gamtan, ajehchu lethuhji Pakaiyin alethuh tei ding ahitai."},"57":{"text":"Chule apipuitele amichingte, agal lamkaiho le avaihomte, chule amihatte kakhamsah gam ding ahi, amaho tonsot imutna ihmuva, thoukit talouhel ding ahiuve, tin lengpa amin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"58":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Babylon kul nasatahho chu chimsoh hela, akotpi bangho kavamsoh ding ahi, miten mohseh-a atohgimuva, amahon mei dinga bou acholpi dingu ahi."},"59":{"text":"Judah lengpa Zedekiah Alengchan kal kum lina-a Maaseiah chapa Neriah Chapa Seriah, Zedekiah to Babylon lama achepet lhona Jeremiah themgao'in athupeh; chule hiche Seriah hi lenga thil le lo ching pipuipen ahi.","title":"Babylon'a Jeremiah Thusei Kithot"},"60":{"text":"Hitichun Jeremiah chun Babylon chunga thilse hung chuding jouse, Babylon chungchang thu kisun jouse jong lekhabu khatna asunlutne."},"61":{"text":"Chuin Jeremiah chun Seriah jah-a, Babylon'a nahunga, hiche thuho hi namu ding, chule aboncha nasimding ahi."},"62":{"text":"Chuteng nangman nasei ding ahi, Vo Pakai, nangman, asunga mile sa khatcha jong umlouhel dinga kisumang hela, a-itih-a kamheljo ding ahi, tin hiche mun douna-a thu naseitan ahi."},"63":{"text":"Chule hiti ding ahi, lekhabu hi nasim joutengle, song khat toh nakanbeh-a, Euphrates lailunga naselut ding ahi:","ref":"Tph 18:21."},"64":{"text":"Achunga kahinpohlut ding thilse-a kona thoudoh lou dinga, hiti ahi Babylon lhalut ding ahitai, nati ding ahi. Chule amaho chollheh diu ahi.
