Hichanhi Jeremiah thuho chu ahi."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah chu leng ahung channin kum somni le khat ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somlekhat alengchange, anu min chu Hamutal ahin, Libnah kho-a Jeremiah chanu ahi.","title":"Jerusalem Khopi Chim (2 Leng 24:18—25:7)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin aman Jehoiakim boljouse bangin Pakai mitmun thilse abolin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hitichun Pakai lunghanna konin Jerusalem le Judah gamsung chu amasanga kona apaidohhel kahsen ahung hitin ahi, Zedekiah chu Babylon lengpa dounan akiphinin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin alengchan kumko lhinkum, lhasom channa, nisom na-a chun ahitin ahi, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar chu asepaite jouseto Jerusalem satdin ahungun, amaidon na chun ponbuh asongun, akhopi kimvela galkul akaikhum taove.","ref":"Ezek 24:2."},"5":{"text":"Hitichun Zedekiah lengpa lengchankal kum somlekhat lhin geijin khopi chu aumchah taove."},"6":{"text":"Chuin lhalina niko nin khopi sunga chun kel akhohtan, gamsung mite din nehding abeitei."},"7":{"text":"Chuin khopi chu akehtan, galbol miho jouse chu khopi-a konin jan-in, kulbang ni kah-a lengpa hon lampi kotpi-a chun ajamdoh-un, (tun Chaldea te chu khopi pam kimvela panga ahiuvin) Phaicham lampi chu ajon taove.","ref":"Ezek 33:21."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla Chaldea sepaiten lengpa chu anungdelun, Jericho phaichama Zedekiah chu aphapao vin, asepaite jouse ama-a konin akithecheh taove."},"9":{"text":"Chuin lengpa chu amanun, Hamath gama Riblah a Babylon lengpa henga apui taove. Hia chun achunga thu atanlhatai."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Babylon lengpan Zedekiah chapate chu amitmu tah-in athatnin, Judah pipuiho jouse jong Riblah a chun athat gamtai."},"11":{"text":"Chujouvin Zedekiah mitchang teni chu akaldoh peh-in, Babylon lengpa chun thihkhaovin akanin, Babylon lama akaijin, athi nikho geijin songkul'a ahentai.","ref":"Ezek 12:13."},"12":{"text":"Tun lhanga na, chuche lha nisom na-a chun, hichu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kum somleko lhinna ahin, Babylon lengpa kinbol, sepai gal lamkai Nebuzaradan chu Jerusalem'a ahungin,","title":"Jerusalem Houin Kisuhset (2 Leng 25:8-17)"},"13":{"text":"Pakaiyin le lengpa in, chule Jerusalem'a in ho ahalin, milenho in jouse jong meijah ahalvam soh heltai.","ref":"1 Leng 9:8."},"14":{"text":"Chuin sepai gal lamkai toh hung kilhon Chaldea sepai jouse chun Jerusalem kimvela kulbang jouse avochim soh hel taove."},"15":{"text":"Chujouvin sepai gal lamkai Nebuzaradan'in miho lah-a migenthei phabeple khopi sunga umnalai amohho, Babylon lengpa henga kipelut ho, chule mipi dangho chu sohchangin akaimangtai."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan'in gamsunga genthei phabep chu lengpilei lhoudingle ngahdin adalhatai."},"17":{"text":"Pakai insunga um sum-eng khompihole akitun naho, Pakai insunga sum-eng twikong jong chu Chaldea ten avoseovin, asum-eng jouse Babylon'a apotaove.","ref":"1 Leng 7:15-47."},"18":{"text":"Khangbel lenho jong, vutloho, chaicheho, kongtong ho, meivah khomho, thihkheho, akinbolnao sum-eng lheng, lhengkong ho apomangsoh taove."},"19":{"text":"Chule khon neoho le vutloho, kongtong ho, khangbel lenho, meivah khom ho, thihkhe ho, chule khon ho, sana-a kisem chu sana in, dangka-a kisem chu dangka-in, sepai lamkaipa chun akilah-in ahi."},"20":{"text":"Khompi ni, twikong khat, atunna noija sum-eng bongchal somleni, hichu Solomon lengpan Pakai insunga asem ahin, hiche lheng le khonho jouse sum-eng chu te jouhoi ahipoi."},"21":{"text":"Khompi thudol; khompi khat chu asandan tong somleget, akimvel tong somlenin akol khumin, hichu bel li sa-a ahin, asung hom ahi."},"22":{"text":"Achunga sum-eng luboh khat aumin, aluboh khat chu tong nga sanga, alubohho chung chu kolbuthei lima themneltah-a kijempah ahin, aboncha sum-eng jeng ahi. Sutpi nina jong chu hiche tobangahi kolbutheija kijempah ahi."},"23":{"text":"Apang khatna kolbuthei somko le gup cheh aumin, themneltah-a kijem chunga chu kolbuthei jakhat-in akimvel ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin sepai lamkaipan thempulen Seraiah le thempu ni channa Zephaniah chule kotngah thumho chu akaijin;","title":"Judah Mipi ho Babylon Gama Sohchanga Akikaiju (2 Leng 25:18-21 , 27-30)"},"25":{"text":"Aman gal hat ho chunga vaipo nukiso pa, khopi sunga um lengpa koma umjing le akivoppi jing mi sagi, sepai janelho lekhasunpa, khopi lailunga kimudoh gamsung mi somgup jong khopi-a konin akaidoh in ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hitichun sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan'in amaho chu Babylon lengpa henga Riblah ah akaijin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Babylon lengpan amaho chu ajepmin, Hamath gama Riblah mun'a athatgamtai. Hitobang chun Judah chu amatah gama konin sohchangin akaimangtan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hichehi Nebuchadnezzar'in sohchanga akaimangho chu ahi. Alengchan kum sagina chun Judah te sangthum le somni le thum ahiuve."},"29":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kum somlegetna in Jerusalem'a konin mi jagetle somthumle ni akaimangin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kum somni le thum lhinna in sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan'in Judah te jasagi le somli le nga akaimangin, abonun mi sangli le jagup ahiuve."},"31":{"text":"Judah lengpa Jehoiachin sohchan kum somthumle sagi lhinna, lha somlenina, chuche lha nisomni le nga nin ahitin ahi, Evil-Merodach Babylon lengpa chu alengchan kum khatna chun, Judah lengpa Jehoiachin lu chu adomsangin, sohchan na-a konin apuidoh-in ahi."},"32":{"text":"Ama chu lungset tah-in ahoupin, Babylon gamsunga alengchanpi ho laltouna vuma alaltouna adosangpeh penin,"},"33":{"text":"asohchanna vonho akhelpeh-in, ahinkho lhumkeijin amasangah changlhah anejom jingpehtan ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chule aneh le chah dingin, Babylon lengpan tahsa phatnading anpha ape jingin; ahinkho lhumkei, athini geijin tanglouvin niseh-in apejing tan ahi."}}}}},"25":{"info":{"name":"Kala","shortname":"Kala","abbr":[],"desc":"Kala ho"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"I-ahungtile mipi dimsetna ana umna khopi chu thomhao tah-a hung uma hitam! I-atile amanu meithainu hung bangdoh-a hitam! namtin vaipi lah-a apipen chule gamkaiho lah-a leng chanu bang anahia chu i-ahungtile tu-a soh hungsoh-a hitam!","title":"Jerusalem Lunghemna"},"2":{"text":"Amanu janteng hakan akapjin, abeng teni mitlhin achupjin, ama ngailuho lah jenga jong alhem lungmong ding khatcha aneijoupoi. Agolte jousen jong ama adoha bolun, amaho amanu melma asohgam taove."},"3":{"text":"Judah chu hesoh gentheina jehle, bolgentheina jeh-in gal hingin kaimangin aumtai. Amanu Pathen helouho lah-a achengin, olna himhim amujou tapoi. Amanu bolgim hon alungdon pettah in aman taove."},"4":{"text":"Zion lampiho chu alhasetai, ajehchu kut loupitah mang dingin koimacha ahung tapouvin; akotpi phung jouseu akamheltai. Athempuhou akhoisan, anungah thenghou athohgimun, chule amanu jong lung gimin aumtai."},"5":{"text":"Amanu kidoupiho apipu ahitaovin, amelmate ahung lolhing taovin ahi; ajehchu asuhkhel nao tampiho jeh-a Pakaiyin amanu asuhgenthei ahi. Achateho jong amelmateu masanga gal hingin achegam taove."},"6":{"text":"Zion chanu-a konin ahoinaho jouse achemang tai. Amanu pipuiho jong sakhigol lhatna mun mujoulou abangtauvin, chule amaho adelpao masanga thabeijin achetauve."},"7":{"text":"Amelmate khutna amite alhuh-a, koimachan akithopi lou phatnin, akisuh gentheina nikhole avangsetna nikhoho chun Jerusalem'in masanglaija akut nopsahnahou chu ahingeldoh-e; akidoupihon amanu amuvin, acholngah nikho hou anuisat bepmui."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem melse tah-in achonsen; hijeh-a chu amanu kiladoh-a ahi. Amanu anajabolho jousen i-asahtapoi, ajehchu amahon amanu sagohkeo ahina chu amudoh taove. Ahi, amanu akhoisasan chule akinunghei kit tai."},"9":{"text":"Amanu thenlounaho anih ho-a abeh-in; akhonung phat ding jong ageldoh poi. Hijeh chun kidang tah-in ama akemsuh-in, alhamonsah ding koimacha aneipoi. Vo Pakai, kahesoh gentheina hinven; ajehchu melma chu amale ama akiloupi sahtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Akidoupipan amanu thilpha neiho jouse chunga akhut ahinlhang doh-e, ajehchu nangman namite houkhom ho lah-a luttheilou dinga nanathupeh Pathen heloute chu, amanu muntheng mun'a alutnu amanun amutai."},"11":{"text":"Amite jouse akhoisa gamtaovin, neh akiholuvin; amahon akihinso theina diuvin thilpha aneijouseu chu akijoh doh gamtaove. Vetan, vo Pakai, chule ngaiton, ajehchu keima thet umtah kahung hitai."},"12":{"text":"Khola vahle ho hiche mun hinjotpaho dinga hichehi imacha hilouva ham? Veuvin, chule heuvin, keima chunga gim gentheina hunglhung, Pakaiyin alunghan khaotah nikho-a eisuhgentheina tobang gim gentheina aum khapoi."},"13":{"text":"Chunga konin aman kaguho sunga mei ahinsol lutnin, hichun kaguho achansoh keijin ahi. Aman kakeng teni-a dingin len ajah-in, keima eikinung heisah kitnin ahi. Aman nilhumkeijin keima eilunglhah sah-in, chule eilhah lhopsah-e,"},"14":{"text":"kasuhkhelna namkoljon chu aman akhut tah-in atuh-in; hicheho chu aman khivuija athilin kangongchanga ei-o pehtai. Aman katha alhahsamsah-in, Pakaiyin amaho khutna keima eipedoh-in, amaho-a konin keima kathoudoh jou tapoi."},"15":{"text":"Keima angsung tah-a kamihat ho chu Pakaiyin achotpha tai. Aman keima douna-a kagollhang ho suhmang nadin mipi akhomin ahi. Judah chanu nungah theng chu Pakaiyin lengpiga chilna bangin achiltai."},"16":{"text":"Hiche thilho jeh hin kakaptai; kamit ngeihi twijin along lhatai. Ajehchu kahinna kidosah kit thei ding lhamonsah chu keija konin gamlatah-a aumtan; galte ahattah jeh-un, kachate jong athomhaosoh taove."},"17":{"text":"Zion'in akhut teni ajahdoh-in, ahinla ama lhamonsah ding koimacha aumtapoi. Pakaiyin Jacob chungchanga chun akidoupiten aumkimvel diuvin thu anapen ahi. Amaho lah-a Jerusalem hi numei nihboh nei abang jengtai."},"18":{"text":"Pakai chu chonpha ahi, ajehchu keiman athupeh kanadouvin ahi. Ngaijun, katao ahi, mipite, chule kalung gimnahi veuvin, kanungah thengle gollhangho jong gal hingin akikai taove."},"19":{"text":"Keiman kangailut ho chu kakoujin, ahinla amahon eijoulhep taove. Kathempuhole ka-upahon khopi sunga ahinnao kidokitna dinga neh ahol nalam uvin alhagao alhagam taove."},"20":{"text":"Vo Pakai neihin ven; keima lung genthei jin kaumtai; kasung akithing tai, kalung sung akipei jengtai. Ajehchu keiman nasatah-in kanadouve, polama chemjamin mihem athatnin, insung jong thina in tobang jeng ahitai."},"21":{"text":"Amahon kakhoisat ajauvin, koimacha eilhamon ding aumpoi. Kamelmate jousen kalunggentheina ajasohkei juvin, nangman naboldoh na-a hin amaho akipah uve; nangman naphon dohsa nikho hinlhun sah-in natin, chutengle amaho keima tobang hung hitaovinte."},"22":{"text":"Amaho gitlouna jouse na-anga hunglhung hen; chule kasuhkhelna ho jouse jeh-a kachunga nabol bangin amaho chunga jong bolin, ajehchu kakhoisatna atame, chule kalung jong alha lhoptai."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Itobang tah-a Pakaiyin Zion chanu chu alunghana meiloma akhu khuma, chule Israel hoinaho chu van'a kona leisetna ahin lelhah-a, chule alunghanlai nikho-a akeng ngapna jeng jong ageldoh lou hitam!","title":"Pathen'in Jerusalem Gotna Apeh"},"2":{"text":"Pakaiyin Jacob chenna mun jouse aval lhumtai, chule khotona aneipoi, alunghana jeh-in aman Judah chanu kulpidet ho chu asonlhan, chule hicheho chu toltoh alhobehtai; aman agam sungle chuche sunga pipuiho jong asubohtai."},"3":{"text":"Aman tijat umtah alunghan na-in Israel ki jouse asubongin, amelmate maija konin akhut jetlam anung loidoh-in, chule akimvel dung meikong hattah bangin aman Jacob dounan mei akondoh sah-in ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aman melma khat bangin athal akamsalin, kidoupi khat bangin akhut jetlamin apangin, Zion chanu ponbuh sunga chun mitvetna hoijouse chu athatgamtai; aman alunghana chu mei bangin asunglhatan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pakai chu melma bang ahin; aman Israel avallhum tan, aleng inho jouse jong aval lhumtai; aman amaho amundet jouseu jong asuhset peh-in, chule Judah chanu ka nale maona jong asupung cheh-in ahi."},"6":{"text":"Aman honlei khat bangin ahoubuh chu pumhatnin alamang tai. Aman mipi akikhopnao munho jong asuhsetpeh tai, Pakaiyin kut loupitah hole cholngah nikho jong Zion sunga suhmilin aumsahtai, chule alunghana nasatah jeh-in lengle thempu jong i-asah tapon ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pakaiyin amaicham apaidoh-in, amun theng jong akidahtai. Aman leng inpi bangho jong melma khutna alehdohtan ahi; hitichun kut loupitah kibol nikho bang helin amahon Pakai insunga chun husa asosah taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pakaiyin Zion chanu kulbang suhset ding agongtai, Aman gamgi khat alhungdoh-in, akhut jong suhsetna lama konin akihsah tapon, hijeh chun aman kul vumle kulbangho chu lunghem na-in asemin amaho lhanguijin aumtaove."},"9":{"text":"Amanu kotpigolho leisetna alhalut tai, amanu thihlhonho chu asuhboh peh-in, asuhmangpeh-e. Alengpale apipuho chu chidang namdangte lah-a aumtaove. Dan thupeh jong aumtapoi, athemgaohon jong Pakaiya kona mu anei tapouve."},"10":{"text":"Zion chanu upate chu tolla atouvun, thipbeh-in aumtaove. Amahon alujang uvah leivui akinuvin, khaodip pon jengin akivon taove. Jerusalem nungah thenghon jong alu-u tolah asulutnun akuntaove."},"11":{"text":"Kamit lhi jeh-in kho kamuthei tapoi. Kasung akithingin, kamite chanuho kisuhmang jeh-in kalungthim jeng jong leiset chunga akisunglha tai. Chapanghole noichep laiho khopi lamlen ho-a anguilha gamtaovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Khopi lamlen ho-a gala kisukhaho banga ahaisamuva, anuteo phei chunga ahinnao abuhlhah lhah laiju chun amahon anuteo jah-a, bule lengpitwi hoibaham? atiuve."},"13":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem chanu nangma hettohsahna dinga ipi thil kamana, katekah ding nahim? Vo nungah theng Zion chanu, ipitoh nakibange kati ding ham? Ajehchu nasetna twikhanglen banga len ahi, koijin damsah theijin natem?"},"14":{"text":"Nathemgao hon nang dingin pannabei le ngolhoi ngen namudoh peh uve. Chule amahon nasohchanna-a kona nakitoldoh theina dinga nakhanset naho amudoh dinghou chu amudoh pouvin, ahinla nangma dingin pohgih dihloule kikai mangna bou namudoh peh-un ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nahinjotpa jousen akhutnu nahin behkhumun, Jerusalem chanu chu anuisatnun, chule akhasuh-un, hiche khopihi hilouham, mihem ten hoina chamkimna, leiset pumpi kipana ahi atiu chu? atiuve."},"16":{"text":"Namelmate jouse nangma dounan akam kauvin, amaho a-eng hamun, aha-u agoijun, meihon amanu aval lhum jou taove, adihtah-in inanga jingu nikho chu hichehi ahitan, eihon ihol doh-un, imudoh taove, atiuve."},"17":{"text":"Pakaiyin agon chu atungdohtai. Aman masang laija athupeh chu asubulhing tai. Aman aseplhan akhotopoi. Chule aman nachunga namelma kipana asosahtai, aman nakidoupi te ki chu atungdohtan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Alungsungu Pakai henga apengin, Vo Zion chanu kulbang, sunle jan-in mitlhi lui bangin longhen, kicholdo hihbeh-in, namit lhi lon banghih hen, atiuve."},"19":{"text":"Thouvin janle pengdoh jengin: Jan phat ahung kipatle Pakai maija nalungsung twi bangin sunglhan lang, khopi lamlhah bul tina nachate chapang khangdongho gilkela lhasamho hinna dingin nakhut teni domsangin, ama lam chu sang jengin."},"20":{"text":"Vetan, vo Pakai, koi chunga hitobanghi nabol em, geltemin. Numei hon alaigilgau khap khat bep chapangho chu anehdiu hitam? Thempuho le themgaoho chu Pakai muntheng sunga kithattei ding hitaovem?"},"21":{"text":"Ateh akhang lamlen ho-a tolla alumtaove, nungah theng kanei hole gollhangho chemjamin alougam taove, nangman nalunghan niho-a amaho natha ahitai. Nangman nathatnin khotona naneitapon ahi."},"22":{"text":"Nangman nikho loupi ni-a bangin katijat naho nasam khomin, hitichun Pakai lunghanna nikhon koimacha ajamdoh theile aumden theija aumpoi. Keiman kahuiluma kavahdoh ho chu kamelma hon asumang heltai."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Alungsatna tenggola hesohna ana mu-a chu keima kahi.","title":"Gimbolna, Lungheina le Kinepna"},"2":{"text":"Aman vah hilouvin, muthima keima eipuilutnin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tahbeh-in aman keima eikidoupin, nilhum keijin kachunga akhut alamin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Aman kaphele kavun avoilhah sah-in, kaguho jong asubongtan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Aman kei dounan kul agenin, thoh hahsa nasatahle gimna-in eiumkhum tan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Aman khanglui laipeh-a anathisaho bangin, munthim lah-a eiumsah-in ahi."},"7":{"text":"Aman keima tho eikai khumin, kapot thei tapoi. Aman kakihenna thihkhao agihsah-e."},"8":{"text":"Keima kapma kepen teng jongle aman kataona akhahchah jitai."},"9":{"text":"Aman song kikheng ho-a ka lampiho akhah-in, kalampiho akonsah gam ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Ama chu keidin vompile keipi bahkai muthim laija um abange."},"11":{"text":"Aman kalampiho ahei mangin, chule eimaltel jengin; aman kamhellin eisotai."},"12":{"text":"Aman athal akamsalin, thalchang chuhna ding lama keima eikoitai."},"13":{"text":"Aman alivatheija thalchang ho chu kalung changa chudin akaplutsoh tai."},"14":{"text":"Keima kamite jouse henga totnopna bep kahitan, chule nilhum keija alasah-u kahitai."},"15":{"text":"Aman keima thil akhatna kha-in eidipmin, chule gamsai twijin eivahkham tai."},"16":{"text":"Aman songbong hemho mangcha-in kahaho eisuhboh peh-in, vutvaijin eivuhkhum tai."},"17":{"text":"Chule chamna-a konin kahina gamla tah-in nachon mangin, phattheina jong kasumiltai."},"18":{"text":"Keiman Pakaiya konin kathahat nale kakinep naho amang heltai, kati."},"19":{"text":"Kahesoh nale gentheina chule kathohgimna, gamsaile gil kha chu kagel doh-in ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kahin nahin hicheho chu ageldoh-in, chule keima suhnemin kaumin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hichehi kalungin kagah gelin, keiman hichea chun kinepna kaneitai."},"22":{"text":"Pakai khoto them naho jala bou suhgama umlou ihiuve, ajehchu amihepina chu alhasam ngaipoi."},"23":{"text":"Hicheho chu jingkah seh-in athah jingin, nakitahna chu alenin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Kachan ding chu Pakai ahi, hijeh-a chu ama-a kakinep ding ahi, tin kahinna hin aseije."},"25":{"text":"Pakai chu ama ngahjing tele, ama holjing mite dingin aphan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Mihem khat dinga Pakai mi huhhingna chu kinema thipbeh-a nga chu thilpha ahi."},"27":{"text":"Mihem dingin akhandon laija namkoljon poh hi aphan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ama achang seh-in thipbeh-in atouve, ajehchu aman hichu achunga apoh ahi."},"29":{"text":"Kinepna-a aumtheina dingin, aman leivui lah-a akam asulutnin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Aman adengpa chu abengphe adopeh-in; housetna-a jong adimin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakaiyin a-imatih-a apaidoh louhel ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Amavang aman sugim jengjongle, amihepi themna tamtah jala chu hepina anei ding ahi."},"33":{"text":"Ajehchu aman, mihem chate chu aphat sah jeh-a asuhgentheija, ahiloule asuhgimji ahipoi."},"34":{"text":"Leisetna sohchangho chu akengtoa chil goija umding ahiuvin,"},"35":{"text":"Chungnung pen masang tah-a mihem khat thaneina lahdohna dinga,"},"36":{"text":"Mihem khat ama hina noisehi, Pakaiyin pha asapon ahi."},"37":{"text":"Pakai jin thu apeh louleh, athusei lhunsah theija chu koiham?"},"38":{"text":"Asele apha hungdoh nahi chungnung pen kama kon hilou ham?"},"39":{"text":"Mihem khatnin achonset jeh-a talen amat chu, mihing khatnin ipi dinga aphunpi ham?"},"40":{"text":"Eihon ilampihou kiholu hitin, chule kipatepmu hitin Pakai lama kihei kitnu hite."},"41":{"text":"Eihon ilungsung houle ikhut houvin van ho-a um Pathen lam sangu hite."},"42":{"text":"Keihon kana sukhelun, chule kanadoutaove, nangman neingaidam tapouve."},"43":{"text":"Nangma lunghan na-in nakikhu-in, chule neisugimun ahi. Nangman nathatnin, khotona naneipoi."},"44":{"text":"Nangman kataona hou ahunglutpai thei louna din nangle nang meilom'in nakitomin ahi."},"45":{"text":"Nangman miho lah-a keiho deiloule bohnen bangin neisem taove,"},"46":{"text":"Kamel mate jouseu keiho dounan akam kataovin ahi."},"47":{"text":"Tijat nale thangkol chule suhgamna le kachunguva kamhelna chu ahung lhungtai."},"48":{"text":"Kamipite chanu kisuh gamna jeh-in kamitlhi luijin along jenge."},"49":{"text":"Kamitlhi apulin, tanglou helin alongdoh doh jenge,"},"50":{"text":"Pakaiyin van'a kona ahin suhvetna ahinmu kahsen,"},"51":{"text":"Kakhopi sunga chanute jouse jeh-in kamitnin kalung atong khatan ahi."},"52":{"text":"Kamelma ten ajeh beijin vacha bangin nasatah-in eidel lele jeng taove."},"53":{"text":"Amahon leinoi kotong sunga kahinkho asumangun, chule kachung song khatnin adelphaove."},"54":{"text":"Twiho kalu chunga alongin, hichun keiman amangthah-a kahitai, kati."},"55":{"text":"Vo Pakai leinoi kotong thuhtah-a konin keiman namin kahinsamin ahi."},"56":{"text":"Nangman ka awgin najai, kakana le kahai ginna konin nanakhang heimang hih-in."},"57":{"text":"Keiman nangma kahinhou nikhon nahung naijin: kicha hih-in, neitin ahi."},"58":{"text":"Vo Pakai, kalung sunga thil umho neisei hun, nangman kahinkho neilhatdoh pehtai."},"59":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nangin kathemmona namutai, kathu neitan peh-in."},"60":{"text":"Nangman kei douna-a alunggel houle aphulahnao jouse namutan ahi."},"61":{"text":"Vo Pakai, amahon eihouset naole eidehnaova alunggelu nangman najatai."},"62":{"text":"Keima douna-a hung kipandoh ho muhle, nilhum keija keima dehna-a agonu abonchan nangman najasoh tai."},"63":{"text":"Amaho toulhahle kipatdoh khu vetan, alasah-u jong keima jontai nabep ahitai."},"64":{"text":"Vo Pakai, akhutnuva athilbolu dungjuijin amaho lethuhna pen."},"65":{"text":"Nangin amaho nasapsetna le lungthim natna chu pen."},"66":{"text":"Pakai vanho noija konin lunghanna in amaho bolgimin lang sumangin."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"I-atile sana mol lha-a hitam! I-atile sana thengtah kikhel jenga hitam! Munthenga songho chu lamlhah tin chenga akisunglha tai.","title":"Akisuhlhuh Nunga Jerusalem Dinmun"},"2":{"text":"Manlutah Zion chapate chu sana thengtah toh tethei ahin, i-atile amaho beldengpan leibel aden bangbepma umu hitam!"},"3":{"text":"Twi saiho jengin jong anoi adon, anoute avah-in ahi. Kamite chanuho hi gamthipma vacha lengho bangin alungselun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Noi cheplai naosen lei chu dang chah-in adanga abehden tai. Chapang khangdong laihon an athumun ahinla koiman apepouve."},"5":{"text":"Annem ne-a hung kivahho chu khopi lamlen ho-a amahthah gamtaovin; ponsanthip silla hung kivahdohho chun eh kisungvum adeijuve."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu kamite chanute khangitlouna talen chu mitphet kah louva kisumang Sodom chonsetna talen sangin alenjoi, chule amanu chunga chun koimacha khut achupoi.","ref":"Semt 19:24."},"7":{"text":"Amanu Nazire mi hina chu buhbang sangin atheng jon, bongnoi sangin abang jon, avouso chu songmantam sangin ahoijon, ahoidan chu Saphir song tobang ahi."},"8":{"text":"Amaho mel chu meihol sangin avom jotan, lamlen ho-ah amaho hetphah-in aumtapouve. Avunhou chu aguhouva abeh-in, molkangto abang jengtai."},"9":{"text":"Chemjam'a kithat ho chu kela thiding hosangin aphajotai. Ajehchu hichehohi lou gasoh ngaichatnan anguijin amangthah jitauve."},"10":{"text":"Khotona nei numei ho khut chun achateu achul chulun, kamite kisuh mangna-a chun amaho chu a-an uvin apang taovin ahi.","ref":"Danb 28:57; Ezek 5:10."},"11":{"text":"Pakaiyin alungsatna chu amolso tan; aman alunghana nasatah chu ahin bunglhatai, chule Zion'a mei akongdoh tai, chule hichun thil bulho chu asumangtan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Leisetna lenghole vannoi'a chengho jousen, akidoupi amelmau chu Jerusalem kotpiho sunga alut jou taove ti anaginchat louhel dingu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu amanu lailung tah-a chu themgaoho chonsetna le thempuho khangitlou jeh-a chondihho thisan kiso-a ahi."},"14":{"text":"Amaho mitcho ho bangin khopi lamlen ho-a avah leuvin, mihon avonhou atohkhah nomlouna diuvin thisanin akisuboh-un ahi."},"15":{"text":"Amahon ajah uva, nangho chemangun, potdoh-un, potdoh-un, hiche hi tongkha hih-un, athengpoi tin asamui, amaho ajam manguva avalele phatnun, amahon Pathen heloute lah-a, amaho chua chun chele tapouvinte tin aseijuve."},"16":{"text":"Pakai lunghanna chun amaho asukhentan, aman amaho khohsah kit taponte, amahon thempuho ajabol tapouvin, chule upaho jong angaisah tapouvin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Eiho dingin vang, kithopi pannabei ivetna lamun imitnu athontai, ivetvet naovahin eihuhdoh jou louvu nam khat ivedoh taove."},"18":{"text":"Amahon ikalson nao ahindel peh-un, ikhopi lamlen hou ijot thei tapouve, ikichainao anaijin, inikhohou alhingin, ajehchu ikichainao chu ahung lhungtai."},"19":{"text":"Eiho eisugenthei hou chu van'a mulaopi ho sangin agang jouvin, amahon lhangsang ho chunga eidelun, amahon gamthipma eiho eichang lhiuve."},"20":{"text":"In'ah homuva hu, Pakai thaonu, eihon ama lim noija Pathen heloute lah-a chenginge itiu chu, amahon akokhuh sunguva eikoi taove."},"21":{"text":"Uz gama chenga, vo Edom chanu kipah-in lang thanomin; khon jong chun nangma nahinphah ding ahi. Nangma nakham ngoldel ding; ahi, chule nangle nang sagohkeo nakiso ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Vo Zion chanu, nakhangitlouna talen namu chu akimolso tai. Aman nangma gal hingin nakai kit taponte, aman nakhangit louna jeh-a gotna napehding ahin, Vo Edom chanu, aman nachonset naho ahung mudoh ding ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hingel doh-in, vo Pakai, kachunguva ipi hung lhunga hitam, ngaiton, chule ven keiho kiphosalnahi.","title":"Hepina Dinga Taona"},"2":{"text":"Kagouhou le kainhou hetlou mite hengle gamdang miho heng lama akiheitai."},"3":{"text":"Keiho naochaga le paneilou kahitaove, kanuteu jong meithaiho abang taove."},"4":{"text":"Katwihou man neijin kadonun; kathinghou keiho henga akijoh-in ahi."},"5":{"text":"Kangonghou suhgentheina noija aumtan; katong gimun olna himhim kanei tapouve."},"6":{"text":"Keihon neh le chah lonan kakhutnu Egypt mite leh Assyria mite henga kapetaove."},"7":{"text":"Kapateu anachonseuvin, tun aum tapouve, chule keihon amaho khangitlouna kapouvin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Soh hon kachunguva vai ahomun, amaho khutna kona eihuhdoh uva koimacha aumpoi."},"9":{"text":"Gamthipma chemjam jeh-in thina geijin neh kakilouvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Kel hoisetah jeh-in kavunu jong lungthu bangin avom jeng tai."},"11":{"text":"Amahon Zion'a numei ho le Judah khopiho-a nungah ho asuseuvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Leng chapate akhutnun akikhaisangin; upaho mai jong jana akipepoi."},"13":{"text":"Amahon gollhangho sumhei hehdin apuijun, chule chapangho thing noija alhugam taove."},"14":{"text":"Kotpi phunga kon upaho, chule tumging theija konin gollhangho abangtauve."},"15":{"text":"Kalung sunguva kipana abangtai, kalamnao jong lunghemna asohtai."},"16":{"text":"Kalu uva konin lallukhuh alhatai; kanachonset jehu'n, Ohe ada kahiuve!"},"17":{"text":"Hichejeh hin kalungu alhamang tan; ajehchu hicheho jeh-a kamit hou thima ahitai."},"18":{"text":"Zion molsang kamhela aumtah jeh-in, sial ho achunga avahleuvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nangma a-imatih chana umjing nahi, nalaltouna chu akhang akhanga umjinga ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chutia chu nangman keiho imatih chana dinga neisuhmilu hija, chule hitihchan pihi neidalhah-u hitam?"},"21":{"text":"Vo Pakai, naheng lama keiho neiheijun, chutile hung kihei taovinge, malaija bangin kanikho hou neisemthah peh-un."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla nangman keiho neipaimang hel taovin; keiho dounan kachunguva nalung ahanglhehtan ahi."}}}}},"26":{"info":{"name":"Ezekiel","shortname":"Ezek","abbr":[],"desc":"Ezekiel Themgao Lekhabu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun ahung hitin ahi, kum somthum lhinkum, lhali channa ani nga channin, sohchangho lah-a Chebar vadunglen panga kaumpet tah-in, vanho anakihongin chule keiman Pathen'a kon thilmuho kanamun ahi.","title":"EZEKIEL'IN PATHEN GAOVA AMU AMASA (1:1—7:27) Pathen Laltouna","ref":"Tph 19:11."},"2":{"text":"Chuche lhasung ninga channi, leng Jehoiachin sohchan kal akum nga channa-in,","ref":"2 Leng 24:10-16; 2 Thusm 36:9-10"},"3":{"text":"Pakai thu chu kilangtah-in, Buzi chapa Ezekiel thempu henga, Chaldea miho gamsung Chebar vadunglen panga ahung lhungin, Pakai khut chu ama chunga ahung kingame."},"4":{"text":"Chuin keiman kagahvetle, veuvin chimpei khat sahlama konin ahungdoh-in, meilom lentah khat achama vahjeng, akimvel vah pempum, chuche lailunga meilah-a kon chun a-eng dum banga vahjeng aumin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hicheho lailung tah-a kon chun ganhing toh kiloutah li ahungdoh-in, chule hichehi amaho melputdan chu ahi; amaho chun mihem melput tobang apuvin ahi.","ref":"Tph 4:6"},"6":{"text":"Chule khatcheh-in mai li aneijuvin, chule khatcheh-in lhaving li aneijuve."},"7":{"text":"Chule amaho keng khophang chu ajangpetnin, akeng khophang hou chu bongnou keng khophang tobang ahin; chule hicheho chu sum-eng kinotval bangin avalsetnin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule amahon apang li uva alhaving hou noija chun mihem khut tobang aneicheh uvin; chule amaho li chun mai le lhaving aneicheh uve."},"9":{"text":"Alhaving hou chu khatle khat akisumat cheh-in, amaho chu ache tengule kiheile louvin, abonchauvin jang petnin angat nalang uva ache jiuve."},"10":{"text":"Amaho li maiso melput dan chu, mihem maiso apucheh uvin, chule ajetlam panguva keipi bahkai maiso apu uvin; aveilam panguva bongchal maiso apu uvin; chule ali uvin mulaopi maiso jong apucheh uve.","ref":"Ezek 10:14; Tph 4:7."},"11":{"text":"Amaho maiso chu hitobang hi ahin, alhavinghou chu chunglam ngan akijal touvin, lhaving ni chu khatle khat akisumatnin, chule ni chun amaho tahsapum akhu khume."},"12":{"text":"Chule amaho abonchauvin jangpetnin malama acheuvin, lhagao chena ding lam lama chun amaho acheuve; chule amaho ache tengule akiheile pouve."},"13":{"text":"Ganhingho chu hitobang ahiuve, alimso dan chu song meihol kou lenglung abangin, chule thaomei vah jong abange. Hiche thaomei vah chu ganhingho lah-a achesuh achetouvin; chule meikou chu avahsetnin, meikouva kon chun kolphe asohdoh-in ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule ganhingho chu kolphe vah bangin alhaijun, chule ahung kileuve."},"15":{"text":"Tun keiman ganhingho kavet petchun, veuvin leiset chunga um mai li nei ganhingho kom cheh-a chun, kangtalai kang khat cheh ahung ume.","ref":"Ezek 10:9-13."},"16":{"text":"Hiche kangtalai kangho lim umdan le akisemdan chu khisong engdum abangin; chule amaho li hin kibahna khat aneijuve. Amaho limdan le amaho kisemdan chu, kangtalai kang lailung tah-a kangtalai kang um abange."},"17":{"text":"Amaho ache tengule, apangli uvah acheuvin; amaho ache tengule akiheile pouve."},"18":{"text":"Kangtalai kang kikol ho chu ahile, amaho chu asang behseh un tijatjat aum jengin; chule amaho li kimvela hiche kangtalai kang kol ho-a chun mit adimset jengin ahi.","ref":"Tph 4:8"},"19":{"text":"Chule ganhingho chu ache tengule Kangtalai kang ho chun ajuijin, chule ganhingho chu leisetna kona dopsanga aumtengle, kangtalai kang hojong dopsangin aum jiuve."},"20":{"text":"Hoilam hile lhagao chenom nalam lama amaho acheuve; ajehchu chulam chu amaho lhagao chena ding chu ahin; chule amaho chutoh kangtalai kang chu dopsangin aume. Ijeh inem itile ganhingho lhagao chu kangtalai kang ho-a chu uma ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chucheho acheteng, hicheho acheuvin; chule chucheho adinteng, hicheho adinguvin; chule leisetna kona dopsanga aumteng, kangtalai kang ho chu amahotoh dopsangin aumuvin ahi. Ijeh inem itile ganhingho lhagao chu kangtalai kang ho-a chu uma ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule ganhingho luchunga vanthamjol banga umchu songval abangin, hichu alu chunguva akikhang jengin ahi.","ref":"Tph 4:6."},"23":{"text":"Chule hiche vanthamjol noija chun alhavinghou jangpetnin khatle khat akingat to uvin, atahsao pang khatlam chu lhaving nin akhu khumin, atahsao langkhat lampang chu lhaving ni ma-in akhu khumin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule amaho ache tengule, alhavinghou hugin chu twipiho gin tobang, Hatchung nungpen awgin tobang, thukisei awgin tobangle, janel ho husa gin tobangin kajan ahi. Amaho adin tengule alhavinghou chu amahon akoilha jiuvin ahin.","ref":"Tph 1:15; 19:6"},"25":{"text":"Chule amaho adinuva, alhavinghou atimlhah tengule, alu vumuva um vantham jola kon chun awgin khat ahung gingdoh jin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule alu vumuva vanthamjol um chunga chun laltouna tobang khat aumin, khisong dumjet to abangin; chule hiche laltouna tobang chunga chun mihem tobang khat aume.","ref":"Ezek 10:1; Tph 4:2-3."},"27":{"text":"Chule keiman akong chunglamse chu a-engdum tobang, asung akimvelse chu meikou bang jengin kamun; chule akonga pat anoilamse chu meikou tobang, akimvelse vah lenglung bangin kamun ahi.","ref":"Ezek 8:2"},"28":{"text":"Gojuh nikho-a meilhang lah-a lhagui lim kimu bang khun, akimvel chu avahpempum jengin ahi. Hiche chu Pakai loupi limso kilang chu ahi. Chuin hichu kamu phatnin, tolla kamai kasulut jengin, chule thu kisei awgin khat kajatan ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin aman kajah-a, Mihem chapa, nakengin dingdoh-in, chule keiman nahenga thu kasei ding ahi, ati.","title":"Pathen'in Ezekiel Themgao Dinga Akou"},"2":{"text":"Aman kahenga thu asei phatnin lhagao chu kasunga ahung lutnin, chuin kahenga athusei chu kajah theina din, kakengin eidinsah-e."},"3":{"text":"Chule aman kajah-a, Mihem chapa keima douna-a kiphinjing, thungailou Israel chate henga kasol nahi. Amahole apu apateuvin keima dounan tunikho geijin chonset abol jingun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu amahohi jumle jalam helou lungtah chate ahiuve. Keiman nangma kasol nahin, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, tia amaho naseipeh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule amahohin, ngaiju henlang ngaihih tajongleu, (ajehchu amahohi kiphin nom insung ahiuvin,) amaho lah-a themgao khat anaum nalaije ti ahet dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule nangma mihem chapa, amaho chu kicha hih-in, athuseiju jong kicha hih-in; ling le khaovin nabom henlang, aipi lah-a cheng hijongle chun; amaho thungailou insung hijongleu, athuseijun kicha hih-in, chule amit vetnun jong lungthoi hih-in."},"7":{"text":"Chule amahon ngaijuhen, ahiloule ngaihih jongleu, keima thuhi ahenguva naseitei ding ahi. Ijeh-inem itile amahohi mikiphin nomte mong ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Ahin nangma mihem chapa, keiman nahenga kaseihi ngaijin; nangma chutobang thungailou insung bangin, thungailouvin umhih beh-in. Nakam hinkan, chule keiman kapehhi nen, ati."},"9":{"text":"Hichun keiman kagahven ahile, veuvin, kahenga khut khat ahung kilhang doh-in, chule ven, hiche sunga chun lekhabu jol khat aume.","ref":"Tph 5:1"},"10":{"text":"Chuin aman hichu ka anga apha jal-in ahi, hichu asungle apoa kisun ahi. Hiche sunga chun kana le lunghemna chule dana thu akisune."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chukal valin aman kahenga, Mihem chapa, namu chu nejengin; hiche lekhajol hi nen, chule chenlang Israel insung henga thu gaseijin, ati.","ref":"Tph 10:9-10."},"2":{"text":"Hitichun keiman kakam kakan, chule aman chuche lekhajol chu einehsah tai."},"3":{"text":"Chuin aman kahenga, Mihem chapa na oisunga lutsah-in, chule keiman kapeh hiche lekhajol hin nasung dimsah in, tin aseije. Hichun keiman kanen ahile, kakam sunga khoiju lhumin alhumin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin aman kahenga aseije, Mihem chapa, chen, Israel insung henga gachen, chule keima thuho hi amaho henga gaseijin."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu gamdang paole pao hahsa mite henga kisol nahipon, ahinla Israel insung heng joh-a nangma kisola nahibouve."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu hetkhahlou paole ham tho nam mite leh pao hahsa nam mite henga kisola nahipoi. Tahbeh-in, amaho henga chun keiman nangma anasol leng, amaho chun nangma thu anangai diu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla Israel insungin vang nangma thu angailou dingu ahi; ajehchu amahon keima thusei jong angailou dingu ahi. Ijeh-inem itile Israel insung pumpihi jachat helou ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Ven, keiman amaho maitoh kitatto dinga namai kasuhtah-a, chule amaho chalpang toh kitatto dinga nachalpang kasuhtah ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Keiman meituh song sanga tahjo thiltah bangin nachalpang kasempehtai. Amaho ginghih beh-in, amaho thungailou insung khat hijeng jongleu, amelput aumdanhou jeh-in nangma lunglhalou jenin, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chukal valin, aman kahenga hitin asei kitnin, Mihem chapa, keiman nahenga kahinsei ding kathuho abonchan nalung sunga kisan lutnin lang, nanakhangin ngaijin."},"11":{"text":"Chule chen, sohchanga um namite le achateu henga nangma galutnin lang, amahon ngaijuhen lang ngaihih jongleu, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, tin amaho henga gaseijin lang gahilin, tin aseije."},"12":{"text":"Chuin lhagaovin eilatouvin, kanung lama chun aw sangtah-a kisei thu khat kajan, hiche aw chun, Amun thenga Pakai loupi chu vahchoijin umhen, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chujongle keiman ganhing ho lhavingho khatle khat akitoh khahto ginle, amaho koma um kangtalai kang ho kitol nasatah gin kajan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hiti chun lhagaovin keima eilatoutan, chule eipui mangtan, chuin lung nommo tahle ka lhagao lunggim tah-in kachetai; ahivangin kachunga Pakai khut chu ahatnin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman Chebar vadunglen panga cheng, Tel-abib'a sohchanga umho heng kalhungtan, chule keima amaho touna-a katouvin, kidang satah in amaho lah-a ni sagi kaumin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin ni sagi kichainin ahitin ahi, hitichun Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin,","title":"Pakaiyin Ezekiel Vesui Dinga Apansah (Ezek 33:1-9)"},"17":{"text":"Mihem chapa, keiman nangma Israel insung dinga avesui diuva kasem nahitai. Hijeh chun keima kamsunga kon thupot ngaijin, chule keima-a konin amaho gihsalin, ati."},"18":{"text":"Keiman mi khang gilou henga, nangma thonlouva nathi teiding ahi kati-a; nangman ama chu gihna pelouva, ahiloule agilou chu agitlouna lampiho-a kona ahinkho akihuhdohna dinga thu imacha ama gihna-a naseipeh loule; chutobang agiloupa chu akhansetna-a chu thitei ding ahin; amavang ama thisan chu keiman nangma khutna kahin ngeh ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Nangman agiloupa chu nanagih nah-a, ama agitlouna-a konle agitlouna lampia kona akiheidoh loule, akhansetna-a chu thitei ding ahin; amavang nangman nahinna nakihuh doh ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chukitle, michonpha chu, achonphatna-a kona kihei manga, gitlouna abolteng, keiman amasanga kipal lhuhna kakoija, ama thitei ding ahi; ajehchu nangman gihsalna nanapeh loujeh-a achonsetna-a thiding, chule achonphatna thilbolho chu kigeldoh lou ding ahitai; amavang ama thisan chu keiman nangma khutna kangeh ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hijeng jongle, nangman michonpha chu gihna napeh-a, chonphan chonset abolji poi nati-a, chonset bol louva aumle, thonlouva hingtei ding ahi; ajehchu ama chun kigihna asangin; nangman jong nahinna nakihuh doh ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chukoma chun Pakai khut chu kachunga akingamin, chule aman kahenga, thoudoh inlang phaichama khun gachen, chule chukoma chu keiman nangma kakihoupi ding nahi, ati.","title":"Ezekial Paothei Louva Aumding"},"23":{"text":"Chuin kakipatdoh-in, phaichama chun kachetai. Chuin veuvin, Chebar vadunglen panga kanamu loupina, Pakai loupina chu anadingin ahi. Hichun keiman tolla kamai kasulut tai."},"24":{"text":"Hichun lhagao chu kasunga ahung lutnin, kakengin eidin sah-in, chule keima eikihoupin, kajah-a, Chen, na insunga gaum chahbeh-in, ati."},"25":{"text":"Hijongle Vo nangma mihem chapan, vetan, amahon nachunga khaohol ho ahinkoi diu, hicheho-a chu nakandiu ahin, chule amaho lah-a nagache dohle louding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule keiman napaomona dingle amaho dinga aphohsalpao nahilouna dinga, nalei chu nadanga kabesah ding ahi. Ajehchu amaho thungailou insung ahiuve."},"27":{"text":"Ahinla nahenga thu kasei tengle, keiman nakam kahona, chule nangman amaho henga, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, tia nagasei ding; angainom pan angaiding, chule angainomlou pan angaida ding ahi. Ajehchu amahohi thungailou insung ahiuve."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihem chapa, nangman leingan kigoutah khat lanlang, hichu namasanga koijin, chule hiche chunga chun khopi lim, Jerusalem lim chu semin.","title":"Ezekiel'in Jerusalem Ki-um Kimvel ding Lim Avetsah"},"2":{"text":"Chule hichu galmiho umkimvel sah inlang, hiche khopi dounan kulbang sah khumin, chule adounan molsang khat tundoh khumin lang, gebuh jong sah khumin, chule akimvela chun kulbang suhsetna manchah ho tung doh-in."},"3":{"text":"Chukal valin nangman thihpheng tupeh khat lanlang, hichu nangmale hiche khopi kah-a chun thihbang kidal bangin dalin; chule hiche lam chu mai ngatnin, chule hichu ki-um kimvel ding, nangman naum kimvel ding ahi. Hichehi Israel insung dinga melchihna hiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Naveilam pang delphan lumin, chule hiche chunga chun Israel insung khangitlouna ho chu koijin; chutobanga hiche chunga nalup nikho jat dungjuija chu nangman amaho khan gitlouna chu napohpeh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu anikho jat dungjuija ni jathum le somko, keiman nachunga akhansetnao kumho chu kakoi ahitai. Hitia hi nangman Israel insung khan gitlouna chu napoh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule nangman hiho chu nasuhbulhit tengle, nangma najetlam panga nalup kitna, chule Judah insung khan gitlouna chu nisomli napoh ding ahi. Keiman nangma dinga nikhat chu kum khatna kasimpeh nahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nangman Jerusalem ki-um kimvel lam chu namai ngat ding, chule naban chu nahodoh-a, hiche khopi douna-a chu gaothu naseiding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule ven, keiman khaohol ho-a kakanna, chule naki-um kimvelna nikhoho nasuhbei kahse-a, nangma langkhatna kona langkhatna kihei theilouva naum ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chujongle nangman, suhlouchang le sakolchang, chule bepi le bepal, chule butun le lengmusel lan lang umbel khatna koijin, chule hicheho-a kon chun nasih-a nalup ding nikhoho dungjuijin changlhah kisemin, hichu nikho jathum le somko sunga chu nangman naneh ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule nangman nikhatna nanehding anchu agihdan shekel somni hiding; chule aphat phatna hichu naneh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangman twi jong teptena neija nadon ding, hin dimkhat hopgupma kihom hopkhat hiding; hichu aphat phatna nadon ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule nangman amaho mitmu dinga mihem'a kona hungdoh eh chu changlhah-a nakana, hichu sakol changa kisem changlhah banga naneh ding ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin aseije, Hitobanga chu Israel chaten, keiman amaho kanodohna chidang namdangho lah-a chu suhbohsa changlhahho aneh dingu ahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Hichun keiman, Pakai Pathen, vetan, kahinna suhboh-in ana um khapoi; ijeh inem itile kakhang dona pat tuchan geijin athikam, ahiloule akimaltelsa kiti kanehih laije; kakam sunga jong thet um saphe alutkha hih laijin ahi, tin kaseitai."},"15":{"text":"Chuin aman kahenga aseijin, Ven, mihem eh khelin bong eh kape-e, nangman hichea chu changlhah nakisem ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chukalvalin aman kahenga aseijin, Mihem chapa, vetan, keiman Jerusalem'a changlhah hung kipohlutna bul chu kasuhtan ding; chule amahon changlhah agih-a ateova chule itcha tah-a aneh dingu; chule amahon twi jong teptena neija chule kidang satah-a adon dingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chutia chu amahon changlhah le twi ahin ngaichat uva, chule khatle khat kidatmoto diu, akhan gitlounao jeh-a mangthah diu ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule nangma, mihem chapa, chemcha hemthet khat kilah-in, samvoupa samchem kilah-in, chule hichun naluchang le nakhamul vouvin; chuteng atenadin khaikot lanlang, sam chu homkhenin.","title":"Ezekiel'in Asam Akivomui"},"2":{"text":"Khopi akiumna nikhoho chu alhin tengle, hop thuma hopkhat chu khopi lailung tah-a meija nahal ding; chule hopthum-a hopkhat nalah-a, hichu chemcha khatna nasat bong ding; chule hopthum-a hopkhat chu hui lah-a nathejal ding; chule anungu chemjam'a kajui ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nangman hicheho lah-a kona chu phabep khat nalah-a, chule hicheho chu naponsil monga nakhi ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuteng nangman hicheho chu nalahkit ding, chule hicheho chu meikong lailung tah-a naselutna, chule hicheho chu meisunga nahalvam ding ahi, ajehchu hichea kona chu meikou khat hungdoh-a, Israel insung pumpi sunga lutding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Hichehi Jerusalem ahi; Keiman amanu hi akimvela um namho le gamho lailung tah-a katundoh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule amanun namdangho sangin kathutana hi gitlounan asodoh-in, chule akimvela um gamho sangin kadan kisunho chu gitlounan aha sodoh-in ahi. Ajehchu amahon kathutana hole kadan kisunho alapouvin, hicheho chu ajuipouvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, nangho nakimvel uva um namtin ho sanga napunjoh jeh-ule, kadan kisunho jong najui tahlou jeh-un; chule kathutanho jong nanit tahlou jeh-ule, nakimvel uva um namtin ho thutan ho dungjuija jong na natoh tahlou jeh-un;"},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Ven, keima, keimatah ngeijong nangho douva pang kahitan, chule namtinho mitmu chang tah-a nalah uva thutanna kalhut ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule keiman kanabol khahlou, chule atobang jong avela kabolkit louding chu, thet umtah nathilbol hou jeh-a nachung uva kabolding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nalah uva paten chapate ahin neh uva, chule chapaten apateu ahin neh dingu; chule keiman nachunga thutanna kalhunsah ding, chule nalah uva ahingdoh amoh chengse chu abonchauva hui lah-a kathecheh ding ahi.","ref":"Kala 4:10"},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun, Pakai Pathen'in, keima hing jingjeng kahito lhonin, nangman kamun theng chu ningset umtahle, thilbohho jouse-a nasuhboh tah jeh-a, thonlouva keiman jong nangma ka kemsuh sah ding; kamitnin jong khen aneideh lou ding, khotona kiti imacha jong kaneilou ding ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Nangma-a hopthum-a hopkhat chu hise-a thidingu, chule nalah tah-a amaho chu kella suhmanga umdiu; chule hopthum-a hopkhat chu nakimvela chemjam'a lou dingu; chule hopthum-a hopkhat chu keiman huija kathecheh ding, chule chemjam'a kanungdel ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chutia chu kalunghana chu kasuh bulhitna, kalungsatna achunguva chuding, chuteng kalungmon ding ahi, chutia chu kalungsatna achunguva kabulhit teng, Pakai kitipa keiman katom panna-a hichehi kasei ahi ahetdoh dingu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chukalvala keiman nakimvela um namho lah le achele jouse mitmu-a, khopi chimsa le noise umtah-a kasemdoh ding nahi."},"15":{"text":"Keiman lunghanna le lungsat na-a, chule lungsa tah-a phona-a nachunga thutanna kahinnei tengle, nakimvela um namtin ho dinga noise umtah le isahlou, kihilna le datmo um nahiding ahi. Keima Pakaiyin kaseidoh ahitai."},"16":{"text":"Keiman amaho dinga manthah na, chule nangma sumang dinga kel lhahna thalchang giloutah kahinsol tengle; keiman nachung uva kel lhahna kapunsah ding, nachang lhah-u hungkondohna chu kasuhtan ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chutia chu keiman kel le gamsa gilou nachung uva kahinlan sah ding, hicheho chun nachateo ahinsuhmang ding; chule hisele thisanin nangma nahinphah ding; chule keiman chemjam chu nachunga kahinchuhsah ding ahi. Keima Pakai Pathen'in kaseidoh ahitai.","ref":"Tph 6:8"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,","title":"Pakaiyin Milimhou Themmo Achan"},"2":{"text":"Mihem chapa, Israel molsang ho lam nganlang, amaho dounan gaothu seijin,"},"3":{"text":"Nangho Israel molsang ho, Pakai Pathen thu ngaijun; Pakai Pathen'in molsang ho, lhangho, vadungho chule phaicham ho henga hitin aseije; Vetan keima, keimatah ngeijin nangho chunga chemjam kahin chuhsah ding, chule keiman namun sang hou chu kasuhmang ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule namaicham hou chu hung kamhel ding, semthu milimho jong suhsetna umding; chule keiman akithatsa namite chu namilimhou masanga kaselhah ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule keiman Israel chate thilongho chu alim semthuhou angsunga kalelhah ding; chule naguhou chu namaicham hou kimvela kathechap jeng ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Namaicham hou akeohel le akamhela aumna ding, na pathen semthuhou suhkeh le suhmanga aum nading, namilim semthuhou satlhah-a auma, chule nanatoh hou suhmanga aum theina dinga; nangho chenna mun jouse-a khopiho chu ahom keuva kilha ding, chule munsang jouse chu kamhela umding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule akithat ho chu nalah tah uva lhujeng ding ahiuvin, chuteng keima Pakai chu kahi nahetdoh dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahijeng vangin nangho gamho-a thecheh-a nahung umtengule, namtinho lah-a chemjam'a asohcha phabep nanghon nanei theina dinguva keiman ahingdoh amoh honkhat kadalhah ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule nalah uva asohchase vang chun gal hinga akikai lutna lam lamu namtinho lah-a chu keima eihin geldoh jing dingu ahi, ajehchu keija kona anapetmang jonlung poho lungsung, chule amit hou jonmit po-a alim semthuhou juiho chutoh kakikhen ahitai. Chule amaho akisuh bohnao jouse-a agilou anaboldoh jouseu jeh-a chu amahole amaho kikidah ding ahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Chule keima Pakai kahi leh, hiche thilse amaho chunga kahinbol ding chu moh-a kasei ahipoi ti amahon ahetdiu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Nakhutnin jepmin, chule nakengin lhonlang seijin, ohe, ada ahiuve! ijeh inem itile Israel insung gilou thet umtahho jeh-a, amaho chemjam'a, kella, chule hise-a lougam ding ahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Koihileh gamlatah-a umchu hise-a thitei ding, chule koihile anaija uma chu chemjam'a loutei ding, chule koihile aumden le umkimvel khuma uma chu kella thitei ding ahiuve. Hiti ahi keiman kalungsatna chu amaho chunga kamolso ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chutengle amilimhou hou lah-a, amaichamu kimvela, lhangsung chung tina, molsang ho chungvum tina, chule thinghing phungnoi tina, gangpi phungnoi tina, amilimhou henga gimnamtui apehnao munho jouse-a chu akithat ho sechu ahung umtengle, nanghon keima Pakai kahi nahet dingu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hiti ahi keiman achunguva kakhut kalhah-a, agamu kamhela kalha ding; chule Diblath lama gamthip sanga jong kamhel jo-a kalha ding ahi. Chule amahon keima Pakai kahi chu eihin hetdoh dingu ahi, ati."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche chungchon chun Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,","title":"Israel Kichaina Ding Anaitai"},"2":{"text":"Nangma mihem chapa, Pakai Pathen'in Israel gam henga hiti jonghin aseije; Achaina, achaina chu gam ningliho chunga ahung lhungtai."},"3":{"text":"Tuhin achaina chu nangma chunga hunglhunga ahitai, chule keiman nachunga kalunghana kahin lhunsah ding, chule nalam lhah dungjuija nathu katan ding ahi, chule thet umtah nahinaho jouse chu nachunga kalethuh ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule kamitnin nangma nakhehchah louding, khotona jong kaneilou ding ahi. Ahivangin nalam lhah ho keiman kalethuh cheh ding, chule thet umtah nahina ho chu nalah tah-a umding; chuteng nangman Pakai kahi chu nahetdoh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hitihin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, Veuvin, thilgilou, thilgilou sehseh bou ahunge."},"6":{"text":"Achaina chu ahungin, achaina chu ahung lhungtan; hichun nangma navelhi jingin, ven, hichu ahung lhungtai."},"7":{"text":"Vo gamsunga cheng nangma, jingkah chun nahinphatan, phat chu ahung lhungtai; hamsetna nikho chu ahung naitai, molsang ho gin athongkit tapoi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-a chomlou kah-a nachunga kalungsatna kahinbuhlhah ding, chule kalunghana chu nachunga kamolso ding ahi. Chule keiman nalam lhah dungjuija nachunga thu katan ding, chule thet umtah nahinaho jouse jeh-a kalethuh ding nahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule kamit nin nangma nakhehcha pontin, keiman khotona jong kanei louding ahi. Nalam lhah hole nalah tah uva thet umtah nahinaho dungjuija nangma kahinlethuh ding; chutengle nangman najepma chu Pakai keima kahi hi nahin hetding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Vetan nikho chu, vetan ahunglhunga ahitai. Jingkah chu achemangtan; tenggol pahcha bangin apah lhatan, kiletsahna chu pahchamum bangin amum dohtai."},"11":{"text":"Hunam nahi gitlouna tenggolin ahung umdoh tan; amaho khatcha umden loudiu, ahaona jouseu ahin, anei agou jouse jong khatcha umden louding; chujongle koiman amaho pul adou louding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Phat chu ahung lhungtan nikho chu ahung naitai. Thil chopa chu kipah hihhen, thil johpa jong lunghem hihhen; ajehchu amihonpiu chunga lunghanna chua ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile amaho hingnalai jongleu, ajohdohsao chu ahenguva hungkile kit louding ahi. Ajehchu gaothilmu hin amihonpiu jouse atongkha cheh-in, hichu kile kit louhel ding ahi; chujongle khan gitlouna-a hingjouse koima ama le ama thahat kipethei louding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Amahon amijouse gotsa ahitheinan sumkon amut taovin; ahinla koimacha galmun jona chea aumpoi. Ajehchu kalunghana hi amihonpiu chunga chu chua ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Chemjam chu polama aumin, natset le kellhah chu asunga aume; loujaova um chu chemjamin thintin, chule khopi sumga um chu kel le natsetna thiding ahi.","title":"Israel Chonset Jeh-a Achunga Gotna Lhung"},"16":{"text":"Ahinla alah uva kona jamdoh ho chu sohchao vintin, phaicham vakhuho banga molsang ho chunga umdiu, abonchauva amacheh khan gitlouna alunghempi diu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Khut jouse chu ngoijin tin, chule khup jouse chu twi banga lhoplha ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Amahon khaodip pon jong akigah dingu, chule tijatnan atoma, amaiju jum-a, aluchanghou tolsoh ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Amahon adangka hou lamlena aselhah dingu, asana hou jong akiladoh dingu ahi. Pakai lunghanna nikho nile adangka houle asanahou chun amaho alhatdoh joulou dingu ahi. Hicheho chun ahinkhou jong alungkimsah joulou ding, a-oiju jong avasah joulou ding ahi. Ajehchu hicheho chu akhan gitlou naova akipalnao hija ahi."},"20":{"text":"Akivona hoina dingun, amaho lultah in akijemun; ahinla hicheho-a chun akisuhboh nao amilimhou, chule kidah umtah thilho chu asemuve. Hijeh-a chu amaho-a kona kakoi gamlat ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule keiman hiche chu hetlou miho khutna kivahna dinga kapeh-a, chule leiset mikhang gilouho henga galthila kapeh ding; chule amahon hichu asuhboh dingu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Kamai amaho-a kona kaheimang ding, chule amahon kamun theng chu ahinsuhboh dingu ahi. Ijeh inem itile gucha michomho hiche sunga chu lut uva, chule hichu asuhboh dingu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Khaokol vuikhat semin, ijeh-inem itile gamsung chu thisan kisona gitlouna-in adiptan; chule khopi chu hunamin adiptai."},"24":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu keiman Pathen helou lah-a aphamopen chu kahinpui ding, amahon a-inhou chu alodiu, athahatnao kiloupisahna jong kasuhbei ding; chule amuntheng hou chu suhboh-a umding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Manthah na ahung lhungtai; amahon chamna ahinhol dingu, amavang chamna umlou helding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Setna chunga setna hunglhung ding, chule thuthang chunga thuthang chuding; chuteng amahon themgao thilmu ahin holdingu; ahivanga danthu chu thempu-a kona, chule thumop chu upaho-a kona mangsoh ding ahitai."},"27":{"text":"Lengpa chu lunghem ding, leng chapa jong manthah na-a kivon ding, chule gamsung mite khut ho chu ngoilha ding ahi. Keiman amaho achonnau dungjuija kabola, achan dinguva lom dungjuija athu-u katan ding; chuteng amahon keima Pakai kahi chu ahet dingu ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule kumgup channa, alhagup channa, chule hiche lhasung ninga nin, keima ka in sunga katouvin; chule Judah upaho ka-anga atou laijun, Pakai Pathen khut chu keima chunga ahung chun ahi.","title":"Jerusalem'a Milim Hou"},"2":{"text":"Hichun kaven ahile, veuvin, meikou limso bangjeng, akonga pat noilamse meikou; chule akonga pat chunglamse chu lhe lahlah-a a-engdum tobang vouso kamun ahi.","ref":"Ezek 1:27"},"3":{"text":"Chuin aman khutlim khat ahin lhahdoh-in, chule kaluchunga kasam lomkhatnin eimanin; chule lhagaovin leile van kah-a eidom touvin, Pathen gaothil musahna-a Jerusalem'a kotpi sungnungjo sahlam nga kotphung, thangthipna milim touna, thangthipna dinga lunghansahna touna chu eihin lhuttan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule veuvin, phaichama gaothilmu kamu dungjuijin, Israel Pathen loupi chamkimna chu hia chun anaume.","ref":"Ezek 1:28."},"5":{"text":"Hichun aman kahenga, Mihem chapa, tun sahlam ngan gakhodah-in, eiti. Hitichun keima sahlam ngan kagakhodah-in ahile, veuvin, maicham kotpi sahlam pang lutna-a chun thangthipna milim aume."},"6":{"text":"Aman kahenga aseibe kitnin, Mihem chapa, hiche hohin ipi abolu ahi namu em? Kamunthenga kona kagamlat nadinga Israel insungin nasatah-a thet um hilai mun'a aboluhi? Ahinla nangma gakihei kit nin, chutile nangman thet umcheh namukit ding ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin aman keima hongsung kotna chun eihin puijin, chuin keiman kagahven ahile, veuvin, banga chun ahom khat anaume."},"8":{"text":"Chujouvin aman kahenga, Mihem chapa, bang chu lai temin eitin; chuin bang chu kalaija ahile, kotkhah kamu doh-e."},"9":{"text":"Chuin aman kahenga, Lutnin, chule hikoma chun khangitlouna thet umtah abolu chu gaven eiti."},"10":{"text":"Hitichun keima kalutnin ahile, a-opma kithol ganhing jouse, chule thet umtah gamsaho, Israel insung semthu milimho akimvela bangho-a jihtho-a aum chu kagamun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule amaho anga chun malaija Israel insungmi pasal somsagi hochu adinguvin, chule amaho lailung tah-a chun Shaphan chapa Jaazaniah chu adingin, mitinin akhutna ama lhengcheh akichoijun; chule gimnamtui meikhulom satah chu chunglama akal touve."},"12":{"text":"Chujouvin aman kahenga hitin seije, Mihem chapa, malaija Israel insung miten muthim lah-a ipi abol, chule mitinin ama ama lunggelna indan sunga ipi abolu namu em? Ajehchu amahon, Pakaiyin eimupouve, Pakaiyin leiset adalhatai atiuve."},"13":{"text":"Chule aman kahenga hitin jong aseije, Gah kiheikit tadin, chutile amaho thilbol thet umjocheh namu ding ahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chujouvin aman keima Pakai in kotpi sahlampang nga-ah kotna chun eihin puitan; chule veuvin, hia chun Tammuz dinga kap numei ho anatouvun ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chujouvin aman kahenga aseijin, Vo mihem chapa, nangman hichehi namunah em? Nangma gakihei kitle chun hicheho sanga thet umjocheh namu ding ahi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin aman Pakai indan sungnungjoa eipui lutnin ahile, veuvin, Pakai houin kotphung, hongcha le maicham kikah-a chun mi somni le nga, Pakai houin nung ngatna, amaiju solam ngacheh aumu vin; amahon solam ngan nisa ahouvun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chujouvin aman kahenga aseije, Vo mihem chapa, hichehi namutah em? Judah insungin hilai mun'a abolu thet umtahho hi thil neocha hintem? Ijeh inem itile amahon gamsung hi hunam adiptauvin, chule amaho keima phinse-a lunghansah din ahung kileuve. Ven, amahon abah chu anahkuiju toh asutouve."},"18":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu kenjong lungsa tah-a kabol ding; kamitna jong kadeplou ding, hejong kahepi louding; chule amaho awsang tah-in kana benga kap jongleu, kangaipeh dehlou dingu ahi, ati."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aman kana benga aw sangtah-in asamin, Khopi dunga thunei ho chu hinnailut sah-in, chule amitakipmin akhutna suhsetna amanchah cheh kichoihen, ati.","title":"Jerusalem Talen Kipeh"},"2":{"text":"Chule, veuvin, sahlam panga um kotpi sangjo lama konin mi gup ahunguvin, amitinin akhutnuva mithana manchah achoijun; chule amaho lah-a khat chu tupat ponin akivonin, chule apanga lekha jihho lekhatwi thei khat akikhaije. Chuin amaho achelutnun, sum eng maicham koma adingun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule Cherub chunga um Israel Pathen loupina chu kotphung geijin akitol toutan ahi. Chuin aman tupatpon kivon apanga lekha jihho lekhatwi thei khai mipa chu agah kouvin;"},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pakai chun ama henga hitin aseije, Khopi lailung, Jerusalem lailung jotpaijin lang, alah uva thet umtah kibol jeh-a khoisa-a kap ho dehpanga melchihna nata ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Tph 7:3; 9:4; 14:1"},"5":{"text":"Chule keima jah dingin adangho henga aseijin, khopi sunga chun amanung juijun lang, nakhut lha uvin, chule namitnun demchah hih-un, khotona jong neihih un, ati."},"6":{"text":"Ateh akhang, numei ho le chapang neoho, chule nupiho thatgam keijun, ahinla koihile achunga melchihna umchan chu ganai hih-un; chule kamunthenga konhin panjengun, ati. Hichun amahon inmaija um tehse ho-a chun apanpai jeng taove."},"7":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho henga, In chu suboh unlang, hongsungho chu akithat ho-a chun dipmun; chule nangho kondoh-un, ati. Chuin amaho akondoh-un, khopi sunga miho chu athat taove."},"8":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, amahon amaho atha laitah-un, keima kahoidohtan, hitichun keima kaboh khupmin kalhun, kapengin, kaseije, O Pakai Pathen, Jerusalem chunga nalungsatna nasunlhah na-a hi, Israel lah-a amohho jouse jonghi nasuhmang sohding hitam? kati."},"9":{"text":"Hichun aman kahenga, Israel le Judah insung khan gitlounahi alen valtai, chule gamsung thisan adimin, khopisung khelna-in adimtan ahi. Ajehchu amahon, Pakaiyin leiset adalhatai, chule Pakaiyin amutapoi, atiuve, tin aseije."},"10":{"text":"Kei hijong leng, kamitnin adepchah lou ding, khotona jong keiman kaneilou ding, akiman chahnao alu chunguva kalethuh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule, veuvin, tupat pon kivon, apanga lekha jihho lakhatwi thei khai mipa chun, athu chu keima neithupeh bangin kaboltai, tin alhut tai."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman kagahven ahile, Cherub ho luchunga um vanthamjol lah-a chun, khisong dumjet laltouna lhehlheh khat aume.","title":"Pakai Loupina-in Houin Adalhah","ref":"Ezek 1:26; Tph 4:2."},"2":{"text":"Chule amapa chun tupat pona kivon mipa jah-a chun thu aseijin, chule hitin ati, Cherub noitah-a kangtalai kangho kikah-a chun chelutnin, chule Cherub ho kah-a konin songmeihol nakhut dimsetnin hamdoh-in lang, hicheho chu khopi chunga gathe jah-in, ati. Chuin amapa chu kamuta-in achelut tai.","ref":"Tph 8:5"},"3":{"text":"Tun mipa achelut phatnin Cherub ho chu chuche in jetlam panga chun adingtauvin; chule inhong sungnung chu meilom'in adimtai."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pakai loupina chu Cherub'a kon chun akaltouvin, chule in lutna kotchunga chun adingtan; chule a-in chu meilom adimin, chule ahongsung chu Pakai loupina vah chun alosohtai."},"5":{"text":"Chule Cherub ho lhaving gin chu Hat chungnung Pathen'in thu aseitenga a-awgin bangin, in ponung geijin akijan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule Cherub hole kangtalai kang kikah-a kona mei-am galan tia tupat ponnema kivonpa henga thu apeh chun ahitin ahi; chujouvin ama alutnin kangtalai kangho koma chun agadingtai."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Cherub khatnin, Cherub ho kahlah-a kon chun Cherub ho kahlah-a um meikou lama chun akhut ahinlhang doh-in, chuin hichu alan, chule tupat ponnema kivon mipa khutna akoijin ahile, amapan hichu alan achedohtai."},"8":{"text":"Chuin hiche Cherub ho lhaving noija chun mihem khut tobang khat ahungdohtan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule keiman kagahvet phatnin, veuvin, Cherub ho panga chun kangtalai kang li, Cherub khat panga kangtalai kang khat, chule Cherub dang khat panga kangtalai kang dang khat aume. Chule hiche kangtalai kang ho limdan chu khisong engdumtoh abangin ahi.","ref":"Ezek 1:15-21"},"10":{"text":"Chule kangtalai kangho limso dan chu, aliuvin kibahna khat aneijuve, hichu kangtalai kang khat lailung tah-a kangtalai kang khat kibut abangin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amaho ache tengule amaho apang li in acheuvin; amaho achepumun akiheile pouve, amavang aluchangun avetna lama lamu amahon ajuijuvin; amaho achepumun akiheile pouve."},"12":{"text":"Chule amaho tahsa pumpi, atungtunhou, akhuthou, alhavinghou, chule kangtalai kang, chule ali uva aneiju kangtalai kangho geijin akimveluchu mitjeng adimsetnin ahi.","ref":"Tph 4:8"},"13":{"text":"Kangtalai kangho chu ahile, keima jah in, Vo kangtalai kang tin akisame."},"14":{"text":"Chule khatcheh in mai li aneijuvin; mai masa chu Cherub mai, mai nina chu mihem mai, chule athumna chu keipi bahkai mai ahin, chule alina chu mulaopi mai ahi.","ref":"Ezek 1:10; Tph 4:7."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Cherub ho chu dopsangin aumtaove. Hiche ganhing hi Chebar vadunglen panga kanamu chu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Cherub ho chu acheteng kangtalai kangho chun amaho ajuijuve; chule Cherub hon leisetna kon kaltouving tia alhavinghou adoptou tengule, hiche kangtalai kangho jonghi amaho panga konin akiheile pouve."},"17":{"text":"Amaho adin tengule hicheho adinguvin, chule amaho dopsanga aum tengule, hicheho jonghi amahole amaho akidomsang jiuve. Ajehchu ganhing lhagao chu amaho sunga uma ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakai loupina chu chuche in kotphunga kon chun achemangin Cherub ho chunga agadingtai."},"19":{"text":"Chuin kamitmu tah-in Cherub hon alhavinghou adomsangun, leisetna konin akaltou taove. Amaho achedoh phat chun kangtalai kangho jong apanguva abeh-in, chule khatcheh chu Pakai in solam kotpi phunga adingcheh uvin; chule Israel Pathen loupina chu amaho chunga aume."},"20":{"text":"Hichehi ganhing, Israel Pathen noija Chebar vadunglen panga keiman kanamu chu ahi. Chule amaho chu Cherubim ahi ti kahei."},"21":{"text":"Khatcheh in mai li aneicheh uvin, chule khatcheh in lhaving li aneicheh-un, chule alhavinghou noija mihem khut tobang aumcheh-e."},"22":{"text":"Chule amaisou hung kilah chu Chebar vadunglen panga kamu tobang maiso mama chu ahin, chule amaho malama jangpetnin ache cheh uve."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chukalvalin lhagaovin keima eidom touvin, chule Pakai in solam kotpi, solam maingatna chun eilhuttai. Chule veuvin, kotpi kotphunga chun mi somni le nga aumin, amaho lah-a chun keiman mipi ho pipui Azur chapa Jaazaniah chule Benaiah chapa Pelatiah chu kamun ahi.","title":"Jerusalem Themo Kichan"},"2":{"text":"Hichun aman kajah-a aseijin, Mihem chapa, amahohi thilphalou gong miho, chule hiche khopi sunga thil gilou thumop leho chu ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Amahohin, phat chu anai hihlaije, eihon inho satadiu hite, hiche khopihi khangbel len chu ahin, chule eiho asaphe chu hiuhite, atiuve."},"4":{"text":"Hijeh chun amaho dounan gaovin, Vo mihem chapa, gaovin, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Pakai lhagao chu kachunga ahungchun, chule kajah-a aseijin, Seijin; Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Vo Israel insung, nanghon hitihin naseitaove; ajehchu keiman nalung sunguva hunglut thil chu abonin kahesoh keijin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nanghon khopi sunga mihem tampi nathat taovin, chule nanghon khosung lamlen jouse mithi nadip taove."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Nanghon namitha hou khopi lailung tah-a nalupsah hou chu sa chu ahiuvin, hiche khopi hi khangbel len chu ahi. Ahivangin keiman hiche lahtah-a kona nangho kapuidohtei ding nahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Nanghon chemjam chu nakichaove; chule keiman nangho chunga chemjam khat kahin chuhsah ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije."},"9":{"text":"Chule keiman hiche lailung tah-a kona nangho kapuidoh ding, chule nangho hetlou miho khutna kapeh doh-a, chule nalah uva thu katan ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nangho chemjam'a nalou dingu; keiman Israel gamgi-a nathu katan ding, chule nanghon keima Pakai chu kahi ti nahet dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hiche khopihi nangho khangbel chu hilouhel ding, alailungtah-a sa jong chu nangho nahilouhel dingu ahi; amavang Israel gamgi-a nachung thu katan ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule nanghon keima Pakai chu kahi ti nahet dingu ahi. Ajehchu nangho kadan kisun ho-a nache tapouvin, kathutanho jong natongdih pouvin, ahinla Pathen helou nakimvel uva umho umdan bangin nanghon naboljo taove, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin ahung hitin ahi, keiman gaothu kasei petnin, Benaiah chapa Pelatiah chu athitai. Chuin kalhun kamai tolla kasulutnin, aw gingtah-in ka pengin, Ohe Pakai Pathen, nangman Israel ho lah-a ahingdoh amoh hohi nasuh manghel jeng ding hitam! tin kaseije."},"14":{"text":"Pakai thu chu keima henga ahung kitnin, hitin ati,","title":"Sohchanga Umho Henga Pathen Thutep"},"15":{"text":"Mihem chapa, nasopi ho, nasopi ho mongmong, na-insung miho, chule Israel insung pumpi jouse chungchanga hi ahi Jerusalem'a cheng miten, Nangho Pakaiya konin gamlaovin: hiche gamhi keiho lodinga eikipeuva ahi, tia aseina chu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun seijin, Pakai Pathen'in aseije; Keiman amaho gamlatah-a Pathen helou miho lah-a lehdoh jengjong leng, chule keiman amaho gamdang danga thecheh jengjong leng, alhunao gamho-a chu amaho dinga keima muntheng neokhat tobang kahiding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; keiman nangho mipi ho lah-a kona kachopkhom dingu, nakithe chehnao gamsungho-a kon kapuikhom dingu, chule keiman Israel gam chu nangho kapeh dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule amaho khulama hungdingu, chule amahon hichea kona chu, chua um ningset umtah thilho jousele thet umtahho chu alahdoh dingu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule keiman amaho chu lungthim khat kapeh ding, chule nasunguva lhagao thah khat kakoipeh dingu; chule keiman atahsaova kona song banga tah alungchangu chu kalah doh-a, chule amaho chu tahsa phe-a kasem lungchang kapeh ding ahi.","ref":"Ezek 36:26-28"},"20":{"text":"Chutia chu amahon kadan kisun ho ajuijuva, kachonna danho anitdiu, chule hicheho chu anatoh-a atohdoh dingu; chutengle amaho chu kamite hiuva, keima amaho Pathen kahi ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ahinla ningset umtah le thet umtah thil ho lama alungu chesahho vang chu, keiman aluchung cheh uva achenau lampi chu kalethuh ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije."},"22":{"text":"Chujouvin Cherub ho chun alhavinghou ajah touvun, chule kangtalai kangho apanguva abeh-in; chule Israel Pathen loupina chu amaho chungvuma aume.","title":"Pathen Loupina-in Jerusalem Adalhah","ref":"Ezek 43:2-5."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Pakai loupina chu khopi lailung tah-a kon chun achetouvin; chule khopi solama um molsang chunga chun adingtan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hiche nunghin lhagao chun eilatouvin, chule gaothil muna-in Pathen lhagaovin Chaldea gama gal hinga kikaiho henga eipuitan ahi. Hitichun keiman thilmu kanamu chu keija konin achetoutai."},"25":{"text":"Chuin keiman Pakaiyin eimusah thilho jouse chu gal hinga kikaiho henga kaseisoh keijin ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai thu jong kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,","title":"Khopem Tobang Themgaopa"},"2":{"text":"Mihem chapa, nangma kiphinjing insung lahtah-a chenga nahi; amahon mun'a ding mit aneijun, amuthei pouvin; jahna ding kol aneijun, ajathei pouve; ajehchu amaho kiphinjing insung ahiuve.","ref":"Isai 6:9-10; Jer 5:21; Mrk 8:18"},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun mihem chapa, nakichon doh nadingin nathilkeo kigon tupmin, chule amaho mitmun sunlai tah-in kichondoh-in; chule nangma naumna mun'a kona munchom dang khatna amaho mitmu-a nakichon doh ding ahi. Amaho thungailou insung hijongleu, angaito maithei dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chujouteng nangman sunlai tah-a nathilkeuho chu amaho mitmu tah-a kichondohna thilkeu banga nahinpoh ding; chule nangma amaho mitmu tah-a nilhah tahle gal hinga kikailut ho che banga nachedoh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nangman amaho mitmu tah-a bang chu natuh vang paiding, chule chutia chu napohdoh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amaho mitmu tah-a nangman hichu nalengkou teni chunga napoh-a, chule hichu khomu chipchet tahle napohdoh ding, tol namuthei louna dinga nangman namai nakikhu ding ahi; ajehchu keiman Israel insung dinga melchihna khatna katun nahitai, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin keiman eikithupeh bangin kaboltai, keiman sunlaitah in kathilkeoho chu gal hinga kikaiho thilkeo bangin kahin podoh tan, chule nilhah lamin kakhut tah-in bang chu katuvang paijin, keiman hichu khomut chipchep nin kapodoh-in, amaho mitmu tah-in kalengkou chunga kapun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin jingkah in Pakai thu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin ati,"},"9":{"text":"Mihem chapa, Israel insung thungailou insung chun nahenga, Ipi nabol ham tia asei hilouham?"},"10":{"text":"Amaho henga nangman hitin seijin, Hitihin Pakai Pathen'in aseije; hiche pohgih hi Jerusalem vaipopa le, amaho lah-a um Israel insung pumpi vetsahna ahi."},"11":{"text":"Seijin, keima nangho dinga melchihna kahin; keiman kabol banga amaho henga jong kabolding ahi. Amaho chondoh-in umuntin, chule sohchang dinga cheding ahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chule alah uva leng chapa chun khomut chipchep tengle athilkeoho alengkouva aputna chedoh ding; amahon hicheho chu pohdohna dinga bang chu atuhvangpai dingu; ama chun amitna tol amu theilouna dinga amai akikhu ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Keiman kalen jong achunga kajal ding, chule ama chu kathangkola ohding; chule keiman ama chu Chaldea mite gam Babylon kalhut ding; chukoma chu ama thi ding, hijongle hichu amulou ding ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 25:7; Jer 52:11"},"14":{"text":"Chule keiman ama panpi dinga ama kimvela umho jousele, ama galsat mihon ho chu hui nunna channa kathecheh ding; chule keiman amaho chemjam'a kanungdel ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule keiman amaho namtin lah-a kathecheh-a, chule gamsungho-a kasuhcheh tengle, amahon keima Pakai kahi chu akihet dingu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahijeng vanga amahon agalhun nahou Pathen helouho lah-a thet umtah ahinahou akiphondoh theina dinguva, keiman amaho lah-a themkhat chemjam'a kona, kella kona, chule hise-a kona kakhendoh ding; chule amahon keima Pakai kahi ahin het dingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chukalvalin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, aseije,","title":"Themgao Kihot hotpa-a Kon Melchihna"},"18":{"text":"Mihem chapa na-anneh chu kihot pumpumin nenlang, natwi chu kithing thingpumin, chingthei tah-in donin;"},"19":{"text":"Chule gamsung mipi ho henga seijin, Jerusalem le Israel gamsunga chengho Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; agam sunguva chengho jouse hunam thilbol jeh-a, asunga chengjouse-a kona kamhela aumtheina dinguva; a-anneh-u chingthei tah-a aneh dingu, chule atuiju kidangsa tah-a adon dingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule mihem chenna khopiho chu manlou sohding, chule gamsung chu kamhel ding; chule nanghon keima Pakai kahi chu nahet dingu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,","title":"Thuchih Minthang tah Leh Koiman Ija Aselou Thu"},"22":{"text":"Mihem chapa, nanghon Israel gamsunga naneiju thuchih, Nikhoho chu akisaosah-in, chule thilmu jouse athontai, tia kiseija chu ipi kiseina ham?"},"23":{"text":"Hijeh chun amaho chu seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Keiman hiche thuchih hi kasuhbei ding, chule amahon hichehi Israel sunga thuchih-a amankit tah loudiu ahitai; amavang, Nikhoho ahung naijin, gaothilmu jouse ahung guilhungtai, tin amaho seipeh-in."},"24":{"text":"Ajehchu pannabei gaothilmu le joule nala Pathen thu kisei kiti himhim chu Israel insunga umkit talou ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ajehchu keima Pakai kahin; keiman kaseiding, chule keiman kaseidoh ding thuho chu hung guilhungtei ding; hichu geisang louding ahitai. Ajehchu vo kiphinhat insung, nangho nikho sunga hi keiman athu chu kaseiding, chule hichu katohdoh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"26":{"text":"Pakai thu chu avelin kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,"},"27":{"text":"Mihem chapa, ven, Israel insung miten hitin aseijuve, Amapan gaova thil amuho ahunglhun nading nikho tampi avat nalaije, chule khonung peh-a hung guilhung ding thua gaothu aseimasah ahibouve, atiuve."},"28":{"text":"Hijeh chun amaho henga seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, kathuho khatchabeh jong kisuhsaobe louding, amavang keiman kaseidoh thu chu tohdoh-a umding ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin ati,","title":"Pasal Themgao Lhemho Douna-a Gaothu Kisei"},"2":{"text":"Mihem chapa, Gaothu seija Israel themgaoho, amaho lungdei deija gaothu seidoh ho dounan gaothu hitihin seijin, Nanghon Pakai thu chu ngaijun;"},"3":{"text":"Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Ohe, ama lhagao lunggela chonna chule ima muneilou themgao ngol hochu ada nahiuve!"},"4":{"text":"Vo Israel, nathemgao ho vang neldi gama sial ho bangbep ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Nangho a-onglaiho-a nachetou pouvin, chujongle Pakai nikho tengle galkisatna-a Israel insunga din theinadin tho nakai pouve."},"6":{"text":"Amahon pannabei amuvin, jouva aisan ahiuvin, Pakaiyin aseije, atiuve: ahinla Pakaiyin amaho asolpoi. Chule amahon athusei houchu kisudet ding ahi tin midangho akinepsah uve."},"7":{"text":"Nanghon pannabei gaothil namu-u hilou ham? Chule nanghon jouva aisan nathu nanaseileu hilouham? Nanghon hichu Pakaiyin aseije nati uvin; ahinla keiman kanaseipoi."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, nanghon pannabei nana seijuvin, chule jouthu jeng namu uve; veuvin, hijeh-a chu keima nang hotoh kidouva kahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije."},"9":{"text":"Chule kakhut hi pannabei jeng mu-a themgaoho chungle jouva aisanho chunga kachuhsah ding ahi. Amaho chu kamite kiloikhomna-a lhalou dingu, Israel insung kisutna-a jong amahohi kisun loudingu, chule Israel gamsunga jong lutlou dingu ahi; chutengle nanghon keima Pakai Pathen kahi nahetdoh dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu amahon kamite chu chamna aume tin ajoulhep mun, ahin chamna aumpon; chule khatnin bang khat atungdoh-in, chule ven, adanghon hichu chilminlou leingan nin aloijol uve.","ref":"Jer 6:14; 8:11."},"11":{"text":"Chilminlou leingana loijol ho henga seipeh-in, Hichu lhutei ding ahi; gohong longlet hela hung juding; chule, O gelchanglen ho, nangho nahung lhah dingu; chule hichu huipi leh gopin asuhtel ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ven, bang chu ahunglhuh tengle, chilminlou leingana naloi bang chu hoilamba hitam? tia kiseilou dingham?"},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Keiman kalungsatna-a hichu gopi leh huipi-a kasuhchim ding ahin; hiche suhmangna dinga chu kalunghana gohong juh-a longlet hela juding; chule kalungsatna gelchang lentah ho-a juding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hitia chu nanghon chilminlou leingana naloijolu bang chu kasuhchim ding akitunna chu holdoh-a aumna dinga hichu toltoh kasuhmat ding, chule hichu lhutei ding, chule hicheho lah-a chu nangho suhmanga naum dingu ahi. Chutengle nanghon keima Pakai kahi nahet dingu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chutia chu chuche bang chungle, chilminlou leingana loijol ho chunga chu kalunghana kasuhbulhit ding, chule nangho jah-a, Bang chu aumtapoi, chule chuche loijol ho jong chu aumtapoi, tia kasei ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hicheho chu Jerusalem chung chang gaothu seija themgaoho le, chamna umlou petna amanu dinga chamna gaothil mupehho themgaoho ahiuve, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije."},"17":{"text":"Chutobangma chun nangma mihem chapa, namite chanute lam nganlang amaho lungdei lama gaothu seiho dounan amaho chunga gaothu seijin,","title":"Numei Themgao Lhemho Douna-a Gaothu Kisei"},"18":{"text":"Chule Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije tin seipeh-in, Sangkhol tinchenga mitpheldoi khao kikhuibeh ho, mihem hinna sumang dinga kisalel milen tahtah ho delkop khuipeh numei ho, ada nahiuve! Nangho kamite lhagao chu nadel lele uva, naheng uva hunga lhagaoho chu nahinghoi diuham?"},"19":{"text":"Chule nanghon kamite lah-a sakolchang khutdim khat, chule changlhah pheng halkhatna athilouding hinnaho thana dingle, ahing louding hinnaho huhdohna dinga, kamiteho najouseiju jaho henga, najou thu-u seija suhboh ding neigot-u ham?"},"20":{"text":"Chuti ahi jehchun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Veuvin, nanghon hinnaho lenmang sah nadinga namanu mitpheldoi ho chu kaki doupin, chule amaho chu keiman nakhut uva kona kamaltela, hinnaho kalhadoh ding, chule lensah dinga nadelu hinnaho jeng jong chu kalhadoh ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Na ultheh pon hou jong keiman kabotela kamite nakhut uva kona kahuhdoh ding, chule amaho chu nangho khutna dellea umkit talou ding ahiuve; chule nanghon keima Pakai kahi nahet dingu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Keiman kasuh gimlouho michonpha ho lungthim jong nanghon jouvin nasulung gimun, chule agitlounau lampia kona akilekit louna diuvin hinna anei dingun thutep nape-un, migilouho khut natha hatsah-un ahi."},"23":{"text":"Nanghon pannabei mu nanei tahlou diu, doile ai nasan kitlou dingu ahitai. Ajehchu keiman kamite chu nakhut uva kona kahuhdoh ding; chule nanghon keima Pakai kahi chu nahet dingu ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin Israel mite upaho lah-a loikhat keima henga ahunguvin, ka-anga ahung touvun ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Milimhou Themmo Achan"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,"},"3":{"text":"Mihem chapa, hiche miho hin asemthu-u milimho chu alungsung uva atundoh cheh uva, akhan gitlounao kipal lhuhna chu amasanguva akoiju ahitai. Keima amaho kholle ding kahim?"},"4":{"text":"Hijeh chun amaho henga hitihin thu seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Israel insungmi amitakip alungsunga semthu milimho tungdoh-a, chule akhan gitlouna akipal lhuhna-a chu amaichanga koija, themgao henga hunga chu; Pakai keiman ahung penpen chu asemthu milimho tam dungjuija kadonbut ding ahi;"},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Israel insung chu asemthu-u milimho jeh-a keija kona gamla ahitah jeh uva, keiman alunglam tah uva matding kati ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun Israel insung henga seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije;
