Hichun vantil eikihoupi chun kahenga, hichehohi ipi ahiu vetsah inge, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin huisum thing lah-a ding mipa chun adonbutnin aseije, hicheho hi leiset pumpi suhle tunga chonle dinga Pakaiyin ahinsol ho ahiuve ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amahon thingphung lah-a ding Pakai vantil chun adonbutnun, keihon leiset hi suhle tungin kachonun, veuvin, lei pumpi chu atouthip beh-in, akicholdon ahi, atiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chujouvin Pakai vantil chun adonbutnin aseije, Vo janel Pakai, kum somsagi jen adouna-a nalunghan khum Jerusalem le Judah khopiho chunga itihchan hepina beija naum ding hitam?"},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin eikihoupi vantil chu thupha le lhamona thun adonbutnin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuti chun kajah-a thusei vantil chun kahenga, hitihin samphongin, janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; keima Jerusalem le Zion din thangthipna lentah in kathang thipmin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule nomtah-a uma Pathen hephalou ho chunga kalung phamolheh jengin ahi: ajehchu keima themkhat bou kalung phamo ahin, ahinla amahon suhgimna chu amasot uvin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije; keima Jerusalem henga hepina toh kahungkile kit tai: asunga chu ka-in kisading ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije, chule Jerusalem chunga tetohna khao kijan ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Samphong nalaijin, Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije tin aseijin; kakhopiho phattheina vanga kikehbe nalai ding; Pakaiyin Zion alhamon nalaiding, chule Jerusalem adeilhen nahlai ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chujouvin kakhodah-in ahile, veuvin saki li kamun ahi.","title":"Themgaopan Gaothilmu-a Sakiho Amu"},"19":{"text":"Chuin keima eikihoupi vantil jah-a chun, hihohi ipi tina ham? kati. Hichun aman, hichehohi Judah, Israel chule Jerusalem thecheh-ah aki li neiho chu ahi tin eidonbutne."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin thingthem bol mili eimusah-in ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin keiman, hichehohi ipi bol dinga hung hiuvam? kati. Hichun aman, hiche ki li hohi Judah thecheh-a, koimacha alu dahdoh ngamlou hela lhaho chu ahiuve: ahinla hiche thingthem bol hohi amaho jamsah dingle, akithecheh na dinguva Judah gam chunga aki-u domsanga chidang namdangho ki hochu suhlhahpeh dinga hunga ahiuve, tin aseije."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima kakhodah kitnin, kaven, chule akhutna tena khao kichoi khat kamun ahi.","title":"Themgaopan Gaothilmu-a Tena Khao Amu"},"2":{"text":"Chuin kenjong, hoija che nahim? kati. Hichun aman kahenga, Jerusalem avai ite hija, adung ite ahi hetna dinga ate dinga che kahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, eikihoupi vantil chu achedoh-in, chule vantil chom khat ama kimupi dingin apotdoh-in,"},"4":{"text":"Chule ahenga hitin aseije, lhaijin, hiche gollhangpa henga khun, Jerusalem chu asunga mihemle gancha atamval jeh-a kulbang neilou khopiho banga chenna hiding ahi, tin gaseijin."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu keima ama dinga akimvela mei kulbang banga kauma, chule asunga loupina kahi ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"6":{"text":"Hei, hung doh-un, chule sahlam gama konin jamdoh uvin tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ajehchu kol ningli-a hui bangin kathejao taove tin Pakaiyin aseije.","title":"Sohchanga Kikaimangho In Lam Hungkile Dinga Akikou"},"7":{"text":"Babylon chanutoh chengkhom Vo Zion, nangma kihuh doh-in."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu, janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; loupina jou chun, nachom gamuva namho henga chun keima eisolin ahi. Ajehchu nangho tongkha-a chun amit laivom atohkhah ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu veuvin, keiman achunguva kakhut kathin ding, chule amaho asohteu dinga galthil kichom hidiu ahi: chutengle nanghon keimahi janel Pakai hinsol kahi nahetna dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Vo Zion chanute, la saovin lang kipah-un: ajehchu veuvin, kahunge, chule nalah uva kachen ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"11":{"text":"Hiche ni chule nam tamtah-in Pakai chu jop untin, kamite hidiu: chule keima nalah uva kachen ding, chutengle keimahi janel Pakaiyin naheng uva eihinsol ahi nahet dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin gamtheng sunga achanvou dinga Juda chu alo ding, chule Jerusalem adeilhen kitding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Vo tahsa hing jouse, Pakai anga thipchetnun: ajehchu ama amunthenga konin akithou doh-in ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin aman, Pakai vantil anga ding thempu chungnung Joshua chule ama doudal ding go-a ajetlama Satan adin chu eivetsah-e.","title":"Themgaopan Gaothilmu-a Thempu Chungnung Amu","ref":"Ezra 5:2; Tph 12:10."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin Satan henga, Vo Satan, Pakaiyin naphoh-e; Pakai Jerusalem kilhenpa tahchun naphoh-e: hichehi meija kona meikho kiloidoh hilou ham? atin ahi.","ref":"Jud 9"},"3":{"text":"Tun Joshua chu ponsil nentah kivonin, vantil anga chun adinge."},"4":{"text":"Aman amasanga dingho chu adonbutnin, ajah uva chun, ponsil nen chu ama-a konin ladoh-un, tin aseije. Chule ama jah-a chun, ven, nakhan gitlouna nanga kona kabeisah tan, chule keiman ponsil hoitah kavonpeh ding nahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin keiman, aluchunga lukhuh hoitah khuhpeh uhen, kati. Chutichun alua lukhuh hoitah akhuh peh-un, ponsil avonpeh taove. Chule Pakai vantil chu akoma adinge."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Pakai vantil chun Joshua henga aphongdoh-in, aseije."},"7":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; kalampi najotna, kathupeh nanit leh, ka-in sunga vai nahom ding, kahong sung jong navetsui ding, chule hikoma dingho lah-a hi vahle theina mun kapeh ding nahi."},"8":{"text":"Vo Joshua thempu chungnung, nangma le na-anga touhon, tun ngaijun; ajehchu amaho datmo umtah miho ahiuve: ajehchu veuvin, keiman kalhacha ABAH chu kahin puidoh ding ahi.","ref":"Jer 23:5; 33:15; Zech 6:12."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu Joshua masanga kasong set chu veuvin, song khat chunga mit sagi umding ahi: veuvin, keiman hia chu thucheng kajih ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije, chule keiman nikhat tengle chuche gam khangitlouna chu katolmang ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule mitinin alengpigui le atheichang phung noija, aheng akomcheh akou dingu ahi.","ref":"Mica 4:4."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin vantil eina kihoupi chu ahungkitnin, mi khat a-ihmutna kona kisuthou bangin eisuthouvin,","title":"Themgaopan Gaothilmu-a Thaomei Khom Amu"},"2":{"text":"kajah-a, ipi namu em? eiti. Hichun keiman kadonbutnin, kavei, chule vetan, achungvuma sumlheng um, chule akhoma thaomei sagi nei, chuche thaomei sagi-a chu akam sagi um, sana jenga kisem meivah khom:"},"3":{"text":"Chule akoma Olive thingphung ni, sumlheng jetlama khat chule aveilama khat um kamui, kati.","ref":"Tph 11:4"},"4":{"text":"Chuti chun, kadonbut nin, eina kihoupi vantil jah-a chun, ka pakai hichehohi ipi ham? katin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin eina kihoupi vantil chun eidonbutnin, hichehohi ipi ahi nahetlou ham? ati. Hichun keiman kahepoi ka Pakai, katin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin aman eidonbutnin kahenga aseije, Hichehi Zerubbabel henga Pakai thusei ahi: thahat jeh hilou, thilboltheina jeh jong hilou, kalhagao vang jeh ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.","title":"Zerubbabel Henga Pathen Thutep","ref":"Ezra 5:2."},"7":{"text":"Vo molsang lenpitah, nangma koi nahim? Zerubbabel masanga phaicham naso jeng ding ahi: chule aman a-aw puma songpi athupipen chu lungsetna, lungsetna tia sampuma ahintoldoh ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chukal valin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, aseije,"},"9":{"text":"Zerubbabel khutnin hiche in bul hi ana phudoh ahin, ama khut maman ajoding ahi: chutengle nanghon keimahi janel Pakaiyin naheng uva eisol ahi nahetdingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu koijin thilneocha nikho i-sah louva akoijem? ajehchu amaho kipah-un tin, Zerubbabel khutna ngentum chu hiche sagiho chutoh amuthadiu ahi; hiche sagiho chu leiset pumpi-a suhle tunga lhaile Pakai mit ahiuve.","ref":"Tph 5:6."},"11":{"text":"Chule keiman kadonbut nin, ajah-a, hiche meivah khom jetle veija olive thingphung teni hi ipi hetna ham? katin ahi.","ref":"Tph 11:4."},"12":{"text":"Chuin keiman kadonbut kitnin, ahenga kaseijin, sana long tenin amani le amani-a kon sana thaotwi alhitkang lhona olive thingbah teni khu ipi hetna ham? kati."},"13":{"text":"Aman eidonbut nin, kajah-a, hichehohi ipi hetna ahi nahetlou ham? eiti. Chuin keiman, kahepoi ka pakai kati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin aman aseijin, hitenihi thao kinusa, leiset pumpi Pakai koma ding teni ahi lhone ati."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin kakiheijin, kakhodah-in, chule kaven ahile, lekhajol leng lele khat kamun ahi.","title":"Themgaopan Gaothilmu-a Lekhajol Leng lele Amu"},"2":{"text":"Chule aman kahenga, ipi namu em? eiti. Chuin keiman, lekhajol khat kamun, adung chu tong somni ahin, chule avai chu tong som ahi, tin kadonbutne."},"3":{"text":"Chuin aman kajah-a, hichehi leiset pumpi chunga dinga potdoh-a gaosapna chu ahi: ajehchu gucha tapou chu lekhajol hiche lampang dungjuija kisumanga, chule akihahsel tapou chu lekhajol khuche lampang dungjuija kisumang ding ahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Keiman kahin puidoh ding ahi tin Janel Pakaiyin aseije, chule hiche guchapa insung le jouva kamina kihahselpa insunga chu lutding; hichu a-insunga chu umdena, chua uma thingpeh le songho puma chu asuhmanghel ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chujouvin keima eina houpi vantil chu ahung potdoh-in, kajah-a, tun khodah inlang apotdoh khu ipiham vetemin, ati.","title":"Themgaopan Gaothilmu-a Numei Khat Changtena Sunga Akikhum Amu"},"6":{"text":"Chuin keiman, ipiham? kati. Chuin aman aseijin, hiche hi apotdoh-a ephah chu ahi. Aman aseibe kitnin, hiche hi leiset pumpi-a akhan gitlounao chu ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, ngen talen khat akidom sangin; chule hichehi numei khat ephah sunga tou chu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin aman aseijin, hichehi khan gitlouna ahi. Chuin aman ephah sunga aseplutnin, chule aman ngen gih-a chun chuche kam chu asingtan ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman kakhodah-in, kaven ahileh, veuvin, numei ni ahungdoh in, alhaving hona chun hui aumin ahi; ajehchu amanin twilungva bangin lhaving aneilhonin ahi. Chuin amanin ephah chu leile van kikah-a adomsang lhonin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman einaki houpi-a vantil jah-a chun, hiche ephah hi hoilama adoplhon dingham kati?"},"11":{"text":"Chuin aman kahenga, Shinar gama a-in sahpeh nading lama: chule hichu kisadoh intin, amanu mun ngeija kitungdoh ding ahi, ati."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule keima kakiheijin, kakhodah-in, kaven ahileh, veuvin, molsang ni kikah-a sakol kangtalai li ahungdoh-in; chule hiche molsang teni chu sum-eng molsang ahi.","title":"Themgaopan Gaothilmu-a Sakol Kangtalai Li Amu"},"2":{"text":"Sakol kangtalai masa-a sakol ho chu asan ahin, sakol kangtalai nina-a sakol ho chu avom ahi;","ref":"Tph 6:4-5"},"3":{"text":"Chule sakol kangtalai thum na-a sakol ho chu akangin, chule sakol kangtalai lina-a sakol ho chu abongpol jeng ahiuve.","ref":"Tph 6:2"},"4":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman kadonbut nin eihoupi-a vantil jah-a chun, ka pakai, hichehohi ipiham? kati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin vantil chun kajah-a, hichehohi van lhagao liho, leiset pumpi Pakai anga adin naova kona chedohho ahiuve.","ref":"Tph 7:1."},"6":{"text":"Chua um sakol vomho chu sahlam gama akitolun; akangho chun amaho chu ajuijun; abongpol ho chu lhang lam gama akitolui."},"7":{"text":"Asan pengho jong apotdoh-un, leiset pumpi-a suhle tunga vale ding agouvin ahi: chuin aman ajah uva, nangho hia konin cheovinlang, leipumpi suhle tungin gakhol taovin, ati. Hitichun amaho leiset pumpi-a suhle tunga avahle taove."},"8":{"text":"Chujouvin aman kachunga apeng jah-in, chule kahenga aseije, ven, hiche sahlang gama cheho khun sahlang gama kalhagao acholdo sah uve, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, aseije;","title":"Joshua Lal Lukhuh Khupeh Dinga Thupeh"},"10":{"text":"Sohchang Babylon'a kona hungho lah-a, Heldai, Tobijah, chule Jedaiah'a kon thilpeh chu la inlang, chuche ni mama chule hungin lang, Zephaniah chapa Josiah ina chun lutnin;"},"11":{"text":"Chujouteng dangkale sana lanlang lallukhuh khat semin, chule hichu thempu chungnung Josedech chapa Joshua luchunga khuhpeh-in;"},"12":{"text":"Chule ajah-a hitin seijin, Janel Pakaiyin aseijin, hitin aseije, ven Mi amin ABAH kitipa chu: Ama aumna mun'a konin khangtouvin tin, chule aman Pakai houin asahdoh ding ahi.","ref":"Jer 23:5; 33:15; Zech 3:8"},"13":{"text":"Aman Pakai houin geija asahdoh-a, loupina chu chang ding, chule ama touva alaltouna chunga vai ahomding; alaltouna chunga chu thempu'a pang ding ahi: chule chamna thumopna chu akikah lhona umding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule lallukhuh ho chu Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, chule Zephaniah chapa hetna dinga Pakai houin sunga umding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule gamlatah-a umho hunguva Pakai houin chu asahdiu, chutengle nanghon keimahi janel Pakaiyin naheng uva eisol ahichu nahetdiu ahi. Hichehi nanghon genngai tah-a Pakai na Pathen'u aw chu nangai ule bou hung guilhung ding ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule ahitin ahi, Darius lengchan kal kum lina, Chisleu kiti alhakoh chana, ni li chanin, Zekeriah henga Pakai thu chu ahung lhungin ahi.","title":"Pakaiyin Dihlou tah-a An Ngol Adem"},"2":{"text":"Hichu amahon Pathen in'a Sherezer le Regem-Melek le amiteu chu Pakai anga taodingin asol uvin,"},"3":{"text":"Chule janel Pakai in'a um thempuho le themgaoho henga, kum tamtah kahin bolngai banga, kachom uma, lha nga channa-a chu kaka ding ham? tia aga dohsah petnu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin janel Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, aseije,"},"5":{"text":"Gamsunga um miho jousele, thempuho jouse jah-a chun seijin, nanghon lha nga nale lha sagina-a an nangol uva chule nalunghem tengule, chuche kum somsagi sung jenga jongchu kahenga, keima henga an ngolla nahibeh um?"},"6":{"text":"Chule nanghon naneh uva nadon tengu jongleh, nangho dinga bou naneh uva nadonu hilou ham?"},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem le akimvel khopiho mihon alo dimsetnuva aphattou laile, mihon lhanglam le phaicham alodimlai juva themgao masaho-a Pakai thusei ho chu nangaidiu hilou ham? ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Pakai thu chu Zekeriah henga ahung lhungin, aseije.","title":"Sohchanga Acheu Chu Thumanlou jeh Ahi"},"9":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Thutan dih mangun lang, mitinin asopi henga hepina le khotona musah hen."},"10":{"text":"Chule meithai le pa neilou, kholjin mi le migenthei ho chu bolgim hih-un, koima chan asopi dounan alungthimin aphalou ngaito hihhen, ati."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla amahon angainom pouvin, chule alengkouvu aheimangun, ajahlouna dingun akol asimuvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Henge, amahon janel Pakaiyin themgao masaho lhagaova ahin thuseidoh ho le adan thupeh ho chu kijakhante tin alungu song bangin atahsah-un ahi. Hijeh chun janel Pakaiya konin alunghana nasatah ahung lhungin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun, ahitin ahi, aman akouva, amahon angailou banguvin; amahon eikouvu keiman kangai lou ding ahi tin, janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla keiman amaho ahetkhah louvu namtin lah-a chimpeijin kathecheh taove. Hijeh chun amaho nungin agamu chu akamheltan, koima ajotpa le akinungle aumpoi: ajehchu gam nomtah chu kamhela akoiju ahitai."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Janel Pakai thu kahenga ahunglhung kitnin, aseije;","title":"Jerusalem Tundohkit Dinga Pakaiyin Atep"},"2":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Keima Zion din thangthipna nasatah-in kathangthipmin, amadin lunghan chungnungin kathangthipme."},"3":{"text":"Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Keima Zion henga kahung kilekitna, Jerusalem lailunga kachen ding ahi. Chule Jerusalem chu thutah khopi kitiding, janel ho Pakai molsang chu molsang theng kitiding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Jerusalem lamlena chu tehse numei le tehse pasal cheng nalai ding ahin, chule akum tambehseh jeh-a mitinin akhutna tenggol akiphu dingu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule khopi lamlena chu pasal chapang le numei chapang dimset ding, akhopi lamlena chu kichem dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; hiche nikho-a hiche mite amohho mitmu-a hichu datmo aumin, chule keima mitmu-a jong datmo aumdem? tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"7":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; veuvin, keiman kamite chu solam le lhumlam gama kona kahuhdoh ding;"},"8":{"text":"Chule amaho chu kahin puija, Jerusalem lailunga cheng ding ahiuve. Chule amaho kamite hiuva, thutah le chonphatna-a keima a-Pathen'u kahiding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Houin kisahdoh theina ding, janel Pakai houin bul kiphudoh nikho-a themgaoho kama thu kisei cheng, tukhanga anakola jajousen naban thau hatsah-un."},"10":{"text":"Ajehchu tumasangin mihem kithalah manle, gancha kigoi man jong akipepoi; hesohna jeh-in alutle apotle dingin jong chamna aumpoi: ajehchu mijouse aheng akomtoh kana kidou sah-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla tunvang, hiche miho amoh cheng henga hin, masang laija chutoh bang taponge tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu muchi chu pha theijin tin, lengpiguijin aga pentin, leijin aga sepdoh intin, vanhon adaitwi hou apehdingu ahi; chule keiman hiche mite amohho chu hicheho jousehi kalosah ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, Pathen helouho lah-a sapsetna nachan jeh uvin, Vo Judah le Israel insung miteho; hijeh-a chu kahuhdoh uva phatthei channa nahidiu ahi. Kicha hih-un, ahin nabantha hatsah jouvin."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; napateu vin eilung hansah uva, nangho engbol dinga kana gotlai bangin, kalung kaheipoi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"15":{"text":"Chuti chun tulai nikhon vang Jerusalem le Judah insung mite chunga thipha bolding kangaito kit tai: nangho kicha hih-un."},"16":{"text":"Hichehi nanghon naboldiu chu ahi; mitinin aheng akom jah-a thutah jeng seijun; nakotpi phunguva thutah le chamna-in thu tanun.","ref":"Eph 4:25."},"17":{"text":"Koimachan aheng akom chunga lungse ngaito hihhen, jouva kihahselna ngailu hih-un. Ajehchu hicheho jousehi keiman kahot ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"18":{"text":"Chule janel Pakai thu chu kahenga hungin, aseije;"},"19":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; lha lina an ngol, lha ngana an ngol, lha sagina an ngol, chule lhasom na-an ngol chu Judah insung mite dinga akipanale thanopna, chule nopsahna kut hiding ahi; hijeh chun thutah le chamna ngailuvin."},"20":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; hung hiti ding ahi, mipi ho, khopi tamtah-a chengho chu hungding ahiuve."},"21":{"text":"Khopi khatna chenga miho chu achom khatna cheovintin, ajah uva, Pakai henga tao dingle, janel Pakai holdingin cheloiju hite: keijong kache ding ahi, ati dingu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Henge, mi tamtah le nam hat ho chu Jerusalem'a janel Pakai holding le Pakai henga taodinga hung diu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; hiche nikho chule hung hitiding ahi, namtinle paotin jouse-a kona misomin Judah mi khat pon atuh uva, keiho jong nangtoh kilhona kachediu ahi; ajehchu Pathen'in na-umpiuve ti kajauve, atidingu ahi ati."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel phungho jouse banga mihemte mit ho chun Pakai lam ahin ngat tengle; Hadrach gamsunga Pakai thua pohgih, chule Damascus chu akicholdona hiding ahi.","title":"Akimveluva Namtinho Chunga Thutanna","ref":"Isai 17:1-3; Jer 49:23-27; Amos 1:3-5."},"2":{"text":"Chule Tyrus le Zidon chu chinglheh jongle, Hamath'in jong hichu agamgit ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule Tyrus'in ama dingin kuldet akisemin, dangka chu leivui bangin asevumin, sana thengsel jong khopi lamlena bonlhoh bangin asevume."},"4":{"text":"Veovin, Pakaiyin amanu apaidoh ding, chule athahatna chu twipia alehlut ding; chule meijin akahvam ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 23:1-18; Ezek 26:1—28:26; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:9-10; Matt 11:21-22; Luk 10:13-14."},"5":{"text":"Ashkelon'in hichu amua kicha ding; Gaza'n jong amua lunggim lheh ding, chule Ekron'in jong; ajehchu akinepna chu kijumso ding; lengpa chu Gaza-a kona mangthah ding, Ashkelon chu chenna lou hiding ahitai.","ref":"Isai 14:29-31; Jer 47:1-7; Ezek 25:15-17; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:6-8; Zeph 2:4-7."},"6":{"text":"Chule Ashdod'a chu jaocha khat cheng ding; keiman Philistine hoithona chu kasuhtan ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule akamsunga kon athisan kalahmanga, chule aha kah-a kona thet umtah ahina chu kalahmang ding ahi. Ahinla aumdenpa, ama tah jengjong chu i-Pathen uva ding hintin, Judah gamsunga chu vaipipo banga umding ahin, Ekron chu Jebus mite tobang hiding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Galmiho jehle, ajotpa jeh le ahung kilepa jeh-a, ka-in hi kaum kimvel ding; chule misugenthei koiman ahin jotpa lou ding ahitai; ajehchu tun kamit tah-in kamutai."},"9":{"text":"Vo Zion chanu, hapan kipah-in; Jerusalem chanu, aovin: ven nalengpa nahenga ahunge: ama chondihtah ahin, chule huhhingna aneije; kineosah tah-in sangan chunga, sangan nou chunga atouvin ahi.","title":"Ahunglhung Ding Lengpa","ref":"Matt 21:5; Jhn 12:15."},"10":{"text":"Chule keiman Ephraim'a kona sakol kangtalai kasuhmanga, Jerusalem'a kona sakol ho chu kasuh mangding, chule gal thalpi jong kisat bongding ahi. Chule aman Pathen hephalou ho jah-a chamna thu aseiding, alenggam chu twipia pat twipi gei, chule vadunga pat kolmong gei hiding ahi.","ref":"Labu 27:8."},"11":{"text":"Nangma dingin jong, nathisana kitepna vangin, twi beina kokhuh-a konin nasohchangho chu kasoldohtai.","title":"Pathen Mite Kitundoh Kitding","ref":"Pot 24:8."},"12":{"text":"Kinepna nei sohchang nangho kuldet lama kileuvin; tuni tah-a hi ajatnia kapehdiu ahi tia kaphondoh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Keiman kathalpi Judah kajebongin, Ephraim chu thalchang bangin thal'a kadipme, nachapate chu thoudoh-in, vo Zion, nachapate doudingin, vo Greek, nangma mihat ho chemjam bangin kaseme."},"14":{"text":"Pakai chu achunguva kimuntin; athalchang ho chu kolphe banga leng ding ahi: Pakai Pathen'in sumkon mut intin, lhanglam chimpeitoh kilhonding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Janel Pakaiyin amaho ahonbit dingu; chule amahon abahgamuva, ah songse songa ajodiu ahi, amahon adondiu, chule lengpitwi kham banga pohchei choidiu; amaho sumlheng ho banga dimuva, maicham ningho bang dimdiu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule a-Pathen'un amite ganchahon banga ahuhdoh ding ahi: ajehchu amaho alua lallukhuh chunga songho bang dingu, agamsunga ponlap banga choisanga umdiu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ajehchu aphatna hi ichana lenna, ahoina hi ichana len hitam? changin gollhangho athanopsah ding, lengpitwi thah-in nungah ho akipasah ding ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Goju nunung laihin nanghon Pakai henga go thumin; chutile Pakaiyin meilom vahsah intin, loulaija hampa tin cheng chu gotwi apehding ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Huhdoh Ding Athutep"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu semthu milimhon pannabei thu aseijun, doi-aithem hon jouthu amuvin, mang dihlou aseijuvin; amahon ahomkeovin alhamonun ahi. Hijeh chun kelngoihon bangin ama ama lampia acheuvin, kelngoi chingpa umlou jeh-in, amaho alungkham taove."},"3":{"text":"Kelngoi chingho chunga chun kalung hang behsehnin, kelchaho chu ka-engbol tai. Ajehchu janel Pakaiyin akelngoihon Judah insung avilin, galbolna sakol phatah bangin aseme."},"4":{"text":"Ama-a konin inning songpi ahungdoh-in, ama-a konin thihkil, ama-a konin galkapna thalpi, ama-a konin misuh gentheina ho jouse chu ahungdoh-e."},"5":{"text":"Amaho chu gal kisatna-a amelmate lamlena bonlhoh toh chotbeh-a mihat tah tobang hunghidiu ahi. Chule Pakaiyin aumpi jeh uva gal asatnuva, sakol chung chongho chu kijumso diu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Keiman Judah insung kahatsah-a, Joseph insung kahuhhing ding: keiman amaho chensah dinga kahin lepui kitding ahi; ajehchu keiman amaho kakhoto-in ahi. Amaho kanapai manglou tobang hidiu ah; ajehchu keima Pakai a-Pathen'u kahin, chule kangaipeh dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ephraim miho chu mi hattah banguntin, alungu chu lengpitwi kham tobanga thanom ding: achateu vin hichu amuva, kipah dingu; Pakaiya alungu kipah ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Keiman amaho dinga huisatding, chule kakhop khomding ahi; ajehchu keiman amaho kalhatdoh ahitan: anapunthei banguva chu pungthei diu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule keiman amaho chu mite lah-a katulut ding: amahon gamlatah-a eihin geldoh dingu ahi; chule achateutoh cheng khomuva, hung kilekit dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Keiman amaho Egypt gama konin jong hinle puidoh kitning ting, Assyria'a kona kakhop khom ding; Chule Gilead le Lebanon gama kona kapuilutna, amaho dinga mun akimulou geija kapuilut ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule ama gimbolna pumin twipi chu galkaijin tin, twipi kinong chu avoh ding, luipi thuhtah jouse kanggam helding ahi: Chule Assyria hoithona kisunema, Egypt te leng tenggol jong kitolmang ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule ken amaho chu Pakaiya hatsah ingting, ama minna chesuh chetoudiu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Lebanon, meijin na Cedar thingho akahvam theina ding, nakot ho hongin.","title":"Vaihom Gilouho Lhuh"},"2":{"text":"Vo chahthing, pengin; ajehchu cedar thingho alhugamtai; ajehchu thing thupi tahtah ho akisuse gamtai: Vo Bashan gangpiho, nangho pengun; ajehchu gammang thingho alhugamtai."},"3":{"text":"Kelngoi chingho pen awgin akijai, ajehchu aloupinao akisuhmang tai: keipi bahkai donglai kitumgin akijai, ajehchu Jordan kiletsahna suhsetnin aumtai."},"4":{"text":"Pakai ka Pathen'in hitin aseije; tha ding kelngoihon ho chu vah-in.","title":"Kelngoiching Ni"},"5":{"text":"Aneiho tah-in amaho athatjiuvin, themmo akisaji pouve: chule amaho joh-a panghon, Pakai chu nunnom hen; ajehchu keima kahao tai, atijiuve. Amaho achinga pangho tah-in jong akhotoji pouve."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu gamsunga chengho chu khoto taponge, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ahinla veuvin, keiman mitin chu aheng akom khut le alengpau khutna kapehdoh ding ahi. Amahon gamsung chu asat dingu, akhutnuva kona kahuh dohlou ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule thading kelngoihon ho chu kavahding, vo kelngoihon lah-a genthei, nangma tahjong kavah ding nahi. Chuin keiman keima dingin tenggol ni kalan, khat chu Ahoi kasah-in, khat chu Kikan khom kasah-in; chuin kelngoihon chu kavahtai."},"8":{"text":"Lha khat sungin kelngoi ching thum jong kasumangin; chule kahinna-in amaho athetnin, amaho hinna-in jong keima eihouve."},"9":{"text":"Chujouvin ken kaseijin, ken nangho vahponge, athi ding chu thi hen; akisumang ding chu kisumang hen; adang chu amahole amaho sa kinetohen, katitai."},"10":{"text":"Chuin katengol Ahoi kiti chu kalan, mijousetoh kitepna kananei chu kasuhkeh nadingin, katan bonghel tai."},"11":{"text":"Chule hiche ni chun hichu abongtai: chule ganhon lah-a agenthei keima eina ngahho chun, hichu Pakai thu ahi, ti ahetauve."},"12":{"text":"Chuin keiman ahenguva, pha nasah ule, kalo neipeu vinlang; pha nasah lou uleh neipeh daovin, kati. Hichun amahon kalo dingin dangka somthum eitedoh peh taove."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, kaman dinga manpha tah amahon eipeh-u chu, beldengpa henga petan eiti. Chuin dangka somthum chu kalan, Pakai in'a beldengpa chu kapetai."},"14":{"text":"Chujouvin Judah le Israel kah-a kisopitna chu kasuhkehthei nadingin, katengol dang Kikan khom kiti chu kalan, kasu bongheltai."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, kelngoiching mingolpa manchah chu lakit nalai jin eiti."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu vetan, keiman gamsunga kelngoiching khat kahin tundoh ding, amachun akisumang dingho avil lou ding, anouho jong ahol lou ding, agu bongho jong aboldam lou ding, adinglaiho jong avahlou ding ahi. Ahivanga aman athaoho phe chu anehding, chule atinho chu ahal hala asat telding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Phatchomna bei kelngoiching kelngoihon dalha-a chu ohe ada ahi! aban le amit jetlama chemjam chuding: abanchu gotheng hela, chule amit jetlam jong thimdel ding ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel dinga Pakai thu pohgih chu, vanho jahdoh-a leiset bulpi phutdeh-a, mihem sunga lhagao umsah-a Pakai chun aseije,","title":"Khonunga Jerusalem Kihuhdoh Ding"},"2":{"text":"Judah le Jerusalem agoma douna dinga aki-um tengle, veovin, Jerusalem chu akimvela mijouse dinga lungvaina khonna kasem ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule Jerusalem chu mijouse dinga pohgih tah songa kasem ding; chuche douna-in leiset mijouse kikhom jongleh, chuche pohgih domkang dinga kigo jouse chu ahal hala kisat telding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Pakaiyin aseije, hiche nikho chule sakol jouse kidangsah na-a, chule achunga touho chu ngolna-a kajep ding; chule Judah insung chunga kamit kaha sah-a, miho sakol jouse mit chotna-a kajep ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule Judah vaipoho chun alungthim uva, Jerusalem'a chengho chu janel Pakai a-Pathen'u jala kathahatnao ahi, atidiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuche nikho chule Judah vaipoho chu thing lah-a meithuh bangle, changphal lah-a meisel banga kasem ding; amahon akimvela mijouse jetle veija akahvam ding ahi. Jerusalem vang chu ama mun Jerusalem ngeija chu chenna kinei kitding ahi."},"7":{"text":"David insung loupina le Jerusalem'a chengho loupina chu Judah chunga akichoisang louna dinga, Pakaiyin Judah ponbuh ho chu ahuhdoh masah ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuche nikho chule Jerusalem'a chengho chu Pakaiyin hongin tin, alah uva chuche nikho-a alhasampen jong chu David bang ding; chule David insung chu Pathen tobang hiding, a-angsung uva Pakai vantil um banghel hidiu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule hunghiti ding ahi, Jerusalem douva hungkon nam jouse chu suhmang dinga kahol ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule David insung chungle Jerusalem'a chengte ho chunga lungsetna lhagao le taona lhagao kahin buhlhah ding ahi. Chule amahon tenga anasutpao keima eivet diu, chule mi achapa changkhat jeh-a alunghem banga amaho lunghemdiu, mikhat acha pengmasa pen chunga lhasetah-a aka banga ama jala kana nasatah umding ahi.","ref":"Jhn 19:37; Tph 1:7."},"11":{"text":"Hiche nikho teng chule Megiddo phaichama Hadad-rimmon pul kidou banga, Jerusalem'a puldouna lentah umding ahi.","ref":"Matt 24:30; Tph 1:7"},"12":{"text":"Chule gamsungin pul adouding, insung jousen atuma; David insungin mitin atuma, ajiteuvin atuma; Nathan insunga miten atuma, chule ajiteuvin atuma;"},"13":{"text":"Levi insunga mite atuma, chule ajiteuvin atuma; Shimei insungin atuma, chule ajiteuvin atuma;"},"14":{"text":"Amoh umnalai insung jousen, insung jousen atuma, chule ajiteuvin atuma pul adou chehdiu ahi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuche nikho teng chule chonsetna le thenlouna jeh-a David insung dingle Jerusalem'a chengteho-a dinga twinah khat hung putdoh ding ahi."},"2":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule hunghiti ding ahi, gamsunga kona alim semthuho min chu kasuhbeija, geldoh-a umkit talouhel ding ahi. Chule athemgao houle lhagao bohho chu gamsunga kona kapotdoh sah ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"3":{"text":"Chule hung hitiding ahi, mi khattou gao thusei aumle, ama hinga anule apa chun ahenga, Pakai mina jou nasei jeh-a nahinlou ding ahi, atilhon ding ahi. Chule ahinga anule apan agao thusei petna chu paihela asutlhon ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule hunghiti ding ahi, themgaoho chu gaothu aseitengule agaothilmu jeh uva jahcha dingu; mi lheplhahna dinga ponham jong akisil tahloudiu;"},"5":{"text":"Amavang, Keima themgao kahipoi, loubol mi kahi; ajehchu kakhangdon apatna gancha chinje min einahil ahitai, atijoh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule khat touvin, nakhut ho-a maha hohi ipi itiham? atile, aman, kagol ho in'a kona machang kahi, atiding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Vo chemjam, kakelngoi chingpa dounan, kakiloipi pa dounan hung thouvin, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije. Kelngoiho jamchehna dingin, achingpa chu volhun: chule keiman anoute chunga kakhut kalhah ding ahi.","title":"Kelngoiching Pha Kithana Dinga Thupeh","ref":"Matt 26:31; Mrk 14:27."},"8":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, gamsung jouse-a hopthum-a hopni kisumanga thidiu, hopthum-a hopkhat bou kikhen ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"9":{"text":"Chule hopthum na chu meija kahin pui galkai ding, dangka kilhatheng banga kalhahthenga, sana kipatep banga kapatep ding ahi. Amahon kamin kou untin, ken kadonbut ding ahi. Keiman, hichehi kamite ahi, katiding, amahon, Pakai chu ka Pathen ahi, atidiu ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Veovin, Pakai nikho chu hunglhung ding ahitai, chule nathil chomdoh chu nalah uva kihomjal ding ahi.","title":"Jerusalem le Namtin"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu Jerusalem galla dou dinga kigo nam jouse kakhop ding; khopi chu kila-a, inho chu kichoma, numei ho kisuse ding; khopi kehkhat chu sohchanga potdoh diu, mipi amohho chu khopi-a kona kisumang louding ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chutengle Pakai chu potdoh intin, galsat nikho-a gal asat banga, chuche namho douna-a gal asatding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule chuche nikho chule Jerusalem mai solama um Olive molsanga chu akenga hung ding ding, chule Olive molsang chu solam le lhumlama alaitah-a kehlha-a phaicham lentah hungsoh ding; mol kehkhat chu sahlama, chule kehkhat chu lhanglama kichondoh ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule nangho molsang phaicham lama najam diu ahi; ajehchu molsang Phaicham chun Azal gei aphah ding ahi. Henge, Judah lengpa Uzziah nikho laija inling kihot masanga najam banguva najam diu ahi: chule Pakai ka Pathen chu hungding, chule mitheng jouse chu nangma toh hungdingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule hunghiti ding ahi, vah chu thenglou ding, thimjong thimlou ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla hichehi Pakai kihetna nikho khat chu hiding, sunjong hilou janjong hilouding ahi: ahinla hunghiti ding ahi, nilhah phatle vah umding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule hiti ding ahi, Jerusalem'a konin hintwi longdoh ding; akeh khat chu solam twipi lama longa, akeh khat lhumlam twipi lama longding, hichu chuhle khala long ding ahi.","ref":"Ezek 47:1; Jhn 7:38; Tph 22:1."},"9":{"text":"Chule leiset pumpi chunga Pakai chu leng chang ding ahi. Hiche nikho chule Pakai khat hintin, amin chu khat hiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Gam jouse Geba'a pat Jerusalem lhanglam Rimmon gei chu phaicham tobang hungsoh ding ahi. Jerusalem chu kidom sanga, Benjamin kotpi-a pat kotpi masagei le kotpi ningchong gei; chule Hananeel insanga pat lengpa lengpitwi chilna geija chenna hiding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule asunga chu miho chenga; avela suhmang hela umkit talou ding, Jerusalem chu bitkeija chenna joh hiding ahitai.","ref":"Tph 22:3."},"12":{"text":"Chule hichehi Jerusalem douna-a gal hinbol mipi jouse chunga Pakaiyin hise alansah chu hiding ahi; Akenga adin laijule apheu junmang ding, amitko sunguva amitnu junmang ding, chule aleiju akam sunguva junmang ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chule hung hitiding ahi, Pakaiya kona thunoh lentah alah uva umding; amaho mitinin aheng akom khut amatna, chule akhut chu aheng akom khut douna alap ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule Judah ten jong Jerusalem asatdiu; chule akimveluva Pathen helouho haona sana, dangka, chule ponsil nengtah-a kichom khom ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule chutobang ma chu sakol natna hise, sangan hise, sangongsang hise, sanganchal hise, chule ponbuh ho sunga ganchaho jouse chunga, hitobanga chu natna hise umding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule hung hiti ding ahi, nam jouse Jerusalem doudinga hungho lah-a panglouse chu, kumseh-a lengpa, janel Pakai houdinga cheova, chule houbuh kut mang dinga chejidiu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 23:39-43."},"17":{"text":"Chule hitiding ahi, leiset chunga inko jouse, lengpa Janel Pakai hou dinga Jerusalem'a hungtou lou chan chunga chu go julou ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule Egypt gam inko achetou lou uva, ahung daoleh, amahon go amu loudingu; houbuh kut mang dinga chetoulou Pathen houlou ho kijepna ding hise chu chang dingu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hichu Egypt mite engbolnale, houbuh kut manga hunglou nam jouse engbolna hiding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule sakol ho ki-o long chunga chu PAKAIYA DINGA ATHENG tia kijih ding; chule Pakai houin sunga bel ho jong maicham angsunga um sumlheng ho tobang hidiu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Henge, Jerusalem le Judah gama bel ho jouse chu janel Pakai dinga atheng hiding ahitai. Chule ganlhaina neijouse chun hung laovintin, an hona-a aman diu ahi. Chule hicheni chule janel Pakai in'a chu Canaan mi himhim umtalou ding ahi."}}}}},"39":{"info":{"name":"Malachi","shortname":"Mal","abbr":[],"desc":"Malachi Themgao Lekhabu"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israelte henga Malachi'a kona kiseidoh Pakai thu pohgih."},"2":{"text":"Keiman nangho kangailui tin Pakaiyin aseije, ahin nanghon iti neingailut nuham? nati uve. Esau chu Jacob sopi hilouham? tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ahinla keiman Jacob kangailun,","title":"Pakaiyin Israel Angailut","ref":"Rom 9:13."},"3":{"text":"Esau vang kahon, amolsangho le agou chanho chu kasusen gamthipma dragonho dingin kakoitai."},"4":{"text":"Edom chun, keiho suhmangin umjong leuveng, kahung kilekit uva, agemsaho chu kasahphat kit diu ahi ati; ahinla janel Pakai chun hitin ati, amahon saovintin, hijongle keiman kasuhchim ding; mihon amaho chu khangitlouna gamgi, tonsotna Pakai lung hanna miteho atidiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule namit tah-un mu uvin natin, Israel gamgi-a kona Pakai chu choi-atna umding ahi, natidiu ahi.","ref":"Isai 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Ezek 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amos 1:11-12; Obad 1-14."},"6":{"text":"Chapan apa ajaboljin, chule soh-in a pakai ajaboljin ahi. Chutia chu keijong pa kahia ahile, eiki jabolna hoiba ham? Chule Pakai kahile eikiginna hoibaham? tin Janel Pakaiyin nangho jah-a aseije, Vo kamin nahsahlou thempuho. Ahinla nanghon hoija chu kanahsah mouvem? nati uve.","title":"Pakaiyin Thempuho Aphosal"},"7":{"text":"Ka-maicham chunga changlhah thenglou natoh-un, ahinla nanghon, hoilaija nangma kasuhboh uvem? nati uve. Pakai dokhang chu nahsahmo-a bolthei ahi tia nasei naova chu nasuh boh-u ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nanghon ganlhaina dinga amitcho natoule, hichu ase hilouham? chule nanghon a-elbai le adamlou natoule, hichu ase hilou ham? tun nagam vaipopao chu hichu gapeuvin, nachunga alung lhaidem, ahiloule nangma nanasang nadem? tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Danb 15:21"},"9":{"text":"Eilungset theina diuvin, tun Pathen henga taovun tia kangeh nahiuve. Hichehi nangho themo ahin, aman nangma nana khohsah nadem? tin janelho Pakaiyin aseije."},"10":{"text":"Ka maichama moh jenseh-a mei natilou nadinguva, nangho lah ngeija moh jenseh-a kot khah ding koi nahiuvem? Nangho-a lunglhaina kaneipon, nakhut uva nathil peh-u jong laponge tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu nisa sona-a kipatna alhumna changeija, chidang namdangte lah-a kamin kithang ding ahin, amun tina gimnamtui le thilpeh theng kamina kitoh ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile Pathen heloute lah-a kamin kithang ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"12":{"text":"Ahin nanghon hichu nasuboh-un, hia chun nanghon, Pakai dokhang chu suhboh ahitai; chukoma aga hole asaho sanin nahsahmon aumtai, tin naseijuve."},"13":{"text":"Chujongle nanghon, veuvin, iti ningkitel um hitam! nati uvin, nanah nakhon khumuve, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije; chule nanghon akibot telsa, elbai, chule adamlou chu thilto dingin nahin choijiuve; hichehi nakhut uva kona kasan dingham? tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla aganhon lah-a achal umjena, chule kihahsela, Pakaiya dinga nol-um toh-a chu gaosap changhen! ajehchu keima leng lentah kahin, chule kaminhi Pathen helouho lah-a kichat umtah ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule tun, vo thempuho, hiche thupeh hi nangho ding ahi."},"2":{"text":"Hichehi nangai lou uva, kamin loupi sahna dinga, nalunga nachin louvule, Janel Pakaiyin aseije, nachung uva gaosapna kahin solding, naphatthei nahou chu kagaosap ding ahi. Nanghon nalunguva nachinlou jeh uva, amaho chu kagaosap sajong ahitai."},"3":{"text":"Veuvin, keiman nachilhah-u kasuhboh-a, namai uva eh kanu ding, na kut loupi houva eh ngeijong chu kanu diu; chule khatnin hiche puma chu napuimang diu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kakitepna Levi mite henga aumjing theina dinga, hiche thupeh hi naheng uva kahinsol ahi ti nahetdiu ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Minb 3:11-13"},"5":{"text":"Kakitepna hinna le chamna chu amatoh anaumin; aman eigin theina dingin hicheho chu ama kapen, chule kamin masanga akichan ahi.","ref":"Minb 25:12."},"6":{"text":"Thutah danthu chu akama aumin, amuh-a khangitlouna akimupoi. Lung mongtah le lungdih tah-in keima toh alhon khomin, mi tamtah akhan gitlou naova konin aleheije."},"7":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile thempu muh chun hetna achintup ding, akama danthu aholding dol ahi. Ajehchu ama janel Pakai thupole ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahivangin nangho lampia konin nakihei doh-un; mi tamtah dan thua nakipal lhuh sah-un, Levi toh kitepna chu nasuboh uve, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nanghon kalampi najotlou dungjuiju le dan thua nalangneiju dungjuija, keiman jong nangho mi jouse anga nahsah mole noise umtah-a kasemu nahi."},"10":{"text":"Ibonuva Pa khatbou ineiju hilou ham? Pathen khatnin eisem cheh-u hilouham? Ipi dinga ami takipmin asopi kitahlou tah-a iboluva, ipu ipateu kitepna isuhboh-u ham?","title":"Pathen'a Dinga Mipite Kitahlouna"},"11":{"text":"Judah'in kitahlouna ana mangin, Israel le Jerusalem'a thet umtah ana kibole; ajehchu Judah'in Pakaiyin angailut athen nachu asuboh-in, hetkhahlou pathen chanu ana kichenpin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hitobang bolpa chu, mihilpa chule ajilpa hihen, janel Pakai henga thilto boljipa hijongle, Jacob houbuh-a kona Pakaiyin asatlhah ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule hiche jonghi nabolkit uve: Pakai maicham chu mitlhiho chule kana le pen na-in nakhu khum taovin, hijeh-a chu thilto chu aman ima agel da-a, nakhut uva chu kipah tah-a asanlou ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon ipijeh inem? nati uve. Ajehchu Pakai chu kitah loutah-a nabol, nakhangdon laija na-inneipi le nangma kikah-a ahetoh ahijeh ahi. Hijongle ama chu nakiloipi, chule kitepna-a na-inneipi hija ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule Lhagao chu achunga aumsah-a, Aman amani chu khatna anasem hilouham? Ipijeh-a khat hijaham? Pathen ngaisah ding chilhah aholna ahi. Hijeh-a chu asenji chunga koimacha kitahlou tah-a aumlouna dingin, nalhagaovin ching theijun."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai, Israelte Pathen'in kida kaho-e tin aseije; ajehchu mihem khatnin aponsilin pumhat akhukhumin ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije. Hijeh chun kitahlou tah-a nachon louna diuvin, nalhagaovin chingthei jun."},"17":{"text":"Nanghon nathuseijun Pakai chu nathachol sah uvin ahi. Hinla hoija kathachol sah-um? nati uve; nanghon, thilse bolchan chu Pakai mitmu-a apha ahin, ama hiche ho-a chun akipah jie nati uva, ahiloule thutan Pathen chu hoija umam? nati tengule nathachol sah-u ahi.","title":"Thutan Nikho Anaitai"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Veovin, keiman kasottol soling ting, aman kamasanga kalampi asem ding; nanghon naholu Pakai, achunga nakipanao kitepna thupole pa ngei chu, photlot louva a-houin'a hung ding ahi. Veovin, hungding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Matt 11:10; Mrk 1:2; Luk 1:76; 7:27."},"2":{"text":"Ahivangin ahung ni chu koiham athohjou ding, ahungkilah teng koiham adingthei dinga? ama chu suhthengna meile sopthengna savon tobang ahi.","ref":"Joel 2:11; Tph 6:17."},"3":{"text":"Ama dangka lhahtheng le suthengpa banga touding; Levi chate chun chonphatna-a Pakai henga thilto atotheina diuva asuhthenga, sana dangka banga alhahtheng dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuteng khangluilai le kum masaho banga, Judah le Jerusalem ganlhaina chu Pakai dinga lunglhaina hikit ding ahitai."},"5":{"text":"Chule keiman thutan dinga naheng kahin naiding: doichoiho, jon panho, jouva kihahsel ho, sum thalo ho le meithaiho chule pabeiho bolgimho, maljinho kiheimang khumho, chule keima eiging louho douna-a hettohsah gangtah kahi ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu keima kikhel lou Pathen kahin; vo Jacob chateho, hijeh-a chu nangho suhmanga umlou nahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Napu napateu nikholaija patnin kahoudan thupeh ho-a konin nache mangun, hicheho chu nitjong nanitpouvin ahi, kahenga hung kileovin, keima jong naheng uva hungkilenge, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije. Ahinla nanghon iti kahungkile diuham? nati uve.","title":"Hopsom Peh Thudol"},"8":{"text":"Mihem'in Pathen achom ngaijem? Ahin nanghon keima neichom uve. Ahinla nanghon hoija nang kachomun? nati uve. Hopsom le thilto-a neichomun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Nanghon neichom jeh-u leh, hiche nam pumpi jeng jonghin eichom jeh uva, gaosapna-a gaosap chang nahitaove."},"10":{"text":"Ka-in'a nehle chah aumna dingin, hopsom jouse thilkholna insung hinlhutnun, van kot ho kahona asunga akoina ding indan aumlou geija phattheina kahin buhlhah hih-em, tun hiche-a hin neipatep untin, janel Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Thmpu 27:30; Minb 18:21-24; Danb 12:6; 14:22-29; Neh 13:12"},"11":{"text":"Chule nangho khohsahna jala bahgampa chu kaphosal ding, aman naleisetna gahou chu asuhmang tahlou ding; loulaija lengpiga injong aphat masanga aga apulsah louding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"12":{"text":"Chule nangma kipa umtah gam nahitah ding jeh-a, nam jousen anunnom nati diu ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"13":{"text":"Nathu houchu kachunga akhouthei lheh-e, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ahin nanghon nangma douna-a chutiloma ipi kaseibeh uvem? nati uvin ahi.","title":"Pathen Thutep Le Hepina"},"14":{"text":"Nanghon, Pathen kinbol hi pannabei ahi: eihon ahoudan thupeh initnuva, chule lunghem tah-a janel Pakai anga ivaleova ipi phachomam? nati uve."},"15":{"text":"Chule tun nanghon mikiletsah ho chu akipah-e natiuvin; henge, khangilou tah-a lamlha ho chu choisangin aumin; Pathen lhem patep ho jengjong ahoidoh-un ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Pakai gingho chu khatle khat akihouvun; Pakaiyin angaijin ajatan; Pakai ginga, amin geldoh jingho dingin, a-angsunga geldoh jingna lekhabu khat akisunin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Kasongmantam ho kasemdoh nikho leh, amaho keima-a hidiu ahi tin janel Pakaiyin aseije; chuteng mipa khatnin alhacha-a pang achapa akhendoh banga, keiman jong amaho chu kakhendoh ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chutengleh hungkile heijun natin, michonpha le mikhangilou nahet khendiu, Pathen jen le ajenlouho nahekhen diu ahitai."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ajehchu, veuvin, meilhumpi banga kading nikho chu ahung lhunge; chule mi hoitho jouse le thilse bol ho jouse kipallhudiu ahi; hiche nikho hunglhung ding chun amaho akahvam heldiu, hichun ajungjong abah jong akhenlou ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.","title":"Pakai Nikho Ahung Naije"},"2":{"text":"Ahinla kamin ginga nangho din vang chonphatna nisa chu alhaving teni-a damna puma hungsoh ding; chule nangho bongkula bongnou kivah ho banga napotdoh uva, nakhandoh diu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hiche kabol ding nikho chule, mikhangilou ho chu nachot phaova, amaho chu nakengto noijuva leivui hidiu, ahi tin janel Pakaiyin aseije."},"4":{"text":"Kasohpa Mosi dan, Horeb mun'a Israel mite jouse dinga ahenga kathupeh, dan kisunho le thutanna chu geldoh jingun."},"5":{"text":"Veovin, Pakai nikho loupi le kichat umtah ahunglhun masanga Elijah themgao kahin solpeh ding nahiuve.","ref":"Matt 11:14; 17:10-13; Mrk 9:11-13; Luk 1:17; Jhn 1:21."},"6":{"text":"Ama chun pate lungsung chate lama, chate lungsung pate lama alehei ding ahi, achuti loule keima hungin ting leiset hi gaosap na-a kajep ding ahi."}}}}},"40":{"info":{"name":"Mathew","shortname":"Matt","abbr":[],"desc":"Mathew Sut Kipana Thupha"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham chapa, David chapa, Jesu Christa khangui thubu.","title":"Jesu Christa Phunggui (Luk 3:23-38)"},"2":{"text":"Abraham'in Isaac ahingin; Isaac'in Jacob ahingin; Jacob'in Juda le asopiteho ahingin;"},"3":{"text":"Juda'in Tamar toh Pharez le Zera ahingin; Pharez'in Esrom ahingin; Esrom'in Aram ahingin;"},"4":{"text":"Aram'in Aminadab ahingin; Aminadab'in Nahson ahingin; Nahson'in Salmon ahingin;"},"5":{"text":"Salmon'in Rahab toh Boaz ahingin; Boaz'in Ruth toh Obed ahingin; Obed chun Jesse ahingin;"},"6":{"text":"Jesse'in David lengpa ahingin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin David'in Uriah inneipi toh Solomon ahingin; Solomon'in Rehoboam ahingin; Rehoboam'in Abijah ahingin; Abijah'in Asa ahingin;"},"8":{"text":"Asa'in Josaphat ahingin; Josaphat'in Joram ahingin; Joram'in Uzziah ahingin;"},"9":{"text":"Uzziah'n Jotham ahingin; Jotham'in Ahaz ahingin; Ahaz'in Hezekiah ahingin;"},"10":{"text":"Hezekiah'in Manasseh ahingin; Manasseh'in Amon ahingin; Amon'in Josiah ahingin;"},"11":{"text":"Josiah'in Jechoniah le asopiho Babylon gama atolmang laijun ahingin ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 24:14-15; 2 Thusm 36:10; Jer 27:20"},"12":{"text":"Chuin Babylon'a atolmang nungun, Jekoniah'in Shealtiel ahingin; Shealtiel'in Zerubbabel ahingin;"},"13":{"text":"Zerubbabel'in Abiud ahingin; Abiud'in Eliakim ahingin; Eliakim'in Azor ahingin;"},"14":{"text":"Azor'in Sadoc ahingin; Sadoc'in Akim ahingin; Akim'in Elihud ahingin;"},"15":{"text":"Elihud'in Eleazer ahingin; Eleazer'in Mathan ahingin; Mathan'in Jacob ahingin;"},"16":{"text":"Chuin, Jacob'in Joseph ahingin, ama chu Christa kiti Jesu penna nu Mariam inneipu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hitichun khang agomin Abraham'a pat David geijin khang somle khang li ahin, David'a pat Babylon gama atolmang geijin khang somle khang li, chule Babylon gama atolmanguva pat Christa pen gei khang somle khang li ahi."},"18":{"text":"Jesu Christa pen umchan chu hiti ahi. Anu Mariam chu Joseph'in aji dinga ahol ahin, akigop masang lhonin amanu chu Lhagao Thenga kona agai akihedohtan ahi.","title":"Jesu Christa Pen (Luk 2:1-7)","ref":"Luk 1:27."},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin a-inneipu Joseph chu michonpha tah ahi jeh-in, lhang phonga japi seithangin aumsah nom hih-in, guhthima kikhenpi ding lung angai totan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Aman lung achuti ngaito laitah-in, veuvin, Pakai vantil khatnin amangin akimusah-in, ajah-a, David chapa Joseph, na-inneipi Mariam gakipuilut ding olmo hih-in; ijeh-inem itile ama Lhagao Thenga kona gaija ahi."},"21":{"text":"Amanu soh intin chapa khat ahin ding ahi, chule amin Jesu nasah ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile amatah chun amite achonsetnuva kona ahuhhing ding ahi.","ref":"Luk 1:31"},"22":{"text":"Pakaiyin Themgao kama asei thu,"},"23":{"text":"Veuvin, nungah theng chu hung gaijintin, chapa khat ahin ding ahi, Chule amin Immanuel asah ding ahi, ati, (Hichu Pathen'in eiumpiuve tina ahi) tia asei chu guilhuna dinga thu hicheng chu soh-a ahi.","ref":"Isai 7:14."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Joseph a-imut akhangin, akipat in Pakai vantil'in thu apeh bang chun abolin, a-inneipi chu akichenpin ahi;"},"25":{"text":"Ahivangin amanun chapa peng masapen anei kahsen kitohkhahpi louhelin aumin; chuin acha chu amin Jesu asahtai.","ref":"Luk 2:21"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Herod lengpa lal laijin Judah gama Bethlehem khopi-ah Jesu apengtan ahile, veuvin, niso lama konin ahsi lekhathem ho phabep Jerusalem'a ahungun, Judah te lengpa apengin ahi, ama chu hoilamham?","title":"Solam Miching hon Ahungvil"},"2":{"text":"Keihon niso lamah ahsi kamuvin, chibai bola hung kahiuve, atiuvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Herod lengpan chuche thu ajah phatnin, amati Jerusalem miteti alungu ajingtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuphatnin thempu pipuiho leh miho danthu sunho chu akhomin, Christa hoija peng dingham, tin adongin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amahon ajah-a, Judah gam Bethlehem'a peng ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile,"},"6":{"text":"Vo Judah gama um Bethlehem, Judah vaipote lah-a nangma iti nama jongle aneopen nahipoi; Ijeh-inem itile nalah-a kona vaipo khat, Kamite Israelte ching ding chu pengdoh ding ahi; tin themgao seija konin akisune, atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Mica 5:2."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Herod in ahsi lekhathem ho chu guhthimin akouvin, ahsi so phat chu kichentah-in ahetoh tan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin amaho chu Bethlehem'a asolin, Cheovinlang naosen chungchang thudol chu chentah-in gadongtoh uvin; chule namudoh tengule keima jong kache-a chibai kagaboh theina dingin thu hinpo kit uvin, ati."},"9":{"text":"Lengpa thu ajah phatnun amaho akipatdoh taovin ahi; chule, veuvin, niso lama amu-u ahsi chu amasanguva achepeh-in, naosen umna chunga chun akingan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahsi chu amu phat uvin athao anomin, hapan akipah-un ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amaho in sunga alutnun ahile naosen chu anu Mariam toh amu thaovin, aboh khupmun ama chu ahou taovin ahi; chuin athil lu bom cheh-u asolhaovin, kipamanin, sana, bego, myrrh ama chu apetaovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chujouvin amanguva Herod heng lama akile kit louna dinguva Pathen'in ahilchah jeh uvin, lam chom ahovin agam lamuva achemang taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin amaho chedoh nungin, veuvin, Joseph amangin Pakai vantil khatnin, Thouvin, naosen leh anu puijin lang Egypt gama jam lutpitan, chule thu kapeh kahsen chua chun um jingin; ijeh-inem itile Herod'in naosen chu suhmang dinga ahol ding ahi, ati.","title":"Egypt Gama Ajam"},"14":{"text":"Chuin ama athoudoh-in, jan-in naosen leh anu akipuijin, Egypt gam ajontan ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule Herod thi kahsen hia chun aumin ahi: Pakaiyin themgao kama asei, Egypt gama konin ka-Chapa kakouve, ati chu guilhuna dinga chuti ahi.","ref":"Hos 11:1."},"16":{"text":"Chuin ahsi lekhathem hon alhim lhah-u ahi akihetdoh phatnin, Herod alunghang behseh-in, mi asolin, ahsi lekhathem ho-a kona aphat ahetchen dungjui chun, Bethlehem le akimvel sese-a pasal chapang kum ni-a lhah noilamse athattan ahi.","title":"Herod Lengpan Bethlehem naosen ho Athagam"},"17":{"text":"Hichun themgao Jeremiah thusei,"},"18":{"text":"Ramah-a akaple amao aw akijai; Rachel'in achate aka akan, Aum lou jeh uvin lhepbi ding anomtapon ahi; ati chu guilhunga ahitai.","ref":"Jer 31:15."},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin Herod athi phatnin, veuvin, Pakai vantil khatnin Egypt gamah Joseph mangin akimusah-in,","title":"Egypt Gama Kona Ahung Kile Kit"},"20":{"text":"Thouvin lang naosen leh anu kipuijin, Israel gam lama chetan; naosen tha dinga goteho chu athitaove, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin ama kipatdoh-in, naosen leh anu akipuijin, Israel gam lama ahung kit tai."},"22":{"text":"Ahivangin Judah gamah Archelaus apa Herod khelin vai apoi ti ajah phatnin, chulama ache ngamta hih-in; amanga akihilchah jeh-in, akipatnin Galilee gamah akileheitai."},"23":{"text":"Chule ama chu Nazareth mi kiti ding ahi, tia themgao hon asei chu guilhun theinan, achen Nazareth khopi-ah achengtan ahi.","ref":"Mrk 1:24; Luk 2:39; Jhn 1:45"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chulai chun John Baptist chu ahungin,","title":"John Baptist Thulhangsap (Mrk 1:1-8 ; Luk 3:1-18 ; Jhn 1:19-28)"},"2":{"text":"Nalung heijun; van lenggam anaitai, tin Judah gam gamthipmah thu alhang samlen ahi.","ref":"Matt 4:17; Mrk 1:15"},"3":{"text":"Isaiah themgaovin, Gamthipma khosam aw khatnin, Pakai lamlen semtohsan koijun, Alampi semjangun, tin aseije, tia asei chu ama hi ahi.","ref":"Isai 40:3."},"4":{"text":"John chu apon-ah sangongsang mul ahin, akongah savun konggah akigah-in, chule a-anneh chu khaokho le gam khoiju ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 1:8."},"5":{"text":"Chuphatnin Jerusalem le Judah gam jouse-a mi, chule Jordan vel gamkol sung jouse-a mi ahenga ache acheuvin,"},"6":{"text":"Achonsetnao cheh aphongun, Jordan luidunga chun ama khutna baptize achang taovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahin Pharisaiho le Saddukai ho mi tamtah ama khutna baptize chang dinga ahungu amun phatnin, ajah uva, Vo gulse sonho, Khonunga lunghanna hung lhung dinga kona jamna ding lungthim koiham napeuva?","ref":"Matt 12:34; 23:33."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun lunghei toh kilomin gadoh-un;"},"9":{"text":"Chule nalah uva, Abraham kapului'u aumnai, tin ngaito hih-un; ijeh-inem itile tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche songho-a kona hi Pathen'in Abraham chate asodohsah thei ahi.","ref":"Jhn 8:33"},"10":{"text":"Chule tu jenga jong thing bultina heicha kikoija ahitai. Chutiachu thingphung aga phalou chengse chu kiphuh lhu-a, meija kisep lutji ahi.","ref":"Matt 7:19"},"11":{"text":"Lungheina dinga keiman twija baptize kachansah bou ahi; amavang kanunga hungpa keima sanga chungnungjo ahi; keima akengchot choi dinga jong kilom kahipoi. Amatah chun nangho Lhagao Theng le meija baptize nachansah dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Aman akhutna godal achoije; aman aphol jap ngimsel intin, achang apang sunga akhum ding; asi vang chu mit theilou meija agovam ding ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Hiche pet chun Jesu John khutna baptize chang dingin, Galilee'a konin John hengah Jordan lamah ahungin ahi.","title":"Jesu Baptize Chan (Mrk 1:9-11 ; Luk 3:21-22)"},"14":{"text":"Ahivangin John anathuphan, Nangma khutna kachan ding johsih-a, nangma kahenga hung nahim? ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, Tun hisah poupoutan; ijeh-inem itile chonphatna jouse abancha hitia hi ibulhit dingdol ahi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Jesu baptize achan jouvin, twilah-a konin apotdoh paitan ahi; chuin, veuvin, ama dingin van kot akihongin, chule Pathen Lhagao vakhu banga ahung lenlhah-a achunga ahungchuh amun;"},"17":{"text":"chuin, Ama hi ka-Chapa deitah ahi, achunga kalung alhai tangeije, tin van'a konin aw ahung gingin ahi.","ref":"Semt 22:2; Labu 2:7; Isai 42:1; Matt 12:18; 17:5; Mrk 1:11; Luk 9:35"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hichun Jesu diabol lhep patepma umdingin gamthipmah Lhagao puitouvin aumtan ahi.","title":"Jesu Lhep Patepma Aum (Mrk 1:12-13 ; Luk 4:1-13)","ref":"Heb 2:18; 4:15."},"2":{"text":"Chuin nisomli le jansomli an ngola aum jouvin, agil keltan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin alhempa chu ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, Nangma Pathen Chapa nahile, hiche songho hi changlhah asona dingin thu pen, ati."},"4":{"text":"Ahin aman adonbut-in, Mihem changlhah jenga hing lou ding ahi, Pathen kam sunga kona thu pot chengsea bou hing ding ahi, hitichun akisune, ati.","ref":"Danb 8:3."},"5":{"text":"Chuphatnin diabol'in ama chu khopi theng lama apuijin, Pathen houin tingvuma chun adinsah-in, ajah-a,"},"6":{"text":"Pathen Chapa nahile, nangma kichomlha jengin; ijeh-inem itile hitihin akisune, Aman nangma chung changah avantilho thu pentin, Amahon akhutnuva nadop dingu ahi; Achuti louleh songah nakeng sukhan nate, ati.","ref":"Labu 91:11-12"},"7":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah-a, Hiti jonghin akisune, Nangman Pakai na-Pathen lhem patep hih-in, ati.","ref":"Danb 6:16."},"8":{"text":"Diabol'in ama mol sangtah chunga apuikitnin, vannoi leiset gamle aloupina jouse jong avetsah-in; chuin ajah-a,"},"9":{"text":"Nakhupboh-a nalhuh-a neihouva ahile, hichengse hi penge, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chutah-in Jesu'n ajah-a, Chemangin, Satan; ijeh-inem itile hitin akisune, Pakai na-Pathen chu houvin lang ama jengbou jenin, ati.","ref":"Danb 6:13."},"11":{"text":"Chuphatnin diabol in ama adalhatai; chuin, veuvin, vantil ho ahungun ama chu ahung jenle taovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n John amantaove ti ajah phatnin, Galilee gam lama achen;","title":"Jesu'n Galilee Gama Anatoh Apat (Mrk 1:14-15 ; Luk 4:14-15)","ref":"Matt 14:3; Mrk 6:17; Luk 3:19-20."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Nazareth adalhan, Zebulun le Naphtali gamkai sunga dillen panga, Capernaum kho-a achen agachengin ahi;","ref":"Jhn 2:12"},"14":{"text":"Isaiah themgaovin asei,"},"15":{"text":"Zebulun gam le Naphtali gam, Jordan gal lang khat gamkol dillen panga cheng, Chidang namdangte Galilee;","ref":"Isai 9:1-2."},"16":{"text":"Muthim lah-a touho chun vah loupitah amutaove, Chule thina gamle alima touho chunguva kho avahtai, ati chu guilhuna dinga chuti ahitai."},"17":{"text":"Hiche laija pat chun Jesu'n thu ahil lhanglen, Nalung heijun; vangam anaitai, ati.","ref":"Matt 3:2."},"18":{"text":"Chujouvin Jesu Galilee dillen panga avale petnin, Peter kiti Simon le anaopa Andrew dillena len ase lhon amun; amani chu nga man mi ahi lhone.","title":"Jesu'n Ngaman Mi Li Akou (Mrk 1:16-20 ; Luk 5:1-11)"},"19":{"text":"Chuin aman amani jah-a, kanung hinjui lhonin, keiman nangni mi man len sepmin sem lhoninge, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin amanin apet petnin alen adalha lhonin, anung ajui lhontai."},"21":{"text":"Chuin ama chukoma konchun achepaijin ahile, midang ucha nima, Zebedee chapa Jacob le anaopa John apau Zebedee toh kong sunga alennu anakhui phatnu amun; amanima chu akouvin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin amanin apet petnin akongle apalhon adalha lhonin, anung ajui lhontai."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Jesu Galilee gamse se-a avahle avahlen, akikhopnao in tinah thu ahillen, Pathen lenggam Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen, miho ahivei jouseu chule adamlou jouse adamsahtan ahi.","title":"Jesu Thuhil Leh Midamsah (Luk 6:17-19)","ref":"Matt 9:35; Mrk 1:39."},"24":{"text":"Hichun Syria gama amin akithangin; thilhavop, abuhthi, langthi, ima hivei chomchom veija anat thohlel jouse ahenga ahinpuijun, aman amaho chu aboldam sohkeijin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Galilee, Dicapoli, Jerusalem, chule Judah gama konle Jordan gal lang khat lama konin mihon tamtah-in anung ajuitan ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aman mipi chengse chu amun, molvum chungah akaltouvin; chuin ama atouvin ahile aseijuite chu ahengah ahungun;","title":"Mol Chunga Athuhil"},"2":{"text":"Chuin ama apaodoh-in, amaho chu hiche thuhi ahil pantan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Lhagaova vaichaho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile van lenggam chu amaho-a ahi.","title":"Nunnom Tahbeh (Luk 6:20-23)"},"4":{"text":"Alhaseteho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile lhep lungmonga umding ahiuve.","ref":"Isai 61:2."},"5":{"text":"Mi lungnengteho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile amahon leiset chung alo dingu ahi.","ref":"Labu 37:11."},"6":{"text":"Chonphatna lama gilkel le dangchah ho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile amaho chu vading ahiuve.","ref":"Isai 55:1-2."},"7":{"text":"Milungset teho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile amaho chu kilungset ding ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Milungthengho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile amahon Pathen amu dingu ahi.","ref":"Labu 24:3-4."},"9":{"text":"Misucham ho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile amaho chu Pathen chate kiti ding ahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Chonphat jala bolsetna thohho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile van lenggam chu amaho-a ahi.","ref":"1 Pet 3:14."},"11":{"text":"Keima jala mihon nahouset uva, nabolset uva, chule nachung uva jouthu-a thugilou asei tengule anunnom nahiuve.","ref":"1 Pet 4:14."},"12":{"text":"Kipah-un, hapan kipah-un; ijeh inem itile van'a nasan dingu kipaman atame; ijeh inem itile nangho masanga anaum themgaoho jong chu mihon chutobangma chun abolseuvin ahi.","ref":"2 Thusm 36:16; Sol 7:52"},"13":{"text":"Nangho leiset chi nahiuve: ahin chi khu tam tahenlang hile, ipi-a ki-al sah dingham? Chukalle apanna umtapontin, paidohle mihemte chotpha dingbou ahitai.","title":"Chi le Meivah (Mrk 9:50 ; Luk 14:34-35)"},"14":{"text":"Nangho vannoi vah nahiuve. Lhang vuma khopi chu akisel theipoi.","ref":"Jhn 8:12; 9:5."},"15":{"text":"Min meivah avah-in, lo akhukhum ngaipoi, atunna chunga akoijin; chuteng in sunga um chengse chu asalvah bouvin ahi.","ref":"Mrk 4:21; Luk 8:16; 11:33"},"16":{"text":"Hiche bang chun navah-u chu miho angah kilanghen, chuteng amahon nachon phatnao chu mu theijuntin, chule van'a um na-Pau chu avahchoi dingu ahi.","ref":"1 Pet 2:12"},"17":{"text":"Keima danthu le themgaoho thu sumang dinga hungin neingaito hih-un; asumanga hung hilouvin, asubulhit dingjoh-a hung kahibouve.","title":"Dan Chung Changa Thuhil"},"18":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Vanle lei aman kahse-a, danthu chu jemsipah penle ajem halsicha jong aboncha abulhin masangse-a mang lou ding ahi.","ref":"Luk 16:17"},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun koi hijongle hiche thupeh neopen lah-a khat suse-a, chule chutobanga bol ding hila chu, van lenggama aneopena kisei ding ahi; chule koi hijongle anitna, chule chutobanga hila vang chu, van lenggama alenpena kisei ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile kaseipeh nahiuve, Nangho danthu sunho le Pharisai ho sanga nachon phatnao achung nunjoh louva ahile, van gama nalut louhel dingu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Tolthat hih-un; koi hijongle tolthat chu thupi tanna-a dinga kicha jinga umding ahi, tia malai mite jah-a kisei thu chu najataove.","title":"Lunghan Chung Changa Thuhil","ref":"Pot 20:13; Danb 5:17."},"22":{"text":"Ahivangin keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Koi hijongle ajeh beija asopi lunghan khuma chu thupi tanna-a dinga kicha jinga umding ahi; chule, koi hijongle asopi, Raca, tia chu houvaipoloi kikhopna-a dinga kicha jinga umding ahi. Chule koi hijongle asopi, Mingol, tia chu damun meidila dinga kicha jinga umding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun maicham mun'a thil to ding nachoija nahunga, nasopi nachunga alung himona nahetdoh-a ahile,"},"24":{"text":"Nathil to ding chu maicham koma chun dalhanlang, chen, nasopi chutoh gakicham masan, chujoule hungin nathil to ding chu toh-in."},"25":{"text":"Nahehpa chu lampia naum petnin kichampin, achuti loule nahehpan thutan vaihom henga leh lutnin natin, thutan vaihom chun sottolle khutnah pedoh-in natin, chuteng aman songkul'a nakhum ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahi, Nangman achai nakei paisa keh khat geija nasahsoh masangse-a, iti jongle chua kona napotdoh louhel ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Jonthanhoi bol hih-in, tia malaija kisei chu nanghon najataove;","title":"Jonthanhoi Chung Changa Thuhil","ref":"Pot 20:14; Danb 5:18."},"28":{"text":"Ahivangin keiman nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hijongle numei jonlunga vea chu amanu chutoh alunga jonga ahitai."},"29":{"text":"Chule namit jetlamin nasuhmo le, kaldoh inlang paimangin; ijeh-inem itile natahsa pumpi damuna lelutna aum sangin, natibah khat aman ding nang dingin aphajoi.","ref":"Matt 18:9; Mrk 9:47"},"30":{"text":"Chule nakhut jetlamin nasuhmo le, hi jong chu satlhan lang paimangin; natahsa pumpi-a damuna nachuh sangin, natibah khat aman dinga nang dinga phajo ahi.","ref":"Matt 18:8; Mrk 10:11-12"},"31":{"text":"Chule, Koi hijongle aji da-a chun, dana lekha pehen, kitisa ahi;","title":"Jida Chung Changa Thuhil (Matt 19:9 ; Mrk 10:11-12 ; Luk 16:18)","ref":"Danb 24:1-4; Matt 19:7; Mrk 10:4."},"32":{"text":"Ahivangin keiman najah uva kasei ahi, Ajon jeh tailouva thu dang jeh-a aji da-a chun, ajinu chu ajonsah ahi; chule koi hile akidasa numei chu akichenpia jong chu ajonga ahi.","ref":"Matt 19:9; Mrk 10:11-12; Luk 16:18; 1 Cor 7:10-11"},"33":{"text":"Chukitle, jouvin Kihahsel hih-un, naki hahselna chu Pakai henga molson, tia malai mite jah-a kiseisa chu najataove;","title":"Kihahsel Chung Changa Thuhil","ref":"Thmpu 19:21; Minb 30:2; Danb 23:21."},"34":{"text":"Ahivangin keiman najah uva kasei ahi; Imachan kihahsel hih-un, van min panin kihah sel hih-un, Pathen touna ahi jeh-in;","ref":"Jac 5:12; Isai 66:1; Matt 23:22"},"35":{"text":"Chule lei min panin kihahsel hih-un, ijeh-inem itile hichu akengto ngapna ahi. Jerusalem min panin kihahsel hih-un; ijeh-inem itile hichu Leng chungnung khopi ahi.","ref":"Isai 66:1; Labu 48:2"},"36":{"text":"Naluchang panin kihahsel hih-un; ijeh-inem itile nangman nasam jang khat jengcha jong nakansah navomsah theipon ahi."},"37":{"text":"Ahin nasei chu ahile ahi, ahiloule ahilou hijenghen; hicheng kalval chu agilouva kona bou ahitai."},"38":{"text":"Mit khela mit, ha khela ha, tia kisei chu najataove;","title":"Kiphulah Chung Changa Thuhil (Luk 6:29-30)","ref":"Pot 21:24; Thmpu 24:20; Danb 19:21."},"39":{"text":"Ahivangin keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Migilou thuh hih-un; amavang koi hile nangeiphe jetlam benga chu, lang khat jong dopeh-in."},"40":{"text":"Koi hile heh dinga nago-a nasangkhol sungnung lah dinga go-a chu, naponlen jong chu pe jengin."},"41":{"text":"Koi hile apoh po dinga nacham louva bola mile khat napuija chu, mile ni chepin."},"42":{"text":"Nahenga thuma chu pen, nahenga thilpa thuma chu kihei mangsan hih-in."},"43":{"text":"Naheng nakom ngailunlang, chule namelma teu hotbolun, tia kisei chu najataove;","title":"Melma Ngailut Ding (Luk 6:27-28 , 32-36)","ref":"Thmpu 19:18."},"44":{"text":"Ahivangin, keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, namelma teu ngailuvin, nagaosap teo chu phatthei boh-un, nahoteu chu phatbolun, chule nadangdat teole nabolseteu dingin taopeh-un;"},"45":{"text":"Chutilebou van'a na-Pau chate nahithei dingu ahi. Ijeh-inem itile aman migiloule mipha chunga anisa asosah gelin, chule michonpha le michonse chunga go ajuhsah gelin ahi."},"46":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile nanghon nangailu teo jeng chu nangailut uva ahile, ipi kipaman nasan dinguham? Kaidonghon jong chutima chu abolu hilouham?"},"47":{"text":"Chule nasopiu jengmai salam naboh uva ahile, midang ipi-a nakhelnao umam? Kaidonghon jong chutia chu abol louham?"},"48":{"text":"Hijeh chun van'a um na-Pau aphat chamkimsoh bangin, nangho jong chamkimun.","ref":"Thmpu 19:2; Danb 18:13"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nathilphabolu chu mihon amuna dinguva amasanguva nabol louna dinguvin chingtheijun; chutia nabol ule van'a na-Pau koma san ding kipaman nei lou nahiuve.","title":"Thilpeh Chung Changa Thuhil","ref":"Matt 23:5."},"2":{"text":"Hijeh chun mi thil napeh tengule, mi pachat ding ngaitonan miphalhem ho bangin kikhopna in tinleh lam dungah namasang sang uva sumkon mut hih-un; tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Amaho chun kipaman akisanu ahitai."},"3":{"text":"Nangma vangin mi thil napeh teng, nakhut jetlamin abol chu nakhut veilam hetsah hih-in,"},"4":{"text":"Chutilebou nathilpeh chu guhthim hintin, guhthima mu-a na-Pan phongtah-a nangma nasah ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nangho Pathen henga natao tengule miphalhem hotoh bang hih-un, amahon mi mu dingin kikhopna intina le lamkontina dina tao adeijun ahi. Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Amaho chun kipaman akisanu ahitai.","title":"Taona Chung Changa Thuhil","ref":"Luk 18:10-14."},"6":{"text":"Nang vang natao tengle, na-insung dana lutnin lang chule kot khah-in, guhthima um na Pa henga taovin; chuteng guhthima mu-a na-Pan nangma phongtah-a nasah ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Amavang chidang namdangte bangin naseisa velsei kit hih-un, ijeh-inem itile amahon thu tamtah asei jeh uva chu jahpeh-a umdinga angaitou ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun amahotoh bang hih-un; ijeh-inem itile nathum masangun, nadei nangai chanu chu na-Pau vin ahenai."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun hitihin taovun; Van'a um ka-Pau, namin kijahen."},"10":{"text":"Nagam hung lhunghen. Van'a nalungchan akim bangin, leija jong nalungchan kimhen."},"11":{"text":"Tunin kaneh khop dingu anneh neipeuvin."},"12":{"text":"Kalei bateu kangaidam bangun, keiho bat jong ngaidamin."},"13":{"text":"Chule lhepna-a neipui hih-un, agilouva konin neihuhdoh jouvin: ajehchu lenggam, thahat, chule loupina atonsotna nanga ahi, Amen."},"14":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile nanghon mi suhkhel nangaidam uva ahile, van'a na-Pau vin jong nangho suhkhel angaidam ding ahi.","ref":"Mrk 11:25-26."},"15":{"text":"Amavang nanghon mi suhkhel nangaidam lou vangule, na-Pau vin jong nangho suhkhel angaidam lou ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nanghon an nangol tengule, miphalhem ho bangin kinguisah hih-un; ijeh-inem itile amahon an angolu min ahetna dingin, amaiso achom ahisah jiuvin ahi. Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Amahon kipaman akisanu ahitai.","title":"An Ngol Chung Changa Thuhil"},"17":{"text":"Nangma vangin an nangol tengle, nalu thao kinunlang, namai jong kiphet in."},"18":{"text":"Chutile mihem mitmu hilouva, guhthima um na-Pa mitmu-a an ngol nabah ding ahin; chuteng guhthima mu-a na-Pan phongtah-a kipaman napeh ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ngetle twi eh-in asuhmang theina, guchan aphet vanga chule aguhmang theina leiset chungah gou khol hih-un;","title":"Van'a Gou Kikhol (Luk 12:33-34)","ref":"Jac 5:2-3."},"20":{"text":"Amavang ngetle twi eh-in asuhmang thei louna, guchan jong aphetvang theilou nale aguhmang thei louna van'ah nagou kholun;"},"21":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile nagou umna-a chu nalung jong umding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mit hi natahsa meivah ahi; hijeh chun namit achima ahile, nati pumpi vah ding ahi.","title":"Tahsa Meivah (Luk 11:34-36)"},"23":{"text":"Amavang namit phata hihle, nati apumpi thim ding ahitai. Hijeh chun nasunga um vah chu athima ahile, hiche thim chu ichana thimding hitam!"},"24":{"text":"Koima pakai ni soh ahi theipoi; ijeh-inem itile aman khat hotbolintin, khatjoh angailut ding ahi; ahiloule khatna hakai jintin, khatjoh anahsahmo ding ahi. Nangho Pathen le sum soh nahikop thei lou dingu ahi.","title":"Pathen Leh Neile Gou (Luk 16:13 ; 12:22-31)"},"25":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nangho jah-a kasei ahi, i-kaneh ding hitam, i-kadon ding hitam, tin na hinna dingun; ahiloule, i-kasila kachen ding hitam, tin natahsa dingun lungkham hih-un. Anneh sanga hinkho, chule nihchen ponsil sanga tahsa thupijo hilouham?"},"26":{"text":"Chunga leng vacha khu ngaitouvin, amahon tula atupouvin, atla a-at pouvin, ahinla van'a um na-Pau vin amaho khu avahnai. Nangho khuteho sanga lujo nahi lou uham?"},"27":{"text":"Nangho lah-a lungkham hatna ahinkho tong khat jopsaobe thei koi nahiuvem?"},"28":{"text":"Chule nihchen ponsil jeh-a ibola nalung kham uham? Jaova molhoipah khu iti khanham ngaitouvin. Hicheho khun tongla atonggim pouvin, patla akhehpouve;"},"29":{"text":"Ahivanginla keiman najah uva kaseipeh nahiuve, Solomon jeng jong aloupina jouse-a akivon chun, hiche molhoi khattoh kibangin akijem hoipon ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 10:4-7; 2 Thusm 9:3-6"},"30":{"text":"Chule jaova hampa tunia uma, jinga lhum sunga kileh lutta ding jengbon Pathen'in achuti jeple, vo tahsan lhomho, chu sanga chu Aman nangho najepjoh lou dinguham?"},"31":{"text":"Hijeh chun, I-kaneh dinguham? I kadon dinguham? I kasil dinguham, tin lungkham hih-un;"},"32":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile chidang namdang ten hitiho chu aholu ahin; chule nanghon jong hicheng chu nangaichaove ti van'a na-Pau vin ahenai."},"33":{"text":"Ahivangin amasatah-in Pathen lenggam le chonphatna hol masaovin; chuteng hichengse jong chu naki pehbe dingu ahi."},"34":{"text":"Hijeh chun jinga dingin lungkham hih-un; jing chun aman hinki ngaito nante. Ni khat hesohna chu ni khatna dingin atohbepmin ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Oimo-a naum louna dinguvin, mi oimo hih-un.","title":"Midang Oimo Thudola Thuhil (Luk 6:37-38 , 41-42)"},"2":{"text":"Na-oimo bang cheh-a chu oimo-a naum dingu ahin; chule nanghon nate bang banguva chu nangho kitepeh dinga nahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Nangma mitna thingtum uma chu ngaito louva, ibola nasopi mitna bohthem chu navet ham?"},"4":{"text":"Chule ven, nangma mitna thingtum uma, nasopi jah-a, namitna bohthem umchu neilahdoh sah-in nati theiham?"},"5":{"text":"Vo miphalhem, nangma mitna um thingtum chu kilahdoh masatnin; chutengle nasopi mitna bohthem chu lahdoh dinga namuchen dingbou ahi."},"6":{"text":"Uichaho khu thiltheng pe hih-un, vohcha anga natwikoh changu seplha hih-un; amahon hitiho chu akengun chonuntin, chule hungkile heijuntin nangho jengjong nalhehtel dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Thumun, kipe ding nahiuve; holun, namu dingu ahi; kiuvun, kihon peh ding nahiuve;","title":"Thumun, Holun, Kiuvun (Luk 11:9-13)"},"8":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile athumchan achangin; aholan amun; chule akiuva chu kot kihon peh ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Achapan changlhah athumle song pe-a,"},"10":{"text":"Nga athumle gul pe dinga, nalah uva koi naum uvem?"},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun nanghobon migiloutah hiuva, nachateo thilpha pehje nahet ule, hiche sanga chu gamchenga van'a na-Pau vin ahenga thumte chu thilpha apeh lou dingham?"},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun ima jouse-a min nangho iti nabolle nadeijum, nanghon jong chutobang chun bolun; ijeh-inem itile hichu dan thupeh le themgaoho thu ahi.","title":"Chondan Pha Chungnung pen","ref":"Luk 6:31."},"13":{"text":"Kot jima lutnun; ijeh-inem itile manna lam chu akot jatah ahin, alampi jong lentah ahi, chule chua lut chu tamtah ahi.","title":"Kotjim (Luk 13:24)"},"14":{"text":"Hinna lam chu akot jong ajimin, alampi akichin, chule hichu amua alhome."},"15":{"text":"Kelngoi von kivona asunglamla ngei hangtah hia themgao lhem, naheng uva hungjiho-a konchun kichih theijun.","title":"Thingphung Chule Aga (Luk 6:43-44)"},"16":{"text":"Amaho chu agauva nahet jeng dingu ahi. Mihemin lingphunga lengpiga aloa, ahiloule meithai seltho linga theichang alo ngaijem?"},"17":{"text":"Hiche bang chun thingphung pha jouse aga aphan, thingphung lungvei chun ga phalou asepdoh jin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Thingphung pha-a aphalou gathei lou; chule thingphung phalouva jong apha gathei lou ahi."},"19":{"text":"Thingphung aga phalou chengse chu kiphuh lhu-a meija kisep lutji ahi.","ref":"Matt 3:10; Luk 3:9"},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun nanghon amaho chu agauva nahet dingu ahi.","ref":"Matt 12:33"},"21":{"text":"Pakai, Pakai, eiti chan chu van lenggama lut ding ahipoi; koi hileh van'a um ka Pa lunglam bolpabou chu lut ding ahi.","title":"Keiman Nangho Kahekha Pouve (Luk 13:25-27)"},"22":{"text":"Hiche ni chule mi tamtah-in kajah-a, Pakai, Pakai, keihon nangma mina thu kasei lou uham? Chule nangma mina thilha kanodoh lou uham? Chule nangma mina bolmo kidang kabol lou uham, ati dingu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hiteng chule keiman amaho chu phongtah-a kaseipeh-a, Keiman nangho imatihchanin kahekhapouve; vo chonset bolteho, kakoma konin chemangun, kati ding ahi.","ref":"Labu 6:8"},"24":{"text":"Hijeh chun koi hijongle kathu hicheng hi ja-a, bola chu, song chunga in sa milungthim phatah toh kitekah ding ahi.","title":"In Kisa Jatni (Luk 6:47-49)"},"25":{"text":"Chuin go ahung jun, twi ahungsoh-in, hui ahung nungin, chuche in'a chun achun; ahin song chunga kibulphu ahi jeh-in alhupon ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule koi hijongle kathu hicheng hi ja-a, bol lou chu, nellei chunga in sa milungthim bei toh kitekah ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin go ahung jun, twi ahungsoh-in, hui ahung nungin, chuche in chu ahin nuhtan ahile alhutai; chule alhuh chu nasatah ahi, ati."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n thu chucheng asei jouvin, mihonpi chun athuhil chu kidang asa lheh-un ahi,","title":"Jesu Thuneina","ref":"Mrk 1:22; Luk 4:32."},"29":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile Aman amaho danthu lekha sunho mihil banga hil louva, thuneitah banga amaho chu thu ahil ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin ama molsang chunga konin akumsuh-in ahile, mipi tamtah-in anung ajuijun ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Miphah Khat Aboldam (Mrk 1:40-45 ; Luk 5:12-16)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin, veuvin, miphah khat ahenga ahungin, chibai ahung boh-in, Pakai, nangma nalung ahile keima eingimsah thei nahi, ahungtin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n akhut alhangin, athamin, Kalung ahi: ngimtan, ati. Chupet tah chun aphah chu adamtai."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n amapa jah-a chun, Ven, hiche thuhi koima jah-a sei hih-in, amavang chenlang thempu gakimu sahtan, chule amaho hettohsahna dingin Mosi thupehsa thilto ding chu gatohtan, ati.","ref":"Thmpu 14:1-32"},"5":{"text":"Chuin Jesu Capernaum alutnin ahile, sepai jalamkai khat ahenga ahungin, ngehna aneijin,","title":"Jesu'n Rome Sepai Jalamkaipa Sohpa Adamsah (Luk 7:1-10)"},"6":{"text":"Pakai, kasohpa alangthin in'a alumin, anat athohlel lheh jenge, atin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Hunging ting hung damsah nange ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin hiche sepai jalamkai chun adonbutnin, Pakai, nangma ka-in sunga nahung lut ding chu, keima chutia kilom kahipoi; nangman thuchengcha khat seile chun, kasohpa dam jeng ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile keima jong mi thuneina noija um kahin, keima noija sepaiho aumun; chule keiman khatpenpen chu, Chen, katile, achen; achomkhat, Hungin, katile, ahungin; chule kasoh jah-a, Hiche bolin, katile, aboljin ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Jesu'n chuche thu ajah phatnin, kidang asan, anunga hungho jah-a chun, Keiman tahbeh-a nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Israel lah jenga jong hitobang tahsan len khatcha jong kamu khapoi."},"11":{"text":"Chule keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Niso lama konle nilhum lama konin mi tamtah hungintin, Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob toh van lenggama toukhom ding ahiuve;","ref":"Luk 13:29"},"12":{"text":"Amavang lenggam chate polam muthim lah-a kipaidoh ding ahiuve; hikoma chu kale hagel umding ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 22:13; 25:30; Luk 13:28"},"13":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n sepai jalamkai jah-a, Nangma chetan, natahsan bangin nachunga lhunghen, ati. Chuphattah chun achapang chu adamtai."},"14":{"text":"Chujouvin Jesu Peter in'a alutna ahile, anupanu khosih veija na analup amun;","title":"Jesu'n Mi Tamtah Adamsah (Mrk 1:29-34 ; Luk 4:38-41)"},"15":{"text":"Chuin aman amanu khut agah thamin ahile, akhosih chu adalhatai.
