Chuin ahung thouvin, amaho jenlen apangtai."},"16":{"text":"Chuin nilhah-in mihon thilha vop mi tamtah ahenga ahinpuijun; aman thilhaho chu anodoh-in, chule ana jouse adamsah tai."},"17":{"text":"Isaiah themgaovin, Amatah-in ihatmonau alan, inat jouseu apomangtai, tia asei chu guilhuna dinga chuti ahi.","ref":"Isai 53:4"},"18":{"text":"Chujouvin Jesu'n akimvela mipi tamtah chu amun, gal lang khat lama che din thu apetai.","title":"Jesu Nungjui dia Kilomho (Luk 9:57-62)"},"19":{"text":"Hiche pet chun danthu sunho khat ahenga ahungin, Houhil, nachena chan-ah juijinge, ati."},"20":{"text":"Jesu'n amapa jah-a, Sial hon ko aneijun, chunga leng vachaten jong buh aneijun, Mihem Chapa vangin alu ngapna ding mun aneipoi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin aseijui dangho lah-a khatnin ajah-a, Pakai, amasa kache-a kapa kagavuina din thu neipen, ati."},"22":{"text":"Jesu'n ama jah-a, Nangman kanung hinjuitan: mithihon amithiu kivui naovinte, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chujouvin ama kong'a atouvin ahile, aseijuite chun anung ajuijun ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Twipi Kinong Aphothip (Mrk 4:35-41 ; Luk 8:22-25)"},"24":{"text":"Hichun, veuvin, dillen'a chun khopihui hanunin anungin, twi kinongin kong chu ahin khu jengtan ahi; ahivangin ama a-imun ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin aseijuiho ahenga ahungun, asukhangun, Pakai, neihuhhing un: athigam ding kahitaove, atiuvin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah uva, Vo tahsan lhomho, ibola kicha-a nahiuvem? ati. Chutah-in ama athouvin, huipi le dillen chu aphoh-in ahile, athip heltai."},"27":{"text":"Chuin miho chun adatmo lheh jengun, Ama hi iti mi hingana, huipi le dillen sanin athu angaije, atiuvin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin ama agalkaija Gargesenes gam alhunin, thilhavop mi ni lhankhuh-a konin amatoh kitoh dingin ahung lhonin; amani chu khohtah ahi lhonin hilam chu koimachan ahothei louhel ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Thilha Vop Mini Adamsah (Mrk 5:1-20 ; Luk 8:26-39)"},"29":{"text":"Hichun, veuvin, amani chu a-ao jah lhonin, nangma Pathen Chapa, Jesu, Nangle keiho ipi ikimatnao umam? Ni kitep lhin masanga eibolgim dinga hunga nahim? ati lhone."},"30":{"text":"Hipet chun aumnao gallampeh-a chun vohcha hon khat alhan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Hichun thilhaho chun Jesu henga, Keiho neikaidoh ule, khuche vohcha hon lah-a khun neisol uvin, tin angeh taovin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah uva, Cheovin, ati. Chuin apotdoh-un, vohchaho sunga chun alut taovin ahi; chuin, veuvin, ahonchangpin halhaijin alhaijun, kolah alhai lhauvin, dillenah alha lutnun, twijah athigam taovin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin achingho chu khopi sung lama ajamlutnun, thu umchan jouse le thilhavop miteni thu chu agaseijun ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin, veuvin, khosunga mi jouse Jesu toh kimuto dingin ahungdoh-un; chuin ama amu phatnun, agam sunguva kona chedoh dingin angeh taovin ahi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin kong'a atouvin, agalkaijin, akhopi ah alut tai.","title":"Jesu'n Langthi Khat Aboldam (Mrk 2:1-12 ; Luk 15:17-26)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin, veuvin, mihon alupna khun pumin langthi khat ahenga ahinpu uvin; Jesu'n atahsanjeu chu amun, langthipa jah-a chun, Chapa, lungmong tah-in umin, nachonset kingaidam ahitai, ati."},"3":{"text":"Hichun, veuvin, danthu sunho kimkhatnin alungthimun, Hipa hin Pathen ataitome, atiuvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hichun Jesu'n alung gelu chu ahen, Nanghon nalunguva ibola lungilou navopmu ham?"},"5":{"text":"Nachonset naho kingaidama ahitai, tileh thouvin lamjotnin, ti, hoijoh seibaijo-am?"},"6":{"text":"Ahoi hita jongle Mihem Chapan leiset chunga mihemte chonset ngaidam theina thahat aneije ti nahetna dingu ahi atin, hichun alangthipa jah-a, Thouvin, nalupna kilah-inlang na-in'a chetan, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin amapa athouvin, a-in lama achetai."},"8":{"text":"Ahin mipin hichu amu phatnun, kidang asauvin, hitobang thuneina mihemte pe-a Pathen chu avahchoi taovin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Jesu chua konin achen ahile, mi khat amin Matthew kiti, akaidonna mun'a atou amun, ajah-a, Kanung hinjuijin, ati. Chuin ama akipatdoh-in, anung ajuitai.","title":"Jesu'n Matthew Akou (Mrk 2:13-17 ; Luk 5:27-32)"},"10":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Jesu chuche in'a an nedingin atouvin ahile, veuvin, kaidongho le michonseho tamtah ahungun, Jesu le aseijuiteho chutoh ankong aum khomun ahi.","ref":"Luk 15:1-2."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Pharisai hon chuche amu phatnun, aseijuite henga, Nahilpauvin ibola kaidongho le michonsehotoh an aneh khomham? atiuvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahin Jesu'n chuche ajan, Atidamten louthem angaipouve; adamlouten bou angaijui."},"13":{"text":"Keiman kithoina kangehpoi, kikhoto nabou kangeh-e, ti hi ipi kiseina ahi gakihilun; ijeh-inem itile keima michonpha te kou-a hung kahipoi, alungheina diuva michonse te kou-a hungjoh kahibouve, ati.","ref":"Matt 12:7; Hos 6:6"},"14":{"text":"Chupettah chun John seijuite ahenga ahungun, ajah-a, Keiho le Pharisai honla an kangol matchet jiuvin, ibola nangma seijuiten an angolji louvu ham? atiuvin ahi.","title":"An Ngol Chung Changa Thudoh (Mrk 2:18-22 ; Luk 5:33-39)"},"15":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n amaho jah-a, Moulang chun aloite aumpilai sungse-a aloite chu kingaise thei ngaijuvem? Amavang moulang chu akomuva kona kipuimang ni hung lhung ding ahin, chuteng chule amahon an angol dingu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Koiman ponthah halin pon lui abeh ngaipoi, ijeh inem itile abehna chun apon chu loisentin, secheh joding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule mihemin lengpitwi thah savun peng luija akhum ngaipoi; achuti loule apeng chu tumkeh intin, atwi longjal ding, apeng jong mahthah ding ahi: amavang lengpitwi thah chu peng thah-a akhum jiuvin, chule anin akihuh bitjin ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Hicheng thu chu asei pettah-in, veuvin, vaipo khat ahungin, ama chibai ahung boh-in, Kachanu tutah chun athin ahi; ahivangin nangma hungin lang achunga nakhut hung ngamle chun amanu hing jeng ding ahi, ahungtin ahi.","title":"Vaihompa Chanu le Jesu Ponmong Thamkhanu (Mrk 5:21-43 ; Luk 8:40-56)"},"19":{"text":"Chuin Jesu akipatdoh-in, anung ajuijin, chutichun aseijuiten jong ajuijun ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, kum somle kum ni athi longa na-a numei khat anung lama ahungin, apon mongkai chu ahung thamtan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile amanun alungthima, Apon jengcha hi thamkha jongleng kadam ding ahi, ati ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Jesu akiheijin, amanu chu amun, Chanu, lungmong tah-in umin; natahsanin nadamsah ahitai, ati. Chua pat chun amanu adamheltai."},"23":{"text":"Chujouvin Jesu vaipopa in ahung lut phatnin, sumkuli mut teho leh mipi poh vengvung chu amun,"},"24":{"text":"Amaho jah-a chun, Potdoh-un; ijeh-inem itile chapangnu chu athi ahipoi, a-ihmu ahibouve, ati. Chuin amahon anuisat taovin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ahivangin miho chu akisoldoh phatnin, in sunga alutnin, chapangnu khut atuh-in ahile amanu athoutai."},"26":{"text":"Hichun hiche gamsesea chun hiche thu chu akithang sohtai."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Jesu chua konin achedoh-in ahile, mitcho ni anung nunga ache lhonin, Vo David chapa, neilungset in, tin asam lhonin ahi.","title":"Mitcho Mini Adamsah"},"28":{"text":"Chuin ama in sung alut phatnin, hiche mitcho teni chu ahenga ahung lhonin; Jesu'n ajah lhonah, Kei hin hichu bolthei jinte ti natahsan lhonem? tin adongin ahi. Amanin, Henge, Pakai, ati lhonin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chutah-in aman amit lhonchu akhoijin, Nathsan bang lhonin nachung lhonah chutahen, ati."},"30":{"text":"Hichun amit lhon ahahtai. Chuin Jesu'n amani chu hakhamin akhamin, Chingthei lhonin, koima hetsah lhon hih-in, ati."},"31":{"text":"Ahivangin amani apot lhonin, chuche gamsese-a chun ama min chu aphongjal lhontai."},"32":{"text":"Chuin acheuvin ahile, veuvin, lampia thilhavop mi paomo khat ahengah ahinpuijun ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Paotheilou Khat Adamsah"},"33":{"text":"Thilha chu akideldoh phatnin, paomopa chu apaotai. Hichun mipi chun kidang asauvin, Israel lah-a hitobang akimukha hih-e, atiuvin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Pharisaiho vangin, Thilha ho lengpa mina thilhaho adeldoh hichu, atiuve.","ref":"Matt 10:25; 12:24; Mrk 3:22; Luk 11:15."},"35":{"text":"Chujouvin Jesu khotinle vengtina avahle avahlen, akikhopnao intin-ah thu ahillen, lenggam Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen, hivei namkimle nat namkim adamsahtan ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Mipi Akhoto","ref":"Matt 4:23; Mrk 1:39; Luk 4:44."},"36":{"text":"Ahin miho chu achingbei kelngoi banga, lhasamle chehchao tah-a aumu amu phatnin, alung selheh-in ahi","ref":"Minb 27:17; 1 Leng 22:17; 2 Thusm 18:16; Ezek 34:5; Mrk 6:34"},"37":{"text":"Chuphatnin aseijuite jah-a, Chang-at ding tam lheh-in, ahivangin natonga alhome.","ref":"Luk 10:2"},"38":{"text":"Hijeh chun achang at dinga natongho ahinsol nadingin, louneipu henga taovun, ati."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin aman aseijui somleni chu akoma akouvin, lhagao boh nomang dingle, hivei namkim le nat namkim damsah dingin, amaho chu thuneina apen ahi.","title":"Solchah Somleni Ho (Mrk 3:13-19 ; Luk 6:12-16)"},"2":{"text":"Hiche solchah somleni ho chu aminu hicheng hi ahi: Amasan Peter kiti Simon le anaopa Andrew, Zebedai chapa Jacob le anaopa John,"},"3":{"text":"Philip le Bartholomew, Thomas le kaidong Matthew, Alphaeus chapa Jacob le Lebbaeus aminchom Thaddaeus;"},"4":{"text":"Chule Canaan mi Simon le ama matsah-a pang Judas Iscariot ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hicheng somleni chu asolin, thu apen, ajah uve, Chidang namdang koima lampi jot hih-un, chule Samaria ho khopi sung khatcha-a jong lut hih-un;","title":"Somleni ho Natoh Ding (Mrk 6:7-13 ; Luk 9:1-6)"},"6":{"text":"Amavang chu sangin Israel insung mi amangsa kelngoi henga cheovin."},"7":{"text":"Chule nache pumun, Vangam anaitai, tin hillhang leuvin.","ref":"Luk 10:4-12"},"8":{"text":"Anaho damsah-unlang, athi thouvun, aphahho suthengun, chule thilha nodoh-un; manbeija nasanu ahin, manbeijin homun."},"9":{"text":"Nanghon nadangka dip sunguva sana, dangka, sumsan kiken hih-un;"},"10":{"text":"chule najinnaova dingin sakhao ahiloule sangkhol thoni, kengchot, tengol kiken hih-un; ijeh-inem itile natongan aneh ding amua lom ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 9:14; 1 Tim 5:18"},"11":{"text":"Chule nacheuva khopi sung hile khoneo sung hile nalut tengule, lhunna-a kilom koi umam phatechan ngaitouvin; chule chua kona napotdoh kahseuvin hikoma chun umun."},"12":{"text":"Chule in khatna nalut tengule, hiche in chu phatthei boh-un."},"13":{"text":"Chule hiche in chu phatthei changhoi ahile, nalungmonnau chu achungah umhen; achanghoi ahi louvangle hiche lungmonna chu naheng uva hung kile kittahen."},"14":{"text":"Chule koi hile nalhunsah louvule nathu seiju ngai lou chu, chuche in'a konle chuche kho-a kona napotdoh tengule, nakengphang uva leivui sanin thinglhau vin.","ref":"Sol 13:51"},"15":{"text":"Keiman nangho jah-a tahbeh-a kasei ahi, Thupi kitan nile chuche kho umchan sanga chu Sodom le Gomorrah gam umchan thohbai joding ahi.","ref":"Matt 11:24; Semt 19:24-28"},"16":{"text":"Veuvin, keiman nangho ngeihon lah-a kelngoi banga kasol nahiuve; hijeh chun nangho gul bangin lungthim themun, vakhu bangin suhset neilou hiuvin.","title":"Ahunglhung ding Bolsetna (Mrk 13:9-13 ; Luk 21:12-17)","ref":"Luk 10:3."},"17":{"text":"Ahivangin mihem lamah kichih theijun; ijeh-inem itile amahon nangho thutan vaihom kikhopna-a pedoh-un natin, chule akikhopnao in'a navoh dingu ahi.","ref":"Mrk 13:9-11; Luk 12:11-12; 21:12-15"},"18":{"text":"Chule amahole chidang namdangte hetsahna dinga, gamvaipote le leng teho anga keima jala hung kikai ding nahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin min napehdoh tengule, ipi iti nasei dingu lungkham hih-un; sei ding chan chu apettah-le nakipe dingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile thuseija chu nangho hilouvin, na-Pau Lhagaovin nalung sunguva asei ahibouve."},"21":{"text":"Chule asopin asopi, pan acha tha dinga ahinpehdoh ding; anu le apa douna-a chate dingdoh diu, chule athi nadiu ahin boldoh dingu ahi.","ref":"Mrk 13:12; Luk 21:16."},"22":{"text":"Chule keima min jala nangho mi jouse hotna nahung umdingu ahi; ahin akhon ni geija thohlhum keija pangdetpa bou chu huhhing-a umding ahi.","ref":"Matt 24:9,13; Mrk 13:13; Luk 21:17"},"23":{"text":"Hiche khopi-a min nabolset tengule, khopi dangah jam lutnun; ijeh-inem itile tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Mihem Chapa ahung masanga, Israelte khopi jouse nachotsoh lou dingu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ahilpa sangin aseijui achungnung jopoi, a-pakai sangin jong asoh achungnung jopoi.","ref":"Luk 6:40; Jhn 13:16; 15:20."},"25":{"text":"Aseijui chu ahilpa toh, chule soh a-pakaipa toh akikotle aphaset ahi. Amahon a-inneipu pen bon Belzabul atiule, a-insung mite chu iti atida dingu ham?","ref":"Matt 9:34; 12:24; Mrk 3:22; Luk 11:15"},"26":{"text":"Hijeh chun nanghon amaho chu kicha hih-un; ijeh-inem itile akiphongdoh lou ding akisela imacha aumpoi, chule hetdoh lou ding imacha aki-ima aumpoi.","title":"Koiham Gin Ding (Luk 12:2-7)","ref":"Mrk 4:22; Luk 8:17."},"27":{"text":"Keiman nangho jah-a muthima kasei chu, nanghon khovah-a seijun; nanauva najah-u chu, in chunga saptho uvin."},"28":{"text":"Chule natahsao thatna, lhagao that theilou ho chu kicha hih-un; lhagaole tahsa akopma damuna sumang theipa bou chu kichaovin."},"29":{"text":"Vasilih ni paisa khat manna kilhaji louham? Achuti vangin na-Pau thu louvin hitiho chu khatcha jong tolla lha lou ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Nalu chunguva nasam jang jouseu jong kisim sohkeija ahi;"},"31":{"text":"Hijeh chun kicha hih-un; vasilih tamtah sanga nangho lujo nahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Hijeh chun koi hile miho anga kei eiphongdoh chan chu, keiman jong van'a ka Pa anga kaphondoh ding ahi.","title":"Christa Phondoh Leh Seilep (Luk 12:8-9)"},"33":{"text":"Amavang koi hile miho anga keima eiseileppa vang chu, keiman jong van'a ka Pa anga kaseilep ding ahi.","ref":"2 Tim 2:12"},"34":{"text":"Leichunga chamna hinpo dinga hungin neingaito hih-un; chamna hilouvin chemjam hinpo joh-a hung kahibouve.","title":"Chamna Hilou Chemjam Joh (Luk 12:51-53 ; 14:26-27)"},"35":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile achapa chu apa dousah ding, achanu chu anu dousah ding, amounu chu atehpi dousah dingjoh-a hung kahibouve.","ref":"Mica 7:6"},"36":{"text":"Chule mihem amelma chu ama insung mitetah hi ding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Koi hile keima sanga anu le apa ngailujo-a chu keija hoi ahipoi; chule koi hile keima sanga achanu le achapa ngailujo-a chu keija hoi ahipoi."},"38":{"text":"Chule koi hijongle athingpel kiputna kanung hinjui lou jong chu, keija hoi ahipoi.","ref":"Matt 16:24; Mrk 8:34; Luk 9:23"},"39":{"text":"Koi hile ahinna mu-a chun achan ding; chule keima jala ahinna channa chun amu ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 16:25; Mrk 8:35; Luk 9:24; 17:33; Jhn 12:25"},"40":{"text":"Koi hile nangho lhunsah-a chun keima eilhunsah ahin; chule koi hile keima eilhunsah-a chun eisolpa alhunsah ahi.","title":"Kipaman (Mrk 9:41)","ref":"Mrk 9:37; Luk 9:48; 10:16; Jhn 13:20."},"41":{"text":"Themgao mina themgao lhunsah-a chun themgao kipaman asan ding; chule michonpha tia michonpha lhunsah-a chun, michonpha kipaman asan ding ahi."},"42":{"text":"Koi hile hiche neochaho lah-a hi seijui ahi tia twi dap khon khat jengcha don dinga pechan chun, tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, iti nama jongle kipaman asan ding achan louding ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hitichun Jesu'n aseijui somleni ho chu thu apeh jouvin, chukom mun'a kon chun akhotin uva thu hille dingle seiphongle dingin achetan ahi.","title":"John Baptist'a Kona Thupole ho (Luk 7:18-35)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin John'in songkulah Christa thilbol umchan thu ajan ahileh, aseijui mini asolin,"},"3":{"text":"Chule ajah-a, Ahung dinga chu nangma nahimong hinam, ole achom dang khat kanga dinguham? agatisah-in ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah lhona, Nangni chelhonin lang nathujah chengse lhon le nathilmu chengse lhon hi John jah-a gasei lhontan:"},"5":{"text":"Mitchon kho amutai, elbaijin lam ajottai, miphah suhthengin aumin, chule na-ngongin kho ajatan, mi thisa kaithouvin aumtai, chule mivaichate Kipana Thupha akiseipeh tai.","ref":"Isai 35:5-6; 61:1"},"6":{"text":"Chule koi hijongle keija kipal lhuhna nei lou chu anunnom ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin amani chu ache nungin aman mipi jah-a chun, John thudol asei panin, Ipi ve dinga gamthipma chu nachedoh-uham? Huijin peng amut lingham?"},"8":{"text":"Achutile ipi ve dingaba chedoh nahiuvem? Ponnem kisil mi ham? Veuvin, ponnem sil hokhu leng in'a um ahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Ibola nachedoh uham? Themgao ve dinga ong? Ahi, kaseipeh nahiuve, themgao sanga chungnungjo ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ven, keiman kasottol namasang sanga kasole; Aman namasang sanga nalampi asem ding ahi, tia kisun chu ama hi ahi.","ref":"Mal 3:1"},"11":{"text":"Najah uva tahbeh-a kasei ahi, Numei sunga peng lah-a John Baptist sanga lenjo koima asohdoh khapoi, ahivangin van lenggama aneojo chu ama sanga lenjo ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule John Baptist nikho-a pat tugeija hi van lenggam hin gimbolna athoh ahin, chule mi gimbol hochun pumhatnin alauvin ahi.","ref":"Luk 16:16"},"13":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile themgaoho jouse le danthun John phat geija chu gaothu aseiju ahitai."},"14":{"text":"Chule nanghon hiche hi sanding nanop uva ahile, amachu ahung dinga kisei Elijah chu ahi.","ref":"Mal 4:5; Matt 17:10-13; Mrk 9:11-13"},"15":{"text":"Angaina ding na neijan ngaihen."},"16":{"text":"Tu khanga mite hi koitoh katekah tadem? Chapangho kaithel tolla touva, aloiho kou-a,"},"17":{"text":"Ajah uva, kuli kamutpeh-ule nalam hih-un; kakaule na-op nabeng pouve, tia seiho tobang nahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile John ahungin ne lou don lou ahin, hichun mihon thilhavop ahi, atiuvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Mihem Chapa ahungin anen adonin ahile, Veuvin, nehhat le julop, kaidongho le mi chonseho jolle gol ahi, atiuve. Ahinla chihna chu anatoh hon them achanan ahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuphatnin thilbol kidang ahabol dehna khoho chun alung ahei lou jeh-u chun, aphohsal pantan ahi.","title":"Atahsanlou Khopiho (Luk 10:13-15)"},"21":{"text":"Ohe Chorazin, nada ahi! Ohe Bethsaida, nada ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nalah uva thilbol thahatna kidang kibol chengse chu, Tyre le Sidon khopi-a kibol hile, sotpia pat chun achenghon khaodip pon kisilpum le vut kinu pumin alungu heitao vinte.","ref":"Isai 23:1-18; Ezek 26:1—28:26; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:9-10; Zech 9:2-4"},"22":{"text":"Ahinla keiman kasei peh nahiuve, Thupi tan nikho le nangho thoh ding sanga Tyre le Sidon thoh ding oljo ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule vangeija choisanga uma nang Capernaum, damuna notlhah-a umding nahi; ijeh-inem itile nalah uva thil kidang kibol chengse hi Sodom kho-a kibol hileh, tugei hin umnalai jinte.","ref":"Isai 14:13-15; Semt 19:24-28"},"24":{"text":"Chujongle tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Thupi tan nile nangho thoh ding sanga Sodam thoh ding oljo ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 10:15; Luk 10:12"},"25":{"text":"Hiche pet chun Jesu apaovin, Vo ka Pa vanle lei Pakai, nangman michingte le lungthim themho hengah hicheng thuhi na-ima, naocha ho henga naphondoh jeh hin nangma kathangvah-e.","title":"Kahenga Hungun lang Choldouvin (Luk 10:21-22)"},"26":{"text":"Ahi, Pa, hiti chu nangma lunglhaina lam ahi."},"27":{"text":"Imajouse ka-Pan keima eipehdohsoh ahitai; chule Pa tailou Chapa chu koimachan ahepoi; chule Chapa tailoule aman aphondoh nomnapa tailou koimachan Pa chu ahepoi.","ref":"Jhn 3:35; 1:18; 10:15."},"28":{"text":"Tong gimte le pohgih te, kahenga hungun; keiman nangho cholngah sah-unge."},"29":{"text":"Keima lungneng tah le nunnem tah kahi; hijeh chun kanamkoljon laovin lang keima-a kihilun; chutile nalunguva olna namu dingu ahi.","ref":"Jer 6:16"},"30":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile kanamkoljon nomtah ahin, kapoh jong jangtah ahi, ati."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hichelai chun cholngah nin Jesu'n changlei lai ajotnin; aseijuite agil keltaovin ahile, changvui asih-un, anepan taovin ahi.","title":"Cholngah Ni Chung Changa Thudoh (Mrk 2:23-28 ; Luk 6:1-5)","ref":"Danb 23:25."},"2":{"text":"Ahin Pharisai hon hichu amuvin, ama jah-a, Vetan, naseijui ten cholngah ni-a bol ngai lou abolui, atiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah uva, David'in aloitetoh agilkel uva abol chu nasim khah lou uham?","ref":"1 Sam 21:1-6."},"4":{"text":"Pathen houin'a alutna, thempu tailou aman jong, aloiten jong neh ngai lou, vetsahna changlhah to aneh jengu chu!","ref":"Thmpu 24:9"},"5":{"text":"Ahiloule houin'a um thempuhon cholngah ni nit louva aum jongun themmo achang pouvin ahi, tia danthubua kisei chu nasimdoh khah lou uham?","ref":"Minb 28:9-10"},"6":{"text":"Ahin nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, Hikoma hin houin sanga chungnungjo khat aume."},"7":{"text":"Chule, Keiman gana lhai kangehpoi, lungsetnabou kangeh-e, tia kisei hi ipi kiseina ahi anaheleu chun, themona nei louho chu nanathemmo sahlou dingu ahi.","ref":"Matt 9:13; Hos 6:6"},"8":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa chu cholngah ni Pakai jong ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin chua konin achedoh-in akikhopnao in'ah alut-in ahi.","title":"Khut Langthi Khat Adamsah (Mrk 3:1-6 ; Luk 6:6-11)"},"10":{"text":"Chuin, veuvin, hia chun mi akhutngoi khat aumin ahi. Chuin ahehset theina dingun, Cholngah ni-a hi boldam dan ngai hina hilouham, tin Jesu adongun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah uva, Nalah uva khattouvin kelngoi khat neihenlang, hichu cholngah nin kokhuh-a lhaluttaleh, gamana galoidoh lou ding koi naum uvem?","ref":"Luk 14:5."},"12":{"text":"Chuti chu ahile kelngoi sanga mihem iti manlutjoh hitam! Hiche jeh chun cholngah ni-a thilpha bol angai ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuphatnin mipa jah-a chun, Nakhut lhangin, ati. Mipa chun akhut alhangin ahile, alang khat bangin adamheltai."},"14":{"text":"Ahin Pharisai ho apotdoh-un ama suhmangna thei ngaiton akihoukhom taovin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahivangin Jesu'n hichu ahet phatnin, chukoma kon chun achemang tai. Chuin mi tamtah-in anung ajuijun, Aman abonchauvin aboldam sohkeijin;","title":"Pathen'in Alhen Soh"},"16":{"text":"chule, ama aphondoh louna dinguvin amaho chu akhamin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Isaiah themgaovin asei:"},"18":{"text":"Veuvin, kalhentum kasottol, kadeitah achunga kalung lhainapa khu, Keiman achunga kalhagao kakoi ding, chule ama chidang namdangte henga dandih-a thutan na aphondoh ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 42:1-4."},"19":{"text":"Aman mi anel lou ding, aw sanga thu asei lou ding, Khosung lamlena koi man a-aw ajah louhel ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ajosoh keija dandih-a thutan achaisoh masangse-a, pumpeng kihehchip kihehbong pai lou ding, chule thaomei pat khao jong athamit lou ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule Ama min chu chidang namdang ten Kinepna-a anei dingu ahi, ati chu guilhuna dinga chuti ahi, ati."},"22":{"text":"Hichepet chun thilhan avop jeh-a paomo le mitcho khat ahenga ahinpuijun; Aman aboldamin ahile, paomopa chu apao theijin, kho jong amutai.","title":"Jesu Le Beelzabul (Mrk 3:20-30 ; Luk 11:14-23)"},"23":{"text":"Chuin mipi chengse chun kidang asa lheh-un, Ama hi David Chapa hilouham, atiuvin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ahin Pharisai ho vang chun hichu aja-un, thilhaho lengpa Beelzabul toh kitho louvin hichepan thilha anodohpoi, atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Matt 9:34; 10:25."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n alunggelu chu ahen, ajah uva, Gamsung khat amale ama kidoutoa kichom khenchan chu amangthah jin, chule khopi khat hijongle insung khat hijongle kidoutoa kichom khenchan jong chu dingdoh lou ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chule Satan'in Satan anodoh-a ahile, amale ama kidouva kichom khen ahin; achutile agam iti dingdoh dingham?"},"27":{"text":"Chujongle keiman Beelzabul vanga thilhaho kanodoh ahile, nachateovin koi vanga anodohjiu hintem? Hijeh-a chu amaho cheng chu nangho thutana pang ding ahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Ahin Keima Pathen Lhagao vanga thilhaho nodohji-a kahivangle, Pathen lenggam chu nahengu hung lhunga ahitai."},"29":{"text":"Chuti ahi loule kon mihat chu kan masa louva a-in'a lutna, iti achom thei ngaijem? Akan masah-a chutengle achom jibou ahi."},"30":{"text":"Koi hile keima lama panglou chu eidouva ahi; chule eikhop khompi lou chu athecheh ahi.","ref":"Mrk 9:40."},"31":{"text":"Hijeh chun kaseipeh nahiuve, mihemte achonsetnao le Pathen ataitom nao jouse kingaidam ding ahi; Lhagao Theng taitoma vang chu kingaidam lou ding ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule koi hijongle Mihem Chapa douna-a thuseija chu kingaidam ding ahi; Lhagao Theng douna-a thuseija vang chu, tu hinlaijin jong, khonunga hinkho hung lhung dinga jong kingaidam louding ahi.","ref":"Luk 12:10"},"33":{"text":"Thingphung chu aphai nati ule, aga jong aphai tingalun, thingphung aphapoi nati ule, aga jong aphapoi tiuvin; ijeh-inem itile thingphung chu agan akihei.","title":"Thingphung Chule Aga (Luk 6:43-45)","ref":"Matt 7:20; Luk 6:44."},"34":{"text":"Vo gulse sonho, nanghon nagitlou pumpiuva thupha iti nasei thei dinguham? Ijeh-inem itile lung sunga aletna kona kamin aseidohji ahi.","ref":"Matt 3:7; 23:33; 15:18; Luk 3:7; 6:45"},"35":{"text":"Miphan thilpha bom lungthima konin thilpha asodoh-in, chule misen thilse boma konin thilse asodohjin ahi."},"36":{"text":"Ahin kaseipeh nahiuve, Mihemin manlou ding thu asei chengse hi, thupi kitan nile asuhto cheh dingu ahi."},"37":{"text":"Nangma nathun them nachansah ding ahin, chule nathu maman themmo nachansah ding ahi, ati."},"38":{"text":"Chuphatnin danthu sunho le Pharisai ho phabep khatnin adonbutnun, Houhil, nanga konin melchihna kamu nomuve, atiuvin ahi.","title":"Melchihna Athumu (Mrk 8:11-12 ; Luk 11:29-32)","ref":"Matt 16:1; Mrk 8:11; Luk 11:16."},"39":{"text":"Ahin Aman adonbutnin, ajah uva, Migilou le mijong khanga miten melchihna aholui, ahinla Jonah themgao melchihna tailou adang kipe lou ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 16:4; Mrk 8:12."},"40":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile, Jonah ni thum le jan thum ngapi oisunga aum banga, mihem chapa jonghi ni thum le jan thum leigila umding ahi.","ref":"Jon 1:17"},"41":{"text":"Nineveh khopi-a miho chu thupi tanna-a tulai khang mite toh hung ding khoma, tulai khang hi themmo ahinchan dingu ahi; ijeh-inem itile amahon Jonah thuhil chun alung aheijun ahi; ahin, veuvin, Jonah sanga chungnungjo hikoma aume.","ref":"Jon 3:5."},"42":{"text":"Lhanglam gam lengnu chu thupi tanna-a tulai khang mite toh hung ding khoma, tulai khang hi themmo ahinchan ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile aman kolmanga konin Solomon chihna thu ngai dingin ahungin ahi; ahin, veuvin, Solomon sanga chungnungjo hikoma aume.","ref":"1 Leng 10:1-10; 2 Thusm 9:1-12"},"43":{"text":"Lhagao boh chu mi sunga kona apotdoh tengle, twi beina muntin-ah avahle avahlen, cholngahna aholin, mula amujipoi.","title":"Lhagao Boh Hung Kilekit (Luk 11:24-26)"},"44":{"text":"Chutengle aman, Kahung potdohna ka-in mama-a chun chekit tange, atin; chuin ahunga ahile, hichu agohkeo, akitheh ngim, chule akijephoi chu amun;"},"45":{"text":"Chuin achen, ama sanga giloujo lhagao dang sagi agapuijin, chule amaho chua chun alutnun, acheng taove; chuin mipa umchan chu amasa sangin anununga akhohjo chehtan ahi. Tulai khang migiloute chunga jong hi chutobang ding ahi, ati."},"46":{"text":"Aman mipi lah-a thu aseina laijin, veuvin, anule asopiten ama hou nom-in aholun, inpo-ah adingun ahi.","title":"Jesu Nu le Asopiho (Mrk 3:31-35 ; Luk 8:19-21)"},"47":{"text":"Chuin mikhatnin ajah-a, Ven, nanu le nasopite nangma hou nom-in naholun, inpo-ah ading jinguve, ati."},"48":{"text":"Ahin Aman chutia seipa chu adonbutnin, Kanu koiham? chule koiham kasopi? ati."},"49":{"text":"Chuin aseijuite lama akhut ajah-in, Veuvin, hiteho hi kanule kasopite ahiuve!"},"50":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile van'a um ka Pa lung lama chonna chu, amatah chu kasopipa le kasopinu, chule kanu ahi, ati."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche nikho mama chun Jesu in'a konin apotdoh-in, dil pangah atouvin ahi.","title":"Muchi Thepa Thulem (Mrk 4:1-9 ; Luk 8:4-8)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin ahengah mipi tamtah ahung khomun, hijeh chun ama kong khatnah alutnin atoutai; chule mipi chengse chu vaokamah adingun ahi.","ref":"Luk 5:1-3"},"3":{"text":"Chuin amaho chu thulemin thu tamtah ahilin, Ngaijun, muchi thepa khat muchi the dingin achen,"},"4":{"text":"Athe atheleh muchi chu abang lamsih-a achun ahile, vachaten ahung lohgam taove."},"5":{"text":"Abang songlheo chung leipatna-ah achun, alei asa lou jeh-in akehdohpai jengin;"},"6":{"text":"Ahivangin nisa ahung soh-in ahile, asanggon; jung anei lou jeh-in agoptan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Abang ling lah-a achun, aling chu ahung khangin adepmang tai."},"8":{"text":"Adangho vang lei pha laijah achun, abang ajat jakhat, abang ajat somgup, abang ajat somthumin agan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Angaina ding na neijan ngaihen, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin aseijuite ahenga ahungun ajah-a, Ibola amaho jah-a chu thulema naseiham, atiuvin ahi.","title":"Thulem Kiseilo (Mrk 4:10-12 ; Luk 8:9-10)"},"11":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin, Nangho vang van lenggam thuguh chu nahet dinguva kipe-a nahitaove; ahin amaho hi kipe lou ahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile koi hijongle aneija chu kipehbentin anei letset ding ahi, aneilouva chu aneichasun jong chu ama-a kona kilahpeh ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 25:29; Mrk 4:25; Luk 8:18; 19:26"},"13":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a hi ajah uva thulema kasei ahi; ijeh-inem itile amahon amu vangun amu hih-un, ana-a ajah vangun aja hih-un, angainaje jong ahepouve."},"14":{"text":"Chule Isaiah themgaovin khonunga thusoh ding asei: Nanghon ja vang janaovin natin, angainaje nahet lou dingu, mu vang munao vin natin, nahetdoh lou dingu ahi.","ref":"Isai 6:9-10."},"15":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile hiche nam mite hin Amitnuva amuva, anauva ajah uva, alunga jong ahetdoh uva, chule ahung kihei kit uva, keiman amaho chu kadamsah louna dinga, alungu thaovin atoma, chule akolseh uva, chule amit asinu ahi, tia asei chu achunguva guilhunga ahi."},"16":{"text":"Nangho mitnin vang amu jeh-in mit nunnom ahin, nanau vin jong ajah jeh-in nakol nunnom ahi.","ref":"Luk 10:23-24."},"17":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Themgao tamtah le michonpha tamtah-in nangho thilmu hi mu atup lhehji uvin, ahivangin amupouvin ahi; chule nathu jah chengseu hi jah atupmun, ahinla ajapouvin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun muchi thepa thulem chu ngaijun.","title":"Muchi Thepa Thulem Ahilchet (Mrk 4:13-20 ; Luk 8:11-15)"},"19":{"text":"Koi hile gamsung thu ajah tenga angainaje helou chu, hiche pettah chun agilou chu ahungin, alung sunga kithesa chengse chu alah mangpeh jitan ahi. Hichepa chu akithe lamsih-a chua chu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Akithea songlheo chunga leipatna-a chua chu, thu ajah jah-a thanom tah-a joppai jenga chu ahi;"},"21":{"text":"Ahivangin alung sunga ajung anei lou jeh-in, ni chomkhat aumjibouve; ijeh inem itile thu jeh-a genthei hesohna le bolsetna aum phat phatle, alhupai jitai."},"22":{"text":"Chule akithea linglah-a chua chu ahile, thu chu ajan, hinla leiset hinkho lungkhamna le lheplhahna dimset haona lungthim chun thu chu adeplihjin, ga louvin aumjitai."},"23":{"text":"Chule a kithe-a leipha laija chua vang chu, thu ja-a, angainaje he-a chu ahi; ama chu aga tahbeh-in, chule abang ajat jakhat, abang ajat somgup, abang ajat somthumin aga pungjin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Aman amaho jah uva chun thulem chomkhat asei kitnin, van lenggam chu mi khat aloulaija muchipha the-a toh kitekah ahi.","title":"Changlhem Thulem"},"25":{"text":"Ahin miho imut petnin, amelma chu ahungin, achang lah-a chun changlhem athepeh-in, achemang tan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin chang kung chu ahung khangtouvin, avui adoh-in ahile, chuphatnin changlhem jong chu akilahdoh-in ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin aneipa sohte ahenga ahungun ajah-a, Hepu, nalouva khu muchi pha nathe louham? Ahile hoilam kona changlhem kehham, atiuve."},"28":{"text":"Aman ajah uva, Melma khattou bol hija chu, ati. Chuin asohten ajah-a, Achutile cheovinlang changlhem chengse gachom khom leuveng nalungham? atiuve."},"29":{"text":"Ahin aman adonbutnin, Angaipoi, chutile changlhem nabodoh khomna lamuvin, changtah jong bodohtha getnun nate."},"30":{"text":"A-at phat kahsen khantha nante, chang at tengle keiman chang at dingho jah-a, Changlhem chu govam dingin khomun lang kankhomun, changtah vang chu kachang pangah koilut taovin, tinange, ati, tin aseije."},"31":{"text":"Thulem dang khat ajah uva asei kitnin, van lenggam chu mikhatnin alah-a, chule alouva athe, ankam mu tobang ahi.","title":"Ankam Mu Thulem (Mrk 4:30-32 ; Luk 13:18-19)"},"32":{"text":"Hichu muchi dang dang sangin aneopenin, ahivangin akedoh-a akhandoh phatnin, hampa dang sangin aphung lenjon, thing asohtan, chutichun chunga leng vachaho abah lah-a ahung gehjitai, ati."},"33":{"text":"Amaho jah-a thulem khatma asei kitnin, van lenggam chu numei khatnin alah-a, chule changbong dan thum lah-a avuija, aboncha apomsoh kahse-a abil, chol tobang ahi.","title":"Chol Thulem (Luk 13:20-21)"},"34":{"text":"Jesu'n mipi jah-a hichengse chu abonchan thulemin aseijin; chule thulem louvin ajah uva imacha aseipon ahi.","title":"Jesu Thulem Seilo (Mrk 4:33-34)"},"35":{"text":"Themgao thu seisa, Keiman thulem seinan kakam kangting leiset kisemtila patna thuguh chengse kaphondoh ding ahi, ati chu guilhuna dinga chuti ahi.","ref":"Labu 78:2"},"36":{"text":"Chujouvin Jesu'n mipi chu asolmangin, chuin insunga alut tan ahi. Chuin aseijuite ahenga ahungun, loulaija changlhem ke thulem chu neiseidoh peh-un ahungtiuve.","title":"Changlhem Thulem Ahilchet"},"37":{"text":"Chuin Aman adonbutnin, Muchi pha the-a chu Mihem Chapa ahi;"},"38":{"text":"Lou chu vannoi leiset ahi; muchi pha chu lenggam chate ahiuvin; changlhem chu migiloupa chate ahiuve;"},"39":{"text":"Melma athea chu diabol ahi; changkhop phat chu vannoi leiset kichai ni ahin, chang atteho chu vantilte ahiuve."},"40":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu changlhem chengse achop khomuva meija ago banguva chu, vannoi leiset kichai ni jongle chuti ding ahi."},"41":{"text":"Mihem Chapan avantilte solintin, chule amahon gamsunga konin midoudal te chengse le akhang giloute jouse chomkhom untin,"},"42":{"text":"Lhum sunga aselut dingu ahi; hikoma chu kale hagel umding ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chutengle michonpha te chengse a-Pau lenggama nisa banga vah ding ahiuve. Angaina ding na nei neijan ngaihen."},"44":{"text":"Chujongle van lenggam chu loulaija kiselgu thillu tobang ahi: hichu mi khattouvin amudoh-in, aselgun; chule kipahtah-in achen anei jouse ajoh-in, hiche louchu achon ahi.","title":"Thillu Kisel Thulem"},"45":{"text":"Chule van lenggam chu sumkolvei mi twikokchang phatah hola toh abange.","title":"Twikohchang Thulem"},"46":{"text":"Ama chun twikokchang man tamtah khat amun, chuin achen anei jouse ajoh-in hichu achon ahi."},"47":{"text":"Chule van lenggam chu len khat twikhanglen'a kisep ngatin ngatang huikhoma tobang ahi.","title":"Len Thulem"},"48":{"text":"Hiche len chu adim phatnin, mihon vaokamah akaidoh-un; hikoma chun atouvun, apha chacha alheng khomun bomah akhumun, aphalou chengse apaitauve."},"49":{"text":"Hiche banga chu vannoi leiset kichai ni jongle chuti ding ahi: vantilte hunguntin, michonpha lah-a konin michonse lakhenuntin, amaho chu lhum sunga aselut dingu ahi."},"50":{"text":"Hikoma chu kale hagel umding ahi, ati."},"51":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah uva, hicheng chu angaije nahettah uvem? tin adongin ahi. Chuin amahon ajah-a, Henge, Pakai, atiuve.","title":"Thutah Thah le Lui"},"52":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah uva, Chuti ahi jeh chun danthusun van lenggam seijui chengse chu, athil manlu lah-a kona thil athahle alui sodoh-ah inneipu khat tobang ahiuve, ati."},"53":{"text":"Jesu'n thulem hicheng chu asei jouvin, chukoma kon chun akipat dohtai.","title":"Nazareth Kho-a Jesu Asan Louvu (Mrk 6:1-6 ; Luk 4:16-30)"},"54":{"text":"Chuin ama gam lamah ahungin, miho chu akikhopnao in'ah ahiltan ahi; chuti chun amahon kidang asa lheh jengun, Hichepa chihna le thil kidang boltheina hi hoija kon hijaham?"},"55":{"text":"Ama hi thing thembol chapa hilouham? Anu min Mariam, chule anaote min Jacob, Joses, Simon, chule Judas hilouham?"},"56":{"text":"Chule asopinute jong hi koma ilah uva cheng hilouham? Achutile hichengpi hi hoija akilah ham? atiuvin ahi."},"57":{"text":"Chutichun achungah alung himo taovin ahi. Hijeh chun Jesu'n ajah uva, Themgao chu ama gamsung le ama a-insung tailouvah jabol louvin aum ngaipoi, ati.","ref":"Jhn 4:44"},"58":{"text":"Atahsan lou jeh-u chun aman chukoma chun thil kidang atam boltapon ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche laitah chun Herod lengpan Jesu thu kithan chu ajan,","title":"John Baptist Thi (Mrk 6:14-29 ; Luk 9:7-9)"},"2":{"text":"Ajenleho jah-a, Hiche hi John Baptist ahi; ama athia kona thoudoh kit ahitai; chuche jeh-a chu chuti thil kidang boltheina chu ama-a uma abol ahi, ati;"},"3":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Herod chun anaopa Philip jinu Herodia jala, hiche masanga chu John amatna, akana, songkul'a akhum ahi.","ref":"Luk 3:19-20."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu John'in ajah-a, Amanu chu ji-a naneiding chu dan ngai ahipoi, anati ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:16; 20:21"},"5":{"text":"Hiche chun lengpan ama chu tha dinga agot vangin, mihon John chu themgao ahi tia angaito jeh-un, miho chu akichan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahivangin Herod aso nikho alhinin, Herodia chanu chu amasanguva ahung lamin, Herod chu alung lhaisah tan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hichun amanu chu ipi hijongle athum chan pe dingin akihahsel leuvin ateptan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin amanu chun, anun ana thuhilsa ahi jehchun, John Baptist luchang kong khatnin hilaija hin neipen, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuphatnin lengpa alungdongtan ahi; ahivangin akihahselna le a-ankong umpiho jal-in, peh ding thu apetai."},"10":{"text":"Chuin mi asolin, songkul sunga John lu agatanden sahtan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin aluchung chu kong khatnin ahin domun, nungahnu chu apeuvin; chuin amanun anu henga ahin choitan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuphatnin aseijuite acheuvin, along chu agapuvin avuitaove. Chuin ahungun thusoh chu Jesu henga ahung seijun ahi."},"13":{"text":"Jesu'n chuche ajah phat chun, chukoma kon chun apotnin kongin akitolin, gamthipma achoma achetai. Ahin mihon hichu ahet phatnun, khopi chengsea konin acheuvin akengin anung ajuitaove.","title":"Jesu'n Mi Sangnga Avahva (Mrk 6:30-44 ; Luk 9:10-17 ; Jhn 6:1-14)"},"14":{"text":"Chuin Jesu vaokama ahung potdohle mipi tamtah amun, amaho chu alung asen, adamlouho chu aboldamtai."},"15":{"text":"Chujouvin nilhah ahi phatnin, aseijuite ahenga ahungun, ajah-a, Hiche komla gamthip ahin, nilhah jongla ahitan, miho hi akho kho-a chea aneh dingu gakichoh dingin sol mangtan, atiuve."},"16":{"text":"Ahin Jesu'n ajah uva, Che louleu akhohpoi; nanghon nehding peuvin ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin amahon ajah-a, Hikoma changlhah pheng nga le nga nisehbou kaneijuve, atiuvin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Aman, Hikoma kahenga hinchoijun, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin miho chu hampa chunga tou dingin asolin, changlhah pheng nga le nga ni chu alan, vanlam aven, phatthei aboh-in, chuin changlhah chu ahehbal balin, aseijuite khutna apen; aseijuiten mipi chu ahoppeh-un ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin abonchauvin aneuvin, ava sohkeijun; anehmoh-u anong chengse chu paipeh somle paipeh ni aloh dimun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Anea chu numeile chapang sim louvin, mi sangnga jen ahiuve."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n mipi chengse chu alhahdoh lai sungsen, gallang khat lama anagalkai masa dingin aseijuite kong'a alutsah-in, asolpaitan ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Twi Chunga Lam Ajot (Mrk 6:45-52 ; Jhn 6:15-21)"},"23":{"text":"Chuin mipi chu alhahdoh jouvin, tao dingin mola chun achomin akaltai. Chuin jan ahi phatnin, ama hikoma chun achang seh-in aumin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hichepet chun kong chu dillen lailung-ah aumin, hui alelama anun jeh-in, twi kinongin kong chu alehle jengin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin khovah ding konin, Jesu ahenglam uva ahungin, twi chunga lam ahin jotnin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Aman chutia twi chunga lam ajot chu aseijuiten amuvin, Joumi ahi, tin atijauvin, akichauvin a-aosot taovin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ahin Jesu'n ahin houpi paijin, ajah uva, Lungmong tah-in umun, keima kahi, kicha hih-un, ati."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Peter'in adonbut-in, Pakai, nang nahile twi chunga nahenga kahungna dingin thu neipen, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin aman, Hungin ati. Chuin Peter kong'a konin akumlhan, twi chunga lam ajotnin, Jesu henga achetai."},"30":{"text":"Ahinla huinun hattah chu amu phatnin akichatan, chuin lhalut ding akigotan ahile, Pakai, neihuhhing in, tin asamtan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n akhut alhan, amanpaijin, Vo tahsan lhom, ibola natahsan lelham, ati."},"32":{"text":"Chujouvin kong'a akal phat lhonin, hui chu athip tai."},"33":{"text":"Chuin kong'a umho chu ahungun, Tahbeh-in nangma Pathen Chapa nahi, atiuvin chibai abohtauvin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin agalkaijun, Genesaret gamsung alhung taovin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Gannesaret Mun'a Adamlou Adamsah (Mrk 6:53-56)"},"35":{"text":"Chuin chuche gam miho chun ama chu ahetdoh phatnun, agam kimvel uva mi asolun, adamlou jouse ahengah ahinpuijun;"},"36":{"text":"Apon mongkai beh atham dingu chun ahenga ataovun, athamkha chan chu adamhel helun ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche pettah chun Jerusalem'a konin Pharisaiho le danthu sunho phabep ahungun,","title":"Pule Pate Thuhil (Mrk 7:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Jesu jah-a, Ibola naseijui ten upate akhang akhanga ahung chonna dan apalkeh-u ham? ijeh inem itile amahon an aneh ding tengule khut asopji pouve, atiuve."},"3":{"text":"Ahin Aman adonbutnin, ajah uva, Nanghon jong ibola nangho chonna dan jeh-a Pathen thupeh napalkeh uham?"},"4":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Pathen'in, Nanu napa jabolun, chule koi hile anule apa gaosapma chu thihel hen ati.","ref":"Pot 20:12; 21:17; Danb 5:16; Thmpu 20:9"},"5":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon, Koi hileh anule apa jah-a, Kavanga naphat chomna dingu jouse chu Pathen kipe-a ahitai, tia seija;"},"6":{"text":"Chule anu le apa jabol lou chu, chamlhat ding ahi, nati uve. Chutichun nangho chonna thu jal-in Pathen thupeh chu imacha hilou nasouvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Miphalhem ho, Isaiah'in nangho khanchan ding thu aseija:"},"8":{"text":"Hiche mite hin akamuvin einaijun, athuseijun eijabolun, Alungula keija kona gamlatah ahi.","ref":"Isai 29:13."},"9":{"text":"Amahon athu hilnaova mihem thupeh jeng thua ahil jeh uvin, eihouvu jong moh ahi, ati chu adihtangeije, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n mihonpi chu ahenga akouvin, ngai phaovin lang hetoh-un:","title":"Mihem Suboh Jia Thilho (Mrk 7:14-23)"},"11":{"text":"Mi kam sunga lut chun ama chu asubohpoi; mi kam sunga kona hung potbou chun asuboh-e, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chutah-in aseijuite ahengah ahungun, ajah-a, Pharisai hon chuche thu ajah uva, alung phatmo-u khu nahet em? atiuve."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Aman adonbutnin, Van'a um ka Pa phu hilouva keh thingphung jouse chu kibotdoh ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hiteho khu limsah hih-un, amaho khu mitcho lamhil ahiuve. Mitchon mitcho lamkaile ani lhona kokhuh-a lhalut lhonding ahi, ati.","ref":"Luk 6:39"},"15":{"text":"Chuin Peter'in adonbutnin, ajah-a, Hiche thulem thuhi neihilchet peh-un, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n, Nangho jong tugeija hetna nei louva naum nahlaiju ham?"},"17":{"text":"Kam sunga lut chu oisunga alhalutnin, posona-ah apotpai jitai, ti heloulai nahiuvem?"},"18":{"text":"Kam sunga kona hung pot vang chu lung sunga kona hung pot ahin; hichun mi asuhboh ji ahi.","ref":"Matt 12:34"},"19":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile lung sunga konin lunggilou, tolthana, miji toh jon, jonthanhoi, guchat, thujousei, taitomna, hicheng chu apotjin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hichengho chu ahi mi suboh ji-a; khut sop louva an neh vangin mi asubohpoi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Jesu chukoma konin apotdoh-in, Tyre le Sidon gamkol lamah achetai.","title":"Numeinu Tahsan (Mrk 7:24-30)"},"22":{"text":"Chuin, veuvin, chuche gamkaija cheng Canaan numei khat ahengah ahungin, Pakai, David chapa, neilungset in; kachanu thilha phalou tah-in amane, tin ahin samin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ahin aman kam khatchan jong adonbutpoi. Chuin aseijuite ahengah ahungun, ajah-a, Amanu hi solmangtan, ijeh inem itile kanungsang chenguvah asam asamin ahi, tin ahung seijun ahi."},"24":{"text":"Aman adonbutnin, Israel phunga amangsa kelngoi heng tailou adanga dinga kisol kahipoi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Ahin numeinu chu ahungin, Pakai, neihutan, tin chibai aboh-in ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Aman adonbutnin, Chate changlhah lahpeh-a uichate koma selhah chu adihpoi, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin amanun, Ahinai, Pakai; ahivangin uichaten jong apu dokhang chunga kona anmal lhajah chu anekhaji, ati."},"28":{"text":"Chutah-in Jesu'n adonbutnin, Numei natahsan alene; nalunggot bang chu hitahen, ati. Chuin chuche pettah-a pat chun achanu chu adamtai."},"29":{"text":"Chujouvin Jesu chukoma kon chun achen, Galilee dillen kom ahung lhungin, mol chungah akaltouvin, hikoma chun atoutai.","title":"Jesu'n Anaho Tamtah Aboldam"},"30":{"text":"Hichun mipi tamtah ahenga ahungun, amaho chun elbai, mitcho, paomo, lhemvei le adang tamtah ahinpuijun, Jesu kengphang bulah alehlhauvin; chuin aman amaho chu aboldam sohtai."},"31":{"text":"Chutichun mipi chun paomon thu aseija, lhemvei adamhela, elbaijin lam ajot, mitchon kho amu chu amuvin, kidang asauvin, Israel Pathen avahchoi taovin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Mi Sangli Avahva (Mrk 8:1-10)"},"32":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n aseijuite chu ahenga akouvin, ajah uva, Hiche mihonpi hi kalung asei; ijeh-inem itile keima toh aumkhom naohi ni thum ahitan, chule neh ding imacha aneipouve. Chule amaho an nelouvin kalhadoh nompoi; achuti loule lampia lhasampa getnunte, ati."},"33":{"text":"Chuin aseijuiten adonbutnun, Mi hijatpi nehva khop ding hikom gamthip laija changlhah hoija kila dingham? atiuve,"},"34":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Changlhah pheng ijat naneijum? ati. Amahon, Pheng sagile nga neo themkhat aume, atiuvin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Aman mipi chu tolla toudin asoltai."},"36":{"text":"Chuin changlhah sagile nga chu alan, thangvahna aneijin, chuin ahehbal balin, aseijuite apen, aseijuiten mipi chu ahoppeh-un ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chuin abonchauvin aneuvin, ava sohkeijun, anehmoh-u ahal chu longkai sagi aloh dimun ahi."},"38":{"text":"Anea chu numeile chapang tailouva mi sangli ahiuve."},"39":{"text":"Chuin aman miho chu alhahdohsoh jouvin, kong sunga alutnin Magadala gamkai lama ahungtai."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Pharisaiho le Saddukai ho ahenga ahungun, apatepnan van'a kona melchihna khat avetsahna dinguvin athumun ahi.","title":"Melchihna Angeh-u (Mrk 8:11-13 ; Luk 12:54-56)","ref":"Matt 12:38; Luk 11:16."},"2":{"text":"Aman adonbutnin, Nanghon nilhahle, Van san asoh-e; kho phading ahi, nati uvin."},"3":{"text":"Chule jingkahle, van san asoh-in van anime; kho phalou ding ahi, nati uve. Vo nangho miphalhem ho, nanghon van umchan suhtoje vang naheuvin, phat umchan melchihna nasuto theipouve."},"4":{"text":"Migilou le mijong khanga miten melchihna aholuve, ahinla Jonah themgao melchihna tailou adang kipelou ding ahi, ati. Chuin amaho chu adalhan achemang tai.","ref":"Matt 12:39; Luk 11:29"},"5":{"text":"Chuin aseijuite gal lang khat agalkaijun, changlhah ahin pohai taovin ahi.","title":"Pharisaiho Leh Saddukai ho Chol (Mrk 8:14-21)"},"6":{"text":"Hichun Jesu'n ajah uva, Pharisaiho le Saddukai ho chol lah-a chingtheijun lang kihongphauvin, ati.","ref":"Luk 12:1"},"7":{"text":"Amaho chun, Changlhah ikenlou jeh-u ahi, tin akihou lhiuvin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Jesu'n hichu ahedoh-in, ajah uva, vo tahsan lhomho, changlhah nahinpoh loujeh uva ibola kihouhou nahiuvem?"},"9":{"text":"Mi sangnga changlhah pheng nga-a chu paipeh ijat nalodoh uvem ti hedoh loulai le geljong geldoh loulai nahiuvem?","ref":"Matt 14:17-21"},"10":{"text":"Chule mi sangli changlhah pheng sagi-a chu longkai ijat nalodoh-uvem?","ref":"Matt 15:34-38"},"11":{"text":"Keiman nangho jah-a changlhah thu kasei ahilou chu ibola helou nahiuvem? Pharisaiho le Saddukai ho chol lah-a kihongphauvin, kati ahibouve."},"12":{"text":"Chutah chun changlhah chol lah-a ati hilouvin, Pharisaiho le Saddukai ho thuhil lah-a chingtheijun, ati ahi chu ahedoh taove."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Jesu Caesaria Philippi gamkolsung ageijin, aseijuite jah-a, Mihon Mihem Chapa hi koi ahi atiuvem? tin adongin ahi.","title":"Peter'in Jesu Christa Aphondoh (Mrk 8:27-30 ; Luk 9:18-21)"},"14":{"text":"Chuin amaho, Kimkhatnin, John Baptist ahi, atiuvin; kimkhatnin Elijah ahi, atiuvin; kimkhatnin Jeremiah ahi, ahiloule themgaoho lah-a khatpen ahi, atiuve; tin aseijun ahi.","ref":"Matt 14:1-2; Mrk 6:14-15; Luk 9:7-8."},"15":{"text":"Aman amaho jah-a, Nanghonla koi ahi neitiuvem? ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Simon Peter'in adonbutnin, Nangma Pathen hing Chapa Christa chu nahi, ati.","ref":"Jhn 6:68-69."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah-a, Jona chapa Simon, anunnoma nahi; ijeh-inem itile tahsaphe le thisanin aphondoh hilouvin, van'a um ka-Pan aphondoh joh ahibouve."},"18":{"text":"Chule keiman jong nangma jah-a kasei ahi, Nangma Peter nahi, chule hiche songpi chunga hi kahoubung kasahdoh ding ahi; chule mithi kho kul kotpin aneh jou lou ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Keiman nangma van lenggam kot-heh kapeh ding nahi; chule leiset chunga nangman nakha chan chu van'a jong kikhah ding; chule leiset chunga nangman nahon chan chu van'a jong kihong ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 18:18; Jhn 20:23"},"20":{"text":"Chujouvin ama Jesu chu Christa ahi koima jah-a seidoh hih-un, tin aseijuite chu ahilchah-in ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuche jou chun Jesu Jerusalem'a achea, upaho le thempu pipuiho chule danthu sunho-a kona thil tamtah athoh-a, chule akitha-a, chule ni thum ni-a kaithouva aum tei ding danje chu aseijuite ahil pantan ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Athoh Genthei Dingle Athi Ding Aseimasah (Mrk 8:31—9:1 ; Luk 9:22-27)"},"22":{"text":"Chuin Peter'in ama chu apuidoh-in, Pakai, hichu nanga konin gamla hen, chutobang chu nachunga chulouhel ding ahi, tin aphoh pantan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ahin Ama akiheijin Peter jah-a, Kanung lamah chen, Satan, Nangma keima dingin kipal lhuhna nahi. Nangman Pathen thulam gel louvin mihem thulam jeng nagele, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuphatnin Jesu'n aseijuite jah-a, Koi hile kanung eijui noma chu ama kingaitom hen, chule athingpel kiput henlang kanung hinjuihen.","ref":"Matt 10:38; Luk 14:27."},"25":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile koi hile ahinna huhhing noma chun achan ding ahi; amavang koi hile keima jala ahinna chana chun akimu ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 10:39; Luk 17:33; Jhn 12:25"},"26":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile min vannoi leiset apumpin neihenlang ahinna chantale, a-ipi phachom dingham? Ahiloule min ahinna lhenga ipi apeh dingham?"},"27":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa a-Pa loupina-a avantil tetoh hung ding ahin; chule chutengle aman mijouse athilbol dungjui cheh-a tohman asansah ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 25:31; Labu 62:12; Rom 2:6"},"28":{"text":"Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hikoma dingho kimkhat hi Mihem Chapa aleng gama ahung amu kahseuva thina tepkha lou ding aumuve, ati."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ni gup jouvin, Jesu'n Peter toh, Jacob toh, chule anaopa John toh apuijin, achomin molsang chung khatna apuitouvin,","title":"Avou Kikhel (Mrk 9:2-13 ; Luk 9:28-36)","ref":"2 Pet 1:17-18."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Ama amaho ang sungah avou akikhelin; Amai nisa bangin avah-in, aponsil chengse chu khovah bangin avamleng jengin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin, veuvin, Mosi le Elijah ahenguva ahung kilah lhonin, amatoh akihou lhonin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Peter'in Jesu jah-a, Pakai, hikoma i-umu hi eiho dingin anome; naphatsahle nang ding khat, Mosi ding khat, chule Elijah ding khat, lhambuh thum songuving kate, ati."},"5":{"text":"Asei pettah chun, veuvin, meibang lhang khatnin amaho chu ahinle khutan; chuin meilhang lah-a kon chun aw khatnin, Hiche hi ka-Chapa deitah ahi, achungah kalung alhai tangeije, athu ngaijun, ati.","ref":"Semt 22:2; Danb 18:15; Labu 2:7; Isai 42:1; Matt 3:17; 12:18; Mrk 1:11; Luk 3:22."},"6":{"text":"Chuin aseijuiten chuche ajah phatnun, aboh khupmun amaiju tolla asulutnun, atija lheh jengun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Jesu ahenguva ahungin akhoijin, Thouvun, kicha hih-un, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin akhodah-un ahile, Jesu changseh tailou adang koima amuta pouvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin molsanga kona akumsuh phatnun, Jesu'n amaho chu ahilchah-in, Mihem Chapa athia kona kaithouva aum masangsen, hiche nathilmu-u hi koima jah-a sei hih-un, tin akhamtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin aseijuiten, ibola danthu sunhon, Elijah hung masa tei ding ahi atiuham tin adongun ahi.","ref":"Mal 4:5."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Elijah chu hung masan tin ijakai ahung semphat ding mong ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahin kaseipeh nahiuve, Elijah chu ahungsa ahitai; hinla ama chu ahetlou jeh-un, achungah anopnop aboltauvin ahi. Mihem Chapan jong chutobangma chu amaho khutna athoh ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 11:14"},"13":{"text":"Hitah chun aseijuiten John Baptist thu asei ahi ti chu ahetauvin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin mipi lah ahung lhunun, mi khat ahungin a-angah adilsun, ajah-a,","title":"Jesu'n Thilhavop Chapang Khat Adamsah (Mrk 9:14-29 ; Luk 9:37-43)"},"15":{"text":"Pakai, kachapa lungsetnin, ajehchu abuhthi ahin, athohgim behseh jenge; abangle meijah alhalutjin, abangle twija alhalut jin;"},"16":{"text":"Chule naseijuite henga kahin puilela aboldam joupouvin ahi, ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n, Vo tahsanna neiloule khanglamvai mite, itihchan kaumpi dingu nahiuvem? Itihchan kakhongai ding nahiuvem? Ama chu kahenga hinpui tangu, tin adonbutnin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n thilha chu aphoh-in ahile asunga konin apot tai. Chuche-a pat chun chapang chu adamtai."},"19":{"text":"Chuphatnin aseijuite Jesu henga ahungun guhthimin, I atile keihon kanodoh jou louvu hintem? atiuvin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n, Natahsan lhom jeh-u ahi, ijeh-inem itile tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Nanghon tahsanna ankam mu tebep nei hileuchun, hiche molsang jah-a hin, Hikoma konin khukoma khun kichonin tileuchun, kichon jeng ding ahi. Nangho dinga imacha bolmo umlou ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 21:21; Mrk 11:23; 1 Cor 13:2."},"21":{"text":"Ahin hitobang hi an ngol le taona beijin apotdoh jipoi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Galilee gamsunga aumlaijin, Jesu'n ajah uva, Mihem Chapa hi mihemte khutna kipedoh dingkon ahi;","title":"Jesu'n Athiding Avelseikit (Mrk 9:30-32 ; Luk 9:43-45)"},"23":{"text":"Chule amahon atha dingu ahi, chule ni thum nile kaithouva umding ahi, ati. Hiphat chun alungdong lheh jengtaovin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Capernaum ahung geijun, kai dongho ahungun Peter jah-a, Nahilpau khun makhai kai ateji louham, tin adongun ahi.","title":"Hou In Kai Kidong Apeh","ref":"Pot 30:13; 38:26."},"25":{"text":"Peter'in, Atiji nai ati. Chuin Peter insung agalutle, Jesu'n ajah-a, Iti nagelem, Simon? Leiset lengte hin kai hijongle sum lamman hijongle koi lah-a adon jiuvem? Achateu lah-a adon uvem, midang lah-a adon uvem, tin anahou masatai."},"26":{"text":"Chuin, Midang lah-a, tia adonbut phatnin, Jesu'n, Ahile, acha anaote cheng onga hija chula."},"27":{"text":"Hitajongle, nangma dil lamah chenlang nga gakoijin; nga nakoidoh masahpen chu lanlang akam keh-le chun dangka cheng khat namu ding ahi. Hichu choi jinlang igom-a dingin gapetan, achutiloule lung himosah get hite, ati."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche pettah chun seijuite Jesu henga ahungun, van lenggama hi koi alenpen ham? tin adongun ahi.","title":"Koichu Alenpen Hijaham? (Mrk 9:33-37 ; Luk 9:46-48)","ref":"Luk 22:24."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n chapang neocha khat ahengah akouvin, alaijuva adinsah-in,"},"3":{"text":"Ajah uva, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Nangho nakile heijuva chapang neochahotoh nabah kit louvule, iti nama jongle van lenggam nalut lou dingu ahi.","ref":"Mrk 10:15; Luk 18:17"},"4":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu hiche chapang neocha banga kineosah chu, van lenggama alenpen ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule koi hijongle hitobang chapang khat keima mina sanga chun keima eisan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahin koi hijongle keima eitahsan hiche aneochaho lah-a khat kipal lhuh sah chan chu, angonga sumhei song lentah kikhaihen, twikhanglen thuhtah sunga kileh lutle ama dingin aphajoi.","title":"Midang Kipal Lhuhsah Louna Dinga Kiginphat (Mrk 9:42-48 ; Luk 17:1-2)"},"7":{"text":"Ohe kipal lhuh jeh-in vannoi leiset adana-e! Kipal lhuhna chu umtei ding mong vang ahi, ahinla ohe kipal lhuh sah-a chu koi hile adana-e!"},"8":{"text":"Chule nakhut ahim, nakeng ahim, khatjo sangin nakipal lhuh sah-a ahile tanbongin lang paimangin; khut ni, keng ni neija tonsotna mit theilou meikonga nakilelut sangin, tibukim loule kengbaijin hinna-a lutle chun nang dingin aphajoi.","ref":"Matt 5:30."},"9":{"text":"Chule namitnin nakipal lhuh sah-a ahile, kaldoh-in paimangin; mit ni neija damun meikonga nakilelut sangin, mitlang chon hinna-a lutle chun nang dingin aphajoi.","ref":"Matt 5:29"},"10":{"text":"Kihong phaovin, hiche aneochaho lah-a khatcha jong nahsahmo hih-un; ijeh-inem itile kaseipeh nahiuve, Avantil teovin van'a um ka Pa mai chu ave jingun ahi.","title":"Kelngoi Mansah Thulem (Luk 15:3-7)"},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu amangsaho huhhing dinga mihem Chapa chu hunga ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule iti nangai touvem? Mikhatnin kelngoi ja khat aneija, alah-a khat ava mangthah-a ahile, aman somko le ko chu adalhah-a, molsang chung lama chea avah mangthah khat chu agaholji louham?"},"13":{"text":"Chule ahol chu amua ahile, tahbeh-a kasei ahi, amapa chun avah mangthah lou somko le ko chunga sang chun, hiche khat chunga chun akipahjon ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chutobang chun hiche aneochaho lah-a khattou amanthah ding hi van'a um na-Pau lunglam ahipoi."},"15":{"text":"Chule nasopi nachunga achonset tah-a ahile, chenlang nangle ama changseh hetnin asetna chu phoh-in; chua angaija ahile sopi chu nanei ahitai.","title":"Chonsetna Nei Sopi","ref":"Luk 17:3."},"16":{"text":"Angai lou vangle, ahetoh dingin mi nile thum kama thu jouse akichetna dingin, ni hile thum hile kipuijin.","ref":"Danb 19:15"},"17":{"text":"Chule chucheng sei jong angai loulaija ahile, houbung henga lhutnin; chua houbung thu jong angaisam louva ahile, ama chu nangho dingin chidang namdangle kaidongho banghen."},"18":{"text":"Tahbeh-a kasei ahi, itobang hijongle leiset chunga nakha-u chu van'a jong kikhah ding, leiset chunga nahonu chu van'a jong kihong ding ahi.","title":"Akiphal Le Akiphalou","ref":"Matt 16:19; Jhn 20:23."},"19":{"text":"Tahbeh-a kaseipeh kit nahiuve, Leiset chunga nalah uva mi nin kilungthoh tah-a thilthum neija atao lhonle, van'a um ka Pan abulhitpeh lhon ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile hoikom hijongle mi ni hile thum hile kamina akikhopnao chana chun, alah uva kei kaumnai, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chupettah chun Peter ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, Pakai, kasopin kachunga ijatvei achonsetle kangaidam dingham? Sagivei geijinem? ati.","title":"Ngaidamna Neilou Sohpa Thulem","ref":"Luk 17:3-4."},"22":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah-a, Najah-a sagivei geijin katipoi; amavang sagi munsom sagivei geijin katijo bouve.","ref":"Semt 4:24."},"23":{"text":"Hijeh chun van lenggam thuhi lengpa khat asohtetoh sum sutoh dinga kigo-a toh kitekah thei ahi."},"24":{"text":"Asuto pantan ahile, alah uva mikhat ama talent sangsom batpa chu ahenga ahinkai taovin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Apeh ding ima anei lou jeh-in a-pakaipa chun amatoh, aji achate toh, anei chengse joh-a chule dit dingin thu apetan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Achuti phatnin asohpa chun aboh khupmin, chibai aboh-in, Pakai, neikhongai tadin, abonin sadoh nange, ati."},"27":{"text":"Hichun a-pakai pan alungsetnin, alhadoh-in, asumbat jong chu abeisah-in angaidam tai."},"28":{"text":"Ahin chuche sohpa chu apotdoh phatnin, asohchanpi khat dangka somnga bat amun; amanin alol ameh-in, ajah-a, Neipeh ding chengse chu neipen, ati."},"29":{"text":"Achuti phatnin asohchanpipa kengbula aboh khupmin, ahenga ataovin, Neikhongai tadin, keiman nang abonchan sanange, ati."},"30":{"text":"Ahivangin ama anom hih-in, apeh ding chengse chu apeh kahsen songkul'a agakhumtan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin asoh chanpihon achuti umchan chu amuvin, alung phamo lheh-un, a-pakai pau henga ahungun thu umchan jouse chu ahung hiltaovin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuphatnin a-pakai pan akoma akou lutnin ajah-a, Vo soh nunse, kahenga natao jeh-a kangaidam ahitai."},"33":{"text":"Achutile keiman nang kalungset banga, nangin jong nasohchanpi nalungset ding thu hilouham? ati."},"34":{"text":"Chuin a-pakaipa alunghangin, abat chengse asah chaisoh kahse-a dingin, mi bol gentheiho khutna apedohtai."},"35":{"text":"Nanghon nasopiteu suhkhelna chu lunggiltah cheh-a nangaidam louvule, van'a um ka Pan nangho chutobanga chu nabol dingu ahi, ati."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Jesu'n thu hicheng chu asei jouvin, Galilee'a patnin akipatdoh-in, Jordan gal Juda gamkai lamah ahungin;","title":"Kida Thudola Jesu Thuhil (Mrk 10:1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Chule mi tamtah-in ajuijin, hikoma chun amaho chu aboldamin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Pharisaiho ahenga ahungun, apatepnan, Ima jouse-a jeh-a min aji ada dan ngai hinam? tin adongun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin aman adonbutnin, Asempan asemtila amaho numei le pasal'a asemsa ahitai, ti thu chu nanghon nasimkhah lou uham?","ref":"Semt 1:27; 5:2."},"5":{"text":"Chule hiche jeh-a chu pasal'in anu apa adalhah-a, ajia beh ding ahi; chule amani chu ti khat hi lhon ding ahi.","ref":"Semt 2:24"},"6":{"text":"Hiti chu ahin amani pumni mi ni hita louva, ti khat hilhona ahitai. Hiche jeh chun Pathen gopsa chu mihemin sukhen hihhen, ati."},"7":{"text":"Amahon ajah-a, Ahile ibola Mosi'n kidana lekha peh-a da ding tia thu apeh ham? atiuve.","ref":"Danb 24:1-4; Matt 5:31."},"8":{"text":"Chuin aman, ajah uva, Nalungtah jeh uva Mosi'n naji da dingu aphal ahibouve; ahivangin atilin chuti chu ahipoi."},"9":{"text":"Keivangin kasei ahi, Koi hijongle mitoh ajon jeh tailouva aji ada-a ji dang nei chan chu ajonga ahi, chule akidasa kichenpi kitna jong chu ajonga ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 5:32; 1 Cor 7:10-11"},"10":{"text":"Hichun aseijuiten ajah-a, Chutia numei le pasal kiloimat dolthua pasal chunga chutobang thu ahile, jinei hi aphapoi, atiuvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahin aman ajah uva, Hiche hi mi jouse jop thei ahipoi, akipete bouvin ajop thei ahi."},"12":{"text":"Mi anu sunga nukiso sa-a penga aumin, abang mihem semthu-a nukiso aumin, adang van lenggam khosahna jala amaho le amaho nukiso-a jong aume; ajop theipan jophen, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chujouvin achunguva akhut angap-a ataopeh dingin chapangho ahenga ahinpuijun, hinla aseijuiten anaphoh-un ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Chapang Neochaho Phatthei Aboh (Mrk 10:13-16 ; Luk 18:15-17)"},"14":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Chapangho chu kahenga hung sah-un, jada hih-un; ijeh-inem itile van lenggam chu hitobang tehoa bou ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chutichun Aman achunguvah akhut angamin, chukom mun'a kon chun akipatdoh tai."},"16":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, mi khat ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, houhilpha, tonsot hinkemlou kanei theina dinga thilpha ipi kabol dingham, tin adongin ahi.","title":"Khangdong Mihaopa (Mrk 10:17-31 ; Luk 18:18-30)"},"17":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah-a, ibolla apha neiti ham? Apha koima aumpoi, khat sehbou aume, ama chu Pathen ahi: ahinla nangma hinna-a chu nalut nomle thupeh chengse nitnin ati."},"18":{"text":"Mipa chun, Thupeh hoihoi chu-em? ati. Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah-a, Tolthat hih-in, Jon bol hih-in; Gucha hih-in, Thu jouvin mi heh hih-in.","ref":"Pot 20:13-16; Danb 5:17-20."},"19":{"text":"Nanu napa jabolin, Nangma naki ngailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun, ati.","ref":"Pot 20:12; Danb 5:16; Thmpu 19:18"},"20":{"text":"Gollhangpa chun adonbutnin, Hichengse chu kachapan laija patna kanitsa ahitai; ipi kabatnah laijem, ati."},"21":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah-a, Nangman chamkimsoh ing natile, chenlang nanei chengse gajoh inlang mivaicha gentheiho petan, chutile van'a gou nanei ding ahi: chule hungin lang kanung hinjuijin, ati."},"22":{"text":"Ahivangin gollhangpa chun chuche thuhil ajah phat chun, gou haotah ahi jeh-in lungnom mo tah-in achemang tan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hijeh chun Jesu'n aseijuite jah-a, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Mihao dingin van lenggama lut ahahsai."},"24":{"text":"Kaseipeh kit nahiuve, Mihao Pathen gama alut sangin, heubil homa sangongsang lut abaijoi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin chuche ajah phatnun, aseijuiten kidang asabehseh jengun, Chuti ahile, koi huhhing-a um jou dingham? atiuvin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hichun Jesu'n amaho chu aven, ajah uva, Mihem dingin vang hitheihoi ahipoi, ahin Pathen dingin ijakai ahitheije, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuphatnin Peter'in adonbutnin, Jesu jah-a, Vetemin, keihon ka-ima jouseu kadalhaovin, nanung kahinjui taove; achutile keihon ipi kasan dinguham? ati."},"28":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Ijakai akisemthah-a Mihem Chapa aloupina laltouna-a atou tengle, nangho eijui chengse jong hi laltouna somlenia natou uva, Israel phung somle phung ni thu natan dingu ahi.","ref":"Matt 25:31; Luk 22:30."},"29":{"text":"Chule Keima min jala, a-in, asopipate, asopinute, anu, apa, achate chule agam leiset hindalha chan chun, ajatja tamtah amube ding, chule tonsot hinkemlou chang ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Amavang amasa cheng tamtah nukhah intin, anukhah cheng masa ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 20:16; Luk 13:30"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile van lenggam chu inneipu khat jingpitah-a alengpi leija goi ding natong ding hola che tobang ahi.","title":"Lengpi Leija Natongho Thulem"},"2":{"text":"Chuin ama chun natong dingho chutoh ni khatna seki ni lo dinga akihoutoh phatnun, alengpi leija asoltai."},"3":{"text":"Vai nungin apotdoh-in, kaithela mohseh-a dingho amun,"},"4":{"text":"Ajah uva, Nangho jong lengpi leija konun; adoldolin napenao ving kate, ati. Chuin amaho chu achetauvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin sunkimvel le ni kiheijin apotdoh-in chutobangma chu abol kitnin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin vaiche phattah-in ama apotdoh-in ahile, midang dingleho chu amun, ajah uva, Ibola sun nilhumkeija mohseh-a nadinu ham? ati."},"7":{"text":"Amahon adonbutnun, Koima eigoijuva aumpoi, atiuve. Aman ajah uva, Kalengpi leija konun, adol dola nakisan diu ahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Nilhah ahi phatnin, lengpilei neipa chun asum chingpa jah-a, Natongho kou inlang athamanu pen, goi nukhahpena patnin goi masahpena chaijin, ati.","ref":"Thmpu 19:13; Danb 24:15."},"9":{"text":"Chuin vaiche phatna kigoipanho chu ahung phatnun, seki ni cheh asangtaovin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin goi masahpenho chu ahung phatnun, kisangtam cheh-inte tin angaito uvin; amala amahon jong seki ni bou asang taovin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin hichu akilah nungun, inneipu chunga chun aphun taovin,"},"12":{"text":"Anununghon nidan kah khatbou na atongun, nangman keiho nisa hahlai thoh-a tonggim chengtoh neikibah sah-un ahi, atiuvin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahin aman alah uva khatpa chu adonbutnin, Kajol, nachungah kakhelna aumpoi; seki ni dinga ikihou hilouham?"},"14":{"text":"Nathaman sum kilah-in chetan, anunung penpa hi nang kapeh jatma chu kapeh nom-in ahi."},"15":{"text":"Kanei nahnah kanopnopma kabol chu kadih louham? Ole kaphat jeh-a hi neimit thip hitam?"},"16":{"text":"Chutobang chun anukhah masan tin, amasa nukhah ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 19:30; Mrk 10:31; Luk 13:30."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Jesu Jerusalem lama achetou konin, somleni ho chu atumin gam choma apuijin, lam dungah ajah uva,","title":"Jesu'n Athumveina-a Athi Ding Asei (Mrk 10:32-34 ; Luk 18:31-34)"},"18":{"text":"Veuvin, Jerusalem jonin ichetouvui; chule Mihem Chapa hi thempu pipuiho le danthu sunho khutna pehdoh-a umding; chule amaho chun athina dinga themmo achansah dingu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule a-el ela aboluva, ajepmuva, thingpel'a khetbeh dinga chidang namdangte khutna apehdoh dingu ahi; chule ni thum nile ama kaithouva umding ahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Hiche petah chun Zebedee chapate anuvin achateni chu ahin kipuijin, Jesu henga ahungun, chibai aboh-in, ahenga ikhat thumnan ataovin ahi.","title":"Jacob Le John Nu Thilthum (Mrk 10:35-45)"},"21":{"text":"Aman amanu jah-a, ipi nangaichat ham? ati. Chuin amanun, Nagam sunga kachate ni hi khat najetna, khat naveija atou theina lhon ding thu pen, ati."},"22":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin, Nanghon nathumu chu nahet louvu ahi. Kadon ding khonna hi nadon lhona, chule baptize kachan ding hi nachan ngam lhon ding hinam? ati. Chuin amanin, Kangame, ati lhonin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin aman, Kadona ding khonna vang chu nadon lhona, chule ka baptize chan banga hi nachan theihon ahinan; kajetle kaveija tousah ding vang chu keima peh dol ahipoi; ka-Pan adinguva agotsaho bou chu kipe ding ahi, ati."},"24":{"text":"Hichun somho chun hichu ajauvin, uchateni chunga chun alung phamo taovin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ahinla Jesu'n amaho chu akouvin, ajah uva, Nanghon naheuve, chidang namdangte chunga vaipoho khu a-pakaiyu vin apangun, chule milen milaltehon achunguva athuneinau apanjiuve.","ref":"Luk 22:25-26"},"26":{"text":"Nangho lah-a vang chuti chu ahipoi; ahin koi hile nangho lah-a alen hi noma chu, nalhachaova pang ding;","ref":"Matt 23:11; Mrk 9:35; Luk 22:26"},"27":{"text":"Chule nalah uva apipuipen hi noma chu, nasoh-u hi ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chutobanga chu Mihem Chapatah jong chu jen dinga hung hilouvin, ajenle dingle mi tamtah lhatdoh na-a ahinna toh dingjoh-a hung ahi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Jericho khopi-a kona akipatdoh-in, mipi tamtah-in anung ajuijun ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Mitcho Ni Kho Amusah (Mrk 10:46-52 ; Luk 18:35-43)"},"30":{"text":"Chule, veuvin, mitcho ni lampamah atou lhonin, amani chun lampi chu Jesu'n ajotne ti ahet phat lhonin, Pakai, David chapa, neilungset lhonin, tin asam lhonin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin mipi chun, Thipbeh-in um lhonin, tin aphoh-un ahi; ahivangin amanin ahasapcheh lhonin, Pakai, David chapa, neilungset lhonin, ati lhonin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Jesu adingin, amani chu akouvin, I-lolhon leng nalung lhonham? ati."},"33":{"text":"Amanin, Pakai, kamit lhon hasah-in, ati lhone."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n alung asen, amit lhon akhoipeh-in ahile amanin kho amupai jeng lhonin, chule anung ajui lhontai."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Jerusalem ahung naijuva, Olive molsanga um Bethphage ageitah-un, Jesu'n aseijuite mi ni asolin,","title":"Loupitah-a Jerusalem Alut (Mrk 11:1-11 ; Luk 19:28-40 ; Jhn 12:12-19)"},"2":{"text":"Ajah lhona, Namasang jon lhona kho sunga khun lut lhonin, chule sangan anoutoh kihen namu paijen lhon ding ahi; hiteni chu sut lhoninlang kahenga hinkai lhonin."},"3":{"text":"Mi khattou ikhat sei aumle, Pakaiyin hiche teni hi manna nom aneije ti lhonle chun, aman ahinsolpai jeng ding ahi, ati."},"4":{"text":"Themgaovin anasei guilhuna dinga hiche ho jouse hi soh-a ahi,"},"5":{"text":"Nanghon Zion chanu jah-a, Ven, nalengpa lungnem tah-in sangan chungah, sangan nou chungah atouvin naheng-ah ahunge.","ref":"Zech 9:9."},"6":{"text":"Chuti chun aseijuite ni chu ache lhonin, Jesu'n asei bangbang chun abol lhonin;"},"7":{"text":"Sangan le sangan nou chu ahinpuijun, achunga aponu aphaovin; achunga chun Jesu atousah-un ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin mipi lah-a atamjon lam dunga aponu aphaovin, adangsen theoboh alhamun, lam dunga aphaovin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule mipi amasang lama che chengsele anungjui chengse chun, David chapa, Hosanna, Pakai mina hungpa chu anunnome; Chungnung pena Hosanna! atiuvin asam asamun ahi.","ref":"Labu 118:25-26"},"10":{"text":"Chuin Jerusalem alut phatnun, Hiche hi koiham? tin khopi pumpin akilohsoh jengun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin mipi chun adonbutnun, Hiche hi Galilee gam Nazareth kho-a kon themgao Jesu ahi, atiuvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin Jesu Pathen houin'ah alutnin, houin sunga thil johho le thil choho abonchan anodoh-in, chule sumlheng ho dokhangle vakhu johho touna chu alekhup peh-in,","title":"Hou In Asuhtheng (Mrk 11:15-19 ; Luk 19:45-48 ; Jhn 2:13-22)"},"13":{"text":"Ajah uva, Ka-in chu taona in kiti ding ahi, tin akisune; ahin nanghon gucha michom kokhuh-in nasem uve, ati.","ref":"Labu 8:2"},"14":{"text":"Chuin houin'a chun mitcho le elbaiho ahungun, aman amaho chu aboldamin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahin thempu pipuiho le danthu sunhon athilbol kidangle houin'a chapanghon Hosanna, David chapa, tia asap chu amuvin, alungphamo lheh jengtaovin,"},"16":{"text":"Amahon ajah-a, Hiteho hin ipi aseiju najah nah-em? atiuvin ahi. Chuin Jesu'n, Kajanai; Naosen leh chapang noi cheplai kamin jong vahchoina nachamkim sahtai, ti chu nasimdoh lou uham? ati."},"17":{"text":"Chutichun aman amaho chu adalhan, khopi-a konin apotdoh-in Bethany'a achen; chua chun agehtai."},"18":{"text":"Chuin jingkah-in khopi lam ahinjon kitnin ahile, agil akeltan ahi.","title":"Theichang Phung Agaosap (Mrk 11:12-14 , 20-24)"},"19":{"text":"Chuin Aman lamkenga theichang phung khat amun, aphunga achen ahile ana tailou imacha aga mupoi; Chuin Aman, Imatih chanin naga gakit tahih hen, ati. Chuin chupettah chun theichang phung chu agoppai jengtai."},"20":{"text":"Hichu aseijuiten amu phatnun, alungdong jengun, I-atile theichang phung chu goppai jenga hitante! atiuvin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Keiman tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Nanghon gingchalel louhela tahsan naneijule, hiche theichang phung hitia bolseh hilouvin, hiche molsang jong hi, Hikoma konin kichondoh inlang twikhanglen'a kileh luttan, ti jongleu chun hi thei ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 17:20; 1 Cor 13:2."},"22":{"text":"Chule ipi hijongle tahsan tah-a taona-a nathum chanu chu aboncha namusoh dingu ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chujouvin Houin'a alutna thu ahil petnin, thempu pipuiho le upaho ahenga ahungun, ajah-a, Ipi thunei na-a hitiho hi nabolham? Kon hiche thuneina hi napeh ham? atiuvin ahi.","title":"Jesu Thunei Dola Thu Kidoh (Mrk 11:27-33 ; Luk 20:1-8)"},"24":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin, Kenjong nangho thu khat donging kate; hichu naseijule kenjong ipi thuneija hicheng kabol ahi seipeh naovinge:"},"25":{"text":"John baptize bol chu hoija konham? van'a konha ahiloule mihem'a konham? ati. Chuin amaho akingai touvin, Van'a kon ahi, tileu henla, chuti ahile, Ibola ama natahsan lou uham? tintin;"},"26":{"text":"Mihem'a kon ahi ti dingla, mipi jousen John chu themgao ahi tia angaito jeh-un ikichaovin, akitiuvin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chutichun amahon Jesu adonbutnun, Kahepouve, atitaove. Chuin Aman jong amaho jah-a, Achutile ipi thuneija hicheng kabol ham keiman jong naseipeh deh pouvinge, ati."},"28":{"text":"Ahivangin iti nangai touvem? Mi koiham khatnin chapa ni aneijin, khatpa henga achen ajah-a, Chapa, tunin lengpi leija konin lang na gatongin, ati.","title":"Chapa Ni Thulem"},"29":{"text":"Aman, Kanompoi; chepong-e, tin adonbutnin, ahivangin khonungin alung aheijin, achetan ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin khatjopa henga achen, ajah-a chutobangma chun agaseijin ahi. Aman, Hepa, chenange, tin adonbutnin; chela achetapon ahi."},"31":{"text":"Hite ni chu koijoh chu apa lunga chonham? ati. Amahon, Amasajoh chu, atiuvin ahi. Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Nangho sanga kaidongho le notiho Pathen lenggam sunga lut masajo ding ahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile John chu chonphatna lampia naheng uva ahungin, nanghonla nanatahsan pouve; kaidongho le notihon bou anatahsan uvin ahi. Nangho vangin chuche namu-u jong chun, ama chu natahsan theina dingun, khonungin nalung naheichom dehpouvin ahi.","ref":"Luk 3:12; 7:29-30"},"33":{"text":"Thulem chom khat jong ngaikitnun: inneipa khat hin lengpilei abolin, palin aum kimvelin, lengpiga chil lhahna pum alaijin, insang asan, chuin alei lhouho khutna apedoh-in, gamdanga achemang tai.","title":"Lengpilei Lhouho Thulem (Mrk 12:1-12 ; Luk 20:9-19)","ref":"Isai 5:1-2."},"34":{"text":"Chuin aga phat anai phatnin, atheiga la dingin aleilhouho henga asohte asoltan ahi."},"35":{"text":"Ahin aleilhouho chun anamanun, khat avovin, khat athatnun, athum napa songin asepmun ahi."},"36":{"text":"Asohte dang amasaho sanga tamjo asol kitnin ahile, amahon angaina bepmin anabolun ahi."},"37":{"text":"Akhonna-in aman, Kachapa hi anaja domunte, atin achapa ahenguva asoltai."},"38":{"text":"Ahinla lengpi leilhou hon achapa chu amu phatnun, amahole amaho akihouvun, Ama hi agou lo dinga ahi; hungun, thatnu hitin, agou lo ding eiho changuhite, akitiuvin ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chuin ama chu amanun, lengpilei polamah akaidoh-un, athat taovin ahi."},"40":{"text":"Hijeh chun lengpilei neipa chu ahung teng, chuche aleilhouho chu i-lontem? ati."},"41":{"text":"Amahon ajah-a, Chuche migilouho chu aman engsanin sugamintin, aga phatseh-a atheiga ape ding leilhou dang khutna alengpi lei chu pedoh tante, atiuvin ahi."},"42":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah uva, In sahon adeimoa apaiju song chu aninga songpi penin apangtai; Hiche hi Pakaiya kon ahin, chule imitmuvin akidange, ti Pathen lekhabua thuhi nasimdoh khah lou uham?","ref":"Labu 118:22-23."},"43":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Nangho-a kona Pathen lenggam kilamanga, agadohsah namdang mite kipe ding ahi."},"44":{"text":"Koi hijongle hiche song chunga lhu-a chu ahal hala chip ding; chule koi hile achunga chuche song chua chu leivui banga kithejal ding ahi, ati."},"45":{"text":"Chuin thempu pipuiho le Pharisai hon hiche athulem sei chu ajah phatnun, amaho chunga thusei ahi chu ahedoh taovin ahi."},"46":{"text":"Chuin ama chu mat dingin agouvin, ahivangin themgao ahi tia angaito jeh-un, mipi chu akichauvin ahi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva thulemin asei kitnin,","title":"Mou Kipui Golvah Thulem (Luk 14:15-24)"},"2":{"text":"Pathen lenggam chu Lengpa khat achapa jineina dinga golvah bol tobang ahi;"},"3":{"text":"Aman agolvahna-a dinga kouna changho chu hungtaovin tia kou dingin asohte asolin; ahinla amaho chu ahung nompouvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin aman asohte asol kitnin, Akikouho henga cheovin lang, Veuvin, golvahna an aphasadema kagot ahitai: kabongchal le kagancha thao ho akithat tan, chule abonchan phasademin gotsan aumsohtai; nangho moupui golvahna-a hunguvin, tin gaseijun, ati."},"5":{"text":"Ahivangin amahon dona neipeh louvin, achemang gamuvin, khat alouva achen, khat sumkol veijin achen;"},"6":{"text":"Adangsen asohte chu amanun, nahsahmo tah-in abolun, athat taovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahin lengpan hichu ajah phatnin, alunghang tan; asepaite chengse asolin, chuche tolthat ho chu asumanghelun, akhou jong ahalpeh taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chutah-in asohte jah-a, Golvahna an gotsa ahitai, ane dinga kakou tehola anehoi ahipouve."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh chun lamka lamthoma cheovinlang, mi namu chanu golvah an nedingin gakouvun, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chutichun asohte chu apot-un lampi dunga acheuvin amu chanu mipha mise apui khomun ahile, golvahna indan chu jin adimset tan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin lengpa chu jinho velen ahungin ahile, moupuina vona kivon lou mi khat amudohtan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Aman, Kajol, moupuina vona kivon louva hikoma iti nahung lutham? tin adongin ahile, amapa sei ding helouvin aumtan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuphatnin lengpan asottolleho jah-a, Akhut akeng kanun lang, kaidoh-un, chule polam muthim lah-a paidoh taovin; hikoma chu kale hagel umding ahi.","ref":"Matt 8:12; 25:30; Luk 13:28"},"14":{"text":"Akikou vang tamtah ahin lhendoh vang lhomcha bou ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Pharisai hon athuseija kona mat theina ding doha abolun akihou taovin ahi.","title":"Kai Peh Thudola Thudoh (Mrk 12:13-17 ; Luk 20:10-26)"},"16":{"text":"Chuin aseijuiteu chu Herod miho toh asolun, amaho chun ajah-a, Houhil, nangma mi dihtah nahi, dihtah-a Pathen lampi chu nahil ahin, chule koima gin naneipoi ti kaheuve; nangman mimai navepoi."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun Caesar kai kapeh-u hi, dan ngai ham, hilouham? iti nagelem? neisei peh-un, atiuvin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Jesu'n alunggilou vop-u chu ahen, ajah uva, Vo miphalhem ho, ibola neilunglah uham?"},"19":{"text":"Kai kidon na-a sum kipeji chu neivet sah-un, ati. Chuin amahon dinarii khat ahinchoi jun ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Aman, Hiche hi koi lim le koi minham? tin adonge."},"21":{"text":"Amahon, Caesar'a ahi, tin adonbutnuve.
