Chuphatnin Aman, Caesar'a chu Caesar peuvinlang, Pathen'a chu Pathen peuvin, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuche ajah phatnun, adatmouvin, ama adalhauvin, achemang taovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuche nimama chun, Mithi thokitna aumpoi ti Saddukai ho ahenga ahungun, thu ahung dongun,","title":"Athi Tho Kit Thudola Thudoh (Mrk 12:18-27 ; Luk 20:27-40)","ref":"Sol 23:8."},"24":{"text":"Houhil, mi khatcha nei louva athile, asopipan anumeinu chu akichenpia, asopipa dinga chu chi akhaipeh ding ahi, tin Mosi'n eihilun ahi.","ref":"Danb 25:5"},"25":{"text":"Ahile tun kalah uva ucha pasal sagi aumun; amasapenpa chun ji aneijin athitai; ahin ama chu chikhai lou ahitah jeh chun, a-inneipi chu asopipa adalhah pehtai."},"26":{"text":"Chuti chun abanapa jong, athumnapa jong, asaginapa geijin chutima chun aumtan ahi."},"27":{"text":"Akhonna-in anumeinu chu athitai."},"28":{"text":"Ahile thokitna-a amanu chu sagi lah-a koipen ji hitantem? Amahonla ji-a anei sohkeiju ahin, atiuvin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin, Pathen lekhabua thu le Pathen thahatna nahetlou jeh uva nakheljiu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Thokitna-a chun amaho akicheng tapouvin, chen jong akichensah tapouve; van'a Pathen vantilte tobang ahiuve."},"31":{"text":"Ahinla mithi thokit dol thu Pathen'in najah uva asei,"},"32":{"text":"Keima Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathen kahi, ati chu simkha lou nahiuvem? Ama athiho Pathen hilouvin, ahingho Pathen ahijo bouve, ati.","ref":"Pot 3:6"},"33":{"text":"Mipi chun hichu ajauvin, athuhil chu kidang asa lheh jengun ahi."},"34":{"text":"Aman Saddukai ho anelkhup hel jeng chu ajah phatnun, Pharisai ho akikhomun ahi.","title":"Thupeh Lenpen (Mrk 12:28-34 ; Luk 10:25-28)"},"35":{"text":"Chule alah uva danthuthem khatnin apatepnan thu adongin,","ref":"Luk 10:25-28"},"36":{"text":"Houhil, chondan thupeh lah-a apipen hoiche ham? ati."},"37":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, Nangman nalung pumpin, nalhagao pumpin Pakai na-Pathen chu ngailun.","ref":"Danb 6:5."},"38":{"text":"Hichu thupeh pipen le amasapen ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chule chutobanga chu anina hiche ahi, Nangma naki ngailut bangin naheng nakoma ngailun.","ref":"Thmpu 19:18"},"40":{"text":"Thupeh hichete ni-a hin thupeh jouse le themgaoho thu kikhai cheh ahi ati."},"41":{"text":"Chuin Pharisai ho akikhop petnun, Jesu'n amaho thu adongin, ajah uva,","title":"Messiah Thudola Thudoh (Mrk 12:35-37 ; Luk 20:41-44)"},"42":{"text":"Messiah thudol hi iti nagel uvem? Ama koi chapaham? atin ahile amahon, David chapa, atiuvin ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah uva, Chuti ahile,"},"44":{"text":"Pakaiyin ka Pakai jah-a, Keiman namelmate chengse nakeng chotpha kaneisah masangsen, kajetlama tou jingin, ati tia David chun Lhagaova ama chu Pakai iti atiham?","ref":"Labu 110:1."},"45":{"text":"Chutia David'in ama Pakai asahle, achapa iti hi dingham? ati."},"46":{"text":"Chuin koimachan cheng khatchan jong adonbut thei tapouvin, chuche ni-a pat chun koimachan thudang khatcha jong adong ngam tapouvin ahi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hichun Jesu'n mipi jahle aseijuite jah-a,","title":"Danthu Sunho le Pharisaiho'a Kon Gihsalna (Mrk 12:38-39 ; Luk 11:43 , 46 ; 20:45-46)"},"2":{"text":"Danthu sunho le Pharisai ho Mosi touna mun'a tou ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun athupeh chengseu abonchan bolunlang nit sohkeijun; ahin athilbol bangun vang bol hih-un; ijeh-inem itile amahon asei chu aseijun abolji pouve."},"4":{"text":"Amahon doutheilou pohgih akanun miho lengkouvah asep-un, amahonla akhutjung khatchan jong thamloh ding anompouve."},"5":{"text":"Ahin amahon athilbol jouseu khu mi mu dingabou abolu ahi; ijeh-inem itile amahon thuchinbom akibu ule akibehho chengu khu apeh aletsah-un; chule aponmongu acholsah-un,","ref":"Matt 6:1; Minb 15:38; Danb 6:8"},"6":{"text":"Golvahna-a mun pipen chule kikhopna in'a touna pipen,"},"7":{"text":"Kai lhanga min chibai aboh dingule, min Rabbi, Rabbi, ati dingu adeijun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Nanghon vang mi Rabbi kitisah hih-un; ijeh-inem itile nangho nahiluva khat, Christa jengtah chu aumnai. Chule nangho nabonchaovin sopikhat cheh nahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Vannoi leiset chunga koima pa sah hih-un; ijeh-inem itile van'ah na-Pau khat aume."},"10":{"text":"Chule nanghon mi lamkai kitisah hih-un; ijeh-inem itile nalamkaija khat, Christa jengbou ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nalah uva alenpen chu najenleuva pang ding ahibouve.","ref":"Matt 20:26-27; Mrk 9:35; 10:43-44; Luk 22:26"},"12":{"text":"Koi hile ama kichoi sang chu kisunem ding; chule koi hile akineosah-a chu kichoi sang ding ahi.","ref":"Luk 14:11; 18:14"},"13":{"text":"Ahinla ohe, Danthu sun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nanghon miho masanga van lenggam nakhah-un; nanghola nalutpouvin, chule lut dinga kigoho jong nalutsah pouvin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Aphatlhemu Themmo Achan (Mrk 12:40 ; Luk 11:39-42 , 44 , 52 ; 20:47)"},"14":{"text":"Vo danthu sunho le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nanghon meithaiho in napum valun, kilepnan sot tahtah natao jiuve; hijeh-a chu nangho themmo chungnung nachan dingu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ohe, Danthusun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile mi khat Juda hou housahna dingin twikhanglen le leiset chunga nache kimvel leuvin, chule koi hile najopjop chu nangho sanga ajat ni-a damun mi nahisah jiuvin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ohe, lamhil mitcho ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nanghon koi hile houin pana kihahsel imathu aumpoi; koi hile houin'a um sana pana kihahsel bou chu leiba ahi, nati uve."},"17":{"text":"Vo lungthimbei le mitcho ho, sana suthenga houin le sana chu hoijoh chungnung-jo-a ham?"},"18":{"text":"Chule nanghon, Koi hile maicham pana kihahsel imathu aumpoi, maicham chunga um thilto pana kihahsel bou chu leiba ahi, nati uve."},"19":{"text":"Vo mitcho ho, thilto suthenga maicham le thilto chu hoijoh chungnung-jo-a ham?"},"20":{"text":"Hijeh chun koi hile maicham pana kihahsela chun, maicham le achunga um thilto aboncha apatna kihahsela ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule koi hile houin pana kihahsela chun, houin le achengpa chu agoma apatna kihahsela ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule koi hile van pana kihahsela chun, Pathen touna le achunga Toupa agoma apatna kihahsel ahi.","ref":"Isai 66:1; Matt 5:34"},"23":{"text":"Ohe, Danthu sun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nanghon pudina le pathikhom, chule jira hicheng chu somakhat natohji uvin, danthupeh lah-a alupen, thu adih-a tan, milungset, chule tahsan hicheng chu nalhadah-un ahi. Ahin hicheho hi naman uva, hitiho jong chu nalha lou dingu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 27:30."},"24":{"text":"Vo lamhil mitcho ho, nanghon thouvaisi nalhiuvin, sagongsang napumval-ui!"},"25":{"text":"Ohe, Danthu sun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nanghon khonle lheng apolam nasil ngimun, asunglam hunama lah le kitimlouna adimsetnin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Vo Pharisai mitcho, khonle lheng chu asunglam silngim masale chun, apolam jong ngim dingbou ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ohe, Danthusun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nangho lhan bangleh-a kiloi tobang nahiuve; hitiho chu apolam hoilheh-in akimun, asunglam mithi gu le imanen aboh jouse adimsetnin ahi.","ref":"Sol 23:3."},"28":{"text":"Chutobang chun nangho jong napolamu mi mu dingin chonphatah nahiuve; ahin nasunglamu vang phatlhemna le khangitlouna adimsetnin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ohe, Danthu sun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nanghon themgaoho lhan nasemun, chule michonpha ho lhan najemun,","title":"Jesu'n Talen Amudiu Asei Masah (Luk 11:47-51)"},"30":{"text":"Chule, Kapu kapateu hinlaija chu keiho uma hileuveng, themgaoho thisan sona-a chu pan kalahlou dingu ahi, nati uve."},"31":{"text":"Chutichun nangho themgaoho that teho son nahiuve ti chu, nangho le nangho ahetoh-a nahiu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Napu napateu thil tena dan chu bulhit pai ngaltaovin."},"33":{"text":"Vo gulteho, gulse sonho, nangho hi damun thutan na-a kona iti nahoi thei dinguham?","ref":"Matt 3:7; 12:34; Luk 3:7"},"34":{"text":"Veuvin, keiman naheng uva themgao, miching, chonna danthuhil kahinsole; amaho lah-a chu abang nathauva thingpel'a nakhetbeh uva, abang kikhopna ina najep uva, chule khotina nabolset dingu ahi."},"35":{"text":"Hichu michonpha Abel thisan kiso-a pat, houin le maicham kikah-a natha-u Barachiah chapa Zekariah thisan kiso geija, leiset chunga michonphateho thisan kiso themona jouse aboncha nangho chunga achuh theina dinga ahi.","ref":"Semt 4:8; 2 Thusm 24:20-21"},"36":{"text":"Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hicheng chu aboncha tulai mite chunga chu ding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Vo Jerusalem, Jerusalem, themgaoho that le ahenga kisol teho songa seplih, ahpin anoute alha noija a-opkhum banga keiman jong nachate ijatvei opkhum dinga kagot hitam! Ahin nangho nanompouve.","title":"Jesu'n Jerusalem Akacham (Luk 13:34-35)"},"38":{"text":"Veuvin, na-in'u chu akamhel dinga nangho kidalhah peh nahitaove.","ref":"Jer 22:5"},"39":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile kaseipeh nahiuve, Pakai mina hungpa chu anunnome, nati masangseuva, tukala keima neimu lou dingu ahi, ati.","ref":"Labu 118:26"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Jesu houin'a kona apotdoh-a achele; houin kisahdan ho chu vetsah dingin aseijuite ahenga ahungun ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Houin Suhmanga Aum Ding Aseidoh Masah (Mrk 13:1-2 ; Luk 21:17-19)"},"2":{"text":"Ahin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Nanghon hicheng hi namu lou uham? Keiman tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hikoma hi song suhchim louva khat chunga khat kisethop himhim umlou helding ahi, ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Olive mol chunga atou petnin aseijuite guhthimin ahenga ahungun, Hicheng chu itihle hi dingham? Chule nangma hung kit ding phatle vannoi leiset kichai ni ding melchihna ipi hi dingham? neisei peh-un, atiuvin ahi.","title":"Gimgenthei Le Bolsetna (Mrk 13:3-13 ; Luk 21:7-19)"},"4":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva hitin aseije, Koiman nangho nalheplhah louna dingun kichih theijun,"},"5":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile mi tamtah keima minin hunguntin, Keima Christa kahi tiuvintin, mi tamtah alheplhah dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule nanghon gal kisatle kidou thuthang najah dingu ahi; chingtheijun, lungdong hih-un; ijeh-inem itile hicheng chu hungsoh tei ding ahi; ahivangin achaina hiloulai ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile vai khatle vai khat, gam khat le gam khat hung kidouvintin, mun chom choma kel lhantin, nat set lengin tin, ling kihot ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hitiho jouse chu naosonat kipan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hiche phat teng chule genthei hesoh thoh dinga mihon nangho nahinpehdoh dingu ahi; chule keima min jala nangho namtin jouse hotna nahung umdingu ahi.","ref":"Matt 10:22."},"10":{"text":"Hiteng chule mi tamtah lunglha ding ahi, chule khatle khat kipedoh tontin, chule khat le khat kihoto ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule themgao lhem tamtah sohdoh-a, mi tamtah alheplhah dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule chonset puncheh cheh jeh-a, mi tamtah ngailutna-a lhadai dingu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahinla akhon ni geija thoh lhumkeija pangdetpa bou chu huhhing-a umding ahi.","ref":"Matt 10:22"},"14":{"text":"Chule namtin jouse hetsahna dinga hiche gamsung thupha hi vannoi leiset pumpi-a kihil lhang ding ahi; chutahle kichai dingbou ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuti ahijeh chun mi sumang thet umtah thil thudol Daniel themgao sei chu mun thenga adin namu tengule, (asim siman hehen,)","title":"Thoh Hahsa Nasatah (Mrk 13:14-23 ; Luk 21:20-24)","ref":"Dan 9:27; 11:31; 12:11."},"16":{"text":"Chutengle Juda gama um chengse thinglhang lamah jamuhen;"},"17":{"text":"In chunga uma jong a-in'a athilkeo kilah dingin kumdahen;","ref":"Luk 17:31"},"18":{"text":"Chule louva um jong apon kilah dingin kile kitdahen."},"19":{"text":"Ahin ohe, hiche lai chule naovop hole nao noichepsah ho ada nadinguve!"},"20":{"text":"Chule najamnao chu phalbilai ahiloule cholngah ni ahi louna dingin taovun."},"21":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile hiche teng chule hesoh genthei khoh chungnung umding ahi; chutobang hesoh gentheina chu leiset umtilla pat tu geijin aumkha hihlaije, um jong umlou ding ahi.","ref":"Dan 12:1; Tph 7:14"},"22":{"text":"Chule hiche nikho chu kisuchom lou hileh, mihem himhim ahinga sohcha umlou dinga ahi; ahinla lhenchomte jala anikho chu kisuchom ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chutengle, khat touvin najah uva, Ven, Christa hikoma aume, ahiloule, khukomah, tijongle tahsan hih-un."},"24":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Christa lhemho le themgao lhemho hung sohdoh untin, melchihna loupi tahtah le mu kidang ahinvetsah dingu ahi; ahitheile lhenchomte tah jeng jong ahinlheplhah dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Veuvin, Keiman kahil masah dem nahitaove."},"26":{"text":"Hijeh chun mihon najah uva, Ven, gamthipmah aume atiuva ahile, chedoh hih-un, ahiloule, Ven, indan sungnunga aume, atiu jongle tahsan hih-un.","ref":"Luk 17:23-24."},"27":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile kolphe niso lama ahung phetdohle, nilhum lam geijin asalvah-in; Mihem Chapa hung kit jong chutobang ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Thilong um umna-a bou muthong kikhom ding ahi.","ref":"Luk 17:37."},"29":{"text":"Ahivangin chutenga hesoh genthei joutah chule nisa thimintin, lha jong vahta lou ding, vanlaijola ahsi ho pullhantin, chule van thahatna ho chengse kihot lingsoh ding ahi.","title":"Mihem Chapa Hungding (Mrk 13:24-27 ; Luk 21:25-28)","ref":"Isai 13:10; 34:4; Ezek 32:7; Joel 2:10,31; 3:15; Tph 6:12-13."},"30":{"text":"Chutahle vanlaijola Mihem Chapa melchihna hung kilang ding; chuteng tahle vannoi leiset phungtin-in a-op achupchup dingu ahi, chule vanlaijola Mihem Chapa thuneitah le loupi chungnung tah-a meilom lah-a ahung amu dingu ahi.","ref":"Dan 7:13; Zech 12:10-14; Tph 1:7"},"31":{"text":"Chule aman avantilte sumkon gin nasatahtoh asoldoh ding; chule amahon van mong khatna patna van mong khat geija, kolkimvel li-a kona alhen chomte alon khom dingu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Theichang phung hin thulem kihilun. Abah adona ana ahungnou tengle, nipi anaitai ti nanghon naheuve.","title":"Theichang Phunga Kon Kihilna (Mrk 13:28-31 ; Luk 21:29-33)"},"33":{"text":"Chutobang chun nangho jong hichengse chu aboncha namusoh tengule, anai tai, kotbul hungeija ahitai ti heuvin."},"34":{"text":"Keiman nangho tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hichengse chu aboncha aguilhun masangse-a, hiche khangguija mite hi mang lou ding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Vanle lei mang ding ahin; keima thu vang mang lou ding ahi."},"36":{"text":"Ahivangin ka Pa changseh tilou van'a vantilte jong, koimachan anikho le anidan tah chu ahepoi.","title":"Koiman Anikho Le Anidan Tah Ahepoi (Mrk 13:32-37 ; Luk 17:26-30 , 34-36)"},"37":{"text":"Ahinla Noah nikho tobang chu Mihem Chapa hungkit nijong hiding ahi.","ref":"Semt 6:5-8"},"38":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile twisanglet masangin, Noah kong'a alut ni geijin, mihon aneuvin adonun, akichengun, akichensah-un,"},"39":{"text":"Chule twisang ahung letna abonchauva alhohmang gam kahse chun ima hepha louvin aumun ahi; Mihem Chapa hung ni jongle chutobang ding ahi.","ref":"Semt 7:6-24"},"40":{"text":"Chutengle mi ni louva um, khat kila-a khat kidalha ding ahi."},"41":{"text":"Numei ni sumheija chang goikhoma, khat kila-a khat kidalha ding ahi."},"42":{"text":"Hijeh chun kiging jingin umum; ijeh-inem itile na-Pakaiyu ipi nikho le nidana ahung ding nanghon nahepouve."},"43":{"text":"Itih phatna gucha ahung ding inneipun ahet hile, kiging jingintin, a-in aphetvangsah lou ding ahi; hichu nanghon heuvin","ref":"Luk 12:39-40"},"44":{"text":"Hijeh chun nangho phasademin umun; ijeh-inem itile nagel lou pettah-ule Mihem Chapa chu hung ding ahi."},"45":{"text":"Ahile, a-pakaiyin aphat phatcha achan dingu an hoppeh ding a-in sunga jouse chunga apipua apansah, soh tahsan umtah chingtah koiham?","title":"Soh Kitah Le Kitahlou (Luk 12:41-48)"},"46":{"text":"A-pakai ahung tenga chutia bol ahungto soh chu anunnom ahi."},"47":{"text":"Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, aman ama chu anei jouse chunga apipua apansah ding ahi."},"48":{"text":"Amavang soh gilou chun alungthimin, Ka pakai ahung geije, tihen,"},"49":{"text":"Asoh chanpiho dengpan tahen, chule ju khamho toh ne khom don khomtale,"},"50":{"text":"Hiche sohpa chun aginchat lou nitahle ahetlou pettah-a a-pakaipa chu hunga;"},"51":{"text":"Ama chu tum ni asoa, achan miphalhem ho lah-a akoi ding ahi; hikoma chu kale hagel umding ahi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiteng chule van lenggam chu thaomei kikenna mou in neipu lamto dinga potdoh nungah somtoh kitekah ding ahi.","title":"Nungah Som Thulem","ref":"Luk 12:35."},"2":{"text":"Alah uva nga chu lungthim bei ahiuvin, nga chu lungthim pha ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile lungthim bei chengse chun, thaomei akikenu chun thaotwi akentha pouvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahin lungthim pha chengse vang chun, thaomei akenu chun atheija thaotwi akentha uvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin mou inneipu chu ahung gei jeh-in abonchauvin alulhuvin, a-imulhu gam taovin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahin jan khang kimim, Veuvin, mou inneipu ahunge! Alamto dingin potdoh-un, tin akisamtan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chutah-in hiche nungah ho chu athouvun, athaomei cheh-u akigot taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hichun lungthim beiho chun lungthim phaho jah-a chun, Nathao twi'u themkhat neipeuvin; ijeh-inem itile keiho thaomei mit ding kon ahitai, atiuvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahivangin lungthim phaho chun adonbutnun, Keihole nangho igomuva dingin lhingponte; chusangin ajohho henga cheovinlang nangho ding gakichoh taovin, atiuvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla acho dinga ache kah-un mou inneipu chu ahungtan; chule kigosa dema umho chu amatoh mou puina in'ah thakhatnin alut taovin; chule kot akikhah tan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chujouvin nungah dangho chu ahungun, Pakai, Pakai, kot neihonun, atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Luk 13:25."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla aman adonbutnin, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Keiman nangho kahepouve, atitai."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun kiging jingin umun, ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa hung nading anikhole anidan tah chu nanghon nahepouve."},"14":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile van lenggam chu asohte kou khoma anei chengse amaho khutna pedoh-a, khol gama chemang mi khat tobang ahi.","title":"Talent Kihoppeh Thulem (Luk 19:11-27)","ref":"Luk 19:11-27."},"15":{"text":"Aman khat chu talent nga apen, khat talent ni apen, khat talent khat apen, athan ajokhop cheh-in sum apen, akipat dohtai."},"16":{"text":"Chuin talent nga sangpa chun chupettah chun achen hiche chun akiveijin, talent ngama aveikanben ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chutobangma chun talent ni sangpa chun talent nima aveikanben ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ahin talent khat sangpa vang chun achen, leiko alaijin, a-pakaipa sum chu agasel mangtan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin phatsot tah nungin hiche soh ho pakaipa chu ahungin, amaho chutoh sum asutoh taovin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin talent nga sangpa chun talent nga ahinchoiben, Pakai, nangman talent nga neipeh ahin; ven keiman talent nga kaveikan ben ahi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin apakai pan ajah-a, Soh pha tahsan umtah, nabol aphatave; nangma themcha khat chunga tahsan umtah nahin, keiman nangma tamtah chunga kapansah ding nahi; nangma na pakai kipana-ah luttan, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin talent ni sangpa jong chu ahungin, Pakai, nangman keima talent ni neipeh ahin; ven keiman talent ni kaveikan ben ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin a-pakaipan ajah-a, Soh pha tahsan umtah, nabol aphatave; nangma themcha khat chunga tahsan umtah nahin, keiman nangma tamtah chunga kapansah ding nahi; nangma napakai kipana-ah luttan, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chujouvin talent khat sangpa chu ahungin, Pakai, nangma hi mikhel nahin, natuna louvah na-atjin, nathejalna lou pouvah nahuikhomjin ahi; hichu kahen;"},"25":{"text":"Nangma kakichan, kachen nasum talent chu leiah kaseltan ahi: ven, nangma-a ma chu nakimu ahi, ati."},"26":{"text":"Ahin a-pakaipan adonbutnin ajah-a, Soh giloule thase, katuna louva ka-atjia, kathe jalna louva kahui khomji nahet ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuti an kasum chu sum veipung na-a anakoi tangem, chutile kei kahung phatna asumthoi puma keiman kasum muta dinga."},"28":{"text":"Hijeh chun hiche talent chu lahpeh-un lang, talent som neipa chu petaovin,"},"29":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile anei chana chu kipehbe-a, aneiletset ding ahi; anei lou vang chu aneichasun chu ama-a kona kilah mangpeh ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 13:12; Mrk 4:25; Luk 8:18"},"30":{"text":"Hiche soh pannabei hi polam muthim-ah gapaimang-un; hikoma chu kale hagel umding ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 8:12; 22:13; Luk 13:28"},"31":{"text":"Mihem Chapa vantil thengte jousetoh aloupina-a ahung tengtah le, Ama aloupina lal touna-a tou ding ahi;","title":"Thupi Tan Nikho","ref":"Matt 16:27; 19:28."},"32":{"text":"Chule namtin vai jouse Ama anga chu kikhom ding; chule kelngoi chingpan keltah-a kona kelngoi achomkhen banga, aman khatna kona khat achomkhena,"},"33":{"text":"Aman kelngoi chengse ajet lama akoija, keltah chengse vei lama akoi ding ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chutengle lengpa chun ajet lama umteho jah-a chu, Hungun, ka Pa phattheiboh changho, vannoi leiset kiphudoh tila patna nangho dinga gotsa kikoi lenggama hung lotaovin."},"35":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile kagil akelin ahile, nanghon neh ding neinapeuvin; kadang achah-in, donding neinapeuvin; kamaljinin ahile neilhun sah-un;"},"36":{"text":"Kasagoh keova kaumin, pon neinasilpeh-un; kadam mon ahile, eiven nahungun; chule kasoh changin ahile, hikoma jong chun kahenga nahungun ahi, ati ding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chutengle michonpha te chun, keihon itih-a nagilkel kamuva, an nehding kapeh khah-um? Ahiloule itih-a nadangchah kamuva, kadon sah-um?"},"38":{"text":"Keihon itih-a namaljin kamuva, kalhunsah-um? Ahiloule nasagoh keova naum kamuva, pon kasil pehkhah-um?"},"39":{"text":"Chule keihon itih-a nadamo kamuva kahung vetnuva; nasohchan kamuva nahenga kahung uvem? ati dingu ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chule lengpan amaho jah-a, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hiche kasopite ho lah-a aneopen khat nabolna chanseu chu, keima neibolnao ahi, tia adonbut ding ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chutengle aman avei lama umho jah-a chu, Vo gaosap changho, kakoma konin chemangun, diabol le avantilte dinga kikoi meilhum sunga lut taovin;"},"42":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile kagil kelin, nanghon neh ding neipe pouvin; kadang chah-in, don ding neipepouvin;"},"43":{"text":"Kamaljinin, neilhunsah pouvin; sagoh keovin kaumin, pon neinasilpeh pouvin; kadammole kasoh chanin, neihungve pouvin ahi, ati ding ahi."},"44":{"text":"Chutengle amahon jong, Pakai, keihon nangma itih-a nagilkel, nadangchah, namaljin, sagoh keova naum, nadammo le nasohchan kamu uva kajenle daovem? tia ama adonbut dingu ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chutengle Aman amaho jah-a, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Nanghon hiche aneochaho lah-a khat nabol louvu chu, keima neibol louvu ahi, tia adonbut ding ahi."},"46":{"text":"Chule amaho chu tonsot kemlou talent man dinga cheova, michonpha ho chu kemlou tonsot hinna-a che ding ahiuve.","ref":"Dan 12:2"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chutichun Jesu'n hichengse chu asei jouvin, aseijuite jah-a,","title":"Jesu That Dinga Akihousomu (Mrk 14:1-2 ; Luk 22:1-2 ; Jhn 11:45-53)"},"2":{"text":"Nini joule kalchuhkut hi ding ahi; chule Mihem Chapa hi thingpel'a khetbeh dinga melmate khutna kipedoh ding ahi, ti chu nanghon naheuve, ati.","ref":"Pot 12:1-27"},"3":{"text":"Chutah chun thempu pipuiho le danthusunho, upaho chu thempu chungnung Caiaphas atiu inpia chun akikhomun,"},"4":{"text":"Jesu chu doha bola matna, thana dingin akihou khomtaovin ahi;"},"5":{"text":"Amavang, Kut sung chun hidahen, ajole mipi lah-a thunoh umgetninte, atiuvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin Jesu Bethany kho-a Simon miphahpa in'a aumpetnin,","title":"Bethany'a Jesu Thao Kinu (Mrk 14:3-9 ; Jhn 12:1-8)"},"7":{"text":"Numei khatnin songval bomin thao namtui manlutah ahinchoijin, ahenga ahungin, a-ankong um pettah-in alu chunga asunglhan anun ahi.","ref":"Luk 7:37-38"},"8":{"text":"Ahin aseijuiten hichu amuvin, alungnom mo uvin, Ibola hitia amoh suhmang jeng hitam?"},"9":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile hiche thao hi aman tamtah-a joh-a, mivaicha gentheiho peh thei ahi, atiuvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahin Jesu'n hichu ahetdoh phatnin, Ibola numeinu hi nasuh lunggimu ham? Kachunga hi thil phatah abol ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile mivaicha gentheite chu nakom uva aum jingnauve, keimavang nangho koma um jinga kahipoi.","ref":"Danb 15:11"},"12":{"text":"Hiche thao namtui eisunkhum hi, eikivui nikho-a dinga chu eigot ahi."},"13":{"text":"Keiman nangho tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Vannoi leiset gam pumpi-a hiche Kipana Thupha kihil lhang nachana, hiche numeinu thilbol jong hi, amanu het jingna-a kiseipeh ding ahi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuphatnin somleni lah-a khat, Juda Iscariot atiu chu, thempu pipuiho koma achen,","title":"Jesu Matsah Dinga Juda Iscariot Anop (Mrk 14:10-11 ; Luk 22:3-6)"},"15":{"text":"Ajah uva, Ama khu matsah leuveng ipi neipeh diuham? ati. Chuin amahon ama chu dangka somthum ateppeh taovin ahi.","ref":"Zech 11:12"},"16":{"text":"Chupet tah-a pat chun aman ama chu pedoh-a matsahna thei dingje agomkom aholtan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin cholsolou changlhah kut ni masa nin aseijuite Jesu hengah ahungun, Kalchuhkut nanehna ding hoikoma goleuveng nalungham, atiuvin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Aseijuite Toh Kalchuh Kut An Aneh-u (Mrk 14:12-21 ; Luk 22:7-13 , 21-23 ; Jhn 13:21-30)"},"18":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah uva, Khopi sunga cheovinlang mi khat jah-a, Houhilin, Kaphat anaitai; kaseijuite toh nangma in'a kalchuhkut an kanehkhom dingu ahi, ati, tin gaseijun, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n ahil bangbangu chun abolun, aseijuiten kalchuhkut chu agago taovin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin nilhah ahi phatnin, aseijuite somleni chutoh atou taovin;"},"21":{"text":"Chuin a-anneh laitah-un aman ajah uva, Tahbeh-a kasei ahi, nalah uva khatnin eipehdoh-a eimatsah ding ahi, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin alungdong lheh jengtaovin, ajah-a, Pakai, kei kahim? aticheh taovin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Aman adonbutnin, Lhenga kaso khompipa tah chu eimatsah dinga ahi.","ref":"Labu 41:9."},"24":{"text":"Mihem Chapa achonchan ding thu kisun bangtah-a chu cheding mong ahi, ahivangin Mihem Chapa pedoh-a matsah dingpa chu ohe adana-e! Ama chu apena peng lou hile ama dinga phajota ding ahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Hichun apedoh-a pang ding Juda Iscariot chun adonbutnin, Pakai, kei kahim? ati. Chuin aman, Nakisei khai, ati."},"26":{"text":"Chuin an aneh laitah-un, Jesu'n changlhah alan, phatthei aboh jouvin ahehbal balin, aseijuite apen, Kilah-un, neuvin; hiche hi katahsa ahi, ati.","title":"Pakai Jan Anjon (Mrk 14:22-26 ; Luk 22:14-20 ; 1 Cor 11:23-25)"},"27":{"text":"Chuin khon alan, athangvah jouvin amaho chu apen, ajah uva, Nabonchaovin don sohkeijun;"},"28":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile hiche hi chonset suhbeina dinga mi tamtah dinga kisodoh kitepna thah kathisan ahi.","ref":"Pot 24:8; Jer 31:31-34"},"29":{"text":"Chule keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Ka Pa lenggam sunga nang hotoh athah-a kadonkhom ni ahunglhun kahse-a, tu kala hiche lengpiga twi hi kadon kit lou ding ahitai, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin amahon la asah jouvun apotdoh-un, Olive molsang lama achetauvin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chutah chun Jesu'n ajah uva, Tujana hi nangho nabon chaova kachunga lungthoi sohkei ding nahiuve; ijeh-inem itile, Keiman kelngoi chingpa kavoh lhuh ding, chutengle kelngoihon chu chehgam ding ahi, tin akisune.","title":"Jesu'n Peter'in Aseilep Ding Asei Masah (Mrk 14:27-31 ; Luk 22:31-34 ; Jhn 13:36-38)","ref":"Zech 13:7."},"32":{"text":"Ahin kathodoh nungle, Galilee gam lam namasang sang uva kache ding ahi, ati."},"33":{"text":"Ahin Peter'in adonbutnin, ajah-a, Abonchauvin nachungah lungthoi jongleu, keima vang itihchan hijongle lungthoi ponge, ati."},"34":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah-a, tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahi, tujan ah khon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi, ati."},"35":{"text":"Pater'in ajah-a, Nangma toh thitha ding mong hijongleng, keiman nangma seilep hihhel ing kate, ati. Aseijuite jousen jong chuti chun asei sohkeijun ahi."},"36":{"text":"Hichun Jesu amaho chutoh Gethsemane atiu mun khat alhunun, aman aseijuite jah-a, Keima khukoma khu kache-a kagatao sungsen, nangho hikoma hin anatou jingun, ati.","title":"Getsemane Hon Sunga Jesu Atao (Mrk 14:32-42 ; Luk 22:39-46)"},"37":{"text":"Chuin Peter le Zebedai chapate ni chu akipuijin; chule alunghem lheh jengin alungkham pantan ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chutah chun aman amaho jah-a, Thina khophelin kalung hesoh behseh jengtai; hikoma umunlang neikigin piuvin, ati."},"39":{"text":"Chuin amasang lama phabep khat ache chonin, akhupbon alhun tolah amai asulutnin, ataovin, Ka Pa, ahi theile, hiche khon hi keija konin kitolmang jenghen; ahivangin keima lunggot bang hilouvin, nangma lunggot bang hijohen, ati."},"40":{"text":"Chuin aseijuite henga ahungin ahile, amaho chu ana-imut lhuh gamu ahungtoh-in, Peter jah-a, Nanghon nidan khat jengjong nei kiginpi jou lou uham?"},"41":{"text":"Lhepna-a nalhah louna dingun kigingun, taovun; lhagao vangin agonan tahsan ajoupoi, ati."},"42":{"text":"Chuin aniveina-in ache kitnin, ataovin, Ka Pa, hiche khona kadon louva kitolmang thei lou ahile, nangma thuthu hihen, ati."},"43":{"text":"Chuin ahung kitnin ahile, amaho chu a-imut lhuh-u ahungtoh-in ahi; ijeh-inem itile amaho chu a-imutsoh lheh jengun ahi."},"44":{"text":"Chutichun amaho chu adalhan, athumvei na-in ache kitnin, ataovin, aseingai bangma chu asei kitnin ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chutah-in aseijuite hengah ahungin, ajah uva, Ahile, tun imuvinlang kitha ol taovin; veuvin, phat alhingtai, chule Mihem Chapa hi michonse te khutna kipedoh-a ahitai."},"46":{"text":"Kipat un, chetao hite; veuvin, eipedohpa ahungnai tai, ati."},"47":{"text":"Chuin hichu asei nalajin, veuvin, somleni lah-a Juda Iscariot chu thempu pipuiho le upaho koma kona chemjam le moltum hintho-a hungkon mipi nasatah chutoh ahung kilhonin ahungtan ahi.","title":"Jesu Amatnu (Mrk 14:43-50 ; Luk 22:47-53 ; Jhn 18:3-12)"},"48":{"text":"Ama pedoh-a pangpa chun amaho chu melchihna ahil masan, Keiman kachop penpen chu ama ahi, ama chu man-un, ati ahi."},"49":{"text":"Chuin aman Jesu heng ajon paijin, Rabbi, chibai, atin achoptan ahi."},"50":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Kajol, Ibola hunga nahim? ati. Chutah-in amaho chun akom ahin naijun, Jesu chungah akhut alhaovin, amantaovin ahi."},"51":{"text":"Chuin, veuvin, Jesu loiho khatnin akhut alamin, achemjam asatdoh-in, thempu chungnung sohpa asatle abilkol lang khat asatlhan ahi."},"52":{"text":"Chuphatnin Jesu'n ajah-a, Nachemjam chu akoina-a koi kitnin; ijeh-inem itile chemjam panteho chu chemjam'a lou ding ahi."},"53":{"text":"Ole tutah jenga jong hi ka Pan avantil janel somleni sanga tamjo eihin solpehna dinga kathum thei louva nangaito ham?"},"54":{"text":"Ahinla chutin kibole hitia hi thu soh tei ding ahi, tia Pathen lekhabua kisun chu iti guilhun thei dingham? ati."},"55":{"text":"Hichepet chun Jesu'n mipi chengse jah-a chun, Gucha michom man dinga kon banga chemjamle moltum nahinthova, keima man dinga nahung kon uham? Keima houin'ah niseh-in katouvin thu kahil jingin, chulaijinla neiman pouvin ahi.","ref":"Luk 19:47; 21:37."},"56":{"text":"Amavang themgaoho lekha sut thu guilhuna dinga, hichengse hi aboncha soh-a ahitai, ati. Chutah chun aseijuite jousen ama adalhauvin, ajamgam taovin ahi."},"57":{"text":"Chuin Jesu manho chun danthu sunho le upaho kikhopna, Caiaphas atiu thempu chungnung henga chun akaijun ahi.","title":"Houvaipo Loi Anga Jesu Thu Kikhol (Mrk 14:53-65 ; Luk 22:54-55 , 63-71 ; Jhn 18:13-14 , 19-24)"},"58":{"text":"Peter vang chun galkanga ajuipeh-in, thempu chungnung inpi leitol geijin ajuijin, hikoma chun alutnin, Achaina munge, tin sottolho lah-a chun atouvin ahi."},"59":{"text":"Hichun thempu pipuiho le houvaipoloi chengsen Jesu thana dingin achungah hettohsah jouthu aholun;"},"60":{"text":"Jouthu hettohsah tamtah ahung vangun, amupouvin ahi. Akhonnan mi ni ahungin,"},"61":{"text":"Hichepa hin, Keima Pathen houin suse-a ni thum sunga sadoh kit thei kahi ati, ahung ti lhonin ahi.","ref":"Jhn 2:19"},"62":{"text":"Chuin thempu chungnung chu adingdoh-in, ajah-a, Nadonbut lou dingham? Hitehon nahehsetna-a thu aseiju hi ipiham? ati."},"63":{"text":"Ahivangin Jesu thipbeh-in aumin ahi. Chuin thempu chungnung chun ajah-a, Keiman nangma Pathen hing mina kahahsela kasol nahi, nangma Pathen Chapa Christa chu nahim? Neisei peh-un, ati."},"64":{"text":"Hichun Jesu'n ajah-a, Naseikhai, chukalvala kaseipeh nahiuve, Tunung kalle nanghon Mihem Chapa thahatna jet lama atoule, meilom chunga ahung namu dingu ahi, ati.","ref":"Dan 7:13."},"65":{"text":"Chutah-in thempu chungnung chun apon abotkeh-in, Hiche hi Pathen ataitom ahi; eihon thu hettohsah dang iding iti tah dinguham? Veuvin, nanghon tun Pathen ataitomna najataovin ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 24:16."},"66":{"text":"Nanghon iti nagel uvem? ati. Amahon, Thi dinga lom ahi, tin adonbutnun ahi."},"67":{"text":"Chutah-in amahon amaijah chil asetnun, akhut tumun akhenun; chule kimkhatnin abengun,","ref":"Isai 50:6."},"68":{"text":"Vo Khrista, gaovinlang seijin, koiham nabenga chu, atiuvin ahi."},"69":{"text":"Hichepet chun Peter polamah leitolah atouvin ahi; hichun sohnu khat ahenga ahungin ajah-a, Nangma jong Galilee mi Jesu toh kiloi chu nahi, ati.","title":"Peter'in Jesu Aseilep (Mrk 14:66-72 ; Luk 22:56-62 ; Jhn 18:15-18 , 25-27)"},"70":{"text":"Ahivangin aman japi angsungah aseilepmin, Nathusei chu kahepoi, atitan ahi."},"71":{"text":"Chuin kelkot phung lamah apotnin ahile, sohnu achom khatnin ama chu amun, chukoma umho jah-a chun, Hichepa jong hi Nazareth Jesu koma uma chu ahi, ati."},"72":{"text":"Chuin aman aseilep kitnin, Hiche mipa chu kahepoi, tin akihahseltan ahi."},"73":{"text":"Chujou phabepmin chukoma um miho chu ahenga ahungun, Peter jah-a, Tahbeh-in nangma jong amaho lah-a khat mongmong nahi; ijeh-inem itile napao chun nangma naphong doh-e, atiuvin ahi."},"74":{"text":"Hiphat chun aman, Hiche mihempa chu kahe hih hele tin kigaosaple kihahsel athopantan ahi. Chupettah chun ahchal akhongtan ahi."},"75":{"text":"Hichun, Ahchal khon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi, tia Jesu thusei chu Peter'in ageldoh-in; chuin polamah apotdoh-in, lhasetah-in hakan akaptan ahi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin jingkah ahi phatnin, thempu pipuiho chengsele upaho jouse Jesu thana dingin akihoutoh taovin ahi;","title":"Pilate Anga Jesu Apuiju (Mrk 15:1 ; Luk 23:1-2 ; Jhn 18:28-32)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Ama chu akanun, akaijun, gamvaipo Pontius Pilate khutnah apedoh taovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chutah-in apedoh-a panga Juda Iscariot chun athi dinga themmo achansah-u chu amun ahile akisih-in, dangka somthum chu thempu pipuiho le upaho alepeh kitnin,","title":"Juda Thi (Sol 1:18-19)","ref":"Sol 1:18-19."},"4":{"text":"Themona neilou thisan kapehdoh chu kachon kheltai, ati. Ahinla amahon, Hichu keiho ka ithu-u umam? Nangman nalo nomnom lotan, ati taovin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hichun aman dangka chu houin sunga asep lhan, chukoma kon chun achemangin, ama akikhai lihtan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin thempu pipuihon hiche dangka chu alauvin, Hiche hi thisan man ahi jeh-in, housum kholna-a koi angai ahipoi, atiuvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hichun amaho akihoutoh-un, gamdang miho vuina dingin, hichun beldengpa leiset achou vin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun tugeijin hiche leiset chu thisan leiset akitin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hichu themgao Jeremiah thusei, Israel chate lah-a kona aman asahsao, aman kisahpa man chu dangka somthum alauvin ahi;","ref":"Zech 11:12-13."},"10":{"text":"Chule, Pakaiyin eithupeh dungjuijin, beldengpa leiset manin apetaovin ahi, ati chu guilhunga ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Chujouvin Jesu chu gamvaipo angah adingtan ahi: chuin gamvaipo chun adongin, Nangma Juda te lengpa nahim? atin ahile, Jesu'n ajah-a, Naseikhai, ati.","title":"Pilate'in Jesu Thu Adoh (Mrk 15:2-5 ; Luk 23:3-5 ; Jhn 18:33-38)"},"12":{"text":"Ahin thempu pipuiho le upahon ahehsetna thu ijat asei vangun, aman imachan adonbutpon ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chutah-in Pilate'in ajah-a, Hitehon nangma douna hettohsahna asei chengseu hi najah louham? ati."},"14":{"text":"Ahin Aman cheng khatcha jong adonbut lou jeh chun, gamvaipo chun adatmo lheh jengin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hiche kut sunga chu sohchang koi hile mihon agotpen penu chu gamvaipo chun alhadohji angai ahi.","title":"Jesu Tha Dinga Athu Kitanlhah (Mrk 15:6-15 ; Luk 23:13-25 ; Jhn 18:39—19:16)"},"16":{"text":"Hichepet chun sohchang amin Barabbas atiu, sohchang minthang tah khat aumin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun amaho akikhop phatnun, Pilate'in amaho chu adongin, Koijoh lhadoh pehleng nalungu ham? Barabbas ha, Christa kiti Jesu joh ham? ati."},"18":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile thangset suma apehdoh-u ahi chu aman ahen ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin ama thutanna mun'a atoupetnin, a-inneipin thu ahin thotnin, Hiche michonpha pa chu limsah hih-in; ijeh-inem itile Ama jeh chun tunin kamangin kathohgim lheh jengin ahi, ati."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla thempu pipuiho le upahon Barabbas chu angeh uva, chule Jesu chu asuhmangsah dingin mipi chu atilse taovin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin gamvaipo chun adonbutnin, Hichete ni hi koijoh lhadoh pehleng nalungu ham? atin ahile; amahon, Barabbas, atiuvin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Pilate'in ajah uva, Achutile Christa kiti Jesu hi i-kalo dingba hitam? ati. Chuin amahon, Thingpel'a kikhenbeh hen, atiuvin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin aman, Ibolinem, ipi suhset aneiham? ati. Ahivangin amahon hasaptah-in asamun, Thingpelah kikhenbeh hen, atiuvin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Pilate'in ananlela abol ima phatsahna ahilou, thunoh baotam asojoh chu amu phatnin, twi alan, mipi angsungah akhut asillhan, Hiche michonpha pa thisan kisona-a themona nei lou kahi; nanghon nalolo lotaovin, ati.","ref":"Danb 26:6-9."},"25":{"text":"Chuin mihon abonchauvin adonbutnun, Ama thisan phu chu keiho le kachateu chungah chuhen, atiuvin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chutah-in aman amaho chu Barabbas alhadohpeh-un; Jesu vang chu ajepmin, thingpel'a khetbeh dingin apedohtan ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chutah-in gamvaipo sepai ho chun Jesu chu Pretorium sungah apui lutnun, akomah sepaiho jouse akikhom sohkeijun;","title":"Sepaihon Jesu Totnopna Aneiju (Mrk 15:16-20 ; Jhn 19:2-3)"},"28":{"text":"Chule aponsil chu ahoh lha uvin, ponsandup asilpeh taovin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chule ling lukhuh aphanun, alu-a akhuhpeh-un, chule akhut jet lamah pengtenggol khat achoisah-un, a-angah adilsuvin, Vo Juda te Lengpa, Chibai, atiuvin, totnopnan ael-elin abolun ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin chil asetkhumun, apumpeng choi chu alauvin, alu avoh naovin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chutia chu totnopna-a a-el ela abol jouvun, pon san chu ahoh lha uvin, ama pon asilpeh-un thingpel'a khetbeh dingin apuitaovin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chujouvin apotdoh uva acheule, amin Simon atiu, Cyrene gam mi khat amuvin, ama athingpel puding chun acham louvin amanun ahi.","title":"Jesu Thingpel'a Akhetbeh-u (Mrk 15:21-32 ; Luk 23:26-43 ; Jhn 19:17-27)"},"33":{"text":"Chuin Golgotha (Hichu lugumun tina ahi) atiu mun chu alhunun,"},"34":{"text":"Amahon Jesu chu gilkhatoh kihal lengpitwi thuh adonsah-un ahile, aman atepmin adon nomtapon ahi.","ref":"Labu 69:21"},"35":{"text":"Chujouvin amachu thingpel'a akhenbeh-un; themgao thusei, kapon akihom taovin, chule kasangkhol chol vang vetnan amang taove, atichu guilhun nan, apon chu akihomun, chule vang avetaove.","ref":"Labu 22:18."},"36":{"text":"Chule hikoma chun atouvun, ama chu angah taovin ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chule HICHEPA HI JESU JUDA TE LENGPA AHI, tin ahehnau hetsahna asunun, alu chungah atah-un ahi."},"38":{"text":"Hiche pet chun amatoh thakhatnin gucha michom ni, khat ajet lamah khat avei lamah thingpelah akhen beh-un ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chuin achele avahle jousen akhasuh khumun, a-el elin ahouvun,","ref":"Labu 22:7; 109:25."},"40":{"text":"Nang houin suse-a ni thuma sadoh kit, nangma kihuh hing tangem! nangma Pathen Chapa nahile, thingpel'a konin hung kumlhan, atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Matt 26:62; Jhn 2:19"},"41":{"text":"Thempu pipuihon jong, danthu sunho le upaho toh chutima chun totnopnan abolun,"},"42":{"text":"Aman midang ahuhhingjin; ama akihuhhing theipoi. Ama Israelte Lengpa ahileh, tun thingpel'a konin hung kumlha temhen, achutile tahsanunge."},"43":{"text":"Aman Pathen asongin; Pathen'in adei ahile tun huhhing hen; ijeh-inem itile aman, Pathen Chapa kahi ati, atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Labu 22:8"},"44":{"text":"Chule amatoh thingpel'a kikhetbeh tha gucha michomte ni jong chun, chutobangma chun ahouse lhonin ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chuin nidan gupma pat Nidan ko geijin, gam jouse chungah mu athim tan ahi.","title":"Jesu Athi (Mrk 15:33-41 ; Luk 23:44-49 ; Jhn 19:28-30)"},"46":{"text":"Chuin nidan ko donin Jesu'n, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani, tin hapenin apengin ahi. Hichu, Ka Pathen, ka Pathen, ibola neidalhah ham, tina ahi.","ref":"Labu 22:1"},"47":{"text":"Chukoma dingho lah-a abang bangin chutia ati chu ajauvin, Hichepan Elijah akouve, atiuvin ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chupettah chun alah uva khat alhaijelin, twichop phon khat alan, lengpitwi thuh adelhopmin, pengtenggol leh-a atah-in, agahdonsah-in ahi.","ref":"Labu 69:21"},"49":{"text":"Ahin adangho chun, Limsah hih-in; Elijah ahuhhinga hunga hung hih-am, veohite, atiuvin ahi."},"50":{"text":"Chuin Jesu hapenin apengin, alhagao alhadohtan ahi."},"51":{"text":"Chuin, veuvin, houin'a pondal len chu achunga pat anoi geijin a-ehlha paijin keh ni akison; chule ling akihotnin, songpiho akeh-in ahi.","ref":"Pot 26:31-33."},"52":{"text":"Chule lhankhuh ho akihongin, a-imu mithengho long tamtah kaithouvin aumin ahi;"},"53":{"text":"Chule ama thokit nung chun amaho chu lhankhuh-a konin apotdoh-un, khopi thenga ache lutnun, mi tamtah akimusah uvin ahi."},"54":{"text":"Chuin sepai jalamkai le aumpi Jesu ngah-a pangho chun ling kihot le thilsoh umchanje chu amuvin, akicha lheh jengun, Hichepa hi Pathen Chapa tahbeh mong ahi, ati taovin ahi."},"55":{"text":"Chule Galilee gama kona Jesu nung hinjuija ajenlea pang numei tamtah aumun, amaho chun galkanga pangin ave jingun ahi.","ref":"Luk 8:2-3."},"56":{"text":"Alah uva chun Magdalene Mariam, Jacob le Joses nu Mariam, chule Zebedee chapate ni nu aumun ahi."},"57":{"text":"Chuin nilhah ahi phatnin, Jesu seijuija pang Arimathea kho-a amin Joseph atiu mihaotah khat Pilate henga ahungin, Jesu long chu athumin ahi.","title":"Jesu Avuiju (Mrk 15:42-47 ; Luk 23:50-56 ; Jhn 19:38-42)"},"58":{"text":"Hichun Pilate chun apeh dingin thu apetan ahi."},"59":{"text":"Chuin Joseph chun along chu alan, tupat ponnem ngimseh chan atomin, song alaihom ama lhan thah sunga chun alupsah-in,"},"60":{"text":"Lhan kotna chun song lentah khat atanglutnin, achemang tan ahi."},"61":{"text":"Chule Magdalene Mariam le Mariam chom nu chu hikoma chun aumun, lhan maija chun atou jingun ahi."},"62":{"text":"Ajingin, hichu kigot ni ahin, thempu pipuiho le Pharisai ho Pilate hengah akikhomun,","title":"Lhan Ngah Ho"},"63":{"text":"Ajah-a, Kapu, hiche milhemlhapa chun ahinlaijin, Ni thum joule thoukit ding kahi, ati chu tun kalunguva alange.","ref":"Matt 16:21; 17:23; 20:19; Mrk 8:31; 9:31; 10:33-34; Luk 9:22; 18:31-33"},"64":{"text":"Hijeh chun ni thum geija alhan ngah ding thu pen; ajole jannin aseijuite hunguntin, gumang untin, miho jah-a, Athi lah-a konin athoukit tai tiget nunte; chutile suhkhel masah sanga suhkhel nunung chu setchehna hi ding ahi, atiuvin ahi."},"65":{"text":"Pilate'in ajah uva, Nanghon santri hon khat naneiju chu; cheovinlang nanga thei theijun ganga phatsah taovin, ati."},"66":{"text":"Chuin amaho angah ding santri hon chutoh alhonun, song chunga chun mohor anamun, lhan chu phatah-in angasah taovin ahi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin cholngah ni kichaija Hapta kipat ni masa ni khovah thenthenin, Magdalene Mariam le Mariam chom nu chu lhan ve ding chun ahung lhonin ahi.","title":"Jesu Thodoh (Mrk 16:1-10 ; Luk 24:1-12 ; Jhn 20:1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Chule, veuvin, ling hahon akihot tan ahi; ijeh-inem itile Pakai vantil van'a konin ahung kumlhan, song chu akotna konin atangdoh-in, achungah atouvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Avouso chu kolphetoh abangin, aponsil chu buhbang bangin abangin;"},"4":{"text":"Chule ama akichat jeh-un angah ho akihot akihotnun, athi-a toh abang jengun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahin hiche vantil chun numei ho chu ahin houvin, ajah uva, Nangho kicha hih-un, ijeh-inem itile thingpel'a kithat Jesu chu naholu ahi kahenai."},"6":{"text":"Ama hikoma aumtapoi; ijeh-inem itile aman asei bang chun athoudohtai. Hungun lang Pakai lupna hung vetaovin."},"7":{"text":"Chule nangho cheloijun lang aseijuiteho jah-a hiche hi gaseijun, Ama athi lah-a konin athoudohtai; chule, veuvin, Galilee gam lamah namasanguvah achei; chukoma chu nanghon ama namu dingu ahi, gatiuvin; veuvin, najah uva kaseitai, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin amaho kichat toh gomin hapan akipah-un, lhan phunga kon chun achedoh loijun, aseijuite henga thulhut ding chun alhaijel taovin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin amaho aseijuite seipeh dinga acheule, veuvin, Jesu'n amaho chu akimupin, ajah uva, Damselun, ati. Hichun amahon aheng ajonun, akeng atuh-un chibai abohtauvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hichun Jesu'n ajah uva, Kicha hih-un, cheovin, kasopite jah-a gaseijun, amaho Galilee gam lama cheohen, chukoma chu amahon eimu dingu ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chujouvin amaho acheu chun, santri'a dingho phabep khopi sunga ahungun, thusoh umchan jouse ahung lhutnun ahi.","title":"Lhan Ngahho Thulhut"},"12":{"text":"Chuin amaho upaho toh akikhomun, akihoutoh jouvun, sepaiho chu sum tamtah apeuvin, ajah uva,"},"13":{"text":"Ka-imut kah-un aseijuite ahungun, agumang taove, tiuvin."},"14":{"text":"Hiche thuhi gamvaipon ajah-a ahile, keihon ama hou lungdam ungting, nangho lung olmosah pouvinge, atiuvin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hichun amahon sum chu akilah-un, ahil bangu chun aboltauvin ahi; chule hiche thu chu Juda miho lah-a akiseison sonin tugeijin aumin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chujouvin seijui somlekhat chu Galilee gama Jesu'n atepnao mola chun achetauvun ahi.","title":"Jesu Aseijuite Henga Akilah (Mrk 16:14-18 ; Luk 24:36-49 ; Jhn 20:19-23 ; Sol 1:6-8)","ref":"Matt 26:32; Mrk 14:28."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Ama amu phatnun, chibai aboh-un; ahivangin abang bangin agingcha pouvin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Jesu ahenguva ahungin amaho chu ahoupin, ajah uva, Van'a le leija thuneina jouse keima eikipea ahitai."},"19":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun nangho cheovin, namtina mi jouse seijuijin gasemun, a-Pa, a-Cha chule Lhagao Theng minin amaho chu baptize gabolun;","ref":"Sol 1:8"},"20":{"text":"Chule keiman nangho kapeh thu jouse hi aboncha anit dinguvin gahilun; chule, veuvin vannoi leiset kichaini geijin keiman nangho kaumpi jing naove, ati. Amen."}}}}},"41":{"info":{"name":"Mark","shortname":"Mrk","abbr":[],"desc":"Mark Sut Kipana Thupha"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen Chapa Jesu Christa Kipana Thupha kipatna;","title":"John Baptist le Athupeh thangkou (Matt 3:1-12 ; Luk 3:1-18 ; Jhn 1:19-28)"},"2":{"text":"Themgaoho lekhabua kisun bangin, Ven, keiman kasottol namasang sang-ah kasole; Ama chun nalampi anasem ding ahi;","ref":"Mal 3:1."},"3":{"text":"Gamthipma khosam aw khatnin, Pakai lamlen semtohsan koijun, Alampi semjangun, tia kisun bang chun,","ref":"Isai 40:3."},"4":{"text":"John Baptist chun gamthipmah twi alutsah-in, chonset suhmangna dinga lungheija baptize chan ding thu lhangsamin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Juda gama mi jouse le Jerusalem'a mi jouse ama henga acheuvin, achonsetnu aphongun, Jordan luija ama khutna abonun baptize achang taove."},"6":{"text":"Chule John chu sangongsang mul ponin akivonin, savun konggah-in akong akigeh-in, chule a-anneh chu khaokho le gam khoiju ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 1:8."},"7":{"text":"Chule thu ahil lhanglen, Kanungah keima sanga hat chungnungjo ahunge, keima hi kuna akengchot khao sutlham dinga jong kilom kahipoi."},"8":{"text":"Keiman nangho twija baptize kachansah nahiuvin; amavang Ama chun nangho Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah dingu ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Hilai chun ahitin ahi, Galilee gam sunga Nazareth kho-a konin Jesu ahungin, Jordan luija John khutna baptize achangtan ahi.","title":"Jesu Baptize Chan le Lhep Patepma Aum (Matt 3:13—4:11 ; Luk 3:21-22 ; 4:1-13)"},"10":{"text":"Chuin twi lah-a kona ahungdoh doh-in, van akikehso-a, Lhagao vakhu bang achunga ahung kumlhah amun:"},"11":{"text":"Van'a konin aw khat ahung gingin, Nangma ka-Chapa deitah nahi, nachungah kalung alhai tangeije, ati.","ref":"Semt 22:2; Labu 2:7; Isai 42:1; Matt 3:17; 12:18; Mrk 9:7; Luk 3:22"},"12":{"text":"Chuin Lhagao chun gamthipma apui mang paijin,"},"13":{"text":"Chua chun nisomli Satan lhep patepmin aumin, gamsa lah-a aumin; chuin vantil hon ahung jenleuvin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chujouvin John songkul'a akikhum jouvin, Jesu Galilee gama ahungin, Pathen lenggam Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen,","title":"Jesu'n Ngaman Mi Li Akou (Matt 4:12-22 ; Luk 4:14-15 ; 5:1-11)"},"15":{"text":"Phat alhingtai, chule Pathen lenggam jong anaitai; nalung heijun, Kipana Thupha hi tahsanun tin alhangsamin ahi.","ref":"Matt 3:2"},"16":{"text":"Chuin Galilee dillen pang ajotpa na-a, Simon le asopipa Andrew dillena lensep amun; amani chu ngaman mi ahi lhone."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n amani jah-a chun, Kanung hinjui lhonin; keiman nangni mi man lensep hisah lhoninge, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amanin alen adalha lhonin, anung ajui pai jeng lhontai."},"19":{"text":"Chuin themkhat achechon jeple, Zebedee chapate ni Jacob leh anaopa John amani jong chu kong sunga len anakhui phat pet lhon amun;"},"20":{"text":"Chuin amani chu akou paileuvin ahile, amanin apa lhon Zebedee chu athalah soh ho toh kong sunga chun adalha lhonin, ajui lhontai."},"21":{"text":"Chuin amaho Capernaum'a achelutnun; cholngah nin kikhopna in'ah alutnin, thu ahil paijenin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Thilhavop Mi Khat Adamsah (Luk 4:31-37)"},"22":{"text":"Aman danthu sunho banga hil louva, thuneitah banga ahil jeh-in miho chun athuhil chu kidang asa lheh-un ahi.","ref":"Matt 7:28-29"},"23":{"text":"Chuin akikhopnao in'a chun lhagao boh vop mi khat anaumin, chule ama chun ahinsam paijenin,"},"24":{"text":"Nazareth Jesu, nangle keiho ikimatnao i-um em? Eisumang uva hunga nahim? Nangma koi nahi kahenai, Pathen'a kon Atheng chu nahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n ama chu aphoh-in, Thipmin, ama-a kon chun hung doh-in, ati."},"26":{"text":"Chuin lhagao boh chun mipa chu aheh-in, hapenin apengin, ahung potdoh tai."},"27":{"text":"Chuin mi jousen kidang asan alungdong lheh jengun; chutichun khatle khat akidongun, Hiche hi iti hintem? Hiche hi thuhil thah ahi! Aman thunei tah-in lhagao bohho thu apen, chule amaho jong athun anung jenguve, atiuvin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Galilee gam kimvel chengse-a amin akithang pai jengtan ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chule kikhopna in'a kona ahungdoh doh-in, Simon le Andrew insunga chun Jacob le John toh alut paijun ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Mi Tamtah Adamsah (Matt 8:14-17 ; Luk 4:38-41)"},"30":{"text":"Ahin Simon nupanu chu khosih-in anan analumin; chuin amahon anat thu chu Jesu ahetsah paijun ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chutichun amanu koma chun achen, akhutnin atuh-in, akaithou tai; hichun akhosih chun alha jengin, chuin amanu chu amaho jenlen apangtai."},"32":{"text":"Chuin nilhah ahia, nisa alhum jouvin, mihon ana damlou jouse le thilhavop ho ahin puijun;"},"33":{"text":"Chule khopi sunga mi jouse kotpi phung-ah akikhomun ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Aman hiveichom chom veija damlou mi tamtah adamsah-in, chule thilha tamtahma adeldoh-in; ama Christa ahi chu ahet jeh-un thilhaho chu apao sahpon ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin jing khovah lhah masang peh-in athouvin, apotdoh-in gamthip munah achen, chua chun agataovin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Galilee'a Thupha Alhangsap (Luk 4:42-44)"},"36":{"text":"Chuin Simon le agoldangho chun anung ajuijun,"},"37":{"text":"Amudoh phatnun ajah-a, Mi jouse hinla nang nahol cheh-un, atiuve."},"38":{"text":"Chuin Aman, Naidunga khopi dang danga jong kahil lhangle theina dingin cheohite; hiche dinga chu hung kahi, ati."},"39":{"text":"Chuin ama Galilee gamsese-ah achelen, akikhopnao in tinah thu ahil lhanglen, chule thilha adeldoh peh-in ahi.","ref":"Matt 4:23; 9:35."},"40":{"text":"Chuin miphah khat Jesu henga ahungin, ajah-a, Nalung ahile neidam thengsah thei ahi tin a-angah adilsun ataotan ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Miphah Adamthengsah (Matt 8:1-4 ; Luk 5:12-16)"},"41":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n alungset behseh-in, akhut alhangin, athamin, Kalung ahi; dam thengtan, ati."},"42":{"text":"Chuin hiche thu chu aseijou jouvin, chupettah chun aphah chun adalha paijin, athengsel tai."},"43":{"text":"Chuin Aman amapa chu akhamchah kheh-in, asolmang paijin;"},"44":{"text":"Ajah-a, Ven, koima jah-a sei hihbeh-in, ahin chenlang thempu gakimusah-in, chule nadam theng thu dol chu amaho hettohsahnan Mosi thupehsa thilpeh ding chu gapetan, ati."},"45":{"text":"Ahivangin amapa apotdoh-in, hiche thu chu asamlen, aha phonjal cheh tan; achuti jehchun chukalin Jesu lhangphong in koima khopi sungah alut theita hih-in, gamthip thipma aumjotai: chule muntina konin ahengah miho ahungjiuve."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni chomkhat jouvin Capernaum'a alut kitnin ahile, in'a aume ti akithang soh jengtan ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Langthipa Aboldam (Matt 9:1-8 ; Luk 5:17-28)"},"2":{"text":"Hiche pettah chun mipi tamtah ahung khomun ahile, aumna dingu mun kotphung jeng jong a-ong tapon; aman amaho chu thu ahiltan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin langthi khat mi lin ajongun ahengah ahinpuijui."},"4":{"text":"Chuin mipi jeh-a akom naija ahung lut theilou jeh-un, in chung chu Ama umna dontah aphet vangun, langthipa chu alupna pumin a-ang sungah agah khailha suh-un ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n atahsanjeu chu amun, langthipa jah-a chun, Chapa, nachonset naho kingaidam ahitai, ati."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla danthu sunho phabep khat hia chu tou ahiuvin, alungthim uva,"},"7":{"text":"Hichepa hin ibola Pathen taitom na-a hitobang thu aseiham? Pathen tailou chonset koiham angaidam thei ding? atiuve."},"8":{"text":"Chuin achuti gelu chu Jesu'n alungin ahepai jenin, ajah uva, Ibola nalunguva hicheng chu nagelu ham?"},"9":{"text":"Langthipa jah-a hi, Nachonset naho kingaidama ahitai, kiti le; Thouvin, nalupna kilah-inlang lam jotnin, ti chu hoijoh seibai jo-em?"},"10":{"text":"Hijongle leiset chunga Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna thahat aneije ti nahetna dingun, atin,"},"11":{"text":"Langthipa jah-a, Thouvin, nalupna kilah-in lang na-in'a chetan kati ahi, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin ama chu athoudoh pai jengin, alupna akilah-in, japi mitmutah chun achedohtan; chuphatnin ajapiuvin kidang asa lheh jengun, Hitobang himhim kamukha pouve, atiuvin Pathen avahchoi taove."},"13":{"text":"Chuin apotnin dillen pangah achekit tai; chuin mihonpi chu ahenga acheuvin ahile aman thu ahile.","title":"Jesu'n Levi Akou (Matt 9:9-13 ; Luk 5:27-32)"},"14":{"text":"Chuin achena-a Alphaeus chapa Levi kaidonna mun'a atou amun, ajah-a, Kanung hinjuijin, ati. Chuin ama akipatdoh-in anung ajuitai."},"15":{"text":"Chuti chun Levi in'a ankong aumpet chun, kaidongho le michonseho tamtah-in Jesu le aseijuiteho chengse chutoh ankong aum khomun ahi. Ijeh-inem itile amaho tamtah ahiuvin, ama nungjui cheh ahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Pharisai ho le danthusun hon michonseho le kaidongho toh an aneh khom chu amu phatnun, aseijuite jah-a, Iti dana kaidongho le michonseho toh an aneh khomham? atiuvin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hichu Jesu'n ajah phatnin, ajah uva, atidamten louthem angaipouve, adamlouten bou angaijui; michonpha te kou-a hung kahipoi; lungheidia michonse te kou-a hungjoh kahibouve, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chule John seijuite le Pharisai hon an angoljiu ahin; amaho ahungun Jesu jah-a, I-atile John seijuite le Pharisai hon an angol jiuva, nangma seijuiten an angolji louham? atiuve.","title":"An Ngol Thudola Thudoh (Matt 9:14-17 ; Luk 5:33-39)"},"19":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n amaho jah-a, Aloite chu moulang chun aumpi laise-a an angol thei ngaijum? Moulang chun aumpi laiseuva an angol thei louvu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Amavang moulang chu akomuva kona kipuimang ni hung lhung ding ahi, chuche nile an angol dingu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Koiman pon sopnem loulai halin ponlui abeh ngaipoi; chuti bolle athahjoh chun alui chu akaiset ding, akehlai chu kehcheh joding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule koiman lengpitwi thah savun peng luija akhum ngaipoi; ichuti bolle alengpitwi chun asavun peng chu tumkeh intin, lengpitwi savun peng akopma mang ding ahi. Lengpitwi thah chu peng thah-a akhumji bouvui, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, cholngah nin Jesu'n changlei lai ajotnin ahile, aseijuiten ache pumun changvui chu asih pantaovin ahi.","title":"Cholngah Ni Nit Dola Thudoh (Matt 12:1-8 ; Luk 6:1-5)","ref":"Danb 23:25."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Pharisai hon ajah-a, Vetan, ibola cholngah ni-a bol ngailou aboluham? atiuvin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin, David le aloiho alhahsamuva, agilkel petnuva chu ipi abolu nasimkhah louvu ham?","ref":"1 Sam 21:1-6."},"26":{"text":"Abiathar thempu chungnung ahi laijin Pathen in'a alutnin, thempu tailou adangin aneh ngailou vetsahna changlhah chu anen, aloiho jong apen ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 24:9"},"27":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Cholngah ni chu mihem dinga kisem ahi, cholngah ni dinga mihem kisemjoh ahipoi."},"28":{"text":"Chuti chu ahin Mihem Chapa chu cholngah ni Pakai jong ahi, ati."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin kikhopna in'a alut kitnin ahile, chuachun mi khutlang ngoi khat aumin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Khut Langthipa Adamsah (Matt 12:9-14 ; Luk 6:6-11)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin ama chu ahehset theina dingun, cholngah ni-a aboldame aboldam hih-em, tin achang lhiuvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Aman khutlang ngoipa jah-a chun, Alaija hung dingdoh-in, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin ajah uva, Cholngah ni-a apha bol angaiha, ase bol angaiham? Lhagao huhhing angaiha, suhmang angaiham? atin ahile, amaho athip chetchut jengun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Aman alungtah jeh-u chun alungphamon, lungsatenin amaho chu ave kimvelin, chuin mipa jah-a chun, Nakhut lhangin, ati. Chuin alhangin ahile, akhut chu alangkhat bangin adamtan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Pharisai ho chu apotdoh-un, amachu iti suhmang dingham ngaiton, Herod miho chutoh akihoutoh paitaove."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Jesu aseijuite toh dillen lama chun achetauve. Chule mipi tamtah-in ajuijin, Galilee gama kon, Juda gama kon,","title":"Dillen Panga Mipi ho"},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem khopi-a kon, Idumia gama kon, Jordan gala kon, Tyre le Sidon gam kimvela kon chule mihonpi tamtah ahiuvin, athilbol loupitah ho ajah phatnun, ahengah ahungun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Mipi jeh chun kongneo gotsa koijin aseijuite asolin, achuti loule eineh khauvinte, ati.","ref":"Mrk 4:1; Luk 5:1-3"},"10":{"text":"Mi tamtah adamsah ahitah jeh chun, natna nei jousen ama atohkhah theina dingun Ama aumchah jengun;"},"11":{"text":"Lhagao boh chengse jong chun ama amuchanun a-angah aboh khupmun, Nang Pathen Chapa chu nahi, tin asamjiuvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahin Aman ama chu aphondoh louna dingun amaho chu akhamchah-in ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin mol chunga akaltouvin, aman angaichat chengse chu akouvin, amaho ahenga ahungun ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Solchah Somleni Alhen (Matt 10:1-4 ; Luk 6:12-16)"},"14":{"text":"Chuin akoma um dingle, thuhil lhangle-a asol dingin, somleni alheng doh-in,"},"15":{"text":"Damlou ho damsah theina thahat neidingle, thilhaho nodoh theina thunei dingin:"},"16":{"text":"Simon aman Peter asah-in;"},"17":{"text":"Zebedee chapa Jacob, chule anaopa John, amani chu amin Boanerges asah-in; hichu van gin chate, tina ahi;"},"18":{"text":"Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, Alphaeus chapa Jacob, Thaddaeus, Canaan mi Simon,"},"19":{"text":"Chule Ama matsah-a pang Judas Iscariot ahiuve. Chuin amaho insunga alut taovin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin mihonpi ahung kikhom kit taovin ahile, an tahbah jong anethei tapouvin ahi.","title":"Jesu Le Beelzebul (Matt 12:22-32 ; Luk 11:14-23 ; 12:10)"},"21":{"text":"Hichu a-inkoten ajahdoh phatnun, angola hitakhu atiuvin, ahung konun thahatsana mat dingin ahung gouvin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule Jerusalem'a kona hungsuh danthu sunho jong chun, Beelzabul vop ahi, chule thilha anodoh jong hi thilhaho lengpa vanga anodoh hija hi, atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Matt 9:34; 10:25."},"23":{"text":"Chuin Aman amaho chu akouvin, thulemin aseijin ajah uva, Satan'in Satan iti anodoh thei dingham?"},"24":{"text":"Gamsung khat amale ama kidouto hen kikhenle, hiche gam chu dingdoh thei louding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Insung khat amale ama kidouto henlang hileh, hite insung chu dingdoh thei pouvinte."},"26":{"text":"Satan jong amale ama kidouto henlang kisep khenle, dingdoh thei louva mangthahjo ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Koiman mihat chu kanchom masa louvin, a-in'a alutnin athilkeu achompeh theipoi; akanchom masatna chutengle achom dingbou ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Mihem chate hi achonsetnao itobang hijongle, Pathen ataitom nao hijongle, taitomna jouseu chu kingaidam ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Amavang koi hileh Lhagao Theng taitom vang chun imatih chana ngaidam amulou ding; tonsot themo channa-a chua ahitai, ati.","ref":"Luk 12:10"},"30":{"text":"Lhagao boh vop ahi, ati jeh uva chutia chu asei ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin anu le asopite ahungun, inpoa adingun, ama kouvin mi asolun ahi.","title":"Jesu Nu le Asopiho (Matt 12:46-50 ; Luk 8:19-21)"},"32":{"text":"Chule avela chu mihonpi touchah khet ahin, amahon ajah-a chun, Ven, inpoa khun nanu le nasopiten nahol uve atiuve."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah uva, Kanu le kasopite koi koi hiuvem? tin adonbutne."},"34":{"text":"Chuin akimvela touho chu ave golin, Hiteho hi kanu le kasopite ahiuve."},"35":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lunglama chonpatah chu kasopipa le kasopinu chule kanu ahi, ati."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin dillen pangah thu ahilpan kittan ahile mihon tamtah akomah ahung kikhomun, chuin dillen chunga kong-ah alutnin atouvin; chule mipi chengse chu vapamah tolah aumuvin ahi.","title":"Muchi Thepa Thulem (Matt 13:1-9 ; Luk 8:4-8)","ref":"Luk 5:1-3."},"2":{"text":"Chule amaho chu thulemin thu tamtah ahilin, athuhil lah-a chun aseije,"},"3":{"text":"Ngaijun, muchi thepa muchi then achen:"},"4":{"text":"chuin ahitin ahi, athe atheleh abang lamsih-a achun, chunga leng vachaten ahung lohgam taove."},"5":{"text":"Chule abang songlheo chunga leipatna-ah achun, alei asalou jeh-in akehdoh pai jengin:"},"6":{"text":"Ahivangin nisa ahung soh-in ahile asanggon, jung anei lou jeh-in, agoptan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule abang ling lah-a achun, aling chu ahung khangin adeplihtan, aga himhim aumtapoi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin adangho chu leipha laijah achun, akehdoh-in ahung khangin chule agatan; abang somthum cheng, abang somgup cheng, abang ja khat cheng apungtan ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah uva, Angaina ding na neijan ngaihen, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin achanga aum petnin, akimvela umho le somleni chun athulem seiho chu adongun ahi.","title":"Thulem Kiseilo (Matt 13:10-17 ; Luk 8:9-10)"},"11":{"text":"Chuin Aman amaho jah-a, Pathen lenggam thuguh chu nangho kipe-a nahitaove; polama um mite jah dinga vang ijakai thulema kisei ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chutia chu amahon muvang chu amudingu, ahetdoh lou dingu, jah vang chu ajah dingu, ahetkhen lou dingu ahi; achuti loule hung kihei kitnuntin, chule achonsetnao ngaidamin umgetninte, ati.","ref":"Isai 6:9-10"},"13":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah uva, Nanghon hiche thulem hi nahet lou mongu ham? Achutile thulem dang jouse iti nahet dinguham?","title":"Jesu'n Muchi Thepa Thulem Ahilchet (Matt 13:18-23 ; Luk 8:11-15)"},"14":{"text":"Muchi thepa chun thu athe ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule hicheho hi thu kithena lamsih-a chuho chu ahi; amahon thu ajah jah-un, Satan ahung paijin, alung sunguva thu kithe chu alah mang peh tan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chutobangma chun songlheo chung leipatna-a chua chu hicheho hi ahi; amaho chu thu ajah jah-a thanom tah-a joppai jengho hi ahi;"},"17":{"text":"Ahivangin amaho chu jung nei lou ahiuvin, chomcha khat aumjiuvin ahi: chujoule thu jeh-a hesohna ahiloule bolsetna ahung umtengle, alhupaiji taove."},"18":{"text":"Chule hicheho hi linglah-a muchi kithe ho chu ahiuve; amaho chun thu ajauvin,"},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin leiset hinkho lungkhamna, lheplhahna dimset haosatna, chule ngaichatna dangdang alutnin, hichun thu chu adeplih jin, ga louvin aumjitai."},"20":{"text":"Chule lei pha laija chua chu; athu ja-a, jopteho chu ahiuvin, abang ajat som thumin, abang ajat som gupmin, chule abang ajat ja-in agapungin ahi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah uva, meivah khu lo noi, ahiloule jalkhun noija tun dinga kihinchoi ngaijem? Akhom chunga tunding chu angaina hilouham?","title":"Meivah Lo kikhukhum (Luk 8:16-18)","ref":"Matt 5:15; Luk 11:33."},"22":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile kiphong lou ding imacha ki-ima aumpoi; kilangdoh lou ding imacha akiselguh aumpoi.","ref":"Matt 10:26; Luk 12:2"},"23":{"text":"Koi hileh angaina ding na neijan ngaihen, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin ajah uva, Najah chengseu hi ipiham, kichihtheijun. Nanghon natebang banguva nangho jong kitepeh ding nahiuve; chule nangho aja chengse hi kipehbe dingbon nahiuve.","ref":"Matt 7:2; Luk 6:38."},"25":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile aneija chu kipehbentin; chule anei louva chu aneichasun jong chu ama-a kona kilahpeh ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 13:12; 25:29; Luk 19:26"},"26":{"text":"Aman ajah uva, Pathen gam umchan chu, mikhatnin amuchi leija athe-a:","title":"Muchi Khangdoh Thulem"},"27":{"text":"Amachu sunteng imuji, janteng thouji, muchi chu hung kehdoh-a hung khangdoh, amatah-inla ajeh ahetlou tobang chu ahi"},"28":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile leisetnin achamin ama-a konin ahin ga sahjin, amasan akung, abanle ado, chujoule avui, chujou kitle avuija aga achanglhing jitai."},"29":{"text":"Ahin aga chu amin phatle, a-at phat ahitah jeh-in, aman koiten a-atpan jitai, ati.","ref":"Joel 3:13"},"30":{"text":"Chuin hitin asei kitne, Pathen gam hi ipitoh kitekah ding hitam? ahiloule ipi thulema kisei ding hitam?","title":"Ankam Mu Thulem (Matt 13:31-32 , 34 ; Luk 13:18-19)"},"31":{"text":"Ankam mu chang khat tobang ahi, hichu leija akithe-a ahile, vannoi leisetna muchi jouse lah-a aneopen ahin;"},"32":{"text":"Ahivangin akithe joule ahung kedoh-a, hung khanga, hampa dang jouse sanga hung lenjo; abah len tahtah hinso-a, chutia chu chunga leng vachate aboh lim noija age theiju tobang ahi, ati."},"33":{"text":"Chuin chutobang thulem tamtah-in amahon ahetthei kham khamun thu ahilin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chule thulem louvin ajah uva imacha aseikhapoi: ahin aseijuite chengse vang chu achanguva aumtengule ijakai ahilchen jin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin nilhah-in Aman amaho jah-a, Agal lang khatna galkaiju hite, ati.","title":"Jesu'n Twipi Kinonglai Aphothip (Matt 8:23-27 ; Luk 8:22-25)"},"36":{"text":"Chutichun mihonpi chu asoldoh jouvun, ama aum bang bang chun kong'a akitolpi taovin, kong dang dangto jong alhonun ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chuin khopihui ahung nungin ahile, twikinong chu kong sunga ahung kinong lut matchet jengtan, chuti ahi jeh chun kong chu dimpai ding ahitan ahi."},"38":{"text":"Amala kong mei lamah lukhap akhapmin a-imun ahi: chuin asukhangun, ajah-a, Rabbi, kathigam dingu hi na ima lou louham? atiuvin ahi."},"39":{"text":"Akhah phatnin huipi chu aphoh-in, dillen jah-a, Umthimin, thipbeh chan umin, ati. Chuin hui chu ahaijin, athip heltai."},"40":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah uva, Ibola chuti kichat nahiuvem? Iti dana tahsanna himhim nanei louvu ham? ati."},"41":{"text":"Chuphatnin Ama chu kichat mainan akichata pouvin, Hichepa hi itobang mi hija, huipi leh dillen kinong sanin athu angaiham? tin akihouchut chut taovin ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chutichun dillen gal langkhat agalkaijun, Garesene miho gama alhung taovin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Lhagaoboh Voppa Aboldam (Matt 8:28-34 ; Luk 8:26-39)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin kong'a kona apotdoh doh-in, lhan lah-a kona hung lhagaoboh vop mikhatnin atoh paijenin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ama chu lhan lah jenga chu cheng ahin, koimachan thihkhaova jong akan joulou ahi;"},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu bul atuh jiuva, thihkhao vajong akanjiu ahin; ahivanga thihkhao chu asat tanjin, bul chu atumkehjin, koimachan abol ngoi jou louhel ahitai."},"5":{"text":"Chule sunle jan-in lhan lah le molchunga aumjin, chule a-aole a-ao lejin, songin ama le ama aki-at chenjin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahin gamlatah-a kona Jesu ahinmu phatnin, ahung lhaijelin a-anga aboh khupmin chibai aboh-in;"},"7":{"text":"Chuin hatah-in asamin, Pathen chungnung pen Chapa Jesu, nangle kei ipi ikimatna umam? Pathen mina nahenga katao ahi, neibolgim hih-in; ati."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu Aman ajah-a, Nangma lhagao boh, hiche mipa-a kon chun hung potdoh-in, ati ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Aman, Namin ipiham? tin adonge. Chuin aman, Tamtah kahi jeh-un kamin Janel ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin chuche gamkai sunga kona asoldoh louna dingun Jesu hengah hataovin ataotan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tun akoma molsang panga chu vohcha hon tamtah lha-a ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin lhagaoboh jouse chu ahenga ataovun, Vohcha hon lah-a kalut theina dingun neisolun, ati taove."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n phalna apetai. Chuin lhagao bohho chu apotdoh-un, vohchaho sunga chun alut taovin ahile, vohcha hon chu halhaijin alhaijun, kola alhai lhauvin, dillena chun alhalutnun, (voh honho chu sangni tobang hiuva ahin,) athigam taovin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin vohcha chingho chu ajamun, khopi sung le loujaovah agaseile taovin ahi. Chuin Ipi iti hitam, tia ve dingin ahungun ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin Jesu kom ahung lhunun, thilha janel voppa chun pon akisila chule lung lima anatou chu amuvin, akicha lheh jengun ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin thilha voppa le vohchaho umchan achen achaija mu-a hetohhon ajah uva aseijun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hichun amahon agam sunguva kona potdoh dingin ahenga atao pantaovin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin kong'a alut phatnin, masanga thilha voppa chun amatoh thakhatna umna dingin ataotai."},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin Jesu'n ajahdan, ajah-a, Na-in'a chenlang na-in kote hengah Pakaiyin itobang thil loupi nabolpeh-a, iti nakhoto hitam abonchan gaseitan, atijotai."},"20":{"text":"Chuin akipat doh-in, Decapolis kho jouse-a Jesu'n thil lentah abolpeh chu lhang phongtah-in asamle pantai; chuin mi jousen kidang asa lheh jengun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin Jesu kong'a akitola agal lang khat pang akaidoh-in, mihon tamtah ahung kikhomum; ama dillen pangah aumin ahi.","title":"Jairus Chanu Le Jesu Ponmong Thamkhanu (Matt 9:18-26 ; Luk 8:40-56)"},"22":{"text":"Chuin kikhopna in'a vaipoho lah-a mi khat amin Jairus chu ahungin, Jesu amu phatnin akhomuh-ah aboh khupmin;"},"23":{"text":"Chule ajah-a, Kachanu chapang neocha khat thi dingin alume; katao ahi, adamdoh nadingin hungin lang achunga nakhut hung ngamin tia katao ahi, tin hangeh-in angehtan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Jesu ama chutoh alhonin achetai, chule mihonpi nasatah-in ajuijun atom lellul jengun ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin numei khat kum somle kum ni athi longa damlou ahin,"},"26":{"text":"Louthem tamtah-a kona thohgimna tamtah anatoh-a, anei jouse asuhmang ahitan, imala aphachom pon, ahin akhohcheh cheh jon ahi."},"27":{"text":"Amanun Jesu thudol ajah phatnin, anunga mihonpi lah-a chun ahungin, apon chu athamtan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Amanu chun, Apon jeng jong hi thamleng kadam ding ahi, ati ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin chupetah chun athiput chu akangin atangtan; chule amanun kanat thoh lela konin kadamtai ti chu ati chunga akihet tan ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chupettah chun Jesu'n ati chunga kona thilboltheina apot chu ahen, mipi lah-a chun akihei kimvelin, Kapon thama chu koiham? atin adong tan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin aseijuite chun ajah-a, Mipi hijatnin naneh chinto mu jinga, iti dana Koiham eithama, natiham? atiuve."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Aman chuche bola chu muleng tin avelelen ahi."},"33":{"text":"Ahin amanu chun achunga thilsoh chu ahen, akichasasan akihot pumpumin ahungin, a-angah aboh khupmin, ajah-a thutah jouse chu aseidoh tan ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah-a, Chanu, natahsanin nadamsah ahitai, lung mongin chenlang nanatna-a kon chun damtan, ati."},"35":{"text":"Aman hiche thu chu aseina laijin, kikhopna in vaihompa in'a kon chun mi ahungun, ajah-a, Nachanu athitai; ibola houhil hi nacholsah nahlai dingham? ahung ti."},"36":{"text":"Jesu'n thukisei chu ajah jah-in, kikhopna in vaihompa jah-a chun, kicha hih-in, tahsana bou neijin, ati."},"37":{"text":"Chuin Peter, Jacob, chule Jacob naopa John hicheng tailou chu, midang koiman ajui ding aphalpon ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chuin kikhopna in vaihompa in'a chun ahungun ahile, anaboi cheichoi jengu le mihonpi aka le maovu chu amun ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chuin Ama insunga alutnin, ajah uva, Ibola poh cheichoi nahiuva chule kapma nahiuvem? Chapangnu chu athi ahipoi, a-imu ahibouve, ati."},"40":{"text":"Chuin amahon anuisat taovin ahi. Ahivangin abonchauvin anodohsoh-in, chapangnu nule pa toh, chule ama hinkilhonpi chengse toh, chapangnu umna-a chun alutnun ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chuin Aman chapangnu khut chu atuh-in, ajah-a, Talitha cumi, ati: hichu, boinu thouvin tina ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chupettah chun chapangnu chu ahung thouvin, adingin lam ajotpai jengin ahi; ajehchu amanu chu kum somle kum ni hia ahitai. Chutah chun amaho chun kidang mainan kidang asapouve."},"43":{"text":"Ahin Aman hiche thuhi koima hetsah hih-un tin thupeh khaotah aneijin; chule amanu chu neh ding an apehna diuvin thu apen ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin chua konin achedoh-in, Ama gam lamah ahungin; chule aseijuiten ajuijun ahi.","title":"Nazareth Kho-a Jesu Asanlouvu (Matt 13:53-58 ; Luk 4:16-30)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin cholngah ni ahung hi phatnin, kikhopna in'a thu ahil pantan ahi. Chuin athuhil chu mi tamtah ajaho chun kidang asauvin, Hichepa hin hoija kona hichengpi hi akilah hingana? Ama kipe-a chihna hi ipi chihna hija, akhutnin hitobang bolmo kidang dang abol jeng hitam?"},"3":{"text":"Ama hi thingthem bol Jacob, Joses, Juda chule Simon sopi, Mariam chapa chu hilou ham? Asopinute jong hikoma ilah uva um hilou hiuvam? atiuvin, chule achunga alung himo taovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Themgao ama gamsungle ama inkote lah, chule ama insung tailouvah jabol louvin aum ngaipoi, ati.","ref":"Jhn 4:44."},"5":{"text":"Chukoma chun ana adamlou phabep khat chunga akhut angapma adamsah tailou chu, thil kidang imacha abol tapoi."},"6":{"text":"Chule atahsan lou jeh-u chun adatmo lheh jengin ahi. Chuin khonainai dunga ache lelen thu ahil leletai."},"7":{"text":"Chuin somleni ho chu akouvin, mini nin asoldoh-in; chule lhagaoboh chunga thuneina apen;","title":"Jesu'n Seijui Somleni Asoldoh (Matt 10:5-15 ; Luk 9:1-6)"},"8":{"text":"Chule ajin naova dingin tenggol tailou ima, changlhah jong, sakhao jong, dangka dip sunga jong sumthem aken louhel dingun thu apen;","ref":"Luk 10:4-11"},"9":{"text":"Kengchot vang kiseuvin; sangkhol thoni ki-ah hih-un, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin ajah uva, Hoikom hijongle nalhun lhunnau in'a chun, chua kona napotdoh kahseuvin umun."},"11":{"text":"Chule koi hile nalhunsah louvu le nathu seiju ngailou chu, chuche-a kona napotdoh tengule ahettohsah nan nakeng phanguva leivui sanin thinglhau vin. Keiman nangho jah-a tahbeh-a kasei ahi, thupi kitan nile chuche kho thohding sanga chu Sodom le Gomorrah gam thohding chu baijo ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Sol 13:51"},"12":{"text":"Chutichun akipat doh-un, mihem ten lung ahei nadiuvin ahil lhangle uvin;"},"13":{"text":"Thilha tamtah anodoh-un, ana damlou tamtah thao anuvin, aboldamun ahi.","ref":"Jac 5:14"},"14":{"text":"Chuin Herod lengpan athu chu ajatan, (Ijeh inem itile athu chu gamtina kithanga ahitai.) Chuin aman, John Baptist athia kona thoudoh kit ahi, chuche jeh-a chu chuti thil kidang boltheina chu ama-a uma abol ahi, ati.","title":"John Baptist Thi (Matt 14:1-12 ; Luk 9:7-9)","ref":"Matt 16:14; Mrk 8:28; Luk 9:19."},"15":{"text":"Akim khatnin, Elijah ahi, atiuvin; adangin, ama hi themgao khat, ahiloule, Themgaoho lah-a khat ahi, atiuve."},"16":{"text":"Herod vang chun chuche thu chu ajah phatnin, Alol katansa John ngei chu ahi: ama athi lah-a kona thou kit ahi, ati."},"17":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Herod'in asopipa Philip jinu Herodias chu akichenpi ahin; amanu jala chu amatah-in mi asola John chu amatsah-a, akana songkul'a akhum ahi.","ref":"Luk 3:19-20"},"18":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile John'in Herod jah-a, Nasopipa jinu ji-a naneija nakichenpi hi dan ngai ahipoi, ati jeh ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuche jeh-a chu Herodias chun ama chu hahot tah-a ahotna, tha ding atup ahin; ahivanginla abol theipon ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Herod chun John chu michondih tah le mithengtah ahi ti chu ahen, akichan, avenbit ahi; chule athuhil ajah teng alung dongjin, hinlah kipahtah-in angaijin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin nikho agomkom cha khat ahung umin, Herod'in apen nikho ahung hi phatnin agam vaihomte, sepai lamkaite, chule Galilee gama milen milal chengse vahnan golvah abolin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Herodias chanutah chu ahung lutnin alamin ahile, Herod le atoukhompi chengse chu alung lhaisah sohtan ahi; chuphatnin lengpan nungahnu jah-a chun, Nagotchan kahengah thumin peng kate, atitai."},"23":{"text":"Chuin akihahselin, Nathum chan kagamsung kehkhat geijin peng kate, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin amanu apotdoh-in anu agadongin, Ipipen kathum dingham? ati. Anun ajah-a, John Baptist luchang thumin, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuphatnin amanu mangang tah-in lengpa hengah ahungloijin, John Baptist luchang tutah-in kong khatnin neipele chun kati, tin athumtai."},"26":{"text":"Chuin lengpa alunggimta lheh jengin, ahivanginla athuteple akihahselna, chule a-ankong umpiho jal chun amanu athutepsa chu asukeh nom pon ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chupettah chun lengpa chun ama ngah sepai khat John luchang la dingin asoltai. Chuin ama achen, songkul sunga alol agatan dentan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin aluchang chu kong khatnin ahindomin nungahnu chu apen, amanun anu agapetai."},"29":{"text":"Chuin aseijuiten ajah phatnun, ahungun along chu ahung lauvin, lhana avuitaove."},"30":{"text":"Chuin solchah ho Jesu henga ahung kikhomun, athilbol jouseule ami hilu umchan jouse aseijun ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Mi Sangnga Avahva (Matt 14:13-21 ; Luk 9:10-17 ; Jhn 6:1-14)"},"31":{"text":"Chuin Aman ajah uva, Nangho chang hungdoh-unlang, munthip mah chomkhat hung kicholngah-un, ati; ijeh-inem itile ahungleh achele mi atambehseh jengin, an nehna ding jeng jong ong man lou ahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Chuin amaho kongin akitolun, gamthipma achomin achedoh taovin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule mipichun acheu chu amun, tamtah-in Ama chu aheuvin, khopi ho-a kon chun kengin ahung lhaijun, akhelpauvin, chule ahenga ahung kikhomun ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Jesu ahung potdohle mipi tamtah amun, achingbei kelngoi hontoh abah jeh-u chun alung asen, amaho chu thu tamtah ahil pantan ahi.","ref":"Minb 27:17; 1 Leng 22:17; 2 Thusm 18:16; Ezek 34:5; Matt 9:36"},"35":{"text":"Hichun nilhangkai lam ahitan ahile, aseijuite chu ahungun ahengah, hikom hi gamthip ahin, khomala agei lhehtan ahi;"},"36":{"text":"Hiteho hi ikimvel uva loujao le kho ho-a acheuva neh ding imathem agakichoh theina dingun soltan, ajehchu amahon nehding imacha aneitapouve, atiuvin ahi."},"37":{"text":"Ahin Aman adonbutnin amaho jah-a, Nanghon neh ding peuvin, ati. Amahon ama jah-a, Kacheuva changlhah dangka jakhat man kagachoh uva kapeh dinguham? atiuve."},"38":{"text":"Aman ajah uva, Changlhah pheng ijat naneijum? gave temun, ati.
