chuin achung changa chonna dan ngaija bol dinga anule apan naosen Jesu chu apui phatnun,"},"28":{"text":"Amapan naosen chu akhutnin alan, chule Pathen avahchoijin,"},"29":{"text":"Pakai, tun nangma thu dungjuija Nasoh hi lungmonga neilhahdoh ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile nami huhhingna kamit nin amutai,"},"31":{"text":"Miho jouse mitmu-a Nangman nagot"},"32":{"text":"Chidang namdangte henga vah kilangdoh dingle, Nami Israelte loupina ding chu, ati.","ref":"Isai 42:6; 49:6; 52:10."},"33":{"text":"Chuin naosen umchan ding thudol kisei chu anu le Joseph'in kidang asa lheh lhonin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin Simeon chun phatthei achunguva aboh-in, anu Mariam jah-a, Ven, hiche chapang hi Israelte lah-a mi tamtah lhuhna le dindohna hung hiding, chule seiset kihetna melchih na-a kitung ahi."},"35":{"text":"Henge, mi tamtah lunggel kiphon dohna dinga, nangma lung jong chemjamin asutpai ding ahi, ati."},"36":{"text":"Chule Asher phung mi Phanuel chanu Hanna kiti themgao numei khat aumin, amanu chu hatah-a teh ahitan, anungah jineija patna ajitoh kum sagi chengkhom ahin,"},"37":{"text":"Chule amanu chu kum somget le kumli geija meithaija uma ahin, amanu chu houin'a kona potdoh louhela, an ngol le taona puma Pathen houva asun ajana um ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chuin hiche nidan tah chun ahungin Pathen athangvah-in, Jerusalem lhatdoh ding kat jinga umteho jouse jah-a chun Jesu umchan thu aseijin ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chuin Pakai danthu dungjuija thil abol chaisoh phatnun, Galilee gama akhopiu Nazareth kho-a akilekit taovin ahi.","title":"Nazareth'a Ahung Kile","ref":"Matt 2:23."},"40":{"text":"Chuin chapang chu akhangin, chule lhagaovin ahatdoh-in, chihna adimset tan; chule Pathen lungsetna achunga aumtan ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chuin anule apa chu kumseh-in kalchuh kut tengle Jerusalem'a acheji lhonin ahi.","title":"Houin'a Chapang Jesu","ref":"Pot 12:1-27; Danb 16:1-8."},"42":{"text":"Chuin ama kum somle kum ni ahi-in, kalchuh kut chonna ngaijin Jerusalem'a achetouvun;"},"43":{"text":"Chuin kut achaijuva akile kit phatnun chapang Jesu anunguvah Jerusalem'ah aumdentan; chule hichu anule Joseph'in ahelhon hih-in;"},"44":{"text":"Mihon lah-a chu uma ahi tin angaito lhonin, ni khat lam achetauvin; chuin amanin a-inkoteho le akihetpiho lah ahol lhonin ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chuin amudoh lhonlou phatnin, Jerusalem lamah akile kit lhonin, aholpeh lhontan ahi."},"46":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, ni thum jouvin ama chu houin sungah agamudoh lhonin, houhil ho lah-a anatouvin, thu anangaijin dong jong ana dongin;"},"47":{"text":"Chule athu jachan chun ahetjele athu donbut chu kidang asa lheh jengun ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chuin amu phat lhonin alungdongleu lhonin; chuin anun ajah-a, Chapa, ibola neihiti bol lhonham? Vetan napale keiman lungdong tah-in kahol lhone, ati."},"49":{"text":"Chuin aman amani jah-a, Ibola neihol lhonham? Keima ka-Pa in'a akin bola umding mong kahi helhon lou nahim? ati."},"50":{"text":"Ahin ajah uva athusei chu amahon ipi kiseina ham ahepouvin ahi."},"51":{"text":"Chuin amanitoh alhonin, Nazareth kho-ah achesuh-un; athu thu lhonin anungin; chule anun hicheng thu kisei jouse chu alungin achingtan ahi."},"52":{"text":"Chuin Jesu chihna le tahsa-a akhangtou touvin; chule Pathen le mihem deisah-in aumtan ahi.","ref":"1 Sam 2:26; Thuch 3:4"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Tiberius Caesar lengchan kal kum somle ngana-in, Pontius Pilate Juda gamvaipo ahia, chule Herod Galilee gam vaipo ahia, asopipa Philip Ituria le Trachonitis gamkai vaipo ahia, chule Lysanias Abilene gam vaipo ahi lai,","title":"John Baptist Thu Lhangsap (Matt 3:1-12 ; Mrk 1:1-8 ; Jhn 1:19-28)"},"2":{"text":"Anna le Caiaphas thempulen ahilhon laijin, Pathen thu chu gamthipma Zachariah chapa John hengah ahung lhungtan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin ama chu Jordan luipang jui kimvela gam jouse-a ahungin, chonset suhbeina dinga lungheija baptize chan thu alhangsam len;"},"4":{"text":"Isaiah themgao lekhabua kisunbang chun, Gamthipma khosam aw khatnin, Pakai lamlen semtohsan koijun, alampi semjangun.","ref":"Isai 40:3-5."},"5":{"text":"Damkom chengse kidip chama, molsang jousele lhang jouse kisunem ding; chule lamkon chu kisujanga, aphon nachu kisunam ding;"},"6":{"text":"Chule mi jousen Pathen mi huhhingna amu ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hiti chun aman, ama khutna baptize chang dinga ahenga hunga mihonpi jah-a chun, Vo gulse sonho, khonunga lunghan hung lhung dinga kona jam ding lungthim koiham napeuvah?","ref":"Matt 12:34; 23:33."},"8":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun lungheitoh kilomin gadoh-un; chule nalah uva, Abraham kapu luiju aumnai titahih-un; ijeh-inem itile kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen'in hiche songho-a kona hi Abraham son asodoh sah thei ahi.","ref":"Jhn 8:33"},"9":{"text":"Chule tu jeng jongin thing bultinah heicha kikoija ahitai; chutiachu thingphung aga phalou chengse chu kiphuh lhu-a, meija kisep lutji ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin mihonpi chun, Achutile keihon ipi kabol dinguham? tin ama adongui."},"11":{"text":"Chuin aman adonbutnin, amaho jah-a, Sangkhol ni neijan anei louva chu kihoppi hen; chule anneh neijan jong chutima chun bolhen, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin kaidongho jong chu baptize chang dingin ahenga ahungun ajah-a, Mihil, keihonla ipi kabol dinguham? atiuve.","ref":"Luk 7:29."},"13":{"text":"Aman amaho jah-a, Nanghon nakiteppeh kalvalun mi-a lahbe hih-un, ati."},"14":{"text":"Sepaiho injong adongun, Keihon jong ipi kabol dinguham? atiuvin. Aman amaho jah-a, Alam louvin koimacha acham louvin lahpeh hih-un; jouvin jong mi heh hih-un; chule nalo jat jat uvah lung lhaijun."},"15":{"text":"Chuin mihon agaldot jingu ahito lhona, Hiche John hi Christa ahi khat tadem, tia lungthima angaito laitah-un,"},"16":{"text":"John'in adonbutnin, abonchauva jah-a, Keima vangin twija baptize kachansah nahiuve; ahivangin keima sanga hat chungnungjo ahunge, keima akeng chot khao sutlham dinga jong kilom kahipoi; amatah chun nangho Lhagao Thenga le meija baptize nachansah dingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Aman akhutna godal akichoijin, aphol ajapngim sela, chule achang pang sunga akhum ding; asi vang chu mit theilou meija agovam ding ahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Hiti chun aman tilkhouna thudang tamtah aseijin, amaho jah-a chun Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ahin John'in Herod lengpa chu asopipa Philip inneipi Herodia jal leh athilbol phalouho jala apho jeh-in,","ref":"Matt 14:3-4; Mrk 6:17-18"},"20":{"text":"John chu songkul'a akhumin, chonset chunga chonset abolbetai."},"21":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, miho jouse baptize achanuva, Jesu jong baptize achan jouvin, ataovin ahile van akihongin,","title":"Jesu Baptize Chan (Matt 3:13-17 ; Mrk 1:9-11)"},"22":{"text":"Chule Lhagao Theng tahsa vouvin vakhu bangin ahung kumlhan achunga achun, chule van'a konin aw ahung gingin, Nangma ka-Chapa deitah nahi; nachungah kalung alhai tangeije, ati.","ref":"Semt 22:1; Labu 2:7; Isai 42:1; Matt 3:17; Mrk 1:11; Luk 9:35"},"23":{"text":"Jesu amihil kipat chun ama kum somthum vel alhingin, mi ngaiton ama chu Joseph chapa ahin, Joseph chu Heli chapa ahin,","title":"Jesu Khanggui (Matt 1:1-17)"},"24":{"text":"Heli chu Matthat chapa ahin, Matthat chu Levi chapa ahin, Levi chu Melchi chapa ahin, Melchi chu Janna chapa ahin, Janna chu Joseph chapa ahin,"},"25":{"text":"Joseph chu Mattathias chapa ahin, Mattathias chu Amos chapa ahin, Amos chu Nahum chapa ahin, Nahum chu Esli chapa ahin, Esli chu Nagge chapa ahin,"},"26":{"text":"Nagge chu Maath chapa ahin, Maath chu Mattathias chapa ahin, Mattathia chu Semei chapa ahin, Semei chu Joseph chapa ahin, Joseph chu Juda chapa ahin,"},"27":{"text":"Juda chu Joanna chapa ahin, Joanna chu Rhesa chapa ahin, Rhesa chu Zerubbabel chapa ahin, Zerubbabel chu Shealtiel chapa ahin, Shealtiel chu Neri chapa ahin,"},"28":{"text":"Neri chu Melchi chapa ahin, Melchi chu Addi chapa ahin, Addi chu Cosam chapa ahin, Cosam chu Elmodam chapa ahin, Elmodam chu Er chapa ahin,"},"29":{"text":"Er chu Jose chapa ahin, Jose chu Eleazer chapa ahin, Eleazer chu Jorim chapa ahin, Jorim chu Matthat chapa ahin, Matthat chu Levi chapa ahin,"},"30":{"text":"Levi chu Simeon chapa ahin, Simeon chu Juda chapa ahin, Juda chu Joseph chapa ahin, Joseph chu Jonam chapa ahin, Jonam chu Eliakim chapa ahin,"},"31":{"text":"Eliakim chu Melea chapa ahin, Melea chu Mennan chapa ahin, Mennan chu Mattatha chapa ahin, Mattatha chu Nathan chapa ahin, Nathan chu David chapa ahin,"},"32":{"text":"David chu Jesse chapa ahin, Jesse chu Obed chapa ahin, Obed chu Boaz chapa ahin, Boaz chun Salmon chapa ahin, Salmon chu Nahson chapa ahin,"},"33":{"text":"Nahson chu Aminadab chapa ahin, Aminadab chu Aram chapa ahin, Aram chu Hezron chapa ahin, Hezron chu Peres chapa ahin, Peres chu Judah chapa ahin,"},"34":{"text":"Judah chu Jacob chapa ahin, Jacob chu Isaac chapa ahin, Isaac chu Abraham chapa ahin, Abraham chu Terah chapa ahin, Terah chun Nahor chapa ahin,"},"35":{"text":"Nahor chun Seruch chapa ahin, Seruch chu Reu chapa ahin, Reu chu Peleg chapa ahin, Peleg chun Eber chapa ahin, Eber chu Shelah chapa ahin,"},"36":{"text":"Shela chu Cainan chapa ahin, Cainan chu Arphaxad chapa ahin, Arphaxad chu Shem chapa ahin, Shem chu Noah chapa ahin, Noah chu Lamech chapa ahin,"},"37":{"text":"Lamech chu Mathusala chapa ahin, Mathusala chu Enoch chapa ahin, Enoch chu Jared chapa ahin, Jared chu Mahalalel chapa ahin, Mahalalel chu Cainan chapa ahin,"},"38":{"text":"Cainan chu Enos chapa ahin, Enos chu Seth chapa ahin, Seth chu Adam chapa ahin, Adam chu Pathen chapa ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Jesu Lhagao Theng dimsetnin Jordan'a konin akilen, chule Lhagaovin gamthipmah apuijin,","title":"Jesu Lhep Patepma Aum (Matt 4:1-11 ; Mrk 1:12-13)"},"2":{"text":"Nisomli diabol lhep patepmin aumin ahi. Chule hiche phat sunga chu imacha ne lou ahin; chule chuche alhin phatnin agil akeltan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hichun diabol'in ajah-a, Nangma Pathen Chapa nahile, hiche song hi changlhah asona dingin thu pen, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah-a, hitin akisune, mihem changlhah jenga hing louding ahi, Pathen thu chengsea joh hingding ahi, ati.","ref":"Danb 8:3."},"5":{"text":"Chuin diabol'in molsang tah chunga apuitouvin, mitphet kah louvin vannoi leiset gam jouse avetsahtan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin diabol chun ajah-a, hicheng jouse chunga thuneina le aloupina nangma penge; ijeh-inem itile keima eikipedoh-a ahitan; kapeh nomnom kapeh ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun neihouva ahile aboncha nanga hi ding ahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah-a, kanunglama chen, Satan: ijeh-inem itile, hitin akisune, nangman napakai, na-Pathen chu houvinlang ama jengbou jennin, ati.","ref":"Danb 6:13."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Jerusalem'a apuijin chule houin tingvuma adinsah-in; chuin ajah-a, Pathen Chapa nahile, hichea konhin nangma kichomlha jengin."},"10":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile, Aman nangma chungchanga avantilho nachang dingin thu pentin,","ref":"Labu 91:1"},"11":{"text":"Chule amahon akhutnuva nadop dingu ahi, achutiloule songah nakeng kisuh khah-in nate, tin akisune ati.","ref":"Labu 91:12"},"12":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah-a, Nangman Pakai na-Pathen chu lhem patep hih-in, tin akiseije, ati.","ref":"Danb 6:16."},"13":{"text":"Chuin diabol'in alhep patepna chengse achaisoh phatnin, chomkhat dingin ama chu adalhatan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Jesu Lhagao thahatnin Galilee'a akilekit tan; hichun akimvel gamtina chun athu akithangtan ahi.","title":"Jesu Galilee Gama Anatoh Apat (Matt 4:12-17 ; Mrk 1:14-15)"},"15":{"text":"Chuin akikhopnao in tinah ahillen, mi jouse pachat-in aumtan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin aseilet dohna Nazareth kho-a ahungin; chuin achon ngaibangin cholngah nin kikhopna in'ah alutnin, sim dingin adingtan ahi.","title":"Jesu Nazareth Kho-a Apomlouvu (Matt 13:53-58 ; Mrk 6:1-6)"},"17":{"text":"Chuin Isaiah themgao lekhabu apeuvin ahi. Chuin aman lekhabu chu aphongin ahile, hitia kisun laitah amudoh-in ahi:"},"18":{"text":"Pakai Lhagao chu kachunga aume, ajehchu aman keima mivaichaho jah-a kipana Thupha hillhang ding, alung naho damsah ding, sohchangho jah-a lhadohna thu phongdoh ding, mitcho ho khomusah dinga, suhnemna umho lhadoh dinga,","ref":"Isai 61:1-2."},"19":{"text":"Pakai lahthei kum seiphong dinga, thao einu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin aman lekhabu chu akhupmin, lhachale khutna ape kitnin, atoutan ahi. Hichun kikhopna in'a mi jousen ama jeng amit lhuh chehtauvin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin ajah uva, Hiche Pathen lekhabu thuhi tuni hin nanakhang sunguvah aguilhung tai, tin asei pantan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hichun abonchauvin ama chu aseiphaovin, chule akam sunga soh lungsetna thu chu kidang asa lheh jengun; Hiche hi Joseph chapa hilouham? atiuvin ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Nanghon, Louthem nangma kiboldamin: Capernaum'a nathilbol kajah chengseu chu hikomah nangma gama jong hin bolin, ti thuchih hi kajah-a nasei tei dingu hina hi, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin aman aseikitnin, Tahbeh-a najah uva kasei ahi, Themgao koima ama gam sungah min ajop ngaipoi.","ref":"Jhn 4:44"},"25":{"text":"Ahivangin tahbeh-a najah uva kasei ahi, Elijah nikho laija van akikha-a, kum thumle lha gup gam jouse-a kel alhah chun, Israel lah-a meithai tamtah aumin ahi;","ref":"1 Leng 17:1."},"26":{"text":"Ahin adang koima henga Elijah kisol louvin, Sidon gama Zerapath kho-a meithainu henga akisol bouvin ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 17:8-16"},"27":{"text":"Chule Elisha'n themgao phatlai chun, Israel lah-a aphah tamtah aum nan; ahinla Syria mi Naaman tilou, adang koima kiboldamtheng aumpoi, ati.","ref":"2 Leng 5:1-14"},"28":{"text":"Chuin amahon thu chucheng ajah phatnun, kikhopna in sunga mi jouse chu alunghang behseh jengun,"},"29":{"text":"Akipat doh-un, khosunga kon chun asondoh-un, abungbua sotlhah dingin akho chennao koldeh lama chun apuitaovin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ahivangin akah uva akihehdoh-in achemang tan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin ama Galilee gama khopi khat Capernaum'a achesuh-in, chule cholngah nin miho ahiltan ahi.","title":"Thilhavop Aboldam (Mrk 1:21-28)"},"32":{"text":"Chule thunei tah-a thu asei jeh chun, athuhil chu kidang asa lheh jengun ahi.","ref":"Matt 7:28-29"},"33":{"text":"Chuin kikhopna in'a chun lhagao boh vop mikhat aumin; chuin ama chun aw sangtah-in asamin,"},"34":{"text":"Neidalhao vin! Vo Nazareth Jesu, nangle keiho ikimatnao i-um em? Eisumang uva hunga nahim? Nangma koi nahi kahenai; Pathen Mitheng chu nahi, ati."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n ama chu aphoh-in, Thipmin, ama-a kon chun hung doh-in, ati. Chuin thilha chun ama chu alaijuvah ahehlhun, suna louvin asunga konin ahung potdoh tan ahi."},"36":{"text":"Hichun abonchauvin kidang asa lheh jengun, amahole amaho akihouvun, hiche hi ipi thuham? Ijeh-inem itile thuneitah le thahat tah-a lhagao bohho thu apehle, amaho ahung potdoh jenguve, atiuvin ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chuin chuche vel gama khotinah athu athangtan ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chuin akipatnin, kikhopna ina kon chun apotnin, Simon in'a aluttai. Chuin Simon nupanu chu hatah-a khosih-a na ahin; amanu ding chun athumpeh taovin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Mi Tamtah Adamsah (Matt 8:14-17 ; Mrk 1:29-34)"},"39":{"text":"Chuin ama akomah adingin, akhosih chu aphoh-in ahile, alhatan ahi. Chuin amanu athoudoh paijenin, amaho jenlen apangtan ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chuin nisalhum konin, hivei chomchom veija ana damlou neiho chun amaho chu akoma ahin puijun; chule aman achung cheh uva akhut angamin, aboldam gamtan ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chule thilhaho jong chu mi tamtah-a konin apotdoh-un, Nangma Pathen Chapa Christa nahi, tin asamun ahi. Chuin aman amaho chu aphoh thipmin, amahon ama Christa ahi chu ahet jeh-un, thu aseisah tapon ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chuin kho avah, phatnin apotdoh-in gamthip munah achetan; chule mipi chun aholun, ahenga chun ahungun, amaho adalhah louna dingin alho taovin ahi.","title":"Jesu Kikhopna in'a Thu Ahil (Mrk 1:35-39)"},"43":{"text":"Ahivangin aman amaho jah-a, Keiman kho dang danga jong Pathen lenggam Kipana Thupha kahil lhangle ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile hiche dinga chu hinkisol kahi, ati."},"44":{"text":"Hichun Galilee gama kikhopna in tinah thu ahilhanglen ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, mipin Pathen thu ngaidinga aneh chinto jeh-un, ama Genesaret dillen panga adingin ahi.","title":"Seijui Masaho Akou (Matt 4:18-22 ; Mrk 1:16-20)","ref":"Matt 13:1-2; Mrk 3:9-10; 4:1."},"2":{"text":"Hichun aman dillen vaokama chun kong ni amun; ahivangin nga manho chu anapotdoh uva, alennu anasopmu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin ama Simon kong joh-a chun alutnin, kong chu vaokama kona themkhat atollut din asolin, chuin atouvin, kong'a chun apangin mipi chu thu ahiltan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin athusei angah phatnin Simon jah-a, lithuhlam jonin, nga man dingin nalen seplhan, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Simon'in adonbutnin, Pipu, jan khovah keijin kabolun, imacha man louhel kahiuve; ahivangin nangma thusah-in len gahsep lhange, ati.","ref":"Jhn 21:3."},"6":{"text":"Chuin chutia abol phat chun, nga atama tam akhukha taovin; alennu chu akeh jengin ahi.","ref":"Jhn 21:6"},"7":{"text":"Chuin amahon kong choma um akikoppiho chu hunga ahung hu dingun agahjap taovin ahi. Chuin ahungun akong nin asung dimun ahile alhalut dehdeh jengin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahin Simon Peter'in hichu amun, Jesu khophang bula aboh khupmin, Vo Pakai, kakoma konin chedoh-in; ijeh-inem itile keima mi chonse kahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Hiche anga matnu chu amale aloiten kidang asah behseh jeh-u ahi;"},"10":{"text":"Chule Simon kikoppi Zebedai chapate ni Jacob le John jong chun kidang asa lhonin ahi. Chuin Jesu'n Simon jah-a, Kicha hih-in; tua pat mihem mana napan ding ahitai, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amahon akongu vaokama ahintoldoh phatnun, abonchan adalhauvin anung ajuitaovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, ama khopi khatna aumpetnin, veuvin, mi khat apumchanga phah aumin; chuin Jesu amu phatnin tolla aboh khupmin, Pakai, nalung ahile neidam thengsah thei ahi, tin ataotan ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Miphah Aboldam (Matt 8:1-4 ; Mrk 1:40-45)"},"13":{"text":"Chuin aman akhut alhangin, athamin, Kalung ahi, damthengtan, ati. Chupettah chun aphah chu apha paihel jengtan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin aman koima jah-a asei louna dingin akhamchah-in, Chenlang thempu gakimusah-in, chule nakibol damtheng thu dol chu amaho hettohsahnan, Mosi thupeh dungjuijin thilpeh ding dol chu gapetan, ati.","ref":"Thmpu 14:32"},"15":{"text":"Achuti jeng vangin ama thu dol akithang chehjengin; mipi atama tam athu ngai dingle anat kiboldam dingin ahung kikhomun ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahin ama chang gamthip muntin-ah achomin achedoh-in, agataovin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, hichelai chun nikhat thu ahil petnin, Galilee gama khoho le Juda gama khoho-a kon, chule Jerusalem'a kona hung Pharisai ho le danthu hilteho chu akoma atouvun ahi; chule mi boldam dingin Pakai thilboltheina chun ama aumpi ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Langthi Aboldam (Matt 9:1-8 ; Mrk 2:1-12)"},"18":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, mihon mi langthi khat ajalkhun pumin ahinpuvin; amahon ama chu put lutna, a-anga koi dingin agouvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin mipi jeh-a aput lutna ding kom amu lou phatnun, in chunga akaldoh-un, in chungkhu chehpheng vangkah-a chun alupna pumin alailunguva Jesu ang sungah agah khailhauvin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin atahsanjeu chu amun, aman, Mipa nachonset naho kingaidam nahitai, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin danthu sunhole Pharisai hon, Taitomna thuseipa hi hoi koiham? Pathen tailou chonset ngaidam thei koiham? tin agel pantaovin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahin agelu chu Jesu'n ahen, adonbutnin, ajah uva, Nalunguva ipi nagelu ham?"},"23":{"text":"Nachonset naho kingaidama ahitai kitile, Thouvin lamjotnin ti hoijoh seibai jo-am?"},"24":{"text":"Ahoi hita jongle leiset chungah Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna thahat aneije ti nahetna dingun,(langthipa jah-a chun,) Thou vin; nalupna kilah inlang, na-in'a chetan kati nahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin hiche pettah chun ama a-angsung uva athoudoh paijin, alupna chu akilah-in, Pathen vahchoi pumin a-in lama achetan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Hichun kidang asa lheh jengun, Pathen avahchoijun, Tunin thil kidangtah imuve, atiuvin akicha behseh jengtaovin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin hiche jou chun ama apotdoh-in ahile, amin Levi atiu kaidong khat, kaidonna mun'a atou amun, ajah-a, Kanung hinjuijin, ati.","title":"Jesu'n Levi Akou (Matt 9:9-13 ; Mrk 2:13-17)"},"28":{"text":"Chuin aman ijakai adalhan akipatdoh-in ajuitan ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Levi chun ama vahnan a-in'ah golvah loupitah abolin; chule hia chun kaidongho le midang tamtah-in amaho chu ankong aumpiuvin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Pharisai ho le alekha sunteu aseijuiteho chunga aphunun, Ibola kaidongho le chonse hotoh nanehkhom nadon khomuham? atitaove.","ref":"Luk 15:1-2"},"31":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, Ati damten louthem angaipouve; a damlouten bou angaijui."},"32":{"text":"Michonpha te kou-a hung kahipoi; alung heina dinguva michonse te kou-a hungjoh kahibouve, ati."},"33":{"text":"Chuin amahon ajah-a, Ipidinga John seijuiten an angol matchet jiuva, tao jong taojiuva chule Pharisai hon jong chuti boljiuva, nangma nungjui hon aneh uva adonjiu ham? atiuvin ahi.","title":"An Ngol Thudola Thudoh (Matt 9:14-17 ; Mrk 2:18-22)"},"34":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n amaho jah-a, Moulang chun aumpi laiseuva, aloite chu an na ngolsah thei ngaijum?"},"35":{"text":"Amavang moulang chu akomuva kona akipuimang ni hung lhung ding ahi, chuche nile an angol dingu ahi, ati."},"36":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah uva thulem khatma aseijin, Koiman ponthah halchu ponluija abeh ngaipoi; chuti bolle athah chun asuhset ding; chule athah-a kona alah ahal jong chu alui chutoh kitoh lou ding ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chule koiman lengpitwi thah savun peng luija akhum ngaipoi; ichuti bolle, atwi thah chun apeng chu tumkeh intin, atwi jong long jalintin, peng jong mang ding ahi."},"38":{"text":"Lengpitwi thah chu peng thah-a khum ding ahibouve; chutile ania kikhehtup jia ahi."},"39":{"text":"Lengpitwi lui dona chun koiman athah don ding agopoi; ijeh-inem itile, Aluibou atuije, ati."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, amasa kichaijou anichanna cholngah nin changlei lai ajotnin ahile, aseijuiten changvui asih-un, akhutnun anoijun aneuvin ahi.","title":"Cholngah Ni Nit Thudola Thudoh (Matt 12:1-8 ; Mrk 2:23-28)","ref":"Danb 23:25."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pharisai ho kimkhatnin, Cholngah ni-a bol ngailou ibola nabol uham? ati."},"3":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Nanghon David le aloihon agil akel phat uva abolu chu nasim khah louvu ham?","ref":"1 Sam 21:6."},"4":{"text":"Ama Pathen in'a alutnin, thempu tailou adangin aneh ngailou vetsahna changlhah chu alan, anen, chule aloiho jong apen ahi, ati.","ref":"Thmpu 24:9"},"5":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah uva, Mihem Chapa chu cholngah ni Pakai ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, cholngah ni chom khatnin ama kikhopna in'ah alutnin thu ahilin; chule hia chun akhut jet lang ngoi mi khat aumin ahi.","title":"Khut Lang Ngoipa Adamsah (Matt 12:9-14 ; Mrk 3:1-6)"},"7":{"text":"Chuin danthu sunho le Pharisai ho chun ahehsetna ding amu theina dingun, cholngah ni-a aboldam em, aboldam hih em tin achang lhiuvin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahivangin aman alungthimu chu ahen, akhut langngoipa jah-a chun, Kipatdoh-in alaija hung dingdoh-in, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n amaho jah-a, Keiman thudoh khat neijung kate; cholngah ni-a apha bol angaiha, ase bol angaiham? Lhagao huhhing angaiha, suhmang angaiham? ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho chu abonchauvin ave kimvelin, akhut lang ngoipa jah-a chun, Nakhut lhangin, ati. Chuin aman alhangin ahile akhut chu alangkhat bangin adamtan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahin amaho athangtom tuntun jengun, Jesu chunga ipi bolding ham akihoutoh pantaovin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, hiche lai chun ama taona mang dingin molchunga akaldoh-in; jan khovah-in Pathen henga tang louvin ataovin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Solchah Somleni Alhendoh (Matt 10:1-4 ; Mrk 3:13-19)"},"13":{"text":"Chuin khovah phatnin aseijuite akouvin; chuin alah uva somleni alhengdoh-in, amaho chu aminu jong solchah asahtan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Peter asah Simon, chule asopipa Andrew, Jacob le John, Philip le Bartholomew,"},"15":{"text":"Mathew le Thomas, Alphaeus chapa Jacob, Zealot atiu Simon,"},"16":{"text":"Jacob naopa Juda, chule ama matsah-a pang Judas Iscariot, hicheng chu ahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chuin amaho chutoh ahung kumlhan, jangcham-ah adingun, aseijui honkhat toh, Juda gam jousele Jerusalem'a kon, Tyre le Sidon gama twikhanglen panga kon mipi atama tam, athu ngai dingle ahiveiju kiboldam dinga hungho;","title":"Jesu'n Thu Ahil Le Mi Aboldam (Matt 5:1-12)"},"18":{"text":"Chuin lhagao boh suhgentheina aumnaova kona boldama umho toh ahin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin ama-a kona thilboltheina ahung potna abonchauva aboldam jeh chun, mipi chun abonchauvin ama chu tohkhah agouvin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin ama akhodah-in aseijuite aven, Mivaichateho anunnom nahiuve; ijeh-inem itile Pathen lenggam chu nangho-a ahi.","title":"Anunnom le Ada (Matt 5:1-12)"},"21":{"text":"Tu-a gilkelteho anunnom nahiuve; ijeh-inem itile nangho nava dingu ahi. Tu-a kapteho anunnom nahiuve; ijeh-inem itile nanui dingu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mihem Chapa jala min nahotbol uva, chule nachom khenuva, nahou setnuva, chule michonse tia naminu apaidoh tengule anunnom nahiuve.","ref":"1 Pet 4:14."},"23":{"text":"Hiche ni chule thanomun, kipah-in kichomum; ijeh-inem itile veuvin, van'a nasan dingu kipaman atame; ijeh-inem itile apu apateuvin jong themgaoho chutobang ma-a chu anabolu ahi.","ref":"2 Thusm 36:16; Sol 7:52"},"24":{"text":"Amavang mihaosa ho, ada nahiuve! Ijeh inem itile nanghon lungmonna alhinga naneiju ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Nangho tu-a oivaho ada nahiuve! ijeh-inem nangho nagil keldiu ahi. Nangho tu-a nuiho ada nahiuve! ijeh inem itile nangho nalunghem dingu chule naka dingu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Mi jousen na-ochat uva naseiphat tengule ada nahiuve! ijeh-inem itile apu apateuvin chutima-a chu themgao lhemho anabolu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Amavang keiman kathu ngaiho jah-a kasei ahi, Nanghon namelma teu chu ngailuvin; nahoteu chu phatbolun;","title":"Melma Ngailut Ding (Matt 5:38-48 ; 7:12)"},"28":{"text":"Nagaosapteu chu phatthei boh-un; nataitom teo dingin taovun."},"29":{"text":"Nabengphe langkhat benga chu langkhat jong dopeh-in; chule naponlen min nalahpehle nasangkhol jong alah ding it hih-in."},"30":{"text":"Nahenga thumchan chu pen; chule nanei nalah peh-a chu thum kit ta hih-in."},"31":{"text":"Min nangho iti nabol leu nadeijum, nanghon jong chuti chun bolun.","ref":"Matt 7:12"},"32":{"text":"Nanghon nangailu teo jeng nangailut uva ahile, ipi pachat nachan dinguham? Ijeh-inem itile michonseho jengin jong angailuva chu amahon angailuvin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chule nanghon nadinguva phaho jengseh phatna ding bolleu chun, ipi pachat nachan dinguham? Ijeh-inem itile michonse hon jong achuti bolun ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chule lemu kit dinga nakinepna hou jengseh henga peleuchun ipi pachatna nachan dinguham? Ijeh-inem itile michonse hon jong michonseho hengah ajatma mu kit dingin apejiuvin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Nangho vangin namelma teu chu ngailuvin, aphatna dingu bolun, chule mu kit ding kinemlel louvin peuvin; chutile tohphat man nasan dingu len ding, chule Chungnung pen chate nahi dingu ahi. Ijeh inem itile ama kipaje helou le miphalouho ahepin ahi."},"36":{"text":"Hijeh chun na-Pau mikhoto bangin, nanghon jong mi khotouvin."},"37":{"text":"Chule mi oimo hih-un, chutile nangho oimo-a naum lou dingu ahi; mi themmo chansah hih-un, chutile nangho jong themmo nakichan lou dingu ahi; mi ngaidamun, chutile nangho jong naki ngaidam dingu ahi.","title":"Midang Oimo (Matt 7:1-5)"},"38":{"text":"Nanghon peuvin, chutile nangho jong nakipe dingu ahi; phatah-in tentin, sonchahkheh intin, lohchah kheh-in tin, letsetna na-op uva nasunpeh dingu ahi; ijeh-inem itile nanghon nate bang banguva chu nangho kitepeh ding nahiuve, ati."},"39":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho jah-a thulem khat aseijin, Mitchon mitcho apui thei ngaijem? Ani lhona kokhuh-a lhalut lhonta lou dingham?","ref":"Matt 15:14."},"40":{"text":"Ahilpa sangin aseijui achungnung jopoi. Athep chamkim teng vangle ahilpa toh akibang bouve.","ref":"Matt 10:24-25; Jhn 13:16; 15:20"},"41":{"text":"Chule ibola nasopi mitna bohthem um chu navetna, nangma mitna thingtum umchu hedoh louva nahim?"},"42":{"text":"Chule nangman nangma mitna um thingtum chu mu louva, nasopi jah-a, Sopi, namitna bohthem um chu neilahdoh sah-in, iti nati theiham? Vo miphalhem, nangma mitna um thingtum chu kilahdoh masah-in, chutengle nasopi mitna um bohthem lahdoh ding chu namuchen ding ahi."},"43":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile thingphung pha-a aga phalou agajipoi, thingphung phalouva jong aga pha agajipoi.","title":"Thingphung Chule Aga (Matt 7:16-20 ; 12:33-35)"},"44":{"text":"Thingphung jouse aga-a kihe-a ahi. Ijeh-inem itile min ling phung-ah theichang aloujipoi, lingboh-a jong lengpiga aloujipoi.","ref":"Matt 12:33"},"45":{"text":"Miphan alung sung thilkholna pha-a konin thilpha asodoh-in; chule miphalouvin alung sung thil kholna phalouva konin aphalou asodohjin ahi; ijeh-inem itile alung sunga aletset teng akamin aphondohji ahi.","ref":"Matt 12:34"},"46":{"text":"Chule nangho kasei thua la chon louva ibola Pakai, Pakai, neitiu ham?","title":"In Kisa Jatni (Matt 7:24-27)"},"47":{"text":"Koi hijongle kahenga hunga, kathusei ngaija, chule bola chu, ama chu koi tobang ham keiman nangho vetsah-unge."},"48":{"text":"Ama chu in sa-a, thuhtah-a lei laija, chule abul songpi chunga phut tobang ahi: chuin twisang ahung lenin, chule luidung asoh-in, in chu hasuh-in asun ahile, guntah-a kisa ahi jeh chun asulhu joutapon ahi."},"49":{"text":"Ahin ja chu jana-a ahia bol louva vang chu, abul beija lei chunga in sa tobang ahi; luidung asoh-in, hasuh-in asun ahile hiche in chu alhupai jengtan ahi; hiche in chu aset anasa lheh jengin ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin aman miho jah-a asei ding thu jouse aseisoh phatnin, Capernaum'a aluttan ahi.","title":"Rome Sepai Jalamkai Sohpa Adamsah (Matt 8:5-13)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin sepai jalamkai khat asohpa deitah hatah-in anan, athikon ahitai."},"3":{"text":"Chuin aman Jesu thu umchan ajah phatnin, ahengah Juda mi upaho asolin, ahunga asohpa chu ahung damsah dingin angehtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin amaho chu Jesu heng alhunun, pontho tah-in ataovun, Ama hi hiche hi nabolpeh-a lomtah ahi;"},"5":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile aman ivaipiu hi angailu lheh jengin, amatah-in kaki khopnao in jong hi eisahpeh-u ahi, atiuvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin Jesu amaho chutoh alhontai. Chuin inkom ageijin jalamkai javaipo chun agolho asolin, Jesu jah-a, Pakai, nangma hung kisugim hih-in: ijeh-inem itile nangma ka-in sunga nahung lut ding chu keima chutia kilom kahipoi."},"7":{"text":"Chutichu ahin keima jong nangma henga hung dinga kilomim kakingaito poi; thu chengkhat jengcha seijin, chutile kasohpa dam jeng ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile keima jong mi thuneina noija um kahin, keima noija sepaiho aumin; chule keiman khatpenpen chu, Chen, katile, achen; achom khat, Hungin, katile ahungin: chule kasoh jah-a, Hiche bolin, katile, aboljin ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n thu chucheng ajah phatnin, ama chu kidang asan adatmon, anungjui mipi jah-a chun, Keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Israel lah jenga jong hitobang tahsan len kamukhapoi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin asolteho chu a-in'a akile kitnun ahile, adammoa um sohpa chu damin amutauvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chujou jou chun Nain atiu kho khatna achen, aseijuite le mipi nasatah khattoh alhonin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Meithainu Chapa Ahindohsah"},"12":{"text":"Chuche kho kotpi phung ageijun, veuvin, mithi khat ahung kipun, ama chu anu chapa changkhatseh ahin, amanula meithai ahin; akhoho mi tamtah-in alhonpiuvin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin amanu chu amu phatnin, alung ase behseh jengin, Kap hih-in, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin aman anaijin thilong kong chu athamin ahile, apuho chu adingtauvin ahi. Chuin aman, Gollhang, thouvin kati nahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin athipa chu atou doh-in, thu asei pantan ahi. Chuin aman amapa chu anu apetan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin abonchau chunga kichatna alhung tan; Ilah uva themgao chungnung khat asohdoh-e; chule Pathen'in amite aviltai, atiuvin Pathen avahchoi taovin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin Judah gam jouse-a le akimvel gam jouse-ah achungchang thu chu athangdoh sohtan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin John seijuiten chuti thu jouse chu ajah-a aseijiuvin ahi.","title":"John Baptist'a Kona Thupole ho (Matt 11:2-19)"},"19":{"text":"Chuin John'in aseijuite mi ni akouvin, Jesu hengah asolin, Ahung dinga chu nang nahi mong hinam? Ole achom dang khat kanga dinguham? agati sah-e."},"20":{"text":"Chuin mite ni akom alhun lhonin, John Baptist-in, Ahung dinga chu nangma nahi mong hinam? Ole achom dang khat kanga dinguham? tia nahenga eihinsol lhon ahi, ati lhone."},"21":{"text":"Hiche pettah-a chu Jesu'n anaho, hiseveiho, chule lhagao gilou vop tamtah aboldama, chule mitcho tamtah lungset tah-a kho amusah ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah lhonah, Che lhoninlang nathilmu chengse lhon le nathujah chengse; Iti dana mitchon kho amu-a, elbaijin lam ajotna, miphah damtheng sah-a auma, chule na-ngongin kho ajah-a, mithisa kaithouva auma, chule mivaichate Kipana Thupha kiseipeh-a hitam John jah-a gasei lhonin.","ref":"Isai 35:5-6; 61:1"},"23":{"text":"Chule koi hijongle keija kipal lhuhna kom nei lou chu anunnom ahi, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin John thupo ho chu apotdoh phatnun, aman mipi jah-a chun John thudol asei panin, Ipi ve dinga gamthipma chu nachedoh-uham? Huijin peng amut lingham?"},"25":{"text":"Achutile, ipi ve dinga ba chedoh nahiuvem? Ponnem kisil miham? Veuvin, lultah-a kivonhole nomsa tah-a umho khu lengho inpi-a um ahiuve."},"26":{"text":"Ahile, ipi ve dingaba nachedoh-uham? Themgao ham? Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, themgao sanga chungnungjo ahi."},"27":{"text":"Keiman kasottol nama sang-ah kasole, aman namasanga sang nalampi asem ding ahi, tia kisun chu ama hi ahi.","ref":"Mal 3:1."},"28":{"text":"Nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Numei sunga peng lah-a John Baptist sanga lenjo aumpoi; ahinla Pathen lenggama aneojo chu ama sangin alenjoi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin athusei ja-a mi jouse le kaidongho, John baptize chansah-a baptize changho chun, Pathen chu them achanun adihsahtauve.","ref":"Matt 21:32; Luk 3:12."},"30":{"text":"Ahin Pharisai ho le danthu themho vang chun, ama chansah-a baptize chang louvin, Pathen'in amaho chunga alunggot chu apaidoh taovin ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule Pakaiyin, Tukhanga miho hi ipitoh katekah tadem? chule ipi toh kilou uvam? ati."},"32":{"text":"Amaho chu chapang kaithel tolla touva, khatnin khat kou-a, ajah-a, Kuli kamutpeh ule nalam hih-un; kakau lela nakap pouve, tiho tobang ahiuve."},"33":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile John Baptist ahungin, changlhah ne lou lengpitwi donlou ahin; nanghon, Ama chu thilhavop ahi, nati uve."},"34":{"text":"Mihem Chapa ahungin, anen chule adonin ahile, nanghon, Veuvin, nehhat le ju lop, kaidongho le mi chonseho jol le gol, nati uve."},"35":{"text":"Ahinla chihna chu achate jousen athem chansah uvin ahi, ati."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Pharisai ho khatnin ama chu an nehpi dingin akouvin; chuin ama Pharisai pa in'a chun alutnin, an nedingin atoutan ahi.","title":"Pharisai Mi Simon In'a Jesu"},"37":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, hiche khopi sunga um numei chonse khatnin Pharisai pa in'ah annen atouve ti ahet phatnin, songval bom khat thao namtui ahin choijin;","ref":"Matt 26:7; Mrk 14:3; Jhn 12:3"},"38":{"text":"Anungah akengphang bulah adingin akapmin, akengphang chu amitlhin akotsah-in, aluchanga asam chun atheh ngim pantan, chuin akengphang chu achopmin thao chu anutan ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chuin an ne-a kou-a Pharisai pa chun hichu amun, alungthima, Hiche mipa hi themgao ahin, hiche atongkha nu hi koi ahi le itobang numei ahi hetahta, amanula chonse ahin, ati."},"40":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n ama chu adonbutnin, ajah-a, Simon najah-a sei ding thukhat kaneije ati."},"41":{"text":"Aman, Houhil seijin, ati. Sumpahom mikhatnin sumba mi ni aneijin; khatpan dangka ja nile somnga abatnin, khatjopan somni le nga abat ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chuin amanin asahna ding anei lhon lou phatnin, ani lhonin angaidam tai. Chuti ahileh koijoh chun ama ha ngailutjoh lhonintem? ati."},"43":{"text":"Simon'in adonbutnin, Kei ngaiton atam ngaidamjoh chun, ati. Chuin aman, natan dih-e, ati."},"44":{"text":"Chuin numeinu lama chun akiheijin, Simon jah-a, Numeinu hi namu-em? Na-in'ah kahung lutnin nangman kakeng silna ding twi neipepoi, amanu vang hin amitlhin ka kengphang asukotnin, asamin atheh ngime."},"45":{"text":"Nangman chopjong neichop poi, amanu vang hin kahung lut tila pat ka kengphang chop atangpoi."},"46":{"text":"Nangman kalu thao neinu pehpoi, amanu vang hin ka kengphang thao namtui anui."},"47":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu kasei ahi, Amanu chonsetna tamtah akingaidam jeh-a hatah-a angailut ahi; amavang ngaidam lhom chun angailu lhomjin ahi, ati."},"48":{"text":"Chuin numeinu jah-a chun, Nachonset ngaidam ahitai, ati."},"49":{"text":"Hichun a-ankong um piho chun, Chonset ngaidam ama hi koi hingana? akitiuvin ahi."},"50":{"text":"Chuin aman numeinu jah-a chun, Natahsanin nahuhhing ahitai; lungmong tah-in chetan, ati."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, hiche joujou chun, ama khopile khoneo tinah avahlen, Pathen gam Kipana Thupha apolen ahillhanglen; somleni ho chu akomah aumun;","title":"Jesu Kiloipi Numei ho"},"2":{"text":"chule numei phabep, lhagao gilou vop kiboldam le anat kiboldamho toh ahiuve. Amaho chu Magdalene atiu Mariam thilha sagi potdohnanu toh,","ref":"Matt 27:55-56; Mrk 15:40-41; Luk 23:49"},"3":{"text":"chule Herod neiching Chuza inneipi Joanna toh, Susanna toh, chule numei dang tamtah toh ahiuvin; amaho chun amaho neija konin ama ajenun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin mipi tamtah ahung kikhom khomun, khotina konin miho ahenga ahung ahungun, aman thulemin thu aseijin;","title":"Muchi Thepa Thulem (Matt 13:1-9 ; Mrk 4:1-9)"},"5":{"text":"Muchi thepa muchi then achen, athe atheleh abang lamsih-a achun ahile min kengin achotphan, chule chunga leng vachaten alohgamtan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Abang songlheo chungah achun; chuin akedoh doh-in, jung akholou jeh-in agop paitan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule abang ling lah-a achun; chuin lingho chutoh akhanthan adeplih taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule adang leipha laijah achun, akhangin, ajat jakhat agatan ahi ati. Chuin thu chucheng aseijin, Angaina ding nakhang neijan ngaihen tin asamin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin aseijuiten, Hiche thulem chu i-kiseina ham? tin adongun ahi.","title":"Thulem Kiseilo (Matt 13:10-17 ; Mrk 4:10-12)"},"10":{"text":"Chuin aman, Pathen lenggam thuguh chu nahet dinguva kipe-a nahitaove; midangho dinga vang, vet chu avetnuva amuloudiu, jah chu ajah uva ahet louna dinguva thulema kisei ahi.","ref":"Isai 6:9-10"},"11":{"text":"Thulem chu athu hiche ahi: Muchi chu Pathen thu ahi.","title":"Muchi Thupa Thulem Kihilchet (Matt 13:18-23 ; Mrk 4:13-20)"},"12":{"text":"Chule lamsih-a ho chu, athu jaho ahiuve, chutengle amahon atahsan daova chule asochat louna dingun diabol ahungin, alung sunguva thu chu alahmang pehjin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule songlheo chungaho chu athu ajah-a, thanom tah-a joppaiho ahiuve; amahon jung aneipouvin, chomkhat atahsanun, chule lhepna aum tengle apul lhagamji taove."},"14":{"text":"Chule ling lah-a chuho chu hiche ahi, athu ajah nungle acheuvin, hinlai khankho lungkhamna, haona, nopsahna chun adeplihjin, aga bulhingji tapouve."},"15":{"text":"Chule leipha laija chua chu, thu chu ja-a, lung kituptah le phatah-a tuh detna, thohhat na-a ga sohdoh jiho chu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule koiman meivah avah-in belin akhukhum jipoi; jalkhun noija jong akikoi jipoi; alut chanin vah amu theina dingun atunna chungah atungji bouve.","title":"Meivah Bel Kikhukhom (Mrk 4:21-25)","ref":"Matt 5:15; Luk 11:33."},"17":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile kiphong lou dinga imacha ki-ima aumpoi, chule hetdoh lou ding le kilangdoh lou ding akiselguh imacha aumpoi.","ref":"Matt 10:26; Luk 12:2."},"18":{"text":"Hijeh chun iti nangaijum chingtheijun; ijeh-inem itile koi hijongle aneija chu kipehbe ding; chule koi hijongle anei louva chu aneija angaito chasun jong chu ama-a kona kilahpeh ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 25:29; Luk 19:26."},"19":{"text":"Chuin anu le asopite ahungun, ahinla mipi jeh chun akom alhung theipouvin.","title":"Jesu Sopiho Le Anu (Matt 12:46-50 ; Mrk 3:31-35)"},"20":{"text":"Chuin ajah-a, Nanule nasopite inpoa adingun, nangma namu nomui, tin aseipeh-un ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ahin aman adonbutnin, amaho jah-a, Kanule kasopite hicheho, Pathen thu ngaija bolteho hi ahiuve, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, chulai chun ni khat aseijuite toh kong-ah atouvin; chuin aman amaho jah-a, dil gallang khatna galkaiju hite, ati. Chuin kong alhaovin akitol taovin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Twipi Kinong Aphothip (Matt 8:23-27 ; Mrk 4:35-41)"},"23":{"text":"Ahin akitol petnun ama a-imutan; chuin dila chun khopihui ahung nungin ahile akongu chu twi adim dehdeh jengtan, amaho setto kichatah-in aumtaovin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin amaho ahenga acheuvin, asukhangun, Pipu, Pipu, athigam kahitaove, atiuve. Chuin ama ahung khangin huipi le twikinong chu aphoh-in; hichun hiteni chu atanghel gelin, athiphel tan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah uvah, hoibaham natahsanu? ati. Chuin amaho akichauvin, kidang asauvin, khatnin khat jah-a, Hichepa hi itobang mi ham! Huile twi thu apen ahile, athun anung jeng lhone, akitiuvin ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Galilee gal ajontah-a um, Gerasene gam alhungun ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Thilhavop Adamsah (Matt 8:28-34 ; Mrk 5:1-20)"},"27":{"text":"Chuin ama kong'a kona leichung agah chot chotnin, khopi-a kon mikhatnin atoh-in; ama chu sottah thilha vop, apon apona sil lou, in'a jong umlou, lhankhuh lah jenga um ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ama chun Jesu amu mun, a-ao san, a-angah aboh khupmin, aw sangtah-in, Vo Jesu, Chungnung pen Pathen Chapa, nangle kei ipi ikimatna umam? Nahenga katao ahi, keima neibolgim hih-in, ati."},"29":{"text":"(Ajehchu aman mipa-a kon chun hung doh-in tia lhagao boh chu thu apeh ahi. Ijeh-inem itile ama chu tamtah vei amat matchetji ahi: chule ama chu thihkhao le bula ahenjiu ahin, ahivangin aman akihennaho chu aphutanjia, thilhan gamthipmah apuimangji ahi)."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n ama chu adongin, Namin ipiham? ati. Chuin aman, Janel kahi, ati; ijeh-inem itile asunga chu thilha tamtah lut ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chule Aman amaho chu leinoi lama asol lounadin thilhaho chun Jesu henga angeh taovin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chule chukom molsang dunga chu vohcha hon atama tam lha-a ahin; thilhaho chun chucheho lah-a alut theina dingun angeh-un ahile; aman alutdiu aphalpeh tan ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin thilhaho mipa-a kon chun ahung potdoh-un, vohchaho sunga chun alut taovin ahile, vohhon chu halhaijin alhaijun, kolah alhai lhauvin, dil'a alha lutnun athigam taovin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin vohcha vah hon hiche thusoh umchan chu amu phatnun ajamun, khopi sunga le loujaovah agaseijun ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin ipi thusoh hitam tia ve dingin ahung potdoh-un; chuin Jesu kom ahung lhungun, thilha potdohna mipa chun pon akisila, chule lunglima Jesu kengphang koma atou amuvin, akicha lheh jengun ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chuin amuho chun thilha voppa chu iti kihuhdoh ahi chu amaho jah-a aseijun ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chuin Gerasene gam vela miho jousen, akomuva kona achedohna dingin ahenga ataotauvin ahi; ijeh-inem itile amaho chu kicha behseh jenguva ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chuin ama kong'a alutnin, akile kittan ahi. Ahin thilhaho potdohnapa vang chun ama koma umding athumin;"},"39":{"text":"Ahivangin Jesu'n, Na-in lama chenlang Pathen'in nangma itobang thil loupi nabol peh-em, hichu gaseilen, tin asolin ahi. Chuin akipatdoh-in, Jesu'n thil lentah abolpeh chu khopumpi jah-a lhang phongtah-in asamletai."},"40":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, Jesu akile kit chun, mipin kipah tah-in ana lamtouvin ahi; ijeh-inem itile amaho abonchauva ama ngah jinga anaum ahiuve.","title":"Jairus Chanu Leh Jesu Ponmong Thamnu (Matt 9:18-26 ; Mrk 5:21-43)"},"41":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, amin Jairus kiti mi khat ahungin, chule ama chu kikhopna in vaihom ahi; chuin ama chu Jesu kengphang bulah alhun, a-in'a hung dingin ataotan ahi;"},"42":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile ama chun chanu changkhatseh aneijin, kum somle kum nibep ahin, amanu chu athi koncha ahi. Ahin achen ahile mipi chun atom lellul jengun ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chuin numei khat kum somle kum ni athi long, louthem ho kijensah na-a anei jouse sumang, khatchan jong aboldam jou lounu chu,"},"44":{"text":"anung lama ahungin, apon mongkai athamin ahi: chuin chupettah chun athi lon chu atangpai jengtan ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n, koiham eithama? ati. Chuin koimachan kei kahi atilou phatnin, Peter le akoma umhon, Pipu, mipin natoma chule naneh chintouva, iti dana koiham eithama? natiham, atiuve."},"46":{"text":"Ahivangin Jesu'n, Koiham khatnin eithame; ijeh-inem itile keija kona thilboltheina thahat potdoh-a chu keiman kahei, ati."},"47":{"text":"Chuin numeinu chun, Ki-imthei kahipoi ti ahen, kihot pumpumin ahungin, a-angah aboh khupmin, ijeh-a ama atham ahi chule chupet tah-a adampaihel chu mi jouse ang sungah aseitan ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chuin aman amanu jah-a, Chanu, lhamong tah-in umin, natahsanin nadamsah ahitai; lung mongin chetan, ati."},"49":{"text":"Aman hiche thu chu aseina laijin, kikhopna in vaihompa in'a kon chun mi khat ahungin, ajah-a, nachanu athitai; houhil chu cholsah hih-in, ati."},"50":{"text":"Ahivangin Jesu'n hichu ajan, adonbutnin olmo hih-in, tahsanpou poutan; chutile amanu hingdoh ding ahi, ati."},"51":{"text":"Chuin in alhun phatnun aman Peter, John, Jacob chule chapangnu nule pa tailou adang koima alutsahpon ahi."},"52":{"text":"Chule miho jouse chun amanu chu akauvin, a-op abeng bengun ahi; ahin aman, nangho kap hih-un; ama athia ahipoi, a-imu ahibouve, ati."},"53":{"text":"Chuin athitai ti ahet jeh-u chun, ama chu anuisat taovin ahi."},"54":{"text":"Ahinla aman amaho chu apotdoh sah-in, amanu chu akhutnin atuh-in akouvin, Boinu, thouvin ati."},"55":{"text":"Chuin alhagao ahung kile kitnin, chupettah chun athoudohpai jengtan ahi; chuin aman amanu chu neh ding peuvin, tin thu apetai."},"56":{"text":"Hichun anu le apa chun kidang asa lheh lhonin; ahivangin aman hiche thil kibol chu koima jah-a aseilhon louna dingin akham chahtan ahi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin aman somleni ho chu akou khomin, thilhaho jouse chunga thuneina le nat boldamna thahat apen,","title":"Jesu'n Seijui Somleni ho Asoldoh (Matt 10:5-15 ; Mrk 6:7-13)"},"2":{"text":"Pathen lenggam thu hil lhangle dingle adamlouho boldam dingin asolin,"},"3":{"text":"Ajah uva, Nakhol jinnauva dingin imacha keng hih-un, tenggol hihen, sakhao hihen, changlhah hihen, chule sum hijongle kiken hih-un; sangkhol thoni jong nei hih-un;","ref":"Luk 10:4-11; Sol 13:51"},"4":{"text":"Nalut lutnau in'a chun umun, chule chua kon chun potdoh-un."},"5":{"text":"Chule nalhunsah lounao chanuva chu, chuche kho-a kona napotdoh tengule, amaho douna hettohsahnan nakengphang uva leivui thinglhau vin, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin amaho acheuvin, akho kho-a Kipana Thupha ahillhangun, adamlou aboldampeh taovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hichun Herod gamvaipopan thil kibol jouse chu ajan, alunggim lhehtan ahi. Ajeh chu mi abangin, John athia kona thoudoh kit ahi, atiuvin;","title":"Herod Lunggim (Matt 14:1-12 ; Mrk 6:14-29)","ref":"Matt 16:14; Mrk 8:28; Luk 9:19."},"8":{"text":"Abangin, Elijah hung kilah ahi, atiuvin; adangse vang chun, Malaija themgaoho lah-a khat thoudoh kit ahi, atiuvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Herod'in, Keiman John lu katantan, ahinla hiche athu kajah hi hoi koiham? ati. Hichun ama mu atuptan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin solchah ho chu ahung kile kitnun, athilbol chengseu chu ama jah-a aseijun ahi. Chuin aman amaho chu apuijin, Bethsaida atiu khopi mun thip khatna amaho changseh apotdoh taovin ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Mi Sangnga Avahva (Matt 14:13-21 ; Mrk 6:30-44 ; Jhn 6:1-14)"},"11":{"text":"Ahivangin mipin hichu ahet phat uvin, anung ajuijun; chuin aman amaho chu anasangin, chuin ajah uva Pathen gam thu aseijin, chule boldam ngaiho chu aboldamtan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin nilhum kon ahitan; hichun somleni ho chu ahungun ajah-a, Mipi hi acheuva khoho le loujao dunga genale anneh agakihol theina dingun soltan; ijeh-inem itile hikoma eiho gamthipma um ihiuve, atiuvin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahin aman amaho ajah-a, Nanghon nehding peuvin ati. Chuin amahon jah-a, Kacheuva hiche miho jouse dinga hi neh kagachoh ngal louvule, keihon changlhah pheng nga le nga ni kalval kaneipouve, atiuvin ahi"},"14":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile amaho chu mi sangnga jen hiuva ahi. Chuin aman aseijuite jah-a, Amaho chu somnga cheng chengin aloi loijin tousah-un, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin amahon achuti bolun, abonchauvin atousah-un ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin changlhah pheng nga chule nga chu alan, van lam aven, hiteho chu phatthei aboh-in, ahehbal balin; chuin mipi anga chu luipeh dingin aseijuite thu apen ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin amahon aneuvin, abonchauvin avasoh keijun, chuin anehmoh-u anong chengse paipeh somle paipeh ni alohdoh-un ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, ama achanga atao petnin, aseijuiho akomah aumun; hichun aman amaho chu adongin, Mipi ho hin keima hi koi ahi eitiuvem? ati.","title":"Peter'in Jesu Aphondoh (Matt 16:13-19 ; Mrk 8:27-29)"},"19":{"text":"Chuin amahon adonbutnun, John Baptist ahi atiuve; abang vangin Elijah ahi atiuvin; chule adangsen, Malaija themgaoho lah-a khat thoudoh ahi tin aseijuve atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Matt 14:1-2; Mrk 6:14-15; Luk 9:7-8."},"20":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Nanghonla koi ahi neitiuvem? ati. Chuin Peter'in adonbutnin, Pathen Khrista chu, ati.","ref":"Jhn 6:68-69."},"21":{"text":"Ahivangin aman amaho chu hichu koima jah-a asei louna dingun hakhamin akhamchah-in;","title":"Jesu'n Athoh Ding Le Athi Ding Asei Masah (Matt 16:20-28 ; Mrk 8:30—9:1)"},"22":{"text":"Ajah uva, Mihem Chapa chun thil tamtah athoh-a, chule vaipo upaho le thempu pipuiho, chule danthu sunho pampaija uma, chule kithat tei ding, chule ni thum nile kaithouva umtei ding ahi, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin aman abonchau jah-a, Koi hile kanung eijui noma chu ama kingaitom hen, niseh-in athingpel kiput hen lang kanung hinjuihen.","ref":"Matt 10:38; Luk 14:27."},"24":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile koi hile ahinna huhhing noma chun achan ding; amavang koi hile keima jala ahinna chana chun ahuhhing ding ahi.","title":"Eima Ima Hia Kigel Lou Ding","ref":"Matt 10:39; Luk 17:33; Jhn 12:25."},"25":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile min vannoi leiset apumpin neihenlang, ama kisumanghen ahiloule paidoh-in umtale, ama dinga ipi phachom dingham?"},"26":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile koi hijongle keima le kathu jachat chanchu, Mihem Chapan ama loupinale, Pa loupina, chule vantil thengteho loupina-a ahung tengle, amapa chu ajachatpi ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Amavang tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hikoma dingho kimkhat hi, Pathen lenggam amu kahseuva, thina tepkha lou ding aumuve, ati."},"28":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, chucheng aseikal ni get jen jouvin Peter toh, John toh, chule Jacob toh apuijin, atao dingin mol chunga akaltouvun ahi.","title":"Avou Kikhel (Matt 17:1-8 ; Mrk 9:2-8)","ref":"2 Pet 1:17-18."},"29":{"text":"Chuin ama ataopetnin, amaiso akikhelin, chule aponsil abanin abangin, aval lahlah jengin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, mi nin akihoupin; amani chu Mosi le Elijah ahi lhonin,"},"31":{"text":"Loupia hung kilah lhona, Jerusalem'a thina athoh chai ding thu chu asei lhonin ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hichun Peter le aumpiho chu a-imutsoh ngui ngui jengun, ahivangin hah jengin aumun, aloupije le akoma ding miteni chu amuvin ahi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin akikhenpi lhona akoma kona achedoh pet lhonin, Peter'in Jesu jah-a, Pipu, hikoma i-umu hi eiho dingin anome; chule lhambuh thum songung kate, khat nangma ding, khat Mosi ding, chule khat Elijah ding, atin; ipi asei ahijong ahepon ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin aman chucheng asei pet chun, mei lhang khatnin amaho chu ahinlekhun; chuin amaho mei lah-a alutnu chun akichauvin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin mei lah-a kon chun aw ahung gingdoh-in, Hiche hi ka-Chapa deitah ahi; athu ngaijun, ati.","ref":"Isai 42:1; Matt 3:17; 12:18; Mrk 1:11; Luk 3:22"},"36":{"text":"Chuin awgin akichai phat chun, Jesu achangin akimutan ahi. Chuin athipbeh-un, chulai chun athilmu-u chu koima jah-a asei pouvin ahi."},"37":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, akit ni-a mol chunga kona akumsuh phatnun, mipi atama tamin analam touvin ahi.","title":"Lhagao Boh Vop Chapangpa Khat Adamsah (Matt 17:14-18 ; Mrk 9:14-27)"},"38":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, mipi lah-a kon chun mikhatnin ahin samin, Houhil, nahenga katao ahi, kachapa hi ven; ama hi kachapa changkhatseh ahi;"},"39":{"text":"Chule vetan, lhagaovin amanjin, phulou helouvin apengjahjin, chule aheh lhujin ahile achilphon akaijin, asuheh jin, lhakang manlouvin amavo jingin ahi."},"40":{"text":"Chule anodoh dinga naseijuite henga kataole, amahonla anodoh joupouvin ahi, ati."},"41":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, Vo tahsanna nei lou khanglamvai mite, nakom uva itihchan kauma, chule kakhongai ding nahiuvem? Nachapa chu hilama hinpuijin, ati."},"42":{"text":"Chuin ahung petnin thilha chun ahehlhun, nasatah-in aveingoi jengin ahi. Ahivangin Jesu'n lhagao boh chu aphoh-in, chuin chapang chu aboldamin apa apetan ahi."},"43":{"text":"Chuin miho jouse chun Pathen thilboltheina loupije chu kidang asa lheh jengun ahi. Chutia chu athilbol jouse chu kidang asah pettah-un Jesu'n aseijuite jah-a chun,"},"44":{"text":"Hicheng thuhi nana sunguvah lutsah-un, ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa chu mihemte khutna kipedoh dingkon ahi, ati.","title":"Jesu'n Aniveina-a Athi Ding Asei Masah (Matt 17:22-23 ; Mrk 9:30-32)"},"45":{"text":"Ahivangin hiche athusei chu ahedoh pouve; ijeh-inem itile amahon ahetdoh louna dinguva, amaho-a kona ki-ima ahin; chule hiche athusei chu ipi aseina ham doh dingla akichauvin ahi."},"46":{"text":"Chuin alah uva koipen chu alenpen ahidem tin kinelna aumtan ahi.","title":"Koiham Alenpen? (Matt 18:1-5 ; Mrk 9:33-37)","ref":"Luk 22:24."},"47":{"text":"Ahivangin Jesu'n alunguva chuche angaitou chu ahen, chapang neocha khat alan, akoma adinsah-in,"},"48":{"text":"Ajah uva, Koi hijongle hiche chapang neocha hi keima mina sanga chun keima eisan ahi; chule koi hijongle keima eisanga chun eihinsolpa asan ahi. Ijeh-inem itile nalah uva aneopen chu alen ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 10:40; Luk 10:16; Jhn 13:20"},"49":{"text":"Chuin John'in adonbutnin, Pipu, mi khat namina thilha nodoh kamuvin, chuin nangma kajuiju eijuipi lou jeh-un kakham taove, ati.","title":"Nangho Douva Panglou Chanchu Nangho-a ahi (Mrk 9:38-40)"},"50":{"text":"Ahin Jesu'n amaho jah-a, kham hih-un, ijeh-inem itile koi hijongle eidoulou tapouvu chu eiho lamma pang ahi."},"51":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi; ama lahtouva aum ding phat alhin konin, Jerusalem'a che dingin amai angat changmelin,","title":"Jesu Samaria Mihon Alhunsah Nomlouvu"},"52":{"text":"Amasangah thangkou asol masan; chule amaho acheuvin ama dinga gotsa anakoipeh dingin, Samaria miho kho khatnah aluttaovin ahi."},"53":{"text":"Ahivangin ama Jerusalem'a che dinga amai angat jeh chun, amahon anasang tapouvin ahi."},"54":{"text":"Chule asolchah teni, Jacob le John nin hichu amulhon phatnin, Pakai, Elijah'in anabol banga, van'a kona meikong ahung lhah-a amaho hi akahvamna dingu thu peleuveng nalung ham, ati lhone.","ref":"2 Leng 1:9-16"},"55":{"text":"Ahivangin ama akiheijin amani chu aphoh-in, ajah lhonna, Itobang lhagao neija nahi nakihet lhonpoi;"},"56":{"text":"Ajeh chu Mihem Chapa hi mihemho hinkho sumang dia hung ahipon, ahuhhing diuva hunga joh ahibouve, ati. Chuin kho choma ache taovin ahi."},"57":{"text":"Chuin lampia ache petnun mikhatnin ajah-a, Pakai, Nachena chan-ah juijinge, ati.","title":"Jesu Nungjui Dinga Kilom (Matt 8:19-22)"},"58":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Sial hon ko aneijun, chunga leng vachaten jong buh aneijun, Mihem Chapa vangin alu ngapna mun aneipoi, ati."},"59":{"text":"Chuin aman achom khat jah-a, neijuijin, ati. Ahin aman, Pakai, amasan kache-a kapa kagavuina ding thu neipen, ati."},"60":{"text":"Hichun Jesu'n ajah-a, mithihon amithiu kivuinao vinte; nangma chenlang Pathen gam thupha gahil lhang letan ati."},"61":{"text":"Achom khatman jong, Pakai, keiman nanung juijinge, amavang amasan ka-inkote kaga lhahna dingin neilhan, ati.","ref":"1 Leng 19:20."},"62":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah-a, Mi koi hile langkon tuhta-a, kiheija anunglam vea chu Pathen lenggama hoi ahipoi, ati."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chucheng jou chun Pakaiyin midang somsagi alhendoh ben, ama chena ding khopi chengsele muntina chun amasang sang-ah mi ninin asolin ahi.","title":"Seijui Somsagi Asoldoh"},"2":{"text":"Chuin ajah uva, Chang at ding atam lheh-in, ahivangin natonga alhome; hiche jeh chun achang atna-a dinga natongho ahinsoldohna dingin, chang neipu henga taovun.","ref":"Matt 9:37-38"},"3":{"text":"Cheovin; veuvin, ngeihon lah-a kelngoi nou banga nangho kasol nahiuve.","ref":"Matt 10:16"},"4":{"text":"Nanghon sumbom ahin, sakhao ahin, kengchot ahin, keng hih-un; chule lampia koima chibai boh hih-un.","ref":"Matt 10:7-14; Mrk 6:8-11; Luk 9:3-5"},"5":{"text":"Chule in nalutna ding chanuva, amasatah-in, hiche in'a hin lungmon lhunghen, tiuvin."},"6":{"text":"Chukoma chu lungmon umtah mi auma ahile, nalungmon chu achunga umding ahi; aum lou vangle nangho henga hung kile kit ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule ipi hijongle amahon napeh peh-u chu neuvin donun, hiche in'a chun umun; ijeh-inem itile natongan athaman asana lom ahi. In khatna konin in khatna kichon hih-un.","ref":"1 Cor 9:14; 1 Tim 5:18"},"8":{"text":"Chule ipi kho hijongle nalutnaova chu min nanasan uva ahile, na-ang uva akoi chanu chu neuvin."},"9":{"text":"Chukoma um anaho chu boldamun; chule amaho jah-a chun, Pathen gam chu nakomu alhungtai, tiuvin."},"10":{"text":"Amavang ipi kho hijongle nalutna uva chu min nana lhunsah louvangule, chedoh-unlang akho sung lamlenuvah,"},"11":{"text":"Kakeng phanguva beh nakho sunguva leivui sana katheh lhah khum nahiuve; hijongle Pathen gam ahung naitai ti hi heuvin, tin seijun."},"12":{"text":"Najah uva kasei ahi, chunileh chuche khopi thoh sanga chu Sodom thoh oljo ding ahi.","ref":"Semt 19:24-28; Matt 11:24; 10:15"},"13":{"text":"Ohe Chorazin! nada ahi, ohe Bethsaida! nada ahi; ijeh-inem itile nalah uva thilbol thahatna kidang kibol chengse chu, Tyre le Sidon khopi-a kibol hile, sotna pat chun achenghon khaodip pon kisilin vut lah-a touvuntin, alungu heitauvinte.","title":"Tahsanna Neilou Khopiho (Matt 11:20-24)","ref":"Isai 23:1-8; Ezek 26:1—28:26; Joel 3:4-8; Amos 1:9-10; Zech 9:2-4."},"14":{"text":"Ahinla thupi tan nile nangni thoh sanga Tyre le Sidon thoh oljo ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule vangeija choisanga uma nang Capernaum, damuna sotlhah-a umding nahi jobouve.","ref":"Isai 14:13-15"},"16":{"text":"Koi hile nangho thu ngai chan chun keima thu jong angai ahi; koi hile nangho pampaija chun keima jong eipampai ahi; chule keima eipampaija chun eisolpa jong apampai ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 10:40; Mrk 9:37; Luk 9:48; Jhn 13:20."},"17":{"text":"Chuin chuche somsagi ho chu kipahtah-in ahung kileuvin, Pakai, nangma minin thilhaho jong kathu-uvin anunge, atiuvin ahi.","title":"Somsagi Le Ni Hung Kile"},"18":{"text":"Aman amaho jah-a, Van'a kona kolphe banga Satan ahunglhah kamui."},"19":{"text":"Veuvin, gulle aipi chonpeh dingle, melmapa thilboltheina jouse chunga chu thuneina kapeh nahiuve; hitia chu imachan nangho nasuhset lou dingu ahi.","ref":"Labu 91:13"},"20":{"text":"Ahivangin lhagaoho nathuva anun jeh chun kipah hih-un, amavang naminu van'a akisut jeh chun kipah jouvin ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin hiche pettah chun Jesu Lhagao Thengah hapan akipah-in, hitin ati, Ka Pa, vanle lei Pakai, nangman mi chingtele lungthim themho henga hicheng thuhi na-ima, naocha ho henga naphon doh jeh hin nangma kathangvah-e; Pa, hiti chu nangma lunglhaina lam ahi.","title":"Jesu Kipa (Matt 11:25-27 ; 13:6-17)"},"22":{"text":"Imajouse ka Pan keima eipehdohsoh ahitai, chule Chapa chu koi ahi Pa tailouvin ahepoi; chule Pa chu koi ahi Chapa le Chapan Ama aphondoh aphondohna miho tailou koiman ahepoi, ati.","ref":"Jhn 3:36; 10:5."},"23":{"text":"Chuin seijuiteho lama chun akiheijin atumbeh-in ahenguva, Nathilmu chengseu namunao mit chu avangphai:"},"24":{"text":"ijeh-inem itile kaseipeh nahiuve, nangho thil mu hi themgaoho tamtah le lenghon mu atup lheh-u ahin, ahivangin amupouvin ahi; chule nathu jah chengseu hi jah atupmun, ahinla ajapouvin ahi, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin veuvin, danthu them khat adingdoh-in, apatep-in, Houhil, tonsot hin kemlou kanei theina dinga ipi kabol dingham, ati.","title":"Samaria Miphapa Thulem","ref":"Matt 22:35-40; Mrk 12:28-34."},"26":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah-a, danthua ipi kisunem? Nangman iti nasimem? ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin aman adonbutnin, Nangman nalung pumpin, nalhagao pumpin, nathanei apumpin, chule nalungthim pumpin Pakai na-Pathen chu ngailun; chule nangma naki ngailut bangin naheng nakoma ngailun, ati.","ref":"Thmpu 19:18; Danb 6:5."},"28":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah-a, Nadonbut dih tangeije; hiti chun bolin, chutile nahin ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Thmpu 18:5."},"29":{"text":"Ahivangin ama them kichan agon, Jesu jah-a, Ahile kaheng kakom chu koiham? ati."},"30":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin, Mi koiham khat Jerusalem'a konin Jericho'a achesuh-in, gucha michomho lah atohkhatan, amaho chun apon alahpeh-un, avovin, athi konin adalha taovin ahi.","title":"Samaria Miphapa Thulem"},"31":{"text":"Chuin thempu khat chuche lampia chun achesuh-in; chuin amachu amu phatnin, lamsih lang khatna apeltan ahi."},"32":{"text":"Chuin chutima chun Levi mi khatma chukom mun chu aphah phatnin, ahungin ama chu aven, lamsih lang khatna apeltai."},"33":{"text":"Ahin Samaria mi khat vang chu akholchena lamah aumna mun chu ahinphan; chuin ama chu amun ahile alung asen,","ref":"2 Thusm 28:15"},"34":{"text":"Akoma achen, avohnao mahaho chu thaole lengpitwi asunkhumin, amahaho chu atomin, chuin amatah gancha chungah atousah-in, jinlhun in'ah apuilutnin, ajentan ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin ajingin apotdoh ding konin, sumnong ni aladoh-in, inneipu chu apen, Ama hi phatechan anajenin, hiche kalval ijat hijongle nasuhmang jat chu keima kahung kile kit teng nangma sanange, ati."},"36":{"text":"Hicheng thum lah-a koipen chu gucha michom lah tohkhapa hengle kom nahisah-em? ati."},"37":{"text":"Chuin aman, ama akhotopa chu, ati. Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Chenlang nangman jong chutobang chun gabolin, ati."},"38":{"text":"Chuin acheuva ahile ama kho khatna alutnin; chuin amin Martha atiu numei khatnin a-in'a alhunsah-in ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Martha le Mariam Agavil","ref":"Jhn 11:1."},"39":{"text":"Chule amanu chun Mariam kiti sopi khat aneijin, amanu jong chu Pakai keng khophang bulah atouvin, athu angaijin ahi."},"40":{"text":"Martha vang chu lhachalen apangin akisalel lheh jengin, chuin ama henga ahungin, Pakai, kasopi nun keima jeng lhachale-a eichanglha hi ima nagel louham? Hijeh chun eikithopi dingin solin, ati."},"41":{"text":"Ahin Jesu'n adonbutnin, amanu jah-a, Martha, Martha, nangma thil tamtah ngaito-a lungkhama lunggim nahi;"},"42":{"text":"Ahinla ngaichat akhoh chu khatsehbou ahin, chule Mariam'in chuche aphalai chu akilhen ahitai; hichu ama-a kona kilahpeh lou ding ahi, ati."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ama mun khatnah ataovin, ajo phatnin aseijuiteho khatnin ajah-a, Pakai, John'in aseijuite taoje ahil bang chun nangman jong keiho neihilun, ati.","title":"Taona Thudola Jesu Thuhil (Matt 6:9-13 ; 7:7-11)"},"2":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho jah-a, nangho natao tengule, Van'a um ka Pau, namin kijahen, nagam hunglhung hen, van'a nalung chan akim bangin, leija jong nalungchan kimhen,"},"3":{"text":"Tunin kaneh khop dingu anneh neipeuvin."},"4":{"text":"Kalei bateu kangaidam bangun, keiho batjong ngaidamin. Chule lhepna-a neipuilut hih-un, agilouva konin neihuh doh jouvin; tiuvin ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Nalah uva, koipen nahiuvem khatnin jol neihen, chule jankhang kimin ahenga chehen ajah-a, Jol, changlhah pheng thum apan neipen;"},"6":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile kajol khat kholjin kahenga ahung lhunge; ahin keiman a-anga luipeh ding imacha kaneipoi, gatile:"},"7":{"text":"Insunga pangin, Neisugim hih-in; tun kot akikhahtai, chule kachatetoh jalkhuna kalum khomui; nangma pe dingin kathou theipoi, tia donbut dinga?"},"8":{"text":"Keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, ajol ahi jeh chun thouhen gape hih jongle, athum lunlun jeh chun thouvintin adei jat chu gapente."},"9":{"text":"Chule keiman nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, Thumun, kipe ding nahiuve; holun, namu dingu ahi; kiuvun, kihonpeh ding nahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile athumchan achangin; chule aholan amun; chule akiuva chu kihonpeh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule nalah uva koipen nahiuvem, mipa hija achapan changlhah athumle song pe dinga? Ahiloule nga athumle nga khela gul pe dinga?"},"12":{"text":"Ahiloule ahtui athumle aipi pe dinga?"},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun nanghobon migiloutah hiuva, nachateo thilpha pehje nahet ule; hiche sanga chu gam chenga van'a Pa chun ahenga thumte chu Lhagao Theng apeh lou ding ham? ati."},"14":{"text":"Chuin aman thilha paomo khat anodoh-in, chuin thilha chu apotdoh phatnin, mipaomopa chun thu aseitan ahi; hichun mipi ho chun kidang asa lheh jengun ahi.","title":"Jesu Chule Beelzabul (Matt 12:22-30 ; Mrk 3:20-27)"},"15":{"text":"Ahivangin alah uva mi kimkhat chun, thilhaho lengpa Beelzabul vanga thilhaho anodoh ahi, atiuve.","ref":"Matt 9:34; 10:25"},"16":{"text":"Adang kimkhatsen ama patepnan van'a kona melchihna athumun ahi.","ref":"Matt 12:38; 16:1; Mrk 8:11."},"17":{"text":"Ahivangin aman amaho lung ngaito chu ahen, amaho jah-a, Gamsung khat amale ama kidoutoa kichom khen chan chu amang thahjin, insung khat kidou chu alhujin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Satan jong amale ama akidoule agam iti dindoh ding ham? Beelzabul vanga thilhaho anodoh ahi neitiula ahin,"},"19":{"text":"Keima Beelzabul vanga thilhaho nodoh kahile, nachateovin koi vanga anodohjiu hintem? Hijeh-a chu amaho cheng chu nangho thutana pang ding ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Ahin keima Pathen khutjunga thilhaho nodohji-a kahi vangle, Pathen gam chu nahengu hung lhunga ahitai."},"21":{"text":"Mihat in manchah kimkeija akipatna a-in angalai chansen, anei bitkeijin aumji;"},"22":{"text":"Amavang ama sang hatjon abulu-a, ajo tengle, akigina agalvon chu asutlhah pehjin, anei alahpeh chu ahomcheh jitan ati."},"23":{"text":"Koi hile keima lama pang lou chu eidouva ahi; chule eikhop khompi lou chu athecheh ahi.","ref":"Mrk 9:40."},"24":{"text":"Lhagao boh chu mi sunga kona apotdoh tengle, twi beina muntin-ah avahle avahlen, cholngahna aholin; chule amu jou hih-in, Kahung potdohna ka-in mama-a chun chekit tange, ati.","title":"Lhagao Boh Hungkile Kit (Matt 12:43-45)"},"25":{"text":"Chuin ahungleh akitheh ngim le akijephoi amun,"},"26":{"text":"Chutengle achen ama sanga giloujo lhagao dang sagi agapuijin; chule amaho chua chun alutnun achengji taove; chule mipa umchan chu amasa sangin anununga akhohjoji tan ahi, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, aman thu chucheng asei chun, numei khat mipi lah-a kon chun aw sangtah-in ajah-a, Navopma naobu le nangman nachep noi chu anunnoma ahiuve, ati.","title":"Kipa Tahbeh"},"28":{"text":"Ahinla aman, Ahinai, ahivangin Pathen thu ja-a jopteho chu anunnomjo ahiuve, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin mipi ho ahenga ahung kikhopkhop phatnun, aman, Tulai hiche khang hi khanggilou ahin; melchihna aholun, ahinla Jonah themgao melchihna tailou adang kipe lou ding ahi.","title":"Melchihna Angeh-u (Matt 12:38-42)","ref":"Matt 16:4; Mrk 8:12."},"30":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Jonah Nineveh mite dinga melchihna ahi banga chu, Mihem Chapa jong tulai khanga ding ahi.","ref":"Jhn 3:4"},"31":{"text":"Lhanglam gam lengnun thupi tanna-a hiche tulai khang mite toh hung thoudoh khoma, amaho hi themmo ahinchan ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile aman kolmonga konin Solomon chih thu ngai dingin ahungin ahi; ahin, veuvin, Solomon sanga chungnungjo hikoma aume.","ref":"1 Leng 10:1-10; 2 Thusm 9:1-12"},"32":{"text":"Nineveh khopi-a miho chun thupi tanna-a tulai khang mite toh hung ding khoma, tulai khang hi themmo ahinchansah dingu ahi; ijeh-inem itile amahon Jonah thuhil chun alung aheijun ahi; ahin, veuvin, Jonah sanga chungnungjo hikoma aume.","ref":"Jhn 3:5"},"33":{"text":"Mi koiman meivah avah-in ningchonga guhthimin akoi ngaipoi, lo jong akhukhum ngaipoi, mi aluttehon avah amu theina dingun atunna chunga atungji bouvui.","title":"Tahsa Meivah (Matt 5:15 ; 6:22-23)","ref":"Matt 5:15; Mrk 4:12; Luk 8:16."},"34":{"text":"Namit chu natahsa vah ahi; namit achima ahile, nati apumpia vah ahi; aphat lou vangle nati pumpi-a thima ahi."},"35":{"text":"Hijeh chun nasunga vah um chu athim louna dingin kivet phatnin."},"36":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun natahsa apumpia avah sohkeija, athimkom aum louva ahile, meivah vahtah-in nasalvah banga vah sohkei ding ahi, ati."},"37":{"text":"Chuin thu aseipet chun Pharisai khatnin an nehpi dingin akouvin; chuin ama alutnin, an nedingin atoutan ahi.","title":"Jesu'n Pharisai ho le Danthu Themho Themo Achan (Matt 23:1-36 ; Mrk 12:38-40)"},"38":{"text":"Chuin Pharisai pa chun an aneh masanga akisil lou chu amun adatmo lheh jengin ahi."},"39":{"text":"Chuin Pakai chun ajah-a, Tun Pharisai ho, nanghon khonle lheng apolam nasil ngim naovin; ahin nasung lamu vang hunama lahle kiloset adimsetne."},"40":{"text":"Vo lungthim beiho, apolam sema chun asung lam jong asem hilou ham?"},"41":{"text":"Hijongle thil nanei kham khamu chu vaicha gentheite tona dingin peuvin: chutile, veuvin; nangho dinga imajouse athenga ahi."},"42":{"text":"Ahinla, ohe Pharisai ho nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile nanghon pudina le lounakha chule anche louhing jouse somakhat natoh jiuvin; ahinla vaihom dihle Pathen ngailut nadonpouve; ahinla chutiho jong chu donda deh louva hicheng hi nabol dingu ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 27:30."},"43":{"text":"Ohe Pharisai ho nangho nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile nanghon kikhopna in'a touna pipenle, kailhanga min chibai naboh dingu nadeijun ahi."},"44":{"text":"Ohe, danthusun ho, Pharisai ho le miphalhem ho nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile nangho buikhuh kimu lou, mihon he louva achung ajotlejiu tobang nahiuve ati."},"45":{"text":"Chuin danthu them ho khatnin adonbutnin ajah-a, Houhil, nangman chutia nasei chu keiho jong neihoutomu ahi, ati."},"46":{"text":"Chuin aman, Ohe, danthu themho nangho jong nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile nanghon poh-a kilom lou pohgih mi napohsah-un, nanghonla pohgih chu nakhut jung khatchan jong nakhoiji pouve."},"47":{"text":"Nangho nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile naputeu napateu vin themgaoho athatnun, nanghon alhanu nasempeh jiuvin ahi."},"48":{"text":"Chutichu ahi jeh-in hichu ahetoh nangho nahiuvin, napu napateu thilbol chu naphasah uve; ijeh-inem itile amahon amaho chu athatnun, nanghon alhan natungun ahi."},"49":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pathen chihna-in jong ahiti seije, Keiman ahenguva themgaoho le solchah ho soling ting; chule amahon abang athaova abang abolset dingu ahi;"},"50":{"text":"Chutia chu Abel thisan kiso-a pat, maicham le Pathen houin kikah-a Zachariah athaova athisan kisogei, vannoi leiset bul kiphu tila patna themgaoho jouse thisan kiso chu, hiche tulai khang mite chunga aphu kila ding ahi."},"51":{"text":"Ahi, nangho jah-a kasei ahi, tulai mite chungabou kila ding ahi.","ref":"Semt 4:8; 2 Thusm 24:20-21"},"52":{"text":"Ohe, danthu themho nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile nanghon hetna kot-heh nalamangun, nanghola nalutpouvin, mi alut dingla nakhamun ahi, ati."},"53":{"text":"Chuin ajah uva thu chucheng asei phat chun, danthu sunho le Pharisai hon lunghan sah-a thu tamtah seisah din, hachang phinin aphin pan taovin ahi."},"54":{"text":"Amoso theina diuvin akama kona phabep khat jahdingin aholun, chule achangun ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche pet chun mipi atama tam, khat chunga khat kal leuva ahung kikhop phat chun, aman amasa penin aseijuite jah-a, Pharisai ho chola chun kihong phaovin; hichu phatlhem ahi.","title":"Phatlhem Chungchanga Gihna (Matt 10:26-27)","ref":"Matt 16:6; Mrk 8:15."},"2":{"text":"Ahinla akiphongdoh lou ding akisela imacha aumpoi, chule hetdoh lou ding imacha aki-ima jong aumpoi.","ref":"Mrk 4:22; Luk 8:17"},"3":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu muthima naseichanu chu khovah-a kija ding ahi; chule indan sungnunga nabenga guhthima naseiju chu, in chunga kisam ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule kajol kagol nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, tahsa thattheija akal ima lo thei lou chu kicha hih-un.","title":"Koiham Ginding? (Matt 10:28-31)"},"5":{"text":"Keiman nakichat dingu hilunge; atha nunga damuna lelutna ding thaneina neija ama chu kichauvin, najah uva kasei ahi; ama chu kichauvin."},"6":{"text":"Vasilih nga khu paisa ni manna kilhaji louham? Ahin, alah uva khat jengcha jong Pathen angah suhmilin aumkhapon ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahin nalu chunguva nasamjang jouseu sana kisim sohkeija ahi. Kicha hih-un; vasilih tamtah sanga nangho lujo nahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Chule najah uva kasei ahi, Koi hile miho anga keima eiseidoh chan chu, Mihem Chapan jong ama chu Pathen vantil teho anga aseidoh ding ahi:","title":"Jesu Phondoh Le Paidoh (Matt 10:32-33 ; 12:32 ; 10:19-20)"},"9":{"text":"Amavang miho anga keima eiseileppa vang chu, Pathen vantil teho anga ama jong kiseilep ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule Mihem Chapa chunga thuse sei jouse chu kingaidam ding ahi; Lhagao Theng taitoma vang chu kingaidam lou ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 12:32; Mrk 3:29."},"11":{"text":"Chule amahon nangho kikhopna-a vaipoho hengle thunei ho henga nakai tengule, Ipi-a iti kadonbut dingham, ipi kasei dingham tin lungkham hih-un;","ref":"Matt 10:19-20; Mrk 13:11; Luk 21:14-15."},"12":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile apettah chule Lhagao Thengin nasei dingu nahil dingu ahinai, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin mipi lah-a kon chun mikhatnin, Mihil, nei le gou eikihoppi dingin ka-u jah-a seijin, ati.","title":"Mihao Lungthimbeipa Thulem"},"14":{"text":"Ahivangin aman ajah-a, Mihem, kon nangho chunga vaihomle neile gou hoppeh-a eisemem? ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin ajah uvah, Ching theijun, neipap kiloset jouse-a konin kikangseuvin; ijeh-inem itile mihem khat hinkho hi anei le gou haona-a chu uma ahipoi, ati."},"16":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah uva thulem khat aseijin, Mihao khat gam sungah neh aput behseh jengin;"},"17":{"text":"Hichun aman alungthimin, Kalousoh chengse kakoikhomna ding munla aumpon; i-kalo ding hitam? ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin aman, hitin bolinge: kachangsal chengse phelhang ting, asanga lenjo cheh-in sangkate; chule kalousoh jousele kathil jouse chua chun koikhom inge."},"19":{"text":"Chutengle kalhagao jah-a, Lhagao, nangman kum sottah-a dinga thil tamtah nakikhol khom ahitai; kicholdon, nenlang donin, nomsa tah-in umin tinge, ati."},"20":{"text":"Ahinla Pathen'in ama jah-a, Vo lungthimbei, tujana hi nahinna nanga kona kiladoh ding ahitai; chule nathil kholkhom chengse chu koija hitantem? ati."},"21":{"text":"Pathen'a dinga haolouva ama dinga sum kikhola chu chutobang chu ahi, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin aman aseijuite jah-a, Hijeh-a chu nangho jah-a kasei ahi, I-kaneh ding hitam tin nahinna dingule, i-kasila kachen ding hitam tin natahsa dingun lungkham hih-un.","title":"Pathen Tahsan (Matt 6:25-34)"},"23":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile anneh sanga hinkho, nihchen ponsil sanga tahsa thupijo ahi."},"24":{"text":"Va-ah hokhu ngaitouvin; amahon tula atupouvin, atla a-at pouvin; pang le changsal la aneipouvin; ahivangin Pathen'in amaho khu avahnai. Nangho vacha sanga iti nalutjoh-u hitam?"},"25":{"text":"Chule nangho lah-a lungkham hatna ahinkho tongkhat jopsaobe thei koi nahiuvem?"},"26":{"text":"Hijeh chun nanghon aneopenbon nabol thei louvule, adangdang dinga ibola lungkhama nahiuvem?"},"27":{"text":"Molhoipah khu iti khanham ngaitouvin: hiche ho khun tongla atonggim pouvin, patla akheh pouvin; ahivanginla keiman kaseipeh nahiuve, Solomon jeng jong aloupina jouse-a akivon chun, hiche molhoipah khattoh kibangin akijem hoi pon ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 10:4-7; 2 Thusm 9:3-6"},"28":{"text":"Chule jaova hampa tunia uma jinga lhum sunga kileh lutta ding jengbon Pathen'in achuti jeple, Vo tahsan lhomho, chusanga chu aman nangho najepjoh lou dinguham?"},"29":{"text":"Chule ipi naneh dingu, ipi nadon dingu, hichu hol hih-un, chule lung dongin jong um hih-un."},"30":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile vannoi namtinin hitiho jouse chu aholjiuve: ahin hitiho chu nanghon nangai chaove ti na-Pau vin ahenai."},"31":{"text":"Ahivangin nanghon Pathen lenggam joh chu holun, chutengle hicheng jouse hi naki pehbe dingu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hon lhomho, kicha hih-un; ijeh-inem itile nangho lenggam pehding hi na-Pau lungdei ahi lheh jenge.","title":"Van'a Gou Kikhol (Matt 6:19-21)"},"33":{"text":"Naneichan-u joh-unlang mivaicha gentheiho peuvin; chule guchan amaiphah louna, nget nin jong anehset louna, van'ah sumbom lui thei lou kisemun, kemlou sum kikholun."},"34":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile nagou umna-a chu nalungu jong umding ahi."},"35":{"text":"Natai kigeh-un, chule nathaomei vahsah jingun;","title":"Kiging Jinga Um Sohpa","ref":"Matt 25:1-13."},"36":{"text":"Chule moupui na-a kona ahunga, kot ahin kiu phat phatle hongpai jeng dinga a-pakai lam kat jinga um mitoh bangun.","ref":"Mrk 13:34-36"},"37":{"text":"Pakai ahunga soh kiging jinga um ahungtoho chu anunnom ahiuve; keiman nangho tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Aman atai akigeh-a, amaho chu ankong aumsah-a, ahenguva hunga amatah ajenleuva pang ding ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chule ama jan dan nina ahim, jan dan thumna ahima ahunga, chuto banga chu ahung to-a ahile, hitobang soh ho chu anunnom ahiuve."},"39":{"text":"Chule itih phatna gucha ahung ding inneipun ahet hile, kiging jingintin, phetvang dinga a-in chu adalhah louhel ding ahi, hichu nanghon heuvin.","ref":"Matt 24:43-44"},"40":{"text":"Nangho phasademin umum; ijeh-inem itile nagel lou pettah-ule Mihem Chapa chu hung ding ahi, ati."},"41":{"text":"Chuin Peter'in, Pakai, hiche thulem chu keiho chang dinga naseiha, mi jouse dinga naseiham? ati."},"42":{"text":"Chuin Pakaiyin, Neiching tahsan umtah le chingtah, aphatcha achan cheh-u an hoppeh dinga a-pakaipan a-insunga jouse chunga apipua apansah ding chu koiham?","title":"Soh Tahsan Um Le Soh Tahsan Umlou (Matt 24:45-51)"},"43":{"text":"Apakai ahung tenga chutia bol ahungto soh chu anunnom ahi."},"44":{"text":"Nangho tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Ama chu anei jouse chunga apipua apansah ding ahi."},"45":{"text":"Amavang sohpa chun, Ka pakai ahung geije tihen, soh numei ho le soh pasal ho deng pan tahen, chule nehen, donhen khamtale,"},"46":{"text":"Hiche sohpa chun aginchat lou nitahle, ahetlou pettah-a a-pakaipa chu hunga; ama chu tum ni asoa, achan chu tahsan louho lah-a akoi ding ahi."},"47":{"text":"Chule soh a-pakai lung lam he-a, phasadema umlou, chule alunggot banga bol lou chu tamtah vei kivo ding ahi:"},"48":{"text":"Ahin hetlouva voh ding dola thilbola vang chu kivo lhom ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile tamtah kipe henga chu tamtah kibeng ding; chule koi hile atamjocheh kivopsah henga chu atamjo cheh kingeh ding ahi."},"49":{"text":"Keima vannoi leiset chunga mei lehlha dinga hunga kahi; tutah jeng jong hin kadohtale katinave!","title":"Jesu'n Kikhentelna (Matt 10:34-36)"},"50":{"text":"Ahivangin baptize chan ding kaneijin, chuche kamolso masangse-a iti kaningnoh hitam!","ref":"Mrk 10:38"},"51":{"text":"Lei chunga chamna lensah dinga hunga neingai touvem? Ahipoi, kaseipeh nahiuve, asukhen dingjoh-a hung kahibouve:"},"52":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile tukal insung khatna mi nga umchu ni-a kikhen diu, nin thum adouva, thumin ni adou ding ahi."},"53":{"text":"Pan achapa adou ding, chapan apa adou ding, nun achanu adou ding; chanun anu adouding, teh-in amounu adou ding, mouvin atehpi adouva kikhento diu ahi, ati.","ref":"Mica 7:6"},"54":{"text":"Chuin aman mipi ho jah-a jong chun, Nanghon lhum lama mei soh namu tengule, go ju ding ahi nati paijen jiuvin;
