ati."},"23":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah-a, Mi eingailua chun kathu anit ding, chule ka Pan ama chu angailut ding, chule ahenga chu kahunguva, ama chu kachenpi dingu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Keima eingailu lou chun kathu jong anitpoi; chule nathu jah-u keija ahipoi, eisola Pa-a chu ahibouve."},"25":{"text":"Keiman nangho kaumpi petna thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve."},"26":{"text":"Ahinla Pan kamina ahinsol ding Lhamonsah, Lhagao Theng chun, imajouse nahil sohkei dingu, chule najah uva kathusei chengse hi nageldohsah dingu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Lungmon kadalhahpeh nahiuve; kalungmon kapeh nahiuve; kapeh hi vannoi mi peh bang ahipoi; nalungu donsah hih-un, kicha jong kicha hih-un."},"28":{"text":"Keima kachemanga, chule naheng uva kahung kit ding ahi kati chu najataove. Neingailut ule Pa henga kache ding ahi tia najah uva kasei jeh-a hi nakipa nathanop dingu ahi; ijeh-inem itile Pa chu kei sanga chungnungjo ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ahung guilhun tengle natahsan theina dinguva, tu-a aguilhun masanga najah uva kasei masah dem ahi."},"30":{"text":"Najah uva thu tamsei taponge; ijeh-inem itile vannoi lengpa hung ding ahitai; chule aman keijah imacha aneipoi;"},"31":{"text":"Ahinla keiman Pa chu kangailut na, chule Pa chun eithupeh bang banga na katoh ahi hi, vannoi miten ahetna ding ahi. Kipatdoh-un, hikoma konin chetao hite."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima lengpigui tahtah kahi; chule ka Pa aleilhou ahi.","title":"Jesu Lengpigui Tahbeh Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Keija um abah aga lou lou chu aman apaidohjin; aga chengse chu aha ga chehna dingin amal ngimjin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nangho jah-a kathusei vanga chu nangho angimsa nahitaove."},"4":{"text":"Keijah um jingun, kei jong nangho-a uminge. Abah lengpiguija aum loule achanga aga thei lou banga chu, nangho jong keija naum louvule naga thei lou dingu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Keima lengpigui kahi, nangho abah nahiuve. Ama keija uma, Keima ama-a kaum mi chu hagan agaji; ajeh chu kei louvin nanghon ima nabol theipouve."},"6":{"text":"Mi keija umlou chu, abah bangin paidoh-in aumjin, chule agopjin; chule min hicheho chu achom khomun mei sungah asep lutjiuvin ahile akavamjitai."},"7":{"text":"Nangho keija naum uva, chule ka thu nangho-a aum jinga ahileh, nagotchan thumun, kibolpeh ding nahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Hichea hin nangho haga nagau hin ka Pa choi-at nin aumji; chule hitia chu nangho kaseijui nahi dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Pan keima eingailut bang banga, keiman jong nangho kangailut nahiuve; kangailutna-a hin um jingun."},"10":{"text":"Keiman ka Pa thupeh ho kanit sohkeija, angailutna kaum bang hin; nanghon kathupeh ho nitleu chun, kangailutna-a naum jing dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Kakipana nangho-a aum jingna dingle, nakipanao akimna dinga, hicheng thuhi najah uva kasei ahi."},"12":{"text":"Kathupeh hiche hi ahi, keiman kangailut bangu hin, nangho khatle khat kingailuto cheh-un.","ref":"Jhn 13:34; 15:17; 1 Jhn 3:23; 2 Jhn 5"},"13":{"text":"Min ajol agol dinga ahinna apeh sanga ngailut chungnungjo koiman aneipoi."},"14":{"text":"Kathupeh nabol uva ahile, nangho hi kajol kagol nahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Tukal keiman nangho soh kati lou ding nahitaove; ijeh-inem itile soh chun apakai thilbol ahepoi. Golte kati nahitaove; ijeh-inem itile ka Pa-a kona kajahho jouse aboncha nangho kahetsah soh nahitaove."},"16":{"text":"Nanghon keima neilhenu ahipoi, keima joh-in nangho kalhen doh-a, nacheuva haga nagauva chule nagau aumna dinga kapansah nahiuve; chutia chu ipi hijongle Pa henga kamina nathum chanu chu, aman napeh dingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nangho khatle khat naki ngailut to chehna dinguva, thupeh hicheng hi kapeh nahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Vannoi'in nahot ule, nangho nahot masang uva keima eihot chu naheuve.","title":"Vannoi Mite Vetdana"},"19":{"text":"Nangho vannoi'a hileu chun vannoi'in ama-a chu angailut ding ahi; hinlah tun nangho vannoi'a nahi louvu, vannoi'a kona keiman kalhendoh nahiuvin, hiche jeh-a chu vannoi'in nahotnu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Najah uva, Soh apakai sangin achungnung jopoi, tia kathusei chu geldoh-un. Amahon keima eibolset nule, nangho jong nabolset dingu ahi; kathu nitleu, nangho thu jong anit dingu ahi.","ref":"Matt 10:24; Luk 6:40; Jhn 13:16"},"21":{"text":"Ahin amahon eisolpa ahetlou jeh uva chu, thil hicheng hi keima min jala nachung uva ahinbol dingu ahi, ."},"22":{"text":"Keima kahunga ajah uva thu kahung sei lou hile, chonset anei lou dingu ahin; tuvangin achonset apaomea akilepna dingu aumtapoi."},"23":{"text":"Keima eihoa chun ka Pa jong ahot ahi."},"24":{"text":"Keiman alah uva mi koima dangin abol khah lou thil kabol lou hile, chonset anei lou dingu ahin; tuvangin amahon keima le ka Pa kakop lhonin eimutaovin, ho jong eiho taove."},"25":{"text":"Ahoi hijongle adanthubu uva, Ajeh beijin eihove, tia kisun chu guilhuna dinga abolu ahi.","ref":"Labu 35:19; 69:4"},"26":{"text":"Ahin keiman Pa koma kona kahinsol ding Lhamonsah, Pa-a kona hungpotdoh Lhagao Theng chu ahungteng, Ama chun keima thudol ahettohsah ding;"},"27":{"text":"Chule nangho jong atila pat kaumpi jing nahi jeh uva chu, kathu hettohsah-a napan dingu ahi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nakipal lhuh louna dinguva, thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve."},"2":{"text":"Amahon kikhopna-a kona nahin kaidoh dingu; koihile nathat chanu chu Pathen dinga napha tonga kingaito ding phat chu hung lhung ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amahon Pa le keima eihet loujeh uva, thil hicheng chu nangho chunga aboldingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin hitiho phat chu ahung lhun tengle, keimatah-in kaseipehsa chengseu hi nageldohna dinguva, thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve. Keiman nangho kaumpi jeh uva, atila chu kanasei lou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tuvanga eihinsolpa henga kache ding ahitai; ahivangin, Hoija nache dingham? tin koiman neidong pouve.","title":"Lhagao Theng Natoh"},"6":{"text":"Ahin thu hicheng chu kasei jeh-in, nalungu lunghem adimjotai."},"7":{"text":"Hijongle keiman nangho thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve; kache dinghi nangho dinga phajo ahi; ijeh-inem itile keima kache loule Lhamonsah chu naheng uva hung lou ding ahi; kache vangle, keiman ama chu naheng uva kahinsol ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule Ama chu ahung teng, vannoi mitehi chonset thudol, chonphat thudol, chule thutan thudola themmo achan aphotchet ding ahi:"},"9":{"text":"Chonset thudola athemo naochu, ajehchu amahon keima eitahsan pouve;"},"10":{"text":"Chonphat thudola athemo naochu, ajehchu keima ka Pa henga che ding kahin, chule nanghon keima neimulou dingu ahitai;"},"11":{"text":"Chule thutan thudola athemo naochu, ajehchu hiche vannoi pipupa thu kitana ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Nangho jah-a sei ding thu tamtah kaneije, hijongle tun nadol joupouve."},"13":{"text":"Thutah Lhagao chu ahung teng vangle, ama chun thutah lam jouse-a nangho napuihoi dingu ahi; ijeh-inem itile aman achama asei lou ding, ajah chan asei dingbou ahi; chule aman khonung thil hunglhung dingho namusah dingu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ama chun keima eichoi-at ding ahi; ijeh inem itile aman keima-a um chengse chu alah-a, chule nangho nahetsah dingu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Pa nei chengse chu aboncha keija ahin; hiche jeh-a chu, Aman keima-a um chengse chu alah-a, nangho nahetsah dingu ahi, tia kasei ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chomkhat joule nanghon keima neimulou dingu ahitai; chule chomcha khat joule neimukit dingu ahi, ajeh chu Pa koma cheding kahi, ati.","title":"Lunghemna Leh Kipana"},"17":{"text":"Hichea chun aseijuiho khatle khat akihouvun, Chomkhat joule neimu lou dingu; chule chomcha khat joule neimu kit dingu; chule, ijeh-inem itile keima Pa henga che ding kahi ati hi ipi eiseipeh-u hintem? akitiuve."},"18":{"text":"Hijeh chun amahon, Chomcha khat jou, ati hiche hi ipi ati naham? ipi asei ahi ihepouve, atiuve."},"19":{"text":"Adoh nomu chu Jesu'n ahen, ajah uva, Chomcha khat joule neimu lou dingu, chomcha khat joule neimu kit dingu, kati chu itidol ahi khatle khat kidongtoa nahiuvem?"},"20":{"text":"Keiman nangho tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Nangho nakauva chule namao dingu, vannoi mite vang kipah ding ahiuve; nangho nalunghem dingu, ahivanga nalunghemnau chu kipana hung sohdoh ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Numei naoso natnin aphah tengle alunghem lhehji-e, ajeh chu aphat hunglhunga ahitai: ahin acha chu asolhah teng vangle, vannoi'a mihem khat apen jeh chun akipahjin, alungdon hesoh chu aheji tapoi."},"22":{"text":"Hiche banga chu nangho jong tu-a nalunghemu ahi; ahivangin keiman nangho kamukit ding nahiuve, chutengle nalungu kipah ding, chule hiche nakipanao chu koiman nalahpeh lou dingu ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule keima imacha neidoh lou dingu ahi. Keiman nangho tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Pa henga ipihile keima mina nathum channu chu, aman napeh dingu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tu geihin nanghon kaminin ima nathum hihlai juve; nakipanao suhchamkima aumna dingin, thumun chutile namu dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Thu hicheng hi keiman nangho jah-a alema kasei ahi; alema sei louva, phongtah-a nangho Pa thu kahetsahna dingu phat hung lhung ding ahi.","title":"Vannoi Chunga Galjona"},"26":{"text":"Hiche ni chule kamina nathum dingu ahi; chule nangho dingin keima Pa henga taovinge, kati ahipoi;"},"27":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Pa amatah-in nangho nangailu uve, ajehchu nanghon keima neingailuvin, chule keima Pathen na kona hung kahi natahsan taovin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Keima Pa koma kona vannoi'a hunga kahin; avela, vannoi kadalhah-a Pa henga che kit ding kahi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chutah-in aseijuiten, Ven, nangman tun thu alema seita louvin, phongtah-in naseije."},"30":{"text":"Nangman ijakai nahesoh-in, chule mi koimachan nangma nadoh ding chu nangaipoi, ti tun kahe taove. Hichea kon hin nangma Pathen koma kona hung nahi ti katahsanui, atiuve."},"31":{"text":"Jesu'n amaho chu adonbutnin, Tuabou natahsan um?"},"32":{"text":"Veuvin, nangho nangma nangma-a cheh-a navacheh sohkeijuva, keima kachanga neidalhah dingu phat ahung lhunge, henge, ahung lhungtai; ahivangin keima kachang kahipoi, ijeh-inem itile Pan keima eiumpinai."},"33":{"text":"Nanghon keija lungmonna namu theina dinguva, thu hicheng hi najah uva kasei ahi. Vannoi'a hesoh gentheina nanei dingu ahi; ahivangin kipah-un; keiman vannoi kajoutai, ati."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu'n thu hiche chu aseijin, van lam ave, Pa, phat chu ahung lhungtai; Na Chapan jong nangma nachoi-at theina dingin, na chapa choi-anin;","title":"Jesu Aseijuite Dinga Atao"},"2":{"text":"Nangman ama napeh ho jouse chu, aboncha aman tonsot hinna apeh dinga, nangman ama chu mi jouse chunga thuneina napeh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Pathen tahbeh khatseh nangma, chule nangman nasol Jesu Khrista ahetdoh dingu hi, tonsot hinna ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nangman bol dinga thil neipeh chu kajouvin, leiset chungah nangma kachoi-an tai."},"5":{"text":"Chule tun, Pa, vannoi um masanga nangma toh kaneikhom loupina-a chun, nangma tahtoh kigomin neichoi-anin."},"6":{"text":"Nangman vannoi'a kona neipeh miho jah-a namin kaphon ahitai; amaho nanga ahiuvin, nangin amaho chu keima neipeh ahi; chule amahon nathu anit taove."},"7":{"text":"Tun amahon nangman keima neipeh thil chengse hi nanga kon ahi ahetauve."},"8":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile nangman keima neipeh thuho chu keiman amaho kapen; chule amahon hitiho chu asangun, chule keima nanga kona hung kahi kichenin aheuvin, chule nangma sol kahi atahsan taove."},"9":{"text":"Amaho dinga katao ahi. Vannoi dinga katao ahipoi, ahin nangman keima neipeh ho dinga bou katao ahi, ijeh-inem itile amaho nanga ahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Chule keija jouse chu nanga ahin, nanga chu keija ahi; chule amaho-a hin choi-atnin kaume."},"11":{"text":"Chule tu-a hi keima vannoi'a hi umlouva kahitai, amaho vanghi vannoi'a aumna laijuve, chule keima nahenga hung kahitai. Ka Pa Theng, eini pumkhat ihi banga, amaho jong pumkhat ahi theina dingun, nangman neipeh chengse hi, naminin hongin."},"12":{"text":"Keima amahotoh vannoi'a kaum lai chun, namina amaho chu kanahon ahi; nangman neipeh chengse chu kahong bitnin, khatcha jong amangthah aumpoi; Pathen lekhabua thu guilhunan, mangthah chapa bouchu amangthah tai.","ref":"Labu 41:9; Jhn 13:18"},"13":{"text":"Tu vangin nahenga hung kahitai; chule kakipana amahon aneikim nadinguva, vannoi'a hiche thuhi kasei ahi."},"14":{"text":"Keiman nathu amaho kapetai; chule keima vannoi'a kahilou banga amaho jong vannoi'a ahilou jeh-un, vannoi miten ahotauve."},"15":{"text":"Nangman amaho hi vannoi'a konin ladoh-in tia katao ahipoi, agilouva kona nahuhdoh nadinga katao joh ahibouve."},"16":{"text":"Keima vannoi'a kahilou bangin, amaho jong vannoi'a ahipouve."},"17":{"text":"Na Thutah chun amaho hi suthengin; nangma thu chu thutah ahi."},"18":{"text":"Nangman keima vannoi'a neisol banga, keiman jong amaho hi vannoi'a kasol ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule amaho hi thutah-a suhthenga aum theina dinguva, amaho jala keima kakisuhtheng ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hitiho chang jeng dinga tao kahipoi, amaho thua kona keima eihin tahsan ding ho jouse dinga jong katao ahi;"},"21":{"text":"Pa, keima nangma sol kahi hi vannoi miten atahsan theina dinguva; nangma keija na-uma, keima nanga kaum banga hi, amaho jong eini-a aum theina dinga katao ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule eini pumkhat ihi banga, amaho jong pumkhat ahi nadingun; nangman keima neipeh loupina chu, keiman amaho kapetai."},"23":{"text":"Amaho chamkimtah-a pumkhat ahina dinguva, Keima amaho-a kauma, chule nangma keima-a na-uma; chule keima hi nangman neisola, keima nei nangailut banga amaho jong nangailut ahi ti vannoi'in ahetna dinga katao ahi."},"24":{"text":"Pa, nangman neipeh loupina chu, nangin neipehho hin amu theina dingun, keima umna-a chun kakoma amaho jong umleu kati ahi; ijeh inem itile vannoi bul kiphudoh masanga nangman neingailut ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Vo ka Pa chondihtah, vannoi miten nangma nahepouvin, kei vangin nangma kahen; chule nangman keima neisol hi, hiteho hin ahetauve."},"26":{"text":"Nangman kei neingailutna ngailut chu amaho-a auma, chule keima jong amaho-a kaumna dinga; namin amaho hi kahetsah ahitan, chule kahetsah kit jing ding ahi, ati."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu'n thu hicheng chu asei jouvin, aseijuiho toh apotdoh-in, Kidron vadung gal lama hon umna-a chun agalkaijun, chuin hon sunga chun amale aseijuiho alut taove.","title":"Jesu Amatnu (Matt 26:47-56 ; Mrk 14:43-50 ; Luk 22:47-53)"},"2":{"text":"Ama matsah-a pang Judas jong chun hiche kom mun chu ahet ahi; ijeh-inem itile Jesu'n aseijuite apuijia hikoma chu tamtah vei chejiuva ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chutah-in Judas'in sepaihon chule thempu pipuiho leh Pharisai ho-a kona sottolleho aloijin, meivah, meisel, chule hem manchah athouvin, hiche kom mun chu alhung taove."},"4":{"text":"Hichun achunga ipi ahung so ding Jesu'n abonchan ahen, apotdoh-in, amaho jah-a chun, Koi naholu ham? tin agadongin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amahon adonbutnun, Nazareth Jesu atiuve. Jesu'n ajah uva, Keima hi kahi, ati. Ama matsah-a pang Judas jong chu amaho lah-a chu dinga ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hitia chu aman ajah uva, Keima hi kahi, ati chun, amaho anung chonun tolah alhu jengun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin aman adong kitleuvin, Nanghon koi naholu ham? ati. Amahon, Nazareth Jesu, atiuve."},"8":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin, Keima hi kahi, tia najah uva kaseitah chula em; hijeh chun keima neiholu ahile hiteho hi chesah-un, ati."},"9":{"text":"Nangman keima neipeh chengse khatcha jong kamansahpoi, tia asei chu guilhuna dinga chutia ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hichun Simon Peter'in chemjam khat anei ahin, asatdoh-in, thempu chungnung sohpa asatnin ahile, ajetlam bilkol asatlhan ahi. Sohpa min chu Malchus ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n Peter jah-a, Chemjam chu apaija khumin. Pan eipeh khona chu kadon lou dingham? ati.","ref":"Matt 26:39; Mrk 14:36; Luk 22:42"},"12":{"text":"Chuin sepaihon le apipuipau toh chule Judah ho sottollehon Jesu amanun akanun,","title":"Anna angsunga Jesu"},"13":{"text":"Anna henga apui masaove; ijeh-inem itile chuche kum-a thempu chungnunga pang Caiaphas nupapa ahi."},"14":{"text":"Miho jouse dinga mi khat athi aphajoi, tia Judah ho thumop chu hiche Caiaphas hi ahi.","ref":"Jhn 11:49-50"},"15":{"text":"Chuin Simon Peter'in Jesu nung ajuijin, chutobang chun aseijui dang khatnin jong ajuije. Chuche seijui chu thempu chungnung chutoh kihe-a ahin, Jesu toh thakhatnin thempu chungnung inpi tolah alut lhontan ahi.","title":"Peter'in Jesu Aseilep (Matt 26:69-70 ; Mrk 14:66-68 ; Luk 22:55-57)"},"16":{"text":"Peter vang chu kotpo lama adingin ahi. Chuin thempu chungnung toh kihe-a seijui chu ahung potnin, kot ngahnu jah-a chun aseijin, Peter chu asungah apuilut tai."},"17":{"text":"Hichun hiche kot ngah nungahnu chun Peter jah-a, Nang jong hichepa seijui ho lah-a khat nahi hilouham? atile aman, Kahipoi, atitai."},"18":{"text":"Chule hiche koma chu soh ho le sottolleho chu dinguva, adap jeh-a meihol akitiuva, kisang lumu ahi; Chuin Peter jong amaho to adingin, mei chu a-oijin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hichun thempu chungnung chun Jesu chu aseijuiho le athuhil thudol adongtan ahi.","title":"Thempu Chungnungin Jesu Thudoh Anei (Matt 26:59-66 ; Mrk 14:55-64 ; Luk 22:66-71)"},"20":{"text":"Jesu'n ama adonbutnin, Keiman vannoi mite anga phongtah-a kasei anahitan; keiman Judah ho kikhop khomji namun kikhopna inho le houin'a jenga jong kanahil jingpeh ahi; guhthima kasei aumpoi."},"21":{"text":"Ibola keima neidoh ham? Ajah uva ipi kasei aja-a amaho chu dongtan; ven, ipi thu kasei amahon ahenauve, ati."},"22":{"text":"Aman thu hicheng chu aseijouvin, akoma ding sottolleho lah-a khatnin Jesu chu akhutphanga angeiphe abengin, Thempu chungnung hitia chu kidonbut ngaijem? ati."},"23":{"text":"Jesu'n ama chu adonbutnin, Thu gilou kasei ahile, kathusei gilou aphotchenna neihetsah-in; thupha kasei ahile, ibola neiden ham? ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Annan ama chu akikan pumin Caiaphas thempu chungnung hengah asoltai."},"25":{"text":"Hichea chu Simon Peter'in dinmuna mei a-oi ahin; chuin amahon, Nangma jong aseijuiho lah-a khat nahim? tin adongun ahile, ama akilepmin, Kahipoi, ati.","title":"Peter'in Jesu Avela Aseilep Kit (Matt 26:71-75 ; Mrk 14:69-72 ; Luk 22:58-62)"},"26":{"text":"Thempu chungnung soh ho lah-a mikhat, Peter'in abilkol asatlhah pehpa inko khatnin ajah-a, Keiman hona chu nangma amatoh kamu hilou nahim? ati."},"27":{"text":"Peter akilep kit tai. Chuin chupet tah chun ahchal akhongtan ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuin amahon Jesu chu Caiaphas in'a konin thutanna in lama akaitaove; hichu jingkah matah ahin; ahivangin kalchuh kut an aneh theina dinguva, akisuhboh louna dingun, thutanna in'a chun amaho alutpouve.","title":"Gamvaipo Pilate Anga Jesu Akipui (Matt 27:1-2 ; 11:14 ; Mrk 15:1-5 ; Luk 23:1-5)"},"29":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pilate apotdoh-in, amaho chu adongin, Hichepa hehna-a achunga ipi thu naneijum? ati."},"30":{"text":"Amahon adonbutnun, ajah-a, Ama hi khangse lou hile nangma khutna pedoh pouvinge, atiuve."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Pilate'in ajah uva, Nanghon ama hi puijun lang, nangho dan ngaijin athu tantaovin, ati. Judah hon adonbutnun, Keiho dinga mi thading chu dan ngai ahipoi, atiuve."},"32":{"text":"Ama iti thia athi ding thudol Jesu'n asei chu guilhuna dinga chutia ahi.","ref":"Jhn 3:14; 12:32"},"33":{"text":"Hiche chun Pilate thutanna in sungah alut kitnin, Jesu akouvin ajah-a, Nangma Judah te lengpa nahim? ati."},"34":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin, Hichu nangman nachama naseiha, ole mi khattouvin keima thudol naseipeh ham? ati."},"35":{"text":"Pilate'in adonbutnin, Keima Judah mi kahim? Nanam mite le thempu pipuihon kakhutna eipehdoh nahi chu; ipi nabolset baham? ati."},"36":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin, Keima kagam hiche vannoi hi ahipoi; ka lenggam hiche vannoi hi hile, Judah ho khutna eikipehdoh louna dinga kasohten asat dingu ahi; ahinla tun kalenggam hi hichea kon ahipoi, ati."},"37":{"text":"Chuin Pilate'in, Ahile nangma leng nahim? ati. Jesu'n adonbutnin, Leng kahi chu naseikhai. Thutah thu hettohsah dinga hiche dinga hi hung penga, hiche dinga hi vannoi'a hunga kahi. Thutah he chan chun ka-aw angaije, ati."},"38":{"text":"Pilate'in ajah-a, Ipiham thutah chu, ati. Chuin hiche chu aseijin, Judah ho henga chun agapotdoh kitnin, ajah uva, Achungah themona kamudoh hihhele."},"39":{"text":"Ahivangin nanghon kalchuh kut tengle mikhat kalhadohpeh dingu chonna ngai khat naneijui; hijeh chun Judah Lengpa hi lhadohpeh leuveng nalungu ham? ati.","title":"Jesu Tha Dinga Athu Akitanlhah (Matt 27:15-31 ; Mrk 15:6-20 ; Luk 23:13-25)"},"40":{"text":"Chutah chun amahon, Hichepa hihih hen, Barabbas joh hihen, tin asamtauve. Barabbas chu gucha michom ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chutah-in Pilate'in Jesu alan, ajeptai."},"2":{"text":"Chuin sepaihon ling lukhuh aphanun, alua akhuhpeh-un, chule ponsandup asilpeh-un,"},"3":{"text":"Chuin akoma ahungun, Chibai, Judah te Lengpa! atiuvin akhutnuva adengpan taovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Pilate agapot kitleuvin, ajah uva, Veuvin, akhan gitlouna ima kamu lou nahetna dinguva, ama naheng uva kahin puidoh ahi, ati."},"5":{"text":"Hiche chun Jesu ling lukhuh khuhle, ponsandup sil pum chun ahung potdoh-in ahi. Chuin Pilate'in ajah uvah, Veuvin mihem hi! ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin thempu pipuiho le sottolle hon ama chu amutah-un, Thingpel'a khenbeh-in, thingpel'a khenbeh-in! tin asamtauve. Pilate'in, Nanghon kaijun lang thingpel'a khenbeh taovin; ajeh chu keiman akhan gitlouna kamupoi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Judah hon adonbutnun, Keihon dan khat kaneijun, hiche dan dungjuija chu thi dingdol ahi, ajehchu ama Pathen Chapa akihisah-e, atiuve."},"8":{"text":"Pilate'in hiche aseiju chu ajah phat chun, akicha cheh jengtan;"},"9":{"text":"Thutanna in sungah alut kitnin, Jesu jah-a, Nangma hoija kon nahim? ati. Ahivangin Jesu'n iman adonbutpoi."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pilate'in ajah-a, Neihou lou dingham? Nangma lhadohna ding jong chule thingpel'a khetbehna ding jong thu kanei hi nahet louham? ati."},"11":{"text":"Jesu'n adonbutnin, Chunga kona kipe lou hile chun, nangman kachunga thuneina himhim nanei lou ahi; hijeh chun nakhutna eipedohpa chonsetna achung nunge, ati."},"12":{"text":"Hichea pat chun Pilate'in ama chu lhadoh ding agotan ahi. Ahinla Judah hon asamun, Nangman mipa hi nalhadohle Caesar jol nahilou ahi; amale ama lenga kisem chan chu Caesar douna thusei ahi, atiuve."},"13":{"text":"Pilate'in thu chucheng ajah phat chun, Jesu chu ahin puidoh-in, chuin Songlhongnal atiu Hebrai paova Gabatha, atiu thutanna mun'a chun atoutan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hichu kalchuh kut dinga kigot ni, nidan gup dontah ahi. Chuin Judah ho jah-a, Veuvin, Nalengpau hi! ati."},"15":{"text":"Ahivangin amahon asamuvin, Sumangin, sumangin thingpelah khenbeh-in! atiuvin ahi. Pilate'in ajah uva, Nalengpau thingpel'a kakhetbeh dingham? ati. Hichun thempu pipuihon adonbutnun, Keihon, Caesar tailou leng kaneipouve, atiuvin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chutah-in aman ama chu thingpel'a khetbeh dingin akhutnuvah apedohtai. Chule amahon Jesu chu akaijun apuimang taovin ahi.","title":"Jesu Thingpel'a Akikhetbeh (Matt 27:32-44 ; Mrk 15:21-32 ; Luk 23:26-43)"},"17":{"text":"Chuin athingpel akiputnin Lugu mun atiu, Hebrai paova Golgotha atiu, mun chu jonin achedoh tan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hikoma chun ama thingpelah akhenbeh-un, chule mi ni asih langto gelah amatoh akhetbeh thaovin, Jesu chu alailhai."},"19":{"text":"Chuin Pilate'in aminchan lekhan asunin, thingpel leh-a chun atah-in ahi. Chule akisun chu, NAZARETH JESU, JUDAH TE LENGPA ti ahi."},"20":{"text":"Jesu thingpel'a kikhetbeh na mun chu khopi nai ahi jeh chun, hiche min kisun chu Judah ho tamtah-in asimun; hichu Hebrew paotoh, Latin paotoh, chule Greek paova kisun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hijeh chun Judah thempu pipuihon Pilate jah-a, Judah te Lengpa tin sun hih-in, Aman, Keima Judah te lengpa kahi ati, tin sunbovin atiuve."},"22":{"text":"Pilate'in adonbutnin, Kasutsa chu kasutsa ahitai, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin sepaihon Jesu chu thingpel'a akhetbeh jouvun, aponsil alauvin, hal li asouvin, sepai khat chu khat hal khat cheh achangui; chule asangkhol jong chu alauvin ahi. Asangkhol chu khui lou ahin, alua pat ato geija kikhong lhungkei ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hijeh chun khatle khat akihouvun, Hiche hi botsepou hite, koipen changam vang kiveuhite, akitiuve. Pathen lekha bu thua kisei, Kaponsil akihomun, Kasangkhol avangpha pha changhen tin vang asantauve, ti chu guilhuna dinga, sepaihon hitia chu abolu ahi.","ref":"Labu 22:18"},"25":{"text":"Tun Jesu thingpel koma chun anutoh anu sopinu, Cleopas inneipi Mariam, chule Mariam Magdalene adingun ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n anu le aman angailut aseijui chu akoma adin amu phat chun, anu jah-a, Numei, ven, nachapa chu, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin aseijui jah-a ma chun, Ven, nanu chu, ati. Chuin hiche-a pat chun seijui chun anu chu ama in'ah apuitai."},"28":{"text":"Hiche jou chun Jesu'n thil ijakai akichai soh chu ahen, Pathen lekhabua thu chu guilhunsoh theinan, Kadang achah-e, ati.","title":"Jesu Thi (Matt 27:45-56 ; Mrk 15:33-41 ; Luk 23:44-49)","ref":"Labu 69:21; 22:15."},"29":{"text":"Chukoma chu bel khatna theitwi thuh kitung ahin, chuin twichop pon theitwi thuh dimsetnin, hyssop mol leh-a atah-un, akamtoh agah sutouvin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Jesu'n theitwi thuh chu adonin, Akichaitai, ati. Chuin akaikun alhagao alhadohtan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Chuin kigin ni ahi jeh chun, cholngah ni-a thilongho chu thingpel'a aumden louna dingin, (ijeh inem itile hiche cholngah ni chu niloupi ni ahi,) Judah hon Pilate henga akeng gaheboh dingle, along galah mangna dingin athumun ahi.","title":"Jesu Tenga Akisut"},"32":{"text":"Hichun sepaiho chu ahungun, akikhet behpi amasapa kengle khatpa keng chu aheh bongui."},"33":{"text":"Ahin Jesu kom ahung geijun, athisa anahitah chu amuvin, akeng ahehbong tapouve."},"34":{"text":"Ahi vangin sepaiho lah-a tengcha choi khat chun atengin anah agahsunin ahile, chua chun thisan le twisih ahung longlha paijen jengin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chule amupa tah chun ahettohsah ahin, chule ama thu hettohsah chu tahbeh ahi: chule aman atahbeh asei ahi chu ahei; nanghon jong natahsan theina dinguva, ahi."},"36":{"text":"Pathen lekhabua, Agu khatcha jong kihehbong lou ding, ati chu guilhuna dinga, thil hicheng chu soh-a ahitai.","ref":"Pot 12:46; Minb 9:12; Labu 34:20"},"37":{"text":"Pathen lekhabu thu dangman, Amahon asutpao chu avet dingu ahi, ati.","ref":"Zech 12:10; Tph 1:7"},"38":{"text":"Chuin hicheng jou chun Arimathea khomi Joseph, Judah ho gina guhthima Jesu seijui hia chun, Jesu long chu pohdoh dingin Pilate henga agathumin ahile, Pilate'in anaphal pehtai. Hijeh chun ama ahungin, Jesu long chu ahung ladohtai.","title":"Jesu Avuiju (Matt 27:57-61 ; Mrk 15:42-47 ; Luk 23:50-56)"},"39":{"text":"Chuin Nicodemus, atila jana Jesu henga hunga chun, myrrh le aloes kihal ser somnga tobang ahinchoijin ahungin ahi.","ref":"Jhn 3:1-2"},"40":{"text":"Chuti chun amahon Jesu long chu alauvin, Judah ho kivui ngai bangin, lounamtui toh tupat ponnemin atomtaovin ahi."},"41":{"text":"Chule thingpel'a akhetbehnao mun'a chu hon khat uma ahin; hona chu koima lupsahna khah louhel lhan thah khat uma ahi."},"42":{"text":"Hijeh chun Judah ho kigin ni ahi jeh chun, chukoma chun Jesu chu alupsah taove; ijeh inem itile lhan chu akomcha-a uma ahi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin hapta nikho masa ni jingpin, kho athimna laijin, Mariam Magdalene chu lhana chun agachen ahile, song chu lhana kona tahdohsa aum agamui.","title":"Lhan Agohkeo Ahi (Matt 28:1-8 ; Mrk 16:1-8 ; Luk 24:1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Hiche chun amanu Simon Peter le seijui dang, Jesu'n angailut henga chun, alhaijelin, ajah lhona, Pakai chu lhana konin apomang taove, chule hoija alupsah-u kahepouve, ati."},"3":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun Peter achedoh-in, seijui dangpa jong chu ahi lhonin, lhan lama chun ache lhone."},"4":{"text":"Hitichun thakhatnin alhai lhonin ahile seijui dang chun Peter akhelin, lhan phung chu alhung masatai."},"5":{"text":"Chuin akunin asung agahvetle, tupat ponnem ho um chu amun, ahivangin asungah alutpoi."},"6":{"text":"Simon Peter jong hiche chun anung nungah ahungin, chuin lhan sunga chun alutnin, chule tupat ponnem ho aum chu amun,"},"7":{"text":"Alu chunga um ultheh pon chu tupat ponnem ho chutoh umtha louva, akijela atuma anaum agamun ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chutah chun seijui dang lhan phung lhung masajopa jong chu alutnin, amun, atahsan tai."},"9":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile athia kona thoudoh kit ding tia asei, Pathen lekhabu thu chu ahet loulaiju ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chutichun seijuite ni chu a-in lam gela achemang lhontan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Mariam vang chu lhan pama chun adingin akap kapmin; aka pum chun akunin lhan sung chu agahven ahile,","title":"Jesu Mariam Henga Akilah (Matt 28:9-10 ; Mrk 16:9-11)"},"12":{"text":"Abana bang vantil ni Jesu long alupsah naova chu khat alulhuna atouva, khat akeng todopma atou amui."},"13":{"text":"Chuin amani chun ajah-a, Numei, ibola nakaham? ati lhonin ahile, amanun ajah lhonah, Ajeh chu ka Pakai apomangun, hoija akoiju kahepoi, ati."},"14":{"text":"Chutia ati jou chun, akinung heijin ahile Jesu adin amun, Jesu ahi chu ahepoi."},"15":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah-a, Numei, ibola nakaham? koiham nahol? ati. Amanun honbol chun angaiton ajah-a, Pu, hikoma kona napohdoh ahile hoija nakoijem seijin, pomanging kate, ati."},"16":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah-a, Mariam ati. Amanu akiheijin, ajah-a, Rabboni ati; hichu houhil tina ahi."},"17":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah-a, Neitongkha hih-in; ijeh-inem itile keima Pa henga chun kakaltou hih laije; ahin chenlang kasopiho jah-a gaseijin, ka Pa, nangho Pa, ka Pathen, nangho Pathen henga kakaltouve, ati."},"18":{"text":"Mariam Magdalene chu achen, aseijuiho jah-a chun, Pakai chu kamutai, atin, chule ajah-a hiche thu asei jong chu agaseije."},"19":{"text":"Chuin hiche nikho mama nilhah lamin, hapta kipat ni ahito lhonin, aseijuite chu Judah ho gina kot akikha khum petnuvin, Jesu ahungin alah uva ahung dingin, ajah uva, Nachung uvah lungmon umhen, ati.","title":"Jesu Solchah ho Henga Akilah (Matt 28:16-20 ; Mrk 16:14-18 ; Luk 24:36-49)"},"20":{"text":"Aman hiche chu asei jouvin, amaho chu akhut le anah avetsahtan ahi. Chuin Pakai amu-u chu seijuite chu akipah lheh jengun ahi."},"21":{"text":"Hijeh chun Jesu'n ajah uva, Nachung uvah lungmon umhen, Pan keima eisol banga keiman nangho kasol nahiuve, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin aman hiche chu asei jouvin, amaho chu ahu alha khumin, Lhagao Theng changun;"},"23":{"text":"Koi hile achonset nasuhbeiju chu, kisubeija ahi; achonset na-umsah-u chu, akiumsah ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 16:19; 18:18"},"24":{"text":"Somleni lah-a khat, Thomas Didymus atiu, vang chu Jesu hunga chu amaho lah-a chu umlou ahi.","title":"Jesu Chule Thomas"},"25":{"text":"Hiche chun seijui dangho chun ajah-a, Keihon Pakai chu kamutaove, atiuvin ahi. Ahivangin aman ajah uva, akhutphang thingkil maha kamua, kakhut junga kakhoija, anah kakhutna katham lousen tahsan ponge, ati."},"26":{"text":"Chuin ni get jouman seijuite in sunga aum pettah-un, chule Thomas jong amaho toh uma ahin; kot kikhah sohkeija ahin, Jesu ahung kitnin alah uva ahung dingin, Nachung uva lungmon umhen, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Thomas jah-a, Nakhut jungin hinkhoijin, kakhut teni hi ven; nakhut hin lhangin lang kanah thamin; chule gingchalel louvin tahsanin, ati."},"28":{"text":"Thomas'in adonbutnin ajah-a, ka Pakai le ka Pathen, ati."},"29":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah-a, Thomas, Neimu jeh-a natahsan ahi, mu louva tahsan ho anun nomui, ati."},"30":{"text":"Tahbeh-a Jesu'n aseijuite angsunga melchihna kidang tamtah abol ahin, hitiho chu hiche lekhabu sunga hin akisunpoi.","title":"Hiche Lekhabu Kisut Lo"},"31":{"text":"Jesu chu Pathen Chapa Christa ahi chu natahsan uva, natahsan vanguva ama mina hinna nanei thei nadinguva, hichengse hi kisuna ahibouve."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche jou chun Tiberia dillen pangah Jesu aseijuite henga akilah kitleuvin; chule akilah chu hiti hi ahi.","title":"Jesu Seijui Sagi Henga Akilah"},"2":{"text":"Simon Peter le Didymus atiu Thomas chutoh, Galilee gam Canna kho-a mi Nathanael toh, Zebedai chapa teni toh, chule seijui dang ni toh um khoma ahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Simon Peter'in amaho henga, keima nga manin chenge ati. Amahon ajah-a, Keiho jong kahungdiu ahi, atiuvin ahi. Chuin acheuvin kong khatna gangtah-in alutpai taove. Chule hiche jan chun imacha amanpouvin ahi.","ref":"Luk 5:5"},"4":{"text":"Ahin jingkah ahunghi phatnin, Jesu vaokamah adingin; ahivangin seijui ho chun Jesu ahi chu ahepouve."},"5":{"text":"Hichun Jesu'n ajah uva, Chate, neh ding ima naneijum? ati. Amahon, Kanei pouve, atiuve."},"6":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah uva, Kong sih jet lama chun len sepleu chun namat dingu ahi, ati. Hijeh chun amahon asepmuvin ahile, nga atama atam jeh chun akaijou tapouve.","ref":"Luk 5:6."},"7":{"text":"Hichun Jesu'n angailut seijui chun Peter jah-a, Pakai ahi, ati. Peter'in, Pakai ahi, ti chu ajah phat chun, sangkhol aki-ah loijin (ijeh inem itile asagoh keova um ahin) dillena chun achomlhan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahin seijui dangse vang chu nga dimset len akaijun, kongneo khatna ahung kitolun ahi; (ijeh-inem itile amaho chu tolla kona gamla lou ahiuvin, tong ja ni tobang bou kikah ahiuve)."},"9":{"text":"Chutichun tolgo agei phatnun, chukoma chu songmeihol meija kitihle, achunga nga kikoi, chule changlhah amuvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah uva, Tu tahtah-a namatnu nga chu phabep galaovin, ati."},"11":{"text":"Hiche chun Simon Peter kong'a akaldoh-in, nga len ja khatle somnga le thum dimset len chu agakaijin; nga achuti tam vang chun alen chu a-ehpon ahi."},"12":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah uva, Hungun jing an hung neuvin, ati. Chule Pakai ahi chu aheuvin, seijui ho khatcha jong, Koi nahim? tia dong ngama aumpouve."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Jesu ahungin, changlhah chu alan, amaho chu apen, chutobang machun nga jongchu apei."},"14":{"text":"Hiche chu athia kona athodoh nunga aseijuite henga akilah athumveina ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin ajing anneh-u achaijun, Jesu'n Simon Peter jah-a, Jonah chapa, Simon, nangman hicheho sanga hi neingailut joh-em? ati. Aman ajah-a, Henge Pakai; kangailut nangin nahenai, ati. Aman ajah-a, Ka kelngoi nouho vah-in, ati.","title":"Jesu Chule Peter"},"16":{"text":"Ani veinan ajah-a, Jonah chapa, Simon, nangman neingailut em? ati. Aman ajah-a, Henge Pakai; kangailut nangman nahenai, ati. Aman ajah-a, Ka kelngoiho chingin ati."},"17":{"text":"Chuin athum veinan ajah-a, Jonah chapa, Simon, nangin neingailut em? ati. Aman thum veijen, Neingailut em? ati jeh chun Peter alungnom motan, ajah-a, Pakai, nangman ijakai nahenai; keiman nangma kangailut nangman nahenai ati. Jesu'n ajah-a, Ka kelngoi ho vah-in."},"18":{"text":"Tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahi, nachapan laija chu nangman natai nakigah-a, nachena nom noma nacheji ahi; na-upat teng vangle, nakhut najah-a midangin natai nagahpeh ding, chule nache nom louna lam lama napui ding ahi, ati."},"19":{"text":"Hichu ama iti thia athi-a, Pathen achoi-at ding chu hetsahna-a, asei ahi. Chuin hiche chu asei jouvin ajah-a, Neijuijin, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin Peter akiheijin ahile, ajan anneh uva a-anga kingaija, Napedoh-a pang dinga chu koiham? tia donga, Jesu'n angailut seijui chun ajui amui.","title":"Jesu Chule Seijui Dangkhat"},"21":{"text":"Peter'in amachu amuphatnin, Jesu jah-a, Pakai, hichepa hi iti dingham? ati."},"22":{"text":"Jesu'n ajah-a, Kahung kahse-a ama hi aumden ding deileng, nang dinga hichu ipidi hiding ham? Nangman kanung juijin, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chuin hiche seijui chu thi lou ding ahi tin sopite lah-a athangtan ahi; ahinla Jesu'n ama jah-a chu, Ama chu thi lou ding ahi, ati ahipon, Kahung kahse-a ama hi aumden ding deileng, nang dinga hichu ipidi hiding ham? ati ahibouve."},"24":{"text":"Hicheng thu hettohsah-a, chule hicheng thu suna hi hiche seijui chu ahin; chule ama thu hettohsah chu tahbeh ahi ti kaheuve.","title":"Thuchaina"},"25":{"text":"Chule hicheng tailouvin jong Jesu thilbol tamtah aumin, hitiho chu abonchan kisun sohkeile, kei ngaiton, lekhabu kisun chengse chu vannoi leiset hin dolponte. Amen."}}}}},"44":{"info":{"name":"Solchah","shortname":"Sol","abbr":[],"desc":"Solchah ho Thilbol"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo Theophilus, lekha masa-a chun Jesu thilbol le athuhil kipattil thudol jouse,","title":"Thu Makai","ref":"Luk 1:1-4."},"2":{"text":"Asolchah lhenho Lhagao Thenga thu apeh jouva lahtouva aum ni geija thu chu kanasunin ahi:"},"3":{"text":"Gim genthei athoh jouvin, chuche solchah ho chu thontheilou hetphotna tamtah toh thon ahingin akimusah in, nisomli geijin ahenguva akilah jin, Pathen lenggam thudol aseijin:"},"4":{"text":"Chule amahotoh aum khomin, amaho chu hiche thuhi apen, Nanghon Jerusalem dalha hih-un; Pa thutep keija kona najah-u chu ngah jingun.","ref":"Luk 24:49"},"5":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile John chun twija baptize achansah ahin, nangho vang tukal ni phabep joule Lhagao Thenga baptize nachan dingu ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 3:11; Mrk 1:8; Luk 3:16; Jhn 1:33"},"6":{"text":"Hichun amaho ahung kikhomun ajah-a, Pakai tu-a hi Israelte gam nakiledoh sah kit dingham? tin adongui.","title":"Jesu Van'a Akaltou"},"7":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah uva, Pan athuneina-a angaitoa agot phat le nikho chu nangho het dingdol ahipoi."},"8":{"text":"Amavang Lhagao Theng nachung uva ahung lhun tengle nanghon thahat nanei dingu ahi; chule nangho Jerusalem'a jong, Juda gamsung le, Samaria gamsung, chule leiset chung gam jouse-a, kolmong geija kathu hettohsah-a napan dingu ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 28:19; Mrk 16:15; Luk 24:47-48"},"9":{"text":"Chuin thu hicheng chu asei jouvin, amahon avet vet pettah-un ama lahtouvin aumin; amitmuva konin meilhang khatnin atolmangtan ahi.","ref":"Mrk 16:19; Luk 24:50-51"},"10":{"text":"Chuin akaltouva van lam avet vet pettah-un, veuvin, ponbang sil mi ni akenguvah ahung dingin;"},"11":{"text":"Miteni chun, Nangho Galilee gam miho, ibola nadin uva van lam navet jinguham? Hiche Jesu nangho koma kona van'a kilatou hi, van'a akaltou namu bang banguva hi hung ding ahi, ati lhone."},"12":{"text":"Chutah-in Olivet molsanga kon chun Jerusalem'a akiletaove; hichu Jerusalem komcha ahin cholngah ni lampi bou ahi.","title":"Juda Iscariot Khelding Kilhen"},"13":{"text":"Chuin alhunun, aumnao indan chungnunga chun aluttou taove. Peter, le Jacob, John le Andrew, Philip le Thomas, Bartholomew le Matthew, Alphaeus chapa Jacob le Zealot Simon, chule Jacob chapa Judas; hicheng chu ahiuve.","ref":"Matt 10:2-4; Mrk 3:16-19; Luk 6:14-16"},"14":{"text":"Hiteho chengse chu numei phabep toh, Jesu nu Mariam toh, asopiteho toh, lungkhat tah-in taona le ngehna ajomjing taove."},"15":{"text":"Hiche nikho lai chun Peter seijui ho lah-a adingdoh-in (mipi akikhoma chu mi jale somni jen ahiuve,)"},"16":{"text":"Sopiteho, Jesu manho lamkaija pang Judas chungchang thudol, Lhagao Thengin David kama aseisah Pathen lekhabua thu chu guilhung ding mong ahi;"},"17":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile ama chu eiho lah-a kisimtha ahin, chule hiche lhacha natohna mun jonghi changa ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tun heche mipa hin khan gitlou man sumin leimun khat alamin, akhupbon achun, atumpi apohkeh-in, chule agil jouse ahungdoh tan ahi.","ref":"Matt 27:3-8."},"19":{"text":"Hiche thuhi Jerusalem'a cheng jousen ahesoh keije; hiti chun amaho paovin chuche leimun min chu Aceldama asahtaove; hichu thisan lei tina ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Labu-a, Ama chenna mun chu agoh keuvin umhen, chua chun koima cheng hihhen; chule apanmun chu midang changhen, tin akisune.","ref":"Labu 69:25; 109:8."},"21":{"text":"Hijeh chun, Pakai Jesu eiho lah-a achele ahungleh phatlai sungse,"},"22":{"text":"John'in baptize achansah-a pat, Pakai Jesu eihoa kona lahtouva aum ni geija ikiloi khompiu hiche miho lah-a khat hi, ama thodoh kit hettohsah-a eipanhu diuva lhentei ngaiding ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 3:16; Mrk 1:9; 16:19; Luk 3:21; 24:51"},"23":{"text":"Chuin mi ni, Barsabas atiu Joseph (amin chom Justus), le Matthias chu alheng doh-un ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin amaho ataovun, Vo mijouse lung hesoh Pakai, hiteni koijoh hi"},"25":{"text":"Chonset jala Judas'in ama mun'a achena dinga alha hiche lhacha na le solchah panmun chu lo dinga nalhenem neivet sah-un, atiuve."},"26":{"text":"Chuin amahon vang asanun ahile, avang sanu chu Mathias chunga achutan; hitichun ama chu solchah somlekhat chutoh akisimtha tai."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Pentecost ni lhingkeija ahunglhun phatnin, abonchauvin lungkhat tah-in munkhatna ana umkhomun ahi;","title":"Lhagao Theng Hungkum","ref":"Thmpu 23:15-21; Danb 16:9-11."},"2":{"text":"Chuin phulou helouvin van'a konin hui hattah nung gin tobang ahung gingin, atounau in chu adimsoh jengin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin meikong bangin lei ahung kilah-in, akikhen jal-in, alu chung cheh uva achongin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin amaho abonun Lhagao Theng adimset taovin, Lhagaovin aseidohsah bangun paochom paochomin thu asei pantaovin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hichea chu vannoi leiset gamtina chitin namtin lah-a kona hou gut Juda miho Jerusalem'a umuva ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin chuche thu akiseithang phat chun mipi ahung kikhomun, amitakipmin ama ama pao cheh-a thukisei ajah jeh-u chun, alung kichih lah jengun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin amaho chun adatmouvin kidang asauvin, khatle khat akihouvun, Veuvin, thu seiho hi abonchauva Galilee gam mi hilou hiuvem?"},"8":{"text":"Chule i-atile eihon amikipmin ipenna gam cheh paova thu kisei ijah-uham?"},"9":{"text":"Eihola abang Parthia mi, Media mi, Elam mi ihiuvin, abang Mesopotamia gama cheng, Juda gamale Cappadocia gama cheng, Pontus gamale Asia gama cheng,"},"10":{"text":"Phrygia le Pamphylia gama cheng, Egypt gama cheng, chule Cyrene gam vela Libya gama cheng ihiuvin; abang Rome'a kona hung kholjin, Juda ho le Juda chona chonho,"},"11":{"text":"Crete mile Arabia gam mi ihiuvin: ahivangin eima pao cheh-a Pathen thilbol loupi thu aseiju thakhat jah-in ijauvin, atiuvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin abonchau chun kidang asauvin adatmo lheh jengun, Itina ahidem, tin khatle khat akidongto taovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahivangin adangho chun ajontaijun, Hiteho lengpiga twithah khama hiuva hi, atiuve."},"14":{"text":"Ahin Peter somlekhat chutoh adingin, aw sangtah-in asamin, ajah uva, Juda gam mite le Jerusalem'a chengho, nanghon nabon chaovin hiche hi heuvin, chule kathusei lungna changin ngaijun.","title":"Pentecost Nikho-a Peter Thusei"},"15":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile hiteho hi nangho ngaito banga lengpitwi khama ahipouve; tu hi vai ahinalai bouve;"},"16":{"text":"Ahin hiche hi Joel themgaovin anasei;"},"17":{"text":"Ni nunungle hiti ding ahi, tin Pathen'in aseije Mi jouse chunga kalhagao kabuh lhah ding; nachapa teo le nachanu teo vin gaothu aseidoh dingu, nakhangdong houvin mu aneijuva, na-upa houvin mang amat dingu ahi.","ref":"Joel 2:28-32."},"18":{"text":"Ahi, hiche niteng chule kasoh pasal hole kasoh numei ho chunga jong Kalhagao kabuh lhah ding, chule amahon lhagao thu aseidoh dingu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule van'a thil kidang dang, noi leisetna melchihna ho; thisan, mei, meikhu kamusah ding;"},"20":{"text":"Pakai nikho loupitah le min thangtah chu ahunglhun masanga; Nisa chu muthim soh-a, Lha thisan soh ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule hiti ding ahi, Koi hijongle Pakai mina tao chan chu huhhing-a umding ahi, tia aseichu guilhunga ahibouve."},"22":{"text":"Nangho Israel mite, hiche thuhi ngaijun: Nazareth Jesu, Pathen'in amanchah-a nalah uva, bolmo kidang, datmo umho, chule melchihna ho abola kona chu Pathen'in nangho henga aphotchet ahin, hichu nanghon naheuve."},"23":{"text":"Ama chu Pathen'in ageltohsa le ahet masahsa bangin pehdoh-in aumtan ahile, nanghon namanun, lungsetna beihel khutho chun thingpellah nakhen beh-un, nathat taove.","ref":"Matt 27:35; Mrk 15:24; Luk 23:33; Jhn 19:18"},"24":{"text":"Ahin thina-in ama chu atuhden hoi ahilou jeh chun, Pathen'in thina-in akan chu asutlhap peh-in, akai thoutai.","ref":"Matt 28:5-8; Mrk 16:6; Luk 24:5"},"25":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile David'in ama thudola chun, Keiman Pakai chu kamaikoh-a kamu jinge, Ajeh chu keima kalon louna dingin, kakhut jet lamah aume.","ref":"Labu 16:8-11"},"26":{"text":"Hijeh chun kalung akipah-in, chule kalei athanome; chuche kalval chun katahsa jong kinema cholnga ding ahi;"},"27":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangman kalhagao damuna nadalhah lou ding, namitheng jong mon mangna namusah louding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Nangman keima hinna lampi neihetsah ahitan, namaiso-a kipana neidip ding ahi, tin anaseijin ahi."},"29":{"text":"Sopiteho, iphung bulpiu David thuhi olmo louhelin najah uva kasei theije, ama chu athin, akivuijin abuikhuh tu geijin ilah uva aum jinge."},"30":{"text":"Ama chu themgao ahijeh-in, tahsalam dola ataiguija kona alaltouna-a toudinga Christa chu ahin tundoh ding ahi tia, Pathen kihahsela athutep chu ahen;","ref":"Labu 132:11; 2 Sam 7:12-13"},"31":{"text":"Chutia chu khonung thu ahet masah jeh chun Christa thokit ding thu aseijin, thikhol khul'a dalhah denin aumpoi, alongin jong mon mangna amupoi, tia asei ahi."},"32":{"text":"Hiche Jesu chu Pathen'in akaithou kittan, ahetoh-a keiho kabonchao kahiuve."},"33":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pathen khut jet lamah choisangin aumin, athutepsa Lhagao Theng chu a-Pa-a konin amun, hichu ahin buhlhah-a, tu-a namu-u najah-uhi ahi."},"34":{"text":"David chu van'ah akalpoi, ahivangin amatah-in hiti hin aseije, Pakai chun ka Pakai jah-a, Kakhut jet lamah tou jingin,","ref":"Labu 110:1"},"35":{"text":"Keiman namelmaho nakeng chotpha kaneisah masangsen, ati."},"36":{"text":"Hijeh chun Israel insung mi jousen kichentah-in heuhen, hiche Jesu nanghon thingpel'a nakhetbeh-u chu, Pathen'in Pakai le Christa-a atun ahitai, ati."},"37":{"text":"Amahon thu hicheng chu ajah phatnun, alungu hema kisun abangin, Peter le solchah dangho jah-a, Miho chule sopite, keihon ipi kabol dingu ham? atiuve."},"38":{"text":"Chuin Peter'in ajah uvah, Nalung heijun, chule chonset suhbeinan Jesu Christa minin nabonchaovin baptize changcheh-un, chule Lhagao Theng kipe-a hi nachan dingu ahi."},"39":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile thutep chu nangho dingle nachateo ding, chule gamlatah-a umho, Pakai i-Pathen'un ama henga akou dingho jouse dinga ahi, ati."},"40":{"text":"Chule thu dang dang tamtah ahettohsah-in, chule amaho chu atilkhouvin, Tulai khang lung gilou ho-a konhin kihuh doh-un, ati."},"41":{"text":"Chutah chun kipahtah-a athu jop chanchu baptize achang taove; chule hiche nilele chun amaho chu mi sangthum jenin abetauve."},"42":{"text":"Chuin amaho chu solchah ho thuhila jong, kithokhomin jong, changlhah semkeh-in jong, chule taovin jong gunchu tah-in apang det jingtaove."},"43":{"text":"Hichun mitin chunga kichatna ahungchun; chule solchah ho chun thil kidang tamtah le, melchihna aboltauve.","title":"Tahsan masaho Hinkhoman"},"44":{"text":"Chule atahsan jouse chu aum khomun, thil jouse neilhangin aneijun:","ref":"Sol 4:32-35"},"45":{"text":"Chule anei agouhou le athilkeovu ajoh-un, abonchauvin angaichat akin tohkhambep cheh-in akihom jiuvin ahi."},"46":{"text":"Chule niseh-in lung khattah-in houin'ah gunchu tah-in aumdet jingun, in tina changlhah asemkeh-un, kipahle lung khatseh pun an anejiuvin,"},"47":{"text":"Pathen avahchoijun, chule mi jouse lungdeijin aumun ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin huhhing-a umho chu niseh-in houbung'a chun abe jingtan ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat Peter le John tao phatnin, hichu ni kihei ahin, houin'a achetou lhonin ahi.","title":"Elbai Khutdopa Kidamsah"},"2":{"text":"Chuin mi khat anu sunga apena elbaija peng ahinpouvin, houin alut jouse henga khut adoa thil akithum dinga, houin'a kotkhah hoi atiuva chu nisehle akoijiu ahi;"},"3":{"text":"Ama chun Peter le John houin'a alut ding lhon amu phatnin, thil eikipele tin anathumin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin Peter'in ama chu ave changmelin John toh ahin, Keini neive lhonin, ati."},"5":{"text":"Hichun aman ikhat mu akinemin lung lut tah-in avetan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahin, Peter'in, Dangka sana kaneipoi; ahivangin kaneisun penge: Nazareth Jesu Christa minin thoudoh-in lang lam jottan, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chuin aman akhut jetnin amanin, akai dingin ahile, chupettah chun akengphang le a-ah khomit guho ahatdohtai."},"8":{"text":"Hichun amapa chu akichomin adingin, lam ajotnin, amani chutoh houin'ah alutnin; avahlen, akichom akichomin, Pathen avahchoijin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin mi jousen avalea Pathen avahchoi chu amuvin;"},"10":{"text":"Chule houin Kotkhah hoi phunga touva khut dopa chu ahi aheuvin; chule achunga thil soh chu kidangle datmo um asa lheh jengun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin elbai akidamsah pan Peter le John atuhpet chun, miho jouse chun kidang asa behseh-un, Solomon kempum atiuva chun ahenguva ahung lhai khomun ahi.","title":"Houin'a Peter Thusei"},"12":{"text":"Chuin hichu Peter'in amu phatnin miho chu adonbutnin, Vo nangho Israel mite, ibola hichepa chunga hi kidang sa-a nahiuvem? Ole keihon keiho thahat le houdih vanga ama hi lam kajotsah theijuva nangaitouva, neivet vet jenguham?"},"13":{"text":"Abraham, Isaac, Jacob Pathen, ipu ipateu Pathen'in achapa Jesu chu achoi-at ahi; ama chu nanghon napedoh-un, Pilate angsung tah-a aman lhadoh dinga agotsan jongin napedoh jengui.","ref":"Pot 3:15"},"14":{"text":"Ahi, nanghon Athengpa le Chondihpa chu naleh doh-un, tolthat joh chu nalhadoh pehna dingun nathumun,","ref":"Matt 27:15-23; Mrk 15:6-14; Luk 23:13-23; Jhn 19:12-15"},"15":{"text":"Hinna Bulpi chu nathat taove; ahinla ama chu Pathen'in athiho lah-a konin akaithou kittan; ahetoh keiho hi kahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Chule ama min tahsan vanga amin chun nanghon nahet jingule namu jingu hichepa hi ahatsah ahitai: ahi, Ama-a kona tahsan chun hichepa hi nangho jouse mitmu-a adamsah hel ahitai."},"17":{"text":"Chule tun, sopite, hichu nahetlou jeh uva nangho le navaipo pipuhovin nabolu ahi kahei."},"18":{"text":"Ahivangin Pathen'in athemgaoho jouse kama aseisah, Christa chun gim genthei athoh ding ahi, ati chu hitia hi aguilhunsah ahibouve."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun nachonset nao chulmanga aum theina dingin nalung heijun, hung kilehei kitnun, chutile Pakai anga konin haldohna kiledohna phat chu hung lhung theijin tin;"},"20":{"text":"Chule naheng uva aphondohsa Christa Jesu chu naheng uva ahinsol thei ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Amavang imajouse akiledohsah kit phat kahse-a chu, van'in ama chu alahlut tahdi ding mong thu ahi; hiche thuhi Pathen'in atil abula patna athemgao thengho kama ahin seisahpeh ahi."},"22":{"text":"Mosi'n apu apateu jah-a, Pakai Pathen'in keima eitundoh banga hi, nangho dinga nasopiteu lah-a khat themgaova atundoh ding ahi; ama chun najah uva thu asei jouse chu nangai dingu ahi.","ref":"Danb 18:15,18"},"23":{"text":"Chule hiti ding ahi, koi hijongle chuche themgao thusei ngailou lou chu miho lah-a kona kisumanghel ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Danb 18:19"},"24":{"text":"Ahi, themgaoho jousen, Samuel'a pat anunga abanjom chengsen jong, thusei jousen tulai thusoh umchan ding hi anasei masatnu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Nangho themgaoho le Pathen'in napu napateu atepna thutep chate chu nahiuve, Pathen'in Abraham jah-a, Nangma chilhah-a kona vannoi leiset phung jouse phatthei chang ding ahi, tia atep chu.","ref":"Semt 22:18"},"26":{"text":"Pathen'in achapa Jesu chu akaithouvin, nagitlou nao chengseova kona lehei dingle, phatthei chansah dingin, nangho henga ahinsol masapenin ahi, ati."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin miho jah-a athusei pet lhonin, thempuho, houin vaipopa, chule Saddukai ho chu achung lhonah achuvin,","title":"Vaipoho Angsunga Peter le John"},"2":{"text":"Mi thu ahilhon le, Jesu vanga athi lah-a kona thokit thu ahil lhon jeh chun, alungphamo lheh jengui."},"3":{"text":"Chuin amani chu amanun, nilhah ahitah jeh chun, ajinga dingin mihenna in'ah akhumtaove."},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin athu jaho mi tamtah-in atahsanun; chule amijat chu sangnga jen ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, ajingin avaipoho chengseutoh, a-upaho chengseu, chule danthu sunho,"},"6":{"text":"Anna thempu chungnung toh, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, chule thempu chungnung inkote chengse toh Jerusalem'a akikhom khomun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin alailung uvah amani chu atungun, Ipi thuneina le koi mina hiche hi nabol lhonham, tin adongui."},"8":{"text":"Chutah-in Peter Lhagao Thengin adimsetnin ajah uva, Nangho, miho chunga vaipoho le Israel upaho,"},"9":{"text":"Tunia hiche michatmo pa phatna dinga thilpa kibol thua, hichepa ipi-a iti kiboldam hela hitam, tia eikidonga ahitah-a ahile,"},"10":{"text":"Nabonchaovin kihet cheh-un, chule Israel mi jousen hecheh hen, nanghon thingpel'a nakhetbeh-u Nazareth Jesu Christa, Pathen'in athiho lah-a kona akaithou, ama mina chu ama hi na-ang uva dama dinga ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Nangho insahon nadei mouva napaiju song, aninga apipena panga chu, ama hi ahi.","ref":"Labu 118:22"},"12":{"text":"Chule koima dangah huhhingna aumpoi; ijeh-inem itile vannoi'a mihemte lah-a huhhing-a iumna dinguva kipe-a min dang aumpoi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin Peter le John hakatje chu amu phatnun, lekha themlou ahi lhonle mimol ahi lhon chu aheuvin, adatmo lheh jengui; chule amani chu Jesu toh kivopsa ahi lhon chu ahedoh taove."},"14":{"text":"Chule mi akiboldampa chu amahotoh adin khom jing chu amuvin, adounan imacha aseithei tapouve."},"15":{"text":"Ahivangin amaho chu akikhop naova kona chu achoma gaumdoh dingin asoldoh-un, amahole amaho akihouvun,"},"16":{"text":"Hiche miho hi iba ilo dinguham? Amahon thil bolmo kidang datmotah abolu hila Jerusalem'a cheng mi jouse hetnin akiphong dohtan; eihon jongla ahipoi tin inel theipouve."},"17":{"text":"Hijongle hiche hi miho lah-a achal cheh cheh louna dingin, tukala Jesu mina hi thu asei kit louhelna dingun hagih-in gihsal uhite, akitiuve."},"18":{"text":"Chuin amani chu akouvun, Jesu mina thu aseija asei louhelna dingule, mi ahil louhelna dingun akhamchah taove."},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin Peter le Johan in adonbut lhonin ajah uva, Pathen thu sanga nangho thu ngaijoh chu Pathen mitmu-a dihnam, nanghon geltoh-un."},"20":{"text":"Keiho vang thil kamu chengseu le kajah chengseu sei louvin kaum theipouve, ati lhone."},"21":{"text":"Chuin amahon agihsal kitleuvun alhadoh taove, mipi jeh chun talent pehnaje ahepouve; ijeh-inem itile thil kibol jeh chun mi jousen Pathen avahchoijun ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile bolmo kidangtah kibolna-a kiboldam mipa chu kum somli chunga mi ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuin akilhadoh phat lhonin, aloiho henga ahung lhonin, ajah uva thempu pipuiho le upaho thusei chu alhut lhonin ahi.","title":"Hansan nadinga Tahsan ho Ataovu"},"24":{"text":"Chuin amahon hichu ajahtah-un, aw sangtah-in, lungkhat tah-in Pathen asamun, Vo Pakai, nangma vanle lei chule twikhanglen, chule asunga um jouse sema Pathen nahi;","ref":"Pot 20:11; Neh 9:6; Labu 146:6"},"25":{"text":"Nangman nalhacha David kamsunga, Namtin vaipi ibola lunghanga hiuvam? chule ibola mihon mohthil angaitou ham?","ref":"Labu 2:1-2"},"26":{"text":"Pakai le a-Christa chunga chun, Leiset chunga lengho apang golun, Chule avaipoteu akikhomui; tia nasei dohsah ahi."},"27":{"text":"Atahbeh-in, nangma thaonu nalhacha Theng Jesu dounan, Herod le Pontius Pilate, chidang namdangte toh Israel miho toh,","ref":"Matt 27:1,2; Mrk 15:1; Luk 23:1,7-11; Jhn 18:28-29."},"28":{"text":"Hung guilhung dinga nakhutle nalung thimin agonmasah chengse chu boldingin akikhomun ahi."},"29":{"text":"Tun, Pakai, ami gihsalnao hi vetan; chule nasohte hin hakat tah-a nathu aseina dingun;"},"30":{"text":"Nalhacha Theng Jesu mina melchihna le bolmo kidang dang abolna dingun, mi damsahna dingin nakhut lhangin atiuve."},"31":{"text":"Chuin amaho atao jouvun, akikhopnao chu ahung kilingin, abonchauvin Lhagao Thengin adimun, hakattah-in Pathen thu aseitaove."},"32":{"text":"Chuin mipi atahsan chengse chu lungkhatle thakhat ahiuvin; khatchan jong anei chu keija tum ahi tilouvin; thil jouse abonchan neilhangin aneitauve.","title":"Tahsan hon Thiljouse Neilhanga Aneikhomu","ref":"Sol 2:44-45."},"33":{"text":"Chuin solchah ho chun thahat chungnung tah-in Pakai Jesu thokit thu ahettohsah jiuvin; abonchauva chungah lungsetna nasatah aumtan ahi."},"34":{"text":"Alah uva jong koima alhasama aumpouve; ajeh chu gam ahiloule in nei jouse chun ajoh-un, chule athil joh manhou chu achoijun,"},"35":{"text":"Solchah ho keng bulah ahung koijiuvin, akin toh khambep cheh-in akihom jiuvin ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chuin Levi phung mi, Cyprus twikol gam mi Joseph, solchah hon Barnabas asah-u (hichu lungmonna chapa tina ahi) chun,"},"37":{"text":"Lou ching khat anei chu ajoh-in, sum chu achoijin solchah ho keng bulah ahung koijin ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahin mi khat amin Anania kitipa chun a-inneipi Sapphira toh anei khat ajoh lhonin,","title":"Anania le Sapphira"},"2":{"text":"Aman alang akikoijin, hichu a-inneipin jong ahet ahin, alang chu ahin choijin solchah ho keng bulah ahung koijin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ahinla Peter'in, Anania, ibola gam man chu alang kikoija, Lhagao Theng najoulhep dinga Satan'in nalung sung alodim hitam?"},"4":{"text":"Aum laija chu nanga tum hilouham? Chule najoh nunga jong chu nangma thu neina-a um hilouham? Ibola hitobang hi lunga vop nahim? Nangman mi najoulhep ahipon, Pathen najoulhep ahibouve, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chuin thu chucheng chu ajah jah chun Anania chu alhun athitai. Chuin aja jouse chunga chun kichatna nasatah achutan ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chuin gollhangho akipat doh-un atomun, apudoh-un, agavui taove."},"7":{"text":"Chuin chuche jou nidan thum tobang nungin a-inneipi chu thilsoh umchan hepha louvin, ahung lutjelin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Peter'in adonbutnin, ajah-a, Hijat manseh bouva hi gam chu najoh lhonham? atile amanun, Ahi, hijatbou chu ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Ahinla Peter'in amanu jah-a, I-atile Pakai Lhagao patep dinga naki thukop lhon hitam? Ven, na-inneipu vuiho kot bul ahung geitaove; amahon nang jong naputdoh dingu ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin amanu chu chupettah chun akeng bulah alhun athipaitai. Chuin gollhangho chu ahung lut ule amanu athi chu ahung mu uvin, apudoh kitnun, a-inneipu komah agavui taove."},"11":{"text":"Chuin houbung pumpi chungle chucheng thu jaho jouse chungah kichatna nasatah achutan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule mipi ho lah-a melchihna le thil kidang tamtah solchah ho khutna konin akibol jengtan ahi. Amaho chu lungkhat tah-in Solomon kempum'a chun aumun ahi.","title":"Thil Kidang Leh Datmo-um Abolu"},"13":{"text":"Ahin midang koimachan amaho lah-a lhah ding chu angapchapon ahi: ahinla mipin amaho chu avesang lheh-ui."},"14":{"text":"Chule atahsana numei le pasal Pakai henga akibelap jengun;"},"15":{"text":"Chutitah chun Peter avale komle ale beh mi phabep chunga achuhna dingin, damlouho khosung lamlenah ahinpouvin jalkhun le talaijah alupsah jiuvin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule Jerusalem kimvela khopiho-a konin mipi chu ahung khomun, adamlouho le lhagaoboh bolgimho ahinpuijun ahile, abonchau chun boldamin aumjitaove."},"17":{"text":"Ahin thempu chungnungle aloiho jouse (amaho chu Saddukai loi ahiuvin), lunghan nan adimun,","title":"Solchah ho Bolgentheija Aumu"},"18":{"text":"Akipat doh-un, solchah ho chu amanun, jalhang henna-a ahentauve."},"19":{"text":"Ahinla jan-in Pakai vantil'in kot ahongin, amaho pamah apuidoh-in, ajah uva,"},"20":{"text":"Cheovinlang houin'ah gadingun, hiche hinna thu jouse hi miho gahilun, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin hichu ajah phatnun, ajing khovah matah-in houin'a alut paijun athu ahiltaove. Ahin thempu chungnung chu aumpi aloihotoh ahungin, houvaipoloile Israel chate a-upaho chengseu akou khomin, khatteho chu gapui dingin songkul in'a chun mi asoltan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla sottol hochu ahunguva songkul sunga ahung mulou phatnun, amaho akileuvin ahenguva,"},"23":{"text":"Songkul inla bitkeijin akikhahchahnan, angahho jong kotphunga adin jingu kagatoh-un, kot kahonule asungah koima kamutapouve, agatiuve."},"24":{"text":"Chuin thempu chungnungle houin vaipo, chule thempu pipuihon thu hicheng chu ajah phatnun, hichea kon chun ipi ahung sohdoh tadem, tin achung changuvah alung dong lheh jeng taovin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin mi khat ahungin ajah uva, Veuvin songkul'a nahenhou chu houin'ah adingun miho thu ahilui, ahung ti."},"26":{"text":"Chutah-in vaipo chu sottol hotoh akonun kangchan agapuijui; ajehchu miho chun songin eisep getnunte ti akichatnu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuin apuilut phatnun, amaho chu houvaipoloi ang sungah adinsah-un: chule thempu chungnung chun amaho chu adongin,"},"28":{"text":"Hiche min hin mi hildaovin, tia hachang khama kakhamu nahiu hilouham? ahin veuvin, nathuhilu Jerusalem nadipsoh taove; chule hichepa thisan phu hi keiho chunga chuhsah dingin nagouve, ati.","ref":"Matt 27:25"},"29":{"text":"Ahivangin Peter le solchah ho chun adonbutnun, Mihem thu sanga Pathen thua kanunjoh dingu ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ipu ipateu Pathen'in nanghon thinga nakhai uva natha-u Jesu chu akaithou tan ahi."},"31":{"text":"Ama chu Pathen'in Israelte lungheina dingle chonset ngaidamna dinga, Pipui le Huhhingpu hidinga akhut jetna achoisang ahitai."},"32":{"text":"Chule hitiho-a hi Ama dinga ahetoh-a keiho kahiuve; chule athua nungho dinga Pathen'in apeh Lhagao Theng jong chu ahi, atiuve."},"33":{"text":"Ahivangin amahon hichu ajahtah-u chun alungchang kikaldoh abang jengun, tha dingin agotauvin ahi."},"34":{"text":"Ahivangin houvaipoloi lah-a mi khat, Pharisai mi, amin Gamaliel, danthuhil, mijousen ajalheh ahin, adingdoh in, solchah ho chu chom chakhat soldoh dingin thu apetan ahi."},"35":{"text":"Chuin aman ajah uva, Nangho Israel mite, hiteho chunga nathil bol gotnu hi chingthei jun."},"36":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile tumasang lai chun Theudas kiti mi khat asohdoh-in, ama chun milen kahi atin; ama henga chun mi ja li jen akaijin; chuin ama chu athat taovin ahile, athua nungho jouse chu acheh gamun, ima hilou asohtaove."},"37":{"text":"Hichepa jouma chun, min kisut laijin, Galilee gama Judas aumdoh kitleuvin, ahenga mi kimkhat aloimangin; ama jong chu amangthah-in, athua nungho jouse jong acheh gamtaovin ahi."},"38":{"text":"Chule tu-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hiche miho-a kon khun kikhin dalun, limsah daovin; ijeh-inem itile hiche thil kingaito le thil kibola hi mihem phudoh ahile, suhmangin hung umnante."},"39":{"text":"Ahivangin Pathen'a kon ahile, sumangjou pouvin nate; ajole Pathen kidoupi hikha getnun nate, ati."},"40":{"text":"Chuin ama sei chu aphatsah-un, solchah ho chu akouvun, avovin, Jesu minin thu sei kit hihhelun tin akhamun, alhataove."},"41":{"text":"Hitichun houvaipoloi anga kon chun achedoh-un, Amin jala jachatna thoh dinga kiloma sim ahi jeh-un, akipah lheh-un ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chuin niseh-in houin le in tinah Jesu Christa thuhil le seiphong atangdeh pouve."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche lai chun seijui ho amijat apunbe cheh cheh phatnun, niseh thil kihoma ameithaiteu adon lou jeh-un, Hebrew ho chunga Greek gam Juda ho aphun taovin ahi.","title":"Kithopi Ding Mi Sagi Kipansah"},"2":{"text":"Chuin somleni ho chun seijui mipi chu akou khomun, Keihon Pathen thu pailhah-a anneh thulam jeng kangaito dingu chu adol ahipoi."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun, sopite, hiche kina hi kapansah thei dingu, nalah uva konin seiphat chang, Lhagao Theng le chihna dimset mi sagi lhengdoh-un;"},"4":{"text":"Ahin keiho vang taona le thu lhacha-a kapandet jing jeng dingu ahi, atiuve."},"5":{"text":"Hiche thua chun mi jouse chu alunglhaijun, tahsan le Lhagao Thenga dimset Stephen toh, Philip toh, Prochorus toh, Nicanor toh, Timon toh, Parmenas, chule Juda chona chon Antioch kho-a Nicolas, hicheng chu alheng doh-un,"},"6":{"text":"Solchah ho angah adinsah-un; chuin atao jouvun, achunguvah akhut angam taove."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Pathen thu chu ahung chaljal tan, chule Jerusalem'a seijui ho amijat hapunin apung lhehjeng taovin; thempuho jong tamtah tahsan thun anung taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Stephen chu tahsanna le thilboltheina dimin, mi lah-a thil kidang le melchihna loupitah aboljin ahi.","title":"Stephen Amatnu"},"9":{"text":"Ahivangin Libertine kikhopna atiu kikhopna-a miho phabep, (Cyrene mi, Alexandria mi, chule Cilicia mihole Asia gam miho) akipat doh-un, Stephen chu akinelpi taove."},"10":{"text":"Ahivangin aman Lhagao le chihna-a athusei chu anelthei tapouvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amahon mi atilgu uvin, Hichepa hin Mosi le Pathen ataitom kajauve ati sah-un ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin amahon mipi ho, upaho, chule danthu sunho chu atilseuvin, Stephen chunga achuvin, amanun, houvaipoloi henga akaijun ahi."},"13":{"text":"Amahon hettohsah lhem asemun, hicheho chun, Hichepa hin hiche Intheng hile dan hi tanglouva ataitomjia;"},"14":{"text":"Hiche Nazareth Jesu hin hiche Intheng hi aphet lhah-a, Mosi danthu peh hi abol lamdang ding ahitai, tia asei kajauve, atiuvin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin vaihom na-a touho jouse chun, amachu ave veuvin ahile, amaiso vantil maiso bangin amuvin ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Thempu chungnung chun, Hiche thuho hi atahbeh ham? ati.","title":"Stephen Thusei"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Stephen'in, Sopite le pate, ngaijun: Ipuluiju Abraham Haran kho-a achen masanga Mesopotamia gama aum laijin, loupi Pathen ahenga akilah-in ajah-a,","ref":"Semt 12:1"},"3":{"text":"Nagam sunga kon le na-insung mite lah-a konin kipatdoh-in, chule keiman kavetsah ding gama hungin, ati."},"4":{"text":"Chutah-in ama Chaldia gama konin ahungdoh-in, Haran'ah achengtan ahi; chuin hia kon chun apa thi nungin, Pathen'in, tu-a nachennao, hiche gama hin achenlut sahtai.","ref":"Semt 11:31; 12:4."},"5":{"text":"Ahin chua chun Pathen'in akengto ngapna kham jong mun alo ding apepoi. Ahivang chun amale anunga asonho geijin alo dinguva kapeh ding ahi tin, chapa anei loulai peh chun athutep tan ahi.","ref":"Semt 12:7; 13:15; 17:8"},"6":{"text":"Chuin Pathen'in, asonho chu hetlou gama pem ding, chule amahon soh-a aloilut dingu, chule kum jali jen kinomsahna anei dingu ahi, tin anaseijin ahi.","ref":"Semt 15:13-14"},"7":{"text":"Chule asohchan nateu vaipi chu keiman athu-u katan ding; chuche joule hung potdoh uva, hiche kom mun'a hi keima eijen dingu ahi, ati.","ref":"Pot 3:12"},"8":{"text":"Chuin kitepna cheptan thu apen; chutichun Abraham'in Isaac ahingin, aniget nin achep atanin; chuin Isaac chun Jacob ahingin, Jacob'in pului somleni chu ahingin ahi.","ref":"Semt 17:10-14; 21:2-4; 25:26; 29:31—35:18"},"9":{"text":"Chuin puluiho chun Joseph chunga thangset abolun, Egypt gama ajoh mangun; ahinla Pathen'in ama chu aumpin,","ref":"Semt 37:11,28; 39:2,21."},"10":{"text":"Agim agentheina jouse-a konin ahuhdoh-in, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh ang sungah khotonale chihna apen, chuin aman Egypt gam chungale, ama insung jouse chunga gamvaipon apansahtai.","ref":"Semt 41:39-41"},"11":{"text":"Chuin Egypt gam sung jousele Canaan gama kel alhan, gentheina chungnung tah alhungin ahile; ipului teovin neh ding amu tapouvin ahi.","ref":"Semt 42:1-2"},"12":{"text":"Ahivangin Jacob chun, Egypt gama anneh aume ti ajah jah-in, ipu ipateu chu amasa penin agah soldoh-e."},"13":{"text":"Chuin aniveina-in Joseph chun asopite chu akihetdoh sahtan ahile, Joseph insungmi chu Pharaoh hetchenin aumtai.","ref":"Semt 46:1,16"},"14":{"text":"Chuin Joseph'in mi asolin, apale a-inkote abonchan mi somsagi le nga chu ama heng lamah agakou sahtai.","ref":"Semt 45:9-10,17-18; 46:27"},"15":{"text":"Chuin Jacob Egypt lama achesuh-in; chuin athitan, ipu ipateu jong athi taove;","ref":"Semt 46:1-7; 49:33"},"16":{"text":"Chuin alongu chu Shechem'a apo galkaijun, Abraham'in Shechem'a Hamor chapatehoa kona dangka-a achoh lhana chun alupsah taove.","ref":"Semt 23:3-16; 33:19; 50:7-13; Josh 24:32"},"17":{"text":"Chuin Pathen'in Abraham athutep chu aguilhun aphat alhin konin, miho chu Egypt gama apungun atamcheh atamcheh jengun,","ref":"Pot 1:7-8."},"18":{"text":"Joseph hephalou leng chom khat Egypt gam chunga avaipoh gei chun."},"19":{"text":"Hichepa chun ivaiju dohathemin abolin, ipu ipateu chu abol gentheijin, achasen hou chu ahin louna dingin apaidoh sah jin ahi.","ref":"Pot 1:10-11,22"},"20":{"text":"Hiche lai chun Mosi apengin ahile, Pathen'a dingin ahoi lheh jengin; apa in'ah lha thum avah-un;","ref":"Pot 2:2"},"21":{"text":"Chuin ama akoidoh phatnun, Pharao chanun akilahdoh-in, achapa dingin akivahtan ahi.","ref":"Pot 2:3-10"},"22":{"text":"Chuin Mosi chu Egypt miho chihna le themna jouse ahilun; chuin ama chu thu le thilbolin thahat tah ahitai."},"23":{"text":"Chuin ama chu kum somli alhin phatnin, asopiho Israelte chu gavil ding alunga aumtan ahi.","ref":"Pot 2:11-15."},"24":{"text":"Chuin alah uva khat alam louhela bolgenthei thoh amun ahile ahuh-in, bolgenthei thohpa phu chu alan Egypt mipa chu avolih tai;"},"25":{"text":"Aman, Pathen'in ama khutna amaho chu ahuhdoh ding ahi chu asopiho chun henaovinte ati ahin; hinla amahon ahepouve."},"26":{"text":"Chuin ajingin alah uva mi ni akidelin ahile ama ahenguva agachen, suhcham ding agon; Vo miteni, nangni sopicha nahiuve; ibola nanghole nangho ahilouva nakiboltou ham? ati."},"27":{"text":"Ahivangin aheng akom ahilouva bolpa chun ama chu asondoh-in, Keiho chunga vaipole thutana koiham natunga?"},"28":{"text":"Jani-a Egypt mipa natha banga chu tha dinga neigot ham? ati."},"29":{"text":"Hiche aseija chun Mosi ajamin, Media gama apemin, chukoma chun chapa ni ahinge.","ref":"Pot 18:3-4"},"30":{"text":"Chuin kum somli alhin phatnin, Sinai mol gamthipmah, Pakai vantil'in hamboh-a meikongin akimusah-in;","ref":"Pot 3:1-10."},"31":{"text":"Chuin Mosi'n hichu amu phatnin, athilmu chu kidang asan; chuin agavechen dingin agache naijin ahile, chua chun Pakai aw ahung gingin,"},"32":{"text":"Keima napu napate Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Jacob Pathen kahi, ati. Hichun Mosi akihot hot jengin ave ngam tapoi."},"33":{"text":"Chuin Pakai chun ajah-a, Nakenga konin nakengchot chu sutlhan; ijeh-inem itile nadinna mun chu mun theng ahi."},"34":{"text":"Egypt gama um kamite hesoh genthei chentah-in kamun, apenu kajan, ahuhdoh dinguva hung kumlha kahi; tun hungin nangma Egypt gamah solinge, ati."},"35":{"text":"Hiche Mosi, Keiho chunga vaipole thutana koiham natunga, tia aledohpa tah-u chu, Pathen'in hamboh-a akimusah vantil chu akithopin asemin, vaipo le huhdoh hikop dingin asoltan ahi.","ref":"Pot 2:14."},"36":{"text":"Ama chun Egypt gamah, chule twikhanglen san le gamthipmah kum somli sungin thil kidang dangle melchihna abolin, amaho chu apuidohtai.","ref":"Pot 7:5; 14:21; Minb 14:33"},"37":{"text":"Pakai na Pathen'un nangho dinga, nasopiteu lah-a kona keima tobang themgao khat asodoh sah ding, athu nangaidiu ahi, tia Israel chate jah-a seija hiche Mosi chu ahi.","ref":"Danb 18:15,18"},"38":{"text":"Sinai molsanga ajah-a thuseija vantil le ipu ipateu toh gamthip gama houbung'a umkhoma, chule eiho pehson ding hinna thu mu-a ama chu ahi.","ref":"Pot 19:1—20:17; Danb 5:1-33"},"39":{"text":"Ipu ipateovin ama thua nun ding chu anom hih-un, ama asondoh-un, Egypt lama alungu aheijun,"},"40":{"text":"Aaron jah-a, eilamkai dingu pathenho neisem peh-un; ijeh-inem itile Egypt gama kona eipuidoh uva Mosi la hoija itia ahi kahepouve, atiuve.","ref":"Pot 32:1"},"41":{"text":"Chuin amahon hiche pet chun bongnou lim asemun, milim houna ding chun gan athatnun, amaho khut sema chun athanomun ahi.","ref":"Pot 32:2-6"},"42":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pathen'in akiheimang sanin, van janelpi hou dingin amaho chu alhatai. Themgaoho lekhabua, Vo Israelte, gamthip gama chu kum somli sunga sa kithat le ganlha-a keima neihou jiuvem?","ref":"Amos 5:25-27."},"43":{"text":"Nanghon Molok Ponbuh le pathen Rephan ahsi hou dinga alim nasemu napoleji bouvui. Hijeh-a chu keiman nangho Babylon kal lampeh-a Katol mang ding nahiuve, tia kisei bang chu ahi."},"44":{"text":"Alim kigon namu bang bang chun houbuh san, tia Mosi hilpa thupeh dungjuija kisa hettohsahna houbuh chu, gamthip gama chu ipu ipateovin ananeiju ahi.","ref":"Pot 25:9,40."},"45":{"text":"Chujouvin ipu ipateu le Joshua'in hichu aneisonpeh-un, ipu ipateu masang sanga Pathen'in anodohho vaipiho gam alo laiju chun apo lutpeh-un, David nikho lai geijin aumin;","ref":"Josh 3:14-17"},"46":{"text":"Ama chun Pathen mitmu-a deisahna amun, Jacob Pathen umna ding athumin;","ref":"2 Sam 7:1-16; 1 Thusm 17:1-14"},"47":{"text":"Ahinla in chu Solomon'in asahpeh jobove.","ref":"1 Leng 6:1-38; 2 Thusm 3:1-17"},"48":{"text":"Ahi jeng vangin, Chungnung pen chu khutna kisa houin'a chun achengpoi; themgaovin,"},"49":{"text":"Pakaiyin, Van katouna ahin, lei ka kengphang ngapna ahi; itobang in neisahpeh dingham? Kacholngahna mun hoikom ham?","ref":"Isai 66:1-2."},"50":{"text":"Thil jouse hi aboncha kakhut sem hilouham? ati, tia asei banga chu."},"51":{"text":"Nangho milouchal teho, lungsung le nakhanga chep tanlou teho, nanghon a-imatih chanin Lhagao Theng nadoudal jingui; napu napateu bol bang chu nanghon nabolui.","ref":"Isai 63:10."},"52":{"text":"Themgao koipen chu napu napateu vin abolset lou umam? Chondihtah hung ding thu sei masaho athatgamun; tun amatah chu amatsah le athatnin nangho napangui;"},"53":{"text":"chule vantil thupeh ahi tia nalah sonu danthu chu nanitpouve, ati."},"54":{"text":"Chuin thu chucheng ajahtah-un, alungchang kikaldoh abang jengun, aha agoi khumun ahi.","title":"Stephen Kitha"},"55":{"text":"Ahivangin ama Lhagao Theng adimsetnin, van lam ave aven ahile, Pathen loupile, Pathen khut jet lama Jesu adin chu amun,"},"56":{"text":"Veuvin, vanho akihona Pathen khut jet lama Mihem Chapa adin kamui, ati."},"57":{"text":"Ahivangin amaho hatah-in a-aosot jengun, akol asimun, thakhat tah-in anovin;"},"58":{"text":"Chuin khopam lama anodoh-un, songin asep aseptaove. Ahetohho chun Saul atiu gollhang khat keng khophang koma apon chengseu akoijun ahi."},"59":{"text":"Chutia chu amahon Stephen songa ase pettah-u chun ama ataovin, Pakai Jesu, kalhagao lan, ati."},"60":{"text":"Chuin adilsun hatah-in asamin, Pakai, hiche chonsetna hi amaho minin sun hih-in, ati. Chuin hiche chu aseijin a-imu damdel tai."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul jong chun athao chu aphatsah ahi. Chuche ni-a pat chun Jerusalem'a um houbung suhmangna dinga bolsetna khohtah aum pantan ahile, solchah ho chengse tailou adang chengse, Juda gamle Samaria gamah avahcheh taovin ahi.","title":"Saul'in Houbung Abol Genthei"},"2":{"text":"Pathen'a kipetum ho chun Stephen chu avuijun hakan akauve."},"3":{"text":"Saul vang chun houbung suhmangna habolin abolin, intin-ah alutnin anumei apasal'in ajandoh-in, songkul'a akhum akhumin ahi.","ref":"Sol 22:4-5; 26:9-11."},"4":{"text":"Hijeh chun avahchehho chu gamtinah avahleuvin, thu chu ahille taove.","title":"Samaria'a Kipana Thupha Kilhangsap"},"5":{"text":"Chuin Philip Samaria khopi-a achesuh-in, ajah uva Christa chu aphongjal letai."},"6":{"text":"Chuin melchihna abol ho chu amuva athuseiho ajah phatnun, mipi chengse chun Philip thusei ho chu lungkhat tahle lunglut tah-in angaitaove."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu lhagao boh vop mi tamtah-a konin lhagao bohho chu hapen nin apengun, ahung potdoh-un; chule langthi le elbai jong tamtah boldama um ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin chuche khopi sunga chun kipa thanop nasatah aumtan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahivangin hiche khopi-a chun amin Simon kiti mitpheldoi choi khat anaumin, ama chun milen khat kahi tia Samaria miho chu kidang satah-a anaumsah ahi:"},"10":{"text":"Amahon ama thu chu anangai lheh jengun, aneopena pat alenpen geijin, Hichepa hi Pathen thahat chungnung chu ahi, atiu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Sotpeh-a pat aman amitpheldoija amaho chu kidang satah-a aumsahsa ahi jeh-a, athu angai lheh jengu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahivangin Philip'in Pathen lenggam thu le Jesu Christa min ahillhang atahsan phatnun, anumei apasal'in baptize achang taove."},"13":{"text":"Chule Simon, amatah jongin atahsantan, baptize achan jouvin Philip toh aum khomjom lhonin, melchihna le bolmo thil kidang kibolho chu amun, kidang asa lheh jengin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin Jerusalem'a um solchah hon Samaria mihon Pathen thu ajoptaove ti ajah phatnun, Peter le John agahsol taove."},"15":{"text":"Amani chu alhunsuh phat lhonin, Lhagao Theng achan theina dingun amaho ding chun ataopeh lhone;"},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche geija chu alah uva khatchabeh chunga chu loulai ahin; Pakai Jesu mina baptize changmai maibou anahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Chutah chun alu chunguva akhut angam lhonin ahile, Lhagao Theng achang taove."},"18":{"text":"Chuin Simon'in solchah ho khut ngap vanga Lhagao Theng kipeh chu amun, amani chu sum peh agon,"},"19":{"text":"Koi chung koi chung hijongle kakhut kangaple ama chu Lhagao Theng achan jeng jengna dingin, keima jong hiche thilboltheina hi neipeuvin, ati."},"20":{"text":"Ahivangin Peter'in ajah-a, Nangman Pathen thilpeh suma choh dinga nangaito jeh chun, nasum chu nangtoh manthan!"},"21":{"text":"Pathen mitmu-a nalungput adih lou jeh chun, hiche thua hin lhahna naneipoi, chan jong naneipoi."},"22":{"text":"Hijeh chun hiche nagitlouna-a konhin nalung heijin, nalung sunga gitlou natup chu angaidam theikhat le Pathen henga taovin."},"23":{"text":"Ajehchu Chonsetna khatveng vungna thinkha-a lhalutna, chule gitlouna-a kikan nahi chu kahedohtai, ati."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Simon'in adonbutnin ajah-a, Nathuseiho chu khatcha jong kachunga alhun louna dingin, Pakai henga neitao peh-un, ati."},"25":{"text":"Hiche chun amanin Pakai thu ahettohsah lhona asei jou lhonin, Jerusalem lama akile kit lhonin, Samaria kho tamtah-ah Kipana Thupha chu ahil lhangpeh lhontai."},"26":{"text":"Chuin Pakai vantil khatnin Philip jah-a thu aseijin, Kipatdoh inlang lhang lama Jerusalem'a kona Gaza jotna lampi-a khun chesuh-in; chumun chu gamthip ahi, ati.","title":"Philip le Ethiopia Nukisopa"},"27":{"text":"Chuin ama akipatdoh-in achetai; chule veuvin, Ethiopia gama mi khat nukiso, Ethiopia lengnu Candace noija thunei chungnung tah, agou jouse chunga vaihom, Jerusalem'a Pathen hou dinga chea ahin;"},"28":{"text":"Akile kit lama kangtalai ja akitol puma themgao Isaiah lekhabu chu asim ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Lhagaovin Philip jah-a, Khuche kangtalai khu naijin lang kiloipin, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin Philip ahenga alhaijin ahile, Isaiah themgao lekha chu asim ajan, ahengah, Nasim chu nahet nah-em? ati."},"31":{"text":"Chuin aman, Mi khattouvin eihilchet loule iti kahet thei dingham? ati. Chuin Philip chu kangtalai chunga kaldoh-a akoma tou dingin akoutai."},"32":{"text":"Amapan Pathen lekhabu anasim asimmun lai chu hiche hi ahi: Ama chu tha dinga kikai kelngoi bangin akaijun; kelngoi nou amul vouho anga hampoh louhela aum bangin, Ama jong akam kapoi.","ref":"Isai 53:7-8"},"33":{"text":"Akineosah nalamin achunga thutan dih aki subeijin; akhang thu koiham aseiphong dinga? ijeh-inem itile leisetna kona ahinna asuhmangu ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chuin nukiso chun Philip adonbutnin, Themgao chun hiche hi koi thudola aseiham? Ama thudola aseiha, midang thudola aseiham? ati."},"35":{"text":"Chuin Philip akamkan, chuche Pathen lekhabua thua chun apanin, Jesu thu aseitan ahi."},"36":{"text":"Chuti chun lampi-a chu ache che lhonle, twi umna mun khat agei lhonin; chuin nukiso chun, Ven, hikoma twi aume; baptize kachanmona ding ipi umam ati."},"37":{"text":"Chuin Philip'in, nangman nalung pumpi-a natahsan le chang thei jin nate, ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Jesu Christa chu Pathen Chapa ahi ti katahsane, ati."},"38":{"text":"Chuin akangtalai chu angahsah-in, Philip le nukiso chu ani lhonin twijah akumlha lhonin, chuin Philip'in ama chu baptize achansah tai."},"39":{"text":"Chuin twija kona ahungdoh lhon phatnin, Pakai Lhagaovin Philip chu alhohmang tan ahile nukiso chun amukit tapon, kipah thanom tah-a achena dinga achepaitan ahi."},"40":{"text":"Philip vang chu Azotus khopi-a amudoh-ui. Chuin aman ajotpaijin, Caesaria alhun kahsen khopitinah Kipana Thupha chu ahillhang pehtan ahi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul vang chu Pakai seijui ho gihsal le that dingin ahai haina laijin, thempu chungnung henga achen,","title":"Saul Lung Kikhel"},"2":{"text":"Chuche lampi tahsan chan chu koi hijongle amu mu numei jong pasal jong akana Jerusalem'a ahinkai theina dingin, Damascus-a kikhopnaho-a dingin lekha agathume."},"3":{"text":"Hichun achele Damascus kho alhun ding konin, phulou helouvin van'a kon vah khatnin avel asalvah soh jenge."},"4":{"text":"Chuin ama tolah alhun, chule ajah-a, Saul, Saul, nangin ibola suhmang dinga neibolset jingham? tia kisei aw ajan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin aman, Pakai, nang koi nahim? ati. Chuin Pakai chun, Suhmang dinga nabolset Jesu chu kahi, nang dingin thihtul monghem lho ahahsai;"},"6":{"text":"Chule aman kithing pumle lungdong tah-in, Pakai ipi neibolsah nom em? atin ahi.
