ajehchu seinom khat aneije, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chuin aman apuijin sepai vaipipo henga achen, Hiche gollhang hin najah-a seinom aneije tin, sohchang Paul'in eikouvin nangma henga hin puijin eiti, tin agaseije."},"19":{"text":"Chutichun aman akhutnin atuh-in achoma apuidoh-in guhthimin adongin, Kajah-a sei ding ipi thu naneijem, ati."},"20":{"text":"Chuin aman, Paul thudol hi kichen cheh-a dongtoh ding ngaito banga, jingle houvaipoloi kikhopna-a napuina dinga nahenga thum dingin Juda ho akilol taovin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ahin nangman amaho thu la hih-in; ijeh-inem itile mi somli valin, Paul itha masang seuvin anneh twidon bolpouhite, tin akihahselun, achanglhi jingui, chule tu-a hi kigosa dema uma, nangma thupeh mai ngah jinga um ahiuve, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chutichun sepai vaipipo chun gollhangpa chu ahilchah-in, Kajah-a naphondoh thu hicheng hi koima jah-a sei hih-in, atin alhadohtai."},"23":{"text":"Chuin aman sepai jalamkai ni ahenga akouvin, hiche thuhi apei: Jan nidan ko-a Ceasaria che ding akenga che sepai jani, sakol sepai somsagi chule tengchoi sepai jani gotsan koijun;","title":"Paul Gamvaipo Felix Heng Akisol"},"24":{"text":"Chule Paul Felix gamvaipo heng bitkeija pui lhungna dingin, ama tousahna ding sa jong gotsademin koijun, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chuin hitihin lekha asune;"},"26":{"text":"Claudius Lysias'in Lal chungnung pen Felix gamvaipo henga: Salam."},"27":{"text":"Juda hon hiche mipa hi amanun, atha ding konun keima sepaihotoh kakonin, ama hi Rome mi ahi ti kahen kahuhdoh tai."},"28":{"text":"Chuin ipi jeh-a aheh-u ahi ahehnao hetdohna dingin houvaipoloi kikhopna-a kapuije."},"29":{"text":"Hia chun thina theihoi le kikanna theihoi thudolin ahehpouve, amaho chonna dan thua asuhkhel amatdoh-u ahitoh-e."},"30":{"text":"Juda hon ama hi thadinga agot uva achanlhih-u kahetdoh phatna, khongai louhela apettah-a nangma henga kahinsol pai jeng ahi, chule ahehho jong nangma ang sunga ahehnau thu sei dingin thu kapei. Damtan."},"31":{"text":"Chuin sepaihon thupeh dungjui chun ajan jan-in Paul chu apuijun, Antipatris lama achepi taove."},"32":{"text":"Ahin ajingin sakol sepaiho chu amatoh alhonsah-un, amaho kulpi lama akiletaove."},"33":{"text":"Chuin amaho Ceasaria alhunun, lekha chu gamvaipo chu apeuvin, Paul jong chu adinsah taove."},"34":{"text":"Chuin aman lekha chu asimin, hoi gampoh mi nahim, tin adongin, chuin Cilicia gam mi ahi ahetdoh phatnin,"},"35":{"text":"Naheh ho jong ahung tengule nathu ngainange, ati. Chuin Herod inpia koi dingin thu apetan ahi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ni nga jouvin thempu chungnung Anania chu upaho phabep toh, chule Tertullus atiu thukalthem khattoh acheuvin, Paul ahehnau thu chu gamvaipo jah-a chun aseijui.","title":"Juda hon Paul Themmo Achanu"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Paul agakouvun ahile Tertullus'in ahehnan achunga thu aseipanin, Nangma vanga lungmon chungnunga kalung monuva, chule nangma vaihom them vanga hiche nam mite hi imalam jouse-a phatdoh sah-a aumu kamu jeh-in,"},"3":{"text":"Vo lal chungnung pen Felix, a-imatih chanin hoikom hoikoma jong lung kipahtah-in kasangui."},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin nangma dinga theida um hiding kanompoi, kathu-u themcha kasei dingu hi nami lungsetna-a neingaipeh dinguva kataovu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile keihon hichepa hi mi sugam, chule vannoi leiset chung jouse-a Juda ho lah-a vaipi chohsea, chule Nazareth chona chonho lamkai pipu ahi kaman doh-un:"},"6":{"text":"Chumale houin suhboh dinga jong agot jeh-a kamatnu ahin, kadannu dung juija athu katan diu dol ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahin sepai sang lamkai Lysias'in in eihung buluvin, thahat sanna kakhut nuva konin ahung lahmangin,"},"8":{"text":"Ahehho nahenga hung dingin thu apen ahi. Amatah chu nangman dongtohle chun kahehnao hi adih adihlou abonchan hesoh keinan nate, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin Juda ho jong chun ajomun, hicheng chu ahicheh-e, atiuve."},"10":{"text":"Chuin gamvaipo chun thu sei dinga Paul akhasuh phatnin, Paul'in adonbutnin: Kum sottah nangma hiche nam mite thutana panga nahitai ti kahen, lung kipahtah-in kakihona thu seijinge;","title":"Paul'in Felix Anga Akihona Thu Asei"},"11":{"text":"Nangman henan natin, Pathen hou dinga Jerusalem'a kachehi ni somle nini aval hihlaije:"},"12":{"text":"Houin sunga mi khattoutoh kakinel, ahiloule kikhopnale kho sunga mihonpi katilsetna imacha eimupouve."},"13":{"text":"Tu-a eihehnao chengse jong chu aphotchenna hiche ahi ati theipouve."},"14":{"text":"Ahin keiman nangma jah-a kaseidoh hiche hi ahi, Amahon houdan chom asah-u lam dungjuija keiman kaputeu kapateu Pathen chu kahouva, danthua le themgaoho lekhabua kisun dungjuija chu thil jouse katahsana,"},"15":{"text":"Amaho jongin michondih jong michondih lou jong athi thokit umding ahi tia akat jingu, hitiho chu keiman Pathen lama kinepna kanei ahi;"},"16":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu Pathen le mihem lama suhkhel beija, ase apha hetkahna neija umdinga a-imatih chana kihabol jing kahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin kum tamtah nunga kanam vaipiu min ahunau thilpeh le thilto hinpo-a hunga kahin;","ref":"Sol 21:17-28."},"18":{"text":"Hichea chun Asia gama Juda hon houin'a kakisuh theng chu eimuve; mihonpi toh kaumpoi, chule thunoh baotam imacha jong aumpoi."},"19":{"text":"Amaho chu hikoma nangma anga hin umuhen, kachunga thu eihehna ding aneijule seijule hi ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ahiloule hiteho hin seijuhen, houvaipoloi anga kadina chu kasuhkhel ipi amatdoh-um,"},"21":{"text":"Alah uva kadina kho kasapma, athiho thokit thua tunia na-ang sunguva eikikouva eikidonga ahitai, tia kasei tailou chu, ati.","ref":"Sol 23:6"},"22":{"text":"Ahivangin Felix'in chuche Lam thudol chu ahetchet jeh-in, athu tan ding chu akhongaijin, Lysias sepai vaipipo ahung tengle nathu-u ngaito chen nange, ati.","title":"Felix Le Drusilla Angsunga Paul"},"23":{"text":"Chuin aman Paul chu sepai jalamkai khat anga sah-in, chamlhat tah-a aumsah-a, ahenga hung ajenle dingle agol apaiho jong akham lou dingin athupeh-in ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin ni ijat-ham jouvin Felix chu a-inneipi Juda numei Drusilla toh ahungin, Paul agakou sah-in, Christa tahsan thudol asei chu angaijin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chuin aman chonphatna, kitim them, chule khonunga hung lhung ding thupi kitan thudol asei phatnin, Felix atija jahtan, adonbut nin, Tun chetan; keiman ka-on phatle nangma hungkousah nange, ati."},"26":{"text":"Chujongle Paul chun sum eipentin kilhadoh tante tijong akinem min, phiveng vungin akousah-in ahoulim pijin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ahivangin kum ni nungin, Porcius Festus'in Felix panmun chu ahinkhel tai; hichun Felix chun Juda ho deija umding ngaitonan, Paul chu akanin adalhatai."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Festus chuche gamkai sunga ahunglhun, ni thum jouvin Ceasaria'a konin Jerusalem'a achetouvin ahi.","title":"Ceasar Henga Paul'in Achungthu Alhut"},"2":{"text":"Chuin thempu pipuiho le Juda miho pipuhon ajah-a Paul chungchang thu ahilou lamin anaseijun;"},"3":{"text":"Chule lampia anachanlhih uva anatha theina dingu lungthim ngaiton, ama chunga chu amaho alungsetnuva Paul chu Jerusalem'a ahinpuina dingin ataovun ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin Festus'in adonbutnin, Paul Ceasaria kikoija ahi, chule keima khu lama chevah ding kahi."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun ama khun suhkhel anei ahile, nalah uva thunei chengse keimatoh kilhonin hungsuh-uhen, hung heh-u hen, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin amaho lah-a ni som val anichon nungin Ceasaria achesuh paijin, akit nin thutan na-a atouvin, Paul gapui dingin thu apetai."},"7":{"text":"Chuin ama ahung lhun phatnin, Jerusalem'a kona hungsuh Juda ho akimvela adingun, Paul dounan thu gilou tamtah-in aheh-un, ahivanginla aphotchenna avetsah theipouve."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Paul'in ama kihonna thu aseijin, Juda ho danthu ahin, houin ahin, ahiloule Ceasar douna ahin, keiman imacha kasuhset kasuhkhel aumpoi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Ahivangin Festus chun Juda ho deija umding angaiton, adonbutnin, Paul jah-a, Nangma Jerusalem'a chetouva khukoma keima ang sunga hicheng thudol hi ngaito-a umding nanop em, ati."},"10":{"text":"Ahinla Paul'in, Keima kathu kitanna dingdol Ceasar thutanna anga dinga kahi. Keiman Juda ho ima kasusepoi, nangman jong nahe sohkeinai."},"11":{"text":"Chutia akhang gilou kahia, thina theiloma suhset nei kahile, thi ding kadapoi; amavang hicheng eihehna chengseu hi tahbeh ahiloule koiman amaho khutna eipedoh thei ponte, Ceasar henga ngehna kabole, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chutah-in Festus vaibol chengsetoh akihoutoh phatnin adonbutnin, Nangman Ceasar henga ngehna nabol ahitan, Ceasar heng nache ding ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin ni ijat-ham jouvin Agrippa lengpa le Bernice chu Ceasaria ahung lhung lhonin, Festus chu salam ahung boh lhone.","title":"Agrippa Le Bernice Angsung Paul"},"14":{"text":"Chuin chua sottah anichong lhonin ahile, Festus'in lengpa jah-a chun Paul thu umchan aseijin, Felix dalhah sohchang kihen khat aumin,"},"15":{"text":"Ama chun Jerusalem'a kaum petnin thempu pipuiho le Juda upahon athu eihetsah-un, athu tana chai dingin kahenga athumui."},"16":{"text":"Akihehpale ahehho kimaito-a akihona thule ahehnau thudol seina neisah masanga mi koi hile thidinga pehdoh chu Rome mi chonna ngai ahipoi tia, amaho chu kana donbut ahi;"},"17":{"text":"Chuin amaho hikoma ahung kikhomun ahile, keima jong chom khatcha geisang louvin akit ni maman thutan na-a katouvin, amapa chu kagakou sahtai."},"18":{"text":"Chuin ahehho chu akim vela adingun, akhan gitlouna thun heh-unte, tia kaginchat bang chu achunga thukhoh imacha aseipouve;"},"19":{"text":"Amaho hou thudol leh Jesu atiu mithisa khat Paul'in ahing kitne ati thudola kinel ahibouvui."},"20":{"text":"Chuin chutobang thu chu atannaje kahevah hih-in, Jerusalem'a chea chuche athu chu tan ding anop anop lou kadongin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ahinla Paul'in ama chung changthu Leng chungnung tandinga ngehna aneiphatnin, Ceasar henga kasol thei ding kahse-a koi dingin thu kapetai, ati."},"22":{"text":"Chuin Agrippa'in Festus jah-a, kei jong keimatah-in hichepa thu chu jaleng kalung ahi, ati. Aman, Jingle janavehta chun, ati."},"23":{"text":"Chutichun ajingin Agrippa Bernice toh loupitah-a ahunga, thu ngaina inpia sepai Vaipipo hotoh khopi sunga miho pipu chengsetoh ahung lut phat lhonin, Festus thusah-in Paul chu ahin puilut taove."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Festus'in, Lengpa Agrippa chule hikoma kaumpi mi jousen hichepa hi namuve, ama hi Juda mihonpin Jerusalem'a jong, hikoma jong kahenga aheh-un, ahinga umhoi ahitapoi, tin asamui."},"25":{"text":"Ahivangin athina theilom ima akhan gitlouna keiman kamudohpoi; chule aman leng chungnung henga ngehna abol jeh-in sol dinga kagot ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ahin achungchang thudol ka pakai henga gahsut ding thu kichentah ima kaneipoi. Hiche jeh-a chu na-ang uva, Vo Agrippa lengpa, nangma ang sungtah-a kahinpuidoh ahi, ijem tia athu dohtoh nunga sutding themkat kanei theina dingin:"},"27":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile akihehna thu sun louva sohchang gahsol chu kitoh kasapoi, ati."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Agrippa'in Paul jah-a, nakihonna thu seitheijin nate, ati. Chutah-in Paul'in aban ajah-in, akihona thu aseijin,","title":"Agrippa Anga Paul Thusei"},"2":{"text":"Lengpa Agrippa, Juda hon eihehna jouseu thua tunia nangma anga kakihona thu sei dinga kaum hi lungnom kaki salheh jenge,"},"3":{"text":"Ajehpen chu nangman Juda ho lah-a chonna danle kinelna thunoh jouse nahet sohkeija, nathemsoh jeh chu ahi. Hijeh chun khongai themin kathu ngaijin tia katao ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kachapan laija patna kanam mite lah-a, chule Jerusalem'a kanunchan kakhanchan chu Juda hon ahe sohkeijui;"},"5":{"text":"Atila patna ahet sohkeisao ahi jeh chun, kahou danuva chondan khelpentah dungjuija kachona Pharisai chona kachon chu sei nomleu asei thei dingu ahi.","ref":"Sol 23:6; Phil 3:5"},"6":{"text":"Chule tu-a hi kapu kapateu Pathen'in athutep chu kineppi jeh-a athu kitan dinga hikoma ding kahi:"},"7":{"text":"Hiche thutep chu mu ding kinema, phung somle phung ni hin gunchu tah-a asun ajana Pathen ahouvu ahi; hiche kinepna jeh-a chu, Lengpa Agrippa, Juda hon eiheh-u ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pathen'in athiho akaithouve ti ibola nanghon tahsan umlouva nangaitou ham?"},"9":{"text":"Keiman jong Nazareth Jesu min douna hin thil tamtah akaleh-a bol ding ahi tin kangaiton ahi.","ref":"Sol 8:3; 22:4-5."},"10":{"text":"Chule hichu Jerusalem'a bol jong kabolin, chule thempu pipuiho-a konin thuneina kamun, mithengho tamtah songkul'a kakhumin, chule athao jong chun kaphasah-in ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule kikhopna in jouse-a talent kape jingjin, engsanin kataitomsah-in, achunguva chun kalungsa tuntun jengin, migam dang khopi gei sanin kabolsen ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hitichun thempu pipuiho-a konin thuneina le eisolnao lekha kamun, Damascus lama kachen ahi.","title":"Paul'in Ahinkho Kikhel Thu Avelsei (Sol 9:1-19 ; 22:6-16)"},"13":{"text":"Hichun, vo lengpa, sunkim tah-in lampia chun van'a kon vah khat nisa sanga vahjo kamun, hichun kakimvel le kalhonpiho chengse asalvahsoh jenge."},"14":{"text":"Chuin tolla kalhuh gam phatnun, keiman Hebrew paova kajah-a, Saul, Saul, ibola nangin neibolset jingham? nang dingin thihtul monghem lho ahahsai, eitia aw khat kajai."},"15":{"text":"Chuin keiman, Pakai, nang koi nahim? katile Pakai chun, Keima nabolset jing Jesu kahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahivangin thouvin chule nakengin pansan dingin; nangman thil namusa chengse le khonunga nahenga kaphondoh ding chengsea kathu hettohsah dingle kalhacha-a pansah dinga, hiche dinga chu nahenga kahung kilah ahi;"},"17":{"text":"Kamiteho-a konle, tu-a kasolna chidang namdang ho-a kona kahuhdoh ding nahi;"},"18":{"text":"Amitnu hadohsah dingle muthim lah-a kona khovah-a, chule Satan thuneina noija aumuva kona Pathen henga akihei theina dingule, achonsetnao akisuhbeija, keima eitahsan vanga kisuthengho lah-a gou alo theina dinguva ahenguva kasol ding nahi, eiti."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun, vo lengpa Agrippa, keima vanthil kamu thua chu nung louvin kaumpoi;"},"20":{"text":"Ahin amasan Damascus-a umho jah-a, chuin Jerusalem le Juda gam pumpi, chule chidang namdangho henga jong lung aheijuva Pathen lama akiheijuva, lungheitoh kilom thil abolna dingun kaseiphong letan ahi.","ref":"Sol 9:20,28-29"},"21":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Juda hon houin sunga eimat uva tha dinga eigotnu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Pathen'a kona panpina kanei jeh-a tuni geija kadina, alen aneo kahetsah ahi, thu dang ima kaseipoi, themgaoho le Mosi'n hung ding ahi tia aseiju,"},"23":{"text":"Christa chun gim genthei athoh tei dingje, athiho lah-a thoudoh kit amasapen ahia; amite le chidang namdangho henga vah aphondoh dingje kaseibou chu ahi, ati.","ref":"Isai 42:6; 49:6; 1 Cor 15:20"},"24":{"text":"Aman chutia akihona thu aseija adonbut chun, Festus chun aw sangtah-in, Vo Paul, angola nahi; nalekha them sangin nasuhngol ahitai, ati."},"25":{"text":"Ahin Paul'in, Vo michung nung Festus, angola kahipoi; thudihtah le chihna thu kaseijoh ahibouve."},"26":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile lengpan jong hiche thudol hi ahei; hijeh-a chu ama ang sunga ngamtah-a kasei ahi; ajeh chu hiche hi ningkoija kibol ahilou jeh-in, ama jah-a ki-ima imacha aumpoi ti chentah-in kahei."},"27":{"text":"Leng Agrippa, nangman themgaoho thuhi natahsan em? Natahsane ti kahei, ati."},"28":{"text":"Chuin Agrippa'in Paul jah-a, thu themcha-a jollhah-a Christian hisah ding neigoi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin Paul'in thu themchan hihen thu tampin hile, nangma chang hilouvin, tunia kathusei ja jouse hi kakikan naho tailou hin, abonchan keimatoh bangleu tin Pathen henga kathume, ati."},"30":{"text":"Chuin aman chutia aseiphat chun, lengpa, gamvaipo, Bernice chule atoukhompi ho setoh akipat doh-un,"},"31":{"text":"Chuin achoma acheuvin akihouvun, Hichepa hin thina hoile kanna dingdol thil ima asuhkhel aumpoi, atiuve."},"32":{"text":"Chuin Agrippa'n Festus jah-a, Hichepa hin Ceasar henga ngehna abolou hile, lhadoh thei ahi, ati."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin kong'a kitola Italy gama kache dingu thu akichet phatnin, Augustus sepai loi lah-a Julius atiu sepai jalamkai khutnah Paul le sohchang dangho apedoh taove.","title":"Paul Rome'a Dinga Kong'a Akitol"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Asia gamkolvel muntina kitol dinga kigo Adramyttium kong'a kalutnun kakitol taove; chule Macedonia gama Thessalonica mi Aristarchus toh kalhonui."},"3":{"text":"Akit nin Sidon kho-ah kong kangaove. Chule Julius'in Paul alungsetnin, agol apaiho henga chea gakithado dingin asole."},"4":{"text":"Chuin chua kon chun twi chunga kacheuvin, hui akaleh lama anun jeh-in Cyprus twikol le lam lamah kakitol taove."},"5":{"text":"Chuin Cilicia le Pamphylia depma twikhanglen kakhelun, Lucia gama Myra khopi kalhungui."},"6":{"text":"Chukoma chun sepai jalamkai chun Italy gam jon ding Alexandria kong khat amudoh-in, hi chun eikhum taove."},"7":{"text":"Chuin sottah olchachan kakitolun, hahsa tah-in Cnidus jon kagei hamhamui, huijin einan jeh-un Salmone gam Crete twikol le-a kakitolui."},"8":{"text":"Hitichun nahnah-in Lasea khopi kom Kaimunhoi atiu mun khat kalhungun ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin akisot behseh tahjeh le kong'a kitol setto kichat aum jeh chun (hichu an ngol kichai jou ahitan), Paul'in amaho chu akhamin,"},"10":{"text":"Vo miho, hiche twi chunga icheuva hin setto hakamna inei dingu ahi kamui; hichu thilkeole kong keo jeng hilouvin, eiho ding jengin jong setto kichat aume, ati."},"11":{"text":"Ahivangin sepai jalamkai chun Paul thu sangin kong pipu thule akong neipa thu ahajop jotan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin phalbi-a umna dinga kongkai mun chu akijen lou jeh-in, mi atam jon hikoma kona chu kitoldoh-a Phoenicia lhun teiteija, chukoma chu phalbi sunga umding asomtaovin ahi. Phoenicia chu Crete twikol gama kongkai mun khat ahin, lhumsah le lhumlhang angatto ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin lhang hui olchachan ahung nungin ahile, alunggot bangu hin angaitouvin, kong chu alhaovin Crete pam chin chinah atoltauve.","title":"Twipi Chunga Huipi Ato-u"},"14":{"text":"Ahivangin chujou chomkhat jouvin, chua kon chun Euroclydon atiu huipi hattah ahung nungsuh tai."},"15":{"text":"Chuin kong'a chun ahung chutan ahile malama atoljou tapouvin, kamoh lhatauvin ahile eilhoh eilhoh jengtaove."},"16":{"text":"Chuin amin Clauda atiu twikol neocha khat-ah kalhaijun, hahsa tah-in kongneo chu kahuhbit nahnah-un ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin hichu akhaidoh-un ahunan amangun, khaovin kong noi lamah akanbeh taove. Chuin ajole Syrtis nel lah-a kileng lut getninte ti akichauvin, pondal kikhainaho alalhauvin ahile eimoh lhoh lhohtaove."},"18":{"text":"Chuin huipi chun eisuhgim behseh jeh-u chun, akit nin thil apaidoh pantaove."},"19":{"text":"Anithum nin keihotah-in kakhut tah-un kong manchah ho chu kapai taovin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuin ni tamtah nisa chule ahsi ho eisalvah-u beihela huipi hat nasatah tang louhela anun anun phat chun, hichea pat chun kisohcha inte ti kinepna aumtapon ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuin ni tamtah an nelouva aum phatnun, Paul alah uva adingin: Vo miho, nanghon hiche settole hakamna hi to louna dinga kathu nangai uva, Crete'a kona chu kong hi nalha lou dingu thu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahivangin tu-a jong lungmong tah-a umdinga katil nahiuve; nalah uva koiman nahinnao nachan lou dingu ahi, kong vanghi mang ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ajeh chu Ama-a kahia, alhacha kapan Pathen chu a-vantil tujan chun kakoma adingin,"},"24":{"text":"Vo Paul, kicha hih-in; Ceasar anga nadin tei ding ahi; chule ven, nalhonpi ho chengse hi abonchauva Pathen'in nangma napehdoh ahitai, eiti."},"25":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun, vo miho, nangho lungmongun; ijeh-inem itile Pathen katahsanin, kajah-a asei bang banga chu hung soh tei ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Amavang twikol khatna ichuh tei dingu ahi, ati."},"27":{"text":"Chuin Adria twikhanglen'a huijin eisuhtol eitoutolu ajan somle ajanli jan-in, khangkimin kong mihon gamlei kinaija hitante ti agingchauvin,"},"28":{"text":"Hichun twi athuh chu ateule lam somni atedoh-ui; chuin phabep ache chonun ate kitleuvun ahile lam somle lam nga atedoh-un,"},"29":{"text":"Song lah-a kikisunte ti akichauvin, kong tom lamah thihhat li aseplhaovin, khovah angahtauve."},"30":{"text":"Ahivangin kong miho chu kong mai lama thihhat seplha ding beh akisauvin, kongneo twikhanglen'a adomlhauvin, jam ding lungthim angaito taovin ahile,"},"31":{"text":"Paul'in sepai jalamkai le sepaiho jah-a, amaho khu kong'a aum louvule nangho changin sohchathei pouvin nate, ati."},"32":{"text":"Chutah-in sepaihon kongneo ho khao chu asattan un, twi lah-a alhataove."},"33":{"text":"Chuin jing khovah konin Paul'in miho chu annen asolin, nanga nangaova an ngola imacha ne louhela na-umnao tuni nisom le nili ahitai,"},"34":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu an ne-a kasol nahiuve, hichu nakihinsona dinguva phachom ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile nalu chunguva nasamjangu khatcha jong lou louding ahi, ati."},"35":{"text":"Hitia chu asei jouvin, aman changlhah alan mi jouse ang sungah Pathen alhaijin, changlhah ahehbalin ane pantai."},"36":{"text":"Chutah chun miho jouse chu abonchauvin alung ngamun, an anecheh taove."},"37":{"text":"Kong'a uma chu mihing jani le somsagi le gup kahiuve."},"38":{"text":"Chuin miho chun an anehva phatnun, suhlouchang chu twi lah-a apaijun, kong chu asujangkhai taove."},"39":{"text":"Chuin khovah phatnin agamlei chu ahetapouve; ahivangin twipang kong ngahna thei khat amudoh-un, ahitheile kong chu chukoma tol lut ding tin akihousom taove.","title":"Kong Ke"},"40":{"text":"Chuin thihhat ho alhalhaovin, twikhanglen'a adalha taove; chuin hichutoh thakhatnin kongkhe kanna chu alham lha uvin, hui chena lama kong ponjal chu atungdoh-un, twipang lam chu ajon taove."},"41":{"text":"Chuin twikinong ni kisuhto na-a kalut khataovin ahile, kong monghem chu leija akiphut dentai; chuin kong mai lam chu long louhelin a-ohdentan, kong meilam chu twikinong chun hasuh-a asuhle akeh pantai."},"42":{"text":"Chuin sepaihon sohchangho chu twi jap gal kaija ajama umget inte atiuvin, tha dingin agotauve."},"43":{"text":"Ahivangin sepai jalamkai chun Paul chu huhhing agon bol dinga alung gotnu chu akhamin, twi jap thei theijan twi jap galkaihen, vapam anakai masahen;"},"44":{"text":"Adang amohse kong'a um khunpehle thil dang dangin kitol galkaihen, tin thu apetai. Chutichun abonchauvin bitkeijin asohchaovin, tolgo alhung taove."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin kasochat phatnu chun twikol chu Malta kiti ahi ahedoh taove.","title":"Malta Twikol'a Paul Natoh"},"2":{"text":"Chule paomah hammah ho chun khoto mainah-in eikhoto pouve; hiche pet chu gojuh lai ahin adap jeh chun mei eitipeh-un eilhunsah sohkeijui."},"3":{"text":"Ahin Paul'in thing lom khat achoma meija chu agahtoleh, meisahula kon chun gulse khat ahungdoh-in, akhut achun akikhaiden jengin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin paomah hammah hochun gul akhutna akikhaiden jeng chu amuvin, khatle khat akihouvun, Hichepa hi tolthat mong ahi, twikhanglen'a asochat jeng vanga hi, thudih tannan ahinghoi dehlou ahi, atiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chuin aman gul chu mei sunga chun athinglhan, a-ima aloupoi."},"6":{"text":"Ahivangin amaho chun hung pomintin, ahiloule phulou helouvin lhuntin, thi ding ahi, tin angah jingun ahi. Ahinla sottah angauva avet jouvun a-ima alou lou chu amuvin, alung gelu akhelun, ama chu pathen ahi atitaove."},"7":{"text":"Hiche mun koma chu twikol gam pipu amin Publius atiu chun gam anei ahin; ama chun eila lutnun, khotona nei tah-in ni thum a-in'a eilhun sah-un ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chuin Publius pa chu khosih le ehthit veija luma ahin; chuin Paul akoma agalutnin, achunga akhut angamin ataovin adamsahtai."},"9":{"text":"Chutia abol jou chun, chuche twikol gam sunga midang ana nei jouse ahungun ahile adam gamtaove."},"10":{"text":"Amaho chun lamchom chomin eijabol lheh jengun, kong'a kakitol phatnun thil kangaichat ding dolchanu kong-ah eihung koipeh-ui."},"11":{"text":"Chuin lha thum jouvin phalbi sungse-a twikol'a chu cham, amelchihna Ucha Sohkop atiu Alexandria kong'a chun kakitoldoh taove.","title":"Malta'a Kon Rome Ajotnu"},"12":{"text":"Chuin Syrakuse'a kakingaovin, chukoma chun ni thum kaumui."},"13":{"text":"Chuin chua kon chun kache velkolun Rhegium kalhungui; chuin ni khat jouvin lhanghui anungin ahile akit nin Puteoli kalhung taove."},"14":{"text":"Hikoma chun sopiho kamudoh-un, akomuva ni sagi nichong dingin eijolui. Chuin chutichun Rome lam ngan kachetauve."},"15":{"text":"Chuin chua kon chun sopihon keiho thu ajah phatnun Appii kailhang le Jinlhun In Thum geijin eilamto diuvin ahungui. Chuin Paul'in amaho chu amu phatnin Pathen athangvah-in alung ngamtan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuin Rome khopi kahunglhun phatnun, sepai jalamkai chun sohchang ho chu angahho jalamkai khutna apedoh-in, ahin Paul chu achanga sepai angahpa chuto umdingin thu apetaove."},"17":{"text":"Chuin ahitin ahi, ni thum jouvin Juda ho lah-a apipuho chu akou khomin; chuin amaho ahung kikhop phatnun ajah uva: Sopiteho, keima inam miteu dounale ipu ipateu dan douna-a ima kasuhset aum lou vangin, Jerusalem'a kona Rome mite khutna sohchanga pehdoh-a um kahitai.","title":"Rome Khopi-a Paul Natoh"},"18":{"text":"Kathem kathemlou aholtoh-un, thina hoi ima kachunga amudoh lou jeh-un, lhadoh dingin eigotaovin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin Juda hon hichu anel jeh-un, kacham louvin Ceasar henga ngehna kaboltan ahi; hichu kanam mite hehna dinga ahipoi.","ref":"Sol 25:11"},"20":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu nang hotoh kimuto-a kihoulim dinga kakou nahiuve, ijeh-inem itile Israelte kinepna jeh-a thihkhaova hi kihen kahibouve, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chuin amahon ajah-a, Keihon nangma thudol Juda gama konin lekha kamupouve; chule sopiho lah-a jong koima hikoma ahungin nangma chung changa khan gitlouna thu hung lhut aumpoi."},"22":{"text":"Ahivangin nangma lung ngaito thudol hi nanga konin kajah nomui: ijeh-inem itile hiche houchom thudol hi gamtina seisetna aum kaheuve, atiuve."},"23":{"text":"Chuin nikho ateppeh-un, aumna-a chun ahenga atama tam ahungun, aman jingkah-a pat nilhah geijin Mosi danthu le themgaoho lekhabua konin thu asodoh asodoh-in, Pathen lenggam thu ahettohsah-in, Jesu thudola ajoltan ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chuin athuseiho chu abangin atahsanun, abangin atahsan pouve."},"25":{"text":"Chuin amahole amaho akilol thei lou phatnun, Paul'in thu khat asei jouvin apotdoh taove; athusei chu hiche hi ahi. Lhagao Thengin themgao Isaiah kama napu napateu jah-a, asei chu adih lheh jenge,"},"26":{"text":"Hiche mite henga hin chenlang gaseijin: nanghon ja vang ja naovin natin, nahet them lou dingu; muvang munao vin natin, nahetdoh lou dingu ahi;","ref":"Isai 6:9-10"},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche mite lungthim hi thaova kitom ahin; ana khangun kho ajathei pon, amitnu asingun ahi, chutilou hile amitnun muvintin, anakhangun ja-intin, alunguvin hetdoh untin hung kilekit khaleu, Keiman amaho chu kadamsah khahding ahi; tia, asei chu ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun hiche hi kihet un, hiche Pathen mihuhhing na hi chidang namdangho henga kisola ahitai; amahon ngai jong angai dingu ahi, ati."},"29":{"text":"Chuin thu hicheng chu aseiphat nin, Juda ho apotdoh-un amaho le amaho hatah-in akinel taovin ahi."},"30":{"text":"Chuin aman inman apeh-a achenna-a chun kum ni lhingset aumin, ahenga hung jouse chu anasangjin,"},"31":{"text":"Pathen gam thu ahil lhangjin, hakattah-in Pakai Jesu Christa thudol ahiljin, koimachan akhampon ahi."}}}}},"45":{"info":{"name":"Rome","shortname":"Rom","abbr":[],"desc":"Rome Mite Henga Paul Lekha thot"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Jesu Christa soh khat, solchah khat hidia kikou, Pathen thupha seiphong ledia kisepdoh chun:","title":"Lem nale Thu Makai"},"2":{"text":"Malaija alekhabu thenga athemgaoho kama athutepsa,"},"3":{"text":"Tahsa lam dolla David chilhah-a kisim, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa, a Chapa thudol,"},"4":{"text":"Thenna lhagao lama vanga chu athi-a kona athodoh kit chun Pathen Chapa chu thunei tah-a atun ahi chu aphongdoh tai."},"5":{"text":"Chidang namdangte jouse lah-a mi tahsan thua nunsah dinga ama vangle ama min jala lungsetnale solchah mun changa kahitai;"},"6":{"text":"Nangho jong amaho lah-a chu Jesu Christa kouna changho nahiuve;"},"7":{"text":"Rome'a cheng mithenga kikou Pathen deite jouse hengah, i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin lungsetna le lungmon nalah uva umjing hen."},"8":{"text":"Natahsanu vannoi jouse-a akithan jeh-in, nabon chaova chungah Jesu Christa vangin ka-Pathen kathangvah masan ahi.","title":"Paul'in Rome Khopi Gaphah Alungtup"},"9":{"text":"Katao chanin tang louvin naminu kapha jingin, Achapa Thupha thua lhagaova alhacha kapan Pathen chu ahetoh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Tubeh-a hi naheng uva kahungna dingin, Pathen thusah-a phat kijen kom khat kato-a kahungjin teiteina dingin kathum jingjin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nadetna dinguva lhagao lam thilpeh phabep nangho kapeh theina dingun, nangho mu kangah lel lheh jengin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hichu nangho jong keima jong khat tahsana kona khat le khat ikitil khou touva, nangho lah-a lunghalna kanei theina dinga kati ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule sopite, chidang namdangte lah-a katohgim ga kamutah banga nangho lah-a jong kamu theina dinga, tamtahvei naheng uva hung ding kakigotji chu nahet louvu kanompoi, ahivangin tu masangsen eisumo aum jingjin ahi.","ref":"Sol 19:21."},"14":{"text":"Greek mitele paomah ham mahte ahin, mithemle mimol ahin, abonchauva kabat ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chutichu ahin, nangho Rome khopi-a um chengse jong Kipana Thupha kahil theichan hil dinga kigosa dema umjing kahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu Christa Kipana Thupha hi kajachatpi hihhele, ajehchu koi hile atahsan chan chu huhhing na dinga Pathen thahat ahin, amasan Juda mi ahin, chule Greek mi jong ahunghi.","title":"Kipana Thupha Thaneina","ref":"Mrk 8:38."},"17":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile asunga tahsan le tahsana kona Pathen chonphatna kilanga ahi; hiche thudol chu, Michonpha vang chu atahsan vanga hing ding ahi, tin akisune.","ref":"Habk 2:4"},"18":{"text":"Ajehchu chonphat louna-a thutah doudal ho, mihemte Pathen ngaisah louna le chonphat louna jouse chunga van'a konin Pathen lunghanna ahung kilangin ahi;","title":"Chidang Namdangho Gitlou"},"19":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen lam thudol het theina chu amaho-a akilangnai; ajeh chu Pathen'in hichu ahenguva amusah ahitai."},"20":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile leiset semtila pat Pathen athahat kemloule Pathen ahije mutheilou thilteho chu athilsema kihedoh-a, kichentah-a kimu ahi jeh chun, amaho athuphatna dingu aumpoi."},"21":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen lah ahenauvin, Pathen bangin avahchoi pouvin, thang jong athangvahji pouve; athil ngaitou ahomkeo ahin, angol lungu athimtan ahi.","ref":"Eph 4:17-18"},"22":{"text":"Akichihsah nau lamah angoljo taove."},"23":{"text":"Chule kemtheilou Pathen loupina chu, kemthei mihem le alha-a leng vachaho, akeng li nei gamsaho le a-opma kitholtho ganhing limin akhelun, ahou taove.","ref":"Danb 4:16-18"},"24":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu alah uva atiu ja umloutah-a bol dinga, amaho lunggot lam then louna lama, Pathen'in apehdoh ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Amahon Pathen thutah chu jouvin alhengun, chule asempau khelin thilsemjoh ahouvun ajenleuvin ahi. Hiche Sempa chu tonsot geija nunnom jing ahi. Amen."},"26":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu Pathen'in amaho jachat umtah huhna lama apehdoh ahitai, anumeiho jongun apenpiu angai monga achonnau apaijun akaleh lamin achonun ahi."},"27":{"text":"Apasal-hou jong angai monga numeitoh achonnau apaijun, huh lama alipmun, pasal le pasal jachat umtah-in akibolun, achon gitlounao chu amahon ati chunguva akisan taovin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Alunguva Pathen hetding amaho nom lou ahiuvin, hiche bangtah-a chu Pathen'in jong amaho lung chatvaina lama apehdoh ahitai."},"29":{"text":"Amaho chonphat louna jouse; jonthanhoi, engset, papset, mi kisuhmo sah, thangset, toltha, minelnoh, dohabol, doulung poh, kihou lhih adimset nun ahi."},"30":{"text":"Guhthima miseise, mihoutom, Pathen hotlam, chonval, hoitho, kithang-at, chonset thah boldoh, nulepa thua nunglou,"},"31":{"text":"Hetna neilou, thutep palkeh, hepina neilou, lhep lung damo, lungsetna neilou ahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Hitobanga chonho chu athi dinga lom mong ahiuve, hiche Pathen thutansa chu ahena saovin achuti chonun ahi, amaho chang jong hilouvin, chutia chonho chu aphasah-un ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun, Mi oimo-a pang, vo mihem, koi hile chun nangman jong nadonbutna ding aumpoi; ajeh iham itile nangman mi na-oimona lama nangma themmo kichanbou nahi, ajeh chu mi oimo-a pang, nangmatah jongin chutobang chu naboljin ahi.","title":"Pathen Thutana","ref":"Matt 7:1; Luk 6:37."},"2":{"text":"Chutobanga chonho chunga chu Pathen'in thutah dungjuija athu-u atan ahi, ti iheuvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Vo mihem, chutobanga chonte oimo-a pang nangman chutobang chu nabolji-a ahile, Pathen thutan na-a chun hoinange, tia nakiginchat mong hinam?"},"4":{"text":"Ole Pathen phatna-in nalung heina dinga nangma napui chu helouva phatna, lungdehat, khongaisot ahao hi nahsah louva nahim?"},"5":{"text":"Nalungtahle lungheilou dungjuija chu, Pathen'in thudih atan ni hung kiphonle alunghan ni-a dinga chu nachunga lunghanna nakikhol khom ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pathen'in mi jouse atoh dungjui cheh-a asansah ding ahi.","ref":"Labu 62:12; Thuch 24:12"},"7":{"text":"Thilpha bola pontho-a lungdesot hatna, loupina, jana, chule kemlou holte chu hin kemlou apeh ding ahi;"},"8":{"text":"Kichangchuna kichamsah, thutah thua nung louva chonphatlou thua nungho vang chu achunguva lungsatle lunghan chua,"},"9":{"text":"Setna bol miho jouse lhagao chunga, amasa Juda mi chule abana Greek mite lhagao chunga, hesoh gentheile lungdonna khohtah chu ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Thilpha bol chengse vang chun loupina, choi-atna, chule lungmonna kipe ding ahi, Juda mi masan tin chule Greek mi hi ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen'in mi dat aneipoi.","ref":"Danb 10:17"},"12":{"text":"Ajeh chu danthu neilouva chonseteho jouse chu danthu beija manghel ding ahiuvin; chule danthu noija chonseteho jouse chu danthua athu kitan ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile Pathen mitmu-a michonpha ho chu danthu ngaija jaho ahipouve; danthu dungjuija bolteho bouchu chonpha-a kisim ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Danthu neilou chidang namdangte jengbonin, apenpi lungpoh-in danthun anungun, danthu aneilou vangun amahole amaho danthun akisemun ahi."},"15":{"text":"Alung sunguva danthu natoh kisun ahi ti chu atahlangun, hiche ase apha ahetnao chun ahettohsah-un, chule alunggel uva chun themosah ahiloule khat le khat themmo kichan aumsah jiuvin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hicheng chu kathupha seiphongle dungjuija, Pathen'in Jesu Christa amanchah-a mihemte guhthim thu atan nikho leh chuti ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nangma Juda mi-a kisei nahi-a, danthua kinem nahi-a, Pathen'a kisong nahi-a,","title":"Juda te Chule Danthu"},"18":{"text":"Alungdei he-a, thilpha chu pha sa-a, danthua kona kihila het neija,"},"19":{"text":"Chule danthua hetna le thutah umdan neija nakiginchat jeh-a, mitcho ho kaihoile leh muthim lah-a umho salvah-a,"},"20":{"text":"Michinglou ho chihsah-a, naosen ho hila nakingaito ahin;"},"21":{"text":"Chuti ahile mihil-a panga nang, nangma jong nachanga kihil jilou nahim? Guchat louna dinga thu hila pang, nangman naguhji hilou ham?"},"22":{"text":"Jonthanhoi bol louna dinga thuseija, nangman jon nabolji hilou ham? Milim hou ho-a nangma, nangman milim houna in'a thil nachomji hilou ham?"},"23":{"text":"Danthu-a kisong nangman, danthu nasuhkeh-a kona Pathen nahsah mo-a nabolji hilouham?"},"24":{"text":"Akisun bang bangin, nangho jeh-in Pathen min chidang namgdangte lah-a taitomin aumin ahi.","ref":"Isai 52:5"},"25":{"text":"Nangma danthua nanunle nacheptan chu phatchomna nanei ding ahin, danthua nanun lou vangle nacheptan chu tan lou ahitai."},"26":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh-a chu cheptanlou chun danthua chonphatna thudol chu nit taleh, achep tanlou chu cheptana kisim lou dingham?"},"27":{"text":"Apena cheptanlou mong danthu nit soh chun, lekhajem'a thule cheptan dan neija jong danthu sukeh-a nangma, nathemmosah lou dingham?"},"28":{"text":"Apolama mi mu-a Juda mi hichu Juda mitah ahipoi, apolam ati chunga cheptan jong chu cheptan ahipoi."},"29":{"text":"Asunggila Juda mi hibou chu Juda mi ahin, chule lekhajem'a hilouva lhagaova lunggil lam cheptanho chu cheptan ahi; ama chu mihem pachat lo-a hilouvin Pathen pachat alojoh ahi.","ref":"Danb 30:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahile Juda mi hi ipi phachomam? Chule cheptan jong iham aphatna?"},"2":{"text":"Imalam jouse-a phachom tah ahi, abulpen chu, Pathen thu chengse amaho kipedoh-a kichinsah anahi."},"3":{"text":"Khat touvin tahsan hih jongleu i-hiding ham? Amaho tahsan lou chun Pathen tahsan umje hi manlou asochom em?"},"4":{"text":"Chuti hihhen; Pathen chu dihtah hihen lang, mi jouse chu ajou hihen; hiche thudol hi, Nangma, nangma thuseija chonpha tia nakisima, Thupitan na-a jong najo theinan, tin akisunin ahi.","ref":"Labu 51:4"},"5":{"text":"Ahivangin ichonphat lounao hin Pathen chonphatna chu akichetsah cheh-a ahile, ipi isei dingu ham? Lunghanga talen peji-a Pathen dihlou ham? (Mihem dan banga kasei ahi)."},"6":{"text":"Chuti ahipoi, chuti ahile Pathen'in vannoi leiset thupi iti atan dingham?"},"7":{"text":"Keima jousei jeh-a Pathen dihje chu ama loupina khopma letset tah-a akihaphon cheh-a ahile, michonse tia themmo changa iti ka umnah lai dingham?"},"8":{"text":"Chule keiho neihehset uva, kimkhatnin kasei loubeh-u; phatna ahung umna dingin setna bolu hite, tin aseijuve, tia neingoh-u bangchun, eihonjong hiti chun seiju hite natijiu hilouham? Chutobang thusei ho themmo achanu chu dihtah ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuti ahile, keiho Juda mi hi midang sanga phajo kahiuvem? Iti nama jongle kaphajo pouve. Ajehchu Juda mi chule Greek mi abona chonset noija um cheh ahi, tia kahilchah sa cheh-u ahitai.","title":"Mihem khatcha Chonpha Aumpoi"},"10":{"text":"Hiti jong hin akisune, Chonpha koima aumpoi, khatcha jong aumpoi.","ref":"Labu 14:3; 53:1-3"},"11":{"text":"Koima ahetoh thema aumpoi, Koima Pathen hola aumpoi,"},"12":{"text":"Lam hilouva akihei sohkei taovin, abon chaovin manlou asohgam taove. Apha lama chona aumpoi, khatcha jong aumpoi."},"13":{"text":"Alol homu lhan kihong ahin; Aleijun lheplhahna thu jeng aseijun, Anel noijuvah gulse gu aumin;","ref":"Labu 5:9; 140:3."},"14":{"text":"Akam sungula sapsetna le thugilouvin adimin;","ref":"Labu 10:7."},"15":{"text":"Akengu thisona ding lamah ajangin;","ref":"Isai 59:7-8."},"16":{"text":"Alampi jouseu-ah man naleh hesohna aumin;"},"17":{"text":"Lungmonna lampi aheta pouve;"},"18":{"text":"Amitmuvah Pathen gin aumpoi.","ref":"Labu 36:1."},"19":{"text":"Mi jouse kam binna dingle vannoi leiset pumpi Pathen thutana-a aum theina dinguva, danthun asei chengse hi danthu thua nungho jah-a kisei ahi, ti iheuve."},"20":{"text":"Danthu juija thilbola mi koima a-angsunga them changa umlou ding ahi, ajehchu danthua kona chonsetna kihedoh ahi.","ref":"Labu 143:2; Gal 2:16"},"21":{"text":"Ahin tu vangin danthua hilouhelin, danthule themgaoho thuhetsah Pathen chonphatna chu akilang dohtan ahi.","title":"Tahsan Vanga Chonphat Chan"},"22":{"text":"Chuche Pathen'a kon chonphatna chu Jesu Khrista tahsan vanga mijousele atahsante jouse chunga kilanga ahi: koima imachom aumpoi:","ref":"Gal 2:16"},"23":{"text":"Ajeh chu mi jouse hi chonsea ahitan, Pathen loupina chu changlela ahiuve;"},"24":{"text":"Khrista Jesu'a kilhatdohna aum jeh-a, Pathen lungset vanga chonphat moh chonbou ahiuve."},"25":{"text":"Pathen'in alungdesot vanga masanga chonsetna kichaisaho talen pelouva aum jeh-in, achonphat vetsahna dinga tahsan vanga athisan chu kithoidamna hidinga apehdoh ahin;"},"26":{"text":"Ama chonpha ahina dingle, Jesu tahsan chan chu chonpha-a asim theina dinga, tulaija hi achonphatna avetsah ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chuti ahile kisonna hoithona hoibaham? Kinotdoh-a ahitai. Itobang danthua ham? Danthu juija natoh naham? Ahipoi, tahsanna danthu-a joh ahibouve."},"28":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun danthu juija natoh vang hilouva, tahsan vanga mi chonpha kisim ahi, tia kangaitou ahi."},"29":{"text":"Pathen chu Juda mite changseh Pathen ham? Chidang namdangte Pathen jong hilou ham? Chidang namdang te-a jong ahi."},"30":{"text":"Ahin Pathen khatseh ahi jeh chun, cheptanho chu tahsana kona chonpha asima, chule cheptan louho chu tahsan vanga chonpha asim ding ahi.","ref":"Gal 2:16"},"31":{"text":"Chuti ahile itahsan jeh uva hi danthu kisumanga ham? Ahipoi; danthu kiphudetjoh ahibouve."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahile tahsa lama ipuluiju Abraham'in amu chu ipi isei dingu ham?","title":"Abraham Vetkah Ding"},"2":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile ama chu natoh vanga chonpha kisim ahile kisonna anei ahi, ahinla Pathen lamah aneipon ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun ipi aseijem? Abraham'in Pathen atahsan jal-in atahsan chu ama dingin chonphatnin akisimtai.","ref":"Semt 15:6; Gal 3:6"},"4":{"text":"Natongte sum san hi lungsetman kiti louvin, asan ding abatnin akiseijon ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla Pathen helou natoh beija chonpha chansahpa tahsana chu, atahsan chu chonphatna kisima ahi."},"6":{"text":"Natong louva Pathen'in michon pha-a asimho chu phatthei achan dingjeu chu, David'in jong aseijin,"},"7":{"text":"Asuhkhelnau kingaidama, Chule achonsetna kikhu khumho chu anun nomui.","ref":"Labu 32:1-2."},"8":{"text":"Pakaiyin achonsetna asimlou dingpa chu anun nome, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuti ahile chuche phattheina chu cheptante chung jenga ham, cheptan louho chunga jongham? Ajeh chu eihon Abraham atahsan chu ama dinga chonphatna-a kisim ahitai, itiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Achutile iti aum petna chonpha kisim ham? Acheptan jouha, cheptan louva aum laija ham? Cheptana aum jou hilouvin, cheptan louva aum lai ahi:"},"11":{"text":"Chule cheptan louva uma atahsanho jouse pa ahi theina dingle, amaho dinga chu chonphatna-a akisim theina dinga, chule cheptan jeng jong hilouva ipuluiju Abraham cheptan louva aum laija atahsan chu,","ref":"Semt 17:10"},"12":{"text":"Hiche tahsan nungjuija cheptanho pa jong ahi theina dinga, cheptan louva uma tahsan vanga chonphat chu hetna-a melchih na-a cheptan chu amu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ajeh chu Abraham le achilhah chu, vannoi goulo ding ahi tia thutep chu danthua kon hilouvin, tahsana kona chonphat vanga joh ahibouve.","title":"Pathen Thutep Chu Tahsan Vanga Kimu ahi","ref":"Semt 17:4-6; 22:17-18; Gal 3:29."},"14":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile danthua kona chonpha kisimhon alouva ahile, tahsan chu ahomkeo ahitai, chule thutep jong chu pannabei ahitai.","ref":"Gal 3:18"},"15":{"text":"Ajeh chu danthun lunghan akonsah ahi; danthu beina-a chun suhkhel jong aumpoi."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu lungsetna-a ahi theina-a, danthu noija umho chang jeng hilouva Abraham tahsan noija um achilhahte jousen, hiche thutep alo dingu chu adet theina dinga, amahon alo dingu chu tahsan vanga alo dingu ahibouve.","ref":"Gal 3:7."},"17":{"text":"Mithiho hinsah theija, aum louho auma banga kou Pathen, Abraham'in atahsan chu, ama angsunga Abraham chu ibon chaova ikonnao ipuluiju ahi; chule hitin jong akisune, Keiman nangma vai tamtah kona puluija kasem ahitai, ati.","ref":"Semt 17:5"},"18":{"text":"Chule kiholna neilou ahivangin, nachilhah hijatpi khu hi ding ahi tia, asei thucheng dungjuija, khonungle vai tamtah pului ahung hi ding chu kiholin atahsanin ahi.","ref":"Semt 15:15"},"19":{"text":"Chule kum jakhat jen alhina, athisa tobang atahsa le Sarah chin jong chu ngaiton, atahsan daideh louhelin aumin,","ref":"Semt 17:17"},"20":{"text":"Pathen thutep chu tahsan lellin aumpon ahi."},"21":{"text":"Pathen'in athutep chu bol jong bol thei ahi ti ahechenin, Pathen avahchoijin atahsan ahat chehjotan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu atahsan chu ama dinga chonphatna kisima ahitai."},"23":{"text":"Tahsan chu ama ding jenga chonphatna-a kisima kisun ahipoi; eiho dinga jong kisun ahi."},"24":{"text":"Pakai Jesu Khrista athia kona kaithoupa tahsana eiho, eiho dinga jong chonphatna-a kisim ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hiche Jesu chu eiho suhkhel jeh-a kipedoh ahitai; chule eiho chonpha ikisimna dinguva kaithouva uma ahitai.","ref":"Isai 53:4-5"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahin tahsan vanga eiho chonpha kisim ihitah jeh-un, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vanga Pathen toh kichamdela um ihitaove.","title":"Themchansah Ga"},"2":{"text":"Chujongle ama vanga chu hiche lungsetna idin detnaova hi tahsan vanga lut ihitaove, chule Pathen loupina-a chu kinema kipah jinga um ihitaove."},"3":{"text":"Chule chuti jengseh hilouvin, hesohna chun thohhat asosahji ihetbangun, ihesoh gentheinao jenga jong iloupi jiuve;"},"4":{"text":"Thohhat chun aphat photchena asosahjin, photchena chun kinepna asosahjin ahi, ti iheuve."},"5":{"text":"Chule hiche kinepna chun eijumso pouve, ajeh chu eipeh-u Lhagao Theng vanga chu ilung sunguva Pathen ngailutna long lut ahitai."},"6":{"text":"Ihatmo laijuvin aphatchan michonseho khelin anathitan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Michonpha chung changah koima pouvin ahinna tohponte; mipha chungchanga ahinna toh ngam jong mi khattou umkhat nante."},"8":{"text":"Ahin Pathen'in eingailutnau photchena eimusah-un ahi; ajeh iham itile eiho chonsetna i-um laitah-un Christa eiho khelin athitan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun eiho tun, Christa thisan vanga chonpha kisim ihitah jeh-u chun, achungchona ama vanga Pathen lunghan na-a kona huhhing-a umtei ding ihiuve."},"10":{"text":"Ajeh chu adouva ipan laitah uva Pathen Chapa thi chun Pathen toh eisuhchamu ahitah-a ahile, akicham jeh-a chu achungchona ama hinna vanga huhhing-a umtei ding ihiuve."},"11":{"text":"Chuti jeng jong hilouvin, tun Pathen toh eisuhcham uva, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vanga Pathen'a pa jong ikipao ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hiti chu ahin, mi khat jeh-a vannoi'a chonset lut, chule chonset jeh-a thina lut ahi; chutima chu mi jouse chonset jeh-a thina chu mi jouse chunga lhungsoh ahitai.","title":"Adam Vanga Thina Christa Vanga Hinna","ref":"Semt 3:6."},"13":{"text":"Ajeh chu danthu kipeh masang peh-a chu vannoi leisetna chonset anaumsa ahin; ahivangin danthu um louna-a chu chonset jong kisim lou ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahivangin Adam'a pat Mosi geijin Adam suhkhel banga sukhel louho chunga jong, thina chun vai analosa ahi. Adam chu ahung dingpa lim banga um ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ahivangin manbeija thilpeh chu suhkhela toh kibang ahipoi; ajeh chu mi khat suhkhel jeh-a midang jouse athia ahile, achungchon cheh-a Pathen lungset le mi khat, Jesu Christa lungset vanga thilpeh chu mi tamtah chunga letsetna chua ahitai."},"16":{"text":"Chule thilpeh chu, achonsea mi khat jeh-a chutoh akibangpoi; ajeh chu mi khatna kona chu themmo channa lama thu kitan ahin, manbeija thilpeh vang chu suhkhelna tamtah-a kona them changa kisima ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ajeh chu mi khat suhkhel jeh-a, mi khat vanga chu thina-in vai alotah-a ahile, lungsetna le chonphat thilpeh letset changho chu achungchon cheh-a, mi khat, Jesu Christa vanga hinna-a vai alo dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chutichu ahin suhkhelna khat jeh-a mi jouse themmo chansahna thutana um ahi; chutima chu chonphatna thilbol khat vanga hinna lama them chansahna manbeija thilpeh chu mi jouse chunga hung uma ahitai."},"19":{"text":"Ajeh chu mikhatnin thupeh apallhah jeh-a mi tamtah chonse kisosah ahitan; chutima chu mikhatnin thupeh anit jeh-a chu mi tamtah chonpha kiso ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Amavang suhkhel punna dinga danthu hung lutbe ahi. Ahinla chonset punna chana chu lungsetna hapun cheh-a ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chutia chu chonsetnin thina-a vai alo bangtah-a chu, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vanga tonsot hinkemlou geija dinga chonphat vanga lungsetna-in vai alo theina ding ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Achutile ipi isei dingu hitam? Lungsetna apun chehna dinga ichonset jing dingu ham?","title":"Chonsetna Thi le Christa'a Hin"},"2":{"text":"Chutiponte! chonset lama athisa eiho, chonsetna iti ihin jing nahlai dingu ham?"},"3":{"text":"Eiho Christa Jesu'a baptize chang chengse hi athina-a baptize changa ihiu hi nahet lou uham?"},"4":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu Pa loupina vanga Christa athi lah-a kona akaithou banga chu, eiho jong hinkho thah lam chu ijot theina dinguva, baptize chana hi athina-a amatoh kivuitha-a ihi taovin ahi.","ref":"Col 2:12"},"5":{"text":"Ajeh chu ama thi lim banga ithiuva amatoh thikhom ihiule, atho kit lim banga jong itho kit dingu ahi;"},"6":{"text":"Tu nung kalsea eiho chonset soh-a i-um louna dinguva, chonset po tahsapum suhmanga aum theina dinga, imi luiju chu amatoh thingpel'a kikhetbeh tha-a ahitai, ti chu iheuve;"},"7":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile athia chu chonsetna kona ongthola ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Chule eiho Christa toh ithiu ahitah-a ahile, amatoh ihin dingu jong ahi, ti chu itahsan un ahi;"},"9":{"text":"Ajeh chu athi lah-a kona kikaithou Christa chu imatihchanna thi lou ding ahi, thina-in achungah thu aneitapoi, ti iheuve."},"10":{"text":"Athi chu chonset lama tonsot geija dinga khatvei thia ahitai; ahin vang chu Pathen lama hinga ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hiche bang chun nangho jong chonsetna lamah athisan kigel unlang, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa jal-in Pathen lamah ahingin kigelun."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun natahsa lung got lama chonna dingin, natahsa thithei chunga chun chonset vaipohsah hihhelun."},"13":{"text":"Chujongle natibah chengseu chonphat louna manchah-in chonsetna lamah pedoh hihhelun, ahin athi lah-a kona hingdoh kahi tin, Pathen'ah kipeuvin, natibah chengseu jong chu chonphatna manchah din Pathen'ah pedoh jovin."},"14":{"text":"Ajeh chu chonset chun nachung uva thu neitalou ding ahi, ijeh ham itile danthu noija um nahitapouvin, lungsetna noija umjoh nahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Iti tantem ahile? Danthu noija um louva lungsetna noija um ihi jeh uva chu, ichonset dinguham? Chutiponte.","title":"Chonphatna-a Sohchan"},"16":{"text":"Koi heng koi heng hijongle athua nung dinga asoh-a nalutna chu; thina dinga chonsetna lam hijongle, chonphatna dinga thua nunna hijongle, athua naumpa soh chu nahi, hichu nahet louvu ham?"},"17":{"text":"Masangin nangho chonset soh nanahiu ahin, ahivangin lunggiltah-a chutobang thu kihil chu nit dinga kipedoh-a athu noija um nahitaovin,"},"18":{"text":"Chule chonsetna kona kichoidoh-a chonphat soh nahiu ahitan, hiche jeh chun Pathen thangvah-in umhen."},"19":{"text":"Natahsa pheu hatmo jeh-a keiman mihem thu banga kasei ahi; ajeh chu nanghon masang laija natibah chengu then louna dinga chonset chunga chonsetna lama soh banga napehdoh jiu ahin, hiche bangtah chun tun natibah chengseu chu thenna dingin chonphatna lamah soh bangin pedoh jengun."},"20":{"text":"Nangho chonset soh nahi laijun chonphatna lam dola onga nahiuvin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chutichu ahin tu-a najachat piu thulam dola hi hiche laija chu aga ipi namuji uvem? Ajeh chu hitiho chu achaina thina ahibouve."},"22":{"text":"Tu vangin nangho chonsetna kona onga Pathen soh nahitah jeh-un, thenna lamah ga naneitaove, chule aleh chu tonsot hin kemlou ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile chonset man thina ahi, Pathen thil mohpeh vanghi Pakai Christa Jesu vanga tonsot hinna ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ole sopite, mihem ahinlai chansebovin danthun achungah thu aneije, ti nahet louvu ham? Danthu themho kahouna ahi.","title":"Kichen Umchan Vetsah-a Kihilna"},"2":{"text":"Numei jineija chu a-inneipu ahinlai chansea danthun a-inneipu toh akanbeh jing ahin, ajipa athi vangle, a-inneipu danthua kona chu ongdoh jia ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun a-inneipu hinpetnin midang ji hitahen hile, chutengle amanu chu ajonga kiti ding ahi. A-inneipu thi teng vangle, danthua kona onga ahitan, pasal dang ji hijongle ajonga hita lou ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nangho chungchang thua jong chutima chu ahi, sopite, Pathen lama iga theina dingule achom khat, athi lah-a kona thoudohpa-a nahi theina dinguva, Christa tahsa vanga danthu lama thisah-a um nahitaove."},"5":{"text":"Ajeh chu tahsaphe-a i-um laiseu chun danthua kona chonsetna lama chalohna chun thina lama iga theina dinguva, itibah chunguva na anatohji ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahin tu vangin lekhajem luija hilouva, lhagao thah-a ijen theina dinguva ithiuva, eikituhnao danthua kona kilhadoh ihiuve."},"7":{"text":"Achutile ipi isei dinguham? Danthu hi chonsetna ham? Ahipoi; chonset chu ipi ahi anahe lou kahi, danthua kona kahetdoh ahibouve; ajeh chu, Papset bol hih-in, ti hi danthun asei lou hile, ipi ahi kanahet lou ding ahi.","title":"Dan Chule Chonset","ref":"Pot 20:17; Danb 5:21."},"8":{"text":"Ahinla chonset chun agomkomcha atohkhan, chuche thupeh-a kon chun kalunga papset imajouse asosahtan ahi; ajeh chu danthu beija chonset chu athi ahi."},"9":{"text":"Masanglai chun danthu um louva anahing jing kahin, chuche thupeh ahung um phat chun chonset chu ahingdoh kitnin keima kathitai."},"10":{"text":"Chule hinna dinga thupeh chu thinajoh-in kananeitan ahi;"},"11":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile chonset chun agomkomcha atokhahjia, thupeh-a chu eilheplhah-a, hiche chun eitha ahi.","ref":"Semt 3:3"},"12":{"text":"Chutichu ahin danthu athenge, thupeh jong athenge, adih lheh jengin aphai;"},"13":{"text":"Ahile apha chu keima dinga thina mongham? Ahipoi. Apha chu amanchah-a chonset chun kachunga thina asodoh-a kona chu, hichu chonset ahi tia akiphon dohna dinga chule thupeh vanga chonset chu setna chungnung tah ahi chu, akichetna dinga chonset jeh joh-a ahibouve."},"14":{"text":"Ajeh chu danthu chu lhagao lam thil ahi ti iheuve, keima vang tahsa lam mi chonset soh-a kijoh-a kahi.","title":"Mihem Sunga Kidouna"},"15":{"text":"Ajeh chu keiman ipi kaboldoh kahepoi, ajeh iham itile kalunggot lou lam jeng kaboljin; kahot lam jengbou kabol jin ahi.","ref":"Gal 5:17"},"16":{"text":"Kalunggot lou lam kabola ahile, danthu chu apha ahi tia oija kahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahivangin tun abola keima hita louva keija cheng chonset chun abol ahitabouve."},"18":{"text":"Ajeh chu keima sunga kasa chunga hin phat achengpoi, ti kahei, ajeh chu lunggotna vang chu aumin thilpha boldoh najohbou umlou ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile apha kalunggot lam chu kaboljipon, aphalou kalunggot lou lambou chun kachon jingjitan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Kalunggot lou lam kabolji ahile, abola chu keima hilouva keija um chonsetjoh chu ahibouve."},"21":{"text":"Chutichun thilpha bol kagot komle, setna chu kakoma ahung umjin, hiche umdanje hi kahetan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Kami sungnungin Pathen danthua kathanom lhehji nan,"},"23":{"text":"Ahivangin kalung lam danthu douva katibah chunga um, chonset danthu, soh-a eipui lutji-a katibah chunga hin danthu chom khat aum kamujin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ohe! mi gentheitah chu kanahi! Hiche thina tahsa-a kon hin koijin eihuhdoh tantem?"},"25":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vangin Pathen kathangvah-e. Chutichu ahi jeh-a keiman kalungtah-a Pathen danthu noija kauma, kasa-a chonset danthu soh na katoh ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hitichun tuvangin, Christa Jesu'a umho, tahsa thua chonlouva lhagao thua chonho dinga themmo channa himhim umlou ahitai.","title":"Lhagaova Hin"},"2":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile Christa Jesu'a um hinna Lhagao danthu chun chonsetle, thina danthua kona eilhatdoh-a onga kahitai."},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu tahsaphen asuh hatmo jeh-a danthun abol joulou chu, Pathen'in Achapa chu chonset jeh-a chonset po tahsaphe lim pu-a ahinsola; tahsaphe-a chonsetna chu themmo achan ahitan,"},"4":{"text":"Hichu tahsaphe lam hilouva Lhagao lama chon eiho chunga, danthun angeh chonphatna chu aguilhun theina ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile tahsaphe lam dana chonteho chun tahsaphe lam thudol agelun; Lhagao lam dana chonho chun Lhagao lam thudol bou agelun ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tahsa lam lunggel chu thina ahin, Lhagao lam lunggel chu hinna le lungmonna ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajeh chu tahsa lam lunggel chu Pathen toh kidou ahi; ajehchu Pathen danthu noija um ahipon, umjong umthei louding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun tahsa lama chonho chun Pathen alunglhai theipouve."},"9":{"text":"Pathen Lhagao nasunguva achen vangle, tahsa lama chon hilouva Lhagao lama chon nahiu ahi. Christa Lhagao neilou vang chu Christa-a ahipoi."},"10":{"text":"Chule Christa chu nangho sunga auma ahile, chonset vanga tahsa chu athia ahin, lhagao vang chu chonphat vanga hinna ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule athi lah-a kona Jesu kaithoupa Lhagao chu nangho sunga achenle, Christa Jesu mithi lah-a kona kaithoupa tah chun nangho sunga cheng ama lhagao vanga chu, natahsao thi thei jong chu ahinsah ding ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 3:16"},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun, sopite, eihon bat ineijuve, amavang tahsa henga, tahsa lama chonna dinga neija ihipouve."},"13":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangho tahsa lam dana nachonule, iti jongle nathi tei dingu ahi; Lhagaova tahsa natoh chengse chu natha vangule, nahin dingu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen Lhagao kaihoija umho chengse chu, Pathen chate ahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile kichat kitna dinga sohchana lhagao hilouva, cha hina lhagao changjoh nahibouvui; hiche lhagao vanga chu, Abba, Hepa, tia ikoujiu ahi.","ref":"Mrk 14:36; Gal 4:6"},"16":{"text":"Lhagao chun amatah-in eiho lhagaotoh kitho-a Pathen chate ihiu eihetsah-u ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule chate ihiule gou lo ding ihiuvin, Pathen gou lo ding, chule Christa toh lo khom ding ihiuve; amatoh ithoh khomule, amatoh choi-atna iumkhom dingu ahi.","ref":"Gal 4:5-7"},"18":{"text":"Tulaija ithohnao hi khonunga ichan dingu loupina hung kilang ding chutoh kikot hoi themin kangaito poi.","title":"Ahunglhung ding Loupina"},"19":{"text":"Thilsem chengse kinem ngui nguitah-a Pathen chate hung kilah ding chu angalel lheh jengu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile thilsem chengse ahomkeo thu noija aumu hi ama chama um ahipoi, kinepna-a aumsahpa thusah-a um ahibouvui.","ref":"Semt 3:17-19"},"21":{"text":"Ajeh chu thilsem chengse hin amahotah jong kemthei soh-a auma kona lhadoh-a aumuva, Pathen chate loupitah-a noma alenaova chu alut diu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahin tugei hin thilsem jouse naosonat thoh banga gim thoh-a peng penga umkhom ahi ti iheuve."},"23":{"text":"Amaho jengseh ahipoi, Lhagao ga masa changa eihotah jeng jong, cha hina, itahsao lhatdoh-a umding chu ngah jinga, ilung sungu peng penga um ihiuve.","ref":"2 Cor 5:2-4"},"24":{"text":"Ajeh chu kinepna in eihuhhingu ahin; ahinla mu-a kinep chu kinep ahipoi; ajehchu mihemin amusa chu ipi dinga akineppi nahlai ding ham?"},"25":{"text":"Mu louva kinem ihiu vangle, lungdet tah-a ngah jinga ihiuve."},"26":{"text":"Chutichun Lhagao jongin ihatmonauvah eikaihoijun eihu jingjiuve; ajeh chu eihon adol lamtah-a ipi-a dinga itao diuham ihepouve; ahivangin Lhagaovin eiho dingin seidoh thei louvin peng pengin eitaopeh jiuve."},"27":{"text":"Chule Pathen lunglam doltah-a mithengte dinga ataopeh jeh chun, lungthimgil kholtoh-a Pathen chun Lhagao lunglam chu ahejin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ahin Pathen ngailuho chengse, ama lunggot lam doltah-a kikouho ding vang chun, thiljouse hin aphat nadingu atongkhom sohkeije, ti chu iheuve."},"29":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile sopihon tamtah lah-a Pathen Chapa chu apeng masapen ahina dinga, Pathen'in ahet masah ho chu Achapa lim banga agot masahsa ahitai;"},"30":{"text":"Chule agot masahsaho chu kou jong akou ahi; chule akouho chu them jong achansah ahitai: chule them achansahho chu choi jong achoi-at ahitai."},"31":{"text":"Chuti ahile hicheng thua hi ipi isei dingu ham? Pathen eiho lama apanle, koiham eidou thei dinguva?","title":"Christa Jesu'a Pathen Mingailut"},"32":{"text":"Achapa khen louhela eiho jouse dinga pedoh jengpa chun, eiho lungset mana ama chutoh thakhatna ijakai eipeh khom lou dingu ham?"},"33":{"text":"Pathen lhenchomteho chu koiham ahehse dinga? Them chansah-a Pathen ahibouve."},"34":{"text":"Themmo chansah-a koiham? Athia, achungchon cheh-a athi lah-a kona kaithouva um Christa chu ahi; ama Pathen jet lama atouvin eiho dingin eitaopeh jinguve."},"35":{"text":"Christa ngailutna-a kona koiham eikhen dinguva? Hesoh gentheile, lungdonna, bolsetna, gilkel, pon beija um, settona, chemjam, hicheng chun eikhen thei dingham?"},"36":{"text":"Hiche dol jong hi akisune, Keiho nangma jeh-in nilhum keijin eikithat jingui; Tha dinga kigo kelngoi bangin eikisim taove.","ref":"Labu 44:22"},"37":{"text":"Ahinla eingailupau vangin hicheng thua hin eiho galjou sanga galjou ihiuve."},"38":{"text":"Ajeh chu I-Pakaiyu Christa Jesu'a um Pathen ngailutna kon chun thina ahin, hinna ahin, vantil ahin, vaipo pipu ahin, thuneina ahin, tulai thudol le khonung ding thu ahin,"},"39":{"text":"Chungsang ahin, noilam thuhtah hijongle, thilsem adang imachan eikhen thei lou dingu ahi, tia dettah-a katahsan ahitai."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keiman Christa-a thutahbeh kasei ahi, kajoupoi;","title":"Israel ten Christa Asanlouvu"},"2":{"text":"Kalunga lunghesohna nasatahle thohlel tang louhela aum hi, ase apha kahetna kalungin Lhagao Thengah eihettohpin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu keimatah-in tahsa lama kanam mite, kasopite khela Christa-a kona manna lama dinga sedoh-a uma, sapset lhunna-a umhel jeng ding kanagot ahi."},"4":{"text":"Israelte ahiuvin; cha hina chu amauva ahin, loupina, thulhun jouse, danthu peh, Pathen houna, chule thutep jouse la amaho-a ahin;","ref":"Pot 9:4"},"5":{"text":"Pute pate jong amaho-a bou ahin, tahsaphe lama Christa jongla amaho lah-a kon ahibouvin, ama chu imajouse chunga chungnung pen Pathen ahin, akhang akhanga pachat tohtah ahi. Amen."},"6":{"text":"Ahivangin Pathen thu chu imacha hilouva um ahipoi. Ajeh chu Israel lah-a kon jouse Israel ahipoi.","title":"Israel Kipaidoh le Pathen Tohgon"},"7":{"text":"Chule Abraham chilhah ahisohkei vangun aboncha keijun achate ahipouve; Isaac'a kona bou nachilhah tia kisei ding ahi, tia asei ahi.","ref":"Semt 21:12"},"8":{"text":"Hichu hiti hi ahi, tahsa-a chate chu Pathen chate ahipoi; thutep chatebou chu chilhah tia kisim ahi."},"9":{"text":"Thutep chu hiche hi ahi, Hiti phattah hile kahung ding ahin, chutengle Sara'in chapa khat ahin ding ahi.","ref":"Semt 18:10"},"10":{"text":"Chucheng jeng ahipoi, ahin Rebecca jong chu mi khatna kona, ipuluiju Isaac'a kona agai laijin,","ref":"Semt 25:23."},"11":{"text":"Achateni so masangin chule apha ase imacha abol masangin, toh vanga hilouva akoupa lunglam le Pathen'in alhen dungjuija, lunggotsa chu adetna dinga,"},"12":{"text":"Amanu jah-a, A-upajo chun anaopa soh na atoh ding ahi, tia kiseija anahi."},"13":{"text":"Hiche thudola hin, Keiman Jacob kana ngailun, Esau vang kanahot ahi, tin akisune.","ref":"Mal 1:2-3"},"14":{"text":"Achutile ipi isei dingu ham? Pathen'ah chonphat louna aume iti dingu ham? Ahipoi.","title":"Israel Kipaidoh le Pathen Chonphatna"},"15":{"text":"Aman Mosi jah-a, Keiman kalungsetpa chu lungset ningting, kahepipa chu kahepi ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Pot 33:19"},"16":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun hiche hi alunga tuppa vang jong hilouva, adelpa vang jong hilouva, alungsetpa Pathen vanga konjoh ahibouve."},"17":{"text":"Pathen lekhabu thun Pharaoh jah-a, Nachunga kathilbol theina kavetsah theina dingle, vannoi leisetna kamin kiphon jalna ding monga nangma katundoh nahi, ati.","ref":"Pot 9:16"},"18":{"text":"Chutichu ahin Pathen'in ahepi nomchan ahepijia, alunggot chan chu alung asuhtahji ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hichea hin nangman kei jah-a, Achutile ibola eithem mosah jiham, neitin nate. Ajeh chu alunggot chu koiham akham theija?"},"20":{"text":"Ahipoi, vo mihem, Pathen douna-a donbut nang koi nahim? Thilsem chun asempa jah-a, Ibola hitia neisem ham, tintem?","ref":"Isai 29:16; 45:9"},"21":{"text":"Bellei lhang khatna bel khat lutah-a dena, khat lulouva den ding, abel lei chunga chu beldengpan thu anei hilouham?"},"22":{"text":"Ahin, Pathen'in alungsat vetsahnale athil bolthei hetsahna ding lung ngaito-a, mangthah dinga gotsa um lungsatna belho chunga alung adesotle;"},"23":{"text":"Chule loupi nikho-a dinga masanga patna agotsa, ahepi belho chunga aloupina hao chu hetsah dinga,"},"24":{"text":"Aman eiho jengjong, Juda lah-a kon jengseh hilouva, chidang namdangte lah-a kon jonga eikouvu hilouham?"},"25":{"text":"Chutobang chun Hosea lekhabua, Kamite hikhalouho chu keiman kamite kati ding, kadeilounu chu kadeinu kati ding ahi.","ref":"Hos 2:23"},"26":{"text":"Nangho keima mite nahipouve tia ajah uva kiseina laitah-a chu, Amaho Pathen hing chate kiti ding ahiuve, tia kisei bang chu ahi.","ref":"Hos 1:10."},"27":{"text":"Israelte thudol Isaiah'in asamlen, Israel chate twikhanglen kama neldi jatnin tam jongleu, amoh thembou sohcha ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 10:22-23."},"28":{"text":"Ajehchu aman natoh chu achaija chule chonphatna-a phat asuh chom ding ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin leisetna hi chomcha khat bou na atoh ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hiche thudol hi Isaiah'in masangin aseije, Janel Pakaiyin chikhai ding einakhen louvu hile, Sodom dung isun diu ahin, Gomorrah toh ibah dingu ahi, ati.","ref":"Isai 1:9."},"30":{"text":"Achutile ipi isei dingu ham? Chonphatna del louhel chidang namdang ten chonphatna chu aphah-u ahitai; hichu tahsan vanga chonphatna ahi.","title":"Tule Tu-a Israel Dinmun"},"31":{"text":"Ahin Chonphatna danthu dela Israel ten, hiche chonphatna dan chu aphajou pouve."},"32":{"text":"Ijeh ham? amahon tahsana hollouva, dan thilbolla ahol jeh-u ahi. Kipal lhuhna songa kipal lhu-a ahitaove."},"33":{"text":"Hiche thudol jong hi akisune, Veuvin, keiman Sion'ah kipalna song le lung lhahna songpi kakoije; koihile ama tahsan chan chu jachatna-a chulou ding ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sopite, lunga kagotle Israelte dia Pathen henga katao nomna chu, huhhing-a ahung umtheina dingu hi, ahipene.","title":"Israel'in Kipana Thupha Angaichat"},"2":{"text":"Pathen lama agunchuve ti chu keiman kahetsah ahi; ahivangin hichu hetna neija gunchu ahipoi."},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu amahon Pathen chonphatna ahetlou jeh-ule, amaho chonphatna phudoh ding agot jeh-un, Pathen chonphat na-ah alut tapouve."},"4":{"text":"Christa chu atahsan jouse dinga, chonphatna amu theina dinguva danthu chaina ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Mosi'n chonphatna danthu anahilchet na-a, chonphatna nitpa bou chuche achonphat vanga chu hing ding ahi, anatin ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:5."},"6":{"text":"Tahsana chonphat vang chun hitin aseije, Nangman nalung thimin, Koiham van'a kal ding? (hichu Christa gapuilhah ding aseina ahi);","ref":"Danb 30:12-14"},"7":{"text":"ahiloule, Koiham lei onga kumlha ding? (hichu athi lah-a kona Christa kaithou ding aseina ahi), ti hih-in."},"8":{"text":"Ahin ipi aseijem? hiche thu chu nakomah aume, nakam sungle nalung sungah aume; (hichu kasei phongleu tahsan thu chu ahi)."},"9":{"text":"Hitia chu nangman nakama Pakai Jesu chu naphon doha, chule Pathen nin ama chu athilah-a konin akaithouve ti nalunga natahsan le, asohcha ding nahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajeh chu chonphatna dinga lunga tahsan ahin, sochatna dinga kama phondoh ahi."},"11":{"text":"Pathen lekhabu thun, Koi hileh ama tahsan chan chu jachatna-a chulou ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Isai 28:16"},"12":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Juda mitele Greek mite chu imacha chom ahipouve; abonchauva chungah Pakai khatsehbou aume, ahenga tao jouse dinga phatna haotah ahi."},"13":{"text":"Koi hile Pakai mina tao chan chu huhhing-a umding ahi.","ref":"Joel 2:32"},"14":{"text":"Achutile atahsan louvu chu iti akou dinguham? Athu ajahkhah louvu chu iti atahsan dinguham? Thusei phongle beija iti ajah dinguham?","title":"Israel ten Kipana Thupha Asanlouvu"},"15":{"text":"Chule akisol louvule iti asei phongle dinguham? hitijong hin akisune, chamna kipana thupha seiphong leho, thilphaho thudola kipana thu poleho keng iti hoi hitam!","ref":"Isai 52:7"},"16":{"text":"Ahivangin mi jousen Kipana Thupha angaipouve. Ajeh chu Isaiah'in jong, Pakai, kathuphonle-u koiham atahsana, ati.","ref":"Isai 53:1"},"17":{"text":"Chuti ahijeh chun, jah-a kona tahsan umdoh, chule jah chu Pathen thua kona hung umdoh ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ahileh amahon ajah lou uham? Ajanauve. A-awginu gamtina athangin, Chule athu uvin kolkimvel achansoh tai.","ref":"Labu 19:4."},"19":{"text":"Ahivanga kasei ahi, Israel miten ahetlou uham? Amasan Mosi'n aseijin, Keiman nangho vai neilou vai khat thangset sah-uving ting, Lungthim neilou vai khatna kona kalunghansah ding nahiuve, ati.","ref":"Danb 32:21."},"20":{"text":"Isaiah'in jong hakattah-in aseijin, Eihol louten eimudoh-un, Eidong loute hengah kakiphongtai, ati.","ref":"Isai 65:1."},"21":{"text":"Ahin Israel jah-a, thua nungloute le nel hatte chunga kakhut kajah nilhum keije, tin aseije.","ref":"Isai 65:2."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Achutile Pathen'in amite chu apailhah hitam? Ahipoi. Ajeh chu kei jong Abraham chilhah-a Benjamin phunga Israel mi khat kahi.","title":"Israel Kipaidoh Chu A-itih Chana Ding Ahipoi","ref":"Phil 3:5."},"2":{"text":"Pathen'in ahet masatsa amite chu apailhapoi. Pathen lekhabu thun Elijah thu asei hi nahet lou uham? Aman Israelte chungchang thu Pathen henga alhutnin,"},"3":{"text":"Pakai, amahon nangma themgaoho athatgamun, nang houna maicham asuchimun, keima changseh kaumtai, kei jong tha dingin eitup jingui, ati.","ref":"1 Leng 19:10,14"},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin Pathen'in adonbutna chu ipi aseijem? Keiman keija dingin Baal anga dilsu louhel mi sangsagi kakikhen nai, ati.","ref":"1 Leng 19:18"},"5":{"text":"Chutobangma chun tulaijin jong lungsetna kilheng amoh moh aumnai."},"6":{"text":"Amavang hichu lungset man ahile, thilbol vanga ahipoi; chuti ahiloule lungsetna hi lungsetna hita lou ahi. Ahinla, hichu natoh vang ahile lungset vang ahitapoi, chuti ahiloule natoh hi natoh hitalou ahi."},"7":{"text":"Iti hitante ahile? Israel miten aholu chu amu louvu ahin, Pathen lhentehon bou amu ahi; adang chengse chu alung tahcheh taovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Pathen lekhabua hitin akisune, Pathen'in tuni gei hin amaho khu imutsetna lhagao apen, amu thei louna dingun mit apen, jah thei louna nakhang apen ahi.","ref":"Danb 29:4; Isai 29:10"},"9":{"text":"David jongin, A-an nehnao dokhang chu amaho dingin thangle pel hihen, Chule akipalnao le akiditnao hihen.","ref":"Labu 69:22,23."},"10":{"text":"Amu mona dingun amitnu thimhen, Chule nangman atingu bonsah jingin, tin aseijin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Keiman, ahile alhuhna dinguva kipala hiuvam, kati. Ahinaisaipoi. Amavang amaho thangset sahna dinga, amaho suhkhel vanga chu chidang namdangte dinga sochatna ahitai.","title":"Chidang Namdangte Huhhingna"},"12":{"text":"Chule amaho suhkhel chu vannoi'in haona-a aneija, chule amaho hakam chu chidang namdang ten haona-a aneija ahile, abulhin nau chu chusanga ijatna chungnung cheh ding hitam!"},"13":{"text":"Keiman chidang namdang mi nangho jah-a kasei ahi, keima chidang namdangte dinga solchah-a kapan jeh hin,"},"14":{"text":"Ijem tia kanam chanpite kathangsetsah-a alah uva abang bang asochat theina dingun katin, lhacha kapana hi kaloupisah lheh jeng ahi."},"15":{"text":"Ajeh chu amaho kipaidoh vannoi'in kichamna-a aneija ahile, amaho kilah kit chu athia kona hinna ding tailou, adang ipi hi dingham?"},"16":{"text":"Chule changbong lum amasa athena ahile, changlhah tum jouse apumpia atheng ahi; chule ajung athenle, abah chengse jong athenga ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahinla abah abang bang akiheboh-a ahile, nangho gam olive bou nahiuvin, abah lah-a kijoma nahiuve, Olive thingphung ajunga kona phattheina changkha nahitah-a nahile,"},"18":{"text":"Abahho chungah kithang-at hih-in. Kithang-at jongle chun, ajung vah-a nang nahipoi, ajungbou chun nang navahjoh ahibouve."},"19":{"text":"Hichea hin nangman, Keima kijopna dinga abahho kisubonga ahitai, tin nate."},"20":{"text":"Aphai, atahsan lou jeh-a hicheho chu kisubonga ahin, nangma natahsan jala nadindet ahi. Hoitho hih-in, kichajon;"},"21":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen'in abah tahbeh bon akhen loule, nangma jong khenpon nate."},"22":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun Pathen phatjele lungkhohje chu veuvin; alhuho dinga chu lungkhoh tah ahin, nangma ding vanga phatah ahi. Aphatna-ah um jingin, achuti loule nang jong naki satlha ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Amaho chu tahsan louva aum jing louvule, kijom kit ding ahiuve, Pathen'in amaho chu ajop kit thei ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile apena patna gam Olive phunga kona kisatlha-a nangma, angai louva Olive phung phatoh kijop nahile, apena patna abah tahbeh ho chu olive toh iti kiha jopmat cheh ding hitam!"},"25":{"text":"Sopite, hiche thuguh hi helouva naum dingu kanompoi, ajole hung kichihsah khauvinate; chidang namdangte akimsoh kahse-a Israel mite kimkhat chunga lungtahna chua ahi.","title":"Israelte Abonuva Huhhing-a Umdiu Ahi"},"26":{"text":"Chutichu ahin Israelte jouse huhhing-a um cheh ding ahi. Hiche thudol hi, Sion'a kona Huhhing-a hung ding ahin, chule Aman Jacob phunga kona Pathen ngaisah louna asuhmang ding ahi,","ref":"Isai 59:20"},"27":{"text":"Achonsetnao kalahmang tengle, Hiche hi amahotoh kakitepnao hi ding ahi, tin akisune.","ref":"Jer 31:33-34."},"28":{"text":"Kipana Thupha thudola amaho khu nangho jala melmate ahiuvin, lhenchom lam thudola apu apateu jala deitahte ahiuve."},"29":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile Pathen'in manbeija athilpehho le akouho chu akhelkit theihoi ahipoi."},"30":{"text":"Masangin Pathen thua nunglou nahiuvin, tu vangin amaho louchal jeh-a lungsetna mu-a nahitaove."},"31":{"text":"Chule chutobangma chu amahon jong, lungsetna namu jaluva hi lungsetna amu theina dinguva, tu-a louchala ahiuve."},"32":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile Pathen'in mi jouse alungset theina dinga thua nunlou na-a akhumchah ahitai."},"33":{"text":"Pathen chihna le hetna haoje hi athuh lheh jenge! Avaihom athutan hetphah hoi ahipoi, chule alampiho holdoh theihoi ahipoi!","ref":"Isai 55:8."},"34":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pakai lungthim chu koiham ahea? Chujongle lungthim pe-a anapanga koiham?","ref":"Isai 40:13."},"35":{"text":"Alepeh kit dinga thilpha anape masa koiham?","ref":"Job 41:11."},"36":{"text":"Ajeh chu ama-a konle, ama vanga, chule ama dinga thil jouse ana uma ahi. Loupina jouse atonsot geijin ama-a hi jinghen. Amen."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun, sopite, Pathen lungset vang hin natipum piu chu longlhen thengtah gan kihinglha bangin Pathen lah thei doltah-in Pathen'ah kipeuvin tia kangeh nahiuve, hichu natoh dinguva kilom tah chu ahi.","title":"Christa-a Hinkho Thah"},"2":{"text":"Chule nangho tulai vannoi leiset chon hin chon hih-un; Pathen lungdeilam, hichu apha, lah theile phat chamkim hi ipi ahi nahetdoh theina dingun, lung thah keng-unlang lim chom puvin."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun eipeh lungsetna vang hin nalah uva mi chengse jah-a kasei ahi, agel dingdol kalvalin koiman kalena ti gel hihhen, amavang Pathen'in apeh kham kham tahsanna dungjuijin kituptah-in ngaito henlang lung geltohhen."},"4":{"text":"Tipum khatnah tibah tamtah ineijui, tibah jouse thakhat ahipoi, apanna akibangpon ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 12:12"},"5":{"text":"Hibang chun eiho jong tamtah ihiuvin, Christa-a ti khat ihiuve; khat chu khat tibah ihi cheh-un ahi."},"6":{"text":"Lungsetna eipeh bang cheh-un eithil peh-u achom cheh ineijun ahi. Thusei phongna apehpan atahsan dungjuijin seihen;","ref":"1 Cor 12:4-11"},"7":{"text":"Sottola pang chu sottolin umhen; mihil chun mihil lamah;"},"8":{"text":"Mitilkhou chun mitilkhouna lamah kipehen; thil homan it louhelin homhen; vaipo-a pang chun gunchu tah-in vai pohen; milungsetnan kipahtah-in lungset hen."},"9":{"text":"Ngailutna alem beihel hihen. Ase lam thet bolunlang apha chu kolchah jingun.","title":"Christian ho Hinkho Umchan Dan Thu"},"10":{"text":"Kisopi ngailutna lamah kideito kisato cheh-in umun; kiginle kijana lamah amasajo ding kichu-uvin;"},"11":{"text":"Gunchuna lamah thase hih-un; lhagao lamah al jingun; Pakai lhachan pangun;"},"12":{"text":"Kinepna-ah thanomun; genthei hesohna-a thohhatnun; taona lamah pontho jingun;"},"13":{"text":"Mithengho lhahsam huna-in kithopiuvin; jindot themun."},"14":{"text":"Nabolseteu chu phatthei boh-un; samse louvin phatthei bohjouvin.","ref":"Matt 5:44; Luk 6:28."},"15":{"text":"Kipah thanomte chu kipa thanop piuvin; akapte chu kapiuvin."},"16":{"text":"Kitohdelin lungkhat nin chon cheh-un. Letna lam lung gel louvin aneo neotoh kiloijun. Nangma chang kichihsah hih-in.","ref":"Thuch 3:7"},"17":{"text":"Mi setna chu setna-in thuh hih-un; mi jouse mitvetna apha chu bol ding gojouvin."},"18":{"text":"Chule ahi theija ahile, najochanun, mi jousetoh kihoutheijun kichamdelin umun."},"19":{"text":"Vo deitahte, kiphulah hih-un, Pathen lunghanna chu otdoh jovin; ajeh chu Pakaiyin, Phulah chu keima kinbou ahi, keiman lethuh nange, ati, tin akisune.","ref":"Danb 32:25"},"20":{"text":"Ahin, namelmao chu agil akela ahile, an nehsah-un; adang achahle twi donsah-un; chuti bolleu chun alu chunga mei-am setkhompeh nahi dingu ahi.","ref":"Thuch 25:21-22"},"21":{"text":"Setna kijosah hihhelun, setna chu phatna-in joujovin."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thunei chungnungte thu thun mi jouse nungcheh hen; ajeh chu Pathen thusah louva thuneija aumpoi, chule aum chengse hi Pathen pansah cheh ahiuve.","title":"Leiset Vaipote Thu Thua Nun Ding"},"2":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun chuche thuneite douva chu Pathen thu douva ahi, chule adouho chun achunguva thutanna akiloikhum dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile vaipoho chu thilpha bolpa dinga kichat um hilouvin, ase bolpa dingabou kichat uma ahi. Thunei ho kicha louhelin umleng ti nagotnem? Thilpha bolin, chutile apachat nachan ding ahi;"},"4":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangma phattheina dinga ama Pathen sottola pang ahi. Ase nabol vangle kichan, aman chemjam adop khu moh-a adop ahipoi; ajeh chu ama Pathen sottol ahin, ase bolpa chunga lunghanga phula-a pang ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun lunghanna ding ahipon, ase apha hetna jala jong athua nun ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu kai jong napehjiu ahi; ajeh chu amaho Pathen sottol hiuva hiti chu abol jing jengu ahi.","ref":"Matt 22:21; Mrk 12:17; Luk 20:25."},"7":{"text":"Peh dingdol jouse chu peuvin; kai pehdol kai peuvin; se choina dolah se choijun; gin dingdol chu ginun; ja dingdol chu jauvin."},"8":{"text":"Khatle khat kingailutto cheh tailouvin koima imacha bat hih-un; ajeh chu michom dang ngailu-a chun Pathen danthupeh chu asuhbulhit ahitai.","title":"Kisopi Ngailut"},"9":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile, Jon bol hih-in, Tol that hih-in, Gucha hih-in, hetphotna dihlou mang hih-in, Papse hih-in, ti thupeh dang um jongle, Nangman nangma naki ngailut bangin naheng nakoma ngailun, tia hin akai khom sohkeijin ahi.","ref":"Pot 20:13-15,17; Danb 5:17-19; Thmpu 19:18"},"10":{"text":"Ngailutna-in hengle kom setna abolpoi; hijeh chun ngailut hi danthu bukipna ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule chuche ti louvin phat umchan hi naheuve; tu hi nangho dingin imutna kona khah phat ahitai; ajeh chu eihon itahsan tiluva sang chun tu hin isochatnao anaitan ahi.","title":"Christa Chu Kivonun"},"12":{"text":"Jan asotjo achetai, sun ahung naitai; hiche jeh chun khaije, muthim natoh pailhau hitin khovah vonin kivonuhite."},"13":{"text":"Suna bangin hoitah-in umu hite; juneh motchonle jukhama um louvin, huhle jonthanhoi nei louvin, kinahnale kithangset beihelin umu hite."},"14":{"text":"Pakai Jesu Christa chu kivonjoh bouvun, naphe phatna dingu tahsa lam ngaichat suhbulhit ding imacha go hih-un."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tahsana hat louva chu nalah uva lauvin, amavang atahsan bukim louna chu oimo-a nol ding ahipoi.","title":"Midang Oimo Louding","ref":"Col 2:16."},"2":{"text":"Mikhatnin imajouse neh theijin atahsanin, ahatmoa chun anche jengbou anei."},"3":{"text":"Anea chun anelou chu musit dahen; chule anelouvan anea chu oimo hihhen; ijeh ham itile ama chu Pathen'in alahsa ahi."},"4":{"text":"Mi insung soh oimo-a nang koi nahim? Adinle alhuh a-pakaipa-a bou ahi. Ahi, Pathen chun adinsah thei ahijeh-a chu ama chu adinsah ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Mi abang khatnin nikho khat nikho dang dang sangin ajabol tumin, abang kimkhatnin nikho jouse kibangin ajabolin ahi. Mi jousen ama lung sunga kihetchen chehhen."},"6":{"text":"Nikho jabola chun Pakai choi-atna-a ajabol ahin; nikho jabollou chun Pakai dinga ajabollou ahi. Chule ima ne-a jong chun Pathen alhai jeh chun Pakai choi-atna-a aneh ahi; anelou jong chun Pathen athangvah-a Pakai dinga anehda ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile eiho koima ama dinga hinga ihipouve, chule koima ama dinga thia ihipouve."},"8":{"text":"Ihinle Pakai dinga hing ihiuvin, ithiu jongle Pakai dinga thia ihibovui; hijeh chun hing jong leuhen Pakai dinga hing ihiuvin, thi jong leuhen Pakai dinga thia ihiuve."},"9":{"text":"Ajeh chu athi le ahing Pakai ahikop theina dinga, Khrista thia, chua thoudoh kitna, chule hing kitna ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ahin ibola nangin nasopi na-oimo ham? Chujongle nangin nasopi ibola musit nahim?
