Ajeh chu Khrista laltouna anga ibon chaova idin dingu ahinalaije.","ref":"2 Cor 5:10"},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu, Pakaiyin aseije, Keima hingjing kahito lhonna, khup jouse ka anga dilsu cheh ding, chule lei jousen Pathen henga aphondoh ding ahi; tin akisune.","ref":"Isai 45:23"},"12":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh-a chu ibon chaova Pathen henga eima chonchan cheh ikisei dingu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun tukal ki-oimoto tapou hite; hiche sang chun hiche hi ngaito jovin, sopi anga lung lhahna le kipal lhuhna koi lou ding ahi.","title":"Midang Kipal Lhuhsah Louding"},"14":{"text":"Thil angai monga thenglou aumpoi, ti hi Pakai Jesu'ah kahechenin katahsan lheh jengin ahi; amavang mi khattouvin thilboh ahi tia angaito chu, ama dinga hichu athenglou ahiji."},"15":{"text":"Na nehle chah chunga nasopi alung phatmole, ngailutna thua chonta lou nahi. Adinga Khrista thia ahitan, ama chu nangman naneh nachah-in sumang hih-in."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun naphatnao chu seisetnin um hihhen;"},"17":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen lenggam chu anneh twidon thua ahipoi; chonphatna, lungmonna, Lhagao Thenga kipana joh bou chu Pathen gam thupi ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile koi hileh chuti thua Khrista lhacha-a pang chu Pathen lung lamtah ahin, mihemin jong, Aphai, tia aphot chen ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun kichamdela umna dingle khantou theina kibolpehto lam juiju hite."},"20":{"text":"Nehle chah jeh-in Pathen natoh suse hihhelun. Thil jouse athengnai, ahinla ikhat neh-a lung lhahna chu anepa dinga setna ahi."},"21":{"text":"Sa neh hijongle, lengpitwi don hijongle, adang ipi hijongle, nasopi kipal lhuhna ahiloule lhasetna, ahiloule thalhomna chu bolda hela pha ahi."},"22":{"text":"Tahsana nanei jem? Nanei chu Pathen angah nangman hetnin nei jingin; aphalam ahi ti ngaito-a themo-a kingaito loupa chu mi nunnom ahi."},"23":{"text":"Amavang lungsa-ih puma nepa chu themmo changa ahitai; ajeh iham itile tahsanna neija aneh ahipoi; chule ipi hijongle tahsanna nei louva bol chu chonset ahi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahin eiho ahat cheng hin eima lunglhaina hol louva, ahatmote hatmona chu ipohhu joh dingu ahi.","title":"Nangma Kilunglhai Louvin, Midang Lunglhaijo-in"},"2":{"text":"Eiho khat cheh-in iheng ikoma houthu lama khantousahna dinga aphatna dingu ngaito-a, lunglhaisah ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu Christa jeng jong ama kilunglhai lou ahi; ahin, Nahouse hon nahouset nao chu keima chungah achutai, tia kisun bangjoh chu ahibouve.","ref":"Labu 69:9"},"4":{"text":"Ajeh chu nidang laija thu kisun chengse chu, lekha kisun Pathen thua kona thohhat le lungmonna imuva kinepna inei theina dinguva, eiho kihilna dinga kisun ahi."},"5":{"text":"Thohhat le lungmon kona Pathen'in, Christa lunglam doltah-in khatle khat lungkhat naputsah cheh-uhen;"},"6":{"text":"Chutia chu nanghon lungkhat le kam khatna I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa Pathen nachoi-at theina dingun."},"7":{"text":"Hichena ding chun Pathen loupi choi-atna dinga Christan nangho nalah bangu chun, khatle khat kilatouvin.","title":"Juda te leh Gentile te Dinga Kipana Thupha"},"8":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile keiman hiche kisei hi, Iputeu ipateu athutep chu phutdet dingle Pathen lungset jala chidang namdang ten Pathen achoi-at theina dinguva, Pathen thu adih chu hetsah dinga, Jesu Christa chu cheptanho lhacha-a hung panga ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Hiti jong hin akisune, Hiche jeh chun keiman chidang namgdangte lah-a Nangma kipah-in phonging ting, Chule nangma minin la jong sange.","ref":"2 Sam 22:50; Labu 18:49"},"10":{"text":"Hitin ati kitleuve, Vo chidang namdangte, amitetoh kipah thanom khomun.","ref":"Danb 32:43."},"11":{"text":"Chukitle, Vo chidang namdangte, nabonchaovin Pakai chu vahchoijun, Chule mi jousen ama vahchoi uhen, ati.","ref":"Labu 117:1."},"12":{"text":"Chule Isaiah'in jong, Jesse jung chu umding ahin, Chule chidang namdangte chunga vaipo dinga hung sohdoh ding ahi; Ama chu chidang namdang ten kinepna-a anei dingu ahi, ati.","ref":"Isai 11:10."},"13":{"text":"Lhagao Theng thahat vanga kinepna nanei letset theina dingun, kinepna Pathen'in natahsan naochu kipa thanop le chamna lungmon na-in dip letset tahen."},"14":{"text":"Kasopite ho, nangho chungchang thua chun, nangmahotah phatna dimset le hetna bukip sohkei nahiuvin, khatle khat kitilkhouto thei nahiuve, ti keimatah-in kahetchen ahi.","title":"Paul'in Khaotah-a Lekha Asut Lonajeh"},"15":{"text":"Ahivangin Sopite, chidang namdangte lah-a Christa Jesu lhacha-a kapan theina dinga Pathen'in eipeh lungsetna vanga hi nangho geldohsahna dinga, akah lahlah-a hakat cheh-a naheng uva kahinsut ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chutia chu chidang namdangte dinga Jesu Christa lhacha kahia; chidang namdangte kilhaina chu lahthei ahia, Lhagao Theng suhtheng ahina dinguva, Pathen Thupha lhacha-a kapan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun tun Pathen dinga natohna lama hin Christa Jesu'ah kisonna kaneije."},"18":{"text":"Ajeh chu chidang namdangte Pathen thua nunsahna dinga Christan keima eimanchah-a, thu le natoh-a abol chengse tailou chu imadang kasei ngam poi;"},"19":{"text":"Hichu Pathen Lhagao thahat na-a melchihna thaneitah le thilbol kidanga kon ahi; hitichun Jerusalem le akimvela kipat Ilyricum geijin Christa Thupha kaphongjal tan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi, hijeh-a chu Christa min kiphah poh louna mun'a kipana thupha lhangsap dinghi kalungtup ahi, achuti loule midang bulphusa chunga insa kahi khah ding ahi:"},"21":{"text":"Ahin Ama thudol kiseipoh khah lounate chun amu dingu: chule ajakhalou ten ahet dingu ahi, tia kisun bang ahi nading joh ahi.","ref":"Isai 52:15"},"22":{"text":"Hiche jehtah-a jong chu hijatvei naheng uva kahung dinga kon, hiche chun eisuhmo jingji ahi.","title":"Paul'in Rome Vilding Agot","ref":"Rom 1:13."},"23":{"text":"Tu vangin hiche gamkai sungah kanatohna ding mun aumtapoi; kum sotna patna nangho henga hung ding kagot jingma ahin,"},"24":{"text":"Spain gam lama kache phat phatle naheng uva kahung ding ahi. Ajehchu nangho mupa ding kakinemin, chule amasan nang hotoh chomkhat kivop khom ingting, chule kache teng jongle nanghon neihung thahleu chun kati."},"25":{"text":"Tu vang hin mithengte gahu dinga Jerusalem'a chetadi ding kahi.","ref":"1 Cor 16:1-4"},"26":{"text":"Ajeh chu Macedonia le Achaia gama mihon Jerusalem'a um mithengte lah-a migenthei vaichaho huna-a sumto ding aphasah uvin ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi, pha asah tahbeh-u ahin, chule abatnu jong hija ahi; ajeh chu lhagao lama chidang namdangte akikop piuva ahile, leiset thil lama jong amahon abatnu ahin, ahu dingdol mongu ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 9:11"},"28":{"text":"Chuche jeh chun chuche kin chu kachai tengle asumdonu chu phatecha kapehdoh joule, nangho kom hinjot pangting Spain gam lama kachepai peh ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chule naheng uva kahung tengle chun, Christa Kipana thupha-a kon phattheina chamkim keija hinpo-a hung ding kahi, ti kahei."},"30":{"text":"Sopite, Juda gama cheng sei ngailouho khutna kona kahoi theija, Jerusalem'a kin neija kachena hi,"},"31":{"text":"Mithengten analah theina dingun, chule Pathen phatsah-a kipahtah-a nangho heng lama kahunga nang hotoh kakicholdo theina dingin,"},"32":{"text":"Pathen henga taona-a hahun neihuvin tia Pakai Jesu Christa le Lhagao Thengin eipeh-u ngailutna vanga, nangho kahin ngeh nahiuve."},"33":{"text":"Chamnale lungmon kona Pathen'in nabonchaovin umpiuvin. Amen."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Isopinu-u Phoebe, Cenchria houbung lhachanu hi Pakai minin mithengte chonna-in lomtah-a analauvin;","title":"Amichanga Kilemna"},"2":{"text":"Chule nahunao angaichatna chan-ah anahuvin tia nangho amanu hitoh kakihettosah nahiuve; ajeh iham itile amanu hin mi tamtah ahun chule keimatah jeng jong eihun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Jesu Christa-a katoh khompi kahinkho huhna-a alol do-a Priscilla le Aquila kasalam anapeuvin;","ref":"Sol 18:2."},"4":{"text":"Kei chang hilouvin chidang namdangte lah-a houbung mi jousen jong apahchauvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule a-in'a kikhom houbung mite jong chu salam anapeuvin. Kasahtah Epaenetus Asia gama Christa tahsan masapen chu salam anapeuvin."},"6":{"text":"Nangho dinga na hatoh-a tonggim Mariam jong kasalam anapeuvin."},"7":{"text":"Ka-inkote kasoh chanpi Andronicus le Junia solchah ho lah-a minchepen keima sanga Christa-a lut masa amani jong chu kasalam anapeuvin."},"8":{"text":"Pakaiya kasahtah Amplias chu kasalam anapeuvin."},"9":{"text":"Christa-a itoh gimpiu Urbane le kasahtah Stachys salam anapeuvin."},"10":{"text":"Christa-a mi kitah kichen Apelles salam peuvin. Aristobulus te insung miho jong salam peuvin."},"11":{"text":"Ka-inko Herodion kasalam anapeuvin. Narcissus te inko Pakaiya um cheng chu kasalam anapeuvin."},"12":{"text":"Pakaiya na hatohgim Typhene le Tryphosa salam anapeuvin. Dei umtah Persis Pakaiya na ahatoh lheh jengin, ama chu kasalam anapeuvin."},"13":{"text":"Pakaiya lhen Rufus le kanu tobang anu chu salam anapeuvin.","ref":"Mrk 15:21"},"14":{"text":"Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patroba, Hermes, hicheng chule aumpiu sopite chengse salam anapeuvin."},"15":{"text":"Philologus le Julia, Nereus le asopinu, Olympus, chule amahotoh kikhom mithengte chengse salam anapeuvin."},"16":{"text":"Khatle khat salam kiboh tovinlang thengtah-in kichopmun, Christa houbung mite jousen salam napeuve."},"17":{"text":"Vo sopite, kangehnao ahi, thu nakihil chengu chu akaleh-a, kikhen chehna dingle kipal lhuhna semteho chu anamelgel unlang, amaho-a konin anachom umun.","title":"Thuhilna Chaina"},"18":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile chutobang miho chun I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa lhacha na tong louvin, a-oisung dingu lhacha na tong jengbou ahiuve; chule kamthemle thungei ngeijin suhset neilouho lung dohan alhemlha jiuvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Nasei ngaijeu chu vannoi'ah akithang dohtan ahi. Hiche jeh chun nachung uvah kakipah lheh jenge; amavang nangho apha lama chingunlang ase lamah lunglhom leu chun kalung ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule chamna lungmonna Pathen'in Satan chu nakengto noijuva achil ngemvah ding ahinai. Pakai Jesu Christa lungset chu nalah uva umjing hen, Amen."},"21":{"text":"Katoh khompi Timothy chule ka-inko Lucius, Jason chule Sosipater hiteho chun salam nahinpeuve.","title":"Paul Golho-a Kona Lemna","ref":"Sol 16:1."},"22":{"text":"Chule hiche lekhasun Tertius, keiman Pakaiyah nangho salam nahinpeuve."},"23":{"text":"Keimale houbung mite jouse lhunna Gaius chun salam napeuve. Hiche khopi-a sumdol Erastus le sopi Quartus'in salam napeuve.","ref":"Sol 19:29; 1 Cor 1:14; 2 Tim 4:20."},"24":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungsetna chun nabon chaovin umpiuvin, Amen.","title":"Thu khumkhana"},"25":{"text":"Kathupha hille Jesu Christa thuphon bangtah-a, tonsotna patna ki-im thuguh chu tu-a akiphondoh bangtah-a,"},"26":{"text":"Tahsan thua ahung nunna dinguva tonsotna Pathen thupeh dungjuitah-a, themgaoho lekhabun aphondoh-a, chitin le namtin jouse ahetsah ahitan;"},"27":{"text":"Nangho sudet thei Pathen chinga khatseh chu Jesu Christa vangin tonsot geijin loupi jinghen, Amen."}}}}},"46":{"info":{"name":"1 Corinth","shortname":"1 Cor","abbr":[],"desc":"Corinth Mite Henga Paul Lekha Thot Khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen phasah-a Christa solchah dinga kikou Paul leh sopi Sosthenes,","title":"Lemna le Thangvahna"},"2":{"text":"Corinth-a um Pathen houbung, Christa Jesu'a kisuthenga, mitheng dinga kikoute henga, gamtina I-Pakaiyu (amahole eiho Pakai) Jesu Christa min pan chengsetoh;","ref":"Sol 18:1."},"3":{"text":"I-Pau Pathen le Jesu Christa-a konin lungsetna leh lungmon naheng uvah umhen."},"4":{"text":"Christa Jesu'a Pathen lungset nangho henga kipeh jeh chun nangho chungchang thuah Pathen kathangvah jinge.","title":"Christa'a Vangbohna"},"5":{"text":"Ijakai-ah, thuseina tincheng leh, hetna tichenga aman nahaosah-u ahitai."},"6":{"text":"Nangho lah-a Christa thu kahettohsah chu kiphut det ahitai."},"7":{"text":"Chutia chu nangho thilpeh lhasam louhela, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung kit ngah-a umjing nahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Chule aman nangho akhon ni geija nakoidet jing dingu, chutengle nangho I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa nikho ni chuleh themona beihela naum dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Pathen tahsan umtah ahi, aman Achapa I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa kithopi dinga nakoulut-u ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Tun sopite, nangho thukhat kisaovin, nalah uva kikhen telna umlouvin, lungkhat le lung ngaito khat na lolhing tah-in kipunkhom mun, tia I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa mina katem nahiuve,","title":"Houbung sunga Kikhen Telna"},"11":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile, kasopite ho, nachung chang thu-u nalah uva kinel noh baotam aume, ti Chloe te inko seinan kajai."},"12":{"text":"Tu-a kasei chu hiche ahi, nangho amilipmin, Keima Paul'a kahi, keima Apollo'a kahi, keima Cephas'a kahi, keima Christa'a kahi, nati sohkeijun ahi.","ref":"Sol 18:24"},"13":{"text":"Christa chu nahop khen khenu hitam? Paul chu nangho dinga thingpel'a kikhenbeh mongam? Ole Paul mina baptize nachan mongum?"},"14":{"text":"Crispus leh Gaius tailou, adang koimacha baptize kachansah lou jeh chun Pathen kathangvah-e;","ref":"Sol 18:8; 19:29; Rom 16:23."},"15":{"text":"Achuti loule keiman keima mina baptize kachan ahi, tia sei umkha ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule keiman Stephanas insung mite chu baptize kachansah ahin, chuche tailou chu adang koima baptize kachansah kahepoi.","ref":"1 Cor 16:15"},"17":{"text":"Baptize chansah dinga hilouva, Kipana Thupha hille dinga bou Christan eisol ahi; chihna thua seiding hilouvin, achuti loule Christa thingpel chu imacha hilou sohkha ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Thingpel thu chu amangthai dingho dingin ngolna ahi; asohcha eiho ding vangin Pathen thahat ahi.","title":"Christa Pathen Thahat le Chihna"},"19":{"text":"Hiti jong hin akisune, Keiman michingho chih chu kasuhmanga, Lungthim themho lungthim moh kahisah ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 29:14"},"20":{"text":"Miching hoiham? Lekha sun mihil hoiham? Tukhanga minel kala hoibaham? Vannoi leiset chihna chu Pathen'in asuh ngol hilouham?","ref":"Job 12:17; Isai 19:12; 33:18; 44:25"},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu Pathen chihna-in, leiset mihem ten amaho chihna-a Pathen ahetlou phatnuva, ngolhoi thu hila atahsanho huhhing chu Pathen'in pha asah ahi."},"22":{"text":"Juda ten melchihna angeh jiuvin, chule Greek miten chihna aholjiuve;"},"23":{"text":"Keihon vang thingpel chunga Christa kikhetbeh thu kahilleu ahin, hichu Juda te dingin kipal lhuhna ahin, chule Greek te dingin ngolna ahi;"},"24":{"text":"Amavang Juda hihen Greek hileh, akikouho ding vangin Christa chu Pathen hatna le Pathen chihna ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Pathen ngolna chu mihem sanga gamchenga chingjo ahin, chule Pathen hatmona chu mihem sanga gamchenga hatjo ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile, sopite, nanghon nakikou dolu hi ngaito temun, leiset tahsa phe lama miching tamtah, thanei tamtah, chule milun tamtah akikou pon ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ahivangin Pathen'in michingho jachat sahna dinga, vannoi'a angolteho alhena; ahat apaoho jachat sahna dinga, vannoi'a hatmoteho alhen ahi."},"28":{"text":"Vannoi leisetna thil kidah um le thil noinung cheng chu Pathen'in alhena, chule aumlou jong chu aumsaho imacha hilou sona dinga alhen ahi;"},"29":{"text":"Hichu ama angsunga leiset mihem akisonga koima aum louhelna ding ahi."},"30":{"text":"Nangho vang chu ama vanga Christa Jesu'a um nahiuve, amachu Pathen'a kona eiho dinga chihna, chonphatna, kithensona, kilhatdohna-a kisem ahi."},"31":{"text":"A kisun dung juijin, Koi hile akisonga chu Pakaiya kisonghen, ati.","ref":"Jer 9:24"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule, sopite, keima vang naheng uva Pathen thu hettohsah seiphonga kahung chun, thusei themna le chihna toh thon kahungpoi.","title":"Thingpel'a Kikhenbeh Christa"},"2":{"text":"Jesu Christa thu le thingpel chunga akikhetbeh thu tailou, nalah uva thudang hehih helinge tia kangaito ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule keima nalah uva hatmotah, kichatah, chule kihot hot jinga kana um ahi.","ref":"Sol 18:9"},"4":{"text":"Kathusei le kathu lhangsap chu mihem chihna-a jollhah themna ahipon, amavang Lhagao le athahatna-a phot tohna ahijon ahi:"},"5":{"text":"Chutia chu natahsan naochu mihem chihna-a dinga hilouva, Pathen thahatna joh-a ding ahina ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amavang apilhing saho jah-a vang chihna thun jong kaseiji naove, ahivangin hiche vannoi leiset chihna thu ahipoi, hiche vannoi leiset vaipo mangthah dingho chih thu jong ahipoi.","title":"Pathen Chihna"},"7":{"text":"Ahin Pathen chihna thuguh, iloupina dinguva Pathen'in vannoi leiset um masanga agot masah chihna thu ki-im chu, kaseijoh-u ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hichu hiche vannoi leiset vaipoho him himin ahetoh pouve, heleu loupina Pakai chu thingpel'a akhetbeh louhel dingu ahi. Hijongle,"},"9":{"text":"Ahin mit mukhah lou, na jahkhah lou, Mihem lunga lutkha lou, Pathen'in angailuho dinga agotsa chengse chu, tin akisune.","ref":"Isai 64:4."},"10":{"text":"Ahivangin Pathen'in eiho hengah Lhagaovin aphongdoh tai, Ajehchu Lhagaovin imajouse akholdoh jia, Pathen thuguh jong akholdohji ahi."},"11":{"text":"Mi lung sunga thu um mihem'a um lhagao tailou adang mihem koiham ahea? Chuche bang chun Pathen thu jong Pathen Lhagao tailou koima dangin ahepoi."},"12":{"text":"Tun Pathen'in manbeija eipeh chengseu hi hetna dinga, eiho vannoi leiset lhagao changa hilouva Pathen'a hungkon Lhagao changa ihiuve."},"13":{"text":"Hitiho chu mihem chihna-in ahil thua sei louva, Lhagao Thengin ahil thu chu, lhagao le lhagao tekah-a kahilu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Tahsa lam mihem ten Pathen Lhagao thuhi alajipouve; ajehchu amaho dinga ngol thu ahi, chule hichu lhagaova hetkhenbou ahi jeh chun athudol chu ahekhen thei himhim pouve."},"15":{"text":"Lhagao mi vang chun thil ijakai ahekhenjin, ama chula koiman ahekhen jipoi."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai lungthim he-a, ama hil thei dinga koiham? Eiho vang chu Christa lung pu-a ihiuve.","ref":"Isai 40:13"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sopite, keiman lhagao lam mite henga sei bangin nangho henga kasei theipon, tahsa lam mite henga sei banga, Christa lama naosen ho jah-a seibanga kasei ahi.","title":"Pathen Lhacha Natong Khom"},"2":{"text":"Keiman nangho an guma vah louva noitwija kavah-bou nahiuve, ajehchu tuchan hin nane thei hih-un, tu jengin jong nane thei hih laijuve;","ref":"Heb 5:12-13"},"3":{"text":"Nangho tu geijin tahsa mi nahi nalaijui. Ijeh-inem itile nalah uva kithangset to, kinah kiphun kikhentel aum nalaije; ahile, natahsa chonu hilouham? chule mi chon chona chon nahi lou uham?"},"4":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile khatnin, Keima Paul'a kahi, nati uva; adang khatnin, Keima Apollo'a kahi, nati laiseuva chu; tahsa-a nahi lou uham?","ref":"1 Cor 1:12"},"5":{"text":"Apollos chu koiham? Chule Paul chu koiham? Pakaiyin mijouse apeh dungjuija, alhacha-a pang, amani-a kona nanghon natahsanu ahibouve."},"6":{"text":"Keiman kaphu ahin, Apollon twi achap ahi, Pathen bouvin akhansah ahi.","ref":"Sol 18:4-11,24-28"},"7":{"text":"Chuti ahin aphutpa jong ima ahipon, atwi chappa jong ima ahidehpoi; akhansah-a Pathen chubou ahipen ahi."},"8":{"text":"Tun aphutpa le atwi chappa chu thakhat ahi lhone, ahivangin atohgim lhon dungjui juija tohman asan gel lhon ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu keini Pathen tohkhompi kahi lhonin, nangho Pathen lou nahiuve, Pathen in-sah nahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Pathen lungset vanga eikipeh dungjuija insa themtah banga abul kaphu ahitai, achunga chu midangin asah ahi. Amavang chuche chunga sa ding chengsen asah danje ding chu chingthei chehhen."},"11":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile abul phudohsa tailou chu abul dang koiman aphutdoh theitapoi, chuche abul kiphut chu Jesu Christa ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuche bul kiphut chunga chun koi hijongle sana-a sanoman sahen, dangka-a sanoman sahen, song mantama sanoman sahen, thinga sanoman sahen, bi-a sanoman sahen, pola sanoman sahen;"},"13":{"text":"Atoh cheh-u chu hung kiphongdoh cheh ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile nikho chun aphondoh ding, hiche ni chule meija kiphongdoh ding ahijeh chun, meijin mijouse anatoh aset aphat apatep ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Achunga insaho chu koi koi hile a-insah chu adin jinga ahile, ama chun toh phatman asan ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule koi hile a-insah akahvama ahile, ama chu hakam ding; amatah vang huhhing-a umding ahi, ahivangin meikong lah pal galkaija bang ding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Pathen in theng nahiuva chule nasunguva Pathen Lhagao achen chu nahet lou uham?","ref":"1 Cor 6:19; 2 Cor 6:16."},"17":{"text":"Pathen in theng suhboh-a chu Pathen'in ama chu asuhmang ding ahi. Ijeh-inem itile Pathen in chu thengtah ahi, nangho jong chutichu nahiuve."},"18":{"text":"Koimacha amale ama kilhemlha hihhen. Nalah uva khattou, tulai khang thua hi kachinge, ti aumle, ama chu achihna ding chun ngol hen."},"19":{"text":"Ajeh chu hiche vannoi leiset chihna hi Pathen dinga ngolna ahi. Ajehchu, aman michingho chu ajonchih naovah amanjie, tin akisune.","ref":"Job 5:13"},"20":{"text":"Chujongle, Pakaiyin michingho lunggel le thil ngaito chu moh ahi ahenai, ati kitleuve.","ref":"Labu 94:11"},"21":{"text":"Hijeh chun koima mihem'a kisong hihhen. Ijeh-inem itile thiljouse nangho-a ahi;"},"22":{"text":"Paul hihen, Apollos hihen, Cephas hihen, vannoi leiset hijongle, hinna hihen, thina hihen, tupetle khonung hijongle, aboncha nangho-a ahi;"},"23":{"text":"Nangho jong Christa-a nahiuve, Christa chu Pathen'a ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keiho hi Christa lhacha le Pathen thuguh chingin min eingaitou hen.","title":"Christa Solchah"},"2":{"text":"Gou ching jenga jonghi, tahsan umtah mi ngaija ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ahivangin, nanghon kaumchan nakhol diu, ahiloule mihem thutan na-in akhol ding chu keima dinga thilneocha bou ahi. Henge keiman jong kaumchan kaki kholpoi."},"4":{"text":"Ajeh chu keiman kachungah imacha kakihetpoi, ahinla hichea hin them eichanpoi; ajeh chu kaumchan khola Pakai joh ahibouve."},"5":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun Pakai hung kahsen aphat masangin thu tanloi hih-un; aman muthima thilsel chu khovah-a ahinphondoh ding, chule mihem lung sungin ipi agelem hi jong chu aphondoh ding ahinai. Hiche teng chule amitakipmin pachatna achan ding dol cheh Pathen'a kona asan ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Sopite, akisun chengse kalvala koiman angaito louding; chutia chu nalah uva khatnin khat asona, achomkhat chunga hoithona aneilou ding ti thuhil hi keinia kona nahetdoh nadiuva, keima le Apollos hi tekah na-a kahinsei ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajeh chu koiham midanga kon nachom khenuva? chule nakisan louvu thil ipi nanei juvem? Nasan uva ahile ibola asang lou banga hoithoa nahiu vem?"},"8":{"text":"Nangho tun nava taove, tun nahautaove, keiho beija lengho banga vai nahomu ahitai. Keiho jong nang hotoh thakhatna vai ihomkhom theina dinguvin, vai hom tahtah hileu chun kati."},"9":{"text":"Pathen'in keiho solchah ho hi, athi dinga kigo-a banga anukhah pena eikoiju hinte tin kangaitoi; hijeh-a chu vannoi le, vantil teho, chule mihem vetchah-a um kahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Keiho vang Christa jala angola kahiuvin, nangho vang Christa-a achinga nahiuve; keiho kadoijun, nangho vang nahatnui; nangho mi jatah nahiuvin, keiho vang mi nahsahmo kahiuve."},"11":{"text":"Tugei jong hin kagilkel, kadang chah-un, ponsil nihchen bei kahiuvin, jepmin ka-umuvin, chennabih neilou kahiuvin;"},"12":{"text":"Kakhut uvin na kakitoh uvin; eihouseuva phatthei kabohjiuvin, eikibolset tengule kathoh hamhamun;","ref":"Sol 18:3"},"13":{"text":"Eikihehset tengule kalhem lungdamjiuvin ahi; keiho vannoi bohsele thil jouse nen bangin tu geijin kaum nalai uve."},"14":{"text":"Nangho jachat sahna dinga hicheng thuhi kahinsut ahipoi, kacha deitahte banga hilchahnajoh-a kasut ahibouve."},"15":{"text":"Ajeh chu nanghon Christa-a chun nahiluva sangsom nei jeng jongleu chun, pa khat kal naneipouve; ajeh chu Kipana Thupha vanga Christa Jesu'a kahinsa kachate nahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun kangeh nahiuve, keima dungsun hiuvin.","ref":"1 Cor 11:1; Phil 3:17"},"17":{"text":"Hiche dinga chu Pakaiya tahsantah kachapa deitah Timothy naheng uva kahinsol ahi; keiman muntina houbung tina kahil banga, Christa-a kaum thudol aman nangho nageldohsah dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tun nangho lah-a kimkhat keima hi naheng uva hungponte, tin nahoitho taovin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakai lunglam ahile naheng uva hung vahnange; chutengle chuche ahoitho cheng thu hilouvin athaneinao henang kate."},"20":{"text":"Pathen lenggam chu thua hilouvin, thanei na-a ahibouve."},"21":{"text":"Hoiche ham nadeijoh-u? Naheng uva mol kachoija kahung dingha, ngailut neija lungnempu-a lhagaova kahung dingham?"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nalah uva jon thanhoi aume, ti kichentah-in akijan ahi, chidang namdangte lah jenga jong kiminphah khalou jon thanhoi aume; mikhatnin apa ji jin aneije.","title":"Houbung Sunga Chon thanhoina","ref":"Danb 22:30."},"2":{"text":"Chutobanga chonpa chu nalah uva kona nodoh-a aum ding lhadaina-a neitah sangin, hoithonan naneijo taove."},"3":{"text":"Keimatah katahsa alhah lou vangin kalhagao nalah uva alhan, chutobanga chonpa thu chu katanin, hitihin kaki chaisah tai;"},"4":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa mina, keima lhagaotoh, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa thaneina toh nakikhop tengule,"},"5":{"text":"Chutia chon mi chu atahsa manna dinga Satan khutna pedoh-un, I-Pakaiyu Jesu nikho nileh alhagao huhhing-a aum theina dingin."},"6":{"text":"Nangho nakisonnao chu aphapoi; chol themchan changbong lum apumpin achansohjin ahi ti nahet lou uham?","ref":"Gal 5:9."},"7":{"text":"Tu-a nangho cholsolou nahi bangu chun, changbong lum thah nahina dingun chol lui chu then ngimun paidoh-un. Ijeh-inem itile ikalchuh kut satha dingun Christa tah chu akithat tan ahi.","ref":"Pot 12:5"},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun chol lui mang louvin kut boluhite, engsetle khan gitlou chola kut bol louvin lung thengselle kitahna-in cholsolou changlhah-in kut boluhite.","ref":"Pot 13:7; Danb 16:3"},"9":{"text":"Keiman nangho kahinthot lekha-a chun jon panhotoh kivopkhom hih-un, tin kahin suntan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Achutinai tin vannoi'a jon panho neipap kiloseho, misumang ho, thilha houho toh nakivop khom louhel dingu ahipoi, chutile vannoi leiset hi nachanhel dingu ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Amavang sopi-a kisimsa khattou ajona, neipap kiloset abola, thilha ahouva, ataitoma, ju akhama, mi anam bola ahile, ama chu kivoppi hih-un, hitobang mi chu an jeng jong neh khompi hih-un, tia kahinsut ahibouve."},"12":{"text":"Polamaho thu tanding ka-ikin tahham? Houbung sunga mite thu natanji hih-um?"},"13":{"text":"Polama miho thu vang chu Pathen'in bou atan ahi. Hijeh chun nalah uva konin chuche michonse chu paidoh-un.","ref":"Danb 13:5; 17:7"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangho khatnin khat chunga boina thu naneijule, mithengho anga hehta louva michonpha lou anga gaheh ji nangam um?","title":"Na Christian Chankhompi Khat Hehhih-in"},"2":{"text":"Mithengten vannoi thu atan dingu hi nahet louvu ham? Chule vannoi thu nangho tanding ahile, thu neopen tan dinga kilom lou nahiu ham?"},"3":{"text":"Eiho hin vantil teho thu kisan itan dingu ahi hi helou nahiuvem? Achutile tulai hinkho chungchang thuhi itanda dingu ham?"},"4":{"text":"Chutia chu tu hinlai thudola thu tan ding nahiule, houbung in imacha-a asimlouho chu thutan na mun'a itousah dinguham?"},"5":{"text":"Najachatna dinguva hiche thuhi kahinsei ahi. Sopicha kah-a thu tanlha thei nalah uva miching khatcha beh jong umlou hellaham?"},"6":{"text":"Ahinla nangho asopin asopi chunga thuboi neija heh-an jong atahsan louho angabou nahehjiuve."},"7":{"text":"Nangho khatle khat nakiheh tou chu nangho dingin losamna lentah ahitai. Themmo nakichan joh jenguva pha hilouham? Lheplhah-a naum joh jenguva phajo hilouham?"},"8":{"text":"Achutipoi, nangho mama-in aphalou nabolun chule mi nalhem uvin, chule hicheho chu nasopi hou chunga nabol uve."},"9":{"text":"Ole michonpha lou hon Pathen lenggam alo lou dingu ahi, ti hi nahet lou uham? Nangho lheplhah-in um hih-un; mijong, milim hou, mijigem, mihuh, palepa kikoi,"},"10":{"text":"Gucha, neipap kilose, jukham, mihanse, minambol; hiteho chun Pathen lenggam alo louhel dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangho abang hiti chu nahiuvin, ahivangin Pakai Jesu Christa minle Pathen Lhagaova kisil ngim nahitaovin, akisuthenga, them changa nahitaove."},"12":{"text":"Keima dingin ijakai bol ngai ahi, ahivangin ijakai aphasohkei poi; imajouse keima dingin bolngai ahi, ahivangin imacha noija umponge.","title":"Natahsao Pathen Loupina Dingin Mangun","ref":"1 Cor 10:23."},"13":{"text":"Oisung dinga an, an dinga oisung ahi; ahivangin Pathen'in agoma beihela ahinlha ding ahi. Chule itahsao hi jonna ding ahipoi, Pakaiya ding joh ahin, chule Pakai jong tahsa-a ding ahi;"},"14":{"text":"Chule Pathen'in athahatna-a Pakai chu akaithou ahin, eiho jong eikaithou dingu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Natahsao chu Christa tibah ahi ti nahet lou uham? Chuti chu ahile Christa tibah ho chu kalah manga noti tibah ho-a kasem dingham? Chutiponte."},"16":{"text":"Chule noti'a beh chu amanu chutoh ti khat ahi ti hi nahet lou uham? ajehchu Pathen'in, amani chu tikhat hilhon ding ahi, ati ahi.","ref":"Semt 2:24"},"17":{"text":"Ahin Pakaiya beh-a vang chu amatoh lhagaova khat hia ahitai."},"18":{"text":"Jon thanhoija konin jamun. Mihem chonsetna jouse hi atahsa polama ahi; jonthanhoi bol vang chu koi hile ama tahsa chunga chonsea ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ahilou jongle Pathen'a kona naneiju Lhagao Theng nalung sunguva chenga chu natahsao hi a-in theng ahi ti nahet lou uham? Nangho nangho-a tum nahipouve;","ref":"1 Cor 3:16; 2 Cor 6:16"},"20":{"text":"Nangho man kipe-a kicho dohsa nahitaove, hijeh chun natahsao le na lhagao un Pathen choi-an nun, hichu Pathen na ahi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun imama thudola kahenga dinga nahin lekha sutnu chu kahindon butna hiche ahi, Pasal'in numei atohkhah louvin aphai;","title":"Kichen Thudola Thudoh Donbutna"},"2":{"text":"Ahivangin jon louna dingin pasal'in numei khat cheh jin neihen, chule numei khatcheh injong pasal khatcheh jin neihen."},"3":{"text":"Ajipan ajinu chu achan dingdol chansahhen, chutobang machun ajinun jong ajipa chansah hen."},"4":{"text":"Numei chun ama tahsa chunga imacha thu aneipoi, apasal'in bou aneije; chutobangma chun pasal jong ama tahsa chunga thu aneipoi, anumeijin bou anei ahi."},"5":{"text":"An ngolla taona-a nakipeh theina dinguva, chomcha khat kikhena chule kivop khomloi kit dinga nakiphasah geluva ahi tailouvin, kikhen kah hih-un; achuti loule kitimlel jeh-in Satan'in lhemlha getnun nate."},"6":{"text":"Ahivangin hiche hi thupeh bangtah-a kasei ahipoi, kaphatsah thua kaseijoh ahibouve."},"7":{"text":"Mi jouse keima tobang cheh hile kati; ahivangin mikhatnin achom, khatnin achom dang, hitobanga chu min Pathen'a kona Phattheina chom cheh anei ahi."},"8":{"text":"Jinei louva umho dingle, meithaiho dinga hiche hi kahinsei ahi, amaho chu keima banghin umleu phante."},"9":{"text":"Amavang akitim jou lou ule ji neiju hen; ajehchu huh-a jon sangin jinei aphajoi."},"10":{"text":"Ji neisaho vang hiche thuhi kapeh ahi, keima kahipon Pakaiyin apeh ahi, numei jin ajipa dalha hihhen.","ref":"Matt 5:32; 19:9; Mrk 10:11-12; Luk 16:18."},"11":{"text":"Adalhah tahjongle jinei louvin umhen, ahiloule ajipatoh kihoucham kit hen. Chule pasal'in ajinu da hihhen."},"12":{"text":"Chule adangho thu dingdol vang chu Pakai hilouvin, keima sei ahi: Sopi khat touvin numei atahsanlou ji aneija, a-inneipu chutoh umkhom anople, ama chu a-inneipun da hihhen;"},"13":{"text":"Chule numei khattouvin pasal atahsanlou aneija, ajipan amanutoh chenkhom ding anople, ama chun a-inneipu chu da hihhen."},"14":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile chuche tahsanlou pasal chu ajinu jala chu kisuthenga ahitai; chule numei tahsanlou jong chu ajipa jala chu kisuthenga ahi; chutilou hile nachateo jong aboh ding ahiuve, tunla amaho athenguve."},"15":{"text":"Hijongle atahsanlou chun adalhahtah-a ahile achele chetante; sopipa ahin ahiloule sopinu ahin hitobang thudola hin kikana aumtapoi; hijongle Pathen'in lungmonga umdinga eikouvu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu, Vo numei, nangman na-inneipu huhhing-a naumsah jou ding iti nahetnam? Ahiloule pasal, nangman jong na-inneipi huhhing-a naumsah jou ding iti nahetnam?"},"17":{"text":"Ahivangin Pathen'in mijouse ahoppeh bangle, Pakaiyin mijouse akou bang cheh-in, chon cheh-u hen. Chule hitobanga chu houbung jouse-a kathupeh ahi.","title":"Pathen'in Nakou Bangun Chonun"},"18":{"text":"Cheptansa kikou umam? cheptan chun chuti umhen. Cheptan louva kikou umam? Cheptan louvin chuti umhen."},"19":{"text":"Cheptan chu imacha ahipon chule cheptanlou jong ima ahidehpoi; Pathen thupeh nitbou hi thupipen ahi."},"20":{"text":"Mijouse akikouva aum bang bang cheh-in um chehhen."},"21":{"text":"Soh nahi puma kikou nahim? hichu khohsa hih-in; amavang ongthol nahung hithei ding vangle, hichu mangchajon."},"22":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile soh hipuma Pakaiya kikou chu, Pakaiya dinga ongthol ahi; chutobang chun a-ongthola kikou chu Christa soh ahi."},"23":{"text":"Nangho aman kipe-a kichoa nahitaove; miho soh hihih-un."},"24":{"text":"Sopite, mijouse akikou uva aum bang cheh-un, Pathen to umkhom cheh uhen."},"25":{"text":"Nungah thengho thudol vang, keiman Pakaiya kon thupeh mong kaneipoi; hijongle tahsan umtah hidinga Pakaiya kona lungsetna mu-a kahi dungjuija, kangaito danje kasei ahi.","title":"Jinei Loulaiho Leh Meithaiho"},"26":{"text":"Chutichu ahin tu laija hesohna jeh hin, hiche hi phante tin kagingchai, mi aum ngaijin um chehhen."},"27":{"text":"Numeitoh kicheng nahim? Ondoh ding ngaito hih-in. Numeija kona ongdoh nahim? Jinei lung gul hih-in."},"28":{"text":"Ahivangin jinei jongle chun achonsea nahipoi, nungah theng jong chun ji neijongle achonsea ahipoi. Amavang chutobang miho chu tahsa lama hesoh genthei athoh dingu ahi; hijongleh thohda leuchun kati ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ahivangin, sopite, hiche phat chu kisuchoma ahitai; tu-a kalin jineija chu jineilou bangin,"},"30":{"text":"Akapte akap lou bangin, akipahte akipah lou bangin, thil cho-a anei lou bangin umuhen,"},"31":{"text":"Chule leiset chonna mangcha-a chun avala mang lou bangin umuhen. Ijeh-inem itile hiche leiset umchan danhi achemang jinge."},"32":{"text":"Ahin ima khohsah louhelin umleu chun kalung ahi. Jineilou chun itile Pakai chu kalung lhaidem tin, Pakai lam thil jengbou akhohsah-in ahi."},"33":{"text":"Ahin jineija vang chun hiche leiset thil, itile ka-inneipi kalunglhai theidem, ti jengbou akhohsah-in ahi."},"34":{"text":"Numei jinei le nungah theng kikah-a jong akikhehna aume. Numei jineilou chun tahsale lhagao agoma thengsela um theina dingin Pakai lam thil jengbou akhohsah jin ahi; jinei vang chun leiset lam thil, itile ka-inneipu kalunglhai sah theidem, ti jengbou ageljin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Hichu nangho thangkola khina dinga kasei hilouvin, naphatchomna dinguva kaseijoh ahi, umchan phakeicha naum uva, baotamna beija Pakai kin nabol theinajoh dinguva kasei ahi."},"36":{"text":"Amavang mi khat touvin acha nungah theng khat kathilbol hi adihpoi tia agela, amanu chu akul ahitah-a, aji neilou akhohsah-a ahile, alung got gotnin bol jenghen; hichea chun setna aumpoi; jineisah jeng hen."},"37":{"text":"Amavang koi hile lung dettah po-a, khohsahna neilouva, alungthim aki thunun jouva, achanu thenna tuhdet peh jingdinga gelha-a chun, thilpha abol ahi."},"38":{"text":"Hijeh chun achanu jineisah-a chun apha abol ahin; ahivangin jineisah loujo chun aphajo cheh abol ahi."},"39":{"text":"A-inneipu ahin lai chansea a-inneipi chu danna kihen jinga ahi, a-inneipu athi teng vangle amanu a-onga ahitan, Pakai tahsan ahipou le anop nop napa chutoh kicheng thei ahi."},"40":{"text":"Amavang keima ngaito danin, achuti um jeng theija ahile, amanu chu minun nomjo ahi, kei jong Pathen Lhagao changin kakingaitoi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Milim houna-a kikatdoh thilho thudola chun: ibon chaovin hetna inei cheh uve ti iheuve. Hetna-in mi ahoitho sahjin, ngailutna hin mi akhantou sahjin ahi.","title":"Milim Houna-a Kitohdoh An Chung Changa Thudoh Donbutna"},"2":{"text":"Mi khat tou, ijakai he-a akingaitoa ahileh, ama chun ahet ding dol imacha ahetlou ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amavang khat touvin Pathen angailut le, amatah chu Pathen het ahi."},"4":{"text":"Milim houna-a kikatdoh thil nehding thudol vang chu, vannoi'a hin milim hi imacha ahipon, chule Pathen khatseh tailou chu Pathen dang aumpoi, ti iheuve."},"5":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile vanlaijola jong, leiset chunga jong, Pathen tia kiminvoho uma ahi, (chutia chu pathen tamtah uma, pakai tamtah uma ahi;)"},"6":{"text":"Eiho ding vangin thil jouse kona, eiho jong ama-a ihiu, Pa, Pathen khatbou aumin, chule thil jouse kona, chule eiho jong ama vanga ihinu, Pakai Jesu Christa khat bou aume."},"7":{"text":"Ahivangin mi jousen chuche hetna chu aneipoi, chuti chun akimkhatnin tu geija masanga achonnau milim hou thu chu achin jeh-un, amaho chun milim houna-a kitohdoh thil ahi tin anejiuvin; chua chun ase apha hetkhenna alungu ahat lou jeh chun, akisubohji taove."},"8":{"text":"Ahin an neh hin Pathen to eikinaisah dingu ahipoi; eihon ineh uleh aphajep ihi pouvin, ineh louvule jong aphamopen ihideh pouve."},"9":{"text":"Ahivangin chingtheijun, nachamlhatnao hi ijem itile ahatmo ding chun kipal lhuhna higet ninte."},"10":{"text":"Hetna neija nangma milim houna-a ankong naum chu khat touvin muhen lang hileh, sele pha hetkhenna-a lhasam ama chun milim houna-a kikatdoh thilchu neh ngam nadinga hansanna aneilo louding ham?"},"11":{"text":"Chutile ajala Christa thia chuche sopi hatmo chu, nangma hetna nei jeh-a manthah lo louding ham?"},"12":{"text":"Ahinla sopite chunga nangho chutia nachonset uva, ase le pha hetkhennau hatmo chu namavo tengule, nangho Christa douna-a chonse nahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun an neh-in kasopi akipal lhuhsah-a ahile, kasopi lhuh louna dingin, a-imatih chanin sa-a san nehdange."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solchah khat hilou kahim? Chamlhat hilou kahim? I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa mulou kahim? Nangho jong Pakaiya kanatoh nahi lou uham?","title":"Solchah Thaneina le Mopohna"},"2":{"text":"Adang dangin solchah hilou jongleng, nangho dingbeh-in kahi; Pakaiya solchah kahi het kichetna mohor nangho nahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Hiche hi kathem kathemlou eikholtohho lekalna kihonna-a kasei ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nehna ding le donna dinga thuneina neilou kahiuvem?"},"5":{"text":"Solchah danghole, Pakai sopite, chule Cephas banga khu sopinu khattou ji-a neija kipuile mo kahiuvem?"},"6":{"text":"Ahiloule Barnabas le kei bouhi kanatoh lhonna-a kon haimo kahi lhonem?"},"7":{"text":"Koiham ama sum kineh-a sepai na tonga? Lengpithei hon sema aga nelou koiham? Gancha honpi vula anoi ne lou koiham?"},"8":{"text":"Chucheng chu mihem ngaidan jenga kasei ham? Danthun jong hicheng chu asei hilouham?"},"9":{"text":"Mosi danthua, Bongchal chang chil pet amuh kan hih-un, tin akisune. Pathen'in bongchalho ding jengbou agel ham?","ref":"Danb 25:4; 1 Tim 5:18"},"10":{"text":"Ahiloule eiho dinga jong asei ham? Eiho ding monga hiche thuhi kisuna ahi; lou kaija chun kinepna neija akai ding; chule kinepna neija chang vo-a chun akinepna banga amu ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Keihon nangho dinga lhagao muchi katu uva ahile, na tahsalam thilu ga kalo dingu chu thil lentah hajaham?","ref":"Rom 15:27"},"12":{"text":"Midanghon nachung uva thuneina chu aneija ahile, keihon kahanei chehjoh lou uham? Hijongle hiche thuneina chu kamang pouve; Christa Kipana Thupha thu kadoudal louna dingun, ijakai abonchan kathoh hamham jovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Thiltheng lhacha-a panghon houin'a thilho chu anehjiuva, chule maichama lhachahon maichama kitoh chan aneijiu khu nahet lou uham?","ref":"Danb 18:1"},"14":{"text":"Chutobangma chu, Kipana Thupha lhangsama panghon, Kipana Thupha-a kona aneh dingu ahi, tia Pakaiyin chonnadan asem ahi.","ref":"Matt 10:10; Luk 10:7"},"15":{"text":"Ahivangin keiman hicheng chu khatcha jong kamangchapoi; chule chutia chu eikibolna dinga hicheng thuhi kahinsut jong ahipoi; kakisonna hi khattouvin ahomkeo asosah sangin, keima thimaleng keima dingin aphajoi."},"16":{"text":"Keiman Kipana Thupha thu kahille vangin kisonna ding ima kaneipoi; bollou theilou kinkhoh kachunga eikisekhum ahijeh-in; Kipana Thupha lhangsamle lou hileng kachung gih ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Keima lungchama bola kahile tohphat man kasan ding ahi; keima lungchama bola kahilou vangle, Kipana Thupha gouchinga eikipansah hinte."},"18":{"text":"Achutile tohphat man kasan ding chu iham? Kipana Thupha kalhangsap leteng Kipana Thupha-a hi kathuneina kamanchah khel louna dinga, Christa Kipana Thupha man beija kahopjal hi ahi."},"19":{"text":"Keima mi jouse-a kona ongthola kahi vangin, mi tamcheh kalah lut theina dinga, mi jouse soh-a kakisem ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chutichun Juda te kalah lut theinan, Juda te henga Juda mi um bangin kaumjin: danthu noijate kaloi lut theinan, danthu noija umte hengah, danthu noija um bangin kaumjin ahi."},"21":{"text":"Dan neiloute kaloi lut theinan, dan neiloute hengah, dan neilou bangin kaumjin, ahin Pathen dan mang louva um kahipoi, Christa danthu noija um kahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahatmote kaloi lut theina dingin, ahatmote henga ahatmo kahi: itilam hijongle themkhat beh kahuhhing thei teina dinga, mi jouse dinga ijakai kasoji ahi."},"23":{"text":"Kabolchan hi Kipana Thupha khohsah na-a kabol ahin, nangho toh chan kaneikhom theina ding ahi."},"24":{"text":"Lhaitet golsehna-a khu mi jouse lhaicheh ji-a ahi, ahivangin khatbouvin hatman asangjin ahi, hichu nanghon nahet lou uham? Nasan theina dingun lhaijun."},"25":{"text":"Chule koi hijongle golseh jouving tia guttena chu, ijakaija akitim hatjin ahi. Amaho chun lallukhuh kem mangthei lona-a abolu ahin, eihovang kemmang theilou lallukhuh lo-a ihiuve."},"26":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu hitia chu lhaija kahi, abidoi kichen nei louva lhaija kahipoi; hitia chu chuma kahi, onghom lai chuma kahipoi,"},"27":{"text":"Kati hi kachup kachupjia kathua kanunsah ahi; achuti loule midangho thu kahille nungin, keimatah ijemtin paidoh-in um khange."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo sopite, hiche hi helouva naum dingu kalung anompoi, Ipute Ipateu chu abonchauva meibol noija ana umuva, chule twikhanglen apal galkaiju ahi.","title":"Milim Chungchanga Gihsalna","ref":"Pot 13:21-22; 14:22-29."},"2":{"text":"Abon chaovin Mosi-a chun meibol le twikhanglen'ah baptize achangun,"},"3":{"text":"Chule abon chaovin lhagao an thakhat aneuvin;","ref":"Pot 16:35"},"4":{"text":"Abonchauvin lhagao twi thakhat anadonun ahi. Hichu anungsang chenguva chea lhagao songpi-a kona chu amahon adonu ahi; chule hiche songpi chu Christa ahi.","ref":"Pot 17:6; Minb 20:11"},"5":{"text":"Ahivangin amaho atamjo chunga chun Pathen alunglhaipon ahi; ajeh chu gamthip gama chun alhukam gamtaovin ahi.","ref":"Minb 14:29-30"},"6":{"text":"Thilphalou alunggot banguva chu eihon jong thilphalou ilunggot louna dinguva, chuti chu eivetsah nau ahi.","ref":"Minb 11:4."},"7":{"text":"Chule amaho lah-a kimkhat milim hou ahi bangu chun nangho um hih-un; hiche thudol chu hitin akisune, Miho chu an neding le don dingin atouvun, chuin alam dingin akipatdoh taovin ahi.","ref":"Pot 32:6"},"8":{"text":"Chule amaho lah-a kimkhatnin jon apat uva, nikhat sunga sangsomni le sangthum athilo bangu chun, eihon jong jon pan pouhite.","ref":"Minb 25:1-18"},"9":{"text":"Chule amaho lah-a kimkhatnin apatep jeh uva gul'in asumang bangun; eihon jong Christa patep pouhite.","ref":"Minb 21:5-6"},"10":{"text":"Alah uva kimkhat aphunchel jeh-un, suhmang na-in asumangun ahi; chutobang chun phunchel hih-un.","ref":"Minb 16:41-49"},"11":{"text":"Tu-a thil hicheng hi avetsahna dinga achunguva soh-a ahi; chule vannoi leiset kichaina hung lhun nading eiho, kithuhilna dinga kisuna ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun koi hile adinga kingaito-a chu alhuh louna dingin chingtheihen."},"13":{"text":"Mihem dou thei kalval lhepna nachung uva achukhapoi; Pathen tahsan umtah ahin, nathan adou jou kalvalin lhepna nachung uva chuhsah ponte; hijeh chun nathoh jouna dingun, lhepna chutoh kilhona nakihuhdohna dingu lampi jong nasempeh dingu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun, kasopi ngaiteho, milim hou jamsanun."},"15":{"text":"Keiman nangho mi lungching nahiu kahetna kasei ahi, kathusei hi nanghon kikhollun."},"16":{"text":"Phatthei channa khon phatthei iboh-u khu, Christa thisan ikiloi khompi nau hilouham? Chule changlhah ihebaljiu khu Christa tahsa ikiloi khompi nau hilouham?","ref":"Matt 26:26-28; Mrk 14:22-24; Luk 22:19-20"},"17":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile eiho mi tamtah hi changlhah lum khat ihiuvin, ti khat ihiuve; ajeh chu changlhah lum khatna chu ibon chaova chan ineiju ahi."},"18":{"text":"Tahsa lama Israelte khu veuvin, kithoina sa neho khu maicham toh chan neikhom hilouham?","ref":"Thmpu 7:6."},"19":{"text":"Achutile ipi kaseijem? Milim houna an chu ikhat ahi, ahiloule milim hou jong hi ikhat ahi, katim?"},"20":{"text":"Chuti ahipoi, chidang namdang ten akithoinao chu Pathen lama atou hilouvin, thilha dingjoh-a atou ahibouve; nangho thilha toh nakiloikhom dingu chu kalung nahipeh pouve.","ref":"Danb 32:7"},"21":{"text":"Nanghon Pakai khon le thilha khona nadonkop thei lou dingu ahi, Pakai ankong le thilha ankong na-umkop thei lou dingu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ole thangset sahna dinga Pakai chu isuh lunghangu ham? Ama sanga hatjobeh ihiuvem?","ref":"Danb 32:11"},"23":{"text":"Thil ijakai keima din bol ngai ahin, ahivangin ijakai phatna ahipoi; ijakai keima din bol ngai ahin, ahivangin ijakai phattouna ahipoi.","ref":"1 Cor 6:12."},"24":{"text":"Koiman ama chang phatna hol louvin, aheng akoma dingjoh hol-hen."},"25":{"text":"Kailhanga kijoh thiljouse chu ne jengun, sele pha hetna jeh-in ima dong hih-un;"},"26":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile leiset le asunga umjouse hi aboncha Pakaiya ahi."},"27":{"text":"Atahsan louho khattouvin an ne-a nakouva nache nomle, sele pha hetna jeh-in ima dong hih-un, na-anga alui chan chu ne jengun."},"28":{"text":"Amavang khattouvin, hiche hi milimho henga kithoina kitoh ahi, tia naseipeh-a ahivangle, ahetsahpa jeh le sele pha hetna jeh chun nehdaovin, ijeh-inem itile leiset le asunga thil um jouse hi Pakaiya ahi."},"29":{"text":"Nangma sele pha hetna kati hilouvin ama-a joh chu kati ahi. Kacham lhatna chu midang sele pha hetna-in ibola ei-oimo dingham?"},"30":{"text":"Ajehchu thangvahna neija kaneh leh, ibola thangvahna kanei chunga chu oimo-a um kahim?"},"31":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun naneh jongule, nadon jongule, nabol jouseu Pathen loupina ding jengin bolun."},"32":{"text":"Juda mi hihen, Greek mi hitale, Pathen houbung mite hitale, akipal lhuhna dingun ima bolhih helun,"},"33":{"text":"Keiman keichang phatchomna ding hol louva, huhhing-a aum theina dinguva mi tamtah phatchomna holnajoh-a, thil jouse-a mi jouse kalung lhaisah banghin, nanghon jong bollun."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima Christa dungsuna kaum bang hin nangho keima dungsuna umun.","ref":"1 Cor 4:16; Phil 3:17."},"2":{"text":"Tun sopite, nanghon imajousea keima neigeldoh jinguva, chonna ding thugou kapeh bang banga dettah-a nachin uva nanit jeh-un kapahchauve.","title":"Pathen Houna-a Pon Lukhuh"},"3":{"text":"Ahivangin Christa chu pasal jouse luchang ahia, pasal chengse numei luchang ahi, chule Christa luchang Pathen ahi chu, heleu chun kalung ahi."},"4":{"text":"Koi hile pasal lukhuh khuhpuma taova ahim, lhagaova thu seidoh ahim chun alu ajabol lou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahin numei lukhuh khuh louva taole lhagaova thu seidoh chun alu ajabol lou ahin, alu chu akiveltol tobang ahi."},"6":{"text":"Numei lukhuh khuh lou aumle kivomui ngal hen; alu veltol le asam kivomui chu numei dinga jachatna ahile, lukhuh kikhuh hen."},"7":{"text":"Pasal vang chu Pathen lim bangle aloupina ahi jeh chun lukhuh khuh lou dingdol mong ahi. Numei vang chu pasal loupina ahi.","ref":"Semt 1:26-27"},"8":{"text":"Ajeh chu pasal hi numeija kona ahipoi; numei joh hi pasal'a kona jo ahibouve.","ref":"Semt 2:18-23"},"9":{"text":"Chujongle pasal hi numei dinga kisem ahipoi; numei bou pasal dinga kisemjoh ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun vantil teho jala numei jin thaneina alua achin ding dol thu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakaiyah pasal beijin numei aumpon, numei beijin pasal aumpoi."},"12":{"text":"Pasal'a kona numei ahi banga chu numeija kona pasal uma ahi; ahivangin thil jouse Pathen'a kon ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nalungin gelunlang ngaitouvin, numei jin lukhuh khuh louva Pathen henga atao hi kilomnam?"},"14":{"text":"Pasal'in asam akihoisaova ahile, ama dingin minah sahmo aume, ti hi chonna ngaimong jongin nahil lou uham?"},"15":{"text":"Numei vang asam asaole ama dingin hichu aloupina ahi; ajehchu asam chu akhu dinga kipe-a ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahivangin anela aumle, eihon hitobang dan mong chu ineipouve; Pathen houbung miten jong aneipoi."},"17":{"text":"Amavang hiche thu kahilchah naova hin kapahcha pouve; nangho phatcheh nadinga kikhomji nahipouvin setna cheh joh dinga kikhomji nahiuve.","title":"Pakai jan anjon Umkhom Thudan"},"18":{"text":"Ajeh chu amasa penin, nangho houbung'a nahung kikhop tengule, nalah uva loitum tumin nakikhen jiuve ti kajan, chule tah jong katahsan thim thime."},"19":{"text":"Nalah uva mikitahtah ho ahung kiphondoh theina dinga, ginchat chom chom nei jong umding mong ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun nangho mun khatna nakikhop tengule, Pakai jan anjon nehna hoi ahijipoi;"},"21":{"text":"Amikipmin adang neh masangin ajan an akineh masahjiuvin, chule khat gilkelin aumin, khat ju akhamjin ahi."},"22":{"text":"Nanehna dingule nadonna dingu na-in'u um louham? Ole Pathen houbung chu nahsahmo-a bola chule ima neiloute chu jachatsah nahiuvem? Ipi kaseipeh ding nahiuvem? Hiche thua hin nangho pahchau vingem? Pahcha pong kate."},"23":{"text":"Pakaiya kona kalah nangho kapehsonu thuhil chu hiche ahi, Pakai Jesu amatsah ding jan-u chun, hiche janlele chun aman changlhah alan,","title":"Pakai anjon kiphudoh (Matt 25:26-29 ; Mrk 14:22-25 ; Luk 22:14-20)"},"24":{"text":"Athangvah jouvin ahehbal balin, kilah-un, neuvin, Hiche hi katahsa nangho dinga kihehbal chu ahi; keima neigeldoh jingna dingun hichehi bolun, ati."},"25":{"text":"Chutima chun, a-anneh jouvun khon jong chu alan, Hiche khon hi kathisana kitepna thah ahi; nanghon nadon chanuva keima neigeldoh na dingun bolun, ati.","ref":"Pot 24:6-8; Jer 31:31-34"},"26":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche changlhah naneh uva, hiche khona nadon lai chanuva, ahung kit kahse-a Pakai thina chu naphondoh jingu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Hijeh chun koi hile anehoi hilouva changlhah chu ne-a ahim, khona chu dona ahim chu, ama chu Pakai tahsale athisana themmo chang ding ahi.","title":"Nangma le Nangma Kikhol Masan"},"28":{"text":"Amavang mi ama kikholtoh chehhen, chule changlhah chu nehen, khona jong chun donhen."},"29":{"text":"Chuche Pakai tahsa chu geltoh lou hella, chule lomlou hella ne-a donna chun, oimo achana dinga adonna, aneh ahi."},"30":{"text":"Hiche jeh chu ahi, nalah uva mi tamtah lhasama chule veise-a ahin, chule nena nen a-imumil tapouve."},"31":{"text":"Eimale eima kikholtoh cheh vangleu hen oimo ichan lou dingu ahi."},"32":{"text":"Oimo ichan tengule, vannoi toh themmo ichantha louna dingun, Pakaiya konin engbolin iumjiuve,"},"33":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun, kasopite, ane dinga nahung kikhop tengule khatle khat kingah kimun."},"34":{"text":"Nahung kikhopnau chu oimo-a aum louna dingin, khattou agilkela aumle a-in'a hin nehen. Adang chengse vang kahung tengle sujang soh nange."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule, sopite, lhagaolam thilpeh thuho chu nahet lou dingu kanompoi.","title":"Lhagao Thilpehho"},"2":{"text":"Chidang namdang nahi laiju chun, puilea naumna chanuva milim pao theilou anga chu puimanga na-umjiu ahin, hichu naheuve."},"3":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun nangho kahetsah nahiuve, Pathen Lhagao thuseija chun koiman Jesu chu sapset chang ahi, atipoi, chule Lhagao Thenga kon louvin, koiman, Jesu chu Pakai, ati theipoi."},"4":{"text":"Thilpeh chan gotchom chom tamtah ahi, ahivangin Lhagao khatsehbou ahi;","ref":"Rom 12:6-8."},"5":{"text":"Chule lhacha gotchom chom tamtah ahin, ahivangin Pakai khatsehbou ahi;"},"6":{"text":"Chule natoh gotchom chom aumin, ahivangin ijakaija ijakai bola chu Pathen khat jengbou ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahivangin mijousen aphattoupina dinga, mi khatcheh chu Lhagao phondohna khat cheh kipe-a ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Lhagaova kona mikhat chu chihna thu kipe-a, chuche Lhagao mama-a chu khat hetnanei thu kipe-a ahi;"},"9":{"text":"hiche Lhagaoma-a chu khat tahsan kipe-a; chule chuche Lhagaoma-a chu achom khat mi damsah theina thilpeh kipe-a;"},"10":{"text":"Achom khat bolmo kidang bol theina kipe-a; chule achom khat lhagao thusei dohna; chule achom khat Lhagaoho hetkhen theina; chule achom dang khat paotin paotang tho theina; chule achom dang khat pao ledoh theina kipe-a ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahivangin hicheng na kitong jouse chu, Lhagao khatmama chun abolsah ahi; aman ama lunglam dola achom choma miho khat khatna ahoppeh cheh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Tipum khatseh ahin, tibah tamtah ahi, tipum khatna tibah tamtah aum vangin, tipum khatbou ahi; Christa jong chutobang ahi.","title":"Tahsa Pumkhatna Tibah Tampitah","ref":"Rom 12:4-5."},"13":{"text":"Ajeh chu eiho Juda mi ahin, Greek mi hijongle, soh hihen, chamlhat hi jongle, ibon chaova tipum khat ihi theina dinguva, ibon chaova tahsapum khat sunga umdinga Lhagao khatna iki baptize-u ahi; chule ibon chaova Lhagao khat eiki don khom sah-u ahitai."},"14":{"text":"Ajehchu tipum hi ti khatseh ahipoi, bah tamtah ahi."},"15":{"text":"Kengphang hin, Keima khut kahi lou jeh-in tipuma kahipoi, tile hiche jeh-a chu tipuma hida dingham?"},"16":{"text":"Chule bilkol jong hin, Keima mit kahi lou jeh-in tipuma kahipoi, tile hiche jeh-a chu tipuma hida ding ham?"},"17":{"text":"Tipumpi abonchan mit hisohkei tale, hoija khojahna umta dingham? Tipumpi khojahna hisohkeile hoija gimnam jahna umta dingham?"},"18":{"text":"Ahinla Pathen'in tibah chengse hi, alung deilam cheh-a tipuma akoi ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule aboncha hin tibah khatseh hitale, tipum hoija umtantem?"},"20":{"text":"Tun vang tibah tamtah, ahivangin tipum khatsehbou ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule mit hin khut jah-a, Imacha kangaichatna na-umpoi, ti theilou ahi; luchangin jong kengteni jah-a, Imacha kangaichatna naum lhonpoi, ti thei lou ahi."},"22":{"text":"Titah sangin, tibah hatmoa kigel chengse hi, akhohpena pang cheh ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule nahsahmo-a igelu tibah ho chengse hi gamchengin ijabolun; chule itibah hoilouho chengse hi gamchengin ahoijoji tai."},"24":{"text":"Chule itibah hoiho chengseu hin hicheng chu angaipoi, ahinla Pathen'in tipum hi asuhto khoma alhing lou alhasama chu gamchenga jabola aumsah ahi;"},"25":{"text":"Hitia chu tipum sunga hi akitumkhen um louhela, kitumkhen tah sanga tibah ho chengse hi thakhat tah-a akikhohsah to sohkei dingjoh ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chutia chu tibah khatnin athohgima ahile, tibah dang chengsen jong athoh gimpi jiu ahi; chule tibah khat choi-at achanle, tibah dang chengsen akipapi jiu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Nangho Christa tipum nahiuvin, mi khat khat chu atibah khat cheh nahiuve."},"28":{"text":"Chule Pathen'in houbung-ah amasatah-a solchah ho, anina themgaoho, athumna thuhil ho, abana bolmo kidang bolthei, chua mi damsah theina thilpeh, kithopina, vaipohna, chule paochom paochom thona apeh ahi."},"29":{"text":"Aboncha solchah hiuvam? Aboncha themgao hiuvam? Aboncha thuhil hiuvam? Aboncha bolmo kidang bola hiuvam?"},"30":{"text":"Abonchauva midamsah thilpeh chang hiuvam? Abonchauva paochom tho hiuvam? Abonchauva pao hilchena pang uvam?"},"31":{"text":"Ahin thilpeh pha chungnung deho chana dingin kihabolun. Chule akalvala pha chungnung lampi kavetsah ding nahiuve."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keiman mihemho paole vantil ho paovin thu sei jeng jongleng, ngailutna kanei loule, sum-eng kivogingle khutbeh kibeng bangbou kahi ding ahi.","title":"Ngailut: Thilpeh Chungnung pen"},"2":{"text":"Lhagao thu seidoh theina thilpeh neijingting, thugil jouse hettohna le hetna jouse nei jongleng, chule mol tolmang theina tahsan nei jongleng, ngailutna kanei loule imacha kahilou ahi.","ref":"Matt 17:20; 21:21; Mrk 11:23"},"3":{"text":"Chule mivaicha gentheiho vahna dingin kanei jouse toh jeng jongleng, govam jeng dingin katahsa pumpi toh jeng jongleng, ngailutna kanei loule imacha phatchomna aumpoi."},"4":{"text":"Ngailutna hin ni sottah athohjin, he jong ahepin ahi; ngailutna hin thangset abolpoi; ngailutna hin kichang vahchoi abolpoi, hoi jong ahoithopoi,"},"5":{"text":"Nunset abolpoi, amachang phatchomna abolpoi, alungsa baipoi, setna agelpoi;"},"6":{"text":"Chonsetna kipah louhelin thutah akipapiji;"},"7":{"text":"Ima jouse-a athoh hatnin, imajouse atahsanin, imajousea akinemin, imajouse athoh hatjin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ngailutna hi imatih chana mangthah lou ding ahi; lhagao thu seidoh vang chu mangthah ding ahi; paochom het jong chu mang ding ahi; hetthemna jong chu mang ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile eihon kim louva ihetnu ahin, kim louma lhagao thu iseidohjiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Abulhing chamkim ahung tengle, akim lou chengse hi kisubeisoh ding ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Kachapan laijin chapang paovin kapaojin, chapang lunggelin kageljin, chapang thu ngaiton kangaiton ahi; kakhanlhit phat vangin chapang thu jouse chu kapailhatai."},"12":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile tu-a hi eihon phatvet sunga kichen louva imu-u ahi; chuteng vangle kimaito-a imu dingu ahi. Tunvang kahet akimpoi, chuteng vangle eihet kimsoh banga hi kahet kimsoh ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Tun tahsan, kinep, ngailut hicheng thum hi aumin; ahin hicheng lah-a hin ngailut achungnung pene."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngailut chu delun; ahin lhagaolam thilpehho chengse chan ding ponpanun, adeh setnin lhagao thu naseidoh theina dingun.","title":"Lhagaova Thuseidoh le Paochom Chom Tho"},"2":{"text":"Paochom dangkhat tho-a thuseija chu mi jah-a seidoh hilouva, Pathen jah-a seijoh ahi; ajeh chu koiman ahetpehpoi, ahinla aman lhagaova thugil chengse chu asei ahi."},"3":{"text":"Lhagao thu seidoh vang chun miho khan tousah nale, tilkhouna, chule lungmon sahna thu asei ahi."},"4":{"text":"Paochom dangkhat tho-a thuseija vang chu ama changa khantouna-a anei ahi; lhagao thu seidoh vang chun houbung chu akhantou sah ahi."},"5":{"text":"Nanghon nabon chaovin paochomin thu seileu chun kalung ahi; ahivangin chusang jong chun lhagao thu seidohleu chun kalung ahijoi; chule paochom tho-a thuseija chun houbung khantou sahna dinga, athusei chu aledoh louva ahile, chusanga chu lhagao thu seidoh chu chungnungjo ahi."},"6":{"text":"Tun, sopite, keiman naheng uvah hunging ting paochom hung tholeng; thu phondoh ahim, hetna ahim, lhagao thu seidoh ahim, thuhilna lam ahim, kasei loule ipi phatchomna nanei ding uham?"},"7":{"text":"Thil gingthei lah jenga jong kuli ahim, selangdah ahim, aginteng a-aw akikhel loule; kuli ahi, selangdah ahi kon ahetkhen dingham?"},"8":{"text":"Ahiloule sumkon gin akichet loule, koiham gal kon dinga kigothei dinga?"},"9":{"text":"Chutobangma chun nanghon mihet bai ding pao natho louvule, ipi naseiju ahi iti kihet dingham? Nangho huijah-a thu sei tobang nahiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ija kihem, vannoi'a hin paochom paochom tamtah aume, ahivangin ikhat kiseina hilou khatcha jong aumpoi."},"11":{"text":"Chuti ahijeh chun chuche pao chu ipi kiseina ahi kahet louva ahile, athusei ngaija keima chu ama dinga paomah kahiding, thuseipa jongchu keima dinga paomah tobang hiding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuti chun nangho jong, lhagao thilpeh chan chom chom nei ding naha lunggulu ahin, hichu houbung in khantou na-a aneina dingin aletsetna nanei theina dingun holun."},"13":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun paochom tho-a chun athu jong ale theina dingin taohen."},"14":{"text":"Paochomin taoleng, kalhagao chu taova ahinan, ahinla kahetna hin ga aso jipon ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuti ahile apipen iham? Keima lhagaovin taovingting, hetna-a jong taovinge; lhagaovin jong la sangting hetna-in jong la sange."},"16":{"text":"Achuti loule nangman lhagaovin thangvahna seile chun, amuna tou ima he loulaiho chun nathang vahna chu, Amen, iti ati thei dingham? Nathusei chengla he louva?"},"17":{"text":"Nangma vang chun phate tah-a thangvahna nanei ahin, ahivangin midang akhantou sahpoi."},"18":{"text":"Nangho nabonchao sanga paochoma thu kasei tamjoh jeh hin, Pathen kathangvah-e;"},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin houbung sunga midangho kahil theina dingin, paochoma thu cheng sangsom kasei sangin, hetna-a thu cheng nga seidoh ding kadeijoi."},"20":{"text":"Sopite, nangho hetna-a chapang hihih-un; amavang nunsetna lama chapang hiuvinlang, hetna lama pilhingun."},"21":{"text":"Dan lekhabua hitin akisune, keiman hetphah lou paochom thohole gamdang miho kama, hiche mite jah-a hi thu kasei ding ahi, hiti chun bol jongleng amahon kathu angaideh lou dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.","ref":"Isai 28:11-12"},"22":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun paochom tho hi atahsan dinga hilouvin, atahsan louho dinga melchihna ahi; lhagao thu seidoh ho vang chu atahsan louho dinga hilouvin, atahsanho dinga melchihna ahi."},"23":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun houbung chengse kikhom henlang, chule ami takipmin paochom thohen, chu-a chun mi maimaile tahsanna neilouho khattou hung lutle, Nangho chu angola ahi, ati lou dinguham?"},"24":{"text":"Amavang nabonchaovin lhagao thu seidoh sohkeileu chun, atahsanlou ahim, milham ima helou khattou hung lutle, hichengpi chun asetna sosal intin, hichengpi chun oimo achan ding;"},"25":{"text":"Chule chutia chun alunggila thuguh jouse chu kiphong doh sohkei ding; chule chutia chu akhupbo-a lhu-a Pathen ahou ding, nangho lah-a Pathen aum chu aphonjal ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Achutile, sopite, iti danham? Nangho nakikhop tengule khat cheh-in la ahim, thuhil ahim, thuphondoh khat ahim, paochom tho ahim, chule khatnin athu aledoh ding nanei chehjiove. Hitiho jouse chu khantouna dinga kibol hihen.","title":"Pathen Houkhom na-a Umchan Dingdan"},"27":{"text":"Khattouvin paochoma thu aseija ahile, ni hijongle atampena thumin, kilhah lhah-in seijuhen, chule khatnin athu ledoh hen."},"28":{"text":"Athu ledoh ding aum lou vangle, ama chu houbung'a thipbeh chan umhen, ama chang jahle Pathen jah ding maijin thu seihen."},"29":{"text":"Lhagao thu seidoh nile thumin thu seihen, chule adang chengse ngaitohen;"},"30":{"text":"Ahivangin akoma touho khatpen pen henga thu kiphong aumle, amasapa chu umthim hen."},"31":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile mi jouse athep theina dingle mi jouse alungmon theina dinga, khatchenga kilha kilha-a lhagao thu naseidoh theiju ahi."},"32":{"text":"Themgaoho lhagao chu themgaohobou thua nung ahi."},"33":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Pathen chu thunoh lungjin kona ahipoi, mithengte houbung ho jouse-a ahi banga, lungmon kona ahibouve."},"34":{"text":"Na numei hou chu houbung kikhop na-ah thipbeh chan umthim uhen; ijeh-inem itile amaho chu thusei kipe-a ahipouve, chusang chun danthua kisei bangin, thu noija umuhen."},"35":{"text":"Amahon ikhat het nom aneijule, a-inmun uvah ajite cheh kidoh uhen, ajeh chu houbung kikhopna-a numei dinga thusei hi jachat umtah ahi."},"36":{"text":"Iham? Pathen thuhi nangho-a kona hung sohdoh ham? Ahiloule nangho changseh heng jengabou hungaham?"},"37":{"text":"Khattou ama themgaova akingaitoa ahiloule lhagao mi-a kingaito aumle, naheng uva kalekhasut chengse chu Pakai thupeh ahi ti hehen."},"38":{"text":"Amavang khattouvin ahet loutah-a ahile, ahe louvin um jenghen."},"39":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun, kasopite, Pathen lhagao thu seidoh guttenin ponpanun, paochoma thusei jong kham hih-un."},"40":{"text":"Amavang imajouse hoitahle kituptah-in bolcheh-un."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo sopite, kahetsah nahiuve, najah uva kalhangsap Kipana Thupha chu san jong nasanu ahitan, chujongle hia chu nadinu ahitai;","title":"Christa Thodoh"},"2":{"text":"Najah uva kathu lhangsap chu nachin jingule, hichea chu huhhing-a um nahitaove; chuti ahi lou vangle natahsanu chu moh ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu amasapena Pathen lekhabu dungjuija eiho chonset jala Christa thia ahitai, ti thuhil pipen kamu chu nangho kapehdoh ahitai;","ref":"Isai 53:5-12."},"4":{"text":"Chule ama avuijun, ani thumnin Pathen lekhabua kisei dungjuijin athoudoh kittan ahi.","ref":"Labu 16:8-10; Matt 12:40; Sol 2:24-32"},"5":{"text":"Chuin ama Cephas henga akilah masapenin, chuin somleni ho henga.","ref":"Matt 28:16-17; Mrk 16:14; Luk 24:34,36; Jhn 20:19"},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin mi janga valjen sopiteho henga khatvei lah-in akilah-in ahi; amaho atamjo tu gei hin aum nalaijui, akimkhat vang a-imu taove."},"7":{"text":"Chuin Jacob henga akilah-in, chujouvin solchah ho chengse henga akilah-in ahi."},"8":{"text":"Akhonna-in aphat louva peng tobang keima henga ahung kilah-in ahi.","ref":"Sol 9:3-6."},"9":{"text":"Keima solchah ho lah-a alhumpen kahin, chule Pathen houbung kabolset jeh chun solchah min pu dinga jong kilom kahipoi.","ref":"Sol 8:3"},"10":{"text":"Ahivangin Pathen lungset vangin kahibep chu kahinai; chule ama lungsetna eitona chu moh-in aumpoi, amaho chengse sangin katong gim jon ahi; ahivangin keima kahipoi eiumpia, Pathen lungsetna chu ahibouve."},"11":{"text":"Ahinla keima kahin, amaho ahiuvin, hitia chu thupha chu samphong cheh kahiuvin, nanghon chutia chu natahsanu ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Ahin tu-a, Christa chu athi lah-a konin kaithouvin aumtai tia kilhangsama ahile, nalah uva mi kimkhat chun, athi thokit himhim aumpoi, iti nati uham?","title":"Eiho Thokit Ding Thudol"},"13":{"text":"Athi thokitna himhim aum loule, Christa jong chu kaithouva umlou hinte;"},"14":{"text":"Chule Christa chu kaithouva umlou ahile, kathu hil lhangleu jong hi moh ahin, natahsanu jong moh ahi."},"15":{"text":"Mithi thokitna umlou ahileh, keiho hi Pathen lama jouthu hettohsah-in kakilangui; ajehchu keihon Pathen'in akaithoulou Christa chu akaithouve tin, kahettoh sah-un ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile mithi thoukit lou ahile, Christa jong chu thoukitlou ahi;"},"17":{"text":"Christa chu thoukit lou ahile, nanghon natahsanu jong moh ahi; nangho tu-a jong chonsetna umjing nalai nahi dingu ahi;"},"18":{"text":"Chuti chu ahile Christa-a imu milteho chu amangthahgam ahitaove."},"19":{"text":"Tu hinlai sung ding jenga Christa chu kinepna ineiju ahile, mi jouse sanga khoto umpentah ihi dingu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ahivangin tun Christa chu a-imuho lah-a aga masapenin apangin, athiho lah-a konin athoudoh tan ahi."},"21":{"text":"Mihem'a kona thina aum jeh chun, Mihem'a kon maman thokitna aumtan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Adam'a mi jouse athi banga chu, Christa-a mi jouse hinsah-a umding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Ahivangin, mijouse ama phatdol cheh-a umding ahi, Christa agamasa hintin, chu joule Christa ahung teng amite hidiu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chujoutah chule kichai ding ahi; chutengle aman vaipoh, thuneina, thahatna jouse asuhmang sohkeija, Pa Pathen khutna gam apehdoh ding ahi."},"25":{"text":"Aman agalte jouse akengto noija akoi masangse-a, aman vai apoh ding ahi.","ref":"Labu 110:1"},"26":{"text":"Gal nukhah pen thina ahi, hi jong chu asuhmang ding ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ajeh chu aman, imajouse akengto noija akoi ahitai. Ahin, imajouse athu noijah akoije, atia hin, athu noija koipa chu chucheho lah-a chu kisimthalou ahi, ti kichenin akilange.","ref":"Labu 8:6"},"28":{"text":"Imajouse ama thu noija aum phat chule, Pathen chu ijakaija ijakai ahi theina dinga, ijakai athu noija umsahpa thu noija chu Chapa jong umding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Chutobang chu ahiloule athiho dinga baptize changho iti taovintem? Athiho kaithouva aum louhel uva ahile, chuteho chu amaho dinga ibola baptize changji hiuvintem?"},"30":{"text":"Chule keiho jeng jong ibola nidan takipma settoh-a kaum jinguham?"},"31":{"text":"Sopite, Pakai Jesu Christa-a nangho chungchanga kakisonna kapatna kanela kasei ahi, keima niseh-in kathi jinge."},"32":{"text":"Keiman mihem ngai banga Ephesia gamsaho toh kisat kahile, phat chomna-a kanei dingham? Athiho kaithouva aum loule, hungun, neuhite donuhite; jingle kithita dingan.","ref":"Isai 22:13"},"33":{"text":"Lheplhah-in um hih-un: kivoppi phalouvin mi nunphat asusen ahi."},"34":{"text":"Chonphatna lama khangun lang, chonse hih-un; ijeh-inem itile abang khat Pathen hetna nei lou ahi. Hiche hi jahcha naovin nate tia kasei ahi."},"35":{"text":"Ahin mi khat touvin, Athiho kaithouva iti umham? Itobang tahsa vou po-a hungji aham, tinte.","title":"Athoukit Tahsa"},"36":{"text":"Vo lungthimbei, nangman muchi natu chu athi loule akehpoi;"},"37":{"text":"Khonunga akung abah ahung umding chu nangma tu ahipoi; kolbu hihen, chang dang hijongle, nangman achangbou natu ahi."},"38":{"text":"Pathen'in alung chama tahsa apeh ahibouve; achang takip chu ama dol cheh tahsa apehji ahi."},"39":{"text":"Amavang sa jouse akithakhat poi, mi-a hihen, sa-a hijongle, vachale nga-a hijongle, got chomcheh ahi."},"40":{"text":"Van vou aumin, leiset vou jong aume; ahivangin van tipum loupina achom ahin, leiset vou loupina achom ahi."},"41":{"text":"Nisa loupina achom ahin, lhathah loupina achom ahi; chule ahsi loupina jong achom ahi, ahsi le ahsi jong aloupina achom chom ahi."},"42":{"text":"Chutobangma chu athiho thokit jong hi ding ahi. Monmang theija kitu-a ahin, monmang thei louva kikaithou ahi;"},"43":{"text":"Manmo-a kitu-a ahin, loupia kikaithou ahi, hatmoa kitu-a ahin, thahat tah-a kikaithou ahi;"},"44":{"text":"Tahsa vou kitu-a ahin, lhagao vou kikaithou ahi. Tahsa vou uma, lhagao vou jong uma ahi."},"45":{"text":"Chule hitihin akisune, mi masa Adam chu mi hing anahi; Adam nunung joh vang chu hinna pe-a lhagao ahi.","ref":"Semt 2:7"},"46":{"text":"Ahivangin lhagao lam chu amasajopoi, mihing joh chubou aum masai; chujouvin bou lhagao lam chu aume."},"47":{"text":"Mihem masa chu leija kisem leija kon ahin, mihem nina vang chu van'a hungkon Pakai ahi."},"48":{"text":"Leija kisem mite jong hi leija kisem mipa chutoh bang cheh ahi; van mite chu van'a Pa tobang cheh ahiuve."},"49":{"text":"Chule leija kisempa lim ilo banguva chu, van'a Pa lim jong ilo dingu ahi."},"50":{"text":"Ahivangin, sopite, Tahsale thisan hin Pathen lenggam alo theipoi, monmang thei hin monmang thei lou chu alo theipoi, tia kasei ahi."},"51":{"text":"Veuvin, keiman nangho thugil khat kaseipeh nahiuve, ibon chaova ina-imut lou dingu ahi;","ref":"1 Thess 4:15-17."},"52":{"text":"Ahinla sumkon gin nunung pena chu, hai khat sunga, mitphet kah louva, ibon chaova ikikhel sohkei dingu ahi; ajeh chu sumkon hung ging ding, chule athiho chu monmang thei louva kaithouva umding, chule eiho ikikhel dingu ahi."},"53":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile hiche monmang thei hin monmang thei lou chu akivona, thi thei hin thi thei lou chu akivon ding ahi."},"54":{"text":"Chutia chu monmang theijin monmang thei lou chu akivona, thi theijin thi thei lou chu akivon tengtah chule, jona-in thina chu aval lhumtai, tia kisun thu chu guilhung ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 25:8"},"55":{"text":"Vo thina, namidena hoiham? Vo lhankhuh, na jona hoiham?","ref":"Hos 13:14."},"56":{"text":"Thina mide-na chu chonset ahi, chonset thaneina chu dan thupeh ahi."},"57":{"text":"Ahinla I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vanga jona eipeuva Pathen chu thangvah-in umhen."},"58":{"text":"Hijeh chun, sopi deitahte, dettah-in suhlong hoi hilouhelin pangun, gunchu tah-in Pakai na tong jingun; natohgimnao chu Pakaiya moh ahipoi ti naheuve."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule mithengte dinga tolom thudol vang chu, Galatia houbung ho thu kapeh bang chun, nanghon jong bolun.","title":"Tahsan Chankhom piho Dinga Thilto","ref":"Rom 15:25-26."},"2":{"text":"Chule kahung teng tolom donna aumlouna dingin, hapta nimasa ni leh Pathen'in phatthei aboh dungjuijin, amitakipmin atojoukham chehi-in dong khomun, anakhol khomun."},"3":{"text":"Keima kahung phatle, koihijeng jongle pha nasah penpenu chu nathilpeh hou gathah dingin, nalekha thot utoh Jerusalem'ah solnange."},"4":{"text":"Keima chea alom jongle, amaho chu keitoh lhonnao vinge."},"5":{"text":"Chule Macedonia kachotsoh phatle, naheng uva hung ding kahi; ajeh chu Macedonia gam chonle ding kigo-a kahi.","title":"Paul Lungtup","ref":"Sol 19:21."},"6":{"text":"Kachena channa neithah le thei na diuva naheng uva phat chomkhat kacham ding, ijem itile phalbi sungse-a bon kacham den ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tu chunga palama kimuto kanompoi; Pakai phatsah ahile, nangho koma chomkhat chamleng ti kakineme."},"8":{"text":"Ahivangin Pentecost geijin Ephesia kho-a hin chaming kate.","ref":"Thmpu 23:15-21; Danb 16:9-11."},"9":{"text":"Ajeh chu kadingin kot lentah toh machal theina tah akihonge, chule eidouva atame.","ref":"Sol 19:8-10."},"10":{"text":"Chule Timothy chu ahunga ahile, kicha louhela nalah uva aum theina ding ana ngaito uvin; ajeh chu ama keima toh bang banga Pakai na tonga ahi;","ref":"1 Cor 4:17."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun koiman nahsahmon bol hihhen. Kaheng ahung lhun theina dingin, achena-a lungmonga avalena dingin thahleuvin; ijeh-inem itile sopite toh ahungna ding lam kat jinga um kahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chule sopi Apollos thu vang chu, sopite toh kilhona naheng uva hung dinga katem jing ahi; ahin tupettah-a hung ding vang anompoi, ahivangin ahung thei phat phatle hung ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Kihongun, tahsanna-a dingdet jingun, pasal pha bangtah-in pangun hatnun.","title":"Thu Khumkhana le Salam"},"14":{"text":"Nabol jouseu chu ngailutna-a kibol hihen."},"15":{"text":"Sopiteho, Stephanas inkote sung hi Achaia gama Pathen thua ga masapen ahiuvin, mithengte jennan akipeuvin ahi, ti naheuve;","ref":"1 Cor 1:16."},"16":{"text":"Nangho jong hitobangho le keiho natoh huna-a tong gimho chengse thu noija umun, tia naheng uva katao ahi."},"17":{"text":"Stephanas, Fortunatus, chule Achaicus teho hilama ahungu hi kakipah lheh jenge; ajeh chu amahon nangho lhinlelna chu asubulhit taovin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Amahon keima lung jong, nangho lung jong akidosah ahi. Hitobang mite hi hethemuvin."},"19":{"text":"Asia gama houbung hon salam naboh-ui, Aquila le Priscilla le a-in lhona kikhom chengsen Pakaiya salam tamtah naboh-uve.","ref":"Sol 18:2."},"20":{"text":"Sopite jousen Salam naboh-uve. Kichop thengin khat le khat kisalam to cheh-un."},"21":{"text":"Kasalam bohna hiche hi keima Paul'in kakhut tah-a kasut ahi."},"22":{"text":"Khattou Pakai Jesu Christa ngailu lou aumle, ama chu Anathema hihen, Maranatha ."},"23":{"text":"Pakai Jesu Christa lungsetna chun umpiuvin."},"24":{"text":"Jesu Christa-a kangailut nao chu nabon chaova chunga umhen. Amen."}}}}},"47":{"info":{"name":"2 Corinth","shortname":"2 Cor","abbr":[],"desc":"Corinth Mite Henga Paul Lekha Thot Nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen lungcham tah-a Jesu Christa solchah-a pang Paul leh, sopi Timothy'in Corinth-a um Pathen houbung te, chule Achaia gam sunga um mithengte jouse henga,","title":"Lemna","ref":"Sol 18:1."},"2":{"text":"i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin, lungsetnale lungmonna chun umpiuvin."},"3":{"text":"Pathen, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa chu vahchoijin umhen, Ama lungsetnaho Pa leh lungmonna jouse Pathen ahi.","title":"Paul'in Pathen Athangvah"},"4":{"text":"Keihon Pathen'a kona lungmonna kaneiju, hiche lungmon na-a chu hesoh gentheija umteho kalungmonsah theina dingun, hesoh gentheina lah-a jong aman eilung monsah jingjiuve."},"5":{"text":"Ajehchu Christa thohgimna chengse keiho-a adimset bangin, Christa vangin lungmon na-a kadimset jingui."},"6":{"text":"Ahin keihon hesoh genthei kathoh-u aumle, hichu nangho lungmonna dingle huhhing-a naumna dingu ahi; lungmonga kaumu jongle, hichu nangho lungmonna dingle huhhing-a naumna dingu ahi; hichu keiho thohjiho tobang hesoh gentheina lungneng tah-a nathoh naova kona nahetdoh-u ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule nanghon hesoh genthei thohna lama chan naneiju banga, lungmonna lama jong chan nanei jingu chu kahen, kakineppi nau adet jinge."},"8":{"text":"Sopite, Asia gama kachunguva hesoh genthei chua chu nahet lou dingu kanompoi, thohjouhoi hilou kathauvin ajo kalvalin nasatah-a eidelpha jengu ahin, hing dinga jong kakihol louvu ahitan ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 15:32."},"9":{"text":"Ahin keihon kalung sungun, keihole keiho-a kitahsan louva athiho kaithouva Pathen chu katahsan johna dingun, kathina dingu ahung lhunge, katiu ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Ama chun chutobanga len thina-a kona chu eina huhdoh-u ahin, chujongle eihuhdoh dingu ahi; ama chun tu-a jong eihuhdoh dingu ahinalaije, tia ama-a chu kakinepnao phutdet kahiuve."},"11":{"text":"Mi tamtah vanga lungsetna thilpeh eikipeh jeh uva hi, mi tamtah-in keiho chungchanga athangvah theina dinga, nangho jong nataonaova eikithopia nahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile kakisonnao chu hiche hi ahi, kalung sunguva ase apha hetnan eihettohsah-u chu, vannoi mite hengah, chule atamjo cheh-a nangho lamah, tahsaphe lam chihna hilouva, Pathen lungset vanga Pathen thenna le kitahna-a kanachon jingu ahi.","title":"Paul Thilgon Kikhel"},"13":{"text":"Nanghon sim jong nasim uva, het jong nahetchet sao thu tailou chu keihon nangho henga thu dang ima kasunpouve. Chule akhon ni geijin heuvin nate tin kakineme."},"14":{"text":"Nanghon keiho neihet phot thimu banga chu, Pakai Jesu nikho nileh nangho kisonna ding keiho kahiu banga, nangho jong keiho keisonna ding nahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Chule hiche tahsanna-a hi, nivei phatchomna nanei theina dinguvin, nangho henga hung masaleng kati ahi;"},"16":{"text":"Macedonia kacheteng nangho kom hin hopangting, Macedonia'a konin nangho henga hungkit ingting, chule nanghon Juda gam lama neithah leuchun kati.","ref":"Sol 19:21"},"17":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu, hitia lung kaput hi, thil neocha dana kalahham? ahiloule kalunggot chengse hi, tahsaphe dungjuija, ahile ahi, ahi loule ahilou, tia kahim?"},"18":{"text":"Ahinla Pathen athutah bangin, nangho lama kathu-u chu, ahile ahi, ahi loule ahilou, ahipoi."},"19":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile nalah uva keihon, keimatah le Silvanus chule Timothy'n, kalhangsap leu Pathen Chapa Jesu Christa-a chun, ahi leh ahilou, aumpoi, ama-a chun Ahi aumbouve.","ref":"Sol 18:5"},"20":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen thutep jouse chu Ama-a chu Ahi chu uma ahi; hijeh-a chu keiho-a kona Pathen loupina dinga, ama vanga Amen hijia ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chule Christa-a nang hotoh eiphutdoh, chule thao einua chu Pathen ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ama chun namdet einam khumuva, chule ilung sunguva Lhagao khamgah na-a eipeh-u ahi."},"23":{"text":"Nangho hoidohna dinga tu geija Corinth-a hung louva kahitai, hiche thua hin kahinna chunga ahetoh dingin Pathen kakouvin ahi."},"24":{"text":"Keiho nangho tahsanna chunga vaipo-a kahipouve, nakipanao chu hujoa kahibovui. Ijeh-inem itile nangho tahsana-a nading detnaove."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahin keima changtumin hiti hin kangaitoi, tukallin lungphamon naheng uva hungtaponge."},"2":{"text":"Ajeh chu keiman nangho lung phatmo sahleng, kalung phatmo sahte tailou chu keima eikipasah dinga koiham?"},"3":{"text":"Keima kipana-a nangho kipah uvin nate ti kagingchan, eikipasah dingho chengse chun kahungteng eilung phatmosah khante tia, hiche thu chu kahinsut ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Chule nalung phatmona dinguva hilouvin, keiman nangho kangailut jeu hi nahetdohna dinguva, lunghesoh, lungkham chule mitlhi tamtah puma hiche thu chu kahinsut ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahinla, lung phatmo sah-a mi khattou auma ahile, keima eilung phatmosah ahipoi, kahabol khoh behseh louna dinguva, ichanham khatna nabon uva nalung phatmo sah-u ahi.","title":"Doumah Bolchu Ngaidamun"},"6":{"text":"Mi atamjoa kona chutobang mihemin talent amuchu, ama dinga phaset ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun nanghon nangaidam uva, nalungmonsah joh uva pha ahi; ajole chutobang mi chu lungphatmo behseh-in val lhum getninte."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu naheng uva katao ahi, nanghon ama nangailut nao chu sudetnun."},"9":{"text":"Nangho imalam jouse-a thungai nahiule, nahilouvu photchetna dinga jong kahinsut ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nanghon nangaidamu chu keiman jong kangaidam ahi.
