Keiman kangaidam-a ahile, Christa maikoh-a nangho jala kangaidam ahi;"},"11":{"text":"Hichu Satan'in ichunguva machalna thei agomkom atokhah louna ding ahi; ajeh chu eihon ama doha lungthim ihaiju ahipoi."},"12":{"text":"Christa Kipana Thupha hila Troas'a kahunga, chule Pakaiyin keima dinga kot khat ahon chun,","title":"Troas Mun'a Paul Lung Olmo","ref":"Sol 20:1."},"13":{"text":"Kasopi Titus chu kamudoh lou jeh-in, lung olna kaneipon ahi; ahin amaho-a konin kakilha doh-in, Macedonia gam lama kachetan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahin a-imatih chana keiho Christa-a galjona-a eipuile jinguva, Pathen chu thangvah-in umjing hen; aman keiho eimangun ama hetna gimnam chu muntin-ah aphong jallen ahi.","title":"Christa-a Galjona"},"15":{"text":"Huhhing-a umhole amangthahho dingin, Pathen lama Christa gimnamtui kahiuve;"},"16":{"text":"Loi khat dinga thina-a kona thina gimnam kahiuvin, loi khatte dingin hinna-a kona hinna gimnam kahiuve. Chule hicheng dinga lhinga koiham?"},"17":{"text":"Mi tamtah-in Pathen thuhi miho doha bola sumkolveinan amang chaovin, keiho vang chutobang kahi pouve; kitahtah-a Pathen thupeh bangbanga, Christa-a Pathen mitmu-a thu kaseiju ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keiho kiseipha pan kit kahiuvem? Ahiloule midangho banga, nangho henga ahim, nangho-a kon ahima, seiphatna lekha ngaija kahiuvem?","title":"Christa Lekhathot"},"2":{"text":"Nanghotah chu kalung sunguva kisun kalekha thotnu, mi jouse het le sim nahiu ahi;"},"3":{"text":"Nangho Christa lekha thot nahiuve, keiho lhacha natoh-a kon; lekha twija kisun hilouva, Pathen hing Lhagaova kisun; songphenga hilouva, lungthim tahsa phenga kisunjoh nahiuve ti kichentah-in akilange.","ref":"Pot 24:12; Jer 31:33; Ezek 11:19; 36:26"},"4":{"text":"Chule Christa vanga Pathen lama hitobang tahsan hi kaneiju ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hichehi keiho-a kona ahi ti dingin keiho chang kalhingjou pouve, kabulhinnao hi Pathen'a kon ahibouve;"},"6":{"text":"Amatah-in kitepna thah lhachale-a eibulhin sah-u ahi; lekhajem'a hilouvin lhagao kitepna lhachajoh ahi. Ajehchu lekha jem chun athatjin, lhagao vang chun ahinsahji ahi.","ref":"Jer 31:31"},"7":{"text":"Ahin thina lhacha-a panna, songa kikhena kisun jengbon chubang tah-a chu aloupi-a, avah kemsuhsuh ding Mosi mai chu avahpempum jeh-a Israel chatehon hoitah-a avet thei lou uva ahileh;","title":"Kitepna Thah Loupina","ref":"Pot 34:29."},"8":{"text":"Achutile Lhagao lhacha natoh chu iti haloupi johcheh louding ham?"},"9":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile themmo channa lhacha natoh bon aloupi-a ahile, chonphatna lhacha natoh chu nasajo cheh-a loupia ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile loupi kisa-a chu loupina nasajo chun akhokheltah jeh chun, hichea hin loupina aneitapon ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amang theija bon chutia aloupi-a ahile, imatih chana umjing ding chu gamchenga loupijo cheh ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chutobang kinepna kanei jeh uva, hakat tah-a thu kaseijiu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Akemsuhsuh chu Israel chaten avet lhumkei louna dinguva ponlu kikhua, Mosi tobang chu kahipouve;","ref":"Pot 34:34"},"14":{"text":"Ahinla amaho chu alungu atahjo chehtan ahi: ajeh chu tulai gei jong hin Kitepna lui chu asimlai chanun chuche ponlukhuh chu hodoh louvin aumjing nalaije; ajehchu hiche ponlukhuh chu Christa-a lahdoh-a uma ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Ahin tuni gei hin Mosi lekhabu asimlai chanun, alunguva chuche ponlukhuh chu aum jinge."},"16":{"text":"Ahivangin mihem khat chu Pakai heng lama akihei teng, aponlukhu chu kilamangji ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tun Pakai chu Lhagao ahi; chule Pakai Lhagao umna chana chu, chamlhatna uma ahi."},"18":{"text":"Eiho chengse vang, maikhu louva phatvet sunga kive-a banga, Pakai loupina chu ivet jinguva, Pakai Lhagaova kon, loupina-a kona loupina lima kikhela ihiuve."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu keiho hepina kachan uva, hiche lhacha-a panna kaneiju hi, keiho kalhadah hihhelui;","title":"Christa Kipana Thupha Vah"},"2":{"text":"Ahin jachatna thil kisel chengse kapai lhaovin, doha lungthimin kachonpouvin, chule Pathen thu chu mi lhep lhahnan kamangpouve; ahin thutah chu kaphongjalun, Pathen mitmu-a amitakip sele pha hetna henga kaum chanu photchena musah kahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chule kakipana Thupha jong hi maikhu kikhua ahile, amangthahho dinga maikhu kikhua ahin;"},"4":{"text":"Pathen lima um Christa Kipana Thupha loupitah chun amaho chu asalvah louna dinga, amaho sunga chu hiche vannoi pathen'in atahsan louho lungmit asuhchot ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajeh chu keihon keiho hilouva, Christa Jesu chu Pakai ahi tia, chule keiho Jesu jala nangho soh kahiu chu kalhang sapleu ahibouve."},"6":{"text":"Ajehchu, Muthim lah-a kona vah hung vahdoh dinga thupeh neijachu Pathen ahin, Jesu Christa maija Pathen loupi hetna chu avahdohna dinga, ama chun kalungu asalvah ahi.","ref":"Semt 1:3"},"7":{"text":"Ahivangin thilboltheina chungnung tah chu keiho-a kon hilouva, Pathen'a konjoh ahina dinga, hiche gou chu keihon leibela kachinu ahi.","title":"Leibela Lhagao Gou Kikhol"},"8":{"text":"Hoima lam jouse-a nehchinton kaum un, ahinla kisudongin kaumpouve; lungdongin kaumuvin, ahinla kalunglha pouve;"},"9":{"text":"Suh gentheijin kaumun, ahivangin dalhah-in kaumpouve; eikivolhu vin, ahivangin suhset helin kaumpouve."},"10":{"text":"Kavalena chanuva katichung uva Jesu hinna chu akiphon theinan, katichungu vah Pakai Jesu thina chu kapole jingui."},"11":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile keiho ahing chengse hi katahsao thi theija hi Jesu hinna akiphondoh theina dinga, Jesu jala athi dinga pehdoh jinga um kahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Chutia chu keiho-a hi thinan na atoh ahin, nangho-a hinnan atoh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Katahsan jeh-a thu kasei ahi, tia kisun banga chu, hiche tahsanna lhagao mama chu kaneijuva, keihon jong katahsan jeh uva thu kaseiju ahi.","ref":"Labu 116:10."},"14":{"text":"Pakai Jesu kaithouva chun, keiho jong Jesu toh thakhatna eikaithou dingu, chule nang hotoh a-anga eidinsah dingu ahi chu kaheuve."},"15":{"text":"Ajehchu mi tamtah thangvahna jala Lungsetna ahapuna, Pathen choi-atna-a aumna dinga, imajouse nangho jala kibol ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun kalhadah hihhelui; kami ponungu akem jing jeng vangin, kami sungnungu aniseh-in athah cheh athah cheh jon ahi.","title":"Tahsana Hin"},"17":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile chomkhat jengcha dinga kathohjiu hesoh gentheina jangkhai hin, tonsot kemlou loupina chu hasema eisempehbe jing jengu ahi;"},"18":{"text":"Muthei thilho ve louvin, mulou thilho chu kave jouve; muthei thil chu chomcha khat dinga ahin, mulou thil vang chu tonsotna dinga ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche pon in tobang kaleiset inu hi kiphelha jongle, khutna kisa hilou tonsot in, Pathen'a kona kisa indet chu van'ah kaneijuve, ti kaheuve."},"2":{"text":"Keihon van'a kachenna dingu in chu kivon ding ngai tun tuna, hiche sunga hi peng penga um kahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Chuche-a kakivon tengule, sagoh keova kaum lou dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu pon in'a kachen uva pohgih kapoh jeh uva peng penga kahiuve; hichu pon beija kaum nom jeh-u hilouva, athoa kakisil uva, thi theina hi hinna chun aval lhumna dinga peng penga joh kahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Chule hiche dinga eigo uva chu Pathen ahin; khamgah na-a Lhagao eipeuva jong ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu lungngama kaum jingu ahi, chule hiche tahsa ina kachen laiseuva hi Pakaiya kona gamla kahiuve, ti kaheuve."},"7":{"text":"(Ajeh chu keiho polam mu theija chon hilouva, tahsan vanga chona joh kahiuve);"},"8":{"text":"Lungngama kaumu ahi, tahsa-a um louva Pakai koma um kanomjouve."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu umu jongleng, umhih jongu leng, kadoiju chu ama lunglhai na-a um kahatup tenu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Mitinin tahsa-a athilbol apha hile, ase hile, athilbol dungjui cheh-a atohman asan cheh theina dinga, eiho ibon chaova Christa thupi tanna anga chu ikilah cheh dingu ahi.","ref":"Rom 14:10"},"11":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Pakai kichat umje kahet jeh uva miho kajolleu ahi; ahivangin Pathen anga kilang jingin kaum naove; chule nangho sele pha hetna-a jong kakilang jingui, tin kakinemui.","title":"Christa Vanga Pathen Toh Kiloi"},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu nangho henga keiho kichang vahchoi kit kahipouve; lungthim thua hilouva kamsung lama kisongte chu nadonbut theina dinguva, keiho lama kisonna naneina dingu phat kapehjoh nahiuve."},"13":{"text":"Ajehchu kangol-ule Pathen'a ding ahin, kachih-ule nangho-a ding ahi."},"14":{"text":"Christa ngailutna chun kachamlou uva eisolu ahi, hiti hin kagelui: mi jouse thi khela khat athia ahile, mi jouse chu athia ahitai;"},"15":{"text":"Chule ahingho chu amaho dinga hing hitalouva, athi kheluva thia thoukitpa ding joh-a hing ahi theina dinguva, mi jouse thi khela thia ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun tukala lhah-in, tahsa lam dola koima kahetapouve; chuti chu ahin masangin Christa chu tahsa lam dolin he jonguleng, tunvang hitobang chun kahetapouve."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun koi hile Christa-a um chu akisemthah ahi; alui chengse chu amang gama ahitai; veuvin, athah ahitai."},"18":{"text":"Chule thil jouse hi Pathen'a kon ahin, Aman Jesu Christa jala eikicham piuva, chule kichamna thu lhachale-a chu eipansah-u ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hitia chu Pathen chu Christa-a uma, vannoi leiset mite themona-a sun louva, amatoh kichamna aboljoh ahi; chule chuche kichamna thu chu keiho eipehdoh-u ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu Keiho Christa palai kahiu ahin, Pathen'in keiho-a kona naheng uva angeh banga, Pathen toh kichamun tia, Christa thalhenga naheng uva kangeh-u ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ama-a chu Pathen chonphatna ichan theina dinguva, chonset helouhelpa chu eiho khela chonsea asem ahitai."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Christa toh natong khom kahiuvin, Pathen lungsetna chu phatchomna beija mu-a nahi louna dinguva kajolu nahiuve;"},"2":{"text":"(ijeh-inem itile aman hitin ati, Keiman san phatchan, nataona kasange; Chule huhhing nikho nin nangma kahun ahi. Veovin, tuhi lahphat tah ahi; tuhi huhhingna nikho ahi).","ref":"Isai 49:8."},"3":{"text":"Hiche lhachale-a kapannau hi nolna aum louna dingin, keihon ilam ilam thu hile kipal lhuhna ding kaumsah pouvin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahin imalam jouse-a Pathen lhacha kahiu hi, hatah-a lungdehat nin, hesoh gentheina thoh-in, lhasama umin, setto lungkhamna toh-in."},"5":{"text":"Kijepna thoh-in, songkul'a kihenin, thunoh lungjinna thoh-in, thohgimna thoh-in, imulouva umin, an ngola umin,","ref":"Sol 16:23"},"6":{"text":"Thenin, hetna in, thohhat sotnin, hepina neijin, Lhagao Thengin, alhem hilouhel ngailutna-in,"},"7":{"text":"Thutah thun, Pathen thahatnin, jetle veija chondihna galvon kivonin,"},"8":{"text":"Gunchuna le jalouna-in, seisetle seiphat chanin, aphot chenna kavetsah jingui; mi lhemlha ho kabangun ahinla kitahtah kahiuve;"},"9":{"text":"Hetkhamlouho kabangun ahinla minchetah kahiuve; athikon kabangun ahinla, veuvin, kahingnaove; engbolin kaumun ahinla eikithat pouve;"},"10":{"text":"Lunghemtah kabangun, ahinla kipah thanom jing kahiuve; vaichatah kabangun, ahinla tamtah kahaosah taove; imacha neilouhel kabangun, ahinla imajouse kanei kimui."},"11":{"text":"Vo Corinth miteho, nangho dingin kakamu akan kalungu akihonglene."},"12":{"text":"Nangho keiho-a nehchinto-a uma nahipouve, nangho kichang lunggela nehchinto-a na-umu ahibouve."},"13":{"text":"Chuti chu ahin kapeh bang neipeh theina dingun (chate jah-a sei banga kasei ahi) nangho jong kihong lennun."},"14":{"text":"Atahsan louho toh kitoh louvin namkoljon pokhom hih-un; chonphat le chonset akikopna ipi umam? Muthimle khovah akibahna ipi umam?","title":"Atahsan louho toh Kiloija Kihouthei Thua Hilchahna"},"15":{"text":"Belial le Christa akitona ipi umam? ahiloule atahsanan atahsanlou toh ipi chan anei khomem?"},"16":{"text":"Chule Pathen intheng le milimho kihoutohna ipi umam? Ijeh-inem itile nangho Pathen hing intheng nahiuve. Chutichun Pathen'in jong hitin aseije, Keima amaho lah-a kachena chule kavale ding ahi; chule keima amaho Pathen kahi ding, amaho kamite hi ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 26:12; Ezek 37:27; 1 Cor 3:16; 6:19"},"17":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun Nangho amaho lah-a kon chun hung potdoh-un, chule achomin umun, tin Pakaiyin aseije; Thilboh tongkha hih-un; Chule keiman nangho kasan ding nahiuve,"},"18":{"text":"Chule keima napau hingting, chule nangho kachapate le kachanute nahi dingu ahi, tin hat chungnung Pakai chun aseije."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh chun, sopi ngaite, thutep hicheng chu ineiju ahi jeh chun, lhagao le tahsa kisuh bohna jouse-a konin kisuthengu hitin, Pathen gingin thenna-a chamkimin umu hite."},"2":{"text":"Keiho-a dingin nalungthimu hongun; keihon koimacha alam louvin kabolpouve, koima kasuse pouve, koima dohan kalhemlha pouve.","title":"Corinth Mite Lunghei"},"3":{"text":"Nangho themmo sahna dinga hiche hi kasei ahipoi; ithile thikhomsap, ihinle hingkhom dingin kalungsung uva nacheng uve tia, masanga kaseisa ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Nangho lama kahakat lheh jenge, chule nangho lama kakisonna jong anasai; chuti chun kahesohna jouseuva lungmonna kadimsetnin, chule kipana-in kaletset jingin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Macedonia gama kahungu jong chun, tahsa-a choldona neilou kahiuve; hoima lam jouse-a hesoh genthei toh jinga umjing jeng kahiu ahi; polama eidouva, lung sunga kichat kanei jing jengjiu ahi.","ref":"2 Cor 2:13."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla mi kisunemte lungmonsah Pathen'in, Tita hung lhun vang chun eilung monsah taove;"},"7":{"text":"Chule ama hung vang jenggoh jong hilouvin, aman nangho-a lungmonna anei, hiche lungmonna chun eilung monsah taovin ahi; nanghon neingaichat jeu, neilhaset piu, kei dinga nagunchujeu, thu ahung seijin ahile, hichea chun hatah-in kakipah kathanom lheh jengtan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajeh chu keiman kahin lekhathotna chu nangho kasuh lunghem jeng vangun kakisihpoi; kana kisih jeng vangin; ajehchu kalekhathot chun nangho chomkhat kahsung hijongle, nalunghemsah lheh jengun ahi;"},"9":{"text":"Keima tun kakipah kathanome, nangho suhlunghema naum jeh-u chu hilouvin, nalunghem nao chun lungheina aso jeh chu ahi. Ijeh inem itile nanghon keiho-a hakamna imacha nanei louhelna dinguva, Pathen lam dola kisu lunghema nahiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen lam dola lunghem chun huhhing-a umna dinga lungheina asoji ahi; hichun kisihna asojipoi; vannoi leiset lam dola lunghem chun thina asojin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ajeh chu, veuvin, Nalunghem nao chu Pathen lunglam dol ahi; nangho-a itobanga kihatup chehna asodoh hitam! nangho dingin: nakisuh thengnao, lungsouna, kichatna, ngaichatna, gunchuna, chule phulahna, asodoh-in; hiche thiljouse-a hi nangho thengsoh nahiu chu naphot chetnu ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Hiche naheng uva kahinsut jeng vang chun, alam louva bolpa jeh-a kahinsut ahipon, alam louva kibolpa jeh-a jong kahinsut ahidehpoi; Pathen mitmu-a nachunga kagun chujeu chu naheng uva akiphon dohna dinga, kahinsut joh ahibouve."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun nalungmon naova lung mongin kaum taove. Chule Titus kipana-a kaha kipa cheh-un ahi; nanghon nabon chaova alung nakidosah jeh-u chun.","title":"Titus Kipa"},"14":{"text":"Ajeh chu ama komah nangho-a kakisonna ima a-umtah jeng jongle, jachatnan kaneitapoi; ahin nangho henga kathu sei jouseu thutah ahi banga chu, Titus anga kakisonao jong chu thutah mong ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule nangho nathu nunnao, itobanga kichatah le kithing thinga nanalem jengu hitam, ti ageldohjile nangho nakhoto nao anasacheh cheh jengin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun thiljouse-a nangho chunga tahsana kanei hi kakipah thanomin ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sopiteho, Macedonia houbung ho kipe-a Pathen lungsetna chu nangho kahetsah nahiuve.","title":"Christian Thilpeh","ref":"Rom 15:26."},"2":{"text":"Ajeh chu hesoh gentheija kipatepna nasatah lah jenga jong akipanao adimin, avaichat thuhlheh jeng vangun, athilphal uva kon aletset jengtaovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Keiman kahet tohsah-a kasei ahi, amahon athao toh kithuh-in, athaovin ajokalvalin jong, amaho lungcham tah-in apeuvin;"},"4":{"text":"Athilto-u chu kasan nadingu leh, mithengte lhachakin bolna-a akithokhom theina dingun eino gangun ahi"},"5":{"text":"Chule hichu kakinepna bangu hilouvin, Pathen lunglamin amaho-a Pakaiyah akipe masaovin, chuin keiho henga akipeuvin ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chutichun Titus'in masanga abol pat banga chu, tu-a jong chuche lungsetna chu nangho lah-a abulhit sohna dingin katiltil jiuvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Amavang, tahsanna, seidohna, hetna, gunchuna jouse le keiho ngailutna nanei letset banguva chu, hiche lungsetna jong hi nanei letsetna dingu gelun."},"8":{"text":"Hiche hi thupeh bangtah-a kasei hilouvin, midangho kihabolna-a kona, nanghon ngailutna tahbeh naneiju chu patepna-a kasei ahibouve."},"9":{"text":"Ajeh chu ama vaichat vanga nangho nahaodoh theina dinguva, ahaonasa nangho jala vaicha jenga, hiche Pakai Jesu Christa lungset chu nanghon naheuve."},"10":{"text":"Hiche thudola hi lungthim kapehbou nahiuve; achuti chu nangho dinga apha ahi; kum khat masanga bol pan masa nangho nahiuve, nabol pat jenggoh-u hilouva bol jong nabolphat nomu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ahin bol ding nalung got bangu chun, than ajochanin bulhit sohkeija aum theinan, tun jong bol bulhingun."},"12":{"text":"Ajeh chu lung got masah auma ahile, aneija chu anei dungjuija, chule aneilou chu aneilou dungjuija kilajia ahi."},"13":{"text":"Mi dang noma aumuva nangho hesoh-a naum dingu katina ahipoi;"},"14":{"text":"Chamgola umna ding ahi, amaho nei letset chu nangho lhahsam bulhitna-a ahung hi theina dinga; tu-a nangho neiletset hi amaho lhahsam bulhitna-a chamgola umna dinga kitoh ahibouve;"},"15":{"text":"Hitia chu, atam lokhoma chu aval aum chomdehpon, chule alhom lokhoma jong chu alhasampoi, tia kisun bang chu ahi.","ref":"Pot 16:18"},"16":{"text":"Ahin Tius lungsunga chutobanga gunchu tah-a nangho khotona neisah Pathen chu thangvah-in umhen.","title":"Titus le Akiloipiho"},"17":{"text":"Ajeh chu keiho tilkhouna jop chu ahinan, ahinla amatah mong lunggut tena ama lung chama nangho henga hunga ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule Kipana Thupha lama houbung ho jouse lah-a akipachatna kithangsoh chu, amatoh lhon dingin kahinsol thaove."},"19":{"text":"Chuti jenggoh chu hilouvin; Pakai loupina dingle, kalunggot tenjiu hi vetsahna-a alhachalea kapanu, hiche lungsetna thu lamdola hi kalhonpile dinguva, houbung in agotsa mongu jong ahi."},"20":{"text":"Alhachalea kapanu hiche thilpeh letset thudola hi koiman eidem louna dinguva, chingtheitah-a chona kahiuve;"},"21":{"text":"Pakai mitmu jenga hilouva mihem mitmu-a jong thil ja umdol chu kangaitou ahi.","ref":"Thuch 3:4."},"22":{"text":"Chule keihon tamtah vei thil tamtah-a agunchuje kaphottohsao isopipao chu, amaho toh kahinsol thaovin ahi, ahin tun nangho-a tahsan dettah anei jeh-in ahagunchu cheh jengtan ahi."},"23":{"text":"Titus thudol hi kiseile, ama hi nangho chungchanga kakivopi le katoh khompi ahi; chule sopi niteni vanghi, houbung ho solchah chule Christa loupina ahi lhone."},"24":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun nangailut nao le nangho jeh-a kisonna kaneiju photchetna chu, amaho kom le houbung ho angsunga amaho chu kivetsah-un."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mithengte kinbol thudol vang naheng uva kahinsutlo angaipoi;","title":"Tahsan Chankhom piho Kithopi"},"2":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile nalunggot danu chu kahenai, hiche dol chu, Achaia kigosa aumna kumkhat ahitai, tia Macedonia mite anga nangho kapaopi ahi; chule hiche nagunchu nau chun mi tamtah achoh thouvin, agunchu sahtan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hitilam thudola nangho kakisonpinao chu ahomkeo ahi louna dinga, kasei banga chu kigosa dema naumna dingun, tia sopiho phabep khat kahinsolu ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Achuti loule ajole Macedonia mi khattou kei lhonpi dingin hunghen, kigo louva na-umu hungtoh tale, keiho chang jenggoh hilouva, kinep pitah nangho dinga jong jachat umding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu masanga pat nakitep nasao thilpeh kitoh chu cham louva lah hilouva, hongphal tah-a peh ahia, gotsadema nakoina dinguva; aphat masanga naheng uva hung dinga sopiho chu tilkhou angaije tia kageltoh ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahivangin hiche thudola hin alhom tu-a chun alhom at ding, chule atam tu-a chun atam at ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Lung phatmo pumpumle peh louva, phamo tia pe louvin, nalung got bangtah cheh-in peuvin; ijeh-inem itile lunglhai sela pe-a chu Pathen'in angailui."},"8":{"text":"Chule imalam jouse-a imatih chana ijakaija bulhingsoh nahiuva, natohpha tintang natoh theina dinguva, Pathen'in lungsetna letset nangho napeh theiju ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hiche thudol chu hitihin akisune, Aman athejalin, mivaichate atoi; Achonphatna chu a-imatih chana umjing ahi.","ref":"Labu 112:9"},"10":{"text":"Chule muchi tu-a chu muchi pe-a chule anneh dinga changlhah pepa chun, nangho muchi napeuvintin apunsah ding, chule nachon phatnao ga chu akhantou sah ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 55:10."},"11":{"text":"Thil phal dinga imalam jouse-a haodoh-a nahitaovin, alhacha-a keiho vangin Pathen vahchoijin aume;"},"12":{"text":"Ajeh chu hiche phatna dingbol lhachale-a panna vanga hi, mithengte lhahsamna bulhinsah jenggoh hilouva, thangvahna tamtah-a kona, Pathen lama jong letset jenga ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Hiche lhacha kin kibola kon, nangho Christa Kipana Thupha phondohna dinga nathu man-ule, amahole adangho jouse tona-a nathilpeh-u jehchun amahon Pathen avahchoijui."},"14":{"text":"Amahotah jong nangho dingin Pathen henga atao ataovun, nachung uva Pathen lungset lentah chuh jeh chun nangai lheh jengui."},"15":{"text":"Athilpeh sei theilou jeh hin Pathen thangvah-in umhen."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima, Paul, naum naova lungnem chule naum lounaova nangho lama hakat chun, Christa chonnemna le nunnem na-a keimatah-in katem nahiuve.","title":"Alhacha Natoh Nachunga Paul Kihon"},"2":{"text":"Hijongle keiho hi tahsa lam thua chon ahi tia eingaitoho mi koi koiham chunga, hakat tah-a chon dingdol ahi tia kageltoh chu, kaum tengle hiche hakat chu kamanchah louna dinga, naheng uva katao ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile keiho tahsa-a chonle kahivangun, tahsa lam thudolin gal kasatpouve;"},"4":{"text":"(Ajeh chu kagalsatnau manchah hi tahsa-a ahipoi, ahivanga, kulpi suhjalna dinga Pathen lama hattah);"},"5":{"text":"Keihon, lungsuhto-a mi nel na, chule Pathen lam hetna douna-a kigel thil sangtah tah kasuh chim jiuva, lungthim ngaito jouse gal hinga kamat jiuva, Christa thua kanunsah jiu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule nangho thua nanun bulhin tengule, thua nunglouho phula dinga jong kigosa jing kahiuve."},"7":{"text":"Nanghon namaikoh uva um thil chu navet uvam? Koi hile mi khattou ama, Christa-a kahi tia amachang kitahsana aumle, ama chun hiche hi ngaito kit-hen; ama Christa-a ahi bang chun keiho jong kahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangho phet lhahna hilouva sahphatna dingjoh-a Pakaiyin eipeh-u kathuneinao hi hatah-in song jongleng, kajachat lou ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Lekhaho-a chun nangho tijatsah tobang hidange."},"10":{"text":"Ajeh chu alekhaho athu agihsan, hat jong ahat ngeije, ahinla amunah atahsa ahatmon, athusei taimo aume, atiuve."},"11":{"text":"Chutobang miho chun heuhen, keiho kaum lou tenguva lekha-a thu banga chu, kaumu jongle thilbola chutima chu kahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile amachang kivahchoi mi abang khattouho toh kisimtha dingle kitekah ding kangampouve; amaho vang chu amahole amaho akitekah jiuvin, imacha helou helin aumui."},"13":{"text":"Keiho vang eikitepeh kalvalun kisong pouvinge, Pathen'in gamkol eitepeh bang bangabou kisong ding kahiuve, gamkol chun nangho jong nahomui."},"14":{"text":"Ajeh chu keiho nangho kom hung lhunglou toh kabah jeng vangun, eikitepeh kalvala kilhonsao kahipouve, ajeh chu Christa Kipana Thupha hille-a, nangho kom geipeh jong kahung lhunu ahi;"},"15":{"text":"Eikitepeh kalvaluva midang tohnasa-a kisonga kahipouve; natahsanu akhantoule kavai hom dungjuiju hin nangho vangin hatah-a keh let cheh-in umunge, ti kakineme."},"16":{"text":"Nangho gam kalpeh geija Kipana Thupha hi kaseiphongle theina dinguva, kakhut uva dinga gotsa um thil dola hi mi gamkol sung kason louna dingu, katiu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahin khattou akisonga aumle Pakaiyah kisonghen.","ref":"Jer 9:24."},"18":{"text":"Ajeh chu ama kiseipha-a chu hilouvin, Pakai seiphat chubou apha tia kisei ahi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kangolna themthema neinangai themleu chun kalung ahi; ahin neinangai themsam naove.","title":"Paul le Solchah Lhemho"},"2":{"text":"Pathen tomlah na-a nachung uva katomlah ahi, nungah theng banga Christa khutna kapeh theina dinguva, nangho inneipu khatseh Christa dinga kaholsa nahiuve."},"3":{"text":"Ahivangin gul chun alepthol doha-a Evi alheplhah bangchun, Christa lama nalungput dihnauva nalung gelu chu ijemtin suchavai getnun nate ti kakichai."},"4":{"text":"Ajehchu keihon athu kasei louvu Jesu chom dang khat thu ahung seija auma, ahiloule nachankhah ngai louvu lhagao chomdang changa auma, ahiloule najop khah ngai louvu Kipana Thupha jop auma, ahile ama chu angai themleu chun aphai."},"5":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile solchah pipui chung nungho sanga neokhat chajong neojo-a kingaito lou kahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla thuseija kalhahchom vangin hetna lama chun kalhachom poi. Ahin imalam jouse-a nangho henga tahlangin kaumun ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ole, nangho choisanga naumna dinguva, keima kaki suhnema, lo beija nangho Pathen Thupha kahilu hi achonsea kahim?"},"8":{"text":"Nangho kinbolna dinga, houbung dangdang kachoma, amaho-a kona lo kasan ahi;"},"9":{"text":"Chule nangho koma kaum laisen kalhahsamna aum jongle, koima dinga gihsatna hilouhel kahi; ajeh chu Macedonia konin sopiho ahungun, kangaichat chengse ahung subulhittaove; chule imalam jouse-a nangho gihsatsah louna dinga kihongdoh jing kahin, kihongdoh jing ding kahi."},"10":{"text":"Christa thutah jouse keima-a aum jehchun, Achaia gamkol sunga kakisonna chu koiman eikhahtan thei ponte."},"11":{"text":"Ipi jehham? nangho kangailut lou jehham? Pathen'in ahenai."},"12":{"text":"Ahinla agomkom holteho chu, akisonao chu keiho tobangbang ahung hi theina dinguva, agomkom atokhah dingu chu kasuhhai theina dinga, kabol hi kaboljom jing ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile chutobang miho chu solchah lhem ahiuve; doha bola milhemlha natong ahiuve; amaho Christa solchah ho lima kisema ahiuve."},"14":{"text":"Hichu thu kidang ahipoi, ajeh chu Satan'in amatah jengin jong avah-a vah vantil mel aputji ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuti chu ahin, alhachahon chonphat lhachaho mel aput chu thupi ahipoi; ahivanga akichainiu chu athilbol dungjui cheh-u hiding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Keiman kasei kit ahi, koiman angolin eingaito hihhen; ahin neingaito ujongleh, themkhat beh kakison theina dingin mingol bangin neisangun.","title":"Solchah Ahijeh-a Paul Hesoh Genthei"},"17":{"text":"Hicheng kasei hi Pakai thuseija kasei hilouva, hiche kisonna-a hi kisonga, mingol thusei banga kasei ahibouve."},"18":{"text":"Mi tamtah tahsaphe lama akison jeh-a, kei jong kakison ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Nangho achinga nahi jeh uva, mingol ho chu kipahtah-a nangaithem-u ahi."},"20":{"text":"Nasohchan sah uva jong, nabah gamuva jong, gal hinga naman uva jong, ama le ama kichoisanga jong, chule nangeipheu benga jong, nangai themu ahi."},"21":{"text":"Keiho hichea ding chun kalhasamui tia jahcha puma kasei ahi! Ahivangin ilam ilam thua hile, midang ngamna-a chun (Mingol thuseija kasei ahi)kei jong kangame."},"22":{"text":"Amaho Hebrew mi hiuvam? kei jong kahi. Amaho Israel mite hiuvam? kei jong kahi. Amaho Abraham chilhah hiuvam? kei jong kahi."},"23":{"text":"Amaho Christa lhacha hiuvam? (Mingol thuseija kasei ahi) keima kaha hidehjoi, na hatohgimin, songkul lut tamin, teptena kalvala kivoh tamin, thina thei setto tamin;"},"24":{"text":"Ngavei Judah ho-a konin somli-a khat lhan eiki jepmin;"},"25":{"text":"Thumveina molin eikivon; khatvei songin eikisepmin, thumveina kongke kathoh, jan khatle sunkhat twi thuh laija kaumin;"},"26":{"text":"Kakholjin lena-a, tamtahvei luipi-a setto, gucha michoma setto, kanam chanpite-a kona setto, chidang namdang ho-a kona setto, khopi sunga setto, gamthip dunga setto, twikhanglen'a setto, sopi lhemho lah-a setto;"},"27":{"text":"Tohgimle hesoh gentheijin, hah jinga imu louva umin, gilkel dangchah thoh-in, an ngola umin, khosih thoh-a pon sillouva umin, hicheng chu kaha hidehna ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hicheng vang chu chutitante, ahivangin apipenin houbung chengse kakhohsah hi niseh-a eidelpha-a ahi."},"29":{"text":"Koi hatmona kahatmopi lou umam? koi kiselhuh na-a katompi lou umam?"},"30":{"text":"Kithang-at go-a hileng, kahatmona tamtah-a hi kakithang-at ding ahi."},"31":{"text":"Jou sei lou kahi, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa-le Pathen tonsot nunnoma chun ahenai."},"32":{"text":"Damascus-a Aretas lengpa noija gamvaipopan, keima man dingin Damascus miho khopi chu angasah jeng ahi;"},"33":{"text":"Ahivangin bangkot homa bomin kulpanga eikhai lha uvin, akhutna konin kasohchatan ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima dingin kiletsahhi ima phachom hihjongle, gaothilmu le Pakai kilahna thuho seijinge.","title":"Paul Gaothilmu le Thil Kilahho"},"2":{"text":"Keiman Christa-a mi khat kahei, kum somle kum li ahitai (tahsa pumaham kahepoi, tahsa puma hilouham kahepoi, Pathen'in ahei) van athumna geijin lahtouvin aumin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Keiman hitobang mi chu kahei (tahsa pumaha, atahsa pum hilouham, hi chu kahepoi, Pathen'in ahei)."},"4":{"text":"Ama chu gam loupi-a lahtouvin aumin, tho thei louhel paochengho agajai, hichu mihem dinga thodoh hoi dan hilouhel ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chutobang mi dinga chu kisong ding kahi; keima chang thua vang, kahatmo naho tailouvah kisongponge."},"6":{"text":"Kison ding lung go jongleng angolla hiponge, keiman thutahbeh kasei ding ahi; min keima eimu-a chule kathu ajah-a itobanga eingaitom, hi sanga chu chungnung-jo-a eingaito louna dinga, kakitim ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule thil kilahho anatsat behseh jeh-a chu kakichoisang behseh louna dingin, Satan thangkou khat eichum dingin, kakichoisang louhelna dingin, kati chungah ling khat eikipen ahi."},"8":{"text":"Keija kona achemangna dingin Pakai anga thumvei kataotan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chutah chun aman, Kalungsetna hi nangma dinga lhingset ahi; ajehchu hatmona-a kathahat kisucham kimjia ahi, ati. Hijeh-a chu Christa thahat keija achen theina dinga, kahatmona-a hi kipahtah-a kakison johding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh-a chu Christa jala hatmona tincheng, suhlema umna, vaichatna, bolsetna, settona hichenga hi lunglhaija um kahi; ajeh chu kahatmo komle kahatjin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Kison na-a ngol kanahi ahitai; nanghon ngollou theijin neilhapouve; ajeh chu nangho choi-at dingjoh kahi; ijeh inem itile keima solchah pipuiho sanga imacha-a nunung jolou kahi.","title":"Paul'in Corinth Miteho Akhohsah"},"12":{"text":"Tahtah-a seijin, solchah hina melchihna ho jouse nangho lah-a thohhattoh kitho-a, melchihna tintang kibola, mu kidang dang chule thilbol theina-a kiboldoh ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahile houbung dangho sanga noinungjo-a na-umnao ipi umam, keiman nangho gihsatsah louva kaum ti lou chu? Hiche kasuhkhel chu neingaidam un."},"14":{"text":"Veuvin, nangho henga hung kakigot hiche hi athumveina ahi; chule nangho gihsatsah lou ding kahi; ajeh chu keima nangho-a ima hola hilouvin, nangho bou kahol ahi; ajeh chu anule apa dinga chatehon sum akhol chu adol ahipoi, anule apanbou chate dinga akhol ding dol ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule keiman kipahtah-a nangho hinna dinga kakiman ding, chule kakiman jouhel ding ahi. Keiman nangho kangai lutnao asanlheh jeh-a, nangho neingailut nao lhasam dingham."},"16":{"text":"Ahoi hitale ahihi hitante, keiman nangho pohgihsa kapoh sahpoi; ahin lungthim thema doha kamat nahiuve."},"17":{"text":"Naheng uva kahinsol teho lah-a khattou nangho doha bolna-a kaman chah umam?"},"18":{"text":"Titus chu keiman kajola, sopiho chu amatoh kahin soltha ahi; ole Titus'in doha nabolnao umam? Keiho lhagao khat hilou kahiuvem? kalson kibanga sepkhom hilou kahiuvem?"},"19":{"text":"Tuchan geija hi keiho kithenhon na-a najah uva thuseija neingaito nahlaiju ham? Keiho Pathen maikoh-a Christa thu seija kahiuve. Chule, ngaitahte, imajouse hi nangho sadoh-a phattou sahna-a kabollu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ajeh chu nakomu kahung lhun tengle, ajole kamu nom bangin muhih khau vingting, chule nanghon jong neimu nom bangin neimu hih khauvinate, ti kagingmoi; ijem itile nalah uva, kibaotam, kithangset, lunghan, kilungdou, kiseiset, kihou lhih, hamhoitho, thunoh lungjin umkhante kati;"},"21":{"text":"Chule ajole kahung kit tengle, ka-Pathen'in keima nangho angah eisunem khantin; chule tu masanga chonsea, thenlouna, jonthanhoi, huh aboluva kon lungheilou mitamtah hochu lhasetpi khagetning kate."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangho henga kahung tu chunga hi athum veina ahi. Ahetoh ni ahim, thum ahim, kama thu ijakai tun dinga umding ahi.","title":"Achaina-a Gihsalna le Lemna","ref":"Danb 17:6; 19:15."},"2":{"text":"Amasanga kanaseisa ahi, chule aniveina-a kaum petna kanaseisa banga chu, tu-a kaum louva jong, tu masanga chonse hole adang dangho jouse henga kasut ahi, kahung kit tengle, khen nei lou ding kahi;"},"3":{"text":"Nanghon Christan keima-a thu asei photchena nahol jeh-u chun; ama chu nangho lama hatmoa ahipoi, nangho-a hattah ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile hatmona jeh-a thingpel'a akikhetbeh jeng vangin, Pathen thahat vangin ahing jinge. Ajeh chu keiho jong ama-a hatmoa kahiuve; ahinla Pathen thahat vanga nangho lama amatoh hingkhom ding kahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Tahsana um nahiu nahi louvu nangho kikholun; photchena dingin nangho kikholun. Ahiloule Jesu Christa nangho-a aum chu nangho tah-in helou nahiuvem? aphai tia lah hilou nahilou ngaluleh."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla keiho hi aphai tia lah hilou kahilou hi nanghon nahet dingu kakineme."},"7":{"text":"Ahivangin nangho thilphalou nabol louna dingun Pathen henga kataojiuve; hiche aphai tia lah kahiu chu kilahdohna ding hilouva, keiho aphai tia lah hiloutoh kabah jeng vangun, nanghon thil ja um chu nabolna dingu ahijoi."},"8":{"text":"Ajeh chu keiho thutah-a ding tilou, thutah dounan ima kabol thei pouve."},"9":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile keiho kahatmo uva nangho nahat tengule kathanom jiuve, chule nachamkim na dingun jong, kataojiuve."},"10":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun asuse ding hilouvin, houthu lama khantou sahna dinga Pakaiyin thuneina eipeh hi, kathunei bangtah-a kahung tengle, kabol khoh louna ding lungthima kahung masanga hicheng hi kahinsut ahi."},"11":{"text":"Achaina keijin, sopite, nangho kipah thanomun, chamkim keijun, lungmongun, lungkhat hiuvin, kitohdelin umun; chutile ngailutle lungmon kona Pathen'in naumpi dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Thengtah-a kibeng chop cheh-in khatle khat kisalam un."},"13":{"text":"Mitheng jousen nasalamui."},"14":{"text":"Pakai Jesu Christa lungsetnale, Pathen ngailutna, chule Lhagao Theng kithopina chun nabonchaovin umpiuvin. Amen."}}}}},"48":{"info":{"name":"Galatia","shortname":"Gal","abbr":[],"desc":"Galatia Mite Henga Paul Lekha Thot"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihem'a kon hilou, mihem vanga jong hilou, Jesu Christa le athi lah-a kona kaithouva Pa Pathen pansah solchah keima Paul,","title":"Lemna"},"2":{"text":"Chule kaumpi sopite chengsen Galatia'a um houbung ho hengah."},"3":{"text":"Pa Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa-a konin lungset le lungmon nachung uva umhen;"},"4":{"text":"Ama chu i-Pathen'u le i-Pau lunggot bangtah-in, tulai vannoi phat louva kona hi eiho eihuh dohna dingun, eiho chonset manin ama akipetan ahi;"},"5":{"text":"Loupina chu a-imatih chanin ama-a hijinghen. Amen."},"6":{"text":"Tule tu kahseh-a Christa milungsetna-a nakou paova kona thupha chombeh lama nakai jengu chu kidang kasa lheh jenge.","title":"Kipana Thupha Khatseh"},"7":{"text":"Hichu thupha chomdang jong ahisampoi; ahinla mi phabep khat aumun, amaho chun nangho nasuh boijuva chule Christa Thupha hi akaleh-a hei ding agotnu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahin keihon nangho henga kahung seiju Kipana Thupha hilou, akalvala thupha chomdang hung seija aumle, keiho hiuving, van'a hungkon vantil khattou hijeng jongle, ama chu sapset chang hen."},"9":{"text":"Masanga kasei banguva kasei kit ahi, nanghon najopsao kipana Thupha chu hilouva, thupha chomdang naheng uva hung seija aumle, ama chu sapset changhen."},"10":{"text":"Keima tu-a hi mihem jola kahim, Pathen jola kahim? Ole mihem lunglhaisah ding go-a kihabol kahim? Mihem lunglhaina ding holnalai kahile, Christa soh hilou kahi ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuti chu ahin, sopite, keiman kahil Thupha thudol hi kahetsah nahiuve, hiche hi mihem lam dol thu ahipoi.","title":"Paul Solchah-a Dinga Kou"},"12":{"text":"Mihem'a kona kamu jong ahipoi, min eihil jong ahipoi, Jesu Christan aphondoh-a kona kamu ahibouve."},"13":{"text":"Malaija Juda mite houdan-a kachon laija kanunchan kakhanchan thu chu najakhataove, Pathen houbung chu teptena kalvala bolsea sumang dinga bola kahi;","ref":"Sol 8:3; 22:4-5; 26:9-11."},"14":{"text":"Chule kapu kapate hou lama katompan behseh jeh-a, Juda te hou danthu lama kanam sunga kakhang golpi tamtah kakho khel ahi.","ref":"Sol 22:3"},"15":{"text":"Ahivangin kanu oisunga kaum laija pat eisepkhena leh amilungsetna-a eikou Pathen'in,","ref":"Sol 9:3-6; 22:6-10; 26:13-18."},"16":{"text":"Kipana Thupha chidang namdangho lah-a kaphon jal ding adeija, achapa keija phondoh ding agotchun, keiman tahsaphe le thisan kadongpai jengpon,"},"17":{"text":"Jerusalem'a keima sanga solchah himasaho henga jong kachepoi; ahin Arabia gama kachen, chuin Damascus'a kahung kile kittan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chujou kum thum nungin Jerusalem'a Peter toh kimuto dingin kagache touvin, chule nisom le ninga akomah kaga ume.","ref":"Sol 9:26-30"},"19":{"text":"Ahivangin solchah ho lah-a khatcha kamupoi, Pakai naopa Jacob bou kamui."},"20":{"text":"Thu hicheng naheng uva kahinsut hi, veuvin, Pathen maikoh-a kasei ahi, jou seija kahipoi."},"21":{"text":"Chuche jou chun keima Syria le Cilicia gamkol sunga kachetan ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule hiche geija chu Juda gama Christa-a um houbung ho mel het louva umnalai kahi;"},"23":{"text":"Masanga eiho eibol sepao chun, tun khatvei suhmang dinga anagotsa tahsan thu chu alhang samlei, tibou chu ajah-u ahi;"},"24":{"text":"Chule keima jeh-a Pathen achoi-atnu ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujou kum somle kum li jouvin Titus jong kapuijin Barnabas toh Jerusalem'a kagachetou kit lhonin ahi.","title":"Paul Leh Solchah Dangho","ref":"Sol 11:30; 15:2."},"2":{"text":"Chule akilangdoh dungjuija gachetouva kahi; chuin Kipana thupha chidang namdangho lah-a kaseiphongle hi, chua um miho jah-a chun kakhelhan kaseitan ahi, ahinla ginle ja umho jah-a vang chun atum beh-in kaseijin ahi, hichu ajole kalhai hi ijem tia moh lhaija hikhange tia kahi."},"3":{"text":"Ahin kalhonpi Titus chu Greek mi ahi jeng vang chun, cheptansah ding agokhoh pouve;"},"4":{"text":"chule hichu eisoh chansah theina dinguva, Christa Jesu'a ontholna ineiju velhiho dinga guhthima sopi lhemho hinpoh lut ahibouve."},"5":{"text":"Kipana thupha thutah hi nangho-a aum jom jing theina dingin, nidan kah khat jengcha jong athu noijuva anakikhum lut louhel kahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Ahivangin ginle ja uma kiseiho lah-a chun (itobang hijongleu, kei kakin akhohpoi; Pathen'in mi koima adatpoi), ginle ja uma kiseiho chun imacha eiseipehbe chompouve;","ref":"Danb 10:17."},"7":{"text":"Seipehbe tah sangin cheptanho dinga Peter ahi banga, cheptan louho dinga keima kahia, Kipana Thupha chu ginchat tah-a eikipeh-a eikinganse chu aheuvin."},"8":{"text":"(Cheptanho solchah-a pang dinga Peter dinga thilbola chun, chidang namdangho solchah-a pang dinga keima dinga thil eibolpeh ahin);"},"9":{"text":"Lungsetna eikipeh chu ahettoh phatnun, Jacob, Cephas, chule John aminche houbung khomho chengsen keimale Barnabas amaho kithopi tin, amaho cheptanho henga acheuve, keini cheptan louho henga kache lhonna dingin, akhut jet lamin eisangjovin ahi;"},"10":{"text":"Mivaichate geldoh jingna ding thu themkhat eiseipeh-un, hichu kei jong abolding kalunggot lheh ahinai."},"11":{"text":"Ahivangin Antioch kho-a Peter ahung chun themona anei jeh-in kanapho lon ahi.","title":"Paul'in Antioch'a Peter Apho"},"12":{"text":"Ajeh chu aman Jacob koma kona mi koi koiham phabep ahung masangun, chidang namdangho toh an anekhomjin; amaho hung phatnin, cheptanho akichan akinung khinin akitum sahtan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule Juda mi dangho chengse jong amatoh hitobangtah chun aphalhemun, aphat lhemnao chun Barnabas kisan jong amaho lamah akai tan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahivangin amaho Kipana Thupha thutah dola chu lungkitah-a achon louvu chu kamun, mi jouse maikoh-a Peter kasosalin, Nangma bon Juda mi hija Juda mi chona chon louva chidang namdangho chona chona chu, ibola chidang namdangho Juda mi chona chonsahtei go-a nahim? katin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Eiho apena Juda mi ihiuve, eiho chidang namdang michonseho ihipouve;","title":"Judah Mi Ahin Chidang Namdang Mi Ahin Tahsan Vanga Huhhingna Chang Ahiuve"},"16":{"text":"Ahinla eihon danthu lam thilbol vanga hilouva, Jesu Christa-a tahsan vangabou michonpha tia kisim ahi, ti iheuve; hiche jeh-a chu eiho jong Jesu Christa itahsanu ahi, chutia chu danthu lam thilbol vanga hilouva, Christa tahsan vanga chonpha tia ikisim dingu ahi; ajeh chu danthu lam thilbol vanga koima chonpha tia kisim lou ding ahi.","ref":"Labu 143:2; Rom 3:20,22"},"17":{"text":"Ahin Christa vanga chonpha-a kisimna dinga ikihabol vanguva jong chonset na-a ilhahjiu ahin, ahile Christa chu chonset lhachaham? Ahipoi."},"18":{"text":"Keiman kaphetsa chu sapha kitleng asukhela kahi, ti chu photchen sah kahi."},"19":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lama kahinna dinga, danthu dola danthu lama athia kahitai."},"20":{"text":"Keima Christa toh thingpel'a kikhetbeh tha-a kahitai; keima ahinga kahitapoi, Christa chu keija hinga ahibouve; tu-a tahsaphe-a kahin hi keima eingailua, keima dinga kipedoh Pathen Chapa tahsan vanga chu hinga kahibouve."},"21":{"text":"Pathen milungset moh kahisahpoi; ijeh-inem itile chonphatna chu danthu lam thilbol vanga ahile, Christa chu ajeh beija moh thia ahitai, kati."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vo lungthimbei Galatia miho, namitmu tah uva Jesu Christa thingpel'a akikhetbeh chu kichentah-a nalah uva kiphongdoh ahitai; thutah-a nunlou nadia koiham najol lha uva?","title":"Danthu Chule Tahsan"},"2":{"text":"Keiman nangho-a konin hiche thu maicha hi kahet nome, Lhagao nachanu chu danthua chona konham, tahsan thu najah uva konham?"},"3":{"text":"Nangho chutobang loma chu lungthimbeija nahiuvem? Lhagaova kipanna tahsa phe-a kichaija nahiu hitam?"},"4":{"text":"Nanghon mohjen seh-a hesoh genthei nathoh-u hitam? hitichu ahile, moh jenseh tahbeh ahi."},"5":{"text":"Lhagao napeuva chule nalah uva thilbol kidang boljia chun, danthua nachon jeh uva abol jiha, tahsan thujah jeh-a abolji ham?"},"6":{"text":"Chutia chu, Abraham'in Pathen atahsana ahile, hichu ama dinga chonphat tia kisuna ahitai.","ref":"Semt 15:6; Rom 4:3."},"7":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun atahsanho chengse chu Abraham chate ahiuve, ti heuvin.","ref":"Rom 4:16"},"8":{"text":"Pathen'in chidang namdangho chu tahsan vanga them achansah ding ahi ti chu ahemasan, Pathen lekhabun, Nangma-a kona chitinle namtin phattheina chang ding ahi, tia masang peh-a hiche thupha hi Abraham ana hetsahsa ahitai.","ref":"Semt 12:3"},"9":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun tahsana kon chengse chu mi tahsan umtah Abraham chutoh phattheina chang khoma ahitaove."},"10":{"text":"Ajeh chu danthua chon chengse chu sapset changa ahiuve; ajeh chu hitin akisune, Koi hile danthubua kisun chengse nitjom jinglou chu sapset chang ding ahi.","ref":"Danb 27:26."},"11":{"text":"Ahivangin danthua chonin Pathen anga koima them achangpoi, ti akichene; ajeh chu, Michonpha chu atahsan vanga hing ding ahi, kitia ahi;","ref":"Habk 2:4"},"12":{"text":"Chule danthu chu tahsana kon ahipoi; ahinla danthu-a chona chu hichea chu hing ding ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 18:5"},"13":{"text":"Christa chun danthu sapset chana-a kona eiho eihung lhatdoh-u ahitai, ajeh chu ama eiho khela sapset hung changa ahi; ijeh-inem itile, Thinga kikhai sang tapou chu sapset chang ahi, tin akisune;","ref":"Danb 21:23."},"14":{"text":"Hichu Abraham phatthei chu Christa Jesu'a chidang namdangho heng alhuna, eihon tahsan vanga Lhagao chu ichan theina dinguva ahi."},"15":{"text":"Sopite, keiman mihem thu seija kasei ahi; mihem kitepna mai mai ahivangin, min aphudet nungle koiman moh ahisah jipoi, chule koiman jong abelap jipoi.","title":"Danthu Leh Thutep"},"16":{"text":"Chuti ahi, thutep ho chu Abraham le achilhah kipe-a ahi. Aman tamtah seina bangin, Chule nachilhah ho, atipoi; khatseh seina bangin, chule nachilhah, atibouve; hichu Christa ahi.","ref":"Semt 12:7"},"17":{"text":"Tun hiche hi kasei ahi, Pathen'in amasanga kitepna khat Christa-a aphudetsa ahin, hichu kum jali le kum somthum nunga umdoh danthu chun kitepna chu moh ahi louna dingin, ason mangpon ahi.","ref":"Pot 12:40"},"18":{"text":"Goulo ding chu danthu vanga ahile, thutep vanga hilouhela hi ding ahi; ahinla Pathen'in thutep vangin Abraham apetan ahi.","ref":"Rom 4:12"},"19":{"text":"Chuti ahile danthu hi ipi phatchomna ham? Thutepna chilhah chu ahung kahse-a dinga, suhkhel jeh-a hichu kibelap ahi; hichu vantil teho kimanga palai khat khutna kitungdoh ahitai.","title":"Danthu Kipeh Lonajeh"},"20":{"text":"Palai chu khat changa dinga palai ahipoi, Pathen vang khatsehbou ahi."},"21":{"text":"Chuti ahile, danthu hi Pathen thutep douvaham? Chuti ahipoi. Hinna pethei danthu kipe-a hile, dih tah-a chonphatna chu danthua kon hitei ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahin Jesu Christa tahsan vanga thutep chu atahsanho akipeh theina dinga, Pathen lekhabu thu chun ijakai chonset noija akhachah ahitai."},"23":{"text":"Tahsan thu hung lhun masanga chu danthu noija eina kikoijuve, ahung kilang dinga um tahsan chu ngana-a kikha khuma inahiu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hitia chu tahsan vanga chonphat ichan theina dinguva, Christa henga eipui dinguva, danthu chu eikaihoi juva anapanga ahibouve."},"25":{"text":"Tahsan thu hunglhun kal vang hin, chuche eikaihoi juva noija chu ihi tapouve."},"26":{"text":"Christa Jesu'a natahsan uva kona chu nangho nabon chaova Pathen chate nahiu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Nangho Christa-a baptize chang chengse chun nabon chaova Christa chu nakivonu ahitai."},"28":{"text":"Hichea chun Juda mi Greek mi aumtapoi, soh leh sohlou aumtapoi, chule numei le pasal jong aumtapoi; Christa Jesu'a chun nabon chaovin pumkhat nahitaove."},"29":{"text":"Chule nangho Christa-a nahiule Abraham son nahiuve, thutep bangtah-a chu gou lo ding nahiuve.","ref":"Rom 4:13"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahin keiman kasei chu, goulo ding chu chapang ahi laisen, imajouse pakai ahi jeng vangin, ama chu sohtoh imachom ahipoi;"},"2":{"text":"Ahin apan athutep alhin phat kahsen, akaihoile a-inngahho thu noija aumjin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Eiho jong chutobanga chu ichapan laijuva, vannoi leiset lekhajem bul noija sohchanga ina-umu ahi;"},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin phat ahung lhintah-in, Pathen'in achapa chu numei sunga soh, danthu noija peng dingin ahin soltan;"},"5":{"text":"Chapate hina ichan theina dinguva, danthu noija umho lhatdoh dingin.","ref":"Rom 8:15-17"},"6":{"text":"Chule nangho chate nahi jeh uva chu, Abba, Hepa, tia kouji Achapa Lhagao chu Pathen'in nalung sunguva ahinsol ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu nangma soh hita louva, chapa nahi ahitai; chule chapa nahile, Christa vanga Pathen goulo ding jong nahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi jeng vangin Pathen nahet lou laijuva chu, apen umchana pathen hilouho soh nanahiu ahi.","title":"Paul'in Galatia Mite Akhohsah"},"9":{"text":"Ahin tun Pathen nahet nunguva, ahiloule Pathen hetjong nahi nunguva, i-atileh lekhajem bul hatmotah soh-a lutkit dinga nakihei kit jenguham?"},"10":{"text":"Nanghon ni, lha, kum kihei, kum nanit jiuvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangho dinga katohgimna ijem tin moh hinte, ti nangho dingin katijan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Sopite, keima nangho banga kaumtah banghin, nangho keima bang hin umun tia kangeh nahiuve. Nanghon ahilouvin neibol pouvin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahin katahsaphe hatmo jeh-a amasa-a Kipana Thupha nangho kahil chu nanghon naheuve."},"14":{"text":"Kasa chunga nangho dinga lhepna um chu nahsahmon nabolpouvin, the jong nathe pouve; Pathen vantil khat bangle, Christa Jesu bang helin neinalem jouvin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuti ahile chuche laija naseiju vangpha nakisah nao chu hoilam hitam? Na-umchan dol thu-u kahettohsah-a kasei ahi, hi theile namitchang sanu nakaldoh uva neipeh dingu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chuti ahile keiman najah uva thutah kasei jeh-a hi, nagalu kahi hitam?"},"17":{"text":"Amahon apha lama tompan tah-a nangho naholu ahipoi; nanghon amaho nahol theina dinguva, nangho chu polama kha khumden ding angaitou ahibouve."},"18":{"text":"Ahin a-imatih chana apha lam hola tompan hi aphai; nakom uva kaum pet jenga hilouvin, imatih chanin aphai."},"19":{"text":"Kanaote, nangho-a Christa lim asodoh kahse-a, keiman nangho dinga naosonat kathoh kit ahi;"},"20":{"text":"Chule tun nangho koma hunga aw chombeh-a thusei kanom ngeijin ahi; ajeh chu nangho chungchang thu kadatmoi."},"21":{"text":"Vo danthu noija umnom teho, seijun, nanghon danthu hi najah khah lou uham?","title":"Hagar Leh Sarah Tekah-a Kon Kihilna"},"22":{"text":"Hitin akisune, Abraham'in chapa ni aneijin, asohnu sunga peng khat ahin, khat chu soh hilounu sunga peng ahi.","ref":"Semt 16:15; 21:2"},"23":{"text":"Sohnu-a chu tahsaphe lam dola peng ahin, chamlhatnu-a vang chu thutep vanga penga ahi."},"24":{"text":"Hiche thuhi tekahna ahi; ajehchu hiche hi kitepna ni ahi; khatjoh chu Sinai mola kon chule soh-a vul dinga cha hinga ahi; hichu Hagar ahi."},"25":{"text":"Arabia gama min Hagar kiti chu Sinai mol kiseina ahi; chule tulaija um Jerusalem jong khu aseina ahi; amanu chu achate toh soh hitha-a ahi."},"26":{"text":"Chunga um Jerusalem vang chu ongthola chamlhatnu chu ahin; hichu ipiu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ajehchu hitin akisune, Achinga chasoh lounu nangma kipah-in; Naosonat thoh lounu sangtah-in khosamin; Pasal neijonu sangin ahomkeova umnu chate atamjoi.","ref":"Isai 54:1"},"28":{"text":"Sopite, eiho jong Isaac banga thutep chate ihiuve;"},"29":{"text":"Amavang chulai tahsaphe lam dola pengpa chun lhagao lam dola pengpa chu suhmang agot ahin, tu-a jong chutobang chu ahi.","ref":"Semt 21:9"},"30":{"text":"Ahinla Pathen lekhabun ipi atim? Sohnu chu achapatoh kaidohtha tan; ajehchu sohnu chapa chun chamlhatnu chapatoh gou lokhom ponte, ati.","ref":"Semt 21:10"},"31":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun, sopite, sohnu hin chate ihipouve, chamlhatnu hin chatejoh ihiuve."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Soh ihi louna dinguva Christan eilhatdoh-u ahitai: chuti ahi jeh chun dingdet jingun, soh namkoljona chun kihen oh kit hih-un.","title":"Nachamlhatnao Chu Tuhdet Jingun"},"2":{"text":"Veuvin, kei Paul'in kahinsei ahi, nanghon chep natan uva ahile, Christa chu nangho dinga imacha aphatchom sah louding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Cheptan ho chengse hettohsah na-a kahinsei ahi, ama chun danthu apumpia bol ding abat jing ahi nalaije."},"4":{"text":"Nangho danthua chonphat chan goho chengse chu, Christa-a kona kisepkhen nahitaove; nangho lungsetna kona pul lha-a nahitaove."},"5":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile eiho Lhagao vanga tahsana chonphat chan kinema ngah ihiuve."},"6":{"text":"Ajeh chu Christa Jesu'ah cheptan hi aphatsahna aumpon, cheptanlou jong hi ima ahidehpoi; ahin tahsan ngailutna-a tonga chu phachoma ahibouve."},"7":{"text":"Nangho nalhaiju aphaname; thutah thua nun louna dinga koiham nasumovah?"},"8":{"text":"Hitobanga kijol lhah hi nakou paova kon ahipoi."},"9":{"text":"Chol themkhat chan changbong lum apumpia apomsah ahi.","ref":"1 Cor 5:6"},"10":{"text":"Nanghon lung adang imacha neipouvinate, tia Pakaiya katahsan lheh nahiuvin ahi; ahinla nangho nasulonguva chu koi hile, achunga thu kitanna talen athoh tei ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Sopite, tu-a hi keima cheptan thu dol seile-a hileng, ibola bolsetna hi kathoh dingham? chutileh thingpel'a kipal lhuhna hi kisubei ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Nangho sulonga pangho chu amahole amaho kitanbongleu pha kasai."},"13":{"text":"Sopite, nangho soh hilou ongthol dinga kikou nahiuve; amavang soh nahilounao na-onthol nao chu tahsa lama dingin agomkomin neidaovin, ahin ngailutna-in khatle khat kijento uvin."},"14":{"text":"Naheng nakoma nangma bangtah-in ngailun, ti thua hi danthu jouse bukimsoh keija ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 19:18"},"15":{"text":"Amavang nangho kiketto saosaole kivalto saosao nahiu vangle, khat bola khat namanthah louna dingun chingtheijun."},"16":{"text":"Keima vangin, Lhagaovin chonun, kati ahi, chutile tahsaphe lam lungtup chu subulhit lou ding nahiuve.","title":"Lhagao Ga Leh Tahsa Natoh"},"17":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile tahsaphe lam lungtup chu Lhagao douna ahin, Lhagao tup tahsaphe lam douna ahi; chutia chu nanghon nalunggot bangu chu nabol louna dinguva, hiteni chu kidouva ahi lhone.","ref":"Rom 7:15-23"},"18":{"text":"Ahin nangho Lhagao pui nahiu vangle, danthu noija um louva nahiuve."},"19":{"text":"Chule tahsaphe lam thilbol chengse vang chu akilange; hichu miji toh jon, jonthanhoi, thenlou, huh,"},"20":{"text":"Milim hou, doichoi, kidou, kinah kinel, kimitthip, lunghan, kiloset, kibungkhen, tahsan dihlou,"},"21":{"text":"Kithangset, toltha, jukham, eltol golnop bol, chule chutobang adang dang jong chu ahi; hichenga chu masanga kahilchah banguva chu masang peh-a kahilchah masah nahiuve, chutobanga chonho chun Pathen gam alo lou dingu ahi."},"22":{"text":"Lhagao ga vang chu ngailut, kipa, cham, thohhat, mihepi, phat, tahsan umtah hi,"},"23":{"text":"Lungneng, amachang kitim, hicheng hi ahi; hitobangho chunga vang danthu aumpoi."},"24":{"text":"Christa-a hiho chengse chun tahsaphe chu alungtuple, angaichat puma thingpel'a akhetbehthao ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Eiho Lhagaova hinga ihiule, Lhagaovin chonuhite."},"26":{"text":"Khatnin khat lunghan sah-in, chule khatle khat kithangset ton, panna beijin hoitho pouhite."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sopite, mi khattou suhkhel neija auma athemona kimandoh aumle, lhagao mi nanghon lungnem tah-in chutobang mi chu boldamun, nangma kiven ajole nangma jong lhepna-a lhakha nate.","title":"Khat le Khat Pohgih Kipohhu"},"2":{"text":"Nangho khatle khat pohgih kipohhu uvin, chutichun Christa danthu nit bukim sohkeijun."},"3":{"text":"Mi khattou ikhat hia kingaito-a, imachala hilou chu, ama kilhemlha-a ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahin, mitinin ama ama natoh kipatep chehhen, chutile ama changa thua kisonna ding mun anei ding ahi, mi dang thua hilouvin."},"5":{"text":"Ajeh chu mitinin ama ama poh cheh akipoh ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Pathen thu kihila mi chun ahilpa chu thilpha lam dol jouse chankhom pihen.","title":"Thilpha Bol"},"7":{"text":"Nangho dohan lha hih-un; Pathen chu nelpeh dan ahipoi; ajeh iham itile mihemin aman atu tu chu a-at ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ajeh chu tahsa lam dola tupa chun tahsaphe-a kona kemmang thei ga alo ding; Lhagao lama tupa vang chun Lhagaova kona tonsot hin kemlou ga chu alo ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Thilpha bolna lamah chimtih nei louvin umu hite, ilhahdah louvule aphatcha ilo dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun hungun, aphat achang agomkom inei bang dol cheh-in, mi jouse chunga thilpha boluhite; ahideh-in eima insung mi atahsanho chungah haboldeh uhite."},"11":{"text":"Veuvin, keima kakhut tah-in jem khoutah-in nangho henga lekha kahinsune.","title":"Achaina Gihsalna le Thuchaina"},"12":{"text":"Atahsa vet hoisah goho chengsen cheptan dinga nabol khoh-u ahi; hichu imadang dinga ahipoi, Christa thingpel jala bolset chu athoh louna dinguva ahibouve."},"13":{"text":"Ajeh chu cheptan tah mongho jeng jongin danthu anitdeh pouve, natahsao chu kisonna-a anei theina dinguva, cheptansah dinga nagotjiu ahibouve."},"14":{"text":"Keivang I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa thingpel tailou chu thu dang imacha song hihhel ingkate; Ama vanga chu vannoi keima dinga chule keima vannoi dinga thingpel'a kikhenbeh kahitai."},"15":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile cheptan chu imacha ahipoi, cheptanlou jong imacha ahipoi; Christa Jesu'a kisem thah bou chu thu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule chuto bang chona-a chonte chunga le, Pathen mi Israelte chungah lungmon chule lungset umhen."},"17":{"text":"Tu-a kalvang koiman eisulung gim tahih hen; ajeh chu kati chunga hi Pakai Jesu melchihna pole-a kahi."},"18":{"text":"Sopiteho, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungset chu nangho lhagaotoh umhen. Amen."}}}}},"49":{"info":{"name":"Ephesia","shortname":"Eph","abbr":[],"desc":"Ephesia Mite Henga Paul Lekha Thot"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen lungchama Christa Jesu solchah Paul'in Ephesia'a um mithengho chule Christa Jesu'a tahsanteho hengah.","title":"Lemna","ref":"Sol 18:19-21; 19:1."},"2":{"text":"I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin lungsetnale lungmon naheng uva umhen."},"3":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pale Pathen vahchoijin umhen; aman eiho lhagao phattheina tintangin Christa-a vanho-ah phatthei eichanui;","title":"Christa-a Lhagao Vangbohnaho"},"4":{"text":"Ajeh chu aman vannoi bul phudoh masanga pat, ama anga ngailutna le thenga chule nolna beihela i-um theina dinguva, eiho einalhen dohsao ahin;"},"5":{"text":"Jesu Christa vanga alamcha dinga einagot masahsao ahi; hichu ama lunggotle lungdeilam bang dungjuija,"},"6":{"text":"Amilungset loupi vahchoi dinga, hichea chu adeitah te hidinga, lahtheija eisemu ahitai."},"7":{"text":"Hiche alungdei vanga chu eiho, athisana kilhatdoh ihiuva, lungsetna ahao dungjuija, ichonsetnao jouse ngaidam ichanu ahitai;","ref":"Col 1:14"},"8":{"text":"Hiche lungsetna-a chu, aman chihnale lunggel themtah chu eivuhdimu ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Chutia chu aman alung ngaitole alung deilam dol dungjuija, alunggil thuguh chu eiho eihetsah-un, aphat lhin tenga dinga ama-a gotsa akoi ahi;"},"10":{"text":"Hichu van ho-a thil chengsele leija um thil chengse, ania Christa-a gop khomsohna dinga ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule masanga patna Christa-a kinema kingaija eiho, eihoa kona ama loupi vahchoina aso theina dinga,"},"12":{"text":"Alunggot dungjui tah-a ijakai bolpa chun, ama lunggot dolla einagotsao ahijeh-in, eihon jong ama jal-in goulo theina imutaove."},"13":{"text":"Ama chu nanghon jong thutah, huhhing-a umna Thupha chu najah uva, ama natahsan uva, thutepsa Lhagao Thenga mohor kinama nahitaove;"},"14":{"text":"Hichu, achohsa ho lhatdoh nikho kahse-a, aloupi vahchoi dinga, igoulo diu khamgahna ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pakai Jesu'a natahsan naole, mithengte nangailut nao thu kajan,","title":"Paul Taona"},"16":{"text":"keiman jong nangho jal-in katao chanin tang louvin kathangvah jinge;"},"17":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pathen, loupina Pa chun, ama hetna lama chihnale, thukilah hetdoh them theina lhagao napehna dingun,"},"18":{"text":"Eikounao kinepna hi ipi ahi, mithengho lah-a goulo ding loupina ahaoje chu ipi ahi,"},"19":{"text":"atahsana eiho dinga athahat, athilbolthei chungnunje nahet theina dinguva, nalung mitnu vahsah-a auma, athahat athilbol theina dungjuija,"},"20":{"text":"Aman Christa-a abola, athiho lah-a kona akaithouva van ho-a ama jet lama atousah ahitai;","ref":"Labu 110:1"},"21":{"text":"Vaipipu hi, thuneina, thahat thilboltheina, vainei, chule min kisah jouse chunga chungnung pen ahi, tu hiche vannoi leiset jenga hilouva, khonunga hung lhung dinga jong ahi;"},"22":{"text":"Chule aman thil jouse ama thu noija akengto noija akoisoh ahi, chule houbung chu thil jouse luchang hina apeh ahi;","ref":"Labu 8:6"},"23":{"text":"Hichu ama tahsa ahia, ama dimset banga ijakaija ijakai adimsah ahi.","ref":"Col 1:18"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule nangho nathemmo naole nachonset naova nathi pettah uva Pathen'in nahinsah-u ahitai.","title":"Thina-a Kon Hinna","ref":"Col 2:13."},"2":{"text":"Hichenga chu hiche vannoi leiset chon ngai dola hinga, vanlaijola thuneitah vaipo, tulai thua nungloute lah-a natonga lhagao, puilea chu masang laise-a chu anachonle-a nahiu ahi;"},"3":{"text":"Hicheho lah-a chu eiho jong ibon chaova tahsaphe lamle ilunggot chan suhbukima, tahsaphe ngaichat thu lama inachonu ahi; chule adang dangho banga apen monga lunghanna chate inahiu ahi;"},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin mihepi khotona haotah Pathen'in ngailutna lentah-a eingailutnu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu themo-a ithi laitah uva Christa toh thakhatna einahin sah-u ahitai; lungsetna vanga huhhing-a umna naneiju ahitai;"},"6":{"text":"Chule Christa Jesu vanga eihepiu hi, khonunga phat hung lhung dinga chu amilungset hao chungnunje phongdoh dinga,"},"7":{"text":"Hiche nadinga chu Christa Jesu vanga amatoh thakhatna eikaithouvu ahitai, chule vanmun ho-a eitousah-u ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Lungset mana tahsan vanga huhhing-a uma nahitaove; hichu nangho-a kon ahipoi, Pathen thilpehjoh ahibouve;"},"9":{"text":"Koimacha kison thei louna dinga, hichu thilbol vanga hilou ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajeh chu eiho ama khutsoh ihiuve; chule ichonphatna dinguva, masanga patna Pathen'in agotsa chuche chonphatna dinga chu Christa Jesu'a kisema ihiuve."},"11":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun tahsaphe dola chidang namdang mi, tahsa-a khutna cheptana kona cheptan min poho lah-a cheptanlou tia kisei nangho,","title":"Christa-a Khat"},"12":{"text":"nangho masang laija chu Christa-a kona achom nahiu ahin, Israelte toh kitimat lou nahiuvin, thutep chonna danho chengsetoh kinepna beile Pathen beija hiche vannoi leisetna hi uma nahiuve, hichu geldoh-un."},"13":{"text":"Tu vangin masanga nagamlat vangun, Christa Jesu'a naum jeh uva Christa thisan vanga chu anaija nahitaove."},"14":{"text":"Ajeh chu ama chu eiho kichamna ahi, aman daltanna banglai chu aphetlhah-a, ania chu pumkhat aso ahitai,"},"15":{"text":"Chonna ngaidan thupeh chu, kidouna chu atahsa-a asuhbei ahitai; chutia chu aman ama-a mi ni chu mi thah khat asosahna dinga asuhcham ahi;","ref":"Col 2:14"},"16":{"text":"Chule chutia chu kidouna chu thingpel'a atha-a, ania chu Pathen'a dinga akichamsahna dinga abola;","ref":"Col 1:20"},"17":{"text":"Chule ama hunga, gamlatah nangho hengle anaiho henga chamna ahung seile ahi;","ref":"Isai 57:19"},"18":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile ama vanga chu eiho iloiniuva, Lhagao khatna Pa anga umna thei thu ineiju ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun tu-a kalin nangho maljinle khopem nahitapouve; mithengte chenkhompi, chule Pathen insung mite nahitaove;"},"20":{"text":"Chule Christa amatah inning song ahin, solchah ho le themgaoho songset chunga nangho kisadoh nahiuve;"},"21":{"text":"In kisa jouse chu amatoh kijop cheh ahin, houin theng hidinga Pakaiya khangtou in nahiu ahi;"},"22":{"text":"Ama-a chu nangho chengse jong thakhatna kisakhom nahiuvin. Lhagaova Pathen chenna khat hidoh-a nahiuve."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu chidang namdang hija nangho, nangho dinga keima Paul Christa Jesu sohchang hi,","title":"Chidang Namdangte Henga Paul Natoh"},"2":{"text":"nangho dinga Pathen lungset eikichinsah ahia,"},"3":{"text":"thu kilah-a kona athugil chengse keima eikihetsah chu najahsao ahitan, (hiche banga chu chunga paltana kahinsut ahi;"},"4":{"text":"Nanghon hichu simleu chun Christa thugil kahetje dan hi heuvin nate);","ref":"Col 1:26-27"},"5":{"text":"Tu-a solchah thenghole athemgaoho henga Lhagaova kona akiphondoh banga hi, malaija mihem chate henga chu ana kihetsah lou ahi;"},"6":{"text":"Hiche thugil chu Kipana Thupha vanga chidang namdangho, Christa goulo khompiho, tahsaphe-a kihoppi thutep chan khompi ahiuvin,"},"7":{"text":"Athilbol theina-a anatoh dungjuitah-a, man beija Pathen lungsetna eikipeh bangtah-a, Kipana Thupha lhacha-a pang kahi."},"8":{"text":"Holdoh hoi hilou Christa haona chu chidang namdang ho henga seiphongle dinga, mithengte lah-a alhumpen sanga jong neojo keima hiche lungsetna hi eikipea ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Jesu Christa jala thil jouse sema Pathen na, leiset semtila patna kisella um thuguh chu mijouse musah dinga,"},"10":{"text":"Pathen chihna jat chom chomhi van munho pipule thuneina neiho, tu-a houbung'a kona hetsahna dinga,"},"11":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Christa Jesu'a tonsotna dinga angaitoa aphudet dungjuija chu,"},"12":{"text":"eihon ama itahsan vanguva ama-a chu lung ngama, chule ginchat neitah-a lut theina thu aneiju ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu hiche hi kataona ahi, nangho dinga kagenthei kahesohna jouse jal hin lungthoi hih-un kati ahi: hichu naloupi nao ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu van'a le leija um phungtin-in, Pa-a kona kiminvona aneiju,","title":"Christa Ngailutna"},"15":{"text":"hiche I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa anga chu dilsua, hichenga hi taojia kahi."},"16":{"text":"Aman loupina ahao dungjuija, Alhagaova athahat athilbol theina-a mi sungnung chu ahatsah-a,"},"17":{"text":"chule tahsan vanga Christa chu nangho lung sunga achensah theija, nangho ngailutna-a najungkhova nabul neijuva,"},"18":{"text":"chule mithengte jousetoh ajaojele asaoje asanje, athuhje, nahettoh theina dinguva,"},"19":{"text":"hetphahhoi hilou Christa ngailutna chu nahet theijuva, Pathen chamkimna jouse-a nangho nachamkim theina dingu ahi, kati."},"20":{"text":"Chutihen lang athahat thilbol thei eihoa natongjia chun, athahat athilbol theina dungjuija, ithumule ilung ngaito jouseu sanga nasajo-a abol theina dingin,"},"21":{"text":"houbung'a le Christa Jesu'a atonsot atonsotnin akhang akhangin loupin umjing hen. Amen."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh-a chu Pakaiya sohchang keima naheng uva kahung tao ahi, Nangho nakikou naotoh kitoh-in chonun;","title":"Nangho Kipumkhat Hiuvin"},"2":{"text":"Chonnemna bukimin, lung nemtoh, thohhattoh thon chonun; ngailutna-in khatle khat kingaithemun,","ref":"Col 3:12-13"},"3":{"text":"Chamna-in kikanun, Lhagaova pumkhat hina dingin kihabolun."},"4":{"text":"Tipum khat ahin chule Lhagao khat ahi; hiche banga chu nakikouvu jong chu kinepna khatna kikou nahiuve;"},"5":{"text":"Pakai khat, tahsan khat, baptize chan khat ahi,"},"6":{"text":"Chule mi jouse Pa leh Pathen khatsehbou ahi; ama imajouse chunga ahin, hoima jouse-a um ahi, chule nangho sung jouse-a um ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla Christa thilpeh teptena dan dungjuija eiho khat cheh lungsetna eipeh-u ahitai.","title":"Lhagao Thilpehho"},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pathen lekhabun aseije, Ama chung sanga akaltou chun, Gal-hinga kiman mihonpi gal hingin akaitan ahi, Chule miho jong thilpehho apen ahi.","ref":"Labu 68:18"},"9":{"text":"Ahile, Akaltouvin, ati hi leiset noinung geijah akumlha masan ahi, ti lou adang ipi kisei naham?"},"10":{"text":"Akumlha-a chu ijakai subukipsoh dinga vanho jouse chung vuma kaltouva ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule aman abang solchah, abang themgao, abang Kipana Thupha lhangsam, abang chinghoi kaihoi, abang mihil hina apeh ahi;"},"12":{"text":"Hichu lhacha natong dinga mithengho pi lhinsahna ding, Christa tahsa chu khantousahna dinga,"},"13":{"text":"Eiho tahsan thakhat ihiuva, Pathen Chapa thudola hetna ineijuva, mi khan kilhit ihiuva, Christa pilhin dungchan iphah masangseuva dinga ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chutia chu miho gitlou lungthim doha lha-a suhkhelna dinga, puichat vaija uma chule thuhil hui lhoh lonle chapang ihi thei lou dingu ahitai;"},"15":{"text":"Chuti sang chun luchang hija Christa ama-a chu imalam jouse-a ikhan touna dingun, ngailutna-in thutah seijuhite;"},"16":{"text":"Ama-a kona tahsa pumpi hi kitoh cheh-a kisuto-a kikilmat khom ahin, hichea chu gu kisuhtona chengsen tibah dangdang ho natohna apeh dan dungjui cheh-a, tahsa pum chu ngailutna-a kisadoh dinga akhantousah ahi.","ref":"Col 2:19"},"17":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu hiche hi kasei ahi, Pakaiya hiche hi kahettohsah nahiuve, chidang namdang ten lungchavai aput dungjuijuva achon bangun chonta hih-un;","title":"Christa-a Hinkho Thah"},"18":{"text":"Amaho chu ahetna lungu thima ahin, Pathen hinna peh chu chang lou ahitaove, asunguva het louna auma, alungu tah jeh chun;"},"19":{"text":"Amaho lungmoh hiuva ahile, thilthenglou tincheng bolna dinga, lop lamle papset lama kipe-a ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Nangho vang chutia chu Christa kihilla nahipouve,"},"21":{"text":"Jesu'a uma thutah dungjuija chu athu chu jatasa nahiuva ama-a kihila nahiule;"},"22":{"text":"Chutichun nanghon masang laija chonna dol lama chon, doha lheplhah, gitlou lung gula haset chehcheh mi lui chu pailhauvin;","ref":"Col 3:9"},"23":{"text":"Chule chutichun nalhagao lungthimun kithah semun,"},"24":{"text":"Chule Pathen lim banga chonphatna le thenna dihtah-a kisem mithah chu kivonun.","ref":"Semt 1:26; Col 3:10"},"25":{"text":"Hijeh chun nanghon jou pailhauvin, amitakip aheng akomtoh thutah jengchan kihou cheh hen; ajeh chu eiho khat khat hi khat tibah hicheh ihiuve.","ref":"Zech 8:16."},"26":{"text":"Lung chu lunghangun, ahin chonse hih-un; nalunghan nao chu nisan lhumkhum hihhen.","ref":"Labu 4:4"},"27":{"text":"Chule diabol chu mun ot hih helun."},"28":{"text":"Agucha-a gucha kit ta hihhen; ahin alhasama ato theina dingin, akhut tah-in napha tong gimhen."},"29":{"text":"Nakam uva konin thuse soh hihhen, ahin aja chan lungsetna hop theina dingin, ngaichat doltah-a hou thu lama khantou theina dingin thupha sohjohen."},"30":{"text":"Lhatdoh nikho-a dinga mohor nakinam nao Pathen Lhagao Theng chu, lungphat mosah hih-un."},"31":{"text":"Lung damlouna jouse, lunghan, lungsat, kinah, kitaitom, hichengse chule gitlou engsetna jouse nangho-a konin koimangun;"},"32":{"text":"Chule nangho kihepito cheh-un; lungnemun Pathen'in Christa-a nangho nangaidam bangu chun, khatle khat kingai damun.","ref":"Col 3:13"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun chate dei bangtah-in, Pathen umchan jom hiuvin;","title":"Nangho Ngailutna-a Hingun"},"2":{"text":"Chule Christan nangho nangailut bangu chun, ngailutna-in chonun; ama nangho dinga Pathen lama maichama thilpeh gimnamtui banga kipe-a ahi.","ref":"Pot 29:18; Labu 40:6"},"3":{"text":"Ahin mithengte chonna doltah-in, jon thule thenlouna tintang chule papset nalah uva kiphapoh hihhen;"},"4":{"text":"Chule jamo, thumotsei, totthanghoi, hicheng jong chu nalah uva um hihhen; Pathen thangvahna umjohen."},"5":{"text":"Ajeh chu Christa le Pathen gam sunga chu mi jonpan, mi thenglou, mi papse, milim hou, hicheng chu ima achan dingu aumpoi, ti chu kichenin naheuve."},"6":{"text":"Mohthu ahomkeovin koima kilhep lhahsah hih-un; hitiho jeh chun thua nunglou chateho chungah Pathen lunghan achujin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hijeh chun nanghon chutiho chu kikoppi hih-un."},"8":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile nangho khatvei chu muthim nahiu ahin, tu vangin Pakaiya khovah nahiu ahitai; khovah chate bangin chonun;","title":"Khovah Chate Bangin Chonun"},"9":{"text":"Ajeh chu Lhagao ga chu phatna jouse, chonphatna, chule thutah ahi;"},"10":{"text":"Pakai lunglhaina ding lam photoh-un;"},"11":{"text":"Ahin muthim natohho ga neilou chu kikoppi hih-un; amaho chu sosalun phohsal jovin;"},"12":{"text":"Ajeh chu amaho guhthim natohho chu sei ding jong jachat umleu ahi;"},"13":{"text":"Ajeh chu ijakai phongjala khovah ahijeh chun, akisosal jouse chu khovah chun aphongjal jitai."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun aman, Vo imumil, khangin, chule athi lah-a konin thoudoh-in; chutengle Christan nangma nasalvah ding ahi, ati."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun iti nachonum, chingtheijun kihongphauvin; mi lung beiho banga chon louvin, michingho bangin chonun;","title":"Chingthei Tah-in Chonun"},"16":{"text":"Tulai nikho hi aphat lou jeh hin, phat kijen petcha hi kichoh-un.","ref":"Col 4:5"},"17":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun lungthim beijin um hih-un, Pakai lunglam ipi ahi heuvin."},"18":{"text":"Chule lengpitwi jin kham hih-un; hichea chun setna aume; ahin Lhagaovin dimset jovin;"},"19":{"text":"Tumging toh tho lan, hou lan chule lhagao lan kihoulimun; nalunggilun Pakai dingin kitohdelin longdelin la saovin;","ref":"Col 3:16-17"},"20":{"text":"Imatih chanin imalam jouse-a dingin I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa minin Pa Pathen thangvah jingun;"},"21":{"text":"Pathen janan khat thun khat nungun."},"22":{"text":"Numei ho, nangho Pakai thu noija bangin na-inneipu chengu thu noija umun;","title":"Nupa Hinkho - Christa Leh Houbung","ref":"Col 3:18; 1 Pet 3:1."},"23":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile Christa houbung luchang ahi banga chu, inneipu jong numei luchang ahi; ama tahsa huhhing-a jong ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ahin houbung Christa thu noija aum bang chun, numei ho jong imalam jouse-a a-inneipu cheh-u thunoija um cheh-u hen."},"25":{"text":"Inneipu ho Christan houbung angailut bangle, ajeh-a ama akipehdoh jeng bangtah chun, nanghon jong na-inneipite chengu ngailuvin;","ref":"Col 3:19; 1 Pet 3:7."},"26":{"text":"Aman twija asilngima, thua asuhthengna dinga, ama kipedoh jeng ahi."},"27":{"text":"Hichu boh beh louhel le avoi kom beihela, thengtah le nolna beihela, a houbung chu loupitah-a ama anga aumsahna dinga ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun innei puhon jong a-inneipite chengu, ama ama tahsa banga angailut dingu ahi. Koi hile a-inneipi ngailu-a chu ama kingailua ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ajeh chu imatih chanin koiman ama tahsa ahotbol khapoi; avah khangin ahebol bouve. Pakaiyin houbung abolna bang chun."},"30":{"text":"Ajehchu, eiho aphele agu-a kon, atibah ihiuve."},"31":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu min anu apa adalhah-a ajia beh ding ahi, chule amani chu tikhat hilhon ding ahi.","ref":"Semt 2:24"},"32":{"text":"Hiche thugil hi giltah ahi; ahivangin keiman Christa le houbung thua kasei ahi."},"33":{"text":"Hijongle nangho changval cheh-in na-inneipi chengu nangma naki ngailut bangin ngailuvin; chule inneipi chun a-inneipu aja ding sumil hihhen."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chateho, Pakaiyah nanu napau thun nungun; hichu chondih ahi.","title":"Chate Leh Nule Pa","ref":"Col 3:20."},"2":{"text":"Nanu napa jabolin; hichehi thutep togoma thupeh masa ahi;","ref":"Pot 20:12; Danb 5:16."},"3":{"text":"Chutile naphat theija leiset chunga nahinkho sotding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule pateho, nanghon nachate chengu sulunghang hih-un; Pakai thuhila chon kichuhna le tilkhouna lamin seiletsah jovin.","ref":"Col 3:21."},"5":{"text":"Sohteho, nangho Christa thu noija naum bangu chun, kichatle kitihot pumpumin, lung jangkeijin tahsa lama napakai te chengu thu noija umun;","title":"Soh Le A-pakai","ref":"Col 3:22-25."},"6":{"text":"Mihem lunglhaisah nadinga mitmu soh hilouvin, lungsunga kona Pathen lunglam bola Christa soh bang hiuvin;"},"7":{"text":"Mihem lama hilouvin, Pakai lama phatna lunggela napha tong hiuvin;"},"8":{"text":"Amitakip, soh hihen, soh hilou hijongle, koi hile thilpha bol chan chun, hiche mama chu Pakaiya kona asan kit ding chu heuvin."},"9":{"text":"Chule pakaiho, chutobangma chun amaho chu bolun, amahole nangho nagom uva na-Pakaiyu chu van'ah aumin, chule aman mi koima datle langkaina aneipoi, ti heuvin lang, hutum gihsal boldaovin.","ref":"Danb 10:17; Col 3:25; 4:1."},"10":{"text":"Achai nakeijin, sopite, Pakaiyah chule athahat athilbol theina-a chun hatnun.","title":"Pathen Galvon Pumpi"},"11":{"text":"Diabol lungthim gilou tincheng masanga nadin jou theina dingun, Pathen galvon chengse kivonun,"},"12":{"text":"Ajeh chu eiho tahsaphe le thisantoh kibon ihipouve; pipuho toh, thahat thuneiho toh, hiche vannoi muthim vaipoho toh, vanmun ho-a lhagao gilou engsehotoh kibonjoh ihiuve."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun nikho phalounia nalethuh jouna dingule, ijakai nabukip sohkeijuva nadindet theina dingun, Pathen galvon chengse panun."},"14":{"text":"Hiti chun thutah-in kong kigah-un, chonphatna ompho kiah-un;","ref":"Isai 11:5; 59:17"},"15":{"text":"Chule gotsa chamna Kipana Thupha kengchot kiseuvin dingun;","ref":"Isai 52:7"},"16":{"text":"Chucheng chunga chun tahsan lum panun, agiloupa thalpi meikong tobang ho jouse chu nasuhmit jouna dingun."},"17":{"text":"Chule huhhingna lukhuh chu kilah-un, Lhagao chemjam panun, hichu Pathen thu ahi.","ref":"Isai 59:17"},"18":{"text":"Taona jousele thumna tintangtoh thon a-imatih chanin Lhagaovin tao jingun, chule hichena ding chun mithengte jouse dingin thohhat le thumna jouse thon hichea chun kiging jingun."},"19":{"text":"Chule keima dingin jong paodohna dingdola thuseidohna eikipeh theija, chutia chu Kipana Thupha thugil hi hakat tah-a kaseiphonga, kahetsah theina dingin, neitaokop jingun;"},"20":{"text":"Hiche dinga chu thihkhaova kihena leng palai natonga kahi, hichea hi hakat tah-a kaseidol kasei theina dingin."},"21":{"text":"Keima thudol, iti kaum ipi kabol, nahetna dingun Pakaiya lhacha tahsan umtah sopidei Tychicus, ama hin ijakai nahetsah naovinte.","title":"Thuchaina","ref":"Sol 20:4; 2 Tim 4:12."},"22":{"text":"Keima umchan dol thu nahetna dingule, aman nangho nalhamon theina dinguva, hiche lungngaito-a chu keiman ama hi naheng uva kahinsol ahi.","ref":"Col 4:7-8"},"23":{"text":"Pa Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin, sopite henga lungmonle tahsan chule ngailut umkhom hen."},"24":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa kemthei louva ngailuho chengse chu lungsetna hin umpihen, Amen."}}}}},"50":{"info":{"name":"PHILIPPIANS","shortname":"Phil","abbr":[],"desc":"Philippia Mite Henga Paul Lekha Thot"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu Christa sohteni Paul le Timothy'in Philippi'a um Christa Jesu'a mithengte jouse hengle aumpiu houvaipole lhachaho henga;","title":"Lemna","ref":"Sol 16:12."},"2":{"text":"I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin lungsetle lungmon naheng uva umhen."},"3":{"text":"Nangho kageldoh chanin a-imatih chanin Pathen kathangvah jingin;","title":"A Lekhathot Simho Dinga Paul Taona"},"4":{"text":"Kataona jouse-a nangho nabon chaova dingin kipahtah-in kataojin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amasapen nikho-a patna tuni geija Kipana Thupha-a neikiloi khompi jeh-un;"},"6":{"text":"Nangho sunga thilpha pandoh-a ama chun Christa nikho ni geija abol molso ding ahi ti dettah-in kagingchai;"},"7":{"text":"Chule nangho nabon chaova thudola keiman lung kahiti gel hi adih lam ahi; ajeh chu nangho kalung sunga kavop jing nahiuve; hiche jeh-a chu keima bulput thudola chule Kipana Thupha lama pana kihonna thuseile phudetna lam thudola, nangho nabon chaova keimatoh lungsetna kachan khompi nahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu Jesu Christa milungset na-a chu nangho nabon chaova iti kangaiju hitam ti eihettoh peh-a Pathen ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule keima hichena ding hin kataoji, nami ngailutnao chu hetna le gelkhen themna adima akhantou cheh akhantou cheh-a;"},"10":{"text":"Chutia chu nanghon thil aphatah chu naphottoh theijuva; lung kitah-a chule suhkhel beihela Christa nikho ni geija naum uva;"},"11":{"text":"Pathen loupina le vahchoina dinga Jesu Christa-a kona umdoh chonphat ga chu nadimsetna dingun."},"12":{"text":"Sopiteho, nanghon hiche thuhi heleu chun kalung ahi, keima chunga thu soh chengse hi Kipana Thupha chalna dingjoh-a hung soh ahi;","title":"Hin hi Christa-a Ahi"},"13":{"text":"Kabulput hi leng in jouse le mundang jouse-a Christa jala ahi ti chu akiphongtan ahi;","ref":"Sol 28:20"},"14":{"text":"Chule sopite atamjon kabulput amuvin Pakai tahsan dettah-in, kicha louhelin thu asei angamui."},"15":{"text":"Atabbeh-in abangin mitthipna le kinelnan Christa chu aseiphong leuvin, chule abangin lungngeijin aseiphong leuvin ahi;"},"16":{"text":"Loikhat chun kabulput chunga hi bolgentheija kaumna ding ngaitonan, lungdihtah pu-a hilouvin, chonoh nadingin aseiphong leuvin:"},"17":{"text":"Adangho vang chun keima hi Kipana Thupha honna-a kitung kahi hi aheuvin, ngailutna neijah abolun ahi."},"18":{"text":"Achutia itiam? Phatlhemin hihen, thutah-in hijongle, itihen iti jongle Christa chu kiseiphonga ahi: chule hichea hin kakipah-e, henge, kakipa ding ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche hi nangho taona le Jesu Christa Lhagao thilpeh vanga huhhing-a kaumna hung hi ding ahi ti kahei;"},"20":{"text":"Chutengle kalung tuple kakinepna dungjuija hi imacha-a kajachat louding ahi; ahinla a-imatih chana hakat tah-a kaum jingji banga chu tu-a jong kati chunga hi thina hihen hinna hileh, Christa chu choisanga umding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ajeh chu keima dingin hin chu Christa ahin chule thi chu hamphatna ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahinla tahsa-a hin hi keima ding tohga sona ahivangle, lhen dingjoh kahepoi:"},"23":{"text":"Ahin ni kah-a lunggima uma kahi; kipatdoh-a Christa toh umkhom chu kalung ahi; ijeh-inem itile hichu gamchenga pha chungnungjo ahi:"},"24":{"text":"Ahinla tahsa-a um chu nangho dinga khohjo cheh ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule nakhantouna dingule tahsan na-a nakipana dinguva kaum nalaiding, nabon chaova kaumpi ding nahiuve ti ginchat hi kaneije;"},"26":{"text":"Chutia chu nangho henga keima hung kit vanga keima-a dinga Christa Jesu'a nakipanao chu adimsetna
