dingin."},"27":{"text":"Nanun nakhannu, nakhosah danu chu Christa Kipana Thupha toh kitoh pou pouhen; chutichun keima hungin hung mu jongleng, ahiloule umhih jeng jongleng, na-umchanu lhagao khattah-a nadindet jinguva, lung khattah-a Kipana Thupha ginchatna lama kisehtena na-umu thu chu janange."},"28":{"text":"Chule nadouteu chu imachan kisuh lung linglausah hih-un; hichu amaho dinga manthah na photchena ahi; ahin nangho ding vangin Pathen'a kona huhhing-a umna ahi."},"29":{"text":"Ajeh chu Christa-a tahsan jenga hilouva, ama dinga hesoh gentheisan thoh dinga jong, nangho lungsetna thilpeh kipe-a nahitaove."},"30":{"text":"Nanghon masanga kagalsatje dan chu namusao ahin, tun jong najaove, nangho-a jong chutobang chu uma ahi.","ref":"Sol 16:19-40"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh chun Christa-a kitilkhou na auma, lungmonsah thei ngailutna auma, Lhagao pankhompina auma, lungnema lungsetna le khoto lainatpina auma ahile,","title":"Christa Kineosah le Aletna"},"2":{"text":"Kakipana hi subukimun, chutichun Lungthim kithakhat, ngailut kithakhat hiuvinlang, thukhat kisaovin, lungkhat hiuvin;"},"3":{"text":"Kilung douna le kiloupisah na-a kona imacha bol louvin, lungnem heochan khatnin adang chu ama sanga phajoa gel cheh hiuvin;"},"4":{"text":"Amitakipmin nangma nangma-a cheh ding jenga thil ve louvin, adangho ding jong veuvin."},"5":{"text":"Christa Jesu'a uma hiche lungput chu nangho sunga jong neijun;"},"6":{"text":"Ama chu Pathen lima uma ahin, Pathen toh kikottena aum chu, kikolchah jing jeng lung angaitopoi;"},"7":{"text":"Ahin ama akisunem min, soh limin aumin, mihem bangin akisemtan ahi;"},"8":{"text":"Chule alimso amelput umchan mihem'a bang bangin aumin, ama le ama akineosah-in, thina gei, thingpel'a thina geisanin thun anunge."},"9":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu Pathen'in sangtah-a achoisanga, chule min jouse sanga min chungnung chu apeh ahitai:"},"10":{"text":"Hitia chu Jesu mina mijouse van'a cheng hihen, leisetna cheng hihen, leinoi'a cheng hijongle, akhup uva dilsu uva;","ref":"Isai 45:23."},"11":{"text":"Pa Pathen loupina dinga lei jousen Jesu Christa chu Pakai ahi ti aphondoh ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun kangaitah te, nanghon sei nangai jing bangu chun, keima um petna bang hilouvin, tu keima umlou pet hin kicha le kithing thingin huhhing-a na-umnao chu tongdoh-un.","title":"Vannoi'a Vah Banga Vahding"},"13":{"text":"Ajeh chu alung deilam tupna dingle tohdoh nadinga nasunguva natonga chu Pathen ahi."},"14":{"text":"Phunchel louhel le kinel baotam louhelin imajouse bolun;"},"15":{"text":"Chutia chu nolna beile suhsetbei Pathen chate nahidoh theijuva, khang lamvaile vahkoiho lah-a nolna beihela naum uva, vannoi'a alah uva meivah banga kilang nahina dingun,","ref":"Danb 32:5"},"16":{"text":"Hinna thu chu dom sangun; chutia chu moh lhaija kahilou, moh tohgim jong kahilou chu Christa nikho nileh kisonna kanei theina dingin."},"17":{"text":"Ahi, na ganlhaina chungu le natahsan pehdohna uva chun todoh-in um jongleng kipah ding kahi; chule nangho jouse toh kakipa ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule chutima chun nangho kipah-un, keima jong neikipa piuvin."},"19":{"text":"Nangho umchan kahettoh-a keima jong kalungmon nadinga chomkhat joule Timothy naheng uva hinsol dinghi Pakai Jesu'a kakinepna ahi.","title":"Timothy le Epaphroditus"},"20":{"text":"Ajehchu keima tobanga lungtheng sela nangho khankho ding gel ama tobang koima aumpoi."},"21":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile mijousen Jesu Christa-a ding hol louvin, amaho deilam cheh aholun ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ahin nanghon ama chu kipatepma aphat kiphochen ahi chu naheuve, hichu chapan apa atohhu banga ama hi keimatoh kitho-a Kipana Thupha jala natong ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun ikati akihet phat phatle ama hi hinsol leng tin kakineme;"},"24":{"text":"Keima jeng jong chomkhat joule hunginge ti hi Pakaiya katahsan lheh jenge."},"25":{"text":"Ahivangin kangaichat koma eijenlea pang nangho thupole, kasopi, kanatoh na-a kakithopi, kasepai chanpi Epaphroditus, ama hi naheng uva hinsol khoh kasatai."},"26":{"text":"Aman jong nangho nabon chaova mu alunggot lheh jeng ahi; nanghon ama anai ti thu najah-u chu alunghimo lheh jenge."},"27":{"text":"Chule tahtah-a na-a thita vang ahi: ahivangin Pathen'in alungsetnin; ama chang jeng hilouva keima jong eilungset ahi; achuti loule keiman kagenthei hesohna chunga genthei hesoh kathoh ding ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu nanghon ama namu kitnuva nakipa theina dingu le, kalung hesoh jong alhomdomna dinga ama hi kahinsol loi jeng ahi."},"29":{"text":"Hijeh chun kipana kimkeijin Pakaiyah analemun, chule hitobang mi hi jabolun;"},"30":{"text":"Ajeh chu keima neijenlenao lhinglou bangkhai chu subulhit dinga ama habola kibola, Christa natohna-a ahinkho jengjong khohsa louva thidehchet ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Achaina keijin, kasopite ho, Pakaiyah kipah thanomun. Thu thakhat mama chu hinsut kit ding hi keima kachimpoi; nangho dingin jong aphachome.","title":"Chonphatna Dihtah"},"2":{"text":"Uichate holah-a chun chingtheijun, kihongphauvin, achon gilou lah-a chun chingtheijun kihongphauvin, chule kitumsahho lah-a chun chingtheijun kihongphauvin;"},"3":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile eiho Lhagaova Pathen hou ihiuvin, chule Christa Jesu'a kipah, tahsa lama kingai lou cheptan chu ihiuve;"},"4":{"text":"Keima tahsa lama kingai jeng jongleng kingai thei kahi; midang tahsa lama kingai theija akingaitoa ahile chuche sanga chu keima kingai thei cheh ding kahi."},"5":{"text":"Keima niget ni-a chepkitan, Israel chi, Benjamin phunga mi, Hebrew miho lah-a Hebrew; danthu lama Pharisai;","ref":"Sol 23:6; 26:5; Rom 11:1"},"6":{"text":"Tomlahna lama houbung bolsele-a; chule danthu dola chonphatna-a themona neilou kahi.","ref":"Sol 8:3; 22:4; 26:9-11"},"7":{"text":"Ahivangin phatchomna kanei chengse chu Christa ding lama hakamna-a kangaito ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Ahi, tah mong mongin ka Pakai Christa Jesu hetna aphat jeh chun abonchan hakam nanbou kagel jing jenge; ama jala chu imajouse hakamna kathoh ahi, chule Christa chu phatchom na-a kanei theina dinga, hichu eh tobanga kagel ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Ama-a chu keima eikimudoh-a, danthua kona hidoh keima chonphatna chu nei louva, Christa-a tahsan vang, tahsana vanga Pathen'a kon chonphatjoh chu kaneija;"},"10":{"text":"Chutia chu amale athokitna thilboltheina thahat chu kahet theija, athohgim naho chu kikoppia kahia, chule ama thitoh kithakhat kahidoh theija;"},"11":{"text":"Ijem tia athia kona thokitna chu kachan khah theina ding kati ahi."},"12":{"text":"Keiman tu-a hi kanei ahitai, chule achamkima kahitai kati ahipoi; Christa Jesu'n keima eimat bangma chu keiman jong hichu kamat theina dinga hadela kadel ahi.","title":"Abidoi Lama Lhai"},"13":{"text":"Sopiteho, keiman kamantai tin kakigel hih laije: ahin hiche thilkhat hi kabole, nung lama um thil chengse chu kasumilin, masang lama um thil chu kadelin ahi;"},"14":{"text":"Jesu Christa-a Pathen kouna sang lama hatman sanna dinga abimun chu hadela del kahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun eiho apilhingsa chengse hitobang lung chu vop cheh-u hite; chule ijem tia lungchom vop na-umule hi jong chu Pathen'in nangho chungah phongdoh nante."},"16":{"text":"Hijongle eihon iphahna chan chengseu hin chonu hite, hiche chu lunga vop jinguhite."},"17":{"text":"Sopiteho, nanghon keima umchan thovin, chule navetkah dinguva um keiho, keiho banga chonho chengse chu veuvin.","ref":"1 Cor 4:16; 11:1."},"18":{"text":"(Ajehchu mi tamtah achombeh-in achontan ahi: amaho umchan chu najah uva kasei matchetsa ahitai, tu-a jong kap pumpuma kaseipeh nahiuve, amaho chu Christa thingpel douva ahiuve;"},"19":{"text":"Amaho chu akichainao manthah ahi, atumpiu chu amaho Pathen ahi, aloupinao chu ajachat naova uma ahi; amaho chun leiset thubou agelui)."},"20":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile eiho vangam mite ihiuve; chule chua kona chu huhhing-a I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa chu ahung ding kinema ngah jinga ihiuve."},"21":{"text":"Aman athilbol theina-a ijakai athua anunsah thei ahi, hiche dungjuija chu eiho tahsa manmo hi akhela ama tahsa loupitah lima chu aumsah ding ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun kasopi deitahteho le kangaitah teho, kakipana le kalukhuh, sahtahteho, hiti hin Pakaiyah umdet jingun.","title":"Kitilkhou na"},"2":{"text":"Keiman Euodias le Suyntyche chu Pakaiya lungkhat hi dingin kajole."},"3":{"text":"Kanam koljon putkhompitah, nangma jong kangeh nahi, nangman hiche numei ho chu anahun; ajeh chu amaho hi Kipana Thupha-a keimatoh kitho-a tonggim ahiuve. Clement le katoh khompi dang danghon jong chutia chu abolu ahi, amaho min chu hinna lekhabua kisuna um ahi."},"4":{"text":"Nangho Pakaiyah kipah thanom jingun; ti kitleuvinge, Kipah thanom jingun."},"5":{"text":"Nangho nachonnemu chu mi jouse het hihen. Pakai anaije."},"6":{"text":"Imacha lungkhamna nei hihhelun; ahin imalam jouse-a taonale thumna mangin, thangvah toh thon, nathum jouseu chu Pathen hetsah-un."},"7":{"text":"Chutengle Pathen lungmonna, hetna jouse khokhel sohkeija chun, nalungu le nalungthimu Christa Jesu'a ahon ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Achaina-in, sopiteho, thutah chacha, ja umdol chacha, adihlam chacha, atheng chacha, dei um chacha, seiphat chacha, phatna nei ima auma chule pachat channa auma ahile, hitiho dol chu lung gelun."},"9":{"text":"Nanghon keija kona nakihil uva najopsao, najahsao, namusao chengse chu bolun: chutile lungmonna Pathen chun naumpi jing jeng dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hitih chanpi nunga ka phatna ding nangaito nao nahin thahbol kitleuvu hi Pakaiya hapan kakipah lheh jenge; hiche dinga chu nagotsao vang ahinan, ahivangin hiche pet chun agomkom namupouve.","title":"Athilpeh Jeh uva Kipa Thuseina"},"11":{"text":"Kalhahsam mana hichu kasei ahipoi, ajehchu keima itobanga iti kaum-em, kaum bang banga lunglhaija umje kakihet ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Nemcha umje jong kahen, haotah-a ninglhinga umje jong kahei; imajousele thil jouse-a, vatah-a umle keltah-a umje, ninglhinga umjele lhasama umje thuguh chu kakihetdoh ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Eihat sahpa Christa vanga chu ijakai bol thei kahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi jeng vangin kagenthei hesohna-a neikithopiu hi nabol pha lheh jengui."},"15":{"text":"Chule nangho Philippi'a miho, Thupha hung lhun tila keima Macedonia gama kona kapotdoh lai chun, nangho tailou houbung khatcha jong pehle lah thudola eikithopia aumpoi ti nanghon nahenaove.","ref":"2 Cor 11:9"},"16":{"text":"Ajeh chu Thessalonica kho-a kaumlai jong chun, kalhah samna khatvei jeng hilouvin kakhohna nagelun eihunan neithot kit leuvun ahi.","ref":"Sol 17:1"},"17":{"text":"Thilpeh chu kahol ahipoi, aga nangho lama apung ding chu kaholjoh ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ijakai kaneikime, kahaove; nangho-a kona thil gimnamtui doija kilha-a Pathen lah theidol le lunglhaina chu Epaphroditus khutna kanamun, hiche chun kaning lhingset tan ahi.","ref":"Pot 29:18"},"19":{"text":"Chule ka-Pathen'in loupina-in Christa Jesu'a ahao dungjuijin nangaichat jouseu pekim naovin nate."},"20":{"text":"Tun i-Paule i-Pathen'u chu atonsot atonsot geijin loupi jinghen, Amen."},"21":{"text":"Christa Jesu'a um mithengte chengse kasalam anapeuvin. Kaumpi sopitehon salam napeuve.","title":"Thu khumkhana"},"22":{"text":"Mithengte jouse, ahideh-in Ceasar insung mitehon salam napeuve."},"23":{"text":"Pakai Jesu Christa milungset chun nabonchaovin umpiuvin. Amen."}}}}},"51":{"info":{"name":"Colossia","shortname":"Col","abbr":[],"desc":"Colossia Mite Henga Paul Lekha Thot"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen lunggot lama Christa Jesu solchah Paul chule sopi Timothy'n,","title":"Lemna"},"2":{"text":"Colossia'a um mithengte le Christa-a sopi ginchat tahho hengah, i-Pau Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa-a konin nachung uva lungset le chamna umhen."},"3":{"text":"Keihon I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa Pathen chu kathangvah-un, a-imatih chanin nangho dingin katao jingjiuve,","title":"Thangvahnale Vahchoina"},"4":{"text":"Christa Jesu'a natahsanu chule mithengho jouse ngailutna naneiju thu chu kajauvin;"},"5":{"text":"Masanga kipana Thupha thutah-a kona najahsao, nangho dinga van ho-a kinepna koisa ahi jeh-a;"},"6":{"text":"Hiche kipana thupha chu najah niuva pat le Pathen milungsetna chu thutah-a nahet niuva pat, vannoi leiset pumpi kom alhuna ga asodoh banga, nangho-a kom jong hung lhunga ga asohdoh ahitai:"},"7":{"text":"Hiche thutah chu kasahtah-u, kasohchan khompiu Epaphras'in nahilsao ahitan; ama hi nangho dinga Christa lhacha tahsan umtah ahi;","ref":"Col 4:12; Phlm 23"},"8":{"text":"Ama mama hin lhagaova ngailutna naneijeu chu keiho henga aphondoh ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a hi thu kajah pat niuva patna chu keiho jong nangho dinga taopeh le thumpeh tang louhel kahiuve; chutia chu nangho chihna le lhagao lam hetna tinchenga ama lunggot lam hetna-a nadim uva;"},"10":{"text":"Chule hichea chu Pakaiya dinga kiloma imalam jouse-a dei um lama nachon uva, thilpha bolna tintanga naga uva, chule Pathen hetna lama nakhantou uva;"},"11":{"text":"Kipah thanoma thohhat le lungdehat phong dinga, aloupi athahat dungjuija nahatdohna dingun;"},"12":{"text":"Vah-a cheng mithengte chan, chan khompia loma eiho eisemuva Pa chu thangvah jingun:"},"13":{"text":"Ama chun muthim thahat thunei na-a kona eihuhdoh uva, Achapa ngailut gam mi eisou ahi;"},"14":{"text":"Ama-a chu eihon athisan vanga kilhatdohna ineijuva, chonset ngaidamna jeng jong ineiju ahi.","ref":"Eph 1:7"},"15":{"text":"Ama chu mutheilou Pathen lima um ahin, thilsem jouse lah-a apeng masapen ahi;","title":"Christa Amatah le Anatoh"},"16":{"text":"Ajehchu ama-a chu thil jouse kisema ahi, van chunga hihen, leiset chunga hijongle, muthei hihen mumo hijongle, laltouna hihen, vaihomna gam hihen, piputna hihen, thahat thuneina hijongle: thil jouse ama sem ahin, ama-a dinga kisema ahi;"},"17":{"text":"Chule ama thil jouse masanga anaum jingsapeh ahi, chule ama-a chu thil jouse umsoh ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ama chu tahsa (hichu houbung) luchang ahi; ama chu abul ahin, imalam jouse-a chungnung pen ahina dinga, athiho lah-a apeng masapen ahi.","ref":"Eph 1:22,23"},"19":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile ama-a chu chamkimna tincheng aum ding chu Pa lunglam ahi;"},"20":{"text":"Chule athingpel thisana chu chamna asema, ama vanga leija um thil jouse hihen, van'a um thil jouse hijongle, amatah-in amatoh suhchama aumsah ahi.","ref":"Eph 2:16"},"21":{"text":"Chule nangho, masang nachon gitlounao jeh-a ama-a kona pampaija uma, nalung sungva melma nahiu ahin, hijongle tun,"},"22":{"text":"Ama mitmu-a athengle, boh beh louhel, chule nolna beija nadinsah theina dinguva, ama tahsa athi jala nakichampiu ahitai:"},"23":{"text":"Nangho tahsanna-a chu najung khouva, naki phudet uva, nanghon najahsao chule vannoi'a thilsemho jouse henga kiseiphong, chule keima Paul alhacha le-a kapana hichea kipana thupha kinepna'a kona hi kichondoh louva naum uva ahileh nadinsah dingu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Tun keiman nangho dinga hesoh genthei kathoh hi kakipapin, chule Christan atahsa, hichu houbung ahin, khohsahna jala ahesoh genthei thoh bangkhai chu kasa-a hin kabulhit jingin:","title":"Paul'in Houbung'a Lhacha Na Atoh"},"25":{"text":"Pathen thu subulhit dinga, nangho-a dinga keima eikipe Pathen gouchin dungjui bangtah-a, chuche lhachale-a chu eikipansah ahi;"},"26":{"text":"Chuche thugil chu akhang akhanga ki-ima thuguh chu ahin, tu-a vang amithengte henga kiphong jala ahitai."},"27":{"text":"Chidang namdangho lah-a chuche thuguh gou loupi chu ipiham ti chu Pathen'in amaho henga hetsah nom ahi; hiche gou loupi chu nangho-a um Christa chu ahi, ama chu kinepna loupi ahi."},"28":{"text":"Ama thu chu kahilu ahi, mi jouse hi Christa Jesu'a aphat chamkima Pathen anga kadinsah theina dinguva, kachihna jouseuva amitakip kapholeuva ami jouse kahilu ahi:"},"29":{"text":"Chutia chu keima-a nasatah-a athilbol thei thahat dungjuija chu, keima jong thohgima hatah-a kiseh kahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangho le Laodicea umho, chule tahsa-a kamel muloulai ho chengse dinga keima nasatah-a kaki habol hi heleu chun kalung ahi;"},"2":{"text":"Chutia chu alungu lhep lungmonga aumuva, ngailutna-a akikhi gom theijuva, hetchenna dimset gouva chu ahaodoh theijuva, Pathen thugil, Pa le Christa chu ahetdoh theina dingun;"},"3":{"text":"Ama-a chu chihnale hetna gou jouse kisela ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hiche hi koiman seithema nalhep lhah louna dinguva kasei ahi."},"5":{"text":"Tahsa-a nalah uva kaum lou jeng vangin lhagaovin kaume, kipahtah-in nachondih jeule Christa-a natahsan detjeu kamu jinge."},"6":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun nanghon Christa Jesu, Pakai chu, nalah bangu chun, ama jengah chonun;","title":"Christa-a Hinkho Lhingset"},"7":{"text":"Ama-a chun jungkhovin chule kisadoh-un, chule natahsan naova chun kiphut doh-un, nakihilu bang chun, hichea chun thangvahna dimin umun."},"8":{"text":"Chingtheijun, achuti louva ahile khat touvin Christa thua tobang hilouvin, mihem thugouchin le vannoi leiset lekhajem bul ho-a kon chihgut lekha themna le doha lhahna moh thua nasuse getnunte."},"9":{"text":"Ajeh chu Ama-a chu Pathen hina jouse chamkimna tahsa-a banga cheng ahi;"},"10":{"text":"Chule nangho hichea chu kisuchamkima nahiuve, ama chu piputle thuneina jouse luchang ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ama-a chu nangho khutna cheptan hilouva cheptan nahiu ahi, tahsaphe chonset naho tahsa chu ponsil pailhah banga kipai lha-a, Christa-a cheptan nahiu ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Na baptize chanuva chu amatoh lhana kivuitha-a nahitaove, chuche baptize chan vang mama-a chu athi lah-a kona ama kaithouva Pathen thilbol tahsan vanga amatoh kaithoutha-a um nahitaove.","ref":"Rom 6:4"},"13":{"text":"Chule suhkhelna leh tahsa-a cheptan louva thia nangho chu, Pathen'in nathemmonao jouse angaidama, thakhat tah-a ama chutoh nahinsah thau ahitai.","ref":"Eph 2:1-5"},"14":{"text":"Chule eidoudal uva ichunguva batna lekhasut danthua kisun chu anoimanga, athingpela thingkila akhetbehtha-a asuhbei ahitai;","ref":"Eph 2:15"},"15":{"text":"Chule piputna le thu neina jouse alelhah-a, hichengse chu ajoa, amaho chengse chu kilangtah-a avetsah ahitai."},"16":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun anneh thua ahim, don thua ahim, kut nikho thua ahim, lhathah nikho thua ahim, chule cholngah ni thua ahimin, koiman nangho na-oimo daohen.","ref":"Rom 14:1-6."},"17":{"text":"Hitiho jouse chu khonunga hunglhung ding thudol lim ahibouve: ahin tahsa chu Christa-a ahi."},"18":{"text":"Nasan dingu tohphat man chu chonnemna lhem le vantil ho hou, athil mulou houva chengdena, atahsa lungu ahomkeova kimoh choisang,"},"19":{"text":"Atahsa pumpi kivah khangna, agu kisuhto na-a kikilmat tona, Pathen khansah-a akhana aluchang chu atuhdet louva mihem koimacha chom mangsah hihhelun.","ref":"Eph 4:16"},"20":{"text":"Chutia chu vannoi leiset lekhajembula kona chu Christa toh thitha nahitah uva ahile, leiset hinna-a hingnalai banga ibola danthu noija lutna,","title":"Christa-a Hin leh Thi"},"21":{"text":"(Tham hih-in, tep hih-in, tongkha hih-in tiho;"},"22":{"text":"Hichengse chu imanchah laija mangthah jeng ahi;) mihem thuhil hole thupeh noija um nalai nahiuvem?"},"23":{"text":"Hiche thilho hin lungchama hou, chonnemna, chule tahsa khoto louna thilbola chihna aneijin; ahinla tahsa ngaichat kitimna lama imacha phatchomna aneipoi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh chun nangho Christa toh kaithoutha-a um nahiule, Pathen jet lama tou jinga Christa umna chung lam thu jengbou chu ha holun.","ref":"Labu 110:1."},"2":{"text":"Leiset thu geldaovin, chung lam thu jengbou gelun."},"3":{"text":"Nangho athisa nahiu ahin, nahinnao chu Christa toh Pathen'a kisela ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ihinnao Christa ahung kilah tengle, amatoh thakhat tah-a nangho jong loupitah-a kilangdoh ding nahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun nanghon leiset chunga natibah chengseu: jon, thenlou, huh, gitlou lungtup, papset, hichu milim hou ahin, hicheng chu thisah gamun.","title":"Hinkho Lui Leh Hinkho Thah"},"6":{"text":"Hicheng jeh chun thua nunglou chate chunga Pathen lungsat achujin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Masanga nangho chuchenga nahin laijuva chu, nangho jong chutihoa chu anachonjia nahiu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahin tun lungsat, lunghan, mitthip, houset, taitom, kam sunga kona thujahmo sei, hicheng jong chu paimangun."},"9":{"text":"Khatle khat thujouvin kihou hih-un; ajeh chu nanghon hicheng chu anatoh puma mi lui chu ponse lelhah banga nalelhahsao ahitai.","ref":"Eph 4:22"},"10":{"text":"Chule nasempao lim banga hetna-a kona kisemthah mithah chu nakivonu ahitai.","ref":"Semt 1:26; Eph 4:24"},"11":{"text":"Hichea chu Greek mi le Juda mi, cheptan le cheptanlou, paomah hammah, Scythia mi, soh le ongthol umlouva ahitai; Christa chu ijakaija ijakai ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun Pathen lhenchom mithengte le deitahte bangtah-in, khotona, hepina, kineosah, nunnem na, thohhat, hicheng chun kivonun;","ref":"Eph 4:2."},"13":{"text":"Nangho khatle khat kidemdaito cheh-un; khatnin khat chunga themosahna ding thu naneijule kingaidam touvin; Christan nangho nangaidam bangu chun nanghon jong ngaidamun;","ref":"Eph 4:32"},"14":{"text":"Hicheng jouse chunga chun ngailutna kivonun; hichu kikankhomna chamkimpen ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule Pathen lungmonna chu nalunguva vaihom hen; hiche dinga chu nangho tipum khatna kikou nahiuve; chule thangvahna dimin um jingun."},"16":{"text":"Chihna jouse-a Christa thu chu nasunguva cheng dimset jinghen; tumgingtoh tho lan, hou lan, chule lhagao lan khatle khat kihilun kitilkhou touvin, lungsetna thua nalung gilun Pakai choiatnan la saovin.","ref":"Eph 5:19-20"},"17":{"text":"Chule thu lam ahin, natoh lam ahin, nabol chanu Pakai Jesu minin bolun; chule ama vangin Pa le Pathen thangvah jingin umun."},"18":{"text":"Numei ho, Pakaiya lomtah-in napasal teo thunoija umun.","title":"Hinkho thah-a Khat le Khat Kah-a Kiguijopna","ref":"Eph 5:22."},"19":{"text":"Pasal ho, na-inneipiteu ngailuvin, chule nunbol hih-un.","ref":"Eph 5:25; 1 Pet 3:7."},"20":{"text":"Chateho, nangho imalam jouse-a nulepa thun nungun; hichu Pakai lunglam ahi."},"21":{"text":"Pateho, nanghon nachate chengu phin lunghang hih-un, ajole lunglhah nan neiget unte.","ref":"Eph 6:4."},"22":{"text":"Sohteho, nangho mitvet soh banga mihem lunglhaina hilouvin, lung thengsel le Pathen ging pumin, tahsa lam thudol ijakaija napakai te chengu thun nungun:","ref":"Eph 6:5-8."},"23":{"text":"nabol chanu chu mihem dinga bol tobang hilouvin, Pakai dinga bol bangin lung gilin tah-in bolun;"},"24":{"text":"Pakaiya kona goulona thilpeh nachan dingu chu heuvin; ajehchu Pakai natong nahiuve."},"25":{"text":"Amavang koi hijongle thil dihlou bola chun athilbol dihlou man chu asan ding ahi: hichea hin maiphavet na aumpoi.","ref":"Danb 10:17; Eph 6:9"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pakai teho, nanghon jong van'a Pakai khat naneiju chu heuvin lang, nasohteu dihkeicha le hoikeichan bolun.","ref":"Eph 6:9."},"2":{"text":"Nangho taona-a pangdet jom jingin, thangvah toh thon kiging jingin umun.","title":"Thuhilna"},"3":{"text":"Chujongle ajeh-a henna kaumna Christa thugil hi kaseiphong theina diuva Pathen'in kot eihonpeh nadingun keiho dingin jong neitaokop jingun;"},"4":{"text":"Chutile kaseiding bangtah-a kaphonjal thei ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule phat kijenpet chu kichoh unlang, polama um miho lama chun chingtheijin chonun.","ref":"Eph 5:16."},"6":{"text":"Chule mijouse chu iti donbut ding ahi chu nahet theina dingun, nakihounao chu lungset thu beh jinghen, chi altoh bang jinghen."},"7":{"text":"Pakaiya sopi deitah chule lhacha tahsan umtah le kasoh hikhompi Tychicus hin kaumchan jouse nangho hetsah naovin nate:","title":"Lem nale Thuchaina","ref":"Sol 20:4; 2 Tim 4:12."},"8":{"text":"Kaumchan thu nahetna dinguva, chule ama hin nalungu amonsah theina dinga, hichena dinga chu ama hi naheng uva kahinsol ahi;","ref":"Eph 6:21-22"},"9":{"text":"Nangho lah-a khat, tahsan umtah le sopi deitah Onesimus toh kahin solthan ahi. Amanin hikom thu umchan ijakai nahetsah naovinte.","ref":"Phlm 10-12"},"10":{"text":"Kasoh chanpi Aristarchus'in salam napeuve, chule Barnabas tupa Mark jongin salam napeuve, (ama chungchang thua thupeh namutaovin; ama naheng uva ahunga ahile analemun;)","ref":"Sol 19:29; 27:2; Phlm 24; Sol 12:12,25; 13:13; 15:37-39."},"11":{"text":"Chule Justus kiti Jesu'n jong salam napeuve, amaho hi cheptanho lah-a kon ahiuve. Hiteho bouhi Pathen gam chalna dinga kakithopi ahiuve; kalung monna amaho hi ahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Nangho lah-a khat Christa soh Epaphras'in salam napeuve; nangho Pathen lunglam jouse-a bukimle tahsan kichenna napandet theina dinguva, ama nangho dinga taona-a ponpan tah ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangho dingle Laodicea chule Hierapolis'a umho dinga ama hi gunchu lheh jeng ahi, ama thudol kahettohsahna hichu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Louthem deitah Luke le Demas'in jong salam napeuve."},"15":{"text":"Laodicea um sopiteho, chule Nymphas le a-in'a kikhom houbung chu salam anapeuvin."},"16":{"text":"Chule nangho koma hiche lekha nasimjou tengule, Laodicea-a um houbung jong anasim sah-un; chutobang chun nanghon jong Laodicea'a kona lekha jong chu anasimun."},"17":{"text":"Chule Archippus jah-a, Nangman Pakaiya namu lhacha natoh chu namolsona dingin chingtheijin, tin ana seijun."},"18":{"text":"Kasalam bohna hiche lekha hi keima Paul'in kakhut tah-a kasut ahi. Nanghon kabulput hi geldoh jingun. Lungsetna-in na-umpiu hen. Amen."}}}}},"52":{"info":{"name":"1 Thessalonica","shortname":"1 Thess","abbr":[],"desc":"Thessalonica Mite Henga Paul Lekha Thot Khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Silvanus chule Timothy'n, Pa Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a um Thessalonica houbung mite hengah: i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a kon lungsetna le chamna naheng uva umhen.","title":"Lem nale Thangvahna","ref":"Sol 17:1."},"2":{"text":"Katao chanun nangho kamin phah uvin, nangho nabon chaova dingin Pathen kathangvah jingjiuve;","title":"Thessalonica'a Umho Hinkho le Tahsan"},"3":{"text":"Keihon tahsana nathilbolu, ngailutna-a nathohgimu, chule I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa-a kinepna neija nathohhatnau chu i-Pathen'u le i-Pau anga sumil louhelin kageldoh jingui."},"4":{"text":"Pathen'a sopi deitahho, lhendoh nahiu chu kaheuvin,"},"5":{"text":"Kathu hilu Kinepna Thupha hi thu keo jenga nahengu hung lhunga hilouvin, thilbol thei thahat le Lhagao Thenga hetna kichentah-a hungjoh ahi, keiho nangho dinga itobang mi kahiu nanghon nahenaove."},"6":{"text":"Chule nangho hesoh gentheina nasatah lah-a Lhagao Theng Kipana-a thu chu anasanga, keihole Pakai umchan tho-a nahitaove.","ref":"Sol 17:5-9"},"7":{"text":"Chutia chu Macedonia le Achaia gama um atahsanho dinga vettoh-a jui dinga uma nahitaove."},"8":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangho-a kona Macedonia leh Achaia gam sunga Pakai thu chu jaldoh ahi, chule hiche jeng chu hilouvin, Pathen lama natahsan jeu chu gamtinah akithangtan ahi; keiho seisei angaipoi."},"9":{"text":"Ajeh chu amahotah-in keiho umchan thudol nangho kom kahung lutjeu umchan, chule nangho Pathen hingle dihtah chu hou dinga,"},"10":{"text":"chule khonunga hung lhung ding lunghana kona eihuhdoh uva Achapa Jesu, athia kona akaithou chu, van'a kona ahung ding ngah dinga, milim houva kona Pathen lama nakiheijiu chu ahillhangleu ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti chu ahin, sopiteho, naheng uva kahungu chu moh ahipoi, ti nangho tah-in nahenaove;","title":"Thessalonica Mun'a Paul Natoh"},"2":{"text":"Ahin amasanga Philippi khopi-a hesoh genthei kathoh-a chule jachat umtah-a eikibol jenga jong, hichu nahetsao ahi; hangsana no-a Pathen Thupha chu nangho jah-a sei dinga ka Pathen uva hangtah-a kanapan-u ahi.","ref":"Sol 16:19-24;; 17:1-9"},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu kathu hilu hi suhkhela kon ahipoi, thenlouva kon jong ahipoi, doha-a jong ahipoi:"},"4":{"text":"Ahin Pathen'in aphai tia eitahsan jeh-a thupha vopsah dinga eigot bangtah-a thu kaseiju ahibouve; mihem lunglhaisah louva kalung sungu photoh Pathen lunglhaina kaseiju ahi."},"5":{"text":"Imatih chana pachat lhem pan lou kahiuve, hichu nanghon naheuve, papset khuna-a jong mangji lou kahiuve, Pathen ahetoh ahi;"},"6":{"text":"Christa solchah kahiu hi, thu neitah hiding kahiuvin, ahivangin nangho nahiuvin, mi dang ahin koimacha-a konin ginle ja kahol pouve."},"7":{"text":"Nalah uva nunnem tah numei anaonoi pelaijin achate akhoukhah banga,"},"8":{"text":"nangho kakhoto jeh uva Pathen Thupha jeng hilouva, nangho kadeitah-u nahitah jeh uva, keihon kahinna chengu kisana nangho peh ding kalungu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ajeh chu, sopiteho, katohgimle kagun chunao nalunguva aumnai; nangho koima chunga pohgih pohsah louna dinga, asun ajana na katoh jiuva najah uva Pathen Thupha kaseijiu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule atahsan nangho lah-a thengtah-a, chonphatah-a, themona beija iti kachonum, ahetoh-a nangho nahiuvin, Pathen jong ahi;"},"11":{"text":"Chule Pathen gama dingle aloupina-a dinga nakou paova dinga lomtah-a nachonna dingu tia apan achate ahil banga,"},"12":{"text":"Keihon jong nangho amichangkima thu kahiluva, katilkhoujiuva, chule kahet tohsahjiu nahiuve, hichu nanghon naheuve."},"13":{"text":"Chule hiche jeh jong hin tang louhelin Pathen kathangvah jingui, nanghon keiho-a kona thu, Pathen thu najah uva chu, mihem thu ahi tia hilouva, Pathen thu tia nalah-u ahibouve; hichu tahmong ahi, chujongle hiche chun atahsan nangho lah-a na atonge."},"14":{"text":"Ajeh chu, sopiteho, nangho Juda gama Christa-a um Pathen houbung ho umchan joma nahitaove; amahon Juda miho-a kona athoh banguva nanghon jong nagam miteuva kona chuto bangma chu nathoh-u ahitai:","ref":"Sol 17:5"},"15":{"text":"Amaho chun Pakai Jesu jong athemgaohou jong athaova, chule keiho jong einomangu ahin, Pathen alunglhaisah louvu ahi, chule mi jousetoh kilekal ahiuve:","ref":"Sol 9:23,29; 13:45,50; 14:2,5,19; 17:5,12; 18:12"},"16":{"text":"Amahon keiho chidang namdangho huhhing-a aumna dinguva, thu kaseipeh dingu eikhamui; achonsetnao bukip molso jing ahiuve; ahinla lunghan khonna achunguvah achunai."},"17":{"text":"Ahin, sopiteho, lunga hilouva tahsa lama nang hotoh kikhena kaum tahdi jeh hin, kangai lutnun namaiju mu ding kaki habol chehjin ahi.","title":"Paul'in Thessalonica Mite Agavilnom"},"18":{"text":"Hichena ding chun, keiho ahideh chu keima, Paul, khatvei, nivei nangho heng lama hung ding kakigot ahitai, ahin Satan'in eisumojin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Ajehchu I-Pakaiyu Jesu ahung tengle a-angsunga kakinepnao, ahiloule kakipanao, ahiloule loupina lallukhuh chu ipi hiding ham? nangho nahi lou uham?"},"20":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile tahbeh-in kaloupinaole kakipana dingu nangho nahiuve."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu kathoh jou loutah phatnuva, Athen kho-a kachanga eikida lhah pha kasa taovin ahi;","title":"Atahsanao Agelkhoh","ref":"Sol 17:15."},"2":{"text":"hiche hesoh thoh jeh-a chu koima alunglao naum louna dinguva, nangho phutdet dingle tahsan thu lama nalungmon sah dinguva, Christa Thupha lama Pathen lhacha le isopiu chule itoh khompiu Timothy naheng uva kahinsolu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu hesoh thoh dinga pang kahiuve, hichu nanghon nahenaove."},"4":{"text":"Hesoh thoh ding ihiuve, tia masanga nangho koma kaum laijuva kaseisao ahi; chujouvin kati bang chun asohtan ahi, chule hichu nanghon naheuvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hiche jehtah chun keiman jong kathoh theilou phatna, ajole lhem chun nangho lhemlha taleu chun katohgim nau moh hikhante, tia hiche jeh-a chu natahsan jeu chu he dinga kahinsolu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahin tun Timothy nangho koma konin ahungin, Kipana Thupha, natahsan jeule nangailut jeu, chule nangho mu katup banga nanghon neimu nomu phatecha neigel doh jingu thu ahinpoh phat hin,","ref":"Sol 18:5."},"7":{"text":"sopiteho, nangho tahsan thudola keiho kahesoh genthei naova kalung mongui;"},"8":{"text":"Ajeh chu tu-a nangho Pakaiya na-umdet jingule, keiho ahinga kahitaove."},"9":{"text":"Ajehchu i-Pathen'u anga nachung uva kakipanao jouse jeh-a hi, nangho chungchanga Pathen itobang tah-a kathang vah dingu hitam?"},"10":{"text":"Namaiju kamu theina dingu le natahsan bulhin lounao kasuhbulhit theina dingun, asun ajanin kaha tao dehset jengui."},"11":{"text":"Tun i-Pau Pathen'in chule I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christan nangho heng lama eipuijuhen."},"12":{"text":"Chule nangho kangailut bangu hin, Pakaiyin nangho khatle khat kingailutna le mi jouse ngailutna-a nabelap uhen lang, naletset sah-u hen."},"13":{"text":"Chutile I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa amithengte jousetoh ahung tengle, i-Pau Pathen anga nalungthimu thenna lama themona beija aphudet ding ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahile, sopite, achaina keijin, keihon Pakai Jesu'a nangho chu kajoluva katilkhou nahiuve, chutia chu Pathen lunglhaisah nadinga iti chon dingham ti thudol chu keiho-a kona nalah bangu chun chon jom jingun, neiletset jing jengun.","title":"Pathen Lunglhaina Hinkho"},"2":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pakai Jesu'a nangho ipi thupeh kapeh-u nanghon nahenaove."},"3":{"text":"Nangho jon na-a kona nakikangse uva naki suhtheng dingu chu Pathen lunglam ahi:"},"4":{"text":"Nangho amitakipmin thengsel le jabolin nabel cheh-u phatea kivopje heleu chun ahi;"},"5":{"text":"Pathen helou chidang namdangho banga huh pan louvin:"},"6":{"text":"Chutichun chonvalin koiman hiche lamdola hin asopi dohan boldahen; ajeh chu masanga nangho kaseipehsao, kahettohsahsao banga chu, hitiho phula-a chu Pakai ahi."},"7":{"text":"Pathen'in eiho aboh dinga hilouva, atheng ding joh-a eikouvu ahibouve."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun ajop lou chun mihem ajop lou hita louvin, A-Lhagao Theng napepao Pathen chu ajop lou ahi."},"9":{"text":"Kisopi ngailut thudola vang hinsun hih jong leng akhoh poi; ajeh chu khatle khat kingailut dingje Pathen'a kona kihilsate nahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Chule Macedonia gama cheng sopite chunga hichu nabolu ahi. Ahivangin, sopite, katil nahiuve, haletnin neilet chehleu chun kati;"},"11":{"text":"Chule kathu peh bangu chun kangkhen cha umje kichuh-un, nangma kincheh kibolun chule nakhut tah-a nakitoh kihabol leuchun kati,"},"12":{"text":"Chutile polama um miho chunga ngeikeicha naumthei dingu ahi, chule lhahsamna nanei louhel dingu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Sopiteho, kinepna bei midangho banga nangho lungkhama naum louna dingun, a-imumil teho thudol helouva naum dingu kanompoi.","title":"Pakai Hungkit ding Chung changa Lhamona"},"14":{"text":"Jesu athin athoudoh kit tai, ti hi itahsan uva ahile, Pathen'in Jesu'a ihmumil teho jong chu amatoh thakhatna ahinpui ding ahi, ti iheuve."},"15":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu Pakai thua kona hiche thuhi kaseipeh nahiuve, eiho Pakai hung geija anahing nalai chengse hi, a-imusaho sanga iti nama jongle masajo lou ding ihiuve.","ref":"1 Cor 15:51-52."},"16":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pakai chu amatah a-awtoh, vantil pipui awgintoh, chule Pathen sumkon gintoh kitho-a van'a kona hung kumlha ding ahi; chule Christa-a thisaho chengse thoudoh ding ahiuve;"},"17":{"text":"Chujoule eiho ahingnalai amoh chengse hi, amaho chengse chutoh vanlaijola Pakai lamto dinga mei kong'a toltouva i-um khom dingu; chule chutia chu a-imatih chana Pakai toh i-um khom jing dingu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun hiti thu hin nangho khatle khat kilhamon touvin."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahivangin, sopiteho, hiche chu anikhole aphat thudol naheng uva hinsut ding angaipoi;","title":"Pakai Hung Ding, Kiging jinga Um Angaije"},"2":{"text":"Ajeh chu jana gucha ahung banga, Pakai nikho chu hung ding ahi, hichu nanghon kichenin naheuve.","ref":"Matt 24:43; Luk 12:39; 2 Pet 3:10"},"3":{"text":"Mihon, Chamnale lungmon, chule bitna aume, tia asei laitah-ule, numei naoso nat banga, phulou helouva manthah na chu achunguva hung chu phung jeng ding ahi; hitia chu amaho chu iti nama jongle sohcha louding ahiuve."},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin, sopiteho, gucha banga hiche nikho chu nachung uva ahung lhun ding chu, nangho muthima uma nahipouve;"},"5":{"text":"Nangho nabonchaovin khovahle sunlai chate nahiuve; eiho janle muthim mi ihipouve."},"6":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun, sopiteho, midangho banga imu louvin, limgehchan kihongpha jingin umu hite."},"7":{"text":"A-imuho khu janlebou imujia ahiuve; chule jukhamho jong janlebou akhamjiuve."},"8":{"text":"Eiho vang sunlai chate ihi jeh-un, tahsan leh ngailut ompho kivon thou hite, chule huhhinga um kinepna chu lukhuh-a neijin limgehchan hah jingin umu hite.","ref":"Isai 59:17; Eph 6:13-17"},"9":{"text":"Ajeh chu eiho lungsat chuhna dinga hilouva, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vanga huhhing chu ichan theina dinguva, Pathen'in eipansah-u ahi;"},"10":{"text":"Eiho hah jing jongleu hen imu jongleu hen, Christa toh ihinkhomna dinguva, ama eiho dinga thia ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun nabol bangu chun khatle khat kitilkhou touvin, kisadohton umun."},"12":{"text":"Sopiteho, naheng uva kahung tao ahi, nalah uva natong gima, chule pakaiya nachung uva kitunga nangho natilkhou ho chu heuvin.","title":"Tilkhouna Got Chomchom le Thuchaina"},"13":{"text":"Amaho chu anatoh jal-u chun ngailutna-in hajan jabolun. Nangho kitohdel chehchan umun."},"14":{"text":"Chule, sopiteho, kahintil nahiuve, angai dol louva chonho chu phohsalun, hilchah-un, alung doija tilkhou vun, ahatmo athadoi huvin lang, mijouse koma kido hatnun."},"15":{"text":"Chingtheijun, koiman setna chu setnan thuh hihhen; ahin khatle khat chule mijouse phatna ding bolnan kihabol cheh-un."},"16":{"text":"Kipah thanom jingun;"},"17":{"text":"tantih neilouvin taojingun;"},"18":{"text":"imajousea thangvah jingin umun; hichu Jesu Christa-a nangho chunga Pathen lunglam ahi."},"19":{"text":"Lhagao Theng chu sumit hih-un."},"20":{"text":"Lhagao thu seidoh ho chu musit hih-un."},"21":{"text":"Imalam jouse patep cheh-unlang apha chu tuhdet jingun:"},"22":{"text":"aphalou jouse-a konin kikhin mangun."},"23":{"text":"Chule cham kona Pathen'in nangho kimkeijin thensah-un; chule I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung tengle nangho chengse lhagao, nahinnao chule natahsao themona beijin koihen."},"24":{"text":"Nangho nakoupao chu tahsan umtah ahi, ama chun hichu bolpeh naovin nate."},"25":{"text":"Sopiteho, keiho dingin neitao peh-un."},"26":{"text":"Kibengchop thengin sopite jouse salam-un."},"27":{"text":"Keiman nangho Pakaiya kahahsela hiche thuhi kapeh nahiuve, hiche lekha hi sopithengte jouse angah anasimun."},"28":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungsetnan umpiuvin, amen."}}}}},"53":{"info":{"name":"2 Thessalonica","shortname":"2 Thess","abbr":[],"desc":"Thessalonica Mite Henga Paul Lekha Thot"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Silvanus, chule Timothy'n i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Khrista-a um Thessalonica houbung mite hengah:","title":"Lem nale Thangvahna","ref":"Sol 17:1."},"2":{"text":"Pa Pathen le Pakai Jesu Khrista-a konin naheng uva lungsetna le lungmonna umhen."},"3":{"text":"Sopiteho, natahsanu hakhana akhantouva chule nangho khatle khat kingailutna aletset tahjeh hin, nangho chungchanga Pathen kathangvah dingu hi kabol ding dolu ahin, kakin mongu ahi.","title":"Christa Hungkit Tengle Thutanna"},"4":{"text":"Hichea chun nanghon bolsetnale bol hesohna nathoh chengseova nathoh hatnaule natahsan jeh-u chun, keihon Pathen houbung ho chengsea nangho paopin kaneijui."},"5":{"text":"Pathen lenggama dinga lomma sim nahitheina dinguva, Pathen gam jeh-a nanghon hesoh genthei nathoh-u ahin, hichu Pathen chonphatna thutan dihtah kiphon dohna melchihna ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nahin sugenthei hochu gimhesoh na-a lethuh ding chu Pathen'a dinga thil dihtah mong ahi:"},"7":{"text":"Chule nangho suhgentheija umho chu, Pakai Jesu athahat loupina vantil chengsetoh van'a kona ahung kilah teng, keiho toh thakhatna icholdo khom dingu;"},"8":{"text":"Pathen helouhole I-Pakaiyu Jesu Khrista Thupha joplou chengse chunga meikong deujeju-a phu alah ding,"},"9":{"text":"Pakai ang sunga konle athahat aloupina-a kona amaho chun tonsot manthah na talent athohgim dingu ahi.","ref":"Isai 2:10"},"10":{"text":"Hiche nikho chule ama amithengte-a loupi dingle atahsanho chengsea (Keiho thu hettohsah natahsanu ahitan) kidangtah-a choi-atna umdinga hungding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hichejeh chun i-Pathen'un nangho nakikou nao toh kilom ahi tia ataija, chule thilpha jousele tahsan natohho jouse athahat athilbol theina-a alolhinsah theina dingin, keihon nangho dingin kataopeh jingui;"},"12":{"text":"chule i-Pathen'ule I-Pakaiyu Jesu Khrista milungsetna dungjuija, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Khrista min chu nangho-a choi-atna auma, chule nangho jong ama-a choi-atna naum theina dingu, katiu ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sopiteho, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung dingle ama koma ikikhop dingu thudola hichea hi naheng uva kangeh ahi,","title":"Agilou Pa","ref":"1 Thess 4:15-17."},"2":{"text":"lhagao khattou sei ahiloule, keiho sei hi ahi, tia thu kiseija konin hijongle, keiho sut hi ahi, tia kei lekhathot khattou ahima kon hijongle, lunglinglao loi hih-un; Christa nikho chu ahung lhunga ahitai ti gel loujenun; lung jong lunggim hihhelun."},"3":{"text":"Koima imachan kilhep lhahsah hih-un; ajeh chu lhahmang na hung lhung masa ding, chule dan suse-a chonsepa, mangthah chapa chu, hung kiphongdoh ding,"},"4":{"text":"ama chun dou apat ding, Pathen minpu jousele hou jouse chunga ama kichoi sanga, Pathen houin kisana jong hung touva hung ki pathen sah ding ahinalaije.","ref":"Dan 11:36; Ezek 28:2"},"5":{"text":"Nakom uva kaum laija hiti thuho kasei jouse chu nageldoh lou uham?"},"6":{"text":"Chule ama chu ama phattah-a akiphondoh ding, ipin akham ahi nanghon naheuve."},"7":{"text":"Ajeh chu dan suhsetna thuguh chun tu-a jong hi na atoh jingsa ahi; lahmanga aum kahse-a hi atuhtanga khat uma ahibouve."},"8":{"text":"Chule hiche teng chule dan suse-a chu hung kiphongdoh ding ahi; ahinla Pakai kama kon lhagao chun ahalvam ma chule ama hung kilah-a chu asuhmang ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 11:4"},"9":{"text":"Hichepa hung chu Satan natoh dungjuija thilbolthei thahat le melchihna chule jouthil kidang bol chengsetoh hung kitho ding ahi,","ref":"Matt 24:24"},"10":{"text":"chule amangthahho chengse chu chonphat louna jouse-a doha lhep lhah-a um ahiuve; hichu amahon huhhing-a aumna dinguva, ngailutna thutah chu alah lou jeh-u ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule hichena dinga hi Pathen'in amaho chunga chu suhkhel lamvaina natoh alhunsah ahi; chutia chu amahon thujou chu atahsan dingu;"},"12":{"text":"thutah tahsan louva chonset alunglam hijoho jouse thu kitan ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Amavang, Pakai ngailut sopiteho, nangho chungchanga imatihchana Pathen thangvah hi kakinu kabol ding dolu ahi; ajeh chu Lhagaova kona thenna-a chule thutah chu tahsan vanga atil abula pat Pathen'in huhhing-a umdinga nangho nalhenu ahi;","title":"Nangho Huhhingna Changdinga Lhendoh Nahiuve"},"14":{"text":"Chule chuche lung ngaito-a chu I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa loupina chu chang thei dinga kathuhil-u Kipana Thupha-a nakouvu ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh chun, sopiteho, pangdet jingun, kathuseiju hijongle, lekha thot hijongle, kahilna chengseu hi abonchan tuhdet jingun."},"16":{"text":"Tun I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa amatah-in, chule eingailua tonsot lungmonnale kinepna phatah lungset tah-a eipe-a, Pa Pathen chun nalungu monsah hen,"},"17":{"text":"chule thilpha bolna lam jouse-ale thupha seijah nalungu chu phutdet jingun."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ajona-in, sopiteho, nangho lah-a banga chu Pathen thu gangtah-a achala aloupidohna dingin,","title":"Neihin Taopeh Jingun"},"2":{"text":"michonsehole migilouho khutna kona kasochat theina dingun, keiho dingin neitaopeh jiuvin; ajeh chu koijakai jousen tahsan na aneipoi."},"3":{"text":"Ahivangin Pakai chu tahsan umtah ahi; amatah chun naphudet dingu chule agilouva kona chu nahuhdoh dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule kathupeh chengseu chu nanit jingui, chule nit jong nit jingunate, ti Pakaiyah nangho thudol ginchat kaneijui."},"5":{"text":"Chule Pakai chun nalungu Pathen ngailutna lamale Christa thohhatna lama kaihoihen."},"6":{"text":"Sopite, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa mina nangho hiche thuhi kapeh nahiuve, sopi koi hile dan ngailouva chona, chule keiho-a kona nakihilnao banga chon lou chu kivoppi hih-un.","title":"Thaset Chungchanga Gihna"},"7":{"text":"Nanghon keiho umchan natho dingu adol ahi chu nanghon nakihet naove; ajeh chu keiho nangho lah-a dan ngailouvin kachonpouve;"},"8":{"text":"Chule aman beijin koimacha an kanepouvin ahi; ahin nangho koima chunga poh gih pohsah louna dingin, sunle jan-in katong gimun pontho tah-in na katongun ahi;"},"9":{"text":"Hichu kahi thei lou jeh-u ahipoi; nanghon keiho umchan nathona dingu, nangho anga vettoh-a tho dinga kachuti chonu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Natong nom lou chun an jong nehdahen, tia nalah uva kaum laija nangho thu kapehsa nahiuve."},"11":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangho lah-a abang khat dan ngailouvin achonun, natong louvin mi natoh sinmon avahlen ahi, ti kajauve."},"12":{"text":"Hitobang mi chu Pakai Jesu Christa mina thu kapeh-a katil nahiuve, thipkhen chan na tonghen lang ama an kinehhen."},"13":{"text":"Sopiteho, nangho vang thilpha bol chimtih nei hih-un."},"14":{"text":"Chule hiche kalekha thot sunga kisun keiho thu ngailou chu nanghon ama chu melgelun, ama chu kivoppi, kiloipi daovin, ajachatna dingin;"},"15":{"text":"ahivangin melmah lungin gel hih-un; sopi tin tilkhoujovin."},"16":{"text":"Tun chamle lungmon kona Pakai amatah-in imajousea nangho chamle lungmon pe jingun. Pakai chun nabonchaovin umpi jingun.","title":"Thu Khumkhana"},"17":{"text":"Kasalamna hiche lekha hi keima Paul'in kakhut tah-a kasut ahi; lekha thot jouse amelchihna ahi, hitia hi kasutji ahi."},"18":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungset chun nabonchaovin umpi jingun, Amen."}}}}},"54":{"info":{"name":"1 Timothy","shortname":"1 Tim","abbr":[],"desc":"Timothy Henga Paul Lekha Thot Khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Eihuh hinguva Pathen le kinepna Pakai Christa Jesu thupeh dungjuija, Christa Jesu solchah, Paul'in,","title":"Lemna"},"2":{"text":"tahsana kachapa tahbeh Timothy hengah, i-Pau Pathen le Christa Jesu'a konin lungsetle khotona chule lungmon nachunga umhen.","ref":"Sol 16:1."},"3":{"text":"Macedonia gama kache kona, mi abang khatnin thuhil lamdang ahil louna dingule, moh thusim chule tan thei lou khanggui thu, hichun tahsanna Pathen gou chinna lama phatchomsah tahsih-a kinelna akonsahjoh ahi.","title":"Thuhil Dihlou Chungchanga Hilchahna"},"4":{"text":"Angaisah louna dinguva, nahilchah theina dinga, Ephesus kho-a umin, tia kangeh banga chu, tu-a jong kati ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahivangin thu kipeh lona pen chu lungthengle ase apha hetna pha chule tahsan kichen tah-a kon ngailut chu anei theina dinguva ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hichenga kon chun mi kimkhat akihei mangin moh houlimna lama avah koitaove."},"7":{"text":"Athuseijula adih ahimonge tia atahtinao jong chu he louhelin, danthuhil ahi nomui."},"8":{"text":"Ahin dan hi adoltah-a nitpa ding chun aphai ti iheuve;"},"9":{"text":"Ahinla dan hi michonpha dinga hilouva, dan sukeh thua nunglou, Pathen ngaisahlou chonseho, abohho athenglou, pathat, nuthat, mithat;"},"10":{"text":"mijong, palepa kikoi, mihem gu, mijou, chule jouva kihahsel; hiteho chengse dinga chule adang thuhilpha kicheh kaleh-a chon aumle, amaho chengse dinga chu kiphut ahi;"},"11":{"text":"Hiche hi pachat umtah Pathen loupina Kipana Thupha keima eikivopsah dungjuija ahi."},"12":{"text":"Keima thahat eipe-a I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa chu kathangvah jinge, ajeh chu Aman keima ginchat uma eingaitoa, alhacha-a eipansah ahitai;","title":"Pathen Lungset Jeh-a Thangvahna"},"13":{"text":"Tu masanga hou taitom kanahia, abolsea kanapana, susehat kanahi ahin: hinla tahsanlou jeh-a hettoh louva kanabol ahi jeh chun hepina kamutan ahi.","ref":"Sol 8:3; 9:4-5"},"14":{"text":"Chule Christa Jesu'a tahsanna le ngailuttoh kitho-a I-Pakaiyu milungset chu hadima dimlet ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Michonseho huhhing-a Jesu Christa vannoi leisetna hunga ahi, ti tahsan umtah hi mi jousen san cheh ding doltah ahi; hicheho lah-a chu keima apipen kahi;"},"16":{"text":"Ahin tonsotna hinna dinga Ama hintahsan dingho chun avettoh-a ajom dinguva, Jesu Christa'n athohhatna chengse chu apipen keija hi alahdoh theina dinga eihepi ahi."},"17":{"text":"Tun tonsot Leng kem theilou, mu theilou, chule Pathen chingtah khatseh, ginnale jana chule aloupina chu atonsot atonsot khangin umjinghen. Amen."},"18":{"text":"Kachapa Timothy, nangma tahsan neitahle ase apha hetna phatah neija, nangma umchan ding thudol masanga kiseisa chengse chu, hiche dungjuija chu phatah-a gal nasat theina dinga, hiche thupeh chu nangma kapeh nahi;"},"19":{"text":"Abang bangin chuche tahsan leh ase apha hetna chu apailhah jeh-un atahsan kong-u akehgamtai."},"20":{"text":"Amaho lah-a Hymenaeus le Alexander chu taitomna akisin lhon louna dinga, keiman Satan khutna kapehdoh ahitai."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu amasapena katilkhou nahiuve, mijouse-a dingin taona, thumna, chule taopehna toh thon thangvah jingin umu hite;","title":"Mijouse Dingin Taovun"},"2":{"text":"Lengho dingin, chule panmun len tuhho dingin; chutia chu eiho Pathen ngaisahna le jabolna lam jouse-a chamdel le lungmong ikhosah theina dingun."},"3":{"text":"Hichu eihuh hinguva Pathen mitmu-a phatah le lahthei ahi;"},"4":{"text":"Aman mijouse huhhing-a aumding le thutah hetna lama ahungcheh diu adei ahi."},"5":{"text":"Pathen khatsehbou ahin, chule Pathen le mihem kah-a palai jong khatsehbou ahi; ama chu mihem, Christa Jesu chu ahi;"},"6":{"text":"Ama chu aphat cha-a hettohsah hidinga, mi jouse lhatdoh na-a hung kipe-a ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hiche dinga chu aseiphongle dingle solchah, (Christa-a thutah kasei ahi; jou kaseipoi); tahsa le thutah-a chidang namdangho hil dinga eikipansah ahi.","ref":"2 Tim 1:11"},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun pasal hon lunghang louhel le kinel baotam beihelin, muntin-ah khut theng domuhen lang taovuhen, hichu kalunggot ahi.","title":"Houbung Sunga Pasal le Numei Dinmun Ding"},"9":{"text":"Chutobangma chun numei ho adol bepchan kijem uhen, kiphalam khenchan ging gehchan umuhen; sampheh jeppah, sana twikohchanga chule thil man tama kijem louvin,","ref":"1 Pet 3:3"},"10":{"text":"thilpha bolin kijemleu kati; hichu Pathen gin phonga numei chonna doltah ahi."},"11":{"text":"Imalam jouse-a numei chu thu noija umhen, gingkhen chan thu kihiljohen."},"12":{"text":"Mi hil dingle pasal chunga thunei dingin numei thu kapepoi; thipkhenin umthim ngetnget johen katibouve."},"13":{"text":"Ajeh chu amasa Adam kisema, chujouva bou Eve kisema ahi;","ref":"Semt 2:7,21-22"},"14":{"text":"chule Adam chu lheplhah-a um hilouva, numeinu johchu bou lheplhah-a uma, suhkhelna-a lhalhut ahi.","ref":"Semt 3:1-6"},"15":{"text":"Hijeng jongle tahsana, ngailutna, thenna, chule umchan phatah-a aum jom jinguva ahile, amanu chu acha neina-a sohcha ding ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Koi hile houbung lam kaija pan nom chun natoh pha alunggot ahi, tia kisei hi thudih tah ahi.","title":"Houbung Sunga Lamkai Dingho"},"2":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu houbung lamkai chu nolna bei, numei khat ji-a nei, kitimthei, lunglimtah, kituptah, jindot them, mi hil them,","ref":"Tit 1:6-9."},"3":{"text":"Juheh lou, miden mang lou; alamlouva phatchomna ding ngaito-a kilose mi hilou, mi nunnem hi ding, dou hollou, sum ngailu lou;"},"4":{"text":"Ama insung phatecha potup thei, jana neitah-a achate athua nunsah thei mi hi ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"(Ama insung chunga vaipohje he lou chun Pathen houbung ho chu iti avetsuija akaitup thei dingham?)"},"6":{"text":"Atahsan thah hilou ding ahi, ajole kiletsah hoithontin Diabol themmo sahna-a chu getninte;"},"7":{"text":"Chulou jong chu, polama mite seiphat jong hiding ahi; achuti loule seisetnin umintin Diabol thangah oh khante."},"8":{"text":"Chutobangma chu houbung lhacha-a pang ding jong chu migun ja-umtah hiding, mi kamtam hilou ding, ju-a lop hilou ding, alam louva sum veikan lung go mi hilou ding;","title":"Houbung Sunga Lhacha Dingho"},"9":{"text":"Chule sele pha hetna thenga tahsanna thuguh tuh mi hi ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Amaho chu kipatep masahen, chujoule nolna bei ahiu lebou, lhacha na tonguhen."},"11":{"text":"Chutobangma chu aji teo jong migun ja umtah, mihehse hatlou, kitim them, chule ijakaija tahsan um hiding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Lhachaho chu numei khatseh ji hicheh hen, achate chengule a-insungu phatecha potup them cheh hiuhen."},"13":{"text":"Ajeh chu houbung lhacha na phatecha tongho chun amaho dinga Christa Jesu'a um tahsan na-a chun dinmun pha le hansana nasatah akilodoh jiuvin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chomkhat joule naheng lama hung ding kinema, hiche hi kahinsut ahi;","title":"Thil Ki-im Lentah"},"15":{"text":"Ahinla kahung gei khatle, thutah khom le abul Pathen hing houbung, Pathen insunga chu mi itobanga iti umchan dingdol ahi nahetna dinga kahin sut ahi."},"16":{"text":"Pathen ngaisahna thuguh chu nelkalna beihela lena ahi; Pathen chu tahsa-a ahung kiphongin, Lhagaova them changin, Vantil ten amuvin, Chidang namdang lah-a seiphongin aumin, Vannoi'a tahsanin aumin, Loupia lahtouvin aumtan ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahin Lhagao Thengin kichentah-in aseije, ni nunung lamle mi kimkhat tahsana kona pul lha-a, lhagaoho misuh lamvaina doha leh thilhaho thuhila hung lunglut diu;","title":"Mihil Lhemho"},"2":{"text":"Hichu ama sele pha hetna thisa kidep tobang miphalhem thujou seiho-a kona sohdoh ding ahi;"},"3":{"text":"Amaho chun kichen akhamun; atahsanale thutah hetohhon thangvah puma aneh dingu, tia Pathen thilsemho chu neh ding ajadauve."},"4":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen thilsem jouse chu phasoh keija ahin, pai ding imacha umlou ahi, thangvah puma ikisanle;"},"5":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen thua konle taona-a kisuthenga ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hicheng thu chu sopiho lunga nakhuma ahile, Christa Jesu lhacha phatah nahi-a, tu geija nahinjuipeh tahsanna thu le thuhilpha-a chu kivah khang ding nahi;","title":"Jesu Christa Dinga Lhacha Pha"},"7":{"text":"Amavang hou seisetnale nupi tehse ho houlimna moh thusim chu la hih-in, Pathen ngaisahna lama them kiha sinin."},"8":{"text":"Ajehchu tahsa lam thil kisin hi phatchomna themcha khatcha ahin; Pathen ngaisahna lama kisin hi imajousea phatna ahi; ajeh chu hichu tu hinkho-a dinga jong, khonunga hinkho dinga jong thutep uma ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hiche thu kiseihi tahsan umtahle jop sohkei ding doltah ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ajeh chu eiho tu chana hi Pathen hinga ikinep jeh uva tonggima kiseh ihiuve; ama chu mi jouse huhhing-a ahin, ahideh-a chu atahsanho huhhing-a ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nangman hicheho hi thupeh-in lang chule hilin."},"12":{"text":"Nakum lhom nachapan chu koima nahsahmon umsah hih-in; ahin nangman thu lamin, houlim na lamin, mikhoto lamin, lhagao lamin, tahsanna lamin chule thenna lamin atahsanho vetjui dingin umin."},"13":{"text":"Keima kahung kahsen, nangma lekha simin, mi suhhalin, mi hilin anaponthon."},"14":{"text":"Upahon akhut angapma kiphongdoh dungjuija nakipeh thilpeh nanga um chu lhadoh loujenin."},"15":{"text":"Nangma hichenga hin gen ngaijin ponthon, chule hichenga chun umjing jengin; mi jouse henga nakhantou akiphondoh theinan."},"16":{"text":"Nangmale nathuhila chun kigingphan chingtheijin; chule hichenga chun umin; hiti chun bolle chun nangmale nathuhil ngaiho agoma nahuhhing ding ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Upa tehse phohsal hih-in, napa tobangin jolthon; khangdongho nasopi bangin;","title":"Tahsan ho Chunga Tohding Kin"},"2":{"text":"Nupi tehse ho nanu tobangin, chule numei khangdongho chu nanaonu teho tobangin lung thengselin ngaiton."},"3":{"text":"Meithai kichehtah ho chu jabolin.","title":"Meithai Dihtah ho Jabolding"},"4":{"text":"Amavang meithai achate ahiloule atute uma chu amaho chun amasan a-insunguva ngailut vetsahje heuhen, chule ahinguva nule pate phatna-a lethuhje kisinu hen; hichu Pathen anga aphale lah theitah ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahin meithai kichehtah achanga uma vang chu Pathen'a kinema, sunle jana thumle taona jenga beh jingji ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amavang atahsa nomsahna lam jenga kipenu vangchu ahinpet jenga jong athisa ahi."},"7":{"text":"Amaho chu seiset achan louna dingun thupeh hicheng hi pen."},"8":{"text":"Ahivangin koi hijongle ama mite ding ngaito lou, ahideh chu ama insung mite ding ngaito lou chun, tahsan chu aledoh ahitai, atahsanlou sanga chonsejo ahi."},"9":{"text":"Kum somgup noija mi hilou, pasal khat ji hisa,"},"10":{"text":"thilpha bolnatina seiphat changsa, chate khoukhahsa, jindot themsa, mithengte keng silpehsa, ahesoh gentheiho phatna bolsa, chonphatna jouse nungjuisa hitobang louse chu meithaijin sun hih-in."},"11":{"text":"Ahin nutil meithai vang chu meithaijin sun hih-in; amaho chun Christa douna-in atahsa nomsahna dingu angaito jeh-un jinei ding agojiuve;"},"12":{"text":"chule akipehnao masa apailhah jeh-un themmo achangjiuve."},"13":{"text":"Chule chuche tailou jong chun, intina alengleuvin, thaset apanjiuve; chutigoh jong hilouvin, amuhthem akamjaovun, minatoh taimon, seilou ding ding aseijiuve."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun, chutobang nutil meithai chun ji neihen, cha hinghen, inneinu na tonghen, melma chun aseisetna dingu kom beihelin umleu kati."},"15":{"text":"Ajeh chu tu jengin jong mi kimkhat Satan nungjui jin akihei mangtaove."},"16":{"text":"Atahsana pasal ahiloule numei khattou meithai neija aumle, ama chun kithopi hen; houbung pohgihsah hihhen; houbung chun meithai kichentah chu akithoipi theina dingin."},"17":{"text":"Upa vaihom themho, thusei lamle mihil lama ponpana gunchuho chu, ajat ni-a ginle jan umuhen.","title":"Upaho Jabolding"},"18":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun, bongchal chang chil pet amuh som hih-un; chule Natongan athaman asanding chu adol ahi, ati.","ref":"Danb 25:4; Matt 10:10; Luk 10:7"},"19":{"text":"Upadol hehna chu ahetoh nile thum ahi loule, la hih-in.","ref":"Danb 17:6; 19:15"},"20":{"text":"Adangin kichatna anei theina dingin, achonseho chu japi angsung tah-a sosalin."},"21":{"text":"Pathen toh, Pakai Jesu Christa, chule vantil kilhengho mitmu-a hiche thuhi kapeh nahi, kichentah-a hetoh loule jachen louva thu tan louvin kathupeh cheng hi mangin; langneijin imacha bol hihhelin."},"22":{"text":"Koima chunga nakhut ngampai jeng hih-in; chule midang chonset chan khompi hih-in; chule kisutheng jingin."},"23":{"text":"Na-oisung jehle nadammo jing jeh chun twisihkeo jeng don louvin, lengpitwi themkhat khat anamangjitan."},"24":{"text":"Khattou chonsetna kilangtah ahin, thutan na-a lhung masa jengji ahi; chule abang khattou setna vangin amaho nung ajuijon ahi;"},"25":{"text":"Chonphat najong chutobangma chu kilangtah ahi; chule chutobang dang dang chu im thei imacha aumpoi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen min chule athuhil chu taitoma aum louna dingin, namkoljon poh noija um soh ho chengsen a-pakaite chengu chu jabolna changdinga lom ahiubang tah-in bulhing setnin jaboluhen.","title":"Soh hon Pute Jabolding"},"2":{"text":"Chule atahsana pakai neihon amaho chu sopi ahi jeh chun nahsahmon boldao hen; chusangin hajen chehjohen, ajeh chu anatoh naova kon phatchomna muho chu atahsana le amaho dinga dei umtah ho ahiuve. Hitiho thuhi hil inlang tilkhouvin."},"3":{"text":"Mi khattou thuhil chomdang hila auma, thupha kicheh, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa thu leh Pathen ngaisahna lam thuhilpha chu asan louleh;","title":"Thuhil Dihlou le Haona Tahbeh"},"4":{"text":"Ama chu ahoithojin, imachala ahejipoi; hettah sangin kinelna, thu nelkalna hivei aveijin, hia kon chun kithangset, kinah, kiseisetto, kiginmo, nelhatna asohjin ahi;"},"5":{"text":"chutobang miho lung chu sesohjia ahin, thutah neilou ahiuvin, Pathen ngaisahna hi sumlam phatchomnan angaito jiuve, hitobanga kon chun kikangsen."},"6":{"text":"Ahin lunglhaisela Pathen ngaisah hi phatchomna tah chu ahi;"},"7":{"text":"Ajeh chu eihon vannoi'a hin imacha ihinpo lutpouve, chule atahbeh-in hichea kona jong imacha ipohdoh thei dingu ahipoi;"},"8":{"text":"Ahinla eihon anneh chule nihchen ponsil ineijule hichea chu ilunglhai jeng dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hao lung goho vang chu lhepna-a leh thangkola chule ngolna tintangle suhset nomna lam tamtah-a alha lutjiuvin, miho suhgamnale manthah na-a alhah lhumsah jiuve."},"10":{"text":"Ajeh chu sum ngailut hi setna jouse bul ahi; hichu mu ding akihabolna lama mi kimkhat tahsana-a konin avah mangun, amahole amaho lunghemna tamtah-in akisun jiuve."},"11":{"text":"Ahin, Pathen mi, nangma vang hichenga kon chun jamin; chule chonphatna, Pathen ngaisahna, tahsan, ngailutna, thohhatna, nunnem na, hicheng chu delin.","title":"Achang Cheh-a Tilkhouna"},"12":{"text":"Tahsan kisehna pha-a kihaseh-in ponpanin, tonsot hin kemlou chu tuh jingin; hiche dinga chu kikou nahi; chule ahetoh tamtah ang sunga phondohna phatah chu naphondoh ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Imajouse hinsah Pathen leh Pontius Pilate ang sunga phondoh phatah phongdoh-ah Christa Jesu mitmu-a, hiche thupeh hi kapeh nahi,","ref":"Jhn 18:37"},"14":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung kilah kahsen, nangman thupeh hi boh beh louhelle seisetna um louhelin chingin."},"15":{"text":"Thunei khatseh, lengho Leng leh pakaiho Pakai, pachat umtah chu aphatcha hung kilah ding ahi;"},"16":{"text":"Ama changsehbou chu thilouna neija ahin, nailut theihoi hilou vah-a chenga ahi; ama chu koiman mukha lou chule mu jong mu thei lou ahi, ama jenga chun choi-at le tonsot thilbol thei thahat chu umjing hen. Amen."},"17":{"text":"Tu hinkho-a vannoi leiset thila haoho chu ahoitho louna dingun hilchah-in, kichetna bei suma kingai louvin, thil jouse imanchah dinga eipeuva Pathen joh-a kingaijuhen;"},"18":{"text":"Amahon thilpha boluhen, thilpha bola chun hao uhen; hop ding jong phaluhen, mi tonan jong thanomuhen;"},"19":{"text":"Tonsot hinna chu atuhchah theina dingun, khonung hinkho-a dinga bulpha neija akikhol theina dingun hilin."},"20":{"text":"Vo Timothy, nangma nakichin sah chengse hi hongphan; chule hou seisetna thumotsei amahon chihna atiu, alam loutah-a kinelna-a kon chun kihei mangin;"},"21":{"text":"Mi kimkhat hiche chihna chu ahoitho piuvin, tahsan nalama abidoiju akheltaove. Lungsetna chu nachunga umhen, Amen."}}}}},"55":{"info":{"name":"2 Timothy","shortname":"2 Tim","abbr":[],"desc":"Timothy Henga Paul Lekha Thot Nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Christa Jesu'a um hinna thutep dungjuija Pathen lunggot tah-a kipansah Jesu Christa solchah, Paul'in,","title":"Lemna"},"2":{"text":"kacha ngaitah Timothy hengah; Pa Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Christa Jesu'a konin lungset, hepi chule lungmon nachungah umhen.","ref":"Sol 16:1."},"3":{"text":"Kapute kapatea kona sele pha hetna thenga kahou Pathen chu thangvah jia katao lai chana nangma geldoh jinga um kahi;","title":"Thangvahna le Tilkhouna"},"4":{"text":"Namit lhi lon chu kageldoh jingin, kipana kadim theina dinga, nangma mu noma asun ajana tao jing jeng kahi."},"5":{"text":"Tahsan kijentah nanga aum chu kageldoh jinge, masanga napi Lois lung sungle nanu Eunice lung sunga chenga chu, nang lung sunga jong achen kagingchai.","ref":"Sol 16:1"},"6":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu keima khut ngap vanga Pathen thilpeh nanga umchu nakonsah jing theina dinga, kahin geldohsah kit nahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen'in eiho kichatsetna lhagao eipepouve, thilbolthei thahat le ngailut, chule lungthim themna lhagaobou eipeh-u ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh chun I-Pakaiyu thu hettohsah thulam dolle asohchang keima chungchang thudola jong jahcha hih helin; ahin Pathen thilbolthei thahat dungjuijin Kipana Thupha jala thoh hahsa hi neithohpin;"},"9":{"text":"Amatah chun eihuhhingu ahi, chule kouna thenga eikouvu ahi; eiho natoh dungjuija ahipoi, ama lunggotle amilungset dungjui-a bou ahi; hiche lungsetna chu tonsot tonsot masang peh-a Christa Jesu'a eiho eina pehsao ahi;"},"10":{"text":"Ahin tu-a vang Eihuh hinga Christa Jesu hung kilah-a kona kilangdoh ahitai, aman thina asubeijin Kipana Thupha-a hinna le thilouna chu vah-a ahinpoh ahi;"},"11":{"text":"Hiche Kipana Thupha lama chu keima chidang namdang te henga lhangsamle solchah chule houhila panga kahi.","ref":"1 Tim 2:7."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu hesoh genthei hichengpi hi kathoh ahi; ahinla kajahchapoi; ajeh chu katahsan chu keiman kahei; chule avop dinga akhutna kapehdoh chengse chu chuche nikho-a dinga chu voppha-a hongbit thei ahi, ti katahsan kichene."},"13":{"text":"Keima-a kona najah thupha kichehho vettoh-a jui ding dol chengse chu Christa Jesu'a um ginchatnale ngailutna chun tuh jingin."},"14":{"text":"Nangma kipe-a thilpha chu eihoa chenga Lhagao Theng chun hongphan."},"15":{"text":"Phygellus le Hermogenes teho Asia gama um chengsen einung ngatsoh taove, hichu nangin nahenai."},"16":{"text":"Onesiphorus insung mite chu Pakaiyin hepihen; ajeh chu aman kalung asuhal matchet jingjin ahi; chule kabulput jong ajachat pipoi;"},"17":{"text":"Ahin Rome kho-a ahungin jong gunchu tah-in eiholin eihung holdoh jengin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Pakaiyin ama chu hiche phattheina hi pehen, hiche nikho ni chule Pakai koma hepina changhen; chule Ephesus kho-a alhacha natoh nasatje chu nangman nahenai."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun, kacha, nangma Christa Jesu'a uma lungsetna-a chun thilboltheina thahat neijin umin.","title":"Christa Jesu'a Dinga Sepai Pha"},"2":{"text":"Chule ahetoh tamtah ang sunga keima-a kona najah chengse chu ginchat um miho chu pedoh-in, amaho jong chun midangho ahil thei dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Nangman Christa Jesu sepai phatah bangin ahahsa kathohgim hi neithohpin."},"4":{"text":"Sepai galsat pet koima tu hinkho-a khankho ding gelnan akisunoh jipoi, pha sa-a sepaija apansahpa lunglhaisah dingbou alung ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule golseh kitetna jenga jong khattouvin gol jona dingin kihabol nama jeng jongle, dan ngaitah-a abol loule, lal lukhuh akhuhjipoi."},"6":{"text":"Loubol mi natongima chu agam ga chang masapen dingdol ahi."},"7":{"text":"Kasei hi ipi ahi geltohin; ajeh chu Pakaiyin imalam jouse-a lungthim napeh ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Kathuhil Kipana Thupha dungjuija, athi lah-a kona thoudoh kit, David chilhah Jesu Christa chu geldoh jing jengin;"},"9":{"text":"Hiche Kipana Thupha jeh-a chu keima akhanggilou banga bulput geija hesoh genthei kathoh ahi; ahivangin Pathen thu chu akihentang dehpoi."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu keiman lhenchom ho dinga, amaho Christa Jesu'a um huhhingna chu achan theijuva tonsot loupina chutoh anei theina dinguva, hichengpi hi kathohgim ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hiche kisei hi ginchat umtah kisei ahi, Athina-a ithiule ahinna-a jong ihin dingu;"},"12":{"text":"Athoh chu ithohpiule avaipoh jong ipohpi dingu ahi; eihon ama seilepleu hen, aman jong eiseilep dingu ahi;","ref":"Matt 10:33; Luk 12:9."},"13":{"text":"Eiho ginchatna bei ihiule, ama chu ginchat umtah hijing ahi; ajeh chu ama kiseilep thei lou ahi."},"14":{"text":"Nangman thu hicheng hi geldohsah jingin; phatchomna bei moh thu pouva akinel baotam louna dingun, Pakai anga hilchahjin; amaho dinga mansuhna ahibouve.","title":"Gunchu tah-a Natong"},"15":{"text":"Nangma kipatep themchang banga Pathen'a kipehna dingin, gunchun ponpanin, jachatna beihel natong mi hin, thutah thu chu jangkeichan homjallin."},"16":{"text":"Amavang Pathen jalouna, hou seisetna, moh thu mai maija konin kihei mangin; ajeh chu chutobang deiho chu Pathen ngaisahmo na lama chal tou cheh cheh ding ahiuve;"},"17":{"text":"Chule athu-u jong chun masemon nehkem banga aneh dingu ahi: alah uva lha-a chu Hymenaeus le Philetus ahilhone;"},"18":{"text":"Amaho chu thutah lampia kona petmanga ahiuvin, amahon Thokitna chu kichaisa ahitai atiuvin, mi kimkhat tahsanna alehei taove."},"19":{"text":"Ahinla Pathen khombul phu dettah chu ading jingnai; achunga hiche thuhi Kinama ahin, koi koi ama-a ahi Pakaiyin ahenai. Chule, koi hile Christa min pana chu chonphat louva konin kikhin manghen.","ref":"Minb 16:5"},"20":{"text":"Amavang inpi sunga khun sanale dangka bel jeng uma ahipoi, thingle leibel jong aumin, hicheho chu abang sahlut dol aumin, abang sahlut lou dol aume."},"21":{"text":"Hichenga kona kithensodoh chu ama chu sahlut doltah ahi, akisutheng ahin, Pakai natonga lomtah ahin, chule thilpha bolna lam jouse-a dinga kigosa ahi."},"22":{"text":"Nangma vang gollhanlai lungtup lungngaija konin jamin; chule chonphatna, tahsan, ngailut, lungmon, chule lungthengsela Pakai henga taoho toh pumkhat hina hicheng chu hadelin,"},"23":{"text":"Ahin ngolkaile lungthimbeiho kinelna-a lhah ding nom hihhelin; hichea kon chun kinahna asohjin ahi, nahei."},"24":{"text":"Pakai soh chun doubol angai ahipoi; chusanga chu mi jouse dinga nunnema, mihil thema, lungdehat ding,"},"25":{"text":"Chule lungnema adouho chu apuijang dingjoh ahibouve; chutia chu Pathen'in ijem tia thutah hetna lama lungheina apeh khatle;"},"26":{"text":"Ama lunggot lama Diabol'in gal hinga amatnao thangkola kon chun kiteldoh thei khat nunte."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amavang hiche hi heuvin, ni nunung lamle phat hahsa khohtah hung lhung ding ahi.","title":"Ni Nunung Lam"},"2":{"text":"Hiche teng chule mi amachangmai kingailua, sum ngailut, nomham, huset le hoitho, taitomhat, nu thu pa thu ngailou, phatna ngaisah lou, then louna,"},"3":{"text":"Lungsetna neilou, kihou champi mohel, hehset hat, ti kitimlou, kichat um, phatna ho-a,"},"4":{"text":"Tahsan pailha, kichamsah,kiletsah, chule Pathen ngailut sanga nopsah ngailut johna;"},"5":{"text":"Pathen ngaisah lhem-a athahat athilbol thei janom lou, hicheng chu hung umding ahi; hichenga kon jong chun kihei mangin."},"6":{"text":"Amaho lah-a kimkhat doha lungthimin mi ina alutjiuvin, chonset pohgih po-a, lung ngaichat tamtah puilonle,"},"7":{"text":"Chule akihil jing vanga thutah hetheilou numei lungthimbeiho chu alhem lhaovin, gal hingin amanjiovin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule Jannes le Jambres in Mosi adoudal lhon bang banga chu hiteho jong hin thutah chu adoudalu ahi; lungput sesa, tahsan lam thua Pathen deimo mi ahiuve.","ref":"Pot 7:11"},"9":{"text":"Ahivangin amaho chu gamlatah mason lou ding ahiuve; khatteni banga chu amaho jong angolnao chu mi jouse jah-a kisei phongle ding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma vang kathuhil, kanun kakhan, kalunggot, tahsan, thohhat, ngailut, lungdehat, bolsetna tintangle, hesoh genthei kathoh nungjuija nahi tai."},"11":{"text":"Antioch kho-a, Iconium'a chule Lystra kho chengsea kachunga itobang thu sohtam, bolsetna ijat kathoh hitam, ahin Pakaiyin chutiho jouse-a kon chun eihuhdoh tai.","title":"Tilkhouna Nunung","ref":"Sol 13:14-52; 14:8-20."},"12":{"text":"Chule koi hile Pathen ngaisah kijentah-a Christa Jesu'a hinding lung go chan chun bolsetna athoh ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahin migilouho chule milhemlhaho vang chu setna lama khangtou cheh cheh ding ahiuve; amaho doha kilhemlha ahiuvin, doha alheplhah dingu ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahin nangma vang nakihilsa chengsele naphotchensa chengsea chun dingdet jingin; koi koija kona kihila nahi nangman nahenai."},"15":{"text":"Chule huhhing-a umna dinga nachihsah thei Pathen lekhabu theng chu nachapan laija patna nahin hetsapeh ahitai."},"16":{"text":"Pathen'in ahaikhum Pathen lekhabua thu kisun chengse chu kihilna-a, kiphona-a, kipuijangna-a, chonphat kisinsahna dinga phatah ahi;"},"17":{"text":"chutia chu Pathen mi chu pha chamkim keija, thilpha bolna lama chamkim keija kigosa dema um thei ding ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu keiman Pathen anga ahingle athiho thu tan dinga Pakai Jesu Christa anga, ama hung kilahna le alenggam chu pana guntah-a kahilchah nahi;"},"2":{"text":"Thu chu hil lhanglen; aphatle aphat louva jong kigosan umjing jengin; lungnengin hiltoh thonlang, athemo nao hetsahjinlang, sosaljin chule tilkhoujin."},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu hitobang phat hi hung lhung ding ahi, mihon thuhilpha kicheh chu angai thei lou ding, akolu thah tuntuna ama ama lung ngaichat dungjuija, mihil akikhop khom dingu ahi;"},"4":{"text":"Chule thutah-a kona anau ahei manguva, moh thusim lama lamvai dingu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahin nangma vang imalam jouse-a limgehchan um jingin; thohhahsa thoh-in, evangelist na chu tongin; nalhacha natoh chu bulhit molson."},"6":{"text":"Ajeh chu tu-a hi keima eikipedohsa ahitai, kapotdoh phat hung lhunga ahitai."},"7":{"text":"Golseh phatah chu kaseh joutai, kalhaitetna kachaitai, tahsan chu kamolsoi,"},"8":{"text":"tu-a kipat hi keima dinga chonphatna lal lukhuh chu koisa uma ahitai; chondih-a thutan Pakai chun hiche nikho ni chule eipeh ding ahi; keima chang jenggoh hilouva, ama hung kilah ngailu chengse jong chu apeh ding ahi."},"9":{"text":"Kaheng lama hungvahna dingin hung kihabolin;","title":"Changvala Ding Thu"},"10":{"text":"Demas'in tulai vannoi leiset angailut jeh-in, keima eidalhan Thessalonica'a achetai; Crescen Galatia lama achen, chule Titus Dalmatia lama achei;","ref":"Col 4:14; Phlm 24; 2 Cor 8:23; Gal 2:3; Tit 1:4"},"11":{"text":"Luke changseh keimatoh kaume. Mark hinpuijin hung lhonin; ama chu lhacha natohna-a kadinga phachom tah ahi.","ref":"Col 4:14; Phlm 24; Sol 12:12,25; 13:13; 15:37-39; Col 4:10"},"12":{"text":"Tychicus vang Ephesus lama kasoltai.","ref":"Sol 20:4; Eph 6:21-22; Col 4:7-8"},"13":{"text":"Troas khopi-a Carpus khutna kasangkhol len kadalhah chule lekhabu ho, ahideh-a savun lekhabu ho chu, nahung tengle hinpon.","ref":"Sol 20:6"},"14":{"text":"Alexander sumsan kheng chu kachunga akhang gilou lheh jenge; athilbol dungjuijin Pakaiyin lethuh nante.","ref":"Labu 62:12; Rom 2:6; 1 Tim 1:20."},"15":{"text":"Nangjong ama lama chun hung kihongphan; ama chun ithu-u hi hadouvin adoudalin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Keima kakihona thu kasei masahpen chun koimacha eipanpi aumpon, mijousen eidalha sohkeijun ahi; hichu amaho themon kisim hihhen tia Pathen henga katao ahi."},"17":{"text":"Achuti vangin keima vanga thu chu hillhanga aum sohkeija, chidang namdangho jousen ahet theina dingun, Pakai chun eidinpin eihat sahtai; hichun keipi kam sunga kon chun kasohchatan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Pakai chun gitlou thilbol jouse-a konin eihuh doh-intin, avan gama dingin eihuhhing nante; Minlet loupi chu tonsot tonsot geijin ama-a hi jinghen. Amen."},"19":{"text":"Priscilla le Aquila chule Onesiphorus insung mite chu salam'in.","title":"Achaina Salam","ref":"Sol 18:2; 2 Tim 1:16-17."},"20":{"text":"Erastus Corinth-a aumdentai; Trophimus vang anat jeh-in Miletus-a kadalhatai.","ref":"Sol 19:22; Rom 16:23; Sol 20:4; 21:29"},"21":{"text":"Nangma phalbi kah-a hung dingin hung kihabolin. Eubulus teho, Puden teho, Linus teho, chule sopite jousen nasalamui."},"22":{"text":"Pakai Jesu Christa'n nalhagao umpihen. Nabonchao chunga Pathen lungsetna umhen, Amen."}}}}},"56":{"info":{"name":"Titus","shortname":"Tit","abbr":[],"desc":"Titus Henga Paul Lekha Thot"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Pathen soh, Pathen milhen tahsana dungjui le Pathen ngaisahna tolhona thutah hetna lama Jesu Christa solchah;","title":"Lemna"},"2":{"text":"Tonsot hinna kinepna-a chu jou sei theilou Pathen chun tonsot tonsot masanga atepsa ahitai;"},"3":{"text":"Ahinla aphatcha athu chu kihil lhanga kiphongdoh ahi; Eihuh hinguva Pathen thupeh dungjuija chuche hillhangna chu eikichinsah ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Tahsan lhangpi thudola kacha tahtah Titus henga: Pa Pathen le Eihuh hinguva Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin lungset, khoto chule lungmon lhunghen.","ref":"2 Cor 8:23; Gal 2:3; 2 Tim 4:10."},"5":{"text":"Thil kibol bulhing lou chengse chu naboltup sohkeija chule khopi tinchenga upaho napansah ding, hiche dinga chu Crete'a kadalhah nahi.","title":"Upa-a Pangthei Dingho Dinmun"},"6":{"text":"Mi chu koi hile nolna bei, numei khatseh ji-a neija, chule achate chu Pathen tahsan hia chon chatvaina lamle thua nun louna lama seiset changlou hi ding ahi.","ref":"1 Tim 3:2-7"},"7":{"text":"Ajeh chu iham itile houbung lamkai chu Pathen gou chinga ahi jeh-a chu nolna bei hi dingdol ahi; kichamsah, lungsabai, ju-a lop, mideng-ah, alam louva phatchomna ding ngaito-a kilose mi hilou ding;"},"8":{"text":"Amavang jindot them, phat ngailu-a, lung limgeh, chondih, atheng, ama chang kitimthei mibou hi ding ahi;"},"9":{"text":"Chule thuhilpha kicheh-a chu mi thuhil athepma, mi nelkal hat teho chu athemo nao ahetsah theina dinga, akihil dungjuija tahsan umtah thu chu tuhchah mi hiding ahi."},"10":{"text":"Thua nung louva thumot seile dohapan mi tamtah aume, ahideh-a chu cheptanho lah-a mi ahiuve;","title":"Upaho Toh ding"},"11":{"text":"Amaho chu akamu huhbing ding ahi; alam louva phatchomna ding gutnan ahildol louhelu thu ahilun, mi kimkhat insung achoh chavaitaove."},"12":{"text":"Amaho thudol mi themgao khatnin ahiti seije, Crete miho chu a-imatih chana jou jing sahang ahiuvin, thasea annehhat ahiuve, ati."},"13":{"text":"Hiche het tohsahna hi adihtah mong ahi. Chuti ahi jeh chun amaho tahsan kicheh mi ahina dingun nasatah-in phohsalin,"},"14":{"text":"Thutah-a kona mi heimanga Juda miho moh thusimle miho thupeh-a lunglut daohen."},"15":{"text":"Atheng dinga imajouse thengsoh ahi, ahin akisuboh atahsan louho ding vanga athenga khatcha umlou ahi, thentah sanga alungule ase apha hetnau agoma bohjia ahi."},"16":{"text":"Pathen kahei, tin akam sungun aseidoh naovin, anatoh lama ajanom pouve; amaho chu thet umtah, thu ngailou ahiuvin, thilpha bolna lama pannabei ahiuve."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangma vangin thuhilpha kicheh chutoh kitoh thu seijin;","title":"Thuhilpha"},"2":{"text":"Upaho chu kitim thei, ja umtah, lunglimtah, chule ngailutna le ginchat, chule lungdehat kichehtah mi ahi theina dingun, hilin;"},"3":{"text":"Chutima chun nupi tehse ho jong chu mi ja um gingkhen hiuhen, mi hehsehat le lengpitwi tamtah sohnu hilouva, thilpha lama mihil hiuhen;"},"4":{"text":"Chutia chu amaho chun nutil khangdongho chu a-inneipute chengu ngailutle achateu ngailutje kisinsah uhen;"},"5":{"text":"Alung limgeh, chon thengtah, inmun natong mi ahiuva, mihepi them ahiuva, a-inneipute chengu thu amanuva, chutia chu Pathen thu chu taitoma aum louna dingin, hilin."},"6":{"text":"Chutobangma chun gollhangho chu lunglim gehcha aumna dingun tilkhouvin;"},"7":{"text":"Imalam jouse-a amahon thilpha bolna lama avettoh-a ajui dingun umin; nathuhila chun bohbehlou nahidan, nabukim dan, nakitahje dan musah-in,"},"8":{"text":"Seiset oimo-a aum louna dingin, chutia chu akaleh lama panga chu ichunguva thuse sei ding nei louva ajachat theina dingin."},"9":{"text":"Soh ho chu a-pakai ho chengu thu noija aumna dingule imalam jouse-a amaho lunglhaina lama aumna dingun tilkhouvin; nelkal louhel hiuhen;"},"10":{"text":"Imacha kiseldoh nei louvin tahsanpha kichehtah musah hiuhen; chutia chu imalam jouse-a Eihuh hinguva Pathen thuhil chu ajephoi theina dingun."},"11":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen milungset hung kilah-a mi jouse huhhingna chu ahinlhut ahitai;"},"12":{"text":"Hitia chu eiho, Pathen ngaisah lounale vannoi leiset lung ngaichat jouse pumpaija, lunglima chondih-a chule Pathen ngaisahna neija tu khanga hi ikhosah dingu ahi,"},"13":{"text":"Chule kinepna thanop um tah chule Pathen loupi chungnungle Eihuh hinguva Jesu Christa loupina hung kilah dinga chu kat jinga i-um dingu ahi chu, eihilu ahitai;"},"14":{"text":"Chonphat louna jouse-a kona aman apeh-a eiho eilhatdoh theina dingule, ama-a hi dinga thilpha bola tompan mi vai khat ama dinga akisuhtheng theina dinga, ama chu eiho dinga kipedoh ahitai.","ref":"Labu 130:8; Pot 19:5; Danb 4:20; 7:6; 14:2; 1 Pet 2:9"},"15":{"text":"Nangman thu hicheng hi seijin, thunei kimkei tah-in tilkhouvin, phohsalin; koimacha kinahsahmosah hihhelin."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangman amaho chu vaipoho le thunei ho thu noija umdingin, sei ngaija thua nung dingin, thilpha bol lam jouse-a kigosa dema umdingin,","title":"Christian Chonnadan"},"2":{"text":"chule mi koima seise louhela, mi koima setna hol louva, chonnema, mi jouse chunga nunnema chon dingin jong hilphan."},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu eiho jong masanga chu lungthimbei, sei ngailou, thua nunglou, lheplhah, lungngai chatle nomsahna tamtah soh anahia, kimitthiple kithangset to-a uma, hot hattah-a khatle khat kihoto-a inahiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahinla Eihuh hinguva Pathen mihepile mihem angailutna ahung kilahdoh phat hin,"},"5":{"text":"Eihon eiho chama ibolu chonphat thilbol vanga hilouva, aman amilungset dungjuija eihuhdoh uva, penthahna-a asila, lhagao thenga athah sema;"},"6":{"text":"Eihuh hinguva Jesu Christa-a kona ichunguva letset tah-a asunlhah-a eihuhhingu ahi;"},"7":{"text":"Hichu amilungset vanga themchanga i-um uva, tonsot hin kemlou kinepna dungjuija gouloa eikisem theina dingu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hiche thu kiseija hi ginchat umtah ahi; chule nangman hiti thu dola hin thu akichetje chu seijin; Pathen tahsan ho chun thilpha bol jing leu kalung ahi.
