Hitiho hi miho dinga aphale phatchomna ahi."},"9":{"text":"Amavang ngolhoi thudohhole khanggui thu kinel baotam, danthu dola kinah, hichenga kon chun nangma kiheimangin; hicheng chu phatchomna ahipoi, mohseh ahibouve."},"10":{"text":"Loitumbol mi chu khatvei nivei nahilchah kalin lata hih-in;"},"11":{"text":"Hitobang mi chu lamvaija chule chonsejia ahi ti nahei, amale ama themlou kichan ahi."},"12":{"text":"Keiman naheng lama Artimas ahiloule Tychicus kahinsola ahile, Nicopolis'a kahenga hung dingin hung kihabolin; chukoma chu phalbi sungse-a umding kagel lhuh ahitai;","title":"Kilhahna Thupoh","ref":"Sol 20:4; Eph 6:21-22; Col 4:7-8; 2 Tim 4:12."},"13":{"text":"Dan thusun Zenas le Apollos ima alhahsam lhon louna dingin, lungthim themtah-in hinlha doh-in.","ref":"Sol 18:24; 1 Cor 16:12"},"14":{"text":"Imiteu jong chu aboithei louna dingle thil ngaichat lhahsam louna dinga, thilpha bolna-a amakai theina dingun kisin uhen."},"15":{"text":"Kaumpi chengsen abonchauvin nasalamui. Tahsan na-a eingailuho chengse salam'in. Nabon chaova chunga lungsetna umhen, Amen."}}}}},"57":{"info":{"name":"Philemon","shortname":"Phlm","abbr":[],"desc":"Philemon Henga Paul Lekha Thot"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Christa Jesu jala sohchang Paul le sopi Timothy'n katoh khompiu kadeitah Philemon,","title":"Thumakai"},"2":{"text":"chule ingailutnu Appia chule kasepai chanpi Arkhippa, chule na ina kikhom houbung hichengse henga chun;"},"3":{"text":"i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin nachung uva lungsetle lungmon umhen."},"4":{"text":"Keiman kataona-a namin kaphan ka Pathen kathangvah jingin ahi;","title":"Philemon Ngailutna le Tahsan"},"5":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pakai Jesu le mithengho jouse nangailut le tahsan thu chu kanajan ahi;"},"6":{"text":"Nangma-a um chule Christa Jesu'a um thilpha jouse hetsahna hin natahsan chu thilpha bolthei asona din katao jinge."},"7":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangma ngailut chu hapan kakipapin kalungmonge; ajeh chu, sopi, nangma vangin mithengho alunghalui."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu angai doltah-a bol dinga nangma thu peh ding Christa-a kangam jeng vangin,","title":"Onesimus Dinga Ngehna"},"9":{"text":"ngailutna jala, tehse keima Paul Christa Jesu jala sohchang hi kahung taothojoh ahi;"},"10":{"text":"Kakihen na sunga kahin kachapa Onesimus dinga kahung tao ahi;","ref":"Col 4:9"},"11":{"text":"Ama hi khatvei chu nadinga phachom lou ahin, tu vangin nangma dinga jong, keima dinga jong, phachom ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Amatah chu kalungtohtah ahin, nangma henga kahin solkit tai; hijeh chun ama anasangin."},"13":{"text":"Kipana Thupha jala kakihenna-a hi nangma thakhela eijenlea apantheina dinga keima kina dinga lhoden kagot ahin;"},"14":{"text":"Ahivangin nangma lung hina louvin ima kabol nompoi; naphatna chu khoh bola kon hilouva, nangma chamchama ahinajoh dinga kati ahi."},"15":{"text":"Amapa hi tonsot geija nanei theina dinga, chomkhat dinga nakoidoh hikhat hinte;"},"16":{"text":"Soh bang hita louva, soh sanga chungnungjo, sopi deitah bang hijohen, kei dingtah-a bon ahile, nangma dinga tahsa-a le Pakaiya gamchenga ha hicheh ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuti chu ahile nangman keima hi tohkhompi tia neigela ahile, ama hi keima neilem ding khelin analemin."},"18":{"text":"Chule ama nangma chunga suhkhel nei ahi jongle, ahilouva nabat aum jongle, hichu keijan simjengin,"},"19":{"text":"Keima Paul'in kakhut tah-a kasut ahi, keiman sanange: hichu, nangma tah-in keima neibat chu neisan, tia kasei ahipoi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi, sopi, nanga konin keima Pakaiyah phatchomna neineisah-in; nangman keima Christa-a neisulung halin."},"21":{"text":"Naseingai gingcha tah-a kahinsut ahi, kathusei chu akalvala phajon bolinate, ti kahei.","title":"Thu Chaina"},"22":{"text":"Chujongle kalhunna ding mun gotsan anakoijin; ajeh chu nangho taona vangin nangho henga peh-in uminge ti kakineme."},"23":{"text":"Christa Jesu'a kasohchanpi Epaphras'in nasalame;","ref":"Col 1:7; 4:3."},"24":{"text":"Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas chule Luke, kakithopiho hicheng hin nasalamui.","ref":"Sol 12:12,25; 13:13; 15:37-39; 19:29; 27:3; Col 4:10,14; 2 Tim 4:10,11"},"25":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungsetna chun nalhagaovu umpihen. Amen."}}}}},"58":{"info":{"name":"Hebrai","shortname":"Heb","abbr":[],"desc":"Hebrai Mite Henga Lekha Thot"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Masang laijin Pathen'in abung abungin got chom got chomin themgaoho kamin iputeu ipateu hengah thu aseijin,","title":"Achapa-a Kona Pathen Thu"},"2":{"text":"tulai ni nununga hin Achapan eiho hengah thu aseitai; hiche Achapatah chu imajouse gouloa atun ahitai, chule thilsem jouse jong hi ama khutna asemsah ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hiche Chapa chu aloupina vah le aumje kibahpi ama limtah ahin, athahatna thua ijakai tuh dinga ahin, amatah chun chonsetna asuthengin chungnunga Lal Chungnung pen jet lamah atoutai."},"4":{"text":"Chule aman vantil ho sanga min phajo gou alo bangtah-in amaho sangin achungnung jotai.","title":"Pathen Chapa Chungnun na"},"5":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile vantil ho koipen jah-a itih pena, Nangma ka-Chapa nahi, Tunia keiman kahin nahitai? chujongle, Keima a-Pa kahi ding ahin, Ama ka-Chapa hi ding ahi tia aseikhah-em?","ref":"Labu 2:7; 2 Sam 7:14; 1 Thusm 17:13."},"6":{"text":"Ahin hiche apeng masapen chu vannoi leisetna ahinpui kit ding tenga ding chun, Pathen vantilte jousen ama chu chibai bohhen, ati.","ref":"Danb 32:42."},"7":{"text":"Chule vantilte chungchang thua hitin aseije, Aman avantilho lhagao asosahjin, Alhachate chu meikong asosahjin ahi.","ref":"Labu 104:4."},"8":{"text":"Chapa chungchang thua vang chun hiti hin aseije, Vo Pathen, nalaltouna chu tonsot tonsot geija umjing jeng ahi; Chule chondihna tengdop chu nagam tengdop ahi.","ref":"Labu 45:6-7."},"9":{"text":"Nangman chonphat nangailun, khan gitlou nahon ahi; Hijeh chun Pathen'in, na-Pathen'in, naloite chengse chungvumah kipana thao nanutan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule, Pakai, atil abula nangman vannoi leiset bul naphudoh ahi; Chule vanho jong nangma khutsoh ahi.","ref":"Labu 102:25-27."},"11":{"text":"Hiteho chu mangthah ding ahi, nangma vang umjing jeng nahi; Hichengse chu ponsil banga lui ding ahi;"},"12":{"text":"Hiteho chu nangman ponlhe banga najel lom ding ahi; Hichengse chu ponsil banga kikhel ding ahi; Nangma vang nabang nahi jinge; Nakum jong bei lou ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahivangin keiman, Namelmate nakeng chotpha kaneisah masangsen, Kajet lamah tou jingin, tia vantil ho koipen jah-a aseikhah-em?","ref":"Labu 110:1."},"14":{"text":"Amaho chengse chu lhachale lhagao, sochatna gouloding teho jenle ding hinkisoldoh hilouham?"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu ithu jah chengseu hi lunglut tah-a igut cheh dingu ahi; achuti loule ajole chucheng chu kitolmang sah khau hite.","title":"Huhhingna Loupitah"},"2":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile vantil ho kama asei thu chu dettah-a, chule suhkhelnale thua nunlouna jouse man adoltah cheh-a asanuva ahile,"},"3":{"text":"huhhingna loupi hi nahsahmo leuhen eiho iti isochat dinguham? Hiche huhhingna hi amasa Pakai kama asei, ajahon eiho dinga aphudet ahin,"},"4":{"text":"melchihna le thilmu kidang chule bolmo kidang got tamtah toh tho-a, alunggot doltah-a Lhagao Theng phathei kihoma chu Pathen'in jong ahettoh sahpiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile khonunga hung umding vannoi leiset thu iseiju chu aman vantil ho noijah akoipoi.","title":"Huhhingna-a Eipuilutpau"},"6":{"text":"Ahinla khatnin mun khatnah ahettohsah-in, Mihem chu ipiham, nangman nalung viltenin? Chujongle Mihem Chapa chu ipiham, nangman navil jingin?","ref":"Labu 8:4-6"},"7":{"text":"Nangman ama chu vantil ho sangin themcha khatbou nanoinun sah-in ahi; Loupitah-in gunchena lal lukhuh-in najemin ahi; Nakhutsoh jouse chunga vaipon natungin,"},"8":{"text":"Chule imajouse abonchan akengphang noija nakoijin anoija na-umsahtai, tin aseijin ahi. Chutichun ijakai aboncha anoija akoi jeh chun, aman anoija akoi lou imacha aumtapoi. Ahivangin tu geijin eihon imajouse anoija alutsoh imu hih laijuve."},"9":{"text":"Ahin vantil ho sanga themcha khat anoinunsah Jesu vang chu imutaove, Pathen lungset vanga mi jouse dinga thina atepkhah tei ding mong ahin, thina athoh jeh chun choi-at nale loupina lukhuh-in akijemtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile ama dinga thil ijakai uma, ama vanga thil ijakai um, ama dinga chu chate tamtah loupina-a apuilut jouse-a chu, ahuhhingnau lamkaipa chun athohgima asuhchamkim ding thu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile asuthengpale asuhthengho chu aboncha khatna konbou ahiuve. Hijeh chun aman amaho chu sopi sah ding jahcha louvin,"},"12":{"text":"Keiman kasopite henga namin seiphong lengting, Houbung ho lah-a navahchoi la sange, atin;","ref":"Labu 22:22."},"13":{"text":"mun chom khatna, Kagin chatna ama jenga kangah ding ahi, atin; chukitman, Ven, keimale Pathen'in eipeh chapangte hi, ati.","ref":"Isai 8:17-18."},"14":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun chapangteho chu thisanle tahsa chang khom ahi jeh-u chun, thina-a thina thu neipa, hichu diabol ahi, asuhpoi theina dingle,"},"15":{"text":"thi kichatmana hinlai sungse-a soh-a umteho jouse chu ahuhdoh theina dinga, amatah jong hichu changa ahitai."},"16":{"text":"Atahbeh-in aman vantil ho umchan tho louvin Abraham chilhahte umchan athojotan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun miho chonset thensona dinga, ama Pathen lama dinga thempu chungnung mi khototah le tahsan umtah ahina dinga chu, ijakaija asopite bangbanga ahung umding chu adoltah ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ajeh chu aman lhepna atoa hesoh genthei athoh jeh chun, lhepna tohho phatna bola hu thei ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh chun, van kouna changkha sopi thengteho, itahsanu Solchah le Thempulen Chungnung Christa Jesu lam chu ha ngaitouvin.","title":"Christa Chu Mosi Sanga Chungnungjo Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Pathen insung jouse lah-a Mosi tahsan umtah ahi bang chun ama jong apansahpa lama tahsan umtah ahi.","ref":"Minb 12:7"},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu in sanga in sapa achoi-at joh bangtah-a chu, ama chu Mosi sanga gamchenga loupijo cheh dingdol ahi, tia kisima ahitai."},"4":{"text":"In jouse chu mi khat sahdoh ahi cheh-in, ahin imajouse sadohpa chu Pathen ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin khonunga thu hung kisei dingho hettohsahna dinga, Mosi chu Pathen insung jouse lah-a lhacha panga tahsan umtah ahi;"},"6":{"text":"Christa vang chu chapa ahin, ama insung chunga tahsan umtah ahi. Akhon ni geija iha kat naole kinepna ikisonao hi ituhdet pou ule, eiho hi a-insung mite ihiuve."},"7":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun Lhagao Thengin asei bangin, Tunia nanghon a-awgin najah uva ahile,","title":"Pathen Mite-a Dinga Cholngahna","ref":"Labu 97:7-11."},"8":{"text":"Lunghansah na-a bang chun nalungu tahsah hih-un, Gamthipma kipatep laija bang chu bol hih-un."},"9":{"text":"Chukoma chun naputeu napateu vin patepnan eideh-un ahi, Chule kathilbolho kum somli amuvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu hiche phung mite chunga hi kalung lhai lou ahi, Amaho hi imatihchana lungchavai te mong ahiuve; Ahinla amahon kalampi ahepouve;"},"11":{"text":"Chua kalung hanga kahahsel ahi, Hiteho kacholngah na-a lut lou ding ahiuve, kati ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Vo sopiteho, chingtheijun, ajole ijemtin Pathen hinga kona pul lhahna dingin, nangho lah-a jong tahsanlou lung giloupo um khauvinate."},"13":{"text":"Ahin chonset lheplhah-a khattou lungtah chehcheh nalah uva aum louna dingin, Tuni kiti phat chu aumlai sungin khatle khat niseh-in kitilkhoutouvin."},"14":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile eihon ikinepnao tahbeh kipana hi akhon ni geija ituhdet jinguva ihipouvule, Christa kikoppi ihiu ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Tunia a-awgin najah uva ahile, Lunghansahna-a bang chun nalungu tahsah hih-un, akitin ahi.","ref":"Labu 95:7-8."},"16":{"text":"Hiche ati hi, athu ajah jouva lunghansah chu koi koiham? Egypt gama kona Mosi khutna ahinpuidohho chengse chu hilouham?","ref":"Minb 14:1-35."},"17":{"text":"Chule kum somli sunga alung himona koi chungham? Gamthip laija along lum, hiche chonseho chunga chu hilouham?"},"18":{"text":"Chule hiteho kacholngah na-a lut lou ding ahiuve, tia ahahselna chu koi chungchang thua aseiham? Thu ngailouho chungchang thua hilouham?"},"19":{"text":"Hichea hin amahon atahsan loujeh uva lut thei lou ahitaove, ti chu imuvin ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun eiho kichau hite, achuti loule ajole ama cholngahna-a lut theina ding thutepsa aum jeng vangin, nalah uva khattou chua lut dinga kona athona umle akilome."},"2":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile Kipana Thupha ijah uva akisei chu eihon ijah mong mongu ahitan, amaho jong chutobangma chu ahi; ahivangin athu jahotoh tahsana akigop lou jeh-u chun, athujah-u chu amahon phatchomnan anei tapouve."},"3":{"text":"Ajeh chu atahsan eiho chengse vanghi cholngahna-a chu ilut laiju ahi; Kalunghana kahahsel banga chu, Kacholngah na-a lut lou ding ahiuve, tia, asei bang chu ahi: vannoi leiset bul aphudoh tila aman anatoh ajosohsa ahitah vangin.","ref":"Labu 95:11"},"4":{"text":"Mun khatna aman ni sagini thudol aseijin, Chuin ni sagi nin Pathen anatoh jouse-a konin akicholngah tan ahi, ati.","ref":"Semt 2:2."},"5":{"text":"Chukitman hikoma chun ahiti sei kitleuve, Hiteho kacholngah na-a lut lou ding ahiuve,","ref":"Labu 95:11."},"6":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun mi kimkhat cholngahna-a alut dingu aumnahlai jeh chun chule masanga Kipana Thupha kisei jasa hon ajoplou jeh uva alut lou jeh-u chun,"},"7":{"text":"khonung sottah nungin, Tuni tin nikho khat atep kittan, David kama masanga kisei bangma chun, Tunia nanghon a-aw najah uva ahile, Nalung tahsah hih-un, ati kitnin ahi.","ref":"Labu 95:7-8."},"8":{"text":"Joshua'n amaho chu acholngahsah hitahenlang hile, khonunga nikho chom thu chu asei lou ding ahi.","ref":"Danb 31:7; Josh 22:4."},"9":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun Pathen mite dingin cholngah ni-a kicholngahna aumnalai jinge."},"10":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen anatoh-a kona akicholngah banga chu acholngahna-a lut jong chu anatoh-a kona kicholngah ahitai.","ref":"Semt 2:2"},"11":{"text":"Hijeh chun koiman chuche thua nunlou umchan chu athoa alhua aum louna dingin, cholngahna-a chu lutna dingin ponpanu hite."},"12":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen thuhi hing jingle natonghat jing ahi, chule hemto chemjam jouse sanga jong hemjo ahi, hinna le lhagao gu kisuhtohna le lhin hichengse chu sukhen theihela sunthei ahi, chule lunggel le lungthim ngaito hetoh paijen jeng thei ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule thilsem ama mitmu-a langlou imacha aumpoi; ichon nao isuhtouva ilhutna dingpao mitmu-a chu imajouse asagohkeo le kihongsa ahi."},"14":{"text":"Vanho chengse jotpaija chea Pathen Chapa Jesu thempulen chungnunga inei jeh-u chun, itahsan iphonu hi ha tuh det jinguhite.","title":"Jesu Thempulen Chungnung Ahi"},"15":{"text":"Ajeh chu ihatmonau eihetpia eithohpi phah lou thempu chungnung neija ihipouve, eibanga imalam jouse-a lhepnale patepna tohkha-a thohkha-a, ahi jenga jong chonsetna nei louheljoh ineiju ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun hepina ichan theina dingule, panpina ingaichat phat ule lungset nale panpina imu theina dingun, hakattah-in lungsetna laltouna chu neijuhite."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile thempu chungnung jouse chu chonset thensona-a thilto le gan kithat alhakop theina dinguva, mi lah-a kona kilachoma mihemte dinga Pathen lam thila chu kipansah ahiuve."},"2":{"text":"Amaho chu ima helouho le sukhelteho chunga nemheocha lungde thei ahiuve; ajeh chu amahotah jeng jong hatmona-in aum kimvel chehjiu ahi;"},"3":{"text":"chuti chu ahin miho dinga abol banga chu, amahotah dinga jong chonset thensona dinga kilhaina abol louthei ahipoi.","ref":"Thmpu 9:7"},"4":{"text":"Chule hiche choi-atna chu Aaron banga Pathen'in akoulousen koiman ama chamin akilahpoi.","ref":"Pot 28:1"},"5":{"text":"Hiche bang chun Christa jongin thempu chungnung hi dingin amale ama akichoi anpoi; ajah-a, Nangma ka-Chapa nahi, Tunia kahin nahi, tipajoh chun achoi-at ahibouve.","ref":"Labu 7:2."},"6":{"text":"Chutima chun mun chom khatnah, Melchizedec umdan banga Tonsot thempu nahi, tin aseije.","ref":"Matt 26:36-46; Mrk 14:32-42; Luk 22:39-46."},"7":{"text":"Ama chun tahsaphe-a aumlai ni chun thina-a kona ama huhdoh theipa hengah hapena pengle mitlhi lha-a taona le thumna atoh-in, chule a-Pathen gin jeh chun ngaipeh-in aumtan ahi;"},"8":{"text":"Chapatah ahi jeng vangin athohna chengsea chu thua nunje kisinna ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Chuin ama chamkimsah sohkeijin aumin, athua nungho jouse dingin tonsot sochatna bulpi asohtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule Melchizedec umchan banga thempu chungnung ahi, tin Pathen'in asahtai."},"11":{"text":"Ama thudol chu thu tamtah sei ding kaneijun, nakolsehtah jeh-un ahilchet jong ahahsai.","title":"Tahsan Nuse Chunga Gihna"},"12":{"text":"Hitih chanpia hi, nangho mihil thei nahi dingu thu ahitan chutitah sangin, khat touvin Pathen thubul kipatna jemho nahildiu nangai chaovin ahi; chule anham hilouva, bongnoi ngainalai mitoh nabangtaove.","ref":"1 Cor 3:2"},"13":{"text":"Bongnoi anna neija chun, naosen ahi jeh-in, chonphatna lam thu hetna imacha ineipoi."},"14":{"text":"Anham vang chu mi kikhan lhitho dingbou ahi, chuteho chun ahet theinao chu aman jing jeh-un, ase apha hetkhenin athem lhehtauve."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun Christa thuhil kipatna api lam donta louvin; chule natoh thisa-a kona lung heile, Pathen tahsan,"},"2":{"text":"Baptize chan gotchom chom, chule khut ngap, athisaho hindoh kit, chule tonsot thutan vaihom thudol lam thuhilna bulphut kit ta louvin, pilhina lam dela masotna dingin kihaboluhite."},"3":{"text":"Chule Pathen'in eiphat sah uva ahile, hicheho chu ibol dingu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajeh chu khatvei khovah changsaho chun van thilpeh chu atep khataovin, Lhagao Theng changa ahitaovin,"},"5":{"text":"chule Pathen thupha le khonunga hung soh ding thilboltheina chu tepkhasa ahitaovin;"},"6":{"text":"Amaho chu alhuhtah uva ahile, alung heina dinguva semphat thah theihoi ahipouve; ajeh chu amahon Pathen Chapa chu amaho tuma thingpel'a khenbeh kit ahiuvin, chule lhangphong tah-ah taipongin aumsah jiuve."},"7":{"text":"Ajeh chu leisetnin, achunga ju jing go twi tintang anadona, adinga lei kigitpehho dinga nehdol anche louhing apensah ahin, hiche leiset chu Pathen'a konin phattheina achangin ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ahin ling phungle ham lingnei apendoh vangle, hichu pannabei ahin, chule sapset anaijin, akhonna chu meija govam ahi.","ref":"Semt 3:17-18"},"9":{"text":"Ahin, deitahteho, chutia kasei vangun, nangho umchan chu hiche sanga phajo leh huhhing-a umnatoh kithokhom thilho nabol dingu kagingcha lheh jengui."},"10":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile nanghon mithengte nanajenleu ahitan; tun jong najenleuvin, hiche Pathen min lama natohgimnao le ngailutna kilanga nalhanao Pathen'in asuhmil ding chu, ama chutobanga chondihlou ahipoi."},"11":{"text":"Chule akhon ni geija kinepna chamkim kichentah chu mu dingin, nahapan ngai bangu chun hapan cheh-un,"},"12":{"text":"Thase louvin tahsan leh thohhat vanga thutep mun loho chu, amaho chonnung chu jui chehleu chun, kalungu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Pathen'in Abraham athutep chun kihahselna ding ama sanga lenjo aum lou jeh-in, ama changin akihahselin,","title":"Pathen Thutep Thon Ngailou"},"14":{"text":"Thon louva keiman nangma phatthei kaboh ding nahi, chule pun jong kapunsah ding nahi, ati.","ref":"Semt 22:16-17"},"15":{"text":"Hiti chun aman angahat, athohhat jeh-in thutep ga chu amutan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile mihon ama sanga chungnungjo chu kihahsel na-a aneijiu ahi, chule thu kichetna dinga akihahselu chu akinelnao jouse kichaina ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chutobanga chu Pathen'in athutep gou lo dingho chu, alung ngaito long lou ahi chu nasacheh tah-a vetsah ding lung agotna, kihahselna chu asuhdet ahi."},"18":{"text":"Pathen jou ahi louna kikhel lou thil ni vanga, eiho kihuh dohna dinga ima sang uva um kinepna kikoi chu tuh dinga lhaija eihon kitilkhou na nasatah ineina dinguva, abol ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hiche kinepna chu hinna thihhat-aija ineiju ahi; hichu kichentah, dettah ahin, chule pondal sung lam geija lut ahi;","ref":"Thmpu 16:2"},"20":{"text":"Hikom mun'a chu Jesu anamasa-a Melchizedec umchan dungjuija tonsot thempu chungnung hia, eiho dinga analut masa-a ahitai.","ref":"Labu 110:4"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche Melchizedec, Salem lengpa chu, Chungnung pen Pathen thempu ahin, chule Abraham'in lengho agatha jouva ahung kile kit chun lampia agalamton phatthei agaboh-in ahi.","title":"Melchizedec Thempu","ref":"Semt 14:17-20."},"2":{"text":"Ama chu Abraham'in thil jouse hopsom-a hopkhat apen ahi. Amin chu amasa chonphat Leng kitina ahin, chuin Salem Lengpa ahi, hichu chamna lungmonna Lengpa kitina ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ama chu nu neilou, pa neilou, chilhah guilhah neilou, ahinkho kipatle ahinkho lhinna bei ahin, Pathen Chapa banga kisem ahin, hiche Melchizedec chu a-imatih chana thempu-a umjing ahi."},"4":{"text":"Lung gelun ngaitouvin: ipului bulpiu Abraham'in athilchom aphalai chengse hopsom-a hopkhat apehpa chu itobanga len hitam!"},"5":{"text":"Chule Levi chate lah-a thempu dinmun changho chun, danthu nungjuija miho lah-a kona, Abraham taiguija peng ahi jeng vangin asopitehoa kona, hopsom-a hopkhat lahna ding thu aneiju ahi;","ref":"Minb 18:21"},"6":{"text":"Amaho phung guija kona akhanggui thu kisimtha loupa vang chun Abraham'a konin hop soma hop khat akilah-in, thutep neipatah chu phatthei aboh tan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule mineojon achunga mi-a kona bou phatthei boh amu chu kinelna bei ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hiche hin hopsom-a hopkhat muho vang chu thina thu noija um ahiuve; khat joh hopsom-a hopkhat mupa vang chu hing jing jeng ahi, ti hettohna kineija ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Chule hopsom-a hopkhat mupa Levi chun amatah-in Abraham'a konin hopsom-a hopkhat apei tilehen ti thei ahi;"},"10":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile Melchizedec chun apu agalamtoa chu Levi atai sunga umnalai ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuti chu ahin, Levi ho themputna chu chamkim sohkei thei hile (ajeh chu chua kona chu mihon chonna danthu amu-u ahi), Aaron umdan banga kisei louva, Melchizedec umdan banga ding thempu got chom khat umdoh lou i-khohta dingham?"},"12":{"text":"Ajeh chu thempu akikhele danthu jong khel tei ding thu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Aumchan thu kiseipa chu phung chom mi ahi; chuche phunga mi koimacha maicham mun'a natonga aumpoi."},"14":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile I-Pakaiyu chu Juda phunga penga ahi chu kichentah-in akilange; ahin hiche phung thua chun Mosi'n thempuho thudol ima aseipoi."},"15":{"text":"Chule tahsaphe thupeh danthu dungjuija hilouvin, mantih neilou hinna thahat dungjuijoh ahin,","title":"Melchizedec Tobang Thempu Chombeh"},"16":{"text":"Melchizedec lim banga thempu chombeh khat hung uma ahile, kathu seiju hi kichen cheh ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile hichu hettohsahna chun, Melchizedec umdan dungjuijin, Nangma tonsot thempu nahi, ati.","ref":"Labu 110:4."},"18":{"text":"Ajeh chu ahatmole phatchomna bei ahi jeh-in chonna dan thupeh amasa chu amangthah tai."},"19":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile chonna dan thupeh chun imacha asucham kimpon ahi; ama mun'a chu kinepna pha chungnungjo kipolut ahitai; hiche chu eihon Pathen kom inailutnao ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule achuti jeng vang chun ama chu hahsel louva thempu-a kipansah ahipoi,"},"21":{"text":"(ijeh-inem itile amaho chu hahsel louva thempu-a kisema anahitauvin; hijongle ama vang ajah-a, Pakai chun akihahsele alung hei kit lou ding ahi, Melchizedec umdan bangin nangma tonsot thempu nahi).","ref":"Labu 110:4."},"22":{"text":"Chuti chu ahi jeh-in Jesu chu kitepna chungnungjo-a panga ahitai."},"23":{"text":"Chule amaho chu thina-in asuhmo uva apan jing thei lou jeh-un, thempu chu ana tamlheh-un ahi;"},"24":{"text":"Ama vang chu tonsot geija umjing ahi jeh chun khel louhel thempu mun changa ahitai."},"25":{"text":"Hijeh chun ama vanga Pathen kom nai lut teho chu, taopeh dinga ama hing jing jeng ahi jeh-a chu, amaho chu huhhing chamkimsoh thei ahi."},"26":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile chutobang thempu chungnung athena theng, lepthol neilou, boh behlou, chonsete lah-a kona kisepdoh, vanho sanga chungnung-jo-a kisema chu eiho dinga kilom mong ahi."},"27":{"text":"Ama chun aniseh-a thempu chung nungho banga chu, amasa ama chonset thensona-a, gan kithat alha masah ding chu akin akhohpon ahi; ijeh ham itile aman hichu amatah akilha jeng jeh chun khat veijin aseibulhit sohkeitan ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 9:7"},"28":{"text":"Ajeh chu danthun apansah thempu chung nungho chu hatmona nei mihem ahiuve; danthu nunga um hahselna thu chun tonsot geija dinga kisucham kimsoh Chapa chu apansah ahi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chunga thu kisei chengse lah-a athupipen hiche ahi, Van'a Chungnung pen laltouna jet lama tou,","title":"Eiho Dinga Thempu Chungnung Jesu","ref":"Labu 110:1."},"2":{"text":"Chule mihem tundoh hilouva, Pakai tundoh houbuh tahbeh le mun theng lhachale-a pang Thempu Chungnung ineijun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Thempu chungnung jouse chu thilto le kithensona ganlha dinga kitung cheh ahiuve; chuti ahi jeh chun hiche Thempu Chungnung jong hin ikhat khat todoh anei tei ding thu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ama vannoi leiset chunga anaum hile, thempu hilouhel ding ahi; ijeh ham itile danthu dungjuija thilto tohdoh dinga chu aum naovin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amaho lhachale-a apannau chu, Mosi'n houbuh sah dinga agot laija, Pathen'in ahilchah-a ajah-a, Chingtheijin, vetkah dinga mol chunga nakivetsah lim bang bang chun bol sohkeijin, tia asei banga chu van'a thil limdanle ale ahibouve.","ref":"Pot 25:40"},"6":{"text":"Tu vangin kitepna phajo cheh palaija apan dungjuija, kitepna chu thutep phajo chunga ahisah-a, lhacha mun phachung nung jo-a panga ahitai."},"7":{"text":"Ajeh chu kitepna masah chu themona beihel hile, aninapa mun ding chu kingaito lou ding ahi;"},"8":{"text":"ajeh iham itile amaho chu a-oimon, Veuvin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije keiman Israel phung mite leh Juda phung mite dinga, Kitepna thah kasemdoh ding nikho hung lhung ding ahitai,","ref":"Jer 31:31-34."},"9":{"text":"Aputeo apateu Egypt gama kona puidoh ding ni-a akhutnuva katuh-a, Amahotoh kitepna kasemdoh, hiche kitepna tobang chu ahitapoi, Ajeh chu amaho kakitep naovah aum jompouvin ahi; Chuti ahi jeh-a chu keiman jong amaho kadon lou ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije."},"10":{"text":"Hiche nikhoho nunga Israelte toh kitepna kaphudoh ding chu Hiche hi ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije; Alungthim uva kachondan thupeh pengting, Chule alung sunguva kasut ding ahi; Chule keima amaho Pathen hingting, amaho jong kamite hi ding ahiuve;"},"11":{"text":"Chule amitakipmin aheng akom le asopite chengu, Pakai chu heuvin, tia ahil lou dingu ahitai; Ajeh chu aneopena pat alenpen geija eihetsohkei dingu ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Asuhkhelnauva jong kahepi ding ahi, Achonsetnao le akhangitlou nau jong geldohta lou ding kahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Hiche kitepna hi aman athah ahi atia ahile, amasa chu aluisah ahitai. Chutichu ahin aluija le atehta-a chu, amang ding kon ahitai."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule kitepna masa-a jong chu Pathen lhachale-a pandanle mun theng, hiche vannoi leisetna mun theng ana uma ahi.","title":"Leisetna Pathen Kihou Dol"},"2":{"text":"Ahoubuh semu chu adan masapena chu meivah tunna, dokhang, vetsahna changlhah to uma ahin, hichu Mun Theng atiu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule pondal nina dan sunga chu houbuh Mun Theng Chungnung atiu chu uma ahin;"},"4":{"text":"Hikoma chu gimnam twi halna sana maichamle, kitepna thingkhong sana kilonkhum chu uma ahin, kitepna thingkhong sunga chu manna umna sana bel leh, Aaron tenggol pahmum, chule kitepna songpheng ni chu uma ahi;","ref":"Pot 30:1-6; 25:10-16; 16:33; Minb 17:8-10; Pot 25:16; Danb 10:3-5"},"5":{"text":"chule achung vuma chu hepi touna lekhu-a Cherub loupitah ni uma ahin; hitiho thu chu tun akip akoijin sei joupouhite.","ref":"Pot 25:18-22"},"6":{"text":"Chuti chun thil hicheng chu akisemin, thempuho Pathen houna lhachale dingin houbuh masa sunga chun alut jingjiuvin ahi;","ref":"Minb 18:2-6."},"7":{"text":"Adan nina sungnunga vang chun thempu chungnung changsehbou kum khat sungin khatvei alutjin ahi; ahivangin ama dingle miho-a ding, het louva achonsetnao thensona ding, thisan chu choi louvin alutjipoi.","ref":"Thmpu 16:2-34"},"8":{"text":"Houbuh masa chu aumlai chansea mun theng sunga lutna lam chu kilangsoh lou ahi, tin Lhagao Thengin aphonge."},"9":{"text":"Chule hichu tu laija dinga tekahna ahibouve; hiche dungjuija chu thilto le kithensona jong alhajiu ahin, hitiho chun ase apha hetna lama ahouho chu achamkimsah thei lou ahi;"},"10":{"text":"Neh dan, don dan, kisil gotchom chomtoh tahsa polam thudan jeng ahin, semphat kah-a dinga anakingaitoa ahibouve."},"11":{"text":"Christa vang chu khonunga hung umding thilpha thempu chungnunga hung panga khutna sah lou, hiche thilsem lah-a hilou, alen chungnung jole gamchenga chamkimjo houbuh-a chu lut ahin,","title":"Van'a Pathen Kihou Dol"},"12":{"text":"Kelchale bongnou thisana hilouva, ama thisana Mun Thenga khatveiseh lutna, eiho dinga tonsot geija lhatdohna kemlou eipeh-u ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile kelchale bongchal thisan chule bongla vutvam kithe khuminbon akisuboho atahsa polamu athensah-a ahile:","ref":"Thmpu 16:15-16; Minb 19:9,17-19"},"14":{"text":"Christa tonsot kemlou Lhagaova, nolna beihela, ama Pathen'a kipedoh jenga thisan chun Pathen hing lhachale-a pang dinga, thina natoh-a kona ase apha nahetnao chu gamchenga asuhtheng cheh ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule hiche jeh-a ama chu kitepna thah palai hija, kitepna masa noija suhkhel neija themoho lhatdoh na-a athitah jeh-a chu, akikouho chu tonsot kemlou gou lo ding ahitaove."},"16":{"text":"Ajeh chu kitepna umna-a chu kitepna sempa chu athi lounaje umlou ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ajeh chu thi nunglebou thulhun chu hatjia ahi: athuteppa hinlaise vangin ahatjipoi."},"18":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu kitepna masa jong chu thisan beija kiphut det lou ahi."},"19":{"text":"Mosi'n danthu dungjuija thupeh miho jah-a aseichai phatnin, bongnoule kelcha thisan chu twitoh ponsan toh hyssop toh alan, lekhabule miho jouse chu athekhumin,","ref":"Pot 24:6-8"},"20":{"text":"Hiche hi Pathen'in nangho napeh-u thupeh kitepna thisan chu ahi, ati."},"21":{"text":"Chucheng kalval jongin houbuh chule lhachaleho manchah chengse jong chu chutima chun thisan chu athekhumin ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 8:15"},"22":{"text":"Danthu dungjuija chu imajouse aboncha thisana suhtheng soh himaija ahi, chule thisanso louva ngaidamna umlou ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 17:11"},"23":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun hichenga chu van'a thil lima um chu hitia hi suhtheng dingdol mong ahi, van thil tahtah ho vang chu chucheng sanga longlhenna phajo cheh-a suhtheng dingdol thu ahi.","title":"Christa Kilhaina Gantha Banga Akitha Hin Chonset Jouse Apomangtai"},"24":{"text":"Atabbeh lima um khutna kisa mun thenga Christa alutpon ahi; ahin tun eiho jala Pathen anga ding dingin van'a alutjotan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Thempu chungnungin kumtina ama thisan hilou achoija, Mun Thenga alutji banga chu, ama thensona gan lha dinga lut matchet ahipoi;"},"26":{"text":"Chuti chu hile vannoi kisemtila patna aman tamtahvei athohgim ding ahitai; ahivangin tun aman amatah longlhengin akitoh jengin chonset suhbeina dingin tu khang nunungpen hin khatveiseh ahung kilahtan ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule mihemte dinga khatvei thia chujoule thutanna hung umding chu gotsa ahin;"},"28":{"text":"Hiche banga chu Christa jong mi tamtah chonset pomang dinga kitoh ahitan, aniveina-a chonsetna beihela ama ngah jingho huhhing dinga hung kilang ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 53:12"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Danthu chu khonunga thilpha hung umding lima hi umbou ahin, alim tahbeh ahi lou jeh chun, akumtina longlhenna alhajiu chun ahin naiho chu achamkimsah joupouvin ahi.","title":"Gan Thisana Kilhaina Achamkim Loudan"},"2":{"text":"Chuti lou hile longlhenna alhajiu chu tangta lou dingham? Ahouho chu khatveija kisutheng hileu setna ahetnao chu umtalou ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ahinla hicheng chun kumtin in achonsetnao ageldohsah jotaovin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile bongchal le kelcha thisana chonset suhbeihoi hilou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hijeh chun Christan vannoi leisetna ahung lut laijin, Nangman longlhenle thilto nanadeipon, Ahin keima dingin tahsa neigot pehtan ahi;","title":"Christa Thi Chun Pathen Lungdei Amolso Ahi","ref":"Labu 40:6-8."},"6":{"text":"Ganpumgo thilto le chonset thensona longlhenna chun nana lunglhai tapon ahi;"},"7":{"text":"Chuin keiman, Ven, keima kahungtai (Lekhabua keima thudola hitin akisune). Vo Pathen, keiman nangma lungdeilam bol dinga hung kahi kati, tin aseije."},"8":{"text":"Aman hicheng chu aseijin, Nangman longlhenna le thilto chule ganpumgo thilto chule chonset thensona longlhen chu nanadeitapon, hichenga chun lung jong nana lunglhai pon ahi, (hichu danthu dungjuija kitoh ahi jeh-in):"},"9":{"text":"Chujouvin, o Pathen Ven, keima nangma lungdeilam bol dinga hung kahi, ati. Hiche anunungjo hi aphudohna dinga amasajo alahdoh ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Hiche lungdei lama chu Jesu Christa tahsa akitoa a-imatih chana dinga khatveija akitodoh jeng vanga chu eiho suhthenga uma ihitaove."},"11":{"text":"Chule thempuho chengse adingun niseh-in hou lhachalen apangun, imatih chana chonset sumang theilou longlhen chu avel avelin atohdoh jiuvin ahi.","title":"Christa Thi Chun Suhthengna Chu Asuh Chamkim Ahitai","ref":"Pot 29:28."},"12":{"text":"Ama vangin chonset thensona longlhen khatseh chu tonsot geija dingin atohdoh-in, Pathen khut jet lama atouvin,","ref":"Labu 110:1"},"13":{"text":"Hiche kalse chun amelmaho akeng chotpha akisem masang seuvin angah jingin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile suhthenga umho chu thilto khatseh-in tonsot geija dinga achamkimsah ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Chule Lhagao Theng jongin eihet tohsah naove;"},"16":{"text":"ajeh iham itile Chuteng chuche ninung le chun amahotoh kitepna Kaphudoh ding chu hiche ahi, tin Pakai chun aseije: Keiman alung sunguva kachondan thupeh pengting, Chule alunguva kasut ding ahi, tia aseijouvin, hiche aseijouma chun,","ref":"Jer 31:33."},"17":{"text":"Chule achonsetnao le asuhkhelnau geldoh taponge, ati kitleuve.","ref":"Jer 31:34."},"18":{"text":"Chutia chu chonsetna chengse ngaidama um ahitan, chonset thensona thilto umtalou ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun, sopiteho, Jesu'n pondal ajotpaija atahsa puma hinna lam thah eisempeh uva chu,","title":"Tahsan Naphon doh-u Chu Tuhchah Jingun"},"20":{"text":"Jesu thisan vanga Mun Thenga lut ngamna ineiju ahin,"},"21":{"text":"Pathen insung chunga kitung thempulen chungnung ineiju ahin,"},"22":{"text":"Chule ase apha ihetnao ilung sunguva aphalou chengse atheh ngima, itahsao twi thenga kisilngima ahitah jeh chun, lung dihtah pun tahsan kichentah-in Pathen kom naiju hitin,","ref":"Thmpu 8:30; Ezek 36:25"},"23":{"text":"Itahsan, ikinepnao hi long louhelin tuh det jinguhite; (ajeh chu thutep pa chu tahsan umtah ahi.)"},"24":{"text":"Chule ngailutna le thilpha bolna lama lungsoudohna dingin kingaitopeh chehjiu hite;"},"25":{"text":"Abang khattou chonna bangin ikikhop hai louvin, nikho chu ahungnai tultulle ti ihet chanun, khatle khat kitilkhouto chehjiuhite."},"26":{"text":"Ajeh chu eihon thutah hetna inei nungun, ihenasale ijanasan chonset bol leuhen, chonset jala longlhenna akikheh umtalou ahin;","title":"Tahsan Vanga Chonpha-a Kisim Chu Hingding Ahi"},"27":{"text":"Thutanna kichat umtah ngah jinga chule adouho kavam gam dingkon lungsatna meikong bou uma ahi.","ref":"Isai 26:11"},"28":{"text":"Koi hile Mosi danthu nahsahmo-a chu ahetoh mi ni le thum kam sung thua kona hepina beihela thia ahi.","ref":"Danb 17:6; 19:15"},"29":{"text":"Chuti ahile Pathen Chapa akengtoa chotpha, chule akisuh thengna kitepna thisan chu atheng louva ngaito-a, chule lungsetna Lhagao nahsahmo-a bola chu nangho lunggela, hiche sanga chu ichana khoh chungchon talent man ding dola nakilomsah um?","ref":"Pot 24:8"},"30":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile, Phulah ding chu keija ahi; keimanbou phuba chu kasah ding ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije; chukitle, Pakai chun amite thu atan ding ahi, tia hicheng seija chu keihon kaheuve.","ref":"Danb 32:35,36"},"31":{"text":"Pathen hing khutna chuh chu kichat umtah ahi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi vangin nanghon masanga khovah namu nunguva hesoh genthei thoh hahsa nathoh laiju chu geldoh jingun."},"33":{"text":"Langkhatna housetle hesoh genthei thoh hahsa thoh laiju, chule alangkhatna hesoh genthei thoh lah-a nahung pannu chu geldoh jingun."},"34":{"text":"Ajeh chu nanghon kakihenna ho-a jong neina khotouvin, chule gamchenga phajole imatih chana umjing van'a gou naneiju chu naheuvin, naneiju kichom chu kipahtah-in nanatoh jengtaovin ahi."},"35":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun chonphatman lentah nei dinga nahakat nao chu pailha hihhelun."},"36":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile nanghon thutep chu nasan theina dinguva, Pathen lung deilam nabol uva pontho tah-a nathohhat dingu angaije."},"37":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile chomcha khat joule Ahung dinga chu hung ding ahi, Hung geisang lou ding ahi.","ref":"Habk 2:3-4."},"38":{"text":"Michonpha vang chu atahsan vanga hing ding ahi; Chule anungchon vangle achunga kalung lhai lou ding ahi, ati."},"39":{"text":"Ahin eiho vang manthah na lama nungchon ho lah-a mi ihipouvin, lhagao huhhing-a umna dinga tahsan ho lah-a joh ihibovui."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tahsan hi kinepna thilho hetchetna, mu lou thil aum monge ti photchena ahi.","title":"Tahsan"},"2":{"text":"Ajeh chu hiche thua hi upahon hettohsahna ananeiju ahi."},"3":{"text":"Tahsan vangin vannoi leiset hi Pathen thua kisuto-a kisema ahi ti iheuve; chuti chu ahin, thil kimuho chengse hi thil kilanghoa kona kisem ahipoi.","ref":"Semt 1:1; Labu 33:6,9; Jhn 1:3."},"4":{"text":"Tahsan vangin Abel'in Cain sangin thensona longlhen phajo alhan, ama chu michonpha ahi ti hettohsahna ananeijin, athilpeh thudol Pathen'in ahettohsah-in: chule hiche vang chun ama athisa ahivangin thu aseije.","title":"Abel, Enoch le Noah Tahsan","ref":"Semt 4:3-10."},"5":{"text":"Tahsan vangin thina amu louna dingin Enoch chu lah mangin aumtan; Pathen'in alah mangtah jeh chun ama chu akimutapon ahi; lah manga aum masangin Pathen lungtoh mitah ahi ti hettohsahna ananeijin ahi.","ref":"Semt 5:21-24."},"6":{"text":"Ahin tahsan beija vang Pathen lung tohoi ahipoi; ajeh chu Pathen aume chule ama holte chu tohphat man apei ti chu ama kom naijan atahsan dingdol thu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Tahsan vangin Noah'in mu loulai thilsoh ding thuah hilchahna thu amun, Pathen ngaisahna neijin akichan, ama insung mi huhhingna dingin kong innei khat asan ahi; chule hiche vang chun vannoi themmo achansah-in ama tahsana chonphat chu achangtan ahi.","ref":"Semt 6:13-22."},"8":{"text":"Tahsan vangin Abraham, akikou chun, alo dinga um mun'a chu lut dingin potdohna ding thun anungin ahi; chule hoilama ache ding jong helouvin akipatnin achedoh jengtan anahi.","title":"Abraham Tahsan","ref":"Semt 12:1-5."},"9":{"text":"Tahsan vangin gamtep gama chun mi gama pem bangin apem jengtan ahi; chuche gamtep chu alopi ding Isaac le Jacob toh pon in'ah acheng khomin anahi.","ref":"Semt 35:27"},"10":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile aman, abul nei khopi, asemtohle asadoh Pathen, hichu anga jing ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tahsan vangin Sara'in jong ateh nungin, athuteppa chu tahsan umtah-a angaito jeh chun nao vop theina aneitan, chule chapang khat apengtan ahi.","ref":"Semt 18:11-14; 21:2."},"12":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun athikon khatna konin van'a ahsi jatle twikhanglen kama neldi jatna tam, simsenlou apengdoh jengtan ahi.","ref":"Semt 15:5; 22:17; 32:12"},"13":{"text":"Hiteho chengse chu tahsan neijin athigam taovin ahi, thutep thilteho chu achang lou ahitaove, ahivangin hiteho chu gamlatah-a pangin amuvin, akolchah-un, chule amaho chu leiset chunga kholjinle gamdang mi ahiu chu aseidoh uvin ahi.","ref":"Semt 23:4; 1 Thusm 29:15; Labu 39:12."},"14":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile chutobanga thusei ho chun amaho gamtum ding aholu ahi ti chu aphondoh-u ahi."},"15":{"text":"Amahon ahung kondohnao gam chu lunga agel jingleu, akile kitna dingu phat gomkom anei dingu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahin tun amahon chuche sanga phajo nomjo khat atupmu ahin, hichu vangam ahi. Hiche jeh-a chu amaho Pathen tia kisei ding chu Pathen kijapi lou ahi; ajeh iham itile amaho dinga chu khopi khat gotsa akoi ahi."},"17":{"text":"Abraham patepmin aumin ahile, tahsan vangin Isaac atoh jengtan ahi; chule kipahtah-a thutep changpa chun, ajah-a,","ref":"Semt 22:1-14."},"18":{"text":"Isaac'a kona nachilhah kisei ding ahi, tia kisei achapa changkhatseh chu peh dingin ago jengin ahi;","ref":"Semt 21:12"},"19":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen'in athi lah-a kona jong akaithou thei ahi ti agel ahi; chule tekahnan ama chu achang kittan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Tahsan vangin Isaac'in khonunga hung lhung ding thuah Jacob le Esau phatthei aboh-in ahi.","ref":"Semt 27:27-29,39-40."},"21":{"text":"Tahsan vangin Jacob chun athi konin Joseph chapateni phatthei aboh gelin ahi; atenggol chunga akingamin Pathen alhaijin ahi.","ref":"Semt 47:31—48:20."},"22":{"text":"Tahsan vangin Joseph'in khonunga Israel chate Egypt gama kona apotdoh dingu thu aseijin ama gu thudolah thu apen ahi.","ref":"Semt 50:24-25; Pot 13:19."},"23":{"text":"Mosi apenin, naosen chu hoi asa lhonin tahsan vangin anule apan lha thum asel lhonin; chule lengpa thupeh jong akicha lhonpon ahi.","title":"Mosi Tahsan","ref":"Pot 2:2; 1:22."},"24":{"text":"Chuin Mosi akikhanlhit phatnin, tahsan vangin Pharaoh chanu chapa tia kiminvo ding adan;","ref":"Pot 2:10-12."},"25":{"text":"Aman chomkhat chonsetna nomsah sangin Pathen mite toh bol hesoh thoh khom ding chu alhengjotan ahi."},"26":{"text":"Egypt gama gou jouse sangin Christa ahousetnau chu chung nungjon agelin ahi; ajeh chu aman tohphat man asan ding lam jeng chu avet ahi."},"27":{"text":"Tahsan vangin aman lengpa lungsat ding chu kicha louvin Egypt gam adalhan ahi; ajeh iham itile aman mu theiloupa chu amu bangin athoh lhumkei jengin ahi."},"28":{"text":"Chule asoh masa chengse that chun amaho asuhkhah louna dingin, tahsan vangin kalchuh kut asemin, chule thisan thekhum abolin ahi.","ref":"Pot 12:21-30"},"29":{"text":"Tahsan vangin amahon tolgo bangin twikhanglen San chu ajot gal kaijun, Egypt miten chutia bol ding chu agouvin ahile, twijin achuplih gamtaovin ahi.","title":"Israel Sunga Tahsana hat Dangdang ho","ref":"Pot 14:21-31."},"30":{"text":"Tahsan vangin Jeriko khopi kul, ni sagi avelun ahile, akulpi chu achimtai.","ref":"Thutn 6:12-21."},"31":{"text":"Tahsan vangin Rahab notinun gam velhiho lungmong tah-in a-in'a alhunsah-in ahile, thua nunglouho toh amantha tapon ahi.","ref":"Thutn 2:1-21; 6:22-25"},"32":{"text":"Akal ipi kasei dingham? Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, chule themgaoho, hiteho thu umchan seisohkei leng phatnin ato lou ding ahi.","ref":"Thutn 6:11—8:32; 4:6—5:31; 13:2—16:31; 11:1—12:7; 1 Sam 16:1—1 Leng 2:11; 1 Sam 1:1—25:1."},"33":{"text":"Amaho chun tahsan vangin gamtin loinemin alauvin, chonphat abolun, thutep ga achangun, keipi bahkai kam ahuh uvin,","ref":"Dan 6:1-27"},"34":{"text":"Meihat achen daijun, chemhema konin asohchaovin, hatmoa konin ahat taovin, galsatnin hattah ahitaovin, apang khom agalteu anojam gamun ahi.","ref":"Dan 3:1-30."},"35":{"text":"Numei hon amithisa chengu hingdoh kit akimu kit taovin ahi; chule adangho chu thokitna phajo chungnung aneina dinguva, ahuhdoh dingu chu anom pouvin ahile, bol gentheijin aumtaovin ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 17:17-24; 2 Leng 4:25-37"},"36":{"text":"Abang kimkhatman engbol le jep athoh-un, bulputle songkul'a khumin patepmin aumun ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 22:26-27; 2 Thusm 18:25-26; Jer 20:2; 37:15; 38:6"},"37":{"text":"Amaho chu songin asepjiuvin, thing atnin a-at tanun, patepmin aumun, chemjamin athatnun, kelngoi vunle kelvuna kivonin avahleuvin, lhasamle hesoh gentheijin bolsetnin anaumun","ref":"2 Thusm 24:21"},"38":{"text":"(vannoi leiset amaho umnahoi ahipon), gamthip laija, molle lhang-ah, songko ho-a, chule leiko homa avahleuvin ahi."},"39":{"text":"Hicheteho chun tahsan vanga hettohsahna anei vangun thutep ga achang tapouvin ahi:"},"40":{"text":"Ajeh chu eiho beija amaho chu suhchamkima aum louna dinguva Pathen'in eiho dinga thilphajo khat gotsa akoi ahi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun eihon jong hettohsahna meipi nasatah-in eium kimvel jeh-u hin einoh phahsah jouseule ichunguva kai jing chonsetna hi pailhau hitin imasanguva um kilhaitetna lampia hin thohhat tah-in lhaijuhite;","title":"Jesu Chu Tahsan Vetkah Pipen"},"2":{"text":"Chule itahsan suhchamkim leh lamkai pipuipen Jesu lam kat jingu hite; aman amasanga thanopna aum jeh chun jumle maimohna nahsah louvin, thingpel geijin athoh lhumkeijin Pathen laltouna jet lamah atoutan ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun lhagao lama nalel uva nalhahdah louna dingun, chonse hon ama douna-a nelkalna thu aseiju thoh lhumpa chu gelun."},"4":{"text":"Nangho chonset douna-in thisan sohleuvin napang hih laijuve;"},"5":{"text":"chule, tilkhouna dinga nangho chapate dolla nakiseipeh nao nasuhmilu ahitai. Kachapa, Pakai gimbolna ngaisah louvin bol lou jenin, Chule aman nasosal tengle lhahdah nan neihih helin,","title":"Pathen Mijepna","ref":"Job 5:17; Thuch 3:11-12."},"6":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pakaiyin angailut chu agimbolji ahi, Chule aman alah chapa chengse chu ajepjin ahi, tia chapa houva nahounao tilkhouna chu nanghon nasumil taovin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Nanghon nathoh-u chu nakisungse nao ahi; Pathen'in achapate bola nabolu ahi; ajeh iham itile apa sungse lou chapa koiham?"},"8":{"text":"Chate jousen athoh cheh sungsena-a chu naum louvule, nangho jaocha nahiu ahi, chatetah hilou nahiuve."},"9":{"text":"Chuche kalvalin, eihon tahsa lama eisungse dingu pate inaneijun, amaho chu inaging lhehji uvin ahi: chuche sanga chu ihinna dinguva, lhagaoho Pa thua chu ihanun cheh lou dinguham?"},"10":{"text":"amaho chun ni chomcha khat dinga amaho phasah sah-a eina sungse tahbehjiu ahin, ama vang chun eiho phatchomna dinga, ama thenna chu ichan theina dinguva eigimboljiu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Gimbolna jouse hi apetle lungnopna ahipoi, lhasetnan akigelbove; ahivangin khonungle hichea kon chun chutia gimbolna umho ding chun aga lungmon umtah chonphat asohjin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun nanghon khut kikhailha leh khup ngoite chu je jangun;","title":"Tilkhouna le Hilchahna","ref":"Isai 35:3."},"13":{"text":"chule elbai lamvaite lampia kona nodoh-a um louva, boldama aumjohna dingun, nakho lhahna diu lampi kisem jangun.","ref":"Thuch 4:26"},"14":{"text":"Mi jousetoh kichamdela umnale thenna chu delun, hiche thenna tailouva chu koiman Pakai chu amu lou ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Kihong phaovin, ajole mikhat tou Pathen lungset changlel umkhantin; thilkha jung hungdon doh-in sumovin natin, mi tamtah suh boh-in umget inte;","ref":"Danb 29:18"},"16":{"text":"Ahi loule khatvei neh mana apenpi agou lo ding joh-a Esau banga Pathen ja loule akideija, ajonga, umget inte.","ref":"Semt 25:29-34"},"17":{"text":"Ajeh chu Esau chun khonungin phattheina gou chu lo ding alunggot tena mitlhi puma gunchu tah-a ahol vangin, lungheina gomkom amu lou jeh-in, paijin aumtan ahi, ti naheuve.","ref":"Semt 27:30-40"},"18":{"text":"Nangho molsang tohkhah theile meija ka, meivom, muthim, khopihui,","ref":"Pot 9:16-22; 20:18-21; Danb 4:11-12; 5:22-25"},"19":{"text":"sumkon gin chule thu kisei awginna-a hung nahipouve. Hiche awgin jateho chun ajah uva thu dang kiseibe louna dingin ataovun ahi:"},"20":{"text":"Ajeh chu ganhing jengin jong mol chu atohkhah-a ahile, songa selih jeng ding ahi loule tenga sutlih jeng ding ahi tia thupeh chu amahon athoh thei louhelu ahi;","ref":"Pot 19:12-13"},"21":{"text":"Chule hiche thilmu chu kichat um behseh jeng ahin, Mosi'n, keima kakicha behseh jengin kakihot hot jengin ahi, ati.","ref":"Danb 9:19"},"22":{"text":"Ahivangin nangho vang Sion mol, Pathen hing khopi, van Jerusalem, vantil sangsom sangja umna mun'a hunga nahiuvin,"},"23":{"text":"Van'a amin kisun apeng masaho khoppi len le houbung heng, mi jouse thutan Pathen heng, chule michonpha lhagao suhchamkima umho henga,"},"24":{"text":"Kitepna thah palai Jesu henga, chule Abel'a sanga phatna chungnungjo thusei thisan thekhum henga hungjoh nahibouvui.","ref":"Semt 4:10"},"25":{"text":"Chingtheijun, thuseipa chu jopda khauvinate. Ajeh chu leiset chunga thupepa jop loubon asochat louva ahile, van'a kona van thupepa akon chun kiheimang leuhen, sohcha louhel ding ihiuve.","ref":"Pot 20:12."},"26":{"text":"Hichea chu a-aw ginin vannoi leiset aho ling jeng ahi; tu vangin aman thu atepmin, Keiman khatvei vannoi leiset jengseh hilouvin, van jong kaho ling kit ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Hag 2:6"},"27":{"text":"Hichea, Khatvei kaho ling kit ding ati hin, long lou thilteho chu aum jingna dinga; thil kisem, thil longho chonmanga umding ahi, ti hetsahna ahi."},"28":{"text":"Hijeh hin eiho long lou gam changa ihitah jeh-u hin, lungsetna neijuhite, hiche vanga chu eihon ginle ja tho-a Pathen lunglhaina lhacha ipan theiju ahi;"},"29":{"text":"Ajeh chu eiho Pathen chu kavamthei mei ahi.","ref":"Danb 4:24"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sopi kingailutna hi umjompeh jinghen.","title":"Pathen Iti Lunglhaisah Dingham"},"2":{"text":"Nanghon maljin phatbol ding chu sumil hih helun; ijeh-inem itile chuti bola konin mi kimkhatnin het louhelin vantil alhunsah-un ahi.","ref":"Semt 18:1-8; 19:1-3"},"3":{"text":"Akihenteho chu nakihenpin gel unlang he jingun; nangho jong tahsa-a um nahiu heuvin lang hesoh genthei thohte chu he jingun."},"4":{"text":"Mi jouse lah-a kichen hi ja umhen, chule ajalkhun jong suhboh-in umdahen; jonpanle miji toh jongho thu Pathen'in achung thu atan ding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Sum ngailut lung po hih helun; nanei sunuva chun lunglhaijun; ajeh chu amatah-in, Keiman nangma iti nama jongle lhaponge, changlha jong changlha pong-e, ati.","ref":"Danb 31:6,8; Josh 1:5."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun eihon, hakat tah-a, Pakai chu eipanpi ahi, keima kichaponge, Mihemin keima i-eilo dingham? iti thei dingu ahi.","ref":"Labu 118:6."},"7":{"text":"Pathen thu nahiluva nachung uva navaipo teo chu geldoh jingun; chule amaho nunle khana kona sohdoh gelunlang, amaho tahsan umchan chu thovin."},"8":{"text":"Jesu Christa chu janhi, tuni, chule atonsotnin abang ahi jingin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Thuhil kidang got chomchom kilhoh mangsah loujenun; lung hi lungsetna-a phudet aphai; anneh-a phudet ding ahipoi, hiti anneh thua chonna lungkhamteho chun phatchomnan aneidehpouve."},"10":{"text":"Houbuh sunga lhachalehon aneh thei lounao, maicham ineijun ahi."},"11":{"text":"Thempu chungnungin chonset thensona-a Mun Theng sunga achoi lutji ganchaho long chu kulpi polama agouvam jiuvin ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 16:27"},"12":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu Jesu'n jong ama thisan mihemte suhthengna dinga khopi kotpi polama thina athoh ahitai."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun hungun, ama ahousetnau chu pou hitin, kulpi polamah ama hengah cheohite."},"14":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile hikoma hin khomundet ineipouve, khonunga khopijoh chu iholu ahibouve."},"15":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun ama vangin vahchoina kithoina chu Pathen henga pe jinguhite, hichu amin jala kipathu iphon dohnao ikamuva kona aga chu ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahin phatna bolle thilpeh phala kihomdela thilbol chu sumil loujenun; ijeh-inem itile chutobang kithoina chunga chun Pathen alunglhai behsehjin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nachung uva vaipoho thun nungun, anoijuvah lutnun; amaho chu umchan thu seitoh-a pang ding ahi jeh-u chun, hichu lung nommo-a bol louva lunglhaisela abol theina dinguva, nangho lhagao ahon jingu ahi; lungnom mon nachung uvah thu seileu, nangho dinga khoh ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Keiho neitao peh-un; ajeh chu keihon ase apha hetna thengtahle ijakaija kituptah-a chondih tup lung kaneijui, ti kakihet chenun ahi.","title":"Thuchaina"},"19":{"text":"Chule nangho heng lama eiki lhadoh vah chehna dinga eitaopeh dinga, nangho atumbeh-a kahin ha ngehdeh nahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Chamna Pathen tonsot geija umjing kitepna thisana kelngoi ching pipu I-Pakaiyu Jesu chu athi lah-a kona puidoh kit chun, ama lunggot lam bol dingin,"},"21":{"text":"nangho phatna lam jouse-a sucham kimun; ama mitvetna alunglhaina lam jouse-a Jesu Christa vang chun nangho-ah molsohen; loupina atonsot atonsot geijin umjing hen, Amen."},"22":{"text":"Sopite, naheng uva kahungtao ahi, kitilkhou na thuhi angai themun; ijeh-inem itile keiman nangho henga paltana kahinsut ahi."},"23":{"text":"Isopiu Timothy alhadoh taove, hichu anaheuvin; ama ahung vah-a ahile, keima amatoh hung lhoningting nangho mutange."},"24":{"text":"Nachung uva vaipoho le mithengho chengse chu kasalam anapeuvin. Italy gam mihon salam napeuve."},"25":{"text":"Nabon chaova chungah lungsetna umhen. Amen."}}}}},"59":{"info":{"name":"Jacob","shortname":"Jac","abbr":[],"desc":"Jacob Lekhat"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa soh Jacob'in, akithe cheh-a phung somle phung ni henga, salam.","title":"Salam","ref":"Matt 13:55; Mrk 6:3; Sol 15:13; Gal 1:19."},"2":{"text":"Kasopiho, nangho patepna tintanga nachuh tengule, hichu kipanan gelun;","title":"Tahsan Le Chihna"},"3":{"text":"Natahsanu kipatep chun thohhat asosah chu heuvin."},"4":{"text":"Ahin nangho lhahsamna beihela nacham kimuva, napum lhin theina dingun, thohhatna chun anatoh tong chamkim molsohen."},"5":{"text":"Nalah uva khattou chihna-a lhasama aumle, it louhel le house louhela peji-a Pathen henga thumhen; chuteng kipe ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amavang ginchat lelna neilouhelin, tahsanna neitah-in thumhen; agingcha lela chu twikhanglen kinong hui mut lonle tobang ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chutobang mi chun Pakaiya konin ima mu neijinge tin kinepda hen."},"8":{"text":"Lungtho nei michu achonna lam jouse-a detna nei lou ahi."},"9":{"text":"Dinmun nemcha neija sopi chun choisanga aum jehchun kipah hen;","title":"Vaichatna Le Haona"},"10":{"text":"Ahin mihao chun suhnema aum jehchun kipah hen: ajeh chu hampa pah banga ama chu mangthah ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 40:6,7"},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu nisa satah-a ahung soteng, asat chun hampa louhing asanggojin, chule apah apul lhan, alimso hoi jong chu amangthah jitan ahi; chutobanga chu mihao jong alamlhah tinchenga molmang diu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Lhepna thoh ham hama chu anunnom ahi; ajeh chu lhep patepna chu ajoa them achan jouva ahile Pakaiyin ama ngailuho peh dinga athutepsa hinna lallukhuh chu apeh ding ahi.","title":"Patepna Le Lhepna"},"13":{"text":"Ahin lhepna-a nachuh tengule, Pathen'in eilhep ahi tin koiman seida hen: ajehchu Pathen chu ase lama kilhem patep theilou ahin, chule amanjong koimacha alhep patep lou ahi."},"14":{"text":"Mi ama ama lung ngaichat thillin ajol lhah-a, aloi lutji-a, lhepna-a chujia ahibouvui."},"15":{"text":"Chule alung ngaichat phalou chu naovop banga avopji teng chonset ahinji ahi; chule chonset chu apilhin tengle thina sohjia ahi."},"16":{"text":"Kasopi ngaiteho dohan lhalou jenun."},"17":{"text":"Thilpeh pha jousele phattheina chamkim chu chunga kon ahi, chule kikhelna le le-lim banga kihei jilou vahho Pa-a kona hung kumlhaji ahi."},"18":{"text":"Athilsemho lah-a eiho hi aga masa loi khat ihi theina dinguva, aman ama lunggot doltah-a thutah-a chu eihinu ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun, kasopi ngaitahho, amitakip angaina lama gang cheh hen, thu sei lama ngaikham cheh hen, chule lungsatna lama jong ngaikham cheh hen;","title":"Thujah Le Natoh"},"20":{"text":"Mihem lunghanin Pathen chonphatna asodoh sahpoi."},"21":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun nanghon thenlouna jousele chon gitlouna long let chu puilhau vinlang, nalhagao huhhing theija thu kiphutsa chu lungnemin sangun."},"22":{"text":"Ahin nangho nangmale nangma kilhem lha-a thu chu angai mai jeng hilouvin, thu chu abolajoh hiuvin."},"23":{"text":"Ijeh ham itile thu angai mai mai hia abola hilou mi khattou aumle, ama chu phatvet maija apenpi alim vea mi tobang ahi:"},"24":{"text":"Ajeh chu ama akiven achemangjin, chule ama chun alim itobang ahi apettah chule asumil jitan ahi."},"25":{"text":"Ahin chamkimkei chamlenna danthu chu vea, chua aum jom jinga, athu chu ngaija sumil mi hilouva, abola pang mi vang chu, hiche mipa chu athilbola chu nunnom ding ahi."},"26":{"text":"Nalah uva mi khattou ama hou ngaisah mi-a kingaito-a, alei tuhtang louva, ama lungthim kilheplhah-a aumle, hiche mipa chun ahou chu moh ahi."},"27":{"text":"Pa le Pathen anga houdan thengle kisuhboh lou chu: Nulou palouho le meithaiho agenthei ahesoh naova vila, chule vannoi leisetna kona boh beh louhela kithenso chu ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kasopite ho, loupi Pakai, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa tahsanna chu mi dat neilou jennun.","title":"Langnei Jeh-a Gihsalna"},"2":{"text":"Ajehchu naki khopnao in'a mi khat sana khutjem kibua, ponhoi lul kisil hunghen lang; chule pon sedihdeh kisil mivaicha khat jong hunghen lang;"},"3":{"text":"Nanghon ponhoi lul silpa chu jabolun lang, Nangma hilaija hin nomtah-in touvin, tiuvinlang, mivaichapa jah-a chun, Nangma khukoma khun gadingin, ahiloule, kakeng todopma hin touvin, tileu chun:"},"4":{"text":"Nangho nanghole nangho lah-a mi dat nanei uva, lung gilou pu-a vai nahomu hilou dingham?"},"5":{"text":"Kasopi ngaiteho, ngai phaovin, vannoi leisetna mi vaichaho chu Pathen'in tahsan na-a hao dingle, ama ngailuho peh dinga atepsa gam chu lo dinga alhendoh hilouham?"},"6":{"text":"Ahinla nanghon mivaicha chu noise tah-in nabol uvin ahi. Mihaoho chun nabolset jiuva, thutan na-a nakai lutjiu hilou ham?"},"7":{"text":"Chule amaho chun nakikou nao min ja umtah chu ataitomu hilouham?"},"8":{"text":"Pathen lekhabu dan thu dungjuija, Naheng nakoma chu nangma naki ngailut bangin ngailun, ti Leng dan chu subulhit nahiu vangle, nabolu apha lheh jenge;","ref":"Thmpu 19:18."},"9":{"text":"Ahin dat naneiju vangle achonsea nahiuvin, chule dan sukhel tia danthu dungjuija themmo changa nahiuve."},"10":{"text":"Ahin mikhatnin dan thupeh chengse nitsoh hen, khatpenah kisumo taleh, aboncha chunga themmo changa ahitai."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu, Jon pan hih-in tia seipa chun, Tolthat hih-in, tia jong asei ahi. Hijeh chun tun nangman jon panhih-in lang, ahin tolthat lechun, nangma danthu suhkeh chu nahi ahitai.","ref":"Pot 20:13,14; Danb 5:17,18"},"12":{"text":"Chamlenna danthu-a athu kitan dingho thusei bangin thu seijun lang, chutima chun bolun."},"13":{"text":"Mi chunga hepina neilou chu, hepina neilou hela athu kitan ahi; hepina chun thutanna chunga jona anei ahi."},"14":{"text":"Kasopite ho, mi khattouvin katahsan aume tihen lang, anatohla um hihhen hile, hichu ipi-a phachom dingham? Hiche atahsan chun huhhing theijintem?","title":"Tahsan le Natoh"},"15":{"text":"Sopipa khat ahim, sopinu khat ahim pon beijin umhen, chule anikho anneh lhasamin umhen,"},"16":{"text":"Nangho khatnin amaho jah-a chun, Lung mongin chen, lum sanlang vaset tan, tiuvin; amaho chu tahsa ngaichat thil pe louvin umleu chun, hichu ipi-a phachom dingham?"},"17":{"text":"Hiche banga chu tahsan jong anatoh beija chu achanga athisa ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ahin mi khattouvin, Nangma natahsan aumin, keima kanatoh aume tinte: nanatoh beijin natahsan chu neivetsah temin, chule keiman natoh-a konin katahsan vetsah inge."},"19":{"text":"Nangman Pathen khatseh aumme ti natahsane; nabol hoije: thilhahon jong atahsanui, agina kihot hot ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Ahin, vo mi gichanglou, nangman anatoh beija tahsan athisa ahi chu nahet nom em?"},"21":{"text":"Ipuluiju Abraham'in achapa Isaac maicham chunga atodoh-a chu, hiche anatoh chu ama dinga chonphatna-a kisima hilou ham?","ref":"Semt 22:1-14"},"22":{"text":"Itobanga tahsan chun anatoh chu ahua, chule natoh vanga tahsan chu kisu chamkima ahi ti namuvem?"},"23":{"text":"Hichea chu, Abraham'in Pathen atahsanin, chule ama dingin hichu chonphatnan akisimtan ahi, ti Pathen lekhabua thu chu guilhunga ahi; chule ama chu Pathen jol tia kikou ahi.","ref":"Semt 15:6; 2 Thusm 20:7; Isai 41:8"},"24":{"text":"Tahsan jengseh vang hilouva, natoh vanga mi chonpha tia kisim ahi chu namuvin ahi."},"25":{"text":"Chule chutobangma chu Rahab notinu jong chun thupole ho chu a-in'a alhunsah-a, chua lam chom danga asolmanga ahile, hiche anatoh vanga chu amanu chu achonpha-a kisima hilouham?","ref":"Josh 2:1-21."},"26":{"text":"Lhagao beija tahsa athisa ahi banga, tahsan jong natoh beija athisa ahi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kasopite ho, midangho sanga eiho gihsajoa mo ichan dingu chu heuvin lang, tamtah mihil-in pang hih-un.","title":"Lei Thununa Tuhtan Ding"},"2":{"text":"Ajeh chu eiho ibon chaovin thil tamtah-a ikipaljiuve. Thua kipalna neilou chu mipha chamkim ahi; ama chu ati apumpia jong tuhtanga athua hei thei ahi."},"3":{"text":"Veuvin, sakol khu ithu nun theina dinga akama kamdal ivo-u ahi; chuteng apumpia igot gotna-a kihei thei ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kong-innei jong khu veuvin, lentah ahia, hui hat nasatah-in atol ahivangin, hichengpi chu ahehna neocha-a chu aheh heipan agotna lam lama aheile ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chutobanga chu lei jong hi tibah neocha khat ahi jeng vangin, hoithona thu nasatah aseijin ahi. Veuvin, mei themhal chan gam lentah iti akahsetji hitam!"},"6":{"text":"Lei hi mei ahi; tibah lah-a lei hi chonsetna dim vannoi leiset ahi; hichun ti pumpi hi asuhbohjia, penpi hinkho lampi chevelkolna hi akahsetjia, chule amatah damun meija kaji-a ahi."},"7":{"text":"Sa namkim, alha leng vacha namkim, ganhing namkim, gul namkim, twija cheng ganhing namkim vahngoi thei ahi sohkeijun, mihem vahngoi jin aumun ahi:"},"8":{"text":"Ahin lei vanghi koiman avahngoi theipoi; ama hi umthim thei lou gitlouna le thina gu dimset ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hichea chun Pathen le Pa chu ivahchoi jiuvin; hiche mama chun Pathen lima kisema mihemho isamse jiuve.","ref":"Semt 1:26"},"10":{"text":"Kamsung khatseh-a kon chun pachatna le sapsetna asoh khomjin ahi. Kasopite ho, hichu chuti dingdol ahipoi."},"11":{"text":"Twinah kohom khatseh-a khu twi atwi le akha put khomji am?"},"12":{"text":"Kasopite ho, theichang phunga Olive ga theijam? lengpi guija theichang ga theijam? hitichun twinah khat na konin chitui le twitheng aput khom theipoi."},"13":{"text":"Nalah uva michingle hetthem theina nei koiham? Ama chun umchan themin anatoh chu nunnem na le chihna-in vetsahhen.","title":"Chunga Kon Chihna"},"14":{"text":"Ahinla nalung sunguva kithangset hat le kilungdou naneiju vangle, kithang-at loujenun, chule thutah douna jou seihih-un."},"15":{"text":"Chutobang chihna chu chunga kona hung kumlha-a ahipoi; amavang leiset le tahsa-a chule Diabol'a kon ahibouve."},"16":{"text":"Kithangset le kilungdou umna-a chu kinahna le gitlouna um tei ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chunga kona hung kumlha-a chihna vang chu amasapena atheng ahin, chule abana kichamdel, lungnem, houlung dambai, hepina-a dim, chule ga pha, dat neilou le, phatlhemna umlou ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule chonphatna ga chu chambolteho chunga kichamdela kitu-a ahi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nalah uva gal kisatle kinahna hi hoija konham? Natibah lah uva nomsah ngaichatnaho kisatto-a kon chu hilouham?","title":"Vannoi Toh Kihouthei"},"2":{"text":"Nanghon nangaichauvin ahinla naneiji pouve; tol nathat jiuvin, neiding nagojiuvin, nanei theiji pouve; nakinaovin nakisatto jiuvin, ahinla nathumji lou jeh-un naneipouve."},"3":{"text":"Nathumun ahinla namu pouve; nangma nangma nomsah-a manchah nagotji jeh uva, nathumu nakhel jiu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Vo numei le pasal jongho, vannoi toh kihouthei hi Pathen to kigalna ahi ti helou nahiuvem? Hijeh chun koihile vannoi toh kihouthei go-a chu Pathen melma ahi."},"5":{"text":"Isunguva cheng Lhagao hin thangthipna angaichat ahi, tia Pathen lekhabua kisei khu kimohsei hija nangaitou ham?"},"6":{"text":"Chuti sangin lungsetna eipehbe jobovui. Hijeh-a chu aman, Pathen'in mi kiletsahho chu alethuhjin, mi kineosah ho lungsetna apei, tia asei ahi.","ref":"Thuch 3:34"},"7":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun nangho Pathen henga kipelut un. Diabol vang chu lethuh-un, chutile nakom uva konin jammang tante."},"8":{"text":"Pathen kom naijun, chutile Ama nangho kom hung nai ding ahi. Vo michonseho, nakhut suthengun; chule lungtho neihon, nalung sungu suthengun."},"9":{"text":"Kisih-un, lunghemun, chule kapmun; nanuiju chu kana chule nakipao chu lungkhamna soh hen."},"10":{"text":"Pakai mitmu-a kisunem mun, chutile aman nachoi sang dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Kasopite ho, kiseiseto hih-un. Koi hile asopi seise-a chule asopi thu khola oimo-a chu, dan thupeh seise-a, dan thupeh khola oimo-a ahi: ahin nangman danthu chu nakhola na-oimo vangle athu nit hilouva athu tanjoh nahi.","title":"Sopi Chunga Thutan Chungchanga Gihsalna"},"12":{"text":"Danthu pe-a khatsehbou aume, Ama chu huhhing thei jong sumang thei jong ahi. Ahin nangma koi nahi-a, midang thu natan ham?"},"13":{"text":"Tun veuvin, nangho mi kimkhatsen, Tunin ahim, jing ahimle, hiche khopi-a khun cheohitin kum khat gathamu hitin, kiveiju hitin, kivei kanu hite, nati uve.","title":"Kiletsah Chungchanga Gihsalna","ref":"Thuch 27:1."},"14":{"text":"Jinga ipi ahung so ding nanghon nahepouve. Nahinkhou chu ipiham? Twimei chomkhat kimu-a chujoule kimujita lou tobang khu nahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Chusangin, Pakai lunglam ahile, hingjing ungting, hiche na hi, khuche na khu tonging kate, tijovin."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla tun nanghon naham hoithonao chu naki thang-at piuve; hiche kithang-at naho chu phalou ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun mi koi hile thilpha bolje hena-a bol lou chu achonse ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tun, veuvin, mihaoho, nangho chunga hesoh gentheina hung chu ding chengpi jeh hin kapmun lang pengun.","title":"Mihaoho Gihsalna"},"2":{"text":"Nanei chengseu amon mangtai, naponu lungin anese joutai.","ref":"Matt 6:19"},"3":{"text":"Nasana nadangkau thih-eh souvin aneheng gamtan; chule chuche thih-eh chu nathemmonao hettohsah-a hungpanga, chule mei banga nasao aneh ding ahi. Nanghon ni nununga dinga gou nakholu ahi."},"4":{"text":"Veuvin, nalouva chang at sum thalo ho thaman, doha nabol uva napeh dahou chun kho asamun; chule chuche sum thalo chang at teho khosap chu Janel Pakai nabeng sunga aluttai","ref":"Danb 24:14-15"},"5":{"text":"Nangho vannoi leiset chunga nomsa le ninglhinga nachengun; kitha nikho-a bangin nalungu nasuthao vun ahi."},"6":{"text":"Nanghon michonpha chu themmo nachanun nathatnun; chule aman nangho nadou thuhpouve."},"7":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun, sopiteho, Pakai hung masangsen lungdehat jingun. Veuvin, loulhou mi khun aleiset ga lutah chu angahjin, gotwi lha masale gotwi lha nunung amu kahsen alungdehat jin ahi.","title":"Thohhat Dinga Tilkhouna"},"8":{"text":"Nangho jong lungdehat jingun; nalungu detsah jingun: ajeh chu Pakai hungna ding anaitai."},"9":{"text":"Vo sopiteho, oimo nachan louna dingun khatle khat kiphun loujenun; veuvin, thutanpa chu kot bula ading jinge."},"10":{"text":"Vo sopiteho, Pakai mina thu seidoh themgaoho chu hesoh genthei thoh le lungdehatna lama vettonin neijun."},"11":{"text":"Veuvin, dingdet jinga thoh lhumho khu eihon anunnom itiuve. Nanghon Job thohhat thu chu najaove; chule Pakaiya achaina umchan jong namu taove; Pakai chu khotonale mihepina-a dimset ahi.","ref":"Job 1:21-22; 2:10; Labu 103:8"},"12":{"text":"Ahin, sopiteho, imajouse lah-a apipen chu hiche ahi, kihahsel hih-un, van panin hijongle, leiset panin hijongle, kihahsel hih-un; chusang chun ahi natiu chu ahi hihen, hilou natiu chu hilou hijenghen; achuti loule themmo changin umkhaovin nate.","ref":"Matt 5:34-37."},"13":{"text":"Nalah uva athohgima umam? Ama chu taohen. Kipah thanoma umam? Vahchoina la Sahen.","title":"Taona Thahatje Umchan"},"14":{"text":"Nalah uva ana damlou umam? Ama chun houbung upaho kouhen; chule amahon Pakai minin ama chu thao nu-uhen, achunga taovuhen;","ref":"Mrk 6:13"},"15":{"text":"Chutile tahsana taona chun anapa chu damsah-intin, chule Pakaiyin ama chu akaithou ding; chule achonse ahi jongle, hichu suhbeija umding ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun nadam theina dingun, khatnin khat komah nasuhkhelnao phongun, khatle khat kitaopeh jiuvin. Michonpha mi taopehna chu thil nasatah bol thei ahi."},"17":{"text":"Elijah chu eiho penpi ngai banga hesoh genthei thoh mi ahivangin, gojuh louna dinga lunglut tah-a ataole, leiset chunga kum thumle lha gup gam sung go ajutapon ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 17:1; 18:1"},"18":{"text":"Chuin atao kitnin ahile, van'a konin go ahin juhsah-in, leijin aga asodohtan ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 18:42-45"},"19":{"text":"Kasopite nalah uva khattou thudih-a kona lamvaija auma, ama chu khattou ahinlepui lut kit aumle,"},"20":{"text":"Michonse alamvaina-a kona hinlepui kitchun thina-a kona lhagao khat ahuhhing ding ahin; chule chonset tamtah akhu ding ahi, ti kihet hen.","ref":"Thuch 10:12; 1 Pet 4:8"}}}}},"60":{"info":{"name":"1 Peter","shortname":"1 Pet","abbr":[],"desc":"Peter Lekha Thot Khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu Christa solchah Peter'in; Pontus gam, Galatia gam, Cappadocia gam, Asia gam, chule Bithynia gama kithecheh khopemho,","title":"Lemna"},"2":{"text":"Thua nung dingle Jesu Christa thisan thekhuma umdinga, Pa Pathen lunggot masah dungjuija, Lhagao suhtheng na-a kilhengdohho hengah: nachung uva lungsetnale lungmonna punghen."},"3":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa Pathen chu vahchoijin umhen; Jesu Christa athia kona athokit vanga amihepina chungnung dungjuija kinepna hing chang dinga eihinu ahin,","title":"Kinepna Hingjing"},"4":{"text":"Gou setheilou, thengsel, chule toi theilou nangho chan dinga van'a kikheh khola,"},"5":{"text":"Huhhing-a umdinga tahsan vanga Pathen thahat na-in achintup, phat nunung lamle hung kilangdoh dinga gotsa nahiuve."},"6":{"text":"Tu chomcha khat dinga, akhoh dungjuija, lhepna tintang jeh-a nalunghem jeng vangun, hiche-a hin hatah-in nakipah-un ahi:"},"7":{"text":"Meija akipatep jeng vanga jong mang thei sana sanga manlujo, natahsan nao kipatepna chu, Jesu Christa hung kilah teng vahchoina, choi-atna, chule loupina-a akimu theina ding ahi."},"8":{"text":"Ama chu mukha louhela ngailu-a nahiuve; tun jong ama chu namu louhel vangun natahsanun, kipana seitheilou le loupina-in nadimun ahi;"},"9":{"text":"Natahsan nao bulhina, nalhagaovu huhhingna ngeichu namu jeh-un."},"10":{"text":"Nachung uva lungsetna hung chuding hiche huhhingna thudol hi, gaova anaseidoh themgaoho chun akholuva, chule gunchu tena anaholuva;"},"11":{"text":"Christa thohgim dingje le nungle loupina-in ajom ding thudol Christa Lhagao amaho lung sunga uma chun aseipeh masah laijuva chu, itobang mi ahiloule itobang phat ahi ding anakholu ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Hiche chu amaho henga kiphong doh-a ahin, amaho le amaho changa dinga hilouva, tu-a van'a kona hinkisol Lhagao Thenga kona Kipana Thupha hillhang lehon najah uva aseiju thil chengsea hi amaho eiho lhachale-a pangjo-a ahiuve; thil hitiho hi vantil ten jong vet atupmu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Hijeh chun nalung kong kigah-unlang lung limgehchan umun, Jesu Christa ahung kilah tengle nachung uva lungsetna hung kilhut ding chunga chun nakinepnao ngaichamkimun.","title":"Hinkhothenga Hingdinga Kouna"},"14":{"text":"Malai nangol laijuva nalung ngaichat dungjuija nachonjiu banga chu chon louvin; sei ngaija thua nung chate chon doltah-in chonun;"},"15":{"text":"Ahin nakoupa athen bangin, nangho jong nunle khan jouse-a thengun;"},"16":{"text":"Ajeh chu, Keima kathen jeh hin nangho thengun, tin akisune.","ref":"Thmpu 11:44-45; 19:2"},"17":{"text":"Chule dat nei louhela mi jouse ama ama natoh dungjui cheh-a thutana chu Pa tia nakouvu ahile, hiche mun'a nakholjin lai sungseu hin ging khenchan hinkho mangun;"},"18":{"text":"Napute napateuva kona kilason chonna homkeova kona namu-u mangthei thil, sana le dangka-a kilhatdoh nahipouve;"},"19":{"text":"Amavang boh beh louhel le nolna beihel kelngoinou, Christa thisan lutah-a chu kilhatdoh jo-a nahi bouvui:"},"20":{"text":"Ama chu leiset kiphudoh masanga gotmasah sa anahin, amavang hiche phat kichai kona hi nangho dinga hung kilah ahi,"},"21":{"text":"Ama vanga chu nangho athi lah-a kona ama kaithou le loupina pe-a Pathen tahsan mite nahiu ahi; hichu natahsanu le nakinepnao chu Pathen'a aum theina ding ahi."},"22":{"text":"Lhagao jala sopi ngailutna daithei lou dinga, thutah thua nanun uva kona nahinnao nasuhthengu ahitah jehchun; khohsahna neitah-in khatle khat lungtheng selin kingailuto cheh-un;"},"23":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangho kem mang thei chia kon hilouva, kem mang theilou chi, tonsotna hingjing le umjing Pathen thua kona thah penkit nahiu ahi."},"24":{"text":"Ajeh chu, Mihem jouse hampa tobang ahi, Aloupina jouseu jong hampapah tobang bep ahi. Hampa agopjin, apah jong apuljitai;","ref":"Isai 40:6-8."},"25":{"text":"Pakai thu vang tonsot geija umjing jeng ahi. Najah uva kihil lhangle-a Kipana Thupha chu hiche hi ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hijeh chun gitlouna jouse, doha lheplhahna jouse, phatlhemna, thangset, chule kiseisetna jouse pailhauvin,","title":"Songpi Hingjing Le Namtheng"},"2":{"text":"Naosen sohthah bangin, thua kon bongnoi thengset chu ngaijin umun, hichea chu nakhan tou theina dingun;"},"3":{"text":"Nanghon Pakai chu milungset them ahi chu natep khah-u ahitah-a ahivangle.","ref":"Labu 34:8"},"4":{"text":"Mihem paija um hijongle, Pathen dinga lhentum le manlutah ahin, Ama henga chu songpi henga hung banga nahungu ahi,"},"5":{"text":"Nangho jong songhing ho banga, Jesu Christa vanga Pathen san thei doltah-a lhagao ganlhaina tohdoh-ah thempu theng hidinga, lhagao in'a kisadoh nahitaove."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun Pathen lekhabua hitin akisune, Veuvin, Sion'ah inning song pipen, lhentum, man lutah chu kadoi; Ama tahsana chu iti nama jongle jachatna-a chu lou ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Isai 28:16"},"7":{"text":"Hichu atahsana nangho dinga man lutah ahi; atahsan louho ding vanga hiti hi ahi, Insahon apaiju song chu Aninga apipena panga ahitai;","ref":"Labu 118:22."},"8":{"text":"chule, kipalna songle suhkhelna songpi soh-a ahitai; amahon thu chu angai loujeh uva kipala ahiuve; hiche dinga chu amaho gotsa jong ahiuve.","ref":"Isai 8:14-15."},"9":{"text":"Ahin muthima kona ama vah kidangtah sunga lut dinga nakoudohpao phatna chu naphondoh theina dinguva, nangho nam lhenchom, leng thempu, vaipi theng, chule ama-a tum hi dinga Pathen mite nahiu ahitai:","ref":"Pot 19:5,6; Isai 43:20,21; Danb 4:20; 7:6; 14:2; Tit 2:14; Isai 9:2."},"10":{"text":"Masanga chu mite hilou nahiu ahin, tu vangin Pathen mite nahitaove; hepina changlou nahiu ahin, tu vangin hepina changa nahitaove.","ref":"Hos 2:23"},"11":{"text":"Ngaitah teho, nangho mi gama cheng le kholjin tobang nahijeh uva naheng uva kahungtao ahi, tahsa ngaichat thil chengsea konin kikangseuvin; hitiho chu lhagaotoh kidou ahi.","title":"Pathen Sohte Nahiuve"},"12":{"text":"Chule chidang namdangho lah-a nanun nakhanu phatsah-un; chutile akhang gilou tia amahon nangho naseisetnao chu amittah-in nathilpha bolu chu muvintin, hiche thudol chu vettoh-a aum nile Pathen avahchoi dingu ahi."},"13":{"text":"Pakai jal-in mihem phudoh chondan thun nungun: mijouse chunga vaipo ahito lhonin, Lengpa thu ahin;"},"14":{"text":"Ahiloule mikhang gilouho chunga phula dingle, mi thilpha bolho pachatna pedinga ama hinsol gamvaipoho thun nungun."},"15":{"text":"Ajeh chu nanghon nathilpha boluva konin lungthim beiho ngolna chu thiphelin lhaleu chun, hichu Pathen lunglam ahi:"},"16":{"text":"Nangho chamlen chonin chonun, ahivangin hiche nacham len nao chu gitlou khunan nei hih-un; ahin Pathen sohte um doltah-in umjouvin."},"17":{"text":"Mi jouse jabol sohkeijun. Sopi tapou chu ngailuvin. Pathen gingun. Lengpa chu jabolun."},"18":{"text":"Sohteho, nangho gingkhen chan napakai te chengseu thunoija umun; apha le anunnemho heng jenga hilouvin, lunggilou puho thunoija jong umun.","title":"Christa Thohna Vetkah ding"},"19":{"text":"Mi khattou Pathen ahet jeh-in thohdol louhel thohgimhen, dihlou tah-a akibolna thohham hamle, Hichu pachat umtah ahi."},"20":{"text":"Nathemmona jeh-in min navo henlang, lungneng tah-in thohle chun, ipi pachatna nachan dingham? ahin thilpha nabola, hiche jeh-a chu nahesoh gentheija, lungneng tah-a nathoh-a ahile, hichu Pathen deilam ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ajehchu hiche-a dinga chu kikou nahiuve: ijeh inem itile Christan jong eiho dinga hesoh genthei athoh ahin, nangho akhonung jui nahina dinguva, hichu vettoh-a jui ding akoija adalhah ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ama chu achonsepon, akam sunga jong doha lheplhahna kimulou ahi:","ref":"Isai 53:9"},"23":{"text":"Houset achanin ahouse thuhpon; athohgim pet jong chun koima agihsalpon; ahin chonpha tah-a thutanpa khutna akingaijon ahi.","ref":"Isai 53:7"},"24":{"text":"Eiho chonset lama ithiuva chonphat lama ihinna dingun, Aman eiho chonset jouse atahsa chunga apon, thingleh geijin apodohtan ahi: ama kijepna maha-a chu nangho kiboldama nahitaove.","ref":"Isai 53:5"},"25":{"text":"Ajeh chu nangho kelngoi hon banga lamvaija nahiu ahin, tu vanga hi nalhagao chingpao le nakaihoipao henga hung kile kit nahitaove.","ref":"Isai 53:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche bang chun, inneipiho jouse na-inneipute cheh-u thunoija kipelut un; amaho abang khattou thua nunglou hijongleu, thua hilouva, a-inneipite chengu khanthem vanga akijo theina dingun;","title":"Inneipule A-inneipi","ref":"Eph 5:22; Col 3:18."},"2":{"text":"Nangho ging gehcha na-umu nanun nakhannu thengsel chu amit tah-a mu-u hen."},"3":{"text":"Sampheh hoi, sana khi-o, nihchen ponsil got chomchom tho-a polam jem-a kijem louvin,","ref":"1 Tim 2:9"},"4":{"text":"Lung sunga guhthim mi, nunnem le lungnem kem theilou jem chun kijem jouhen; hichu Pathen mitvetna man lutah ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajeh chu malaija numei theng Pathen'a kingaiho jong chu chutia chu kijema, a-inneipute chengu thunoija kipelutnu ahiuve:"},"6":{"text":"Hitia chu Sara'in Abraham chu pakai asah-a athua ananun banga; nanghon kichase louhela thilpha nabol uva ahile, ama chanuteho nahiu ahi.","ref":"Semt 18:12"},"7":{"text":"Chutobangma chun, inneipu teho, natao nao daltana aumlouna dingin, hinna lungsetna nachankhompiu ahiuto lhonin, numei chu belkehbai bangin jabolun lang, hetna dungjuijin amaho chu chenkhom piuvin.","ref":"Eph 5:25; Col 3:19."},"8":{"text":"Achainan, nangho nabonchaovin lungkhat hiuvin, kilainatto cheh-un, sopi khat bangin kingailuvin, kilungsetto themun, nunnem tah hiuvin.","title":"Adih Boljeh-a Genthei Thoh"},"9":{"text":"Set phu lahnan set bolhih helun; chule houset phu lahnan house thuh hih-un: chusangin phatthei bohjouvin; ajeh chu phattheina chu lo dinga nangho kikouva nahiuve ti heuvin."},"10":{"text":"Ajeh chu Mi koi hile hinkho ngailut ding noma, nikho phaho mu noma chun Gitlouna-a konin alei, chule milhep lhahna thu seija konin amuh tuhtanghen;"},"11":{"text":"Ama chu gitlouna konin kileheihen, thilpha bolhen; Chamna hol henlang, hichu nungdel peh hen."},"12":{"text":"Ajehchu Pakai mit chu michonpha ho chunga aumin, Ataonao ngaina-a ana asungin ahi; Ahin Pakai mai chun thil gilou bolho lam angat jingin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nangho apha chu juija nahi vangule, koiham nabol engse dinguva?"},"14":{"text":"Ahinla chonphat jala hesoh genthei thoh nahi vangule, anunnom nahiuve: chule amahon nasuh kichatnao chu kicha loujenun, lung jong lungdong hih-un;","ref":"Matt 5:20; Isai 8:12-13"},"15":{"text":"Chusangin nalunggil uvah Pakai Pathen chu sutheng jouvin: khattou nasunguva um kinepna thudol chu adonga auma ahile, amaho chu lungnemle ging gehcha donbut dingin phasademin um jingun:"},"16":{"text":"Sele pha hetna pha neijun; chutile Christa-a nahinkho manu adihlou tah-a seisehon thilphalou bol banga nachung uva athuseiju chu jahchatna anei dingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ajeh chu thilphalou nabol jeh uva genthei hesoh thoh sangin, Pathen lunggot lam ahile, thilpha nabol jeh uva nathoh gimu chu gamchenga phajo ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ajeh chu Christa'n jong chonsetna chengse jeh-a, chonphatah chun chonpha louho dinga, eiho chengse hi Pathen kom eilhut theina dinguva, khatvei hesoh genthei athohgim ahi; ama chu tahsa-a kithat ahin, amavang lhagaova hinga ahi:"},"19":{"text":"Chujongle lhagaova chea kul-a kihen lhagaoho henga thu agasei ahi;"},"20":{"text":"Amaho chu phatkhat lai, Noah nikho laija kong kisem lai sungse-a, Pathen lungdehatna-in anga laija chu thua nunglou anahiuva ahin, hiche kong'a chu mi themcha khat, miget sehbou twija anasohcha-a ahi.","ref":"Semt 6:1—7:24"},"21":{"text":"Hichu Jesu Christa thokit vanga isochatnao baptize channa lima kibol (hichu tahsa nen pailhah hilouva, Pathen heng lama sele pha hetna pha donbutna ahi;)"},"22":{"text":"Ama van'a akaltouvin Pathen jet lama aumtai;
