vantil chengsele, thuneina, chule thilboltheina thahat jouse ama thu noija uma ahitai."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuti chu ahin, Christa'n tahsa-a eihodia athohgim jeh chun, nangho jong chutobang lungput chun kivonun; ajeh chu tahsa-a thohgima chun chonsetna adalhah ahin;","title":"Hinkho Kikhel"},"2":{"text":"Chutia chu aphat umnalai chengse chu mihem lung ngaichat lama tahsa-a hing talouva, Pathen lunggot lama ahin johna ding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ajehchu nomsahna lung ngaichat, huh, juneh hat, julhang neh, nehkhom, thet umtah milim houna-a i-um laijuva chu, chidang namdangho lunggot lam bolna dinga iphatnu tamtah inamanu ahitan;"},"4":{"text":"Nanghon setna lama amaho chu nachon khompitah loujeh uva kidang asah uva, nahouset jiu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ahingle athi thutan dinga kigopa anga chu amahon achonnau asuhtoa apeh cheh dingu ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu amaho mihem dola tahsa-a athu-u akitana, lhagaova Pathen lungdeija ahin nadinguva, athisaho jahdinga jong Kipana Thupha chu kiseija ahitai."},"7":{"text":"Ahinla thil jouse hi abeina ding nikho anaitai; hiche jeh chun lunglim gehchan umun lang taojing dingin chingtheijun.","title":"Pathen Thilpeh Gou Chingpha"},"8":{"text":"Imajouse chungvuma gunchu tah-in khatle khat kingailutto nalah uva habolun; ajeh chu ngailutna hin chonset tamtah akhujin ahi;","ref":"Thuch 10:12"},"9":{"text":"Phunchel louhelin khatle khat kilhun sahton umun:"},"10":{"text":"Amitakip lungsetna thilpeh achan dungjui cheh-in, Pathen milungsetna gotchom chom tamtah gouching phaho bangin, khatle khat kijento jingin umun."},"11":{"text":"Thuseija aumle, ama chun Pathen kamsoh seijin seihen; chule mi jenlea aumle, Pathen'in apeh thahat dungjuijin jenlehen: chutia chu thil imajousea Jesu Christa vanga Pathen vahchoija aum theina dingin; Vahchoina le thuneina tonsot geija ama-a ahi. Amen."},"12":{"text":"Ngaiteho, nangho patepna ding patepna meikong chu thil kidang nachung uva hung chua bangin kidang sahih-un;","title":"Christian Hijeh-a Hesoh Genthei Thoh"},"13":{"text":"Nangho Christa hesoh genthei thohgim thoh khompi-a nahiu bangtah chun kipahjo uvin; chutia chu aloupina hung kilah tengle, kipana nasatah-a nakipa theina dingun."},"14":{"text":"Nangho Christa min jala houset nachanuva ahile, anunnom nahiuve; ajeh chu loupina Lhagao chule Pathen Lhagao chu nachung uva aume: amaho jal-in Ama seiset nin aumin, nangho jallin Ama choiat nin aume."},"15":{"text":"Nalah uva koiman toltha jeh ahim, guchat jeh ahim, khan gitlou jeh ahim, midang tohna chunga khut lha jeh ahimin, hesoh genthei thoh hihhen;"},"16":{"text":"Christian hi jeh-a hesoh genthei thohgima aum vangle, ama chun jachatnan nei hihhen; ahin hiche min jehchun Pathen choi-an johen."},"17":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen insunga kona thutanna ahung kipat nading phat chu ahitai: chule hichu eihoa akipatna ahile, Pathen Kipana Thupha thua nunglouho kichaina chu iti tantem?"},"18":{"text":"Michonpha bon huhhing-a aum ahahsatna ahile, Pathen ngaisah louho le michonse hon hoija amaiju alahdoh dingu hitam?","ref":"Thuch 11:31"},"19":{"text":"Chuti ahi jeh chun Pathen lunglam dola hesoh genthei thohgimho chun thilpha bolin alhagaovu chu tahsan umtah asempa henga bangin ama henga pedoh-u hen."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nalah uva um upaho chengse chu, Christa hesoh gentheina hettohsah-a, chule loupina hung kilang ding chankhompi, na-upat chankhompiu keiman kahin til nahiuve:","title":"Pathen Kelngoi Hon"},"2":{"text":"Nalah uva Pathen kelngoi hon umho chu phaten chingphaovin, bollou phamo tia bol louvin, lung chamin bolun; alam louva phatchom ngaichatna-a jong hilouvin, lung guttenin bolun;","ref":"Jhn 21:15-17"},"3":{"text":"Chule Pathen gouloho chunga kipipuisah louvin, ahon chun avettoh-a ajui dingu joh-in umun, kaihoijun."},"4":{"text":"Chutile Aching pipupa hung kilah tengle, nanghon chul theilou loupina lallukhuh chu nasan dingu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chutobangma chun khangdong ho, nangho upaho thunoija kipelut un. Chule nangho nabonun khatle khat kithununto cheh-un lang, kineosah na-in kivonun: ajeh chu Pathen'in mikiletsah ho adoudalin, mi kineosah ho lungsetna achanjin ahi.","ref":"Thuch 3:34."},"6":{"text":"Hijeh chun Aman aphatcha nangho nachoisang theina dingun, Pathen khut thahat tah noija chun nem heochan umun:","ref":"Matt 23:12; Luk 14:11; 18:14"},"7":{"text":"Nalungkham najouseu ama chunga sep lha uvin; ajeh chu aman nakhankho dingu agelnai."},"8":{"text":"Limgehchan umun, kihongphauvin, ajehchu nakidou piu diabol chu keipi bahkai kituma banga, koi kaval lhum theidem, tia hollea vahlea ahi;"},"9":{"text":"Tahsan dettah-in ama chu douvun; vannoi leiset chunga um nasopi ho chengseu chunga jong chutobang thohgim chu chusohkeija ahi chu heuvin."},"10":{"text":"Chule lungsetna jouse Pathen, tonsot tonsot geija um aloupina-a dinga Christa Jesu jala nakoupao tahchun, chomkhat nathohgim jou tengule, nasuh chamkimuva, naphudet uva, nahatsah uva, chule nachendet sah dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Tonsot atonsot geijin loupinale thuneina chu ama-a hijinghen, Amen."},"12":{"text":"Tahsantah sopi-a kangaito Silvanus khutna, nangho tilkhouna le hiche idin naohi Pathen lungset dihtah ahi ti jong hettohsah na-a, chomcha kahinsut ahi.","title":"Khumkhana Salam","ref":"Sol 15:22,40."},"13":{"text":"Nakilhen khompiu Babylon'a um houbung le, kachapa Mark'in nasalamui.","ref":"Sol 12:12,25; 13:13; 15:37-39; Col 4:10; Phlm 24."},"14":{"text":"Kingailut na-a kichopton khatle khat kisalam un. Christa Jesu'a um nangho, nabonchaova chungah lungmona umhen. Amen."}}}}},"61":{"info":{"name":"2 Peter","shortname":"2 Pet","abbr":[],"desc":"Peter Lekha Thot Nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu Christa soh le solchah Simon Peter'in, Pathen le eihuh hinguva Jesu Christa chonphat vanga tahsan lutah kachan bang changho hengah:","title":"Lemna"},"2":{"text":"Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Jesu hetna-a konin nachung uva lungsetle lungmon hapunin punghen."},"3":{"text":"Aloupina le aphatna-a eikoupau hetna vanga Pathen thahat chun hinna le Pathen ngaisahna lam thudolla thil jouse eipeh-u ahitai:","title":"Pathen Mikouna Le Milhenna"},"4":{"text":"Chule hicheng vanga chu thutep lentah le manlutah chu eipeh jengu ahitai; hitia chu ngaichatna jeh-a vannoi leisetna um suhbohna-a kona chu nahoidoh uva, Pathen nunle khan chankhompi nahina dingu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hiche jehtah chun nanghon potthona kimkei pandoh-un, natahsanu chun phatna, naphatnao chun hetna;"},"6":{"text":"Nahetna-u chun tibah timthem, natibah timthemu chun thohhat, chule thohhat chun Pathen ngaisahna;"},"7":{"text":"Pathen ngaisahna chun sopi hepina, chule sopi hepina chun ngailutna sodoh hen."},"8":{"text":"Ajeh chu hichengse chu nangho-a auma, aum dimset jinga ahile, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hetna thudolla nangho hatmo le ga beija naumsah lou dingu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahin hicheng neilou chu amitchoa ahin, gamla mulou ahin, masanga achonset luiho chengse-a kona kisu ngim ahi chu asuhmil ahitai."},"10":{"text":"Hijeh chun, sopiteho, nangho nakikou nao le naki lhennao chu kichetsahna dingin kihabolun; nanghon hichu nabol uva ahile, a-imatih chana nalhuh lou dingu ahi:"},"11":{"text":"Chutia chu I-Pakaiyu le eihuh hingpao Jesu Christa tonsot lenggama chu lut theina thu letset tah-a nakipe dingu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun nanghon hichenghi hejongleu chun, chule tu-a nangho-a uma thutah-a chun umdet jing jongleu chun, hicheng thudol hi nangho geldohsah jing ding ngaisah louva kaum louhel ding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chule hiche pon in'a hi kaum laichanse-a, nangho chu geldohsah jinga hah jinga umsah dinghi adihlam in kagele."},"14":{"text":"Ajeh chu I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christan eihetsah banga, hiche pon in hi kadalhah vah ding ahi ti kahei."},"15":{"text":"Chule kadalhah nung tengle hicheng thudol hi nageldoh jing theina dinguva jong kihabol kahi."},"16":{"text":"Keiman Pakai Jesu Christa thuneina le ahung ding thu nangho kahetsah laija chu, lungthim thema suhto-a semthu thusim juija hilou kahipouve, Leng Chungnung loupitah ahije mittah-a mu-a hettohsahjoa kahibouve.","title":"Christa Loupina Mit Tah-a Muho"},"17":{"text":"Ama hi ka-Chapa deitah ahi, achunga kalung alhai tangeije, tia Leng Chungnung loupina-a ahenga aw ahung lhuna chu, Pa Pathen'a kona choi-atle jabol changa ahi.","ref":"Matt 17:1-5; Mrk 9:2-7; Luk 9:28-35"},"18":{"text":"Van'a kon hiche aw hung ging chu molsang theng chunga ama toh kaumuva kajah-u ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chule themgaoho thu chu kichet chehna-a kahengu hung lhunga ahi; nangho chuche thua lunglut tah-a na-umu hi apha lheh jenge; jingkho ahung vah-a nalung sunguva jing niso ahung sodoh masangse-a, muthim lah salvah jing vah tobanga chingthei tah-a na-umu chu nabol hoi lheh jengun ahi."},"20":{"text":"Pathen lekhabua gaothu kisei jouse hi koiman ama chang tuma ahilchet ahipoi ti hemasao vin."},"21":{"text":"Ajeh chu malaija gaothu kiseidoh hochu mihem lungchama kona sohdoh-a ahipoi: ahin Pathen mitheng hon Lhagao Thengin amanchah dung juijuva aseiju ahibouve."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahin miho lah-a themgao lhem asodohtah banga chu, nangho lah-a jong mihil lhem hung sohdoh-a, guhthima misumang thei thuhil ki dang ahinpoh lut dingu, amaho achopau Pakai tah jeng jong chu ajahda uva, chule poh phunga achunguva manthah na akiloi khum dingu ahi.","title":"Themgao Lhemho"},"2":{"text":"Chule mi tamtah-in amanthah nao lampi chu ahinjui dingu; amaho jeh-a chu thutah lampi hi seisetna hung umding ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule kilosetna-a jou thua ki sumkol veina-a nahinnei dingu ahi; ahinla malaija patna achunguva thu kitan chu khongai sot lou, chule amanthah nau jong chu lulhu lou ahi."},"4":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen'in vantil chonseho jengbon chu khen louhela, damuna ale lut jenga, athu-u kitan ding ngah-a kokhuh thima akhum jenga;"},"5":{"text":"Chule Pathen ngaisah lou vannoi chunga twisang aletsah-a chu vannoi lui chu khen louhela, adang sagitoh chonphat thu seile-a Noah chubou akhena;","ref":"Semt 6:1—7:24"},"6":{"text":"Chule Sodom le Gomorrah khopi teni chu vutvai asosah-a, themmo chan na-a alekhupma, chule Pathen ngaisah louho chunga itobang ahung chuh ding vetsahna-a asema;","ref":"Semt 19:24"},"7":{"text":"Chule mi engseho khan gitlouna-a kona thoh gentheija michonpha Lot chu ahuhhinga ahile:","ref":"Semt 19:1-16"},"8":{"text":"(Ajehchu hiche michonpha chu amaho lah-a chenga, achonsetnao chu amua ajah-a, achonset jeh uva chu ama chonphat lung sunga chu niseh-a lungphamo lhehji-a ahi);"},"9":{"text":"Pakaiyin Pathen ngaisahho chu lhepna-a kona huhdohje ahen, chonpha louho chu thupi kitan ni kahse-a dinga talen matsah-a koije ahei:"},"10":{"text":"Ahideh-a kisuhbohna lam ngaicha-a tahsa lama chonteho le, gamvaipo nahsahmoho. Amaho chu ngol hanle ama lungchama chon ahiuvin, amahon loupina changho jengsan jong houset ding atijapouve."},"11":{"text":"Vantil ho chu thahat le thilbol theija chungnungjo ahi jeng vangun, amaho dounan oimona thu Pakai anga alhut pouvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Ahin hiteho vanghi lungel neilou sahemho tobanga achonnau dungjuija kimana kisumang ding ahiuvin, ahet phah louhelu thu chu aseiseu vin ahi; chule amaho asetnaova chu mangthah ding ahiuvin;"},"13":{"text":"Chule amahon suna kivah nehnop hi nomsah na-a angaito jeh uva, chonphat louna tohman chu asan dingu ahi. Amaho chu boh beh le nol uma ahiuvin, nangho toh kivahna-a ankong aumkhom ji tengule adoha lungthim uva akisuboh jiuvin;"},"14":{"text":"Jon thanhoina dimset mit aneijun, chonsetna ngathei lou ahiuvin; mi lungdet louho ajol lhajiuve: alungu chu thangset bolna lama kichuh ahin, sapset chang chate ahiuve:"},"15":{"text":"Amahon lamdih adalhaovin, lam hilouva avahmangun, chonphat louna thaman ngailu-a Beor chapa Baalam lampi chu ajuijun ahi;","ref":"Minb 22:4-35"},"16":{"text":"Ahin ama chu achonkhel jeh chun pho sal-in aumin; pao theilou sangan chu mihem paova apaodoh-in themgaopa ngolna chu akhamtangin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Hitiho hi twi umlou twikul ahiuvin, khopi huijin asemmang meilhang ahiuve; muthim lhangkhal kiheh chu amaho dinga a-imatih chana dinga kikheh khol ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ajeh chu amahon hamhoi thona thumanlou asei tengule, lamvaina-a umho lah-a kona hung jamdoh ho chu tahsa lam ngaichat huhna lama ajol lha jiuvin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Amahon chamlen athutep jiuvin, ahinla amahotah kemmang soh ho ahiuve: ajeh chu mi jo-a aumna-a chun, soh-a akailut jiuvin ahi."},"20":{"text":"Pakai le huhhing-a Jesu Christa het vanga, vannoi leiset kisuhbohna tincheng ajamsan nunguva, chuche thenlouna-a akikhi oh kitnuva, jo-a aum kitnuva ahile, aumchan amasa sanga anunung chu sejocheh ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ajeh chu ahet nunguva, amaho kipe-a thupeh thenga kona akiheimang sangun, chonphat lampi chu ahet louhelu hile, amaho dinga phajoa ahi."},"22":{"text":"Ui jin aloh lhahsa ajon kitjin, vohpi kisilngimsa jong bonlhoh lah-a kibolin akilejie, ti paochamtuh hi amaho chunga lhung ahitai.","ref":"Thuch 26:11"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngaitahteho, keiman nangho lekha kahinthot hiche hi anina ahi; anigela chu nangho geldohsah na-a kona nalung thengu chu kahinsuh thou ahi;","title":"Christa Hung Ding Tepsa"},"2":{"text":"Nanghon malaija themgao thengho thusei chengsele, Pakai le Huhhingpa solchah keiho thupeh najahsao chu nageldoh jingna dinguva kahinsut ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amasan nanghon hiche hi heuvin, ni nunungle jontaina manga jontai hatteho hung umdoh ding ahiuve, amaho chu ama tahsa ngaichat lama chonuntin,","ref":"Jud 18"},"4":{"text":"Ahung dinga thutepna chu hoibaham? Iputeu ipateu athiuva kipat tu gei hin, thilsem jouse hila semtila aum ngai bangbangin aumnan, atiuva nahin jontai dingu ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ajeh chu amaho hicheho-a hi kihetmo sah uva ahin, malaipeh-a patna Pathen thusah-a vanho chengse le twi chunga le twinoija um leiset hohi um ahi.","ref":"Semt 1:6-9"},"6":{"text":"Chuche laija vannoi leiset chu twisanglen'in asuhmang ahitai:","ref":"Semt 7:11"},"7":{"text":"Hiche thuma ma-a chu tulai van le leiset hi Pathen ngaisah louho thu kitanle akisuhmang niu geija dinga meija dinga kikheh kholla ahi ti hi,"},"8":{"text":"ahin, sopi ngaiteho, nanghon hiche thuhi sumil loujenun, Pakai dingin ni khat chu kum sangkhat tobang ahin, kum sangkhat chu ni khat tobang ahi.","ref":"Labu 90:4."},"9":{"text":"Mi khattouvin geisang asah chu Pakai athutep lam dola geisang ahipoi, koima amangthah um louva mi jousen lung aheiman nading angaitoa, eiho jala khongai sot ahibouve."},"10":{"text":"Amavang Pakai nikho chu janna gucha banga hung ding ahi; hiche ni chule vanho chengse ha gina ginglul lula manghel ding ahi, chule thilbul chengse meijin akah jola kavam gamhel ding ahi; chule vannoi leisetle asunga thil um jouse aboncha kavam sohkei ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chu chengse chu chutia mang ding ahile, nunle khan then lamle Pathen ngaisahna lama itobang mi nahi ding dol uham!"},"12":{"text":"Pathen nikho hung lhung ding chu pontho tah-a kat jinga kinema umding dol ahi; hiche ni chu ahung lhun jeh-a vanho meija kong'a kavamhel ding, chule thilbul chengse meisa-a jolmang sohding ahi."},"13":{"text":"Ahinla eihon vang ama thutep dungjuija vanthah hole leithah kinema ingau ahi; hichea chu chonphatna chenga ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hijeh chun, sopi ngaiteho, hicheng chu kat jinga nangho ama anga boh beh louhel le nolna beihela lungmonga nakimudoh theina dingun kihabolun."},"15":{"text":"Chule Pakai mi khongaisot hi huhhinga umna ahi ti gelun; isopiu deitah Paul'in jong ama kipe-a hetna dungjuija, chutobangma chu nangho henga ahinsutsa ahitai;"},"16":{"text":"Alekhathot chengsea chu hiche thu chu aseija, chutobangma chu asut ahi, hichenga chun het hahsatahtah thu aume; hichu mi lunglhomho le lungdet louhon Pathen lekhabua thu dang dang angai koiji bangun, angai koijiuvin amale ama akisumang jiuve."},"17":{"text":"Hijeh chun, ngaiteho, hichengse chu nahet masatsao bangin, kihongphauvin, achuti loule nangho jengjong michonseho lamvaina lama puimangin umun natin, napandet phapet lhaso khauvin nate."},"18":{"text":"Ahin I-Pakaiyu le Huhhing-a Jesu Christa milungset le hetna-a khangtou jingun. Ama-a chun tu le tonsot geijin loupina umhen. Amen."}}}}},"62":{"info":{"name":"1 John","shortname":"1 Jhn","abbr":[],"desc":"John Lekha Thot Khatna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Atil abula patna umsa jing, kana-a kajah-u, kamittah uva kanamu-u, kanavetnu, chule kakhut tah uva kathamu, hinna thu chu;","title":"Hinna Thu","ref":"Jhn 1:1."},"2":{"text":"(Ajehchu hiche hinna chu hung kiphonga ahin, chule keihon kamuvin, kahettohsah-un, chule chuche tonsot hin kemlou, Pa koma um, keiho henga hung kiphonga chu nangho kamusah nahiuve);","ref":"Jhn 1:14"},"3":{"text":"Henge, keihon kamusa chengseole kajahsa chengseu chu, nangho jong keihotoh ikiloi theina dinguva nangho henga kaphondoh-u ahi; chule tahbeh-a keiho kiloikhomna hi Pa toh, chule Achapa Jesu Christa toh kiloikhomna hija ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule nakipanao achamkim theina dinga hicheng hi kahinsut ahi."},"5":{"text":"Keihon ama-a kona kajah-u nangho kahilsonu chu hiche hi ahi, Pathen chu vah ahi, ama-a chu muthim himhim um louhel ahi.","title":"Pathen Chu Vah ahi"},"6":{"text":"Amatoh kiloi kahi itiuva muthima ivaleu vangle, thujou sei ihiu ahin, chule thutah chu nit lou ihiuve;"},"7":{"text":"Ama vah-a aum banga eiho jong vah-a chu ivaleu vangle, khat le khat kiloikhom ihiu ahin, chule Achapa Jesu Christa thisan chun chonsetna jouse-a kona eisilngimu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Eihon chonsetna kaneipoi itiuva ahile, eimale eima kilhem lha-a ihiu ahi, chule thutah chu isunguva umlou ahi."},"9":{"text":"Eihon ichonsetnao iphon vangule, ama chu eiho chonsetna chengse ngaidam dingle chonphat louna jouse siltheng dinga tahsan umtah chule chonphatah ahi."},"10":{"text":"Eihon chonsetna kaneipoi itiuva ahile, ama chu ijousah-u ahin, chule athu chu isunguva umlou ahi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kachateho, nachonset louna dinguva hicheng hi naheng uva kahinsut ahi. Chule khattou chonse jeng tajongle, Pa anga eihuva eisei champeh chonphatah Jesu Christa chu ineinaove.","title":"Eipanpiu Christa"},"2":{"text":"Ama chu eiho chonset thoidamna ahi; eihoa ding jengseh hilouva, vannoi chonset jouse-a ding jong ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule eiho ama thu nit ihiule, hichu ama ihetaove ti hetna ahi."},"4":{"text":"Keiman ama chu kahetaila tia athupeh nit lou chu mijou ahin, asunga thutah umlou ahi."},"5":{"text":"Ama thu nit vang chu Pathen ngailutna chu asunga tahbeh-a chamkima ahitan: hichea kon chun ama-a um kahi ti iheuve."},"6":{"text":"Keima ama-a um kahi tia chu, ama chon bang banga ama jong chon ding dol ahi."},"7":{"text":"Sopiteho, keiman nangho henga thupeh thah kahinsut ahipoi, atil abula nanghon najahsao thupeh lui chu kahinsut joh ahibouve; atil abula kona najah-u chu hiche thupeh lui hi ahi.","title":"Thupeh Thah","ref":"Jhn 13:34."},"8":{"text":"Chule thupeh thah jong kahinsune, hiche hi ama-a chule nangho-a jong thutah ahi; ajeh chu muthim abeikon ahitai; khovah dihtah chu hung vah pan ahitai."},"9":{"text":"Keima khovah-a uma kahi tia asopi ho-a chu muthima umnalai ahi."},"10":{"text":"Asopi ngailu-a chu khovah-a uma ahi, ama sunga chu kipal lhuhna imacha umlou ahi."},"11":{"text":"Asopi ho-a vang chu muthima uma ahin, muthima vahlea ahin, chule achena ding hoilam ahi ahepoi; ajeh chu muthim chun amitchohsah ahitai."},"12":{"text":"Kachateho, ama min vanga chu nachonset nao ngaidama uma ahitai; hiche jeh-a chu naheng uva kahinsut ahi."},"13":{"text":"Vo Pateho, nanghon atil abula patna anaumpa chu nahet jeh uva naheng uva kahinsut ahi. Khangdongho, nangho agilouva chu nanehjou jeh uva kahinsut ahi. Chapangho, nanghon Pa chu nahet tah jeh uva naheng uva kahinsut ahi."},"14":{"text":"Pateho, nanghon atil abula patna anaumpa chu nahet jeh uva naheng uva kahinsut ahi. Khangdongho, nangho athahat nahiuvin, nasunguva Pathen thu chu chenga ahin, chule nanghon agilou chu nanehjou tah jeh uva naheng uva kahinsut ahi."},"15":{"text":"Nanghon vannoi leiset le vannoi leiset lam dol thil chengse ngailu hihhelun. Koi hile vannoi leiset ngailu-a chu alung sunga Pa ngailutna cheng lou ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ajeh chu vannoi'a umho jouse: tahsa lam ngaichat, mitvet deichat, hinkho kiletsah, hicheng hi Pa-a kona ahipoi, vannoi'a kona ahibouve."},"17":{"text":"Vannoi leiset le athil ngaichat mangthah ding kon ahitai; ahin Pathen lung lama chonpa chu imatih chana umjing ding ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chapangneoho, ni nunung lam ahitai; Christa dou hung dingkon ahitai tia kisei najah bangu chun, tutah jeng jong hin Christa dou tamtah asohdohtai; hichea kon hin ni nunung ahitai ti iheuve.","title":"Christa Dou"},"19":{"text":"Amaho chu eiho lah-a konin apotdoh taove, ahin eihotoh ikimatnao aumpoi; eihotoh kimatna neija hileu eiho koma umding ahiuve: ahinla eihotoh kimatna anei louvu chu kiphon dohna dinga, amaho chu potdoh ahitaove."},"20":{"text":"Ahin nangho vang Athengpa thao nu chu nahiuvin, ijakai hesohkei nahiuve."},"21":{"text":"Nanghon thutah chu nahepouve tia naheng uva kahinsut ahipoi; thutah nahet jeh uva, thujou chu thutah-a kon ahipoi tina-a kahinsut joh ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule Jesu chu Christa ahi ti janom louva seilep kalvala jou seija koiham? Pa le Chapa janom louva chu Christa dou ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chapa jada-a chun Pa chu anei loulai ahi; Chapa janoma vang chun Pa jong chu anei ahitai."},"24":{"text":"Atil abula nanghon thu najahsa chengseu chu nalung sunguvah chenghen. Atil abula patna nathu jahsa chengseu chu nalung sunguva achena ahile, nangho jong Pa leh Chapa-a chu um jinga nahi dingu ahi."},"25":{"text":"Hichu amatah-in eiho eithu tepnao athutep tonsot hin kemlou chu ahi."},"26":{"text":"Nangho nalhem lhaji hou thudola keiman hicheng hi kahinsut ahi."},"27":{"text":"Nangho vang ama-a kona thao nu nachanu chu nasunguva achengin; min nahil dingu nangai pouve: ahin hiche thaonu mama chun imalam jouse thudol, thujou hilouva thutah nahil jeh-u chun, aman nahil dungjuijun, nangho ama-ah umdet jingun."},"28":{"text":"Chule tun, kachateho, ama ahung kilah teng kisonna ineijuva, chule ama ahung tengle amasanga ijachat louna dingun, ama-a um jingun."},"29":{"text":"Ama chonphatah ahi chu nahetnuva ahile, koi hile chonphatna lama chonpa chu ama-a kona pengdoh ahi ti naheuve."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Veuvin, Pan eingailutjeu hi itobang hitam, Pathen chapate tia kikou dinga i-um jenguhi! hiche jeh-a chu vannoi'in eiho eihet louvu ahi, hichu ama ahetlou jeh-u ahi.","title":"Pathen Chate","ref":"Jhn 1:12."},"2":{"text":"Ngaiteho, tun eiho Pathen chate ihiuve; chule ipi ihung hi dingu tun akiphongdoh hih laije. Ama ahung kilah tengle, eiho ama bangbang ihi dingu ahi ti chu eihon iheuve; ajeh chu ama aum bangbanga chu imu dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule koi hile ama-a kinem chu ama athen banga ama jong chu kisuthenga ahi."},"4":{"text":"Koi hile achonsea chu danthu sukeh ahi; ajehchu danthu suhkeh chu chonset ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule chonset pomang dinga ama hung kilahdoh ahi ti nanghon naheuve; chule ama-a chu chonset beihel ahi.","ref":"Jhn 1:29"},"6":{"text":"Koi hile ama-a uma chun chonset abolji poi: koi hile achonsejia chu ama mu loulai, chule he loulai ahi."},"7":{"text":"Kachateho, koima dohan lha hihhelun; ama chonpha ahibanga koi hile chonphat bola chu chonpha ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chonset bola chu diabol'a ahi; ajeh chu diabol chun atil abula pat chonset abol ahi. Diabol natohho jouse sumang dinga Pathen Chapa hung kilah ahi."},"9":{"text":"Koi hile Pathen'a kona penga chun chonset abolji poi, ajehchu amuchi asunga uma ahi: chujongle ama chu Pathen'a kona peng ahi jeh chun achonse thei poi."},"10":{"text":"Hichea kon hin Pathen chate le diabol chate akilangdoh jin ahi: koi hile chonphat bollou chu Pathen'a kon ahipon, chule asopi ngailulou jongchu Pathen'a kon ahipoi."},"11":{"text":"Ajehchu atil abula nathu jahsao chu hiche hi ahi, Eiho khatle khat ikingailutto cheh dingdolu ahi;","title":"Khat Le Khat Kingailut Ding"},"12":{"text":"Agiloupa-a kon hungkondoh asopipa thatna Cain tobanga chu hilouvin. Ama chu ipi jeh-a athaham? Ama thilbol chengse aphalou jeng ahia, asopipa thilbol chengse chonphatna ahi jeh ahi.","ref":"Semt 4:8"},"13":{"text":"Sopiteho, vannoi'in nahot uva ahile hichu kidang sahih-un."},"14":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile isopi teu ingailut jeh-uva thina-a kona hinna-a galkaija ihitaove ti iheuve. Asopi ngailu lou chu thina-a umjing nalai ahi.","ref":"Jhn 5:24"},"15":{"text":"Koi hile asopi ho-a chu tolthat ahi; tolthat lungsunga tonsot hin kemlou achengpoi ti naheuve."},"16":{"text":"Aman eiho dinga ahinna apeh jenga kona hi eihon Pathen ngailutna ihetnu ahi; chule eihon jong isopiho dinga ihinnao ipeh dingdolu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahin mi khattou leiset thilin ninglhing hen, ama chun asopi lhahsam muhen, khoto louvin umle, ama lung sunga chu Pathen ngailutna iti umding ham?"},"18":{"text":"Kachateho, khaije, eihon thu jengle kamsung keo jenga hilouvin, natohle thutah-in ngailu uhite."},"19":{"text":"Hichea kona chu eiho thutah-a kon iheu ihet dingu ahin, chujongle ama angsunga ilungu kinem jinga umding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Ajeh chu ilungun eiho eithemmo sah uva ahi jongle, Pathen chu eiho lung sanga chungnungjo ahin, chule ijakai ahesoh-in ahi."},"21":{"text":"Ngaiteho, ilungun eiho eithemmosah lou uva ahile, eihon Pathen lama lung ngamna ineiju ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule eihon athupeh initnuva, amitmua alung deilam jeng ibol jeh uve, ipi hijongle ithumu chu ama-a kona imu-u ahi."},"23":{"text":"Athupeh chu hiche hi ahi, eiho Achapa Jesu Christa min itahsan uva, chule aman eiho eithupeh banguva khatle khat ikingailut dingu hi ahi.","ref":"Jhn 13:34; 15:12,17"},"24":{"text":"Chule koi hile ama thupeh nit chu ama-a uma, chule ama jong ama-a chu uma ahi. Chule aman eipeh-u Lhagaova chun ama eiho-a aume ti iheuve."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngaiteho, nanghon lhagao tapou tahsan hih-un; ahin amaho chu Pathen'a kon ahi ahilou hettohna dingin, lhagaoho chu kholtoh-in patep jiuvin; ajeh chu vannoi leiset chungah themgao lhem tamtah asohdoh tan ahi.","title":"Lhagao Dih Leh Lhagao Dihlou"},"2":{"text":"Hichea hi nanghon Pathen Lhagao chu nahet dingu ahi; Jesu Christa chu tahsa-a hunga ahi ti janoma lhagao chu Pathen'a kon ahi:"},"3":{"text":"Chule Jesu chu tahsa-a hunga ahi ti janomlou jouse chu Pathen'a kon hilou ahi: hichu hungding ahi tia najahsao Christa dou lhagao ahi; chule tu-a jonghi vannoi'a uma ahitai."},"4":{"text":"Kachateho, nangho Pathen'a kon nahiu ahin, chule hitiho chu nanehjouvu ahitai; ajeh chu nangho-a umpa chu vannoi'a umpa sanga chungnungjo ahi."},"5":{"text":"Amaho chu vannoi'a kon ahiuve: hijeh-a chu vannoi thu aseiju ahin, chule vannoi'in amaho thu chu angaiju ahi."},"6":{"text":"Eiho Pathen'a kon ihiuve: Pathen he-a chun eiho thu angai ahi; Pathen'a kon hilou chun eiho thu angailou ahi. Hichea konahi eihon lhagao dihle lhagao dihlou ihet khen theiju ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ngaiteho, eiho khatle khat kingailutou hite: ijeh inem itile ngailut chu Pathen'a kon ahi; koi hile ngailutna neichan chu Pathen'a kona peng ahin, chule Pathen ahet ahi.","title":"Pathen Chu Ngailut Ahi"},"8":{"text":"Ngailutna neilou chun Pathen ahetlou ahi; ajeh iham itile Pathen chu ngailut ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hichea konahi Pathen mingailut eihoa kiphonga ahi, ama vanga eiho ihin theina dinguva, Pathen'in Achapa changkhat chu vannoi'a ahinsol ahi."},"10":{"text":"Hichea hi ngailut uma ahi, eihon Pathen chu ingailutnu ahipon, ama joh-in eingailut uva, chule Achapa chu eiho chonset thoidamna dinga ahinsol ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ngaiteho, Pathen'in chutia chu eingailut uva ahile, eiho jong khatle khat ikingailut ding dolu ahi."},"12":{"text":"Pathen chu koiman imatih chanin amukhapoi. Eiho khatle khat ikingailut touva ahile, Pathen eihoa uma ahin, chule angailutna chu eihoa chamkima ahi.","ref":"Jhn 1:18"},"13":{"text":"Hichea kona hi eihon eiho ama-a um ihiu, chule ama eihoa um ahi chu ihetnu ahi; Aman ama Lhagao eipeh tah jeh-u chun."},"14":{"text":"Chule Pa chun Chapa chu vannoi huhhing-a ahinsol ahi ti keihon kamuva kahettoh sah-u ahi."},"15":{"text":"Koi hijongle Jesu chu Pathen Chapa ahi ti phongdoh-a chu, Pathen ama-a chu uma, ama Pathen'a uma ahi."},"16":{"text":"Pathen'in eiho-a ngailutna anei hi eihon ihetnuva chule itahsanu ahitai. Pathen chu ngailut ahi; chule ngailutna-a uma chu Pathen'a uma ahin, chule Pathen ama-a chu uma ahi."},"17":{"text":"Thupi tan nile eiho ihakat theina dinguva, hichea kona hi ingailutnao kisuchamkim ahi: ajeh chu ama um banga, eiho hiche vannoi'a hi i-umu ahi."},"18":{"text":"Ngailutna-a kichatna aumpoi; amavang ngailut chamkim chun kichat anodohjin ahi: ajehchu kichatna chun talen matding anei ahi. Akicha-a chu ngailutna-a chamkim lou ahi."},"19":{"text":"Aman eingailut masah jeh uva eihon ama ingailutnu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Khattouvin, Keiman Pathen kangailui tihen asopi hotale, ama chu mijou ahi: ajeh chu amusa jing asopi bon ngailu lou chun, amukhah louhel Pathen chu iti angailut dingham?"},"21":{"text":"Chule hiche thupeh hi ama-a kona ineiju ahi, Pathen ngailu-a chun asopi jong ngailuhen."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Koi hile Jesu chu Christa ahi tia tahsan chu Pathen'a kona penga ahi; chule koi hile ahinga ngailu-a chun ahin jong chu angailut ahi.","title":"Tahsan Hi Vannoi Jousoh Ahi"},"2":{"text":"Eihon Pathen ingailut uva, athupeh init tengule, hichea kona hi Pathen chate ingailutnu ihet dingu ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ijeh inem itile athupeh initnu chu Pathen ingailutnao ahi; chule athupeh chengse jong chu pohgihsa ahipoi.","ref":"Jhn 14:15"},"4":{"text":"Ajeh chu koi hile Pathen'a kona penga chun vannoi hi ajo ahitai. Chule vannoi jouva chu itahsanu hi ahi."},"5":{"text":"Jesu chu Pathen Chapa ahi tia tahsan kala vannoi jouva koiham?"},"6":{"text":"Twisih le thisana hunga chu Jesu Christa tahchu ahi; twi sehseh hilouva, twisih le thisana kon ahi. Chule Lhagao chu hettohsah ahi; ajeh iham itile Lhagao chu thutah ahi.","title":"Jesu Christa Chungchang Hettohsah"},"7":{"text":"Ajeh chu van'a ahettohsah thum aumin ahi, Pa, Thu, chule Lhagao Theng: chule hicheng thum chu pumkhat ahi."},"8":{"text":"Chule leisetna ahettohsah thum aumin ahi, Lhagao, twisih, chule thisan: chule hicheng thum chu khatna akitoh-un ahi."},"9":{"text":"Eihon mihemte thu hettohsah ilah uva ahile, Pathen hettohsah chu chusanga chungnungjo ahi; Aman Achapa thudol chu ahettohsah chu Pathen thu hettohsah ahi."},"10":{"text":"Pathen Chapa tahsana chu alung sunga hiche hettohsahna chu chenga ahi: Pathen tahsan loupa chun ama chu ajousah ahitai; ajeh iham itile aman Pathen'in Achapa thudol ahettohsah chu atahsanpoi."},"11":{"text":"Chule hiche hettohsahna chu hiche ahi, Pathen'in eiho hin kemlou eipetaove, chule hiche hinna chu Achapa-a um ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chapa neija chun hinna anei ahitai; chule Pathen Chapa nei lou chun hinna anei lou ahi."},"13":{"text":"Nanghon hin kemlou naneiju nahet nadingule, Pathen chapa mina natahsan theina dinguva, thu hicheng hi Pathen Chapa mina tahsan nangho henga kahinsut ahi.","title":"Tonsot Hinkemlou"},"14":{"text":"Chule ama-a kisonna ineiju chu hiche hi ahi, ipi ipi hijongle ama lung deilam dola ithumuva ahile, aman eingaipeh jiuvin ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule eihon ithum chanu eingaipeh jiuve ti ihetnuva ahile, eihon ama henga ingaichatnu chu imu-u ahitai ti iheuve."},"16":{"text":"Mi khattouvin asopi chonsea amua achonset chu thina khop chonset ahi louva ahile, ama chun thumhen, chutile aman thina khop hilouva chonseho chu hinna apeh ding ahi. Thina khop chonset aume; hiche chu thumhen tia kasei ahipoi."},"17":{"text":"Chonphat louna jouse chu chonset ahi: chule thina khop hilou chonset aume."},"18":{"text":"Koi hile Pathen'a kona penga chu achonseji poi ti iheuve; ahin Pathen'a kona penga chu ama akihongdohjin, chule agilou chun atongkhajipoi."},"19":{"text":"Eiho Pathen'a kon ihiu le, vannoi pumpi hi gitlouna-a uma ahi ti iheuve."},"20":{"text":"Chule Pathen Chapa chu ahungin, hiche adihtah pa chu ihet theina dingun lungthim eihung petaovin, chule eiho adihtah pa, Achapa Jesu Christa-a chun i-umuve ti iheuve. Ama chu Pathen dihtah le tonsot hinna ahi."},"21":{"text":"Kachateho, milimho lah-a konin kihong phaovin. Amen."}}}}},"63":{"info":{"name":"2 John","shortname":"2 Jhn","abbr":[],"desc":"John Lekha Thot Nina"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Upa keiman thutah-a kangailut numei kilhengnule achateho; keima changseh hilouva, thutah heho chengse jong;","title":"Lemna Salam"},"2":{"text":"Eiho sunga uma, chule eiho toh tonsot geija umjing ding thutah jala chu."},"3":{"text":"Pa Pathen le Pa Chapa Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin lungsetna, hepina, chule lungmona chun, thutah le ngailutna-in naumpi jing taohen."},"4":{"text":"Pa-a kona eihon imu-u thupeh bangtah-a, nachateho lah-a kimkhat thutah-a achonu kamun kakipah tangei jenge.","title":"Thutah Le Ngailutna"},"5":{"text":"Chule tu-a hi, numei pha, keiman nahenga thupeh thah hinsun tobang hilouva, atil abula ineisao, khatle khat ikingailut tocheh dinguva nahenga kahung tao ahi."},"6":{"text":"Chule hiche hi ngailut ahi, eiho athupeh dungjuija ichon dingu ahi. Chule hiche hi thupeh ahi, nangho atil abula najahsao banga chu, hichea chu nachon dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ajehchu Jesu Christa chu tahsa-a hunga ahi ti janomlou vannoi'a hin doha milhem lha-a tamtah ahung sohdoh tai. Hiche hi milhem lha-a le Christa dou chu ahi."},"8":{"text":"Iboldohsa chengseu chu mansah louhela tohphat man isan bukimna dingun, kive phaovin."},"9":{"text":"Koi hile dan palkeh-a le Christa thuhila um louva chun Pathen aneilou ahi. Christa thuhila uma vang chun Pa le Chapa chu ania aneikop ahi."},"10":{"text":"Koi hile hiche thuhil hinpolouva naheng uva hunga aumle, amachu na-in uvah lhunsah hih-un, chule kamphan jong lem hih-un:"},"11":{"text":"Ajeh chu koi hile kampha-a lema chun achon gitlou ho jouse achan khompi ahi."},"12":{"text":"Naheng uva hinsut ding thu tamtah kaneije, ahivangin lekhapheng le lekha twija sut kanompoi; ahin ikipanao achamkim theina dingin, naheng uva hunging ting kimaiton kihoulim naohite ti kakineme.","title":"Khumkhana Thu"},"13":{"text":"Nalhen tumtah nasopinu chaten salam napeuve. Amen."}}}}},"64":{"info":{"name":"3 John","shortname":"3 Jhn","abbr":[],"desc":"John Lekha Thot Thumna"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Upa keiman thutah-a kangailut, kangai Gaius hengah.","title":"Lemna Salam","ref":"Sol 19:29; Rom 16:23; 1 Cor 1:14."},"2":{"text":"Ngai, thildang jouse sangin, nalhagao akhantou banga nakhantouva chule nadam nadingin kataovin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Sopiteho ahunguva nanga um thutah ahung hettohsah-u chun nasatah-in kakipah-in ahi."},"4":{"text":"Kachate thutah-a achon thu kajah-a kakipa sanga chungnungjo kakipana dang aumpoi."},"5":{"text":"Ngai, nangman sopiho le hetphahlou maljin chunga nabol jouse chu kitah tah-in nabolin ahi;","title":"Gaius Kipachatna"},"6":{"text":"Amahon nangma ngailutna thudol chu houbung-ah ahetsah-un ahi. Nangman amaho chu akholjin naova Pathen'a doltah-a nanathah ji-a ahile, nabol phat lheh ding ahi."},"7":{"text":"Ijeh-inem itile amaho chidang namdang ho-a kona imacha kilah louva, ama min jala chu kalsongdoh ahiuve."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu thutah-a dinga kithopi ho ihi theina dinguva, hiteho tobang mi chu eihotah-in ilhunsah dingu thu ahi."},"9":{"text":"Keiman houbung henga kahin sutsa ahitai: ahinla alah uva piput ngailu-a Diotrephes chun kaseiju alapon ahi.","title":"Diotrephes Le Demetrius"},"10":{"text":"Hiche jeh-a chu keima kahunga ahile, thu gilou tamtah kachunguva aseija eiseisetnao athilbol achonna chengse kageldohsah ding ahi: chua jong chu lunglhai loulaijin, sopiho chu amanla alhunsahpon, lhunsah dinga goho jong ajahdan, houbung'a konin anodoh jengin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ngai, nangma vangin ase chu jom louvin, apha chu jomin. Apha bola chu Pathen'a kon ahi; ase bola vang chun Pathen amu loulai ahi."},"12":{"text":"Demetrius chu mijousen aseiphan, thutah-a konin hettohsahna pha achangin, henge, keihon jong kahettohsah uvin; chule keiho hettohsah chu thutah ahi ti nangman nahei."},"13":{"text":"Nangma henga hinsut ding thil tamtah kaneije, ahinla lekha twi le lekha mola hinsut ding kanompoi:","title":"Khumkhana Salam"},"14":{"text":"Ahin chomkhat joule nangma kamua chule kimaito-a ikihoulim ding kakineme."},"15":{"text":"Nachungah lungmon umhen. Golle paihon nasalamui. Golle paiho chu amin cheh phan salam'in."}}}}},"65":{"info":{"name":"Jude","shortname":"Jud","abbr":[],"desc":"Jude Lekha Thot"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu Christa soh, Jacob naopa Juda'n, Pa Pathen suhtheng chang teho chengse, chule Jesu Christa-a kikheh le kikouho chengse hengah,","title":"Lemna","ref":"Matt 13:55; Mrk 6:3."},"2":{"text":"Hepina, chamna, chule ngailutna nachung uva hapunin punghen."},"3":{"text":"Ngaiteho, lhangpi huhhingna thudola naheng uva lekha hinsut kagot laijin, masanga mithengho anakipedohsa tahsan lama chu ponpan dinga nangho tilkhou na-a naheng uva hinsut ding khoh kasatan ahi.","title":"Thuhil lhemho"},"4":{"text":"Ajeh chu mi koi koiham guhthima hung kithol lut aumui; amaho chu hiche themona hi chang dingdol ahiuve tia masanga patna gotsa, Pathen ngaisah lou, i-Pathen'u milungset chu huhna lama sodoh ho, Pakai Pathen khatseh leh I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa janomlou ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Pakaiyin Egypt gama kona amite ahuhdoh-a, chuche nunga atahsan louho asuhmang jeng thudol hi khatvei nahetsao hita jongle kahin geldohsah kit nomui.","ref":"Pot 12:51; Minb 14:29-30."},"6":{"text":"Chule achanvou masa-u kolchah louva achennao dalha-a vantil ho chu, aman niloupi chungnung ni-a athu tan dinga tonsot muthim noija henna-a ahen ahi."},"7":{"text":"Sodom le Gomorrah, chule akimvela amaho tobang khopiho chengse, huhle jon thanhoi patna lama kipumpeh-a, chule tahsa lamdanna nung juiho chun vetton dinga phulahna tonsot meisa athohgim bangu chun.","ref":"Semt 19:1-24"},"8":{"text":"Chutobangma chun hiche mang kidah um manho jonghin tahsaphe asuboh-un, thuneina nahsahmon abolun, loupinaho chu aseiseuvin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Ahinla Mosi long chungchang thudola vantil pipuipen Michael diabol toh akinel chun, oimo-a houset ding angampon, ahin, Pakaiyin nahouse hen, atin ahi.","ref":"Dan 10:13,21; 12:1; Tph 12:7; Danb 34:6; Zech 3:2."},"10":{"text":"Hinla hiteho vang hin ahettoh louhelu aseiseuvin ahi: ahin lungthim neilou gamsaho bangin, angaija ahetsao hitiho-a chun amaho le amaho akisuboh-un ahi."},"11":{"text":"Amaho chu ada ahiuve! ajeh iham itile amahon Cain lampi chu ahovin, kipaman duchatnan Baalam lamvaina lama loptah-in alhaijun, chule Korah golkehna-a chu amangthah taovin ahi.","ref":"Minb 22:1-35; 16:1-35"},"12":{"text":"Amaho chu nangho toh an naneh khom komu le nakidei vahnauva chu twi noija kisel songpi ahiuvin, kichatna neilou ama kivah kelngoi ching ahiuve; amaho twi ko lou meilhang, hui mut lonle; chavang kichai kona thingphung ga lou, nivei thi, ajunga kibotdoh ahiuve;"},"13":{"text":"Twikhanglen kinong, ajachatnau twiphon sodoh; ahsi vahle ho ahiuvin, amaho dinga chu muthim lhangkhal tonsot geija dinga kikheh ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule Adam'a pat khang sagina Enoch jong chun hiteho chungchang thudola hi gaothu anaseidoh-in, Veuvin, Pakai chu amitheng sangsom sangja toh,","ref":"Semt 5:18,21-24."},"15":{"text":"Mijouse chunga thutan dingle, alah uva Pathen ngaisah louho jousen Pathen angaisah lounao thudola a-Pathen ngaisah louna thilbolu, chule Pathen ngaisah lou chonse hon ama chunga thu hamtahtah aseiju chungchanga themmo chan dingin ahunge, ati."},"16":{"text":"Amaho chu phunchel hat, oimo-a seiset hat, ama lung ngaichat lam cheh-a chona ahiuve; chule akam sungun hamhoitho thu aseijun, phatchom ngainan kam sungin mi ajabolun ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ahin, ngaiteho, masanga Pakai Jesu Christa solchah hon aseisao thuho chengse chu nanghon geldoh jingun;","title":"Gihna Leh Hilchahna"},"18":{"text":"Amahon, Ni nunung lamle mi nuisat nelpeh hat, Pathen ngaisah louva ama ama lung ngaichat dungjui cheh-a chonteho hung umdoh dingu ahi, tia asei bangu chun:","ref":"2 Pet 3:3"},"19":{"text":"Amaho chu loitum sem, tahsahing, Lhagao neilou ahiuve."},"20":{"text":"Ahin, ngaiteho, nangho vang natahsanu theng chungnung chunga chun nangmaho kisadoh-un, Lhagao Thengah tao taovun,"},"21":{"text":"Pathen ngailutna-a chun kihongun, chule tonsot hin kemlouna dingin I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa mihepina-a kinemin kat jingin umun."},"22":{"text":"Chule mi abang agingchalela chu hepiuvin,"},"23":{"text":"Abang meija konin loidoh-un; tahsaphen asuboh nihchen ponsil sana thetbol pumin, kicha gehchan huhhingun."},"24":{"text":"Tun nakipal lhuh louna dinguva nangho hongbit theile, ama loupina ang sunga themona beihela kipahtah-a lhut theija,","title":"Vahchoina Taona"},"25":{"text":"Eihuhhing pau Pathen ching khatseh henga chun, loupina, chungnunna, thahat thuneina, tu le atonsot geijin umjing tahen. Amen."}}}}},"66":{"info":{"name":"Thuphon","shortname":"Tph","abbr":[],"desc":"John Henga Thuphondoh"},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu Christa thuphondoh, Pathen'in asohte hetsah dinga apeh, thil hung sohvah dingho chu; aman avantil asola asoh John ahetsah ahi.","title":"Thumakai"},"2":{"text":"Ama chu Pathen thudol le Jesu Christa hettohsah thudola athil muho jouse thu umchan chu ahettohsah ahi."},"3":{"text":"Hiche lhagao thuseidoh ho sima, chule ja-a, chule asunga kisun thuho chengse nitna chu anunnoma ahi; phat anai jeh hin."},"4":{"text":"John'in Asia gama um houbung sagiho hengah: Auma, Aumsa, chule Ahung umdinga konin; chule alal touna anga kona Lhagao sagi-a konin; chule athiho lah-a kona peng masapen, leiset lengho jouse vaipo;","title":"Houbung Sagiho Lemna","ref":"Pot 3:14; Tph 4:5."},"5":{"text":"athu hettohsah ginchat umtah Jesu Christa-a kon chun lungsetle lungmonin umpiuvin. Eiho eingailua athisana ichonset chengseova kona eisoptheng uva,","ref":"Isai 55:4; Labu 89:27"},"6":{"text":"chule avaipohna gammi le a-Pathen le a-Pa thempu-a eisemuva chu, loupinale vaipoh thuneina atonsot atonsot geijin ama-a hi jinghen, Amen.","ref":"Pot 19:6; Tph 5:10"},"7":{"text":"Veuvin, ama meihotoh kilhonin ahunge; chule mit jousen, asunhotah jong chun amu dingu ahi; chule leiset namtinle phungtin-in a-op achupchup dingu ahi. Chuti chu ahi, Amen.","ref":"Dan 7:13; Matt 24:30; Mrk 13:26; Luk 21:27; 1 Thess 4:17; Zech 12:10; Jhn 19:34,37."},"8":{"text":"Auma, Aumsa, chule Ahung umdinga, Hat chungnung Pakai chun, Keima Alpha le Omega, apatna le achaina kahi, ati.","ref":"Tph 22:13; Pot 3:14."},"9":{"text":"Jesu'a um thohhatle leng gam chule hesoh genthei nathoh khompiu nasopiu, John, keima Pathen thule Jesu Christa thu hettohsah jeh-a Patmos twi twikol'a chu um kanahi.","title":"John'in Mihem Chapa Amu"},"10":{"text":"Pakai nikho ni-a chu keima Lhagaova kaum ahi; chule sumkon gin tobang awgin nasatah khat kanung lama kajan,"},"11":{"text":"Keima Alpha le Omega, amasa le anunung, kahi: Nathil mu chengse lekhabu-ah sunin lang, hichu Asia sunga um houbung sagi-a: Ephesia, Smyrna, Pergamos, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia chule Laodicea-a gahthotnin, ati."},"12":{"text":"Chuin kajah-a thuseija aw chu ve dingin, keima kakiheijin ahi. Chuin kakiheitan ahile, sana meivah khom sagi kamui;"},"13":{"text":"chule meivah khomho lah-a chun khat mihem chapa tobang, aponsil akhophanga lenglha, sana konggah a-opkonga kigah;","ref":"Dan 7:13; 10:5"},"14":{"text":"aluchangle asam kelngoi mul banna banga, buhbang tobang ahin; amit meikong tobang ahi;","ref":"Dan 7:9; 10:6"},"15":{"text":"akengho chu lhum sunga kigoujol sum-eng kinotval tobang jeng, chule a-awgin chu twi tamtah gin tobang jeng ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule akhut jet lama ahsi sagi achoijin, akam sunga konin hemto chemjam ahema hem ni ahungdoh-in ahi; chule ama melso chu nisa hasattah-a asat pettoh abangin ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin ama kamu phat chun keima athitoh kabang jengin akhophang bulah kalhu jengin ahi. Hichun aman akhut jet lamin eithamin, kajah-a, Kicha hih-in; keima hi amasale anukhah kahi, ati."},"18":{"text":"Chule ahing jinga chu kahi; keima athisa kahi; ahinla, ven, a-imatih chana dingin kahinge, amen; chule thinale damun kot-heh kaneije."},"19":{"text":"Hijeh chun nathilmu chengsele aum chengse chule ahung umding chengse abonchan sunin;"},"20":{"text":"kakhut jetna ahsi sagi namuho chule sana meivah khom thuguh hi sunin. Ahsi sagi chu houbung sagi solchah ahin, meivah khom sagi chu houbung sagi ahi, ati."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephesia'a um houbung solchah hengah hiti hin sunin: Akhut jet lama ahsi sagi choija sana meivah khomho lah-a vahlea chun hitin aseije:","title":"Ephesia Houbung'a Lekha Thot"},"2":{"text":"Keiman nanatoh ho jouse, chule nathohgimle nathohhat chu kahei; chule, Solchah kahi, tia solchahla hilou, amaho jong chu napatep-in, nakholjin ajou namandoh jengin ahi;"},"3":{"text":"chule thohhat tah-a kamin jala thoh thoh-a lhadah lou nahi."},"4":{"text":"Ahivangin nachunga demna kaneije: nangman nangailut masa chu nalhatai."},"5":{"text":"Hiche jeh chun nangma hoija kona nalhuh ham; hichu geldoh-in, chule nalung heijin, nanatoh masah ho chu tongin; achuti louva nalung nahei loule, nahenga gangtah-a kahunga nameivah khom chu aumna-a kona kachon mang ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Ahinla Nicolaitan ho chon keiman kahot chu, hicheho chu nangman jong nahon ahi, hiche phatna chu naneije."},"7":{"text":"Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen. Ajouva chu keiman Pathen ollim daija um hin thingga kanehsah ding ahi.","ref":"Semt 2:9; Tph 22:2; Ezek 28:13; 31:8."},"8":{"text":"Chule Smyrna-a um houbung solchah hengah hitin sunin: Amasale anukhah, thitasa hing kit chun hitin aseije:","title":"Smyrna Houbung'a Lekha Thot","ref":"Isai 44:6; 48:12; Tph 1:17; 22:13."},"9":{"text":"Keiman na natoh nagenthei, nahesoh chule navaichat kahenai (ahin nangma nahaonai), Juda mi kahi, tia Juda mi hilou, Satan vaipi kikhopnajoh ahiuva, hou thu ataitomu jong chu kahenai."},"10":{"text":"Thil nahinthoh dingho hi kicha hihhelin; ven, napatep na-a nalah uva mi abang bang chu diabolin songkul'a akhum ding koncha ahi; chule hesoh genthei ni som nathoh dingu ahi. Nangman nathi geijin tahsanin; chule keiman nangma hinna lallukhuh kapeh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen. Ajouva chu thi nina chun asuhnat lou ding ahi.","ref":"Tph 20:14; 21:8."},"12":{"text":"Chule Pergamos'a um houbung solchah henga hitin sunin: Hemto chemjam ahema hem nei Pan thu hicheng hi aseije:","title":"Pergamos Houbung'a Lekha Thot"},"13":{"text":"Nangma na natoh chule hoi laija cheng nahi kahenai, Satan laltouna muntah chu ahi; chule nangman kamin natuh det jinga, chule Satan chenna nangho lah-a ginchat umtah, kathu hettohsah Antipas, atha laiju sana jong keima tahsana seilep lou nahi."},"14":{"text":"Ahivangin nachunga demna thil themkhat kaneije, ajeh chu Israel chate masanga kipal lhuhna koija, milim houna sa nehsah dingle jonsahna dinga, Baalak lungthim pe-a hila, Baalam thuhil choija hikoma chun naneijui.","ref":"Minb 22:5,7; 31:16; Danb 23:4; Minb 25:1-3"},"15":{"text":"Chutobangma chun kathil ki-dah pen Nicolaitan ho thuhil choija jong naneijui."},"16":{"text":"Hijeh chun nalung heijin; achuti loule nahenga gangtah-a hung ding kahi; chule kakam sung chamjama amaho chu gala kasat ding ahi."},"17":{"text":"Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen. Ajouva chu guhthim manna kapeh ding ahi; chule songkang khat jong kapeh ding; hiche songa chu min thah khat kisuna ahi; asangpa tailou koimacha dangin hiche min chu ahepoi.","ref":"Pot 16:14-15; 16:33-34; Jhn 6:48-50; Isai 62:2; 65:15."},"18":{"text":"Thyatira-a um houbung solchah hengah hitin sunin: Amit meikong tobanga, akhophang sum-eng kinotval bangah Pathen Chapa chun hitin aseije:","title":"Thyatira Houbung'a Lekha Thot"},"19":{"text":"Nathilbol jousele, nangailut chule natahsanje, chule nalhacha natoh hole, nathoh hatje, chule nathilbol masah sanga nathilbol nunung anasatjoh chu kahenai."},"20":{"text":"Ahivangin nachungah demna kaneije, nangman Jezebel kithemgaosahnu chu navethim in naum sah-in ahi, ama chun jonthanhoi dingle milim houna sa neh din thu ahilin, kasohte alhemlhan asulamvaijin ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 16:31; 2 Leng 9:22,30"},"21":{"text":"Keiman hinu chu alung heina ding phat kapeh ahi; ahinla aman ajon thanhoija konin alung ahei nompoi."},"22":{"text":"Veuvin, keiman amanu chu ajalkhuna kajamhel ding ahi; chule ajonpiho chengsen jong amanu chonna-a kona atanuva alung ahei louvule, hesoh gentheina chungnung tah-a kalelut ding ahi."},"23":{"text":"Chule thi gamna-a achateho katha gam ding ahi; chuteng chule houbung jousen keima lungthim gille lungsung kholtoh soh kahi, hi ahet dingu ahi; chule keiman nangho nathilbol dungjui uva kapeh cheh ding nahiuve."},"24":{"text":"Ahivangin Thyatira-a amoh nalah uva um, hiche thuhil chu jop lou aumin, mi abanghon thugil atiu, Satan thugil chu helouho chengse chu, najah uva kasei ahi, nangho chunga pohgih imacha dang belap ponge."},"25":{"text":"Ahin nanei sun-u chu kahung kahsen tuh det jingun."},"26":{"text":"Chule ajouva akhon ni geija kathilbol chengse nit chu, keima pa-a kona kamu banga, ama chu namtin vaipiho chunga thuneina kapeh ding ahi;"},"27":{"text":"Chutengle ama chun thih tenggola vai ahoma beldengho bel akea ahal hala aum banga, abolding ahi;"},"28":{"text":"Chule keiman ama chu Jing Valpa kapeh ding ahi."},"29":{"text":"Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chule Sardis'a um houbung solchah henga hitin sunin: Pathen Lhagao sagile ahsi sagi neija chun hitin thu aseije: Keiman nathilbol kahenai, nangma amina ahinga nahin, hinla athisa nahibouve.","title":"Sardis Houbung ho Lekha Thot"},"2":{"text":"Khangin lang hah jingin umin; chule adang athikonho chengse chu suhalin din detsah-in; ajeh chu Pathen mitmu-a nathilbol achamkimsa imacha kamupoi."},"3":{"text":"Hijeh chun nangman atila iti natahsana, iti najah ham, hichu geldoh-in, hichu nitphan, chule nalung heijin. Hah jinga naum louva ahile, gucha banga nahenga kahung ding ahi, chule itih phatle naheng kahinsuh nahet louhel ding ahi.","ref":"Matt 24:43-44; Luk 12:39-40; Tph 16:15"},"4":{"text":"Ahinla apon kisuhnen lou mi phabep khat Sardis'a aumui; amaho chu ponbang vamleh silla keimatoh kavale dingu ahi; ajeh chu amaho hiche dinga chu kilomtah ahiuve."},"5":{"text":"Ajouva chu ama jong chutia chu ponbanga kijem ding ahi; chule keiman ahing lekhabua kona ama min chu kathaimang louhel ding ahi; ahin ka Pa angsungle avantil chengse angsunga ama min chu kaseidoh ding ahi.","ref":"Pot 32:32-33; Labu 69:28; Tph 20:12; Matt 10:32; Luk 12:8"},"6":{"text":"Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen."},"7":{"text":"Chule Philadelphia'a um houbung solchah henga hitin sunin: Athengale adihtah, David kanglong heh neija, aman ahonle koiman khah thei lou, chule aman akhale koiman hong thei lou, ama chun hitin thu aseije:","title":"Philadelphia Houbung'a Lekha Thot","ref":"Isai 22:22; Job 12:14."},"8":{"text":"Keiman nathilbol chu kahenai; ven, koiman akha thei lou kot honsan na-anga kakoije; natha vang alhome, chule kathu nanit jingin kamin naseilep poi."},"9":{"text":"Ven, Satan loi kihou khomna-a miho chu, Juda mi kahi tia Juda mi hilou, thu jou sei ahiuve; ven, chutobang miho chu abang bang nakhophang bula kalhuhsah-a chibai kabohsah dingu ahi; chutile keiman nangma kangailut chu amahon ahetdoh thei dingu ahi.","ref":"Isai 49:23; 60:14; 43:4"},"10":{"text":"Nangman keima thohhat thu chu natuh det jeh-a hi, vannoi leiset chung cheng miho patep kholchilna-a vannoi leiset chunga hung lhung dingkon, hiche phatna kona chu keiman jong nangma kahuhdoh ding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Ven, Hung vahjet ding kahi; nalal lukhuh chu koiman nalahpeh louna dingin nanei sun chu tuh det jingin."},"12":{"text":"Ajouva chu ka Pathen houin khoma kasem ding, chule chua kona chu potdohta louhel ding ahi; chule achunga, ka Pathen min, chule ka Pathen khopi Jerusalem khopi thah, van'a kona ka Pathen koma kona hung kumlha ding, hiche min chutoh keima min thah kasut ding ahi.","ref":"Tph 21:2; Isai 62:2; 65:15"},"13":{"text":"Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen."},"14":{"text":"Chule Laodicea-a um houbung solchah henga hitin sunin: Amen, tahsan umtah chule hettohsah dihtah, Pathen thilsemho bul chun hitin thu aseije:","title":"Laodicea Houbung ho Lekha Thot","ref":"Thuch 8:22."},"15":{"text":"Keiman nathilbol kahenai, nangma votla navotpon, sala nasapoi; navotle votngalin, nasatle sangal lechun pha kasah ahi."},"16":{"text":"Hiti chun sala nasapon, votla navotpon, alum dapdap bep nahi, hiche jeh-a chu kakama kona kakhondoh dingkon nahi."},"17":{"text":"Nangman, Kahaove, sum kakholle, imachan kalhasampoi, natin ahi; ahinla nangmatah ada pen, khoto umtah, vaichatah, mitcho chule sagohkeu nahi chu nakihetpoi."},"18":{"text":"Hijeh chun nahaona dingin, meija kisong jola kilhatheng sana, chule sagohkeu nahi najachat kiphon louna dingin, ponbang sil ding nanei theina dingin, mit nu ding mitlou, hicheng chu keija konin kichoh-in, tia kathu mop nahi."},"19":{"text":"Keiman kangailut chan chu kaphosala kasehgimji ahi; hijeh chun nangma tompanin lung heijin.","ref":"Thuch 3:12; Heb 12:6"},"20":{"text":"Ven, keima kotkhah bulah kadingin kot kakiu jinge, mi khattouvin ka-awgin ajah-a kot ahona ahile, keima kasunglhah-a ama chu an kaneh khompi ding ahi; chule aman jong keima an eineh khompi ding ahi."},"21":{"text":"Keiman kajo-a ka Pa koma alaltouna-a katou banga hi ajouva chu kakoma kalaltouna-a katousah ding ahi, ati."},"22":{"text":"Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche jou chun keiman kaven ahile, veuvin, van'a kot khat akihon kamun ahi, chule keima eikihoupia sumkon gin tobang aw amasa kajah, aw khat chun, Hiche lama hin hung kaltouvin, tu nunga thil hung soh tei dingho chengse chu kavetsah ding nahi, ati.","title":"Van'a Pathen Kihou"},"2":{"text":"Hichetah chun Lhagaovin kaumtan ahi; chuin, veuvin, van'ah laltouna khat akidon ahi, chule hiche laltouna-a chun mi khat atouvin;","ref":"Ezek 1:26-28; 10:1"},"3":{"text":"Hiche-a toupa chu jasper songle sardion song bangin alange; chule laltouna kimvela chun lhagui aumin, emerald songtoh abangin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule laltouna kimvela chun laltouna somnileli aumin; hiche laltounaho chunga chun ponbang kisila alua sana lukhuh kikhuh upa somnileli atouvui."},"5":{"text":"Chule chuche laltouna-a kon chun kolphe, aw, chule van gin ahung sohdohjin ahi; chule laltouna maija chun meija kong jing jeng meivah sagi aumin, hichu Pathen Lhagao sagi chu ahi;","ref":"Pot 19:16; Tph 8:5; 11:19; 16:18; Ezek 1:13; Tph 1:4; Zech 4:2"},"6":{"text":"chule laltouna maija chun crystal songvala val phatvet twikhanglen tobang khat akimui; chule hiche laltouna ningtin le laltouna kimvela chun ganhing li aume; amaho chu amalam anunglam amit jeng amit jeng dimset ahi.","ref":"Ezek 1:22; 5:10; 10:14"},"7":{"text":"Ganhing amasapen chu keipitoh abangin, anina chu bongnou toh abangin, athumna chun mihem mai apui, alina chu alengle mulaopi tobang ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hiche ganhing liho chun lhaving gup cheh aneijui; akimvel le asunglam amit jeng amit jeng dimset ahi; chule amaho chun, Athenge, athenge, athenge, Pakai Pathen, hat chungnung, aumsa auma, chule ahung umdinga chu, tin asun ajanin cholnga louhelin, ati, atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Ezek 1:18; 10:12; Isai 6:2-3"},"9":{"text":"Chule hiche ganhingho chun a-imatih chana hing jing, laltouna-a toupa chu, avahchoi juva, ajaboluva, athangvah tengule,"},"10":{"text":"upa somni le liho chun laltouna-a toupa anga chu lhujiuva, a-imatih chana hing jingpa anga chu, alallukhuh aselhah jiuva chibai abohjiuva,"},"11":{"text":"Vo Pakai, nangma bou vahchoile choi-at chule thilbol thei thahat changa lom nahi. Ajeh chu imajouse nangma sem ahi; chule nangma phatsah-a hicheng chu uma chule kisema ahi, atiji dingu ahi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin laltouna-a toupa khut jet lama chun, asunglam apolam alangtoa kisuna, sinkhana sagi-a kisinkha lekhabu khat kamun ahi.","title":"Lekhajol Chule Pathen Kelngoinou","ref":"Ezek 2:9-10; Isai 29:11."},"2":{"text":"Chuin vantil hattah khat kamun ama chun, Hiche lekhabu hi phonga asinkhana lhamlha dinga lom koiham, tin hasap tah-in asamlen ahi."},"3":{"text":"Ahin van'ah, leijah, lei noijah lekhabu chu aphong theile ave theija koimacha aumtapon ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin lekhabu chu aphong dingle asim dinga khatcha jong akiholmo jeh chun hakan kakaptan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hichun upaho lah-a khat chun, Nangma kap hih-in; ven, Juda phung Keipi chule David Jung chu hiche lekhabu phong dingle asinkhana sagi chu honglha dinga ajosohsa ahitai, ati.","ref":"Semt 49:9; Isai 11:1,10"},"6":{"text":"Chuin keiman kaven ahile, veuvin, laltounale ganhing liho lailung-ah chule upaho lailunga chun Kelngoinou kithatsa lheh lheh khat adin kamui; ama chu aki sagile amit sagi ahi; hichu vannoi leiset pumpi-a kisol Pathen Lhagao sagi ahi.","ref":"Isai 57:7; Zech 4:10."},"7":{"text":"Ama chu ahungin laltouna-a toupa khut jet lama lekhabu chu alan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hichu alah phat chun ganhing liho chule upa somni le liho chu Kelngoinou anga chun abohkhup taovin ahi; amaho chun akhutna selangdah khat chehle sana sumlheng, mithengho taona, gimnam twi dimset akichoi cheh-un ahi.","ref":"Labu 141:2"},"9":{"text":"Amaho chun la thah khat asauvin, Lekhabu chu ala dingle asinkhana lhamlha dinga lom nangma bou nahi; ajeh chu nangma kithattasa nahi; phungtin leh chitin namtina mi, paotin paotanga mi, gamvaipi nam jouse-a mi Pathen'a dinga nangman nathisana nachoh doh ahitai.","ref":"Labu 33:3; 98:1; Isai 42:10"},"10":{"text":"Pathen dinga amaho chu gamsung mile thempu-a napansah ahitai; chutia chu amaho chun vannoi leiset chunga vai apoh dingu ahi, atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Pot 19:6; Tph 1:6."},"11":{"text":"Chujouvin kagahvetle, chuche laltounale ganhingho chule upaho kimvela chun vantil asang aja aw kajan ahi; amaho chu sangsom tamtah jat sangsom, sang tamtah jat sang tamtah ahiuve.","ref":"Dan 7:10."},"12":{"text":"Amaho chun aw sangtah-in, Akithatsa Kelngoinou chu thahatna, haona, chihna, thaneina, choi-atna, loupina, chule pachatna chang dinga lom ahi, atiuve."},"13":{"text":"Chuin van'a, leija, lei noija, chule twikhanglen'a thilsem jousen, chule chucheho lah-a um chengsen ahiti seiju aw hi kajai, Laltouna-a toupale Kelngoinou chu pachatle choiat, chule loupinale thunei vaipoh atonsot atonsot geijin chang jinghen, atiuve."},"14":{"text":"Chuin ganhing liho chun, Amen, atiuvin ahi. Chule li ho le upa somni ho chengse chu aboh khupmun a-itih-a hingjing chu chibai abohtauvin ahi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin Kelngoinou chun asinkhana sagi lah-a khat chu ahon kamui, chule ganhing liho lah-a khat chun van ginga bangin, Hungven, ati kajan ahi.","title":"Sinkhanaho"},"2":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu kagah vetle, veuvin, sakol kang khat ka mun, achunga toupa chun gophel achoije; ama chu lukhuh khat apeuvin ahi; chule ama chu ajoupehle ajoupeh dinga hung kondoh ahi.","ref":"Zech 1:8; 6:3,6"},"3":{"text":"Chuin sinkhana anina ahonle, ganhing nina chun, Hungven, ati chu kajan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Hichun sakol chom khat ahungdoh-in, hichu asan ahi; chuin miho chu amahole amaho akithatona dinga, achunga toupa chu, leisetna kon chamna lah mangna kipe-a ahi; chule ama chu chemjam lentah khat jong kipe-a ahi.","ref":"Zech 1:8; 6:2"},"5":{"text":"Chuin aman sinkhana athumna ahon phat chun ganhing athumna chun, Hungven, ati kajan ahi. Chuin, veuvin, sakol vom khat kamun ahi; chule achunga toupa chun khaikot achoijin ahi.","ref":"Zech 6:2,6."},"6":{"text":"Chuin ganhing liho lah-a kon chun, suhlouchang khai khat man makhai, chule sakolchang khai thuma makhai ahi; chule nangman thaole lengpitwi vang chu sumang hih-in, ti aw kajan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin aman sinkhana alina ahon phat chun, Hungven, ti ganhing alina aw kajan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hichun kavetle, veuvin, sakol engdang khat kamun; chule achunga toupa chu amin Thina ahi; chule damunin anungnung ajuijin ahi. Chule chemhema, gilkela, thina-a, chule gamsa-a atha dinguva amaho chu vannoi leiset hop li-a hop khat chunga thuneina kipe-a ahiuve.","ref":"Ezek 14:21"},"9":{"text":"Chuin sinkhana angana chu ahon phat chun, Pathen thu jalle hettohsahna aneiju jala kithatteho lhagao hing chu maicham phung noijah kamun ahi."},"10":{"text":"Amaho chun aw sangtah-in asamun, Vo Pakai thengle kitah, thu tanna chule leiset chung chengho chunga keiho thisan asou phulah ding chu itihchan nakhongai dingham, atiuvin ahi."},"11":{"text":"Hichun amaho chu ponbang ape chehtauvin ahi; chule amaho chu, asohchanpiho chengseole asopite chengseu amaho banga atha dingu chu akim masangse-a, chomkhat anga tahdi dingu ahi, tin ajah uva aseijun ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chunin sinkhana gupna chu ahon phat chun, veuvin, ling nasatah ahung kiho kamun; chule nisa chu samul khaodip pon bangin adumtan, chule lhathah pumpi thisan abang jengtan ahi;","ref":"Tph 11:13; 16:18; Isai 13:10; Joel 2:10,31; 3:15; Matt 24:29; Mrk 13:24-25; Luk 21:25."},"13":{"text":"chule van'a ahsi ho chu hui hattah-in, theichang amut linga ahut apul lhah bangin, leijah apul lhagamtan ahi.","ref":"Isai 34:4"},"14":{"text":"Chule van chu lekha kijel bangin akijelin amangheltan ahi; chule molle lhang jousele twikol gam jong ama ama mun'a konin akichon mang gamtan ahi.","ref":"Tph 16:20"},"15":{"text":"Chule leiset lengho, milenho, sepai lamkai pipuiho, chule mihaoho, chule ahatteho, chule soh ho chengsele soh hilou ongthol chengse, kokhuh sunga le molsanga songpiho a chun akiselun;","ref":"Isai 2:19,21"},"16":{"text":"chule molsang ho le songpiho jah-a chun, Kachung uvah hunglhun lang laltouna-a toupa maikoh-a konle Kelngoinou lunghan na-a konin neiselun;","ref":"Hos 10:8; Luk 23:30"},"17":{"text":"ajeh chu alunghan nikho chungnung chu ahung lhungtai; koiham ading thei ding, atiuvin ahi.","ref":"Joel 2:11; Mal 3:2"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujou chun vannoi leiset ning li-a vantil li dinga, vannoi leiset chungle twikhanglen chunga chule thing chunga hui anun louna dinga, vannoi leiset hui li tuhtanga kamun ahi.","title":"Israel Mi 144,000 Melchihna Kinam","ref":"Jer 49:36; Dan 7:2; Zech 6:5."},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pathen hing melchihna choija, niso lama kona hung kaltou vantil chomdang khat kamun; ama chun hatah-in asamin, leisetle twikhanglen suhsetna ding thu kipe-a vantil liho jah-a chun,"},"3":{"text":"I-Pathen sohteho chala melchihna kanam masangseuvin, nanghon leisetle twikhanglen chule thingho suse hihtadiuvin, ati.","ref":"Ezek 9:4,6"},"4":{"text":"Chuin melchihna kinama chu amijat kajan; Israel phung chengsea melchihna kinama sang ja khatle sangsomli le sangli ahi;"},"5":{"text":"Juda phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Reuben phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Gad phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni;"},"6":{"text":"Asher phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Naphtali phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Manasseh phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni;"},"7":{"text":"Simeon phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Levi phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Issachar phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni;"},"8":{"text":"Zebulun phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Benjamin phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Joseph phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni ahin;"},"9":{"text":"Hicheng jou chun kavetle, chitin namtina kon, phungtina kon, chule mite tinchenga konle paotin paotanga kon, koima simsen lou mipi atama tam abang jenga kivon, lusuna kichoija laltouna angle Kelngoinou anga dinga kamun;","title":"Namtin Vaipia Kon Japi Kikhom"},"10":{"text":"chule amaho chun, Huhhingna chu laltouna-a tou i-Pathen'ule, Kelngoinouva ahi, tin aw sangtah-in asamui."},"11":{"text":"Chule vantil jouse chu, laltounale upaho, chule ganhing liho kimvela chu ding jinga ahiuve; amaho chu laltouna anga aboh khupmun Pathen alhaijun,"},"12":{"text":"Amen: pachatna, loupina, hetna, chihna, thangvahna, choi-atle thuneina, chule thahat atonsot atonsot geijin i-Pathen'uva hi jinghen. Amen, atiuvin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin upaho lah-a khat chun eihin houvin kajah-a, Hiche ponbang jenga kivonho hi koi hiuva chule hoija hung kon hiuvam, ti eidongin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Keiman ama jah-a, Ka pakai, nangman bou nahei, kati. Hichun aman kajah-a, Hiteho hi bolgim hesoh genthei chungnunga kona chu hung ahiuve; amahon Kelngoinou thisana chu avonu akisop bangu ahitai.","ref":"Dan 12:1; Matt 24:21; Mrk 13:19."},"15":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu amahohi Pathen laltouna anga umuva, asun ajana a-houin'a chu ama lhachale-a panga ahiuve: chule laltouna-a toupa khu amaho lah-a cheng ding ahi;"},"16":{"text":"amaho hi itihchan hijongle gilkel, dangchah kit talou ding ahiuve; nisan jong sangta lou ding, sat jong thohta louhel ding ahiuve;","ref":"Isai 49:10"},"17":{"text":"ajeh chu laltouna lailunga um Kelngoinou khun avah diu, chule hin twinah dunga chu apuihoile ding ahi; chule Pathen'in amitlhi jouseu athehhul ding ahi, ati.","ref":"Labu 23:1; Ezek 34:23; Labu 23:2; Isai 49:10; 25:8"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin aman sinkhana sagina ahon pat chun van'ah nidan keh khat kahset athipchet jengtan ahi.","title":"Sinkhana Sagina"},"2":{"text":"Chuin Pathen anga ding jing vantil sagi kamun; chule amaho chu sumkon sagi chu apeuvin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chujouvin gimnamtui halna sanabom choija vantil khat ahungin maichama chun ahung dingin; laltouna maija um sana maicham chunga chu mithengho jouse taona abelap peh dingin gimnamtui tamtah apeuvin ahi.","ref":"Amos 9:1; Pot 30:1,3."},"4":{"text":"Hichun mithengho taonatoh thakhatnin vantil khut chunga kon chun gimnamtui khu chu Pathen angsung geijin akikhodohtan ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hichun vantil chun gimnamtui halnabom chu alan, maichama mei chu akhumin leiset chunga agah seplhatan ahi. Chutah chun van agingin, aw agingin, kol aphen, chule ling akihotan ahi.","ref":"Thmpu 16:12; Ezek 34:23; Pot 19:6; Tph 11:19; 16:18"},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin sumkon sagi choija vantil sagi chu sumkon mut dingin kigosa demin aumtaovin ahi.","title":"Sumkon ho"},"7":{"text":"Chuin amasapenpan amutle, thisantoh kihal gel le mei ahung umpaijen jengin ahi; chuin hichengse chu leiset chungah agah seplhaovin ahile, chutah chun thingho hop thuma hop khat akavamin, chule hamhing jouse jong akavamtan ahi.","ref":"Pot 9:23-25; Ezek 38:22."},"8":{"text":"Chujou chun vantil nina chun amutle, meija ka mol lentah tobang khat twikhanglen'ah asep lut taovin ahile, chutah chun twikhanglen chu hop thuma hop khat thisan asohtan ahi;"},"9":{"text":"chule twikhanglen'a cheng thilsem lah-a ganhing hop thuma hop khat agamtan ahi, chule kongho jong hop thuma hop khat suhmangin aumtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin vantil athumna chun amutle, meisel banga al-lenglung ahsi lenpi khat van'a konin ahung lhan, luiho hop thuma ho khat chungle twinahho chungah achun ahi;","ref":"Isai 14:12."},"11":{"text":"chule ahsi amin chu Gamsai akiti; chule twi hop thuma hop khat chu gamsai asohtan ahi; akibol khat jeh chun twija kon chun mi tamtah athi.","ref":"Jer 9:15"},"12":{"text":"Chuin vantil lina chun amutle, nisa hop thuma hop khat, lha thah hop thuma hop khat, ahsi ho hop thuma hop khat athimna dingin akivosen, athima khovah beihelna dingin sun hop thuma hop khat akivosen ahi; jan jong chutima chu ahi.","ref":"Isai 13:10; Ezek 32:7; Joel 2:10,31; 3:15."},"13":{"text":"Chujouvin kavet jingle, vantil khat vanlaijola lengle-a hiche hi hasaptah-a sama aw kajan ahi, Khuche vantil thum sumkon mut dinga kigoho khun asumkon mut banu amut tengule, leiset chung chengho chu adanauve, adanauve, adanauve, ati."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin vantil ngana chun amutle, ahsi khat van'a kona lha-a leija chua kamun ahi; chule ama chu lei-ong kokhuh hehna chu kipe-a ahi."},"2":{"text":"Chuin aman lei-ong kokhuh chu aheh hongin ahile, kokhuh sunga kon chun pummei nasatah-a bangin meikhu ahung khudohtan ahi; chule kokhuh sunga kona hung khudoh meikhu chun nisale van athimsahtan ahi.","ref":"Semt 19:28"},"3":{"text":"Chule meikhu-a kon chun khaokhote lei chunga ahung sohdohtaovin ahi; amaho chu leiset chunga aipi thanei tobang thaneina kipe-a ahiuve.","ref":"Pot 10:12-15"},"4":{"text":"Chule leiset chunga hampa louhing, anche dong chule thing khatcha suse louhela, achala Pathen mi melchihna kinamlou mihobou chu nasuhset dingu ahi, tia kiseipeh ahiuve.","ref":"Ezek 9:2"},"5":{"text":"Chule amahon hiteho chu tha chu atha lou dingu, lha nga geija agenthei agentheija agimbol dinguva bou kipe-a ahiuve; chule amibolgimu chu aipin mi ape tenga bolgimna tobang bolgimna ahi."},"6":{"text":"Hiche lai teng chule mihon thina ahol dingu, chule iti hol jongleu amu lou dingu ahi; chule thi alung ngai dingu chule thina chu amaho-a kona jammang ding ahi.","ref":"Job 3:21; Jer 8:3"},"7":{"text":"Hiche khaokhoho limso chu galsat dinga gotsadem sakol abangin ahi, chule alu chunguva chu sana tobang lukhuh aumin, chule amaiju chu mihem maitoh abangin ahi.","ref":"Joel 2:4."},"8":{"text":"Chule asamu chu numei samtoh abangin; chule ahau chu keipi hatoh abange.","ref":"Joel 1:6"},"9":{"text":"Chule a-omphou chu thih ompho tobang ahin, alhaiju gin galsat dinga lhaija sakol kangtalai tamtah lhai gintoh abangin ahi.","ref":"Joel 2:5"},"10":{"text":"Aipi mei bangin ameiju aumin, amidena ajang jong aumin ahi; chule amaijuva chu lha nga geija mihemte agenthei theija gimbolna athao uma ahi."},"11":{"text":"Lei-ong solchah chu alengpao ahi; amin chu Hebrai paovin Abaddon ahin, Greek paovin Apollyuon ahi."},"12":{"text":"Dana masa kichaija ahitai; veuvin, tu nunga hi dana ni hung lhung ding ahina laije."},"13":{"text":"Chuin vantil gupna chun amutle, Pathen anga um sana maicham saki ho-a kon chun aw kajan ahi;","ref":"Pot 13:1-3."},"14":{"text":"khat chun sumkon choija vantil gupna pa jah-a chun, Euphrates luipi-a vantil li kihenho chu lhan, ati."},"15":{"text":"Hichun mihem hop thuma hop khat that dinga, anidan, anikho, alha, akum phasadema kigotpeh vantil liho chu akilhadoh taovin ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule sakol chungchong galmiho chu ami jat sangsom jat ni sangsom jat ahiuve; ami jat chu kajan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chule kathil mu-a chun, sakol chengsele achunga chongho chu hiti hin kamui; a-omphou chu kamsan sung abangin, a-engdumin, chule sakol ho chu alu keipi lutoh abangin ahi; amaho kamsunga kon chun mei, meikhu, chule kath ahung sohdohjin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuteho kamsunga sohdoh mei, meikhu, chule kath chucheng thum chun mihem hop thuma hop khat akithat gamtan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Akam sungule ameijuva chu athaneinao uma ahi; ameiju chu gul lheh lheh abangin, alu aumin; hichea chu mi agimbolu ahi."},"20":{"text":"Suhgamna chuchenga kithat moh ho chengse chu akhut tham athilbol uva konin alungu aheipouvin ahi; hichu amahon thilhahole khomu theilou, khoja theilou, vahle theilou, sana, dangka, sum-eng, song chule thinga asemu milimho hou atang pouvin ahi.","ref":"Labu 115:4-7; 135:15-17; Dan 5:23."},"21":{"text":"Chule amahon toltha mitphel doi choi, jon thanhoi, guchat, hichenga kon chun alungu aheipouvin ahi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin vantil chomdang hattah khat meija kitom, van'a kona ahung kumlhah kamun, alu chunga chun lhagui akiveijin; amai chu nisatoh abangin, chule akeng chu meikong khomtoh abange;","title":"Vantil Chule Lekhajol Neocha"},"2":{"text":"chule akhutna chun lekhabu neocha kiphonga khat achoijin ahi, ama chun akeng jet lamin twikhanglen achonin, vei lamin leiset chun achonin ahi;"},"3":{"text":"chule keipi kitum banghelin hatah-in kho asamin ahi; akhosap chu van gin sagin ahindongin ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chule van gin sagi chun thu asei phat chun lekha-a sun ding kakigo tan ahi; chuin van'a aw ahung gingin hitia hi kajah-a asei kajan ahi. Van gin sagi thusei chu imchah-in sun hih-in, ati."},"5":{"text":"Chule twikhanglen le leiset chunga dinga vantil kamu chun van lama akhut jetlam adom sangin,","ref":"Pot 20:1; Danb 32:40; Dan 12:7; Amos 3:7."},"6":{"text":"vanle vanlaijola thil um chengsele, leiset chule asunga um chengse, chule twikhanglen le asunga um chengse, aboncha sema a-imatih chana hing jing, ama min chu apanin ahahselin, Sotta lou ding ahi;"},"7":{"text":"ahin vantil sagina chu sumkon mut akigot tengle, hichu agin phat phatle, Pathen thuguh, asoh themgaoho henga anaphondoh banga chu guilhung ding ahitai, ati."},"8":{"text":"Hichun van aw kajah chu kaja kitleuvin eihouvin kajah-a, Khuche twikhanglen khule lei chunga dinga vantil khutna um lekhabu neo kiphonga khu chenlang galan, eitin ahi.","ref":"Ezek 2:8—3:3."},"9":{"text":"Chuin keiman vantil henga chun kachen ajah-a, Lekhabu neocha chu neipen, kati. Chuin aman kajah-a, Lanlang nejou jengin; hichun na-oisung akhatsah ding ahi; ahin nakama vang khoiju banga lhum ding ahi, ati."},"10":{"text":"Hichun keiman vantil khut chunga kon chun lekhabu neocha chu kalan, chuin kanetan ahi; hichun kakamah khoiju lhumin alhumin ahi; ahin kaneh jou phat chun ka-oisung akhatan ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin amaho chun kajah-a, Miho, chule chitin namtinle, paotin paotang, chule lengho tamtah chungchang thu naseidoh kit tei ding ahi, ati."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hichun tenggol lheh lheh pengmol khat keima eipeuvin, vantil chu adingin kajah-a, hitin aseije, Kipat inlang nangman Pathen houin le, amaicham, chule asunga um ahouho chengse khu gaten.","title":"Hettohsah Mi Ni","ref":"Ezek 40:3; Zech 2:1-2."},"2":{"text":"Houin polam aleitol chu khendoh-in te hih-in; ajeh chu chidang namdangte kipedoh ahitai; chule amahon lha somli le lhani geija khopi theng chu achotpha dingu ahi.","ref":"Luk 21:24"},"3":{"text":"Chule keiman kathu hettohsah ni thuneina kapeh ding, chule amani chun khaodip pon akisil lhona ni sangkhat le ni jani toh ni somgup sunga thu aseidoh lhon ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amani chu vannoi leiset Pathen anga dinga Olive thingphung ni chule meivah khom ni chu ahi lhone;","ref":"Zech 4:3,11-14."},"5":{"text":"hiteni chu mi khattouvin bolgim dinga agot jouse-a, akamsung lhona kona mei potna amelma chengseu chu akah vam jengji ahi; chule hitia chu koi hile amani chu bolset go-a chu kithat jeng ding ahi."},"6":{"text":"Amani chu athu seidoh lai lhona chu go ajuh louna dinga, van khahchah thei ahi lhone; chule amanin suhgamna tintanga leiset asuhgam lhona, twi thisan asosah nomchan lhona, asosah lhon dinga twi chunga thuneina anei lhon ahi.","ref":"1 Leng 17:1; Pot 7:17-19; 1 Sam 4:8"},"7":{"text":"Amani chun athu hettohsah achai lhon tengle, lei-onga kona hung pot sahem chun amani chu akisatpia amani chu ajoa atha ding ahi.","ref":"Dan 7:7,21; Tph 13:5-7; 17:8."},"8":{"text":"Chuteng Sodom le Egypt, hiche lhagao lam min umna khopi, a-pakaiyu thingpel'a akhetbehnao, khopi sung lamlena chu along lhon kijam ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 1:9-10"},"9":{"text":"Mitehon, chitin namtinle phungtina min, paotin paotanga min, chule namtin vaipin ni thumle akeh geija along lhon chu avet avet jeng dingu ahi, chule along lhon chu vuiding thu apeh lou dingu ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule vannoi leiset mite, amani chungchanga chu kipah thanom ding ahiuve, khatle khat kipaman kithotto ding ahiuve; ajeh chu hiche themgao teni chun leiset chung chengho agimbol lhon ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin ni thumle akeh jou chun asung lhona Pathen'a kona hinna lhagao alut jeh chun, amani akengin ading gel lhontan ahi; chuphat chun ave veho chu akichata lheh jengtaovin ahi.","ref":"Ezek 37:10"},"12":{"text":"Chuin, Hilama hung kaltou lhonin, tia van awgin nasatah aja lhonin ahi. Chutah chun amani chu mei kangtalai jin van'a akaltou lhontan ahi. Chule amelmateu chun amu jingu ahi lhone.","ref":"2 Leng 2:11"},"13":{"text":"Hiche pettah chun ling nasatah ahung kihottan ahi, hichun khopi chu hop soma hop khat achimtan ahi; hiche ling kiho chun mi sangsagi athin, chule athimoh chengse chu atijatlot jeh-un van Pathen chu avahchoi taovin ahi.","ref":"Tph 6:2; 16:8"},"14":{"text":"Dana nina chu kichaija ahitai; dana thumna chu hung lhung vahjet ding ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin vantil sagina chun amuttan ahi, chule van'ah aw nasatah atama tamin ahinjomin, Vannoi gamvaipoh hi I-Pakaiyu le a-Christa-a ahitai; chule aman atonsot atonsot geija vai apoh ding ahi, atiuve.","title":"Sumkon Sagina","ref":"Pot 15:8; Dan 2:44; 7:14,27."},"16":{"text":"Chuin upa somni le liho Pathen anga alaltouna cheh-a touho chu akhupbon alhuvin Pathen chibai aboh-un,"},"17":{"text":"Vo Pakai Pathen Hat chungnung, Auma, Aumsa, Ahungding nangma kathangvah-ui; ajeh chu nangman nathuneina chungnung chu nakilah-a vai napoh ahitai."},"18":{"text":"Namtin vaipi lunghanga ahiuvin, chuin nangma lunghanle, athiho thutan phat, chule nasoh themgaoho le, mithengho, nangma min gingho alen aneo, tohphat man peh phat, chule leiset sumangho suhmang phat chu, hung lhunga ahitai, atiuve.","ref":"Labu 2:5; 110:5; 115:13."},"19":{"text":"Chuin van'a um Pathen houin mun theng chu akihongin, chule a-houin Mun Theng sunga chun kitepna thu thingkhong chu akimun ahi; chule kol aphen, aw agingin, van agingin, ling akihottan ahi, chule gel len nasatah alhan ahi.","ref":"Tph 8:5; 16:18,21."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin van'ah melchihna chungnung khat akimun ahi; numei khat nisa-a kijema, akengto noija lhathah uma, chule alu chunga ahsi somle ni-a kijem lallukhuh kikhuh ahi:","title":"Numeinu Le Dragon"},"2":{"text":"chule amanu chu naovop ahi; chule naoso nat thohgima ham hama ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chuin van'ah melchihna kidangtah achom khat akimu kittan ahi; veuvin, dragon san lentah, alu sagi, chule aki som chule aluho-a chu lallukhuh sagi kikhuh, khat ahung umin ahi.","ref":"Dan 7:7"},"4":{"text":"Chule amei chun van'a ahsi ho hop thuma hop khat aloilhan leiset chunga aseplhan ahi; chule dragon chu asoh dingkon numeinu anga chun asolhah tihtih acha chu aval lhum jeng theina dingin ading jing jengin ahi.","ref":"Dan 8:10"},"5":{"text":"Chuin amanun chapa khat ahingtan ahi; ama chun namtin vaipi jouse chunga thih tenggola vai apoh ding ahi; chuin acha chu Pathen hengle alaltouna-ah lahtouvin aumtan ahi.","ref":"Isai 66:7; Labu 2:9"},"6":{"text":"Chuin numeinu chu gamthip lama ajam mangtan ahi; hikoma chu ni sang khatle ni jani leh ni somgup geija akivahna dinga, amanu chu Pathen'in mun agotpehsa ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin van'ah gal akisattan ahi; Michael le avantil ho chengsen dragon chu asat taovin ahi; hi chun dragon le asolchah ho jong chun asat thuhtaove;","ref":"Dan 10:13,21; 12:1; Jud 9."},"8":{"text":"ahivangin ajoutapouve; chujongle van'ah amaho mun akimu kittapon ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin dragon len chu gul lui, Diabol le Satan kiti vannoi pumpi lhemlha-a chu, ama chu leijah lelhah-in aumtan ahi; chule asolchahho jong chu amatoh lelhah than aumtaove.","ref":"Semt 3:1; Luk 10:18"},"10":{"text":"Hichun keiman van'ah aw nasatah khat kajan ahi; Hichun, Tun huhhing, thahat lenggam i-Pathen'uva, chule thuneina chu a-Christa-a ahitai; ajeh chu isopiteu hehsea chu akilehlha-a ahitai, ama chun i-Pathen henguva amaho chu asun ajana ahehset jingji ahi.","ref":"Job 1:9-11; Zech 3:1."},"11":{"text":"Chule amahon Kelngoinou thisan vangle ahettohsah thu-u vanga ama chu ajokhup dingu ahitai; chule amahon thi geija ahinkho itcha louhel ahiuve."},"12":{"text":"Hijeh chun, Vo vanho chule asunga cheng chengse, kipah thanomun; leisetle twikhanglen chu ada naove; ajeh chu diabol nahengu hung geisuh ahitai, phat chom chabou anei chu ahen, lunghan chungnunga lunghanga ahi, ati."},"13":{"text":"Chuin dragon chun leija akilelhah chu amun, hichun acha soh-a chapa khat hinga numeinu chu abolsetan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin numeinu chu ama mun gamthip lama chu gul chun amu phah louna-a alenmang theina dingin, mulaopi lhaving ni akipen ahi;
