hikoma chu phat khat, phat ni chule phat keh khat geija kivahdoh ahi."},"15":{"text":"Hichun gul chun twi lhohsah theina dingin akamsunga konin numeinu nungsanga chun luipidung tobang leuvin twi aphidoh tan ahi."},"16":{"text":"Ahinla vannoi leisetnin numeinu chu anahun, chuleh leiset in akam anakahomin, gul'in akamsunga kona aphidoh twi luipidung chu anaval jouhel tan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chutah chun gul chu numeinu chunga chun alunghangin, amanu chilhah ho Pathen thupeh nitle Jesu Christa thu hettohsah jop amoh chengse chutoh kisat dingin akondohtan ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule achen twikhanglen nel chunga agading tan ahi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chutia keima twikhanglen neldi lah-a kadin chun twikhanglen'a kona sahem khat ahung kipatdoh kamui; ama chu aki som ahin, alu sagi ahi; akihoa chun lallukhuh som aume, chule aluho-a chun Pathen taitomna minho aume.","title":"Gamsa Ni","ref":"Dan 7:3; Tph 17:3,7-12."},"2":{"text":"Hiche sahem kamu chu lutnu toh abangin, akengho chu vompi kengtoh abangin, chule akam chu keipi kamtoh abange; chule dragon chun athahatle alaltouna chule athuneina chungnung ama chu apetan ahi.","ref":"Dan 7:4-6"},"3":{"text":"Chujou chun keiman kamui, chuche aluho lah-a khat chu thihela kisat lheh lheh ahi, ahin thihela akisatna chu kiledoh ahitai; chule vannoi pumpin kidangin amuvin ajuitaove;"},"4":{"text":"chule sahem chu athuneina apeh jeh chun mihon dragon chu ahouvun, Hiche sahem tobang koiham? Koiham amatoh kisat thei dinga, atiuvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Hitichun hamhoithonale Pathen taitom na-a thuseina kam apeuvin; chule lha som lile lha ni geija thilbol dingin thahat thuneina apetaovin ahi.","ref":"Dan 7:8,25; 11:36."},"6":{"text":"Chutah chun Pathen taitom na-in akamkatan ahi, aminle, achenna, chule van'a chengho jouse ataitomtan ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule mithengho toh kisat dingle amaho chu jou dinga ama chu thahat kipe-a ahi; chule ama chu phungtin leh mite tincheng chule paotin paotangle chitin namtin chunga thuneina kipe-a ahitai.","ref":"Dan 7:21"},"8":{"text":"Chule leiset chunga chenga mi jousen ama chu ahou dingu ahi; leiset bul kiphudoh tila patna akithatsa Kelngoinou hinna lekhabu sunga amin kisun louho chengse chun.","ref":"Labu 69:28"},"9":{"text":"Nakhang neija aumle ngaihen."},"10":{"text":"Gal hinga kaidol gal-hinga kikai ding; chemhema mithat aumle chemhema lou ding ahi. Hichea hi mithengho thohhatle tahsan kilanga ahi.","ref":"Jer 15:2; 43:11"},"11":{"text":"Chuin sahem chom khatma leisetna kona ahungdoh kamun ahi; ama chu kelngoinouva tobang aki ni ahin, chule dragon bang bangin thu aseije."},"12":{"text":"Chule ama chun sahem masapa thuneina jouse chu ama angsunga amangchan ahi. Chule ama chun vannoi leisetle asunga chengho jouse, thihela akisat kiledoh kit sahem masa chu ahousah tan ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin ama chun melchihna thil nasatahtah abolin, miho mitmun van'a kona leija mei lhahsah geijin abolin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chutia chu sahem mitmu-a chu melchihna tintang bolna ding thahat ama chu kipe-a ahi, hichea chu aman vannoi leiset chung chengho asuhlamvai ahi; ama chun leiset chung chengho jah-a, Chemjam'a kisat lem kiledoh kit sahem chu alim khat semun, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chule sahem lim chun thu asei theina dinga, chule chuche sahem lim chu ahou lou jouse akitha theina dinga, ama chun sahem lim sunga chu hinna hu akhum ding, hichan geija chu thaneina kipe-a ahi."},"16":{"text":"Chule ama chun aneo alen, ahao avai, chamlenle soh, hicheng jouse chu akhut jet lamu ahim, achaluva ahima, melchihna chu aban neisah ahi;"},"17":{"text":"chule chuche sahem melchihna, amin chu ahiloule, amin number neilou chun, cho theita lou, joh theita lou ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hichea hin hetna chihna akilange; lungthim theman hiche sahem number chu simhen; ajeh chu hichu mihem number ahi; chule hiche number chu Ja gup le somgup le gup ahi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujou chun, veuvin, Kelngoinou chu Sion mol chunga chu adin kamun, mi sang ja khatle sangsomli le sangli toh ahi; amaho chu achaluva ama minle a-Pa min kisuna ahi.","title":"Kelngoinou Le Lhatdohsa ho","ref":"Ezek 9:4; Tph 7:3."},"2":{"text":"Chuin van'a konin twi tamtah gin lheh lheh le van gin lheh lheh aw kajan; ka-aw jah chu selangdah tumhon aselangdah cheh atumu gingtoh abangin ahi."},"3":{"text":"Chule amaho chun laltouna ang le ganhing liho chule upaho anga chun la thah khat asauvin ahi; chule vannoi leisetna kona achohdoh mi sang ja khatle sangsomli le sang liho tailou chu, adang koimacha hiche la chu kichuh them thei lou ahi."},"4":{"text":"Amaho chu numei chunga kisuboh louhel ahiuve; amaho chu suhkhah loulaihel nungah thengsel ahiuve. Amaho chu kelngoinou chena chana anung nung juileho chu ahiuve. Pathen'a dingle Kelngoinou dinga aga masa tia, amaho chu mihemte lah-a kona kichodoh ahitaove;"},"5":{"text":"chule amaho chu akam sunguva thujou pot kihekha louhel ahiuvin; Pathen laltouna anga monabei ahiuve.","ref":"Zeph 3:13"},"6":{"text":"Chujouvin keiman vanlaijola vantil leng lele khat kamui; ama chun leiset chunga cheng, chitin namtinle, phungtin, chule paotin paotangle, miteho henga seiphongle dinga tantih neilou Kipana Thupha anei ahin,","title":"Vantil Thum"},"7":{"text":"ama chun aw nasatah-in asamin, Pathen gingun, aloupije chu vahchoijun; ajeh chu athutan avaihom phat ahung lhungtan ahi; chule vanle, lei, twikhanglen, twinah jouse, hichengse sema chu houvun chibaijun, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin vantil anina achom khat ama nung nunga chun achelen, Ajonthanhoi jeh-a lunghanna lengpi ju chitin namtinle phungtin donsah-a Babylon khopi chungnung tah chu achimtai, achimtai, ati.","ref":"Isai 21:9; Jer 51:8; Tph 18:2."},"9":{"text":"Chuche jou chun vantil thumna chun amani nung nung chu ajuijin hatah-in asamin, Koi hile sahem chule alim chu houva chibai boh-a, chule achala ahim, akhut ahima, amelchihna kinamdoh chu kilah-ah aumle,"},"10":{"text":"ama jong chun Pathen lunghanna khona chu alunghana lengpi ju imatoh hal louhel gotsa kikoi chu adon tei ding ahi; chule vantil thengho mitmule Kelngoinou mitmu-a chu meile kath kah nat athoh gim dingu ahi;","ref":"Isai 51:17; Semt 19:24; Ezek 38:22"},"11":{"text":"amaho nat thohgim meikhu chu a-imatih chana kitungdoh jing jenga ahi; chule chuche sahem chule alim chu houva chibai boh-a chule koi hile amin melchihna kilah chan chu, asun ajana oltih nei louhel ahiuve.","ref":"Isai 34:10"},"12":{"text":"Hichea hin Pathen thupeh hole Jesu tahsan thu nit mithengho thohhatje thu akilangin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuin van'a aw ahung gingin, Sunin, tukala Pakai mina thiho chengse chu anunnoma ahiuve; ahi, amaho chu atohgim naova kona cholnga ding ahiuvin, anatoh chengun anungu ajui ahi jeh chun, tia Lhagaovin kajah-a asei chu kajan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin kavetle, veuvin, meibang khat chule achunga chu mihem chapa lheh lheh, alua sana lukhuh kikhuh-a, akhutna koite hemtah khat kichoija tou kamun ahi.","title":"Vannoi Chang Atle Lengpiga Lo-a Chil","ref":"Dan 7:13."},"15":{"text":"Chuin houin sunga kon chun vantil chom dang khat ahung potdoh-in meibang chunga toupa jah-a chun aw sangtah-in asamin, Nakoite paninlang chang attan, nang dingin a-at phat ahitai; vannoi leiset chang aminin akoitai, ati.","ref":"Joel 3:13"},"16":{"text":"Chuin meibang chunga toupa chun vannoi leiset chungah akoite alamtan ahile, hichun vannoi leiset chang aki-at tan ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chuin van'a houin sunga kon chun vantil chom khat ahung potdoh kitleuvin; ama jong chun koite hemtah khat aneijin ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chuin vantil chomdang khat mei chunga thuneija chu maichama konin ahung potdoh-in, koite hemtah choipa jah-a chun aw sangtah-in asamin, Nakoite hemtah chu paninlang vannoi leiset lengpiga abohho at khomtan; aminsoh ahitah jeh khun, ati."},"19":{"text":"Chuphat chun vantil chun akoite apanin vannoi leiset lengpiga abohho chu a-at khomin, Pathen lunghanna lengpiga hehna len chungnung khuh sunga chun asep luttan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule khopi polama lengpiga hehna khuh sunga chun achilun ahile, lengpiga hehna khuh sunga kon chun thisan ahung sohdoh-in, ching sang khatle ching ja gup geijin sakol kamdal chan gei aphan ahi.","ref":"Isai 63:3; Kala 1:15; Tph 19:15"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujou chun keiman van'ah melchihna thil kidang chungnung tah achom khat suhgentheina nukhah sagi neija vantil sagi kamun; hicheng chu suhgentheina kichaina ahi; ajeh chu Pathen lunghan hichenga chu kichaisoh ahi.","title":"Gamna Hise Nukhah pen Nei Vantilte"},"2":{"text":"Chuin meitoh kichoh hal phatvet twikhanglen tobang khat kamun; sahem chule alim chule amelchihna chule amin Number chu neh jouva, chuchenga kona kihuh dohho chengse chu Pathen selangdah akichoijuva, phatvet tobang twikhanglen panga chu adin jingu kamun ahi."},"3":{"text":"Amaho chun Pathen soh Mosi la chule Kelngoinou la chu asauvin, Vo ijakai, bol thei Pakai Pathen, nangma thilbol hi aloupin akidange; Vo mithengte Lengpa, nangma lampi adih-in akitah-e.","ref":"Pot 15:1"},"4":{"text":"Pakai, koiham nakicha lou dinga? Chule nangma min vahchoi lou dinga koiham? Ajeh chu nangma jengbou atheng nahi; ajeh chu nangma chonphat thilbol kiphon jeh-a hi chitin namtin nangma anga hung kun cheh ding ahi, atiuve.","ref":"Jer 10:7; Labu 86:9."},"5":{"text":"Hiche jou chun, veuvin, van'a hettohsahna houin dan sungnung Mun Theng chu akihon kamun;","ref":"Pot 38:21."},"6":{"text":"chule houin'a kon chun suhgentheina sagi chunga thuneija vantil sagi chu ahung potdoh-un, tonjih ponnem manlutah athena thengin akivonun, sana konggah a-om uvah akikouvin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chuin ganhing liho lah-a khat chun vantil sagiho chu a-imatih chana hing jing Pathen lunghanna dimset sana sumlheng sagi apetan ahi."},"8":{"text":"Hichun Pathen loupinale thunei na-a kon meikhu chu houin sung chu adimset jengtan ahi; chule vantil sagi chun suhgentheina sagi chu abulhit masangseu chun koimacha houin sunga chun alut theipon ahi.","ref":"Pot 40:34; 1 Leng 8:10-11; 2 Thusm 5:13-14; Isai 6:4"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin houin sunga kon chun vantil sagiho jah-a, Nangho cheovinlang Pathen lunghanna sumlheng sagi chu vannoi leiset chungah gabung lha uvin, tia hasaptah-a kisam aw kajan ahi.","title":"Pathen Lunghanna Sumlheng ho"},"2":{"text":"Hichun vantil amasapen chu achen vannoi leiset chunga asumlheng chu abunglhatan ahi; hichun sahem melchihna neile alim houva chibai boh miho tichunga chun anat hoisetah tina achutan ahi.","ref":"Pot 9:10."},"3":{"text":"Chuin vantil anina chun twikhanglen'a asumlheng abunglhan ahile; hichu mithi thisan bangin thisan asohtan ahi; chule ganhing jouse abonchan athigamtan ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin vantil athumna chun luidungle twinahho jouse-a asumlheng abunglhan ahile; hichun hichu thisan asohtan ahi.","ref":"Pot 7:17-21; Labu 78:44."},"5":{"text":"Chuphat chun twi vantil chun hitia asei kajai, Vo Pakai, Nang Auma, Aumsa, chule Thengtah, Dihtah nahi; hicheng jeh-a chu nangman hitia hi thu natan ahitai;"},"6":{"text":"Ajeh chu amaho mithenghole themgaoho thisan anasou ahi; hijeh-a chu nangman jong amahon adon dinguva thisan napeh ahitai; hichu amaho chandia lomtah ahi, ati."},"7":{"text":"Chujou chun maichama kona hitia kisei chomkhat kajan ahi, Ahi, Pakai Pathen, Hat chungnung, nangma thutan vaihom chengse hi akitah-in chule adihsoh keije, ati."},"8":{"text":"Chuin vantil alina chun nisa chunga asumlheng abunglhan ahile; hichun miho chu meija asahgop dingin thuneina apetaovin ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin miho chu asajapjappi chun asanggoptan ahile, hiche suhgentheina sagi chunga thunei Pathen min chu ataitomun, aloupina chu vahchoi dingin alungu aheipouvin ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chuin vantil angana chun sahem laltouna chunga asumlheng abunglhan ahile; hichun agamsung mu athimsohtan; chule amaho chun anat thohlel jeh-un alei apettaovin ahi;","ref":"Pot 10:21."},"11":{"text":"chule anat thohgim ule atina thohlel jeh-u chun van'a Pathen ataitomun, achonnau athilbol uva konin alung aheipouvin ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chuin vantil agupna chun Euphrates luipi-a asumlheng abunglhan ahile; hichun nisona lama kona hung ding lengho dinga lampi gotsa aum theina dingin, chuche luipi dung twi chu akangtan ahi.","ref":"Isai 11:15."},"13":{"text":"Chuphat chun dragon kam sunga konle sahem kam sunga kon chun, chule themgao lhem kam sunga kon chun uphoh tobang lhagao boh thum ahungdoh kamun ahi."},"14":{"text":"Hitiho chu thilhaho lhagao ahiuvin, melchihna kidang dang, vetsah ahiuve; amaho chun imajouse bolthei Hat chungnung Pathen, nikho loupi chungnung ni-a galsat dinga vannoi leiset pumpi-a lengho kikhopsah dinga, amaho henga chu chea ahiuve."},"15":{"text":"Veuvin, keima gucha bangin kahunge. Koi hile kihong jinga sagoh-a auma ajachat kiphon louna dinga aponsil kivetphat jing mi chu anunnom ahi.","ref":"Matt 24:43-44; Luk 12:39-40; Tph 3:3."},"16":{"text":"Chuin amaho chun Hebrai paova Armageddon atiu mun laija chun amaho chu akikhopsah taovin ahi.","ref":"2 Leng 23:29; Zech 12:11."},"17":{"text":"Chuin vantil asagina chun vanlaijola asumlheng abunglhan ahile, hichun van houin'a konle laltouna-a konin, Akichaitai, tin aw sangtah ahung soh-in ahi."},"18":{"text":"Hichun kol aphen, aw agingin, van agingin ahitai, chule vannoi leiset chunga mihem umtilla patna chutobang lingpi kihotkha louhel, hitobangtah chun ling akihottan ahi."},"19":{"text":"Hichun khopi chung nung chu hop thum akisotai, chule chidang namdangte khopi chengse chu achim lhagamtan ahi; chule Pathen lunghan chung nungna lengpiga ju khon chu peh dingin, Babylon khopi chungnung chu Pathen anga geldoh jingin aumtan ahi."},"20":{"text":"Chule twikol gam jouse ajam manggam tan, molle lhangho jong akiholmotan ahi.","ref":"Tph 6:14"},"21":{"text":"Chuin mihemte chunga, van'a konin agih talent khat toh kikot gel len nasatah alhan; hiche gelpi chun asuhgam jeh-u chun mihem ten Pathen ataitom taovin ahi; ijeh ham itile hichu nasa behseh jenga ahi.","ref":"Pot 9:23; Tph 11:19"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujouvin sumlheng sagi choija vantil sagiho lah-a khat chu kahenga ahungin, eikihoupin, kajah-a, Hungin, twi tamtah chunga tou notinu matding talen chu vetsah ingkate;","title":"Noti Minthang Nu","ref":"Jer 51:13."},"2":{"text":"Amanu chutoh leiset lengho ajong taovin, chule ajonthanhoina lengpiga ju-a vannoi leiset chung chengho akham ngolsah soh gamtan ahi.","ref":"Isai 23:7; Jer 51:7"},"3":{"text":"Hiche chun ama chun, Lhagaovin gamthip lama eipuitan ahi. Hichun, Pathen taitomna min dimset, chule alu sagi, aki som nei, sahem santhip chunga tou numei khat kamun ahi.","ref":"Tph 13:1."},"4":{"text":"Hiche numeinu chun pon sanduple ponsanthip asilin, sana, khisong mantam jengle twikohchangin akijemin; chule akhutna chun thil thet umtahle ajonthanhoina bohnen dimset sana khon khat akichoijin ahi;","ref":"Jer 51:7"},"5":{"text":"chule achala chun hiche min hi akisune, THUGIL, BABYLON KHOPI CHUNGNUNG, VANNOI LEISET NOTI HO LE THILTHET UMTAHHO NU."},"6":{"text":"Chule numeinu chu mithengho thisanle Jesu thu hettohsah ho thisana kham ngolin kamun ahi. Amanu chu kamun kidang kasa behseh jengin ahi."},"7":{"text":"Hichun vantil chun kajah-a, Ibola kidang nasah ham? Khuche numeinu le apuilea, alu sagi, aki som nei, sahem thuguh khu seipeh-inge."},"8":{"text":"Sahem namu khu aumsa ahin, umtalou ahi, ama lei-onga kona hung kaltouna manthah na-a che ding ahi. Chule vannoi leiset kisem tila patna hinna lekhabua amin kisun lou, leiset chung chenghon aumsa, tu-a umtalou, khonunga hung umding sahem chu amu tengule, ama chu adatmo lheh dingu ahi.","ref":"Dan 7:7; Tph 11:7; Labu 69:28"},"9":{"text":"Hichea hin chihna lungthim them thu aume. Alu sagi chu mol sagi ahi; hicheng chunga chu hiche numeinu chu touva ahi;"},"10":{"text":"chule hicheng chu leng sagi jong ahiuve; amaho lah-a nga chu alhusa ahitan, khat aumpet ahi, chule khat vang chu um loulai ahi; ama chu um jongle chomcha khatbou umding ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule chuche sahem, aumsa, umtalou chu, amatah chu agetna ahi, chule sagiho loija mi mama khat ahi; ama chu manthah na lama che ding ahi."},"12":{"text":"Chule nangman aki som namu chu leng som ahi; amaho chu tua gam nei loulaiho ahiuve; ahinla nidan kah khat sunga dinga sahem chutoh thakhat tah-a gam vaipohna thu anei khom dingu ahi.","ref":"Dan 7:24."},"13":{"text":"Amaho chu thu khat akisauvin athahat naole athuneinau hiche sahem chu apeuve."},"14":{"text":"Amaho chu Kelngoinou chutoh kisat ding ahiuve; hintin Kelngoinou chun amaho chu ajo ding; ajeh chu ama pakaiho Pakai le lengho Leng ahi, chule aumpiho chengse jong akikoule lhenchom chule tahsantah cheh ahiuve, ati."},"15":{"text":"Chuin ama mama chun kajah-a, Nangman namu twi tamtah notinu touna chu twiho chu mitehole mipi chule namtin vaipi, chule paotin paotangho ahiuve."},"16":{"text":"Chule namu ki som chule sahem chun notinu chu ahot dingu, chule imacha nei louhel le sagohkeova alha dingu, chule meija agovam dingu ahi."},"17":{"text":"Ajeh chu Pathen thu guilhun kahse-a alunggot suhbukimna dinga amaho chu lung khat ahiuve, agam cheh-u sahem chu apehna dinguva, Pathen'in alungu achothou ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule nangman namu numeinu chu, vannoi leiset leng jouse chunga vaipo, khopi chungnung chu ahi, ati."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiche jou chun vantil thuneitah achom khat van'a kona ahung kumlhah kamun; aloupi chun vanle leiset asalvah soh jengin ahi.","title":"Babylon Khopi Chim"},"2":{"text":"Ama chun aw sang chungnung tah-in, Babylon khopi chungnung chu achimtai, achimtai; thilhaho chennale lhagao bohho jouse kihen khomna, chule vacha boh thet umtahho kihenna bom asohtai.","ref":"Isai 13:21; Jer 50:8; 14:8"},"3":{"text":"Ajeh iham itile amanu ajon thanhoija kona lung hanna lengpiga ju-a chu chitin namtin kisep lhu gama ahi; vannoi leiset lengho amanu chutoh ajong thanghoi jun, chule amanu nomsah vala kona vannoi leiset sumkolvei ho haodoh gama ahiuve; tin asamin ahi.","ref":"Isai 23:17; Jer 51:7"},"4":{"text":"Chujou chun van'a kona hitia kisei hi aw achom khat kajan ahi, Vo kamite, nangho amanu chonsetna chu nachan khah louna dingule, amanutoh nakisuh gamtha louna dingun, amanu-a kon chun hungdoh-un.","ref":"Isai 48:20; Jer 50:8; 51:6,45."},"5":{"text":"Ajeh chu amanu chonset van'ah akidong heltan ahi; athemona chengse Pathen'in ageldoh ahitai.","ref":"Semt 18:20-21; Jer 51:9."},"6":{"text":"Amanun napeh bang bangu chun nanghon jong amanu chu lethuh-un; chule ama thilbol dungjui jin ajat ni-a ajat nin phulah-un; achopolna khona chun ajat nin chopol peh-un.","ref":"Labu 137:8; Jer 50:29."},"7":{"text":"Akiloupi sahle akinomsah val bang bangin sugenthei jun, sulunghemun; ajeh iham itile amanun alungthimin, Keima lengnu-a tou kahin, meithai kahipoi; itihchan hijongle lunghem ni mu lou ding kahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Hijeh-a chu thina, lunghem, chule gilkel, hicheng chun asuhgentheina-a amanu chunga ni khat lhuna lhung ding ahi; chule amanu chu meija kigouvam ding ahi; ajeh iham itile amanu chunga thutana Pakai Pathen chu chungnung tah ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chule vannoi leiset lengho, amanu jonpiho chengsele nomsahpi ho chengse chun, amanu kigona meikhu chu amu tengule, amanu chu kacham-untin a-op achup chup jeng dingu ahi;","ref":"Ezek 26:16-17."},"10":{"text":"chule amanu nat thoh gim chu kicha-a gamlatah-a dinga, Ohe! Ohe! Babylon khopi chungnung, khopi dettah, nadanave! Nidan kah khat sungin nachunga thu kitanna alhungmai jengtai, ati dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chule vannoi leiset sumkolvei ho jousen amanu akauvin, alhasetpi lheh jengun ahi; ajeh chu amaho kiveina thil:","ref":"Ezek 27:31,36"},"12":{"text":"sana, dangka, khisong mantam, twikohchang, tonjih pon, ponsandup, lungpon, ponsanthip, thing namtui mantam jouse, chule thing kongle bel jouse, chule thing manlu-a, sum-enga, thihle, songvala kisem kongle bel jouse;","ref":"Ezek 27:12,13,22"},"13":{"text":"thingthal, aisaga, thingnai gimnamtui, kinu ding thao namtui, bego, lengpiga ju, Olive thao, changbong, suhlou chang, bongle kelngoi, sakol, kangtalai, soh, chule mihem hinkho hichengse chu koiman achohpeh tahlou jeh chun."},"14":{"text":"Chule nangaichat nalhangai gaho chengse chu nanga kona chemang gama chule ahoile thilval chengse kisuhmangpeh nahitai; mi koiman hitiho chu itihchan hijongle amu lou ding ahitai."},"15":{"text":"Thil chuchenga amanu haova kona haodoh sumkolvei ho chengsen amanu nat thohgim chu kichan, gamlatah-a adingun amanu chu akachamun alhaset piuvin,","ref":"Ezek 27:31,36"},"16":{"text":"Ohe! Ohe! tonjih ponnemle ponsandup chule ponsanthip kisila, chule sana khisong mantam chule twikohchanga kijem, khopi chungnung nadanave!"},"17":{"text":"Nidan khat sungin nei le gou hijatpi amanghel jengtan ahi, atiuve. Chule kongtol miho jouse, kong'a kitolla muntina vahlehole kong khao lhaleho chule twikhanglen'a kilonho chengse, hiteho chengse chu gamlatah-a adingun,","ref":"Isai 23:14; Ezek 27:26-30"},"18":{"text":"amanu kigona meikhu chu amuvin, Hiche khopi chungnung toh kibang hoija ipi khopi umam, tin asamun ahi.","ref":"Ezek 27:32"},"19":{"text":"Chule amaho chun alu chunguva leivui akithe khumun kapkaple lhasetah-in, Ohe! Ohe! khuche khopi sum hao vanga twikhanglen'a um kong neoho haodohna khopi chungnung chu adanave! Nidan khat sungin amangdel jengtan ahi, tin asamui.","ref":"Ezek 27:30-34"},"20":{"text":"Vo nangho, vanle mithengho chule solchah ho le themgaoho, nangho amanu chungchanga khun kipah thanomun; ajeh chu nangho chunga thu kitan chu Pathen'in amanu chunga thu atan ahitai.","ref":"Danb 32:43; Jer 51:48."},"21":{"text":"Chujouvin vantil hat chungnung tah khatnin sumhei lheh lheh song lentah khat adomin twikhanglen'ah aseplhan, Hiche banga hi Babylon khopi chungnung chu hase-a kiseplha ding ahi; khonungle itihchan hijongle kimu kit talouhel ding ahi.","ref":"Jer 51:63-64; Ezek 26:21."},"22":{"text":"Chule selangdah tumho selangdah tumgin, lathemho lasah, sumkuli mut teho mutgin, chule sumkon mut teho sumkon gin a-imatih chana nalah uva kijata louhel ding ahi; chule khut thema khut them nalah uva kimuta louhel ding ahitai; sumhei gin jong nalah uva kijata lou ding ahi;"},"23":{"text":"a-imatih chana nalah-a meivah kivahta louhel ding ahi, chule nalah-a mounule moulang aw kijadohta louhel ding ahi; hichu nasumkolveiho chu vannoi leiset pipuho milen milal ahiuva, chule nangma doi choija namtin vaipi alamvai jeh ahi."},"24":{"text":"Chule themgaoho le mithengho thisan chule leiset chunga kithat jouse thisan aboncha hiche sunga hi kimudoh ahi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hicheng jou chun van'ah mipi atama tam aw gin lheh lheh nasatah kajan, Halleluijah; huhhingnale loupina chule thahat thuneina Pakai i-Pathen'uva ahi;"},"2":{"text":"ama thutan vaihom akitah jehle adih jeh ahi; ajeh chu ajon thanhoija leiset suchavaija noti lennu chu aman athu atanin, amanu khutna atanin, amanu khutna kon asohte phu chu alatan ahi, atiuve.","ref":"Danb 32:42; 2 Leng 9:7"},"3":{"text":"Chuin avel velin, halleluijah, atiuve. Chule amanu khu chu tonsot geija kitungdoh jing jeng ding ahitai.","ref":"Isai 34:10"},"4":{"text":"Chujou chun upa somni le liho chule ganhing liho chun laltouna-a tou Pathen chu ahouvun, Amen, Halleluijah, atiuvin ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chuin laltouna-a kon chun aw khat ahung sohdoh-in, Vo Pathen sohteho, ama ginga nangho chengse alen aneo nabonchaovin, Pathen chibaijun vahchoijun, ati.","title":"Kelngoinou Moupui Golvah","ref":"Labu 115:10."},"6":{"text":"Chujou chun mipi atama tam aw gin tobangle twi tamtah lon gin tobang, chule van gin tobangin kajan, Halleluijah; I-Pakaiyu Pathen, Hatchung nungin, vai apohtah jeh hin.","ref":"Ezek 1:24; Labu 93:1; 97:1; 99:1"},"7":{"text":"Hungun, kipa thanop boluhitin, aloupina vahchoi uhite; ajeh chu Kelngoinou chu ajineina ding aphat ahitai; aji dingnu chu kigosa dema uma ahitai."},"8":{"text":"Chule aji dingnu chu akijepna ding tonjih ponbang, ngimsel val lailai, kipe-a ahitai; hiche tonjih ponnem chu mithengho chonphatna ahi."},"9":{"text":"Chuin ama chun kajah-a Kelngoinou ji kipuina golvahna-a kikouho chu anunnom ahiuve, tin sunin, eiti. Chuin ama mama chun kajah-a, Hicheng hi Pathen thu dihtah ahi, ati.","ref":"Matt 22:2,3."},"10":{"text":"Hichun keima ama chu hou dingin akho bulah kaboh khuptan ahi. Chuin aman, Chingtheijin, hitobang chu bol hih-in; keima nasoh chanpi chule Jesu thu hettohsah nasopiteho soh chanpi kahibouve; Pathen jengbou nahou ding ahi, ajeh chu Jesu thu hettohsah chu gao thu seidoh lhagao ahi, ati."},"11":{"text":"Chuin keiman van kot kihon kamun ahi; chule, veuvin, achunga toupa chu amin Tahsan umle Dihtah akitin ahi; ama chu chon dihtah-a thutan vaihoma chule galsat ahi.","title":"Sakol Kang Chunga Toupa","ref":"Ezek 1:1; Labu 96:13; Isai 11:4."},"12":{"text":"Ama chu amit meikong ahin, alua lallukhuh tamtah kikhuh ahi, chule amin khat akisunin, amin chu ama tailou koimacha dangin ahepoi.","ref":"Dan 10:6"},"13":{"text":"Chule aponsil chu thisan kithe khuma ahi; chule amin chu Pathen Thu kitia ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule van sepaiho chengse tonjih ponneljet vamleng le ngimsel akisilun, sakol kang chunga anung ajuijun ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chuin namtin vaipi asatna dingin akam sunga konin chemjam hemtah khat ahungdohtan ahi; ama chun achunguva thih tenggola vai apoh ding ahi; chule Hat chungnung, Pathen lunghanna kichat umtah lengpiga hehna-a jong chu aman achilji ahi.","ref":"Labu 2:9; Isai 63:3; Joel 3:13; Tph 14:20"},"16":{"text":"Chule aponsil chungle amalbuh laija, LENGHO LENGLE PAKAI HO PAKAI, tia min kisun khat aume."},"17":{"text":"Chuin keiman nisa chunga dinga vantil khat kamun; chule ama chun vanlaijola lengle-a vachate jouse jah-a,","ref":"Ezek 39:17-20."},"18":{"text":"Hungun, nanghon lengho sa, sepai lamkaiho sa, ahat apaoho sa, sakolhole achunga touho sa, chamlenle soh ho sa, aneole alenho jouse sa, nedingin Pathen golvahna chungnungah hung kikhomun, tin asamin ahi."},"19":{"text":"Chuin sakol chunga toupale asepaiho chutoh kisat dingin, sahem chule leiset lengho chule asepaite chengseutoh akikhomun kamui."},"20":{"text":"Chuin sahem chu amantaovin; chule themgao lhem, amitmua melchihna kidang dang bola sahem melchihna kilahhole alim chibai bohho lhemlha-a sulamvaija chutoh amattha taovin ahi; chuin kath meika al-lenglung jing jeng mei dilah ahingin alehlut taovin ahi.","ref":"Tph 13:1-18"},"21":{"text":"Chule adang amoh chengse chu sakol chunga toupa kam sunga kona hung potdoh chemjam chun athat gamtan ahi; chuin vachate jouse ahungun asao chu ahung neuvin avaset taovin ahi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin lei-ong hehnale thihkhao khat choija vantil khat van'a kona ahung kumlhah kamun ahi.","title":"Kum Sang Lenggem"},"2":{"text":"Chuin ama chun dragon, gul lui chu, hichu Diabol le Satan ahin, amanin, chuin akanin kum sangkhat geija dingin lei-onga chun asep luttan ahi;","ref":"Semt 3:1"},"3":{"text":"chule chuche kum sangkhat chu alhin kahse-a, namtin mite alheplhah thei louna dingin akhachah khumin, asinkhana anam khumtan ahi; chujoule chomkhat dinga kilhadoh ding ahi."},"4":{"text":"Chuin keiman laltouna phabep khat kamun; achunga touho chu thutan vaihom apedoh-un ahi; chule Jesu thu hettohsah jalle Pathen thu jala alu kitanho, chule sahem chule alim chibai boh lou, achal le akhutnuva melchihna kilah-a kichin lou amaho chengse lhagao hing chu kamun ahi; amaho chu ahinga ahitaove, chule kum sangkhat Christa toh vai apo khomui;","ref":"Dan 7:9-22."},"5":{"text":"hiche kum sangkhat chu alhin masangse-a chu mithiho amoh chengse chu hingdoh lou ahiuve, hichu thokit masa ahi."},"6":{"text":"Koi hile hiche thokit masa changkha chu minunnomle atheng ahi; amaho chunga chu thi nina chun thu aneilou ahitai; ahin amaho chu Pathen le Christa thempu hiuva amatoh kum sangkhat vai apoh dingu ahi."},"7":{"text":"Chule kum sangkhat chu alhin tengle, Satan chu akihena-a kona kilhadoh-a,","title":"Satan Gallel"},"8":{"text":"vannoi leiset ning li-a cheng namtin, vaipi, twikhanglen'a neldi jat, Gog le Magog chu, doha lhemlha-a galsat dinga, kikhopsah dinga hungdoh ding ahi.","ref":"Ezek 7:2; 38:2,9,15"},"9":{"text":"Chuin amaho chu leivai khahtanin aleilimin akonun mithengho ngahphol le khopi deitah chu aum kimvel taove; hichun van'a Pathen na konin mei ahung lhan amaho chu akavam gamtan ahi."},"10":{"text":"Chule amaho lhemlha-a diabol chu meile kath meika dil sunga chun asep lut taove; hiche koma chun sahem chule themgao lhem jong chu aumui; chule amaho cheng chun tonsot tonsot geija asun ajana thohgim nasatah athoh jing dingu ahi."},"11":{"text":"Chuin laltouna len chungnung abana bang khatle achunga toupa chu kamun; ama angsunga kon chun vannoi leisetle van ajam mangtan ahi; hiteni ding chun mun akimutapon ahi.","title":"Thupi Kitan Achaina","ref":"Dan 7:9-10."},"12":{"text":"Pathen anga chun mithiho jouse alen aneo adin kamun; chujouvin lekhabu phabep khat aphongui; chuin hinna lekhabu atiuvin achom khat jong aphongun ahi; chuin chuche lekhabua kisun dungjui chun mithiho chu ama ama thilbol dungjui cheh-in athu atantaovin ahi."},"13":{"text":"Chuphat chun twikhanglen'in ama-a um mithiho jouse chu ahinleh doh-in; chule thinale damunin jong amithiho chengse ahinlehdoh sohkeitaove; chuin athilbol dungjui cheh-in athu atan taovin ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chuin thinale damun chu mei dil sunga chun aleh lut taove, hiche chu, thi nina ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule hinna lekhabu sunga amin kiholdoh louse chu mei dil sunga chun aleh lut taove. Hiche chu, thi nina ahi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chujou chun keiman van thah lei thah kamun ahi; ajeh chu van masale lei masa chu kitol manga ahitai; twikhanglen jong aumtapoi.","title":"Van Thahle Lei Thah","ref":"Isai 65:17; 66:22; 2 Pet 3:13."},"2":{"text":"Chule a-inneipu henga dinga kijema kigosadem mounu banga khopi theng, Jerusalem thah chu, Pathen kom van'a kona ahung kumlhah keima John nin kamun ahi.","ref":"Isai 52:1; 61:10; Tph 3:12"},"3":{"text":"Chuin keiman van'a kon chun, aw sangtah-a thu kisei kajan, Veuvin, Pathen chenna chu mihem lah ahung hitai, chule ama amahotoh cheng khom ding; amaho chu ama mite hi ding ahiuve; chule Pathen amatah mongin aumpi dingu, chule a-Pathen'u hi ding ahi;","ref":"Ezek 37:27; Thmpu 26:11,12"},"4":{"text":"chule amit uva amitlhi chengseu atheh ngim ding; chule thina umta louhel ding; chule lhasetnale kana chule nat thohgim umtalou ahi; thil masaho chengse chu kitol mangsoh ahitai, ati.","ref":"Isai 25:8; 35:10; 65:19"},"5":{"text":"Chuin laltouna-a toupa chun, Veuvin, keiman ijakai kathahsem sohkeije, ati. Chuin ama chun, kajah-a, sunnin; ajeh chu hicheng hi tahsan umle thutah ahi, ati."},"6":{"text":"Chuin ama chun kajah-a, Hichengse chu kichaija ahitai! Keima Alpha leh Omega, akipatna leh akichaina kahi. Adangchah-a chu hinna twinah-a twi chu manbeijin penge.","ref":"Isai 55:1"},"7":{"text":"Ajou chanin hicheng hi alo ding ahi; keima a-pathen hingting, ama kachapa hi ding ahi.","ref":"2 Sam 7:14; Labu 89:26-27"},"8":{"text":"Ahin mi kichaseho, tahsan neilouho, thet umho, tolthat teho, jon panho, doi choiho, milim houho, chule mijouho jouse meile kath meika al-lenglung jing jeng mei dila chu achan dingdol cheh chang ding ahiuve; hiche thi nina ahi, ati."},"9":{"text":"Chuin suhgamna nukhah dimset sumlheng sagi nei vantil sagiho lah-a khat chu kahenga ahungin, kajah-a thu aseijin, Hilama hin hungin; keiman nangma Kelngoinou inneipi ding mou chu vetsah inge, ati.","title":"Jerusalem Thah"},"10":{"text":"Chuin ama chun keima Lhagaovin molsang lentah chungah eilhoh touvin, Pathen kom van'a kona hung kumlha-a, Pathen loupina nei khopi len, Jerusalem theng chu, eimusahtan ahi.","ref":"Ezek 40:2"},"11":{"text":"Avahje dan chu khisong man tamtah abangin, jasper song lheh lheh ahin, songval valin avalin;"},"12":{"text":"akul chu lentah chule sangtah ahin, akot somleni ahi; kot somle ni-a chun vantil somleni aumin; chule min phabep khat chua chun akisunin; hichu Israel chate phung somle phung ni min ahi.","ref":"Ezek 48:30-35"},"13":{"text":"Akot chu thumin niso lam angan, thumin sah lam angan, thumin lhang lam angan chule thumin nilhum lam angan ahi."},"14":{"text":"Chule khopi kul chu akhombul somleni ahin; hicheho chunga chu Kelngoinou solchah somleni ho min chu kisuna ahi."},"15":{"text":"Chule khopi chule akotle akul chu tena dingin, kajah-a thuseipa chun gamtena sana tenglhon achoijin ahi.","ref":"Ezek 40:3"},"16":{"text":"Khopi chu aning li kitoh, adung avai kibang ahin ahi. Chuin gamtena tenglhona khopi chu atele, mail sang khatle mail ja nga ahi; adung, avai, atun kibang sohkei ahi."},"17":{"text":"Chujouvin kul chu aten ahile, tong ja khatle tong som lile li ahi; vantil thiltena chu, mihem thil tena jong ahi."},"18":{"text":"Chule kul kiget chu jaspi songa kigen ahi, chule khopi chu phatvet thengtah tobang sana thenga kisa-a ahi.","ref":"Isai 54:11-12"},"19":{"text":"Khopi khombul song chu khisong mantam jat chom jat choma kijema ahi. Khombul masapen chu jasper khisonga kijem ahin, abana chu sapphir khisong ahin, athumna Chalcedon khisong ahin, alina emerald khisong ahin;"},"20":{"text":"Angana sardonyx khisong ahin, agupna sardius khisong ahin, asagina chu chrysol khisong ahin, agetna beryl khisong ahin, akona chu topaz khisong ahin, asomna chu chrysopras khisong ahin, somlekhatna jacinth khisong ahin, somle nina chu amythyst khisong ahi."},"21":{"text":"Akot somleni chu twikohchang khat khatna kisem ahi. Chule akho sung lamlen chu phatvet thengsel tobang sana theng ahi."},"22":{"text":"Chule asunga chun houin kamupoi; Pakai Pathen Hat chungnung chule Kelngoinou chu a-houin ahi jeng jeh chun."},"23":{"text":"Chule khopi chun asalvah dinga nisa jong ngaita lou, lhathah jong ngaita lou ahi; ajeh chu Pathen loupi chun avahsah jeng ahin, chule Kelngoinou chu ameivah hi jenga ahi.","ref":"Isai 60:19-20"},"24":{"text":"Chule huhhingsa namtin vaipi avah-a chu vahle ding, chule leiset lenghon aloupinao asunga chu ahinpoh lut dingu ahi.","ref":"Isai 60:3"},"25":{"text":"Chule akotkhahho chu a-imatih chana suna kikhah lou ding ahi (chua jan umtalou ding ahi jeh chun);","ref":"Isai 60:11"},"26":{"text":"chule namtin vaipin loupinale jabolna asunga chu apoh lut dingu ahi."},"27":{"text":"Chule iti nama jongle thil aboh pou poule thet um thil bola chule jou pana lut louhel ahi: Kelngoinou hinna lekhabua amin kisunho chengsebou chu lut ding ahi.","ref":"Isai 52:1; Ezek 44:9"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Chuin ama chun Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna-a kona put hintwi theng luidung crystal songvala val, khosung lamlen lailunga chu eivetsah tan ahi.","ref":"Ezek 47:1; Zech 14:8."},"2":{"text":"Chule luidung chu apang langto-a hinthing keh ahin aga jat chom chom somleni ga-a, alha seh-a ga jing jeng ahi; chule thingnaho chu namtin vaipi boldamna ahi.","ref":"Semt 2:9; Ezek 47:12"},"3":{"text":"Chule sapset umta louhel ding ahi. Chule Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna chu asunga chu umding ahin, chule asohten ama chu ajen dingu;","ref":"Zech 14:11"},"4":{"text":"Chule amahon amai amu dingu, chule achaluva amin umding ahi."},"5":{"text":"Chule jan umta louhel ding ahi; chule amahon thaomei vahle nisa vah ngaita louhel ahiuve; Pakai Pathen'in amaho asalvah ding ahi jeh chun; chule amaho chun atonsot atonsot geija vai apoh dingu ahi.","ref":"Isai 60:9; Dan 12:10"},"6":{"text":"Chuin aman kajah-a, Thu hicheng hi tahsan umle dihtah ahi; chomkhat joule hung soh ding hichengse chu themgao thengho Pakai Pathen'in asohte vetsah dinga avantil asol ahi.","title":"Jesu Hungding"},"7":{"text":"Chule, ven, kahungvah ding ahi; hiche lekhabua lhagao thuseidoh ho chengse nitpa chu anunnom ahi, ati."},"8":{"text":"Kei John tah-in hichengse hi kajah chule kamu ahi. Kajah-a chule kamu phat chun hichengsepi eivetsahpa vantil anga chun, ama chu chibai boh dingin kaboh khuptan ahi."},"9":{"text":"Hichun aman kajah-a, Chingtheijin, hitobang chu bol hih-in, keima nangma soh chanpile nasopi themgaoho sohchanpi chule hiche lekhabua thu nit teho sohchanpi kahibouve; Pathen joh chibai bohtan, ati."},"10":{"text":"Chuin aman kajah-a, hiche lekhabua lhagao thu kiseidohho hi imchah hihhelin; phat anaitah jeh hin."},"11":{"text":"Achonpha lou chun chonphat lou bol jinghen; aboh chu boh jinghen; chule achonpha chun chonphat bol jinghen; athenga chu athengin umjing hen.","ref":"Dan 12:10"},"12":{"text":"Veuvin, keima kahungvah ding ahi; chule athilbol achonna dungjui cheh-a lethuhna kapeh ding tohman kakoma aume.","ref":"Isai 40:10; 62:11; Labu 28:4; Jer 17:10."},"13":{"text":"Keima Alphale Omega kahin, amasale anukhah kahi, chule abul leh aleh kahi.","ref":"Tph 1:8,17; 2:8; Isai 44:6; 48:12"},"14":{"text":"Hinthing chu lo theina dingle kotpi-a lutna khopi sunga lut theina dinga, athupeh nit ho chu anunnom ahiuve.","ref":"Semt 2:9; 3:22."},"15":{"text":"Uicha hole doi choiho, chule jon thanhoi panhole tolthat teho, chule milim houho, chule thujou sei ngailu-a semdoh ho pamah aumui."},"16":{"text":"Kei, Jesu'n, houbung ho-a dinga hicheng thuhi nangho hettohsah dinga kavantil kahinsol ahi. Keima David jungpile achilhah, Jing Valpa vahtah chu kahi.","ref":"Isai 11:1,10."},"17":{"text":"Lhagao le mouvin, Hungin, ati lhone; ajachanin, hungin, tihen; chule adangchah chan hunghen; ago chanin manbeijin hintwi chu kilahhen.","ref":"Isai 55:1."},"18":{"text":"Hiche lekhabua lhagao thuseidoh hi ajachan kahet tohsah-a kaseipeh ahi, Koi hile hicheng hi abelap aumle, Pathen'in hiche lekhabua kisun suhgam naho chengse hi achunga abelap ding ahi.","title":"Thuchai Khumkhana","ref":"Danb 4:2; 12:32."},"19":{"text":"Chule koi hile lhagao thuseidoh hiche lekhabua thuho lamanga aumle, Pathen'in hiche hinna lekhabua kisun hinthinga konle khopi thenga kona chule hiche lekhabu sunga kisun thilho-a kona hi achan alahmang ding ahi."},"20":{"text":"Hicheng thu hettohsah chun, Ahi, kahungvah ding ahi, ati. Amen, hitichun Pakai Jesu, hungin."},"21":{"text":"I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungset nachun, mithengte nabon chaovin umpiuvin, Amen."}}}}}}}
